I understand for bigger orders it makes sense to have a system in place, but it took us 10 minutes to get a slice of cake that should've taken all of 30 seconds. The cake was fine, nothing to write home about. I'd give it a 3/5. I wouldn't say it was much better than anything you could pick up at the grocery store, especially not for $9. The bake shop was clean and the employees were very friendly. Just be prepared to wait, even for a simple order.

I used to watch Cake Boss pretty casually, so it was exiting to get to visit one of his locations. Inside the Venetian, you'll find Carlo's Bakery, and you'll know when you've found it because there will be a line out the door! But don't let that scare you - Although the line looked long, they get through everyone quickly and we probably didn't even wait more than 15 minutes. While you're in line, there's a huge window where you can watch the pastry chefs create desserts, it definitely helped kill the time! There are so many different options to choose from, and I just wanted something small so I tried one of the cannolis... It was fantastic! Also pretty huge for just one! The staff here are very friendly and efficient, too. Even though it might seem like a tourist trap, it's still a fun place to visit if you've watched the show.

I was very excited to go to Carlos Bakery on my trip to Vegas. I love going to pastry shops when I travel and bring home some goodies as souvenirs. Pastries: Generally, the pastries are pretty good and they have a lot of filling!!! *Cannoli - Pretty dam good *Eclair - So much filling. Yum! *Lobster tails - There were four flavors and I got the hazelnut and one other. *Cheesecake - I didn't try this but my friend said it was average. Cons: - There are no price tags. Don't over order! I ordered six items for a little over $40... - Out of the six items, I was missing one cannoli!! When I opened the box after I got back to my hotel room, there was one missing! - The service wasn't that great. Basically someone on an iPad will follow you around and you tell them what you want and they put it in their iPad. I asked what a couple of items were and the girl seemed so annoyed. Honestly, she was helping me for less than one minute and she seemed like she hated her job. I want to give them more stars because the pastries were pretty good but the service was not great and they forgot an item! If I'm being charged over $5 a pastry and is missing one, I don't know if I want to come back. Vegas has many other bakeries you can go to...

I was looking forward to trying this bakery for a very long time! The sweets created by Buddy and his crew on their television show have always made my mouth water. What I found out here was that these two items cost $22+ and were just as flavorful as ones I could have grabbed at Whole Foods or the grocery store. They were decent but not $22 worthy.

Came here during the weekend and there was quite a few people in line. The line went fairly quick. I had high expectations for this placing watching the show. I was pleasantly surprised how delicious the cakes were. I was expecting it to be overly sweet but it was just right. I tried the canolis but it wasn't my cup of tea.

What could be better than scrumptious pastries inspired by Buddy?!? Not much that I can think of. Carlo's has all the amazing treats featured on his show and they all taste incredible. The bakery is small and a shell of his real bakery in Jersey, but it gets the point across. Every time I go I am greeted immediately by a friendly bakery employee and order whatever I want from the case. They are very knowledgeable and helpful in assisting you with your sugar cravings. It is definitely expensive, but it's expected. Once you order you pay and wait for them to beautifully package it all up. You can get anything from cakes and cookies to lobster tails and cannolis and if you want a souvenir to last you can even buy memorabilia. I haven't had anything that I didn't enjoy, though my favorites are the butter cookies, linzer cookies, pecan shortbread covered in chocolate, and the almond coconut cookies with chocolate on top. Do yourself a favor, go to Carlo's and indulge in some sweat treats...you're in Vegas after all!!!

I was excited after seeing the show to try the baked goods. I ordered a cannoli and they were just filling them so it was tasty creamy and crunchy. Ordered also the red velvet cake, dont bother, was dry and flavorless . Might be back but not for cake. Do better cake boss.
Got the 5 pack of cannolis. And man can I say they were sweet. Definitely could only eat one. But they were delicious. Fast service and decently priced.

If you're like me and can't easily get to Hoboken, New Jersey for Buddy's original bakery, at the very least you must try his location in Las Vegas! You feel like a kid in a candy shop. Displays filled with all the sweet cakes, rolls & cookies you can imagine. Get at least 5 lobster tails because you're going to want at least 2 for now, 2 for later and 1 to share (if you're into that, otherwise it's all you)! There's no actual lobster in this pastry, the name comes from the lobster-tail shape. Paper-thin layers of dough with a satisfying crunch filled with gobs of sweet cream, topped with chocolatey hazelnut drizzle. Enjoy!

Every time I come to Vegas I always stop by Carlo's Bakery I love their brownies. I stopped in around Christmas time and unfortunately I didn't see any brownies in the case. When it was my turn to order I asked about them. The lady said they didn't have any, but then a baker showed up with some goodies to put in the case and overheard us. She said they had some in the back that just needed to be frosted and offered to frost them if I was willing to wait She literally made my day I love those things. I also tried this time one of their lobster tails and it was great - my husband even liked that and he is not a fan of sweets.

The worker was nice but the baked goods were horrible honestly. Not at all tasty my friend is a baker and was dying to get to this place, broke her little heart. We're order a few different things because she wanted to taste them all and um yeah we didn't like it.

My friends daughter wanted a rainbow cake and came across Carlos Bakery with so many pics that showcased alot of that. So she ordered one from here. We were celebrating both our kids bday thats a day apart and figured for both to have similar cakes yet different and ordered from here as well. Although $50 for a small simple 6 inch bday cake was the most I ever paid for, for what you get, i figured coming from Venetian and a celebrity chef which i was told couldn't go wrong but boy was I wrong! Looks cute and pretty for the kids but thats all there is to it. The cake was no different than what I would get at a supermarket or costco, so to speak but for 3x the cost!! Its as if i could have slapped a bunch of sprinkles on it myself and add a celebrity name to it and charge others triple! Bottom line: it was dense, WAY overly sweet and dry. Last thing we need is our kids any more hyper than they already are and many trips to the dentist which will add to that cost of this cake. Quite disappointed coming from a celebrity chef named behind it. Perhaps he needs to find another sous chef or another bakery to represent as this does not look good. On the defense, perhaps its just the cake and other treats they have are better but with this costly experience that was not even close to edible, it makes us hesitate to try other things. Let say for 2 small 6in cakes....we have half the cake of each leftover and the slice we each had on our plates were half eaten was how bad it was for our whole party. No one, not one person enjoyed it. Actually, even a 4 year old didn't even care for it saying it was not soft and moist enough which is bad. So I am surprised at the crazy long line other reviewers have stated as it is over rated and overly priced for what you get. Sorry but not sorry. Thank you but no thank you.

This is my third visit to Carlos Bakery, once to his Hoboken location and twice here. First time I went in Jersey, I was really impressed with the food. But this time in Vegas, not so much. The cannoli's were not that great, compared to previous time's I've eaten them. And the red velvet cake? I had to throw it away. I've had the red velvet cupcakes in Jersey and they were fantastic! But this slice of cake I got in Vegas was just not edible at all. I did enjoy the black/white cookie, so there's that. I don't think I'll be going back to the Vegas location again. But, if I'm back in Jersey anytime soon, I'll have to make a stop at the original location.

Service was excellent, carrot cake was very average. Dry, kind of flavorless. Had a piece of pumpkin pie too. Was ok, underwhelmed with both. The problem is that food in Vegas is AMAZING. So it's a bummer when something is just average. I would call these items that we tried, average
Everything was good. We order the lobster tail, cannoli, and a dark chocolate mousse. We had one lobster tail the looked weird but it tasted fine.

Went here with a couple of friends for some early morning treats. Giving them three stars for their service as the bakery items were a little lackluster and just did not live up to the hype. Got an oatmeal cookie and it was just okay--nothing super special.

When we entered the grand canal shoppes, this was the first stop that we went to. This bakery had so many pastries to choose from. We ended up just trying out two pastries. My co-worker told me about how the cannoli were good so we decided to get one. I don't remember the name of the other pastry that we got. The cannoli tasted too sweet because of the filing inside. The other pastry had a good amount of sweetness to it. We also got a small pack of cookies and they also tasted too sweet too. Besides pastries, you can also get some merchandise as well such as t-shirts, hoodies, mugs and DVD's.

I'm a big fan of the show so we were excited to try this place since we are guests here in the hotel For the weekend but we found this in our rainbow fudge cake slice. Very disappointed & disgusted. The counter clerk was not friendly at all seemed bothered when we asked a question. I probably will not make a purchase again from any of their locations but still a fan of show & buddy of course.

Upon arrival you can see into the bake shop from a window. It's pretty awesome when a bakery lets you view what goes down! We didn't want to order a whole lot because we were just about to get lunch. We got a chocolate dipped strawberry(so juicy and the chocolate didn't crumble!) and a fondant sugar cookie(perfect amount of fondant) next time I'm going to get a lobster tail for sure! Pros: -lots of variety of cookies, lobster tails, donuts, pastries -Taste was on point -Easy to get in and out -You can watch the bakers -Cakes are on display Cons: -The people working there seemed confused, we stood there waiting for a few minutes before someone finally asked to help us -People seemed to not understand where the line formed. We kept getting cut off and crowded

Cake Boss!!! It is exactly like the mini version of the OG Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken. They are usually packed but I came on a weekday morning and it was empty. Located on the second floor at the Venetian. Easiest way to find it is if walk outside by the Tao entrance and walk along the pathway toward Palazzo. You will see the entrance to the inside. They have a ton of Italian bakery items. Prices are on the higher side because of their popularity. Cannoli - $3.95 - Creamy sweet ricotta filling with a crispy shell. Lobster Tail - $5.50 - I loved the crispy shell. They have different topping variations. Cream Puff - $2.95 - Crap, tasted like an frozen one you can buy in the market. Butter Crumb Danish - $4.95 - Like a flat sticky bun. Was so so. Decent desserts, but it is more for show. Price and taste do not level up to each other.

Carlos's Bakery has a beautiful display of bakery items. The line was long and the service was tepid. It appears as though the location provides enough of a tourist base for steady customers and they do not have to put a lot of effort into building on return visitors. I ordered a cannoli and three cookies. My purchases were pretty but basic and flat tasting. They did not offer a "wow factor."

Selection is super limited to a handful of items, but do yourself a favor a grab a million of the lobster tails yummy goodness--HELLO!!! The whole time I'm eating those darn little things I kept saying, "this is interesting," which is a compliment to the baker! I love creamy desserts--add whipped cream, French cream, mascarpone and I instantly fall in love but man, these little lobster tails had me crunching away! Is it a philo dough over a croissant??? You bite into these little heavenly jewels, and you get this flaky crunch, then soft crescent, then light French cream. I mean who knew something so simple could just make you want to dance a happy dance???? if y'all know me, you know I can't order one thing in a bakery, so we added cheesecake, every flavor lobster tail, and a strawberry shortcake slice. Cheesecake was super awesome amazing. I don't like cheesecake ordinarily, but they were so pretty and petit, I had to try!!! It's a bold bakery that offers mini cheesecakes with no crust and a simple strawberry on top--hot damn it was good!!! Although I enjoyed the strawberry shortcake--I prefer a chiffon cake (from Candlelight Bakery) over a sponge. The lightness of the cream and tartness of fresh strawberries just always seem to go better with the airiness of a chiffon...all in all, the star of this visit were the lobster tails!! going back today before we leave Vegas to grab a box!!!

My daughter and I were big fans of 'Cake Boss' and were excited to try this Las Vegas iteration. Buried deep within the Venetian it wasn't easy to find, but thanks to some kind hotel staff along the way we were finally able to locate the bakery across from Buddy V's namesake restaurant. The Good: - Friendly and knowledgable staff - Gorgeous-looking cakes and pastries - Good coffee. Had an iced black Americano that was spot-on The Not So Good: - No place to sit inside the bakery - Pricey! $32.00 for four pastries and a small coffee - Quality was lacking. All four pastries 'looked' legit but were all very dry. My daughter loves cupcakes and her peanut butter cupcake in particular was undersized and as dry as the Sahara. We've had supermarket cupcakes that were far superior. I had the coffee cake and though it tasted okay, again the cake itself was so dry and hard that we snapped the plastic knife trying to cut it into shareable pieces. I wish we could recommend this place, but unfortunately at these prices and at this level of quality, 'Carlo's Bakery Las Vegas' gets a hard pass from us.

I'm a huge fan of the Cake Boss and when I found out I could visit his bakery while in Vegas, I knew I needed to! The location is inside the grand canal shoppes inside the Venetian. There are plenty of signs to help direct you. When I arrived, there wasn't a line and I was able to put in my order right away. I ordered an Oreo lobster tail, a fondant cookie and a chocolate cannoli. The girl took my order and then asked me to wait for a bit while they packaged it. My name was called, I paid and I was on my way. Super quick service! Let me tell you...the lobster tail was delicious! The pastry was crunchy, flaky and the filling was so creamy, light and fluffy! It was pure perfection. And the cannoli was the best I've had. The filling was so tasty and paired well with the cannoli shell. The ricotta filling had just the right flavor of cinnamon and a few chocolate chips inside was just right. I have no way to describe them other than by saying they were decedent. I think that's it. Even the cookie was soft, flaky and the fondant was smooth as silk. Wowza! I'm so glad I was able to visit and try a few sweet treats.
Ordered carrot cake tasted like a box cake you get off the shelf at the supermarket really bad you could tell it had been sitting around for a while. Very dissatisfied.
Cannoli was average. Not what we are used to from Arthur Avenue in The Bronx. However the sfogliatella pastry was absolutely perfect. Staff was very nice and helpful!
We went with the chocolate cake from the machine at Rio, and it was pretty darned good! Large piece, plenty to share! Give it a try.

This review is based on presentation only as we didn't buy here today. This is The Valastro's bakery in the Venetian Palazzo - across the hall from their Buddy V's restaurant. This is a cute bakery split into 2 sections. One for preparation and one for baked goods sales. We passed on buying as we planned to eat dinner Buddy V's later and order dessert there (which we did and OMG - the Italian Birthday Cake!). This all said, if your looking for a sweet baked item, try this place.

very expensive. i got like 4 things it was $30. wtf. and they want a tip. everything looks and tastes soo yummy. i got a cannoli, lobster claw, cannoli cheesecake, rainbow cookie. i wish the hotels would have actual mini fridges we could use to buy items. these celebrity restaurants are all the rage everywhere in vegas

I've been to this bakery a couple of times. The location is what keeps me from frequenting it more; it's not convenient for me. The selection is great. Everything we've ever tried was very very good. The prices are okay. I really enjoy viewing the small kitchen area when someone is in there preparing desserts. There is typically a line and luckily the few times we've been there it wasn't too much of a wait. Staff have been friendly and efficient. The canollis were completely filled; no hidden gap in the middle! Not too rich so it was easy to eat a whole one and not share; mine! I've tried the famous 'lobster tail' which was good. Overall, the store decor and goods are above par, but the location means I rarely get here.

Bought a rainbow cake for my daughter. She loves watching the Cake Boss. It was super sweet with very little other flavor. It costs around $10. I don't think there are too many kids don't like super sweet cakes. Three stars because she enjoyed it.
For those who ever watched Cake Boss on TLC or other channels but never made it up to Hoboken NJ to try it out. This place is great. Same great treats with a little Vegas price.

This place was unbelievable, not in a good way. Customer service was very poor, they had a legitimate complaint and did nothing about it instead they pointed out that all sales are final on a recipe they did not give us. We ordered a cheesecake strawberry preserve and it was old and the strawberry on top was rotted. It looked like it was a week old, the preserves on top were very stiff and crusty on the edges! Clearly had been in the case for a while.

I ordered several baked goodies from the famous Carlos Bakery through Goldbelly. My initial experience was Carlos Bakery Las Vegas and it was everything my carb loving heart desired. The Frozen Goldbelly rainbow cake, lobster tails and cannolis were all delivered in pristine condition. After careful following of instructions- the cake was as expected- soft, sweet and perfect. I have ordered both the individual slices and the whole cake- both are absolutely worth it. The Cannolis as well were magical. I don't know what they're doing to these but they are amazing. Crispy and creamy all at the same time. I ate several and still wanted more. Now the Lobster tail I would recommend having at the bakery. They are an experience and need to be eaten fresh. They were much smaller and not the foodgasmic experience I had at the bakery in Vegas. Overall, it is a lot of hype and depending on what you like and what is fresh (bakery vs Goldbelly) it can be said there is something carbtastic for everyone.
My cheesecake had a giant curly hair in it and so did my replacement cheesecake. I also ordered a danish that had hair in it. Pastries were good but clear health issues. Would avoid.

The prices were quite steep for this kind of place. We got: cherry cheesecake, strawberry cheesecake, lobster tail, chocolate moose and some sort of strawberry eclair. The cherry was good minus we had a pit in one of the cherries... everything was pretty good but we must be super spoiled with Oakmont Bakery in Pittsburgh, PA because nothing compares to it. Still, all in all, a good bakery but definitely not our favorite!
Great stuff coming from someone who prefers savory to sweet...I have stopped here on all 3 times I have been here and I will stop here next time again.
We got the dulce de leche lobster tail. It did not disappoint. Tons of filling and great flavor. We tried a chocolate dipped cannoli which added a new dimension to the cannoli experience.

This little bakery had a lot of options from cake slices, cupcakes, cookies, cookie sandwiches, and unique authentic pastries. The place is bright and clean and the staff was friendly. Unfortunately, everything we sampled (two cookies and a cupcake) were lacking in flavor and were just lack luster. Because it's Vegas, we spent much more on these items than we would back home, and that was salt in the wound. There has got to be better dessert/pastry shops in Vegas!

3 stars is 3 stars is 3 stars. That's the review average and that is what it is to me also.. Way overhyped for sure. Everybody has to try the cake boss' bakery. Long lines, expensive, and they are exploiting it. Things have changed since they opened and now all cookies taste like shortbread, they sell by the pound, and they're priced differently...It amounts to a confusing bill for sure... Everything looks great in the glass cases but you will experience some sticker shock. Cakes and various baked goods we tried were good but nothing that makes you say "wow". The cannoli they make is very good. Still not worth it really. The cookies all taste the same to me. Nowhere to sit and you just take your order to go. I would bet this place makes 5K a day easy. Wow... I'm doing something wrong.

I could embarrass myself silly in this place. Yeah I'm a fan of bakeries and patisseries. I'm a home baker and love all things chocolate (dark is the best...milk chocolate doesn't count. Boring.) and any dessert that has cream cheese as an ingredient. My friend and I picked three items to share and they were amazing. No complaints. None. The lobster tail was my favorite. I thought it would be the chocolate mousse filled cake or the cannoli. Nope, nothing could hold a candle to that lobster tail.

This is my first time to visit this Bakeshop bcoz one of my girlfriends raved about this place. Well, as a family who is always on the lookout for " good pastries" this place is very disappointing. First, it's overpriced ( it's Vegas, duh) . We ordered the cannoli,-- taste is bland, nothing special & the cream even tasted " grainy"! We also ordered 3 different flavored croissants & I really think we were ripped off. We left it overnight for the next morning & the croissants became really hard to eat. Lastly, we also bought the apple crumble pie & tasted like we bought it from Vons/ Ralph's ! We Won't come back, not worth the money at all. But the staff is really nice-- that's for the star I gave.

WOOOOOOOOW! Is all I can say after having the Hazelnut cream puff. I thought I would never say this, but forget the cannoli and go straight for the cream puffs (hazelnut to be precise!) I died and went to heaven when I entered Carlo's Bakery at the Venetian. I was a fan of Cake Boss on tv, so visiting here during my trip to Vegas was a MUST! It's REALLY hard to find once you're inside the Venetian. I had to ask ten people. It's literally right next to the walgreens, so if there is an entrance near there or through Walgreens, take that route! Don't be like me and run around the Venetian like a chicken with its head cut off! One thing that I am sad about, they forgot to put the red tote bag I purchased in my order! I only realized after I got home... oh well!

Carlos's Bakery in Vegas? When did this happen? Good to know I can visit the Cake Boss in Vegas rather than fly to the East coast. Located in the Gand Canal Shops, you can taste the various pastries and cupcakes Buddy has to offer. I got the lobster tail, which reminded me of a denser and thicker croissant filled with vanilla cream. It was a mess eating it with all the flakes and powdered sugar. Be sure to grab extra napkins. I'm not too sure what I was expecting but it tasted "okay". It wouldn't be something I would order again. I'd probably try something else. There weren't a lot of places to sit outside of the bakery. You can walk toward the center of the shops and find seats...or eat them in your hotel room. FYI: Stand in line and choose your sweets. They'll package it up and call your name when it's ready.

The cannoli was delicious (5 stars). The staff and ordering process was awful (1 star). How many people can stand behind the counter doing nothing but stand there, 4. How many people actually taking orders, 2. There was a line out the door, 2 people taking orders, 1 fulfilling them but 4 literally standing there doing nothing the whole time we were in line.
This was an amazing experience. All the deserts we tried were delicious. We had the lobster classic, chocolate cake, vanilla cupcake and strawberry cheesecake. It's a must visit.

I have been the Vegas many times and every time we went by Carlos Bakery there was a huge line and even though I love sweets I couldn't stomach the line. Since we are staying at the Venetian it is now just a 5 minute walk away. This is a Thursday night and the wait was 10 minutes. We tried a little of everything and it was all very yummy. They have a lobster claw which is a cream filled pastry and it was great. I also tried the chocolate filled cream puff, the cannoli and two different cupcakes. Everything was fresh and delicious. They wrap everything up for you in a nice box with a gift-like presentation, very classy. The price point is such that everyone can afford to try "something" as most of the items are in the $3 to $5 each and I paid $11.00 for a chili dog earlier so in comparison this place is a deal. I still have 3 more days here in and I am certain I will be stopping by again to try some other delightful goodness. Update. I'm back several months later and this place is still rocking the sweets!! Make sure to add this to your list of must do's in Vegas! Enjoy!

This place is very mediocre. The line is always long and wait for your food can get a bit long as well. I don't like how there are no prices for anything on display. I love watching cake boss and adore Carlo's humor but sadly I don't think I will be coming back to this place. The baked goods were yummy but I don't believe that the prices really reflect the quality. It's a good experience to come here one time but other than that, I think I will be eating elsewhere.
2nd time ordering the cannoli's, their delicious and great priced! Make sure to sign up for their rewards, you'll receive free items when accumulating points. Plus they offer military discount!

Had to try this place because of all the hype and seeing it on TV. Covid made it hard because only 8 people are able to go in the bakery at a time. The cakes cookies and pastries looked good, but they are known for their cannolis, so had to try those. We tried their cookies chocolate fudge cupcake and their traditional cannoli. Cookies were ok and the cupcake was kind of in the dry side. The famous cannoli was just ok. Though that the cannoli would be the best item, but all were just so so. Almost forgot our friends got the rainbow cake so we were able to try some of that too. It was moist and very colorful but again nothing special. Was really looking forward to some of his pastries to blow us a away, but was disappointed. This is a place where the hype didn't meet expectations.

Carlo should focus on quality His bakery in Hoboken has been around for such a long time and is delicious ( it use to be anyway ) Spent 54.00 on some lobster tails and cannoli to bring home for a treat Got home and couldn't wait to try They were disgusting !! Literally threw them out They were old and had no flavor ! Shame on you Buddy for taking advantage and profiteering from tourists !!!

I always come here when I'm at The Venetian Hotel. The last time I came here was on a Sunday, 03/20/22 before 9pm and there was only one guest ahead of me. The cannolis is a must, not too sweet, crunchy and my go to. We got the cheesecake which was a good size portion and tasted good as well. If you like cake, try the confetti cake and red velvet cake, they are delish.

I am a huge fan of cooking and baking shows and loved watching Cake Boss so when I saw there was a Carlos Bakery here, I knew I had to stop in. After reading he reviews on here, I wasn't so sure it would be worth the stop or the money but I'm glad I came anyways. The bakery is actually a lot smaller than I thought it would be. There was also a long line but it moved fairly quickly. I ordered all 4 lobster tail flavors because that seemed to be very popular amongst the yelp reviews. Of course I got the cannolis, one regular and one chocolate dipped. And one slice of red velvet because that's my favorite flavor. Total was about $45. The staff were all nice and helpful. I had a piece of each cannoli and I don't have much to compare it to so I thought it was really good. I prefer the original over the chocolate dipped one. The lobster tails were good. I wasn't expecting such a crunchy exterior but it definitely added texture to the soft cream inside. The red velvet was great. The cake was moist and the frosting had a nice flavor and consistency. I thought it would be overly sweet but it was very balanced. If I lived in the area, I wouldn't go here often to be honest. But it is definitely worth a stop if you're visiting!

I've always been a fan of Cake Boss and Buddy's family. I've been to the original bakery in Jersey and I've actually met most of his family, including him. I have to say I am really impressed with the selection at this bakery in the Venetian! I loved my lobster tail, especially how crunchy and creamy it was. I got a cookies and cream cupcake which I liked as well. I would definitely recommend going, especially since they have a very small line compared to their bakery in Jersey.

wow the food is so amazing here. I know this won't see the business owners eyes but the cannoli's are awesome. I wanted to get a box of 5 and instead I got three because I could not mix and match so that was a few dollars they didn't make and I wonder how many times that happens a day. Everything was yummy especially the lemon custard lobster tail. It was awesome to see my childhood tv show come to life.

Love this place! My mom and I go every time we are in Vegas! Usually not long of a wait and the pastries are always up to par! I recommend the Rasberry linger cookie and the lobster tail, some of the best pastries I have ever had!

The rainbow cake is THE BEST item to get! Followed by the cookies and cream lobster tail! I've been here several times and have always had great customer service. Sometimes there can be a line up but they tend to move fast. I Always stop by here when I'm visiting Las Vegas.

I've been here twice now; once last year and I ordered a few cannolis which were to DIE for, and I also got their rainbow cake with vanilla icing in single slices. I enjoyed it so much that I thought that I'd get one of the already made cakes they have ready for purchase for my mother in law's birthday. The cake was just 'ok' this last time (in January '21) it wasn't as moist as I remembered.. but I'm sure that could be due to it being one of the ready made cakes.. I'm not 100% sure. All in all, I still quite enjoy this place and their many desserts. OH!! they also have yummy iced coffee.

Start off I saw the slice cakes in the vending machine in the Harrahs casino in the lobby.The cost for a slice cake is $9.00. I told my husband let's just go to the bakery so I can see the bakery myself . It's cute more selection is nice. I got myself 2 cupcakes 1 chocolate fudge and 1vanilla cupcake with white icing. That cost $7. and some change. I made a statement to the cashier wow for $7.they must be good cupcakes Smh that was the sign because he didn't even say anything. Shoot I got back to my room just to eat a stale cupcake. If you in the Las Vegas area this is not your spot unless you want high end Stale Cupcakes. That is a shame I am wondering if the slice cakes in the machine are past due date and stale too.

My first time coming here and I was super excited to try some sweets. The line was super long but that wasn't a surprise. Went by super fast. The customer service was great. There cakes were good very moist nothing I thought really special didn't really like the red velvet idk just to much cream cheese for me. The sprinkle cake was good as well. The cakes didn't really give me like a wow omg yes they are so bomb worth a try. Oh yes and the prices are unbelievable. Very affordable!!!

TERRIBLE!!! I'm hoping Buddy sees this. I was so excited to try his bakery without the flight east. Everything looked awesome, but then we took a bite. We tried the rainbow cake, and I'm sorry, but I could make a better tasting frosting with my eyes closed. It was so gross. But we continued on to the "famous lobster tail". I didn't know it would be like eating an actual lobster tail. It was hard and EXTREMELY chewy. It truly was disgusting and inedible. Next we had the cannoli and third time the charm? I'll say it was better than the other two, but nothing I'd buy again. How did he get famous with horrible deserts? I'll never know. I'm ready for Buddy to prove me wrong.

We picked up some desserts after early dinner. They have a lot of different ones to choose from, but my kid wanted a rainbow cake which could be seen everywhere in Vegas (they sold it on a machine at the pizza cake as well), I just went for their class lobster tail. I love my lobster tail; it's so crispy and not overly sweet. Desserts are not too cheap, for 2 items, I spent 15 dollars here, but hey you are in Vegas!

The Lobster tail and strawberry shortcake...omg my mouth is watering just thinking about these.... ahhhhhhh. My cousin Keane, his wife Adriana, my bf Javan and I decided to go to Carlos' Bakery the night before we had to leave Vegas. We decided the go 1 hour before they were closing and upon arriving there wasn't too long of a line and plenty of desserts and sweets to choose from. Adriana strongly recommended the lobster tail to me and when I saw the strawberry shortcake it was too hard to pass up. I also purchased one of their cannolis to see what it was about. Ordering and paying was quick and easy. The staff was very nice and helpful too. I barely watched Cake Boss when it was on TV but I was definitely hyped for this spot and the hype is real! If you're going to visit, get the lobster tail for sure. The crunchiness of the shell and buttercream together are a match made in heaven! The strawberry shortcake wasn't too sweet and just the right size to eat. The cannolis was soft the day after I bought it but still good. If you're at the Venetian, stop by and grab a lobster tail. You won't be disappointed!

Popped in here for an extra treat after lunch at Buddy V's. They have a couple of cake slices but mostly whole cakes, in addition to various pastries, large cupcakes, and several cookies. Lauren C and I each opted for a cookie, priced around $4 each- large and soft, loaded up with toppings. The cookie itself was just fine and the service was okay, counter staff seem to be used to a lot of people "just looking". Pricing was about as expected ($50-60 for a 6" cake) but selection of specialty slices was lacking (3 choices?) and there is no available seating- everything is packed as takeout. I was slightly more impressed with their new San Antonio location.

Everything was tasteless. I can't even explain how disappointed we all were. It was OK, not good, just ok, so not worth the money in my opinion. $9 for a slice of cake? Cannoli, eclair and lobster tail were mediocre. I don't understand how to describe it. It's like the didn't add any flavoring (like vanilla, almond etc) just sugar. There's no depth you just get sweet with no other flavor. I will not return.

Have been to New York several times but never been able to come here because it's been busy and always out of the way. We got the lobster tail and the confetti cake. The lobster tail is amazing, and it is a must if you ever come here. It is so crunchy, and not burnt, and the cream filling is not too sweet at all, it's the perfect amount of sweet and whipped-ness (not a word, I know!). The way the lobster tail crumbles when you bite into it with the perfect amount of crisp is genius! The confetti cake on the other hand was way too sweet. I did not like it one single bit. I which they're able to use the same custard / cream filling in the lobster tail as the icing for the cake. That would be incredible. I truly found the cake way too dense and way too sweet. Two pairings that make it overwhelming. Overall: 10 out of 10 would recommend the lobster tail, 5/10 would recommend the cake, and 7/10 would recommend coming here. It is quite over priced

My gf is a huge fan of Buddy so of course we had to check out the bakery! Stopped by the bakery for dessert after getting lunch at his restaurant. Overall satisfied and impressed with the quality of his desserts. We got the cannolis and one of the lobster pastry things. Not sure what they're called but it was heaven!! Loved everything about it. The filling is delicious and never had anything like it. Highly recommend Carlos bakery. Service was great as well. I was really hoping they'd have some desserts from his new show "bake you rich". Hopefully it's in the works.

Decided to try this place again because there was no line. We got a chocolate cake donut and a Caramel Lobster Tail. The donut was dry as ****. The lobster tail would have been better if it wasn't so darn hard. It was difficult to even take a bite it was so hard. Had good flavor but I threw most of it out. $10 down the drain. Also, as we were waiting for our items to be bagged up we noticed that the kitchen was a disaster. Maybe they shouldn't have windows. Buddy, your restaurant is good but your bakery needs some serious improvement.

Friends, food, fun that's all a girl ever needs sometimes. That and several CANNOLI. Always wanted to come here because of the whole Cake Boss series. The icing on top were the cannolis! Friends and I were here at around 815 pm on Martin Luther King Jr day. There was a short line of about 5 people in front of us. It was my first time but I had my heart and tummy set, then someone mentioned the lobster tails! The place is pretty small, there's no place to eat and sit, but there's a nice shelf for you to quickly set your box of goodies down and stuff your face or mix your coffee, whatever floats your boat. There's a viewing window of the bakery but I really wasn't paying attention. There was a staff of two serving everyone and the bakery cold cases were fully stocked. Everything looked amazing. I stuck with my gut and got four cannolis- 2 chocolate dipped and 2 original, and an original lobster tail. Polite and quick with service, I would've stayed to ask questions but the line behind me was 10 deep. Got home and scarfed a cannoli down before bed, then ate my awesome lobster tail for breakfast with coffee the next day. I gotta say I will probably be back for more!

I wanted to try this bakery after watching him compete with Duff on the food channel. The shop has a lot of pretty baked goods. A sales person takes your order and the back staff packages it while you head over to the cashier. We shared a regular cannoli. The ricotta filling was very thick like a NY cheesecake. I still prefer the creamy filling from the Modern Pastry ship in Boston. The cookie shell was good and crispy but thick. Wished we had time to try the cakes.

My mother is a HUGE fan of Cake Boss and Next Great Baker, so I was insanely excited when my brother and I told her about the Vegas trip, and that we were going to take her to Carlo's. She was sooooo excited, and told everyone that she was going to Carlo's when she talked about Vegas. I'm sure her excitement probably got some people watching the show, at the very least, because she told that many people. Lol. My mother wanted a cannoli. This was her big thing. My brother got her one on her birthday, and she hated it. Lol. So she was a little hesitant to try it here, thinking it would be the same. This one was perfect. It was crispy, and sweet. My mom loved it. I'm so glad we convinced her to try it. We also had a lobster tail. I don't remember what kind it was, but there was a couple choices. It was my least favorite thing we tried. The outside was weirdly crispy, like I was chewing it forever. I ended up picking out the filling and just eating that. The selection in the bakery seemed a little weak, like they were out of a lot of things and the shelves were a bit empty. That was the one thing I noticed. Other than that, what we did have, I thoroughly enjoyed. That was my one big complaint, I suppose, if I could pick anything apart. The staff was amazing. That definitely stood out to me. We had a kid, I don't know his name, helping us. Even though the descriptions were listed on each thing in the display case, my mother conveniently missed that and started asking about different things and what was in them. This kid was more than patient. and didn't just say read the sign. Although, I'm sure he was thinking it. Lol. He was more than happy to discuss it with my mother and answered all of her questions thoroughly and with a smile. He gave us plates and a knife since we were sharing everything. He really went out of his way to make sure we had everything we needed and it was a great experience. Would I return? Absolutely. I wish there was a Carlo's bakery closer to me than Las Vegas. But then I would be even fatter than I am now. Lol. But the experience was wonderful. It was so amazing to be able to take my mother here and try all of the things she has seen on TV from the show. Definitely worth a trip. Review 81 of 2017.

I have watched Cake Boss for years since I am a cake decorator and baker as well. Buddy has always awed me with his creativity which made me want to try his products. I had the chance when we were at LV last week, there was no line and they had tons of pastries to choose from. But there are no sign or price as to what the items were. So it's hard to choose more so. We opted to just try the cookies, m&m and chocolate chips and a Christmas sugar cookies. Got 3 of each and 1 cheese danish. I was so surprised though that all of it rang to more than $40. The kids liked the cookies but they were like any other cookies that you can buy from bakeries that costs less. I didn't like the cheese danish because it was too sweet and the pastry itself was a bit hard, I'd prefer the ones from Panera bread. Maybe next time when I get the chance I'll try the cakes. We didn't get any at the time since we had some cakes already from another bakeshop.

My friend and I stumbled on this place as we were exploring the hotels. I love the show and have always wanted to get my hands on their goods! There was a line, it was around 10am on a Sunday. We didnt mind waiting as we just needed to satisfy our sweet tooth. While waiting in line you can watch the bakers making baking the delightful treats! As we got closer my eyes kept getting bigger and bigger. If their items were calorie free I would have ate more! Since we had already had breakfast I just got a canolli but decided to wait to eat it. After about and hour we sat down and enjoyed our treats. Everything tasted really good! I know for sure I will try their other items. Recommend if you get a chance to visit the Venetian hotel. I am not sure if it gets busier during the evening but the morning seemed to not be too bad. Note: I did not find their prices to be pricey as some reviews mentioned. Items made from scratch come at a cost, and you can taste the quality. It's a treat not a daily occurrence. Eat up and enjoy!

We showed up without a reservation and we were seated right away. Josie, our waitress was not only extremely pleasant but incredibly quick and proficient and explaining the menu, taking our order and making sure that we received exactly what we expected. A great evening and we will for sure be back. We simply can't say enough about Josie and her upbeat personality and friendly reception during our stay.
These cannolis are a must get when you are by Carlo's Bakery. The taste is like no other cannoli out there. Really cool place!

My mother and I went in to get a wedding cake ordered for my wedding for the 4th of July weekend and Shenel was amazing. I had been nervous about this process and Shenel, the pastry chef, made this experience so great and easy. I was pleasantly surprised how smooth the process went. Shenel put me at ease stating she would actually be the one who will make my cake. I could not be more grateful for her help and cannot wait to see how everything turns out. THANK YOU SO MUCH SHENEL!! -Sonny

Always wanted to try this place but the lines were always so long. We lucked out on this day as there wasn't a line so we walked in and ordered the 4 pc cake deal for 26 bucks We got a red velvet, a chocolate, a confetti birthday, and a rainbow cake with strawberry frosting. Cakes were good, I think the chocolate was made on site, the rest were in a sealed container so north sure They were all yummy

I am so disappointed! TV has a way of really dramatizing an experience! I've waited years to visit The Cake Boss bakery. I've been there twice in less than 10 months and both times fell FLAT! Nothing in the bakery deserves higher than 3-star. We've tried everything from the cheesecake, cake, cannoli, and cookies. Today I said let me try the dipped strawberries. The cashier "cautioned" me they were weighed. I asked her to remove the stems, bc they weren't edible and I lie not they were every bit of 3-4 inches long. She just stood there and shook her head "no". Four strawberries weighed in at nearly $13. Whoa! And they were not that great. Just average. My local Publix has some for .99 ea. THEY ARE DELICIOUS! As a special treat if you want an absolutely mouthwatering dessert GO across the hall TO BUDDY V's for the Italian Bday Cake! I think the pastry chef there needs to retrain the cooks at Carlos Bakery.

I really wanted to like this place but for some reason the two cannolis I ordered yesterday 5/16/2022 (1 original and other was chocolate) both of the fillings were semi bland and gritty. Super bummed and hope it was just an off day but I don't think we'll be back anytime soon and rather go to black tap for dessert.

Regretfully I was tooo full from BuddyVs restaurant and had a dessert to actually order a cake but I have to say that I admire the energy and whimsy that surrounds this bakery. People seem to flock to these colorful and enticing cakes and sweets. Probably the most iconic is the rainbow layer cake. I also realized that that are numerous Carlos Bakery vending machines with slices of cake scattered around the strip like in Paris. I look forward to trying a slice one of these days and then I will update the review with the verdict but since I tried the birthday cake at BuddyVs I am confident the cakes will be rich and delicious.
This is a must try! Don't pass on the legendary Buddy's pastries. if you've never been, try the cannolis!
Carlo's Bakery made my wedding cake and all the pastries for our wedding! The cake was unbelievably delicious and absolutely more beautiful than I ever expected! Everyone raved about the pastries.

Lobster tail is as good as I remember. The pastry is crispy with lightly dusted powdered sugar and the cream is smooth and not too sweet. The rest of the pastries look okay. I come here mainly for the lobster tail. Before COVID the line usually wrapped around the corner but it is quick today.
This is by far my favorite place in Las Vegas!!! Ya wish they had one closer to Texas so I could come more often. Highly recommend if you want something sweet and at a good price!

Honestly I feel like I set my expectations too high for this place since I've been watching cake boss for as long as I can remember and actually eating it was such a disappointment. My mom & I were both disappointed because it's not what was expected. Anyways, they put too much egg in the pastries, especially the lobster tails, it has such a strong smell of egg & it makes you not want to finish it. The cannolis are okay, they just need to work on making the filling less grainy.
Excellent cake and cookie, I can taste the quality ingredients used to make the baked items. I did find it a bit pricey. Worth check out thought. Four thumbs up

Hm for an italian bakery they have rly bad cannolis. I took a bite and threw it away...I got it chocolate dipped and the shell was a little soggy but fine. The filling was odd tasting like spoiled milk.... Luckily the strawberry eclair was better ! The choux pastry had a nice crisp on the outside and slight softness on the inside. The cream wasnt too sweet and strawberries tasted fresh. However for such a well-known bakery it was very subpar. I've had so many more cannolis and eclairs elsewhere that have been so much better!! Cake boss let me down ://

A bit of a mixed bag from this place. We had one of the lobster tails and it was amazing. Light and crispy with a delicious filling. The cannoli on the other hand was virtually inedible. The cream inside was very grainy and the cannoli shell was far from crisp. We each tried one small bite and threw the rest away. Have had far better cannolis and cheaper ones too.

Pretty poor! Coming from North Jersey, and being immersed in the Italian culture, the cookies from Carlo's were extraordinarily underwhelming. I've bought better Italian cookies in Publix, in Florida. Honestly, Great Value Cooke's far out-class what I purchased today at Carlo's in the Venetian. Mama would be vety, very disappointed, Buddy. What is also amazing (not really) to me is that for all the reviews here on Yelp, there isn't a comment back from the company. I guess Buddy and his gang are just too full of themselves and too rolling in dough to even care that their quality is so pathetic. Guess they believe that there are plenty of suckers born every minute. Sorry, Valastro, but you have completely tarnished your reputation as an actual quality baker - you're just another side-show charlatan. Nuthin' matters but the almighty buck, huh?

Was a bit skeptical after reading the bad reviews but I went anyway because I love the show.. to my surprise it was actually pretty good! Ordered the lobster tail and the cannoli . Ordered regular flavors because I figured those would be best. The lobster tail was flakey and the cream inside was really good and sweet! Tasted like some type of cream cheese! Very unique; haven't tasted anything like it before. The cannoli was really good too. I do have another fav cannoli shop in West Hollywood so I was pretty sure that buddy's cannolis would taste bad based on the reviews but it was actually really delicious! It has its own taste to it and it wasn't too sweet or too plain! I enjoyed it. Huge fan of the show!!! Been waiting nearly 10 years to try Carlos bakery and I finally did! Although I'm upset that I haven't tried to actual jersey location but I guess this will have to do for now! Will try other items next time!! Location is a little difficult to find. Obviously in the Venetian hotel but the Venetian is completely complicated. Prices were kinda high but it's Carlos so ya knowwww
First Cannoli experience and it was incredible! I had the tradition and chocolate. Neither was too sweet which I liked. I'll definitely be back to try everything else!

Been waiting 10 minutes for a coffee and an egg sandwich. There are 5 very confused and hideously inefficient people behind the counter and even fewer customers. I've never seen anything like this in my life.

We came here for dessert after dinner. Sooo many options. We got the carrot cake and it was a bit on the dry side(we did come late in the evening afterall). Apple crumb cake was also a bit on the dry side. The Nutella cookie was Ok, but a bit hard, then again it may be intended to be that way. Will try to come by earlier in the day next time.
Really pricey but the chocolate chip cookies are worth their weight in gold. They are now serving cake slices as well and I think it's a great way to sample their cakes before fully committing.
Bakery is good, always busy. The cake is moist and very tasty. I've bought the cookies,cake and cannolis ,and I'll I can say is I want more!! So much to choose from!! Need to get back there
Had the cannoli, lobster claw and strawberry rainbow cake. All were delicious. Service was pretty fast and place was great. Thanks!
The staff was extremely helpful and accommodating. Cake is out of this world ! Had the chocolate fudge and a sprinkle cupcake. Both were A+

I read the reviews before I purchased the cake but still purchased it because it was cute. Had it delivered through Uber Eats. It was worth it to not deal with the Strip and Venetian during a pandemic. Anyway, the cake wasn't dry at all, but it wasn't good. It very much so tasted like a store-bought cake. The buttercream frosting was gritty ... like in the way that your mouth feels a little gritty after your teeth are polished but you haven't fully rinsed, yet. Without delivery, the cake is only like $36. It's not terrible, but honestly, I'd prefer my own h go one made cake or a boxed cake compared to this. It just wasn't very flavorful. That said, the cake was gorgeous and the colors were vibrant, so.... I guess that was the trade-off?

Carlo's is right across the hallway from Buddy V's restaurant inside Venetian's Grand Canal Shoppes and it's so worth the long walk to get there. I tried the pecan chocolate chip cookie which has 2 kinds of chocolate and the cookies and cream cupcake. Both were super sweet and amazing! Prices are normal for a casino, so there was nothing to complain about.

When Carlo's opened several years ago it was extremely good. Good selection, great flavor. The past few years, the selection is terrible but occasionally I've found a tasty cupcake or something minor to eat. The last time the cupcake was terrible so this past week I decided on just cookies. Three different kinds of cookies from chocolate to sugar to chocolate chip to snickerdoodle.....they all tasted the same. $18.00 for four cookies and my husband and I wound up throwing most of them away. I can't believe that thiishment to go down hill the way that it has. Simply put...the only reason it stays open in my opinion is because people who visit Vegas may never go again. I've finally learned my lesson...I will never waste my money on another Carlo's item.

Well, was I excited to get to see Buddy's store of confections? Duh! Yes! Did the sugary treats taste as first-class as I had imagined? Nope! We tried the chocolate chip cookies, they were delicious, but I was starving! They didn't taste homemade. They were spot on to what you could purchase at a high end gourmet grocery store bakery. Tried the rainbow layer cake too. It was just ok. Nothing out of the ordinary. Just cake that looked cooler than it tasted. Prices are expensive but everything else is also expensive in Vegas. Glad we stopped in but I would go out of my way to go back. Definitely want to at least try it once, after all....Buddy is the Cake Boss.
The cake was killer and we loved celebrating my birthday with Alice's if the sweet delicious rainbow cake!

Over rated bakery do not let the hype fool you this place is trash I mean super duper trash. I got the cannolis bruh they taste like chalk and powder I mean it's super nasty and way over priced. Everything I mean everything is over priced and so trash. Do not go here please read the reviews first don't waste your money like me. This place is ass

I have been a huge fan for many many years. I have always wanted to go to this bakery. So when I saw Vegas had a bakery I HAD to go. This place is mega clean and the staff are very friendly. All of their treats looked amazing! Wish I could have bought more while there but we were headed to the airport right after. It was very good. All that I imagined that it would be! I would love to go here again soon! So happy I go the opportunity to come and try treats for myself.

Staff was nice when I was there! It just kinda hard to find the location! I recommend the original cannoli, lobster tail and red velvet cake. The original Cannoli taste so much better in my opinion rather than the chocolate dipped one, cause the choco one for me was way too sweet for my liking. The lobster tails is my favorite but sometimes when you keep in the fridge too long of course the pastry kinda dry and so hard to bite. My suggestion is eat it right away for lobster tail since if you keep it too long it was way too hard to eat the pasty. The one that way over price is the cheesecake. The cheese cake is okay not that good and it almost $11 for small tiny cheesecake... yeah it's on the pricier side for all pasties and cakes.

Hella expensive and it did not meet my expectations. Lol the worker tried to convince us to buy two lobster tails because as he put it "is like a piece of heaven"... idk about him but if that was his heaven then that's pretty sad. The lobster tail looked good don't get me wrong, but the taste and texture wasn't amaze balls. The outer shell was crunchy and hard, not flaky and soft. We also got an individual strawberry cheesecake with crumbs and for the size of my palm (and I have a small palm) you pay $10 for okay cheesecake. I wouldn't mind paying if it was a GOOD pastry but I did not think this was at all worth the money.

My husband surprised me with a red velvet cake from Carlo's Bakery in Vegas. I was not only blown away with his (my husband's) overall presentation but the cake itself was perfect. Moist, thick, not too sweet and perfect cake to icing ratio. Thank you for helping make my day special.

Went in to get our favorite, lobster tails. All orders are to go due to COVID so we had to find somewhere to sit and eat. We have had Carlos lobster tails a few times and look forward to eating these when we visit Vegas. My husband and I were very disappointed . They were so old and stale that each of us took 2-3 bites and we threw all three we purchased out. Not only were we disappointed but it was a waste of money. In addition, there is always a premium in Vegas. I suppose we could have walked back to ask for our money back but we were headed in the opposite direction and did not have the spare time to head back. I have to say that the staff was very pleasant and did their best to direct us to the nearest seating. Quality was seriously disappointing though.

I used to always watch and love the Cake Boss show and I was so excited to learn that Carlos Bakery is open in Vegas. Rushing to get there as quickly as I can and with my anticipation to try their pastries, I took that one bite from one of their cupcakes....I was so disappointed. You could immediately taste the cannola oil they use instead of butter, and the cake itself too is dry and old, it'seven worse than the prepacked or vending machine type. So I gave another try to take a bite from one of their cannoli. Another disappointment! I wonder if Carlos' pastry chef is managing quality control or they are just catering their products to the regular mass without considering the authenticity of the real Italian Cannoli. Overall, it's just the hype that makes people get inline to try their pastries and I will never come back nor recommend Carlos Bakery.

I got there at 10:30pm on a Saturday and everything was well stocked. Except, they didn't have any crumb cakes. I ended up getting several cannolis, a red velvet cupcake, and original lobster tails. They also had samples of their red velvet cake available which was delicious. We brought the desserts back to our hotel room and enjoyed them right away. I was looking forward to tasting the lobster tails. I'm a big fan of the show and I've been wanting to try these for quite some time. Maybe it was because of the build up but I wasn't impressed with the texture or flavor of the shell. It tasted like it was stale and too crunchy. The cream was a little on the runny side but it had good flavor. Perhaps the texture of the shell would be different if it were fresh? I don't know. The cannoli. I'm not even a fan of cannoli but this, this was really really good. The cream was the perfect consistency and sweetness. The shell was crunchy and slightly flaky. Yum. Get it. You won't be disappointed. I bought enough stuff to get Carlo's Bakery swag (glass cup). If I were to return, I'd order a crumb cake in advance to try it out. Hopefully I won't be disappointed.

We had to go her for our pasties of course, being a fan of Cake Boss and all. Well needless to say they do a wonderful job!!! We went 3 out of 4 days of being in Vegas, yummy all the way!! They do it right savory and sweet, we got a spinach feta croissant type pastry, caramel lobster tail, and chocolate croissant. Everything was so delicious and very memorable to say the least. The staff extremely knowledgeable and kind!! We will be back when we go back to Vegas!!

During my trip to Vegas I had to try the Carlos bakery cakeboss. The rainbow cake was very pretty and too well designed, unfortunately it lacked the "home mady" taste I desired and looked for. The taste appeared manufactured. But good experience.

Every time I'm in Vegas, i need to get their lobster tails. I failed in love with them in NY and since then, whenever I'm in a city that has Carlos bakery, I can't resist to get one, or two or maybe more... These are the best I ever had, the shell is very crunchy and not sweet at all, so it goes very well with the pastry filling that is light and delicious. I'm not a fan of theirs cannolis and other items. For me it's just the lobster tail. It's a bomb.

Having watched all of Cake Boss and Buddy Vs. Duff, we were excited to finally get to try pastries from Carlo's. Unfortunately, we were very disappointed. The Lobster Tails were supposed to be one of Carlo's specialties. Two of us were splitting it but it was so hard it was impossible to cut. The filling had a good flavor but was a little runny. We also tried the Chocolate Fudge Cake, and it was just average. Maybe Buddy needs to consider some quality control.
Heart broken at the taste of the pastries for $59 dollars. The covid precautions were non existent besides wearing masks, everyone was one on top of another, so disappointing.

The couple of experiences I've had here have all been positive. The lines are long of course but what do you expect? They're highly sought after. (The line is formed against the side and there's windows so you can see inside the bakery which is pretty cool while waiting). It's also alllll the way towards the end of the strip so it can be a walk if you stayed in the middle. If you really want to give the place a taste than the wait shouldn't be a problem considering everyone else is there trying to do the same, it's just about being courteous. Anywho I LOVED everything I tried so far (I will be back ahah) but my favorite treat are the cannolis omg they are so great, good crunch, yummy filling and I love the little chocolate chips and chocolate dip on my ends. Buddy was there on one of the days I went and I felt the passion in his work and I'm not just being a fan he's a hard worker, you can sense integrity.

If you're expecting something amazing please don't go prices are steep and the quality just isn't there. My wife wanted to try it since she's a fan of cake boss and we where both extremely disappointed

AMERICA!!! Save yo money. Expensive and mediocre product. Soooo overated. Cupcakes at Albertsons and Ralphs are way better than this piece of shit. Imagine that. And some pushy sales lady. Stay away. Y'all thank me later.

Great selection and service. Order taker told me that the cannoli is the most popular item so that is what I ordered. It was awesome. Cream cheese was filled with chocolate chips. Baked items are also made in house.

Got here right before they opened on a Friday morning! As soon as they opened I was greeted with a smile & Welcome to Carlos Bakery! I called before I arrived to Las Vegas and already received good customer service and had all my questions answered about the cake options & prices. I bought a beautiful white cake with fresh strawberries for my daughters 21st Birthday! It was delicious, moist and the strawberries were sweet! We all loved it!

Grew up watching cake boss and have been a big fan of buddy. For the birthday cake and it was pretty good. For some reason I expected a lot more given the hype this business has. It was still very good but maybe I just got the cake on the wrong day. Hope to return soon and have a better experience

Not Impressed. We got a wedge of pecan pie, a chocolate dipped cheesecake, a cookie and cream cupcake, and a slice of rainbow buttercream cake. The pecan pie was the only thing with good flavor. The chocolate dipped cheesecake was mediocre. The cookie and cream cupcake was a slightly dry underflavored chocolate cupcake with some gritty speckled frosting on top that tasted nothing like cookies and cream. The rainbow cake was equally flavorless and unimpressive. I'm honestly pretty upset with the inflated prices we paid for underwhelming bakery goods. Don't get lured in by the Carlos name and Buddy's face everywhere. You can get a better cake out of a box at the store for $2 and save yourself $20. The only reason this isn't a one star review is because the staff were great.

We were looking for deserts to take it back to the room because we were so full after dinner and we found this place from Venetian website. Unfortunately it was not what we expected. This is the store inside Venetian. From the look, all their baking products, there was nothing impressive at all. We went ahead and got a slice of chocolate cake that ready packed in a clear plastic container and a white chocolate mousse to take it back to our room. The cake was overwhelmingly sweet like a grocery store bought cake. There was no quality into it. One would expect the store in a nice hotel like this would make high end deserts, not this one though. Go some place else if you want a high end dessert from a Michelin Chef. But if you don't mind just a piece of cake load nothing but sugar, this is for you

8/16/21 Another late review Always pass by but never had the opportunity to give it a chance and Finally we did! Love the easy set up, you order first on the bakery counter and then when they have your order ready they call you by name and you pay. Wait is not long at all, may seem long by the many people that go there but just wait, it goes by quickly. We got a box of cannolis that come with lobster tails and woww they are so worth the price!!! Cannolis are not too sweet they are just right on the sweetness. Definitely want to come back and try a slice of cake.

Good tasting desserts. The red velvet cake is perfect, great flavor with cream cheese frosting that is not over powering. I also purchased a cannoli, which was delicious. Chocolate chips were in the cream which was an added surprise. The prices are rather high but you are paying for the name. I would hands down purchase from this location again. They were quick and spot on with the way they were running the bakery.
This cake was delicious! I was nervous it was going to be a little too sweet but it was the perfect balance. The cake was very moist and the frosting was delicious.

I grew up watching Cake boss buddy was an inspiration! I finally got the chance to go to one of his bakery's in Las Vegas, I was so excited!! Only to be disappointed by his product. Obviously I know that the majority of his product is factory made now because of the demand for them. But that doesn't mean that the cake should be dry. I was very disappointed I got three different slices and the only one that wasn't dry was the chocolate. The cannolis were frozen before purchase they weren't fully thawed out I was disappointed because I've had better cannolis at my local shop in California and Buddy is known world wide they should've been amazing. I also purchased some cookies and there wasn't anything special about them. The little moose cake was amazing. Overall I was disappointed maybe going to the original Carlos bakery the quality of his product is better.
The shop exceeded my expectations! I dealt with Lisa from beginning to end and was not disappointed. You guys should definitely consider this spot for your sweet tooth!
Good pastries, although very expensive. Paid 120 for 14 cannolis. Ok cannolis, a little dry.

I have always wanted to try this bakery and finally but the bullet last night. I was not craving for cakes so I i tried the hazelnut cream puff and hazelnut lobster tail. Unfortunately the cream puff was stale. :( so that was a downer. However the lobster tail was good. Not great. Just good. We didn't have to wait too long in line and was checked out less than 5 mins. Two lobster tails and 1 cream puff cost us 16$(rounded up). Would i come back? Maybe for the cake. But not for the ones i have gotten last night.

Although quite pricey, the cannoli sampler was awesome! It reminded me of this little hole in the wall spot back in Boston that locals kept to themselves about to avoid the touristy hype. The cookie I got was kind of dry and crumbly - I prefer the soft and chewy cookies. Would go back just for the cannolis.
Awesome service. They were able to make a last minute surprise birthday cake and on time.

I have ordered cupcakes from this bakery twice through DoorDash and both times I get cookies. I want a refund for both orders but they are closed. No answer by phone. DoorDash won't respond either. Every time I call this bakery they don't answer.
Absolutely terrible. We threw away the cookies and cupcakes we bought because they tasted so bad.

This place is busy!!! We didn't get a chance to try the lobster tail at the restaurant, so we saw some more being sold at the bakery across the hallway (why they wouldn't deliver more to the restaurant is beyond me?), so we got in the looong line. The wait was about 30min and there is a guy with an ipad taking orders way head of you seeing all the pastry cases, which is super annoying. I know they are doing this for speedier service, but I had no chance looking to see what is down the line, so I simply ordered the lobster tail and that was it. He was pretty pushy too, so I missed out on some other things that looked good when I later came all the way down to pay. If you are interested in buying things, walk along the side and check out the display cases first and then go in line or let your hubby wait in line while you check out what they have.

Stood in line for about 7mins to place the order, then you wait for another 5-7mins when your name is called to pickup your order. There are no prices anywhere, you must ask for the prices when placing your order. Don't wait to go and pay to find out the prices are outrageous (like I did!) The cake was okay- not worth $10 for a slice. ONE SLICE. It didn't taste much different than getting a slice of cake from Vons or Walmart. Save your money and time.

We got the 5 pack of cannoli and 4 pack of lobster tails variety pack each. It was very delicious. The price was a little steep we paid 47.00 for both. I can say i ate at carlo's bakery and had the cannoli for 47 dollars. No line we were in and out very quickly. I enjoyed the experience can i find cheaper cannoli somewhere else? Maybe. Will it be as good as carlo's . But for my first Cannoli at least i have a good starting point for what i know is a good cannoli.

This place is right on! It's tiny but the line moves fast. There was some confusion with my order. When the bill rang up to $40+, I was shocked but then they realized that they charged me for a whole cake rather than just 2 pieces. Then they had to open up the tied box to place the 2 pieces inside. Just as I was leaving they were going to give me my 2 lobster tails that were already in my bag. The lobster tail was so crispy and the cream inside was so smooth and tasty. The box of goodies flew home to Hawaii (stopped by TSA and the box had to be wiped for drugs or bomb residue) but luckily it didn't get confiscated and we got to get it home to be given as a gift to the caregiver of my 4 legged baby to thank her for her love and care while we were away.

Food: 2 stars. Ambiance: 3 stars Service: 3 stars Tried the overrated Cannoli and we were underwhelmed. Frankly nothing looked super appetizing. I would not consider this place a fine bakery and there are much better choices within few steps away. But hey, we had to give it a try after watching many episodes of Cake Boss. Carlo was nice enough to take picture with us in his cut-out form :). Good bye...

The 3 star rating is based purely on the coffee and lobster tail. I would definitely visit again and try more treats to see if there's something better. When I went in the late morning there were only a few people in the store so I was served quickly and there was a large variety of items available. I ended up choosing the original lobster tail, which I was told had Bailey's flavored cream inside. I also got a hot coffee, which was a lot cheaper than I expected! Employees were friendly and helpful when I asked about flavor options. The downside was that there really wasn't any seating, so my husband and I wandered around the shops until we found a bench. The lobster tail was really crisp. Like really crisp. Causing an explosion of powdered sugar on my shirt and pants. The pastry dough tasted a bit stale, but I don't have much lobster tail experience so maybe this is the intention? The cream was indeed Bailey's flavored and plentiful. Definitely a messy pastry to eat on a bench, so I'd keep that in mind!
A go-to location every trip to Vegas. Enjoy the lobster claws!

When I found out there was a Carlo's Bakery in Vegas, boy was excited. I've haven't had the time to check out the one in LA, so when I found out there was one in Vegas I had to make a stop. I think the reviews are a little bit lower than they should be. Sure people expectations our high and so are the prices here. This place similar to Milk Bar in the Cosmopolitan is one of the most expensive places to pay for dessert. I only tried to item a chocolate Cannoli & hazelnut lobster claw. Just for those two things it was like 12 bucks, we could have really spent even more money, but I just wanted a taste. Originally I was going to go with the Oreo Lobster claw, but one of the employees said the hazel nut ones one of the best flavors. The lobster claw is like a croissant, but it is a little harder, the hazel nut cream was delicious. I thought my wife's cannoli was alright. I would come back though I feel like there could be more choices in unique baked goods.
Due to Covid, they only allow a certain amount of people to come in, but they seem to be handling it well.
Good or not, I ordered through DoorDash and $20 of my order was NOT delivered. Called the establishment and no answer. Terrible customer service for what I paid and it's Easter Sunday

I learned about this place from a friend who told me to try the lobster tails and I was glad I did. Keep in mind, that's the ONLY thing I get from here. Food: I only order the original lobster tails from here when I'm in town. I've tried the other 2 variations they have and they were way too sweet for my taste buds so I stick with the original. They can run out if you're in at night during peak season for Vegas so try to go in the mornings. Staff: Everyone is helpful and they have multiple people working behind the counter to try to keep the lines down. They separate the people that put your order together and the ones that are the cashiers to make the wait go by faster which I think is smart. After you order all of your stuff, they tell you to wait by the window until your name is called by a cashier then you pay and get your treats. Location: This place is tucked away in the Venetian mall in one of the side walkways but it's not hard to find as they have signs to it. I love watching them work in the bakery as you can see the pastry chefs working on their next creation during normal business hours. It's fun to watch and keep you distracted if there's a wait.

Chocolate cannoli to die for and actually not to sweet. My baby sis loves her rainbow cake slice and the lobster tails original and hazelnut ammmaZING! It was my dream to go to Carlo's bakery and get one of each and I did and those were by far my favorite but everything was delicious. My dad loved the hazelnut cookies and lemon ones too. My best friend said her fave was the double chocolate chip cookie and carrot cake. I will definitely be making this my go to stop before we leave.

Got SUPER lucky & came on a day where there were only 2 people ahead of me in line! Anywho, the bakery is adorable! Located in the Venetian, it took forever to find (we parked @ self- park & walked through the shops by the Canal). But the trek to find it took us through areas we would have never seen otherwise! But it was so cute! There's big windows to watch cakes being decorated (but no one was in there while we were there)... Can definitely understand why people get aggro over the wait- it's pretty small & people tend to be indecisive and ask TONS of questions... When it was finally our turn at the cashier we ordered 2 chocolate covered cannolis, 4 Rainbow/Venetian/7 Layer Cookies, & an original Lobster Tail. The grand total camr out to just under $35??!!! I don't go to bakeries often, but I've never spent that much on 5 single baked goods & 4 Cookies?! But I will say this- they were REALLY, really good!!! The Cannolis here HUGE & generously filled. The shells were thicker than I'm used to, but they held up very well on our car ride home! The cookies were just like I remembered them... I used to get them from a little Italian bakery in my neighborhood growing up & rarely find them anymore- these were delicious! But the Lobster Tail- that was AMAZING & worth the $5.50!!! I was told the cream has bourbon in it but didn't think I would taste it, but it was definitely in there! It secretly made my husband and I happy that we didn't have to share it with the kiddos (LOL)!!! Definitely worth stopping by once if you're a fan of the show or looking for some Italian baked treats. I probably won't ever come back again but I'm glad I tried it once!
Awful!!! No flavor, weird textured, super expensive!! We threw $100 worth of his crap away. Terrible!!! Blah!!!

I wanted to pick up a cake for a special occasion and when I saw the picture of the rainbow cake I knew it was the one. I ordered the cake to be picked up the next day. When I arrived- at 11:30 on a Sunday morning there was no line at all and my cake was ready. They had placed it in the box and then wrapped the box in plastic which helped keep it fresh. The cake was EXACTLY as pictured. It was absolutely beautiful and tasted just as good. I loved all of the layers. If I lived closer I would order more often.
