I really wanted to love this place since cake is pretty much my "favorite food"! The place is cute, it's awesome that it's open late, the woman working there was super nice .... BUT, almost $6.50 for a mediocre (at best) tasting and small piece of cake?!!! No thanks :/

I've tried the vanilla cake with chocolate icing and raspberries as well as the browned butter blondie. Both were absolute perfection. The decorations are cozy, fashionable, and elegant with a coffee shop vibe. I HIGHLY recommend it.

As soon as you walk in, it feels like you've traveled back in time and ended up in a wealthy person's parlor. The cakes have a beautiful display and there are a variety of drinks to choose from. The staff are friendly and move carefully behind the counter. There is also a parking lot right next door (unusual in lawrenceville), big plus! This would be a great place for an intimate conversation on the sofa or at one of the outdoor garden areas. The cake flavors are interesting combinations that aren't generally offered at grocery store or barebones bakeries. I took away a star because although the cake was yummy, it was a bit heavy. The cream was airy and subtly sweet, and the strawberries were fresh. The prices are similar to Cheesecake Factory dessert prices. This is a great spot to satisfy your sweet tooth and feel healthy doing it as the desserts are vegan.

YAS! What's not to adore about a place that serves perfect coffee and heavenly (gimme all the cake!) homemade desserts that is open past 9pm (they're open until 11 most days) in Lawrenceville! Throw in a smattering of friendly workers and a chic atmosphere, and this is my new go-to work-friendly meeting spot. Note: Try their homemade buttercream frosting!
Stopped in with my family. We came in for the 2018 Lawrenceville Cookie Crawl. On a saturday, easy parking, and such a great time. We orderded so much food and 5 drinks and the barista was so great!

Coffee was fine both the decaf and the regular. We had lavender with pistachio cake and chocolate cake. Both were made days ago, I think, they were not fresh and both taste similarly! Specially the chocolate cake had little cocoa powder, it was more like food color (red). For this quality they were pricy! $6 per slice. Coffee was $3.5

The cake was very dry and lacked notable flavor. I typically don't review but I was really craving a good slice of cake that day and drove pretty far with high hopes. Perhaps the cake is best when eaten with coffee or tea, but certainly not for a moist cake fix.

Finally got a chance to visit the bakery. Interior has subdued lighting with couches, high back upholstered chairs and regular tables and chairs. Walked up to the display case and was a little disappointed with the limited variety of cakes. Prior to my visit to the bakery, I was under the impression that they had a larger number of cakes to taste. The few cakes they had were not my taste with the exception of a almond cake with raspberry frosting. The cake was very dense and the frosting was very tasty. They had a couple of other items in the case such as brownies. If they will have more of their products on display to experience, I definitely would return. Otherwise, I will pass up any future visits to the Butterwood.

The cakes here are good but not spectacular, which might be because of how late in the evening we came. The service was quick and friendly, but the cakes were way overpriced considering the quality. In addition, the slices were served cold, and cold cake tastes like old cake. After just a few bites, we took our slices home where we let them warm up, after which they tasted like entirely different--much better--cakes.
They have really tasty, rich, cakes. Great decor. Very chill, laid back atmosphere. Glad that it's open late. Would definitely recommend for a late night dessert.

I dont understand what the attraction is. It's definitely cute, but my cappuccino was cold and the cake was dense and not very good. My husband had chocolate cream pie that was literally pie crust with a very thin layer of chocolate. Not good.

I ordered two specialty cakes for my baby shower and they were amazing. I was overwhelmed by choosing flavors so the staff helped me pick. Ended up getting a black sesame cake with chocolate cinnamon buttercream that was phenomenal. Seriously one of the best cakes I've ever had. Also got a vegan chocolate beet cake with salted almond frosting. I didn't tell most people that cake was vegan and it was definitely the crowd favorite. $40/9"cake that easily cut into 20 slices each. If I want a gooey layer cake I will definitely order from here in the future.

Was in the neighborhood for a vet appointment, so we stopped in to try the cake. I had seen the really beautifully adorned cakes on instagram, and with flavors like 'blueberry rose with pistachio buttercream' how could one not be, at the very least, super curious!? This place is super cute and cozy, and would be great if you're looking to snuggle up to a book either inside or in the adorable garden area out back. Also, the cake did not disappoint! It was very dense, but also quite moist, and not overly sweet or gluttonous. My partner said they reminded her of a cake donut, but I suppose I enjoy cake donuts more than she does ;). I also had the hibiscus passion fruit iced tea, which was perfect. I hardly ever eat sweets, but this place makes for a perfect departure from the regular. Most of the time I will decline sweets because I feel that they aren't "worth the calories" (I'm more of a savory girl), but this place is definitely worth any and all calories. And while I didn't try them today, they had plenty of really good looking vegan options! Definitely worth a stop :)

Pittsburgh really needed a place like this: a bakery/cafe that's open late (especially on weekends). Perfect decor. Small, unusual menu, and for someone who loves dessert but is picky (like me), I was relieved to have one "normal" option - the chocolate cake. Now I'm not a chocolate cake fan, but I loved this cake. The icing was amazing. Even my husband -- who isn't into chocolate -- agreed. I ordered a hot chocolate, which came in a saucer with dark chocolate, along with separate containers of milk and whipped cream. I mixed it up but couldn't get the right level of sweetness. It wasn't warm at all, so I quickly lost interest and drank water instead. The cups were small, so my friend and I finished our waters quickly. Minor quibbles, especially since the place hasn't been open long. This is a great addition to Pittsburgh and we'll be back!
Average desserts, I definitely would not go out of my way to eat here. There are plenty of other good dessert places in Pittsburgh.

If you are looking for a decent tarts and cakes for coffee this place is the place to go to and has fantastic Ambiance and the food is delicious without a doubt. However if you don't like being given the stinkeye the entire time you were sitting in the establishment then I would not suggest this place. The employee who served us was not only rude and curt but the only one in the establishment which may have affected the mood she was in. That being said, the dark chocolate olive oil cake with green pistachios was excellent as was the peanut butter chocolate cake and raspberry tart. Come for the cake .
Wow this place is good!! Try anything with the buttercream frosting .... it's perfect sweetness. And awesome back patio!

I'm picky about cake. Most American cake is just fluff; it doesn't have the body, the dense crumb that you see in, say, British cakes. Butterwood is legit! I went there with a friend who was deciding on a vendor for her wedding cake. Between us we tasted pretty much every cake they had on offer that day, and took the leftovers home in boxes. My friend has decided to go with Butterwood for her wedding cake - it was the best and most unique of all the places she tried. All the cakes were excellent: good texture, good flavor, unique combinations of cake and buttercream. Note that in their nut buttercreams, the nut flavor is there but it's pretty delicate. So for example, in a salted caramel cashew buttercream, the salt, butter and caramel were the forward flavors, with a hint of cashew. Still delicious! We also tried one of the pudding cups, which was amazing. I have also sat in here on a weekday and studied, with a piece of cake and a cup of tea to sustain me. It's pretty quiet in the middle of the day so I don't feel too bad about occupying a table, and it gives me time to finish one of those enormous slices of cake. :)

I was looking for a unique place to celebrate my anniversary with my hubby & our little one! I wanted to celebrate it with Cake! This place did not disappoint! The atmosphere made the occasion feel extra special! The cake, tea, & coffee was delicious!!! The staff was welcoming & very helpful. This is a perfect place to relax with friends, snuggle with your sweetheart, or share a scrumptious slice of chocolate cake with someone special!

Looking for what is the BEST ICE CREAM in TOWN? Look no further because Handel's is it!!! I first took notice of them back home in San Diego and my friend brought me to their Calrsbad location and when we first walked up it was a little building with a long line outside...that alone assured me that their ice cream was no joke and definitely going to be the talk of the town. Since then, I moved to Vegas and didnt think id ever find Handel's out here until I went to my trusty little app Yelp lol Was super excited that they had a location out here so I made a mission immediately to drive across town to relive that joy I experienced when I took my first bite of cookies n' cream (HIGHLY RECOMMED). Drove up and they had their same store front image with a walk up window and their menu display of all their flavorful ice cream including their eye catching "cookie monster." My gf ordered their banana split, her son got a cookie dough ice cream on a waffle cone and I ordered their pecan praline in a cup. We waited impatiently outside their store because thier indoor seating was closed off but it was fine, since their were benches very close to the pickup window. When we finally got our ice creams, my gf banana split looked amazing and definitely had some weight to it and I was beginning to have a change of heart and steal hers lol but I was being a good boy and stuck with mine...we all started eating our ice cream and we all couldnt help but smile and compliment how smooth their ice cream texture was and just how refreshing it was to finally taste what good ice cream tastes like. Of course the saying goes, whenever its quiet when people are eating that means its a good sign...lol well that stands true 100% When we got done with our ice cream her son looked at me and told me with a huge smile that he gives this place five stars and that it really was the best ice cream in the world...that really made me felt happy to hear him say that and much happier that now we all have a favorite ice cream place to go to now. If you can, make the drive you will not be dissapointed I promise, the only dissapointment would be not ever knowing what good ice cream tastes like and you're just left wondering until you try Handel's!

It's a walkup style ice cream shop. You place your order at the window and they prepare it right there. You can see inside from the window which is cool. There isn't anywhere to really sit, so expect to take it with you. This concept is exciting, but not in the Vegas heat because you wait in a line outside. They have so many ice cream flavors and mix ins. The best thing is that they have a banana split which is hard to find in Vegas! Sonic discontinued theirs so this is the next best place to get it.

LP for my visit on 3/5. We had just finished lunch at Fukuburger and despite the fact that it was cold and windy, I was craving ice cream and in case you were wondering...no I'm not preggo :-) My friend recommended this spot and since I'm always about trying new places I readily agreed. I ordered the following: 1 pint of Chocolate Malt with Caramel (malted chocolate ice cream with caramel ripple) 1 pint of Coffee Chocolate Chip (coffee ice cream with chocolate chips) 1 scoop of Blue Monster (blue vanilla ice cream with Oreo ® cookies and Nestle ® Chocolate Chip Cookies) PROS: Ice cream was phenomenal. Creamy, silky smooth and delicious. Prices were very reasonable. CONS: Short line.....long wait. This wouldn't normally be a problem, but when it's super windy and you have to stand outside to order :-( I will definitely be back to try the other flavors. I'm an ice cream fiend so it's my mission to try every single flavor on the menu....twice... LOL

Perfect for the hot summer heat. I found a coupon online that's good for 2 waffle cones for the price of $7.50. I couldn't be happier. Their quality is consistent and creamy deliciousness! So many yummy flavor. I chose pecan praline and hubby chose the blue monster which we have no idea what flavor it is lol a mystery blue flavor. Kids would love it!

Great place to get that creamy, rich yummy homemade ice cream! There's no store front persay, it's more like a window walk up. You walk up, order than wait for your treat. Outdoor seating only. They offer an abundance of ice cream plus sherbet options. We've tried the pecan praline, salted caramel, banana foster, blue monster, chocolate and oree. All were delicious. We got a small and medium (2 flavors) in a waffle cone. And one banana split. Service is ridiculously sloooooooooooow. So if you see it's a line, that's why. Average to high price. However you get great quality creamy ice cream. Overall positive experience.

Favorite genuine ice cream stop, seasonal flavors alway change to add variety. I tried the chocolate peanut butter brownie and chocolate pecan. One kid had the sherbet flavors: lime, pineapple, orange and red raspberry. The other had the Cookie Monster and grandma had bing cherry. Everyone enjoyed their choices.

This ice cream is good, but not super different from many other ice creams out there. It is a little on the pricier side, so I will probably go somewhere else next time. Also, I got a banana split only to have my bananas cut into thin slices.
Love love love their salted caramel ice cream. The rest, some of them aren't as smooth as regular ice cream, kinda icy.
The best place in the world. I'm on a quest to try every flavor and I'm about halfway through the menu. So far each one becomes my new favorite when I eat it.
Seriously still not sure why there is a line of people waiting for this ice cream... Not tasty, price is high

My son called here, looking for a job, after dropping off an application to work here. He liked this place, their food, having lots of fun memories with his friends and family over the years. The owner or manager? he spoke to was very rude and unprofessional to him, saying "if someone quits or I fire someone I'll let you know!"

Handel"s Homemade Ice Cream...simply the best ice cream around!! German by name, started in Youngstown Ohio, brought to the valley of Las Vegas, and now there is no better ice cream to be found! Located on the far west side of town, which for me is a solid 35 minute drive, but it is soooo worth it! It's truly a homemade ice cream that separates itself from the pack in it's rich creamy texture! With possibly as many as 50 different flavors available at any given time, the decision making can be tough! There is a chain on the east coast called Bruesters, that has the exact same setup and flavors, so I was by no means an amateur to these flavors. I have always loved their Graham Central Station and decided to do a sundae with adding their Vanilla Nutter Butter! Who doesn't love nutter butter cookies?? Topping it with whipped cream, peanut butter sauce, and hot fudge just made this delectable!! They pride themselves on not skimping...on anything! That they do hold true to so be aware of what you get as they will be adding a lot to it!

I would not recommend! Was there on 1/28 pm. The middle-age guy who helped us was rude. He acted like we were a pain by asking what two of their flavors were. As much as we wanted some ice cream from Handel's, we went to another ice cream shop.

I'm new in town and I love ice cream. I was excited to try this place because of the great reviews. I ordered a QT of Black Cherry and the Chocolate Malt with Caramel as well as the pineapple Sundae to go. The Sundae looked great, but when I got to the vanilla IceCream, it lacked the "Vanilla" and sugar, and tasted like creamy milk. I thought maybe I got a bad badge of vanilla IceCream. But when I finally tried the Black Cherry and the Chocolate Malt with Caramel....both were underwhelming as well. All the IceCream I ordered lacked sugar and how they're supposed to taste. The Black Cherry tasted just like the vanilla IceCream but with cherries and reddish food coloring and the chocolate malt was also lacking "something". I'm glad I tried this place, but I won't be back sadly. I gave it two stars because of how long I waited in line and how much I spent. It was edible and wasn't bad, but it wasn't good either.

I just visited Handel's Homemade Ice Cream & Yogurt for the very first time and I needed to write this review right away. I like to consider myself an ice cream expert, I drive hours and hours and sometimes even take flights just to try new ice cream shops. I've had a pretty firm top 3 for the last 4 years and today that list was shattered into pieces. I just ordered a two scoop cone of Blue Monster (with both Oreos and chocolate chip cookies) and chocolate chip cookie dough and let me just say, it was the best hard ice cream (not soft serve) cone I've had in my enter life, no joke. This ice cream was so rich and creamy, the cone was packed from top to bottom, and it was so flavourful that I'm willing to drive a half hour here every single day for the rest of my life. Overall, everyone in Las Vegas needs to come and try Handel's ASAP. Thanks for making the best ice cream ice ever had and thanks for having a smile when you did it? Kudos to this place on perfection.
Best ice cream in town. So in love. All the flavors are great, it is just so good! Mint oreo is my favorite but it's seasonal!
Friendly staff.....Always fresh amazing ice cream!! Best of Las Vegas for sure I will go back every week!!

It's 41 degrees outside, not exactly the weather for ice cream! But when on vacation, and have the chance to try one the top ice creameries in the world...we will come, rain or shine! We ordered a BANANA SPLIT to share, three choices of ice cream. With 45 flavors to choose from, to select only 3 was daunting ! We finally chose, GRAHAM CENTRAL STATION--CHOCOLATE MALT w/ CARAMEL--and PEPPERMINT BARK. Three HUGE scoops of homemade ice cream, on a bed of sliced bananas, massive mounds of whipped cream, and the works of toppings! Not the prettiest presentation, but It was monstrously delicious! My husband prefers the purity of a single or double scoop, but because he loves me, he agreed to share this concoction! It fulfilled my banana split dreams! We ate the whole thing, and agreed, this was indeed world class ice cream!

They have good ice cream but I m really worried about the hygiene there. Even during pandemic they were not wearing mask all the time not to mention they touch money and than they don't put on gloves when they make your ice cream or if they do they don't change them. Also there were some employees in the past that were super rude and try to over charge me. Too bad

I've had a lot of ice cream in life but this ice cream right here changed the game. I loved it, it's perfect, it's everything I want and need. So this place has a window you can go up to and order. Be prepared there are a lot of ice cream flavors to chose from, it's gonna take a while to decide. Service is very quick, the line moves fast. I went with strawberry cheesecake and banana cream pie. The strawberry cheesecake was incredible, I loved it. But let me tell you, the banana cream pie is the greatest ice cream I've ever had. I don't think I could go back without getting it every time it's that's good. Overall, this is the best ice cream place on the planet, change my mind.

I have been coming to Handel's for 5 years! I have to admit that I don't eat here often (maybe only once every two to three months) due to cold sensitively from my teeth. Whenever I have the cravings for ice cream, I tend to get the Graham Central Station, Banana Cream Pie, or Coconut cream pie flavors. The ice cream is always fresh, not overly sweet, and tasty. Even the waffle & sugar cones are amazing. The staffs are always friendly & efficient. Two Buck Tuesdays are the best - what a wonderful way to get the bang for your buck.

Seriously good ice cream! On the weekends, this place gets pretty busy. Probably because everyone knows that their ice cream is a great end to the week! There's a wide range of unique flavors to choose from. Some of my favorites are banana cream pie, coffee chocolate chip, apple pie, and coconut caramel delight. I recommend getting the four scoop sampler because you can mix and match hundreds of combinations! Then, if you want some for later, you can get your favorite flavors in a pint or quart!
Our favorite ice cream in town! Great quality, great flavors! Love the seasonal additions to the menu.

Delicious homemade ice cream, tried sundae, Oreo dough and strawberry cheese cake, all the flavors were so good. I took one start because of the price but overall great place to stop and enjoy this ice cream.

Was introduced to this institution when I first moved here five years ago, and then three years ago bought a place a mile away! How lucky was that!! Can't go wrong with anything you pick. Ice cream is nice and creamy and the texture is perfect. The portions are huge. A small is surely enough to satisfy, but if you wanna indulge get a medium with two flavors.

Wow!! This is one of the best soft serve ice cream & Yogurt location in Las Vegas! Handel's Homemade Ice Cream & Yogurt was on my "to-visit" list and I finally had a chance to stop by over the weekend on a Sunday afternoon! Handel's Homemade Ice Cream & Yogurt is located off of the 215/Tropicana, a few blocks away. It's within a relatively large shopping plaza with spacious amount of parking. Handel's Homemade Ice Cream & Yogurt's is outside. There are a variety of benches available for seating though! Handel's ice cream has a ton of soft served ice cream flavors, milkshakes, sherbets, brownies and much more! It wasn't too long of a wait. There was two other parties in-front of ours. After reviewing the menu we had ordered the following 1) 4 Scoop Sample - Apple Delight, Cinnamon, Salty Caramel Truffle, Birthday Cake 2) 1 Scoop of Chocolate 3) Blondie with Vanilla ice cream/Whip Cream. The customer service team was super friendly. They were all adhering to the current health safety measures, wearing face masks, gloves, and social distancing. The 4 scoop sample was awesome!! The Apple Delight had almost like a apple cinnamon swirl in the middle. It reminded me of a slice of apple pie. The Cinnamon was super good and flavorful. The Salty Caramel Truffle was my favorite. The caramel flavor was delightful and the truffles added in it gave it a crunch with all of the salty, caramel flavors! The Birthday cake was good. It didn't have a yellow cake flavor, but more of a sprinkles flavor profile. The Blondie was warm, and the vanilla ice cream was a perfect match! Handel's had topped a ton of ice cream and whip cream on it! The sweet treat was delicious! Handel's wasn't too expensive for all of the goodies we had ordered, approximately $17.00. The team here is awesome! I'd highly recommend going to Handel's Homemade Ice Cream & Yogurt if you haven't been to it yet!

Believe the reviews. The ice cream here is so good and I am an ice cream connoisseur. The best part is that they are ridiculously inexpensive. I ordered a 4 scoop sampler and it was around $5!!! From where I'm from, $5 for good ice cream is one scoop! If you love coffee, you gotta try the coffee chocolate chip flavor!!!
If we're out this far in Vegas we always stop in for some handels. Heavenly Hash, you won't be disappointed. It's a mixture of marshmallow fluff, chocolate ice cream.

We tried the Banana Cream Ice Cream and Strawberry Cheesecake Ice Cream which were very good. On Tuesdays it's $2.75 for a scoop in a cup for a limited time only. Handel's Ice Cream tastes Fresh and has bits and pieces of Bananas or Strawberries and cheesecake in the flavors we chose.

A taste of the Midwest here in Vegas! The first time I had Handel's was in Ohio & I'm so happy it's made its way here. Located at the in Smith's plaza on Hualapai & Tropicana. You order at the window :) (not a sit in type of ice cream shop). But! They do have benches for you to enjoy your goodies. (As of this moment, they do have signs that state to refrain from sitting on the benches) they also have markers so that you properly practice social distancing. So good. So creamy. It is a must try for everyone! They do not skimp on their flavors. Every bite will have some sort of ingredient. I ordered the blueberry cobbler & each bite had blueberry & scrumptious, sweet crumble along with some creamy vanilla ice cream. Did I mention how their one scoop is tremendously generous?! Your "one scoop" is honestly two scoops here. I love their variety of flavors. If you are contemplating which to get, they have a perfect option of a 4 scoop sampler. You can pick any four flavors & they scoop it into a cute little container for you to enjoy at that moment or take home. Speaking of take home, they have hand packed quarts & pints! You can choose any of their 50 flavors to enjoy at the comfort of your own home. It's even more perfect because the weather is getting warmer. You will not be disappointed! have to try their 4 scoop sampler next time so I can try more flavors!!!

I'm sure I've rated them before but for some reason its no longer here. But my opinions‹ have not changed. This mid-western family chain makes great ice cream deserts with clever combinations and all kinds of options and flavors. The menu has so many flavor choices which they change from time to time and so many of them sound wonderfully sinful that it's‹ hard to choose. There‹ is often a line and be glad you need to wait a few minutes because they expect you order when you get to the front. The staff are all hustling‹ and work fast to get your order out once you get to the front of the line. There is noinside‹e seating and only a couple of benches outside. Most people stand around talking with family and friends while enjoying amazing ice creams. Even in the dead of winter people seem willing to line up in the cold outside for this great ice cream.
I would give them 6 stars if I could. There's ice cream then there's Handel's. We used to get scoops now we just get pints.

I don't hate ice cream but it's not my favorite thing. I don't normally crave it. It's been hot so I wanted some ice cream. If I'm going to have ice cream I want it to be an unconventional flavor not some thing I can find at the grocery store. I looked up a bunch online and found this ice cream parlor and there were so many different flavors online. I thought there's no way that this place can have all these flavors at this time....And they don't! that's very disappointing!! I figured I would get the flight of four ice cream scoops and I probably would only have a few bites of each but I wanted to try ice cream and I want more than just a little spoonful of it. But when I got there my plans were foil because two of the ice cream flavors I wanted we're not offered that night snickerdoodle and chocolate butter fudge don't those sound amazing I wish I could've tried them!! Bananas Foster was one of my choices and that's the seasonal flavor but when I got to the ice cream parlor I wasn't really in the mood for ice cream anymore!! However oh I am a sucker for cherry flavored things recently and they had a cherry vanilla ice cream so not a very unconventional flavor choice this time around! I don't hate ice cream so I'll probably go again and see what kind of flavors they have a couple of times this year.
This is probably the best ice cream in Las Vegas area. We tried chocolate and salty caramel and both were on point. Service was good and the scoops are big enough.

One of my mothers spots that my 2kids had treated me@! Quite nice and they did enforce the social distancing here. If u don't mind standing in short & fast served line, then come on down the Handle's!! I had a pint of salted caramel truffle packed for me to enjoy @ home. I believe that my first born had the blue monster and my nephew had the black cherry & raspberry scooped ice cream and I think my son (my 2nd born) had the banana cream pie shake. The texture of the ice cream was oh so smooth and of course delicious! So if u want to be served and handled sweetly, then come on down to Handle's everyone!! We'll sure to be back here! Thank u smooches for making me n my fam one of your satisfied customer!

I don't like writing a bad review, but today I had a bad experience. First the young man had attitude. After that I asked don't put nuts on my order, and of course when I got my order there was nuts on it. He wrote it down when I ordered "no nuts".Second of all: I ordered one scoop from one flavor and one scoop other flavor in a bowl. When I got my order I got 2 bowls with 3 scoops in it. I'm so disappointed. We like their ice cream.

The ice cream is always amazing and the staff they usually have on is great except for whoever picked up the phone today. I wanted to pick up some ice cream but before driving 35 minutes to get there I thought I'd give them a call to see if I could do a pick up or at least to see if the flavor I wanted was in stock. they were out on my last trip so I don't want to make an hour long round trip for nothing. "We're not taking pickup orders I don't have the staff" CLICK I get your busy and all but you hung up before I could even ask another question. Why do you pick up the phone in the first place if you're gonna hang up on customers?
Such a yummy ice cream selection on a hot summer day also many different flavors to add on to each ice cream

I passed by this place so many times and every time when in Vegas I go to my favorite Italian Joint next door. I meant to try the ice-cream but was always in a hurry and the lines were 20 people deep, and that was in February not July in Vegas. I finally got a Quart of chocolate and boy was it great. I had ice-cream pretty much in every city I stop when travel and bar none this is the best ever. Texture is fluffy, creamy, not to sweet and over all just right, or as I say it...out of this world...I wish I could give you more than 5 stars because you deserve the Milky Way.

Went on a Tuesday night with friends and my boyfriend, and it was $2.75/scoop Tuesday! Like it's an actual thing they have! We got there around 7, almost 8, and the line extended out the parking lot. It was pippin to be honest, but the line went by quickly and we didn't mind the wait because we were deciding on which flavors to get. See here, I have a major love for "blue Cookie Monster" ice cream. So when I saw that Handel's has "blue monster" flavor, I had to try it out myself because my mission is to find the best blue Cookie Monster in town. From my opinion it was pretty good, BUT it didn't hit the spot. I had a scoop of that and banana fosters. Surprisingly, it was good together haha! My friends and boyfriend had the salty caramel truffle and a mocha flavor one (I don't remember the name), but they all loved their flavors (even though it wasn't their original pick)! The staff who helped my friends said to check on Grubhub for which flavors are available in store.
Absolutely delicious! Hands-down the best mango sorbet I've ever had. Very large portions--the small was 3 scoops!

This ice cream is absolutely fantastic to me. My daughter brought some of this stuff home because her boyfriend took her and she loved it. I'm glad she was thoughtful enough to do that. The flavors are very natural and it's almost dangerous because I know I could eat the whole pint in one sitting. All I got to say is that it is a must try if you haven't already. Let me know what you think.

Place is small but the flavors and selections are huge. They use choice ingredients which becomes apparent in your first taste. Good luck trying to figure out which item to get because they are all so good. The crew behind the counter does an excellent job taking and preparing your orders too.

First time at this ice cream place. The ice cream is absolutely amazing. The mango actually tastes like mango. This time I got two scoops on waffle cone and they offer sugar cone as well as bowl. They have many flavors to choose from. Definitely coming back for some more.

10/10 best homemade soft serve in the valley , then again they've been around for almost a century ! Hands down some of the best simple soft serve in Vegas , with a rotating special set of flavors depending on the season ! The line is old school like back in the day , you wait in line extending out to the parking lot (great for social distancing ) and two Windows have servers / cashiers . Ordering ice cream is simple thanks to their menus being right in front of you , and they've got ample toppings to go with them . I love the prices too they're as cheap as cheap can be for the times .

I think this place is the reason I'm gaining weight. Love the single scoop deal on Tuesday's- but honestly, I will come to this place any day of the week. By far the best ice cream place in Las Vegas. I usually come with friends and we open the back of the pickup truck and enjoy our treats. Graham Central Station is probably my favorite flavor, although the orange sherbet is always yummy too. You won't regret getting Handel's.
This place is amazing. We have been looking for a good homemade I cream place and it did not disappoint. Ice cream was delicious

I have driven by this ice cream shop tons of times all year. I finally decided to go check it out on a chill sunday evening. I parked and saw a long lone so I figured that was a good sign it must be good. There is a ton of unique dun flavors of ice cream but I decided on just getting a single scoop cake cone ($4) & my guest got a hot fudge sundae w whipped cream n a cherry on top (bday cake & coolie dough ice cream). The single scoop was pretty big-I am not really a desert person and it was a lot for me. I want to try the "4 scoop sampler" next time (@&4.55). Friendly staff, and they all wore masks for covid safety measures. I will be back next time I have a sweet craving! Great flavored ice cream and big portions for the prices.

Handel's never disappoints! My go to ice cream place. I just relocated from California and I used to go to the Handel's location in Lake Forest and I was super happy when I found out that there's a location near my new apartment! Would definitely recommend this ice cream place!

Honestly this is my favorite place in town to get ice cream. It's all homemade daily and the selection is absolutely breathtaking. The prices are really great as well. I highly recommend the sampler for $4.25. You get 4 big scoops of any flavors you want. Such a great value. My personal favorite is the monster shake, extra thick made with chocolate peanut butter brownie ice cream. I'd put that up against any dessert in town. To top it all off with a cherry, Customer service is top notch as well. Keep doing your thing Handel's!!!!
Very good icecream and other things Especially great in the summer Worth the trip in a Smith's shopping center
Hands down the best ice cream!! I love Tuesdays special because one scoop is $2.75. One scoop is not just literally one scoop. They layered it up for you. If you're around the area, stop by!

I used to love this place but lately they have gone down on quality and quantity and increased prices. I can understand post covid a lot of businesses have to increase prices. But Handel's has not only increased prices but also reduced the size of scoop by more than half and there are hardly any pistachios in the pistachio ice cream and chocolate chip cookie dough zero cookie dough and barely 1-2 almond pieces in chocolate almond. Very disappointing experience.

Came here after a certain unnamed place was sold out for the day. Lucky for us, it was a Tuesday and scoops are only $2.50. I decided on a red raspberry sherbet on a sugar cone. My husband chose chocolate chip cookie dough in a cup. My 6 year old opted for a chocolate milkshake. Thanks to the deal, this was just about $10 for the 3 of us. The red raspberry was cold, sweet, creamy, and full of raspberry goodness, everything but the seeds! The chocolate chip cookie dough was also creamy, the bites of cookie dough soft and buttery. The chocolate shake was huge (see photo for comparison against 40 oz water bottle) and it was malty, chocolatey goodness without tasting syrupy like some milkshakes do. Would we come back? Definitely and most likely on a Tuesday again. There is a plethora of flavors that can last me a whole year of Tuesdays to try them all!

So so so good. I'm lactose intolerant and I keep coming back to this place. I like that it's a walk up window type of ordering that still offers some seating outside. There aren't many employees inside at a time, so the line can build up on weekends and during the summer, but they find a way to keep things moving and I've always been approached with a great attitude. There are so many ways to enjoy your Handel's, from a classic cone to shakes, sundaes, hurricanes, and even take home pints and quarts. The 4 scoop sampler is such a steal, especially if you can't make up your mind when choosing flavors. Speaking of which, there are an insane amount to choose from. Make sure to check out the other pictures and signs they have posted on their doors for others they may have added. You won't find many other ice cream shops or grocery stores offering these unique flavors and they honestly give Ben & Jerry's, Baskin-Robbins, or really any other one of your favorite brands a run for their money. They're creamy, rich, and last pretty long so they won't melt too fast before you can enjoy. Even with the overwhelming choices, Handel's makes getting great tasting and high quality ice cream super simple. There's something about how this place doesn't take itself too seriously with itself and how it stays true to its brand that adds to the Handel's charm. A lot of people will tell you that this is the best ice cream they've tasted in Vegas and they're not wrong.

We love Handel's ice cream at our house! If you are a local and haven't been to Handel's, you are missing out. We have tried quite a few flavors and our favorites are buckeye, Oreo dough, and blue monster. This is a walk up place with just windows to order. They do have benches to sit outside if you want to. They also have 2.50 scoops on Tuesday, which is nice. Super creamy and flavorful ice cream. Also, be aware that the scoops are more like three, so keep that in mind.
Best ice cream/yogurt place in the entire city. If you have a sweet tooth this is place is for you.

I was craving for something sweet so off to Yelp to find some new sweet spots to try! Handel's did not disappoint! They have a walk up window where you order your desserts and along the business they have benches that you can sit at to enjoy your ice cream! They have a variety of ice cream flavors to choose from and different ways to have your ice cream such as sundaes, milk shakes, etc. They also have pint and quart size ice cream for you to take home and enjoy. We ordered the 4 scoop sampler to try a few different flavors. Of course we had to try one of our favorite flavors mint chocolate chip, blue monster, coffee choc chip and strawberry cheesecake chunk. Each flavor ice cream was so delicious but I really enjoyed the blue monster and strawberry cheesecake chunk the best that we bought a pint and quart size to bring home. Will definitely be back again to try some of the other flavors!
Our first time here and OMG deliciousness! Very family friendly spot where you can just grab a seat and relax. There are too many bomb ice cream options, all the reason to return!

I love this ice cream!!! The owner is super nice too. He played with the kids through he window and doors; ice cream and free entertainment!! What else can we ask for?? We been here a lot of times and we have never been disappointed. The only downside is there's not a lot of seating outside.
The best around. Try the 4 scoop sampler, so many good flavors. Vegan options for plant based friends

It is a good thing Handel's Homemade Ice Cream is on the other side of town! YUM. Super friendly staff and it is delicious. No place to sit down- just counter to order from. So many different flavors to choose from. Since it was the first time they suggested vanilla- which Was creamy and burst with vanilla goodness. On Tuesdays they have $2.50 special... that could be dangerous for my waistline! But every once in a while wonderful treat!!

Visited this place with my teenage girls. Absolutely incredible ice cream. A variety of different flavors. It is a walk up window and seating in on adjacent park benches in the walkway area of the strip Mall. The price is decent for what you get.

This is definitely the best of the best ice cream I ever had in my life. I'm not a ice cream person but man!!! The silky smooth texture with just perfect amount of sweetness makes this place a MUST for ice cream craving!! And they really really NOT Skimping you! Big portions!

The best ice cream in Vegas, no question. They sell money at a quite affordable price compare to others. The portion is huge and the waffle is so amaxing. I fell in love with their pitaschio and chocoholic chunk. The strawberry and pineapple also amazing but sadly not avaiable till summer

Went there on a Sunday afternoon after work. At that time they were not too busy. I tried several times before in the evening but the long line always stopped me and I turned around. Anyway we got the hot fudge brownie Sunday my friend with vanilla ice cream and myself with strawberry cheesecake ice cream. Before ordering I asked if the brownie was homemade and the employee said yes. Well I don't know which kind of chocolate they use, probably cheap stuff because even though the ice-cream was not too bad the brownie was terrible ! My friend thought same. So I guess if you go there just get ice-cream but I'm not even sure if it's worth to wait that long... it's nothing special just average.

Well what can I say about Handel's some few years later?! Not good ! As I left my review all those years ago it remains the exact same in regards to the Graham Central Station. Now, i will say over the past few months I have given them numerous occasions to come thru for me only to fail! The "owner" years ago told me it only has to clumps of sugar when he makes it as the "kids" don't make it right. So, I decide to call and ask for him to give him my opinion on the failed GCS... I get another person In charge who tells me oh it's the supply chain shortage. I am thinking hmmm brown sugar is in low supply ?!! Sugar?! Needless to say the 2 she made me were still lacking . Basically, you get one of three kind of GCS - 1. Solid plain ice cream no brown sugar/ Graham crackers I assume and no black balls. 2. Solid ice cream with several black balls and zero brown sugar / Graham. 3. Tiny bit of brown sugar / Graham and some black balls. All of the above is so lackluster! You new people do not know what you are actually missing when it is made right and that has just never going to happen! Too bad, but also I don't need to get fat so keep making it poorly and use the excuse of the shortage when you were making it crappy years before pandemic and supply chain ! Ha
We always go here! All of their ice creams are amazing! Definitely worth it! My favorite is their strawberry cheesecake!

I had heard of Handel's but didn't think it was in an area we'd likely be in. But then we went for our first dinner at Anna Marie's, and there it was, right next door. The insanely long line told me there must be something to it, so we figured we'd come here for dessert, and then we did. I think it has been years since I've had a real ice cream cone. We always go for frozen yogurt, so this was a treat. I tasted just two flavors - chocolate almond and coffee chocolate chip. I was disappointed that the almonds weren't crunchy, so I settled on the coffee, and loved it - lots of chocolate and creamy ice cream. The single serve was so big I thought the server had misunderstood, but no. It's a little less expensive than B & J's, but I'm no connoisseur - I will not say what I used to pay for a cone when I was a kid because no one on Yelp would believe me! My husband wasn't as thrilled with his, but he ordered the one sugar-free flavor. But this is my review, and I'm a fan.

The ice cream is amazing but the customer service is awful. They have no idea how to move a line quickly. You wind up waiting a ridiculous amount of time compared to the other Handel's and other ice cream stores around. You could milk a cow and make your own ice cream in the time you wait for your turn to be helped. This is the best ice cream in Vegas but until the Vegas franchisee figures it out the wait will always be abominably long.
Amazing ice cream and great customer service ! The owner actually took our order and was so frendly , he went above and beyond. Great experience and we'll be back again soon.

My boyfriend has lived in LV in nearly 40 years. Me: 8. He knows every spot for everything, so, when I pull a trick he hasn't seen from my hat, and he loves it, it makes me super happy. Handle's is the bomb. No tables. No fussy nonsense. Old-school all the way! Casua, order at the window and chill on a bench or in the car goodness. Hand made, fresh everything. Ultra clean kitchen. Hand paked pint to-go for his son, because it's that good.

I thought CJ's was up there until I tried this ice cream. This is less showy and more straight forward. The flavors were delicious and the texture was almost like soft serve ice cream. I got the 2 scoop waffle cone with Blueberry Cobbler and the Graham Central Station. They went perfectly together!

Ice cream was amazing especially on this hot summer day. On my first time here I decided to go with the most popular and recommended graham central station I believe it's called and boy I was in for a treat. The flavors just made you want to keep eating. I will definitely be coming back to try everything! If you're ever on the west side and craving ice cream this is the spot. My number 1 hands down choice.....Enjoy!

We stopped by here on a hot day based on friend's recommendations. This place is great. Everything is so fresh and the flavors are so bright! I haven't had ice cream this good in a long time. We'll be stopping by here quite a bit. Lots of different flavors to try out.

I have been to this location twice now! Probably the best ice cream in town. Prices are reasonable and they have so many unique flavors to choose from. My friend and I are obsessed with this place! I don't think we've ever gotten a bad flavor. The staff has always been very kind and attentive as well. My personal favorites are the chocolate peanut butter and the salted caramel. Love Handel's!

Wow! This is good ice cream! It all started back in Ohio apparently and has now made its way to Vegas. They have a huge menu, and it's the kind of place where you order from the window and take it with you. They have a few benches for seating also. The menu (as mentioned above) is huge. Tons and tons of flavors and all kinds of sundaes. The staff were very patient and friendly while we perused the menu. Samples are freely offered. I opted for the brownie sundae with blueberry cobbler ice cream. Wow! The brownie was awesome, and the ice cream was absolutely like blueberry cobbler. This was topped with hot fudge just for a few extra calories. It was excellent! The ice cream was creamy and the brownie perfect and fudgey. The next time you're craving ice cream try Handel's!! You will be glad you did!!

You scream! I scream! We all scream for Handel's ice cream! Handel's makes the best ice cream on this side of the strip! I frequent here a lot during the summer but noticed I never reviewed them. Today being hot and humid required a lovely melting cone of chocolate pecan one of my favorite flavors. Handel's has been around since 1945 and makes their ice cream fresh in the store and they hail from Ohio. They have cones, cups, sandwiches, and pops so get your ice cream the way you want it. You can also order pints to go of your fav flavors. Even with Covid19 still on the prowl, this location is all about being outside with social distancing! The service is always friendly from the young kids who work here which makes it an even more desirable place to return to. If you haven't been here yet, what are you waiting for???

Tried handels as i saw they are supposed to be made by hand daily. Got a 4 scoop sampler w pistachio, chocolate marshmellow, hazelnut w nutella, and salty caramel truffle. Prices are good. The ice cream was good but a bit salty. The texture was nice and creamy It did melt pretty quick but that would be expected on fresh made ice cream. I will definitley give them another shot and try some more flavors.

Yooo!!!! This place has a loooong wait but you watch them scoop it fresh and it's so so good you'll want to come back right away. I tried the 4 pack so I could taste several flavors. I wasn't a huge fan of the Graham cracker flavor everyone recommended but the others were all very good.

We have been back to Handel's a few times with disappointing customer service on multiple occasions. We waited in line for approximately 20 minutes on each trip. My boys received Handel's gift cards for their birthday. We went over to get their birthday treats and they told me their gift card machine was broken. Um ok. Way to make that money Handel's. I coughed up the cash. We returned, again, to use their gift cards. I was told their was no money on the gift cards. I coughed up the cash again. If you read my previous review, I got a different ice cream than I ordered. This time, I ordered a cup, I got a cone. Fool me twice, wait three times....we won't go back.

Great little place but it's not a place to hang out as there's no inside seating. There's a few benches and grassy area, but the storefront is located at the entrance of the strip mall. There's 100's of flavors to choose from, and they even have flavors of the month. You can ask for a sample, especially for those with vague descriptions like Graham Central Station. Prices aren't cheap, about $3.50 for a scoop. It was a nice scoop, and you can even say a generous scoop, but its still one scoop of ice cream. Was it the best ice cream I've ever had? Hmm, not sure. It was good, and it hit the spot on a warm Memorial Day evening.

I can't stop coming here, and it doesn't help that this location is minutes away from my home. I really love that the ice cream is made in-house, and the story that goes behind this business. I like to think that I'm somewhat of an ice cream connoisseur (I mean, what ice cream lover wouldn't think so of themselves), and the sweet treats here are TO DIE FOR. I can't tell you what my favorite is because they all are (except for maybe grape). When bananas foster is around, that would probably be my go-to, but graham central station is so unique and delicious that it would be my overall new favorite ice cream flavor. Definitely stop by, even if the line is long, because taking home a pint is worth it.
This place has the most amazing icecream flavors and such an awesome friendly staff!! I'm so glad I'm within 5min of this place because Handel's is the best!

STOP!!! This is what I observed during my visit tonight Saturday March 20, 2021 at 9:15 PM. The same staff member that takes your order and money goes to the dipping case to scoop your ice cream without washing his hands or wearing a pair of gloves. At best, this is not sanitary and worst they could be spreading COVID-19. We all know that money is filthy and we should wash our hands after handling it. The unsafe practices at the establishment should be criminal. God know just how many unsuspecting customers caught the COVID-19 virus from this place.
Very good ice cream fr best out there!! So yummy and soft. My favorite is that coffee flavor one !
This is the best by far ice cream in Las Vegas I am not a big fan of ice cream but at handles I get ice cream at least three times a week and the workers know what I want by heart what a great place

Showed up and the one attendant they had working was sweeping while not wearing a mask or gloves. Then went straight to the register when a customer arrived (who also was not wearing a mask) and began to take his order, take his money, scoop his ice cream, and serve him without even washing his hands first, using hand sanitizer, or putting gloves or any kind of mask on. My girlfriend and I just walked away and drove off.....I'd rather pick up some Thrifty's ice cream than support a business that doesn't care enough about their customers or society as a whole to even just wash their hands, let alone at least wear a mask.

Great ice cream but mask policy is non existent. Outside or not there are often a lot of massless customers in line not social distancing. I mostly won't go because it's so unsafe. The owner needs to put a mandate in place and enforce it. No mask no shoes no service.

I enjoy great ice cream and this place didn't disappoint. It was a hot day in Las Vegas so I stopped in after lunch. Went with the waffle cone with black cherry and strawberry ice cream which was yummy and generous in portion. They don't have any indoor seating, but they do have a few benches you can kick back at. Overall, totally yummy ice cream and a good place for satisfying my sweet tooth!

Meh. After all of the positive reviews I expected something better, instead I felt like I could have done a blind tasting with Baskin Robbin's ice cream and I wouldn't be able to tell them apart. It's nice that they offer a huge list of flavors, malts, & shakes but I took a couple bites of mine and tossed it. The guy at the register was really nice and offered suggestions to someone in my group who didn't know what to order, and the ice cream was ready quickly despite the long line. No place to sit aside from two benches, so be prepared to park it in your car if you don't want the ice cream to instantly melt in our 105 degree weather!

OMG. Came here from a recommendation from a coworker and was not disappointed. Ice cream here is delicious and generous! I can't say "best ice cream ever" but it's definitely worth a visit. ITS WINDOW SERVICE ONLY so don't get confused and try to open any of the doors. I got a double scoop of Oreo and cookie dough. Food was creamy and sweet. Definitely high quality ice cream. Overall, great option if you had a great meal and need something sweet. Highly recommended.
Ice cream is great here but the staff and service needs some training. And you need a better ordering system to eliminate errors and confusion...

Yum yum yum. Fresh creamy and just really delicious ! This ice cream shop is a take out or delivery. You order at the exterior windows and can sit at the benches they have on the side of the store or have the ice cream delivered. Either way it is so worth you to go snd try. This by far is the best ice cream I have ever had. You can tell they use the best ingredients and it's fresh. So many different flavors to choose from that you have to keep going back to try different flavors. Located in the Smiths shopping center so there is plenty of parking and it is the corner store so easy to find.
Ice cream was amazing! Chocolate chunk. Drove all the way to Summerlin and the ice cream was worth it. Very friendly too and not too pricy.

Great flavors but I'm docking a star for portion size. I've eaten at other locations and the portions are significantly larger. These were notably small and one of our orders was given to the wrong person and we got hassled about it. They ultimately remade it but we thought for a moment that they were going to try and charge us to remake it. If the flavors hadn't been so strong, I would have given one or two less stars for the overall experience.

The ice cream is delicious. The servers are friendly. The wait....had to wait in line, only 2 windows open, then again it was a Monday around 3pm. But, it appeared to me that it's social hour for the employees. They spent more time talking, and less time working to serve the people in line. I would definitely go back, but hopefully service will be faster. After all, I spent over $40.00 while I was there. When I was a kid, the boss used to tell us "no talking" while it was busy. Ah, the good ol' days.

This is probably the best ice cream I have ever had. I had the Blue Monster and I love it. I went in wanting the Graham central station but it was sold out. My 2nd choice black Walnut was too, that is ok because my 3rd choice was so good. Great customer service skill as well.
Was craving something sweet and came upon this place. I ordered a milkshake and it was huge. This place has many flavors to choose from which is awesome.

My boyfriend and I come here all the time! Nothing beats Handel's and if anyone hasn't tried it- they're missing out! Definitely compares to buying ice cream from the grocery store. This ice cream is hand made by Patrick directly inside the location and tastes AMAZING! The flavor variety is so enormous. With that said, it's best to do the Four scoop sampler! Each scoop is a great size for a great price of $4.25. I personally get: Chocolate PB brownie, mint chocolate, birthday cake, and green tea! They also have frosty paws if you have a puppers! Oh and PS to a previous reviewer below complaining about not liking the idea of standing outside.... It differentiates the shop from the others and it restores the old days... Plus, the ice cream is so damn good I'll wait no matter how cold or hot it is outside lmao.

Growing up in the Midwest means that as a child I got to experience the ice cream flavor that is "Blue Moon". Recently I had a craving for this particular flavor and learned that it really is only common in the Midwest, so the hunt to find it out here was on. I stumbled upon Handel's on Yelp and to my excitement I saw that they had Blue Moon as a constant flavor. I was a little worried going up to the window and seeing a picture of the Blue Moon flavor being listed as "blue raspberry flavored" (because Blue Moon is NOT blue raspberry) but decided to try it out as I went all that way for it specifically. And it was perfect. It was the correct Blue Moon flavor and it was so creamy and delicious. I recommend this flavor completely. I don't know how to describe the taste other than "kind of like fruity pebbles" but trust me, it's awesome. I also got to try a bite of the Nutella/chocolate hazelnut flavor (yum) and while eating our ice cream we were already talking about what we'd want to try next time! I honestly can't wait to come back and try more ice cream flavors here. I love that this is a local business and I adore that they sell hard packed ice cream, which is so hard to find in the valley. Their pricing is fair for a non-chain hard packed ice cream shop, and it's even cheaper on Tuesdays when they offer single scoops for $2. I completely recommend this shop (and their Blue Moon) and I can't wait to go back again.

The ice cream is good and there are many flavors. Coconut cream pie is my favorite, but they do not always have it. My issue is that they brag about generous portions but ours were not. This is two scoops. While I usually take two days to eat it I had no problem finishing it in one sitting.

The ice cream was good. The two stars are for the cranky employee who served us. First, he wouldn't give me a sample of their Ice cream flavors, I wanted to try the Carmel Apple. He said it was due to the the long line (line was only 5 people deep after us with 3 windows open), but then he said, "Just one sample". When he returned with the one sample, I was there with 2 other people that were too scared to even ask for a sample, because the employee was so snappy. Secondly, when we ordered, one of my people said, she wanted the salted Carmel Ice Cream in a cone. The employee said the ice cream is somewhat melted and suggested a cup. We asked for a sugar cone on top of the cup so she could crunch the sugar cone into the ice cream. We did that also with the Carmel Apple and the cookie dough ice creams. Finally, to my surprise, the employee charged me for the sugar cones! .25 each, not nice to charge you on the back end of 2 buck Tuesday (where the single scoop is two bucks) deal. There goes your tip, Mr. Cranky employee!! Also, remember, Mr. Cranky, you were the one that said the ice cream was melty and suggested a cup. So, I guess two buck Tues is not really two bucks, if people are charged for the sugar cone. On the other hand, their ice cream was good, creamy and actually had good apple flavor and ribbons of carmel. If you do go, just be warned the sugar cones are .25 more if you get your ice cream in a cup.

Yum Yum Yum I had 3 very happy little boys who got 3 Giant scoops of Delish Ice Cream!! And only 2 Bucks on Tuesdays!! Very happy Mommy and wallet too!! I personally had the Orange Cream Dream!!! So good!! We'll see ya next Tueaday!!

My continuing mission to discover nondairy ice creams (Ice dessert) in Las Vegas has brought me to Handel's. The mission is also to pursue those icy sweet indulgences while preserving my fragile digestive system. This time, mission was a success. Handel's has three nondairy options: 1) Coconut, 2) Watermelon Ice, and 3) Mango. They are all distinctly fantastic. Three options may seem measly, but this is the most I've seen in a ice cream shop thus far. Coconut is my favorite fruit; messing it up would have instantly made the mission a presumptive failure. Luckily, Handel's coconut ice "cream" blew me out of the water. The coconut was not overpoweringly sweet--something I value highly. The coconut flavor was subtle just like a real coconut. More impressive was the soft coconut flesh hidden in the ice cream, they added some welcoming texture which also retained the flavor a bit longer in the mouth once the cream portion happily melts away. Needlessly to say, Handle's coconut ice cream was a resounding victory. The Watermelon Ice flavor was equally impressive. As the name suggests, this is just ice with presumably watermelon juice. The lack of creamy taste is a refreshing contrast to the coconut. Again, no overpowering sugar taste here, each spoonful filled with potent watermelon flavor. The texture is soft but does not have that sandy texture most shaved ice have. It almost feels like crushed watermelon flesh. Pretty cool. I only had a little bit of the mango because I am just not a big fan of the fruit. However, I will not be hesitant to recommend the mango flavor to those who love mango--It had the same great attributes the coconut flavor had. My mission to discover nondairy ice desserts continues on, but it could have ended with Handel's. If you miss out on ice cream because of dairy, Handle's got you covered.

No joke, best ice cream I've ever had! You can tell it's homemade! It's fresh, creamy smooth and delicious! We got 3 pints and 1 scoop for $22 buck and that was a killer deal! My favorite is the strawberry cheesecake! Needless to say that pint is already gone..opps! Can't wait to try more of their amazing flavors! This place beats Dairy Queen, baskin robins and cold stone out of the water! YUMMMMMM
We went to get ice cream and ice cream sandwiches it was so delicious but the wait was so long I love it but I don't think I like waiting that long in line for ice cream but it was so delicious.

Best ice cream in town! Went here on a Tuesday and got a single soup just for a $2.75! Always love seeing families come out to enjoy some ice cream. I especially love this place because of all their different flavors and their huge proportions! The pistachio flavor is my personal favorite (on the sugar shell cone). Today I also got the sampler with four different flavors- strawberry cheesecake, Reese's pieces, matcha, and butter pecan. One day I will try all their flavors! Can't wait to go again

My family and I are always trying places we never been before and we stumbled upon Handel's, glad we did. There banana split is award winning, great priced ($6.25) fresh toppings and large portion. They only have a walk up window to order with usually two windows open, but their is always a line, it's worth waiting for!

Handel's is by far the best ice cream in Las Vegas. It's approximately one million degrees outside this time of year, so ice cream is a must. Luckily, Handel's has tons of flavors to choose from, ranging from sorbets to ice creams. My personal favorite is the Nutella flavor, but I've tried many of their flavors and have never been disappointed. They also have a $2.50/scoop deal on Tuesdays which is simply unbeatable! My only gripe would be the customer service. I'm pretty sure I've never been thanked or smiled at here, however, the ice cream makes up for that.
Best ice cream in Vegas! A variety of flavors and different presentations. The kids that work there are great!

Don't be fooled by the amateur poster designs adorning Handel's windows: This is by far the best ice cream joint that I've experienced ANYWHERE! If you're trying to decide on which flavor to try first, go for the Graham Central Station. It will not disappoint. None of the flavors will, really. And all the awesome serving combination options they have?! Even a giant oreo cookie sandwich with your choice of ice cream flavor in the middle?! Fuhhhhh. I'm so glad my house isn't located closer to this place. This is a must-try for my out-of-towner friends that visit Vegas in the summer. I always purposely order too much and then put the leftovers in my freezer. Literally, as I was typing this, I took out some of my leftovers to finish because it just sounded so good. And it is.

None of the employees are wearing any kind of masks gloves our any thing to prevent them from infecting the ice cream will they lean over the freezer and scoop multiple times in a row.. the kid say there inches from my daughters ice cream taking to us through the window 3 different times. I made her scoop the top scoop off and throw away the spoon before she ate half of what she order... Im not going back and risking eating uncooked food with no precautions to keep from contaminating everything. Not just what that are Scooping but every container in every freezer they lean over and drool on. If you aren't going to do it right DON'T REOPEN!!!! The ice cream is always great but good me a goddamn break.. How do you not even Provide a way to safely serve n uncooked food item. You are not essential and shouldn't be able to remain open.

I loved this ice cream place in California and when I saw it here I SCREAMED! I am pretty sure it was a freezing winter night, but that didn't stop me from ordering. The variety here is amazing and every flavor is creamy and delicious. There is something here for everyone! Always get the 4 scoop sampler because it is such a good deal! 4 large scoops for $4.25 If you tried to order 4 scoops at Cold*****, prepare to pay an arm and a leg, #justsayin. You'll want 4 scoops because you won't be able to pick one! If you think you can't finish it, bring it home and freeze it. Your future self will thank you, I promise. Some of my favorites include graham central station, blue monster, and blueberry cobbler. The line may look long but it moves fast. The workers and the way their store is set up are very efficient. They will also let you try samples, so don't be shy.

Seriously really good ice cream, excellent texture and tons of flavors to choose from. Love the set-up, old school walk up to the counter window. This place has a nice old fashioned vibe that is very comforting. Will definitely be back!

Great variety of flavors that taste absolutely amazing!!! I highly recommend doing the 4-scoop sampler to get a variety. Only downside is waiting in a long line (we waited about 25 minutes on a weekend evening) outside in the heat and then having to eat your ice cream as quickly as possible before it turns into a puddle. But I'll be going back again and again...

Well, damn it now that I know this plane exists - how am I supposed to control myself? My friend James posted about this place and their Graham Central ice cream. When I read about it I immediately thought - Graham cracker ice cream =yuck! But I saw they had Butter Toffee as one of the flavors.... I literally drove there the next morning, arriving right as they open. This place doesn't have any open to public doors... just walk up windows but the ice cream speaks for itself! Dani was the absolute best. You can tell she loves her job and is very helpful in choosing flavors. I asked about the Butter Toffee, but she informed they don't have it but recommended I try the Graham Canyon... Begrudgingly, I said OK.... But was already trying to figure out what other flavor I'd really order. HOLY MOLY Graham Canyon is the best ice cream I've every had. Graham cracker ice cream with delicious pieces of butter toffee... I'm seriouy in love. Highly recommend this place. Delicious ice cream & amazing customer service! Great job, Handel's!
This is the best place for ice cream. It gets busy at night, but it's worth the wait. I go here all the time haha
Disappointed. No sugar free flavor available and employee just said "no" when I asked if nutritional information was available. Expected more. The vegan mango sorbet was just ok.

The best ice cream in the world!!! My Go To is the strawberry. The sweetness is just right and the strawberry flavor is perfect. A lot of other places the flavor is dull and they just focus on the sweetness. Handels has that perfect balance between the two. If you want to Treat Yo Self, I recommend the strawberry cheesecake. Which is basically half ice cream and half cheesecake. It's almost too sweet for me but like I said. Treat Yo Self. They have specials on Tuesdays but the line is too dreadful for me. I don't mind paying full price so I go on the days is not busy. Maybe they should implement some kind of system where you pick a number and wait to be called? Other than that, this place is a must!

Frankly I don't know what people like about it. To me this gelato just doesn't taste very good and I give it 3 stars because I am in a good mood. It's not terrible just not the place I would frequent (come again)

Went with my brother and my niece tonight. Holy crap. I've never seen an ice cream place so packed before. That being said, there was a lot of confusion to just how many lines there were. Anyway, we eventually got our ice cream and it was well worth the wait. A little pricey but will probably be back once COVID goes away.

I'm originally from Cleveland OH. Everyone loves Handel's from back home. Moved to Vegas awhile ago and I started getting cravings. Happy to find a Handel's right down the street. Best ice cream in the country.

I scream for ice cream!!! Loved this joint. Came here on a Tuesday but i must warn you it is busy because of $2 ice cream on Tuesdays. Though its busy, I barely waited 10 minutes. As you stand in line, I suggest you take a picture of the menu and choose it before they take your order. It just makes the process much faster. I got the 4 scoop sampler for $4.25. Beat that Baskin Robins. Anyways, it comes in a clear container. You could also order a side cone or waffle but I just had sushi so I was a bit stuffed. I chose the blue monster (chips ahoy & oreos), strawberry, watermelon, and pineapple. So colorful and bomb!! They all had great flavor. The watermelon and blue monster were my fav. No seating so we sat in the back of the truck (Hawaii Style).

Wasn't like the most incredible customer service, but i'm sure they were exhausted and over working over 4th of July. Nonetheless, graham central station was STUPID good. The flavor was recommended by the associate that was assisting us. We did get charged $.75 on one of our cones for chocolate syrup that probably ended up more so on all the napkins/the floor while the associate was transferring the cone to up. Word to the wise: Even if you order a single scoop, you can 100% share.

WE NEVER SKIMP... that's a lie. I've been to Handel's multiple times and have enjoyed great service, knowledgeable staff, and great portion sizes. However, I was very upset with my most recent experience. The employee was untrained so he was not familiar with the menu and gave us portions that were half the size of everyone one else around us. When I had asked for my ice cream to be served in a sugar cone instead of a dish he said that it would be an extra charge, even though it says that the Tuesday special includes a sugar cone and I've never been charged extra for a sugar cone in my past visits. He also was not familiar with what the Boston Cooler was, and when we asked for a Boston Cooler with banana cream pie ice cream, he was confused what it was and instead of clarifying if that was not doable he charged us for both the float and the ice cream separately. Usually, when we receive our ice cream it fills up the entire cup and then some, and our portion was a tiny measly scoop that filled up half the cup at best. They really need to train their employees better before putting them at the front of service. Having this terrible experience due to an untrained employee has greatly tainted my view of this place. Ice cream was pretty good tho
Have been here every night made the drive from mgm to try the sampler. It is the best. Great service totally delicious
Ice cream is good but service is slow-we are in line but barely moving and it is extremely hot.

Best ice cream in Las Vegas. Do not have indoor seating but there are a few benches around. Always a line. Chocolate marshmallow is the best! Can also get 4 scoop sampler to try a few different flavors. Well worth the trip. No bathrooms available in the area, Have to go to Smiths market

I had a craving late at night like most of us do, I thought I'd look around for ice cream other than your basic ice cream stores like Baskin robins or Yogurtland. Found this place and give it a try, I ordered 4 different flavors ( Oreo, Coffee Chip, Black Cherry, and Vanilla) just to see what they were about. My absolute favorite was Black cherry followed by coffee chip, it reminded me of the Thrifty ice cream I used to get, but with so much more natural flavors. If your on the west side of Las Vegas, this place is a MUST!

I got a quart of the Oreo vanilla ice cream. It is so creamy and amazing, however I am genuinely disappointed in the amount of Oreo in the ice cream. It seems to be all vanilla with just steaks of Oreo throughout. I can barely taste the Oreo at all. It just tastes like vanilla I really wish they would add more to make it actually taste like Oreos.

Handel's has amazing ice cream customer service is wonderful however I love the pecan praline ice cream and pecans had that old rancid taste..and I've noticed over the last several months they hardly put any pralines or caramel in it it's just like vanilla ice cream now with a couple of pecans and I wish they would be consistent and put more stuff in it otherwise I might as well just or vanilla ice cream and I had told them about it a couple months ago and I just got some more last night and it's still the same

Ice cream and shakes- 5 stars. Teens that don't want to work or answer the phone like it's a joke- 1 star. Too bad, the service is a deterrent to a great product. I give the owners a lot of credit to have a primarily teenage workforce, and like with all employees- it takes that ONE to create the blanket that everyone gets put under.

I have eaten a lot of ice cream, in my lifetime, and I can honestly say, that this is some of the best ice cream, that I've ever eaten in my entire life. I go there frequently, and the chocolate peanut butter brownie, is top notch! I go here at least three times a week! Highly recommended....
Must try once. Its not super sweet like other ice cream places. Price are reasonable as well.

A wonderfully sweet and creamy delight! Handel's has been our Friday night traditional for almost a year now and we live a solid 20 minutes away. There are SOOOO many flavors to try. The best thing to order is the 4 flavor sampler. BEST WAY to order it? Ask your cashier their favorite 4 flavors. I have tried 1-3 new flavors every time coming and they're always SOOO good. I don't think I have a favorite but I love them all equally. From traditional flavors like pistachio, vanilla, and chocolate to nutter butter, chocolate chip coffee, monkey business, blueberry cobbler and the list literally goes on.. The staff are all young but I've always had great customer service! They offer call in pick up for pints and quarts which makes it easy to swing by. I usually order pints over the phone and a sample tray when I get there just to save time ;) If you're a fan of Basken Robbins it's time to up your game at Handel's

Genuinely the best ice cream available in vegas. If you plan on going do yourself a favor and get a pint , quart or two to take home. Favorites are graham central station, buckeye, chocolate peanut butter brownie , birthday cake and salted caramel truffle. Their hurricanes are amazing as well, far superior than that of a blizzard. Only necessity during the summer heat are perhaps the need for awnings or misters as the lines are long and it gets hot waiting for vegas' best dessert. Must try if you're on the west side and always a great idea to call in advance for pick up / to go orders.
Always a great treat especially now with smaller lines than in the summer. The staff is awesome and there is no better quality ice cream to be found anywhere else since 1945!

The ice cream here is always amazing. It's soooooo creamy! I also love all the flavor options which rotate weekly or monthly. I just wish they could enforce mask-wearing among patrons. Some customers were good and considerate while others decided they were above others' safety. I don't expect Handel's workers to police too much, but they could certainly refuse service to those not wearing masks. I ordered 2 pints: one coffee w/choc chips, another choc malt w/caramel. Love love loved the coffee flavor! So delicious. The fam finished that quickly. The choc malt is tasty, but a bit on the ultra sweet side. Also, I was hoping for caramel ribbons. You can't really see any caramel. I suppose it's mixed in? Anyway, still, delicious ice cream!

Drove a long way to try what I was told was the best ice cream in Vegas. When I got there the employees were not wearing masks. I wish they would advertise: "Hey everyone, come get your Covid here!" Not today, satan. Not today.

Bought extra thick cookies and cream milkshake. I couldn't drink it fast enough with a straw. Extremely runny from the time it was handed to me. Clerks were friendly as they took my money and handed me my liquid shake.
