Let me start by saying that the quality of their ice cream is good, however, I called to ask if they had a product that they've been out of for months and the owner/manager responds that he wouldn't put something up if he didn't have it. However, I've come here before, and it was posted as if I they had it in stock, only to find out that they didn't have it due to supply issues. Bottom line: he was rude, unprofessional and quite frankly a jerk! I will never patronize this business again!

Their ice cream is nice and creamy. Perfect to cool off fm the hot weather of Las Vegas. The staff is quick and gives you your order right away. I tried the sample of 4 different ice cream. I like the praline pecan not too sweet and just enough pecan from every scoop. Definitely worth coming back even during the cold weather
Owner contacted me and has the same arrogant and absurd attitude as his employees. Much better ice cream and FAR better service at Gelatology on Rainbow.

Can you 'Handel' it?!?! The ice cream, that is. I am glad and also not glad I found this little dessert stand just because I love sweets but my waistline/jeans DO NOT....sadly. I came because it was recommended by a friend as her favorite place for ice cream. There is a large window/menu of options and plenty of pictures because they are worth a thousand words. Little mural/back story on the side of the building stating how it all got started in Ohio. I tried the 4 Sampler so I can try different flavors. So I got birthday cake, praline pecan, black cherry, and salted caramel. For me, ice cream HAS to be frozen like a rock for me to enjoy it. I guess I'll just have to call it "sticks-to-the-roof-of-your-mouth" frozen and NO - that does not roll off the tongue (intentional) From now on, Black Cherry is a must and it tastes just like cherries jubilee at another 'ahem' ice cream parlor. Birthday cake was good too has frozen buttercream and rainbow sprinkles/jimmies if you're east coast. Praline pecan is like butter pecan to me and they have that too.... Salted caramel was okay...it gets soft on me tooo quickly (even though I stored in freezer for a day). Service is pretty efficient as they greet you right away if you're standing there which is great. They seem like young kids which I think goes with vibe (y'know you're getting old when everyone seems younger) But otherwise this place is like....TOTALLY TUBULAR...or some junk...and I truly cannot wait to go back. :)

Simply THE BEST ice cream you will ever eat. Personally, my husband and I love the Graham Central Station flavor, my daughter obsesses over the blue monster, needless to say the flavors are all delish.
Ice cream is good, but the workers don't wear masks when customers aren't close by. They are all very close to each other inside. Unfortunate they aren't taking things seriously.

Can I just start by saying there's always room for dessert no matter how full you may be. I love ice cream so again, this may be biased. There is something so satisfying about a thick, creamy quality home made ice cream. The ice cream here is delicious! They offer a wide variety of flavors for everyone. Sample as many as you want before you decide. Prices are reasonable and staff is very friendly. Check out their 4 scoop sampler for $4.25 or stop by on Tuesdays for their $2 - 2 scoop special. I've never had to wait long for my order to be taken care of. My fav ice cream flavors are Graham Central Station & Banana Cream Pie. They rotate flavors fairly often so it's always nice to try something new! Just FYI - There's some outdoor seating but nothing indoors. Still worth the drive here!
Ice cream is always tasty. The staff is always the best. I'd go there anyday...right in the neighborhood. High quality product

Having visited the Original in Youngstown Ohio many years ago, I have to say the Vegas outpost stays true to the original. Super clean creamery, robust taste on all of the flavors. Super creamy. If this is your first time get the 4 flavor sampler pack and add a cone on top for the crunch. Service is quick at the window. Portions are generous, a multitude of flavors each day. Will definitely put this on dessert rotation even though we live in Southern Highlands and it's a bit of a drive. Highly recommend.

Delicious homemade ice cream waffle bowl was thin & crispy. Salty Caramel Truffle was yummy with lots of mini chocolate caramel truffles in it. Blueberry Cobbler had lots of blueberries and mint chip was refreshing & very minty!

This is quite possibly our FAVORITE dessert places! It's a cute walk up ice cream shop that is often busy because all of the ice cream is home made and to DIE for. The Blondie sundae is...perfect. Graham Central Station is a MUST and their four scoop sampler is probably one of the best values I have ever seen. Patrick, the owner is absolutely awesome really cares about taking care of his customers and it shows! Everything is made with quality ingredients that you can totally taste. It's a MUST STOP!
We had the chocolate and banana ice cream. Was good. I had pralines and cream for the second time, and again the pralines tasted old. Too expensive for the amount you get.

Amazing ice cream and please expect a wait as you would at any other incredible small business that is very popular. The selection is vast and the staff is super friendly. I personally love the black cherry and the blueberry cheesecake chunk. As a dessert junkie I keep going back and am grateful for this place.

Turns out, many if the Flavors they advertise are not available. I had 3 Quarts picked out to take home and not 1 was available.. So went home empty handed..Some might say that falls under the Bait n Switch category.. Too bad..

My husband and I have been looking for an ice cream place that serves a legit homemade taste ice cream. This place is the place! Their ice cream is really creamy and it tasted rich in flavor. They usually have a long line but it's worth the wait.
Pre and post COVID, Handel's is the bomb. Service, Product, Price can't be beat. Don't know why I had been wasting my time at Cold Stones. If you find a Handel's near you stop by you won't regret it.
One of the best ice cream places I've had in awhile. They have a platter for 4 flavors!! One of my favorite ice cream there is the Cookie Monster!

Excellent choices of ice cream flavors and absolutely delicious. I had the Keylime and I loved it. It was well worth the wait in the long line even with the Covid restrictions. The lines did move fairly quick though. The Help was friendly and accommodating. Reasonably priced and home made.... that makes all the difference. We will definitely come back again.

Wow wow wow, this place has some amazing ice cream options! I am all about the fun flavors. They have a sampler for 4 scoops of different types of ice cream ($4ish dollars, such a good deal!) so I could try a few flavors! My favorites were the graham central station and the coconut cream pie for originality and some awesome chunks of yumminess mixed inside. Will definitely be back!

Craving some ice cream on a Sunday evening, I decided to check out Handel's Homemade Ice Cream. Located in a busy shopping center anchored by a Smith's , I noticed the line building in front of Handel's as I pulled into the parking lot. At first glance there is a long list of flavors to choose from and a few stood out for my first time. There were 3 open windows to order from so the line went pretty quickly as customers seemed to know what they wanted. My turn to order I decided to try a scoop of chocolate chip cookie dough on a cake cone. The chocolate chip cookie dough was amazing and just the right amount of sweetness and texture. I wanted to try other flavors so I ordered a 4 flavor sampler pack which is a great value for first time at Handel's. The four flavors in the sampler pack were Coconut Milk Ice Cream, Graham Central Station, Vanilla Oreo and Oree Dough. All of the flavors were amazing but my favorite was the Coconut Milk Ice Cream which has no dairy but a great flavor and texture plus coconut chunks inside for a nice touch. Definitely going back to Handel's ASAP!

Delicious! My go-to is the Chocolate Marshmallow, since I'm a big fan of Rocky Road (they don't have the exact Rocky Road flavor), so it is the next best thing. The "Blue Monster" is another one of my favorites. I recommend this flavor if you are a fan of chocolate chip or Oreo cookies, as it is a blend of both. I'm usually not a big fan of dairy, but the ice cream here is great, does not have a milky taste whatsoever, & is also homemade! Don't let the long line scare you, as it moves very quickly. They have Tuesday ice cream specials with discounted scoops. This is a must-visit! I've brought family and friends here multiple times and they have always enjoyed our visits with the friendly staff and great ice cream!

Ice cream is literally SO good but the only complaint I have is the line to get your ice cream the line is always so long and they usually only have two windows open so it's not the quickest place ti get ice cream.
I scream! You scream! We all scream when we see how long the line for this place is but then we get the ice cream and remember that it is 100% worth it. Order online and save a little time, though.

One of the best I've cream places in town! Everything is home made and amazing! Every time we go there is a line because so many people want it. The great thing is you can buy pints and take it home! The s'mores is my favorite!
Best ice cream ever!. Staff is very courteous and friendly. I would like to highlight the diversity of flavors and toppings.

I didn't review this place before??? How?!?! May be I wanted to keep this gem all to myself... With the product Handel's offers, it would be quite impossible. The icecream here is spectacular! Soooo many flavors, sooo creamy, sooo chunky, flavors are sooo well pronounced! Let me just say, I love chunky icecream! I love when it has chunks of what ever deliciousness I desire mixed in it. Handel's does just that. Not all flavors are chunky but ofcourse the ones I loved are :) My faves? Blueberry cobbler, banana cream pie, salted caramel with chocolate covered pretzels- sooo magical!!! Another bonus, there's a sampler pack - 4 flavors for $4.25. Amazing deal for high quality ice cream. So there it goes, cat's out the bag... Handel's is the crack!
May be the best ice cream in Las Vegas. Butter pecan is the best I've ever had. Expect a line, especially on a hot summer night. Tuesday still offers the $2.50 special.

My favorite ice cream ever!!!! The only problem is that it's addicting lol Can't get enough of it. They also have ice cream for dogs, which my dog totally loves!! On Christmas time they have a flavor called "peppermint stick": You have to try it!!

Is this the best ice cream ever? No. But I guess people go cuz it's inexpensive and tastes good enough. I got a 4 scoop combo for less than $5. What a deal. Spouse like a house was my fave flavor. A great choice for peanut butter lovers. I'm not a huge fan but this was gooooood. Oh man, it was like eating Reese's butter cups but an ice cream version or something. Imagine a cold or sit butter mouse cake. Mmmmmmmmm. We also got grape. Such an odd choice but this was also my top fave flavor. Would def go back for these two. I think I'll skip the Oreo and the salted caramel. I'd rather eat Haagen Daz for Oreo or that fancy shmancy McConell's salted caramel which is only sold at whole foods. Will be back for SPOUSE LIKE A IZZ HOUSEEEEEE. In da Handel's house southwest saaaiiiiiiide!
Graham central station best flavor hands down! We come here every couple weeks! The staff is super friendly and nice and the ice cream is always amazing!
Awesome ice cream chain from Ohio. The staff was so friendly. Kids got huge 2 scoop waffle bowls and I got an extra thick chocolate milk shake!

Somewhat of a shitshow location run by teenagers with half assed customer service and management. I dont get the rave reviews considering this is an overhyped Baskin Robins and only tried out as I live in the Southwest. Yes they have tons of flavors but with nothing special about the quality at all as I beyond expected compared to ice cream from the grocery store. So many better ice cream shops on Rainbow alone from Gelatology and Asia Creamery where there are so many unique delicious flavors, tropical or savory, among the quality being much more fresh and not sickly sweet. Complete pass for me here as nothing stands out aside from the complete lack of managment and a well run environment. Sticking to my staples from now on!
Love Handels and their unique flavors! Especially love their 4 scoop sampler for the value and option to try more flavors!

Delicious and generous amounts scooped here! They might be a little more expensive than Baskin Robbins, but they are so much better! A wide variety of flavors and seasonal ones to boot! I decided to go with the snickerdoodle cookie and mint ice cream. I am a huge fan of mint ice cream and this ice cream was not your average mint ice cream. I could taste that it was made with fresh mint and it was delicious! Can't wait to bring our friends here to try it out!

I've been looking for a good ice cream spot in Las Vegas for the longest time. It's near South Summerlin, so it's probably far from a lot of people in Vegas. It is conveniently located for me. Recently, I took a trip to Portland and had Salt & Straws homemade ice cream. I knew nothing could top that, and thus started my mission for finding a decent homemade ice cream place back home. I came upon this on yelp, gave it a try, and it's amazing. They hand make all the ice creams fresh in the morning (supposedly) and it shows. It is so creamy, delicious, and they have TONS of flavors. You can get bars, popsicles, scoops, cones, sandwiches, shakes, smoothies, you name it. It's very traditional in a stand outside the window and order kind of way. It also has $2.50 Tuesday's. Even if you order a single scoop here, I'm not sure if it's just a thing at Handel's, but they always give you 2+ scoops.

Being a first time customer I wanted to try a few pints and see what grabbed me. I should have gotten the sampler plate. I would have gotten the taste of all 4 for a better bang for my buck. The gram central station - I liked it a lot, if you're a fan of the gram, it's for you. Chocolate peanut butter was good. 90% dark chocolate. We got a couple others that were tasty, not sure I'd drive to the other part of town for them again. But if I'm in the neighborhood it's a good stop.

I fell in love with this place when I used to visit my now husband in Indianapolis. It was my sister's suggestion and boy was it a winner! So back when we lived in Vegas, I made note of the fact that there was one here, too! Well, we finally made it happen last weekend when we were vacationing without the kids. It was the perfect place to meet a friend and sit and chat on a bench in the nice weather! It should be noted that you can't go inside. You order at a window and can sit on one of the four or five benches provided. There was plenty of room when we went on a Sunday afternoon. Try not to be overwhelmed by the expansive menu! They are more than happy to grab samples if you're indecisive like me. While I did try a few new flavors, my old favorites were definitely the way to go. Hubby and I shared a four scoop sample of Birthday Cale, Blackberry Chocolate Chip, Graham Central Station and Peanut Butter Brownie. Graham Central is one I used to get all the time. The ice cream itself has the perfect graham flavor, crumbles of actual graham cracker and chocolate covered honey comb (which gives the best crunch!). Looking back, I shouldn't have shared and should've just gotten Graham and Brownie because those are my favorites and my sweet tooth is bottomless. Lol. So hopefully we'll make it to another Handel's again soon!
Quality ice cream! Love when I eat ice cream that isn't full of sugar to make up for the lack of taste. We ordered 3 different flavors and all were fantastic.

Great customer service. I feel like their ice cream is better than it was when we first started going, maybe because they have become so popular, the ice cream is turned over so often. Great prices too. We love taking our dog, we can walk right up to the window with him. Perfect on a summer evening.

Wow! This is my second time here at Handel's and it's just as great as the first. The flavor section is vast and delicious. I tried the 4 scoop sampler (great deal) and ended up falling in love with the New York Cheesecake. If you like cheesecake, you will be hooked. Seriously, it's to die for. I want to eat for breakfast and pretty much any meal. Not only are the flavors rich, but it tastes fresh. You can tell they aren't playing around with the ingredients. The line is always long, but you know it's because of the high quality product. Don't be discouraged of the line because the staff is quick. Not to mention the window staff is friendly and courteous. On top of that the prices are amazing! Don't hesitate-check out Handel's!!!!
Best ice cream love almost all favors especially my Banana cream. Always fresh homemade ice cream. Every Tuesday special cone $2.50. They bring special favors during holidays.

My kids enjoyed the ice cream and I couldn't take the picture fast enough! This is my second time here and I can't wait to try more flavors. On this visit we had the hazelnut with Nutella and the strawberry cheesecake chunk, both in waffle cones. We'll be definitely be back for more!
I drove across town to give this ice cream a try. I truly love ice cream and Handel's is top notch! The sampler which gives you 4 decent size scoops is a great deal at just over $4.

UPDATE--- this review below is for PASADENA, CA location. Never been to the vegas location, yet... but will visit soon! Ice cream here is amazing! You can taste the freshness of the ice cream (made daily) and the quality in ingredients. The cream is delicious. KLP is the bomb. That's Key Lime Pie flavor. Do not sleep on this. It's the best of both worlds! It's tart but sweet because of the graham cracker. My favorite flavor so far! Staff is always friendly! Their small serving is 3 scoops!! I mean there's a line for a reason! This place is a must try!

Ok.. it is getting very cold outside. I am wearing a heavy jacket and the queue extends into the parking lot... I think this says it all. Simply the best. Nothing gets you through a tough time of staying at home as a rewarding bucket of Handel's ice cream. More than recommended.

Love Handel's. Been coming here for a number of years! Definitely much needed during Vegas summer as well. A wide variety of assort flavors and option types that are always changing. Better stock up on your favorite flavor because you'll never know when it'll be back! Sometimes they're understaffed and the line gets backed up so you may just have to learn the times that it won't be busy if you don't want to wait long. All in all, I Definitely recommend it and support them all the way!
The sampler is the best deal, 4 different scoops for $5. The ice cream is homemade and so good. I have never had any ice cream like this.

I've gotten ice cream from this location in the past and the ice cream was delicious. Unfortunately on my last trip which was a couple of days ago we were very disappointed with our purchase. The ice cream tasted like baking soda. We got multiple flavors and we had to toss it. YUK

Handel's is a great ice cream shop where you won't find the quality like this for the price. Pretty fantastic. We've been coming here weekly for years and here is a very seasoned (and now fat) take on this spot: Pros: -Really creamy, high butter-fat ice cream. -4 scoop sampler is best value at about a dollar a scoop. Pretty amazing. -TONS of flavors, albeit unbalanced Cons: -Ice cream quality is hit or miss with flavors. I've had more misses than hits with the mix-ins they add. For example, I've had blue monster 6 times in the past couple months and I'd say 4 out of the 6 barely had any cookies mixed into it. I've had a time where I got buckeye and had ZERO buckeyes in it. Again, I'd sadly say I've had a lack of mix-ins than a good amount. -Flavors. While they have a lot, it is HEAVILY skewed to fruit flavors. I know this is a business, but they only have a couple peanut butter/chocolate options and many more fruit flavors. Favorites of ours like Chocolate Cake Batter and Snix will probably never come back, according to the manager. Very frustrating. This is why we just get Ben & Jerry's at the Smith's next door, and even inspired us to make our own ice cream with the flavors we like. -Be prepared to wait. They take a LONG TIME. I don't think the workers are slow by any means, people just like to order a lot I'm guessing. With our family still deciding at the window, our whole ordering and receiving process takes only a couple of minutes, where I've seen customers take 15 plus minutes. Not sure why this is, but I would love a "speedy" check out line for 2 or 3 items or less. I've left line multiple times to just get Ben & Jerry's to come back to Handel's and the line has barely moved. They should address this as I know, from us alone, they've lost business because of this. Overall, great ice cream, we love it. But we have stopped coming significantly due to lack of consistency in quality and their lack of flavors we love. If you are a fruit ice cream fan, you shouldn't have any complaints, other than the long wait times. If you are a mint or peanut butter fan, your options are limited and you will most likely be disappointed.

Came here at 920p on a Tuesday. They close at 10p. The line wasn't long at all. Lots of employees working most of the windows were open for service. All the staff are young kids, don't expect the best service from them. I advise the girl it was my first time there but she didn't care to be enthusiastic or helpful in explaining anything. Our interaction was painless since I kinda knew what I wanted already. There's no place to sit inside to enjoy your ice cream. It's basically an enclosed ice cream stand. There's a couple park benches you can sit at but other than that you eat in your car or take it home. Over by Tropical Smoothie Cafe there's a lot of picnic tables if you wanna walk over there. We were there on Tuesday for the $2 deal but opted to get the 4 scoops sampler for $4. We got coconut, Oreos, strawberry cheesecake & graham central station. They were all good. I a sucker for coconut, however, the coconut one was my least favorite. Oreo & graham central station were delicious. They're not the best ice cream I've ever had but it was good & reasonably priced. Will definitely be back to try other flavors.

"Taste Of Ohio In The Desert" ATMOSPHERE: Handel's Ice Cream from Ohio is the latest frozen treat spot to open on the Southwest side of town. Walk up windows are your only choice here, and it's standing room only like we did, in the evening, and while it was in the 40's. Just like Luv-It Frozen Custard, your car is your dining area... BITES: A wide variety of flavors to choose from, sundaes, shakes, splits, pints, you name it, they got it! I went with the Four Scoop Sampler ($4.25) so I could try four of their 25+ flavors offered. My choices were Banana Cream Pie, Blueberry Cobbler, Salted Caramel Truffle, and Spouse Like A House which is malted vanilla ice cream with chocolate covered peanut butter filled pretzel pieces. I enjoyed the Banana Cream Pie and Spouse Like A House, but my other two flavors were a bit too sweet for my tastes. I also got a bite of Wifey's Cherry Cordial Sundae, and that too was very sweet! overall, just okay for me, but I can at least say I've tried Handel's. CLOSING STATEMENTS: Variety, flavor options, and price point may catch people's attention, but be warned that there's no dining area, only your car, and some of the flavors tend to be excessively sweet which may not be such a good idea if you have kids. They'll definitely be bouncing off the walls! ALOHA!!! Shaka Meter: \uuu/ \uuu/ \uuu/ 3 Will I return? Not likely....I'll just stick to what I know and like...
Best ice cream in Vegas hand down but I ordered ice cream for pick up today and none of the employees were wearing a mask .

Definitely some of the best ice cream I've had. The selection is massive and the prices for the amount served are more than generous. I highly recommend even if you have to go out of your way. The lines are long so bring your patience, it will be worth the wait :)
Love this place, customer service, quality, just everything about it. But please let your team enjoy the Super Bowl properly it starts at 3:00 pm. Super Bowl Sunday needs to be done properly
So many yummy flavors! Just a bummer that the line is always so long. Worth the wait though!

A little backstory: I'm not an ice cream person. That's a strange thing to read, probably, because everyone loves ice cream. But it's true: I've gone months without eating ice cream (gasps). I remember eating gelato from a famous gelato place in Rome (that was in Eat, Pray, Love) and thinking it was OK, maybe even overrated. Initially, I thought it was awesome, but after some thought, I had to wonder if it was the place that made it taste good - Rome being romantic, beautiful and rich in history and all. But Handels ice cream -- I feel like I could eat blindfolded in some dark, dank corner of the universe and still think it tastes great. We Yelp-discovered this ice cream place in San Diego, and I almost fainted when I saw that we have it here in Vegas, too. With Handels, I'm finally excited about ice cream. I'm almost 40, so I've tasted a lot of stuff, and I know my sugar well. Pretty sure I've met my ice cream soulmate with Handel's. I'm also at a point where I think that if I get love handles (Love Handels) from eating Handels, I wouldn't hate myself for it. I'd be like, "OK". Handel's makes their ice cream fresh daily. Which means it tastes fresh, and heavenly. I've tried only a handful of flavors so far, but judging by the flavors that I've tried, I feel like the Handels were very discerning in how they developed their flavors. Their ice cream is delicious, but never overpowering. Their pistachio flavor (which I want to try next) should confirm this. Because every pistachio ice cream out there literally tastes like some plasticky almond. We shall see. Love you Handel's.

This is my 1st time been here! Came with friends who recommend it and OMG! WOW!! I'ce cream is soooo GOOD!! I had the Sampler it comes with 4 scoops of whatever flavor you'll like I had -Banana Cream Pie! Love it -Strawberry Cheesecake! It taste like a dam piece of cake -Mango Sorbete the bomb!!! Real freaking mango flavor -Cherry Vanilla fabulous The Prices are Great!!!

Love this place! I always get the classic vanilla cone with extra cake sprinkles. The staff members are always so polite and willing to answer any questions, which I applaud them for given how ridiculously busy they can get. So happy we found this place--a must try for ice cream lovers!
I try ice cream in every state I visit. Handel's is delicious. I really like the Nutter Butter flavor. I do not like their pie flavors. Worth a visit! I think they have specials on Tuesdays.

You can't go wrong with Handel's ice cream. This is the 4th Handel's location I've been to (Northridge, Carlsbad, Redondo beach) but the flavors here are the most inconsistent. Banana cream pie and lemon bar were heavy on the graham cracker crust and lacked fruit flavor. Customer service was friendly and efficient, just like the other Handel's locations.

I had no idea what I was missing out on. This isn't just ice cream, it's flavor. Packed full of flavor! Apparently, after reading the story of the company while waiting for our ice cream, it's much closer to custard than the normal ice cream you get anywhere else. It's very creamy, smooth. I was surprised how busy it was on a Wednesday at 7:30. We had to wait about 20 mins because there was such a long line. But now I know why! It's soooooo good. I got a scoop of the black cherry and the monkey trail. Hard to say which one was better! Definitely coming back.

We have been living in the valley for 26 years from GV Ranch, to Centennial Hills and now we live in Rhodes Ranch Country Club. I have never had such delicious ice cream...Ever. We found it this month and now I'm totally in Heaven whenever I go get.

Handel's ice cream is great. We love all the flavors we have tried and frequently go back for more. I gave this business a 1-star review today because the employee serving ice cream and taking payments was NOT WEARING A MASK. This is unacceptable and we, along with other customers in line, walked away without getting ice cream. Not sure if I will be back to this business which does not seem to be taking the necessary covid precautions. I do love their ice cream, but I'll just go to the store instead where the employees and customers are wearing masks.
This is the real deal. Handel's ice cream is the best!

I will keep this short and to the point. The 2 stars is for their seemingly complete disregard for customer safety. No masks, no gloves and zero physical distance between employees inside the space. And while I cannot comment on their cleaning practices when they open and close, it was clear to me when we picked up a pint they they need to improve their interaction practices with the customers. I wore a mask, it would be simple for the owner to provide them for his employees. I implore the owner to reach out to me and let me know that they are working to improve. On the plus side, the ice cream was spectacular. Now if they can only improve the safety.

This place is just a window in the wall in South summerlin where you can get pretty great ice cream. There are so many unique flavors here it's hard to choose. But it's ok because you can get the sampler which is a plastic box with your choice of 4 flavors. So far my favorites are strawberry cheesecake, chocolate malt, and coconut cream pie. I was recommended Graham Central station and I didn't really care for it. Monkey business looked good, but it didn't impress me too much because it kinda had a weird aftertaste that bugged me a little. Overall it's a super cool place, nowhere really to sit down, but some pretty amazing ice cream at a pretty amazing price.

I came here one night and tried the butter pecan, it was far too salty. I like butter pecan ice cream but instead of a hint of salt, it tasted like salty ice cream. I also don't like the idea of standing in a line outside during the summer. The service was great and the line move quickly.

I'd like to say this is my new favorite ice cream shop! On their Facebook page they show you how fresh the ice cream really is! Not only is it fresh but the flavors are unique, affordable and definitely mouthwatering!

The best ice cream I've ever had! Maybe consider moving the list of flavors that sits between the windows. I find that when people cluster in line and at the counter, they often stand in front of it making it hard to read.

What a Treat!! The ice cream & the employees especially JUSTIN - he was soo nice & friendly & informative.He went out of his way to help us & the ice cream ( anyone you get ) is DELICIOUS!!- we shall be back!!

Handel's is finally open, bringing gourmet ice cream from Ohio (of all places!) to the Vegas valley. When I say gourmet, I'm not even kidding- they have a rotating list of nearly 50 phenomenal flavors, making it hella difficult to make your choice. The only solution is to come here frequently! Torn between peanut butter parfait or salted caramel truffle, the guy at the window recommended the latter- and it was downright divine. Smooth, salty caramel ice cream, with chunks of sea salt caramel truffles. For a regular price of $3.50/scoop (cone or cup), it was indulgent. Service is friendly, be advised that the location is a walk-up window NOT a dine-in establishment. Same plaza as Smith's, closer to the Great Harvest Bread Co.
Great ice cream but would be nice if they cared enough about their customers to notify them that they are not open for the rest of the year. It would save a lot of people a drive.

Call to get the prices of black walnut after looking at menu, and they guy says,"we don't have black walnut ". Where did you see our menu? Instagram or Facebook? Me: neither. I am searching thru yelp.
Amazingly good! This is a must visit when in Vegas! Tuesdays have price break specials. Unusual and unexpectedly delicious flavors. Lines are long, but it moves fast. You won't be disappointed

The best ice cream!!! If you're not here on Tuesdays what are you waiting for?! $2 buck Tuesday is great, they're so generous with their scoops! It's actually like 3 scoops lol. A few of my favorites are anything with cheesecake because they come with little cheesecake chunks, the blueberry cobbler, and the blue monster which comes with lots of cookie pieces! They have seasonal flavors that I like to try out too! Please try this place out, you won't be disappointed!

Best ice cream spot in town by far. Minus 2 stars for their ridiculous policy of not giving change back for cash. I understand the whole national coin shortage, but this has absolutely nothing to do with bills. This is just pure laziness by management. My bill was $11.35. I gave the worker 13 bucks and told him to keep the change as a tip. So they got cash they just too lazy to insure they have enough for customers. Sad!

Arrived to find none of the staff behind the counter were wearing any type of protection - no mask , gloves , nothing . No thanks! After my post I received a negative email from management there (I assume) arguing with me. Sounded like it was written by a 3rd grader. Absolutely no interest I going back. No regard for the safety of their clients at all.

OMG! I Love this ice cream but after going there this evening and noticed that none of the employees were wearing masks or using gloves I will not be subject to irresponsible practices. We all need to be safe and courtesy of each other's health. You should also know that it is mandated by the Governor that masks are also required of your customers or they don't get served. Whether you believe or not in this virus you do not have any right to disregard health directives. So disappointed.
This place has a really huge selection! I got the brownie sundae and the portion was a little small for the price it was but it was delicious!

Handel's was the first place i had ice cream when i made LV my new home. that was a special day enjoying great ice cream with a special person. Been back several times and it never disappoints. So here's the skinny(skinny and ice cream? give me a break). Every flavor one could want, all tasting like homemade. Totally unplanned trip today, can you say spur of the moment? today's treat was coffee with nuts and a bit chocolate fudge, two spoons, two people enjoying great ice cream on a sunny afternoon. bottom line, great ice cream, great service, fair price. I know i'll be back, so many flavors to taste.

If you love ice cream, you'll love Handel's. They have an array for flavors that are all homemade! They are a take out only restaurant. The line is always so long but so worth the wait. We always get the sampler which's includes 4 scoops for $5! So far, their banana foster is my all time fave but I've also never had anything I didn't like there.

This is by far the best ice cream around. I was first introduced to Handel's in Southern California. I was so happy to see them build one in Vegas. To be honest, the location isn't the greatest but I'm definitely willing to make the drive for this frozen goodness. There are a ton of delicious flavors to choose from. If you are new to Handle's, I highly recommend the 4 scoop sampler. They give you a solid amount of ice cream for $4.25. I have tried 10 or so flavors but once I found my favorite flavor, it has been hard to part from it. My favorite is definitely Chocoholic Chunk. If you like chocolate ice cream or dark chocolate in general, you gotta try it. It is super creamy and will quench your chocolate craving in no time at all. I haven't tried their shakes, malts, or coolers because their homemade ice cream is just too good on its own. On Tuesday night they have $2.50 for one scoop in dish or sugar cone. They give you a nice big scoop too. Just a fair warning, the line is huge on Tuesday nights. But that said, they move pretty fast at the window. I can't recommend Handel's enough.
The best ice cream hands down! They need more locations here in vegas but im willing to drive.

So Handel's changed their cup design for their hot fudge sundaes. The cups are now designed to hold them in your hand easier but there is definitely less ice cream in them. Yet they still charge the same price. Not cool.
Worth the wait. It's so good. The choices can be overwhelming but that is not a bad thing. We will definitely be back!!

So many options! The quality of this ice cream is so good. There are so many flavors of ice cream that this is a spot for everyone! Service was friendly and fast, even with the line. I had the butter pecan and blueberry cobbler and it was an amazing mixture. Will definitely be back even if it is a drive for us!

I have always been a Ice cream lover! When my daughter let me try some of her heavenly hash, immediately I fell in love! I had to find the originator of this place, so here I am wanting to taste some of that deliciousness once again. I must say they did not disappoint! Customer for life!
The choices were wonderful and the line moved very quickly. The ice cream tastes so yummy

Ok - you know it's good when it's winter...freezing (for Vegas standards) and we are all waiting outside for ice cream. The taste is rich, creamy and authentic! Love love love and can't wait to go back

This is the only reason to go to Las Vegas. Who cares about the bright lights, the big buildings, when you can eat delicious ice cream!?!? I went here on a Friday night around 7:30 PM. There were four people working and the line was into the street. However, the line move fairly quickly and even if it was longer I would've waited. I decided on a fourth Cooper sampler which is by and large the best option on the menu. I had blueberry cobbler, chocolate marshmallow, banana cream pie and Keylime pie. The person who took my order was knowledgeable about all of the ice cream's and knew what was in each of them. I like the banana cream pie ice cream the best followed by the Keylime pie followed by the blueberry cobbler and chocolate marshmallow tied. I also thought that the four items sampler was super affordable based on how delicious it was and how much ice cream there with us. There is no reason to ever go to Las Vegas and not stop here for ice cream even if it is a little bit out-of-the-way. The only other tip is to my knowledge there are no bathrooms and there isn't much seating outside so that could be a challenge.

Our little quick date night Handel Ice Cream located on Tropicana and Hualapai. one day i went to repair my vacuum next door to Handel Ice Cream. i never pay attention to that place till i saw that long long line of people. i was wondering what they were waiting for. seriously the line was as long as the little nuts waiting to enter best buy on black friday. the lady in line told me "Best ice cream ever" Of course you CAN'T walk away from ice cream so i waited like everyone in line. 25mns later (people in line were not even bitching or mad like you would think!) the place is uncommon. the servers are all inside and you order from outside. they serve you through the sliding window. price is super cheap and the ice cream delicious! many many flavors! i always go for pistachio or black cherry, kids for oreo, orange sherbet they give you a really nice serving not like other place on tuesdays they do $2 ice cream must try it, i promise you will be surprised i though my favorite ice cream places was cold stone, golden spoon well i am adding Handel Home Made ice Cream

This place has some really yummy stuff. I couldn't help but indulge in my daughters, my friends & my own ice cream. It's the in we fatty screaming at me saying 'Do it for Yelp!' So yeah I took one for the team. The blue raspberry my daughter enjoyed in a baby cone, which was the cutest thing. My friend James has a strawberry cheesecake & that was like heaven in a cup! Mine, because I'm lactose intolerant & Dani, the sweet gal runnin the show, informed me they had vegan options. They have coconut milk & almond milk ice cream!! How cool is that! I totally got a quart because I finished the pint I just bought from Whole Foods! On Tuesday's they have $2 Two Scoop Tuesday's. Super neat way to cool down on a budget. Totally coming back to see Dani's smiling face & hear more recommendations!

This is ice cream at its best. You can tell that this comes from homemade recipes and you can tell that it's fresh and just delicious. The scoops are very generous so one scoop, in a cup or in a waffle bowl, is a lot bigger than I would expect. I got the black cherry scoop of ice cream in a waffle bowl. The ice cream was the best I have ever had for black cherry ice cream, no contest. The waffle bowl is freshly made on the premises and it was absolutely yummy. My friend got the bananas Foster ice cream and was pretty much in heaven. We got our son the chocoholic ice cream and it was amazing as well. We got lucky when we got there because there were only two people ahead of us. The lines tend to get long at times. We initially saw this place in California and the line to get the ice cream was around the building so we were excited to find one near us in Las Vegas. When we started ordering our ice cream, we noticed at least 20 people behind us. This is no surprise because the quality of the ice cream and the cones are incredible. The prices are right and I highly recommend it. We are definitely going back.

call-in orders only for regular customers! this place does't work with delivery companies [drivers]! don't expect them to take care of delivery drivers! just had the worst experience....some guy with a name "nick", said he is the manager of this place, almost cancel my order, because i had placed order for grubhub, the manager didn't want to give diner's order to driver, because they don't work with delivery company/drivers lol ! hopefully owner take a note of this!
Lack of covid compliance. Owner refused to put on a mask and told me to mind my own business until I pay his bills. Won't return.

I have never been treated so poorly until I went back to this establishment, I returned because the order I had ordered the night before was not correct, one of my banana splits had no bananas, I was eating it at home when I said to myself, something is missing, I took a picture of my split without bananas, along with my receipt. That's where I was treated horribly my the manager and the managers manager, I was accused of possibly picking out the bananas, was accused of eating it all, even though I showed him a picture. I have called and filed a complaint with corporate, they were not impressed with my treatment, was reported they would send a message to the owner of this facility, I'm still waiting for a phone call!
We just moved here and this is hands down the best ice cream I've ever had.. Beats cold stone out of the water .. We love Tuesdays it's $2.50 single scoop of ice cream you can't beat it

Very disappointed! I love this place so much and come on a weekly basis, and have never had an experience like we had tonight. I'm 9 months pregnant, and we were out celebrating our wedding anniversary so we wanted to go to our favorite ice cream spot as a night cap. We arrived at 9:30pm with a small wait, which was expected on a Friday night! But what I was not expecting was how unfriendly the worker was towards us. We happened upon an unpleasant and displeased employee right from when we walked up to the window on the very far right, which was by 9:50. I asked 2 questions to clarify, and all he seemed was irritated and kept closing the door on our faces like he was dismissing us. I ended up just ordering 2 quarts to go because I felt so uncomfortable, and just wanted to leave. My husband encouraged me to speak up because I was wanting to try something new, so I tried to order one additional thing by the time he even got back to us (which was at 10:01). He rolled his eyes and denied me service because "I wasn't allowed to order it once they were closed." ...Even with other people still in line, ordering what I had tried to add on to my order. Maybe if he wasn't so rude from the beginning, I would have actually been able to enjoy my anniversary dessert but this completely dampened the night and put a bad taste in mouth because of the customer service.

Came here for $2 scoop Tuesdays for the first time not too long ago. Tried a scoop of the strawberry cheesecake and my husband got the ore dough flavor. I really liked both and we bought a point of the grahm Central station for home since we tried that before at a friend's house. I like how their scoops are generous and they have a lot of flavors to choose from. The line was pretty long since they had that promotion, but it goes by quick with the amount of workers helping out each customer. I would recommend if you're in the neighborhood to come check them out and try one of their many flavors of ice cream.

My first visit since I'm not usually in this part of town but I totally get the hype. Way better than B&R in cost and taste! I'll be back! Oh and definitely try the black cherry ice cream, it's a flavor explosion in your mouth!
Girl with pink / blue hair was very sweet :) she deserves lots of credit with handling how busy her location was
Sadly not open during this time. Went on Sunday to do pick up. Closed. Saw 4 other cars/ people try to get ice cream also.

We were Virgins tonite as this was our first trip to Handels and Trip it was as it was 20 miles one way to get there. I say it was worth the trip. The Flavors were not only good but plentiful and fun. Lin had the chocolate marshmallows which she said lacked marshmallows throughout the scoop. She also had coconut cream pie was the better of the two. I had the Praline Pecan & Vanilla Oreo which were both good with the Praline the better of these two. Our young man that served us lacked a smile and just kind of blew me off when I tried to say something to him. Overall it was worth the 2 hours that we spent going to & fro and we met a cute lil lady that was in 3 grade but talked like she was in High School and made the wait in line a delight. ( I bought her cone cause she was a cutie too). Thanks to the internet I found Handels and we will make a return trip.

Ice cream heaven... Ever wonder what it's like to go to ice cream heaven? This is it folks. This place makes homemade ice cream and you can taste it. I've been trying all sorts of flavors and my favorite hands down is the graham central station which is for anyone who enjoys golden graham cereal and graham cracker crust. Luscious perfection... They have tons of flavors. They make every type of sundae, milkshake, smoothie, whatever you so please and honestly I haven't tasted anything I haven't liked yet. Second favorite would be the chocolate marshmallow and the marshmallows are so fresh & soft that it's mind blowing. For anyone looking for an extra deal, come on a Tuesday for $2 scoops. The scoops here are HUGE. I'm a big time fan & have become a regular!
Best iced cream in Las Vegas.. convenient, consistent . Creative. I've tried all the flavors.
Hands down the best ice cream in Vegas!!! Definitely suggest getting the 4 scoop sampler since there is tons of great flavors.
Fantastic ice cream. I usually have the mint chocolate chip or Handel pops. Always crowded cause of the quality.
WOW! So good. Definitely the best ice cream in Vegas, may be the best ice cream anywhere. We travel all the way from Centennial Hills to go here.
#ERROR!

flavors were much too sweet for me and nothing stood out about the texture except that there too many add ins, but maybe i have been getting the wrong flavors. usually been somewhat disappointed after my visits here, but i'm a harsh critic

Handel's is a great place to experience at least once... From there you can decide if you're soon to become addicted to this incredible phenomenon! With so many options, and so many different flavors you're bound to find the perfect fit to fulfill what your palate is craving for. I chose to indulge with a Banana Split which includes 3 scoops of Dutch Apple Pie flavored ice cream. Not only was was this a phenomenal choice, I'm so addicted. Amazing to say the least. My host was a young lady who made this exceptionally well. She was super helpful and attentive as well. Great experience and awesome place all around. Definitely Recommended and have given this experience 5 stars from start to finish. Thank you Handel's.

WoW Excellent ice cream. Chocolate chip mint. Rich & Delicious. My new ice cream place. Way better then the more popular place. And a better price too. The scoops are way bigger here too. A single scoop is like 2 scoops. Try it you'll love it. I promise....

We all scream for ice cream! This place is on point if you want some quality ice cream! I recommend the banana split! Also, the banana cream pie oh my! So many options to choose from. This place can get very busy so beware of that. Also, this place in similar to sonic in the sense of you don't go inside. One bad thing about this place is that there is no order to the lines. It's just a bunch of windows and everybody looking around to see who is next. If they had like dots to stand on or numbers to stand on, that would help.
Real ice cream, natural flavors that do not taste artificial at all, and friendly service. There really is not much more to say. Best ice cream place in Vegas that I have tried.

Yum!!Located on the corner of Tropicana and Hualapei. Super friendly staff. Lots of flavors to choose from. They have ice cream and frozen yogurt. Generous scoops. You order from outdoor windows only (no indoor store). There were two benches to sit and eat your sweets but it's basically takeaway. Plenty of flavors to choose from. Ordered pint of mint chocolate chip and double scoop chocolate peanut butter chocolate almond double. Very good not overly sweet.

Samples: Banana Cream Pie, Birthday Cake, Butter Pecan, Salty Caramel Truffle, Midnight Madness Oree-Dough and Graham Central Station Blondie Sundae with Buckeye and Peanut Butter Parfait, Caramel, Whipped Cream, Cherry An Ohio native of the Northwest who spent his formative years with Toft's, Friendly's, Breyer's or Soft-Serve before developing a taste for the finer things at Jeni's in Columbus, it really does not seem all that strange that it took 36 years to visit Youngstown-based Handel's Homemade Ice Cream & Yogurt but on Saturday the omission was finally righted, a trip to the Las Vegas Scoop Shop on the corner of Hualapai and Tropicana actually more impressive than one may of thought. Born in 1945, techniques changed but formulas still using an old-school base with all flavors churned on site, Handel's Las Vegas occupies a somewhat out-of-the-way corner in the western Suburbs and with nothing but tableless benches offered as seating the layout is decidedly grab-and-go only, a few patrons wavering over nearly thirty options while others opted to do some tasting. Featuring four windows, though the midday only saw two open as a duo of young ladies provided smiles with the scoops, tastes of Butter Pecan and "Salty Caramel Truffle" reminded me of slow-spun flavors from my childhood, the Banana Cream Pie and Birthday cake trending a bit more over-sweet and artificial while a seasonal special titled "Midnight Madness" delivered all sorts of richness with Dark Chocolate Punched up by Oreos and Reese's Peanut Butter Cups. Affordable and sizably portioned compared to others, two scoops approximating a pint for just $4.25, it was on the cashier's advice that Graham Central Station was paired to Chocolate-Chip Cookie Dough with a mix-in from Nabisco, the former a lot like eating soggy S'mores while the later was exactly as might be expected, the texture intriguing but overwhelming sweetness difficult to ignore. Always a sucker for a Sundae, not to mention housemade baked goods, part two of the tasting entailed a warm blondie at the base of a plastic clamshell and although whipped cream and caramel were both no better than store-bought the pairing of Peanut Butter Parfait and a treat from my Home State were as delicious as they were nostalgic, the blend reminding me a lot of Moose-Tracks - a flavor so difficult to track down in my childhood that a three hour trip to Youngstown may not have been all that bad. THREE STARS: Noteworthy for its old school appeal, though nouveau Artisans have long left their flavors and smoothness far behind, Handel's is well served in its suburban strip-mall location, no doubt a step-up from the Midwest to Sin City while still maintaining its nostalgia but by no means 'destination worthy' stuff.
Drove all the way here for yogurt. The business name says "..& Yogurt". They did NOT have yogurt. Ice cream was fine, but I wanted frozen yogurt. I wish businesses would stop lying to me.

5/5 for flavor but unfortunately I did take away a star for the experience. I had no idea there was no seating and it was an order up place. Guess I should have read some reviews. Let me clarify there was a few benches that a bunch of kids were jumping off of and their clueless parents didn't care. Another annoying thing was the sign location of their flavor choices...TO ALL PARENTS: please be advised that when you prop you child or children on the counter in front of this sign it makes it very difficult for other to view. Staff was friendly and the four flavors we sampled were amazing! Just wish I was able to enjoy it not sitting on a curb with tons of kids around.

Best ice cream in town. It makes you feel like a real city/hometown with this walk up window style setup. We were greeted by a smiling face and great service. This place gets busy on Tuesday's, especially when it's nice out, for the $2.50 single scoop promo. Great portion sizes with so many choices. Take a look at the menu online so you have an idea of what to get when you make it up to the window.

3 words: GRAHAM CENTRAL STATION Just try it, you can ask the staff for a little tasting spoon of it. And then you'll end up buying it by the pint. Red raspberry sorbet is a close second, but when you want to indulge, GCS is the way to go. Las Vegas has so many frozen yogurt and boba tea places, it's nice to have a go-to (real) ice cream destination that is quick, convenient and most importantly, delicious! Staff is super friendly and I love the story behind the brand. Trop & Hualapai...I will be back soon :)
The ice cream is great. They have monthly flavors so every month is a new adventure. Also don't forget about their Tuesday special. If u haven't been you are missing out!!

Las Vegas Yelpers came to my rescue again with this amazing gem. I ordered the 4-scoop sampler with chocolate chip cookie dough, coconut milk ice cream, peanut butter parfait, and vanilla with oreo. The best part: it only cost $4.25! Not only were the scoops of ice cream decently-sized and filled with mouth-watering, sugar-craving deliciousness but the price was insanely cheap for the amount I received. If I am ever in Las Vegas again I will definitely return for round 2!

Great ice cream! Great selection! AWFUL service! The employees are rude to every one of us giving them our hard earned money. We choose to spend our money on their product and they couldn't be more unprofessional, unpleasant and down right rude to all of us in line. I have seen this more than once here and feel it is time to make a change and take my money elsewhere, too bad when the product is so good!

On a hot day, there are few things better than a scoop (or three) of homemade ice cream. Whether you visit for $2 two scoop Tuesday or any day for 4 scoop samplers for $4.25, Handel's does not disappoint. My top flavor picks: Blueberry Cobbler, Banana Cream Pie,Graham Central Station, and Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough Only downside: Outside seating only... Don't be discouraged by the long lines, they move fast.

Just received a heart-warming message from Patrick Frank the owner of Handel's telling me to "get a life" in response to my 1 star review for Handel's not caring about their customers enough to make their employees wear masks. That definitely warrants another 1 star review.

I decided to give this spot a try after driving by a couple of times and seeing a line extending out into the parking lot. Even though the line looks incredibly long, they have 4 windows where they are taking orders so, it actually moves relatively quickly. Their menu is also extensive. They have a ton of flavors and to my surprise, it's not that expensive. I was expecting Diary Queen or Cold Stone prices, but it was slightly cheaper. I ordered a Cotton Candy waffle cone and the it was great! I also tried the Strawberry Cheesecake Chunk & it was good although, the strawberry taste was a little too artificial for my liking. It tasted like vanilla ice cream mixed with Hershey's Strawberry syrup. But, I will definitely be going back to try some other flavors out !

Best Ice Cream Ever!! We drove here because it was recommended while in Vegas. Although it's a hike from the strip, it was well worth the time & gas. We tried: Birthday Cake - my fave! & hands down the best I've ever tasted. Period. Oreo - delicious! Pistachio - O.M.G. That's all I'll say. Banana Cream Pie - Yum! Key lime pie - delish! The flavor I will try when i come back to Vegas is Bananas Foster.

Man it took a long while to drive here from the strip but totally worth it. The ice cream options vast and packed with flavor. Beware as the lines here can get long. The service we experienced was kind and patient. They happily offered trials of anything you wanted. I had the special Key Lime Pie and still miss it dearly as I don't live in Las Vegas. This is a small chain and there might be one close to where you live so check out their website. A great experience!

Maybe it's just me, but this place is starting to go down hill. Really bad service on the last two visits, and the scoops are totally inconsistent...and seem to be getting smaller and smaller. The owner/manager was leaving the premises in our last visit, and I thought it was really thoughtful of him to park his fancy sports car right up front in the handicap spot.
The service was quick and courteous. The waffle cone, Mint chocolate chip was delicious. And my wife's non-dairy coconut dish was rich and creamy. The inside looked immaculately clean and organized.

Surprised I haven't written a review sooner for handles. Absolutely love it so much! Best icecream ever and if you haven't been you're missing out. The 4 scoop sampler is the best bet and you won't be disappointed no matter which flavor you choose and there are many. I do wish they had more non dairy flavors. Quick and friendly staff.
My grandkids love this place they're quantity is a bit much but it's delicious. Everyone is nice and fast
Amazing ice cream!! They even have kid size cones which was nice. Oreo and blue monster were my favorites. Will definitely come back

My go to ice cream place! The staff is always friendly, they give a military discount and they ice cream is delicious! I normally get the hand packed quarts. I love the variety of flavors and the quality of their ice cream. They are open late so if you get that after dinner craving you can satisfy you craving. I wish they had indoor seating/ordering so you don't have to stand outside in hot or cold weather. Other than that you will not get any complaints out of me.

I am from the other side of the US. I am reporting that Handel's Ice Cream has BLUE MOON during the summer months! This place is a serious drive for me, but SO worth it! Their ice cream selection choice is amazing. Although there is no "inside" place to sit, that doesn't bother me - because BLUE MOON. (Although when it is 120 degrees outside, then it might bother me a little...) You order at a window. But BLUE MOON. That is all.

Very good handmade ice cream. Definitely worth the wait on a warm night. I can't recall what I ordered, only that it was quite delicious. So next time your craving some cold dessert, keep driving past DQ and head over to Handel's for some proper Ice Cream.
The best ice cream!! Such a cute little walk up ice cream shop that's been there forever!! Def a must try if you like ice cream!

Yeah it's back to inconsistency. Some mixes must be harder to get right than others. I've had bad interactions with other businesses because of my lackluster reviews BUT I haven't had a bad interaction with them. And I'd like to keep it that way. If they serve you something, and it's not to your liking, they'll fix it. They try to do a good job. And I get it. It's homemade and hand-scooped so all the servings can't be uniformly good. But it's frustrating to buy a quart or a pint or some scoops and get home and it not be what you wanted. The 4.5 star overall rating shows that plenty of ppl *are* getting what they want so take my review with a grain of salt. If the flavor sounds appealing try it (especially on Tuesday) and *you* will probably like it. This review is just a reflection of how I feel - not a anything that should carry more weight than the multitude of five star reviews for this spot.

Ice Cream: Pleasantville Edition. Coming to this ice cream shop gave me flashbacks to an old place I visited in Kansas City when I was just 15 or 16 years old. It really doesn't seem to fit in the modern age, and I love that. There is no establishment to enter, just windows that face the outside so they can take your order and hand your dessert off. There are some metal benches outside, but they aren't comfy. I took off a star because I would appreciate some seating so that this could be a date night. At the moment its just kind of a pick-up and go home place. Still, if I am completely honest, the vibes I get from ordering at the window are cool. All the employees are friendly and chill (get it?). Actually, I think I will give that star back. I would like chairs, but I appreciate them for what they are. Judging by their other locations, it looks like they originated in Ohio. I am so ecstatic they chose to start up a shop in our own little city of Vegas! Do yourself a favor and get the sampler. You get four very decently sized scoops so you can try more than one flavor for only slightly more cash than a single scoop. Boyfriend and I always do the sampler! My favorite flavor is Ore-Dough. It's an Oreo/Cookie Dough mix that gets everything right! It isn't listed on their website so they may be late at updating.

I'll start off by saying that I'm completely biased toward Handel's. I'm from Youngstown, Ohio where this ice cream chain originated not 10-20 years ago, but 70 years ago. Because I've been eating this ice cream since the 80s, this ice cream is my standard and what I use to compare everything else. As far as their service procedure, one person is at the window and he/she takes your order, makes it, and cashes you out. Everything is made when ordered, including hand packing the pints and quarts. There are no seating areas aside from a few benches. This is the way it's done at the original Handel's on Market and Midlothian in which you go and wait at least 15-20 minutes in line and you eat ice cream inside or outside your car. Should they continue this procedure like it's 1945? Absolutely not and hopefully they'll make some changes. For now, just be prepared for the wait and to enjoy your ice cream somewhere else beside a table or bench. We shared the banana split this last visit and it was the same delicious ice cream as it always is. Some may think the sweetness and creaminess factors are high, but they are just right to me. 70 years worth of satisfied customers will also agree with me.

I love Handel's! The ice cream here is absolutely fantastic. They have a huge variety of flavors and a really good special on Tuesday's. I'd give it 5 stars if there was a place to eat your ice cream that wasn't only outside. It's nice sometimes, but most of the time I don't enjoy eating my ice cream in 110 degree weather. It's always a race to eat my ice cream before it melts and sometimes I wish I could just sit back and enjoy it, because the flavors really are delicious.

A group of us stopped here for our final stop of a long day of hiking, volunteering, eating, and Handel's was the finish line. I went with the four flavor sampler which I was assured was a good way of tasting different varieties at a value price of $4.25. I got the chocolate raspberry truffle, salted caramel truffle, spouse like a house, and buckeye. My least favorite was the chocolate raspberry truffle and I liked the salted caramel truffle the most. It's difficult picking flavors when you have no idea what they are based on some made up fun names. It would be like ordering sushi rolls based on the names those places give if there was no listing after to explain the ingredients. That would have been my problem had I gone by myself and didn't have friends who had already been there to ask questions and get their advice. The ice cream is OK and it is creamy but I don't think there's anything special to it. While this is fairly close to home, I could think of a couple of places I'd go for more exotic and creative flavors. Since this is close to home, I'[m sure I'll be stopping here again but it won't be my go to place.

Came to Handel's for the first time with a group of friends a long long time ago, back when Kauai Cafe was still in this plaza. I didn't even know that this was an ice cream place because of the walk-up window. That's how they keep this place really clean, by not having a store with constant foot traffic. Smart, I suppose. They have a pretty big menu - cones, sundaes, smoothies, hurricanes, etc. So many flavors of ice cream, but I decided to be boring and try the Oreo. It really was nothing special. I am fine with my Dreyer's Cookies 'N Cream ice cream that I have at home. Anyway, didn't come back here for a while since I am actually a fan of Thrifty's ice cream at Sweet Addiction. When I ended up here again for the second time, I decided to order the Raspberry Sherbet Parfait since it looked good in the picture. Daaang, it was delicious! Can't even remember the last time I actually had good Sherbet, but this is the only reason why I keep coming back! Although, the amount that you get is a hit or miss depending on the employee who makes it. Sometimes the scoops are huge and stacked high, and sometimes the scoops are just sad. The lines can be long during the summer. Maybe I'll try other flavors of their ice cream in the future, but for now I am definitely a fan of their Sherbet!
You really can't beat this place for a fun ice cream trip. Be ready for a line but it is worth the wait. So many great choices to choose from! The black and white milk shake is our fav!
I had the blondie sundae and it was incredible!! I only wish they had water available to purchase! No inside seating but there were benches outside that were nice

I mentioned ice cream earlier in the day because it was hot. When we were on our way home, my girlfriend asked if I still wanted ice cream- of course since that's her second favorite thing after tacos. (3rd is pizza). As we were driving from northwest past Summerlin to southwest, I kept refreshing Yelp to find near locations. I wanted to try something different and not the typical brand ice cream places. I found this place and was excited because I never heard of them, they have homemade ice cream, they had good reviews and they were only 4min from the freeway. We got the 4 flavor scoop. Strawberry cheesecake, pistachio, their flavor of the month- key lime and Oreo. It was all really smooth. Next time we know we'll be fine with just 2 scoops of Pistachio! We put the leftover in the freezer for later. I'm not a fan of really sweet things and Pistachio was the least sweet of them and strawberry Cheesecake was the most sweet. I could try their no sugar added ice cream next time too. I wish they had a vegan ice cream flavor- I would be all over that! She asked if we found a new ice cream spot. I said no! Because ice cream isn't good for you, we shouldn't be eating it like that. She said once a month is ok.

Cheap smooth creamy ice cream for the 4 flavor sampler deal! Unfortunately, I don't live nearby and there's no inside seating area so I wouldn't necessarily come back or recommend if you live far... If I'm in the area and craving ice cream, I will stop by tho. Tip: ask to try the flavors, bc some are pretty sweet...

When I tell you this is The BEST homemade ice cream I am not lying l!! They have over 25 different flavors. The brownie sundae and Apple pie a la mode is deeeeelicious!!! And every Tuesday is $2 for a single scoop but it's so huge it's like a double!! Go here NOW!!!!
Best place ever!! Don't go on Tuesday's the line sucks. Go with sampler if it is your first time
Friendly staff and so many choices!! Love that you can pick 4 flavored as combo and try them all.
So good. And I'm not a big ice cream person. Absolutely best bday cake and cotton candy ice cream ever. And I don't like cotton candy ice cream.

A friend bought my boyfriend & I, what I believe was The Blue Monster . First time trying ice cream from the company & we were really loving it. Until..I went in for another bite & a long piece of hair came out! (Hard to see, but zoom into picture) it's a white hair & I have Black hair so it's definitely not mine. I get it. I work in the food industry & it happens. Will definitely reconsider changing my review & rating whenever we do decide to take a trip there..As long as I don't find another piece of hair.

The many, many different homemade flavors is what got my attention. The way the flavors are created makes me curious. Love the way they serve it too. The old school walk up window makes it different. Creates a different appeal and expectation for their patrons. Tries the strawberry cheesecake and blueberry cobbler. Served on a waffle cone, it was a real treat! They also serve hurricanes, sherbert, sundaes and pops! The line is usually pretty long, we got lucky but be prepared to wait, especially during the summer.
BEST ICE CREAM EVER ! That's all you need to know this place is the holy grail of ice cream. Once you have Handels any other ice cream will be simple and flavorless

My review is more based on the customer service. Ice cream is delicious and the location is nice. The young kids working this place truly need to smile when dealing with a big amount of customers. There attitudes alone can drive away service.

This was my first time going to this business. I am a huge fan of cheesecake ice cream and theirs is spot on. It has chunks in the ice cream not just flavoring. The location is easy to find and it's very well priced for the quality. Great place for ice cream
Employees are not wearing a mask. This should not be optional. Ice cream was great as always. Service was average at best.

Our family loves this place! The customer service and the quality of the ice cream is superb especially when you're lucky enough to have Danny serve you. She is such a kind person and always has a big smile on her face and makes delicious ice cream taste even sweeter than it regularly would. If you haven't tried Handel's homemade ice cream it may be time to go by and sample all of their different flavors.
My daughter and I went following the father daughter dance. We both loved the ice cream. This is a must visit fo any ice cream aficionado. We will go again!

This place was random and honestly was not planned. Was craving ice cream and this place was rated 4.5 stars so me and my friend came to check it out. We got there 9pm and there was a line. I ain't gonna lie tho, the line didn't take long. And on their shop window lists their menu. They got probably maybe about 20 flavors of ice cream. All home made. The names of some that stick out to me was the orange dream, butter pecan, pistachio, cheesecake, and more! I decided to go with the waffle bowl double. The bottom scoop of ice cream in the bowl was coffee mocha chip and the top was strawberry cheesecake. I didn't get the sundae version because I wanted to taste the flavors of the ice cream. And boyyyyyy, I was not disappointed. The ice cream was heavenly! My favorite was the strawberry cheesecake. There was chunks of cheesecake in the ice cream and tasted well with the waffle bowl. The mocha chip was alright, the strawberry cheesecake blew me away! Home made ice cream always tastes better to me. Would honestly rate this place 4.5/5. I wanna try the orange dream flavor next time! I'd definitely recommend

Ice cream here is slightly above average, but every other aspect of this experience isn't. There could be one person in front of you in line ordering a scoop and you will still wait 20 minutes. This place is always understaffed and the service is unfriendly. I would suggest putting a larger menu in front of the glass so those in line could make their decision while they wait. Not worth it.

My kiddo and I love this place, so many flavors to choose from, many have one or two mix-ins! It's a walk-up place, so you order outside at the window and then get handed your ice cream through the same window.
Delicious! I have a sweet tooth! This place definitely delivered. I got the waffle cone sundae! Pralines & Cream! Parking is easy and service was quick! Yummy

Yummmmmmmmm. This place was good. I had the four scoop sampler which is a pretty awesome idea. Graham central, chocolate peanut butter brownie, monkey business and ore-dough. I'd get them all again except maybe would swap the ore-dough. It wasn't bad by any means but I think the others were just sooo good they overshadowed it as it was a simpler flavor. Also the guy working when we swung by on a Friday afternoon was friendly so I didn't gave a bad customer service experience as others have mentioned. I'm bummed that I don't live in state to go back here but my jeans will probably be happy about that!
My family loves this place! The 4 scoop sampler is the way to go! Thank you to Stormy for the great customer service!
Favorite ice cream spot hands down! Really happy it's located at my side of town. Rarely order ice cream, but when I crave it, I get my fix here

Graham Central Station - enough said. Homemade daily, quality ice cream with the BEST mix-ins. I can't even tell you what's in Graham Central except that it is by far the best one we've tried. I'm not a graham cracker lover either. It's seriously just the best - try it. Not that any of the others are not good- they're all INCREDIBLE. It's only that I dream of Graham Central and try to find ways to "reward" my children (myself) by bringing them here. There's also $2 Tuesday where you'll get a GIGANTIC scoop of ice cream (when they say single scoop, it's pretty much the size of a double or triple) for $2. Lastly, we once ran into Dan Reynolds (lead singer of Imagine Dragons) here and I really really wanted my kids to say hi (ID is their favorite band and they know every song off of both CDs) but were too shy. So, next time you're in the mood for ice cream - come here, get a Hot Fudge Sundae with Graham Central & nuts. You're welcome!

Heard this place made the best ice cream. I have to disagree! Baskin Robbin's flavors are better. No place to sit and eat, there are only 3 benches. Its not a parlor where you can sit and enjoy a sundae if you so choose to get one. With all the hype, expected to have homemade sauces and whipped cream NOT. Brought my relatives from out of state, they were very disappointed... Do not recommend and will not go back.

Honestly I wasn't impressed. :( I really wanted to like this place. This had been book marked on yelp for a while now.... Well I gotta say -1 star for the lack of service. The girl that came to the window was prompt.... But when I asked to sample a third flavor since they like a bazillion flavors... She kind of gave me a look like..."geez make up your mind already.". I didn't appreciate the look.... But I came here to get over cream so I got some. -1 star also cuz it was pretty much a stand.... No place to sit and enjoy the ice cream. Maybe I missed it on yelp somewhere but I did not know that they had no place to sit. :( The flavors were OK. They didn't pop like I wanted them to. They tasted like gourmet ice cream that u could buy at the store. Texture was OK. It was creamy but only after I left it sit for a bit. But it is a great deal for your buck. I got their special.... 4 scoops for under $5... Good deal. Would I go back? Maybe if I was in the area craving ice cream. But would I drive here specifically for the ice cream.... Probably not when I have Gelatology so much closer to me. So more like 2.5 rounded up to a 3.... Just middle of the road. It wasn't great but it wasn't horrible either.

The best ice cream I have ever eaten. I've been coming here now for a few weeks thanks to some friends and I regret not coming sooner. I'm actually not really suppose to eat ice cream because of some dairy problems but surprisingly enough, this place doesn't cause any issues. Probably because it's REAL and delicious. I normally get the graham central station (x4) and my boyfriend gets the 4 scoop sampler with all the cheesecake options. WE LOVE THIS PLACE SO MUCH. Now I will say the lines are a bit ridiculous at times but all the aggravation goes away when you take that first scoop and it melts in your mouth. This will now be my go to dessert spot and I've told all my family and friends. If you've seen this place and haven't stopped by yet, DO IT NOW. Especially for the 2 buck Tuesday's.

The parking is the worst at this place. It is very hard to find anything close, only a few spots of your lucky. Other than that everything else about this plz r is awesome. This is your classic ice cream parlor. They have a huge selection of flavors and will let you try as many as you want. Prices are extremely good a single scoop on Tuesday's is only 2.5 and there is more than a single scoop. I would recommend this to anyone that wants a classic ice cream. Our favorites were the black raspberry and the pecan praline so so good.

Ok so the Super Bowl was boring but my ice cream sundaes made halftime! I discovered Handels not too long ago and they make the Best homemade ice cream---there-on premises. Two things I noticed immediately: 1. It's pristine clean. You can see thru the windows where they make the ice cream! 2. The teens that work there---positive, upbeat, clean cut and happy to give out samples. Reminds me of the In n out burger philosophy! And most importantly the ice cream is sooo good! I called ahead yesterday and ordered 5 quarts: buckeye, strawberry cheesecake, blue monster, malt and good ol choc chip cookie dough. My guests at halftime were impressed! Ok I'm from Ohio, never heard of them there and am sooo happy they are in vegas. On tuesdays they have 2 for Tuesday but I never seem to be there on that day. Oh well!!!
