Omg in love! I love that Vegas has a place like this. It reminds me something you would see in a smaller town and back on the East coast. I love little ice cream places like this. The best deal is the four scoop sampler. You get four scoops of ice cream for $4.25! What a steal. I got this and tried chocolate chip cookie dough, pistachio, chocolate peanut butter and another peanut butter flavor but the name escapes me! (oops :) ) I loved the pistachio-one of my favorite flavors for sure. There is no inside to this place so be prepared to wait outside. It also can be very busy-I waited over a half hour last time I was there. It would be nice if they were better staffed to accommodate the large crowds because last time they only had two people working.

The ice cream is great and the employees are either really customer centric, or not. The only issues that I have with this place is the process. They have several windows, most are closed, and theres really no structure to the "line" or "who is next" and theres no apparent process. The person handwrites your order and disappears. They come back with your items one by one, then when you have to pay, they take your credit card away to a back area to process your charge. They need a proper POS and ordering system, and they need to make the ordering and payment process simple and transparent.
Best ice cream in town. You might have to wait a minute but it's worth it. You can also call ahead for pints and quarts only and go right up to the window and pick it up
Delicious Ice cream. Wish it was closer to where I live. I'd be indulging every week. Try the sampler, it may be too much ice cream for one person but I took it as a challenge

I don't eat a lot of ice cream, when I do fresh McConnell's is my favorite. what is perfect ice cream? The perfect balance between sweetness, creaminess and texture is different for everyone so there is no right or wrong answer. This hits the spot for me and I don't have to go to California to get it. So good I ate all 4 flavours in the sampler by my self! I tried blueberry cobbler which didn't taste like a cobbler, just blueberry. Coffee chocolate chip, which was my favorite, tasted like a late rather than boring drip coffee. Spouse like a house (I know right) this one is a little more elaborate with peanut butter cups, peanut butter ripple and chocolate covered peanut butter filled pretzels. The pretzels are chocolate covered so they, maintain their crunch unlike others that get soggy or stale. Caramel pretzel had the same chocolate covered peanut butter filled pretzels with a Carmel ribbon. Subtle and perfect. Bring on the food coma!

I'm not sure how I had never heard of Handel's prior to last week, but alas someone told me about it and it didn't disappoint. I kidn of dig their set up. Just 4 walk up windows, no inside seating, but you can see where all the magic happens through the window. It is a little odd not looking at the ice cream as you make your selection. Given some of the odd names it can be tough to know what's what. However, I tried two samples and they were super cool providing them. Cost for a cone is less than Baskin Robbins and on Tuesday's I learned they have $2 scoops. If I lived closer I would definitely hit this place up on the regs. Being in the Henderson/Green Valley area that's just not possible. For my maiden voyage I went with an old classic, Cookies & Creme. Or I think it was Oreo chunk, something along those lines. The pics from fellow Yelpers is what put it over the top for me. They are not shy with the Oreos, which is how all versions of this ice cream should be. Super creamy, Oreos were soft. And while there were a lot, they were spread out, so you didn't just eat the Oreo then have none for the rest of the journey. It was perfect. My wife went with the Cookie Dough and it was disappointing. Not a ton of dough and a little blah-zay. She loved my selection though. Cool place, good ice cream. If in the area I'd definitely stop by!

Updating my review - the ice cream is still good but I noticed last night that there are no descriptions of the flavors anywhere (even checked their website)... for common flavors such as cookie dough, or pistachio... those are obvious, but Blue Monster?? I suppose I could ask the employees what every flavor was and hold up the normally very long line but seems it would be beneficial to list the specifics of each flavor somewhere. Also another annoyance is that for the "small" cone/bowl, you get 3.5 scoops of ice cream but it can only be one flavor? Kind of dumb that you can't split flavors....

Our GO-TO ice cream of all time. Seriously beats all the other ice cream shops here. There's something about this place that makes the ice cream taste so much better. Imagine a hot summer day and you're craving ice cream, you see an ice cream stand in the middle of the park. That nostalgic satisfying taste of summer is this. TRY IT ALL!

Best homemade ice cream! It is a stand, no indoor shop. Love that it is close by.. it has a variety of flavors including ice cream, shakes, ices and sorbets, sundaes.. you name it! they have pint and quart size options to take home as well & you can't forget about $2 Tuesdays! My favorite is Graham Central Station and Blueberry Cobbler. Cant wait to come back and try more flavors!
This ice cream is absolutely delicious!! I highly recommend the banana cream pie flavor! Seating is outside only and very minimally available at best.

I eat at Handel's almost everyday, I get salted caramel in a sugar cone which is delicious! I have to say if it wasn't so good or there was another one closer I would stop going to this one. Salted Caramel is a really soft ice cream, I would think for $4.00 a scoop they could give you a cup on top especially when it is 108 outside. They want to charge .25 extra. How much could a cup cost .01. Terrible owner, not nice.

I'm not sure about the fuss. I was in the mood for some gelato or ice-cream and Handel's had 4 stars on Yelp. It's a definite local spot. There's no inside area, so you just order at the window and I ended up eating in the car. I got 2 flavors to try it out, pistachio and Elvis (banana and peanut butter). I always get a nut flavor if they have it. The pistachio didn't have a lot of pistachio flavor even though it had tons of nuts in the ice cream. The Elvis was actually really good, the combo of banana ice cream with peanut butter. It wasn't as awesome as I expected with the great reviews. The serving was huge and the price was cheap, a little over $4 for 2 scoops.
The quality is so good. The downside is the wait, and they get busy sometimes, but they're nice here and the flavors and quality of the ice cream are worth it. We're addicted now!

It's so nice to have an ice cream place in Vegas. Real ice cream. Too bad they don't have an indoor area to sit down and enjoy. This is a service window only type establishment. Large selection of flavors. I bought a handpacked pint of Salty Caramel Truffle ($4.95) then went back for a hot fudge sundae made with Cherry Cordial the next night ($4.75). I think their best deal is the 4 scoop sampler for $4.75. The ice cream is pretty good. It's not Tillamook Ice Cream good, but its pretty good. The hot fudge sundae could have been a little bigger, and had some peanuts. It's probably 3.5 stars but since its ice cream and semi-local I rounded up. $2 single cones on Tuesdays.

Stopped by for an afternoon treat and tried the 4 scoop sampler. What a bargain $4 for 4 scoops. This would've set you back $12 at Baskin Robbins. My favorite flavor of the 4 was Salted Caramel Truffle.

The ice cream is some of the best I have ever had. It's fantastic and is worth every penny, a little more expensive then some other places, but worth it. That said, the reason this is not a 5 star rating is the way Handel's operates. They never have enough windows open and the same person takes the order, gets the ice cream and takes your payment. It leads to a very slow process and ridiculously long lines. This could be easily fixed if they adjusted the way they worked. The service is as bad as the ice cream is good. It's not the fault of the employees - but someone in charge needs to look at the work flow.

This place has the worst customer service!!! The little "blond" child is so rude. My wife was ordering an ice cream sand which and when the girl asked what type of ice cream she'd like in. She has to repeat herself and then the blonde kid said "Do you speak English" You wanna talk trash about your customers do it behind the closed glass jerks!!!
Love this place.. best Ice cream and speedy service.. home made at it's best.. they have plenty of flavors and Tuesdays are the best.. only $2 scoops..

Best place to get ice cream in Las Vegas! They have have SO MANY flavors to choose from. The chocolate peanut butter brownie flavor is to die for! They also have sundaes, milkshakes and other great options too. The line is typically very long, but it usually moves pretty quickly!

Great variety and selection of ice cream! Love coming here on Tuesdays when a scoop is only $2! I love how they are generous with their scoops. My favorite is the pineapple. It is refreshing to have on hot summer day. I need to try other flavors but so far I have yet to hear there is a bad flavor. Just a warning, it is so good that there is usually lines but it is worth the wait and the people who work there are really nice!

Loved how Handel is super inviting and homey, I brought my dogs and sat down on the benches and made small talk with so many different groups of people there! I got the cookie dough hurricane, the ice cream was super creamy but I wish that there was more cookie dough and/or another sweet inside the hurricane to make it more chunky like a blizzard. I can't wait to go back and try other flavors!

36 degrees outside and I'm craving ice cream!! This place did not disappoint and I was able to place my order and pick it up so I wouldn't have to wait in the cold!!! I had the banana split and it was delicious, especially the crushed cherry topping!
Best I've cream I've had in a long while definitely worth the trip Grahm Central station flavor is the BeezNeez

We've seen people standing in line for several months at this place. We always wanted to go see what the fuss was all about...and after ordering the much anticipated a common Brownie Sundae and Blondie Sundae we quickly realized there was no difference between Handles and DQ. If you're willing to spend $13 on a couple of average sundaes, We recommend you run into Smiths and grab yourself some Haagen-Daza (real ice cream) and make your own. It just wasn't that good!!

I don't know how anyone could not like this place. So many flavors!! These ice creams are so thick, rich, and creamy. I usually stay away from dairy but it's pretty impossible to resist dipping in for another bite after you've started. My sister and I shared a 4 flavor sampler($4.25). Flavors chosen: Coconut cream pie Banana cream pie Blueberry crumble Raspberry cheesecake -My favorite out of the four! Price is right, service is great. I can see the wait being a bit frustrating in the summer when it gets busy. They have multiple windows to order from but with so many flavors to try and choose from, making a decision might take a while. I hope that they decide to add some outdoor seating soon.
The ice cream is pretty good. Employees are friendly. My kids like to go for the Tuesday special.

Ok.... so I may be a little biased because the first 29 years of my life I lived in the heart of Cleveland Ohio...but this ice cream is 1.BOMB 2. So homey 3. The staff is so friendly, clean, speedy and incredibly good polite all I can say is get the BUCKEYE!!!!!!! Attention owners I LOVE YOU and thank you for being so Ohio loyal and awesome!

My husband is from OH and grew up eating Handel's so we were very excited to see one opening in Vegas and 2 miles from our house made it even better. Since they've been open I have probably tried 90% of the flavors on the board and they are ALL delicious! My favorite is the Graham central station. The staff is always super friendly too.
Hidden gem. My sister and I are eating ice cream in the car with our seat warmers on. It's 40 degrees and very windy outside.... but when the need for ice creams comes on.. you must try this place!!!
Best ice cream in Vegas hands down! We've never tried a flavor we didn't love. The portions are huge as well.
Best homemade ice cream in Vegas! The black cherry is amazing! Heck try them all, you won't be disappointed!
YUM! THE ice cream spot in Vegas. Reminds me of the local ice cream shop in my home town. The four scoop sampler is where it's at. Also love the hurricanes. The line is worth the wait.

Not looking forward to the long line but I will defintiely be back... Its not your typical ice cream you can definitely see why there are so many chains across the nation. they know what they're doing when it comes to ice cream.. Me and the wifey tried the 4 flavor sampler Banana Cream, Spouse like a house, Butter Pecan, Chocolate Malt Caramel The ice cream is very thick and creamy also you can taste that it has high content of butter fat so it made your eyes roll back on first bite. I cant wait for us to try more stuff when we come back. I think the chocolate malt caramel stood out for me as well as the butter pecan. I dont really like banana ice cream but wifey sure did enjoy it.
This place is just the bomb!!! Love all different flavors and Tuesday specials!!! Everyone is friendly

***YELP 100 CHALLENGE 16/100*** It's nice to see so many people are excited for this new addition in the SW community. A personal recommendation from our son's teacher was our nudge to try this place. The excitement was quite contagious as you see natives of Youngstown abuzz and reminisce their childhood days eating this ice cream. They have an interesting lay out as there isn't any tables, chairs or benches to sit on, just a walk up window to order, which I think would be challenging during summer time when people just wanna hang out and relieve themselves from the unforgiving Vegas heat. We got the Banana split for the hubby; Blueberry crumble, Buckeye and Salted caramel truffle single scoops at $3.50 each which in retrospect, had I paid attention or a suggestion from the lady helping us, we should've gotten the sampler instead which would have been a better value at $4.25 for 4 scoops. The flavors I tried seemed to be on the sweeter side which was a little too much for me. Quality is ok and would like to try more flavors but not in a hurry to come back.

This place is so good!! They make fresh ice cream everyday. They have $2 tuesdays. The staff is friendly. I definitely recommend this place. I got a single scoop waffle cone the other night and I'm glad I only got the single and not double!! It was so much and worth the price. I got chocolate peanut butter brownie and I can't wait to go back and try more flavors.

On a random whim we sought ice cream....no cookies or donuts, we wanted ice cream Searched yelp and picked Handel's!! We were in for a pleasant surprise! How have a not known of them before this?!? As many times as I have come to Vegas I thought I would have stumbled upon them at some point but alas...we were destined for this day. By far the recommendation of Graham Central Station was the BEST!! You think you would get tired of the graham bits and chunks but NOPE, still ONO!!!We and back a second time to make sure we were right LOL!! Take some time, no matter the weather and stop here folks! You won't regret it!

Probably the best ice cream in town! There is a wait most times, but it is worth it. Coffee chocolate chip is my favorite but all of the others are just as good. I take my kids every weekend, it's our little treat to ourselves. Staff is friendly. They do have some benches so you can enjoy your ice cream right away.
Love taking my grandkids here! So many flavors! Friendly staff. My favorite ice cream spot by far. Tuesday's right now are $2.50 for a generous cone.

Love Handel's! It's so much better than the chain ice cream brands that Vegas still seems to live by. It's just an outside counter similar to Luv It's but with 5x the flavors and it's ice cream, not custard, which I personally like better on most nights. The number of flavors is both a blessing and a curse, they will not be happy if you hold up the line because of indecision. Figure out what you want before you hop in if you can! I recommend the Graham Central Station. Delicious!
I was shocked to see how incredibly understanding and compassionate the staff here were. The ice cream is hands down the best in Vegas. Thank you for your hospitality and kindness.

I have not been here in a long time since I'm avoiding sweets. But today was so hot that I had to stop by on my way home, instead of having coffee. Don't expect a fancy ice cream shop, this place is just a window you order from. They have a variety of flavors and some daily specials. I always get the four (4) scoop sampler, as I can't decide on what flavor all the time. The price is unbelievable for $4.60 out the window (get my drift). You can also get pints to take home, banana split, sundaes and ice pops. They only have two (2) windows to order from and service is good.

Called in for a pick up but was told not until 3 because there was only one person on duty. Ouch! Who hasn't been there? No problem I understand. So I go down expecting to stand in line but there was no line and there was 2 people on duty. Maybe the second person just showed up to help and was in a hurry because he wasn't wearing a mask. He asks me what I want and I told him banana pudding and he replied with snark in his voice, it's not in the menu, what else? I reply chocolate chunk aaaaaand "I'll let you decide and I'll be back" he says as he closes the window. The other person working finally came to the window to ask what else, they were nice, so I told them Banana cream pie and asked them to remind the guy about wearing a mask since he was now digging in the ice cream. He came to the window and asked me if there was anything I needed and I nicely asked him to mask up, to which he replied "He didn't need to because we are social distancing and he works in the back" I simply reminded him he is working with food and he closes the window and walked away.... which honestly I didn't have anything else to say and glad he didn't either. I hope he has corrected himself out of respect and safety for the customers of this place...

Delicious! I love ice cream!! This place is delicious. I have been trying to find a good place for a milk shake and this is my new place. Every flavor I have tried has been great and haven't been disappointed. Whoever is complaining about this ice cream being too sweet is silly! Uh you are eating ice cream dumby! Ice cream is supposed to be sweet. I will come back because it's good. The line doesn't move very quickly because there is only 1 or 2 people working at a time.
Great tasting ice cream. Not too sweet, perfect richness. Love the fruity selections. Awesome service. Will definitely be back for more.

I love this place! Right by my house so I am always here for $2.50 Tuesdays!! So far I've had the Nutella & Hazelnut, green tea, pistachio, and NY cheesecake. Everything is made fresh onsite and is well worth the wait if you happen to stop by during a busy hour. Prices are affordable and they work quickly to make sure everyone is satisfied. They even apologize if it takes a bit long if they are making a fresh batch, which is much appreciated and nothing to be sorry for! Worth a trip to the far west side and a great kept secret!!

Ice cream was good and there were plenty of options. However, it was pricey for what you get and the service was lacking. The women at the window wasn't rude but she wasn't friendly either. After paying over $12 for three single scoops I realized I needed a couple plastic bowls to keep my kids from making a mess on their benches. Handel's charged me 54 cents for two 3-cent plastic bowls. They also don't have any napkins outside the serving windows, so if you need any extra, prepare to wait 10 minutes in line just to get napkins. In summary, good ice cream but I probably won't be willing to pay their prices again for the mediocre service.

Omg the banana ice cream and the coffee chip are amazing! I went here today for my first time and tried the 4 scoop sampler. I also had the strawberry cheesecake and caramel truffle and they were great as well! Delicious!

Always crowded which is a great sign so I finally tried it. Got the 4 scoop sampler. Amazing homemade ice cream. Loved all 4 flavors Graham Central Station Chocolate peanut butter brownie Oree-dough Mint Chocolate chip
wow!!! I wasn't a fan of ice cream but, when I saw the line outside of this place I had to try it. Since then this is our favorite ice cream spot in vegas, everything is goooood.

No pictures to share...it was that good! I tried the Nutella/Hazelnut ice cream in a little cup and it was so creamy and smooth. Makes it hard to want to have any other ice cream now! Go check this place out!

If it's your first time coming here then good luck. Customer service was terrible. We told the girl it was our first time and she vaguely told us how it works. She also assumed we were done ordering when my friend still hadn't ordered. As we waited in line, some other customers also told (a different cashier) that it was their first time and she just told them to take their time. As we got our cones, the presentation was terrible. No consistency in any of their products. One cone was broken and was clearly dripping so she just gave us extra napkins rather than having used a different cone. Quality of product is meh (doesn't stand out from other ice cream shops) but customer service needs serious improvement. It's a gamble so just ask yourself if you also want to waste your time waiting outside in the heat only to deal with terrible service and mediocre quality of products.

Delicious! Ice cream is not even one of my favorite desserts but Handel's is in a class by itself! Completely worth the 20 min drive for me. Coconut cream pie is amazing. Have also tried the chocolate cake batter (very good and super rich) buckeye (vanilla with peanut butter/chocolate, yummy!) and graham central station(I didn't think a graham cracker centered flavor could actually be so tasty!). Service was super slow and the girl did get one of my sampler flavors wrong but I am sure it is just because they just opened.

Where do I start?? I LOVE ice cream and my cousin (Anika C.) took my daughter and I here for a 4th of July special treat in Redondo Beach, CA. There are numerous flavors to fit your fancy from Vanilla with Oreo (my fav) to Buckeye and Graham Central Station; the flavors are endless and delicious. We were able to get a sample to tease our taste buds until we made it home. Don't let the line intimidate you...it goes by fairly quickly, once you try the ice cream you will understand why there is a line. This establishment has a walk up window to order your delectable creamery which gives it a nostalgic feel. On Tuesday's scoops are $2.00, you can purchase a pint to take with you and they have handle pops and so much more. We get the 4 scoop sampler so we can continue to try new flavors...which have not happened yet because we are satisfied with Birthday Cake, Cookie Dough, Vanilla w/ Oreos, and chocolate peanut butter brownie!!! This will be my new ice cream spot for many moons to come!!!
Best Ice Cream Ever!!! Love the Graham Central Station..... $2.00 scoops on Tuesday! :)

I love Handels. We have tried the Handels in Encinitas, CA and now the store in Las Vegas. The ice cream is the best. A bazillion flavors and my favorite is the Grand Central Station. Recommend this Ice Cream to all ice cream lovers
Great ice cream with decent prices.Had ice cream for four. Would definitely come back here for more! You have to try this place.

As a Youngstown native I have to say I was surprised to see my hometown shop in the middle of Vegas. I always laughed at the worse west coast variants of ice cream and I'm super happy to see real ice cream finally. Everything is great here and I can attest from 25+ years of memories that this Handel's is just as good. (They also carry TONS of flavors--much more than Ohio!)

Gone to this ice cream place twice already and guess when...TUESDAY. Why? $2 buck TUESDAY! Handel's gives enough ice cream for you to enjoy. I like how there's just a window for you to order and not the typical ice cream businesses. It reminds of the old days. We usually order Pistachio or Butter Pecan. Recently we tried their seasonal ice cream called Pumpkin Pecan. The best choice! It was delicious!
Homemade ice cream, can't really beat that. With tons of flavors to choose from!!! And there arent every many locations on the west coast either! Very delicious!
The ice cream is delicious. Love all the flavor choices. one that I tried that I wasn't sure of at first but that I ended up really liking was the nerds hurricane!

BAZILLION FLAVORS O_O I could decide where to start... literally there are so many things to choose from... they serve everything out of a window which reminds me of the snack shops along the beaches back home. There were 2 workers working there when we came... they seemed young.. the guy that took care of us could not remember our scoops so he had to keep coming back to the window... we ordered the 4 scoop sampler which is just scooped into one clear Togo container. Definitely thought that there would be some dividers or something. PINK CHAMPAGNE SHERBERT - light & also had a pretty color aahahaha ORANGE SHERBERT - not my choice... but it was still OK SPOUSE LIKE A HOUSE - thanks to Jin N. Review we got this for the big brother & he liked it w/ the chocolate COFFEE CHOCO CHIP - My choice & it was good definitely had a whole bunch of chocolate chips in them which gave the coffee a more espresso flavor STRAWBERRY CHEESECAKE - Could use more if the cheesecake flavor STRAWBERRY x2 - Cant go wrong w/ strawberry CHOCOLATE - Chocolate is chocolate Will definitely have to come back to try some other stuff... but two of the 4 sampler scoops came out to be about close to $10

Slight disclaimer, considering that it was Vegas in June. But this place was better than advertised. I'm a life-long ice cream man, and I have tasted some good stuff. This was the best I've ever had in Vegas, hands down. Tons of different flavors to choose from. Almost problematically so, because every flavor is equally great. They do a 4-flavor sampler which is a great option, because then you can become addicted to multiple flavors, rather than just one. It is a slightly odd setup. No interior seats or tables. You walk-up to the window and order and pay right there. Not a problem, just different, that's all. We found it because some lady on Family Feud said it was the best. I will definitely be going back, but I wish they had more locations in Vegas. This one is located a long way from everything in Vegas, and could be more convenient.

Best ice cream flavor I have ever had in my life - Graham Central Station. I crave this every time I visit family in Vegas. It is creamy with a graham cracker-type flavor but it's solid contents are brown sugar and these crunchy, scrumptious chocolate/caramel type bits. A must try.
My favorite ice cream with a wide variety of flavors but I like the pineapple sherbet shake the best especially on a hot summer's day.

Graham Central Station is hands down the best ice cream I've ever had. Never been a huge fan of ice cream and dairy products in general but I could eat my weight of GCS. Huge chunks of graham cracker with chocolate-covered I-don't-even-know-whats. Be forewarned. A waffle cone "single" scoop is more like a single, shovel scoop. It's huge. We have to eat in our car during the summer months; otherwise, it melts and drips faster than I can gobble it down. Their other flavors are really good too but I've now synonymized "Handels" with GCS. They'll let you try any flavor you want but try to save GCS for last so you can at least consider the other flavors before dedicating your life to GCS.

We love Handels so much! Every flavor we have tried has been delicious! If you're overwhelmed with the amount of choices they let you sample them! My favorite is the New York cheesecake! We let everyone know about handels and bring everyone with us! If you're weary you should try it on Tuesdays for their $2 scoops! So so good, we'll probably go tonight for date night ;)

Holy crap this ice cream is amazing!! Also, the store is incredibly clean!!! Never seen a place so well taken care of. Excellent choice and definitely worth the drive! I drove 30 minutes to get here. Try it!!

Having been to Handel's on a number of occasions, I was looking forward to the new location opening in the area. I arrived around noon on their opening day. There are so many great flavors to choose from I decided to get a more conventional flavor, the chocolate raspberry truffle in a cake cone. Flavors were solid and I'm happy to have another dessert option on the Southwest side of town. I think adding some outdoor seating might be a nice next step for this location, to mirror others I have visited.

Only Getting One Star, Because It Won't Let You Review, Without... I Was Just Turned Away From Service, Although I Was In Line Before The Store's Posted Closing. They Turned Off The Lights, And Made An Announcement That The Woman In Front Of Me Was Last... It Was Very Poor Customer Service, And You May Want To Retrain Your Staff... They Were Having Fun, Visibly Goofing Off, Inside. Hence The Line Not Moving. As I'm Writing This, The Line Has Yet To Be Completed. I Would Be Ashamed If This Was My Store.
Absolutely the best ice cream I've ever had in my life. Always a line here, but well worth the wait. Amazing variety of flavors that are all made on site.

Taco Tuesdays? Love em...but Handels low-key has the one of the sweetest (pun intended) Tuesday deals in the city. How can you not love $2 Tuesday one nice hearty scoop of a their delicious creamy ice cream flavors after work. I love to go and try different flavors, I recommend the pineapple sherbet and pistachio, always satisfy my sugar cravings. I like the simplicity of Handels you go up to their window... ask and go, there is out door seating if you wanna get to business right then and there. I kinda wish they had some indoor seating only because I do like to eat ice cream year round, but I'll manage. The staff is always friendly and I've never seen anybody leave with the look of unsatisfaction. Definitely a top ice cream spot here in Vegas, good flavors, can be a bit pricey if you don't go on Tuesdays, but worth treating yourself to some quality ice cream every now and then!

My favorite ice cream ever. I highly recommend their salty caramel truffle flavor, followed closely by Buckeye. I've never had anything but a dish of one of those flavors. No toppings, no shakes. I don't feel like I'm missing anything. There is no indoor seating and if you go on $2 Tuesday, expect a line. It will be worth it.
Amazing selection of ice cream. Their hurricanes and sundaes have all been delicious. $2 Tuesdays for a scoop is great to try their flavors.

I was born and raised in Youngstown Ohio so this icecream was a staple for all occasions. I grew up eating it and I'm so happy that it made its way to Vegas. Buckeye and graham central station are a must!!!! You will not be disappointed. If you're a pumpkin lover like me their pumpkin cheesecake, pecan and ripple are to die for. They only have these during the autumn season. I really don't understand why everyone is complaining about the lack of seating? I don't understand how you could give this place less than five stars. I guess it is a west coast thing to want to sit down while eating icecream. Back home you stand, chat with your friends, sit on the trunk of your car and enjoy your sweet treat. People find anything to complain about. Vegas has large chain restaurants and lacks the "mom and pop" shops that you can taste the love in whatever they serve. Handels is authentic, affordable and never disappoints! To those of you people who disagree go back to eating your overpriced, boring DQ or Baskin Robbins crap and save the good stuff for us real icecream lovers!

PROS...Large variety of creamy flavors and ways to have your ice cream. Vegan options. CONS....It's a service window you walk up to, with outside seating only. Depending on the time of day, you could be standing in a line with 15 people in front of you. That's especially not fun in the sun with Vegas summers. Prices are high. Staff are sometimes not so friendly, seem pretty stressed, so maybe there's not enough staff.
One word, OHSOYUMMY! Worth every penny, smooth creamy, great flavor selections. Unless you are lactose intolerant, you won't be disappointed, but you better eat quick or it will get messy

You can't go wrong here. There are a ton of choices and a scoop is pretty big it's a tough decision. They are very helpful with letting you taste anything you want. I did the blueberry cobbler and black cherry delicious!! Next time I'm going for the coffee chip my friend got it and it was amazing!!

I honestly wish we had Handel's in Denver, CO. I was in the Summerlin area, and wanted to try some new desserts... It was between ice cream and boba. It was a tough decision but honestly, the reviews at Handel's interested me! How is this place getting consistent 5 stars? I checked out the menu and saw all the raves about Graham Central Station (w/honeycomb) and Graham Canyon (w/butter toffee) and decided I needed to go and try it out for myself. No walk-in ice cream shop but there's plenty of seats and benches. The long lines can be quite a bit of a deterrence BUT DON'T LET THAT STOP YOU! This ice cream is so worth it. Our server was patient and allowed us to try 4 samples before we settled on a flavor. This company does not lie when they say they don't skimp on the cones and the ice cream. I was thrilled to see how far my $5 goes (get the waffle cone, it's worth it). The ice cream is so smooth and contains so much flavor. I would say though, for the Graham Canyon, my scoop had a bit too much butter toffee in it, and it was rather sweet by the time I reached the waffle. Other than that: amazing ice cream, worth the money, worth the wait. I can't wait to come back to Las Vegas and try more flavors!

I just moved into the neighborhood and found Handel's last week. Let's just say the staff is super friendly and very conscious of long lines. As they opened more windows to serve the guests faster. The ice cream was the best I've ever had. In fact I brought my family back three times last week and took my aunt and her kids there. I found out the company is from Ohio and so am I. Handel's reminded me of the ice cream stands from Ohio. I will always rave about Handel's ice cream. It will be a weekly stop for my family. Oh and the cones are sky high!!

I first heard of Handel's Ice Cream from my bf. We decided to try the place since his dental professor claims it's the best ice cream in town! There was a line when my bf and I arrived at the location. I quickly noticed that Handel's was not your typical ice cream shop. Instead, they had two windows for placing your orders and a bench for sitting on the side. We didn't mind waiting in line, since there were so many flavors to choose from and the line seemed to move fairly quick. I ordered the "4 flavor sampler" that had butter pecan, birthday cake, cookies & cream, and rocky road. I was really impressed on how creamy the ice cream was, especially for the butter pecan! Pros: -$2 Tuesdays -Bigger Scoops (in a cone - except for the "4 flavor sampler") -Good Service -Affordable price for ice cream (awesome for those on a college budget!) Cons: No place to really sit Although I am lactose intolerant, I still make occasional stops for that butter pecan & waffle cone! Just pop in some lactose pills and you're good to go! I've tried Blue Bell & Cream... in my opinion, it still does not compare to the quality of Handel's Ice Cream.

The absolute best ice cream! I always get a hot fudge brownie sundae and it's unbeatable! The portions are always good and they always make sure everybody is getting their orders quickly so you're never stuck in line too long. Amazing selection of flavors and excellent quality ice cream!

This place seems busy usually but I can't understand why. It was dead tonight, Sunday at 7:30 pm. I've been here three times and it seems like the employees never know what they are doing. What's strange is they leave the dippers in the freezer which makes it impossible to scoop the ice cream. Each time I watch them struggle with trying to scoop the ice cream and get it out of the dipper. Have they never heard of a "dip well" that you leave the dippers in that trickles water so the scoops are always rinsed? Tonight I got a banana split which is supposed to be a split banana (hence banana split) laid along the side of the three scoops in the container but only got a few slices dropped in beside the ice cream. Then he put the whipped cream on first before the toppings. Common sense should tell you this is wrong for anyone who's ever seen a picture of a banana split but he's an untrained teen so I can't blame him. For toppings, only a very awful tasting over portioned crushed pineapple and crushed maraschino cherries. Absolutely awful. And then no chocolate syrup and no nuts. Then he hands me the open container with the pineapple and crushed cherries spilling all,down the side from where he ineptly tried to put the toppings along side of the ice cream and whipped cream. Can't put it on top, whip cream came first. The last time I was there I got a hot fudge sundae and also no nuts and a smidgen of fudge. The way it looks is always unappealing. This is what happens when you turn your store over to be run by teenagers with attitude. They really don't care about what they are serving and when you're looking for a sweet treat to lift you up its quite frustrating to be served this crap. They opened this store in a nice neighborhood with families that have probably a little more than the average families expendable income. If they provided a better customer experience, better product and presentation, they could get away with charging more. Serving poor quality product and giving poor service just because the price is low is not a mixture for success. I doubt I'll be back there.

They scream there is very good the workers are very friendly there was let you try a sample of ice cream to see if you like it first before you buy it if you don't like about the places there's no place to sit is walk up only and you can take it home to eat it or eat it in your car so but the ice cream is very good there
Went here got a 4 scoop sampler it was so yummy. Orange dream, strawberry cheesecake, mango sorbet and banana cream pie. They are amazing!!!
The graham central station is hands down my favorite flavor!! Probably one of my favorite ice cream spots in Vegas!
Never disappointing. I love the variety as well as the quality. Best ice cream joint in town! The service is great too. If there is a long line, it's worth it. Promise.

Ohio based ice cream company that I grew up in Pennsylvania loving finally made it's way to Vegas a couple years ago. The only thing that I wish they had was Superman ice cream. I'm almost positive the ones back east had that flavor, but this one does not. They have blue moon though....(one of the flavors in Superman ice cream) My dog loves their sugar free options.

This is from our community where we grew up in Ohio. Would go on Sundays for a treat. Just got some in Tualatin, Oregon & retuned home to get more. Buckeye is the best. Wish there was one of these in Idaho!
Great variety of flavors, very friendly staff, used to get busy when school lets out but not a problem now, I always buy some to take home, highly recommend it
Cute ice cream shop to stop by and leave! No tables as this location is a walk up window. The ice cream has a good consistency and is really tasty.
Best ice cream EVER!!! Service is face to face. I wore a mask as a courtesy please have your employees wear a mask too.

Really good ice cream! I was just looking for some ice cream on a cone, nothing special and when I got here it was like "wow, look at this menu!". They have a lot of flavors and options to choose from. And it's really good! I got myself a strawberry cheesecake on a waffle cone, absolutely amazing!!! It's a little weird of a place with no inside, you order at a window and just leave with your ice cream. There's no sitting down, so if you're thinking of hanging out while enjoying your ice cream, this is not the place. According to the guy, it's old school, like ice cream places used to be back in the day. The only reason why I'm not giving this place five stars is the service. See, it's not the fact that you can't sit down and enjoy your ice cream peacefully, that didn't bother me as much as the way the guy who served us was acting. So grumpy, not personable at all. I felt like we were bothering him by being there to order something. It's an ice cream for place! Be nice. There are so many places you can go to to have ice cream (that you can actually sit down), if you're picking that place they should offer you nothing but a good experience.

Just wow. Quite possibly best ice cream spot if not top 3 I've ever been to, and I've been to a lot. Flavors like the banana creme, new york cheesecake and blueberry cobbler are out of this world! People that work there are so nice too and don't be shy to sample!
FANTASTIC! This place is ON POINT! Super great ice cream, very creative offerings. Just say no to 31 Flavors and get the REAL DEAL here!

When Im asked, what would you last meal on earth be? I respond with whatever restaurant Im feeling, and ice cream from Handels. Im thankful its 60 miles from my home, or I would become a spouse like a house (one of their cleverly named flavors!). I flip out over the flavors they come up with, yesterday I tried pumpkin pecan, and cinnamon roll. Both divine. My go to, banana cream pie, chocolate cake batter, often times they have blueberry cobbler which is amazing, and sometimes I go with a seasonal. This ice cream is, hands down, the best ice cream I have ever eaten. Note, I just saw a sign that they now have lactose free ice cream made with almond milk!!
I love handle's! Great service , and love ice cream ! The employees have been great through covid making us feel as normal as we can !

Love love love Handels Ice Cream, especially on $2 Tuesday!! You can't beat that deal and it's worth waiting in line. My girls lean towards the cookies n cream but when we steer them to try a new flavor they always like or love it. They also have excellent tasting non dairy options for those who prefer or need that. For myself I pretty much read the entire flavor menu each time only to choose Blueberry Cobbler. I can't stop ordering it, soooooooo good!! I'm never disappointed. If you live close to Summerlin, Handels is a must try.
This ice cream is mouthwatering! They have such unique flavors that taste so fresh, their prices are super reasonable for the amount of ice cream you get. Highly recommend!
Great ice cream & worth the wait even in the face of the usual lines of loyal customers.

Handel's is easily my favorite place to go for ice cream! Not only is their $2 Tuesday a great deal, its actually more like 3 or 4 scoops rather than the advertised 2. They consistently have new seasonal flavors but every time I go I have to order my all time favorite, blueberry cobbler! The coconut creme pie was a close second but unfortunately they don't carry it any more. Pro tip: keep an eye out for their coupons in the mail!

I would wait an eternity or drive a thousand miles for this stuff!!!! Crack on a cone! It was nice to see families getting together to enjoy some ice cream on a hot night and standing in line talking to each other about what to choose while they waited for their time at the old fashioned outside window. So far I've tried Bananas Foster, Butter Pecan, Salted Carmel Pretzel and Graham Central Station-Holy Cow! Not a bad one in the bunch!!!! ***Bonus***next door is Anna's Italian Bistro which is excellent!!!! Save room for dessert and step next door to Handels-truly a perfect evening!

My kids and I have been well over 50 times to Handel's for their 2.50 Tuesday special! The staff is always so friendly and always allow my indecisive son some advice for his flavor choice. The ice cream is delicious and the service is great! Well worth the line for their special Tuesday deal!

Oh I love Handel's! All flavors are to die for. When stressed out, we look forward of going here and everything will go well most specially having the pistachio flavor ice cream. Kids love it here all the time

I love this place! When I came here I thought it was a walk-in ice cream shop but it's actually more like a take out stand. They have such a large variety of ice cream flavored and the four scoop sampler is the best deal. My top flavors are pistachio, peanut butter parfait, praline pecan, and cheesecake. The best thing about their ice creams is that each ice cream flavors have the actual food in it. For example, cheesecake has cheesecake bites and pistachio has actual pistachios, etc. My least favorite ice cream flavor was Reese's peanut butter cups. I avoided getting the Reese's pieces one because I don't like Reese's pieces. I got the peanut butter cup expecting it to have crushed up peanut butter cups but instead, it was crushed up Reese's pieces! I don't know if the girl got my flavor wrong since she only remembered one out of my four flavors and had to ask again, but that was the only disappointing part of my meal. Overall this is my new favorite ice cream place and I would always come back here for ice cream! Especially now that the Vegas heat is increasing!

Handel's easily has some of the best ice cream in Vegas! Everything is made daily and there is a wide variety of flavors and options when it comes to enjoying everyone's favorite cold treat. Also, great value with $2 Tuesdays! Be prepared to stand in line! My family and I love this place. We're here almost every week. However, there is no sit in area and the lines can get really long, especially during the summer and during normally busy times like Saturday evening. Small price to pay for some scrumptious ice cream!

Handel's is the best Ice cream in town! It's made fresh and in small batches! Pick a flavor and you CAN'T go wrong! My favorite is peanut butter parfait, but they are all delicious! Tuesday night's special is $2 a scoop (and their scoops are BIG)! You may wait in a long line, but it's worth it! We also love the 4 pack sampler, which is pretty much like getting your cake (or ice cream) and eating it too!
Omg!!! Delicious flavors. Ice cream was delicious, added some extra toppings too. Staff was very nice and patient.

LOVE love love Handel's. I'm a huge, unbearable ice cream snob and I hate getting ice cream that isn't local to the place. BUT I'll make an exception for Handel's. It's delicious. And cheap. And so welcome always in the Vegas heat.

Awesome ice cream best in town! Great flavors and so many to choose from. I love to get the sampler it's 4 med sized scoops for a great price and u get to try them this way. Friendly staff and the best ice cream in town! Definitely will come again and again!!!!
Amazing! Best ice cream in town with a wide variety of flavors. Been a long time customer

Being from Youngstown, I was soooo excited to hear that Handel's was coming to Las Vegas. There is NOTHING like this here. DQ, Baskin Robbins...ICK. Ive had to settle for frozen yogurt. When you've had Handel's everything else mine as well be from the freezer section of the grocery store in a carton. Its just like home, stand outside and wait in line at a walk up window. I got my usual, a scoop of grape and a scoop of vanilla w oreo. YUMMY! Had some of Eds butter pecan....OMG so delish. The flavors are the same as Ohio (thank goodness). My reason for 4 stars is because the scoops seemed a lil skimpy compared to Youngstown which was a lil disappointing but my waistline thanks me :) Vegas....go treat yourself. If you love ice cream, there's NO DOUBT you will fall in love. Unsure what to choose from all the flavors? Just ask for a sample.
Not bad ice cream... I'd go Tuesday night (there's a good discount) I got ice cream sundae with fudge... give it a 4 when it comes to ice cream.

Best ice cream? ......No, there are other choices in the Las Vegas area that are just as good. But customer service is terrible and MAYBE not because of the server's fault. It's the store policy! My daughter, her friend, and I went into the store to buy ice cream cones. The server takes our order and hands the cone to my daughter and her friend. Well, the scoop of ice cream falls out of the cone and onto the floor. We made it a point to tell the server the ice cream just fell right out without tipping the cone. He replied the rehearsed line, "it's our policy not to replace the ice cream.".....REALLY?..... And this after you didn't smush it down into the cone hard enough so it could stay put or that the little girl didn't tip the cone over? (she's 9) So I had to shell out another $3.75 to replace the cone. I think the goodwill shown by replacing the ice cream scoop for free is better than having to charge the customer more money for something that wasn't even the girl's fault. I don't fault the server (he's following orders from the owners) but taking good care of your customers is worth a lot more than an extra $3.75. You can always make an exception, especially when it's a young child. How can you tell a child who drops their ice cream ( clean drop, no licks yet) that they can't have a replacement?

Awesome! Awesome! Awesome! Ordered ice cream for my sons birthday party, phenomenal service with so many choices. Patrick was more than helpful at accommodating me when putting together my order. I highly recommend every flavor but Monkey Business was my personal favorite! Best in town
Dairy free coconut ice cream hot fudge brownie sundae. Are you kidding me? You can't beat this place, I would just like to see more dairy free flavors!

I would get ice cream here everyday if i could. 1 minute from my house! Handels is one of those places where you just walk up to to the window and order. Its like a glorified ice cream stand lol. One thing I like is the amount of flavors!!! They have classic flavors and new flavors! I usually get the 4 scoop sampler because I can never decide on one flavor. The service is always nice here but sometimes they have long lines. If you live around here you know theres a lot of ice cream in this area but this is my go-to.

Get ready to get ice cream wasted because one scoop is going to be what it takes to fill your stomach! The portions are huge it's crazy! Went with my family (7 people) each ordered something different from single scoops to hurricanes to 4 scoop sampler and paid $30 which is great! And we still couldn't finish all of it! There's a huge selection of ice cream nothing too unique but most likely going to find a flavor you at least would want. For the prices and servings it's great. Not sure if I'd return for a particular craving but definitely a good place to experience.
You wouldn't think that a walk up ice cream shop would work in Las Vegas because it's SO HOT people are trying to get out of the heat... but it does. Best ice cream in town.

Such a cute, old school type of ice cream shop! They have a ton of flavors & I love that they do a 4 scoop deal for only $4.25. Great & cost effective way to see what flavors you like. My favorites were the mocha almond & the salted caramel. Some flavors were just okay, like the blue raspberry but overall the flavors were good. Don't come here if you're looking to eat inside because it's an outside, walk up & order type of deal. They do have some benches outside though. The only downfall to me was their baked goods. I got a blondie & it barely had any flavor to it. I'd say get the ice cream & skip out on any of their baked goods.

Delicious!!! What a great concept! You walk up to the window to order your delicious homemade ice cream! What more do you want in Las Vegas on a hot night!!!! Hope they open more locations!! Fast friendly service. Did I mention the price? Affordable, and delicious.

You can taste the quality! Now they don't have one on my side of town (probably a good thing...for my a$$ size) however, if you find yourself nearby, deff dont pass up! I fond this place on dollar cone day, which happen to be a Saturday..score right there. And you're thinking $1 cones *tiny*, nope..3 scoops atop a sugar cone (I tipped my scooper- that's how we do things in Vegas ya' know & he might have been a bit heavy-handed on my $1 cone) - I'm not complaining! They seem to also have deals other days of the week too. So 4 starts: The only thing I was disappointed in was the lack of seating outside. It's a walk-up window, which is fine, but non-existent seating is a dealbreaker. Lots of families, running, yelling kids (its an ice cream joint on $1 cone day right!?!) but the lack of seats made the commotion a little nerve racking for me. It was a nice day outside, I can only image what chaos summer will bring, I hope they invest in more seats...its like a missed opportunity on their part.

The ice cream here is only so so. They have rented out a huge place. You cannot go inside. You must place your order at a window that a woman opens. There are NO restrooms. NO place to sit. Not customer friendly. Maybe the business should relocate to a place that people can enjoy sitting down.

Best ice cream especially on Tuesday $2 scoops can't beat the price! I've been here quite a few times and their ice cream never fails in flavors! Some specialties are gram central station, monkey business, blueberry cobbler and bday cake the lines are somewhat long at times but they move quickly
Handel's is so worth the wait. There's almost always a line and for good reason. The ice cream is so good and there's such a wide variety. I've never been disappointed.
Love this place !! I tried the 4 scoop sample.. You cannot go wrong with any type of ice cream you choose.

Graham Central station, banana cream pie, blueberry cobbler, and blue monster. Can't go wrong with these! I absolutely love this place! So worth the wait and they always have these nice young kids working there! If you go on a non-Tuesday, you might as well get a 4 scoop sampler or a pint than a single scoop bc the cost isnt that much more. That's how we got suckered into eating 15 pints in a span of 4 months!! LOVE THIS PLACE!
Best ice cream ever! My favorite is the Nutella. We visit Handels every time we are in Vegas.

Wonderful ice cream and the seasonal flavors make the experience even better! They get slow on tuesdays ($2 Tuesdays) but still worth the wait. The Peppermint stick and blueberry cobbler are my favorite.

The ice cream was great, the service was sub-par. I pulled this place up on Yelp before heading over and didn't realize, even after reading others reviews that this place has no actual store front so keep that in mind. It is walk up window service ONLY. That wasn't too big of a deal but might take some reconsideration in the summer time on hot days or for those who have a car full of kids. Handel's has an extensive menu full of fun names and sweet flavors of creamy goodness. I didn't want to be one of those people that didn't know what I wanted, but I guess I was. I asked a total of three questions and was given short agitated answers by the man behind the window. I'm sorry I don't know what cookies or candies are inside your ice cream flavors sir. The man was impatient and seemed rushed to get me away from his window. I quickly ordered a cone with graham central station and paid in cash. I was at the window a total of two minutes...no one was behind or in front of me. The ice cream was delicious with swirls of graham cracker and chocolate and a nice healthy service for less than $4 but I don't feel welcome enough to come back and worry that not having an actual store might hinder customers with small children who want to pick a "color" or need a place to sit while eating their cones. That is something to keep in mind.

Handel's....Yum! My girlfriend and I ate here every Tuesday for $2 buck Tuesday and my husband brings home a quart or pint every other week or so. My absolute favorite is the coffee chocolate chip. I seriously can't get enough of it. Maybe a rewards card would be nice.

I followed their instructions and called in my order, which was waiting for me when I got there. Fast, easy, and delicious as usual. Thanks so much for reopening, you didn't have to but I am so happy you did. This ice cream is absolutely the best in town and their employees are always so nice and friendly.
The best ice cream in Vegas! Great Staff! The 4 Scoop Sampler is the perfect choice for the newby or ice cream lover! Something for anyone in the family!

Another new dessert spot serving frozen carbs has opened up. I've never heard of Handel's before which is kind of bad since it was born in Ohio and so was I; I'm not a good Buckeye, apparently. We came by on the first night of opening because Yelpers have FOMO like that. I didn't know it was an outdoor establishment where you order at the counter; there's no place to eat indoors. Because of this fact, our group of friends was standing around in a circle eating our ice cream, trying to create body warmth amongst us while we ate spoonfuls of frozen sugar; go figure. There are a plethora of flavors to choose from, making it difficult to choose. Thankfully, there is a 4 scoop sampler available for $4.25, which was just perfect. The b/f chose two flavors and I chose the other two, which were Chocolate Peanut Butter Brownie, Cherry Cordial, Spouse Like a House (Louse? Mouse?), and Buckeye. Spouse Like a House, the flavor with a funny name, is vanilla ice cream with chocolate-covered peanut butter pretzels and it's delicious. I also liked Buckeye, which has chocolate-peanut butter candies shaped like the nut of Ohio's state tree. Actually, all four flavors were fabulous. I can foresee this place being popular with the Bishop Gorman students since their campus is right down the street, as well as any other ice cream lover. Welcome to town, Handel's, a bit of Youngstown now in Las Vegas.

I live just down the street from Handel's and I go there all the time! Especially now that I'm pregnant, I go a couple times a week. When I first started going here, the ice cream used to be so amazing and filled with lots of chunks of whatever (cheesecake, cookie dough, etc.) But now it seems like they are getting pretty skimpy on the chunks of stuff. It's still good ice cream, don't get me wrong, but I just wish they didn't start being skimpy on the fillings. :(
Awesome flavors Galore!!!!! So many yummy treats to choose from! It's my favorite ice cream place in Nevada & honestly the only ice cream place I keep going back to. Everything else falls short.
Disappoint that I couldn't get a hurricane 15 minutes before they closed. The worker told me they don't do hurricanes 15 prior to closing. Did i miss that on the website?

This has by far been the best ice cream joint I've visited here in Las Vegas. The ice cream was delicious, creamy, and had awesome flavors. -1 star though for the service, the young man that helped my girlfriend and I was such a Debbie downer, and so was the girl helping the gentleman next to us. It wouldn't hurt to smile guys!

I thought by all of the high star ratings that this place has, that this was going to be a great ice cream place. After reviewing the extensive menu, I decided to try a brownie hurricane. There was not anyone else waiting, and it seemed to take a while to prepare. What I received was a cup of melted ice cream with some brownies in it. It was very unappealing, I've had milkshakes thicker than this. On top of that it $5 for this melted ice cream, don't think I'll ever be going back.

This ice cream is crazy good. We came here in the freezing cold and I was not thrilled about standing outside in line to get it......but boy o boy was it worth it. I think this is the best ice cream I've ever had in my life and I'm a fat kid that's had A LOT of ice cream.

I've been wanting to try this place for a while now. Finally decided to go with my son this past Saturday. When we arrived I noticed that it's a walk-up window only. Not a problem since we were not going to eat there anyway. They have a good size menu with lots of flavors and cookie sandwiches. My son decided on the latter and I opted for two scoops on a waffle cone. I proceeded to order when the girl tells me that I cannot get two scoops of two different flavors. She stated they go by serving size. I stood there with a confused look on my face. Okay, so I cannot get two scoops with two different flavors? Isn't a scoop a serving size? I'm confused. She said no, then went on to explain their serving size. Again I was a little confused. Whether it be scoops or serving size, she made it seem as if I could not get two different ones on a cone. Her explanation was a little weird to me, thus leaving a sour taste in my mouth. Especially after looking over to the gentleman next to me, walking away with two different scoops on a regular cone. By the time I received my waffle cone with only one flavor I was annoyed and did not enjoy my it at all. I felt like I could have went to Sweet Addiction for Thrifty's Ice Cream (some of the best in my opinion) or Baskin Robbins and been satisfied. Now that it's been a few days since my visit I feel like I can give a good review without being annoyed as I was initially. Will I go back? No. Was the ice cream good? Honestly it was just alright. I was very underwhelmed.

I went for two buck tuesday at around 3, so there were many kids and their parents in line since they had just gotten off school. Two registers were open. I asked the cashier at mine if I could try a flavor (whatever the monthly special was) and he said "we're not doing taste tests because of the super long line." I hear another customer ask for a sample to the other cashier, and she says yes. I just comply with what my cashier told me and get my usual flavor, salted caramel. I ask for it in a cone but to also give me a cup since salted caramel is usually very melty. He gives me the ice cream, I pay, then walk off. I finally decide to look at the receipt when I get home and find that he charged an extra quarter for the cone. For some reason, I thought cones were included in two buck tuesday. Maybe it's because i asked for it with a cup. Anyhow, i won't be coming back to this handel's on a tuesday because the cashiers seem moody.

This place is so amazing!! Every flavor is so good. The buckeye ice cream is full of tons of little Buckeyes. The coffee ice cream has chocolate chips in it. If you are looking for tons of variety and great ice cream. Try this place!!

Handels we love coming here. Your ice cream is top notch but your customer service has slipped and fast. With no line tonight and orders for 2 hot fudge sundae why could not the team chip in and help make the 2 orders? Instead we stand around as 2 employees look at social media sites and take pictures. Poor service makes me question coming back.

Definitely real ice cream! Probably some of the best in Vegas. Tried the banana split & loved that they actually used chocolate, strawberry & vanilla ice cream. Very large & covered in toppings. Great value too. Also had the 4 pack sampler & great to try different flavors. Loved them but thought the chocolate malt was really bland.
I've only tried 3 or 4 flavors so far, but we have been coming here frequently! Everything tastes great! $2 Tuesdays! This is an awesome place to take the kids!

hire more help! line is ridiculous every night, you are losing customers because of this. you need someone taking orders, someone scooping, someone doing toppings. you serve ice cream how hard can it be to be fast??

I absolutely love Handel's! I always come with my friends! I have been here 3 times already and the quality is consistent. I love the four scoop sampler because it is cheap and gives me a variety. The birthday cake flavor is rich and tastes exactly like it's supposed to. The cookies and cream has Oreos inside and you can definitely taste the flavors. My favorite is the cotton candy because they perfectly capture it in an ice cream. The strawberry cheesecake is also delectable because there are little cheesecake bites within it!

The first time we ever had Handels was when my family and I were just wandering around Redondo beach on vacation. There was a line for it so we tried it out and loved it! We recently moved to the southwest area, near Bishop Gorman and were so surprised that Handels was here near us! Best ICE CREAM spot! My favorite is their banana creme pie flavor! They've got a lot of flavors and every Tuesday is $2 TUESDAYS!

I'm very happy I found this place. It's open somewhat late which is nice for those like me who's sweet tooth kicks in when the sun drops. The ice cream is very creamy. I usually get the Butter Pecan in a cake cone. The pecans are very large and, in my opinion, always has a perfect ratio between the ice cream. If you're coming in at night, just walk up to the window and order. I think you'll be very satisfied with it. If you've had better, then consider yourself fortunate.

My favorite ice cream place in Las Vegas. In fact it's the only place I go to for ice cream. Truly it's always fresh and delicious . Staff were always super friendly and prompt. Thank you Handel's for recognizing the Veterans every single year!!!

Don't get a milkshake until they figure out that the tiny straws that they provide don't work. Got my milkshake 30 minutes to go and I have yet to get anything out of it. On top of them convincing me to get a monster shake. Just the lack of thinking on their part deserves this one star. ORDER BIGGER STRAWS!
Really awesome place to go when you want ice cream. Had the Blondie Sunday tonight. It was the best!!!

Homemade ice cream heaven!!!!!! Get ready to die from the massive flavor selection. Every single scoop of this creamy treat will create an ice cream addiction that you will not be able to break. Nothing else in town can compare. You'll have to move to another city to get away from this ice cream crack stand. This is not an ice cream joint for the bullshitter. Serious ice cream consumers only! The calories will kill you, but the trip to homemade ice cream heaven is worth every bite.

Never got to taste the ice cream. Waited in line behind one person for 5 minutes and left. All they wanted was an ice cream cone. Perhaps the employees should be focused on customers instead of talking among themselves. And this was at 1:30 on a Sunday afternoon. I can get bad service anywhere. I won't be going back.

I have to say coming from Ohio where I know where the original Handles originated, I am apalled at the fact I was asked if I had a child present with me when I ordered a child sized cone of vanilla ice cream with the rest of my order. I was taking my order for my family home, and because I didnt have a child present with me I was told they could not sell me a child size cone of vanilla ice cream. Riley was our cashier. I'm sure this is not her fault, but a result of being told she could not, since she repeated how she could not sell us the child size cone if our child was not there. I would appreciate if I am a paying customer and I am ordering from a menu you advertise with options that I can choose from, that you not embarrass me, nor make me feel inadequate while making my purchase. We asked for a specific size for a specific reason. Nothing was asked for free and was part of a full order, to go. I am strongly debating to return to this establishment which was one of our favorites here in Vegas that made us feel closer to home. I was surprised I still ate my ice cream with how disturbed I was. I work in the food industry and have never seen this type of service to a customer. Especially from a Handle's.

Unless you grew up in the midwest you probably haven't heard of this chain. It was new to me and I was pleasantly surprised to see a wide variety of flavors that are unique when compared to most other ice cream chains. A large menu next to the walk-up-and order windows lists all the flavors and specialty items available. It can get busy so you'll have plenty of time to decide what you want. Portion sizes are generous, with a "single scoop" actually consisting of three small scoops of ice cream. The product itself is pretty good. There are plenty of chocolate truffles in the chocolate raspberry truffle flavor, the New York style cheesecake ice cream was also full of cheesecake chunks, and malt balls and bits of graham crackers dotted the Graham Central Station ice cream. All were creamy and somewhat airy, but with a sugary and grainy finish. With summer just around the corner there's no doubt the lines will get even longer. 3.5 Stars
All I can say great homemade flavor ice cream. Nice customer service. Great specials and fresh ice cream. Open late night and quality on point. For sure give a try!
Best ice cream I have ever eaten in my life. I think about it constantly and tell everyone I know about this place.

Oh my gosh, this place is a true gem! It was hot so I Yelped "ice cream" and Handel's was one of the closest spots with the best reviews. There is no inside seating area at all, this is more of the walk up and go kind of place. I definitely enjoyed their ice cream selection but was a little bummed when I didn't see rocky road on the menu...it's one of my faves. I chose the four scoop sample! Anything with cookies is a winner. Their mango sorbet is PHENOMENAL!!

My in-law family is from Ohio. This is a taste of home for them and I now absolutely LOVE this place. Never again will I go to a chain ice cream shop. Our top (and only) 3 picks are Buckeye, Gram Central Station, & Banana Cream Pie.

This is my new favorite Ice Cream place! Handel's Home Made Ice Cream & Yogurt is a Walk up window service place. I was a bit overwhelmed with the menu. Tons of ice cream flavors & creations to chose from! They are constantly busy. Even with the busyness the staff still maintained good customer service. That's a bonus for me. Final three flavors were: Graham Central Station, Coconut Creme Pie & Butter Pecan. Each scoops were a very generous size. All I have to say is 3 words Oh my goodness!!! The ice cream was very creamy, full of flavor & I'm assured that it was all made with LOVE! Handel's is a must have!
Best ice cream hands down! $2 scoop tuesdays is the way to go. Creamy and so good! I got the peanut butter and chocolate and hubs got the dairy free in watermelon. Great price too!

2 bucks Tuesday for the family and Coffee chocolate chip ice cream HEAVEN on Earth The staff is friendly and although the lines can get long they work fast and efficiently so your not waiting more than a few minutes. A great place to go to after dinner or Just for a treat its worth the trip.
Best strawberry cheesecake ice cream ever. My boyfriend and I come here probably two or three times a week...hehe. If you're an ice cream lover I definitely recommend this place to you.
Homemade ice cream in the heat of summer! Great place to take the kids and grab a scoop on the run. Could use just a few more seats but it really dosen't matter.

How could anyone not like this place? They have 25+ flavors of ice-cream and the prices are reasonable. They even have dairy-free options. I'm not an ice cream connoisseur, so perhaps the texture isn't perfect, but it's ice cream and it's good.

Best ice cream in Vegas hands down! I'm originally from the birthplace of Handel's (Youngstown, OH) and got ice cream here after every one of my softball games when I was younger. I was really surprised to see it out here. But very pleased. Tons of different homemade flavors - black cherry, graham central station & chocolate pb brownie are awesome. Give this place a try!!
Omg. I'm. In. Love. Homemade ice cream. We recommended this spot already to at least two dozen families. You HAVE TO try Handel's. Unbelievably Awesome. First time my husband was rendered speechless.

First time visiting. I ordered one scoop of the oree-dough. They gave me so much! It had nice big chunks of Oreo in it. I thought it might be like cookies and cream ice cream with cookie dough but it's just Oreo. The presentation was great though. One big scoop with a mini scoop on top. My boyfriend got the malt milk shake and an ice cream sandwich. It was about as big as the palm of my hand and was delicious. I'm not a huge fan of malt so the milkshake was meh in my opinion, but he did order extra malt. He loved it. Might get extra thick next time though. Overall it was great! The place looks nice and clean and the line moves quickly. I would definitely recommend!
This place is amazing! We loved every bite! Nice to have awesome service as well - this is now our go to ice cream shop!

Love the tastes and texture of this ice cream. Graham Central Station is a perfect example of this. Love trying new flavors and I haven't been disappointed with any of them! 2 buck Tuesday is awesome!

Such a delicious treat! We were getting sick of all the frozen yogurt places and this hit the spot. The ice cream is perfectly creamy (not too hard and not too soft). The flavors are so yummy! We had mint choc chip, choc chip cookie dough, chocolate and strawberry. We also had a milkshake which was one of the best milkshakes I've ever had! These were so good we wanted to try more! This is our new favorite spot! A definite must try!

Your Green Tea ice cream is amazing. It's one of the best in the US. I can really taste the matcha flavor. Please do not discontinue this flavor. You have no idea how difficult it is to find a good green tea ice cream.
We go here almost every Friday. Best ice cream in town. Love all the selections. My favorites are Elvis, New York strawberry cheesecake and Graham central.

Yaaayyy!!!!! It's finally here! I never thought it's going to happen. I've eaten so much ice cream in my life but Handel's is hard to beat! For anyone who has no background of this wonderful treat, this hails originally from Youngstown, OH! They make everything fresh daily one batch at a time in every location! Now that's something to boast about being in existence for almost 70 years! I was 1st introduced to this deliciousness by my husband about 7 years ago & that has left such an imprint in my head that whenever we get to go back to his hometown IT has to be the 1st pit stop before doing anything else . I think they're most popular for their Chocolate Pecan Ice Cream so it's just fitting that my 1st order for their opening day would be such & it did not disappoint! Thank you Mr. Patrick for taking a chance to make this a reality for all the Handel's patrons in Las Vegas! Good luck & I hope it'll be here for years to come! Now what are you waiting for? Get off your bottom, head out west & get your 1st lick & I'm sure it won't be the last!

Okay, so I absolutely LOVE ice cream, and I was a little disappointed with Handel's. The ice cream was great, but the customer serivce leaves much to be desired. So Handel's offers a large variety of flavors to choose from. Not only that so many different ways to have your ice cream too. It's a bit overwhelming but in a good way! Also, they are cheap either! This is a walk up place so don't expect to sit anywhere besides the benches. They make ice cream from scratch and you can tell from the flavors and textures. It's smooth and not icy like something that's been sitting and refrozen like other places. Their ice cream really leans on the side of frozen custard. I chose the Oreo Cookie Sandwich, which was okay. But I really enjoyed the Butterfinger Twist, which made every bite come to life. My brother ordered a Milkshake and he feel absoulty in love with it after the first sip. Over this is a good place, but I wish it wasn't so far away, and the customer service was more friendlier.

Omg! The best ice cream ever! Get the four scoop sampler because it's too hard to decide on just one flavor! Now I know what you're thinking, "the four scoop? Oh that's too much! I really shouldn't!" Yes you should!! So many flavors, you have to try each one because even though you have probably had mint chocolate chip ice cream before, you've never had it like this! And you HAVE to have the buckeye! The ice cream is so creamy and rich it's hard to resist licking the plastic container your four scoops of deliciousness comes in, and ok, I almost did lick the container when I was done but a stranger would've seen me (my brother and sister in law would have to but they would understand and not judge me). Regular ice cream will never be the same.
If looking for something other than yogurt this is a fantastic "real" ice cream parlor. My 3 & 4 year old LOVE it!

My Co-worker recommended this place. We finally got the chance to try it and when we pulled over, there were a few people in line and a few more eating their ice cream cones. My husband and I were eager to see what they have with the number of people around. We got the 4 scoop sampler, butter pecan, graham central station, NY style cheesecake, spouse like a house for less than $5, what a deal! The sampler was too much for the 2 of us. We will definitely be back and will bring friends & family if they are in town.
I love coming here... Or even in Rancho Cucamonga. This place satisfies the sweet tooth
Best ice cream in Las Vegas. The blueberry cobbler and graham central are my favorites. Get it baby, trust me
Good selection, delicious flavors. Quite pricey though. Would come back if I was in the area not worth the drive from the other side of town though

The ice cream was excellent! It's a walk up window with a list of a million flavors. Ask the staff for a sample they'll get right on it. Ask for more than a few they get cranky lol I mean who wouldn't. The walk up window takes away the experience I mean when you see the ice cream it's so much easier to decide and know what you want. Like (Thrifty's, Cold Stone, Baskin Robbins, etc...) it's a bummer because their Ice Cream is so much better than all those competitors! They have the store space so maybe in the future.

I ordered the four scoop sampler since this was our first visit. Butter pecan, birthday cake, vanilla turtle and chocolate marshmallow were all very good. With the hot weather on the way we will definitely be back to try more.
Love this place. Specialty blends and signature treats. Soooo good. The pack pints and quarts. Reasonable prices. Ez walk up windows.

We love this place. So many hand made ice cream flavor to choose from. Ever Tuesday is $2 Tuesday. It's a great way for me to show my son appreciation for all of his hard work at school. If you don't like this place then you probably won't like anything :-)
Solid ice cream creations. Very friendly staff (and accommodating) and fast service. Will be back
Yum!!! Worth the drive!! Banana cream pie, Midnight Madness, Coconut Almond Ripple, and their Graham Central Station !! $4.25 for a 4 scoop sampler.... worth it!!
