This is the best place to get ice cream! The ice cream is so smooth and so delicious! My boyfriend and I always get the four scoop sampler and we love it!!

Awesome awesome ics cream! We did the 4 flavor sampler. Strawberry cheesecake, cinnamon Graham, cookie dough and asked the guy manning the store for the 4th flavor! He gave us blueberry cobbler and MAN! IT ROCKED!

Hands down one of the best ice cream place in Vegas! Been going here for a year and I just LOVE everything I've gotten. I usually do the single scoop or 4 scoop sampler. It's so rich and creamy. Fave flavors are coffee chip, salted caramel, and buckeye...well everything is pretty good. There's no chairs/tables though so u pretty much eat it outside or take it to go. I wish they would eventually provide tables and chairs outside. Overall, I love the ice cream and most of the employees are pretty nice.

If you find yourself in this plaza running errands, then notice a long line of folks eagerly awaiting ice cream, you've found Handel's. Handel's only does window orders, so there's no building to enter. The order window closing on you as the employee grabs your order is a bit off-putting at first, but you get used to it, it's basically a "walk-thru" instead of a drive-thru experience. There are a few benches outside if you'd like to sit down and enjoy your treat, or you could always pick up a pint to take home. Our first visit was a bit of a revelation that we had been missing out. I got a single waffle cone of mint chocolate chip and my husband got the graham central station. When they say "single", they really mean way more than one scoop. The waffle cone was delicious, and I ended up leaving a scoop of ice cream in a bowl and popping it in the freezer for safe keeping. My husband has already been craving his graham central station selection. The girl helping us was very friendly and happily let us sample a few items since it was our first time. She told us their most popular flavors are the graham central station and the butter pecan. I did eventually go back and try the butter pecan, but found it way too buttery, while my mom thought it wasn't buttery enough (she's crazy lol). There are a lot more things for us to try here so it'll be nice to pop in here over the summer when it's hot outside. Pro Tip - expect long lines for their 2 Buck Tuesday specials

First visit to Handle's. Large menu to choose from. The Apple dumpling was extremely good. Great dough! The banana split hurricane not so much. I feel like it needs more banana, some chocolate and some nuts. Very friendly staff. We will try it again some time.

Really, really great ice cream. Two of us each went with our own 4 scoop sampler. This is an incredible deal at $4.25, and they have so many flavors that it would seem impossible to choose just one. We tried the following: Coconut Cream Pie -- Awesome. Really the best coconut ice cream out there. Cake Batter -- Just cake batter ice cream. You can get this anywhere. Though, it does have a large amount of sprinkles. Chocoholic Chunk -- Tastes remarkably similar to Haagen Daz. Also good but not my favorite. Butter Pecan -- Tons of pecans. They really aren't cheap with their additives, which makes for great ice cream. Buckeye -- Real mini buckeyes make this a good ice cream. I could use more of a peanut butter swirl or something, though. Spouse Like A House -- Too malt flavored for me and not enough pretzel. This was my least favorite. Salted Pretzel Crunch -- So good. You have to love caramel and love chocolate covered pretzels. Luckily, I love both. Graham Central Station -- By far my favorite. I don't even like honeycomb, but it was perfect in this ice cream. This isn't the best location, and it would be cold in the winter to eat your ice cream outside, but I would definitely make the sacrifice in order to eat this ice cream.

Very good but a little pricey. Come for 2 buck Tuesday and problem solved. I love the buckeye ice cream, peanut putter, fudge and vanilla ice cream swirl with buckets candies yummmmm. You have to stop by if you're looking for a delicious dessert destination
$ 2 ice cream on Tuesdays are the best!!!! They also have big servings!!! Best ice cream place here in Vegas!!! I tried the Graham flavor ice cream and it did not disappoint! Will come back again!
Two dollar Tuesday's is what it's all about! All their flavors are to die for! You must check this place out if you haven't already. Service is always friendly and fast too!

Literally the best ice cream I have ever eaten. Got the strawberry cheesecake chunk- definitely did not regret it. Real strawberries and real cheesecake (not the fake frozen chunks they serve at froyo places). So freaking good. Will return (probably more times than I should)!

It's in the smiths parking lot ! Back Corner ! You order by the walk up window. Customer service is awesome! All very friendly. I came here on a Tuesday and it was 2 bucks Tuesday ! Such a great deal. Ice cream was delicious. I got the ny cheesecake and my bf got the graham station.

Old fashioned freshly made ice cream with so much of a plethora of flavors that you seem like (figuratively) a kid in an ice cream store (figuratively too because you order from a window and they get it for you). The flavors are amazing and the ice cream is made fresh in the store EVERYDAY. That shows why they get as much business as they do. I have always seen lines waiting to order.

The ice cream is amazing but the service absolutely sucked!!! Natalie served us and I don't normally call someone out but she was extremely rude. Ask for one sample and then when I asked for a second for my wife she told me this is the last sample and we needed to pick one. Pretty nice person huh??? Sorry but we never heard what an ELVIS ice cream is! She was pretty rude though out the translation! Step it up Natalie!!
Absolutely love this ice cream shop! The service was friendly and the ice cream was smooth and flavorful. I recommend the 4 scoop sampler.

This is a walk up window with benches outside which we didn't know before going but didn't bother us at all. All of their ice cream is homemade and they have tons of flavors, and not just your typical kinds. I would recommend getting the 4 scoop sampler so you can try a few, plus it's only $4.25. The graham cracker, oreo cookie dough, strawberry cheesecake, blueberry cobbler, salted caramel truffle, peanut butter brownie, cinnamon roll were all delicious, some of the best ice cream we have ever had! The only one we didn't care for was the pumpkin pecan but that's just cause it was a little too pumpkiny which is probably more of a personal preference thing then a fault of the ice cream itself. I highly recommend and we will be going back.

This is one of the most underrated ice cream places I have ever been to. I first tried it near Rancho Cucamonga when I was in California, and I fell in love with the texture of the icecream and the flavors. It's just so creamy and rich. The flavors are so creative and delicious. Now, I come here all the time. The service is quick. The icecream is inexpensive, and you get gigantic scoops. The flavors are so on point - especially the strawberry cheesecake!!!! It's a must-try. You wouldn't know it's right beside the Smith's grocery on Tropicana. It's kind of a hidden gem. You definitely have to try this place.

This is basically an ice cream stand in a strip mall. They have a million flavors and it's hard to decide which is my favorite. There are a few benches outside for seating but nothing inside. You order at the window and stay outside. Ice cream was good and from what I gather from my Ohio people, it's a staple back there.

Straight from Ohio!! Homemade ice cream with chunks of fresh fruit in their pineapple & strawberry flavors. Get the sample...4 scoops for $4.50 Best Value! A flavor for everyone's liking. You won't be disappointed.

This is the spot!!!! Hands down best ice cream in the city !!!! This is the only thing that keeps you from missing blue bell!!!! I love this place and they make the ice cream by hand. It's a little pricey compared to some spots but it's definitely worth it. If your family is big you gotta go in Tuesday's $2 special is always good!!!!!
Homemade ice cream can't get any better than this! YUM!! I got a nerds on the moon hurricane... raspberry syrup, nerds, and vanilla ice cream blended

The guy that serve me the 4 sampler scoop is not paying attention. I ordered 2 scoops of peanut butter brownie chunk, 1 scoop hazelnut and peanut butter parfait. What I received is 2 peanut butter parfait, and 2 peanut butter. Lack of attention to detail and listening skill.

Creamy, but not overly sweet...I am glad that I made the drive out here to try this place. I got the 4 flavor sampler and my favorite was the Oree-dough, although the others were good too (graham station, salty caramel, and cherry vanilla). My boyfriend got praline pecan and I forget the other flavor...the only one I tasted was the praline, and it was delicious! He really liked his, and is sort of an ice cream fan of sorts...so if he liked it, it has to be good.
If you are EVER in the mood for ice cream, I wouldn't go anywhere other than Handel's. Its quick, its delicious and every flavor is an explosion to your taste buds! Absolutely love it!
Unreal ice cream. The shopping center is also a great place to sit and enjoy a come after a day in the park or at work. Tons of flavor selections and top shelf service!!

Hands down, the best ice cream in Las Vegas. Quality taste that can't be beat. There's a large variety of really good flavors, but my favorites are the oreo hurricane and chocolate milkshake. The service is also very efficient and friendly. It's a very family friendly location as well, kids, dogs and all.

Came to Handel's with my sisters and waited 20 minutes for what should've been 5. This is what my milkshake looked like when it came out, then I had to wait additional time until they realized they forgot part of my order. Very disappointing.
This is the creamiest ice cream I've ever tasted.. The taste is simply unique. Wish they had an actual done in area, it was pretty windy trying to eat our ice cream. But otherwise it was D'lish!!!

Best ice cream in Vegas hands down and well worth the trip from the strip. A ton of flavors and they're all awesome or at least my 2 year old son thought so. Patrick, is a big plus too! He's quite flavorful himself!

It may be just a stand but they have wonderful icecream its the best in Vegas so far and I've eaten a lot of places that also had five stars but this is a true five stars even better than most gelato places. And not to mention my favorite part is the staff. If they come in a flavor I'm buying it!

I love this place. I was a little turned off at first by a few things: One, this is an outdoor place. You go up to the window to order and there are only benches outside to eat at (which are really hot in the summer, so we ended up eating in our car with the air on). Two, some of the flavors have strange names, so you don't know what they are unless you ask. Three, it was kind of a long wait and there weren't that many people there. But, the good outweighs any negatives here. The staff are very helpful. I asked what some flavors were and they were happy to tell me. They gave us samples of the flavors we wanted to taste. I asked one employee for her recommendation on a flavor, and I'm so glad I did. We got the four flavor sampler, and that's the way to go. It's around $4.25 for four scoops of ice cream. We had strawberry, a graham cracker flavor, a black raspberry flavor, and salted carmel truffle. All of which were incredible. I would highly recommend eating here.

I fucking love this place. Blue moon and cotton candy are my two favorite. BUT ALL THE FLAVORS ARE SO GOOD!!!! Recommend getting a 4 scoop sampler. 4 scoops of different flavors for like $4-5!!! I get that whenever I don't go on the two buck tuesdays

Believe it or not, there are some people who live in Vegas that think anything under 80 degrees is freezing. Wink wink! But if there's one thing that's going to get them outside to brave the harshest of frozen desert temperatures in the winter, especially if they're the Yelping type, it's ice cream. I don't know much about the history of Handel's, just mainly that they're from Ohio and people all across the country love them. This new location, while possibly different from others I've heard about, is completely walk up service only. It's located in a shopping center on the NE corner of Tropicana & Hualapai. And even with a space size that puts pretty much every ice cream shop in town to shame, there is absolutely no where safe from the elements that is customer accessible. Well, besides their own vehicles of course. With 5+ walk up windows preparing to operate during all business hours, there shouldn't be any problem getting you served up pretty quickly though. On the menu, you're going to find probably way more options then you'll know what do with. There's hurricanes, sundaes, parfaits, ice cream sandwiches, shakes...the list goes on! And if you just want a good ole fashioned scoop or two, there's about 40 or so different choices between the regular ice cream flavors, sherbets and the monthly special. I'm all for having options, but to be honest, there's almost too much here. It could be just be my indecisiveness kicking in, but it was a bit overwhelming. I will say this though. The 4 scoop sampler is one of the coolest things they offer, and I'd imagine it's got to be pretty popular. It's exactly what I ended up going with, and is a steal at only $4.25. It took a while but we ended up going with Banana Cream Pie, Buckeye, Chocolate Peanut Butter Brownie and Spouse Like A House (vanilla ice cream with peanut butter ripple and chocolate covered peanut butter pretzels swirled in). Each flavor was spot on with what they described and I'd have a hard time picking out a favorite of the four. The banana had a nice, smooth whipped cream type texture and big chunks of banana. The Buckeye had plenty of whole candies in it, which are basically like a big Rolo, but with peanut butter inside. And both the Chocolate Peanut Butter Brownie and Spouse Like A House had plenty of peanut butter flavor without having that terrible frozen peanut butter texture. All were a tad on the sweet side, but very creamy and delicious. The only thing I didn't like is that they all started to melt pretty quick, even in the January winter weather. I imagine during the summer, it'll be tough to finish before you have sugar soup. For being all window ordering, the service is very friendly. Each employee we talked to was very friendly and seemed to be quite knowledgeable about the products. With our visit being on the first day open, I think that's pretty impressive. Adding that to good quality products at great prices, I'll definitely be returning to Handel's!
It's good . The owner kind of genius imo as you can't walk in the store and you can only see it and Order from the walk up window making all Their customer standing place is free rent.
Really, the best ice cream you can find in Vegas. REAL ice cream, not that frozen yogurt bullshit. Chocolate raspberry truffle or the ore-dough will change your life.

Definitely one of my favorite ice cream shops! Every time we've gone the employees are always very helpful and pleasant! My family loves to go and get some creamy yummy goodness on a hot summer night! Love this place!

Cannot seem to figure out the best flavor. I am a Chocolate flavor person by heart. The banana split is waaÃ aaaaa6yyyyyyyyyytyty too big. But the ice cream itself is nice and creamy and full of flavor. I like this joint but it gets busy and when you have kids just hanging all over you while you wait it is almost too much to wait for. Anyhow, this ice cream is worth it once it's your turn.

Tried Handel's for their $2 Scoop Tuesday's and 1. Their "scoop" is really 3 scoops (no complaining here) 2. They have so many flavors to choose from its amazing 3. The staff is friendly and cheerful (always a huge bonus in my book) I had the chocolate peanut butter brownie and it was deelish, my hubby had the Chocolate marshmallow also good, my son had the cookie dough and really enjoyed the huge chunks of dough and my youngest had the blue moon which was raspberry and although it was a little too tart for me, she loved it. We will be heading back and taking advantage of their $2 scoop Tuesday

WOWWWWW this place straight killed the game!! i love the classic walk up window vibes..and the homemade ice cream was on point! i got the 4 sampler with banana cream pie, peanut butter chocolate brownie, birthday cake, and blue moon.. sooo bomb

I was surprised to this is a walk up place with no seating. We went on a weekend evening and the line was 10 minutes long easy. They had two windows open taking orders and moved through the line efficiently, there was just a lot of people. The ice cream was amazing! Highly recommend and the line is worth it.

This place has some of the creamiest ice cream I've ever had! The pink champagne sherbet is my personal favorite item right now. FYI, You just order from a window, there is no indoor seating. They have a couple of benches nearby you can sit on outside.

Best ice cream ever...I'm totally hooked. They're located right next to Smith's and I just can't resist. There is always a new flavor to try and it's always so good. They have $2 Tuesdays which always draws a crowd in the evenings.

Errrrr merrrrr gerrrrrd. Yes. The banana cream pie and blueberry cobbler are outstanding. I wish their menu was a little easier to read/in a different spot, there's always so many people there they kind of block it. Glad I don't live too far from this place!
For the one scoop big serving for two bucks every tuesday, totally worth it! All of the flavors are amazing.

Love, love, love this ice cream and you will too. Tried key lime today, so good with chunks of like graham cracker crust. The Pink Champagne was delicious too. The servers are always nice, patient and helpful when it comes to wanting to sample. Get yourself over there for some good ice cream.
The best ice cream and yogurt! Yummy they have so many flavors to choose from. And are open all year round. Love two buck Tuesday.

Who doesn't love ice cream on a boiling hot day? There are so many choices here, the worst thing about it is trying to decide which flavor to order! We went with banana cream pie, which was fantastic. Super creamy, really tasted homemade. I'd recommend doing the four scoop sampler, though, simply because you get to taste more delicious flavors!
Totally fresh handmade ice cream. Many great flavors. Tuesdays are special. Good prices. I definitely recommend it for ice cream aficionados
First time here and took everybody's advice on here and got the "Graham Central Station" it was so good and tasty!!! Wish I could taste all the flavors!!! I will definitely be back for more!
Great selection, but slow service, and no line order. Waited 35 minutes for a banana split and only two people in front of me. Ice cream melts... No urgency!

Handel's Ice Cream is AMAZING!!!! It has to be some of the best ice cream I've ever had!!! Their customer service is great, and they have so many selections of ice cream flavors!!! I highly recommend Handel's to anyone and everyone wanting amazing ice cream!!!

This is my kids favorite stop after a baseball game at The Mesas Park. We would be giving them a five star rating but their service is a little bit slow. But don't let that deter you, the quality of their ice cream is well worth the wait.

This place is great!! SO MANY flavors to choose from. Not only that so many different ways to have your ice cream too. It's a bit overwhelming but in a good way! This is a walk up place so don't expect to sit anywhere besides the benches. They make ice cream from scratch and you can tell from the flavors and textures. It's smooth and not icy like something that's been sitting and refrozen like other places. The service is friendly and quick! Don't hesitate to ask for samples because they encourage it! I chose the twix parfait and did not regret it. It was quite large and my boyfriend told me I would not finish it. Well he was wrong because I basically inhaled it. Their hot fudge is so good!! Almost as good as nielsens hot fudge. In this case coming in second to that is not a bad thing. I can't wait to go back and try more flavors!

I'm giving them a 5 star because I love love love the ice cream. I'm from Ohio and I used to go here all the time. However, my review is on the staff. I waited in line forever and then when I finally ordered, everything was all messed up (I literally ordered a small cone and a scoop of vanilla ice cream for my dog). I gave her my card to pay and she didn't tell me how much it was nor did she give me a receipt. I know they have young kids working there but still..

Happy to hear a new ice cream shop opened up nearby my house with homemade ice cream?! After seeing their flavor choices on yelp once they opened, I admit I was not really excited to try anything because the flavors all sounded basic, nothing unique. I had no urgency to try this place and I am sucker for homemade ice cream. I've tried it and I don't get the hype. 4 scoop sampler- salted caramel truffle, chocolate chocoholic, oreo, peanut butter chocolate something. The ice cream- soft and creamy but not in a good way. In a way that it will melt within a few minutes. We tried to take it home and we live a mile away. As soon as I got into the car I noticed the flavors melting into one another since all 4 scoops were next to eachother in a small plastic container which had ridges. Not to sound too picky but with ridges it melts into the ridges making it harder to eat. I would prefer a styrofoam cup over the plastic with ridges. Flavors are not memorable. They taste is very sweet, very artificial, and not special in any way to make me return. Service: people mentioned 4 windows. I didn't see that. I saw 2 people working. One was cleaning and one was stressed taking orders. There is this window that slides open. It was awkward because the girl working there asked if I wanted a sample. She held the door open while talking to me and had a hard time holding it and writing it down on her little notepad at the same time. Her awkwardness made me feel like helping her. I find that sliding window annoying because it stops the interaction much like a drive through window. If the ice cream was $1 a scoop I can see it being acceptable. But for $3.50 a scoop I would expect to have a place to sit (although there was a bench or two,one family of 4-5 people took over that area) and to be able to interact more with the person giving me the ice cream. Anyway I wanted two samples. She wrote one down halfway and the other she didn't write down. I never saw someone write a sample down. When she went to get it, she forgot the one she did not write down. I thought that was kind of sad. But she must have been overwhelmed because when she went to give me my ice cream I noticed her entire backside of her arm had blue ice cream smeared over it as it was dried on so it was there for a while. Gross! Take some time to wash your hands people. That's not ok. The sliding window showed even more awkwardness as she was unable to get me spoons and my ice cream without it slamming on her while my ice cream would have been thrown aside if she let the sliding glass door go. I just wanted to get out of there but I noticed she didn't give me napkins nor did I see any outside on the counter. I think napkins are a must for customers to have access to in Vegas summer heat.

We go to Handel's a lot for their amazing ice cream. However this past visit, we felt that the service was appalling. We went for Father's Day because my husband wanted one of the amazing monster milkshakes. He ordered and I ordered a cone with 2 flavors. The server said that I would have to order a double which is 4 1/2 scoops of ice cream if I wanted two flavors. A single is 2 1/2 scoops. He insisted that he could not do 1 scoop of one flavor and 1 1/2 scoops of another. Which seems crazy to me. And I know they have done it before. Then my friends ordered and paid the whole bill. After they paid they saw that we were double charged the milkshake and my cone. When we brought it to their attention, the server was curt and handed her $6.50, the cost of the milkshake. My friend pointed out that she was still owed for the cone and tax. So the manager came over and was just as curt. He finally gave her the cash back and then slammed the window shut. I was shocked. It is too bad because every other time the women who served us were friendly and accommodating. These two gentlemen, the server and manager, need to up their game.

First time here and loving it!!!!! This place is amazing they make fresh ice cream daily.. Why you ask, because they run out all the time! How can u go wrong. The owner is super cool and friendly I think he said Ohio. The proof is in the taste, it's so fresh and creamy. They have tons of flavors to choose from, the best day to go there is on Tuesday. It's two dollar scoop day all day long...... I will be back for more!! A-MAY-ZING

I give Handel's 5 stars because I always search for a blueberry cheesecake and never get what I want. And Handel's Blueberry Cobbler ice cream hits the spot. So delicious. Blueberry swirls and rich creamy sweet ice cream with cookie/pie pieces mixed in. I'm a happy camper

Ive driven by this place multiple times while picking my kids home from school but never checked it out. It wasn't until a friend of mine said they had the best ice cream ever. I decided to check it out and I have to say Im hooked. Best ice cream hands down. The flavors are so good and the ice cream is super creamy. It sucks that theres no seating and the the service is quite slow, but i would deal with it just for the ice cream.

The opening of this Handel's location has been a Divine Godsent gift from the heavens above. Oh, try the banana creme pie or graham central station. Those are amongst their best flavors. But really, if you want a taste of summer, Handel's delivers it well.

Truly exceptional ice cream! This place has fresh ice cream and wonderful staff. The Buckeye ice cream is an Ohio classic and highlights the store's roots. The caramel pretzel crunch is fantastic. You order from the outside windows which is fun in itself. Welcome to town Handel's!

This has got to be one of, if not, the best dessert spots in town. Rich, delicious, homemade ice cream, in both classic and non - traditional flavors. You're always safe with anything chocolate in my book, but I always catch myself leaning towards an addition of a scoop of coconut cream pie or banana cream pie too. The walk up will always have a line but well worth the wait. Pricing is very reasonable for what you get and the staff are all attentive and friendly. If you haven't been here yet do yourself a favor; write it down, take a picture, or better yet, just get your a$$ down to Handel's.

I wasn't WOWED by this ice cream or the experience at Handel's. The chocolate with peanut butter cups was very rich. I wouldn't order it again. I will give this another try when the weather is warmer and they have all the kinks worked out.
Great place with awesome ice cream. Everything is fresh and hand made. Staff is super friendly too. Seating outside and unfortunately in direct sun (in the afternoon). A must try place.

Same great taste. I remember going to a Handel's ice cream shop in Montclair, California. This is the same franchise I believe. I ordered the banana cream pie sundae and it was so fresh and creamy. It was the right consistency of melty, creamy and a good amount of sweetness on my tongue. The banana cream pie had little chunks of crust and a hint of banana flavor. This place has so many other flavors to choose from. We are coming back for sure...
The best ice cream in Vegas! The shop is impeccable and so friendly! Do yourself a favor and run, don't walk, to treat yourself!

Being from Youngstown, I was thrilled when I heard Handel's was opening in Las Vegas...and a mere two blocks from my house. The new location reminds me of the ones in Y'town....walk-up windows, no seating....great ice cream. Some are a little richer or sweeter than I'd like (choc. peanut butter and chocolate raspberry truffle), so I stick with chocolate malt w caramel, banana creme pie, chocolate pecan, or chocolate marshmallow. The only two downsides: the walk-up and the wait. That said, that's how it is in Youngstown, so why expect different here?

Their 4 scoop sampler is great for trying many flavors. My favorites are banana cream pie, New York cheesecake and cookie and creme. The syrup they use for strawberry cheesecake is a little too sweet for me.

This place is super great. I really like the huge portions for the small prices. Definitely want come back again. I really like the friendly employees and their ice cream was really creamy. If you are looking for a good dessert spot, I would highly recommend Handel's.
Best best best handmade ice cream. If you haven't been here, your true my missing out. So many flavors to choose from and can purchase punts and quarts as well.

I hate not giving this place a perfect review but the management team/owners need to know that some of their workers are cheats! I have a 2 year old that loves ice cream but he's not ready for the regular cones yet so the baby come they offer is perfect. He loves vanilla and it's the right amount. Every time my family goes there we order it for him and no problem, but today we were helped by a teenager/maybe early 20s kid who refused to give him any. He explained "the baby cones are for babies! He wants ice cream he needs a regular size!" I'm sorry but is the rule now only a infant can have a baby size cone? It wasn't even the matter of price because I know they offer the baby cones for free but if it was a big deal we would have paid for it because it's just the right size for him. But this guys literally refused! I don't know if he was trying to make money or thought we were taking advantage but it put a bad taste in my mouth! My family loves this place. The ice cream is always good and perfect on any hot Las Vegas Sumer day! So the store itself deserves 5stars and most of the workers we met in the past are genuinely pleasant and seem like they love their jobs unlike the guy we had to unfortunately be helped by today!

If you aren't coming here and you're even remotely a fan of ice cream....you're f**king up! The four scoop sampler (only $4.25) of the best ice cream you've ever put I your face is a must...I am more than a customer, I am a raving fan! Beyond quality product, great service, killer price...

This seems to forever be my most favorite Ice cream place, the peanut butter parfait is to die for. Recently tried rolled ice cream all I can say is stay loyal or you may regret. Staff is always friendly here and so happy Cinnaholic is on the next street over my two favorite dessert places are neighbors
Omg amazing!!!! Need I say anymore ... Nutella , key lime pie , butter pecan , deep dish apple pie are all ridiculously good ! Be sure to try it out

As I walked up to the window, the concrete floors were swept, and the stainless-steel countertops were, pun intended, stainless. The red, white, and blue color scheme occupied my line of sight. The pictures posted of the ice cream dropped my jaw to the ground and led a river to flow out of my mouth. The gorgeous atmosphere and savoring pictures give a warm welcome to anyone who approaches. However, the long line of desert hungry people awaiting to have their orders taken haunted me. I stood distraught at the idea of this long line starting at the window and ending at the handicap parking space. The waiting time just get up to the window was around eight minutes; this was a minor inconvenience that can later be redeemed if the ice cream is delicious. On my first visit, I was overwhelmed by the dozens of flavors mounted on the sign. I was taunted by each flavor. It felt like each flavor of ice cream was calling out to me to get a scoop. The multiple freezers you can see inside the store only make you wonder what flavor is hidden inside. Any concoction you can make up, they will probably have it. They had a variety of ice cream flavors such as Chocolate Malt with Caramel, Banana Nut Cake, Coffee Chocolate Chip, and Pistachio. Not only does Handel's serve ice cream, they serve sherbets, ices, fat-free ice cream with no sugar added, and low-fat yogurt (if you want a somewhat healthier option). The manifold of desert options given at Handel's flood your head as soon as you come face to face with the menu. The various ways you can get the ice cream served is also endless. You can get your ice cream served in four different types of cones, in a normal bowl, or even in a quart and pint. Your ice cream can also be made into different variations; they can be served as a banana split, a sundae, a hurricane, and as a popsicle. This variety, for both flavors of ice cream and ways the ice cream is served, really impressed me. Some ice cream shops I have visited just have a couple of tubs of ice cream and they have the option of it being served in a bowl or cone. The fact that Handel's has been able to branch out of being a traditional ice cream shop made me set it apart from any other ice cream shops. Once I got up to the window to order, I found the service to be mediocre, well at least from the person serving me. He greeted me and took my order, but what became prominent is that he did not want to be there, which is understandable. He did not receive me with a smile on his face and he forgot one thing I ordered. The waiting time to get the ice cream in your hands can also take a while as they have to walk away and scoop into a tub of frozen cream and sugar. I then got the ice cream in my hands. I got a tower of the Chocoholic Chunk and I tried Banana's Foster, Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough, and Chocolate Peanut Butter Brownie from those I went with. My ice cream of choice was a chocolate party because the ice cream was very rich in chocolate and had chunks of chocolate all throughout. You had a chunk in each bite, and the best part was that the chocolate was not hard and chalky like the M&M's get in a Mcflurry. As I just got a lick of the three other flavors I can only have a minimal opinion. The Banana's Foster was a blast of banana with a hit of sweet caramel. The Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough had the same big lumps of chocolate and smooth indulgent balls of cookie dough all mixed in a rich vanilla ice cream. The Chocolate Peanut Butter Brownie had squares of chocolate rich brownies and scoops of actual peanut butter spread throughout the chocolate ice cream. The intensity of these flavors freezing our tongues made the wait worth it. If the ice cream is this indulging the prices must be outrageous as well. Each type of cone and bowl come with a price less than five dollars. Each of these cones come with a pile of three of more scoops making the price well worth it. The pints and a plate with four scoops of ice cream are also around five dollars. What I believe is a great deal at Handel's is the Two Buck Tuesday promotion they have every Tuesday. Any cone or bowl of ice cream will come down to two dollars each rather than four dollars. If you decide to go on a Tuesday, you better be ready for the long lines! The price point is perfect for a flavor packed scoop of ice cream.

Banana Cream Pie is the best hands down! I would give this place 5/5 but I was there last Friday and they only had 4 people working ... I had to wait over 15mins in line. Other then that this place is awesome!

The ice cream is good but I give the three stars because the staff just seems to really lallygag and just hang around back there while everyone waits outside. They make the milk shakes with a lot of milk and a little ice cream. Maybe the whole experience will be better on another day. I'll give it another chance some other time.
Great place to get yummy gourmet ice cream! Love their NY cheese cake and green tea flavored ice cream!
Love the selections of ice-cream and variety of sizes to enjoy on the benches when out walking or take home for friends to enjoy.

Went here this afternoon, Sunday 9/23/18, because I was craving some homemade chocolate ice cream. I have been to this location before and really enjoyed the ice cream and I enjoyed it again today. What I didn't enjoy is the bad attitude from the boy at the service window. From the get go he had an attitude and I could tell he just doesn't like his job. His overall attitude was just blah. There was no hello nothing just basically what do you want. Asked for it to go and when he gave it to me with a spoon and no lid I asked if I could have a lid and he threw the spoon out and slammed a lid on the cup then slid it through the window and said here it is, TO GO. Sarcastic much? I gave him the money, he gave me the change then closed the window, didn't say thank you, bye, see you next time, nothing. Sorry if you were having a bad day, as we all have them sometimes, but leave it at home and don't take it out on the people that come there. Probably won't be back as there are ice cream shops all around, and ones where I can get good ice cream without the attitude of young workers.
the best ice cream in the world deep dish apple pie is incredible unlimited tastes good luck trying to make a choice

This is by far the best ice cream I have ever had! My favorites are salted caramel truffle and the pretzel caramel ice cream. If I lived close to this place I would gain an extra 60 pounds. It's that good for real lol! I won't eat any other ice cream here in Las Vegas. Hands down #1 in my book.
Vegas really needed a place like this on the West side. The ice cream is super flavorful. Creamy but not too rich. The service was great too. Good place for my teens to go on a date.

I usually come in the summer to get some Handel's. The ice cream here is definitely worth the splurge especially on 2 buck Tuesday. What I wasn't so happy about was the customer service that I had. We went up to a line on the side where a family was being serviced. We already stood and waited behind them for 3 minutes. The girl left to do something and I assumed she would be back. There wasn't a sign to say the counter was closed or anything so I waited another 5-7 minutes before someone finally opened the window to ask if we needed something even though I made eye contact with at least 2 people during my entire wait. After someone finally opened the window, the person told me I had to go around to a different window. No one could've taken 10 seconds to tell me to go around before that??? I waited another 10 minutes in the other line. When I finally got up to the counter, they opened the same window that I had waited for before literally 3 minutes after they told me to go around with the same girl at the counter! I was definitely unhappy with today's service.

This place is delicious. The only reason I didn't give it 5 Stars was the seating situation. If there was indoor seating it would be an easy 5 Stars. The staff was friendly and patient as it took a while to read through all of the flavors. I look forward to going back.

First trip there was a mix-up with my order, the service was friendly, and the ice cream was good, manager said they would fix things. Second trip order was perfect, ice cream was great, service terrific (wish I had gotten the young man's name). The manager had taken care of the problem. Really can't wait to try one of their shakes.
brought my little nephew here and he loved his ice cream, and i loved my blizzard (or whatever its called in handel's world!) it was so great, we both loved it and will definitely be back!

This is an awesome new find for me. Such a cute walk-up ice cream place and their staff is always upbeat and generous when you ask to try some of their flavors. They're reasonably priced and their ice cream is one of the best I've had!

The staff is friendly, quick and awesome. We've been coming here every week, which is good and bad! Honestly, I can't see myself going anywhere else for dessert... Handel's is hands down the best ice cream you will ever eat. They are very generous with their portions and anything you eat, you will love. I absolutely am in love with the blondie sundae. Instead of just plain vanilla, I get it with praline pecan ice cream!

I was born and raised in Ohio so I am very familiar with this place and I gotta say I was so happy to find one here and they lived up to my expectations! Omg their ice cream is amazing! The only thing I could recommend is there someone be at the window or watching the window because we stood there for awhile before getting helped and maybe putting some type of seating outside... a bench or two! I hope they make more locations here in Las Vegas because it's a very far drive for me! I would visit more if there was a closer location!!! Great ice cream I loved the flavors and they have an amazing selection of ice creams to choose from! Can't wait to visit again!

Just came across this place randomly and really glad I did, this place has some of the best hidden Ice cream in Las Vegas, a must go if you are out by the area. I will be coming back and the prices are really reasonable
Great ice cream at decent prices. Love the set up and ordering windows remind me of my childhood growing up.

I used to pass by this place and wonder why there was always long lines. I finally stopped one day and I am so happy I did! I get the 4 scoop sampler every time I go and I have yet to find a flavor that I DO NOT like. Birthday Cake and Banana Cream Pie are my top two.

Yum Yum Yum. No joke my fave ice cream... they have about a million flavors... some with obscure names and no descriptions... so thats kinda a bummer... what does "spouse in the house taste like?" but the graham central station is to die for. I like a good gram cracker... but would never think I wanted it as an ice cream flavor... but after seeing so many yelpers talk about it I had to try... A-Maz_ing!!!
Oh wow... BEST waffle cone sundae I've ever had! Can't wait to try the next delicious adventure

I usually dont give reviews but this has definitely been a lousy experience. Ice cream was mediocre and service is horrible. I understand they have a lot of customers everytime i pass by. But today happens to be one of those days wherein there was only two of us in line. Employee was rude and impatient, rushing me so i can finish my order. This was my FIRST time, it's not like i can memorize the names of ice cream flavors available and the flavor options were located in the middle so had to keep on going back and forth to give ____ my order. Seriously if you have issues pls dont bring it to work. Really disappointed.
Best ice cream in vegas!! My fave flavors so far are: Banana cream pie Chocolate pecan Oreo Salted caramel Customer service is amazing too!! Can't wait to try all the flavors!!

I like this place, I really do, however, they are not kid friendly. I have a 3 and 5 year old. They cannot eat 2.5 scoops of ice cream. I cannot stand how they have NO kid size servings. I am able to split the single serving into a cup and cone, but it has to be the same flavor. Seriously? Have you ever met a 3 and 5 year old who can agree on anything, let alone any flavor of ice cream? I haven't and it's super annoying. McDonald's dollar comes here we come!!

Banana Cream Pie on two buck Tuesdays. You're welcome. I really should end it there. Blueberry cobbler was too sweet. Mint chip was alright. Graham Central Station was amazing. Good thing I don't live here anymore. I'd stop by way too often!

Best ice cream in Las Vegas! Might even be the best I have had anywhere. My go to flavors are the Butter Pecan and Salty Caramel Truffle. I have sampled many other flavors and haven't found one that I haven't liked.

We just discovered this place and we really like it. The ice cream is very excellent and of all the flavors we have tried I have to say chocolate pecan is by far superior. On Tuesdays they have two buck Tuesday where all regular cones are $2. Keep in mind a regular cone is not small so it's a really good deal. As other yelpers have said be prepared to wait because they are kinda slow. Overall with these hot vegas nights Handel's is a great place to cool down with a great treat.
Love this place! The ice cream reminds me of back home! Finally found the blueberry was my favorite! The 4scoop sampler is always a winner!
I'm not a sweets guy and certainly not an ice cream guy...but there is a reason National Geographic voted them best ice cream in the country!!!

I'm not sure how any one can give less than 5 stars! Delicious, rich, home made ice cream. Get the 4 scoop sampler for $4.25 and try a few flavors. Yum! My suggestions are the Graham Central Station, Blueberry Cobbler, and Banana Cream Pie And- it's a walk up order/pickup window.. so sit outside and enjoy
I am from Youngstown OH!!! This was where we went... All the time. BEST ice cream EVER. Your first time you must try Chocolate Pecan!!!! You will keep going back... Take a quart home!!

I used to go twice a week , after being ignored for almost 2 years and referring people from my work , I got tired of the rude attitude from the owner , but spending 20 dollars a week and the only one standing in line for 15 to 18 mins at a time a finally got tired of waiting .The ice cream is good but the owners attitude is terrible, I stopped going and told my co workers that had the same experience with the owner.....I actually gave him another chance not going for 2 years you figure he would say ( where have you been )? But no he made me wait again for 12 min and I was the only one in line ..... terrible service IM DONE with this place !

Okay, so why was this gem hidden away from me for so long. Summerlins little secret. The ice cream at this place is dangerous. The flavors are rich, they're creamy and truly taste like they should. Have you ever had something called "strawberry something" or "cherry whatever" but when you taste it you feel like you've been duped? Well that won't be the case at Handel's. I love the Graham Central Station, with chunks of graham cracker cookies, a cinnamon-y vanillaish flavor with oodles of goodness in there... good greif call 911. But only call 911 after you've tried their Birthday Cake. I wish it didn't have the sprinkles in it but the swirls of icing and the actual flavor are so good. My suggestion is that you get the 4 scoop sampler. The only thing is that if it's hot outside, you better eat up quickly, lol
Tasty and original flavors, especially spouse like a house and graham central station. Friendly staff and definitely somewhere I will visit again!

I don't have to try it to tell you how much I LOVE it....My Dad grew up in Youngstown OH and his parents and my grand parents took us there ALL the time....This is what I grew up on. I will defiantly be switching ice cream spots and taking my kids and grand kids. THANKS Handel's for all the great memories :)

I finally was near this ice cream shoppe so my daughter & I decided to go. She went up to the board & called me w/flavors, (as I am unable to walk w/o a scooter while recovering from surgery). There had to be at least 30 to choose from. It just happened to be $2 Tues for a very generous scoop of ice cream. I found their prices to be quite reasonable especially compared to Cold Stone. I tried the four sampler ($4.25 + tax) and a qt of half cherry vanilla & half butter pecan ($7.50 + tax). My daughter got a scoop for her daughter-Oreo-to go for the two dollars (she is 8 & had some last nite & tonite & has enough left for dessert tomorrow nite!). She bought add'l flavors for her hubby & herself. We thoroughly enjoyed our treats. I recommend giving them a try. I'm sad they are a ride from where I live but happy on the other hand b/c I'd weigh a ton if they were any closer. We will go back b/c it's worth the ride a few times a year! Yummmm.

This is one of my favorite ice cream places ever. They they have some of the best ice cream I've ever had. they have lots of different flavor choices and will give you a sample to see if you like it. Don't know if they still they still have this but they used to have one or two ice creams that were vegan. I think they have a $2 special on Tuesdays. Definitely worth checking out , there's a reason there's usually a line there.
$2 Tuesday!. Don't miss out. Great deal, friendly service and great ice cream. You can eat outside while watching people licking ice cream off their shirts!

Hands down the best ice cream in the world. Seriously. We move a lot and always make a point of finding the best ice cream and this outshines them all. Get the four scoop sampler and try the graham canyon and whatever else suits your fancy. You won't regret it and will probably find yourself buying a pint to take home like we do!

I got the 4-scoop sampler with banana foster, blueberry cobbler, cookie dough and Oreo! Banana foster was the flavor of the month, would definitely grab that again, And the blueberry cobbler was crazy good. All of them were life changing ! Can't go wrong
Walk up ice cream window. Best ice cream I've had since moving to Las Vegas. They have SOOOOO many flavors. There is usually a line but it is worth it. Make sure you try chocolate cake batter!
Had a milkshake. Pretty good, 4/5. The regular size is huge. They need bigger straws though, hard to drink the milkshake with the small straws.
Yum! Great tasting ice cream. I have been here twice. Love $2 Tuesday even though the line is very long.

Love this place! I tried the 4 sampler for 4.50. It was well worth it as I enjoyed trying their unusual flavors such as heavenly hash, buckeye, graham central station, and coconut cream pie all of which were delicious but my favorite wax the heavenly hash! Great place to take the kids! Only down side, the indoor seating and they only have two benches outside so having a place to eat your ice cream can be a problem.
Came here and was a great experience the ice cream was fantastic the staff was very friendly would strongly recommend this place for anyone and all ages can't go wrong here!!!

This place brings me back to my childhood- ice cream of all interesting flavors served out of a window ! On the east coast it is very common to find a little ice cream stand on the corner serving amazing ice cream! I had the black raspberry and it was so good! Def going back this summer !

Loving all the new businesses opening in my hood. Finally got to check this place out the other day. I couldn't believe the variety of flavors they offered. Everything from vanilla Oreo to Graham Central Station, the classics, and everything in between. Sooooooo many options!! (Reference to Shaqtin' A Fool ) They have sundaes, shakes, cones and I believe some other options. Prices are reasonable. I paid less than five dollars for a waffle cone with a large amount of ice cream. The young man at the window was so polite! I'm a happy camper and will frequent this little find especially now that summer is quickly approaching.
This is the best homemade ice cream. I love the blueberry cobbler and the graham cracker one. The shakes are also good.

Love. My favorite ice cream ever . Ill never eat ice cream from the store or anyplace else ever again !Lots of great flavors. All the ones I have tired so far .Strawberry cheesecake chunk, Chocolate, Strawberry, Mint chocolate chip and my very favorite Deep dish apple pie AMAZING!! Staff is great to! Oh so very patient :) A Big Thanks to the genius guy that brought Handel's to Vegas !
Amazing ice cream!! A great Young man by the name of matt severed me very funny guy! Great customer service definitely coming back

I love Handel's ice cream!! My friend and I had gone to lunch and decided to stop by to get one of their delicious ice cream cones to top off a nice afternoon. When we walked up to the window we saw a woman in the back. We waited patiently for her to come up to the window. Two more customers walked up. My friend knocked on the window to get her attention, nothing. The other customer also knocked but nothing. When they walked away I called the business, but it was just an automated machine. After waiting 15 minutes we decided to leave. Very disappointed with the lack of service. Maybe there should be more than one person working behind the counter.
Best...ice cream...EVER... The menu was a little overwhelming, only because there is so many good flavors! I strongly recommend this place!

We were extremely satisfied with the very generous 1 scoops of homemade ice cream in waffle cones! Worth the visit! New tradition for us while in Vegas!!! Website said they don't skimp...they don't lie!
Great dessert, but the guy working was a little rude. I felt like he was going to get in trouble if he kept the window open to talk to us.

We moved to this side of town 3 months ago and I'm almost embarrassed of how many times we have visited this place! I haven't tried a flavor I didn't like. My favorite is Graham Central Station and a close second is Buckeye. All of the ice cream is made fresh and is amazingly delicious!

The best ice cream in Vegas. There is no indoor seating but they have a few benches outside. The ice cream is fresh and delicious. The serve real fruit in their ice cream which is a plus. Will be going back again.
Place was really awesome! A true Ice cream shop! Banana split was really complimtary with the diffrenet fruits they put on as toppings! They are actually Fresh!

I haven't found a decent ice cream in the Southwest since we left Wisconsin a year ago. That all changed the moment we tried Handel's... this is literally the best stuff in all of Nevada. I can't believe they don't have a location on the Strip yet, but also, yay for us locals, we don't have to go to the Strip for this ice cream!

Went here twice in one week! I lived in Ohio for four years before moving to Las Vegas and never tried this place out! On my first visit I tried the four scoop sampler with Bananas Foster, Blueberry Cobbler, Graham Central Station and Blue Moon. They were all delicious but Graham Central Station was my absolute favorite. It's unique and you can taste the graham crackers/cinnamon as well as the fun toffee texture and crunch. Blueberry cobbler is always delicious with a creamy texture pairing well with sweet blueberry flavor. Blue Moon is hard to find anywhere else in Vegas and is a nice raspberry flavor in a vibrant blue for the summer though not my cup of tea. I could taste the rum in the Bananas Foster which was tasty but not my personal fave. During my second visit I tried the banana cream pie... every bite tasted of real banana as well as the perfect amount of pie crust. It's hard to pick a favorite but for now I'd say Graham Central Station and Banana Cream Pie are tied. I'll have to come back to discover more favorites and expand my ice cream palate!!

The line situation is iffy. We waited outside for quite a while and the guy tending our lane just booked when we were next and we stood there confused as to if he was coming back for 10 minutes until someone else helped us. Otherwise, the ice cream is definitely top notch. And I consider myself an ice cream aficionado.

Tried this place several times with several different flavors of ice cream. Each time, I came away thinking the ice cream was average. It is pretty soft...almost a hybrid of hard pack and soft serve, and melts pretty fast. I would not say it has the high cream content of higher end ice creams. Just does not have that special creamy goodness.
Amazing. Worth the wait in line. Salted Carmel truffle and graham central station the best!!!

We came here last week for the first time and there was quite a line, we waited patiently with our two dogs and a good 20 mins later got to the window. Well no wonder there was such a wait, the guy took our order one at a time. Made mine, came back to give it to me, and then asked what my girlfriend wanted. I've been to many other walk up ice cream spots (different cities, mind you) and they take your order as a whole. There would also be more than three people working!! Annoying. So whatever. The ice cream was really only okay. I'd rather Coldstone or Smiths brand for that matter. But we come back a few days later on Wednesday for a second try and the line was still so long. We stood in it for 7 minutes and it didn't even move! So we left and went to Coldstone. I can't imagine what the wait time/lines are going to be like when Summer actually hits. No thank you.

I grew up eating Handel's in Youngstown, OH and tonight was just like being home on a summer night! The Black Cherry and Chocolate Pecan haven't changed from my childhood. The boyfriend had cake batter and he said it was too sweet & he has a HUGE sweet tooth. The only down side is that there was no napkins outside to clean up the ice cream drips. What I don't think people understand who have left 2 or less stars. Where Handel's was started it was about socializing with the neighborhood. You sat on the curb or leaned on cars trying to finish your ice cream before it ran down your arm. So don't worry about the fact there is no indoor seat and instead start a conversation with the person next to you.

The most amazing ice cream EVER!!!! I grew up outside of Youngstown, OH where the company originated from. Moving out to Las Vegas made me miss the best of the best from back east. But long behold, Handel's is finally here! The ice cream is dead on from Ohio. So many flavors to try but I can never get past by favorites! Try the malted chocolate peanut butter or the salted caramel truffle. You may want to pass up the scoop and opt for a quart because it is that good. Staff is super friendly and the owner is totally awesome! Keep up the great work Handel's. I'll see you real soon!

Lots and lots of fun flavors and good prices. We tried the 4-flavor sampler and loved all four of the ones we tried. Looking forward to going back and trying more. I only wish they had an air-conditioned seating area!

This place has tons of different flavors to choose from. If you're sick of the typical fro-yo places all around town give this place a chance and you won't be eating fro-yo again! Spouse Like A House and Buckeye are the best two flavors.
Very delicious ice cream. Best Birthday cake ice cream I've had. Very friendly people.
The employees are really friendly and helpful. Ice cream it's delicious just wish they had room to stay n eat the ice cream there but I love it.

We ordered the banana split and the guy prepared it without wearing gloves which I think is unsanitary since its the same person who is collecting the money and preparing the order. This guy who helped us was very nice but the owner should provide gloves for the employees.
Very good ice cream! Fast & friendly service. The Chocoholic Chunk is a chocoholic's dream :-)

Seriously Handels??? Who thought of the bright idea to think ppl want to eat their ice cream, I mean soup out in this weather. You couldn't find a way to have some kind of inside seating? And the service was atrocious. The guy at the window could not have been any ruder. Ice cream was ok but not worth the cost or having to sweat in it while eating. Many other places worth going to than here.

The ice cream here is amazing! Easily the top ice cream I've had in vegas so far. They have tons of flavors... My husband and I both got a four scoop sampler. I tried the salted caramel truffle (my favorite!!), the cookie dough, the banana cream pie which really tastes like its name, and the chocolate marshmallow. My only suggestion would be to make the chocolate marshmallow more marshmallow-y, it's just the chocolate ice cream with marshmallows in it and I was expecting more throughout. My husband got plain chocolate and vanilla, cotton candy, and the watermelon ice. Usually, ice has no taste but this one was so tasty! I can't wait to go back and try more. They also gave my toddler a free baby cone of vanilla. The prices are really great, we spent $9 and change and I gave the girl a $10 and told her to keep it and she was super grateful just for that little tip. I highly recommend this place, it was perfect to sit outside at nice with my family and enjoy a treat.
Cinnamon roll shake was amazing!!! As well as the chocolate PB. Prices are fair. I'll definitely be back again.

The BEST ice cream in Las Vegas!!! Lots of flavors and every one we've had so far have been delicious and reasonably priced! The four scoop sampler is great for trying new flavors! We love this place and they are all really nice there, give them a try you'll be hooked!!!!
Awesome ice cream shop from Ohio that is made at each location. Plenty of flavors and great prices

Ice cream is good but not worth the wait. Everytime my husband and I go, there is a line of about ten people and one maybe two employees working. This evening sealed the deal that we will not be going back. This is the third time we stepped out of line to grab ice cream elsewhere. This makes me sad only because I worked at the one in Ohio when I was in high school. On summer nights we had every window open with limited line waits. Customer service is something this location may want to think about improving. Gotta spend the money to make the money.

Not very happy.. I really should have got my $8.00 back for the worst banana split ever!!! Who dosn't put hot fudge or chocolate or Pineapple or strawberry or somthing??? On a split... ice cream nuts cool whip was it... had to ask for a cherry and sprinkles because my 4 year old was so disappointed. .. ice cream was fair not worth $8.00?? They need better customer service. They need to clarify a banana split comes striped

Went the first week it opened and was disappointed especially since my reference knows my love for ice cream. Scoops were pathetic but today I ordered 2 pints, apple pie and blueberry cobbler. Still haven't tried the $2 scoop Tuesday but the pints were far worth another try. DEFINITELY WILL RETURN.

Always saw a line so thought, "this must be good." I went on $2 Tuesday. The line was really super long. I waited 40 minutes in the sun. When I finally reached the front of the line, a mean elderly lady cut me. The lady argued could cut everyone because no one was ready to order but her. This upset everyone waiting in the sun even more. When I ordered, the guy at the window slowly took my order, would come back, hand me an ice cream, then tediously leave and close the window to go get another ice cream. There has to be a better system! It is not that this the world's best ice cream and people are lining up, getting speedy service, and leaving. People have to stand in a line for a long, long time. So do not get deceived with the long line of people like I did. Regarding the ice cream, I thought the ice cream was too sweet. Besides the long line which requires standing within a bunch of angry, frustrated consumers, there are only three benches to sit and eat your ice cream. They should add some ice cream tables.

The ice cream is good, but the service is terrible. We were in the area and decided to pick-up 2 quarts (cocount cream pie and oreo). The problem is that we had to wait 20 minutes to get our order, for a line that was 6 deep and 3 guys working behind the counter. If you decide to go, you can have my space in line we won't be back.

Love their ice cream! So different from store bought. When it is hot in Vegas, this is a great place to cold down and indulge in their delicious sweet creations. There was a line when we got there, but they did not have a good system so people do not jump the line. They need to work on that, otherwise, they could have people who get offended. The price is a bit high, but the quality is top notch.
OOOHH, MA GAAWWD! This place is the best EVER!!! My new favorite ice cream place. I LOVE LOVE ice cream! It's my favorite food group! YUM!!!

Good product BUT owner is not very nice. Not friendly, not welcoming & makes u wait @ the window even if there's no customer. His employees are nice though. I use to go @ least 3 times a week & referred many people but after so many chances I stopped going.
Been to many ice cream shops, from coast to coast and by far this chain has the best chocolate shakes.. It's trouble we live up the street from this place!!
Some of the best ice cream I have ever tasted in life. NO JOKE
If you can't decide the 4-scoop sampler is the way to go. Have yet to have a flavor we didn't like!!
Amazing homemade chocolate pecan ice Cream. This is the real deal creamy, fresh ingredients. Icecream...like nothing you have ever tasted! The Buckeye's do it again.....welcome Handel's to Las Vegas!

Simply very good ice cream. A wide variety of flavors, excellent size options and very good prices. The servers were welcoming, offered advise and quickly transacted our purchase. Just a very nice experience following our trip to Red Rock Canyon..

Feels and tastes like neighborhood ice cream shop that I remember growing up. Large selection, up beat employees, reasonable prices. Can also take pint or quart to go. Thankful that they opened so close to our home.
Always a good place to stop by and grab some ice cream. I recommend the orange sherbert parfait.
Best ice cream in town! Great service and so many flavors to choose from. I never go anywhere else!!

This place is Da bomb.com I love it so much. The milk in the ice cream tastes like it comes from Heavenly cows in pastures in Pennsylvania. You can only imagine what this must taste like when this ice cream touches your mouth for the first time it is simply delectable.

It was just ok for me, I come from Chicago and we have a lot of old school ice cream parlors there so im kinda biased. As for Vegas ice cream parlors it does the job...their ice cream is very creamy and they have variety of flavors. My disappointment was when I ordered a shake and asked for it extra thick only because there on the sign you can get it extra thick with a $.75 charge. Upon getting the shake I found it to be really liquidy, maybe that's what they considered thick... my definitions of extra thick is when you need to eat with a spoon. The prices are a tad high for the amount of ice cream you receive and the best day to go is $2 Tuesday. Wish they had more seating areas as well. Overall, this place is not bad but nothing more than 2 stars from me. Its good for those hot summer nights and you want to bring the fams out for a treat. I guess for family bonding time. Check it out... you might like it!!

It's pretty good. It's nice that you can choose the sampler pack and get 4 scoops of different flavor a. My wife is keen on the coconut cream pie flavor, so we end up coming here quite a bit for simply just that.
Three words....OFF THE HOOK! I do wish they had smaller sizes. Such a great selection and it's all delicious.

I would rate them lower if their ice cream wasn't so good. I always get Oreo ice cream (simply because their board is overwhelming and I don't know what's in any of the funny nicknames for flavors) but I'm reluctant to come back because the customer service is always less than desirable. First, there isn't anywhere to sit because there are always people sitting on the ONE bench outside, so by the time I get home and comfortable to eat my ice cream, it's melted. Second, there is just a stupid window which makes you feel completely isolated from the person making your ice cream when they literally shut the window while you're talking. And last, the people always take forever. What are you doing back there? All you have to do is scoop the ice cream... I'm not just talking about something I don't know about... I work at coldstone, so I actually know how long it takes to ACTUALLY mix the ice cream. Theirs is pre made, so it makes no sense on why it takes so long... Their ice cream is good, but not worth waiting forever and getting the window shut on you
Amazing ice cream! Sooooo yummy. So many different flavors to choose from and great customer service. So glad I found this place! 2 buck Tuesday's are everything!

Decent ice cream. Good selection of flavors and generous with the mix ins. Lines can get long and sometimes they seem understaffed with only one window open. The guy I think is the owner/manager could use a refresher on his customer service skills. Can be pretty short with customers. I go there when bored with Ben & Jerry's flavors.

Saw the hype about this place opening and finely took my grandkids. Got there just after 11am so no line. Took sometime for service as he was in back. Got are orders in a timely manner. Now they have no indoor area to sit so that leaves just a couple of benches outside ( no tables ) as many of the other places in town have. If you have little ones I would get it to go. Their ice cream was ok but not worth the drive as I noticed on their signage. Next time I feel like ice cream or custard and need to drive with no place to sit I'll go to my favorite place "luv it custard" at LV Blvd and Oakey.
Smooth and creamy ice cream, lots of ingredients in the mix and great customer service. Great ice cream shop!

This is the number 1 homemade ice cream in Las Vegas !!! Fresh ingredients, smooth, creamey and Delicious. Handles was my only ice cream parlor in youngstown ohio while growing up the lines were around the building every day of the week. Now I am so excited to have one here and is a short walk to get there, you got to go and see for yourself.
This place is a childhood favorite of mine. I am so happy that it is here in Vegas. I absolutely love their icecream. The staff is super friendly too.

Hands down best ice cream in vegas! Got to try their Mint chocolate chip, salted caramel truffle and blueberry cobbler. All amazing. Location is clean and staff is very friendly. Store bought ice cream has nothing on them. Can you handle HANDEL'S???

We've been eyeballing this place out for quite sometime now since we live just around in Town Center. My husband and I were looking for a new close by desert spot and decided to finally try this place out. We came a little pass 9pm last night (Sunday) and there was a short line but nothing crazy. We were excited by the huge selection they had to offer specially when the advertisement said that their ice cream were hand made daily. I decided to get the 4 sampler and my husband wanted a hurricane. The guy who helped us from the left windrow told us they can't make a hurricane anymore. It didn't need to take him to roll his eyes to show that he was being so salty to his customers. Though it looked like he really wanted to. The other guy on the right window was alright by the way. I wasn't sure if this guy was in a bad mood or something. But my husband felt so uncomfortable to the point he finally got so irritated and decided not to get anything for himself anymore. At first there was a lady in front of us that ordered and before she even completely finished ordering, the guy just shut the window on her. I felt bad for the lady because she was so sweet and she felt a little embarrassed about what he did too. Too bad we came in the wrong time as our first time. Maybe well go back again because we like supporting this kind of food joint. Maybe when were not feeling Yogurtland on Flamingo/215, but not anytime soon.

Coconut cream is my new favorite flavor! So creamy with plenty of coconut flavor. I have been here several times, and the ice cream never disappoints. The banana splits are the best...traditional! My only reason for dinging 1 star is the wait....sometimes it takes awhile to get your ice cream, especially if there is a line.

This was our first time here. It was so good! I got the graham central station and that was so delicious!!! My husband got the brownie sundae ( not sure what's it called) but that was good too much whipped cream. Overall we will definitely be back!
Most amazing ice cream on the planet! Soo happy our hometown ice cream finally came to vegas!!! Yum!

This is not your regular bakery, this is an experience. Honestly from the moment you walk in is a different world. They have amazing pastries but their ham and cheese croissant which is not really a croissant more like a quiche was mind blowing. Is always my favorite thing to eat there. Their lavender lemonade is amazing and fresh and the staff is super friendly. You order first your pastries and then your drinks. I loved to see how inclusive this place is, I felt welcomed from the moment I walked in and their staff even though they were training a new member, were really patient and nice. This will be a new go to every time we go to Charlotte.

Visiting from CA! The interior is cute and seems like a popular place to study/bring the aunties to lounge and converse. Decorations and ambience is 5/5. As for the actual food and drinks....let me begin with the drinks! I am a big Italian Creme Soda Girl and I loved every sip of my Peaches and Creme soda!!!! It is basically fresh milk with carbonated water/soda and peach purÃ©e. 10/5. I loved it so much and was sad that I finished it so fast. The iced coffee was eh my little sister drank it but wasn't raving (she loves Dunkin' Donuts vanilla coffee)....and now for the pastries...We both love Honey + Butter (macaroon specialty shop in SoCal). Upon seeing the flavors and the macaroons on display we opted not to get any. The flavors were a bit basic, but I am sure they are a classic macaroon, just not up to the standard of creativity and presentation that is offered back home. We got the peaches and creme tart instead and the raspberry merengue one. They weren't bad but it was a bit underwhelming. I would say pass on those and get the macaroons or like the strawberry fruit tart before going for those. I will give the pastries we tried a 2/5. It looked better than it tasted, which is a common bummer for many bakeries, not just this one! But still it was underwhelming enough for me to bump two stars because I really went to this place to try the baked goods with ambience as a plus but it was really vice versa-- Overall, will I be back if I ever go back to NC? If I am in the area then yes I will come back for the peaches and Creme soda, then YOU BET. But then again I can make my own from this side of the ocean so it was a good experience and I took some nice photos for the memories!

Stopped by the new 36th Street location and it's really nice! The concept is the same as the original Amelie's, but a few more designs. The Eiffel Tower replica is a hit! There are macaroons and other dessert designs on the ceiling and it's really nice! Plenty of seating areas inside and a few tables outside. Great place to grab some really good food, desserts and coffee/tea! Give the new location a try!

This is such a fun cafe to go to! I loved all the decor, such an awesome place for photos. The menu looked great, but I ended up getting the granola and yogurt, which wasn't great. I'm not a fan of their granola and yogurt, so I regret not trying something else. I did have a latte, which was good.

Looking for a later evening dessert place on a Monday in Charlotte is tough! Especially when you are from out of town. Fortunately good local friends recommended Amelie's. They have at least two in town, this location was the only one open. Wonderful French cafe feel, with the bottom of the Eiffel Tower right in the restaurant! We had a variety of tarts...mixed berry, chocolate, peach and raspberry. Rave reviews by our party of four! Just what we needed for an after dinner dessert and coffee.

I love all Amelie's. I used to go pretty regularly before the pandemic, but even when I go occasionally I always love what I buy. The macarons, pastries, salted caramel brownies, and the salted caramel cafÃ© mocha - it is so good! I have frequented the old location in NoDa, the Uptown location, and even the location near Park Road, so I had to stop in and check out the new spot. It's really cute, and full of French-inspired decor as you would expect. I love the Eiffel tower that decorates the dining room, and I think the new store is a great size not to mention it's in the perfect location. Same great treats you would expect at any Amelie's location and the prices seem reasonable. Years ago they used to sell a strawberry pistachio croissant, and it was to die for! I really wish they would brings it back, and I check every time I go into Amelie's, but unfortunately not. Anyway check out the new location and buy some sweets for a friend.

Came here as I was craving something sweet and it was close to the area I was in. I am so glad I tried them out! The cutest interior, like Paris threw up in there (in a good way lol). They have such a wide variety of pastries/sweets. Even various coffees & beverages and savory items as well. I only tried the sweets so can only go off that. I had a few macaroons my favorite was the lavender lemon, as I like a nice balance of sweet and tart. Their mousse cup is divineeeee! *Now I love chocolate esp when it's dark rich and creamy. So if you don't like dark chocolate or rich desserts, that dessert is not for you!* Had their key lime pie/tart, apple tart, peach tart, & caramel brownie. Everything is sooo good. Going to go back there again before I leave

I was pretty pumped to go try this Cafe out. The decor and inside area was pretty cool set up. What really took me away was the all of the macaroons and pastries on display that you can choose from. I couldn't make a choice so I got one of every flavor macaroon and didn't disappoint. My favorite was the birthday cake!

Highly recommend! This is such a fun hangout place with the best decorations! Definitely is a good place to bring someone out of town for just for a date or friends catching up. They give you a really good amount of food and the pastries are absolutely amazing! I got one that was some kind of strawberry shortcake and I highly recommend! The staff was very friendly, and there is lots of seating which is great because on the weekends it is pretty busy

This place is super kitschy, and honestly that was my favorite thing about it. I loved getting to check out the crazy sculptures and chandeliers and reading how to say 'I love you' in 40 different languages on the banister while waiting in the insanely long line, and had we eaten in I would have loved to have done it underneath some Eiffel Tower-themed monstrosity. Unfortunately the food was disappointing, and it was made worse by their confusing pickup system. They give you different categories of things in different bags in different places, which wasn't made clear, so we drove all the way back to our hotel only to open up the bag and find half our breakfast missing. The best things in our order were the pastries: the almond croissant, cream puff, and pecan tart. The quiche was average and the chai was the worst I've ever had; it tasted like a ton of corn syrup and artificial Christmas cookie flavor fell into some hot water.

My new favorite spot!! I've been here 3 times this week. The service is amazing and the pastries.... Well if you love fresh baked goods this is the place. I'm also in LOVE with the pecan and peach salad!!! It's a must try. Also the Bacon, fig and Brie sandwich leaves your mouth watering for more!!!
