Amelie's is my go-to for French pastries and macarons! I needed several dozen pastries for a work event a few weeks ago, and I was able to place my order online in advance and pick them up at 7:30 - and they looked (and tasted) amazing! I always love trying their seasonal offerings as well - they have great hot drinks and even small meals, and each of their cafÃ© locations has a great quirky vibe.
This place always has fresh pastries and great coffee. The staff is amazing and treats you like family treats you like family.

I stopped in here with a friend for a quick snack in the afternoon after a day out together. We got a salted caramel brownie as well as a cookie with a lot of different ingredients in it like pretzel, coffee, and oatmeal. The servers were extremely friendly and helpful to describe the baked goods as well as just pleasant to talk to you. Also the line moved pretty quickly and we were able to find a table. overall a nice spot and I'd recommend to stop in, a little pricey but definitely good products. we found parking right out front in the parking lot it's very large so I can't imagine it's ever an issue.
It's a good place. Good pastries, treats, and coffee. Good space to work on the weekend.

Cinnamon Cherie def doesn't look like the picture. Plus cold. Plus had to be remade. Sad because i first came here and it was wonderful, today i brought my sister visiting from Miami and was embarrassed. Not only was everything slow, the drinks were cold, her same drink for here was given in a Togo cup. We asked for our croissants warmed and that was not to the servers liking. Just uncomfortable experience today.

Anytime I visit the area I try to make a point to come to Amelie's. I love their coffees, their food and especially the baked goods. I tried a lavender macaron this time, because I'm obsessed with anything lavender, and was pleasantly surprised to find lemon curd on the inside! What a delightful treat, these macarons are also huge! We got sandwiches as well, a pick-your-own breakfast croissant with bacon, egg and cheese, and the chicken, sun-dried tomato and goat cheese on a banquette. Yum! Excellent bread and yummy fresh ingredients. And of course we got more pastries to go!

Awful... If I want to start a horrible restaurant I'm going to slap a French Bistro name on it so it sounds fancy. They did a great job with social distance including the staff who distanced themselves in the back not to be seen. Up front service was painfully slow. My wife ordered a croissant and a overpriced $4.50 lemonade. Simple enough. I ordered an $8 chicken sandwich on a baguette. Sounded great. Didn't come with anything. The guy at the counter asked us to step aside and wait for my sandwich which he said would take 5-10 minutes. I thought I heard him incorrectly. Just do the math in your head to build a sandwich with 4 ingredients. The restaurant was dead. 15 minutes later my fancy French sandwich came out. It was tiny and the chicken was thin grilled pieces. Some blue cheese crumples and bonjour! The experience was horrible with a fancy accent over the "e".

They are open 24/7 365 days ... @ this location --open every day .all year long! That is not a typo. All the pastries and desserts tasted very fresh as we witnessed them coming out regularly. Obviously depending on what your tastes are ... I don't think you can go wrong All the fruits were fresh and the custards and creams appeared creamy and recently made You can get coffee tea and drinks and lunch sandwiches also. It is worth another trip and apparently other locations are in NC, Rock hill, SC and Atlanta
Great French bakery, delicious, real pastry, well decorated, very friendly, good service, parking lot, the cinammon sticks are very good, the pecan pie and croissants.

Stop this place was absolutely adorable!! We stopped here while we were in town for a conference and I am so glad we did! I got a breakfast sandwich, chai tea and a key lime tart. Everything was delish I probably could have kept ordering stuff ha. I totally loved the eclectic vibe this place had. I wish we had a place like this in Charleston! If you are ever in Charlotte I totally recommend you check this place out, you will not be disappointed!

Finally tried the famous French chain in Charlotte and loved it! Beautiful bohemian chic deco, different chairs and tables, all eclectically mixed and fun. The line did get crazyyyyy on a Friday night, but no wonder! The desserts and coffee were yumyumyummmmmers! I got a small macchiato (not the big Starbucks one) and it was perfectly done. The dessert choices were endless! I tried a coconut macaroon and a Palmer (my fav French dessert). Both were delectable! Can't wait to come back here and try more!
I think this place is cute but there isn't much for me so outside of social meetup with friends, I have no real need to come back.
Awesome spot! Totally recommend. I got the breakfast sandwiches on a croissant and the pastries make your day, week, year happier.

This places is very unique, they had very cool decorations and one of the largest selections of pastries and desserts I've seen, which is great. The lines can be extremely long, but it's worth the wait. Everything tasted amazing, I recommend getting some of the fruit tarts, they are my favorite.

Delicious place ! we have stopped by here when we are in town due to it being a little further than the rock hill location we usually go to. This spot is just as friendly and unique and lovely as the other locations ! The pastries are absolutely delicious and I love going there every single time it leaves me so so happy ! We ordered the macaroon gateau for valentine's day the previous year and they were very friendly when we called to place the order and had no problems picking it up. It was absolutely worth the money and we enjoyed it for that special occasion!

AmÃ©lies French bakery is amazing!! Everytime I come to North Carolina I have to come to get a delicious dessert! Wish I were closer to them haha! Definitely recommend you give Amelies a try if your in the area or in the mood for something sweet!

Amelies on park road is fantastic. Not only is all of the food fantastic, but the staff there is what makes it such a great place. Krystal is truly one of a kind, every time I've been she has the best vibes and always personally makes sure everything is good. She really is what makes amelies on park road so special!

This is a quaint little cafe and bakery tucked away among a strip of other stores. The staff is welcoming as you walk through the door and a beautiful display of pastries light up the room. This was my first time visiting and it won't be my last. I had a Ham and Honey Dijon sandwich with carmelized onions on a banquette and my husband had a Chicken sandwich with sundried tomatoes and goat cheese. Everything was delicious. Their beverages consist of an array of teas, coffees and canned sodas. The eating area consist of eclectic tables and chairs. Very inviting and comfortable. You seat yourself. Lots of space. I couldn't leave without taking a few pastries home. Delicious. Don't pass this place up if you're in the area.

We heard a lot about Amelie's French Bakery and we decided to try out the bakery after the dinner. The cafe decor and ambience was amazing. We loved the decor and the cafe was nicely decorated. The cafe has different sweet options and there are lot of sweet options. From the options we decided to have Napolean, Creme Brulee, Mini Mousse Cup, Coconut Macaroon and Key Lime Mini Tart. All the sweets we ordered were delicious and finger licking. Do try this cafe as they have amazing sweet options.

I loved everything about this place! From the cute Parisian art and theme throughout to all of the yummy pastries! My mom is a baker and I also know not all macarons are created equal. These were delicious! I also appreciate the gluten free options they have. A few things not photographed (because I inhaled it apparently ) the veggie quiche and almond croissant were both very good! Overall I'd recommend and definitely come back the next time I'm visiting Charlotte!

I love Amelie's! I've been going for years and the food is always delicious. It's usually our dessert spot for date nights

I met with some friends at AmÃ©lie's French bakery and I absolutely love this place! The staff is friendly and very patient with first time customers (like me) who can't decide on all the awesome French pastries choices. The entire restaurant was spotless and spacious, adorned in French decor as far as your eye could see. The atmosphere was so peaceful with a homely feel; sort of like a home away from home. It's a nice spot to connect to the free wi-if and just focus without distractions and the best part is it's open 24 hours! Oh yes, and the food was awesome! We ordered breakfast croissants, pull-apart cinnamon bread and a cheese danish and everything was delicious. Amelie's is my new go-to spot!

AmÃ©lie in my tummy makes me happy! Seriously, if you're looking for good pastries that are unpretentious and delicious, AmÃ©lie's your gal. Noted, I visited pre-pandemic in early February, but I'm sure their food quality has not diminished. I got their portobello, red pepper, pesto tartine, tiramisu croissant, and an oat milk latte. Here's the thing, the food presentation itself to me wasn't the prettiest pastries/food I've ever seen, but here's also another thing, the flavors and quality of food itself were outstanding. I'd rather have taste over looks, ya know what I mean? Here we are in November, and I still dream about this place, hence why I also remembered I never wrote a review for them. Love this bakery. They are a little pricey, but I've never had a bad menu/bakery item from here. I would go back.

Extremely scrumptious and decadent French pasties! I came out of town after finding this bakery online and seeing the decor. Such a vibrant bakery with eclectic and cute decor that made it feel both homey yet chic. Got a assortment of desserts to try such a the macarons (flavored meringue cookie), elephant ears (sugared phyllo pastry), salted Carmel brownie, pecan pie tarts and entremet (nut layered cake. Everything was delicious and it was my first time having a honey macaron which was beautifully decorated with edible gold foil.
excellent pastries and coffee, oh my!!! Great story

Omg. I am in town for a day and went to the other location for a late lunch and loved it. Had to come to this 24/7 location to eat more deliciousness before I skip town tomorrow. Have been to a few other locations & always love the pastries. Kind of sucks that they were out of the fall flavors I wanted to try this time though. Knowing they are a 24/7 shop I think they should be prepared with plenty of inventory. Coffee was pretty good though.

Good egg sandwiches although expensive. Good counter service. Salted caramel brownie was old, stale, took a bite then had to throw out, dry too. Next time I'd try something else but I'd recommend trying this first before you walk away, I should've returned it. That one got past quality control.

My turkey & cranberry sandwich hardly had any sauce or cheese. It didn't even look appetizing. Our hot drinks were just as gio good as Starbucks. Very disappointed for the money I spent.

Known as a Charlotte gem, AmÃ©lie's offers a very unique decorative cafe which allows people to digest new scenes on every wall or lights shining all around. I love treating myself and others to their delicate fruit tarts and macaroons (strawberry shortcake). Always fun bringing new friends in order to try all the goodies on their diverse menu!

It's usually pretty crowded regardless of the time of day which isn't ideal, but if you need a coffee shop to work in past 7pm, this is the spot for you.

So busy and super long line, but yet I freaking like this place. 24/7 hrs open with lot of goodies I mean LITTLE SWEET NOT GONNA HURT YOU at all!! This place is hella cute inside I love how their place is all about vintage and cozy. They have a big space for customers to hangout with the nice chairs and sofa with tables. Love this place that never sleep #sweetooth @.0

Amazing french bakery and a gem of Charlotte. I tried the french macarons, apple tart, chocolate croissant, and chocolate danish. They are currently not doing dine-ins, but the line was long when we got there. Service is great and the prices are very reasonable for the quality of pastries.

Amelie's is such a fantastic little bakery. I am writing this review having eaten something from Amelie's in NoDa 5 times, but never stepping inside once. My girlfriend has stopped by and gotten me macarons from Amelie's a few times before and they have been nothing but amazing every single time. The only other thing I've had here was a bacon, egg, and cheese on a croissant that was DELICIOUS. I'm not sure why I haven't gone back for another but it's something I need to do in the immediate future. I know my girlfriend gets croissants, coffee, lemon spritzers, pie, and other things from there and she's always enjoyed everything she's purchased! I have nothing but good things to say about Amelie's. 5 out of 5 would go again and again.

I had heard great things about this place and it was all true! Great lattes, nice decor, affordable prices and good service. Salty caramel brownies were so good - I regret not buying more for my trip back to Atlanta. Coconut macaroons were also really good. Oh and a parking lot in NoDa is a nice thing to get! We will be back soon hopefully!

So amazing. The macaroons are top notch, the mouse was great as well. The line moves quick even when busy. Overall a great experience. They have several gluten-free options. The chocolate mouse is a must try. They also do macaroon cakes for birthdays. The prices are also good. The baguettes were also cooked fresh while we were in the shop & came out great. Nothing negative to say.

We visited Charlotte and was told this is a great pastry place. We ended up coming twice in a three day stay to buy lunch and pastries. The first time all was eaten in one day so my wife wanted to come again to buy more. It was delicious. Just be aware all is buttery and sugary.

Came here after the club/bar at 3 am I like that it's opened 24/7 but it suck that you don't have that much options late at night. Was sad we didn't get to order the creme brÃ»lÃ©e. There were endless unique flavors of macaroons to choose from that it was hard to decide. Overall, loved the pastries.

Wow... I know many businesses have been effective with Covid, however this place is always full with a long line. I used to love coming over for the pastiries and service, but now the service is the worse. No coffee press available, have to ask for the bread with my soup, only one person taking your order for over 30 people on the line and the another one as a cashier, and top it off the register was not working properly, What a shame!!!

Favorite study spot (so many hood memories here from undergrad). Their 24 hour availability makes those cram sessions bearable! Best soups with an amazing selection. Love the Sammy's as well! No need to mention all the delicious pastries-too many to recommend just one! My go to drinks are a dirty chia or iced green tea! 10/10 recommend Amelie's-NoDa and Park Road!

I ordered a key lime tart and creme brulee and both tasted awful. The key lime was overwhelmingly tart and the creme brulee was too hard. The quality tasted like it was from an amature baker who was following a recipe online. Not sure why so many people rave about this place. Maybe that's all they have in the area.
There's no better place to go get coffee and a yummy pastry in the morning before starting your day! The staff and overall vibe of the cafÃ© is awesome and I enjoy my visits each time.

The pastries and bakery items are great, that's the the good. The 3 stars is because of one issue I experienced with their service. I've been cutting places breaks due to the worker shortages and all, but this place was well staffed when we stopped by. It was 9:20, they closed at 10:00, and we waited 10 mins in line which was a good sign - the staff was hustling to move the line and doing well with it. Several folks in front of me placed coffee drink orders but when I placed mine - just a cup of coffee, nothing special - at 9:30, I was told they had stopped serving all drinks. I wasn't going to argue, but my thought was, why stop serving coffee a half hour before you close? If you're going to stop serving part of your menu at 9:30, change your hours to close at 9:30.

Amelie's is a must! The inside is so eclectic and cool. There are so many things to look at!! Let's start with the goodies first.... If you have a sweet tooth, you won't be disappointed. There are so many options. I had the chicken and goat cheese sandwich and a side salad with goat cheese. Both were so full of flavor! We had several kids with us and they were all happy with their lunch choice! Don't pass this place up.

Delicious pastries and really good coffee. This is a great place to get brunch or get some work done! I'm always on the lookout for their napolean cake, petite gateau, and/or entremet when I go to pick up pastries.

Amelie's is super cute and quirky. The sandwiches were a little unimpressive, but the sweets were beautiful and delicious. Definitely not a lunch spot I would choose again. The staff members weren't very friendly and not very attentive. Overall just an okay experience. I'd go back for the bakery, but definitely wasn't a great first time experience.

Amelie's is a treasure of Charlotte. Although each of their locations are special, the NoDa location is my personal favorite. All of their baked treates - from macaroons to croissants to cupcakes - are incredibly delicious and baked with absolute love. I also love all of their breakfast offerings in the mornings. I was also SUPER impressed with how innovative Amelie's was during COVID-19 in order to find creative ways to still provide their treats to their loyal following. They set up delivery everywhere in the area. They even developed the cutest "decorate your own cookie" kits that I have gifted to friends with little kids - and they were a huge hit. I highly recommend trying what they have to offer; you'll be hooked.

Fantastic little spot! Raspberry Tart was to die for!!!! Fig, bacon and Brie Tratine was also excellent. Also sampled other pastries all were spot on! Cool funky little spot!!! Staff was super helpful bending to my picky kids and making them happy. Would definitely come again!

I make an excuse to come here at least once every couple months, especially if a friend is in town visiting or if it's a date night and we're looking for dessert. This flagship location of Amelie's is by the far the best one in Charlotte. I remember when it was the only one, actually, and it was so packed you couldn't even find a parking spot. There's always still a line though so you KNOW they've still got it. Amelie's is decorated with eclectic furniture and decor, from quirky chandeliers to smashed Parisian plates on the wall to bird cages to a Van Gogh cutout by the door with a Santa hat for the holidays. Open 24/7, the French-themed cafe has everything from desserts to salads and juice. Everything is fresh, right down to the raspberries atop the merengue tarts (and we all know how fast raspberries go bad!) The dessert cases offer tons of options, up to 15 flavors of macaroons at once, even multiple flavors of eclairs, creme brÃ»lÃ©es, and fruit tarts. I stand there like an idiot every single time I come because I. Want. To. Eat. EVERYTHING here. There's something for everyone here, even if you just want a coffee. The staff is incredibly kind and patient with the long lines and patrons (sometime myself) who just need a minute to decide. They offer great recommendations and are incredibly knowledgeable about ingredients, flavors, and cooking and baking methods of everything they have to offer. Amelie's is hands-down the best dessert spot in Charlotte for its atmosphere, service, and sweet treats. *Pro tip: they offer one free eclair on birthdays!

We've been to this AmÃ©lie's a few times. The service is always good. My wife is celiac and there's a few items that are gluten free that she can have. The macaroons and a majority of the mousse cups are good for her to have. I would love for them to offer a few more items for celiac, is my only criticism.

A dream for coffee lovers & pastry enthusiasts! I was so excited to check this place out due to all of the positive reviews. The decor, pastries, & coffee were fantastic! I would highly recommend AmÃ©lie's to anyone in the Charlotte area. First off, the decor is AWESOME! You literally feel like you have stepped into Paris as soon as you walk through the door. There are murals of the Eiffel Tower, the Mona Lisa, & locks along the gate at the front depicting the Pont des Arts bridge in Paris. There is also plenty of spaces to sit. They have a large back room with couches, tables, chairs, & a front area with the same setup. Even on the busiest of days, I can always snag a chair or two! Now for the good stuff.... the coffee & pastries! My first visit included a lavender coconut cream latte & a strawberry & cream cheese danish. That danish was absolutely delicious! I would order it again in a heartbeat. The lavender coconut cream latte was good. I'm not a huge fan of coconut, but LOVE lavender so I had to give it a try! My second visit consisted of a fresh fruit danish & the chai creme. The fresh fruit danish was so yummy! I could have eaten an endless amount of those heavenly things. The chai creme was my favorite coffee that I ordered out of all of my visits. I would highly recommend this coffee item. During my third visit, I ordered a vanilla almond milk latte & a blueberry cream cheese muffin. Once again, the pastry did not disappoint! The muffin was moist, flavorful, & filling (the perfect combo). The vanilla almond milk latte was pretty darn good as well. I would definitely order it again. This is the perfect spot to grab a cup of coffee, read your favorite book, or work on school stuff. They are open 24 hours, which is awesome for people in school! If you haven't checked out AmÃ©lie's, please stop what you are doing & drive there immediately. It will leave you wanting more!

AmÃ©lie's is a racist institution. They refer to black employees as "the help", decorate in blackface and have failed to have any leaders that are not white despite many opportunities. Leadership has referred to their black employees as people who were not "otherwise employable". Think twice before you give them any of your money. AmÃ©lie's has been problematic for YEARS.

Stopped here for lunch and to take pastries back for a thank you gift. Staff was very friendly and helpful. The food was super amazing. A bit pricey for what you get but we were still happy. Everything was super fresh from the salad to the pastries to the coffee beans!

This is the OG. This is the first ever Amelie's and I love it for that. I'm sad they plan to leave, but I'm sure the new space will be more than wonderful. The whole place is decked out in eclectic French-ish decor and there is always something interesting for your eyes to wander over to. That is, if you aren't too distracted staring at all of their amazing desserts :P One downside to this location is that the line forms in front of the display case, so often you are being asked what you'd like and you haven't made it past the front of the case yet. Hellooo FOMO! But everything is good so you really can't go wrong. Everyone loves the salted caramel brownies here, but I'll admit they aren't my favorite thing they offer. I really like some of the little tartlets they offer. This particular check-in I got the peach tartlet and the fruit was fresh and the pastry was buttery and flaky. It was wonderful. One of my friends also got some sort of chocolate cake that we all took tastes of while he went to the bathroom (#worthit) and it was AH-mazing!! The coffee here is a custom Amelie's blend from Pure Intentions, which is a local roaster and I love that local is supporting local.

Their pastries are to die for and we were just there a little over a week ago and they were just as tasty as always although they didn't have a full window shopping area full because their air conditioning was out and they looked short staffed. But what they had was amazing as always. Look forward to going back again really soon.

We went to AmÃ©lie's after hearing lots of good things from friends in Charlotte. It was incredibly busy inside the whole time we were there, and after trying the desserts, I can see why! I got a raspberry lemon tart, a chocolate raspberry tart, a salted caramel brownie, a strawberry vanilla cake, and a creme brÃ»lÃ©e. The creme brÃ»lÃ©e was sweet, creamy, and melted in your mouth. I loved seeing the flecks of vanilla bean in the custard! The strawberry cake was good and not dry, but the taste was pretty ordinary. The raspberry lemon tart was filled with a delicious lemon curd and sour raspberries on top of a buttery crust; delicious, but the meringue made it a touch too sweet. The chocolate raspberry tart was amazing; rich, melt in your mouth dark chocolate with a dollap of raspberry jam/preserves. One of my favorites! The best dessert was definitely the salted caramel brownie, I can see why this was their rise to fame! Smooth salty caramel on top of a crispy, chocolate brownie. I would come back to Charlotte just to buy ten of those! The only bad thing about AmÃ©lie's was the service was incredibly lackluster. The girl serving us was rude and had a condescending attitude. I asked what was in the chocolate cake and she replied, "chocolate cake". What if I had a food allergy and wanted to know if I would be able to eat it? If only the quality of service matched the quality of the food, then AmÃ©lie's would get five stars, but we were not impressed by anybody working there that night.
Worst visit in 8 years. Nothing in the cabinet and very behind. Amelie's has always had bins full and plenty of backup. Not sure what happened but what a wasteful trip.

I usually don't give 5-stars to anywhere off the bat and wait til I have at least two visits under my belt because sometimes you have an initial 5-star experience and then go back and it doesn't live up to the first time. Well, Amelie's was definitely 5-stars both times and I can definitely see this place being my new late night Crown Town hang out! First off, this place is like a museum with all sorts of weird, quirky, and fun decor! The back room especially feels like the living room of a close friend if they were a hip hoarder of chic, contemporary, and collectible french-themed tchotchkes. Second, their menu is just stellar and oddly not that overpriced, especially for the NoDa area. Third, they are open 24/7! Recently, I was locked out of my place and had to find somewhere to chill from 4:30am-7am...Amelies to the rescue! Not only did I have the comfy couch all to myself, but I curled up on it w/my phone connected to their free wifi and easily killed 2.5hrs into the dawn w/a delectable lavender coconut creme cafe and bacon brie tartine. The staff can be a little hit or miss, but for the most part, they are friendly and informative if you have a question about a menu item. Service is counter and they will give you a number to bring your food items out to you, but you pick up any coffee/tea orders at the counter. They do have a separate place to order from the bakery/pastry case (haven't tried anything from there yet because I am afraid to unleash that beast, but it will probably happen on my next visit). Their bfast croissant are fantastic and their shot in the dark (drip + espresso shot) passed my palate. Being a new transplant from Austin (a city that is almost too cool for itself), this place totally felt like home and I can't wait to have an excuse and some disposable income to come back as soon and as often as possible!

It has been several weeks since I visited this bakery, and I can't stop thinking about it. So I'm writing a review. I remember how amazing and rich the first bite of the salted caramel brownie tasted. My mouth is watering just thinking about it. I visited at about 10pm. There was an amazing selection of sweets. I recommend getting as many menu items as you can and sample everything. This is an amazing bakery, and my next trip to Charlotte won't be complete until I stop by!
Visited amelie's while visiting charlotte. O.M.G. you must go. life changing everything was so good i made two trips to this bakery within 2 hours of each other. authentic fresh french goods

Today I was transported to Paris and it was delicious. All matter of pastries from tarts, to pies to mini cakes, to cupcakes to macarons and all types of coffee and espresso. The decor transforms you to an eclectic Parisian cafe with mixed match tables and chairs and decor and lighting that makes this place easily a favorite. And did I mention that it's open 24 hours.
Visited Twice. At the first time, the macarons were amazing. During the second time, the butter cookie macarons were too dry. These are expensive!

This place is absolutely overrated and as long as I have lived in Charlotte I have given it try after try. It always manages to be over priced and disappointing. There is nothing more annoying than a pastry that taste worse than it looks! This is nothing like a real French bakery and isn't worth the time. I recommend Renaissance Bakery for anyone looking to get good French baked goods in the Charlotte area, NOT AmÃ©lie's!

This is a go to spot for me when we come visit Charlotte. Open 24 hours, the food is always consistently decent (sometimes awesome), the vibe is cool and welcoming. Depending on the time of the day I feel the pastries are better. We came late at night and the display was somewhat empty but hey, beggars can't be choosers. Still a wonderful time!

Unique Charlotte bakery that is a must-visit for anyone coming to the city. The NoDa location is my favorite with its large social area that extends out into the interior of the building. There are always unique characters here. Lots of good people watching If you're into that. Highly recommend the chocolate croissant or any of the macaroons. They also have a great BLT (on baguette) and other food options. Open 24 hours!

Not the pastry, they have the best products ever. We love to go once in a while myself my wife and my two kids. It's about the lady at the cash register, I feel she just downgraded us every time we are there, I think because my wife wears a muslim scarf, she does not go the extra mile to help us like she does with every customer in the line. Today again we had the same bad attitude towards us. That's why I decided to write this review. I have more things to say but I'll stop here.

Long line be for a great treat. Just wish more of the staff was serving the long line. I'm sure they were doing something equally important so that we would have treats to choose from. I will always come back because I always like what I get. I bought a chocolate raspberry tart and lemon berry tart. They were both very good flavor with a good blend of filling to crust. I have never purchased anything that was less than really good!!!

The original Amelie's on N. Davidson is a must visit place if you are going out on the town. I usually stop by after a night of partying in Noda and get their famous salted caramel brownie, or a macaroon or two. They are always open and seem to be at their busiest during the nights on weekends where the line wraps around the corner and heads towards the back of the building. The line does seem to move fairly quickly where you are rewarded with your choice of amazing pastries from the case. The coffee is also very good as they use Pure Intentions coffee who has made a custom blend of coffee and espresso just for them. They recently added a couple flavors of macaroon ice cream sandwiches, I had the salted caramel version and it was super good, I would definitely recommend trying this if they have them available.
Loved it! Bougieee-fy your taste buds. It's worth the trip. Tha almond croissants and powder pillowy goodness and worth the extra time spent in the weight room!!!

I think people go here for the look and feel plus environment. It sure did have unique decorations and very spacious, lots of tables for work and hangouts. The $2.29 macarons were larger than usual macarons but didn't taste fresh, doesn't have that moist feel. It was just crunchy and harden. I didn't eat a lot of the other pastries but my boyfriend wasn't hugely impressed. For the long line that wrapped around the corner, not worth the wait.

Amelies is one of my favorite places to do work, get coffee, a quick sandwich for lunch, or a beautiful and delicious dessert. Literally I could spend my whole day there (and I have before). I would recommend getting their macarons or any of their fruit tarts!

I have never had a bad thing from here. I have even had "cakes" made and when they say it feeds 6-8 you better believe it because they are as sweet as can be a delicious. We love their spinach tartinis, Chocolate Croissant, Salted Carmel and so much more

Amelie's French Bakery is like stepping into a Parisian Doll House, just add delicious pastries and bomb coffee. As a coffee lover, O M G. Try the Cafe Marcotter. The pastries are also very yummy, my favorite are the fruit tarts. Fast and casual environment. The staff are knowledgeable and friendly as well. They have a good selection of sandwiches and quiche They even have a small sitting area. I will for sure be returning here.

My favorite French bakery! I always stop by for a breakfast sandwich on croissant and grab a latte or espresso. Can't beat their coffee prices! Other coffee shops in the area overcharge for their watered down coffee and I think Amelie's does the opposite. I love seeing what pastries are in stock and it's always a treat to splurge on one (or four). Def recommend for a local cafe and bakery.

The food is "okay" but the service is awful. We ordered 2 breakfast sandwiches to go and waited 20 mins. We were the only two people in line and it really shocks me that it took 20mins to cook two egg/cheese sandwiches. Don't waste your time if you are in a hurry.
Beautiful bakery with tasty food! But expect a wait on the weekends because it's pretty popular

AmÃ©lie's is my homespun love story! By far my favorite coffee shop ever! The minute I stepped inside I thought I had been transported to a chic cafÃ© in the middle of France. It is impossible not to fall in love with the decor and cozy atmosphere. With more than ample seating it is the perfect spot to have a drink, prop open a book or your laptop, and have a wonderful time. You could pick any one item off of the menu and you would not be disappointed! Service has always been exemplary and even when the line is out the door I've never waited too long to get my order. Among my favorite drinks are the French press coffee, salted caramel brownie cafÃ© mocha, and the blueberry lemonade. As for treats, try the napolean, any of the tarts or macarons, the mini mousse cups, and the petit fours!

Very popular and very busy went to the one in Dillworth. Had quite a wait. But worth it. The Monsieur croquet sandwich was a master ham and cheese sandwich. The macaroons were perfect taste and texture.

This is a North Carolina staple. A very cute and eccentric cafe that's open 24/7. I was surprised to hear their hours but apparently it's the best spot to come after a good night of going out! I'm pretty obsessed the vibe. It's like a randomly collection of French art, and crazy chandeliers and couches. While there I got chocolate mousse (no egg or gelatin). It is very massive and definitely not a one person thing to handle!! I would recommend the mini cup instead for one person.

Amelie's is a Charlotte staple. You can't find better pastries. The original Amelie's is my favorite. The rest don't quite measure up. The Petit Fours are over of my favorite things to get. They also have great macaroons and seasonal cakes. Their fruit tarts are good and let's be honest, is there anything that isn't? The salted caramel brownie is the most popular thing, but I don't like chocolate, so I can't speak for it. I also love coming here for a sandwich at lunch or for brunch. The seeded roast beef and Croque Monsieur are my favorite sandwiches. Their soups are also very good. The eclectic decor also can't be missed. The downside of this location is that there isn't a ton of seating for the number of people that come to work at a table by themselves. This is a must try Charlotte destination!

Parisian 24 hour bakery and cafe - who woulda thunk?! Easy access to Amelie's with a giant parking and plenty of seating inside the cafe. I simply got a double baked chocolate croissant and chocolate tart. The baked goods were just okay for me. There is a larger menu for sandwiches and salads and drinks which I didn't partake in. The atmosphere is whimsical and super cute. Sideway chandeliers, Paris themed art work decorated a la Alice in Wonderland. Fun place to spend some time in day or night!
It's a fantastic bakery with awesome service. I had Napoleon that was to die for! As was the key lime tart and caramel salted brownie. So many different treats and beautiful tastes!

I don't know how, I haven't written a review for this place! I have been coming to this place since 2009, and it is one of my absolute favorite places that I must visit every time I'm in Charlotte. It is nearly impossible to list all of my favorites for this place, but some true highlights are their macarons, salted caramel brownies, and twice baked chocolate croissants. I also love their tarts, and LOVE LOVE their coffee. They also make a salted caramel french soda that is yummy. Their coffee is the best coffee I have found ANYWHERE. The roast is just perfection. When I visit, I buy multiple bags of coffee, as Amelie's decaf is just spectacular, but so is their normal house blend. They also made the most beautiful cake for my baby's half birthday, and I was so grateful that they did. It was delicious and hit all the right spots. If I don't get to visit any other places when I'm in Charlotte, that's fine, I just know I have to stop at Amelie's.

Visiting my sister out of state and reading so many great reviews about this place I was SO excited to grab some goodies with my sisters and niece. However while waiting in line from afar my sister was aggressively shouted out about the mask she was wearing. She was wearing a face shield from her nose below. Had she known she was wearing a face covering that wasn't up to standard she would have immediately corrected the issue. Instead she willingly stepped outside while I continued to order. At that time I let the cashier know how rude and inappropriate her approach was and had we known from the beginning it wouldn't have been a problem. She then let me know employees had been tested positive and they had to be shut down. That's no excuse for poor customer service. Once leaving the cafe we called to get her name which is Terry and she hung up the phone several times once asking to speak with the manager. Hopefully the food tastes better than the employees attitude.

Love this place! The best coffee and pastries around. It is the cutest little spot and the staff is very friendly. They offer a variety of macaroons which are my favorite! I can't wait to try the macaroon ice cream sandwiches!

Let's give this review a proper title "Ride or Die". 10PM I decide to make a sweets run. Of course my darling fiancÃ© decided to stay in bed---good for you. I Text my neighbor and she's up and ready. Sneakers, yoga pants and a Hoodie. We take a 15min ride to heaven. I've been to this Amelies MANY times in College. 24hrs can be dangerous to your wallet. The line wasn't very long, and of course the staff was quick. We were in and out. My neighbor has never been to Amelies--She was so excited!! Normally parking is a pain, however I found a great spot. Upfront, there were a few college students on their labtops, studying and or hanging out. This is the perfect place to kick back and relax. I love coming here. I wish they'd serve wine like the other locations---coming soon I'm sure. The decor is always fun, lots for vintage inspired artwork.

My best friend introduced this to me years ago and I can't describe how much I love this place. Their baked goods are freshly made in house and you can really taste it. I'm super picky about macaroons & they have the best ones I've personally tasted in the US. Customer service is always quick and friendly. Prices are fair for the quality of food/drinks you get.

First time EVER going here. I loved the atmosphere and the staff was friendly and helpful. They had samples of the salted caramel brownie that I've heard about so I had to get one of those. The lemon raspberry tart was really good too. I can't imagine that anything here wouldn't be tasty and I'm just going by appearance. I hear it's usually crowded but since we stopped in during Sunday brunch maybe that's why we were able to get in and out. I'll definitely return to try some of their other offerings and hang out.
Love their sticky pecan buns and cotton candy macaroons, mousse cups are delicious I love this place

I had a small pecan tart that was great and my husband had a chocolate eclair with vanilla cream filling. We split a pot of French pressed coffee. We really liked the food. I do not like crowds and this place is really crowded with people pushing past and knocking your table. We were here at around 5:00 pm on a Saturday, so I am thinking this is probably a typical crowd. For me the desserts and coffee would be a 4.5, but the crowds and the noise bring it down to a 3. Great pastries and coffee, but not great enough to deal with the crowds. Not sure what AmÃ©lie's can do about it. It was on a few lists of where to go in Charlotte, so we stopped by. Don't regret coming, but unless I lived in Charlotte, I would not bother to return.

Felt all the Parisian vibes while visiting this bakery in Charolette's NoDa area. Definitely not as cheap as it was when I did visit Paris (here we spent about $30 for a couple of tarts, cakes and eclairs), but equally as tasty. There is ample space to sit down and enjoy your purchases or set up shop for a long day of working on your laptop. The workers there were also very pleasant and helpful. And as an added bonus, I love that the bakery is open 24/7! For some reason macaroons taste better after 12 AM.

Food is great, but service has gotten terrible over the past 6+ months. We tend to call ahead for orders to-go and we actually take bets on the order being either screwed up or not even made by the time we get there (or the staff outright forgetting to make it and apologizing when we get there). This has happened at least 4 out of the 6 times we've come here. I hope AmÃ©lie's fixes their to-go order process and has more attention to detail. The staff is super friendly and polite, but this doesn't really address the issue.

The gluten free salted caramel was spectacular! Wowzer! The chocolate cake which my husband enjoyed is pictured! Very, very good! Plus, I love the eclectic look and feel too! We went to the 24 hour one!!!

Open late. Amelie's French Bakery was hopping at 10pm on a Wednesday. I was told they're open 24 hours. The coffee was fabulous. I don't usually expect much from a bakery, where the focus usually is focused on their baked goods, but the coffee was noteworthy. The second thing I appreciated was the eclectic decor. Not just funky like some coffee shops, but interesting and odd while attractive & clean. There are multiple rooms, so plenty of seating. I saw a group playing a board game. The selection of baked goods was beautiful and tempting. I tried the vanilla cake with buttercream, my friend had the cake with pistachio buttercream (that was pretty incredible). They also had a selection of macarons, financiers, croissant and so forth. Great place to end the night.

Danish Breakfast omg this blueberry, lemon& thyme Danish for the win. This is a nice refreshing choice for breakfast. It is very tasty and filling. You never can just run in without grabbing a macaroon or two.

Loved this place! Cute atmosphere and delicious food. I ordered the turkey and Brie sandwich with the broccoli and pea salad. I loved that the salad came with croissant croutons! The sandwich was also pretty amazing, with a healthy chunk of Brie and a nice crusty bread. They also have desserts in a variety of sizes so you can sample a few and not feel too guilty. Strong endorsement for the key lime tart!

Loved everything about this bakery! Decided to stop here the last night before I left North Carolina. The decor, the pastries, and the quiche were delicious. Nice and friendly staff. Would definitely go there again if I'm ever in town.
Great desserts and always fresh. Have not tried the food.
Their double-baked almonds croissants are something else, we can not stop eating them.

Cute atmosphere, finding a table to sit was a little challenge (had tables of 4 with one person sitting there). The servers are very....."hurry up & buy", so know what you want before you get in line! Some of the items that we thought would be soft were hard & crunchy. I don't know how students can afford to come here to get a snack & study- it's pricey & adds up quickly.

WOW WOW WOW. Amelie's, please come to Raleigh! This food joint is a dream come true! -It's open 24 hours! The first food joint in NC that I have heard of that does this. -You can get a quarter, half or full baguette warmed up and sliced with butter or spread. The quarter baguette makes for the PERFECT snack when you are feeling peckish. I really enjoyed the smoked gouda spread. -They have tons of delicious authentic french desserts on display that you just can't resist. We shared the large mousse cup and it was fantastic. -Tartines!!! -Baguettes!! (again) -Cute decor, nice staff and plenty of seating. -Plenty of breakfast/brunch items and standard coffee shop drinks. -Did I say fresh, warm baguettes??? :) I guess it is good that Amelie's is not in Raleigh, because I would literally be there every day.

LOVE THIS PLACE. Eat. All. The. Desserts. I go here every time I visit and I'm never disappointed. Don't let the long lines intimidate you: it's worth the wait!! There's a sea salt caramel bar that is to DIE for. Also their macarons are amazing! I love everything I eat here so I'm biased. Ha!

Friendly staff, tasty pastries, and decent coffee! Only thing I would like to see is less waste, less plastic products etc. pricing is a bit high too, $2.25 for a Macron is definitely steep. I'll be back though!

NoDa has another gem. The relaxed atmosphere and unique decor is spot on and the meal did not disappoint. Sweet fig spread with smoky crisp bacon, paired with rich smooth brie all on top of toasted baguette slices. The staff was very informative and all smiles which seemed to gravitate to the clientele. The next time I have a midnight craving for sweets or a great lunch I know exactly where to go. Oh!!! and this location is pretty much open 24/7.

I expect a coffee place to serve coffee in ceramic coffee cup instead of a use and throw paper cup. We drove 30 mins just to try out this place and there was no coffee in my mocha. Yeah, no kidding!! What I fail to understand is why will a place that is open 24/7 will serve coffee to it's customers in a to-go cup unless asked for it? I would rather recommend you to go somewhere else, especially if you live far away.

Went to this location on a Saturday and night and man it was packed at midnight like it was peak hours. It was smaller than the other locations I have been to and a lot of items were sold out as well. I wanted fruit tart but they didn't have any. The long was line too considering it was midnight but i guess that may be the norm for this location.

What a cute little place. Actually not so little. There are so many cozy corridors and nooks to settle in and relax. Amazing selection of pastries and treats. Highly recommend the pecan tart, salted caramel brownie and vanilla eclair. So delicious!

I love this restaurant. I am a pastry chef and came across this spot as it is near my home in the fun area of NODA and just fell in love. I loved the decor, the product selection, the beautiful case with all the goodies, they have great teas and fruit drinks, plus the lighting is very special and artistic. I have tried many things here from the crunchy buttery croissants, the mini fruit tarts and I have had them all, the mini tea cakes, chocolate tarts, i always purchase macaroons in many flavors the colors and selection is wide and exciting. They have meal options from fresh creative salads to what they call Tartines that are open faced sandwiches and my FAVORITE is the Fig with Bacon and Brie I can't tell you how many times I have ordered the full order and ate the whole thing in one sitting. Every time I go I enjoy what I order and always try a new item from their case. The only issue for me is if you do not hit this spot at the right time the line can be 20 or more deep while they do have a decent sized staff it is not enough to always handle the long line. But you do get in and out with good service, great food and many things to look at. They have seating indoor and outside and offer all ToGo and the containers are well thought out and your food gets home safe and sound and tastes great. I would recommend this restaurant to anyone that is not watching their calories, loves pastry, loves sweets and wants to try some new fun tastes and flavors. Again, this is a popular spot and there are a couple locations to check out. A new one is coming soon and they are calling it their "Flagship" shop can't wait to check it out!

I love the food and bakery items... however it may have been the lady behind the counter's bad day. She wanted to rush us and didn't wanna really help out except getting us out of her line ASAP. Just gotta work on the customer service. Negative vibes are not cute.
AmÃ©lie's has a great dessert case and an even better atmosphere. Whether early in the morning or late at night, this is the spot.

The highlight of the morning was the Tartine with Brie, Fig and Bacon. Go for the full if you're hungry because the half is a bit small on the stomach. We also ate a Brownie Macaron and it was really good! There's outdoor seating which was really cool and comfortable

When you're in NODA, you neeeed to stop by Amelie's for dessert; it's mandatory! Had one our local relatives in N.C. Treat us to this place and we loved it so much we come back as much as possible. Why? Cuz the pastries are so *expletive* delicious! Amelie's is a beautiful cafe/pastry joint that'll satisfy just about anyone's sweet tooth. They have eclairs, a variety of croissants, pies, cakes, a full service coffee menu, tartes, and my favorites: Macrons of all flavors! The ambience is super cool as well; just loads of interesting decor, paints, sideways chandeliers... it's lots of fun to look at! The only thing keeping me from giving a perfect 5: from what I've noticed it seems like a majority of the seating is taken up by "study-ers." You know those people that take up an entire table for themselves and have their books and laptops laying everywhere while they've been babysitting whatever the cheapest item is on the menu?! Yeah those people hang out here too. JUST GO TO A LIBRARY!!! So good luck scrounging for seating! If it's a nice day/night, there's usually a few seats outside. We mostly end up eating in our car or take it to go. I'm not claiming to have ever visited Paris but if I had to dream of what Parisian pastries/sweets taste like, this is it. Matter of fact, I'll probably be disappointed if one day I go to Paris and things don't taste like what Amelie's serves haha. Okay, that comes across a bit ignorant but, you get the picture. Come here, enjoy the sweets and leave happy!

Must hit place in Charlotte and doesn't hurt that it's located by all things cool in Noda! Open 24 hours, there's never an off-time (although there are many ON times, with a line reaching into separate rooms). You'll know you're in the right spot right away, with all the creative artwork and antique pieces, I've heard it feels just like France (although I will verify AFTER my future visit!) The restaurant is made up of 3 rooms with an eclectic array of chairs and tables. Free wifi, and water too and you'll find outlets along the walls for the necessary charge [NOTE: I discovered the back room gets the best reception during my visit!] You'll walk in and immediately be greeted by a glass counter filled with goodies: pastries and sweet treats. But that's not all that Amelie offers! They've got a breakfast and lunch menu filled with sandwiches, quiche and coffee/teas. I recommend the turkey and brie sandwich, it's served on a baguette with a seedy raspberry jam. I've tried an assortment of treats and much say I need to keep trying! The Napoleon was too messy and tricky to eat: you really need to let it heat up but it falls apart really easily. I also tried a fruit (maybe orange) and tarragon macaron recently that was just ok on flavor although great texture. The downside is that Amelie's is pretty pricy when it comes to their bakery, so you can't go too crazy without the bill going crazy. I'll keep returning until I find the perfect combination, you really can't get over the atmosphere!

I want to eat everything in the case, but my waistline wouldn't be happy about that! Amelies has become sort of a staple in charlotte, with its kitschy decor, savory food options, decadent dessert and coffee/tea options galore. I'm a fan of the the mini desserts, because I feel like I can have a few of them rather than one large dessert, and you get to sample various flavors. Their chocolate croissant is one of my go-to items, as well as the vanilla cream soda, but honestly you cannot go wrong with anything on their menu. I also recommend the cream puffs and creme brÃ»lÃ©e, or anything season they have at the time! If you're going to savory make sure you save room for dessert! Amelies is a great place to get "lost" for a little bit. There is ample space to do work there and escape the craziness of a busy day, which is always an added bonus...along with free wi-fi.

This place is amazing and everything you can think of!!! My first time here and in Charlotte, NC and it had delicious food and TONS of options! You can get anything from a macaroon to a breakfast meal or just a coffee! I wish it had more seating areas because is always so packed! I would recommend this place a trillion times!

This bakery is a great place to get your fix of delicious pastries and coffee as well as find a spot to do hunker down and get some work done. At my visit I had the pumpkin cream puff and cinnamon dark chocolate macaron. The cream puff was really good, the filling tasted just like pumpkin pie. The macaron was also very tasty. I've had the soup and half baguette before too, which hit the spot late at night. Another perk of Amelie's is that they are open super late so you can do work until late into the evening or stop by for a midnight snack. There's ample seating and the building seems to extend forever. The decor is also eclectic and unique, with mismatching furniture, couches, and fun wall decor. This place is a must-visit for anyone who lives in Charlotte.

What to get: pastries, salted caramel mocha Service: 4/5 Atmosphere: cafe, study or meet up spot Wait: 10 mins (Saturday 8PM for 1) Parking: shared parking lot The Experience: It was around the end of my solo trip and though it's easy to secure a spot most places for one, Charlotte on a Saturday night gets crowded no matter where you go. At least all the well-known places do. So tired of potentially waiting for 30+ mins for even a spot at a bar, I headed over to Amelie's to have dessert for dinner. This particular location is in a strip mall with multiple businesses, so it's a large, shared parking lot. Biggest perk is that this place is open 24 hrs. Therefore, I can see it as a great place for studying late nights or getting together to meet up and chat with friends. To order, you'll likely line up by the counter, but it moves constantly. A lot of their pastries looked great. I tried a fruit tart and multiple flavors of macarons. The flavors of macarons weren't posted, so I just picked based on color. The cookies are actually pretty fluffy and moist, even after a day or so. The tart was fine, but nothing particularly special. Their salted caramel mocha latte(?) was actually the highlight for me. I'm always up for anything different they have on their coffee drinks menu and this one was well balanced. Mellow and slightly sweet, which made it easy to have with or without any treats to along with it. Pretty cute spot and a nice haven to get away from the crowds at dinner time.

Fact 1. it's open 24hrs. Therefore it's my type of place already, because I work late hours and it's always nice to have a place I can go and get some good tea/desserts. (not a coffee fan) but they have good choices in coffee as well. I haven't been impressed by the sandwiches or the food in general. Buuuuuut.... The freshly made desserts/pastries/cakes/... everything the Glass case has been outstanding. I highly recommend the Macaroons. (my fav is the lemon). But they have a new flavor normally everyday. There are some that stay constant, but the rotational macaroon is always a nice surprise when trying to find something new on the menu.

Snagged a quick cutie little macaron plus a salted caramel brownie (who cares if it was 10am, they're open 24/7!) and I felt like I was in another world. It looks like a French cafe only BIG. Lots of beautiful art and light fixtures all over. Peaches and cream macaron was awesome and the brownie.....let's say I'll be back.

Great large coffee shop and bakery. Ample parking and nooks to work. Amazingly this place is always packed with long lines, but they have line control down to a science. It would be nice to have a self service black coffee line, but I would assume people would take liberties. If you need to kill an hour, head here. Would be five stars, but the coffee is pricey and not very strong. All the baked goods are 3-5 stars depending on your taste.

Desserts here are fantastic. Whether it's the macaroons or the eclair, desserts here hit the spot. With covid going on I also do appreciate that that they had face masks at the door in case someone did not bring one. I also had a coffee from here and that was the only thing that did disappoint me that's why it's only 4 stars. I am definitely coming back here soon.

Fantastic Coffee and Pastries. I had a Latte and a Chicken sandwich with fresh basil, goat cheese, in a toasted baguette. I enjoyed it very much. I was just in the mood for this all day. This is the 2nd location I've been to.
Love this bakery, the pastry's are among the best I have tasted! Yum, yum, yum. The sandwiches are small but tasty, the quiche is also very good!

I have always loved the NoDa Amelie's, so I hate to write a bad review. I drove across town for food. After waiting in line, I got to the register around 9:30. Closing was at 10. The cashier told me "no food because we've already closed the kitchen." My order didn't require any preparation aside from heating it up and putting it in a box. I asked to take it cold, figuring I'd heat it up at home. The cashier refused again. Shutting down the kitchen early is lazy, and I doubt the owner would be thrilled about the lost profits. If you're going to cut corners so that you can leave 10 minutes earlier, at least be willing to work with customers.
Most delicious impeccably presented various types of desserts: pastries, croissants, cakes, and cookies.

The only French cafe I've ever been to in Charlotte is Renaissance Patisserie so I wanted to try a new place out of curiosity. I know Amelie's is very popular here in the Queen City so I decided to go here one night after a romantic dinner date at a very nice Italian restaurant. Upon walking in to Amelie's, I felt like a stepped back in time and was transported to France. Gorgeous decor and I really love the style of the place. It made me feel like I was inside a little dollhouse. The food did not impress me like the decorations did. I got a slice of chocolate peanut butter cake and it was SO DRY I couldn't even finish it. Absolutely disgusting. I took 3 bites and tossed the rest in the trash. I also got 2 macarons and those were alright. It didn't taste as good as macarons I've gotten from other places. I was very disappointed with the food here and I can't believe this place is so popular in Charlotte. I'm gonna stick to Renaissance Patisserie whenever I want to go to a French cafe.

Most think of Amelie's for the bakery but these salads were amazing!!!!!!! It was only $2 more to add on Salmon or Portobello mushrooms. They were very fresh. I got a champagne vinaigrette dressing which was flavorful. We also got to sit outside and eat. I love this place for meetings or just to come work for a couple hours.

I love this place. I have been coming for 8 years now. I wish they still had the sandwiches they use to serve but beggars can't be choosers. One of my favorite places to go and grab a coffee late night

This was a really good bakery! Definitely somewhere you'd want to go with friends, no matter the time of day or night. I came here at 2:30am one night and there were still so many people there. Definitely a safer spot in an otherwise sketchy neighborhood. I personally LOVE LOVE LOVE the pecan tart! It's amazing. I had their iced coffee, too. It was pretty good, nothing to rave about though. The only thing holding me back from giving this place 5 stars is the fact that they don't have as much of an array of treats later at night. Otherwise, a solid spot.

Not sure if I came at a bad time, but has the quality of the food here gone down? My friend got the macaron and it was super hard. So hard it wasn't edible... I got the creme brÃ»lÃ©e and it also wasn't good. The custard to caramelized top was way off. They need to get a more shallow dish so the whole dessert isn't just a cold custard. Probably won't be back unless their quality is good again.

Found Amelie's after googling Desserts. I had two of Their small tarts. We liked it so much we came back the next morning. I had the twice baked chocolate croissant. Service was great and all the pastries tasted fresh.

I really enjoy this restaurant I have been to the one in NoDA and in uptown. Down side a little pricey, upside the food is fantastic! The decor of the restaurant is so fun, and really incorporates the Parisian theme. The restaurant is very clean. If you go in the morning, lunchtime, or dinnertime the line gets really long, but the staff tries to move fast. Luckily it is open 24/7 so you can go whenever! My favorite part is the lavender! Acquired taste for sure, but if you love lavender you must go!! The lavender lemonade is so refreshing and delicious. They also just got macron ice cream sandwiches and they have a lavender lemonade one! So good!!

Stopped by this place solely based on their reviews. The place has a French style to it, but was not very clean. We bought a good variety of sweets to taste. But I have to say I was disappointed. The macaroons were very dry and pretty much tasted plan. I expected better from a place with so many reviews. The fruit tarts were ok but not something I can't pick up at a local place. A good place to stop by once, maybe twice, but had better sweets else where.
Seemed overwhelmed on a weekday mid-morning and forgot an item in my order. Food was otherwise decent. Would possibly try again.

I honestly think this place is a bit overhyped. There was a line of over 20 people at 9pm on a Friday. I tried the macarons, the salted caramel brownie, and a small strawberry topped cake. I was disappointed to find that the food looked better than it actually tasted. The macarons were okay but tasted stale. They probably taste better when they have a fresh batch ready but it appears that they restock items from a freezer or fridge in the back. The salted caramel brownie was really flat and small portioned. It was also rather hard from being refrigerated. I prefer brownies warm and soft. The strawberry cake was decent but also cold and hard.

This was one of the stop for the NC Tour De Food in Charlotte. Such a cute bakery.. it is very French-est. yes, I made that word up! The decor is very interesting which make the bakery a very fun place to be in. The inside is pretty spacious with 2 floor and another floor for private functions. A very lovely spot for a hot sip of your favorite brew and some sweets! As part of the tour, I was able to try the soup (forgive me I don't remember the name!) but it was so good. Very rich and creamy! Also got the try the infamous salted caramel bars. I guess it's famous for a reason!!!! biting into the bar I thought it would be a HARD caramel but it was so soft and so good! I wish I had time to buy some home but I didn't. I would recommend out of towners to visit and try some treats there!

Ooh la la.... I felt like I was in an European cafe. This place is so fancy but inviting. Mona Lisa everywhere and every corner of this place has a cute place to sit and enjoying your time there. Food was delish! Great place for pictures.
Best French pastries outside of Paris itself! Highly recommend the turnovers and croissants. YUM.

My favorite item is not only their coffee but their spinach, asparagus leek soup which is 9 times out of 10 always available on their menu with another signature soup of the day. I tend to pair it with the chicken goat cheese and sun dried tomato sandwich for a 1/2 soup, 1/2 sandwich choice. Everyone is super friendly and nice to be around as I'm stressing getting my work done for school haha
People with Sweet tooth , be careful! ;) My favorites are breakfast sandwich, macaroons, coffee, and their herbal tea. Best part is about sitting there working or reading.

AmÃ©lie's is packed with some tasty treats! Their chicken salad on a croissant is one of my go to lunch options. They expanded their menu quite a bit now offering many seasonal options. I got the blueberry cream cheese muffin and had it warmed. It was perfection. There was an oat-cinnamon-brown sugar-pecan topping that was a wonderful compliment to the warm muffin. AmÃ©lie's is a perfect spot for a quick friend meet up, work planing meeting or part of a date night.

This bakery is so authentic. Straight out of France. I really have not had coffee so good since I was in Europe. I also tried this berry tart and chocolate caramel brownie that was gluten free. Simply amazing. Must go

If you know me, then you know dessert is my favorite part of any meal. Last night my sweet tooth kicked in and my friend brought me to Amelie's. I had ate the almond tea cake last night and it was perfect. It was crispy around the edge, soft in the center and buttery. I saved the key lime tart for today and it was divine. My friend was pleased with the gluten free salted caramel brownie and a dark chocolate raspberry petit-four. I can't wait to go back so I can try the bread pudding.

I have had very mixed experiences with this place but it is the only food french inspired bakery, despite the horrendous decor. 90% of the time I come, the line takes at least 15 minutes, because they only have ONE person on the register who is also packing the pastries. Not only that but if you manage to get to the front of the line and order, your food will take 20 minutes to get (I ordered a sandwich). Twice now, I've had an awful experience with two of the employees, when I was ordering and they gave me attitude. If you don't like working in customer service then find another job?? Idk what to tell you. I only gave it two stars because I like the sandwich I get, but these experience make me think twice of coming here.

My reputation for copious sugar consumption apparently has not preceded me all the way to Amelie's, when advised: "wow, someone's going to be doing extra laps" Thanks for the sugar-shaming but it's been forever since I'd last been here & I'll definitely admit my eyes were bigger than my stomach.....but shouldn't that have made you happy at the big sale, instead of making me feel guilty about purchasing so much? Plus, I'm a now & later kind of girl so this lasted me for days....... But my bigger lesson learned, was that I should reread my own reviews b/c I got sucked into delish-looking treats that actually weren't as delish-tasting as they appeared.....& then I saw I had tried them before & made note to skip. Oh well, lesson reinforced! Here was this visit's damage: Salted Caramel Brownie - the brownie layer continues to remain very thin & grainy from the sugar - it hadn't fully dissolved in the baking process & combined w/ the soft caramel layer, the overall effect was grainy & greasy - will def pass on this next time Peach Tart - looking forward to being peach season, I didn't read my note about there being little peach flavor & the 1st assessment still held true - there was an abundance of lemon & hardly any peach Brownie-Salted Caramel Chocolate Torte - this was a new indulgence for me & it was phenomenal! Take a blondie brownie w/ chocolate chips ( or a toll house bar cookie, if you will ) & put a layer of whipped cream in between, then add a small salted-caramel layer on top & you're talking 1 seriously delish torte Cream Cheese Muffin - the pastry part was nice & flaky & crumbly. More cream cheese would have made this even better Sticky Bun - the caramelized topping had hardened to the point it was like a toffee candy. Would have preferred much more goo! Twice-baked croissants - there was only 1 left by the time I got there & the croissant was not crispy or flaky at all - it had been over-saturated by whatever liquid they soak it in before the 2nd "bake" so it was flavorful but not really almondy or croissant-like So for the off-day pastries ( my unwise choices ) & the snarky comments, this experience was just an A-OK
What an eclectic place with LOTS of options and each one is just as delicious as the next!!! It's kind of dangerous because you can easily let the ordering get away from you!!!

This place is dope not many 24 hour spots Great food deserts and drinks and Thomas is off the chain He made us feel at home and had great recommendations that were all incredible You definitely need to check this place out especially if your a night owl Cheers

What a SWEET place! My friends were raving about it and I have finally decided to try it out. This is the NoDa location!The place has so much character and the baked goods are just phenomenal! Can't wait to go back!
Amazing!!! Yummy. So good. I have a few different treats. I'll use pictures. Treat $2 to 6 dollars each. WORTH IT!!! Seats fill up fast. Grab that first.

In my annual visit to Amelie's, they once again failed on my order. Every.single.time. Kathleen took my order. Waited in a long line, ordered soup, a half ham and gruyere tartin, and a bottle of water to go plus a $2 tip. Got the bottle of water, but the food never came. People before me and after me got their food, drinks and bakery items. 30 minutes later I asked for a refund. Got the refund for the food, but of course she didn't offer to refund the tip. I will continue to avoid this place and encourage my friends to meet me anywhere else (Trade and Lore, Smelly Cat, Burney's, Queens Coffee Bar, Central Coffee, etc).

I ordered a birthday cake from them and it was very bad. It is a very huge thing for me to not like cakes as I can literally like anything that is sweet. Firstly it was such a huge disappointment as none of the guests ate the cake and after some time they didn't even bother trying it also. It was very very dry that once you start cutting the cake it all just fell apart and the frosting was very thick and has no taste whatsoever. NEVER EVER BUY CAKES FROM THIS PLACE.

Cute little 24 hour bakery. There is a large array of pastries and drinks. The location is good but parking can be troublesome (I've warned you). The pastry is rich in quality and extremely filling in my opinion.

Why does Charlotte love AmÃ©lie'? because...obviously.. 1) This one is around the clock 24/7. 2) The roast beef on a croissant is over-the-top. 3) Everyone raves about the salted caramel brownie. My next visit mission to find out why this brownie gained such prominence. Four and Half Yelps.
An outpost for students and eclectics of all ages. Open 24-7-365. Wonderful food and sweets. The staff and decor are amazing. Make sure to grab a couple of the salted caramel squares

Late night bakery stop after comedy show with friends. We decided to try this way instead of late night drinking. Did not disappoint. We carried on our full of laughter conversations while enjoying the various choices of bakeries.

Like a true Charlottean, I am a fan of AmÃ©lie's! This location always seems to be bustling but there are great seating areas for working on a laptop or gathering with friends. I love the salted caramel brownies. You honestly can't go wrong with any of their pastries. I have tried many of them and I have never been disappointed. The coffee is great too. I love the decor and that they are open whenever I am having a late night sweet tooth

I used to love Amelie's, but I feel that the pastries have gotten worse and more expensive. They are so pretty to look at and look delicious, but they virtually have no flavor. I ordered this strawberry cake, which is a perfect individual size. I was super excited to try it. The cream frosting had no flavor. It tasted like whipped, non-flavored air. The sponge cake tasted like spongy, non-flavored air. The strawberry juice soaked into the sponge cake tasted like cold water. The strawberry on top tasted like a strawberry. So I ate a whole cake to taste a strawberry on top. Super disappointed. I will stick to sunflour baking company

There are not enough amazing things I can say about Amelie's. This was my first trip with my daughter, who got to enjoy her first Macaron from Amelie's and her first real hot chocolate. We had a great time picking out our desserts and then sitting around and enjoying the atmosphere. She asked to come back for her birthday. (I am sure we can make that happen)

5 out of 5 stars!!!! amazing bakery with delicious pastries and even better drinks! has space in the back with tables and free wifi for you to sit, sip your latte, and get some work done. if you're in the area or you're just visiting, this place is a one of a kind! definitely stop by and taste some amazing things! next time: i will try the sandwiches or lunch entrees.

Amelie's is a wonderful coffee shop for late-nights or early mornings. The best thing about Amelie's is that it is open 24/7...not many Charlotte establishments can boast that! Amelie's is unapologetically kitschy, with French accoutrement covering the walls, tables and menu. The decor can only be explained as "what an American imagines a Parisian coffeehouse to be," although any French person would die laughing if they came inside. But Amelie's recognizes its frivolity, even relishes in it, with tongue-in-cheek art and silly t-shirts. Amelie's prÃ©tention a la cÃ©lÃ©britÃ© are the incredibly gorgeous pastries prepared daily. Cakes, tarts, honey buns, turnovers, brownies, macarons, eclairs, the list goes on and on. They even offer gluten-free and some dairy-free options, but do not offer any vegan pastries (super depressing to this girl). You can order individual portions or full-size pastries for an event. In addition to pastries Amelie's offers a menu of sandwiches, salads and drinks that updates seasonally. A personal favorite is the mushrooms duexelles tartine, a fabulous garlicky mushroom pate (almost) spread over the most wonderful crispy baguette. Usually served with cheese (for non-vegans) as an open-faced sandwich. Amelie's is a great place to take friends and family when they come visit you in Charlotte. It's cute and fun, with plenty of conversation starters, and open 24/7/365. Bon appÃ©tit!

I love this location. even with all the other locations they have in NC, this one is the farthest for me. But would be willing to drive up here every time no matter what time is the day. The staff are always so welcoming and nice and their French bakeries are always bomb! They also soup and sandwiches, which are my favs. And of course they're open 24/7-365 days!
Love the macaroons so very much. When ever we are in town we pick up a couple of dozen! So glad this place exits lol!

Amelies is like my safe place. I eat amelies like every day of the week. This place is awesome and they have the sweetest workers at the uptown location. Everyone is always so happy and full of compliments.. there's always a worker keeping me updated on all the new goodies and Treats that are in. This place is such a comfy place to go to and just relax. The prices aren't bad either. I always take the cutest pictures in there!
There are sooooo many delicious treats. It's so hard to stop ordering when you go here. From macaroons to tarts and muffins they are all so good. The coffee is yummy too!

OMG! This place is eclectic and the food awesome. The staff are super nice and helpful. It is unfair however the desert counters are first when you are in line and they are so good you HAVE to buy some deserts. Then you get to the 'regular' food section and selection is good and tastes great!

First time I ever stood in line at a bakery at 10pm. But I have to say it was worth it. The peach tart was amazing and so were the Macaroons. The Napoleon was good and the only thing that was lacking was the Croissant. It was not fresh. But I would definitely stand in line again since this is very close to a Patisserie I have come here.

I have so many great things to say about Amelies. It's different than a typical bakery it has more French items . I come here specifically for the salted caramel brownie or the Napoleon. There's a lot of gluten free options.

What a surprising, pseudo-swanky fall-into-the-rabbit-hole coffee and dessert place. Grant L took us for a taste of Charlotte. The coffee was pretty tasty, and I'm not a dessert eater but the Napoleon looked too decadent to pass up. It was huge, probably 5-6" long, flaky fresh and stuffed with delicious pastry cream. I couldn't finish half of it. Heaven! The star of the show is really the whimsical interior, with a mismatched Alice in Wonderland meets the Mad Hatter meets the Queen of Hearts and Mona Lisa at the pseudo-Versailles kind of vibe. It's bigger than it appears from the outside. Really for adults of all ages, but it's quiet, cozy, eclectic... full of collegiate and twenty-something hipsters on their laptops and iPads. I guess I fit right in! ?!? =p

We held a baby shower brunch at Amelie's event space (NoDa location) and were delighted. All the details of planning were made very simple. We were able to arrange for the space and menu online. Guests loved both the setting and the food. Our menu selections lived up to their photos! Our server was excellent. There's ample parking. The room was so well appointed and so interesting that no additional decorating is needed. No crepe paper. No balloons. Nothing to fuss with the day of the event.
