This cupcake also had the glob of dark chocolate frosting in the middle of the cake. So overall they were all good, I rank it Fruit Tart, Red Velvet,and Dark Chocolate. One funny note, my GF and I were thrown off my their plastic "silverware", the plastic forks/spoons/knives are silver and for a second we thought it was the real deal! If you have a sweet tooth, this is a must stop!
They ran out of coffee at 9:00 am with a line of 5 deep waiting for some. That was bad. The fruit tart was pretty good.

WOW! The croissants here were flaky and buttery--something I'd always read about what a good croissant should be, but had never really experienced it until I had one at this bakery. It was so heavenly, and I could've ordered a half dozen or so to have for myself. Luckily, I exercised some self-control. Also had the caramel (ok), orange (yummy), raspberry (yummier) and chocolate (yummiest) macarons here. They were soft, chewy and very tasty. The piece de resistance and the 'signature' Bouchon cookie, I've heard, is their version of the oreo. There's no way an oreo could ever compare to the Bouchon oreo. We should just replace all oreos with Bouchon ones! They were tres magnifique. Highly recommend stopping by this bakery if you're at The Venetian. You won't regret it.

So I came back to Bouchon for the a box of macarons...just to try the different flavors. The coffee was good, as usual, the vanilla bean and lemon were also good. The raspberry was okay. I liked the texture overall and do recommend it. The thing is that I like desserts, but I don't like them overly sweet. I had the red velvet and I know a lot of people like it super sweet, but I liked that it was more chocolate in taste and it had the right moisture. If you're looking for really sweet red velvet, I probably would not recommend this to you. But I felt that Bouchon delivered me what I was looking for. =)
Pastries at this location is just as good as the one in NYC. :)

the most amazing cheese danishes ever! nothing like the store bought cheese danishes i've always thought them to be. these ones are like croissants with whipped cream cheese on top. amazingly delicious! orange juice is freshly squeezed. croissants are flaky. whatever you get, this place does not fail. i always go here every time i'm in town.
My cheese danish was light & fluffy. Friendly service. And a nice patio to enjoy my sweet while I waited for Vegas to wake up!
good food but it's not actually a bakery, more like a small coffee stand. overpriced and hard to find.

Must. Try. Macarons! I wish I got the TK Oreo cookie but didn't. Wah wah... next time. The macarons were great. Vanilla was my favorite. Oh, and FYI, eat them ASAP! They kind of lose their exterior crunchiness within a couple of days. I F'd up and got 2 of the boxes 2 days before I was to arrive home.... yeah, don't do that.

They have a good selection. I love that theire Macarons are bigger than usual and box of 6 for 17.50! The eclairs was also good, but not super amazing. I also got the chocolate tart and the pecan tart... The only thing awesome here is the macarons just grab at least one!
Go. Go early. Go often. Try lots. Start with the carrot cake sandwich. Or a macaroon. Or get a big box of assorted baked perfection. So good. So effing good.

What a great little mid afternoon snack... JMa loved the pear bread pudding... I was very happy with the chocolate macaroon. Priced a bit high, but really, I think that for the quick on the run food for the epicurian, it was amazing.
if it was in chicago I would try everything there. they have sandwiches too. yes. good. uh huh. chocolate and various cakey goodness

I went looking high and low all over Vegas for the best macarons in this town. I have to admit that these were THE BEST of all 4 that I had researched on Yelp. I would suggest just 1 or 2 boxes of these since they're $17.00/ box...yum yum!

I am giving 4 stars for the coffee, otherwise it would only be three. My croissant tasted dry and as if it was made a few days ago. However, I could tell it was yummy. I find it very difficult to find a good cup of coffee out of my house and neighborhood, since we are spoiled in the Bay Area. Sure enough, they actually use a Bay Area roaster (Equator) and it was great and quite the relief!

I ordered a chocolate bouchon, one epi baguette with butter, the ham and cheese sandwich and a chocolate croissant for my friend. Everything was delicious. They did not seem to have the cashew butter/jelly sandwich that is on the website's menu. Williams-Sonoma sells the bouchon mix, I am considering trying it out to see if it is as good as the real thing.
Ok sweets but the employees enjoy their cellphones mote than those jobs and it is painfully obvious.

came here on a cool friday morning and was greeted by the sweetest barista, bought a croissant and boy was it good, I even came back the following day to try out their almond croissants...cant complain, one of mt favorite spot to eat at in vegas

The eggnog latte, croissant, and chocolate macaroon were to die for. It was also located right across from the Phantom of the Opera Theater wich was really neat. Can't say a single bad thing about this place. Great for a little pick-me-up snack or breakfast.
Macarons are fan-freaking-tastic! Wish I'd gotten the pain au chocolat fresh, but it was delish nonetheless. I don't know if it was because I ate it the next day, but the PB&J brioche was a tad dry.

mmmmm.. macarons..i had 2 of each to bring back home to share with the wifey. when i told her i was going to vegas she asked to bring something back from bouchon. im glad she did. she loved the pistacio. my fave was the coffee flavored one. theyre also quite larger than others i've tried... i also had to try the oreos and too bad i only got 2.
I tried every single french macaroon place in Vegas and this is the best. However, I've had better in other cities. The macaroons are bigger than most, but they are pretty pricey.

It was a little bit confusing to find (it's not in the main shopping part of the Venetian but closer to the hotel but a very nice security guard walked us straight there) but I'm glad we did! Chocolate covered pistachio macarons WHAT WHAT? I ate half of it when I got it and then the other half much later that night drunk while laying on my side (AKA "Hasselhoffing it"- it was delicious both ways.) I also have a weakness for fancy bakery versions of Oreos and the TKO (Thomas Keller Oreo) delivered! Super dark barely sweet chocolate cookie with delicious ganache inside, mmmm. I also got a cheese danish to eat later and it was delicious even though it was all crushed in my bag for a couple days. I ended up eating it at the airport waiting for my delayed flight and I was so tired and miserable I ate that thing like a beast with no napkin and no shame, the guy next to me had to be disgusted. It wasn't your regular danish (which is flat) but tall like a roll FULL OF DELICIOUS CHEESE with a little bit of lemon flavor and delicious flaky crustiness. My friend loaded up on strawberry croissants to eat and take home to her husband so if you don't hate strawberry (like me!) then those are apparently a must try item as well.

It was just okay. I had been to the Bouchon Bakery in NYC which was great, so I had high expectations. The pastries weren't memorable and there wasn't really a place to sit except for around the corner in the food court. I would go back to Jean Philipe at the Bellagio over this Bouchon Bakery.

HORRIBLE customer service ever. My husband and I were in Vegas for vacation this summer (June 2013) and our first morning we went for coffee at Bouchon. We were surprised when we saw the coffee mug given to us. One of the coffee cup had disturbing Racist comments written over it. We were shocked but did not wanted to argue with the servers. We went directly to the hotel concierge and the manager was called. They were shocked to read it too. The hotel security was called and a complaint was filed against the bakery staff. We were told that the matter would be investigated and someone from the bakery will contact us within 24 hours. We were there for 4 days and never ever heard back anything. Our whole vacation was spoiled because of this disturbing experience. After about 3 weeks when I called the bakery manager she admitted that she was aware of the situation and started making stories that it was the customer's fault. When I told her that I was the customer, she completely flipped and said ,"oh let me investigate and call you back." Since then I have never ever heard anything from them. The WORST customer service I have ever seen in my life !!!!!
Chocolate Almond Croissant - 5* Carrot Cake Cookie - 4* Chocolate Eclair - 3.5* Sticky Bun - 4.5*

It was a little hard to find the place, but any dessert lover should definitely check out this place. We ordered the raspberry macaron, an apple croissant, and a plain croissant. The plain croissant wasn't very flaky, and didn't taste very good. The apple croissant, on the other hand, was delicious. Crunchy butter sugar topping on a sweet layer of thinly sliced apples and a yummy croissant. It was delicious! The macarons were huge! They were about two or three inches in diameter which is huge for a normal macaron. The ratio of filling to shell was perfect, not too much, not too little. I thought the raspberry macaron had a very pleasant flavor. It wasn't extremely strong, but it was definitely present. Overall it was a pretty good snack, but I would skip the plain croissant.

I had high expectations for this little bakery stand because it has Bouchon attached to it and I've heard great things about the restaurant. However, I was a little disappointed with my visit here. I decided on the red velvet cupcake and a caramel macchiato. For $3.50, the cupcake was a good deal for it was the size of a muffin! Most cupcakes I've had are for the same price but pretty dinky in size. The frosting wasn't overly sweet and the red velvet was nice and moist. It was a tad bit doughy though, but nonetheless pretty good. The coffee however, is where things start going downhill. Maybe I came on a bad day or maybe it was a new worker, but I've had caramel macchiato before at various coffee places and never had I had one like this. For $5 I got their smallest size and when I picked up my cup, I was surprised at how light my cup was compared to the other girls that ordered other Lattes and such. I opened my cup and found it to be filled halfway with foam, barely any coffee so I asked the barista if it was the correct order. He just kept saying that that's how it's suppose to be. It didn't seem right, but in any case, I didn't make a scene about it. $5 for half a cup of bitter coffee and foam is not well worth it! They also have a few other things there like sandwiches and such, but all were a bit pricey. Expected I suppose since it is Vegas.

I have been to Bouchon in NYC, Beverly Hills, and now Las Vegas in the Venetian. I love the Bouchon macarons. When I was at the Vegas Venetian, the sales clerk told me that if I bought 5 large macarons, I would receive a set of (5?) mini macarons. Great, I thought...I was going to get some for family so I bought 15 large ones, expecting 3 sets of mini-macs. When I got back to my hotel room in another hotel down the strip, I realized the sales clerk gave me NO mini-macarons...NONE. I was going to catch a plane in about 1.5 hours, and to walk back there might have been pretty tight. I called over and left a voicemail. I expected them to at least call me back, but I never heard a word. Boy, was I sorely disappointed at the customer service. I love Bouchon NYC, and like LA very much. I was a big fan of Bouchon. But after this experience, I am pretty "meh" now on the brand...no matter how much I liked their macarons. Sigh. Really disappointed.

Overpriced pastries and lack of choice. I have paid $4 for cappuccino which was exactly 3 sips. Double chocolate chip cookie tasted fine but for the price i would bake it myself. Do not recommend this place.
Really good honey bran muffins. My husband got one first and then I went back to get my own. A little expensive for just a muffin but at least it was tasty!
This place was delicious! Went here twice during my stay in Vegas. The cheese danishes are what brought me back. Definitely worth checking out!

Very surprised. All this bakery has going for itself is its brand name. The coffee was burned, croissants too dry, macarons were old. Bakeries should have freshly baked goods in the mornings. This one doesn't. Tomato soup was great though.
Love the carrot cake cookie n oatmeal cookie. Croissants are above avg but nit the best. Slight edge to cest si bon in nb

I went over to the bakery around 8 pm on Christmas Eve and was disapponted since the bakery was closed!! But, the ladies were really courteous when I asked them about the box of macarons. They told me to come here tomorrow early because all 5 boxes were sold out quick today! When I got to Bouchon Bakery the next day, the already sold out 2!! The price was 17.50, and the macarons are huge! They're scrumptious, but just be careful since they're really delicate and start to crack away at the slightest warm temperature! Chocolate and raspberry was awesome! I also got the RED VELVET CUPCAKE! The frosting had just the right sweetness and the cake had just the right moisture! I regret not buying one or two more deserts to bring home.

i don't know where they make all the pastries, but i know they don't have a oven anywhere near the store. that explains the tko being slightly dry. even though the bakery at yountville bakes everything in store, you can't beat listening to slot machines and smelling cigarettes while munching on some pretty tasty pastries.

Make sure you go to Bouchon Bakery during the week. The food seems to be made fresh daily during the week, but the weekend seems to be leftovers from Friday's batch. We went on a Friday AM and a Saturday AM and the quality was vastly different. The beignet on Thursday was the best I had ever had and the cheese danish was fantastic. On Friday, the danish and the brioche were both very subpar.

bought some macaroons to bring home. they are bigger than your average macaroon and cost more too! $3.25 per macaroon. they just have basic flavors. chcoclate, earl grey, vanilla, coffee, raspberry, snd caramel. I was not amazed.i did not buy cookies, but ifnyou do, get a huge cup because the cookie is the size of your face.
yummy macaroons! not the best, but they are pretty good. if you get the box of 6, you get a bit of discount. also, these macaroons are huge!

Given their reputation I had to try it. Actually I tried it 2 years ago and I wasn't really impressed. So I had to try it again, cause my wife liked it. We got a wide selection of items: chocolate almond croissant, pain au raisin, strawberry croissant, chocolate croissant, beignet, pecan roll, and a few others that I can't remember. The only things that I really liked were the strawberry croissant that had a streusel on top and the beignet. I thought everything else tasted a little dry. BTW the latte was really good. Overall the prices weren't bad considering you're inside a casino in Vegas and everything is more expensive. I thought the majority of the pastries were better than average but not as good as any basic pastry shop in a Paris train stop. I don't think I would go out of my way to stop there, but would stop if it was on my way. Frankly the croissant shop around the corner from my house makes a lighter, fluffier and tastier croissant, but their coffee sucks. After reading some if the other posts, I wish I would have gotten a macaroon but I couldn't justify paying $3.50 for one. There's an italian bakery in San Francisco's little italy that makes these and sells them for less than a $1 a piece and they're perfect. Although they're a little smaller.
Pricey but delicious. Cheese danish was light & flaky. Friendly service. Hit the spot while I waited for Vegas to wake up!
yeah, i am a girl, and these macarons are still as good as i remembered. just this location. i didn't like the LA one.

Bouchon creates the best macarons I've tried to date, and by FAR the best on the strip. And I've tried macarons from Sweet Factory and Payard and they simply do not compare. They're huge -- like the size of 3 regular macarons (and priced to match!) but the flavor and texture are on point. I generally am not a fan of fruit flavored macarons but I love the raspberry flavors here; those, along with pistachio and vanilla are my go-to's. Their vanilla eclairs are yummy too. I recommend snagging tickets to Phantom and then munching on a couple of these afterwards!

Mmm.. I was kind of expecting a bit more for a place so popular for their macarons.. Yes the macarons are super big but also too chewy and too sweet for my taste. They also carry pretty limited flavors, only about 6 different ones. i had better so it's hard to love Bouchon Bakery.. but I suppose the macarons are still enjoyable, just don't have too high expectations.
My all time favorite ice cream place!! I love it here!!! The Cookie Monster with the donut is my all time fave!!!
Great customer service and the ice cream is the best ! We will come back next visit fir sure
Impromptu dessert stop to end date night, and oh so yummy! To full from dinner to get the doughnut, so we must come back soon, like maybe tomorrow!

I personally got vanilla icecream with oreo crumbles and it was very basic, they didn't even mix it in. They just sprinkled it on top. The rest of my family got the more unique/speciality options and they loved it. My mom got the cookie one that turns your tongue blue and she loved it.
Good And it the best I've cream in the world and you have to try the ice cream it is very good and tasty

Ordered through the outdoor window and ate outside. The donut sandwich was incredible and the staff was nice, helpful, and quick! Would recommend for a quick stop, the place has parking and a fun outdoor seating area, but no misters or cover so during summer you can't stay long.
Delicious flavors!! Best service ever! Def worth the wait! Uhhmm why are you still looking at the reviews????? JUST GO!! (try the leslie knope)
Was in the area and kids wanted some late night treats. Location was kind of hidden with hard to find parking. Ice cream was very good and friendly staffs. Will come back again.
One of my favorite snacks! You'll love it too!! The warm bun with the cold ice cream is just heaven.

Me and the hubs were driving through back to Texas and while I was Yelp surfing I found Novel. It's located in a small food park area. You can turn in and park in front ir park on the street. There's outdoor seating if you'd like it have it there or take it to go. When we first walked up we thought they were closed. The inside is closed, and we stood at the window for a few minutes and no one came - we almost walked away (sitting in AZ summer heat isn't my jam). However, the nicest woman was working the window when she came. They have a set menu but also some rotating specials. The people working explained the history of the business, owner, and flavors which was super nice. I chose a single scoop of the award winning Madagascar vanilla, the hubs went for the dough melt. The vanilla I had was very basic basic. Award worthy? No. I liked that it wasn't overly sweet, but I would give it maybe one step over your grocery store brands. The wafer cookie that it came with was probably the best part. The dough melt was just too much for me, a doughnut cut in half with ice cream I took a small piece and it didn't really taste like anything. If you live in AZ I'd say give it a shot. If you're from out of town, you didn't really miss anything.
By far the best ice cream EVER. Staff is always friendly. Definitely worth a drive. I highly recommend to everyone.
Good ice cream, nice people, cute place. I like The environment. Sometimes it's hard to find parking though.

I have been meaning to try this place for so long and we finally went a couple of weeks ago. I was not in the least bit disappointed! I got the cookie monster ice cream sandwiched between 2 donut halves and it was perfection. Our server was super nice and helpful. She even dressed up my toddler's simple order of chocolate ice cream with sprinkles. I am thinking about returning here again as I am typing this review. The location is super cute as well. It is housed right next to a tattoo parlor, hair salon, coffee shop, and restaurant.

THE BEST!! I love the flavors and the cute aspect of this place. You just have to try it for yourself - so unique and delicious, how does this sound....LAVENDER HONEY ice cream topped with Cinnamon Toast Crunch cereal -- you will be at a loss for words, orgasmic. The sweet person at the register named a character on the wall after me, it's probably common but it made me feel special. LOVE-LOVE this place.

NOVEL PRIZE Ain't it hipster these days to make a chic food business in a worn down building or in a disparaged part of town? Well I guess by that criteria this place is hipster. But hipster these days to me translates to delicious. Just off the side of Grand Avenue, you enter a wonderland where the streets are rough but ice cream exists. DOUGH MELT- donut ice cream sandwich is not a NOVEL concept, but doing it right is where the art is. Bourbon Caramel Toffee crunch in a Glazed donut with cinnamon toast crunch you would think would be too sweet and give you one of those sugar toothaches. But the ice cream is very creamy without being too sweet which levels out the other components. Called the Dough Melt because it is pressed like a panini, so it is warm on the outside and cool on the inside. The donut was soft and not thick or bready. This ice cream shop is not too far from the art district and other restaurants so it is worth the hop and skip over for an intimate hangout.
Novel Ice Cream is amazing! They had many options, and the ice cream was unique and flavorful. You can tell that there is effort put in to making their ice cream.

I was going to give three stars, because I don't really get the hype tbh. But after comparing prices with cold stone, I decided Novel should get a cool 4 stars. I got the ice cream (bourbon toffee iirc) in a donut. It was good. But I think any store bought ice cream inside of any store bought glazed donut would taste exactly the same. Yummy, sweet, ice cream and donut. Nothing special or unique flavor or texture wise. The donut gets a little soggy. I think they may have heated the donut but I couldn't tell for sure. It was lukewarm. (Not sure how it is supposed to be.. not a criticism just an observation.) I'd get it again if in the area and having a craving for ice cream,

I don't know if I could ever rationalize going to a chain ice cream shop again, knowing this option is available. My experience with their staff has been positive- always great service. Not only do they beat out other ice cream in flavor and texture, they're also so reasonably priced! I love their honey lavender flavor. It reminds me of Salt & Straw on the west coast, but with less stress on my going-out budget.
Delicious flavors, wide variety, excellent customer service. Always busy but definitely worth the wait! Would definitely get the Dough Melt if it's your first time trying it out.

Delicious! Must visit! Ice cream is fresh and full of flavor. Donuts are soft and compliment the ice cream very well. We really enjoyed this place. Definitely give it a try! Wonderful location in the art district.

Been going here for a couple years and the customer service & quality of the ice cream is amazing. Prices are affordable! Happy to see them expand to Mesa. Will always continue to support Novel! I don't think they will compromise quality while growing their business. -Sarah & Christian (the ones with the big Great Dane)

First time here and we were undecided on what to order. Brandon was amazing and super helpful. We ended up getting two dough melts (duh) one with Bourbon caramel toffee crunch with Cinnamon Toast Crunch and a Madagascar vanilla with fruity pebbles. Both were amazing. I prefer simple so I loved the vanilla. The donuts were so soft and light.. I'm going to dream about this place. Can't wait to come back! Side note: parking is minimal, plan to park on the street. Also more tables would be nice!
Overall rating: 4/5 Wait: 4/5 Arrival time: Friday 6pm Food: 4.5/5 Order: 3 scoops (Hawaiian, Orange, Grapefruit), Earl grey donut melt Service: 5/5 Price: 4/5 Would I go again: Yes

I absolutely love coming to Novel whenever I am in the Tempe area. It's a must. I am in love with their lavender honey ice cream and before I left back home to Boston I bought a pint because it was that good. If you're like me and you like sweet stuff but also something that i refreshing then I would recommend this. One of the many things that I love about Novel is that they are always changing the flavors and being innovative. They currently have this Madagascar vanilla ice cream that is so delicious!! I love all of their staple flavors there and donuts. Everything there is handmade and artisan. Which is what I love, it's nothing artificial, it's all real flavoring and made with real ingredients. The staff there are incredibly nice and welcoming. It's always a joy to see them and they make it all worth the trip coming down there!

Amazing spot, great prices, it's super lowkey tucked in the back of a brew house, a hidden gem that you must try for a late night munchie hit, after a date or just a nice day time vibe. Service is top notch and quick! Little walk up window where you order and pick up with little benches outside to munch out on. May be a line but don't be discouraged it goes quickly. Oh and flavors for the ice cream are ridiculously delicious. They have a doughnut (fresh) that they stuff with ice cream of your choice with toppings.

Omgggg! The best donut, ice cream and service! We came on a Saturday night around 9:30 and just missed the line because there was no line! The owner was so nice and welcoming. He described every flavor to us and how it's made and allowed us to try any and all flavors we wanted. The flavors were sooooo good but I opted for Madagascar vanilla with the doughnut sandwich and no topping. The donut was amazing!! Soooo good and light in your mouth. You get to choose one topping with your ice cream. My boyfriend got the butter pecan in a cup with Cinnamon Toast Crunch as his topping. The butter pecan ice cream was amazingggg! The manager/owner was so nice and we will definitely be back!!
This was a perfect dessert after a big dinner. The homemade ice cream was fantastic and the doughnut was not too sweet so it was great. It is not a glazed doughnut like I was expecting.

This is pretty much the best place for hand made ice cream. If you are going there one should definitely try their dough melt. It is the best concept ever. They will put a scoop of your choice of flavor between a hot bun. The combination is OMG! This is a must try if you are in the city.
This place is GREAT! What's better than ice cream in a warm donut? Nothing! The ice cream here is so bomb! Donuts are fresh!

You cannot come to Phoenix and not stop here. My friends and I stopped in on the way to Sedona from the airport (and plan to stop on the way back to the airport). The owner is super friendly. I hear you can request flavors (mental note for next time). The dough melt is on a soft warm glaze donut. I got the butter pecan which was amazing. Not everyone can do butter pecan but I recommend theirs. We have been here 2x and tried multiple flavors, I have never had anything I didnt like.

Ice-cream is an obvious necessity when you live in a place that is super hot. Novel Ice Cream is known to anyone in Phoenix as the place to go to when you want good-quality, delicious, and unique flavors. They also have a good seating area, and a bright colorful wall to take photos against.

I found this place recommended to me through a Facebook group, and I'm so happy I went!! The shop itself is small, and the seating area around it is more of a shared seating area between the other restaurants/snack places there. The line stretched out pretty far when I went there, so I was super excited. The cashier person taking the orders at the window was so friendly, he gave a spiel for everyone who said they were new to the place. I ordered the honey lavender flavour, and it was really good! I would recommend this place to others, especially when they're in the area.

This little place is in the heart of downtown phx right off grand. The ice cream is all homemade and the waffles and donuts are so fresh almost feels like your eating a cloud. Incredible this is definitely my favorite place in town to get a craving. Parking is slim but there is always parking on the street.
Great little ice cream place! Be sure to try the Dough Melt, a mouthwatering doughnut stuffed with ice cream.

The ice cream is more a 4/5 for me, but service was so great that I have to give this place a 5/5. I dropped by Novel Ice Cream on a Saturday night and was met with a line out the door! But hey, it moved pretty quickly so I can't really complain. My friends and I ended up going all in and got the famous ice cream donuts across the board. I got the cookie monster ice cream with sprinkles and was not disappointed. It had a classic cookies and cream flavor and a great texture overall - aka no icicles or crunchy bits. I also loved that they didn't skimp on toppings; I definitely had a ton of sprinkles on my ice cream~ Service is extremely friendly as is the owner of the store. Parking can be hard within their own lot, but you should be able to find street parking nearby pretty easily! The biggest downside for me here was the lack of indoor seating or even some sort of fan outside. It was a summer day in PHX so it was in the 90s even at 8/9 pm and it was completely unrelenting. Other than that, this place was a winner and I will definitely go back to grab some ice cream!
Best ice cream / donut sÃ¡ndwich ever! Everyone from out of town I take here and always a favorite for everyone. A must try in Phoenix!

This is one of those cool late night spots to come and enjoy some ice cream. I love how the menu has a fair amount of choices to choose from. They also offer interesting seasonal flavors such as the "birthday cake" or "Arnold Palmer sorbet." I highly recommend getting the dough melt and then picking any flavor of ice cream that you're into. I went with the donut ice cream sandwich with Cookie Monster ice cream and lucky charm marshmallow topping... it tasted great! Even the donut itself was warm and soft. Parking sucks but plenty of space to grab a seat and chill with friends.

It was good but quite frankly, too expensive. I think every ice cream and gelato shop is overpriced anymore. I'm tired of paying the price of a gallon of ice cream for a scoop or two. Doesn't make sense in this economic disaster we are just touching the tip of. Did it because my GD was with me.

Don't come here unless you want to make it a regular stop. The staff is friendly and attentive. They also explained the menu as well as how the ice cream is made. I tasted a few flavors and ended up getting Horchata as well as the "Fat Elvis" flavor , which was peanut butter, banana, and bacon which I loved. They are dog friendly and even have ice cream for them!

Novel Ice Cream has one of the best ice cream makers in the country. The result is ice cream which is creamy, and full of flavor - a decadent treat. Give into your cravings and go to Novel. I had been looking for my favorite flavor - Rum Raisin; when Brandon learned of my search, he asked his ice cream maker to create it. The result? Best Rum Raisin ice cream Ever! It is full of rum, they even soaked the raisins in it, it is very flavorful - perfect for the holidays. I bought two half gallons. All of their flavors are made with premium ingredients by one of the best! Novel will be opening another store in Mesa (on Main Street) later this winter...get ready Mesa! to enjoy Novel's excellent ice cream.

The owner, Brandon, invited me back for a second visit, after I left a review not being a fan of the Fat Elvis flavor. He explained that it is a very polarizing flavor, love or hate. He also said that customers can ask to try every and any flavor! Feel free to ask for a sample of every flavor, no judgement! He wants his establishment to be different than some other ice cream shops that act like it's a burden to sample more than 1 flavor. Their menu has some flavors that stay every day, and some that rotate, so each time you go there will be different flavors to try. Today I tried 6 flavors: Straight Up Strawberry: the best plain strawberry ice cream I've ever had. I'm not usually a fruity ice cream type of person, but I wanted to venture out. Worth it! Very fresh Lemon Blueberry Sorbet: not a big sorbet fan, but this was amazing. Very tangy and sweet at the same time. Tasted like a frozen lemonade. Very soft, the spoon goes right through it. Bourbon Caramel Toffee Crunch: this is a great choice is you want something with texture. The bourbon and caramel makes a great sweet but interesting flavor. This one is worth a sample at least, some may not like the bourbon but I do! Honey Lavender: one of my top 2! I just love honey lavender, and it's a hard flavor to get right. This one tasted very natural. Floral and sweet perfection. Sweet Cream and Honey: very subtle sweetness. This one would probably be loved by EVERYONE! Thai Tea: one of my top 2! Thai tea ice cream is rare to find and I've only seen it a few times. This one was so amazing. They source real authentic tea leaves and use it in their ice cream, you can see the leaves in the ice cream. No artificial flavors here. This one is definitely a love it or hate it flavor, but it's my favorite! It tastes just like a Thai tea drink, but in solid form. Brandon is a great business owner and really cares about the experience. He uses REAL INGREDIENTS and many are sourced locally. If you ever have a bad experience here feel free to reach out to him, he will make it right! Im now a huge fan of this establishment. The customer service from every employee I met was amazing. The ice cream is award winning, their ice cream chef competes in ice cream convention competitions! No wonder this place is 5/5.

Whether you live in Phoenix or just visiting like us we highly recommend stopping by Novel Ice Cream! This cute little red cottage on Grand Avenue has figured out the way to our hearts - through delicious artisanal ice cream and super friendly service! I had an ice cream stuffed donut and it was incredible. They formulate their donuts to deliberately not detract from the ice cream in any way and it works perfectly. It is a tender, yummy donut, and then it's crammed full of such delicious ice cream! I chose the Honey Lavender, a personal weakness of mine that I like to try wherever I see it. Novel's version is amazing. It has just the right amount of lavender (there is a fine line) and honey. Thom got the butter pecan and loved it. I really love the texture of their ice cream. This is going to be a must stop for us every time we are in town now!!!
Holy shit first time here got the hot doughnut studded with the caramel toffee bourbon ice cream!! Hurry!!
Best ice cream and donuts EVER. Went here for some ice cream during our trip and ended up coming back 3 times!! Never had ice cream like this before!

I've had Novel ice cream in my bookmarks for a long long time. I took my kids here tonight bc we had to wait for my moms flight to come in. So the owners are so so nice and friendly not going to lie I was a little intimidated walking in it's so tiny and in a little hole in the wall. So the owner you could tell loves his ice cream shop and so do I. They insist on you sampling some flavors which we kinda did. So fresh so creamy so delish!! My son did the Waffle sandwich and I did the donut sandwich. You should just go in ready to have some yummy ice cream. I'll make the trip from Glendale any day to get some ice cream sandwiches

Absolutely can't go wrong looking at the reviews I kinda thought it was over hyped like most places with a lot of good reviews but this place actually has above and beyond ice cream and sweets highly recommended if you need to get your sweet fix

Novel Ice Cream is so good! We stopped by as this place was highly recommended. The guy at the window was very friendly, and informative about the menu and the flavors/toppings that they offered. He also spoke very highly of the flavors that were award winning. The ice cream is top quality for sure. I ordered two scoops of the Madagascar Vanilla w/Oreos on top. Novel is definitely worth trying!
National recognized place to visit in Phoenix AZ. This is my second time here and I cannot get enough of this place.... A must try spot if you love great food.

Wow! Novel Ice Cream sure is a novelty. Their flavors are new, original, and magically unusual. Between the unexpected mix of a hot donut and ice cream to the flavor profiles ranging from an amaretto with animal cookies in a cone to a perfectly not too sweet honey lavender scoop it's pretty amazing. Love that their menu rotates and the possibility of trying even more flavors on my next visit.

I recently tried novel for the first time at a different location and was blown away by their ice cream donut. This location is great and as expected did not disappoint. I tried the fat Elvis and the coconut cold brew both of which were delicious. When it comes to novel ice cream they just do it right.

We were downtown today and had pizza at Pizzeria Bianco for #MickeyFriendsgiving. Looked up ice cream and couldn't ignore the reviews on this place. Definitely an accurate account! Great service explaining the options and going over the choices with our kids. Socially distant markers were in use and great safe experience. Ice cream was amazing. Finding a place that al five of us are satisfied is tough to do these days but this one crushes it. We opted for the chocolate, strawberry, doughnut sandwich and cherry cobbler. All amazing and would recommend it to anyone. Worth traveling into the city for!

The best ice cream place I have ever been to! I can't believe I haven't reviewed this place till now, but trust me I have been coming here every chance I get. This is a small store but with some award winning flavors. Brandon is extremely nice and makes his customers feel super welcome. He takes his time to explain all the flavors while being patient as everyone gets to try the flavors. The ice cream itself is so creamy and on the thicker side, so it just feels and tastes so much better than any other "slow-churned" ice cream at the store. They have rotational flavors as well, but their award winning vanilla and butter pecan are some of the best of those flavors I have ever had, ever. Everything about these flavors taste authentic and real, and there is no other way to describe the flavors other than to try them yourselves. I will keep coming here whenever I am in the area and this place is there. I have yet to find a place that is as welcoming and amazing as this place, and I really think this shop brought back the ice cream loving child in me.

This place is amazing! Flavors are on point, employees are super friendly, and prices are very reasonable. I had to combat the 110 heat somehow, and this did the trick. I'll definitely be returning, though maybe at a cooler time of year so my ice cream doesn't melt so quickly.

I don't know where to start. The vibe here is amazing!! I love this little strip of businesses. The tap house looks awesome. Everyone is enjoying their time drinking and sitting around! Beautiful views! We order 3 doughnuts melts 1 with chocolate ice cream and Cookie Crisp 1. Cookie Monster with fruity pebbles, 1 with caramel with Cookie Crisp and a scoop of vanilla ice cream with sprinkles and fruity pebbles. They are all soon good!! I love that the donuts were warm and didn't get hard. We have gone other places that once the ice cream touches it. It's hard as a rock well not here. Ice cream is handmade there and so delicious!! Customer service was amazing! She told us all about the award winning ice cream maker! She greeted us with kindness! Absolutely worth the drive!!
Amazing ice cream selection. Amazing staff and atmosphere. Would highly recommend this little ice cream shop. Date night maybe if the kids come with or not.

Interesting place. First of al they'd get 5stars for staff and food quality BUT their parking situation sucks! They have 5 parking spots, or the street, well we went around 7pm and the closest open spot we found was about 10 miles away...ok about 6 blocks away. Not very convenient to walk in a questionable dark neighborhood with little kids. Ice cream was very good, interesting concept on having the ice cream in a hot donut. I had the banana bread pudding in a cup and it was delicious. My daughter tried the honey lavender, she liked it I didn't, but I don't like lavender anything, except for lavender soap . The donut itself was very good, perfect texture and sweetness. I'd definitely go here again but maybe in the day light.

This is such a long, overdue review that I keep remembering I need to write because the customer service was THAT stellar! I've been twice and both times two different people who were working were incredibly patient, joyful and explained the ice cream with such a passion you don't normally encounter at a dessert shop! The lines get pretty long (worth it) and they still take the time time to not rush you and make sure you order exactly what you want. The ice cream is AMAZING! The donut sandwich has all the right textures and taste especially when you add a cereal mix! Lovely concept and energy at this place!

I was in a nostalgic mood today, I visited mine and my brother's old spots. I highly recommend the Fat Elvis and Bourbon Caramel icecream. INCREDIBLE!!! Definitely want to bring the old friends back and share the experience with new ones.

!!!BEST RATED ICE CREAM 4 A REASON!!! When I first came here I was too quick to judge the only two flavors I ordered. It didn't dawn on me that there were so many more flavors behind the scenes that could potentially change my life. I want to personally thank Brandon for being such an amazing owner and personally taking the time to help me find the right ice cream flavor for my weekend cravings. You can taste the effort and love he puts into putting out the best possible ice cream. He provides quality, amazing customer service with his team and excels at giving everyone the chance to find their perfect flavor for a stress free and delightful experience. There's something for everyone; don't be afraid to also reach them on social media, I know they would be more than happy to help you find the perfect treat for you! I am obsessed with their famous bourbon caramel toffee flavor, their strawberry lemonade and berry lemonade flavor!!! Here's some impressions on the flavors I tried: Strawberry- creamy; fresh; you can taste and feel the real strawberry. Never frozen always made with fresh ingredients. Berry lemonade - acidic but not overwhelming: tangy and gives you that wide awake feeling. Both flavors really shine together and taste harmonious. Pineapple- frothy, great strong pineapple flavor ; very smooth on the pallet. Very quenching and Refreshing. Has a satisfying creamy after taste that feels sooo good on the pallet. Bourbon Carmel Toffee: - you get that crunchy bite from the toffee, the caramel really comes through and you can feel the two different textures one from the creamy burbon and the gooey goodness from the caramel. The toffee adds that little hint of salt that makes this such a guilty pleasure.! Orange Cream "Orange Julius"- Reminiscent to the orange creamsicles I had during my childhood. This one is unique in that it's both cream and sorbet like. With the orange zest and zing dancing on your tongue you can't go wrong with this one. If you love oranges this one is for you. Strawberry Lemonade - so tangy and tropical tasting. It taste like being on an island with a bowl of fresh fruit on the beach. The acidity is perfect and you can see the pieces of real fruit. So so good! This is my new favorite spot for ice cream and I can't think of a reason to not come back!

What happens when you combine a warm, melt-in-your-mouth donut with creamy, mouth-watering ice cream? It's perfection. Found this little gem on our vacation to Phoenix, and I don't think we will ever stop talking about this place. Do yourself a favor and make a stop here. (Pro tip- don't eat dinner beforehand so you can eat more ice cream.)

THE BEST ICE CREAM OF MY LIFE Yes, you read that right. This ice cream is the creme de la creme of ice creams. They make every flavor by hand and you can tell the creator is passionate about making ice cream because you can taste all the love they put into it. I tried multiple flavors but the Honey Lavender stole my heart. It was perfectly balanced and not overly sweet. I would go back everyday to try all the flavors if I could! Absolutely worth the wait.

Came here one night with a friend and I was so impressed!! Brandon was so kind and asked all about ya and where we are from since we just moved here. He let us sample flavors and they all were delicious. He really took his time and we felt like valued customers. Very good with covid protocol. 6ft apart all had masks on and sanitized the desk area. Would def come back for the donut melt!!

Soooo many amazing things to say about Novel. I've gone here too many times to count. The quality of ice cream to the staff is a 10/10! Also I'm guilty of leaving the house at 11 at night to grab some ice cream before they close. If you live in the valley and you haven't tried Novel, I'm going to assume you do not live here! but all jokes aside...10/10. Check them out!

The donut ice cream sandwiches here are beyond amazing. They have such unique flavors that are always rotating and the staff here go above and beyond for everyone and really treat you like they've known you forever. I will keep coming back.

First time here!! When we arrived the line was really long and it was a bit hot outside even at 11pm. I think its really awesome that they are open late which allows for perfect date night desert run! When we finally got to order, it was heavenly sweet surprise! I will definitely be back!

Ok this is krispy creme doughnut meets baskin robins. LoL. But i cant describe how awesome this tastes is with homemade ice cream sitting in the middle of a warm doughnut! Whats weird is i never remember the ice cream melting! I would suggest the bourbon. Im a vanilla and strawberry fan but I promise if you get the bourbon you wont be disappointed. Hell order two. LoL
O-M-G!!! Amazing. The bourbon toffee ice cream was the favorite, but also had the banana pudding and the lavender. All REALLY good! Was worth the 30 minute wait!

This was super cute spot!! It's in little tiny shed looking houses and it has other cute places. Anyways upon entering the little area where the venue is, there was a small farmers market and music. From there you walk in to this tiny place and they walk you through the flavors and what to do and samples. They have several flavors and toppings. Vegan choices too!! I had the raspberry sorbet and it was pretty incredible. Got my ice cream right away and on the Side of the little house there was a seating area. Overall it was cute, outside of the walls it's a little weird. I got a little weird ambience. However the place is super adorable and I do recommend it.
The ice cream tasted fresh and homemade. It was delicious and I'll definitely be back.
This is the best ice cream I have had. They have really unique flavors that are tasteful. You can't beat the price for the quality you get. The outdoor patio is very nice place to hangout.

Home made ice cream, best in the valley! I've been here so many time it's not even funny. They have a variety of in house ice creams. My favorite is the Cookie Monster with Oreo on the dough melt. Small place and limited parking within the lot. More then like you will need to park near by in the street. Good vibes and a great place for you family and friends to get the best ice cream. In the day time the line isn't to bad, but can vary during the weekend and night time.

Wow what a super cute business property of 5-6 colorful "little homes" selling different stuff but sharing a nice shady space to chill. This place has legit ice cream and I'm sure if the owners are ambitious it can be in more places in AZ. Had the cookie monster to share with kiddo and hubby chose some alcoholic one (boubon? It was delicious). The cookie monster ice cream is really blue so beware you'll really look goth after eating it. But so worth it.

BEST ICE CREAM IN PHOENIX I literally take everyone here it's the best Ice cream I've ever had and their dough melts are perfection! Everything is quality fresh and well thought out! Absolutely love, always go here, and hope they're around forever! GO HERE

Wow! This place was so good. My wife and I went there for some dessert at the end of a date night and we shared a dough melt. Such good flavor and loved that the ice cream stayed frozen even with the warm and toasty doughnut. The owner, Brandon, was so friendly and hospitable to us and everyone in the store even though it was quite busy. He took his time with each person to make sure we all got what we wanted. Thank you so much for a great experience!

This review is going to seem trite considering the unbelievable number of five-star reviews they already get, but believe me when I say that Novel Ice Cream deserves every one of those stars for both their wonderful ice cream and their friendly, speedy service. I had picked up a friend who dropped her car off at a nearby mechanic, but rather than seek out dinner she wanted something sweet. A search of nearby offerings popped up Novel Ice Cream. The reviews compelled us and the photos convinced us that we needed to make it our dinner -- a perk of being a so-called "adult". Owner Brandon Douglas served us from their walk-up window (we are in the pandemic period where the sit-down inside area is closed) and offered us samples of anything and everything while telling us about the shop's history. When we finally made the excruciating choice of all the flavors not to get until next time, my friend got a triple-scoop bowl with Lemon Bar Cheesecake, pastel pink Taro Root, and their signature blue Cookie Monster. I ordered their signature Dough Melt and had them fill the glazed doughnut buns with Lemon Bar Cheesecake ice cream, a flavor of the moment. It was one of the most delicious and refreshing summertime snacks I've ever had, and the quality of the ice cream was surprisingly evident in both its denseness and in how slowly it melted in the 95ºF heat. I didn't rush eating, yet there was almost no melted ice cream in my wrapping by the end. My friend's triplet of scoops was the same. Heavy and rich, all the flavors were fantastic. We decided we must become regulars to patronize Brandon's wonderful little scoop of heaven whenever we are in central Phoenix. If your sweet tooth is yelping, you will not regret eating here!

My favorite ice cream in phx! The dough melt is amazing and fresh and the ice cream is perfectly crafted. Never once have I received bad service and I have been to the downtown location as well as their Mesa location. The community in downtown Mesa is so excited to have them in the area!

Another 5 star review for world class service and world renowned ice cream. It is SO. GOOD. and with a donut? Ugh amazing. I wish I took a picture first to post on here but I'm sad to admit the second it goes in my hand it's gone so quick. This place is a GEM.

So stinking good. I was on the search to find some lavender ice cream in Phoenix and I hit the jackpot with this place! It took a minute to find, but I love everything about the location. I had no idea those little cabin shops were there and I'm so glad I found them! I ordered the honey lavender ice cream in a waffle cone and it was amazing! So creamy and not too overpowering. It's such a unique flavor, I love it! I also had a sample of the cookie monster and they weren't kidding when they said it would turn your tongue blue, watch out! The employees are so friendly and let my family try literally every flavor. It was such a great experience overall and I can't wait to go back!
I love the Knope! Iykyk. Cute area ! Great service always. You can hang out in the patio where there's more shops to browse.
Amazing ice cream and friendly service! The ice cream is delicious and made with fine ingredients which is evident when you bite into the waffle cone!

My daughter and I came here after having dinner at the new downtown Ingos , the ice cream is off the charts! Suck a cool place too. The people are so nice and explain everything! I had an Irish car bomb car cream and my daughter had the Cookie Monster. Highly recommend

Now as a vegan, I wanted to write a new review to reflect my thoughts on Novel Ice Cream. I visited with some friends on Friday night. The space is really small and there were two people behind the counter serving samples, scooping scoops, and checking us out. With about 6-7 people ahead of us, It took about 15 minutes before we got to the ordering counter. We taste tested the two vegan flavors that they offered in the current moment - lychee and some sort of berry sorbet. The berry sorbet was VERY sweet, but the lychee was perfect! I shared a double scoop with my partner and added a single vegan topping. While the berry was overly sweet, the lychee was able to tone it down a bit. I believe they also offer a vegan sprinkle cookie and certain cereals as toppings! Maybe they'll make vegan doughnuts or offer more vegan flavors one day?? Know that there was plenty of street parking when we arrived. There was a scatter of people before our arrival. When we got our ice cream, there was a long line of about 15 people down the ramp! Timing is everything I suppose. Love the vegan offerings and will be back/recommend because of this!
First time going there and the small batch ice cream is delicious, and customer service is very helpful with explaining toppings. Parking is a little tight but other than that we will be back.

Here's all you need to know: they have an ice cream sandwich made with a glazed donut. I've been here a couple times, and there's always a line out the door. This is a local, individual-owned ice cream shop serving more than just ice cream -- they've become a staple in an area where a lot of small shops are being pushed out due to a rapidly gentrifying area. Come out to support them, and at the very least you'll leave with a belly full of happiness.
Haven't been back in a while but loved my visit. The friendly staff let me and my buddies sing as a barbershop quartet while they prepared our treats!

Amazing Ice cream! I tried the dough melt which was overwhelming and I couldn't finish the entire doughnut. The Cookie Monster ice cream flavor was delicious! It goes well with captain crunch topping. The cookie monster ice cream does turn you mouth blue however. I don't think I will try the dough melt next time just because how heavy it turned out to be. But ice cream was great! Service was good too. The catchier explained everything about the menu and ice cream pretty well and answered all our questions. It was quick too!

Great ice cream at a cute shop! This ice cream store is located in a small wooden house as a part of a group of other small houses surrounding a small patio-like area. The area has an overall kitschy vibe to it, as the decorations on the patio are eclectic and each house is painted a different color. You order your ice cream at a windowfront with the menu posted next to the window. The workers are very sweet, friendly, and ready to explain the menu for any first-timers. My personal favorite here is the honey lavender, as I'm a sucker for floral flavors and it's sweet and light! You can order a pint to take home for the classic flavors, which is perfect when you don't want to make the drive over to just get ice cream. Your order also comes with a mini stroopwafel, which is a nice addition of texture and sweetness to the ice cream. As a heads up, parking can be kind of difficult, as there's only residential and some sparse meter parking. I once came here in the nighttime and there happened to be a car show going on, and it was near impossible to find any parking! Nevertheless, if I ever get the chance, I always stop by to have their ice cream!

I really loved this little ice cream spot. Tucked away in a cool art area of Phoenix. Great artisan ice cream made in small batches. They are open late which is really nice when you get a late night craving for high quality ice cream. I had the fat elvis flavor with the dounghnut. The combination was outrageously delicious. I would definitely go back. The list of flavors had at least six I wanted to try. Highly recommended!!!!

Another Yelp discovery, have literally never seen a place with five stars on over 900 reviews. I was curious about the place and wanted to try out what the hype was all about. The shop is located in a very cute area, there are other stores as well novel ice cream is a nice pink color small shop in the group. You were greeted by a very friendly staff, given that this was our first time at the ice cream place explained the different options and also the dough Melt. Based on the information provided the place has one a number of awards for their ice creams as well as donut ice cream. Fun I wanted to try the dough Melt and went with a recommendation on ice cream, it lived up to the hype was delicious and was gone in less than 90 seconds. Really enjoyed the warm exterior of the donut with the cold ice cream and the crisps in the middle giving it a burst of flavors and textures in every bite. Overall really unique experience and we absolutely enjoyed it. Highly recommend it to anyone looking for an ice cream place in downtown Phoenix to try it out.

The parking for this place is sparse, but this was absolutely worth the wait. Got a dough melt with madagascar vanilla + cinnamon toast crunch add. Doughnut was fresh and warm and acted as a great vessel for the artisanal ice cream. I would absolutely go here again.
Had the dough melt with Cookie Monster, sooooo good. The doughnut was not too think it's sweet and really balanced the creamy ice cream out. First time here and I loved it!!

We met Brandon running the register and he was so nice! We mentioned it was our first time here and he introduced us to how their menu works including their rotating menu. The vibe here on Grand is beautiful and such a nice place to spend the night. Definitely will make it back here!
Ice-cream in a doughnut!!! Need I say more. We love waking down Grand Ave, stopping at Novel. Their food ice cream flavors are perfect, something for everyone!

Dear Phoenix, you did NOT disappoint with this spot!!! I was in town on vacation and ran across this jewel! At 115 degree weather, yea... THIS HIT THE SPOT! Hands down the BEST ice cream I've had! Totally worth the drive!

This has been a family favorite for at least 5 years! Hands down delicious, we drive out of our way for this spot with no complaints from the back seat lol I get the Cookie Monster dough melt, the kids and hubby always try something new. There's always a line but I don't think we've waited more than 20 minutes in line, rain or heat! There's no indoor seating but great patio space shared among the other businesses.

Even though the line was kind of long, the line was moving fast! The dough melt was great! The doughnut part seemed fresh since it was warm to the touch. The honest lavender was perfect! It wasn't too sweet and the lavender taste was not too strong. The strawberry guava sorbet was also refreshing! Would definitely come back again!

I find it hard to give out 5-star ratings since I believe these should be reserved for the BEST food of the category with the BEST service. This place earned it, though. This was a wonderful experience. Here's my breakdown: Ice cream: Having participated in a food development competition in my undergrad involving ice cream, I can say that this ice cream is deluxe. The flavors are so amazingly balanced. For example, their honey-lavender ice cream manages to have that delicate honey flavor come through and not overpower it with lavender, which could easily make the ice cream taste like soap if overdone. They nailed the flavor though. Their vanilla is also fantastic, which is essential since it is the base for most of the other flavors. I love how they blended multiple kinds of vanilla in order to make a truly special vanilla-flavor. Donut: Their donuts are specifically formulated by them in order to complement--not detract--from their ice cream. I really don't like donuts in general either, but these are an exception. They were fried amazingly well so that they don't have any oily flavor. There isn't really any glaze in this case, either, so that they don't over-sweeten your palate. Well done on these. Service: The employees were enthusiastic about their craft, which I loved. They were sincere and attentive without being overly friendly. I really appreciated their patience with my indecisiveness as well, and they actually offered a really good recommendation for a cereal mix-in that I ended up loving. They basically said it's a good idea to put cereal with the ice cream instead of mixing in caramel because the crunch adds nice contrast to the soft ice cream and donut. I wholeheartedly agree. I highly recommend Novel Ice Cream. Remember, it's just ice cream, so it probably won't change your life or anything. Maybe. But it's dang good ice cream!

Please visit this place! It's nestled in a corner off a busy street, so it's kind of easy to miss. Not only was the service amazing, the ice cream was too. We were actually the first customers of the day a couple days ago, as we got there exactly at noon when they opened. We saw two more people throughout the time it took for us to decide what we were getting, place our order, receive our order, and get back in the car to cool down, which was really only about 5-6 minutes. Seemed like a pretty popular spot. The cashier who helped us was extremely helpful, patient, and friendly. She let me try two flavors I was in between: the taro and honey lavender. Both of those flavors were delicious and fresh, but I couldn't pass up the Taro! My bf got the Elvis (peanut butter, banana, and bacon. Are you kidding?) flavor. They have what's called a Dough Melt which is a lightly glazed donut stuffed with an ice cream flavor and includes one topping of your choice like Fruity Pebbles, Reese's puffs, Cocoa Pebbles, Cinnamon Toast Crunch, sprinkles, etc. If you've ever been to Afters Ice Cream, it's similar to their "Milky Bun", but the Dough Melt from Novel was much better and fresher tasting. The price for two dough melts was $11.95, so a little less than $6 per dough melt, which is pretty reasonable for gourmet-tasting ice cream. I was glad they weren't overpriced like some of the other ice cream spots around. The lady preparing our Dough Melts was also really nice and patient. Another thing I noticed was how they were properly using gloves when handling food, and they both properly wore their masks. During these times, those things matter, and it just added to the overall great experience. We'll definitely be back when we're in Phoenix again!

One of my favorite ice cream experiences of all time! After a night out with friends, my hubby, daughter and I decided to visit Novel Ice Cream. The shop is so tiny that you can only fit 4-5 folks in there at a time, so everyone else awkwardly waits outside. It was well worth the wait as their honey lavender ice cream was the most amazing I've ever had! My hubby decided to get their signature donut + ice cream combo, but it was too much for my tastebuds. My daughter got one of their signature flavors with an assortment of cereal toppings and didn't speak the entire way home because she was so happy with her dessert. The folks at Novel Ice Cream are so unbelievably nice and you'll feel like an old friend is serving up ice cream they made just for you!

Absolutely loved this place. Drove 20 minutes to get here after hearing about the donut creation. It was perfect. I worked at a fancy artisan ice-cream shop for over 2 years and this had them beat by far. Our new favorite place

After multiple visits, my girlfriend and I have become big fans of Novel. They offer several flavors of ice cream, keeping the selections small, creative, and not to the point where it will overwhelm newcomers. You're free to sample whatever you like, although it's hard to make recommendations due to the ever-changing menu. Yes, the dough melt is what everyone talks about. Eat it while it's warm to appreciate the hot-cold contrast. It's good, but not something I would get regularly due to the heaviness of it all. Also, as another reviewer pointed out, their ice cream is good enough to where it actually stands on its own without the need to sandwich it between a doughnut or waffle. Nevertheless, their love of cereal and soda mirrors my own and serves as a nice reminder that there are still people like myself who keep their childhood obsessions intact well into adulthood. I suggest keeping a close eye on their social media accounts. Aside from a few staple flavors, most of their flavors come and go very quickly, so if your favorite ends up being something that's being showcased short-term, there's no guarantee that it will always be there. The owners are very nice people that are very enthusiastic about what they're doing. I feel their success is very well deserved and I anticipate that their following will continue to grow over time. Highly recommended!

my Most favorite ice cream shop EVER!! I exclusively come here for Ice Cream. The best ice Cream, the best service (literally every single person in the shop is a freaking rockstar), and all around just the best little place to go to.
Super friendly! Great service! Fantastic flavor options and toppings. Reasonably priced! If there's a line dont worry it moves quick! Worth the drive! Try the dough melt super bomb!!!!
Will definitely come back again the dough melts are amazing!! Was able to get details on each ice cream flavor and there was plenty of toppings to pick from
Great place to get a tasty treat! Lots of yummy flavors to choose from. But the donut sandwich was the way to go.
Best thing I've ever eaten! The fruity pebbles with lemon cheesecake ice cream on a donut was an other worldly experience must try!!!

My oh my this place has my heart! Between their homemade ice cream options and their donuts, this place has everything dessert lovers crave. They only offer a few ice cream options and they do the flavors so well they don't need to add any more! We got the sangria sorbet with raspberry drizzle, the honey lavender ice cream, and the Cookie Monster dough melt and all were loved and devoured in less than 5 minutes. The dough melt was the perfect blend of warm and cold and the cookie crumbles on top of the vibrant blue ice cream made it fun to look at as well as eat. Get yourself one and you won't be sorry!

While breaking curfew a sweet treat is definitely needed. My friend and I had a sweet tooth and were looking for a place to satisfy our cravings. I decided on getting a strawberry dough melt with fruity pebbles and raspberry syrup. It was by far the best! Ice cream ever and the atmosphere is amazing. Will definitely come back again with friends and family.

Guys, there aren't many places on Yelp that have a full 5 stars. When you find a place that does, you know you gotta try it out. I have pretty high standards for ice cream, so I had to put Novel to the test. When we walked in, the owner/server was just so friendly and excited for us to sample the flavors. You know a place is gonna be good when the workers show passion in what they're selling you. I honestly liked every single flavor I tried but had to settle on the vanilla and butter pecan. I know what you're thinking - vanilla? But this vanilla was unlike most. It was so creamy and rich, and has apparently won national competitions. Their other flavors are also great, including the cookies and cream and honey lavender. I'm gonna need to come back many times to have them all. Trust the reviews - go to Novel! You won't regret it.
First time trying Novel today and HOLY MOLY. We're obsessed. We will be back! Excellent service, excellent area, excellent price for the quality.

Had the sweetest experience at Novel! Was visiting Phoenix for the weekend and we had to try this place out. The ice cream flavors are unique and they allow you to sample once you get up to the window. I got a scoop of the carrot cake flavor in the donut, topped with Cinnamon Toast Crunch cereal. A little bit of a messy treat but the flavors were amazing. The best part was the service -- we had admittedly arrived quite late and close to their closing time, and the line continued long past our party as well. Even after closing, we were served with a smile and with the utmost patience. The girl at the window was so helpful and made conversation with each customer, and overall it was such a pleasant experience. If I'm ever back in Phoenix, I will be back!!

The best vanilla icecream ever!!! The donuts are sooo delicious I always get one on the side haha. Great selection of flavors my only complaint is that they don't offer nuts. Pecans/ walnuts etc.. that's okay though just an FYI super cute place be prepared to wait in line but it's definitely worth the wait each and every time

835 reviews and a 5 star rating speaks for itself. Try Novel out and you'll see why! Tucked away in a Phoenix neighborhood, as mentioned, parking CAN be difficult/limited. The Thursday night we went we had no problem. They are currently doing ordering at the little window; you cannot go inside. They are still doing samples which is a great way to try all the yummy and unique flavors! I believe the flavors rotate daily (don't quote me on that). Besides classic scoops, you can have a doughnut melt or the Leslie Knope which is iced cream sandwiched in a waffle! *mind blown* You can also order a float! The butter pecan is HEAVENLY and rich. The bourbon caramel toffee crunch really does taste of bourbon but not overpoweringly so. The fat Elvis (peanut butter ice cream, honey, and bacon) really tastes like peanut butter if that's your thing! (But it's not mine). Really you can't go wrong with Novel.

Amazing little gem, doughnuts stuffed with locally made (in house) ice cream. You really can't go wrong but they excel. Tried both the lavender honey I've cream and the cantaloupe sorbet, both winners. Support local! And check out wayword Taphouse in the same complex or a grab a new plant at Pueblo nursery across the street.
Totally great. A fun place to stop after a concert or event downtown.

Omg so yummy!!! We came out here on a Saturday night to try their famous dough melt. Of course, after seeing the Yelp pics, we had to try to cookie monster ice cream. It was so creamy and delicious! My husband and I split a dough melt with the cookie monster ice cream with waffle cone pieces (you get to choose a topping on the ice cream in the dough melt too!). We could've probably gotten our own because they tasted so good, but we definitely would've been overly full because they are quite big! I like the set-up of the outdoor seating area because they have plenty of room, and I think we may have snagged a seat if it weren't so hot out ;) we opted to eat in the car only for that reason! My husband is not one to go out of the way to get food/dessert, but he said "this was definitely worth the 30 minute drive," so we will for sure be back!

We wanted some ice cream for a quick stop and found this place on yelp. The girl at the window was fabulous and told us about their artisan ice cream and then told us about the dough melts. Yassss honey, sold! Must stop!!

Finally made my way to Novel Ice Cream after my co-worker's recommendation. I'm so glad I did! I got one of the most popular flavors, the Cookie Monster. At first I was hesitant since it seems like it would be too much but it all worked. Maybe just don't get it too often? Lol. The ice cream itself was delicious! Very creamy. The ambience was great too. Little houses and different colors. Cute! I will be back to try more flavors for sure!

Unforgettably delicious! The pictures do not do the Dough Melts justice - they are even better than pictured. It's a warm donut filled with your choice of ice cream and topping. It's a combination of warm and cold temperatures. Soft and crunchy textures. Not to mention, the customer service is amazing!!
BEST ICECREAM EVER!!! Last time I was there the owner told me Novels vanilla ice cream won a national aware... and ya know what... I believe it! My go to is the Cookie Monster ice cream. :)

The best crafted ice cream in arizona! They have the most delicious donuts as well! I come here everytime I'm waiting for my pizza being made right across the street. This place makes me eat dessert before my meal. I think this is the only respectful way to eat at this fine establishment.

Very delicious but the area needs misters, or at least some fans during the summer. It was unbearable trying to enjoy it so we rushed eating the donut ice cream, the bourbon ice cream was great and girl at register was extra nice! We won't be back until it cools down.

Just go get some ice cream at Novel. trust me. so good! i had the mango sorbet and the peach ice cream, both Cider Corps collaborations. Cider Corps also is wonderful and local in Mesa but Wandering Tortoise and Sprouts carries some of their cider too. But back to Novel - just go. Oh, and Grand Avenue Pizza right across the street is amazing too. so get some pizza and then go across the street to Novel for desert. Go now, what are you waiting for?!?!

My Order: Cookie Monster. I haven't had much ice cream in Phoenix yet but it was a fantastic flavor. Will be visiting again to try out the leslie knope. Price: Appropriate for what we got. Service: Excellent, polite and quick. Seating/Social Distancing: No tables in the patio section in front of the serving window. Employees wearing masks. Doing the best they can. Parking: Free. Not crowded when I went. Street parking or small lot.

This is it, man. There is no better ice cream. PERIOD. Staff are incredibly kind, patient and genuine. Unique flavors, toppings and classic drinks. I fundamentally do not understand how they can warm a donut and not melt the ice cream but also not have the ice cream so cold it hurts your teeth to bite?!?! A modern marvel.

Novel is our favorite ice cream place. The prices and ice cream are great, and the staff is friendly and polite. The toffee caramel bourbon crunch is amazing; we love it so much I buy a couple pints of it every so often just to make ice cream cake.

Novel is still the best in our state! Open responsibly, keeping each other and our community safe and full of the most delicious ice cream, donuts, glass bottle sodas and more! The only thing that matches their stellar product is their team~

How does one describe the best? There are no words. You just have to try it for yourself - and trust me when I say if you get the dough melt (basically a donut ice cream sandwich OMGGGGG) with LAVENDER HONEY ice cream topped with Cinnamon Toast Crunch cereal -- you will be at a loss for words, as well. Which is probably for the best because your mouth will be full of rainbows and sunsets and fireworks exploding over a still lake. So....GO NOW! (Oh, and the nice person at the register named a character on the wall after me. Probably does it for everyone, but still. Great and fun customer service :) Fan for life.

Definitely check this ice cream shop out. Homemade ice cream, how can you say no?! It was a treat to meet and speak to the owner Brandon. He allowed my date and I to sample some of their unique ice cream flavors and I ended up choosing Tres Leches which had a rich and creamy taste. The ice cream shop is right in the Grand Ave area, nearby a brewing company. This place would be perfect to stop in if you are taking a stroll outside . Excited to be back to try all the other flavors.

My best friend and I came here for a treat after dinner and we got just that. She had been here before and was raving about it and I could see why. When we walked in there was a a small one and when we made it to the line. One of the owners was serving and you could tell he was not only well versed but passionate about his business. They have great treats like ice cream in a donut. I opted to getting my treat in a cup. It was great! I ended up getting the mimosa servers which was amazing. I want it now but unfortunately I don't live in Phoenix but anytime I'm in town.... I'm making a stop here! There is outdoor seating but not indoor seating. This is a great business and a great place for a date or catching up and hangout with a friend or loved one.

Amazing ice cream wonderful customer service!! Love this place the atmosphere is really neat too, right in the art district on grand. Wayward is adjoined to the whole complex and we absolutely love them both!

Cute little spot with a great atmosphere. I got the Cookie Monster dough melt. The ice cream was amazing and the donut was amazing. But they're amazing separate if that makes sense. Together in a sandwich just didn't taste right. So I recommend just getting one or the other. Very good ice cream flavors. Check this place out!

Novel Ice Cream Small ice cream shop off of Grand Ave and 11th Ave, when I mean small, it is small, no seating and about 6 to 10 people may be able to stand in there if they all inhale at the same time. Very friendly workers willing to let you sample as many flavors as possible, they tell you about the flavors and how everything is homemade. I had the Blackberry Merlot Sorbet, so refreshing especially on a day that it was 109 degrees and the AC blower inside was not helping a whole lot. Fun place, especially if you are in the area. Would go back to try other flavors, I did sample about 3 different flavors and could have done more.

Named one of the best spots for ice-cream and I can see why! Their ice-cream is homemade and the flavors unlike any other spot. They've perfected the donuts they use for their donuts sandwhich it's not too sweet not too un-sweet. I love the lavender honey ice-cream and the taro! Super yummy and the patio is so cute! Perfect for a day out with fam or partner. Lovely people nice and friendly and I guarantee you'll come back after the first time!

Came here while in town to see my son. He and his girlfriend have been wanting to try it. The people are super friendly and helpful. I wanted the doughnut-had to try that while there. I got the lavender honey ice cream. Delish! Wasn't sure about topping so decided to have them surprise me. They did fruity pebbles. Right answer!!!! This was so delicious. I'm sad and glad at the same time that I live in California, or this place would be a normal place for me! We will definitely go back when we are there in September.
