If your in town and deciding if it's worth it or not. Let me tell you ITs WORTH IT! Run don't walk. Don't let the long line scare you. They are very efficient and fast.

This ice cream is delicious! It's super creamy & the flavors are something special. Today I had a donut melt (donut ice cream sandwich) with half & half, honey lavender & London fog latte. Honey lavender tasted like a sweet cream honey with a hint of lavender. London fog latte tasted like earl Grey tea with cream & sugar. Stuffed inside a large glazed & hole-less donut, this was an incredible treat! Price: $5.50

Went there on a very hot afternoon. The staff was super friendly and helpful with their menu! The parking area is very small so be aware of that. It is fixed up in this small, little building next to other small containment ship stores. I got the dough melt to share with my bf and it is a warm doughnut and you choose your choice of ice cream and topping in it! The Cookie Monster was suppppper delicious. So delicious that I couldn't stop thinking about it the next day and unfortunately I am from out of town so that sucked. But it was worth trying and I would love to try their other flavors!!! Very unique and fun ice cream ideas. The only con is that it was so freaking hot outside I wish they had misters around the area at least

Holy crap people. This is good ice cream. And while it LOOKS like a social media gimmick, the donut ice cream sandwich is super legit and delicious. (For those wondering, just the OUTSIDE of the donut is pressed and warm so no, it's not a drippy mess - that is key). Topping it off with the exceptionally nice humans working there means this is the place to be... honestly, don't miss it. Spend some time in the cool little hangout courtyard and make a friend or two over bomb ice cream.

Such a great little ice cream shop in the downtown area off Grand. We waited about 30 minutes in line, but it was definitely worth it. We tried the two alcohol sorbet flavors (grapefruit mezcal & pear sangria) and they were really good. We were too full from dinner to try the donut, but definitely next rime. The guy at the window was so incredibly nice and patient! He is exactly who should be at the front of the shop! Loved the whole experience, but will try the ice cream and the donut next time!
Excellent food excellent staff got the lemon basil sorbet and was blown away by how lemony and delicious they were able to get it I'd rate this the best ice cream I've ever had.

very very very Yom! I love this place and have always stopped by when in Phoenix. I got a banana and bacon ice cream in between a glazed donut--dangerous. It's a must for me and it should be for you too!

I had a split scoop: Fat Elvis (peanut butter with sweet banana and bacon), Arnold Palmer Sorbet. I enjoyed the Sorbet the best. Wife and Daughter got the Dough Melt with berries and cream and had it cut in half.

I want to call this a resolution review- but for me I wasn't even looking for one or expecting to make one. I had shared previously my experience on my last visit, and was quick to see the owner Brandon messaging me regarding my review. Like less than 24 hours fast. I have met Brandon a handful of times in the store, and it was so refreshing to see a message coming directly from him. He was passionate, determined to resolve what my visit lacked, and super helpful to my friend and I. I've told him, and I will continue to preach, how amazing I think novel is. The customer service shows throughout, and they take full accountability. Novel is theeeeee ice cream spot to visit in downtown Phoenix, and while I am moving out of the city - I cannot wait to come back on my next visit.

Outstanding all the way around! Fat Elvis was super tasty PB, banana with bacon pieces. Tastes incredible! Great customer service from Brandon- he must be the owner. Definitely a must visit for Phoenix

Novel Ice Cream is, in a single word, delicious. Read on to hear see the rest of the story, but the short version is this: this is incredible ice cream; personally served by a gracious and knowledgeable owner. Each flavor is unique and everything tasted delicious. I would go all in and get the ice cream served on the donut for a truly spectacular experience. Arizona during the summer gets hot and nothing beats a cool scoop of ice cream. As such, I am always on the hunt for new and interesting places to get a frozen scoop of deliciousness. A quick Google of best ice cream shops in Arizona revealed to my friend and I that Novel was not just one of the best ice creams in Arizona, but very likely, the best ice cream in the U.S. We had to try it. When we arrived Saturday evening there was already the start of a line. Given all the accolades this physically small (maybe a few hundred square feet) ice cream shop was getting a line was expected. However, do not despair, the line moves quickly, the people are friendly, and the entire time anticipation builds for what was going to be a delicious scoop (or two). When it was our turn in line, we found the owner personally scooping ice cream for customers. He greeted each one of us, was incredibly gracious, and was extremely knowledgeable about this product. "Our bacon comes from here...this is a 16% butterfat mixture...our donuts are created specifically for us to create these sandwiches." He encouraged us to try different flavor options. Even though there was a line out the door, the owner took time to make conversation and introduced himself personally (as did my friends and I). I chose the Burbon coffee toffee and the bright blue cookie monster. Once we received our dessert my friends and I went outside and started tasting. It was more delicious then we could have imagined. Incredible flavor and texture the perfect treat for a hot summers evening. I will be back!
Home grown Ice !! Have to swing here... Trending and always new trys! Swing by this place after a slice of pizza across the street from Grads Pizza

Yum yum yum !! Thats all i can say! Its amazing atmosphere the owner is so sweet him and his daughter we are there 2x outta the week! Keep it us! Yall are a true gem in downtown phx ! Cant wait going again tonight to take all our family from outta town!

Imma subpoena the yelp powers that be and have them add another star to this wonderful ice cream shop. Thanks to my son for finding it on his prom night. We stopped in after running some errands down town for a nice treat. Little did I know I was about to embark on an ice cream dream. This little shop is kind of tucked away amongst other shops like a hair salon, tattoo parlor, and a restaurant. See pic. After drooling over the ice cream selection, getting odd looks from the nice lady behind the counter, I settled on a bourbon salted toffee and butter pecan waffle cone. Hello!!!! You had me at bourbon!! WOW!!! The flavors were spot on and had a nice balance of sweet creaminess and texture. The Mrs. had a single scoop in a bowl of the Bourbon salted toffee, it she was very impressed. My son had a double scoop bowl of fresh strawberry and Madagascar vanilla bean. Oh my goodness. The lady behind the counter said the strawberry was made from fresh berries, not the standard frozen variety. And the vanilla was actually imported from Madagascar, you got to move it move it! Yeah, that place. They had flavors like chai tea, honey lavender, and taro, amongst others. They give samples and I urge you to take them up on it. You can thank me later.
This place is adorable and has excelled customer service and their ice cream is fantastic. I will definitely be back to try more flavors, but the chocolate was excellent!!
The ice cream is very good and the cashier was extremely friendly - asking us where we were from and telling us about their ice cream. The serving size was modest but the taste was great!

Came here just for the Dough Melt (donut ice cream sandwich). Got it with Bourbon salted carmel toffee ice cream and free topping of jimmies. Lived up to expectations. This place reminds me of Afters ice cream in Cali but with a hipster vibe attached to a cyclist bar. Definently coming back next time I'm in Phoenix. Might want to try the waffle sandwich ice cream.

The donut tastes SO GOOD and its soft and warm. The I dream omg it tastes like heaven. Come here every weekend. The place is so cool as well very nice to come with your friends to hang out and have a delicious dough melt.
I love the variety of unique flavors that change at every visit. There's sweet flavors and not so sweet for the perfect sweet tooth!
Loved it! Took my bf for his first time and he enjoyed it very much! Cookie Monster will definitely be my GO to!
The ice cream looked great but smelled like the toilet! When I ate the ice cream, it slightly tasted like it too. The ice cream was okay.

Absolutely. Incredible. My friend and I were greeted very kindly and warmly by the owners and they gave us a brief history of the ice cream. They were so generous in letting us try as many flavors as we wanted. Their ice cream has won big awards nationwide -- when you taste it you'll see why. Every single flavor is quality. Creamy, flavorable, and what I love most is that it's not too sweet. I got the donut melt and I was surprised that I was able to finish it without needing water or milk! I've tried other donut ice cream sandwiches and normally it's so sweet that I have to throw away pretty much the last bit of it. Their flavors are so pleasant. Their donuts and ice cream go together so well that I could eat ten of them and still want more. I am so happy I found this place.
OMG! Run! Don't walk. Can't decide? Order the indecision. You cannot go wrong with the award winning flavors.

Nestled in the next part of the area to be gentrified is a nice little enclave that stands out as a haven of artisan excellence. The menu is somewhat limited but it changes enough to make every new visit an adventure. Unless you already have a favorite that you don't want to leave. It's tough to top the Lavender Honey donut mixed with a handful of Captain Crunch.
This is the best ice cream in Phoenix hands down great staff, great everything. If you are in the area it is a must stop if you aren't, don't be lazy just go get it.

They have the best sorbet! I ordered a berry one that was on the menu but they also had a honeydew one today. I know the menu changes daily so I'll have to check back often to see what new options they have that are non dairy. My friend ordered baileys style Irish car bomb and she said it tasted just like baileys!! We got a single scoop each which was a good serving size after just eating lunch at a nearby restaurant! Absolutely check this place out!!

One of the best ice cream spots in the valley and possibly the state of Arizona. I had the honey lavender ice cream and my husband had the chocolate and the acai sorbet. Each cup comes with a complimentary little waffle sugar cookie, too. I can't explain it - their ice cream is just fresh and creamy and perfect. The guy running the cashier is friendly and welcoming to each and every customer, even though their lines are quite long! He could rush through each transaction, but he doesn't. And that's not to say you'll be waiting long. Just go to Novel when you want ice cream or dessert, and do not hesitate!

Great ice cream shop (shack??) that serves unique flavors that rotate on a frequent basis. There was a medium sized line around 9pm on a Friday, and it took about 20 minutes to get to the front and order. I hope they start posting more menus before people get to the front, so they can decide on their order beforehand instead of having to read the menu and decide at the same time. The only menu that I saw available were the tiny ones right next to the order window. They had 10 different ice cream flavors available, with some non-dairy options. I ended up trying their Cookie Monster & Honey Black Sesame (Single/$3.50)- THANK YOU for allowing split scoops!! Not many places do, and they often charge extra, so this was awesome. Their cookie monster was solid, but the blue color was super distracting, and definitely makes your entire mouth turn blue. I really liked their honey black sesame, which had a mild honey flavor but a lot of black sesame. The mini stroopwafel was a nice touch. The owner, Andrew, was super friendly and helpful, and really added to the overall experience. According to him, their ice cream maker is one of the most highly regarded in this area, and I hope to come back and try more of their ice cream flavors. Parking will be the toughest part about coming here- there are some street parking spots but they are limited throughout this area. Shared outdoor patio seating is available.

Super delicious and creative! This used to be my favorite place to go when we would lowride on Saturday nights until the popos shut fun down. And for what you ask? We were just families low riding with our friends, supporting local businesses. No drama just a love for old cars and old music. Really no reason to go to grand now sadly. Everyone is in Glendale and it's not the same I'll tell you that right now

You can hear the buzz and feel the energy around Novel Ice Cream all the way down Grand Avenue. Went to Novel Ice Cream last Friday night. Grand Ave was pretty dead but the Novel Ice Cream area was live. There was a line of about 20, and maybe 30/40 people eating their ice cream outside. The hype is real. The flavors are so unique and so dang good. The owner was so kind and appreciative. Gotta support local, and it doesn't get more local than Novel Ice Cream. This was an ez 5 star review.

WOW, we googled ice cream and Novel Ice cream came up. It had the best reviews so we decided to go out of our way to get some ice cream from Novel. It was so worth it! I have a double scoop - chocolate and vanilla. They were both delicious! My husband had a scoop of the bourbon caramel crunch and he thought it was excellent! Neighborhood is a bit odd and it's tucked away in a small building painted red and black. Not a lot of parking. You order at window and eat outside (there is a large tarp covering the patio). By the way the woman who waited on us was extremely friendly and helpful

It was heaven to our taste buds, this little shop is filled with so much awesomeness. We were greeted with the most amazing guy at the window, he was funny. Then came our time order, decisions, decisions!!! We ordered the Cookie Monster, Jasmine Vanilla and Bourbon ice cream. If we could all eat a gallons we would of. This is a must see and must eat place. Tucked away in a cute artsy district. You won't be disappointed and whatever you choose. And go with an open tummy as you will wanna go full throttle and eat away. Enjoy
The customer service and ice cream was out of this world!! Absolutely amazing!!! I will definitely be coming back to try more flavors.
A must visit. Best butter pecan I've ever had! The staff was super friendly and we ended up taking pints home with us. Kids will love the Cookie Monster in more than one way .
The best little ice cream shop with amazing ice cream and the dough melt is a must try. It's well worth the drive if you don't live close.

I've been to thirdspace many times recently, however none had been within Novel's hours. So last night, I was happy to see the door open with its smiling ice cream painted walls inviting me from within. I walked up with the intent of checking out the flavors (WITH MY EYEBALLS) and walking back out to my people. I even announced as such to the couple behind the counter (spoiler alert: they're the owners). They smiled and kindly insisted I try one. Nah, I'm good. But then I saw the honey lavender, which is often too strong of a flavor by most ice cream shops. So they offered again that I taste. Well, maybe just this one.... And then they offered another. And then another. And I found myself falling into a black hole of needing ice cream that I was doing PERFECTLY FINE WITHOUT mere moments prior. But here's the thing, this isn't just ice cream that you can get at any old place. These are fresh, delicious, creamy, and perfectly balanced flavors. If I'm going to be eating ice cream, please know that it will be this ice cream and only this ice cream. Anyway, I ended up walking out with a scoop of the honey lavender. My boyfriend was intent on getting the sweet tiki and his friend couldn't leave without the Leslie Knope (waffle sammy) with sweet tiki ice cream. This is, of course, after they realized I'd been gone for so long that they had to investigate, then also found themselves coerced into tasting all the flavors upon the bidding of the ever-pleasant and obviously business-savvy owners. Ice cream is the perfect way to round out a good evening.
This place is so cool! Went there w my siblings on a late night adventure and their treats were delicious! I got the donut ice cream sandwich and my siblings got regular cones. 10/10!

Holy bajeebus! Good things come in small packages! This looks like a little hole in the wall place and holy moly it's amazing! We were greeted right when we walked in and asked if it was our first time. We were told we were free to sample anything we would like. I settled on the doughmelt with Cookie Monster ice cream topped with crunch berries. The cold ice cream sandwiched in between the warm donut. So good. I could only eat a few bites as it was so rich but crap it was the best few bites ever! I will be coming back next time and bring the kids. Thanks for a great experience guys!!
Hidden treasure!!! This place is absolutely delicious!! There was a bit of a wait but 100% worth it. I promise you won't regret trying it.
My boyfriend took me there as a late night date and it was one of the best ice creams I've had !! You can't Go wrong with this !! I recommend trying

We were on our way home from work and off of grand we noticed this place! We heard about the race immediately both dropped our jaws and flipped a u turn. So so so worth it! Great & fast service. The ladies in there were awesome and helpful. Cute little spot, the colors and little houses surround it made it a really hipster atmosphere. I will definitely be back.
Amazing and decadent. The concept is awesome and the flavors unique. I love that this place is open late too.

Great ice cream and location (not too far from downtown Phoenix) Regular ice cream flavors are all good and the four alternating flavors also look delicious (too many to pick a favorite). People working are so friendly and there's plenty of places to sit and eat your ice cream :)

I was so excited to try out Novel ice cream because I've heard such great things. I hadn't found my ice cream spot until I came here. My friends and I visited on a Friday night. There was no line behind us, so we felt no pressure to decide our order fast. In addition, Brandon (the owner) was so nice and accommodating! He spent time describing all of the different flavors and allowing us to try any of the ones we wanted to. There were so many unique flavors that we decided to go with the indecision (5 scoops + 1 topping). My two favorite flavors were the bourbon caramel toffee crunch and butter pecan. The other flavors we tried (Cookie Monster, Fat Elvis, and the Ron Swanson) were delicious as well! Next time, I must try the Leslie Knope (as I am a huge Parks and Rec fan).

Wow! I was not expecting for an ice cream shop to blow me out of the water. I decided to give this place a try because I've heard so many good things about their different ice cream flavors made in house. First, the service was fantastic! They made sure the patio was spaced out so when people went up to get their order no one was stepping on each other's toes. The team Novel Ice Cream did a great job answering all my questions and allowed me to try a few flavors before I made my decision. They also shared with me what was gluten-free on the menu, including the little biscotti that comes with the smaller ice cream cups. I know when I go back to Phoenix, I am definitely coming here.

Y'all... what even is this magical place?!? My husband and I decided to do a unique date and have a 3 course meal, but all at different locations. I came across Novel Ice Cream by chance when I was sitting here for 20 mins trying to find the best place to go and have dessert...well.... I found it. We shared (again a 3-course meal) a "Dough Melt" we did the vanilla ice cream (Won 1st place for a reason) with cookie crisps (childhood anyone?!?). This mixture of the warm doughnut on the outside and the cold ice cream on the inside was the perfect combo of magic. Literally magic in my mouth. Do yourself a favor... park on the street if you have to and walk your way on to Novel.
Literally Novel ice cream has the best ice cream donuts! I have to beg my bf to take me there 10/10 recommend the Cookie Monster ice cream donut!

This place practically saved my sweet tooth several time during the summer of 2020. It was hot, and my options were low. The fact they operate in a shack actually helped them figure out a safe and efficient way to serve people during the pandemic. The ice cream is absolutely incredible. Novel creates some unique flavors, as well as a variety of classics. I enjoy ice cream with honey and lavender during the summer, and these people had my back. The floral bloom was a subtle high five to the sticky sweetness.

So delicious! First time so we asked for their top sellers. We had the cookie crunch dough melt with half/half Cookie Crisp and Oreo toppings and the Bourbon Cinnamon Toast Crunch doughmelt. Both were out of this world! Will definitely be bac

I was craving a sweet treat before flying out of Phoenix and based on Yelp reviews found this little gem. Parking was a bit of a challenge. Cute little outdoor patio, dog friendly! Delicious fresh tasting Ice Cream. I had the Lemon Poppyseed and Strawberry (something).

One of AZ's hidden gems! If you're looking for a melt watering ice cream wrapped in a warm donut, this is for you! They hand make all of their ice creams daily and offer a great variety. Their Honey Lavender and Madagascar Vanilla are 10/10 Let's not forget about the service! Top notch the owner is so friendly, informative and patient! It is worth the wait time and the calories!

The fat Elvis is dope! And so is the lavender ice cream they have it's fire. Wouldn't recommend the vanilla ice cream just because it's definitely one of the worst vanillas I've tried but all the other flavors me and my girl tried are legit.
Absolutely love this spot! Friendly staff delicious treats! Highly recommend! Had the butter pecan ice cream in a warm doughnut ugh so bomb!!!

The people who work here are so kind and friendly. I think that's what keeps people coming back for ice cream in the middle of nowhere, where parking sucks and the sun beats down on your back when waiting in line. (It get so hot that they have a cover for the handle and a pad to push the door!) They're known for the dough melt, which is an ice cream scoop in a warm donut bun. This comes with a free topping all for $5.25. They also have the "Leslie Knope" (which I wanted to try because Parks & Rec was such a fun show), but I picked the dough melt over it. The dough melt was delicious. I didn't think the donut was too sweet by itself. It was fluffy and chewy at the same time. They let you sample flavors. Vanilla and chocolate were their award winning flavors. I ended up sharing a $5 root beer float with the vanilla ice cream. Other flavors I thought tasted pretty good were caramel toffee crunch, lemon raspberry sorbet, and Cookie Monster. My experience with Cookie Monster is from Afters in Orange County, CA; the ice cream is uber sweet and doesn't really stain your mouth blue. The Cookie Monster ice cream here is not sweet (it's actually a bit thick), but it has multiple toppings in it, like Oreo and brownies. It will stain your tongue blue. When I asked for Oreo topping, the server said it was the "rightest" choice! You can come here knowing there is a bit of a wait, but the service here is unlike that of any other business.

Thought we were too full from dinner but decided to check out Novel Ice Cream to see what was going on, and I'm sure glad we did! Fun ice cream selections and Brandon was super helpful and friendly, he gave great information about the shop, it's history, and flavor recommendations too. We had a dough melt with Cookie Monster ice cream and a double scoop of chocolate and that killer bourbon caramel toffee ice cream, so so so GOOD. Next time I'll try a sorbet, but I don't think you can go wrong with any of the flavors, they all sound so delicious!

When Yelp tells you the best ice cream spot is in your town, you have to check it out. We made our way over after dinner on a Saturday night. Parking is tough but manageable on side streets. I wanted to try everything. Every flavor of ice cream was so good!!! I ended up with vanilla and chocolate bc let me tell you this was the best vanilla I've ever tasted in my life. Who knew vanilla could have so much depth of flavor?! My husband had a donut sandwich and it was amazing. The staff is so friendly and make the experience that much better. I can't wait to come back with friends to try more flavors!
Fantastic ice cream, interesting flavors - too many! Hard to choose. Extremely friendly staff who really took time with us. Wish there was one in Dallas!

First off the guy who took our order was so patient and nice and explained the whole gig to us since it was our first time coming the ice cream was to die for. Amazingly awesome and so delicious! Our new ice cream stop for sure!!!

While on a short trip with my boyfriend I was craving something deliciously sweet and happened upon this lovely gem of a place. The owner was so nice and probably gave me a bit more than he normal. Butter pecan and cookie dough was sooooo good. If I'm ever back in Phoenix I'll be sure to drop by!

We were looking for an ice cream place for my youngest to have dessert, and found this place just by chance, googling "ice cream near me." My gosh, this place is heaven on earth! I was not planning to personally get anything, but after sampling, there was no way I could not. Everything we sampled was top notch, and the employees were both so friendly. And they are extremely conscious of good practices to avoid cross contamination if you have nut allergies like I do. I highly highly recommended.

This place was top notch! The homemade artisan ice cream was by far one of my favorite ice creams to date. If you are traveling through Phoenix like us it's a MUST stop. We enjoyed the honey lavender and bourbon pecan. The honey lavender is calm, yet sweet. The lavender shines through with a touch of honey. It's like walking through a lavender field in sunshine. The bourbon pecan was sweet, very creamy. The owner was very kind, spoke to us like we were part of his ice cream society. We enjoyed chatting with him while checking out. As my teenage kids put it "some of the best ice cream I have had in my life. I'm glad I don't live here I would be poor from coming here everyday!" The cost is price pointed well. It's what I would expect to spend on a single scoop. The setting where the ice cream shop is located is cozy, a great courtyard to eat ice cream and share the happiness of ice cream with friends and family! Thanks for creating such a wonderful local ice cream shop! You're welcome to come and open one in Greensboro, NC for us!! We hope to travel back through and eat this again!

Novel Ice Cream is indeed novel. Located in a cute cottage-like establishment, they have a small outdoor patio for enjoying your creation. They have multiple toppings (including your favorite childhood cereal), homemade fun ice cream flavors, and the option to put the ice cream into a donut ice cream sandwich (you heard me) or with a vegan sprinkle cookie stuck in your cup. The staff were incredibly nice and helpful. They let us sample multiple flavors before settling on our combinations. I got a lavender honey ice cream with cookie crisp on top and the cookie. I wish they had options of other cookies but the cookie was good (more like a sweet biscuit texture). The ice cream flavor I got was potent (not for everyone) but I love lavender in anything! If I find myself back in Phoenix I would definitely seek out ice cream from here. Such a fun place with original options!
Best ice cream in Phoenix. We have tried a bunch of places and this is the best. Get one of the donut ice cream sandwiches!
Great ice cream, great donuts, great donut melt :) so glad we stumbled upon this place! We will definitely be back for more.

SO GOOD EVERYTHING ABOUT IT. Love the down town feel. You can tell the ice cream is homemade and the doughnuts too. They warm the doughnut and place the ice cream in a doughnut blanket all nice and cozy the bite is perfectly soft warm and cold

I had a lavender and honey ice cream donut sandwich and it was absolutely amazing. First off the ice cream is delicious. Rich and creamy without any cloying sweetness to it. Just the right amount of lavender so it takes like a flower (but not a cleaning product). Now you're thinking that ice cream on a donut will be too much, too heavy. You're wrong. The donut is perfection. Warm with a subtle glaze. A crunch to the exterior but OH SO FLUFFY on the interior. The combination is absolutely to die for. As you wait in line the owners will regale you with tales of winning competitions and putting everything into this ice cream. BELIEVE IT.

Turned to Yelp to find a dessert option while in Phoenix and was not disappointed by Novel Ice Cream. We were intrigued by the Leslie Knope (ice cream sandwich made on mini waffles), which was every bit as good as it sounds. We arrived around 8:30 PM on a Saturday and street parked because the nearby lot was full. There was a short line outside of the shop that was a bit slow-moving, but the level of individual attention we were given inside explained the brief wait. When it was our turn, the owner himself waited on us. When he learned it was our first time, he explained the shop's background, walked us through all of the flavors, and encouraged free samples. I wish I hadn't come straight from dinner --- I would have loved to order the Indecision, which allows you to get scoops of multiple different flavors. BF and I split a double scoop with Fat Elvis and bourbon caramel toffee crunch and it was phenomenal. I was nicely surprised at how affordable it was, too --- we ordered 3 different things to be split amongst 3 couples and the total was under $15. Wish I lived closer --- there'd be a lot of donut-ice cream sandwiches in my future.

I have to agree with all of the hype I've heard about this place - for a small shack, this place does serve up some of the best ice cream in town. My husband and I went on a Saturday afternoon during COVID. It was not busy, so there was no problem with social distancing. We ordered at the window outside and ate the ice cream on the way back to the car. My husband ordered a cup with honey lavender and bourbon toffee. I ordered a dough melt with cookie monster and the bourbon toffee ice creams. Yum! The donut was warm and did not disappoint! The only thing I will say about this place is that it is out of the way and not in the most convenient location. I don't know how comfortable I'd feel going there at night.

The Ice Cream here was amazing!!! A friend, my husband and I took a spontaneous late night trip to an ice cream shop and it turned out to be the best trip ever. Once you get your ice cream you can also take a walk around the area. It's very nice with many other shops around. I come here with my family and friends a lot more.
So good! The customer service exquisite....the owner is so nice And makes you feel so welcome!

Amazing. The environment is fantastic, definitely a cute, relaxing little hangout area. The night space is so comforting. The crew was bright and helpful. I had the donut melt and liked it a lot. They have a lot of interesting and good favors of ice cream. I had the bourbon caramel Toffee crunch and loved it. My boyfriend had the Fat Elvis and fell in love. Friends has the Cookie Monster and honey lavender absolutely loved them. Novel made our late night ice cream run worth it.
This is a local gem in Phoenix, AZ. THE ICE cream is delicious. I haven't tried it yet, but the dough melt seems to be the go to people buy when I'm there.

This is my third time coming to Novel ice cream and it really is a unique ice cream experience! The store is tiny and only fits about 6 people inside so there's often a line outside! The owners are always there and serve you with the biggest smile and passion about their ice cream that I've ever seen!!! They love telling you about their award winning flavors and their ice cream stuffed donut which is amazing! Their passion for their high quality product keeps you coming back!!! My favorite flavor is the butter pecan! It's very rich in butter flavor!! Definitely a must try if you're a ice cream lover!

YUM! Excellent customer service and even BETTER ice cream?? Also ice cream DONUT sandwiches. Say what?! Count me in! Novel ice cream is a little gem kind of hidden away on a small side street (or it may have appeared that way since we stopped by late at night). Street parking is the way to go. Walk on in and you'll be greeted by some of the nicest people in town. The man behind the counter (I think the owner) was really great, and explained the different flavors and encouraged us to try whatever we wanted. I settled on Thai tea and the honey lavender but didn't want two whole scoops so they kindly did a half and half combo in a cup for me. Since I was debating getting a cone, they put a small stroopwafel in the cup for me :) Thai tea flavor was strong and delicious, as was the honey lavender. I inhaled the ice cream like it was nothing, after having had a massive meal for dinner. I personally felt like the ice cream was kind of sweet and think it would be even better if it was made with less sugar, to enhance the flavors already in it. My friend got the ice cream donut sandwich, which looked bomb. We destroyed our ice cream and donut pretty quickly and would definitely recommend that anyone passing through Phoenix make a detour to stop at Novel. You won't regret it!
Ice cream flavors are so good and the doughnut is served warm. However the portions are kind of small. A great quick treat though!
Great ice cream and service. The cookie monster is the kids favorite.

Best ice cream in Arizona!!! Friendly and helpful staff will let you sample any of their amazing flavors. I always go for the Cookie Monster, but every flavor is worth a try. Won't regret checking them out. Cute area to hang out too!

So good. Get the doughnut thing. I know it seems extra but trust me just do it. I got it at 8:30pm on a Wednesday and it was still so soft and fresh. Also bring your dog. They make pup cups with bacon and peanut butter. Great customer service too. 13/10 experience
Much worth the ice cream. :) The team serving the ice cream is super friendly and give good vibes. I would recommend coming here anytime you're craving good ice cream!

I need to give everyone the TSD (tea, scoop, dish) on this place. The bad: I always do bad no matter what, nothing and no one is perfect but here I can't really think of anything bad. Maybe the only thing is it was small, but not too small. Another bad thing is it was so good I couldn't take a picture of it because I finished it so fast lol The Good: CUSTOMER SERVICE is on point, to me customer service is SO important. I use to serve in college and since then I always value good customer service. Brandon the owner and Sarah as soon as we came in greeted us and asked if we'd been before, we hadn't so they did a great job of explaining everything. We had as many samples as we wanted cause we're greedy, and they were so kind and patient, we all laughed with them and had a great time, it was like meeting up with old friends. The ice cream was so good I got the Cookie Monster doughnut and it wasn't too sweet to me, and I also got a small pineapple. SOOO good, the 5 star was well earned and I can not wait to come back!!
How did I miss this gem? Amazing 1st time visit...definitely will return, and real soon!

Love this place! They have handmade ice cream which has seasonal flavors. Be sure to get their butterbeer flavor if they are on available! Staff is very friendly. I was surprised they remembered me and my friends when we stop by. I've taken a lot of friends here and they always want to go back now. Prices are very reasonable and are worth it. Parking is a bit cramped so you might have to park in the neighborhood. Other than that, I have no complaints at all!

Okay.... let me start our by admitting I am not a huge ice cream fan. Yep... I am a bit off. LOL. It's not that I don't like it. It's just never been my first choice for a treat. However... Novel might be changing my mind. We have been there twice and both times, I have to be honest... THE ICE CREAM IS INCREDIBLE!!!! They specialize and pride themselves in providing small batch, artisan ice creams, with novelty flavors! And they absolutely deliver on taste and texture! I have never met a friendlier group of people and when you step into their cool little shop, you are greeted like you are a long time friend! Their ice cream is award winning and once you try it, you will understand why. They have some awesome and creative flavors to choose from and even make their own donut, that is used to create their famous The Dough Melt; which is ice cream, placed inside their home glazed donut! AMAZING and an absolute MUST HAVE!!!! My favorite thus far is the bourbon caramel toffee crunch ice creams. Can't get enough of it and from what I hear, it's a crowd favorite as well. Anyway, if you haven't been to Novel Ice Cream, you need to get over there stat. You won't regret your decision to stop by. I am already thinking about my next visit!!!!!!!
INSANE!!!! So yummy and the best staff!!!!! They were so sweet and let us know all of the best things! Their ice cream is perfect consistency

It is rare to find a local business where Quality, Service, and Price are all inline, however that is not the case for this business. Novel, congratulations on operating a business who focus on offering EXCEPTIONAL EXPERIENCE!!! P.S. your ice cream is amazing, just look at the picture... ()
best ice cream hands down!!!! they even have a honey lavender ice cream and the cutest cat who roams the tables!!!
Staff is so lovely and really take care of you. Even during the pandemic they managed to stay sweet. Recommend this ice cream shop over any.

We recently stumbled upon this spot while visiting the bar "the wayward" which is located next door. The dough melt is AMAZING which is basically a donut warmed with ice cream in the middle ! I ate mine within the blink of an eye, 100% worth it to go try! You won't regret it!

First things first.... GO TO NOVEL ICE-CREAM NOW!!!! My wife and I were in Phoenix for Spring Training. We were walking around the downtown area looking for some place to eat, when a gentlemen asked us if we need help. We said no, and he said, "If you need desert go to Novel I've Cream". We looked it up, and I'm so glad we did! The ice cream here is amazing! It's almost impossible to make up your mind, but whatever you choose you'll be happy with.

Ice cream was fantastic and customer service even better. They are very sensitive and respectful of gluten allergies. Assured measures taken to avoid cross contamination/ offered all of their alternatives. So happy I know I can come here

Been here twice and always very satisfied w the nice service and yummy flavors available! Sample them all if you want! Both times visiting, Brandon, the (co?)owner, gave us a very warm welcome and explained all their flavors in detail. You can tell these owners are super passionate about what they're making. I loooove their bourbon toffee flavor. They also have rotating flavors and I think 6 staple flavors that stay in the shop. My friend loves the donut ice cream they offer. I believe they slightly heat up the donut too so it makes it super soft to bite into it and pairs well w the ice cream texture. I was on the hunt to find a perfect ice cream spot in Phoenix, but I think novel has won the title. They know what they're doing ppl! Visit them soon!
I got the cookie monster ice cream. It is a busy place and had a long line but it's in a very quaint location. It has a nice outdoor patio that is enjoyable to sit and talk to friends with.
Great service, very fast and efficient. Their menu is the best and the cashier is super helpful when you're trying to decide! Definitely recommend

Found this gem on a whim during a vacation. Staff were super friendly, helpful, and patient. They genuinely seemed happy to be serving you and worked together well which made the whole experience better. Ice cream was not your typical ice cream flavors which can sometimes be scary, but these were great! This will definitely be our go-to whenever we're in Phoenix!

Amazing artisan ice cream stuffed in delicious warm donut melts. If you're lucky you'll get served by the owner Brandon one of the nicest guys you'll ever meet. There's a reason they've won so many awards since they opened five years ago. You will not be disappointed! Hands down the best ice cream place around. And they just opened another one in Mesa!
So delicious and in a super cute spot. I got the lavender ice cream with fruity pebbles in a donut, so good!
Delicious! Went here last week for the first time and the staff is friendly and their Donut Melts delicious! Recommend to try out :)

Very good ice cream and the server at the window was so kind and gave us a whole background on the sweet shop and all the ice cream. Very nice experience and there is a cute little court yard to hang out with your loved ones! Fun place to visit highly recommended if you like exotic flavors they have em for you!

Definitely love supporting local and this gem is great! The owner is a nice guy and his employees are always on top of it. Don't pass up the dough melt(seriously don't). The fat Albert ice cream is great and butter pecan is even better!! Oh I forgot to mention they make their own donuts!!!
Nice little dessert spot in Phoenix. All of the homemade ice cream flavor are so good!
I really enjoy this place! Such a great atmosphere and the ice cream is delicious. You need to try the donut stuffed with ice cream

The star of the little cove you'll find it in, Novel Ice Cream goes in and takes no prisoners. They don't even have the interior space for prisoners. That is to say, you're gonna be sitting outside. The guys behind the counter are very friendly and emphasize that all the ice cream is hand-made. I can believe it, because the texture is perfect and the flavors get pretty wacky(and taste good). Cookie monster looks like playdoh but it tastes a lot better. Definitely a good pick for cookie monsters, like my brother. As for the honey lavender, it wasn't my first time with lavender ice cream, but it was my first good experience. Usually it tastes like soap, but the honey balanced it out and the lavender was a lot more subtle, as it should be. I think this is a good place to bring your friends because I saw pods of young adults hanging out. They left when the family with kids showed up, however. Expect the unexpected.

We heard of this delicious little find from an article "The Best Ice Cream shop in Every State". I have to say, they were not too far off the mark on this one. The ice cream itself is amazingly tasty and the way it is served up stuffed in a light airy donut, brilliant! I suggest you go give it a try.

What a quirky little spot! You don't have to write a novel length review to know that Novel Ice Cream has delicious desserts. The shop is in the Thirdspace building complex which is actually a set of barracks that used to house WWII POWs. So this building used to be a prison and is now an ice cream shop decades later, who would have thought! Novel Ice Cream had me at the name Leslie Knope. I love Parks and Rec so when I heard there was a Leslie Knope waffle ice cream sandwich I knew I had to get it. You get your choice of ice cream (They can do two flavors if you'd like) and the waffles are made fresh on the spot. There were so many delicious sounding options and the gentleman here (Who sounded like he was the owner) was happy to give us samples. I enjoyed the honey lavender and bourbon caramel toffee crunch which has real bourbon in it. I ended up with the bourbon caramel and split it with a friend. The waffle sandwich was so good! The waffles were light, crisp, and the ice cream was so smooth, rich, and had just the right balance of different flavors. The sweetness level was perfect for me. I had a bite of the doughnut ice cream sandwich which was still good, but I liked the extra crunch from the waffles more. The Leslie Knope also comes with your choice of mix in (Mainly cereals), we went with the Cinnamon Toast Crunch which provided an extra little hit of toasty crunchiness which was great. Service was so friendly and nice. The only negative is that it can be hard to find parking in this area and it's not in the nicest part of downtown Phoenix. If I'm around the area again you bet I'll be back for some more superb ice cream!
Novel is my favorite ice cream shop in Phoenix! Friendly staff, unique and tasty flavors, and overall a great vibe! Highly recommend!

Hands down the best strawberry ice cream I've ever had in my life. I'm new to the Phoenix area, but I have a hard time imagining going anywhere else for ice cream now that I've found Novel. This little ice cream shop is located on the outskirts of downtown Phoenix, within a small cluster of independently owned shops with their own small parking lot and plenty of street parking. The owners, Brandon and Jennifer, are incredibly warm and humble hosts, and it's clear that they have a genuine passion for hand making ice cream and crafting unique flavors. Upon walking in, we were greeted with kind smiles and genuine care. Brandon told us that at any given time, they have eight ice cream flavors, half of which are standard and then other half that rotate depending on ingredients and what they dream up (and are their imaginations impressive). Samples are generously offered and even encouraged, and it was difficult to choose between all the impressive flavors. On the particular day I went, the flavors included honey lavender, butter pecan, strawberry, peach, fat elvis (peanut butter, banana, and bacon bits), cookie monster (cookies and cream with blue food coloring -- a favorite for kids, I'm sure), and more! They also offer donut ice cream sandwiches, which are toasty on the outside and refreshing on the inside. A variety of cones are available as well, and though I was tempted to add on a waffle cone, I opted for a double scoop because I couldn't resist the amazing flavors. Strawberry with real ripe strawberries churned in: Seemingly simple, this strawberry ice cream literally made me want to buy a tub of it and eat it all by myself. Brandon let us know that they churn in fresh ripe strawberries before freezing, which gives the ice cream a fragrant taste of summer and is like no strawberry ice cream I've ever had before. Strawberry is my favorite flavor in general, but I've yet to have a strawberry-flavored anything that was as balanced as this ice cream. The fruitiness offered an refreshing sweetness to the creaminess, which kept the ice cream from being too sweet or too rich -- hence the desire to never stop eating it. Honey lavender with real lavender buds: If I'm ever in the mood for a slightly sweeter, more floral flavor, this honey lavender would be my first choice. I was impressed with the use of real lavender buds, which gives a surprisingly potent pop of lavender every time I came across one. I loved it -- but be warned if you're not a fan of floral flavors: it's very strong. Fat Elvis: This flavor naming made me laugh, and it was an interesting blend of peanut butter, banana, and bacon bits. The bacon is very subtle, but the bacon bits give a nice pop of saltiness in contrast to the peanut butter and banana in every bite. I'm not a huge fan of banana or bacon, but I could tell this flavor was made really well with the intention of balancing saltiness and sweetness, and my other couldn't get enough. Cookie Monster: This is a huge hit with the kids, I bet, and it's the only flavor that had anything artificial churned in (blue food coloring). This cookies and cream wasn't overly sweet, and it had the added fun of turning your tongue blue! I think it's sweet that the owners considered putting in a flavor that was attractive to kids, and it just goes to show the care and thoughtfulness they put into their work. I'm missing that strawberry ice cream just writing this review, and I can't wait to go back soon.

the absolute king of sweets trophy belongs to this place! novel is the boss, king of the heap. el patron, finest in all of the land! do not be a fool and go anywhere else. prices do not matter... it is worth it! do it. treat yourself!!!

I hate that this place is in walking distance from me...mainly because I fear how much money I've been spending here. They've taken two of my favorite things (ice cream and donuts) and turned them into one amazing dessert. Just abandon all healthy instincts you have and come to indulge in unbridled gluttony. Their ice creams, while a small selection, are amazing. My favorites so far have been: Cherry Panna Cotta, Bourbon Toffee, Marshmallow Sundae, and Fat Elvis (PB, bacon + banana). Although they are great on their own, the best thing by far is the Bourbon Toffee Crunch on a donut sandwich with Cinnamon Toast Crunch. The owners are also super friendly, and it just makes me happy to support them.If you haven't made a stop here yet, you're missing out big time.
Must try the lavender honey ice cream... I'm hooked, take some to go or have it on their donuts... to die for
Everything about this place delivered! The atmosphere. The service. The ICE CREAM! I'm so thankful to have spent my Friday night here. Worth every second.
Loved this quaint ice cream shop sandwiched by two doughnught slices. YUMMY! CHECK THEM OUT IN DOWNTOWN PHX

Handling covid regulations so much better. The owner personally reached out to tell me their new rules and implementations. I'm so grateful to have a wonderful ice cream place like this in my neighborhood. I adore their efforts. Also, try the bourbon caramel ice cream its heaven. We stan for companies that excell in customer service

No cap this place is bussin. That's it. Bring your friends because Novel never misses. Make sure you get the donut sandwich though. The waffle one is not amazing ( not bad but not game changing like the donut). YOU HAVE TO TRY THE LAVENDER-something. I forgot the name but that ish phenomenal
Oh dang oh dang. Wish I knew this place sooner! Phoenix is a better place with Novel!

This spot is in a small little building clustered with some other businesses. There's no indoor seating but there is plenty outdoor seating and the whole area has a nice vibe. We were immediately greeted by the super nice staff. Upon learning it was out first time visiting, they walked us through the place and the flavors, even asked us if we wanted any samples. I tried the Fat Elvis, which was a peanut butter/banana/bacon concoction. It was so good I just decided on getting a scoop right then and there. Honestly, as I devoured it, it was probably some of the best - if not THE best - ice cream I have ever had. The flavor was just perfect. My girlfriend sampled the almond joy flavor and enjoyed it, but decided to go with the vanilla since she wanted to get the Leslie Knope: a waffle sandwich including a topping of your choice. She said it was honestly soooooo amazing. One of her favorite desserts she's ever had. They said that they have some standing flavors and others they they rotate, so we will definitely come back. 100% check it out if you like ice cream, it's that good.

There's a reason this place wins all of the awards and has such amazing reviews!! Two things I love about this place: 1. They warm up their donut so that it molds around your ice cream. 2. They don't overly sweeten the donut, so it's not sickly sweet when paired with the ice cream. They also have delicious non-dairy options! I will be going back again and again. Only warning is that they don't have indoor seating, so eat quickly if it's hot outside!
What a fantastic find! The ice cream is the best I've ever had. The service was excellent!
I love this place. They have such good Icecream and waffles! Right now they are openly doing a to go window, but there are several tables outside you can eat at instead!

Staff at Novel Ice Cream are amazing! They have ice cream flavors that I've never heard of. We got a sampler of 5 different ice creams and were not let down. Each flavor is so delicious. We had: chocolate, butter pecan, Madagascar vanilla, black cherry, Cookie Monster, and got an extra scoop of cucumber lime. Everyone needs this place in their lives. So amazing!

Hanging out with my big bro in Arizona. Oh my gosh! The Leslie Knope is AMAZING! You also get a full size candy bar with the Candy Bar ice cream flavor! Travis and Val are SO kind and helpful! 10/10 for everything!
OMG !! The donut melt highly recommend right amount of sweetness! You have to try this spot it's phenomenal

Yes Please! It was the Leslie Knope for me and the Dough Melt for my son. Lovely owners, charming service and the little kitties outside were just so sweet. Even on a hot summer evening it was perfect eating outside on the patio. Well placed and well shaded for those summer evenings. We found a new favorite ice cream spot.

Every so often in life, you're blessed to stumble across an establishment that makes you smile, that makes your heart sing, and that makes your stomach happy. Ladies and gentleman, this is such a place. Service: I cannot tell you how much the owner loves people and his shop. He's always kind, helpful, and willing to tell you about what makes each flavour special. I've been here twice since moving to Phoenix and I can't say enough about how welcome I feel every time I visit. The diversity in the clientele is incredible with people from all walks of life enjoying these treats. Food: Donut and ice cream. And ice cream and ice cream. The ice cream is made with love. It is fresh and so darn tasty. The prices are also incredibly reasonable. You can easily share a $4.50 double scoop. We had the taro and Thai tea the first time, and the strawberry and Cookie Monster the second time. Delicious. The only thing that outshines the ice cream is the service. See above. Ambiance: the shop is located in a cute neighborhood of Phoenix off of Grand. The diagonal-ness of Grand ave scares me, but not enough to not come to Novel. There's lots of seating area under the string lights. Come here, come for a date, just find a way to taste the ice cream. Also, don't be scared by the lines, they move quickly and the ice cream is worth every minute of the wait.

Okay y'all! I've lived in Phx all my life and I've driven by this place plenty of times, but today I have finally tried this place out for myself! The customer service was amazing! It was our first time here and they let us try a few flavors while also letting us know what this place was all about! The ice cream was amazing! I highly recommend getting the donut with your ice cream it's the bomb. Also there is plenty of space to sit outside and enjoy your ice cream. Parking is limited, especially at night. Other than that, it's one of the best ice creams, hands down.
Great place for a first date and has such an amazing outdoor vibe, I like the Cookie Monster ice cream and the big open area

Talk about a cool experience! We went when we were in the area for a sweet treat, and it sure was! The owner Brandon was there and as nice as could be and very informative. We tried almost everything and each one was better than the next! I ordered a scoop of sweet cream and honey, it was delicious! I'll be back when I have more room to try a donut sandwich- their claim to fame! Super great experience and quaint place! Will be back again!

I actually came by Novel twice, because the first night I tried to stop by I couldn't wait in the crazy long line. The second day luckily had a shorter wait (because who wants icecream at 11am except for me and the few other people there). Awesome cute little shop in a collection of cute shops with a friendly staff and some dank choices. I appreciate all of the cereal offered as toppings. I am not an icecream donuts guy, so I sprung for just a regular scoop. Both the Cookie Monster and the Chocolate were rad, but I do with that they had a little more flavor. The cookie monster assaults you with more blue dye than anything else. I'd be careful if you're wearing white!

This has to be one of my most favorite ice cream places ever! Truth is, I had a donut filled with vanilla bean ice cream and fruity pebbles in Chicago ( my hometown.) I feel so much in love with it. I searched high and low. And came across this GEM! I have to first say that aside from it being DELICIOUS! The staff members are my favorite people on this planet! They have the cutest and bubbliest personality. It's a win for me when you serve amazing food and have great people to make your business amazing! The parking is a really small area like most places in the downtown area. I have always found a spot even when it's pretty busy ( and they certainly get busy!!!) they have an outside patio area where you can enjoy the deliciousness! The inside is SUPER tiny. But it's so so worth it! You must visit novel ice cream!

I'm an ice cream nut, raised in a family of ice cream nuts, and I'm telling you right now this is the best ice cream in Phoenix. Both people working in the shop were friendly and incredibly knowledgeable about ice cream. They were enthusiastic about giving us samples and made great suggestions. As for the ice cream...if you're an ice cream nerd, obsessed with milk fat and mouth feel, this is the place for you. If you just like amazing ice cream, this is ALSO the place for you. I had a Dough Melt - that's a warm donut filled with ice cream (butter pecan) and a topping (cinnamon toast crunch). Changed my life a little.
Amazing ice cream, DEFINITELY recommend! ! And that customer service greatttt. Also during this COVID-19 thing going on they managed to stay open and provide a walk thru window which is soo nice
Cookie Monster! Amazing flavors that taste authentic - Butter Pecan, Madagascar Vanilla and the Lavendar Honey. I have not tasted better ice cream.

The staff is so friendly! Omg! They offer some of the most delicious tasting ice cream! I had the honey lavender and it was delicious! Pet friendly and also offer a pup cup! Would definitely go back!!
The Dough Melt feels like you are biting into a slice of sweetness and coldness. Excellent ice cream and fresh donuts! A must try for everyone.

I could move into this little ice cream cabin of heaven, curl up into a ball on the floor with some blankets and a pillow (maybe a good book) near the ice cream freezer.......with a long spoon, and simply lift my head off my pillow and scoop more of their delicious ice cream onto my long handled spoon and be happy for the rest of my life. Their ice cream is FRIGGIN DELICIOUS. The people who work there are FRIGGIN NICE AND COOL. The prices are FRIGGIN reasonable. The flavors are FRIGGIN OUT OF THIS WORLD. They have samples! We couldn't decided between the amazing artisan flavors they offered so went full piggy and ordered the ice cream "flight". Oh, yes people, they have ice cream flights. It doesn't get any better. Oh wait, yes it does! They had a "Leslie Knope" waffle ice cream sandwich. Homemade, warm waffles with a scoop of ice cream in between. Who doesn't love Leslie Knope, waffles, and ice cream??? I loved the little courtyard where we sat and enjoyed our treats. I DID NOT like the stupid billboard I could see from the courtyard depicting our president with nazi signs. Not the businesses fault but damn that was obnoxious. I don't care what you think about our president, that is over the top. I will be happy to return when I am in Phoenix and just hope they have a different billboard by then. All in all, amazing stop! :)
Yes Sir!!!! This is the place! The best ice cream in the Valley all tucked into a donut. Wow. You gotta go
2nd trip to Phoenix and had to come back for ice cream. This place is really incredible.

Amazing ice cream with flavors that are unique and oh so yummy. My picture is my kids favorite. Lucky to get one picture because it was still 106'F outside so we all started eating right way and forget to take selfies. Thank you to Brandon for taking the extra few seconds to explain the flavors and giving us a sample. We all loved our choices!! We will be back.

I've been going to this little ice cream shop since I was in high school and it has been one of my favorite spots to go visit with my friends. I'm never disappointed with any of their ice cream selections they offer and the staff is fantastic! I always recommend their strawberry ice cream, it's legitimately the best I've ever had.

839 5-star reviews... gotta check it out. Make that 840! We saw tons of reviews mentioning Brandon, but Travis (his brother) hooked us up with tastes of all their delicious flavors. Come get some ice cream, and bring the dog!
They are so good. Diabetes central, it is sooooo good for a once-in-a while treat! Try the honey lavender. It's real good.

This is the best ice cream I've had in my whole life. I got the bourbon caramel with straight up strawberry and it is divine. The donuts are always on point and melt in your mouth. The employees are all super nice and helpful if it's your first time.

This is my all time favorite Ice cream shop. It's a little small inside, but great seating outside. Everytime I go the staff is super friendly and welcoming. The prices is great not expensive considering they make their own flavors. Thier Ice cream is just AMAZING!! They mix up thier flavors from time too. So it's always new and exciting. My boyfriend got some bourbon flavor on a donut bun with cinnamon toast church. so so good. I got the Fat Elvis. I highly recommend trying this place you won't regret it.
Holy smokes Outstanding ice cream and cheaper than lesser competitors. I have no idea where they came up with some of their flavors, but a little ice cream fairy was whispering to them pure magic.
Incredible ice cream and service!! Super kind staff, and some of the best ice cream I've ever had, especially the strawberry!!! A must try
Such good ice cream. Such good donuts. Such nice people. I think the rest of reviews speak the praises already so I'll keep it brief!

Visited on a Saturday night. They were very busy. It's a small shop so you might have to wait outside if there's a line inside. I now know what the hype is all about because damn this place is good! I got the chocolate ice cream and it was so good! They won awards for some of their ice cream flavors. The two guys who were working (I think maybe their do-owners?) were so friendly and very personable.

Wow! I can honestly say this is one of my top 2 favorite ice cream places here in Phoenix. You can probably tell since I have so many pictures from my many trips there, HA! They have a few flavors that are always there and the rest are always rotating, so you can always count on trying out something new! The workers are extremely knowledgeable about how each ice cream is made and what ingredients are put into it. The place is pretty small so be prepared to wait outside if there is a line. However, they are relatively quick at getting the ice cream and all the samples out so the line doesn't take that long. The vibe around the stores on the outside is super chill and cute! I've brought a couple friends from out of state here a couple times and they loved it! I highly recommend everyone to try novel ice cream at least once because once you do.... you'll be addicted!

Phenomenal!! If you had not stopped into this little 600sq ft. of a wonderland of dreaminess, creamiest, indulgence perfection.......STOP what your doing, put down whatever you're eating and head to Novel ASAP! Seriously, you're welcome for passing on the most positive ice cream experience ever! Here's the down-low it took this owner 2 years, to find the perfect ice cream maker, and a year to perfect his doughnuts! So bottom line; the PERFECT doughnut is stuffed with perfect ice cream! Here's the scoop, there's 12 flavors of ice cream, handfuls of toppings, and cereal, if you choose, to top off your ice cream. I tried all flavors before deciding on what I think is the best combination in the world! Strawberry balsamic and a scoop of honey lavender! I kid you not, it's the best! My son got Cookie Monster stuffed in a warm doughnut, hubby got bourbon toffee with cinnamon crunch cereal stuffed in a warm delicious doughnut! This may sound over sweet, and stomach churning with sugar overload, on the contrary....it's not too sweet! It's perfected to be balanced, leaving you wanting more! It's magic, I don't understand it? The owner and staff were outstanding providing exceptional service, and products!! I'm bowing down, as I finish this review! See you tomorrow!

This place is amazing! First off, they have some of the friendliest employees you'll find anywhere. I was so excited just going through and trying the different flavors. I felt like I was doing something far more special than just ordering ice cream. Maybe that's because it's so much better than just ice cream. I ordered the fresh strawberry, not made with any frozen strawberries which is a big deal, on a donut...yes a donut!! With Cap'n Crunch Berries. OMG!!! The donut is slightly warm, the ice cream was amazing, and the crunch added to the overall explosion of texture and flavors. The prices are very reasonable, almost cheap considering the quality and the experience. My daughter, who made her own special concoction, summed it up best when she stopped eating hers for a couple of minutes and said, "it's so good I don't want to eat it cause it will be gone". Highly recommend!

Thanks guys, for the warm welcome and the delicious creamy ice cream. First timers here, and the guys were patient, helpful, welcoming, and friendly. The ice cream was absolutely delicious and the building is such a cute little place. I had the bourbon Caramel toffee crunch! My kids and hubby had chocolate ice cream and floats. Next time I will have to try the donut too

Wonderful delicious hand crafted small batch artisan creamy ice cream! Full flavored and great mouth feel. You have options of cereal sprinkles, fresh made crispy waffles or the WARM TOASTED DOUGHNUT SANDWICH. The owner and Ice Cream Chef Brandon was very cordial and hospitable. He offered us tastings, was very friendly and told us all about his ice cream. I had the Panna with imported Italian Cherries Ice Cream stuffed into a Toasted, Warm, Airy, Light, Sweet Doughnut. It was heavenly. It was like getting a prize each time I bit into a big sweet delicious Cherry. My husband got the toasted doughnut with chocolate. The chocolate is also outstanding. I usually don't like chocolate ice cream because most people don't use a good quality chocolate but here chocolate is Delicious so no worries here. The only down side is that this ice cream parlor is in a very small building that doesn't have room for tables so you have to get a seat on the patio in the heat. For that reason I would rate a 4.5 but rounded it up to 5 because the Toasted Ice Cream Doughnut Sandwich is really Delicious!

If you havent tried every flavor, I would suggest you do. Not that it will help you decide because, trust me, it may only make the decision harder being that ALL the flavors are amazing. Lucky enough, they thought of people like me and offer The Indecision.

It was perfect because the seating is outdoor. I had the lavender and honey ice cream in a doughnut sandwich. It was phenomenal. The lavender and honey ice cream was not too strong and not too sweet which complemented the also not too sugary doughnut very well. My friend also got the blue ice cream which made his mouth completely blue! How playful! He is not a fan of ice cream but this time it was a totally different story. He ate the ice cream and loved every spoonful and mouth bite of it. What a fantastic experience.
This place is awesome! Super unique and eclectic spot with delicious ice cream! Get the dough melt!

there's a reason this place has 600+ reviews with almost all of them being 5 stars. it's AWESOME SAUCE! our family stopped by novel ice cream while we were in phoenix for a weekend vacation. some places have a lot of hype, but don't deliver... that is not the case with novel ice cream. it's located in and among some others stores, restaurants, bars. the shop is pretty small with no indoor seating, but there are plenty of outside seating. there's even a park down the street as well. the parking on site is limited, but we just drove down the street a few blocks and was able to find street parking. after a short walk we arrived. since it was around 6:30p on a weeknight the line was pretty short. i bet it's much longer on the weekend and later in the evening. they offered us all the samples we wanted and we took them up on their offer. the owner was there and super helpful in explaining the different flavors and all the ingredients in them. they've won multiple awards for their ice cream. we make ice cream at home and they've inspired me to up my game. my kids ended up choosing the cookie monster and butter pecan. i got the dough melt (ice cream sandwiched between a warm glazed donut) with their award winning chocolate. i forgot what my wife ordered, but she loved it. the price point is higher than you're going to pay at thrifty's or mc donalds, but the quality is so much higher, it's not even fair to compare. there was definitely the standard sugar rush and subsequent crash, but we loved this place. i asked them to open a store in tucson, but maybe it's a good thing they haven't done that quite yet.

After all of the ice cream places in town had closed at 10 we were happily surprised to see that novel was still open when we got there around 10:45 there was a line through the parking lot and I have to say they moved quite quickly and it was absolutely worth the wait

This place sure get a crowd. The shop is tiny but offers several options for ice cream and toppings. Their claim to fame is of course their scoop of ice cream inside a warm glazed donut. How could you go wrong with that? I tried the Fat Elvis scoop of ice cream which had actual pieces of bacon inside and some sort of banana flavor. It was good! I ordered two scoops but felt that one would have been enough to get the idea since the flavors were so pronounced. The person scooping the ice cream said that their most popular flavor was the cookie monster which was a dark blue and *WARNING* would stain your whole mouth. So, I wasn't surprised to see several blue mouths walking around later that night.

We come here quite often and we are never let down. Their ice cream here is stellar and refreshing to see new flavors weekly. Brandon is amazing and the customer service is out of this world! I highly recommend this place for anyone in the area!
Owned by two brothers very friendly. A great little spot for some good ice cream! Great flavors and everything is homemade. Check them out!
Best Ice cream place in Phoenix,Arizona... Get yourself a ice cream donut sandwich Any of their ice cream flavors is really good

I'm visiting from California and needed something to help cool me off because it's so damn HOT out here! I decided to try out Novel Ice Cream because of the great reviews and I'm happy I tried it out! I had the mimosa sorbet and it was very refreshing on a very hot day. However, my favorite part was the customer service! Jalen was extremely nice, funny, and helpful. If I ever come back to the this hot ass desert again, I will Forsure come back to Novel Ice cream

Well when your daughter has a hard time talking because she can't resist the next bite I'd say you've found a great spot. When you walk outside to enjoy it then when you go to leave decide to go back for some to go for the mrs and there's a brand new flavor I'd say it's one of the best ice cream places around. A must try if you love where you live. Local AZ

We came here tonight after dinner at Chibo and we're so glad we did. I loved the mocha nut joe ice cream. And my guy loved the lemon poppyseed and strawberry ice cream. Fantastic service from Brandon. We would come here again in a heartbeat.

In the past I've always been hesitant to ask for even one sample when I go out for ice cream (I'm not referring to Novel). Sometimes you can just tell that you're annoying the staff for asking for one or multiple samples, but when you walk into Novel Ice Cream that's the first thing you're asked, it's "what would you like to sample today?". Although I have my go-to flavor, from talking to the owners and staff I know that a lot of thought goes into the creation of all their crazy delicious and one of a kind flavors and I like having the opportunity to try bits of it. This business not only has great ice cream, they have great service, passion, and the genuine desire to make the experience unique and enjoyable for all.

Very good ice cream!! Love the honey lavender and berries and cream! There were 6 of us and we all had cones, except for one donut sandwich and he said that was really good too. So creamy amd flavorful.

My wife and I commented after leaving Novel, that Brandon and the other employee there were some of the kindest food/beverage workers we've ever met.
