Wow! Best ice cream sandwich I've had. Mouthgasm-fantastic. Love it here.

I mean it's hard to complain when it's ice cream.... Novel is a cute spot in a slightly hidden location. Although I do love the look and feel of the artsy/grungy sitting area -- very First Friday vibes. Novel is known for their ice cream between two warm donuts. I couldn't do something that sweet so I settled for a scoop of their lavender lemon. It was light and refreshing! I wish there were more flavors to choose from, I was slightly underwhelmed by their selection. But still a great late night spot in downtown.

Went to Novel for the first time and loved the vibe of the whole place, though with its small size you're gonna be standing in line outside for a little bit. The service was excellent with friendly staff that was very informative and allowed you to try a ton of different flavors! I got the Leslie Knope because waffles. Honestly the waffle wasn't exactly my favorite just because of its softness, I had wished it was a little bit crispier. Waffle cone might have been better decision for my personal preference. Got the Blue Monster and the Elvis flavor (peanut butter, bananas, and bacon). Both were very good and you can tell they were made with TLC.
This was an awesome find. Yelp helped in this location. It's truly a hidden gem. Great options and excellent customer service.

This place is pretty small, but super cute, and with great employees. We tried their vanilla bean, honey lavander and the bourbon crunch; they were so rich and creamy! And really delicious! We plan our trip downtown around visiting this place, and it was well worth it.
I would say this is one of the best icream shop I have been to. And I would say my favorite in this state.. I tried the Cookie monster ice cream and it was amazing

Perfect dessert on a hot night in Phoenix. The owners are very nice and very catering the FAT ELVIS and Cookie Monster are my favorite. It's small and cute place to stop by to grab a bite. We will def come back! Great Job Novel
Always so friendly and delicious flavors!! A really cool experience - if you are in downtown you should stop by a see their flavors for that week!

I went there and it wasn't as special as I thought it was going to be. Also, what I always see featured the fruity pebble sandwich wasn't available? The ice cream was good but nothing over the top amazing.

Novel Ice Cream is the best Ice Cream in all of Phoenix in my opinion, but considering all the awards they've won, I know I'm not alone in my beliefs! The owner is almost always there and you instantly see his passion for his craft! All of their flavors are unique and delicious. Do yourself a favor and get a scoop!!

I don't even what to know what my trip to the dentist will be like after a stop here. Novel Ice Cream sure knows what they are doing. These flavors are packed with a punch and always rotating. Their specialty is jam-packing a donut with your flavor and topping, toasting it and bringing it to you so you can enjoy a donut sandwich. After testing ALL the flavors, you will be in a conundrum as to which one to pick, but don't worry the staff is amazing and has insight. If they are still toasting up the Leslie Knope: waffle sandy with a scoop of ice cream...I don't know why you wouldn't get that.

The moment I took a bite of my donut ice cream sandwich, the words "HOLY F***" involuntarily jumped from my lips. The ice cream is rich, creamy, incredible, and would make anyone gleeful by itself. But the donut - dear GOD the donut is just....just...... I don't have the right words to accurately describe it. Succulent? Can you use the word succulent to describe a donut? It's so soft yet substantial. It doesn't fall apart or collapse like other particularly soft donuts I've had. It's perfectly moist, fresh, sticky without being too messy.... I just.... wow. Literally the best I've EVER had. Plus the owners are super nice, friendly, and chill. Two thumbs up aren't enough.

Uhm. Go. That's all I have to say. But seriously, the ice cream is amazing, the doughnut is amazing, then they roll it in your favorite cereal?! I don't think it matters the flavor you get, but I had the frosted sugar cookie, rolled in Reese puffs, between the most deliciously warm doughnut I've ever had. The ladies working are the sweetest. Just... go! You won't regret it.

Not a place you stumble on by accident. It's tucked away. But so worth the effort ! Delicious ice cream. Be sure to do yourself a favor and get it in the warm doughnut ! Wasn't planning on it but when the owner described it I thought why not I'm here. Glad I did. We will be back next time we are in town .

I had the dough melt this time! I got the butter pecan ice cream with crunch berry toppings! The donut was perfect and wasn't overly sweet and the butter pecan went really well with the crunch berries! I highly recommend getting a dough melt when you come by! Next up on my to-do list will be the Leslie Knope (a waffle ice cream sandwich).

So, my buddy at work was telling me about a "donut ice cream sandwich" that he had. Donuts and ice cream, together? Sign me up! My buddy Rick also had written a review of this spot a few months back, so I was excited to try it. I was in the area the other day, and decided to stop in. The shop is really small! It is a little tricky to find, too (if the sign was not out on the curb of Grand, you could easily pass it by). Once you do locate it though, you are in for a treat! I walked inside and was greeted by the owner, Brandon. He asked me if I had ever been before, how I heard about them etc. Really nice dude! I told him that I heard about their famous donut ice cream sandwich, and he smiled and let me know that's what they are famous for. He explained how they have an ice cream chef, and a donut chef with many years of experience between the two. He also let me sample whatever I wanted. I browsed the flavors and had my eye on two of them right away. The Cookie Monster, and The Fat Elvis. I had a sample of both, and decided to go with a donut sandwich with a scoop of Fat Elvis topped with Oreo cookie pieces (you get your choice of a topping, or a sauce/drizzle). He warmed up the donut, scooped out the ice cream and handed over the goods. Here is how it was.......................... Fat Elvis Donut Ice Cream Sandwich- Sometimes, when you get a "gimmicky" dessert, it doesn't work out and doesn't live up to the hype. I am happy to say, this ice cream sandwich TOTALLY lived up to the hype! The donut they use is a glazed donut. Texture was perfect. It wasn't a heavily glazed donut, which actually worked out better because it was not messy/sticky.. It sort of reminded me of a brioche roll, but more sweet. The ice cream stuffed inside was delicious! The Fat Elvis is a peanut butter/banana/bacon combo of flavors. It was really tasty and I would come back to just get a few scoops of this in a cup on its own. The Oreo pieces added that extra sweetness and chocolaty goodness to the sandwich. It was a damn fine ice cream concoction! I could have easily had 2 or 3 of these things! Might get a little pricey if I did that ($5.00 per sandwich), but if I had an extra $20.00 laying around, that would be a hell of a way to spend it, lol! Overall, I am glad my friend told me about this spot! Brandon was awesome, the donut ice cream sandwich was delicious, and I'm sure I will come back soon enough. I'm not down this way too often, but this is a spot that would be worth driving to! It was great!

Ice cream in a donut... you have to try it. They also have waffle ice cream sandwiches. Did I mention they were heated? You get a wonderful mix of warmth and cold. My favorite flavor was cookie monster. I just love the colors and it adds more to the experience. You can also get two flavors in a dough melt so if you can't choose between two flavors, you can get both. The owners and staff were very friendly and knowledgable. If you're craving sugar, you know where to go.
Tried the concha stuffed with horchata ice cream, this was the best ever!!! We love going to Novel!
The best ice cream in Phoenix. No questions. The Leslie Knope with butter pecan ice cream is the best thing you'll ever eat. Don't be intimidated by the line, good things are worth the wait!

Guys. I'm a ice-cream lover, a foodie and totally head over heels for Novel. I was a Phoenix resident for 10 years. So I've had all of the usual staples.. melt, baked bear and sweet republic. This place tastes amazing in comparison its so dense, flavorful and most of all well thought out. Even tho I recently moved away I will make this a for sure go to stop for myself and others looking for a ice-cream spot. Huge shout out to Brandon what a super cool, passionate and creative dude! He is super proud of his shop and that is what truly sells this spot. You have nothing to lose! Check it out! Bet the flavors won't be the same! Just keep on keeping on your a real Novel idea!

I will start by saying I'm not a big donut person, and I do like icecream but I have to be in the mood for it. I'd been wanting to try this place for some time though and finally took my gf for her bday in lieu of bday cake. Needless to say she was THRILLED as she IS a donut person! Novel did not disappoint. We met one of the owners and he was very personable. The icecream was incredible! And of course the donut was crazy amazing. Not too sweet, not too much, just soft and warm enough, wow. I did not expect to like it as much as I did. My gf was out of this world and we'll definitely be returning and taking our family and friends when they come visit us from out of town. Novel, you've got yourself some new foodie fans! P.s I am a big fan of chocolate, good chocolate and their chocolate icecream is perfection. Just try it.

World class ice cream. I used to be jealous of my Portland friends because they had Salt and Straw. I think Novel is in that same league. This place is amazing!!! If you go please try the Cookie Monster ice cream ! You can get it with as a waffle sandwich or as a donut sandwich or even just in a cup with a little piece of cookie waffle on the side! All their ice cream is homemade! I love this place so much! Must

This place is a gem in phoenix! My coworkers and I heard rave reviews about this place during happy hour and knew we needed to pay it a visit before leaving. The place is very small but it definitely takes customers down memory lane with the decorations and beverages. They make donut icecream sandwiches and i highly recommend trying it! or the flight of ice creams if youre indecisive but the owner is also super generous and will let you sample everything if youre willing to ask (i was and i tried EVERY flavor. #noshame). The donut icecream sandwiches are also toasted a little so it's warm when you take a bite! All the flavors are amazing but the Madagascar vanilla, chocolate and strawberry are rich and really takes basic to a whole new level! I ended up choosing the lavender vanilla and it was light and delightful.

Oh man... if you haven't been here before you are missing out! The ice cream is made in small batches and it is amazing! I was told that super creamy ice cream is their goal and boy did they succeeded in that. Brandon the owner is super friendly and very welcoming when you walk in. He is clearly super passionate about the ice cream he serves and is a huge advocate of "try every flavor you want"! I tried 4 flavors even though I already knew exactly which one I wanted before I came in. I tried cookie monster, honey lavender, fat elvis, and the maple bourbon one. The cookie monster is basically a cookies and cream dyed blue but tastes a million times better. Cookie monster tastes a lot fattier than your normal cookies and cream (this is a good thing), is super creamy (since they blend most of the cookie into the ice cream), and it will dye your mouth blue (my bf got it and his lips and mouth were blue LOL). Fat elvis had a good flavor to it. I honestly can't remember the flavor profile because I was a little distracted by the bacon in it. I love bacon but it was chew and that was off putting for me. I probably would have preferred if the bacon was added after on top so that it was still crunchy. Together, the flavors were great but if you don't like chew bacon this probably won't be for you. Maple bourbon sounded like it would be really sweet to me but it had a nice non-overpowering maple bourbon flavor that was just the right amount of sweetness. I kind of got that as the general theme for the sweetness level of all the ice cream here. Just right. The honey lavender was what I came here for. It's not often that I have been able to find lavender flavored ice cream on a menu and it's not often that I have been able to find it on a menu that won't charge me a ridiculous amount of money to have it. I was trying to not get really excited on my way here just in case the honey lavender ice cream was a huge let down... It seriously made this hot day perfect. The lavender flavor was present and floral but didn't taste like I was eating potpourri. There was very few pieces of actual lavender flowers in the ice cream. This flavor was so light and airy. It was nice and it paired really well with the gingerbread waffle cone cookie piece they put in the cup with the ice cream (nice signature touch by the way! I love it.) I plan to come back to try the donut melt, which is ice cream stuffed inside of a glazed donut. They heat the outside and cool the inside of the donut and then stuff it with ice cream. I didn't have enough room in my stomach to get that and I feel like I completely miss out.

Best ice cream in Phoenix. I love how creative they are. I can appreciate basic flavors like vanilla and chocolate but let me tell you their vanilla ice cream is not basic and hands down the best I've ever had. The staff told me it was voted number one in some type of competition and they import a specific ingredient from Madagascar to make it. How cool!!!!

Wow. I had seen the reviews online and when we got there the wait line was impressive. Customer service was top notch and the product was excellent too. Parking can be a bit crazy, but still give it a shot. Novel is definitely worth it.

There are few experiences comparable to being handed a warm, sliced doughnut with artisan ice cream packed in between the two sides. The warmth that spreads from the doughnut to your hand and up your arm is surpassed when you begin to devour the treat and you are granted a dawning realization that this is how doughnuts and ice cream were meant to be consumed all along. Customer service is absolutely fantastic--pretty sure they somehow recognized me and my spouse even though it had been over 10 months since we were last there and we were wearing masks--or at least they're really good at reading body language and they knew we'd been there before. They greeted us like old friends. It's obvious they love what they do and we love them for it. Anytime we find ourselves in the downtown area for a date night, we try to cap off our evening by hitting up Novel. Do yourself a favor and try them! Finally, Grand gets pretty busy on Saturday nights because the car crowd has started to parade around and check each other's heavily modified rides. We parked on Polk and made the short walk along Grand. I'd say you're probably better off finding a similar close side street instead of trying to drive along Grand and park right at Novel.

So, there's a place in California where I first tried and got addicted to ice cream stuffed donuts. So when I found Novel I had to go, and Novel is sooo much better. Honestly how can you go wrong with a doughnut stuffed with ice cream. And on top of that their ice cream is amazing! The owners of this small shop are wonderful! They let us try the ice cream before placing our order. I went with a very simple vanilla ice cream with Oreo. Seriously some of the best dessert I've had in awhile.. you will NOT be disappointed!

You must go to this place! There are 12 different flavors of ice cream! Their specialty is to make a ice cream sandwich using a warm donut. I got a scoop of the German chocolate cake ice cream and scoop of the snickerdoodle cupcake with Cinnamon Toast Crunch topping in a donut! Counting down the days until I go back to try something else!

Just discovered this place on yelp and saw the five stars. It deserves it. I got the dough melt with sweet cream and oreo topping, my wife got the dough melt with chocolate and cocoa pebbles as a topping, her siblings got a cookie monster on a waffle cone, chocolate and Madagascar vanilla in a cup, and strawberry and lemon blueberry sorbet in a cup. We loved everything. So creamy and delicious. That dough melt is just fantastic. Super friendly staff that take pride in their craft. We will be back to try the Leslie Knope! Parks and Rec reference is always a win!
Awesome place makes me feel like I'm a kid again getting ice cream. Yum. Every flavor I try is good. Love the Cookie Monster flavor.

Can you say Delish? OMG Brandon you are definitely doing the damn thing! Best icecream I've tasted yet and I love the fact that you have a nut allergy protocol. Thanks for taking my health condition serious

My family loves this place! Literally the best ice cream and donuts anywhere in the state. The owner is so fudging cool, when you can catch him, he really enjoys taking to his customers and finding out all about your foodie commonalities lol He told me all about his journey to see his business come to life and it was amazing to know how much pride and effort he takes to give us the absolute best of the best! Seriously though don't hesitate to stop by, I know the shop is a little tight and it can be super duper busy most nights but I promise it's like so worth it (:

I had to stop here after seeing all the hype from Yelp and Buzzfeed recently and let me tell you...it's soooo worth it! They were recognized as being one of the best ice cream sandwich shops in the country! They offer sandwiches on waffles and warm glazed donuts yummmmmm. The ice cream itself is amazing too and it seems like they always have unique flavors! I tried the waffle sandwich with cookie monster ice cream topped with Oreos and I've been thinking about it ever since! My boyfriend and his friend got the donut sandwiches and they were both in love too lol. Highly recommend checking this place out!!!

This might be the holy grail of dessert places. Artisan ice cream in flavors like horchata cinnamon, Cookie Monster, lemon basil sorbet, and honey lavender. Fun toppings from sprinkles to cereal. A ridiculously delicious concoction called a dough melt (take the above ice cream, add the above toppings, and stuff it into a glazed donut bun). Plus, they're open until 1am on Fridays and Saturday. To top it all off, the owners are so incredibly nice. What more could you want? A waffle? Oh, they make those too.

This place was delicious. My brother and I went and got raspberry lemon donut, with fruity pebbles. Sooo good. And we got a scoop of cafe con leche. Honestly it tasted so good. My first impression was holy this is really good. A small place but we got there on time because then it go super busy. If you are ever downtown you NEED to go. We will be back soon!!

Novel moving in less than half a mile from my apartment is one of the best things to happen my whole life. The owners are always so friendly and welcoming! They allow unlimited taste testing, which is perfect for my indecisive self. There are always new and exciting flavors, along with some basics (although the basics are never basic --they are especially delicious). Tonight I sampled the strawberry smiggles -- it had real whipped strawberries, marshmallows, topped with Trix, and possssibly something else mixed in I'm missing. I usually don't like strawberry ice cream but this one was SO GOOD. You can telll their ice cream is made in house, no doubt. I paired it with a scoop of chocolate & topped with marshmallow mateys -- unparalleled !! 10/10 would recommend this place.

My kid loves this place. On a hot day there is nothing better than an ice cream donut sandwich. The donuts are warm and fresh, and the Cookie Monster ice cream is amazingly good. Be prepared to look like you ate a smurf for a few days. I've never seen an ice cream that is so blue! Great vibe, kind staff, and fun treats!

this place is AMAZING!!! THEY ARE OPEN DURING COVID-19 OUTBREAK ! - (seating inside is closed and they are taking all precautions) go check them out! they have such unique flavors and they stuff donuts with their amazing homemade unique ice cream flavors! my family took me here tonight for my first time and i received the absolute best customer service i have ever received in my life. he described each flavor ice cream to me thoroughly and gave tasters. he also thanked us several times for our business and told us how grateful they are to have us there. i have never been anywhere that gave such amazing customer service and was so passionate about their job. this LOCALLY OWNED SMALL BUSINESS DESERVES YOUR BUSINESS .. AND IT IS BEYOND WORTH IT! check them out!!!! :) thank you for such an incredible experience tonight!
Omg this ice cream was so amazing ... I mean it's the best I've ever had ¼ super creamy and full of flavor , I had the cookies and cream and strawberry.. this will be my number one spot ..
AMAZING ice cream, funky area of town, owner was super friendly and helpful...and come on, cereal ice cream donut sandwiches?!!! YES PLEASE!
Really cute hole in the wall type spot. With a little line of course but it moves quickly and the treats are worth it. Friendly staff and a perfect pass through late night treat.

We happened upon this place by chance and it was probably the best luck I've had all week. This place is UNREAL. The ice cream itself is standalone (honey lavender, tangerine, etc), but paired with their famous "dough melt" (a donut ice cream sandwich) made it even better. And toppings were cereals like cookie crisp, lucky charms marshmallows, Reese's puffs... Plus it's in a really cool area of Phoenix! The little plaza it's in is the cutest place. If you're in the area you HAVE to go. It's so worth it.

Was looking for a local ice cream establishment. I looked through yelp to find an establishment worthy of this indulgence. I stumbled across Novel Ice Cream. Located in a very unassuming location I was greeted by the owner and a couple workers who were all very friendly. The owner was very passionate and proud of the donut and hand crafted ice cream they make. Apparently the donut has won awards along side the ice cream. Since it was a slow night It appeared to be ok to try Most of the flavors. I ended up with chocolate stuffed inside a warmed donut cut in half. It obviously was not part of my food program however when I'm Phoenix a donut stuffed with gourmet ice cream has no calories so I was ok. I strongly recommend paying this establishment a visit and trying the donut stuffed thing they make. It's pretty outstanding.
This place is delicious! Brandon, the owner is nice and attentive to his clients. The ice cream is delicious and the donut is exceptionally yummy. Highly recommend this place.

Best ice cream in town.......check. Amazing house made glazed donuts.....check. Wonderful owners....check. Lots of tasty toppings....check Put this all together and this hidden gem is going to be a favorite of mine and for ANY who gives it a try. After enjoying Father's Day with my great dad and entire family, I recommended we all try out Novel Ice Cream as my dad loves a cold treat. Who doesn't? With that said, we all (9) showed up at Novel and I must admit I was concerned. As us yelpers know, when you recommend a spot blindly you just hope your thoughts of the establishment are right on and thank the Lord, Novel Ice Cream was a huge hit. Upon entering, the owners (Brandon and Jennifer) were so darn friendly. Brandon gave us all the rundown and offered everyone as many tasting as needed in making our selections. It took me no time at all as I knew the Fat Elvis (PB, banana, and bacon) was the one for me. Okay, I can't lie, I had a scoop of the lavender and honey as well. Both amazing. After everyone received their ice cream, we headed outside to the patio (no seating inside) to enjoy our dessert. As I have already said, best dang ice cream not only have I ever had but my family too. Like my entire family!!!!! Mind you my father who is 70+ and considers himself a connoisseur of amazing ice cream kept telling me that it was the best ice cream he has ever eaten. He also continued to tell me what a great job I did at finding the place. Almost made me feel like a played a part in making the amazing stuff. Upon finishing my sweet treat and having to do my yelper job, I tried others treats as well. The glazed donut (nice and warm) with ice cream (Cookie Monster) slammed in the middle was awesome. The pistachio ice cream was the best I have had and I have tried a lot. Everything here was just great. Overall, this gem is a winner and you better hit the place up before everyone else knows about it. There is not a better joint in town for ice cream and better people serving it.

I can see the excitement of an ice cream stuffed donut, hey, it's why I visited this week. Sometimes the novelty of a food marriage is done well and sometimes it just doesn't work for *me. I feel like the donut took away from the awesome flavor of Novel's ice cream; however, the ice cream here stands on its own extremely well. We sampled five or six of the flavors and I ended up choosing cherry ice cream on a donut. The sample I tried was awesome, but after a few bites of the stuffed donut, I had a tough time tasting the ice cream. I ended up eating their delicious ice cream and scrapping the donut. I'd definitely come back for the ice cream, but I won't be ordering the donut next time. Now don't let my opinion stop you from trying their donut or waffle sandwiches, the combo just wasn't for me, but the ice cream was delicious on its own. The owners were super nice and are excited to offer delectable desserts to anyone with a few $ to spare! Happy Yelping Phoenix, eat more ice cream. :-)

Rosemary...in your ICE CREAM? YES! This place lives up to the hype. Not only is the ice cream incredibly delicious and inventive, you get treated like an old friend every time you walk through the door. Want to see passion? Get Brandon to tell you about his ice cream flavors. I just want someone to talk about me the way he talks about chocolate covered honeycombs. Best ice cream, best people, best hilarious social media updates. To us, it's totally worth driving half an hour one way for (and probably a lot further!).

Oh my lord, this ice cream is amazing!!! I tried the Elvis just because I had to and it was delicious. Then I started with a scoop of raspberry sorbet followed by a scoop of butter pecan. I usually cant finish my second scoop, but this scoop had me almost licking the bowl for the last drop. Super cute shop and the gal at the counter knew everything about the ice cream. From ingredients, to how its made to shop and owner info. She needs a raise!!!

This was by far the best donut ice cream sandwich on the planet The donut was light and complimented the fat Elvis Vanilla ice cream that was stuffed into the donut.......Heavenly!!! "Smack your mamma Delicious"

This place will blow your socks off. They're amazing and it's one of my favorites to go for a treat. It's an adorable store just perfect for ice cream. They have cool drinks to choose from.. but most importantly the ice cream is BOMB. Best ice cream in Phoenix and the customer service is hands down the best I've had at an ice cream shop period. And they're open super late. Definitely will be back again and again for a late treat. Ps they have doughnut & waffle ice cream sandwiches

Cute downtown location right off Grand Ave. I had heard a lot about this ice cream shop so I wanted to try it out. The shop is in a little cabin house type of building and I can probably say there is about 4 more business in separate little houses. Once you open the door you notice how small it is and probably has a max of 5-8 inside at a time. We were greeted as soon as we walked in and the guy serving the ice cream was very polite and explained to us the different options. He also told me that the ice cream was made by a vendor which really made great ice cream by batch. The Ice cream we decided was creamy and delicious and most definitely will return very soon!
Do you like ice cream? Donuts? Ice cream sandwiches made with donuts??? So delicious, great price, easy to-go window and friendly staff!

Unfortunately, by the .3 seconds that I took to inhale this awesome ice cream sandwich, I forgot to post a photo! I'm impressed, not only by the creative flavors, combinations, and doughnut with the sandwich.. I'm genuinely impressed that someone like myself that isn't a fan of sweets at all (I don't even eat my own birthday cake!) I've definitely grown an exception in the .3 seconds it took me to inhale this ice cream sandwich.. don't think about it, just trust me; you won't be disappointed. You need this in your life. Thanks novel!
Hands down some of the best ice cream in Phoenix. Staff are always so friendly and attentive. Love the unique flavors and combinations they have.

This place. Moment of silence for this place. Okay, I'm back. This place has managed to take my two favorite things: fluffy delicious donuts and sweet creamy ice cream, and merge them together for a delectable treat. I stumbled across this place and I've never made a better discovery. I sampled a few different flavors and they were all so good. They have a person who creates these amazing flavors and on their own they are so delicious but then paired with a homemade donut and a cereal topping is a combination done perfectly! You HAVE to try this place!

It was my first time here today. Kind of a scary drive and a ghetto area but the customer service was outstanding and professional. I tried a little bit of the bourbon, pineapple and lavender, all were really good and had a unique taste. I decided to go with the chocolate bc she said it tied for 1st place in the nation. I'll be coming back.

10/10 would recommend!!! It was great, probably my new favorite ice cream place in Arizona. The service was above and beyond; it really seemed like they genuinely cared about there impression on the people they served. Overall ice cream was great, service was great. Finally the ice cream stayed firm and didn't melt at all even in 104 degree weather. They were very knowledgeable about their Ice cream selection. And even tried to get to know us.

We passed by the sign for Novel and we were intrigued by the idea of ice cream stuffed donuts. I've enjoyed the Dough Melt (Cookie Monster stuffed in a warm glazed doughnut bun) and the Leslie Knope (waffle ice cream sandwich with Cookie Monster). I've also enjoyed pairing Cookie Monster with other flavors like Sweet Cream and Honey and Birthday Cake. The shop itself is small and cute with an outdoor patio area for you to sit and enjoy your ice cream. The owners and their staff are so friendly and welcoming!

Holy cow. Literally. Bless the cow whose milk made this ice cream. It's a tiny shop in one of a cluster of restored POW-camp cabins, so be prepared to be patient if it's a popular time. The ice cream is startlingly delicious, creamy, and creative. Being basic, I tried the bourbon caramel. It is fantastic. Take your dish and sit on the patio. Watch the sun set over the picturesque restored cottages. Watch the moon rise, if you're a night person. Get pizza across the street first, if you're hungry. The owner is super-nice, too. It's so cool meeting people who love what they do.
The ice cream sandwiches will change your life. I Looooooove the Cookie Monster and the lavender ice cream. So amazing.

Wow!! My husband and I were so impressed. This place is so cute. Loved the ambiance of the patio with the twinkle lights. We met the owner at the window and he took his time to explain the menu and tell us what the best flavors are. We got the dough melt, the Leslie Knope, and the indecision! LOVED every single flavor. Best ice cream we both have ever had. We will definitely bring our friends who visit here!!

Oh my effing God. Lol. This might be one of the best artesian ice creams and best glazed donuts I have ever had. The doughnut melt (which is a glazed donut with your choice of ice cream and toppings) has to be one of the best ones I've had. I had similar places in California and I was sad that there isn't one in Arizona that is similar to the taste, but this place is it. I usually get the glazed donut bun with, Cookie Monster ice cream, and Oreo toppings. Love at first bite. Not sure what else you can ask for. The owners are incredibly nice too. Note: they have waffles and are opened til 1am on Friday's and Saturday's so you can grab a late night bite :)
Great place with great service. It's small and there's a line - but they kill it quick and the next thing you know you're on your way out. Great service - great product. Definitely coming back.

Oh my goodness! The service was incredible (especially for first timers) and the ice cream was damn good. If it looks like there's too many options to choose from, I definitely recommend The Indecision (5 options at once, y'all).
Good unique flavors with lots of sampling.

Oh man!! This place is SO good! It's a little ice cream shop near downtown phx. It's a cute cozy place. The owner, Brandon, is super nice, and very helpful. You could tell he loved his shop. He gave my boyfriend and I suggestions, and told us what exactly was in each flavor. There's eight total flavors, half is limited, while the other half their signature flavors. I had a limited flavor which was the Black Raspberry Cashew, boy do I tell you, it is the BEST ice cream I've had in awhile! I was contemplating on getting it in a warm glazed donut until the Leslie Knope (love the name by the way) caught my eye. It's a warm waffle sandwich. You also get a free topping with it, so I got the basic sprinkle (boring I know) but it was so good! Thinking about it now makes me wish I had one. My boyfriend had the Leslie Knope as well but with the Cookie Monster flavor (one of their signatures). That was also delicious! It is definitely a must try! You will not regret it!

I literally cannot stop laughing about this place. I mean, the sheer audacity of Brandon and Jenny Douglas to serve such unapologetically sinful desserts like this is just beyond comprehension. Warm donuts stuffed with ice cream? Waffle ice cream sandwiches? With cereal toppings? And a variety of glass bottled soda offerings? To those grossed out by this boldness, you might as well leave this review now. Me? I just had to see this for myself. After a soft opening in early March, I went to the Grand Opening Saturday night, appropriately enough the same weekend as Art Detour. Located on Grand Avenue & Fillmore in the same complex as ThirdSpace, Novel occupies the red building in back that has seen a number of concepts come and go over the years, but none with such an eye popping slogan out front as "Ice Cream Stuffed Donuts". Downtown Phoenix is certainly a friendly breeding ground for entrepreneurial experimentation, but could something this crazy actually work? Brandon and Jenny were delightful from the moment I walked in the door, and you can pick up on just how passionately devoted they are to their bold new concept. The ice cream flavors are made to their own specs, the donuts and waffles are made fresh in house, and they'll pretty much let you sample as many flavors as you want. With bold flavors like Bourbon Caramel Toffee Crunch, Cookie Monster, and Panna Cotta Cherry, as well as more familiar offerings like Butter Pecan, Madagascar Vanilla, and Mint. I counted 14 different flavor offerings this go around. If the ice cream and pastry combination wasn't crazy enough, did I mention toppings? From cereals? You've got options like Captain Crunch, Cookie Crisp, Fruity Pebbles, Fruit Loops and even Cocoa Puffs. I was craving a waffle this go around, so for me tonight would be a date with me and the Leslie Knope. And yes that is an entirely intentional reference to Amy Poehler's character on Parks & Rec. Two fresh made waffles with ice cream and a topping in the middle. My kryptonite of choice? Honey Lavender ice cream and Cinnamon Toast Crunch. Normally $5, tonight it was discounted at $3 for the grand opening (though I would've happily paid $5 for this magic). After a few minutes it was put together and placed in wax paper for sandwich style portability. The first bite had me filled with thoughts that I should maybe be remorseful for this obscene creation, but no, no I was not remorseful at all. Let's pretend calorie and cholesterol numbers don't count and I'll instead just tell you this is really good for you, and it will make you happy. Add Novel to the growing list of great restaurants dotting the landscape on Downtown's Grand Avenue food scene including Treehouse Bakery, Irma's Kitchen, and Barrio Cafe Gran Reserva. In addition to donuts and waffles stuffed with ice cream and toppings, they offer soda floats, traditional ice cream scoops on a waffle (or pretzel) cone, and even an ice cream flight of 5 flavors. And not a single item on the menu is more expensive than $8. Novel might leave you laughing about what you've just done to your diet or embarrassed to admit what you've eaten, but I think you'll find the mixed emotions worth the trouble. It may be early in Brandon and Jenny's fledgling concept, but from what I can see, they've hit on a winner.
Great service and great people. What else could you ask for. It took me a few extra minutes to find the location as it's tucked away in a parking lot.overall it was totally worth it.

Wow. Let's start with the service.. We just happened upon this place after seeing the positive Yelp reviews. The owner welcomed us like old friends! He spent time with us discussing the many flavors and ingredients. I don't think there is a wrong choice, they were all so delicious. Throw ice cream in a doughnut and I'm sold. Amazing place, we will be back. 10/10 would eat again

My family and I were visiting from out of town and had a little sweet tooth after dinner. We browsed through Yelp and found this hidden gem, nestled among a few other brightly colored, tiny houses. We went up the little ramp and walked in to find a fairly modest interior- rainbow squares along with fun doodles plastered all over the walls and one case of ice cream with a row of toppings showcased in cute little labeled containers. The owners greeted us with a warm smile and graciously gave us the run down- we could try every flavor of ice cream before choosing one, pairing it with a free topping and choosing how we wanted it. We could do the traditional scoop or try one of their signature styles- a donut ice cream sandwich or a waffle ice cream sandwich! He explained that both their ice cream and donut chefs were widely acclaimed for their desserts. While they have only been open for about 6 months, they have worked for two years to accrue the best ingredients, best flavors and best chefs to create the BEST product. I ordered a single scoop of the Fat Elvis (peanut butter ice cream with banana and bacon bits) with waffle cone pieces on top and my boyfriend ordered the donut ice cream sandwich with the Nutella ice cream. After the first bite, we agreed- this is hands down the BEST ice cream we've ever had. The ice cream itself is very creamy and packed with flavor. And the donut combination was to die for!!!

So happy to see Novel is doing so well! The first time I came here it was fairly new and with only a few reviews on Yelp. Decided to test the waters since it was the closest place that sold doughnut icecream sandwiches (oh and waffle icecream sandwiches)...well...I actually ended up getting a one scoop in a cone without any toppings because I really just loved the flavor of the icecream itself. I believe the flavor was lavender honey! Delicious and not overbearing at all. A friendly couple owns this shop and one of the owners informed me that their icecream is made locally by an awesome chef. He let me sample my heart out until I fell in love with the honey lavender - which is made with real lavender flakes and none of the extract crap - you can taste the difference. Overall, wonderful experience, nice crowd, and a small cute shop with lots of icecream to choose from!
This treat is extraordinarily delicious! The fresh warm donut sliced the filled with delicious homemade ice cream is amazing. This is a must try...
If you're from Cali and love Afters ice cream, this is a great place to get your fix! The dough melt was divine
Amazing! Go for the special donut sandwich. Hands down the best ice cream experience I've had, and I'm an ice cream snob.

Don't miss this place if you're in downtown Phoenix! They have delicious house made ice cream with unique rotating flavors. I had a double with taro and honey lavender. Both flavors were uniquely tasty! Excited to go back and try the other varieties, the customer service is outstanding! You can tell they truly value their customers.

It's a nice area and a comfortable place to spend time in. The donuts and ice cream were amazing. Brandon (the owner) was way nice and personable. They don't give you a hassle for wanting to try different flavors and even encourage you to get the flavors you will enjoy most! We're still working on pitching him to come out to Utah:) PS - the dating culture combined with a large student population that also doesn't drink creates a perfect market for a place like this

Great ice cream, great donuts. They give you the option to add toppings into your ice cream. Staff is very informative and let you try as many flavors you want. Location is kinda hidden in a cool lot with a few other small businesses.
Yummy yummy ice cream! And super friendly service! Not too heavy and not overly sweet! Bringing my daughters next time for sure!

I am a huge ice cream fan and it's my go to when I want to splurge. This place has amazing ice cream with very unique flavors. The gentleman working told us that the creator of the flavors was one of the most decorated in the southwest. I didn't get their signature donut ice cream sandwich, but instead the classic waffle cone and two flavors. I got the honey lavender and fat Elvis, so good. You're in for a real treat.

Came from LA to visit a friend and found this cute Ice Cream shop on yelp. Such a good decision. The ice cream was so good and refreshing. Also the service was so great. Very friendly staff and they really know their ice cream! Definitely will be stopping by again before we head back home! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

Amazing ice cream! Quality ingredients and flavor. The donut ice cream sandwich is so good, when I first found this place I went 3 times in one week! I always recommend this place to my friends/family headed to the downtown area. It's such a cute little shop and the staff are always very friendly.

Hi guys! I am a phx local and let me tell you.... THIS PLACE IS INCREDIBLE. Their ice cream is delicious, creamy, hand made, and just overall literally the greatest ice cream I've ever had. The owner served us himself and with his lovely staff they made this ice cream and our experience one that we will never forget and one we will soon repeat! AND THEYRE OPEN UNTIL 1am FRIDAY AND SATURDAY !!
Phenomenal, tasted like cold ice cream The waffle cone tasted like waffles And the small house style surrounding makes it seem like a cool hipster village

Oh goodness where do I begin. So when we arrived there was a bit of the line & I could hear the people ordering talking to the employee asking about the types of options they had, but I couldn't hear all the info cause ya know, social distancing, so when we got to the window to order I was hesitant to ask because she might be sick of explaining the same damn thing over and over lol but noo she was so sweet and explained everything to us. Eventually ended up getting the Cookie Monster dough melt and OMG After each bite of it I was getting sadder and sadder, I DIDNT WANT IT TO BE OVER *insert hysterically crying face* the doughnut was warm and delicious as was the ice cream ugh loved it and the area was cute, nice little sitting area loved everything about it :)

I can see why this place has 5*! Brandon was very friendly and helpful. Visiting from NY, he let us try all the flavors if we wanted. He was patient and it didn't matter if there was a line behind us. He treated everyone equally and with respect. The ice cream and sorbet was BOMB! Would definitely come back for more and support Brandon next time I visit Arizona.

Best ice cream, ever. and we've tried them all - nationally and locally, from Jeni's (OH) to Graeter's (OH) to CoolHaus (LA) to Lotus Scoop (NYC) to every single place in Phoenix. We are die hard ice cream fanatics. The flavors at novel are truly NOVEL- super unique, creative and insanely amazing. Our favorites are honey lavender and Cookie Monster! Service here is incredible - Brandon the owner is friendly, kind, and generous. They even give free ice cream and treats to dogs! Our pup loves this place as much as we do! Love the donuts - if ever y'all did churro sandwiches, our great city of PHX would lose its mind.

The. Best. The. End. Kidding, Yelp makes me say more in order for the review to be 'recommended.' First, you get to try any and all flavors you want. They don't want to feeling guilty to keep asking for tastes, and do a great job of encouraging it. They only do small batch ice cream, so the flavors are constantly rotating. I won't say every ice cream was my cup of tea, but that's just fine since they let me taste until I find perfection. Price point is very fair, and the portion size is perfect-- it's small enough that you don't feel like a glutton, and big enough to be fully satisfied. I've been here three times now. I went for my first time on a Friday night, and loved it so much I had to take my roommate the very next day. I'll keep on coming back! Service, price, flavor, ambience-- every part of this place is five stars.

MUST TRY!!! I am not a dessert person at all and I went here reluctantly but I will go back willingly in the future. The ice cream was very good and the donut was very good and the combination of the two was AMAZING! I highly recommend this place. 11/10 stars!

Loved the style of the shop and how friendly the staff was. Great little spot to chill and eat donuts with ice cream. We tried butter pecan and Vanilla Bean both amazing. If you're in Phoenix great cool spot to check out, outside of downtown.

You Scream! I Scream! Well I now scream for NOVEL Ice Cream! Well I do for now and I know you will too. An amazing Ice Cream shop opened in downtown Phoenix. In the heart of the urban district filled with locally owned shops this yet tiny store can curb a sweet tooth craving. Today was my first time in as the store that is only 10 days old. Lucky me who lives a dairy free life style got the opportunity to taste the Tangerine Sorbet. Freshly made by a local maker this fruity sorbet has Vitamin A, Vitamin C, Vitamin E and some carrots. I have to say I am highly impressed with the overall taste. What is different to me about the flavoring is you can tell not only that it is fresh but the flavor is powerful. It is not an artificial taste. It actually tastes homemade. The sorbet is creamier than most sorbets which I am not use to. I have to say I actually prefer the creamier taste. I can't wait to come back and try other flavors. My coworker the daring one was sold on the Bourbon Caramel Toffee Crunch. Even though the super friendly owner Brandon had offered to allow my party to sample other flavors she ended up choosing the most popular one. One she had topped with "sprinkles." Not on a cone or a cup in a doughnut. Yep! a warm doughnut that did not even melt the ice cream. It melted in her mouth not in her hand. Let's say we did not talk for a while as her new favor treat consumed our time. (Laugh out Loud) I am excited to come back to explore another flavor. Brandon mentioned they are working to add more nondairy flavors. However, the items not free from dairy are creative and look so good. The toppings they offer are unique. They offer cereal. That's right the delicious cereal choices you chose as a kid can be topped on your ice cream like Fruit Pepples or Coco Puffs. This shop is not a dine in location but the perfect place to drop in to get a scoop to go while walking the local shops in downtown Phoenix.
The cutest little shop with some of the best and most power-packed flavors I have ever had! Would recommend to anyone!!!

5 stars all around!! This place has been bookmarked for some time now and I'm so glad I finally got the chance to try this awesome place out! One spontaneous night. My friend and I were craving for something sweet. We were all the way in the West valley but said hey why not take a drive for some what could be awesome ice cream. And guess what, the drive was worth it and the ice cream was definitely worth it!! There was two people in front of us trying out different flavors. As we waited the guy at the cash register greeted us and welcomed us. He also recommended a few things and made suggestions. We looked at the menu and anticipated the taste trials! Our turn was up and we weren't rushed at all and were even recommended to try as many flavors as we wished! Brandon (The owner) behind the counter was very nice. I finally decided on the 'indecision' (5 scoops of ice cream) with a topping of choice! It was so hard for me to choose and Brandon even made it harder but also so kind to let me choose a topping of choice AND a syrup drizzle of choice. It was a hard decision but I finally went with chocolate, strawberry, butter pecan, bourbon caramel toffee, and Cookie Monster! Cookie Monster was my most fave! My friend went with the dough melt with the fat Elvis ice cream as her choice and she highly enjoyed it also! We're both excited to come back real real soon!!

Such a sweet spot in the middle of the desert. If you are driving by you'd have a hard time seeing it. The great thing about Phoenix is meeting new people and hearing about cool off the wall places you'd never probably find on your own. I love the feel right when you walk in and the cute art on the walls. You're always welcomed the second you open the door and can always sample the flavors to get your perfect treat. You can get a sugar, waffle or regular cone, a warm donut filled icecream, Waffle....bowl . It's endless. There's plenty of outdoor seating and if you're like me you can walk down Grand and check out all the other cool art. I heard a while back that the houses that hold these little shops held pow's in the war, but still researching to see if that's true. That would be a cool piece of history. Do yourself a favor and check this place out. Today I had peanut butter icecream with bacon in it and it was amazing. Yum!

Great little ice cream shop! On our last day in Phoenix I was looking for some ice cream. Novel had great reviews so we went. The reviews were right. The ice cream was delicious and the service was awesome. We were greeted by a friendly employee who promptly took our order. My husband and son got the donut ice cream sandwiches. They were great. My other son loved the Cookie Monster ice cream. I got a double scoop in a yummy waffle cone. I definitely recommend this shop!

Stopped by on a late Friday night with a friend as we were craving a yummy dessert. We were happy that they stay open pretty late on the weekends, but we were worried they weren't going to have any vegan options. When we got there it was pretty busy which is a good sign lol. There was a man and a woman working there at the moment I would say owners? They were both really friendly, super helpful, and happy! They had 2 vegan friendly sorbets, unfortunately the vegan sprinkle cookie is only available on weekends. However, the young lady offered us a coco whip topping to spruce up our sorbet and omg it was super delicious!!! She also suggested sprinkles which I could not resist lol. I am so glad she offered us the suggestion, since we were looking for a little bit of indulgence that night haha. We ended up going with the raspberry sorbet with a coco (coconut based) whip topping and a dash of sprinkles. It was a great way to sit down, indulge and have girl talk on a summer night. I will most definitely come back here next time on a weekend I'm curious about the sprinkle cookie I've heard so much rave about. This ice cream shop is a must stop and if you're vegan don't let that stop you, they will welcome you with open arms and ice cream scoopers ready to satisfy your tastebuds!
Cookie Monster and the Madagascar Vanilla are the real deal
Amazing service. Plus they gave us water considering how hot it was outside. Ice cream was delicious.

This place is a hidden gem! They had fun unique kinds of ice cream and had a doughnut/ice cream sandwich that was unbelievable! On top of that, the owner was thanking every single customer walking in! Talk about amazing customer service! Thank you Novel Ice Cream! I'm going to tell all of my family and friends about you guys!
This place has the best ice cream!!! I got my ice cream in between this delicious waffle that was all warm and perfectly crunchy outside. I almost cried when I bit into it!

Got the Cookie Monster flavor for my waffle ice cream sandwich after trying a few of the amazing flavors of ice cream they have. There's also a cooler full of different kinds of bottled sodas like Dr. Pepper, root beer, and others I've never seen before but was tempted to try. I will be back!
Loved the combo of ice cream and donut. Wasn't very sweet at all. Will be coming back.

Literally the best ice cream I have ever had. Not to mention the customer service, the people that run this place are the only thing cooler than their ice cream. Don't be afraid to put it on the doughnut, it's so sinfully delicious you'll need to make it too mass on Sunday morning to repent. If I could give you guys ten million stars I would!

Wow! Loved every bite of this super fun ice cream stuffed donut, as well as meeting the enthusiastic and very sweet (pun intended) owners. The bourbon and chocolate ice creams were both outstanding. Might be back tomorrow. Wish I was kidding.
I love the different flavors they offer... love the staff , they are helpful with their suggestions really polite and just super awesome
I think we might be back! "Ice cream donuts from Heaven" says thirteen-year-old Braeden

So this starts up with me wanting tacos late Saturday night around 11 PM we went to go eat tacos and they sucked. So I looked up ice cream places near me Now coming back home from California I had this amazing ice cream place called Afters and I had been craving a good quality ice cream that was really local. And having experience a local spot back home in California I wanted something really local here to Arizona, so this place comes up. After the disappointment of eating tacos that weren't that good we decided to come at 11:30 at night. Parking was fairly good and we had to walk a little bit but it was fine because we were still full. The gentlemen that greeted us was super nice! I don't remember his name. He asked my hubby and I if we had come here before so we said no, he gave us the run down which was much appreciated! He let us try the amazing ice cream flavors I tried the honey lavender twice because I couldn't make up whether I had liked it or not. (Plot twist I loved it) I ended up getting the Leslie and honey lavender ice cream with Oreo topping (super delicious) Besides the point that this ice cream is freakin delicious he said "if you don't like it make sure to come back in and we'll get you something better that you like, I want to make sure you're happy." I really appreciated that as a customer Delicious and interesting ice cream concepts Even better customer service We'll definitely be coming back!

i was in town for a work conference in downtown phoenix. i had a break and needed to calm my sweet tooth so i whipped out my yelp app out in search of the best ranked ice cream. i didn't have a car so i walked here, which i probably wouldn't recommend as some areas were questionable but once i got there i was fine and it was worth the trek. i found novel ice cream is situated in a little strip of tiny shacks with a little outdoor seating area. there is a pretty good selection of ice creams. i wanted the cookie monster which was basically ice cream with cookies but dyed bright blue! i thank the servers who told me it would definitely stain my lips/teeth and i had to pass because that would not be good to go back into work like that haha. i opted for a basic chocolate/vanilla combo in a donut. it was to die for. i wish i could have one more bite. like. right. now.
Best Ice cream in town! Great service and even better ice cream. Do yourself a favor and order the dough melt you won't regret it!

THE BEST CUSTOMER SERVICE they were so friendly and knowledgeable. 3 stars for the ice cream: Cereal as toppings and unique flavors like honey lavender and bourbon caramel toffee crunch. The ladies next to me tried the Cookie Monster and it made their mouth blue. I sampled the honey lavender. Not a strong lavender or honey flavor. I ended up going with the frosted sugar cookie in the donut with Cinnamon Toast Crunch. I appreciated the unique flavors but nothing wowed me. The ice cream donut sandwich I got was so sweet I couldn't finish it. I might go back to give it another try. I might have gotten the wrong flavor.
The perfect little ice cream shop. I love how close I am to novel but people come from all over just to get their ice cream!

Such a fun way to eat the BEST ice cream in Phoenix! Their ice cream is like a finely aged wine and totally satisfying. Staff are super friendly and helpful when those decisions are so hard to make! They take care of our 4-legged girl too!
This place was seriously so awesome staff is SO NICE and the donuts are heavenly!! Will definitely be returning!!

A funny thing happened: I had a dream, Of a tiny little building, That made delicious ice cream. Then the guy behind the counter, In that little hut, Took the ice cream and placed it, Between a glazed dough-nut. As I ate the ice cream sandwich, Unlike any other, I had a crazy realization, This was no dream, brother! The place is Novel Ice Cream, It will rock your world. The perfect place to end the night, Get dat chocolate-swirl.
Their ice-cream is so good. Coming with all kind of interesting flavors and keep updating!

Loved this place ! They had so many good flavors that it was very difficult to choose one. I ended up doing a donut with vanilla and the crunch berries it was so good !! Their pecan ice cream was also very delicious. They are not overly sweet with a great creamy consistency. The donut was also not too sweet so it paired well with the ice cream. Will be going back to try another one for sure !!! The place was also very cute and the staff was super friendly and answer all my questions when asking what was all in the flavor. Loved it !

Great little ice cream spot! Customer service and even better ice cream. The flavors, even the basic flavors, were well executed and I experienced a flavor explosion with every bite. They source local products for the ice cream. The glazed donut was moist and complimented the ice cream well. The ice cream is award winning and the donuts are made especially for the shop. Doesn't get any better than this local tasty gem! The donut sandwich process: 1-choose an ice cream flavor 2-roll it in a cereal as a topping or choose a sauce to drizzle ;caramel or chocolate) 3-place the cereal/sauce covered ice cream in between the sliced donut 4-enjoy!

The ice cream is amazing and affordable for me and my boys. Mom and kid approved! Friendly staff and detailed of the flavors. Flavors constantly change. So if you go tomorrow and get strawberry shortcake, they may not have the following week. However, they for sure will have another new delicious flavor you will fall in love with!
It is so good I loved the warm donuts. I will recommend this place who loves ice cream and donuts together !!!
Amazing!!! Just amazing!!! Must have, a must try! The the shop is small and packed. You are given the option of trying any ice cream before purchasing. Very happy and super content.
Ommmgee the best ice cream store in Phoenix!!! I got the Leslie Knope with carrot cake ice cream and it was BOMB!! We will be back!!

The most Gucci donut ice cream sandwich to eat during a quarantine run. The Oreo mint ice cream is so good wolf'ed it down and proceeded to run back home as fast as I can to take a massive deuce from my dairy intolerance. Worth it. No regrets.

OMG, OMG, OMG - this place just opened about 8 months ago - two brothers running the place are really nice and the ice cream is to die for! Better than the best I've cream shop we love in Santa Cruz, CA! Our college son recommended and it's definitely worth it, if your in the area (and even if you have to go out of your way to get there). Really small shop in the middle of nowhere, but I'm betting they will grow and expand!

OMG! I can't believe I forgot to write this review. Novel Ice Cream has completely changed the dessert game. Thanks to the collab that Yelp did with Buzzfeed last month, I stumbled across this hot new business. I came in with two of my closest friends, and let's just say we were NOT disappointed. We waited quite awhile before it was our turn to order. Since their location is quite small, we had to wait outside. Though we weren't mad in the slightest! I mean what do you expect, it is THE best ice cream sandwich in the state of Arizona - the hype is real, people! The business owner felt bad for our long wait time, and graciously thanked us for our patience. He did everything right. He gave us suggestions, he was patient, kind, and gave us our fair turn in line. I truly wish this man the best of success! I ended up ordering the toasted almond ice cream smashed between two waffle pieces. This wouldn't typically be my go-to choice but.... WOW! It was AMAZING in every way. My two friends were completely satisfied with what they ordered, as well! I'm not a doughnut person at all, but after trying theirs my opinion changed. I hope I've talked this place up enough for you to give it a try. Believe me when I say it was well worth every calorie, and one of the most satisfying desserts I've ever had. Thank you, Novel. I will be back again, and again, and again!

Probably in the top 5 things I have ever put in my mouth. The woman who took our order was super nice and helpful and let us sample whatever we wanted. I got the ice cream sandwich in a doughnut bun and it was everything. The doughnut was warm and the ice cream (the flavor was called Lil Sebastian) was delicious. My boyfriend got the Leslie Knope (waffle sandwich) with Cookie Monster ice cream and judging by the complete silence while he was eating it, it was another winner.

Delicious small batch ice cream. Adorable and hip location. Super friendly owner and staff. Husband got the tres leches and I got the Cookie Monster in a warm doughnut. I was warned it would turn my mouth blue, and all I can say is it was worth every bite!!!! The warmth of the soft donut and the cool of the ice cream make for a dreamy melt in your mouth combo. Prices are reasonable considering its artisan ice cream which is usually priced at $5/scoop and upward. Loved it! Will definitely come for the dough melt!!!

Yum!!! Cool local business with nice husband and wife owners alert! Is that an alert? It should be. They change their flavors often and offer 12 flavors at a time. You can have a warm glazed donut ice cream sandwich or a Leslie Knope waffle sandwich! There are other delish options too like fancy cones or a less fancy cup. Pretty sure Novel is hitting all of my favorite things in the world, parks and rec, supporting the local economy and ice cream treats! It is located behind thirdspace in a cute little tiny house community of shops. The inside is hand painted with cute unicorns and ice creams. I can't wait to visit again to see what new exciting flavors they have!

Seriously my favorite ice cream place in all of Phoenix! The owner is incredibly friendly! Novel has the same affect as Chick-fil-A on a Sunday. I always find myself wanting it on a Monday. The ice cream donut gives me life. Great for a hot night in Phoenix. Great for a cold night in Phoenix. Just great is what I'm trying to get too!

Oh. My. Gosh. This place you guys is next level! The staff there was incredibly nice and when we went there was no one there so we had a chance to literally try ALL the flavors. SO GOOD. We were able to split two flavors on their amazingly soft and warm home made doughnuts. I got Bourbon Toffee with the Honey Lavender, my sis got Cookie Monster and their Madagascar Vanilla Bean (she said that she never gets vanilla because it tends to be boring but NOT this one, there was a reason why it had won so many awards), and my friend got Butter Pecan. I am not kidding when I say we were literally dying is was sooooooo awesome!! Go out of your way and try this place!
Mmmmmm. Just mmmmmm. Samples for the asking and you still won't be able to make up your mind! And then you need to pick what container you want it in! Edible is best. Just saying.
Interesting delicious flavors. My daughter's favorite was lavender honey. Truly interesting location. Everyone was friendly. It was a nice experience.

When you see over 700 five stars reviews , it would make you wonder why you haven't been there. Stopped by tonight, and absolutely agreed with five stars. Small hidden place off of the grand Avenue. So happy to tried them. Love it.

My wife and I seriously loved it here! The outside reminds me of a big backyard that you just want to hang out at! I'm sure it gets super fun when it's a Friday or Saturday night!!! But let's get down to the ice cream. The ice cream donut sandwich concept is seriously godsend. While I've had it in New York, Vegas, and California, it is just as amazing every time! And the fact that they serve it with the donut warmed up is even more amazing!! My wife got the Cookie Monster ice cream donut sandwich and I had the caramel toffee flavor ice cream with a topping of Cookie Crisp cereal. Wow. Just wow. Prices are very fair as well! I can't even imagine how busy this place gets but we loved it and will definitely be back. They are super friendly and it's just a fun atmosphere!
Really unique and tasty ice cream. Doughnut ice cream is the best. Recomend 100% Great convenient location close to Downtown.
I love their ice cream. Seriously, I'll always be a fan. When can I get pear blue cheese? :)

Owner could not have been nicer and more friendly. There's a reason this place has five stars ... you will not find a better ice cream place in the state of Arizona. We were visiting from Los Angeles, and truth is this place would make profits anywhere in the United States. Highly recommend this spot to any true ice cream aficionados.
Icecream is fantastic love the lavendar icecraem service is great very friendly staff

I walked in was greeting by the most friendly staff ever. These guys and girl are awesome. Just the service made me want to comeback already. I told him I had eaten a doughnut sandwich in Cali but have never found one in az so I ordered the Cookie Monster doughnut sandwich, (same I had in cali) and I actually think that Novels sandwich is way better! Was so good and will be back forever !

My husband found this lil gem on Instagram and we decided to give it a try. I'm a huge ice cream lover and know what I like. This was AMAZING!!! So creamy and the flavors we tried were delish. Me and my daughter got the cookie monster and hubby got the vanilla in a donut. Parking kinda sucks but worth the lil walk we took. We will def be back. The owner was very nice and welcoming.

This place, and the people who own it, are awesome. Good vibes and great ice cream. We got two dough melts, one with cookie monster ice cream+ fruity pebbles and one with fat elvis+coco puffs, and a single scoop of honey lavender. Everything was insanely delicious The owners were telling us how every batch is hand made with real ingredients, the honey lavender has real honey and real lavender, and how they take care to make sure they are serving quality items. They were very friendly and personable, we are excited to come back again. You can sample any of the flavors and they are excited to tell you all about what's in it and why they like it. I can't give you a flavor suggestion because they were all too good to pick from. 5 stars!

This place is too cute! We met the owners while we were there too. They've only been open 6 weeks, but word of their store has definitely gone out. They have some innovative flavors. I recommend trying the Honey Lavender ice cream with Cinnamon Toast Crunch wedged between a glazed donut. If you want innovative ice cream ideas, definitely come here!

My husband and I went to visit there one night and kids were not in town so we decided to try something new. We saw the reviews everything was good we went there customer service was amazing and very hospitable very helpful even though it was almost 1 in the morning and they had a really good turnaround time as far as getting us the ice cream we tried the dough melt out. I also tried some of their cucumber lime sorbet which was mind blowing it was really good I highly recommend
Just adding to the great reviews. 11/10 recommend. Good people. Good ice cream. Good times. Outdoor cats.

Just finished a delicious treat here. Me and my husband were first timers and the young man there was so kind and gave us knowledge of the flavors and the business. It was nice. We definitely recommend. Don't be discouraged at first glance it's really great here and super friendly.

I don't know who was smiling harder, me or the gal who greeted me as I walked in! I have a real sweet tooth and seeing an ice cream shop with 5 stars?! HAD TO GO! And I was not disappointed! Immediately as we walked in, I was greeted enthusiastically and asked if I've ever been here. And sold on their doughnut of course. The cool thing is you get to try every single flavor, and they are SUPER knowledgeable with what's in each one and how it'a made. What I appreciated most was there wasn't a lot of asking questions or waiting around for me to pick, both gals took the time to really conversate and intertwine every flavor profile into the conversation. Literally, my favorite ice cream place so far - tastes great but the people make the experience even BETTER!

Okay so I'm not one to normally post reviews but OH MAN THIS PLACE!!!!! I've had their ice cream twice. The first time my roommate brought me home just a cup of strawberry ice cream. It was probably the best strawberry ice cream I've had! The second time, I went to the ice cream shop. It is in a cute little hidden village of shops. When we first walked in we were greeted immediately by the nice owners! They let us try all the flavors we wanted. I tried the Fat Elvis (peanut butter ice cream w/ caramelized bananas and bacon). It was delicious. I also had to try the honey lavender because I have heard great things and it was so light and yummy. But I was there for one thing. The donut melt!!!! Donuts + ice cream?! What could be better?? I got the Cookie Monster (blue cookies and cream flavor with chocolate chip cookies, Oreos and vanilla wafers). They warm up the donut sandwiches and they are so perfect. And you get one free topping! My boyfriend got the Leslie Knope which is a European waffle ice cream sandwich. He chose the Fat Elvis flavor. It was also delicious! I would much rather support a local small shop and this is just the place I will be picking. If you haven't already, GO TRY IT!!! You won't be disappointed!

An award winning ice cream chef, delicious ice cream, doughnuts AND ice cream inside a donut... what else could you possibly want at an ice cream shop??? I had the chai tea ice cream in a donut it was delicious I'd recommend anyone downtown Phoenix to swing by this friendly shop to get your daily fix of ice cream 15/10

Our daughter found this place and said we had to go before we moved- so glad we did! Small place but packed a big punch when it came to service and quality! Loved the ice cream melt- a donut and ice cream- I mean seriously..... two worlds collide! A must do for all who like donuts and ice cream... and only $5! I had the Cookie Monster Ice cream with crunch berry topping- yeah I know it sounds amazing- it was!

BTW, I'm from Phoenix not San Fran?? Don't know what happened there. Lots of bad reviews, I asked him how come? He was honest with me. He did really good for my boy and I wanted to give him a 5 star review. I've read the other complaints. Maybe, that was then. Our experience was 5 stars!!!!!!
Bomb! I tried the pineapple, no toppings on the fresh donut. Fun and friendly staff, a true treasure!

We happened to be in the area and couldn't leave without a pitstop here after seeing all the great reviews. Parking was a breeze (free) and there was no line. The two employees working were so friendly and helpful, as well. The ice cream is made by hand- there are 8 standard flavors and 4 rotating. There are flavors for everyone, whether you are dairy free, gluten free, vegan...or EGG free (their ice cream is made without eggs)! It was a tough pick, but finally decided on the sweet potato and old town road. Their vanilla, chocolate and butter pecan flavors have all won awards and rightfully so! Each flavor was so delicious, none of them over powering at all. The chocolate was top notch, not too sweet and you could taste the high quality chocolate they use. They are apparently known for their ice cream donut sandwiches (which they also make homemade) but after spending time at the tamale festival right before this I couldn't fathom eating a donut haha. That said I would definitely try this next time! One of our top five ice cream places in the country without a doubt!!

Sitting outside Novel writing this review. First time visitors, and we are in love. Super friendly, explained who they are and what they do and we settled on 2 melts and a cup! The quality is unmatched by other ice cream places. Love the interesting flavor combinations.

Absolutely Phenomenal. As an ice cream connoisseur, I can say that this is one of the best ice creams I have ever had. The Toffee Bourbon and Madagascar vanilla were absolute heavenly masterpieces. Stop by and you will not be disappointed. A bit hard to locate , but they are next nestled next to third space on Grand avenue.

This is the best little spot. The owners are super nice and seems like they care about their business and their customers. My kids absolutely love this ice cream spot and it's location is very cute and easy to find. I'm always looking forward to coming here.
The hype is real!!! Go get yourself some damn Ice cream and experience pure joy of the senses!!!
Love this place. If you're a fan of ice cream and a fan of donuts why not try them together and bring your butt to Novel.

The ice cream was amazing. Went with friends and they had different flavors like the nerds and Cookie Monster which they said tasted amazing also. The negative part of the whole thing was that there was a "band" outside "playing music" extremely loud. But the ice cream place itself was amazing.

My son and I stopped in this late evening for a sweet treat after attending the Phoenix Symphony. I checked Yelp for nearby places and stumbled on Novel. We both agreed to give it a try and sure glad we did! There was a short line which extended out the door, but once we got inside it smelled like heaven. You can see all the fresh donuts and the gentleman that helped us (sorry, can't remember his name!) offered us samples of anything we'd like to try. While making our requests he made small talk with us which was nice! Asked our names and how we heard of Novel. We went outside to enjoy our treats where they have several places to sit down. We'll be back again! Parking sucks, but it's downtown Phoenix so it comes with the territory.
Great place to take family! The staff was kind and very helpful and added nice little touches to each ice cream (they put little eyeball sprinkles on my son's cookie monster ice cream cone!)

My wife says I want a warm donut with ice cream, wow that is specific I said, never heard of that. Well she found it and wow it was better than she even imagined. If your wife is pregnant or just had a sweet tooth this is simply out of this world. We just had a warm glazed donut with peanut butter and jelly ice cream with Reese's puff cereal! Unfortunately I had to share with my 2 year old who literally took the last big bite from my hand and ate it.

This place is great. It's completely unique and the customer service is super friendly and customer oriented. They all have wonderful attitudes and a can do mentality. Would recommend checking this place out.

I went here looking for a milkshake. Well, there weren't any. The ice cream was good and rich!! The ice cream in the donut was interesting. This is a sweet little place but if they invested in a blender their business could be more profitable. I wouldn't go back unless they did because I don't usually have time to sit and eat ice cream. UPDATE: I received a wonderful note from the owner of Novel. It seems that to add milkshakes (to the level that the City of Phoenix expects) would compromise the quaint awesomeness of this special little business. Like I said the ice cream is good and rich. I had to taste the Fat Elvis but I love a rich coffee ice cream and the special sodas were a treat too. (I did get a King Cake Soda to bring home, being from Louisiana I couldn't resist).
This is truly special ice cream!!! The staff is fantastic and eager to share their amazing ice cream.

What an exceptionally great experience we just had at Novel! The owners were so kind and patient as we tried just about half their flavors and ended up with a Dough Melt stuffed with Bourbon Caramel Toffee ice cream with Cinnamon Toast Crunch on the edges. My gosh it was SO good!!! I look forward to coming back and getting their Mexican Chocolate or Cookie Monster on another Dough Melt or Leslie Knope!

After having my wisdom teeth removed I've been on a ice cream kick. It's lunchtime and I really didn't want to go to McDonald's, walaa!!! NOVEL ice cream!! Super friendly super cute and super Duper delicious!! I can't wait to come back and try all the flavors' make sure you come out too!!

Probably the closest thing in AZ that resembles my favorite ice cream place in SoCal. Why? Because it has the Cookie Monster! Though, it does turn your mouth blue, it's worth it! The staff is nice and welcoming. They got 8 consistent flavors and 4 new flavors every 3 weeks or so. The only downfall is the location. Parking can be an issue depending on the day and time in addition to the surrounding area. It's not the nicest place to be walking by yourself, especially at night. Otherwise, make sure to swing by and get some ice cream!
