Travis and Brandon were so hospitable and have the best ice cream I've ever had! I had the bourbon and cheesecake.... so good! Great environment and grade a customer service!
Highly rated ice cream shop. Very well-deserved! Both the ice cream and the service and! My whole family had a wonderful visit!

Absolutely the cutest little ice cream place! The Cookie Monster flavor is one of their best selling, but my favorite is the Stranger Things one. The donut style is way too sugary for me so I would rather share it, if not the waffle cone is super delicious. Not the usual, thrifty ice cream waffle cone.

The ice cream is good, the dough is amazing, but Brandon is the BEST ice cream shop owner. My husband and I couldn't stop talking about what an awesome experience we got out of buying ice-cream. Brandon is so passionate and patient and made us feel very welcomed and definitely wanna come back! Don't miss this place as I'm sure you will feel the same way and come back and write a 5-star review :)

I had three kinds because I could not decide on one! Handcrafted creamy deliciousness. Amazing customer service, the owner greets you by name and answers any questions, never rushes you despite the line, encourages you to sample them all and thanks you for coming in. An experience far beyond a cup or cone! I'd absolutely recommend this place to anybody and everybody! I'll be thinking about this place when I leave Arizona and I already cannot wait to return!

Bay bay (that's baby in normal lingo lol)!! Let me tell y'all...I'm never going to a corporate ice cream spot. Ever! Like ever ever!! This spot was the absolute best. It sits on a corner with limited parking and the inside remind me of a tiny home. It's a tight squeeze. the two individuals working were super sweet and kind. They explained all the flavors, where they came from and offered samples of anything we wanted. We got a single scoop of freckled lemonade, the Madagascar vanilla on a waffle cone, a single scoop of Cookie Monster (I'll talk about that in a min) and the donut thing (ice cream sandwich made with donuts) w/butter toffee with homemade caramel. First, there should be a disclaimer or warning sign for the Cookie Monster although she gave me a wipe. My son made the biggest mess. Sheesh. I was trying to eat more of my wife's ice cream because it was so refreshing. My review could go on and on but y'all get the point. It was really good and everyone should support this local business.
Delicious stuff always amazing dont let this heat beat u get the wonderful ice cream from novel

Really great place to spend time and get ice cream. They have a lot of flavors that cater to almost anyone. The best part about this place is the fact that you can get ice cream sandwhiched between a ice glazed donut. I mean who can pass that up? They have many different toppings to pick from. Most of it is cereal type toppings and a few syrups. The Fat Elvis is pretty good when it comes to being sandwhiched between a donut or waffle. The sorbets that they have are really good, they constantly change. The owner is always really friendly and willing to help and offer samples. Its really small inside which makes it hard to move around if you bring a few people or people are already in there. The ice cream is like any other ice cream ive had nothing to special besides the flavors. Its a great place to relax, cool off and hangout while eating a sweet treat.

MUST CHECK THIS SPOT OUT! Wow. Amazing ice cream near the heart of downtown Phoenix. Spoke with the owner for a while about his product and the area. Love that this part of town is growing small business and influencing artists. The ice cream was awesome! The flavors were unique, but not so crazy you can't stand the taste. The Elvis was great, Cookie Monster was cool and the Butter Pecan, Salty Watermelon and Madagascar Vanilla also worth tasting. Enjoy!
Great service, atmosphere, hours, location and best of all the ice cream is awesome. They always have new interesting flavors to try, but really the best is the vanilla.

After a Cubs game my wife and I stopped here at our second attempt to try this phenomenal ice cream because last time we were here the line was too long for our kids to be patient through. Did not disappoint. This is hands down the best ice cream I have ever had and the service was super friendly and you felt welcome by everyone. Definitely recommending and coming back no matter how long the line is.

I have lived in the valley for 7 years now and can't believe last night was the first time I tried Novel ice cream. I am a crazy dessert fanatic here and I feel strongly that this place now holds the title of THE BEST ICE CREAM IN ARIZONA. It beats baked bear, it beats churn, it beats cold stone and baskin robbins etc. this place is truly a hidden gem. I am soooooo impressed and want to go back again today. The employees were amazing- great customer service! They let us try as many samples as we wanted. Tiny little shop but so cute!!! Amazing!!! I highly recommend you try this place out! It is located on a corner lot with a few other small shops. Tons of outside seating to sit and enjoy your dessert! If you are an Arizona native or traveling from out of town- this is a must try!!!!
There hot donut cold ice cream scoop in the middle is to die for. fresh made in house hot donut yum just yum ! I loved the cookie monster ice cream !

Excellent small batch ice cream - owner scooped it up for us & was so nice & patient. I had a scoop of Butterbeer & a scoop of Bourbon Caramel Toffee Crunch & both were excellent. My husband & daughter enjoyed donut ice cream sandwiches. Parking is difficult but worth it!

Novel has the best name because that is exactly what it is. It unique and special and like nothing else. The ice cream is really to die for, or kill for if necessary. Then of all things they take the deliciousness and place it between two halves of a warm decadent donut. right? It's a cute tiny shop with a lot to offer. Super customer service the peeps running this show are very cool, and not just cause there is ice cream in there. Don't be a dumb and miss your chance for a mouth pleaser!

The only late night ice cream shop around! That alone is worth 5 stars. But it can only happen in a hot place like Arizona. . But the ice cream was delicious and you won't find flavors like the ones they have anywhere. Even the cookies'n'cream flavor tastes different and it's blue. I tried a lot of flavors and they were all good. If I lived here, I'd come very often. Kudos to the customer service as well. Everyone there was awesome.

This place is MINDBLOWING! A dough melt... handcrafted ice cream stuffed in a doughnut with a cookie or cereal topping and put onto a press to heat the doughnut and crisp the outside... WOW! So good and we will probably be back tonight. Such a fun place to visit while we're here for a conference!
Creamy, sweet, delicious! The service is friendly and memorable! Way to be a local business with great food and service! If you haven't been there you have to go! A real Phoenix gem!

My wife really wanted to try Novel so after dinner we had made our way over. The parking lot was pretty small but the environment was pretty cool. The staff was very friendly and helpful. The ice cream was flavorful and filling. If your in the area and want something sweet I'd recommend it.

This is one of those businesses that makes you reassess your whole rating system. Novel Ice Cream is such a perfect business, it makes me wonder if I've been too generous with most of my previous ratings. Novel is located in a tiny little house(?) in a strange little section of downtown Phoenix, right at the corner of a residential neighborhood. We happened to walk in at an apparently uncommon moment (Sunday around 4pm) during which there were no other customers in the store, so I cannot speak to the typical crowds or parking situation. The people working that day, including one of the owners, Brandon, were incredibly friendly and helpful and clearly genuinely passionate about their store and their ice cream. They encouraged us to try lots of different flavors and excitedly gave detailed descriptions of the ice cream, its ingredients, and the hand-crafted process involved in making it. It's always special when you find a family owned and operated establishment in the Phoenix area, but it's especially rare and invigorating to find one this full of passion and enthusiasm. For the experience alone, this place is a 5, and then there's the actual ice cream. It's incredible. The flavors are unique and interesting, and the exceptional care that goes into crafting their flavors is immediately evident. Everything tastes real, flavorful and balanced. The doughnut used in the dough melt is warm and soft and perfectly compliments whatever ice cream you choose to put inside it. I had the Thai Tea ice cream in a Dough Melt with Captain Crunch topping, but I tried samples of most of the other flavors on offer that day as well. My partner got a scoop of the Raspberry sorbet and the Lemon Basil sorbet, both of which were also excellent. This is definitely a place you can bring your vegan and dairy-free friends and you will all leave satisfied. Novel is one of my favorite types of places: the kind of place that, for a moment, makes the big city feel like a small town. It's a rare gem, and owners Brandon and Jennifer deserve every bit of praise that's been heaped upon them.

Have you ever been to an ice cream joint where you didn't feel guilty to ask for another sample? I can definitely say I did NOT feel guilty! Special thanks to the owner and staff, they make you feel so welcoming and encourage you to try as many flavors as you'd like. I went home with two delicious flavors: Bourbon Caramel Toffee Crunch and Honey Lavender. Great Combo! Definitely coming back to try their new flavors.
Novel ice cream is an absolute gem! If you haven't gone here yet, RUN because it just that good. Make sure you try the bourbon ice cream with cinnamon toast crunch in a warm donut! Absolute bliss.

I went here after a friend recommended it to me. Her, being an ice cream lover, had tried an exorbitant amount of places one summer, trying to find the best ice cream in Arizona and after trying it, I agree that this is the best ice cream shop in Arizona, or at least within the Phoenix metropolitan area. Their butter pecan is absolutely amazing!

Yum, yum, yum! This quaint little ice cream shop is located in a parking lot on 11th ave and grand. You have to try the fat elvis. Which is peanut butter ice cream with bananas and bacon. My husband had the dough melt. Which is a glazed donut ice cream sandwich. I had the fat elvis in a waffle cone. They also have ice cream floats. You pick your soda and ice cream flavor. They are on only $5. You have to try this place. Friday and Saturday nights are the busiest and lines are into the parking lot. We came on a Sunday and there wasnt a wait. I love little places like this. Small and locally owned.

If you want some of the best Ice cream you've ever had, Novel is the place to go! It is a small little place but really cute and all the staff is really nice. They are genuine and truly care about you as a customer. They have a lot of unique flavors to choose from and you are able to sample before ordering. I got the dough melt with the bourbon maple toffee ice cream (I'm pretty sure that was the name of it) and it was SO good. The ice cream is smooth and bursting with flavor. My friend got the Leslie Knope and it was equally as good! I am never disappointed when I come here!

My wife and I were looking for a really good ice cream place and looked on Yelp and other sources and the ratings for this place were overwhelming so it wasn't a tough choice, but with that said, our expectations were still surpassed. This eclectic nook on Grand Street shows the true spirit of Phoenix, an inner-city on the rise again. The shop: We visited while Covid restrictions were in place. Full points for the owners handling of products and dealing with customers while maintaining social distancing and still presenting a very personal service. We got a brief description of the company, their ethos and the commitment to only providing the best low volume, hand made ice cream. I had a Dutch stroop-waffel cone and my wife had a dough melt. Both were amazing! Normally we would have taken pics but we got so caught up in the wonderful flavors that we totally forgot!!! Loads of great pics from Novel on Yelp so not feeling guilty :-). In short, this is now our "Go-To Place" for ice cream. 11/10

Where do I even start to begin to explain the explosion of flavor is in my mouth! This is a very unique place very glad to have found this in Phoenix wonderful choices of ice cream handcrafted ice cream! The owner took his time to explain all the delicious choices of ice cream he has to offer definitely makes you want to come back so many flavors

Novel has an amazing selection of Ice Creams that are all amazing! Tonight I enjoyed Coffee Ice Cream inside their amazing Donut with chocolate drizzle!!! I ate my entire sandwich before I even paid for it and as bad as it is I even licked the wrapper!!!

Glad I can be review 100! Anyways, its the exact score I would rate this place. The ice cream...when they start telling you they "compete" for best ice cream and the Madagascar vanilla won last year in its category, and the butter pecan was runner-up in 2015; that has to tell you how amazing the stuff is! Reasonably priced as well. As for the service: off the charts impressive! The owner (Branden) and his brother (Tony) genuine down to earth people trying to provide a quality product...and they hit it out of the park with this one. I will DEFINITELY bring my kids, friends, and family from out of town here. *side note* they have glass soda that is amazing. I got a Dr. Pepper, and it does taste different for the better. We got the doughnut sandwich, and I look forward to another fantastic ice cream adventure.

Get the PBJ Donut melt with Cinnamon crunch topping! They have a handful of flavors, but oh my, they all taste so so so so good. I have been to other 'popular' ice cream places in the Valley, but never have I tasted such a good depth of flavor. Their ice creams are hand churned two tubs at a time. They also have floats, although I am yet to try it. And Novel is open late, which is great news for all the folks who crave ice cream at 12 midnight.
We enjoyed the Cookie Monster ice cream. The staff was extremely nice, helpful. They gAve us plenty samples and lots of information to make sure we obtain our best choice.

Great ice cream in an awesome environment. Stop by exceptional customer service. The Fat Elvis is delicious and the Cherry Limeade is so fresh. The Cookie Monster makes your mouth as blue as a smurfs ...

Great little shop with super personable staff. Ice cream sandwich was great. Definitely some unique flavors at this place. I would recommend checking it out if you're an out of towner. Pricing is right on point with what I'd expect to pay somewhere else. Cute little place, excited to see them grow.

One of the best ice cream sandwiches I've ever had. Warm, soft fresh donut with creamy goodness in the middle. Worth the short wait! Fantastic customer service. Definitely go check this little hidden gem out, you won't regret it:)
Amazing ice cream I love the vibe of this small ice cream shop. Butter pecan is to die for. The best part is you're able to sample their ice cream when most ice cream shops right now won't let you.
The Dough Melt is worth every penny! It's basically an ice cream scoop in between a donut, the perfect marriage of both worlds. Also love the late hours!
Must go back soooo good. Pineapple upside down ice cream My family also did the donut ice cream highly recommended.

Came because I saw a friend post about this magical place that serves ice cream in a warm doughnut.... I had the bourbon caramel ice cream in a doughnut and it was really good. I feel like I'm slipping into a diabetic coma but it was tasty. If you find yourself in Phoenix put this on your list of places to try! You won't be disappointed.
Not 31 flavors, more like 10 but the Best ice cream in Phoenix, hands down. Similar to Bi-Rite in San Francisco or Bobtail in Chicago. It's in a strange little area but will worth it.

I'm visiting the Phoenix area for Dodgers Spring Training with my daughter. We decided to stop for ice cream on the way back to the hotel. She Yelped and found Novel, and were very lucky that she did. First, it's a very cute store with a large covered patio with tables and chairs attached. It's larger than the store. Secondly there were many unique flavors to choose from and the owners were encouraging to try them all. I knew what I wanted after the second taste - Tangerine Dream. My daughter decided on Panna Cherry. They were both delicious. Thirdly, the owners were super friendly and we chatted with them while waiting for our ice cream. We were surprised that they had only been open 10 days!! They were going to have their Grand Opening in two days and very pleased with the results of their "soft" opening. They have what it takes to be successful. We wish them all the best!!
Best ice cream joint in Phoenix! They switch it up a lot with seasonal flavors and somehow they are all amazing. Great staff too!
love this place. the owner is always nice and so are the employees and the ice cream is always good

When you live in Arizona ice cream is a must to combat the scorching temperature. Novel is in the right place at the right time, and does not disappoint. We have been wanting to try Novel for some time now but didn't get around to it. But let me tell you it was worth the wait. At first we could not find it, it sits on the corner of Grand and 11th but is tucked away with other small businesses. Thank God for the signs because it helped us navigate to ice cream euphoria (i.e Novel). We where greeting right away and given a run down of the flavors and additional choices. My daughter got pink (strawberry) with sprinkles of course and I got the bourbon in a donut. Both flavors knocked it out of the park and I loved how the donut was a little warm. I also picked up a glass bottle of squirt to take home to the Hubbs. We will come back to try the new flavors they surprise us with.
Best Madagascar vanilla ever! Just wish the cones and scopes were bigger. Would probably make me feel better about the $6 I spent on two scoops

Super friendly customer service!! Genius idea (doughnuts and ice cream) ! Amazing ice cream, huge perfectly balanced flavor, perfect texture! Fun stop on a fun night. I had buyers regret a little, I really should have ordered the fat Elvis, it was amazing.

This place was amazing! Service was spectacular, he let us try all the flavors we wanted! I tried several and had a hard time deciding because it was all great. Ended up going with the donut with vanilla ice cream and fruity pebbles. Best vanilla I've ever had.

I never eat donuts.....but I'd eat these all day. Had the donut stuffed with award winning chocolate ice and a sprinkle of Coco Peebles....wow!! This is an incredible experience. Donut was warm, melt in your mouth soft. Ice cream so perfectly chocolate. You'd be crazy not to try it.

Yo, ice cream and a donut, put together????? Where have you guys been all my life? This spot is awesome, tiny hole in the wall vibe, but the people are friendly, very informative, and the flavors are great. I had the honey lavender this last time, seriously my fav. Check them out!!!!!

Let me start by saying I'm 9 months pregnant and due any day...Tonight I had a random craving for a warm donut with ice cream on top. My husband laughed and said I would have to invent that because he didn't think it existed. I googled exactly that "warm donut with ice cream" and the skies opened up and and heaven sent down this amazing little shop! We drove 20 minutes to get here and after having it I would have driven twice that far. It's a good thing I didn't find this place sooner in my pregnancy or else I'd be the size of a whale, but dangit it'd be happy. I had a warm glazed donut with peanut butter and jelly ice cream and captain crunch for the topping....yes, that. Just. Happened.

Everything is just perfectly done. They have great selections of ice cream and original flavor . They said its hand maid which i wouldn't doubt its real ... its just so very good .. store is small so theres waiting outside .. on the side of the store theres a good place to hang out while having the ice cream

Easily the best ice cream shop in Phoenix/Scottsdale area. The owner is super nice and wants every person who comes through his doors to have the best experience possible. Guests can enjoy a creation of donut and ice cream together in one of the most delicious desserts I've ever had. The donuts are house made and warm. The ice cream is also locally made and smooth. With several different flavors, the donut and ice cream are put together for a magical experience! I highly recommend getting this. If you want just a regular cone or cup of ice cream you can also get it here. They can be made into floats as well. All the prices are very reasonable. If you visit one ice cream place here, you have to come to Novel Ice Cream.
Stumbled on this place by accident and will definitely be back!! Owner was super nice and engaging. Don't miss out on this treat!

Oh. My. Gosh. This was the most delicious thing I've ever tasted. I got the doughmelt with the chocolate cherry pistachio ice cream and it was heaven. The three other people I was with tried different ice cream flavors with their melts and everyone was in love! We will definitely be back. The only downside is that they're not located closer to me!
Best ice cream I've ever eaten!. Had the Cocoa puff ice cream d's sandwich with cookie monster filling!

I love this place. They have a great staff who has true pride in their product. They know where everything is sourced and how its made plus they're always happy to serve up ice cream with a smile (I mean who wouldn't be happy to work with ice cream all day? I'm looking at you MELT employees ). I love love love the dough melt and the Leslie Knope. The ONLY thing I do not like about Novel is how I can't not finish it before walking back to my car. Seriously. I try to challenge myself every freaking time but the ice cream always seems to win. Sure you can order two one for the walk and one for the road but, diabetes. Damn you diabetes. Hooray for ice cream in donuts!

This ice cream is a must in Pheonix. They have about 8 - 10 flavors and all of them were so good that I had a hard time to pick which one for my donut melt. I finally came with honey lavender ice cream. The donut by it self was so soft and yummy. With the ice cream inside, it tasted like heaven!

It was such a cute late night spot! I had the Ron Swanson with graham crackers it was AH-MAY-ZING! All their ice cream is hand made and they switch up flavors. (Idk how often) They are super patient with you when asking for samples, they want to ensure you love what you get. Definitely recommend!

Awesome service; it's a small business and you can tell a lot of thought goes into creating their flavors. Really unique stuff here which explains the name! You can customize toppings and the server has solid recommendations if you're having trouble.

Not just good, not just great, it is the G.O.D of ice cream. A inner or outer fat girls dream come true, forget marriage and come here to eat your feelings and everyone else's - guilt free. The combinations of flavors are mad scientist, while the thought of combining donuts and ice cream is it's namesake - novel.

Oh Man!!! This was an awesome recommendation from a friend. A little gem on the art district in downtown Phoenix. The ice cream in incredible. The donut ice cream sandwich is over the top! The flavors are incredible!

Amazing late night snack!!!! My boyfriend and I came here on first Friday last months. The customer service was so pure, I could tell they really cared about their customers. The ice cream itself was rich! I would recommend getting the donut/waffle sandwich.

Not often do I give 5 stars but this place is up there! They have a good selection of product and it's all delicious. My wife and I grabbed an ice cream filled donut. We had the animal cracker and Cookie Monster. The ice cream is really made with natural products. I did not end up with that bloated feeling or sweet after tastes that other ice creams leave behind. Besides the delicious treats, the owner was super nice and took his time explaining the menu. The women before us sampled all the flavors, which was the fing annoying but, he was courteous and very patient with them. Will definitely go back!
My new favorite ice cream place!!!! I took my family from out of state and they love it! My favorite is the Fat Elvis. It's so bomb!!!! I
Absolutely LOVE this little shop! Everyone is so friendly and kind. And can we talk about how yummy the donuts are?! They never disappoint!
Super fun place with exotic flavors...they'll let you try as many as you'd like and make great recommendations. Very friendly owner and operator. Will be back!
Amazing ice cream. You have to try the donut ice cream sandwich, but if you don't the ice cream itself is still awesome

The ice cream here was not the best per say. It was good though. The part that I actually loved is that they put that cold ice cream right in the middle of a warm donut. It's a small cute little ice cream shop and I like the area it's in. I will however be trying it again

This is probably my favorite ice cream place & I love ice cream! Its is just perfectly delicious & it is not overly sweet that I actually finished it all! I also really enjoyed the atmosphere, the music being played outside was ideal for the setting, the friendly and knowledgeable customer service was great and good vibes overall.
Oh...my...god! What a great idea and incredibly delicious! Super nice owner with an amazing business. Go check them out!!! Try the donut stuffed with ice cream.

Cool little hole in the wall ice-cream donut shop. Great selection of ice cream to choose from, don't be afraid to ask to try them because I know I wasn't. The employee that was assisting us with our order turned out to be part owner of this shop, really amazing individual, you don't often see a co-owner working in the front. Will be back to try more!
Owner is brandon and is a super humble dude. Second time I have ever been here and many more times to come :):)
Brandon, the owner, was super friendly and the ice cream , made locally, was fabulous!!! Definitely a must!!!

Just left this place and let me tell you, you will not be disappointed!!! We were greeted by the owner who was very friendly and explained everything to us (since it was our first time). We sat out on the patio and enjoyed our donut stuffed with ice cream! We will definitely be back!!!
Though I don't like the donut, the ice cream is really good and the service is really friendly

Stopped in after waiting so long (dietary restrictions) to finally try. I did some menu research ahead of time and was excited. On the evening of my first visit I encountered a short line. But hey, it's a small cozy shop and it is good so expect a little line on your visit. The ice cream selection rotates but they keep their most popular around. They let you try all the flavors you want. On this visit I had lavender honey ice cream with fruity pebbles in the donut as well as a float with their pistachio ice cream combined with a cream soda from thier house curated soda selection. Treats in hand I sat out on the shared patio at 3rd Space and enjoyed the evening.

What a novel concept! (Pun intended.) And I'm not just talking about the interesting flavors, such as the honey Sriracha (hippy, I know, but keep an opened mind and read on), Novel has to offer but the enthusiasm and genuine human kindness from the staff. Tucked in a little house on a cul-de-sac of eateries, Novel is cute and homey and is a rather small ice cream parlor, but good things can come in small packages (or at least some good things...) As soon as we walked in, we were greeted by very friendly people who were more than happy to let us try whatever we want. Now I am a traditionalist when it comes to ice cream and sweets but I am not going to turn down trying "honey sriracha". My theory was "I like honey and I like sriracha; I should try it!" Well, let's just say I was glad I tried it because now I don't have to try it again anymore! It was definitely not bad and very interesting, but I learned that I prefer my ice cream to be sweet and non-spicy. I also tried the honey lavender and it was the perfect balance of honey and lavender, which I think is pretty difficult to achieve due to the two flavors being relatively mellow on its own. Nevertheless, I cannot eat a whole scoop of honey lavender just because it's too avant-garde for me. But butter pecan? That I can do a whole scoop, and then some. Saw it, tried it, loved it, getting it. I know butter pecan belongs to the lackluster ice cream flavors category, but this is probably by far the best butter pecan ice cream I've ever had. My partner had the donut ice cream sandwich and I had a bite. I must admit it was much better than I had anticipated. In fact, I wouldn't have mind if I had a donut sandwich for myself. The donut tasted fresh and soft without being too sweet. The ice cream in the donut was some sort of peanut butter and banana. It had some crunchy graham cracker/cereal as well, but I forget what it was. Everything combined together was a match well made. The patio outside has tables and chairs and is lit with Christmas lights. The ambiance is relaxing and lovely. All in all, I would normally avoid places that serve "hand-crafted artisan ice cream" just because of the stigma that usually come with that kind of labeling but I am glad I tried Novel and the interesting ice cream flavors and met the friendly crew. And if you haven't tried this place, I'd say it'd be a novel thing to do to give it a whirl.
Wow!! Hello delicious. Seriously so good and very nice people. The ice cream texture and flavor are on point. Go visit them!

I have been to Novel many, many times. I have a friend who lives on the same block. I have driven over after long evenings of kids activities. After reading Sherise M.'s comments and Brandon's gracious response I felt compelled to voice my perspective. I have almost always been greeted and offered samples. On many summer nights when I have been to Novel we find a long line waiting outside on the ramp. It is a testament to the quality product offered and creates great anticipation for the awaiting treats! A wonderful time to visit with my kids and friends discussing what flavor we are going to have. We will keep coming back to support small local businesses like Novel who do a great job!
Amazing! Seriously hands down best ice cream I've ever had. Never disappoints! And the owners and employees are so nice just makes you want to go back even more.

We went in there tonight and I have to say it is the best ice cream I have ever had. Got the Elvis ice cream donut and my god was it good. Here for a couple more days and gonna try to go back and get another one. Tried some of the other flavors and they were all good too. If you are in the area you have to stop in.

One of the things I appreciate about Novel Ice Cream is that even though there's a super long line, the employees don't rush you and encourage you to sample flavors, whether it's your first time or not! That makes it so it's not just delicious ice cream between doughnuts, but you get that priceless feeling of being a valued customer! Only complaint is that it's fairly small and you'll want more, for sure

This ice cream shop is the best little gem! Not to mention the surrounding shops, cafe and seating. There was even love music playing last time I went. Always fresh flavors, like lavender honey! Each flavor tasted EXACTLY like their names which is very unique because a lot of times flavors can be hard to taste. Strawberry is made with real, never frozen strawberries. Also, tons of toppings and sauces. You can get either a cup, cone or an ice cream sandwich which is ice cream smothered between two warmed glazed donuts! Best ice cream I have every tasted!

Had to try Novel ice cream after seeing so many good reviews and articles about the shop. The owner, Brandon, does a great job of welcoming customers in, speaking about each flavor, and offering samples. I ended up with German chocolate cake flavored ice cream and loved it. The shop is very small but has outdoor seating to enjoy your treat. Definitely one of the best ice cream shops in Phoenix!

I have been to Novel an embarrassing amount of times given that they have not been open very long. Novel is a dangerously tasty little ice cream/donut shop that is close to my house. They have a decent variety of flavors that change frequently. Their ice cream is super tasty...even their simple flavors are great (the vanilla is awesome....the strawberry tasted like fresh strawberries). My fave flavor is the fat Elvis.... Bacon and peanut butter wonderfulness. My one problem? They won't tell me who sources their ice cream...they don't make their ice cream or donuts in house and when asked they will report that they get them from a local person who does not want them to share their identity. That's a little..... weird. Beyond that, the ice cream is good....the dough melt is crazy good (and I don't even particularly like donuts).... The husband likes the Leslie knope.... The prices are fair (5$ for the dough melt in which you can get two different flavors of ice cream and a topping). I have brought many friends here and recommend you also give them a try.

There are a number of fantastic ice cream shops in Phoenix these days. None of them hold a candle to Novel!! Product quality is off the charts great. Innovative & creative ice cream flavors are extraordinary. Location is as cool and funky as you'll ever find in Phoenix. The X-factor at Novel, however, is their team. Whether your visit is with one of the owners or one of the other team members, whoever helps you with your order is most likely the nicest, kindest person you'll meet all day! Great people, great service and out of this world ice cream make Novel a one-of-a-kind ice cream shop. It's been selected as top 10 in the US three times already in it's two-year existence. Not a surprise to me; I'm hooked.

Ice cream is bomb. Especially the bourbon caramel toffee crunch and honey lavender flavors. Oh, and the donut sandwich is quite ridiculous. My only regret is stuffing my face with too much pizza at a pizza joint beforehand, so I didn't do such a great job making room for more scoops of ice cream goodness. Then again, my tummy would've disowned me. Staff is super friendly and genuinely happy to be there. Will definitely be back to try more of their decadent flavors.
My husband was shocked when I said this place had a full 5 stars! After eating some, I can see why. Not only that, the employees were extremely nice and welcoming!

I have never written a review on yelp, but I had to take the time to do this one. We were in Phoenix for one night on our way to California and decided to go to Novel for the Dough Melt. The customer service was incredible, the surroundings wonderful, and the ice cream marvelous!

Me and my husband were driving around Phoenix and it was super hot so we wanted to get something sweet and cooling ! I stumbled across this place on yelp and it looked so good I had to try. It's a cute little building located in the art district. We we're greeted as soon as we got out of the car and we went up to the window we we're greeted by a very sweet girl I'm sad I didn't get her name ! We had the doughnut with ice cream it was so delicious , I had raspberry chocolate and I tell you best ice cream I've ever had ! And the doughnut tasted so fresh and warm it was such a amazing combination !

The best Ice cream spot in Arizona, their donut ice cream will make you regret ever considering going on a diet. It is soooooooo gooooooood. I find myself visiting this place whenever my travels lands me here.

BEST ICE CREAM EVER! Novel was so good and had really great flavors. The customer service was amazing. I had to get three flavors because I couldn't just chose one. I had Cookie Monster which was so creamy and delicious, strawberry which had real strawberries in it, and the chia tea. This ice cream is so creamy. It was my first visit and I definitely will be coming back! Also, I got a free water bottle from the owner, which was amazing in this hot summer!

Novel is a "must go" if you are craving ice cream! The flavors are super unique which makes it even more awesome. Yesterday we had cake batter and an apple cider ice cream, so bomb! I also love the unique toppings that are available (shown in the 2nd picture). Check Novel out. The owner is also always there and very nice and tells you the story behind the flavors which is personal and awesome!

COME TO THIS PLACE. Eat some ice cream and before you're done, your life will be forever better.* You'll also have an opportunity to meet some really great people who put their heart into this heaven...and it shows! *Not an exaggeration

After a day at the Children's Museum, I felt it was only right to finish the fun filled day with some ice cream. As an out-of-towner from Brooklyn, NY I yelped to see what was in the area. It was such an amazing Yelp find! This ice cream was absolutely delicious! I had the bourbon carmel toffee but also tried the chocolate, and lavender honey. Heaven in my mouth! When I'm in Phoenix again, I will be going back, and would recommend anyone I know going to Phoenix to check it out. Two side notes - The owner is super friendly and passionate about his business which I feel is a plus. Secondly, the actual building/area is a cute little space.

Found this amazing place on Yelp (of course) and had to try it!! We live about 20 minutes away but after reading all the good reviews I figured it would be worth the trip. I was definitely right!! The ice cream was amazing!! The owner Brandon and all of the staff were super sweet and very friendly! I would seriously recommend this place to anyone in need of a sweet treat! I'll be back for sure!

Ice cream is amazing! We had the indecisive and was able to try 5 scoops! Honey lavender was aaamazing. Loved the cookie monster. Such good flavor. FYI limited parking. Small venue with outdoor seating, so plan accordingly in 104 degree heat! Great service!

This place not only has a unique take on ice cream and donuts , but has outstanding customer service! When I informed the owner that I had a severe nut allergy, he stopped what he was doing and informed me that he was going to change his gloves and use a new scooper. As I waited for me dessert to be prepared, I observed him greeting everyone and learning their names, followed with a notion of gratitude for them coming to his business. I left there with a delicious treat and the amazement of customer service I had just experienced and witnessed.

When ice cream falls in love with a donut and waffles swim in sweet cold buttercream. Specialty ice cream done right! Flavors like Fat Elvis made up of maple and bacon or bourbon with toffee ice cream. Awesome blue Cookie Monster Cookies & Cream. Come visit Novel Ice Cream and beat the heat folks. This place is really cool with lots of places to seat and eat. Tremendous neighborhood vibes that will keep you smiling!

Some of the best ice cream I have ever had. We're not from Phoenix, but anytime we're in the Phoenix area we go out of our way to get ice cream at Novel ice cream. They always have a great selection of unique flavors, great stories about the various ice cream flavors, and allow you to sample the flavors before you make your final pick. I definitely recommend this place!
The consistency of the ice cream here is amazing. Highly recommend. Parking is tricky though so that's why I give it 4 out of 5.

The experience I've ever had. I have craved this everyday since I went for the first time last week. I had butter pecan inside of a donut with cereal topping. My husband had the waffle & everything was really delicious. They took the time to take care of customers one at a time not feeling rushed. Wonderful experience.

The people serving the ice are really kind people. The ice cream here is delicious, especially the Cookie Monster flavor. When I was here I got two glazed donut and a waffle sandwich. I forgot the name of the waffle but it was delicious! The atmospheres here was nice. I came here at night and everything seemed 'chill'. Overall, this place is a great little place. Definitely going to come back!

I'm tempted to not share how amazing this place is because it is one of those gems you want to keep to yourself. This is the best ice cream I have ever had in my life. I tried a doughnut sammy with Fat Elvis ice cream and cocoa pebbles. I can't wait to go back to have something else. The peach habanero was hard to not get as well but I will next time. Bottom line is you have to try this place because it is amazing.
Hands down best ice cream /dessert place ever !the staff was great and really knew their story

As much as I love donuts and I love ice cream, I couldn't imagine how mind blowing the combination could be. Ice cream inside a warm donut? WOW! The flavors are delicious and the ice cream is dense and creamy. The donut is glazed to perfection and the perfect consistency. The banana cream pie was hands down the best ice cream I've ever had!

The selection is forever changing. We went three days in a row and found at least two new flavors each day. The ice cream filled donuts are genius! We loved everything about this cozy shop. They let you try any flavor you want. All of the ice creams are made with real food. It's amazing that the fruits are not previously frozen. The ice cream is very delicious but the best part is (who I believe to be the owner) Brandon. He is so kind and down to earth. He truly is passionate about what he does and cares for the people. On weekends they sell vegan cookies that are wonderful. It's a must visit place while you are in town. Superb location (middle of art district)

This is going to be a short review because that's all you need. GO HERE. They have 5 permanent flavors and a few rotating flavors all made in house. That's not the reason you need to go though. This is: 1) Donut ice cream sandwich: select a flavor and they make a sandwich by slicing a donut in half and warming it up. Seriously amazing. 2) "Leslie Knope Special" AKA waffle ice cream sandwich: for those of you who watch parks and rec, you know about Leslie's obsession with waffles. Here, they take a sweet twist on it by creating a waffle sandwich which is warmed up and your pick of ice cream in between. I seriously can't pick one over the other, so you'll have to get both or go twice!
You must stop here! AMAZING ice cream in a fun shop at a great price! Owner was very friendly and clearly loves his business! Had the ice cream stuffed donut- YUM!!!
Awesome, awesome, awesome. What else do I need to say?! Locally owned, nationally recognized and still keeping its roots.

Had to complete the night with a midnight run to the top ice cream shop in the US, right here in Phoenix! Service was outstanding and in a very novel area! We met a few bachelors, ventured in the dark and yes, I tried the famous "Dough melt." Sooo good and so don't count those calories! It was all worth the homemade ice cream!! I highly recommend the Cookie Monster, blue tongue and all!

Fabulous! Best ice cream in the valley. We tasted almost all the flavors on the display and each one of them were pretty tasty and "novel". Our favorites were strawberry, German chocolate (best of all), butter pecan and fat Elvis. Would recommend everyone to try this place, you won't be disappointed.
Cutest ice cream place! Came for the first tonight and definitely will reccomend and be back! Owner is super nice as well :)

Truly amazing ice cream! We were just in town from Yuma for a day and found this shop on Yelp. Boy was it a great find. Whenever we find ourselves in Phoenix this will be a guaranteed stop!! The young man running the place was great and very informative. Novel has very tasty and unique flavors so look them up and enjoy, you will not be sorry!!
Amazing ice cream and amazing owners. I really enjoy going here and I don't even like ice cream.

Yum yum yum yum Get in my belly! Warm yummy doughnut filled with delicious perfectly crafted ice cream? Take my money! If you are looking for a delicious treat, one that is worthy of a cheat day, worthy of all the calories, look no further. I can't even say much else. It's so good. Just go. Oh I had a glazed doughnut with the Cookie Monster ice cream. Mmmmm Ok thank you, bye bye

This place was amazing. The ice cream tasted so fresh and was so creamy. The workers were so sweet and kind; my family had come here before and they remembered their names. The chocolate ice cream was very rich and the Cookie Monster ice cream was so blue and yummy. The donut ice cream was so good that we had to order another. Definitely recommend!

Learned of this charming Ice Cream shop that is tucked inside Third Base from a friend. Walking into the quaint shop, instantly greeted by the friendly owner and staff. They have a variety of Artisan Ice Cream and Sorbet on display for taste testing if you'd like. They serve your choice of ice cream with cereal toppings as a ice cream sandwich between a Glazed Donut or Waffle. You can get it in a cone or even a cup to go. Limited parking, park on the street and walk up. They have outdoor seating to enjoy the cool evenings. Perfect to take a date, friends and family. First Fridays tend to be busier so you may have to park across the street or down the block, but don't let that scare you off, trust me, it is worth it. Been back about 6 times for the Sorbet. My friends love the Fat Elvis and Cookie Monster.

WOW!! If you are looking for really good ice cream, this is the place! I loved the Vanilla ice cream and was pleasantly surprised that they had gluten free cones!! Tasted all natural - homemade. I'm pretty picky about my vanilla ice cream - not liking anything that tastes artificial or too sweet. My sister had a scoop of the cantaloupe (tasted just like it!) ice cream and really enjoyed it.

By far one of the best ice cream spots I've been too! To start with the service was spectacular! I went in with my two sisters and boyfriend and we wanted to try all the flavors that were there. They were so patient, and sweet, plus, they gave us the background to practically every flavor! We were all fascinated and delighted by everything! The ice cream was awesome of course, we all got the waffle sandwich and we all can't wait to go back to try it in the donut! Such a great spot I loved it!

SO delicious. Went on a double date here with friends and we all loved it. I had the lavender honey ice cream - super delicious. Husband had the strawberry inside of a donut - also delicious. It's standing room only inside, and very little standing room at that. But ample seating outside and I'm sure it's nice to sit out there when it's not 110

Novel Ice Cream is anything but novel. They're more like a) wrong, b) phenomenal, and c) so serious that their VANILLA won a Novel Peace Prize... or something like that. The blackberry merlot & chocolate go together like fine wine and good chocolate. Anyway, I'd keep coming up with really apt ways to describe their flavors, but they rotate faster than I can write copy, so just keep 'em on your radar. Tl;dr - Novel's making Grand Avenue grand again.* *If you're offended by taking that slogan in vain, I recommend you avoid Grand Ave entirely (insert winking smiley face).
Fresh, warm donuts filled with handcrafted, specialty ice cream flavors make up an amazing ice cream sandwich! Don't forget the cereal topping for a little added crunch. Worth every calorie!

Yo this place is absolute BOMB. I have brought my dad, mom, and brother here when they visited Phoenix as a place they absolutely cannot go without.The staff knows their ice cream facts and the ice cream is honestly the best I've ever had. They always have new unique flavors but they also have award winning favorites. Also if you don't get the ice cream sandwhich with the donut you basically didn't go.

Love, love this place. The people working there were extremely helpful and so patient with explaining everything and letting us sample whatever we wanted. They made sure everything we chose, we'd be happy with and we definitely were! In addition, the owner was also extremely friendly. You can tell he enjoys what he does and has a passion for his shop; and who he employs to work in it! I highly recommend, I will be back! Thank you so much for the free cookie!!

Wow! A hot delicious soft donut with the most delectable Madagascar vanilla ice cream I've ever had in my life. This place is incredible. It is located behind Third Space in a pink little house. Great flavors but I'm a purist and went with vanilla...it was incredible.
Quite possibly the best doughnut, ice cream combo I've tried. I literally eat ice cream 3 days a week and there is none better in the valley.

I've only been here twice so far and it's already one of my favorite local ice cream shops! Doughnuts and ice cream are already a match made in heaven - it's even more amazing with Novel's freshly baked donuts and artisan ice cream flavors! Add a cute little pink house in downtown Phoenix and you're set! Choosing a flavor is honestly so hard for me, and they always have so many to choose from. The honey lavender flavor is amazing, but I'll always have a special place in my heart for chai. Luckily, you can put two flavors in your donut!! Every other flavor I've sampled has been delicious as well. You just really can't go wrong with ice cream and a glazed donut! The only real downside is that the ice cream melts so quickly, especially if you go during the day in the summer! Brandon and his wife are SO sweet and enthusiastic about the business and I'm so, so glad they brought Novel and donut ice cream sandwiches to Phoenix!! Definitely bringing friends here anytime we're craving ice cream (which is always!) Fresh ice cream, delicious donuts, and some amazing people behind the olace, what more could you want?! Support a local business!! Highly, highly recommend this place!!

Novel Ice Cream is as good as it gets! I wish I had the self control to take a photo, but I inhaled my ice cream stuffed doughnut before doing so! The combination of a warm glazed doughnut with any of their artisan ice cream is almost too delicious to describe with words. YOU NEED TO TRY ONE!!! Brandon and Jenifer are some of the coolest and down to earth small business owner's I've had the pleasure of meeting. Go to Novel, bring your friends, and you won't regret it!
Wow! Damn good ice cream. Owners are so nice and you can see their passion. No wonder they have 5 stars. Check this place out!

I love fun and unique experiences... And that is exactly what this was. The outdoor sign caught our attention "ice cream stuffed donuts". My life is now complete. The owner takes pride in the quality of the ice cream flavors as well as the goodness of the donuts. A great break from the hum drum of "usual".
Amazing!!! Seriously the donut and ice cream was delish !!! I will be coming back!!!

We visited this place on our visit to Arizona and we would come back every week if we didn't live in the area! The quality of ice cream is so amazing and the flavors we're so refreshing. On top of all that the ambiance has that local, friendly vibe with a very friendly staff!

The BEST ice cream in AZ!! It is tasty, fresh and soo DELICIOUS! Their donuts pair perfectly with the ice cream (donut sandwich), and they have a lot of flavors of ice cream. Floats are made with your choice of ice cream and your choice of soda. A must have when you are craving and need your sweet tooth fix!

AMAZING ice cream! I only got to try 3 flavours today but they were all good! I ended up getting Honey Lavender (I love lavender) and Butterbeer (I'm a Dumbledork). Great combo! It's nice to know I can get hand-made ice cream for an affordable price. I cannot wait to try the other flavours! Some flavours are "rotating" so you never know when you'll come across a flavour you've never tried before. Brandon (owner?) is super, SUPER nice and friendly. He makes you feel extremely welcome and he seems to really appreciate the business of everyone who walks in. This little boy standing next to me at the store (who apparently was giddy to get his hands on some creamy, delectable ice cream, leaned over to me and said "Brandon is the nicest guy ever." :) There is limited private parking but there are enough parking along the street if you go by car. The store itself is small (stick 7 people in there and it becomes crowded), so it's not a place to sit indoors and enjoy your ice cream, but during the cooler months, there is a small outdoor seating area. But during the summer months, just get your ice cream, run to your car, and crank up the AC to enjoy the taste of whatever delicious flavour(s) you chose! I haven't tried the famed Dough Melt, but I'm trying that next time!

We always drive by this place and finally rode our bikes up to try out. It is awesome. The ice cream stuffed donuts are tasty. The Leslie Knope ice cream sandwich was just as tasty. The price is reasonable for such great craft ice cream. The owner and employees are super friendly and love the local vibe. Will definitely come back again and again.
Best ice cream in town!! I remember going here and you could walk right up, now your are waiting in a line out the door :) This is must!
Kick-ass hole in the wall ice cream spot! Make every ice cream sammy with donuts and cereal! Butter pecan, golden grahams, and a glazed donut...a dream

I heard about Novel from Instagram when they first opened and we JUST got the chance to go. I had a Leslie Knope with Fat Elvis ice cream with reeses puffs, my husband had a dough melt with the cherry sundae ice cream and the raspberry drizzle and my son had a half/half scoop with cookie monster and cherry sundae. Everything was so incredibly delicious, top quality and made with love. The owners, Brandon and Jennifer were so sweet. We will go back and send all of our friends. Love the location too! Super quirky, and it's great to see so many local phx businesses come together and support one another. Proud to be a phx girl. in a nutshell- RUN DON'T DON'T WALK to Novel Ice Cream!

Our waitress at a the vig tipped us off on this place when we needed a late night dessert downtown. Omg, first it's in the cutest historical courtyard. Ask the staff about the history of the buildings. Secondly, ice cream stuffed donuts? Yes please. Worth the 5 minute drive to the arts district if you are downtown for a show or game.

Easily the best ice cream I've ever tasted. I was blown away by how good it was. We tried 6 different flavors, one flight and one in that donut thing that was AMAZING. Nothing was half assed, every single flavor was out of this world and makes any other ice cream I've ever eaten look terrible. The owner was extremely helpful, friendly and cool. Told a little story about the history of the place and the award winning ice cream lady, showed us around all the flavors and offered samples to see what we liked. The ambiance is off the charts. The place is extremely quaint and just makes you wanna stay and hang out in that little square. I can't recommend this place enough. It's the absolute best ice cream in AZ. Go try it now.
The best ice cream in Phoenix hands down. Very good quality product along with friendly owners.
Spiced pear sorbet is amazing! You'd never guess it's dairy free: rich and creamy! We're happy to find this gem on the first night of our Phoenix trip, we'll be back!
Awesome customer service, good variety of ice cream to choose from, amazing flavors and very cool vibe. Would HIGHLY recommend this place to anyone!
Best ice cream I've ever had! I live 30 minutes away and make the drive. Everyone is so friendly when you come in.

Lavender Honey Just gave me life. I found Novel in July 2017 just before my flight to return to Savannah after finding a place to live in Phoenix on a whim. I have introduced a number of friends to Novel, who have introduced a number of their friends as well. Everyone loves it...and you will too. Hands down...best ice cream in Phoenix...quite possibly America.

When you google doughnut and ice cream this is place pops ups. It is so good the fresh in house ice cream is beyond tasty. The people are so friendly and genuine! I had Sicilian pistachio ice cream topped with Cinnamon Toast Crunch all in a warm doughnut
I liked the butter pecan the most, I got it on a Waffle sandwich, Leslie Knopp, I believe it was called. The waffle was so good and tasted as though it had syrup on it, warm mmmm.

Kind of more expensive than the chain ice cream places BUT the ice cream was delicious. Tried roasted almond and the cookie monster flavors. Not too heavy and definitely the cool treat that we needed during the still hot Arizona days. Met the owner. Such a friendly guy. Moreover, the location is such a great place. We were planning to just grab ice cream and go but we felt the vibe and chilled for a bit. Even went back to grab a nice sugar cane Coca Cola from Mexico to complete the afternoon 'snack'. Sad that we were just passing through but definitely glad to help out a local owner and hope to return again.

I have tried many ice cream places that serves the cookie monster flavor and in my opinion Novel Ice cream serves the best! It is a cute small red cabin that has a very helpful staff. The first time I came in this shop the owner explains right away how the ice cream is made and ask how our day was. It's not every day where shops ask about how our day is. This shows how they care about their customers. Novel Ice cream doesn't disappoint!

Stumbled upon this place after searching for dessert near by. It was awesome! I got the dough melt with strawberry shortcake ice cream and loved every last bite. The staff was so friendly and explained all the options and provided suggestions and background info. The line seemed long when we got there but it actually went really quickly.

I can't tell you how amazing this was! A warm donut with Bourbon Toffee Caramel Ice cream, as an ice cream sandwich. Just a little glaze on the donut so not too sweet and creamy homemade ice cream. Soooo good!

Awesome new place!! The ice cream is delicious, full of flavor, and creamy. Fun toppings including your favorite sugar cereals from childhood. The donut melt is out of this world! Hot donut filled with cold ice cream - wow!!! Owner Brandon is charming and super nice!

Awesome idea ran by great people. Had the "Leslie Knope" (ice cream sandwich in between two waffles). We also went with the doughnut stuffed with ice cream as well, and it was ridiculously good. Love that they make everything by hand as well, you can definitely taste the difference. We're visiting from Chicago, and the kids have already made us promise we'll stop there again before we leave!
Wow! The most amazing Cream stuff doughnut I've ever had, actually the first I've ever had!!! Delish!!

Novel ice cream is hands down one of the best spots in Phoenix! The owner Brandon is awesome and super friendly. The staff are always very friendly and welcoming too. I love that they use a lot of local ingredients in their ice cream and are very knowledgable about their product. My favorite is the honey lavender - so tasty! Can't wait to go back and try more flavors.
Great ice cream and friendly staff . I had the waffle ice cream sandwich and it was delicious . Next time I go I'll try the donut ice cream sandwich.
It was the best ice cream I ever had I had a stuffed donut and the out side was warm but the in side was cold I hope I can come back again

Delicious ice cream combined with excellent service. The owners have done their research and are putting their all into this adorable little ice cream shop. They have a rotating menu with several unique flavors including sorbets. And if that's not enough you can add toppings or put your ice cream between a honey bun or on top of a waffle. When you come here you feel like you're helping the little guy and making the world a better place. Plus you get ice cream out of it so it's a win win!

Amazing! They always have small batches of creative flavors and options, the staff is always super nice, and their social media posts are hilarious. There is an ice cream shop like this in my home town, and I'd been looking for one since I moved to Phoenix a few years ago. Finally found it thanks to an invite from a friend last year. Love Novel so much! They're doing it right!

Yuuuuuum! The ice cream donut was soooo good! Warm on the outside and ice cream on the inside. The owners are very friendly and inviting. My kids looooved this awesome treat. I will definitely be going back.

This place is amazeballs. I love ice cream sandwiches and general fattery. This is really wonderful though. I had the lavender ice cream, and it was so incredible, made with real lavender, and really playful and delicious. Brandon and his spouse are lovely folks and their ice cream is bomb. Do it!

A social media moment - Novel Ice Cream popped up on my yelp notifications. It is close to my house so I decided to head on down. That turned out to be a great idea! Brandon and Jenny are great and so is their ice cream. We opted for a Dough Melt - a doughnut stuffed with ice cream. For filling we went with Fat Elvis and Bourbon Caramel. Loved it! Highly recommend that you check this place out. Cool location, great owners, and darn tasty ice cream. N*joy....

They do an incredible job at making you feel welcomed and are very proud and passionate about their product which all around makes for an amazing experience. This treat was unlike any other and I look forward to going back many many times. Also, the patio area out front is perfect for relaxing or for someone like me who always has her dog with her :) Also -- if you do bring your dog they even give your dog it's own special little treat! So sweet!!
The best ice cream in town! All the flavors are amazing and they are very generous when it comes to free samples.

This little shop is run by the most amazing, lovely couple Brandon and Jennifer. They always remember me and ask about how I'm doing! The customer service is EXCEPTIONAL. You meet a lot of people in your everyday life, but you will feel a strong sense of community with the staff here that you don't feel much elsewhere. I never knew getting ice cream would become such an uplifting experience for me. ANYWAYS, the ice cream is AMAZING! Best ice cream I've ever had. I personally always get two scoops of the Bourbon in a waffle cone, but I know their vanilla is award winning and amazing too!!!

We came here for the first time and the service was amazing and the owner was so nice! He was super friendly, and super passionate about his shop. He also let us try everything we wanted and it was overall an exceptional experience! Also, got the donut stuffed with ice cream. BOMB!

The owners take so much pride in what they do and they were so welcoming! They encouraged us to try all of the flavors, and I tried quite a few. I shared a donut with chocolate and Oreo topping with my friend, and had a separate scoop of coconut lime sorbet. Both were awesome! We were there at 6:30 on a Friday, before there were lines. There's no inside seating, so dress appropriately. I highly recommend!
Best of both worlds! Ice cream and donut in one...My favorite flavor: Cookie Monster with Oreos. Come take a look, you won't regret it!
5 stars for a good reason, there vanilla in a donut is A1. Customer service was amazing and they are so nice and explain everything so well
The bourbon caramel toffee ice cream stuffed donut is the most amazing dessert ever created. You. Must. Try. You won't regret it!
I had the chocolate and the strawberry ice cream, and it was ok. Nothing to write mom home about but worth a try for sure.

Amazing ice cream!!! I had the Cookie Monster and it was so damn good. The owner is a kind man and the staff is super nice. Awesome place to go with friends or fam. I'm absolutely coming don't pass this place up!!!!!!
This is the best ice cream I've had in my life, and they're all so nice ! Also creative names, 10/10

Let me just say that I've had a lot of ice cream from around the valley and this place is my new favorite hands down. I tried a little bit of all the flavors and all are spot on, creamy and delicious. For those who haven't been the must have is the ice cream stuffed doughnut. I've seen a few places try to do this but not like Novel Ice Cream. I ended up getting butter pecan with Coco pebbles. The doughnut is warm in contrast to the cold creamy ice cream with the crunch of the cereal. It's too perfect. Not normally one to write reviews but had to give this place props for the amazing dessert. Definitely check out this little hidden gem off of Grand.

I wanted to love this place more than I did. The location and cuteness of it was the best part. The bathroom is located in the restaurant building. It was raining the day we visited and that added the charm. There were two employees working and they were not overly friendly but were efficient. Fun to pick out ice cream, have it stuffed in a donut and then rolled in cereal. The flavors did not pop the way I hoped they would. Loved the flavor options just not the end result.
Absolute best. Owners are super nice and the ice cream is the best there is. The dough melt is now my favorite dessert.
We visit Arizona for Spring Training and found this new GEM in our travels and was not disappointed!!!! It is a must stop for anyone!!! Definitely a unique treat that was incredible!!!!!

This is my favorite place for ice cream in Phoenix! Carefully made, super creamy, and delicious! AND, the people who work here are very nice, and know what's special about the produce. AND... waffle and donut sandwiches!! Try the spiced pear!

This may be the best kept secret downtown Phoenix! My son brought us over there and we've been hooked ever since. We've probably been back over 10 times now in the last 2 months. These guys claim they have an "ice cream chef" .. i sort of believe it...the ice cream is extraordinary. Its too hard to describe here...i suggest you just go there and check them out if you're in the area.

It's a little hard to find, but well worth the trip. The ice cream is very delicious. I ordered a waffle cone with two scoops of ice cream - the Fat Elvis and a bourbon caramel crunch ice cream. My only complaint is that I wasn't able to distinguish the two scoops and there were no chunks. I would have loved to have had actual chunks of bacon and banana in the Fat Elvis and the bourbon crunch had no crunch. But overall the ice cream tasted fresh and delicious.

We came at the recommendation of a good friend. I was intrigued by the thought of donuts filled with ice cream. The place is tucked behind a bar/cafe so don't be afraid to walk in towards the little houses in the back. Novel is a super cute little shop decorated with the cutest paintings. My husband got the butter pecan and he said it was the best he has ever had!!! I enjoyed the vanilla and it was amazing. My 14 year old tried the donut and he was completely in heaven! Great local shop with great service. We will definitely be driving out of our way to come visit this place again!

Flavor, ambience and excellent service. I've been going here since they started and recommend them to anyone I talk to too. Lol. They have a base group of flavors but constantly rotate new and inventive flavors so you never get bored. Why go to a new place to try something different. Just make weekly trips to Novel and check out what fresh flavors they have in stock!

Best ice cream in town The customer service was great. Me and my fiancÃ© drove all way across town just to see what the hype was about ....LISTEN I had the donut and butter pecan with caramel I just can't believe how soft the donut was ..I sound super fat great job ladies

Holy buckets of smooth frozen cream!!! I had to sleep after my first Novel experience to be sure to gather myself together and not write a dissertation on this tasty treat. After a solid 8 hours, here we go... last night I tried Novel, I had heard great things so I had to check them out. First, they were so upbeat! I was told by a friend to try every flavor "because they love when you try all the flavors" I thought she was joking, she was not! They heartily encouraged me to try every flavor, so I did! And wowza were they good!! I settled on pistachio because it is a specialty flavor that they don't have consistently. I normally don't really even like pistachio, but this was delicious!! I had it in a donut, of course, with no additional toppings. I stood there in the shop in creamy doughnutty ecstasy while my friend continued to have a convo with one of the owners. I can't even believe I've lived in Phoenix for a year and this is the first time I've been here! All those days of not eating ice cream or settling for store bought ice cream, breaks my heart! Well those days are gone! Thank you Novel for this amazing experience and phenomenal tasty treat!!

Ice cream stuffed donuts you say?? You are in for a one of a kind treat at Novel Ice Cream. If you have a hard time deciding, try ALL the flavors. I knew what I wanted as soon as I read and saw the blue "Cookie Monster". Their unique DoughMelt was like nothing I've ever had before. At first, the warm and cold felt weird, but tasted great. A few more bites and I was in heaven! This thing works and tastes amazing! I would drive 500 miles, and I would drive 500 more for a DoughMelt. Definitely will be back and with more friends!

Combining the two best things in this world: donuts and ice cream. Where could they go wrong?? They didn't! Both items were delicious, and they were even more delicious together! Be aware though - the blue ice cream will turn your mouth blue!

I cannot begin to describe the awesomeness of this hidden gem. Flavor orgasm in your mouth. I've been to several ice cream shops and this one is right up there with the best. The variety of flavors are a plus and the cookie monster is a must try! If you're in the area stop on by. The staff was very pleasant. I read the angry post by the person that rated them a one star and its hard to believe this establishment would treat anyone without the highest level of respect . Give this place a shot! 5 STARS!
Their donut/ ice cream sandwich WAS DELICIOUS!! They had the most welcoming and kind staff. Although it was a pretty penny, their ice cream was worth it!!!

Always a treat! Great service- your one stop shop to soothe your sweet tooth. I always enjoy a good Cookie Monster, but just be prepared for your mouth to be blue the rest of the night. Give Novel a try for your next dessert stop.
Amazing ice cream, awesome owners, not to be missed! Unique flavors all made small batch, like nothing you will find other places

This place is the best ice cream shop and locally owned. They have unique flavors and they change frequently. I love the honey lavender ice cream. You have to eat on the patio, but it is a nice space near Roosevelt. This place is a real treat! I originally found the shop on Yelp! as I wanted a fun, easy treat for my co-workers. We were all raving fans when we were done!

Even if you just go to try out some crazy blue ice cream, go. Awesome owners answer any and all questions you have, you get to try out every flavor beforehand, you just can't go wrong. Cute building with lots of character, super awesome and delicious creamy goodness of ice cream, great people. You just can't lose.

I had the Dough Melt with honey lavender ice cream and added fruity pebbles. It was absolutely delicious. The service was great from all 3 of the employees that were present. We will be back and we look forward to trying more of their rotational flavors!

My daughter was looking for good ice cream with great reviews. She found Novel Ice Cream! We loved everything about it. The actual shop is a neat place. The service was fabulous. They were very friendly and informative. The ice cream was delicious. We all tried something different. We left very satisfied. I highly recommend Novel Ice Cream. When we're back in Arizona, we will definitely visit again. Great find!!!!

This gem is near the university and close to the airport. It's on a corner lot and on the interior side of the parking lot, so we almost missed it. So glad we found it - This is officially on our list of stops when visiting Phoenix! The chocolate ice cream was hands down the very best ice cream I've ever had! No, I wasn't starving:) It was creamy and rich - so good! The fact that it was wedged inside a donut and sprinkled with Oreos just made it that much more amazing. And we're on vacation, so zero calories, right?
This is a little whole in the wall place the service is awesome. The donut and ice cream with cereal topping is insane

This is my first time here at thirdspace. And the first place to catch my eye was the novel ice cream shop. So right after I finished eating my meal I headed straight over there and was greeted by Jennifer and Brandon. They were awesome and they really took the time to explain what they had and really toon into consideration that it was my first time and walked me through the process of the Stuffed Doughnuts. And seriously they are absolutely pieces of heaven.

If you like ice cream you owe it to yourself to go to Novel. The best ice cream I have ever had served by the equally fantastic owners, Brandon and Travis. Don't be afraid to ask for tastes as they are happy to oblige. You think vanilla is, well, vanilla? Wait until you try their Madagascar Vanilla and be blown away. I'm not a big fan of honeydew (fight me) but Novel has managed the extract all the delicious flavor with none of the usually meh. I ended up getting the Thai ice tea in a donut and it was awesome. This is my first review and Novel earned it 100%. I hope y'all will enjoy Novel as much as I did, and with what Brandon and Travis have done, I am pretty sure you will!

My only regret is not finding this place sooner! Novel is a unique gem! My husband and I came on a Friday night around 8 pm. It was busy but we got to the front of the line in about 10 min. Brandon, the owner, is amazing. He explained all of the ice creams to us and let us sample as many as we wanted. We each tried 3 or 4. I decided on the bourbon toffee caramel crunch in a glazed donut. I loved the warm/cold combo and the flavors were delicious. Brandon has an awesome staff, too. Everyone was very friendly. So excited we discovered Novel!

This place was tucked in a cute little area on Grand Ave. went in for chocolate chip cookie dough ice cream and got this cool Cookie Monster flavor that has cookies all in it! I was in and out and the people that worked there were really nice! (Marissa and I forgot the guys name) They we're friendly and even welcomed me back to Phoenix. I'd choose this place over Coldstone just to support local business! Oh and the waffle cookie they put in there was really chewy and soft! I wish I would've gotten the actual cone!
Amazing people and amazing ice cream. How does it get any better? AND WAFFLES?!? Perfection. Favorite ice cream spot.

I am hesitant to leave 5-star reviews for any place, because I feel as though if you set expectations too high, it may let down others who have different ideas of what 5-star-worthy should be. 4-stars still leaves room for others to be impressed. That said, I'm still giving this place 5-stars and here's why: They have 12 flavors of ice cream, all home made in small batches by a chef with 30 years experience. Two brothers own and run the shop and are very personable. Living in Phoenix, I'm accustomed to dealing with store employees who act like robots and would rather be doing something else. I was confused when everyone that works here was so out-going and friendly. Was I still in Phoenix? I like it! You can have cereal toppings on your home made ice cream, or you can have your ice cream inside of a donut! There are also cones and cups for your ice cream, as well as fresh waffles to sandwich the ice cream in-between! To be honest, I thought the neighborhood was shady, but that's just my old-age attitude. Once you find a place to park down the street, everyone is courteous and friendly. It draws the right crowd. There are several businesses all tucked in behind ThirdSpace (the business you will see from Grand Ave.) It's a very unique layout, with a tattoo shop, a bicycle shop, a smoke shop, a barbershop and Novel ice cream. Across the street is Grand Avenue Pizza and many places around here are open until 4am!!! The ice cream and toppings are fresh and delicious. A pair of brothers own and operate the place. This is what America is supposed to be about. People loving what they do, following their passion and their dreams. How can you NOT support a business like this? Before Ben & Jerry sold out to a major corporation, they used to be a small, family-owned business. I find more value and appreciation from small businesses than ANY corporations. Do yourself and these small business owners a favor and give them a try. You won't be disappointed!!!

We heard about Novel from reviews of the grand avenue festival and decided to give it a try. Wow! I don't ever think I've tasted chocolate ice cream that was as smoooth and rich and creamy as that ever. I really want to try the doughnut "cone".

I saw yelp reviews and had to stop here. I really liked the location of the store. It felt like I was on an island. The owner and staff are really friendly and professional. I wanted to try different flavors and the owner was very patient and happy to have me sample. I got a donut with half a scoop of Cookie Monster and half Madagascar vanilla. It was AMAZING! Perfect for a hot day in Phoenix. Presentation 10/10. Taste 10/10. Quality of donut and ice cream 10/10. If I lived in Phoenix I would come here weekly!
Literally the greatest place on earth! Always new and unique flavors.. always a welcoming awesome environment! If you haven't gone.. go! You won't regret it.
The best ice cream ever. I highly recommend the flavor called Fat Elvis. The customer service was also second to none. We loved it and will be back soon.
Grate place love there ice cream.. best in the valley.. every body needs to try there ice cream.. and the staff is grate and nice service can't go wrong with this place..
Favorite new ice cream shop! I've been 3 times and taken my whole family and haven't been disappointed. Super delicious flavors and super fresh!

Love this ice cream shop, everytime we come we get excited about the new flavors they bring out and they never disappoint. The workers are passionate about what they do and always have so much pride when explaining their flavors.
Truly a great ice cream artisan. Some of the best I've ever tasted. Tucked in the back of a coffee shop courtyard neighborhood.
