Great!! I Would Reccomend this place,Yess!!:) The donuts with the ice cream so Bomb and delicious.
So yummy! The ice cream flavors are so unique and delicious and we love the ice cream donut sandwich!!! Highly recommend!

I celebrated national donut day here last night and OMG I cannot get over how good this place is. I don't even like donuts. I don't think I've ever eaten a whole donut by myself. But last night I devoured a donut stuff with ice cream and fruity pebbles in all of maybe 30 seconds. So good I am heading there again for round 2. This place is addicting in such a good way! The best!!!
This is amazing ice cream! Very funky setting, great guys and wonderful flavors! The butter pecan is out of this world and the strawberry is the best I have ever had.
This place is awesome. The owner was so nice, and the icecream was even better! It's open late too, so it's a perfect place to take a date after dark if you want something sweet.

This is my favorite ice cream in the whole Phoenix area! Every time someone comes out to visit me, I make sure we hit this spot! The atmosphere is awesome, the service couldn't be better and the ice cream flavors are intoxicating! When you go, WHICH YOU SHOULD, get the donut melt! It is to die for.

The donut and ice cream sandwich is life changing. My wife and I are in town for a short vacation and I honestly was blown away by the quality of ice cream from this place. I am not a connoisseur, or an expert, but I eat a fair amount of ice cream. I don't think I have met an ice cream I didn't like. But this place is not even in the same ballpark as any other ice cream place. This is the nectar of the gods. The doughnut for the sandwich was phenomenal. I would move here from Chicago just to go here on a regular basis. If you live in the area you have no excuse. Even if you are within 30 minutes driving you need to do it. If you are passing through... it's worth going out of the way and stopping there for the experience. As for my wife and I? We already are planning on going back before we fly home....
The best ice cream! The ice cream stuffed donuts were amazing. The strawberry ice cream was the best I have ever tasted, i will definitely be coming back!

This place makes my many half-hour-one-way drives to the airport worth it if I get to add this stop off. Ordered the Cookie Monster Dough Melt with Fruity Pebble topping: taste bud party. Super nice folks and they both take a lot of pride in their product and service. Got to try as many flavors as I wanted too (going back for that Fat Elvis and Honey Lavendar next time). Love the hours and the shop is just too cute! See you next time!

Do yourself a favor and get a scoop... ANY scoop of ice cream here! Possibly the best I've ever had! The owner is clearly passionate about what he does and he was so kind and welcoming. Made my night!

First, the owner Brandon was an awesome guy! He went over his ice creams and his vision for the shop. He asked about us and once he found out that we were from out of town he talked to us about our time here. He alone made the experience awesome...and then there was the ice cream! I loved the Cookie Monster and my wife loved the Lavender. I got the Cookie Monster doughnut and my wife got the Cookie monsters and lavender doughnut and OH MY GOODNESS! It was perfect! I could definitely have one every day! Every time I come back to Arizona this would be my first stop!
As always, the best ice cream ever....never disappoints, Cookie Monster all the way for the win.

Nice little ice cream spot that is open late. It's a little hidden in the back of some other restaurants on Grand Ave but promise you will be your go to ice cream spot. They have a ton of flavors and the employees are very nice and informative. They'll let you sample any of the flavors and also make some good recommendations. I got just the plain vanilla and chocolate and they were some of the best tasing ice cream I've ever had you can tell quality and freshness is superior here. Also makes a great date night as Grand Ave Pizza co is across the street you can grab a slice and have some ice cream for dessert.

This is the best ice cream shop in Central Phoenix. Me and my friends are regulars here. Tip try everything even if it seems weird. The doughnut is amazing but too much for me I usually go with a single the ice cream is rich

This place has the best tasting ice cream I've ever had, hands down! Put those amazing flavor concoctions into a fresh glazed donut and you have a little slice of heaven. My family and I happened upon this place by accident after leaving the Science Center and we will most definitely be coming back. My husband, son and I all chose to get the donut stuffed with ice cream, while my daughter opted for two scoops in a cup. Both kids got the Cookie Monster flavor (comes with a few blue mouth lol), while my husband got the Madagascar vanilla. I opted for a duo of the more adventurous Fat Elvis (peanut butter ice cream, banana pieces and bacon bits) and Bourbon Caramel Crunch - which is seriously the BEST ice cream I've ever had in my entire life. We also enjoyed sampling the unique bottles soda flavors out of the mini fridge. The best part about our visit however was the amazing customer service. We have been to another local ice cream shop several times (starts with an M) and while the flavors are good, we have been treated horribly by the staff every time. We are super excited to have a new unique local shop to frequent where the people are actually nice and the food is amazing. Win win!!

I don't give 5 stars often. 1. This was open with no line about 3 on a Saturday. 2. They had honey lavender ice cream. 3. They had honey lavender ice cream 4. Did I say...okay, okay. They also had other awesome selections which we were able to sample. They were all good! . Donut ice cream sandwich! My wife loved it with the bourbon toffee crunch ice cream. They are all creamy and just the right amount of sweetness! Can't wait to go back. Must try!

My family and I love this place! The owner now recognizes us, not sure how good that is...haha!! We live in Buckeye and make the drive anytime we want ice cream...we won't go anywhere else. Splurge on the donut, you really won't regret it!

The ice cream stuffed donut may be the best thing I have ever eaten. I had the bourbon Carmel ice cream stuffed in a warm donut with a Carmel drizzle. My daughter had the cookie monster vice cream in a donut. Best desert ever.

While visiting Phoenix with family, we stopped at Novel for after lunch ice cream. Brandon, the owner, greeted us immediately and encouraged us to sample as much ice cream as we desired. Between the five of us we all had a Doughmelt which included a warm donut with a generous scoop of ice cream and a topping of our choice. Each flavor we had was excellent, but the experience with Brandon was definitely what made this a five-star location.
Novel Ice Cream has extraordinary ice cream. I would definitely recommend this place to everyone. I am absolutely coming back to this place as soon as possible!
Came down for the "soft" opening, great desert, good vibes atmosphere fits the name! Creative flavours and great people, will be back next time im in the downtown area :)
Sweet sweet lemon basil sorbet this place is a hidden gem that I will not stop coming to.

This place is an absolute must! We walked in fully expecting to leave with a small scoop for our group. We had just completed an incredibly large meal, and we already we're feeling like ice cream was overkill. How wrong we were. We talk to the staff, and by the time we finished sampling we knew what we were going to order: the donut ice cream sandwiches. If the donuts or ice cream (or both for that matter) weren't good it would still be the best experience I ever had, but every aspect of the sandwich was perfect. I was in utter disbelief by how amazing the experience was, and we came back two days later. Whenever I'm nearby I always try to make a not to come by. This place is an absolute must.

Cute little low key ice cream shop. They have great customer service and are super friendly, sociable, and helpful. Their ice cream is absolutely delicious and you can get the ice cream stuffed into a donut. I was pleasantly surprised how warm and fresh the donut was and the ice cream was deliciously sweet and so thick it hardly melted inside of the donut!
Amazingly delicious. Such a great idea. A doughnut ice cream sandwich with hand crafted artisan ice cream. I can't even describe how delicious it was. A must try.

This ice cream spot... First let's start with the staff. There were two brothers who make the ice cream, donuts, and run the place themselves. One brother does your order, and the other is very nice and asking about if we've been here before and such. I got the donut melt with the Cookie Monster, and I would say that the donut and ice cream is a creative combination. I wouldn't say it tastes the best because it was a little overpowering in flavor. Other than that, if I would recommend the honey lavender flavor because that seems less overwhelming. Side Note: They have innovative and different flavors.

Best ice cream ever! We all had the ice cream filled donut. My kid had vanilla (only flavor he likes) and he said it was the best vanilla ever. I had honey and lavender and that was sooooo good. We are visiting from California and we will make it a point to come here the next time we visit.

Very good first experience, husband and wife owned business. Very friendly people & they let us try everything! I got the doughnut sandwich with sweet tiki ice cream and lucky charm mellows! The donut was warmed and the ice cream surprisingly did not melt! It was delicious!

As always it was a late night run ha ha We packed up the kids and went for it. The ice cream was delicious and the customer service was awsome! The woman had ice cream scoops but listen to me, get the ice cream stuffed glazed doughnut! It's a bad mfr!
I will be a customer for life! Just love this place. Creative, fun and unique ice cream place. I hope they do more collaborations with local brews the owner and staff are great people!

This place has LAVENDER HONEY ice-cream, which in itself is a dream come true, BUT THEN they stuffed it inside of a warm, fresh donut. Oh my lawd. Do yourself a favor, or should I say FLAVOR, and go. Next time I will be trying the Leslie Knope... Go check it out.

In Phoenix visiting and the kids wanted ice cream. Did some yelp searching and found this place . I had the chocolate ice cream with donut. Absolutely delicious. The location is super cute as well. Worth checking out. You won't be disappointed.

Amazing lemon basil sorbet!! It was super tangy, not too sweet and just a hint of basil. My bf had bourbon caramel ice cream and said it was over the top delicious. The shop is located next to a few other unique shops that share a common courtyard with plenty of seating. The customer service is outstanding, too. The owner kept offering sample after sample without tire. I'm hoping next time we return they have a different vegan offering, but if not, I don't mind as that lemon -basil was delicious.
Located in such a beautiful area, this small shop had a big impact on my sweet tooth! The staff were friendly and inviting and the ice cream was spectacular. 10/10 recommend!
Awesome ice cream!!! I had the butter pecan, my husband had Nutella, and our son had strawberry. All were amazing!!! Very friendly staff. Can't wait to come back.

The ice cream was so wonderful, it was soft & sweet & the perfect amount of flavor in each bite! We tried so many different flavors and literally every single one was good!! I got the (I think it was called) sugar cookie which was to die for! My boyfriend got the lavender flavor, I didn't try it but he did say it was so good & after every bite he took he talked about how good it was! I personally couldn't get o we the real lavender pieces but he loved it! NOW onto the service. The 2 workers there were SO nice & explained everything & every ice cream to us which i thought was really sweet! They asked us how we heard of them we told them we just ate up the street so they asked us how our dinner was & they genuinely seemed interested in our night! & then THEY thanked US for allowing them to be apart of our night not just "thanks for coming in" which I thought was so cool! Overall a good experience & will most definitely be back!
Best ice cream ever! Highly recommend going totally baked!! U will want to eat the whole place! Keep it chronic 420 baked style ya know!!!

After searching around yelp for a couple days I settled on going to Novel. Best decision! Cutest shop, hidden away in a neat little area with a tattoo shop and a couple other shops. We were greeted by the nicest guy, asking a few questions about us then explaining their flavors and options. They want you to try as many flavors and really encourage it! We got a Cookie Monster and Madagascar vanilla in a donut with fruity pebbles. This ice cream is ridiculous! Probably one of the best I've ever had. Super creamy and great texture. Put into the warm donut which was amazing too, it was incredible. I had been craving ice cream and now I will be thinking about this spot back in Washington!

They have unique flavors that are all awesome! My favorite is the vanilla lavender. I was skeptical and worried that a donut with ice cream would be sugar overload but it's actually really good. Not your average ice cream shop. They always have the best customer service; they're so nice and friendly!

Ok if you want amazing, creative ice cream flavors/combos, this is the place to go! You can also put the ice cream in a donut and when you do that, you'll never wanna get ice cream another way from another place! The guys who work there are the most friendliest, chillest people around. So stop on in and give them a tip! They deserve it!

This place is amazing. Went again tonight and had the Ron Swanson ice cream on a doughnut cuz there is no better way....another awesome dessert. I was brought here by one tough critic who could not stop talking about how good it was a year and a half ago. I have now taken 2 tough critics; a few indifferent friends upset we drove 40 minutes and passed at least one ice cream place on the way; and a 9 (now ten) year old who just loves sugar. They all have the same thing in common. They will make the 40 minute drive any time they can without my prodding now. Not sure what you need to read to go but here it is Best ice cream maker/designer/chef or whatever the proper term is who always has a new favorite thought up when I go....seriously the Ron Swanson was amazing. An award winning doughnut to throw the ice cream in. Your favorite kids cereal to throw on top And an owner who manages to work 15 hours a day or some ridiculous amount, be there every time I go, and not once be in a bad mood or anywhere near it. Tonight we went there and it was slammed. Not one person could go inside (if anyone seriously asks why I'll be scared at this point) but the line was healthy even though it was north of 100. Don't get me wrong they got us up there really quick and don't be dissuaded by the line length if you go. But even then when we got up there and the owner found out it was my gf first time he explained how everything was prepared. What to do and suggested what she get. We were out in a hurry but never felt rushed. GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!

The owner as well as the lady that took our order were very friendly and welcoming. Ice cream (only item we tried) was delicious! The flavors were natural and we were happy campers with what we got. Service, price, ambiance and flavors get all 5 stars!!
Wow. Fantastic ice cream. Tres leches cake was my favorite. Owner and staff are super nice.

Great, great, great!!! First time visiting this place & was very impressed! We had the melt (donut) stuffed with half Bourbon Carmel Toffee Crunch & half Fat Elvis.....Super DELICIOUS!! We will definitely come back again!!

Hands down the best ice cream in a Phoenix! Don't be put off by its location and small size, this place is worth the visit. They are always changing up their flavor options, and always have something super unique! It's all made in house, and you are welcome to sample it all. They offer doughnut ice cream sandwiches, yes doughnut ice cream sandwiches. It sounds like too much but they are actually perfect! Not too sweet, and not overly huge. They even get pressed inside a warm panini machine that warms them to perfection before enjoying. Last time I stopped in I hade their vanilla bean ice cream which sounds super plain but it was by far the best tasting and most fresh vanilla bean I have ever tasted! It has won awards for its flavor (no joke). They don't advertise and rely solely on word of mouth, super sweet and personable to all customers. LOVE this place.

What can I say that everyone hasn't already said? This place is delicious and every time someone comes to visit from out of town we always come here. The workers are always nice and willing to share the information about their ice cream and doughnuts. I love this place! They're open late on the weekends as well, If you have a craving for icecream or just desert don't go anywhere else!

So good! I had a donut sandwich with Elvis ice cream & Reese's puffs cereal, my brother had the waffle sandwich with butter pecan & Cap'n Crunch. I mean how can you go wrong! The brothers that operate the shop were amazingly friendly and insightful about their product. Will be back!

La flameyyyy!!!! The perfect donut and ice cream proportion. Not too sloppy, and fit perfect in your hands. I got the Cookie Monster mix with the STRAIGHT UP STRAWBERRY and I will be getting that next time I go. The ice cream specialist was so nice and informative. You can tell he loves his job, and is proud to work there. I will be back

Novel is the BEST (by far) dessert in Phoenix! Whether you prefer a simple scoop or a treat with all the fixings, Novel has you covered. Brandon is incredibly knowledgeable and passionate about his ice cream and the shop he runs. We have been coming to Novel since the beginning and will continue to bring all out of town guests and friends to this shop!

Went in for the animal circus ice cream, found out about the stuffed donut melt, so I got that ice cream in the donut and it was perfection. The donut was perfectly warmed and the ice cream was amazing. We also ended up getting the monster cookie ice cream and that was hands down the BEST ice cream I have ever had (we ended up getting more of the Cookie Monster ice cream on the same trip)

This is my new favorite ice cream place in Phoenix! An ice cream sandwich made with a donut - FANTASTIC!!! I have had the Cookie Monster ice cream with the glazed donut twice now... And there are soo many different flavors... I can't to come back again!!
Great delicious flavors of ice cream. And can try a bunch in a sample muffin pan dish!
Literally the best Ice cream I've had in my life. Ice cream is so tasty on a donut! Also comes with waffles, which tastes like a chocotaco
This is literally the CUTEST PLACE EVER. The owner was so nice, my new favorite place to come with friends or family :))
Love the ice cream here would Recommend to any one who loves ice cream. It's a great date night snack or if your just out with friends

Not only is this some of best Ice cream, donuts and waffles I've ever had but the owners and staff are incredibly friendly and helpful! I am so blown away by this little hole in the wall spot! It reminds me of the places I used to go to in nyc. The ice cream by itself is incredible and totally worth the trip, add the unbelievable warm donut or waffle ... I have no words... other then absolutely amazing ... and worth every penny and then some!
Incredible flavors, unique ideas with the donuts and waffles. I come here as much as my diet permits!
Tried going to melt first, but they were closed. Their loss, our gain. Sweet young lady at counter was amazing and had great produxt knowledge. The waffle knope was delicious!

Amazing little place in a quirky neighborhood serving unique ice cream and out of this world donuts. I could go on and on about Novel. Definitely the best glazed donut I've had in a long time. I love how light and not to sweet these are and they make the perfect "bun" to sandwich a scoop of creamy ice cream between. The owner is super hospitable and sincere, and makes you feel welcomed. My family and I can't wait to go back!
Stopped here tonight and really enjoyed it! I got a dough-melt with cookie monster ice cream and fruity pebbles - so good. It's located in a cute little spot in Third Space. Lots of outdoor seating.

I am not an ice cream fan as I am not really fond of sweet things. My husband usually gets something and I taste it and then I am done with ice cream. That's what I was expecting when he asked if I wanted to try this place. He ordered a donut with a scoop of honey lavender ice cream. He took it, had a bite and offered it to me for my taste. Imagine my shock when I didn't want to give it back to him. I asked for my own and ate the whole thing! Best ice cream I have ever had! We go back every time we are in Phoenix. I rave about it and drag all of my out of town visitors to try it.

Just tried this place for the first time last week and it did not disappoint! A lot of great flavors. I had honey lavender ice cream and it was AMAZING! The workers were also very friendly. Definitely coming back!
The hype about this place is spot on! The most delicious ice creams and sorbets you will taste. Brandon and staff are so friendly. Don't miss this place!

Here's the thing. I'm an ice cream inTHUSIAST, okay. I have high standards for my ice cream. This place, SURPASSED expectations. The staff are amazing. Personable. Fun. And care about their job. They're more interested in the customer than the sale. The ice cream is so so good. They have one of the most decorated ice cream chefs(one might say ice cream wizard) make their delectable creams. All batches are small batch made so you know it gon be fresh. Try it. Love it. Tell your friends.

I've had amazing customer service every time I've stopped by. The ice cream is freaking delicious 500 something reviews later and they are still standing at 5 stars for a reason. I literally have not had better ice cream than this place, I tell everyone about it!

The dough melt here is so delicious it should be against the law! The combination of warm donut and ice cream is just heavenly. Staff was very friendly and helpful. It is a little hard to find but worth the search.

This is a pretty cool ice cream shop. They allowed me to sample some flavors and the honey lavender ice cream really stood out to me. I decided to have that in the glazed donut with fruity pebbles. It was a really nice combination. The fruity pebbles added a nice crunch. However, I thought the donut was supposed to be glazed but mine wasn't and neither was my friend's. Other than that, it was good!
Great flavors and awesome service! Our favorite ice cram spot!

I drove the kids 45 minutes across town in the blistering heat to try this place on Father's Day and I'm glad we did. The owners are great people, the ice cream is amazing, and it's tucked away in a cool little retail location with a local artsy vibe. Try it, you won't be disappointed.

Holy freakin crap this was the absolute best treat. It's tucked in a laid back court yard but don't let that fool you. The owner is super friendly and helpful in helping you try to narrow the many many options to a donut sandwich of ice cream perfection. We're only in Phoenix a few days but will for sure try to come back at least once if not twice more. Go there. Right now.
The ice cream/donut sandwich is the most delicious thing I've ever tasted. This place is a must visit.
They have a wide varied of flavors and toppings and each one is delicious! Brandon, the owner and the rest of the staff are very friendly and personable as well. I highly recommend Novel Ice Cream!
Best ice cream around! Novel combines two of my favorite things by somehow filling warm fresh donuts with super good artisan ice cream in the center. A+++

Hands down best ice cream shop me and my family had a very fun time my nephew had the Cookie Monster my sister had the honey lavender I had the Leslie knope and my brother in law had the donut ice cream sandwich with the Elvis ice cream and we all absolutely loved everything amazing place

The best service ever. I don't mean to exaggerate but the patience is overwhelming and the humbleness gives you a feel of "home". I don't know them but they are super sweet. The ice cream - no preservatives at ALL. You have to try the dough melt with Cookie Monster flavor ice cream and captain crunch as a topping.

Stopped in before the rush on a Friday night. We are new to town and looking for a new favorite ice cream shop and we definitely found it! Everyone in the shop was very friendly and Brandon did a great job making sure we chose our favorite flavor. We will definitely be back!

My cousins Christina and Manny favorite spot, this place is amazing and delicious!! The donut melt is to die for with the banana ice cream and the cookie monster is out of this world!! (Warning it will turn your mouth blue ) give them a try and it's reasonable priced

Such a cute little establishment in the Grand Avenue Arts District, downtown! They always rotate their ice cream flavors so you'll always have a new flavor to try. Never thought I'd have lavender flavored ice cream til I stopped here. It's amazing! Add a warm donut to the mix and it's a great way to make anyone's day! The staff are always so friendly and make you feel as if you've known them forever with the way they engage so effortlessly. Definitely a must have if you're ever in the area!

Me and my friends had a great time at novel ice cream Sara Jalen and Nami took great care of us and were great conversationalists. The butter pecan ice cream is great and the cookie monster was great too. Highly recommend stopping by for a visit
Oh my gosh! Best waffle ice cream sandwich I've ever had!! You have to try this place!!!

With so many 5 star reviews this place caught our attention. On a recent trip to Phoenix one night we decided to have ice cream for dinner. (Try it sometime!) We loaded up and made our way to Novel. It's in a nice, working class neighborhood with well maintained houses just off 7th Ave. it's an area quickly gaining a good reputation for innovative and high quality dining choices. As soon as we walked in we were welcomed by Brandon who told us about their ice cream, the awards they've won and what they are most famous for: stuffed doughnuts. After my family and I tried several samples we each chose a different flavor and a topping for our stuffed doughnut. It's a glazed doughnut without the hole that is used to make a sandwich for their delicious, creamy ice cream. The food alone was worth a 5 star review. But I wish I could give it 6 stars because Brandon and the two helpful and charming young ladies that helped us were warm and friendly and made us feel so welcome. I travel to Phoenix several times a year but sadly this was my first time coming to Novel. Don't repeat my mistake. Of all the places I've been in Phoenix this tops the list of must sees when it comes to dining.
Ice cream, doughnuts and cereal all in one place with super customer service! Unique flavors located in a quiet spot in Phoenix. Close to downtown Phoenix next to a lot of cool spots.

Wonderful experience... we stop by based on yelp reviews to find a lovely small little ice cream boutique shop with homemade specialty ice cream. It was just spectacular. We had bourbon caramel something or another, I fell in love. You can order with a donut or a waffle. Owners are great too. We will be bsck

One of the best ice cream I've ever had. Can't remember the full names but on the two times I came here I ordered bourbon, strawberry (not the original strawberry) and taro coconut and all were so amazing. I even sampled multiple other flavors such as honey lavender, the peanut butter one, cookie and more. The ice cream is rich and creamy without being too overpowering. I also tried their Donut sandwhich and I really liked their donut as well. It was a pretty light donut so it complimented the ice cream very well, but I prefer just getting a cone or cup. The service was quick and incredible. I sampled almost all the flavors before choosing the flavors I wanted to order and although they were a little busy they did not seem to mind at all. 10/10 highly recommend this place, so delicious!
They have very unique flavors and their ice cream is delicious! The owner was very nice and engaging. We don't live far so we will be back soon!

This place is absolutely adorable and the ice cream is to die for! I had the Dough Melt with Bourbon Caramel Toffee Crunch topped with Cinnamon Toast Crunch. Ummm, one word...delicious. The staff are super inviting and helpful too. I'll definitely be back!

The flavors are great, the vibe is very chill, and best of all, the donut ice cream sandwich was not messy or unwieldy at all! We expected the process of actually eating the delicious creation to be a lot more hazardous than it was- instead, you are able to enjoy it all the way through! Great customer service too, even with long lines.

Get the warm donut with your choice of ice cream. It's an amazing combination, they deliver with the donut and the ice cream on so many levels. Super friendly staff as well. Hoping to revisit this place soon. It's a messy but orgasmic ride. Have a lot of napkins ready.
Wow.. amazing recommend by a good friend of the family. Your kids mouth will drop once they try the Cookie Monster Flavor

They have the best service, super friendly and very clean. We arrived on Sunday right at closing and they heard my 5 yr old so bummed out because it was closed, they went out of their way to open the door and serve us! This was a priceless experience to me!

Incredible ice cream, truly some of the best I've ever had and the staff/owners are wonderful! Even my husband who hates dessert said their honey lavender ice cream was the best ice cream he's ever had. I'm only sad I didn't come here sooner.

This is a must visit ice cream shop! There is a constant rotation of new and unique ice cream flavors and their dough melts are heavenly with the perfect balance of doughnut fluffiness but dense enough to hold the ice cream. I go there every time I'm in the area

We stopped in yesterday after reading the amazing Yelp reviews and certainly weren't disappointed! This ice cream is just so yummy. My husband had the lemon sorbet (some of the best ever), I had the honey lavender (unique and so tasty) and our dog had a scoop of free vanilla ice cream (love that they are so pet friendly). The owners are so friendly and genuinely grateful for the business...we will definitely be back again and again!

Found this place on yelp and I am not disappointed. Cute little shop with amazing owners! They were both so welcoming and detailed with what they had to offer. All of their homemade artisan ice creams are soooooo good! I was so indecisive after sampling everything but ended with honey lavender which is AMAZING. Check this place out!

I love the ice cream and the people at Novel! The waffle and donut ice cream sandwiches are must haves. Their regular flavors are great and the rotating flavors are always delicious and innovative. Definitely worth a try!

Great variety of homemade ice cream and toppings- lucky charms marshmallows, so good on ice cream! The owner was super friendly and recommended flavors since this was our first visit. The chocolate was delicious and the Cookie Monster was a fun twist on cookies and cream... 12/10!!

This place is worth all the hype! Brandon was so sweet and let my husband and I try as many flavors as we needed before making our choice, which is hard because all the flavors are delicious! We both ended up going with a donut sandwich and were not disappointed! We will definitely be back!

This place is truly something special. My husband and I came into Novel Ice Cream tonight. We were greeted by Brandon, the owner, who explained all about the small batch ice cream made here. He let us try any flavors we wanted. He took the time to ask us our names and showed appreciation for each customer who visited Novel. As for the ice cream- it's fantastic! I looooved the Lychee sorbet on a sugar cone. Lychee is one of my favorite fruits but I've never had it in ice cream. It was so smooth, light, and aromatic. My husband had the lychee sorbet on donut. Like, how can you not love a place that serves ice cream on a donut? Total win.

the Leslie Knope waffle ice cream sammy is glorious. The waffle is perfectly fluffy and comes freshly pressed off the waffle iron and the ice cream in the middle is so light and delicious. It's hard to explain the phenomenon. You kinda have to be there. You won't be disappointed.

Oh my goodness! What a gem. I had the dough melt with sweet cream and honey. Whoever thought of using a donut for an ice cream sandwich is a genius. Best dessert I've had in Phoenix. Love the small and fresh batches of ice cream, which when paired with a warm donut is heavenly. Great service from the owner's too. I will be back again.
Super cute place. Friendly and helpful staff. Great ice cream and very creative creations to enjoy. I would definitely recommend this place. Also, very reasonably priced. .

We tried this place out after finding it in yelp. I will definitely be back. I was pleased with the great customer service and overall atmosphere. I had the butter pecan and it was great. I would recommend stopping by.

Hands down best ice cream sandwich I've ever had. I ordered there fresh waffle ice cream sandwich which was unreal, the customer service was awesome, really cool place, I will definitely be back again!
Such friendly staff that made you feel very welcome. Not to mention how amazing the icecream was!!
Greatest spot and greatest owners. Every flavor is amazing!! I've gone twice now and will for sure be coming back many more times. A true Phoenix treasure.

Absolutely the best ice cream!! I tried honey lavender and it's so delicious. I also recommend getting Madagascar Vanilla, it's a rich vanilla taste. The place is known for their doughnut and ice cream sandwiches. I highly recommend getting the doughnut ice cream, the doughnut is made fresh from a local baker and it's lightly glazed so you're hands don't get too messy. I recommend honey vanilla with the doughnut sandwich. I will be coming back regularly. (Also the workers there are so nice and chill)

I would give this shop 5 stars based on the ice cream alone. I'd give it 5 more stars, if I could, for the ice cream donut sandwiches. I'd give it 100 stars for the staff. The dudes that run it are always friendly & seem like they really love what they are doing. There are a lot of places out there that sell good ice cream, but there are so few that do it so well AND with great, unpretentious, customer service. Love 'em. Just absolutely love 'em.

When I travel I love to check out different ice cream shops. This trip to Arizona my husband and I lost track of time and we were really pushing our time to make it to Novel and not miss our flight. Soon as we got there we couldn't really find the location, so frantically rushed for time I asked a random girl on the road. She informed me it was closed on Mondays and to come back Tuesday at 12. I told her that we were in our way to the airport, but thanks for the info. She proceeded to inform me that she worked there and would would open the shop just for us!! This was the PERFECT way to end our trip. The ice cream here was AMAZING and so flavorful, and the amazing service was the cherry on top. I got the Cookie Monster and cherry chip smash in a doughnut. Thank you SOO much Novel for making my day and ending my trip on the most perfect note.

DoughNOT miss out on this delectable treat. Donut ice cream sandwich with bourbon toffee crunch is the perfect combination of light fluffy dough with sweet, salty, crunch, cream perfection. The donut is half glaze donut and half sweet bun. In addition we had to get the indecision... because commitment is the worst, so why not have it all? Cookie monster, butter pecan, bourbon toffee crunch, strawberry and berry Madagascar vanilla... worth every bite.

This cute little ice cream shop was huge in flavor! The people there were super welcoming and made us feel really welcomed. I tried the honey lavender ice cream with the donut and my husband tried their chocolate ice cream in a donut. Best decision ever! I would definitely come back again!
You take a donut and heat it up... slice it down the middle and then pack it with the best vanilla ice cream known to man and make a sandwich. I should of thought of that! Seriously amazing!
Awesome please plus they are dog friendly and my Siberian husky loves coming here for his special treat
Loved the Leslie Knope with cookie monster ice cream The waffle was so delicious & worth the price. Definitely coming back!

All of these 5 star reviews speak for themselves, but hell what's another one? This place sure deserves it! My fiancÃ© and I discovered this place on yelp and decided to try it out one day. The famous dough melt really caught our eye and that's what we were set on. Upon arriving at this place, it's in a cute little closed in area with little shack looking/tiny home-esque businesses and lots of outdoor seating. Parking is limited as the lot is small, so if it's busy, you may need to find another place to park. Luckily when we went we were able to get a spot. When going inside you may feel a little claustrophobic. It's pretty tight inside, especially because most of the time there's a line going outside and quite a few people inside. The employees never rush you though, which is very much appreciated. The lady was nice enough to let me try a few flavors before making my decision, and I finally ended up going with the bourbon caramel toffee crunch (I believe it was called) and it was so good! My fiancÃ© ended up going with the chocolate. We also both got chocolate pebbles as our topping. As soon as they handed the dough melts to us, the donuts were warm and soft, and smelled simply delightful. We went outside and and each took a bite and we both looked at each other like it was the best thing we've ever had. The donut was so fresh, soft, and glazed perfectly. Paired perfectly with the cold ice cream. A great little treat on a warm day! Definitely recommend this little place to anyone eyeing the dough melt! Worth it by far! We will for sure be coming back many, many times in the future!

I already want to go back for more and I finished mine about 30 mins ago. I had the pumpkin cheesecake ice cream in a cup and it was wowomg good. Larger cheesecake pieces than I normally find in ice cream, which was a huge plus for me because it was so good. We were nicely greeted as soon as we walked in and you can tell they really believe in the products they sell. Very friendly and plenty of options to choose from. I wish I would have found this place months ago. Cant wait to go back and try a new flavor and this time get it in a donut.
Super yummy! The staff is beyond nice. We are in for a short visit from Houston and so glad we found this place on yelp.

This is a sweet little gem hidden in down town Phoenix. If you haven't been in before, I definitely recommend you, your partner and your friends, and your dog (!!) all head out and go get some Cookie Monster on a cone or their pecan praline was amazing too. It would have been way more awesome of an experience if I wasn't too cold to sit outside and watch the free love DJ; unfortunately, Novel is the size of my bathroom so you can't sit in there or stand really. No knocks on Novel! Just keepin it real. The staff are very respectful and know their shite! They were pleasant and helpful. Overall it was great. Tad pricey but I guess you get what you pay for!
Love this place!! Cookie monsters dough melt is the best hands down! Great service, great people and amazing ice cream!
Get the donut sandwich with Cookie Monster ice cream and fruity pebbles. So good! Also your mouth will be completely blue.

I thoroughly enjoyed myself at Novel Ice Cream. Brandon was extremely friendly and knowledgeable about their flavors. I did not have the chance to get the name of the cashier but she was extremely welcoming as well. She gave me a few recommendations of places to visit while I was in Phoenix. I tried the half honey lavender/half strawberry ice cream and it was absolutely delicious. I would highly recommend anyone visit this establishment to try this place at least once!

Today I visited this wonderful new shop and it was the best decision I made all day! The owners are super friendly and very knowledgeable about their product. I can tell they truly care about and love what they do. It really shows through! I am not a huge ice cream lover, but today I may have changed my mind. I tried several different flavors, all delicious, but I settled on the Panne Cherry. And trust me, this is the flavor you need to enjoy. The creaminess of the ice cream was perfect, not over sweet or any bit icy. The delicate flavor of the cherries throughout was extraordinary! And because it is an option, I had this wonderful creation sandwiched in a doughnut. Yes a doughnut! So put Novel on your list of places to go, and soon!! With, I believe, 12 different flavor options (EVEN a vegan option) you are sure to find one to suit you!
Icecream was delicious.. decent priced and well made. not toooo sweet.. although it is icecream, sweethtooth! lol

Wow...this place is amazing. The ice cream is delicious and I got it stuffed between a warm glazed donut. The owner was incredibly nice and welcoming. If you are in Phoenix and are searching for a unique local treat, this is the place!
One of my favorite places for dessert. It's a hidden gem but the donut ice cream sandwiches are amazing!

The ice cream is amazing. Not only that, but a hot donut sandwiching it made my day. Definitely fairly priced, and the people running it are kind and proud of their business. I will definitely be back!

Been here twice and loved it each time. The ice cream is truly incredible. I haven't found another ice cream shop in AZ that matches its quality. To top it off, both times I've been in the owner has been working and he will let you take your time to ask questions and try as many flavors as you want. You can tell he just wants you to have the best experience possible. I can't say enough good things about this place, it's definitely worth trying out.

Ice Cream stuffed Donuts !!! Need a I say more? Great Ice Cream flavors, friendly staff, if you're downtown and need to satisfy a sweet tooth you have to stop in. Tucked away just off Grand, so it's easy to miss.

I am visiting Phoenix for a few days and had some time to kill today. Based on the reviews, I hoped it would be worth the one mile walk to Novel in the 100 degree heat. It was! I was blown away by how good the ice cream was. They had so many fun flavors that were perfect for the season. Even better, the owner and woman working were so friendly and engaging. I felt so welcome in their store! Thank you so much for a great experience! :)
Great flavor. The donut with ice cream it is so good. The ice cream melts nicely. We might think it sounds too sugary but it balances the flavors.

So happy we stopped by last night. Novel ice cream is in the cutest location with surrounding restaurants. The owner was so personable and really made it point to introduce himself, talk about his journey opening his ice cream shop and showing his appreciation for his customers. We were all super impressed with him and the ice cream donut! We will definitely be back
Unbelievably good ice cream paired with a small business owner who is genuinely very kind. We love this little shop off Grand Ave. They even offer gluten free cones which is so great for our kiddo.

Novel is the best!! It is the highest rated ice cream shop on yelp for a reason. Whenever I come into town I make sure to stop here. The owner Brandon is really nice. Also kailey is amazing too! They both always give me great suggestions for new things to try.
I have come here now twice within just a few days. Amazing concept with ice cream inside the donut. Omg so good. The people that work here are so wonderful. I keep being my friends. Love it
The best ice cream I've ever had. Such a cute little shop. Owner is so kind & the ice cream is so delicious. Very underrated. Will be coming back again!

I had heard about this place for awhile, so my hubby and I drove an hour to get there from across the valley to have a birthday treat. Totally worth it - best ice cream / donut and the guy that helped us was very passionate and excited to tell us about the flavors. Great experience!

Amazing ice cream! I had a dough melt with cookie monster ice cream and both the ice cream and the donut were top notch. Awesome, cozy location. The owner was super nice and informative. Will recommend to anyone!
Tried Cookie Monster, matcha, and honey lavender. All were so good! The owners were also super friendly. Would definitely recommend :)

I've never written a review about an ice cream place but if you're in town holy heck get ice cream here. It is honestly the best ice cream I have ever had. The people working there are so nice as well! Also they let you taste as many flavors as you want so how can you go wrong with a place like that!! All I can say is go enjoy some delicious ice cream.

This is my favorite ice cream joint by far. Not only is the quality a cut above, but the various ways you can get it is so much fun. Nothing better than stopping here on a hot summer day. The different flavors are plentiful and I haven't had even one that was only mediocre.

We were on the hunt for a good dessert place after a show at the Talking Stick Resort Arena. We found this place by browsing yelp, and boy are we glad we stopped by! I got the honey lavender and lemon poppyseed side by side, between 2 European style waffles (aka Leslie Knope style!). My husband got the strawberry ice cream sandwiched in a doughnut. They were both sooo good!! My husband is very picky, but he seriously said it was the best thing he's ever eaten. The doughnut was not overbearingly sweet and went so well with the creamy ice cream. The owners were so friendly and welcoming! Would definitely come here again!

Seriously best ice cream, "dough melt," and experience. The Dream Team KILLED it on their costumer service and I can tell you that you won't be disappointed if you go here. If there is a line, I promise it is worth the wait. I had the "dough melt" with the Honey Lavender ice cream in it, and it was THE BEST EVER! Go and try it now... like right now.

The owners were super friendly and had great customer service. The Strawberry ice cream was very yummy and my boyfriend had the Bourbon Caramel. I'm gluten-free and they have GF cones which I was very excited about!

We had the donut stuffed with butter pecan ice cream and it was heaven!! The donut is warm and the ice cream is so fresh and creamy! Jennifer and Brandon were so friendly and let us try as many flavors as we wanted, we will definitely be back!!

Oh em gee! New ice cream shop in the Thirdspace complex. They have amazing hand crafted flavors like honey lavender and marscapone coffee whosiewhaty. I had the "Leslie Knope" which is a freshly made waffle sandwich with the honey lavender. The waffle adds a little crunch and is not too sweet. The ice cream was a perfect blend. My husband had a dish of the mint chocolate chip. They have several flavors to try so I'll definitely be back to get more.

This place was recommended to me by a doctor that I work with. And well, it was amazing. The ice cream had so much flavor. I got the honey lavender and my son got the Cookie Monster. It was a pretty cool little shop and the owner was super nice and so was the rest of the staff. We sat outside and enjoyed our ice cream and it was a neat little set up outside. We will definitely be back to enjoy some more ice cream!
Everything they have is cheap, all of their staff are friendly, their Ice Cream is very good, not to mention their Donuts. You'll find something you'll like here, without a doubt.

Wow! Just left this place and it's the BEST! The actual doughnut is so delicious, the flavors of the ice cream are so unique and the customer service is amazing! Love to find small businesses this passionate for what they do, thank you!

Delicious!! They have special ice cream flavors made fresh just for them! The owner was super friendly & helpful on suggestions. The bourbon caramel toffee ice cream in a donut sandwich was amazing!! Never had anything like it & I highly recommend it!
It's a quaint little shop with friendly staff and the ice cream taste amazing. The quality is fantastic and I've defiantly been missing out since moving here in 2007
This place is great. Unique flavors, delicious combinations. And they have a scoop sampler that they put in this convenient to go container with toppings on the side. Definitely will go back!

Went there this afternoon for the first time with my wife and kids and it was amazing. I had the donut with vanilla ice cream, and I loved it. This is definitely going to be one of those places my kids ask for every weekend.
This place is SO cute! We tried the ice cream- filled doughnuts. The homemade ice cream did not disappoint.

Had a single scoop HALVED! Lemon and honey lavender...delicious. Great service, we came during their "soft opening" and they let us try whatever flavors and honestly, they were all delicious we had a hard time choosing. I'm not a big Icecream person but I would come back whenever I'm in Phoenix.
Amazing ice cream! Donuts tasted like made from gods. Put the together....... And you will fall in love. Will definitely be back!!

Yum. Randomly saw a sign on the side of the road...it was the best thing I seen all day. Tried out the stuffed doughnut with half cookie monster [cookies & cream] and half bourbon on the rocks. OMG...we took a bit getting into it so it was a little melted...who cares....I would have drank it out of the bag it was so delicious. The doughnut was perfectly warm and the ice cream was super creamy, it was so smooth and full of flavor without being overbearing. We definitely need to come back and try the waffle sandwich next. They have floats and if you are like me and can't make up your mind....try the flight option. Otherwise a scoop or three in the Oreo cone....what!?!

AMAZING. Amazing ice cream, amazing waffles and donuts, amazing treats. A wonderful concept and a creative take on a classic dessert. We love love love Novel. The owners are friendly, genuine people. The atmosphere is great and the choices are wonderful. The ice cream is handmade and truly tastes authentic. I would (and do) recommend Novel to all my friends!
Had the best experience at this ice cream shop! Both the ice cream and customer service were out the roof incredible. Can't wait to go back! Such a hidden gem.
Wowowowowwowowowoowow I'm super satisfied with my cinnamon horchata ice cream donut! The area is also really nice at night
All I can say is AMAZING AMAZING AMAZING! The best doughnut ice cream sandwich in Phoenix. My partner & I love to try new foods, sweets are on top of our list !

Man when can you not get enough ice cream and this is all nautical themed stuff for you and me to come pick up your ice cream that's all natural for the good old yummy if you love natural food/desserts here the place to go love it.......

Nothing screams like a cup of ice cream from Novel! I was pleasantly surprised by how great this place is. You have to try the cookie monster ice cream! (Do this after any important business meetings though.) Your mouth will look like Cookie Monster defecated his armpits all over your teeth! (False teeth included.) My suggestion is just that too. It is 2019 our bodies could use a rest from all the fake sh** we stuff down it. How about they relax on the food coloring? It serves no purpose and has been proven as a cause of cancer. Overall rating 7.8/10

I'm a big supporter of local businesses and this place has all the quirks and charisma of a local dessert shop. It's located in an unsuspecting and hidden corner of town, but finding it is part of the fun! The ice cream filled donuts are "ahh-mazing!" And they have gluten free cones! The owners are super nice and genuine and took the time to ensure I found the right dessert to fix my craving. Make sure to check them out if you're in the area!

The ice cream here is very well crafted and super delicious. The customer service was even better! My guy Brandon let me know all about the ice cream and how it's made and where it comes from. Place was super cool with it being a little building but such great service and product coming out of it. Definitely will be back soon.
The best ice cream and donuts in town and the owners and employees are extremely welcoming and friendly!

I'm swooning for the ice cream flights and ice cream filled donuts at this little gem in downtown Phoenix. Brandon, who co-owns NIC with his wife, instantly made anyone that came through the door feel welcome as he dished up hand turned ice cream with half a dozen fun toppings, many of which are playfully named after TV shows. As if that's not enough excitement, I've been told their locally sourced donuts were named one of the 50 best donuts in America and the best donut in Arizona.
The build up was huge but it didn't disappoint! This was fantastic. Worth every calorie. I couldn't imagine how it was going to work and yet every bite was fantastic. I give it six stars if possible
Best ice cream! The staff is helpful. The donut is so soft and melts in your mouth. The ice cream is so so good. They have won many awards for their ice cream. Novel ice cream does not disappoint.

My boyfriend and I just visited here just at the end of our trip to Arizona and it was absolutely incredible. We were greeted by a gentleman who allowed us to try as many of the flavors as we wanted- which all tasted great. We found out that he was the owner and he seemed really passionate and excited his business which was really sweet. The ice cream itself was incredible! They have an ice cream sandwich that's made with a donut which is amazing. Unfortunately they don't sell pints online or I would surely order! You should definitely stop by if you're in the area- it's something you won't want to miss!

Holy cow kids, this place is the real deal! Delicious homemade ice cream, served from the sweet, customer focused owners in an adorable old bungalow. Why are you not there right now?!? It's certainly hot enough outside! We wanted ice cream and were lucky to find this place. Their thing is an ice cream filled doughnut...which sounds yummy but is a little much for me. Honestly their ice cream was so good you don't need the embellishment. I had the bourbon toffee crunch and the pannacherry...both were excellent. What else can I say, this place is solid and we'll be back! Check it out!
Hole in the wall spot (quite literally) & absolutely delicious! Love the original flavors. Splurge for the Donut ice cream sandwich!

Donuts and ice cream is a SUPERB combination. Hidden Novel Ice cream is worth a special trip or you can visit a bunch of places around this location. Small little place with outside sitting. Friendly service is a plus.
This place is AMAZING! I brought my friend from Nashville here and we both loved it! The workers were so friendly and the doughnut sandwich was delicious

I can't say enough good things about this place. The ice cream is amazing and homemade, and the couple that owns the place is so personable and sweet to every customer that comes in. It's in a really cute part of Phoenix as well. Can't wait to go back to Phx so I can get this ice cream again! So so good!!
Cutest little ice cream shop , with the most delicious ice cream there ever was ! The Bourbon Toffee crunch is a must !! Don't let the area scare you off , this is truly a hidden gem !
New experience with the ice cream stuffed donut but it was delicious!! I will be back
Sweet people with great customer service. The ice cream is delicious! Will definitely come back

Warm doughnuts stuffed with ice cream? Wow!! The ice cream scoop in a waffle cone is delish. Friendly, teeny tiny place. A variety of sinful ice cream flavors. There is WWII history about the hut. You can enjoy your novelty on the patio with your dog.

Very unique and welcoming ice cream shop. The flavors aren't your typical "chocolate and vanilla", that you find in most places. The lavender honey ice cream and ice cream filled doughnuts are awesome! If you want to get away from the norm, come check this place out!

Was craving ice cream and found this place on BuzzFeed's "best of yelp" list. Super cute small business with really great (artisanal) ice cream. But don't let artisanal fool you- yes it is deliciously handcrafted, but the price point is affordable for even poor college students. Looking forward to coming back and trying the waffle sandwich!

I tend to only review places that I want to truly reward - meaning they get 5 stars so don't think I just love everything. Novel is really, really, really good - far and away the best in the valley IMHO. The owners are obviously dedicated to producing the best ice cream they can. The flavors range from the expected to eclectic without becoming ridiculous. I'm stuck on the bourbon toffee crunch, but fortunately my wife skips about the other flavors so I have had a fair sampling. As well they will give you multiple samples to whet your appetite or just confuse the decision making process. The owner is really a gracious host and fun to talk to. Makes you feel right at home. I hope they can continue to grow so they can open another location. They deserve great success and rewards for their hard work in producing such outstanding ice cream.

Been going to this place once a week, I've been there 5 times so far. My favorite is the honey lavender. I like their sorbets as well. Yummy! Also, make your own dough melt, so worth it. Brandon and Jennifer are just wonderful people, always friendly and constantly getting everyone to try all the flavors. Customer service can't get any better than that.

First off this ice cream shop just looks cool when you're walking up and the inside is nice and clean.. now the ice cream here is bomb and my favorite was by far the butter pecan! The dough melt was so bomb I had to order a second. They also have excellent customer service so it's safe to say I will most definitely be making my way back done to Novel!
A must see. Grand Ave Barrio, small, cute & best of all the ice cream is excellent! This is authentic Downtown Phoenix small business making it happen. Love it.

Just tried this place for the first time and it was perfect! The owners were the ones working and they were super friendly and let us try any flavors we wanted. I ended up getting a double scoop of ice cream of pistachio and cookie monster and both were insanely delicious! My friend got a doughmelt with vanilla ice cream and toppings and he loved his as well! Definitely will be coming back again and again for more! Also loved the location - very small but very cute!
The staff and service here were OUTSTANDING. We sampled about ten different flavors and they were all incredible. Can't wait to visit again!
This place is amazing and super cute! The owners are such humble and kind people! Great place, delicious ice cream, and amazing menu! Will definitely be back!
The staff was so incredibly nice and helpful of getting exactly what you wanted! Didn't regret spending the money here!

The best ice cream I've ever had. Not sickeningly sweet, exquisitely creamy, and creative flavors to boot. It's a great place to stop on the way home out of the downtown area. The dough melt is a must-have.

I went here with my girlfriend a few months ago and had a great experience. The employees were very friendly and the ice cream was delicious. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone that asks

I saw Novel on channel 12 news and decided we needed to take a ride! Worth the next trip I had the Chocolate Cherry Pistachio sandwiched in a fresh-made donut, my husband who is a sorbet lover had the Honeydew Melon sorbet...Can't wait to go again worth the drive.

Wonderful house made ice cream! When you enter this cute ice cream shop, you'll be greeted with genuine smiles and an offer to sample whatever you like! After sampling everything that sounded good, we settled on a two scoop of their pumpkin (with sea salt caramel and cinnamon oat streusel) and Fat Elvis (peanut butter ice cream with honey glazed bananas and bacon). They added a few cookie like wafers. The ice cream was creamy, flavorful, and delicious. I would definitely like to return next time we're in town!

Delightful and delicious ice cream. I had a scoop of Madagascar vanilla and the toffee Carmel. Both were great. The owners are there serving the customers and talked about butter cream and sugar ratios. If I lived here I would come daily just to support these guys. Fabulous ice cream makes it a no brainer.
I drove 10 miles to try their ice cream, and it was worth every minute! Best ice cream I've ever had. I always go to new spots to try new ice cream, this is hands down the best

Novel was a really awesome spot. Was in the downtown area and luckily found this place on Yelp and I am so glad I did. Owners were very well informed and nice. The ice cream was incredible, I had the butter pecan and highly recommend it. 5/5
This place is off the hook, if you want delicious ice cream that does not come after pulling a lever then this is the place for you. We will definitely be back, don't be a sucker go try it.

Met the Owner Brandon, who was uber friendly, ...gave us a great overview of the shops history, and then allowed us to sample every flavor of ice cream, while telling us about the nuances of each recipe. I had 2 scoops, one of the honey-lavender, and the other was the bourbon caramel toffee crunch. Made me smile VERY big!! May have been the best ice cream I've ever had! Definitely a must try location.
So good!! Lots of original flavors, they let us sample whatever flavors we wanted to. We all had doughmelts and they let you add a topping. Such a nice treat! We will totally be back.
Excellent ice cream. The dough melt is very delicious - I've never had anything quite like it - and the service was top-notch!
Awesome customer service (Brandon) and definitely amazing ice cream!! By far the best ice cream place I've found in the Phoenix area!!
Great service and great ice cream. The staff explained the process and were very passionate about the ice crean they create. Definitely coming back.
I had the lavender honey ice cream in a waffle cone with caramel drizzle. It was amazing! The owner is nice, too. 10/10 will visit again. :-)
My bf and I went late one night while I was Phx for work. He made us go back for his birthday later that month... we live in Oklahoma City. It's that good.
Love their Ice Cream choices, they are sooooo good!! My daughter are enjoying our Saturday Night out and decided to come and have some Ice Cream!!!

Soooo this place I saw on IG by a friend and had to try it. Ice cream in a donut? Sold! We get there and it was small but absolutely adorable. Really loved the feel where it was located. I got the Cookie Monster ice cream with Cookie Crisp inside a donut. They warned me it would turn my mouth blue and teeth, tongue, etc. I didn't care, because it was amazing! The donut was warm and delicious. It was so perfect together and a perfect combo! The owner even served my friend and I our ice cream! I love when owners are so involved with their business and assisting the customers. He was such a cool dude! On a side note, it also turns your poop blue- so don't panic! LOL honestly, it was the best and I would definitely be going back!

Our go-to dessert in Phoenix! I can't say enough good things about this place. The service is excellent and the owner is passionate about their quality products. I recommend the dough melt, the artisan ice cream and specially baked donuts make all the difference. I'd had donut ice cream sandwiches before, but nothing this good. They'll let you try all the flavors you want, so you're guaranteed to get something you like!

This place is amazing! Crazy friendly staff that is fun and informative on all the ice cream. Everything I sampled was full of flavor and delicious. The store is a little small when it's packed but it didn't really bother me since they move so fast to get you in and out. There is a outdoor area with other shops around and usually have live bands on specific nights. Love love love!!!

My wife and I stopped by for some ice cream Saturday night. The ice cream was excellent I tried the fat elvis and the bourbon toffee mix up and it was great. I will definitely be back when I get the craving for ice cream.

Talk about a Hidden Gem!!!!!! Took my family on a little Spur of the moment Adventure downtown to visit a restaurant. The restaurant was decent not unimpressed however not impressed. That is until we decided to visit the little shops behind it. Only a few were open however one that was open at the time made our trip completely worth it!!! Novel ice cream shop !!!!! It is tucked away in a little cottage that used to house POWs in Phoenix from World War II. So the history behind it is pretty cool however that's nothing compared to The Taste, the Quality and the Service you will get from this little ice cream shop!!!! All of their ice cream is made from scratch, by hand....and I don't mean in a big vat. I mean by hand a few quarts at a time. They let our entire family taste each one of the flavors before we decided on our favorites. They serve it in cones, cups or between a waffle however my recommendation is the way we had it which is stuffed in a donut believe it or not! The donut was fresh and warm and ice cream was amazingly cold inside. Talk about sinful. Lol And of course the ice cream was amazing however shadowed slightly by the two people own the place ! They are an amazing couple with an amazing product!! This shop is definitely a must-see !!! Like I said before absolutely worth the trip!
I can't rave enough about this place. Everything is so obviously handmade because it's fan-freaking-tastic. Try anything, seriously, you won't be disappointed. It's all amazing.

So here's the story I am about to tell about a little red house on grand ave!!!!! It is full of excitement and surprise!!! The 2 people who live inside are the most amazing ice cream gods you will ever find! All the ice cream is made by full blown certified ice cream chefs and are made fresh almost daily! Honey lavender was an awe inspiring treat to get us to come back again and again!!!! The way people have been lining up to get those warm soft and delicious donuts you would think something illegal must be inside!!!! Hahhaha and who knows maybe it is!!! If you are ever looking for the next great thing find your way here and you will be hooked just be careful to not over do it and to call the hotline number if you get in over your head!!! This will be the best thing you have ever tried!!! Can you see me smiling now!!!!
Love this little ice cream parlor and the owners are so sweet. They take their product seriously and offer awesome unique flavors.

Attention ice cream and donut lovers! Out in Phx. off of Grand Ave & 11th. ave. behind the Third Space green building. You gotta try this very tasty homemade ice cream and floats at Novel Ice cream! Fun and eclectic flavors to choose from! From Honey & Lavender, pistachio, cookie monster (blue), tangerine sherbet, and many other delicious mouthwatering flavors. Including chocolate, and strawberry. Even their award winning Madagascar vanilla! You can choose to have any flavor ice cream filled in a donut with or without cereal toppings. Or a waffle filled ice cream sandwich! An ice cream float with your choice of soda. Or just the simple ice cream scoop in a cup or a cone. Friendly employees and the prices are not so high. Plenty of space to sit out front and enjoy your tasty treat and the warm sunshine. Now off I go and burn off this ice cream.
We almost overlooked this due to location, but so glad we didnt!! great ice cream and wonderful customer service!!! Plan to come back when in the area again!!
The best ice cream shop in all of Arizona. The dough melt is the best combination of pastry to ice cream that I've ever encountered. The owner/operator of the shop is also an all around cool human.

Love this place. Great service from this family owned business. Novelty ice creams. I had the Leslie Knope with Honey Lavender Ice Cream. Awesome. We're making this a stop for every time we're in Phoenix area.

This is it guys. This is the place where hopes and dreams come true. You'll never have a better donut or better ice cream, let alone both at the same time. I have no idea how they get the donut so hot and fresh and the ice cream so cold. If you get anything but a donut sandwich, like just a scoop of ice cream, may God have mercy on your soul.
Thickest ice cream west of the Mississippi River. So thick that you got to pull the ice cream off the spoon with your mouth. Great quality!
The best ice cream I have found in Phoenix so far! You have to have it in the doughnut.

This is an amazing little gem that is a must visit. Found this place online through a New Times article in my local Google feed. Decided to stop by with the family on the way to the state fair. We arrived right at noon, greeted by the owner who was just opening the doors to a friendly greeting and a welcome. We went inside and were walked through the offerings and offered samples of all the flavors available, while also getting a brief story of the business. Needless to say this business is a labor of love and it shows in the product. No matter where you are in the valley this is worth the drive for a treat. We will be driving from Peoria quite a bit to enjoy these amazing treats. Can't recommend this place enough. Great local business.

Absolutely a must try for all. This place is small but you know what they say about GREAT things coming in small packages. My favorite thing is their dough melt with honey lavender ice cream and fruity pebbles as the topping. Brandon and Jenn are awesome and always have you feeling like you're family when you walk through their door. If you're looking for ice cream, look no further, you'll love this place.
Delicious ice cream and super nice people! The Cookie Monster ice cream in a warm donut is perfection.

Holy heaven! From the moment we walked in I was blown away. They insisted on a sample of every flavor to help me find my "frozen soul mate", and then scooped me the best butter pecan ice cream side of the Mississippi, plopped it into a specially made warm glazed donut bun, and topped it with Cinnamon Toast Crunch cereal. We didn't stop there though. A fresh pressed waffle sandwiched my honey lavender ice cream with fruity pebbles on top! Over the top? Absolutely! Worth every delicious bite? You betcha!!!

Love this place! The ice cream is so delicious! Their flavors are not the ordinary ones you find in an ice cream shop, my kids love Cookie Monster. Such a brilliant idea to combine ice cream and a donut, my two favorite sweets. The donut is warm, but doesn't melt the ice cream! How do they do that?.... the shop is small without in door seating, but it is nice and very clean. I don't live close, but it is definitely worth the drive. If they ever consider expanding, I hope they come to north Peoria!
If I could give 10 stars I would, not only is the ice cream phenomenal, but the owner and staff make this place. Eat local! You won't regret it
Yummy ice cream with creative flavors. Kids loved the Cookie Monster flavor. A little hard to find but now I know. Will be a regular spot.
Excellent ice cream, especially the butter pecan! Favorite ice cream place in Phoenix! And the two brothers who own the place and serve you are super cool!

I'd give this place 10 stars if it were an option! The ice cream is amazing. The doughnut or waffle sandwiches are to die for and come with a free topping - which I'm sure would all be super yummy but Cinnamon Toast Crunch is my favorite. Even better than the food is the service (if that's possible). We went for the first time last week and we're all blown away by how friendly the guy behind the counter was. Tonight we made a trip back down (we live on the north side) but realized they are actually closed on Monday's. When we pulled up we saw they were closed but the owner noticed us and said if we wanted to come in he'd be happy to serve us! We've never had someone invite us in on a day off just to make sure we were happy! We got to eat fresh waffle sandwiches and they were so good! Love this place and so happy to support a small business that's doing everything right. Thanks Brandon for taking care of us on what was supposed to be a day off for you! By far our favorite ice cream shop!
Great little place. The owners are so kind and the ice cream is phenomenal. I love that they ask for flavor suggestions. They seem to really care about customers and their vibes are great.
The best ice cream, donut melts, service and atmosphere around. You will not be disappointed.

This is what customer service is supposed to look like in a business. It's good to see a younger generation that knows what hard work and good customer service looks like. When we're in the area we will certainly be back. What makes it even better is the ice cream is amazing!

Can't say enough good things about this new little place. Friendly owners, wonderful ice cream, great location at Third Space! Ended up getting the donut filled with Fat Elvis ice cream. So delicious! Please stop by and support this novel (haha) little spot. I can't wait to go back and try more flavors!
DELICIOUS ice cream spot. The strawberry is amazing & fresh, and the lavender honey is super yummy. Stoked to have them in the neighborhood!

First time trying Novel and I am thoroughly impressed. I am quite the connoisseur of desserts- and this place has a great selection of high-quality, hand-crafted, small-batch ice cream. I tried the "indecisive" ice flight. It was all amazing!!! The owners are local, they support local. New favorite downtown for ice cream.

Extremely good dessert with tons of unique flavor combinations. I only wish they still made the pancakes and syrup shaved ice. It sounds weird but it was my favorite. I have so many new favorites they are hard to choose from. The staff is always friendly and helpful when ordering. Well be back
I had the strawberry balsamic ice cream in a doughnut melt. definitely worth the try! the staff was very friendly and encouraged us to test different ice creams before we bought

Excellent customer service. They let you try all the flavors. Then pineapple was fabulous, but we went with strawberry and some fruity tooty thing, both of which were great. The neighborhood was full of "character" at night, but it was a cute place. I'd go back.

This soon not to be hidden gem was a delight. The workers were so helpful and told us about each of the ice cream we sampled. Great nook of a place that will never be a regrettable choice. Their specialty flavors and stuffed treats are a local rarity. Personally, the ice cream waffle sandwich (the Leslie Knope) is my favorite, but the ice cream stuffed donut is a close second.

I was hesitant to visit novel I've cream based on Sharise M.'s review, but decided to judge for myself. Not only was the service fabulous, but Novel's Ice cream is absolutely delicious. I'm not really an ice cream person, but my kids loved it. The little wafer that comes on top is a great finishing touch. My kids got their donut sandwich thingies and they were pretty packed for the price. The money was well worth it. It is a small establishment and can get pretty busy, but the wait was less than 8 minutes. The staff was pleasant. I think this Sharise lady is just looking to cause some good businesses grief. I looked at her other Yelp reviews, and the first 6 or 8 are one star and the same calling card style. She complains about rude staff, long wait times, low quality, blaaaahhhhhh. PLEASE check out other Yelper's reviews before you buy into other people's delusions. We almost missed a gem of a business because I almost believed ONE unhappy reviewer. I will be writing more Yelp reviews for other businesses because of this one lady. It's unfortunate that there are people that think it's fun to sabotage other people's livelihoods with their nastiness. If you see the owner's reply ( She calls him Mr. Owner Brandon. I'm pretty sure a normal, loving mom wouldn't name their kid "Owner". ), he has proof that she is bonkers and he is willing to share it with current and future customers.

This place has so many different fun ice cream flavors. The best part is that you can put your ice cream in the middle of a warm donut or waffle! What really got me was the customer service from the workers, who I believe were the owners. They were very friendly, helpful and just overall sociable. I can't wait to go back and try some other ice cream flavors!

We were looking for a new dessert place and decided to try novel. There was a line out the door, when we got in, the owner was really energetic and told us about his ice cream and the donuts. I got a doughmelt with the fat Elvis ice cream and it was great. The donut was fresh and delicious and the ice cream was very flavorful. I will definitely go again!

My 4 year old son and I stopped in yesterday to try it. Loved the way it was a little hidden and the place itself is super cute! We met Brandon and he was very nice. The customers were even friendly! Lol. My son got the Cookie Monster ice cream with marshmallow charms for the topping. I got myself and my boyfriend a strawberry ice cream and butter pecan. They were SUPER delicious! We are definitely going to be back!
Artesian Ice Cream stuffed inside a warm Glazed Doughnut along with your choice of cereal topping. Amazing!!
I got the doughnut iced cream sandwich, to die for so delicious! The doughnut is hot and fresh, the ice cream is perfect. You have to experience it to know!

Delicious! We had Dough melts. I ordered Cookie Monster ice cream with Oreo cookie topping. The glazed donut was warm and soft. Great customer service! They also offer flights. They had an ice cream with bacon that was savory and so good. I can't wait to go back. This place is awesome I'm happy we have this in Phoenix.
EXCELLET ICE CREAM AND DONUTS, got the Madagascar flavored ice cream, if you like vanilla bean, this is the place that everyone should go!!

Amazing handmade ice cream in an awesomely eclectic location. To top it off they are open till 1am on Friday and Saturday for those late night ice cream cravings. With this being said, it is not a question of wether I will be back, but wether I will ever go back home.

This place is IN-credible!!! Went for the first time tonight and had the best service and the best ice cream... probably the best ice cream I've ever had.
