The owners were awesome and chatted with us about how it was made, all the awards their flavors won, and just fun facts about their business in general. Run, don't walk! Deliciousness awaits.
Can't even put into words how amazing the ice cream was and the ownership was even better!! New favorite spot.
Delicious. I had my warm donut filled with a tasty bourbon ice cream. The location is pretty cool. There is live music next door.

This place blew me away. I was skeptical at first because it looks too much like a start-up, but I was pleasantly surprised. The brothers who own the shop served us and they were extremely friendly and helpful. They told us the whole story and how the ice cream is made in small batches by one of the best ice cream makers in America and their donut was just voted one of the 50 best doughnut in America. Both deserve the rave reviews. All of the ice creams were more creamy and flavorful than any I have ever had. AND THE DOUGHNUT! Best I have ever had or will ever have. I hate overly sweet and iced doughnuts. This was a perfect mixture of sweet and savory and texture. We will be back!
Amazing small artisan ice cream shop! Absolutely loved the small batch flavors, friendly owner and its uniqueness! Will be back!

Amazing! Our family happened upon this wonderful little place and we were not disappointed! Sampled many flavors and we settled on strawberry, Cookie Monster, cherry cheesecake and Fat Elvis (peanut butter, banana and bacon!) So good! Can't wait to go back. Too bad we live 1400 miles away!

Tasty and unique ice cream flavors. The honey lavender is flavorful, but mild as well. It worked perfectly on the hot donut with waffle pieces. I will definitely make the trek back here just for ice cream.

They try and it shows. I had to go back in and get seconds after I had my first ice cream filled donut. Try the cookies monster ice cream, sure it makes your mouth and bowel movements a weird color for a day but it's worth it!!!!!!! Seriously one of the best ice cream places I have tried in a long long time.
We had the ice cream-stuffed doughnut and it was amazing! Pretty good size, one is perfect for sharing. Fun live music in the outdoor seating area, too.

I have been dying to try their ice cream for a while now, ever since my co-workers told me about it. So my family and I went here today and we were not disappointed! The staff was super nice! They were very patient with my two little girls, who kept asking questions at the same time and wanted to try ALL the flavors, lol. My kids ordered a scoop each of two different flavors, my hubby ordered two scoops of the caramel toffee (I can't remember the exact name) and I ordered two scoops of the honey lavender, which was delicious!! We really enjoy our ice cream. Hubs even loved his. They use real lavender flowers in the honey lavender and you can definitely taste the honey as well. The prices were a tad higher than what I'm used to paying when we go out for ice cream, but I'm okay with that since this is fresh, handmade ice cream. I'd definitely recommend this place and would also go here again! I do hope they move to a bigger location in the future because my one critique would be that it is a small place with no seating and I'd love to be able to sit down at a table with my family and eat ice cream.

Cold ice cream + Warm Waffle nothing short of amazing. Quality ice cream sandwiched inside a doughnut or waffle are things dreams are made of. Do your palette a favor and give this place a shot. You won't regret it.
Worth every calorie! It was a cold night but we didn't care, the ice cream was worth it !

We found this little hidden Ice Cream gem in yelp and all I can say is Oh my gosh, it was delicious. It is a "must try" place and the best thing is that they have glazed doughnuts stuffed with ice cream of your choice. It can't get any better than that! We tried the honey lavender ice cream and I think it is my new favorite. All of their ice cream are locally made and they have a very good variety of flavors as well as toppings. And if you get thirsty you can also grab a drink from their soft drink selection. This is a family friendly place, good for kids (I love finding places where my 1 year old is welcomed) and it is the the cutest little neighborhood down grand ave. They have only been open for a few weeks and i really hope it continues open for many years to come. It's a family run business and you can really tell they take pride in what they do! I definitely recommend this place to everyone!

By far the BEST hole in the wall ice cream shop you'll ever find!! Excellent, off the wall and creative flavors! Stop in, have one, you'll love it and probably be hooked. Follow them on Instagram too...you won't be disappointed!

Yeah, 5 stars for a reason. Super yummy ice cream, and unique. Delicious well made donuts... combine those (if you want), and you get a delicious explosion of yummy fatness in your mouth! (But not overly fat... don't worry dieters) Not to mention the staff is super nice and really take pride in their business. Very sweet and helpful. Will definitely be back and tell peeps about this place

My husband and I first went here because we were craving dessert, and it was still open late at night. The owner, Brandon, and his wife gave us a tour of the creative ice cream flavors. They are so passionate about their treats which makes it even better! We ordered the Dough Melt - a fresh and warm donut filled with ice cream and the right amount of crunchy cereal (I got chocolate ice cream with Cinnamon Toast Crunch)! Ever since that night, I dream about these ice cream sandwiches! Tonight I ordered the Dough Melt with Bourbon Caramel and Cinnamon Toast Crunch. Both times, I left Novel in an amazing mood! I want to keep Novel a secret because it's so good, but that would be horribly selfish!

Came from Texas for work and found this suggestion. This is hands down the best ice cream I've ever had. First time I had the red velvet and cookie monster. Second time I took my coworker and the owners remembered me! I had the baklava and cookie monster. Great place and great ice cream. Don't usually give reviews, but these guys deserve it!!!
Amazing place! The donut melt is the way to go and the staff are super personable! Definitely recommend!

Hands down the best ice cream you'll ever eat. It is made in small batches and a wide variety of flavors. Try a dough-melt. Their version of an ice cream sandwich is in a hot glazed donut. My favorite is honey lavender ice cream with fruity pebbles added.

I have been coming here for the past three days in a row. I love it! It's so delicious. I tried the dough melt which is a warm glazed doughnut with ice cream of your choice and a free topping. I was in love the first moment i took the first bite as the warm doughnut melted in my mouth along with the ice cream. Then i tried the waffle ice cream sandwich.. they are both to die for
This is are go to place when we have a sweet tooth. Usually it's the same few people working all really friendly with great costumer service.

I was hangin out at third space and noticed this new joint in the compound. Super friendly staff that encouraged me to try their ice cream filled donut with cereal crammed in. I've gotta say this thing is un-f'n-believable! Have you ever ate an ice cream sandwich with a cookie where after the first bite the ice cream shoots out the back side and all over your pants? Whelp, Novel has solved the riddle and they adddded cereal! Wow. Just wow. I'd give this place 6 stars if I could. I'm def going back.

I practically live here in the shop. It's almost tradition to come here to get A1 top notch quality ice cream. I always get Cookie Monster because why not. And the doughnuts...don't even get me started. They're AhhhMazing!! Everything is good quality and the owners are always there and are the best people for running the best ice cream shop! I definitely recommend!
Omg this place is so amazing! I had the donut with ice cream...will be back for every cheat day
This is my favorite ice cream. I get a scoop of bourbon Carmel toffee crunch and a scoop of butter pecan so good. But all of there treats are good.

Absolutely delicious ice cream! And combining it with donuts and cereal almost isn't fair! I got the Cookie Monster ice cream with the donut and Cookie Crisp cereal. Definitely recommend this combo. The owner was so nice and welcoming in addition to the amazing dessert. We will definitely back, and soon!

This is my first review on yelp ever. It was worth it. The ice cream was the best thing I've ever had. And the service is just as good as the ice cream. It was an amazing experience. Can't wait to bring my friends and family here. They truly treat you like they value your business.

Hanging at Third Space and saw the most amazing looking ice cream donut sandwich - just had to check it out! Sampled tons of the flavors and all were so good I couldn't decide which. I went with the bourbon, maple and toffee flavor and my boyfriend got the donut sandwich with the Fat Elvis. So basically a donut cut in half with some amazing ice cream filling. The Fat Elvis was smoky bacon, caramelized banana and like peanut butter ice cream! Wow!!

Jewel in Arizona! Must go place rather u live in Arizona or are just visiting, especially if u r a sweet tooth. The owner and the workers were very attentious and kind. They made sure we tried every flavor we wanted. They are known for the donut ice cream sandwich but I got the leslie knope, which is a waffle ice cream sandwich and it was delicious!

One of my favorite places to go! Whenever we are downtown, we make a point to stop here. Every flavor is great and change often, so ask for a sample before you order...or don't, I'm sure you'll love whatever you order!

This place is off the chain! The ice cream stuffed doughnuts flavor is nothing short of amazing. There are many unique flavors and toppings to choose from, but forget the donuts we're here to go nuts!

This is seriously the best Ice cream I've ever had. We were looking for ice cream and typed it in to our maps and this place popped up. I got the Cookie Monster waffle sandwich (YUMMM) and my boyfriend got the chocolate ice cream waffle sandwich (ALSO YUM). Our apartment is only a few minutes away and we had completely finished our ice creams before we got home. This is a MUST TRY in Phx!! I highly recommend it!

As a different ice cream shop employee, I can honestly say that the ice cream at Novel exceeds any ice cream I've been able to make at the shop I work at. No matter what the drive is, I can say this place is worth it. I will be returning here all the time.
Excellent services by the owners them selves. We felt very welcomed and comfortable. The donut melt was very delicious and I would definitely come again and recommend.

Very small amount of ice cream. Very disappointed. This place was hard to find because it is in a neighborhood and it is VERY small. Previous reviews stated that it was inexpensive. Well, not true. Today I was there and for a small, 1 scoop vanilla ice cream in a bowl and an oreo cookie sprinkled on top and a donut, we paid $9.97. The cup was the size of one that would be considered a child size, think, Dixie Cup size. NOT worth your time!!
AMAZING!!! The honey lavender ice cream is incredible and the donut is a great compliment to it. A truly unique dessert and the best ice cream I've ever had. This is my new favorite ice cream shop!

The owner, Brandon, was an absolute gem. Very friendly, knowledgeable and extremely passionate about his ice cream and overall concept. Every flavor I tried (which was several, because Brandon insisted I try as much as I want!) was delicious. Great choices for toppings, and you could even get your ice cream pressed in between donuts or waffles. Such a great little addition to the Grand Ave scene!

The best donut ice cream sandwiches ever! There waffle ice cream sandwiches were amazing as well! My whole experience here from the moment I got in line to the moment I finished my food was spectacular. Definitely worth the 49 minute drive and I'll definitely be back again!
Cute little place, the Ice cream is delicious. I had The Leslie Knope of course. Great place for kids, they loved it.

This gets a big ole' Pennsylvania approval from me. Not just approval but... the BEST desert option I have EVER had. I love food, that is not a lie, what also isn't a lie is me literally saying "oh my god" after taking a bite. This is what happened with my cookie monster, doughnut with oreo topping concoction. To say it was incredible was a VAST understatement. I CANNOT stress enough how incredible the ice cream, doughnut, temperature and everything else about it. My original fear was that it would be too sweet, but.... Heres the deal, they have the doughnuts baked FOR them by a local doughnut maker (baker?), and they are purposely made sugary and not overly sweet, along with incredibly soft on the inside and perfectly warmed on the outside. Honestly, I cannot say enough good things. Food alone here is worth a 5/5 stars, but dare I say it they deserve more? Yes. Yes I do. We went on a Sunday morning around 1pm and there was no one in line. No wait, and no one else in the "Business". The owners were there and were so incredibly informative and friendly. Talking about everything from the uniqueness of the ice cream to the individual attention each doughnut gets. The owners love talking business, AND love hearing your story. They also informed me that they will typically have lines at busy times of the day, so maybe sneak in there earlier or at odd hours to avoid the rush. With that being said, this doughnut contraption is EASILY worth a hour + wait.
I had such a great experience here! The workers aka "the dream team" were so passionate about their business and the ice cream was so unique! They have so many delicious flavors. 10/10 recommend!!

Been dying to try this place. Def worth the hype! Thank you Brandon for not letting me bust my head over picking just one topping. Will definitely put this place down on my calendar for my next cheat meal

Hands down the best ice cream in Phoenix. I had the Biscoff cookie ice cream and the butter pecan ice cream and it was unbelievably good. This ice cream is so good I finished two scoops before getting back to my car. If you're ready to experience a new level of ice cream artistry, then you have to go to Novel.
Very unique and delicious combo. Took my family for dessert after dinner and it lived up to all the hype. Will never go to Phoenix without stopping in.

Just a little nugget of joy in this place. Beautifully hand crafted ice cream done in small batches. We sampled several choices( which was highly encouraged by the owner) before finally making our selections. You can tell when a lot of love and pride is poured into a business. Inside decor was vibrant, and a great reflection of the uniqueness of this place.
owners are super friendly and upbeat! very unique delicious flavors and awesome toppings. so glad they moved into third space, definitely my new favorite pit stop :)

Found this little gem today after doing a quick yelp search. So glad we decided to stop in. Brandon was such an amazing help with helping us decide what to get. You can tell he has a passion for what he does. The ice cream flavors are amazing and very unique with a few of the classics!

After reading all the reviews I expected great ice cream, but I did not realize I would also get such an amazing experience. I really wanted to try the Frosted Circus Animal Cookie ice cream, but we went late in the evening after the Grand Avenue Festival and I really did not expect to get to try it. The owners are amazing! I ordered butter pecan from the case, but I mentioned the Frosted Circus Animal Cookie ice cream I really wanted to try even though it was not in the case and they brought some out for me and put a confetti cookie on top without me asking for it. I love the cookies from the store, but the ice cream is so much better!
The best ice cream and customer service I've ever had!! I'll definitely be back and would highly recommend this place to anyone
Definitely the best desert place I've ever been to. Friendly servers and delicious ice cream. I got the donut sandwich and boy let me tell you It was the bomb. Definitely goin back.

So happy we found this gem and the drive was so worth it! We ordered the Madagascar vanilla, strawberry, butter pecan and honey lavender. All were delicious!! The owner, Brandon was incredibly nice and humble. Can't wait to go back and try the other flavors.

Tried this place on Saturday with the family and it was amazing! My daughter went with the waffle cone sandwich and Nutella ice cream and my son of course had to try the Cookie Monster. I tried the donut with the tiki ice cream and it was everything. The hubs just went with the Madagascar vanilla but everything was so great. One of the owners we spoke with was was super sweet and nice. You can tell he loves what he is doing, and they are open late! We will definitely be back soon!
OMG, this was some the best ice cream I have ever had. Much better than the what we get in my hometown of Chicago. Such a great vibe also - really friendly staff. Prices are very reasonable.
Delicious and adorable! (The ice cream shop, not my daughter). Plenty of choices and incredible toppings. Super friendly owners makes me want to come back again soon.

So many flavors to choose from and not enough time in one night. That alone will have me coming back. Frozen yogurt, BLIZZARDZ and Ice cream stuffed donuts?!! Cold Stone, it seems you've met your match. Belgian Waffle cone for breakfast, i got that sweet tooth . The patio area is my chill spot for this outside fall weather.

If I could give this place 100 stars I would. I was in Arizona for vacation, and was down in Phoenix for one last day. The temperature reached to 105 degrees and I was in need for something cold to eat-- of course, I wanted ice cream. After looking through many reviews I saw that Novel's reviews were very good and decided to take my dad there. It's a small shop located amongst other small shops (really cute) and although there was no indoor seating to avoid the scorching heat, the ice cream totally took away from all that (not to mention we stood inside and talked to the owners and workers, out of the heat). Speaking of the staff, they were all amazingly kind, warm, and welcoming, making us feel very at home in their little shop. Immediately walking in, one of the owners explained their ice cream to us, explaining how it was hand made with rotating flavors. I greatly appreciated that, and he offered us to try as much as we'd like! I got what they called the Leslie Knope-- a waffle ice cream sandwich, but they also offer a donut sandwich which I thought was extremely appetizing as I saw someone take it out. I tried their Cookie Monster in between the two waffles, and it was amazing! I thought it was so good, I wanted to try more and I sampled their sorbets, the Freckled Lemonade and Honeydew Sorbet. Both were amazing and I got another scoop, because I couldn't help myself. My dad had the same idea and got something called the Bourbon(something something) and the Fat Elvis. I got to try quite a lot of flavors along with those and they were so rich and tasty! I highly recommended what I listed above. Because we stayed inside, one of the owners was so friendly to my dad and I got to chat with the others, who just made friendly conversation with me. I absolutely love the vibe and of course, the ice cream, and if I'm ever in Phoenix again I'll be stopping by!
They are so friendly & the owner is super down to earth. I absolutely loved each flavor I got to try. Definitely an awesome spot for great ice cream.

We stopped at Novel tonight after dinner. The guys running the shop were great, explained everything, gave us samples. I didn't hold out much hope for ice cream in a donut, but that was the headliner, so I gave it a shot. It was probably one of the best deserts that I have ever had. Enough said. It was that good. It wasn't as heavy as I expected. I will recommend this place to everyone I know. Quality product, great service!
Small little place but great customer and excellent ice cream. Highly recommend the Dough Melt hot donut with delicious ice cream inside.

This is a small, independently run ice cream shop. The owner served us and couldn't have been friendlier or more willing to assist. He told us to try multiple samples (and we did!). He was willing to make recommendations, and didn't try and rush us in the decision making process. I had the Fat Elvis ice cream (peanut butter, banana, with bits o' bacon) waffle sandwich with Reese's puffs cereal as a topping. The waffle was warm and the ice cream was incredible! I wanted another immediately after I was done tearing through the first one. My girlfriend had a scoop of the Honey Lavender and a scoop of Chocolate. She couldn't stop raving about the Honey Lavender ice cream. Literally. I had to take her to urgent care and have them shoot her up with a muscle relaxant until she came down from that sweet, sweet, Honey Lavender concoction. It's located in a cool little area next to other local businesses. It's a small establishment so you should be prepared for lines if you go during popular hours. Just know that waiting in line is a small price to pay for this ice cream. They have standard flavors that are always there, and they rotate in new flavors depending on the day. This place is my new favorite ice cream place in Arizona.

We drove over an hour (from San Tan Valley) to check this place out per a friend's referral. I would drive a whole nother hour as it was PHENOMENAL! Unlike anything else I've ever had before. Check this place out!

My best friend took me here and it was seriously the most amazing ice cream I've ever had. The owners are the sweetest people. They introduced themselves and told us their story which I thought made the experience more personal. Cute atmosphere as well! The honey lavender with the donut for the win holla

Best ice cream in Phoenix with unique and constantly changing flavors...and two of the sweetest people that own the shop! I feel like family every time I go in. They have only been open for a little over 3 months and I have been here about 5 times! I love bringing out of town visitors here and my boyfriend asks every single week if we can take a walk over to Novel. Highly recommend!
Excellent ice cream and great local business. The brothers who run it are really friendly and let us taste several flavors before we made our choices. The donut ice cream sandwich is soooo good!

Incredible! We were recommended to try this place from a few friends and we were not disappointed! The owner and staff were super friendly. They allowed us to try practically every flavor before deciding on what to order. I am tempted to say it is the best ice cream I have ever had! If you are in the area, you HAVE to stop by and get some Novel Ice Cream!!
A small house serving donuts and ice cream, what more could you ask for?! The owner was very nice and served us quickly yet still made some small talk. So glad to see someone doing what they love.
Seriously amazing ice cream! And the doughnut is so good and fresh. Everyone was so friendly and a really overall amazing experience

The best ice cream donuts anywhere. They change ice creams pretty regularly but always keep a few standard flavors. You can get ice cream by the scoop but the donut or waffle ice cream is where it's at. We go whenever we are in the area and sometimes make the 30 min drive just for this place

Omgosh...the staff was so friendly! It was nice to see how much of Park & Recreation Fans they were..Leslie Knope Ice Cream! Tried about 5 of their homemade flavored ice cream and each were so yummy. It was in a fun corner alongside a coffee/bar, hair salon, and tattoo place. Yup, but the place had a pretty cool outdoor hangout with lights. Come try!

The kindest, friendliest, and most welcoming service! The owners were so patient with us as we tried multiple flavors, and he described each one's ingredients to us in detail. They really care about their customers and we left feeling happy! Not to mention the ice cream is beyond creamy and delicious. Will definitely come back! MUST TRY!!!

Wanted to treat myself after a half marathon, and this place was perfect for it! It is in such a cool area near downtown... we loved the outdoor seating area under the trees. I had a doughnut stuffed with butter pecan ice cream and it was to me a perfect combination of flavors and textures... it was truly delicious!
super good ice cream!!!!!! highly recommend the melt. also the owners are super nice.

I'm not a big fan of ice cream but after coming to Novel I am now. The employees here are amazing and very welcoming! I live 45 mins away from here but I'll be making the drive down here for more often now. I don't really recommend places but this is a place I would definitely would let people know of! 10/10 :-)

Not only was the ice cream extremely good, but Brandon and Jennifer are also some of the nicest and friendliest people that you will meet! Great atmosphere and great ice cream! Definitely do not pass over this place!

Visited this place for the first time and it was such a nice experience. Not only are the Dough Melt's amazing, but the owners are so kind and personable! They recognized my friend who had been in once before. Great people, great treats. I'll be back!
The best ice cream shop in Phoenix! Such creative flavors that were all delicious. The owner was very welcoming and was generous enough to give us several samples. Will definitely be returning!

What a treat, pun intended. What an excellent place. We liked exploring this little area of Phx while on vacation staying near midtown. Was connected in a small courtyard like area with a cool bar we would have liked to have visited and few other shops. The flavors were excellent and they had something for kids (strawberry) and something for adults (Mexican chocolate with cinnamon and cayenne) Everything was delicious and wish we could come back to try the ice cream filled doughnuts. Owners were friendly and accommodating with free tastes etc.... great little place
I love it. Trying not to get diabetes and eat so much that I have to be carted to the hospital is the only negative.
Wonderful craft ice cream in grant arts area. Worth finding. The doughnut sandwich is crazy good!
Today had a Bourbon Caramel toffee ice cream with Donut, it was amazing.. staff are so friendly..
Good icecream, good doughnut, good people! Can't wait to go back again! Cute spot, and I dont think service could possibly be better. Plus it tastes great!
To say that the dough melt is life changing would be an understatement and disservice to this amazing product!

This place is great. We were greeted by the owners who were SO friendly and really knew their stuff! Donut sandwich was amazing and any flavor you try is a win for sure. Will definitely be back, especially bc of the great customer service.
A true beacon of snacking perfection! You will not be disappointed! Also the owners are some of the nicest people you will ever meet!

This is the best ice cream I have ever had. The customer service, ice cream, donuts, waffles even the complementary cookie on the side is just amazing every single time I come. I hope they stay in business forever and grow/ expand to their hearts content. Novel is the perfect name for this place. It's perfect!

BEST Place in Phoenix!!!! The ice cream is out of this world. We're from manhattan and I am an avid ice cream consumer and I can tell you this is the best I've ever had. And the owners are so nice and so passionate about their business:)

Although small, this is one of the best places for ice cream in The Valley. They care about making great ice cream and they seem to be knowledgeable. The flavors I've tried are very creamy and delicious.
Came down because my wife's friends were talking about it. I had no expectations but it was by far the best ice cream I have had since moving to AZ. I will be back. The owners were awesome as well.

Friendly people walked us through everything and were happy for us to try their flavors. Amazingly great people that made this place worth coming to. The ice cream was amazing as well with tasty flavors and creative options. Definitely worth a try. I couldn't recommend any more for you to try this place. Small little house tucked away with seating and lights. Again... amazing ice cream place, must try!

Looking for good ice cream late Saturday night found this place on yelp. This little red building is tucked away off Grand and 10th dont blink you'll miss it. OMG what a find! Best ice cream I've had. You can tell they are homemade with passion. The flavors were old time favorites like chocolate and artisan flavors like fat Elvis wow. I had butter beer hubby had toffee burbon crunch yummy. Ice cream in a donut really it's perfect. The owners Brandon and Jennifer love what they do they told us the how the business started and what goes into their ice creams. You can tell they have a real passion and it shows In their product. I live on the west side but will make the drive to come back often worth the drive.

Cannot rave enough about this place. In back of an outdoor bar/cafe club in a revitalized area of downtown Grand Ave in a row of little stores behind the Third Space building. Heard about it but finally went at a social event held there tonight. The owners Brandon and Jenny stayed open later than they usually do on Sunday to accommodate us. The ice cream was better than the chain stores, ice cream stuffed donuts, cups, cones,a row of every type of topping possible. Glass bottle sodas, waffle ice cream sandwiches, cereal toppings, real oreo cookie toppings. Welcoming owners. I will be back. People, support your local businesses, they are here to serve you.

Made the trek out from Gilbert, at the suggestion of some friends and oh my goodness am I glad I did! Many unique flavors of the most wonderful ice cream, that is then stuffed into a warm donut "bun" and topped with your choice of cereal. Holy yum. And the owners were fantastic. We will be back SOON! Try the Fat Elvis, you won't be disappointed!
Great ice cream!! Great staff! We were visiting from California looking for good ice cream and found this little gem! Try the dill pickle ice cream...soooo good!!
Great local spot for homemade ice cream. Games available for kids. I wish they would expand their vegan options!
Good ice cream. Nothing out of the ordinary. Everyone was friendly. Pretty busy but line moved fast.

I love the pecan turtle in a waffle cone! The waffle cone was sweet and had great flavor! The ice cream was very good and topping were perfect! Best ice cream I've had in a long time! Must try at least once in your life!

Very good ice cream. Taste homemade. I got the pecan toffee and it was amazing! I will have to go back to try other flavors. They had a pickle flavor and I didn't try it, but I guess there's something for everyone.
Brownie milkshake is very tasty. The ice cream sandwiches are good too. On the less creamy side, the sorbet is a great option
It's okay, little girls serving ice cream with smiles and giggles. Basic flavors, basic menu, that's not bad, it's just ice cream. Family friendly. I'd certainly go back again and so will you.

Great spot to get some really good ice cream. We like to get the sweet sundae where you can choose 4 different kinds of ice cream, comes with a cookie, brownie and a toasted marshmallow. This is a great item to share. I have also got the sorbet, strawberry and coconut which is very refreshing as well. Typically on the weekends they have enough employees to handle the line. When I recently went this past weekend, they do not have any seating inside only about two tables outside. Love to come here when we are in the area!
So so good! Good for a late snack or that sweet tooth! Such a family friendly place as well
Delish! Ask them what their popular flavors are when you go in... great options! Staff was friendly and knowledgeable on their ice cream!
Excellent flavor of both ice cream and cones. I've tried a few different flavors and was always pleased. I also like their aesthetic - light and airy and sophisticated.

We initially came here because of a Yelp Elite perk and we've been back a couple times ever since! While you can get ice cream at a lot of places, Sweet Republic's is local. It's also creamy and yummy! Just how I like my ice cream. Our favorite is the Campfire S'more Sundae with flambÃ©ed handmade marshmallows. The warmth and softness of a freshly toasted marshmallow blends together with the cold creamy ice cream very well!
Visiting from out of state & wanted something sweet after dinner. 10/10 recommend!! I got the Banana Sundae so yummy.

When it's 115 out and you're wishing for something cool, head on over to Sweet Republic! They have a great selection of flavors, sundaes, and shakes. We ordered the Blue Moon & Pineapple Whips and they both left us wanting more please... Thank you Yelp for inviting us to the Sweet Republic Elite function yummmm!

A big disappointment in today's flavors. Without the ability to taste test,the situation is now pray and hope you like the weird new flavors. Big miss was the pineapple whip and blue Hawaii. Those two were nasty. The best choice was the shoefly pie ice-cream with authentic molasses flavor. Maybe stick to the old flavors.?

VARIETY!! This spot is awesome! They have a large variety of flavors including some interesting savory flavors such as Dill Pickle and Blue Cheese! I ordered a scoop of the Coconut Sorbet, the employee told me it's made with real coconut milk which is what makes it so smooth and creamy. Watching them scoop it out was sooo smooth and satisfying! I also sampled the Honey Lavender flavor, which did not disappoint! There is some grass and areas to sit outside, so we enjoyed our dessert under the stars laying in the grass. I'd definitely return for dessert if I'm in the area.

Man, I cant believe Ive never written a review for sweet Republic. So, if you like baskin robbins then you may not like Sweet Republic. Or your mind could be inexorably blown! The flavors that Sweet Republic offers are wide and interesting. They make all their own ice cream and actually has cream in it. Isnt that why its called ice CREAM?!? They have 3 locations so if you're in Scottsdale, Tempe or Phoenix, you're in luck. Their sorbet is delicious, their milkshakes and sundays are tasty and their waffle cones are just right (according to my teenagers). I love their kulfi ice cream the best. Beware of their mint, its unlike the green stuff at the supermarket. Go and try it!
Yummy!! This icecream was delicious. They are very fast working. We didn't have to wait long at all!

Pricey! But reeeaaaalllyyy good ice cream and sorbet!!! We always get Blue moon Ralley the valley sorbet Salted butter caramel with toffee Toffee banofi Strawberry sorbet(amazzzzzing!) These are all winners!! Come try it out!
1st time and ice cream is yummy. We had salted Carmel and chocolate. They also have shakes, and dairy free sorbets

This was super yummy treat by the water! Love that you're permitted to have three taste testers which is perfect for to try out some of their fun flavors! Wonderful outdoor area to sit and enjoy the sunshine and sweets!
Solid ice cream spot that's open until 10pm. Got the maple pecan and it didn't disappoint. Try out the flavors prior to committing to an order.
Oh my goodness.. so good!!! I don't really like ice cream and I ordered the toffee, vanilla bean ice cream in the waffle and it was the best ice cream I've ever had!!!

I have been coming to Sweet Republic before I even moved to Phoenix! For out-of-towners looking to make a culinary pilgrimage of the sweet variety, please come to Sweet Republic! The oldies but goodies are almond buttercrunch and salted butter caramel (always in a waffle bowl or cone). If you are adventurous, please sample the seasonal flavors like chocolate rosemary (divine), brown bread (for St. Patty's day and delish), or something savory like blue cheese. I bring all of my out of town visitors here to this original location. It is worth the drive. And who doesn't love an ice cream shop that sells shirts that say "Welcome to the Dark Side, We have Ice Cream"

Hard to find, tough to beat. Same great flavors and service as the 16th Street location, but without the crowds. There are 2 customer parking spaces on the street level, then a big parking structure. Don't know if the structure parking is free or not.

Yummm! I have bought sweet republic treats before from Whole Foods but I had never actually stopped in here before. I was craving a sundae but wasn't super hungry so the mini sundae was just right for me! I got it with the brownie swirl ice cream. Next time I'd get it without the whipped cream, but it was delicious! My boyfriend loved his ice cream too, I think he got some sort of caramel flavor? It was all delicious and we will totally come back soon! Good service too, it got a little busy and the two people working behind the counter handled it all well!

So delicious! The ice creams are fantastic. They have fun limited flavors in addition to the usual selections. Info about these limited flavors are available on their Instagram. The waffle cones and bowls are super light and crunchy, and beautifully flavored. We always add a bag of handmade marshmallows or almond toffee brittle to our order! We are addicted to this place.
Super sweet staff that offers suggestions if you are on the fence, worth coming here for their ice cream or unique sundae combos!

Sweet Jesus, I miss honey lavender ice cream from Vancouver. I never thought I'd find such a flavor in Phoenix of all places but lo and behold - Sweet Republic has it! Oh my, my tummy and heart were very satisfied with that delicious, perfectly smooth scoop of honey lavender ice cream. Since then, I've been back multiple times and never been disappointed with their flavors, including the espresso chip, kulfi, matcha, strawberry buttermilk, and Madagascar vanilla. My friends and I can't stop coming back here! They've got other really cool flavors too - watermelon sorbet, peaberry espresso, strawberry balsamic, you name it. They've also got the traditional vanilla, chocolate, salted caramel, etc. Get it in a cup, cone, or as an ice cream sandwich. And if you're feeling adventurous they serve ice cream sundaes too. This place is sure to please for people of all ages! Yum yum yum, I'll be back - that's for sure.

I absolutely love this ice cream shop, from the name to the flavors, to the toppings, it's all good. They were actually featured on the Food Network show for one of their Sundaes. They have really unique flavors and everything is homemade. I like their salted butter caramel, it's my favorite. I haven't tasted a flavor I didn't like.

I decided to try this place out with my friend after hearing positive reviews & I mean really positive reviews (best ice cream shops across the US) so I walked in with high expectations. I got Madagascar vanilla ice cream and something else with brownie bits in it. Anyways, it's just average ice cream. Nothing special.
I paid 8 bucks for a strawberry shake. It was small and mostly milk. Won't be going back there.

So good! My husband and I shared the Toffee Banofi sundae and it was plenty of dessert for 2 people! The toppings towered far over the waffle bowl and was full of flavor. When we arrived the place was super busy, but the staff did a great job at fulfilling orders quickly and getting folks through the line. There is a large selection of ice cream and sorbet flavors and the menu offers scoops, sundaes, floats, and milkshakes. We were very pleased and will be back for sure!
First time visiting. Great homemade ice cream!!! Try the Ice cream Sandwich!! We will be back!!

Wish I got a photo before I dove into my delicious ice cream in a waffle bowl with a toasted marshmallow on top! I enjoyed a scoop of black sesame and brownie and cream. Both were delicious. But honestly I would go back just for the toasted marshmallows.
Insider Tip: go for the small batch or seasonal! Awesome Small Batch Peaberry Coffee Ice Cream! As other reviewer's echo that's a bit pricey but definitely a nice treat. Super creamy!
I love coming here. Prob my fav ice cream spot. They make sure to label each ice cream with any allergies. Which is a huge deal for someone like me.
Delicious and refreshing! Best waffle cone I've ever had! Glad I stopped by. Great customer service with lots of unique flavors.

Wherever they get their Ginger Beer from. I need it. I proceeded to order a shake and so did my husband and my younger children all recieved Ice Cream. Really good flavors! So sad theres no dine in! But the service was nice

Was in the area and decided to give them a try. The ice cream was very rich, creamy and fairly sweet. It seems like they make their own? This is what Cold Stone USED to taste like. Definitely a decadent treat!

I should have known what I was getting into when they didn't have peanut butter as a topping choice. The ice cream is just OK. It's not amazing and it's not bad. Getting fancy with flavors doesn't mean they are good. If you are just visiting the area, I would try somewhere else.
Tastes good but not allergy friendly. We were told that one of the flavors had no dairy, only eggs, but it turned out it did in fact have cream. Many of the sorbets contain corn and soy too.
Fun ice cream selections. I went in for a simple fudge sundae but had trouble sticking to it since there are so many yummy options!

Without a doubt the worst cookie that I've ever had in my life. This was an absolute monstrosity of a cookie. I have no idea that you could make cookies taste this bad. It also leaves a taste in your mouth that you can't stand. Save your money and your taste buds and go get some NestlÃ© Toll House cookies.

After seeing this on the Food Network a few years ago, I had to try this place. If Alton Brown puts his stamp of approval on something, you know there is something special there. The store was clean and there was a bit of a line. Once through the line, there was no where to sit right away but that didn't stop us from enjoying a Toffee Banofi and Camp Fire Smores. You really get a good mix of flavor in the Toffee Banofi. The textures play with each other nicely. You have the crunch of the cone and toffee, the smoothness of the banana, and a nice sweet kick from the caramel. I must say that I actually enjoyed the Camp Fire Smores a little better. If you close your eyes, you can actually smell the campfire. I don't know how they add that smokiness, but Alton Brown really needs to try this one as well. Eventually we snagged a table and were able to relax and enjoy these magical creations. There is also tap water available - wish they had free milk! Worth the trip out to Scottsdale to try this ice cream shop.

Just average for us. Very expensive for what you get. I'm all about quality over quantity but over 4 bucks for a very small scoop of ice cream. I got the salted caramel and it tasted like freezer burn. It was very creamy but I prefer Culver's frozen custard.

Went here for ice cream. Pretty good ice cream. A bit pricey. But good quality. The salted Carmel ice cream was good, and the little almond pieces of goodness they put on the toffee banofi are out of this world!

So the Reason that we knew of this place and gave it a shot is because Alton Brown said this was the best thing he ever ate on the Food Network TV show!!!!! YES IT WAS!!!!! We had the Toffie Banofi! So amazing!!!! Pure Madagascar vanilla bean ice cream, fresh bananas, almond toffee brittle, salted butter caramel, and whip cream in a waffle bowl!!!! So reasonably priced and such a great treat we will definitely be back. Service and preparation was amazing!!! Everything is made in house!!!

You know where to find me this summer. This was spot on. Had the toffee sticky pudding and creme brÃ»lÃ©e. Wow, amazing combo. I love my ice cream and this is on the favorites list. Perfect treat when we warm up this summer.
I am here now and the service was great and quick. I really enjoyed how clean it was inside. I will write more soon. I had the peach and the brownie.

Great sweet treat on a hot day! Lots of unique flavors and very clean sanitized place. We enjoyed the almond brittle flavor recommended by the young man service g is and it was amazing! You won't be disappointed !
Came here on a first date and had a great time! Super friendly staff and amazing ice cream!
Delicious ice cream! Would highly recommend. All whole made ingredients. Super fresh. Hits the spot!

Wow! This place is amazing. Great ice cream produced and sourced locally. The flavors are phenomena and the staff extra friendly and helpful. No old waffle cones here, only pure joy. Covid has caused the elimination of tasting but they are being safe and I appreciate their masks, requiring customers to mask up, and their use of gloves.

Wonderful. Wanted to find a nice local joint to have dessert and found this gem!!! The staff were all very kind, sweet, courteous...and the ice cream...OHHH the ice cream!!!! I got the Toffe banaffee and it was heavenly!! My wife got the Campfire Smores and she said it was DEE-LISH!!!! The price is comparable to ANY CHAIN but the quality is BETTER. I will agree with Natalie W. this place IS BANGIN...
Amazing homemade ice cream and all toppings made from scratch. The taste is delicious and they have many flavors to choose from. Staff was very friendly.

Yummm yumm yumm!!!! This place is awesome. I was won over just by walking in and seeing their mini table and mini chairs for kids. My girls immediately went to sit down, it was adorable. They also have a selection of board games that you can sit and play while you eat your dessert. We ordered the toffee banfoi which was my favorite. The toffee and bananas were so good together. We also got the smore campfire which was pretty much just as good. They toast the marshmallow on top so it's get nice and hot and easy to pull apart with each bite. Their strawberry sorbet was very refreshing and light. They had a great selection of ice cream to choose from. There were a lot of plaques on the wall from all the awards they have won. I can see why! I wish I had a place like this near home!

Another one of those places with impossible to keep up with expectations. With small batch ice cream, the flavors ranged from phenomenal (salted butter caramel) to more average (mint chocolate chip). Got a generous sized scoop and we loved through the line quickly. The waffle cone was decent too. Is it best ever? Not for us but that's not a knock on them either. This was definitely an enjoyable scoop.
Our family lives to ride our bikes here (it's right off the green belt bike path). Unique flavors and delicious homemade treats, friendly staff.

Welcome to the Republic. The Republic of rich, luscious ice cream! They have some unique flavors, including some holiday flavors like peppermint, gingerbread, and eggnog. After browsing through the flavor selection, I decided on an ice cream sandwich ($4.50) with the gingerbread ice cream. The cookies included with the sandwich are either chocolate chip or molasses but you can also upgrade to a premium cookie (A chocolate chip oatmeal concoction) for $10. I felt like mixing it up so I had a chocolate chip on one side and a molasses on the other. The ice cream itself was great and I loved the bits of gingerbread mixed in with the ice cream. The cookies though tasted too sweet for my tastes so when I bit into the sandwich all I could taste was a generic sweetness rather than the actual ingredients. Also, while the molasses cookie had a nice chewiness that made it easy to eat with the soft ice cream, the chocolate chip was harder. Service was warm and friendly. If I'm in the area and craving ice cream I'd go here again.

It took me many years to get out to Scottsdale to taste the goodness of Sweet Republic and boy am I glad I did!! Delicious ice creams and a cool store!!! Loved the flavors and the fact that they are made in small batches. Writing this review has me wanting to drive 40 minutes to get me some Sweet Republic ice cream :)
Toffee Banofi ... HEAVENLY Alton agrees - pecan turtle Madagascar vanilla ice cream DELICIOUSNESS - MUST GO!

I came in yesterday to grab some ice cream. This has been on my list to try for a while and my Dr recommended it. I ended up getting two pints to take home. The Salted Butter Caramel was amazing, dare I say the best I've ever had. The second flavor I got was the Browned Butter Pecan, also amazing. The lady was so nice and helped bag up my ice cream with ice so that it would stay cold during my 40 minute drive home. Next time I need to try some more flavors, they all looked delicious.
Hands down the best ice cream ever! It's a good thing that their Horchata ice cream is a seasonal flavor otherwise I'd be eating it daily!
This place is worth a visit! The ice cream and sorbet were rice and delicious. And the waffle cup was made perfectly. Our family really enjoyed this place!

Sweet Republic is the land of artisan ice cream handcrafted in Scottsdale. Populated by a range of rotating creative flavors, Sweet Republic is a destination for ice cream lovers. Get a scoop or more, indulge in a sundae, drink a milkshake, make it easy to eat with a sandwich or cone, or take a pint home. This the land of ice cream freedom. I am pretty much a creature of habit when it comes to ice cream. I like to stick with chocolate, mint, or lavender honey. Some of the flavors are just average, but everything is decent overall. The staff will let you sample as much as you like so that you can find the flavors you like, but be a little mindful when there is a long line. Prices are relatively reasonable. Expect this shop to be a busy place, especially during the brutal Arizona summer.

They let you try 3 samples which is great because I never know what to get! Prices are a bit steep for a small scoop - around $4 but justified with all the unique flavors and ingredients they have. Love that they have sorbets but would be so excited if they started making dairy free icecream!

I've been a loyal customer of this place for years... until today. Today after school, my little girl wanted an ice cream. The place was empty and while I was ordering my ice cream my daughter went to the bathroom. Even if the place was empty, the employee behind the counter was in a rush and in a bad way asked me if I was planning to order anything else... I said we will order my daughter's ice cream when she got back. When she did I placed the order for her, and at that moment I step to throw a paper in the garbage (2 seconds literally) as more customers started coming in. In those 2 seconds he had already put some brittle and a piece of brownie as toppings, and I corrected him "it was only one topping" and in the MOST RUDE WAY he took the cone, threw the brownie to the garbage and handed me the cone. When I turned to my daughter she had TEARS in her eyes and said "Mommy, he threw my brownie and I told him I wanted brownies because I already have the brittle" (I bought a bag of brittle with my order). I waited until he was done with the next customer and (still politely) asked him "hey, my daughter said she wanted brownies" , he turned to me and basically yelled at me... your daughter said she wanted 3 toppings!!! (I knew she was ordering brownies but also he could have confirmed with me). He was so RUDE and my daughter felt so bad (she wouldn't even receive the ice cream), that the next customer intervened (it was his first time at sweet Republic ) and said ... hey, this girl said she wanted brownies... could you please change it for her? And the RUDE employee turned to the customer and said "you need to pay extra". This man was so upset that he told, "ok I will pay for it, just give the little girl the brownie". At this point I came to the counter, thanked the man and told him that was not necessary, but he handed $1 to the scooper and asked him to "keep the change" since he was being so ridiculous and making such a scene in a place now full of customers. I asked him for his manager and he put a paper in front of me and in a very defiant way he asked me to write my number and she will call. I asked for his name and again using defiant words and tone he handed me the paper on the picture. If I want my daughter to have a nice experience definitely I will go somewhere else, and not being yelled and embarrassed as she felt today.

Always the best! My son had gingerbread and I had peppermint stick. Both were amazing. The gingerbread had gingerbread cookie crumbles in it. Plus, we had to add the brÃ»lÃ©ed marshmallow on top! Decadent but worth it.
Get the sea salt caramel! You'll be hooked from the first spoonful. The staff is friendly and fast - we like coming here after a round of mini golf at Glow Putt that's right downstairs!
Open and awesome! Love this place, thank you for opening and keeping us cool during this hot mess of a pandemic!
Meh, not terribly impressed. Didn't particularly like the ice cream and the service was not great. Disappointing.

Loved the ice cream! So creamy! My husband had vanilla and I had Salted Caramel in a waffle bowl. The bowl tasted like it had just been made, not stale like other places I've been to. Can't wait to return!
I have ordered a Brownie Swirl and tasted great. This ice-cream doesn't disappoint you.

The staffs were taking their time. After they've scooped out my ice cream, they were still helping out the people in front of us (very slowly). I waited at least 3 minutes before they gave me my ice cream (it's been sitting on their countertop), by the time they handed it to me it was already melting. They also got my order wrong, which they provided a refund, but by the time I finally got what I wanted, I've already lost my interest of having ice cream. First time walking out of an ice cream store with such disappointment.

I've been going here since they opened! They've always been good and their flavors consistent! Sometime ago I couldn't have dairy and though they don't have a huge selection of sorbets, what they do have tastes amazing! And creamy. Once in a blue moon I might give into a craving for their Campfire S'mores sundae though
They are my absolute favorite ice cream place EVER! My favorite is the Earl Grey ice cream, but the Horchata, and the Blue Moon are amazing! Blue moon kinda tastes like cereal~

We were in town and looking for a dessert place and I came across Sweet Republic so decided to give it a try. I tried a scoop of Banana Foster and Huckleberry Swirl. Not that I didn't like the Huckleberry but I should have just gotten Banana Foster. It is literally my FAVORITE ice creams ever! I talk about it all the time. It is that good! When I get back to Scottsdale or Phoenix, I'll definitely be going back to get some more! Totally recommend this place! Delicious ice cream! The toffee sundae was a hit with the group too.

We went here twice on a recent visit to Arizona. Any time we go on a trip and I can try locally made food or a local specialty I'm a happy camper. The ice cream was tasty. For me, it wasn't mind blowingly tasty as some people say. Some of the flavors I tried were interesting. However, I was a big fan of their waffle bowls. The waffle bowls are crispy and thin enough that you can break it with a plastic spoon. Other places have overly thick waffle bowls that require a small hammer to smash. I also liked that they torch the handmade marshmallow on the S'more Sundae $7.25. The Java Jolt milkshake was also tasty $6.25. A single scoop is $3.00. The line is pretty slow because they have one employee scooping ice cream AND running the cash register at times (which isn't a great idea for sanitary reasons). Overall, Sweet Republic is decent and is locally made so it gets five stars from me.

The ice creams were excellent and there were some unique flavors that I hadn't see anywhere else. We couldn't get a taster bite to taste some of the flavors due to COVID. The staff was friendly though and overall it's a nice place for a post-dinner visit for some desserts!
Can't think of a better place to go get a sweet treat on a warm summer day. I would highly recommend Sweet Republic to anyone looking too cool down with some amazing ice cream!
Delicious! A little pricey but best ice cream around. They homemade marshmallows and toffee are also a favorite

Sweet Republic is a dandy little ice cream joint - sort of in between a B&R (lots of flavors) and a Cold Stone (I don't think they do mix-ins at Sweet Republic?) Anyway - 2 good reasons to go right now. 1) The waffle cones - lighter, more crisp and delicate than most, with cinnamon, I think? 2) Mayan Chocolate ice cream - chocolate, cinnamon, and chile flavored ice cream - yes, please! It's hot and cold and spicy and sweet at the same time - wow!

The kids were dying for ice cream so we came here. Wasn't impressed. Totally dead inside. The guy behind the counter was kinda rude. Only 3 samples per person cause they're using real spoons, which he told me after I chose my 3. My son got a cone with chocolate brownie on top. $1 for 4 TINY brownie pieces, maybe an ounce, if that. He doesn't want to ever come back. Lots of other places in the valley that are better and more hospitable.
It's ice cream, I mean come on let's be honest here, the pricing is a bit out of control!

I've had the opportunity to know this brand and have had their Ice Cream samples at Food Festivals I've attended. The place is cute and bright, very fun looking atmosphere. One person taking orders, filling orders and checking out orders. Quit a line was forming. As we waited, we looked over the flavors offered. Fortunately as we waited, another employee came out and took my order. The young man was very nice. My friend and I shared a 2 scoop cup with Salted Butter Carmel and Brownie Swirl. The ice cream tasted heavenly, sweet and creamy. My only thoughts are, I wished they had more traditional flavors. I would definitely be back to try the ice cream sundae and milk shakes. Atmosphere: bright and fun looking. Service: good. Ice Cream: excellent

In A Nutshell: -If you are looking for nice sweet, cold sweet treat, then Sweet Republic has it covered. -Their sundaes are plentiful, but if you are there on a Friday, Saturday or Sunday, I suggest you order their "Toffee Banofi". -This sundae features 2 scoops of Madagascar vanilla ice cream, fresh bananas, almond toffee brittle & salted butter caramel sauce in a waffle bowl. -It's big enough to share for two. -Take it outside in the warm night air to enjoy. Overall, this is an award winning ice cream shop located in Scottsdale!
The best possible ice cream. The attention to detail is incredible and the caramel sauce on top is rich and buttery.

I came here because of the rave reviews on yelp. Don't get me wrong- everything here was good, but not worth the hype IMO. The location is clean, well decorated, and seems new. The woman working there really knew what she was talking about and was well informed on all of the products there. Honestly, maybe it was my fault for not going for the toffee banofi which is their signature item. The cookies there look bomb, ice cream is good (not the best) waffle cones were really good an fresh. All in all it was a good experience, just nothing too special.

This is probably my favorite ice cream spot in Scottsdale. Every time I come here it's such an indulgent experience. Everything is awesome everything is fresh everything is so scrumptious. There so many different flavors and combinations you could sit here and just try to figure out what you want for several hours and then even then it will be hard to decide. The people are always really super friendly and the service is always great. You can't walk out of here and not be happy.
Nothing beats their ice cream flavors! We buys them by the pint to have at home. Support local!

I really like Sweet Republic. Some observations follow that might help your first experience here be a good one. Yes, Sweet Republic has received all sorts of national and local recognition. One of the best ice cream shops around. Don't, however, let your expectations be warped unreasonably. It's a fun little shop that serves unique hand crafted ice cream. Nothing more. Go with that expectation and you'll love Sweet Republic. Some flavors are truly unique. Take a taste or two before you commit to a flavor. As much as I love Sweet Republic, I've encountered some flavors that were not at all what I expected. I suspect it's the natural ingredients... Flavors offered do change. Just be patient. Your favorites will come back around with the seasons, the day of the week or at the whim of the proprietor (who might be in the house). There are a few staples, however, you can rely on being available. Consider spending a little extra and opt for a sundae. These concoctions really differentiate Sweet Republic. Warning. They're addictive. No way around it. Sweet Republic is a bit expensive. You're paying for quality ingredients and unique flavors. Not a bad tradeoff.

Basis for my starred ratings (which skews heavily to the food or drink): 1 star: Never again. 2 stars: Poor food, poor experience, extraordinary measures in order for me to come back. 3 stars: Average, nothing really special, nothing particularly bad. 4 stars: Very good, would definitely return. 5 stars: A favorite, one of the best. Just an update review after a long while. Still one of the best ice cream places in the country. Still do original and interesting flavor combinations without going overboard or too experimental like some other ice cream places. No gimmicks here, just quality ice cream. This time had the peaches and cream. Beauty in simplicity. Sweet cream ice cream with chunks of peaches. The sweet cream base tasted like the milk I had in France. Rich, sweet, and actually tasting like dairy. It is unctuous, decadent, even. The chunks of peaches were a biiiiit undersized, but still added flavor and a slightly tart counterbalance to the sweet cream.

Touring Arizona and it is incredibly HOT out so we came to try their lime basil sorbet having it bookmarked only to find it's available in pints :(((( Ended up getting the strawberry sorbet and it's delicious. Not too sweet and completely refreshing ! Would like to mention that they use metal spoons if you want to try certain flavors. Eco-friendly !
The ice cream is great here!! Love it and it's right by my house which is nice!!! The line can get a little long but it's worth it!!

Old fashion hand crafted ice-creams, lovely staffs and super cute setting. I took my son and his 6 friends here for my son's bday celebration and it was perfect. Although we sat outside which is perfectly fine because it was full house inside. But the rest of the family (adults) sat inside and they enjoyed so much.
Staff is friendly, welcoming, and is very helpful with the menu. Waffle bowls are amazing and the ice cream flavors are so good!! This is my family's "go-to" for ice cream!
Delicious and unique homemade ice cream! Lavender honey is the best! I could swim in this stuff!

Joe and I stopped in after going to Gigi's place I ordered the pecan turtle Sunday and OMG it was amazing and tasted delicious Joe got coconut sorbet and strawberry sorbet and he said he love the coconut I love that they had a dairy free option for Joe so he could enjoy something nice and cool on this hot summer day we really like Sweet Republic it was worth the extra money because everything was tasty Jennifer in the area again and want ice cream we will go there
I heard about this place from Alton Brown on Best Thing I Ever Ate and had to try the Toffee Banofi. It did not disappoint and I will definitely be back to try more!
Amazing ppl, and product. Real ingredients and the best part; only real ingredients as listed on the side of the pint.

I looked up best ice cream places to go in each state, and this one definitely lives up to its title. Very clean and lots of seating to enjoy the richest ice cream you'll ever taste. So good I had to get three scoops! They have vegan flavors and Complimentary water too! If you're in Arizona, you've gotta go!

LOVE their ice cream and toppings. I absolutely adored every flavor I tried, so much so that I had to get a triple scoop! And their marshmallows looked so good that I had to get a torched one on the side. The rose vanilla? Flavor is to die for and the malt chocolate chip is my new favorite. So glad I live close by and can satisfy my ice cream cravings at any time!!!!
Nothing like it! Original, posh & one-of-a-kind ice creamery ! Must visit! All the must have flavors and unique flavors you'll be fascinated to try all in the same place. Perfect date night spot!

The three staff members working at 9:00pm on January 14th were AWESOME! Super friendly two guys and girl and they recommended the best ice cream flavor! They even out a toasted marshmallow on top. Everyone who's in the area should come check this place out. Clean, friendly and DELICIOUS! 10/10

Hello delicious! They were the vendor for a previous job of mine where I discovered black sesame ice cream...who would've thunk? Amazing. When I visited this business, I tried the honey lavender ice cream and was blown away. We ended up leaving with a pint. Try something unique at this great business!
Great ice cream spot! Service was quick & the ice cream was delicious! The Mint chocolate chip could have more mint flavor, but texture was remarkable.

Visiting on business trip and looked for a good ice cream place. Well! I found it! Ice cream was great! The gentleman that helped us very friendly and helped us with picking a flavor by giving us a sample of the ice cream. My husband had brownie swirl and almond butter crunch in a waffle cone. I have a scoop of almond butter crunch and salted butter crunch in a cup. I had a bit of my husbands and I was wishing I had a waffle cone too! Best ice cream and definitely the best waffle cone I have ever had. Can't wait to visit here again!
Best ice cream in Arizona- hands down! The pecan turtle sundae is my absolute favorite and a must try.
Expensive, but delicious! The honey lavender was great! Small batch means great care, but also high price. I was prepared for it, so make sure you are too. Very delicious.
Great ice cream, friendly staff and reasonable prices. We try to go once a week. The kids love it.

I just dropped by Sweet Republic after dinner to see if they have one of my favorite ice creams. The one I was looking for was Kulfi. I have been stopping by every so often to see if they have it as it appears to be seasonal. When they don't have Kulfi, I just get one of their other delicious ice creams--so wonderful and very unique. I have even tasted one with blue cheese in it. Anyway, TODAY I FOUND MY KULFI!!!!!!!! So excited. I bought a pint and brought it home. Much to my dismay, it was not like the kulfi of the past. It lacked in cardamon and pistachios. It was missing that exotic flavor of spices that used to be in it. This tasted more like just an ice cream base without much of anything in it. I'm crying in my ice cream right now as I was SO looking forward to my Kulfi. If I had taken a sample taste of it, I probably would have chosen another flavor of the many interesting ones that they have. But why would I ask for a sample when I thought I knew my kulfi so well?! Hope that the management fixes the problem with the kulfi. Whoever was mixing the flavor did not follow the recipe because it does not taste as before. Thinking of bringing it back. So disappointed.
This is probably my favorite ice cream store in Phoenix area. Attentive staff and really nice and clean dining area. Definitely will come back with my friends to try different scoops.
Yes! You won't be disappointed. PS. The toasted marshmallow can be put on anything!

Stopped in today with my niece and nephew. It was 90 degrees outside and we rang the doorbell on several occasions and they still opened 10 minutes late and didn't apologize. My niece and nephew requested certain items, nothing unusual, vanilla and chocolate and were told they could only have one or the other. And also they weren't allowed to pick out which sprinkles they wanted. We're in the age of COVID and thought getting some ice cream together as a family would be a nice idea but this experience and the young woman working made it such a bad uncomfortable experience that we will never come back. It put a terrible taste in our mouth and I'm not only talking about the ice cream.

I heard about Sweet Republic being on a top ice cream list, so naturally I was so excited to try it. I love artisanal crafted ice cream, definitely preferred over Baskin Robbins or Cold Stone. I went on a hot summer day, and even though there was a line, it wasn't too bad. The servers are all very friendly and I got to try many of their flavors. I loved the salted butter caramel and the sweet corn. I'm excited to try the next season's flavors!! I was not disappointed by any of them and agreed that the ice cream was certainly some of the best! They have a nice sitting area equipped with board games and cards. Very clean and inviting! This is by far my new favorite ice cream shop in Arizona! :)

What's shaken,"sweet republic" thang? You're like the guy with the "hot" pictures on Match.com that you have to stop and look, and send a "wink" to. Yes, you are. I was in Scottsdale and wanted something "sweet", some "honeylicious" ice cream. So, where do I go? I check my Yelp app (my Match.com for food) and I come across this place. I stop and look at these pictures! Oh my - what a dime! You look good, you ice cream sundae, you! Damn, I want a piece of that! I ain't gonna "wink", I'm gonna visit you because you just look too damn good! So...I race over there and I get one scoop of espresso and one scoop of mocha crumble ice cream. No syrup, no toppings - I like it all natural! Sweet Republic, you are everything I expected you to be! Delicious and satisfying!

Before I went vegan, Sweet Republic was the best place to get awesome sundaes and inventive ice cream flavors. Now that I'm vegan, I really appreciate that they have dairy-free sorbets on the menu. The last time we went, I had the chocolate sorbet with chocolate sauce (also dairy-free) and it was awesome! I just wish they'd add a vegan cookie or waffle cone that I could have to accompany my sorbet.

This place summoned me from its reviews and my need of ice cream while in Scottsdale. They have a toffee banofi which was amazing!! The last time I had banofi was in India and I can't find anyplace our there that sells anything banofi. The toffee banofi is vanilla ice cream, slices of bananas, almond toffee brittle, salted buttercream Carmel sauce and whip cream in a waffle bowl. The serving is huge and definitely enough for 2 or 3 people. They have quite a few ice creams and sorbets. They also make milkshakes, sundaes or you can get plain scoops. There is 6 tables with wall seating. It was pretty busy but a table happened to open up as we were paying. The employees working were very nice and knowledgeable. My son originally wanted the mint chip and the gal suggested he try a sample of it as it was made with real mint leaves so it has a stronger minty flavor. He liked it but decided on the brownie swirl which was really good! Glad to try this place out as I have been eyeing it for a while just was not in the area. I will be back soon for that toffee banofi!!

As far as ice cream goes, this place is pretty average. The flavors don't have a lot of mix-ins like you might find in a pint of Ben & Jerry's. Not many toppings either. Three stars for just being average, with one more star knocked off for their mask policy. Enforcing a mask policy at an ice cream parlor is, in my opinion, laughable.

We came here after seeing this place listed in an article at the top place for ice cream in Arizona. The service is very good and friendly. The place is clean and organized. However, I tried 4 flavors and none of them were great. I felt like I had to order something after getting samples so I chose the salted butter caramel on a waffle cone. The waffle cone was underwhelming also. The price was over $4 for one scoop and a waffle cone. The scoops are way too small for the price. We don't plan to come back here again

Went here a couple of days ago with a group of friends and some of their kids and I have to tell you this place is unbelievably great. The ice cream is out-of-this-world amazing the cookie toppings and the waffle cones are just incredible and it's a really nice comfortable atmosphere and everybody felt good. Apparently most of everything that they have is made from scratch which is really unusual and of course everybody appreciates that as well. The kids were in heaven and even my friends could not get enough of this wonderful ice cream spot. We'll be coming back every chance I get. This place is an absolute must go to.
It's a great dessert spot. I love their Walnut Oatmeal flavor! Their sundaes are also a hit!

I am very glad we tried this shop out while in Scottsdale and I immediately knew I wanted the toffee bonoffi (sp?). All the flavors went together very well but my favorite flavor component was definitely the salted caramel butter sauce. I was a bit disappointed by the toffee, I like mine a little more buttery and this batch tasted slightly burnt. Overall though, we still enjoyed it, big serving so is probably good to share. They also have some fun and unique flavors which we sampled such as sweet corn and habanero bacon avocado which were fun. I can't say I would order a scoop of them but was nice to check them out. If you are in Scottsdale I definitely recommend stopping by sweet republic!
Great, great, great ice cream! Love the Toffee Binofee. Just wish it wasn't so expensive, $32 for 3 ice creams. But, it was really good.

Can you say mouthwatering!! The flavors and service was delicious! I absolutely love to visit an ice cream shop that makes their own cones, and has truly original flavors. My favorite was the Pear Sorbet. It's taste just like it had been soaked in red wine just like the description noted. A favorite of our family was the Madagascar vanilla. The servers were extremely nice an patient with our rather large group. We had lots of questions especially those in our group who were lactose intolerant. They received 4/5 stars because of the smell. It sort of smelled like old water in which did not complement the sweet atmosphere.
Good ice cream with interesting flavors to choose from that rotate pretty frequently. Nice that it is right off the bike path as well.

We are from out of town and came here based off the excellent reviews! (4.5) Kinda surprised as to why. I was expecting very rich, creamy ice cream but it didn't meet that expectation for me. All the flavors were just pretty average, there was no flavor in particular that I was dying to have more of. The texture didn't do it for me either. The waffle cone is what definitely makes it. Was crowded the entire time we were there so must be a local favorite. Personally, I didn't think it was worth the price. Staff was friendly and let us sample everything. Thought it was fun they had a bunch of board games to play and appreciated the free self-serve water.

Don't miss their waffle cone. I've never had a better waffle cone. It has flavor and texture and it's really the only time I've ever liked a waffle cone. Also the butted pecan is the best pecan ice cream I've ever had. It's rich and sweet and creamy and full of pecans. I loved it. I also got a scoop of the black sesame seed ice cream. It wasn't great. Not a lot of flavor. That Japanese grocery store in Tempe sells black sesame ice cream that is better than this. The employees were wearing masks and super helpful. They have 6 foot markings designated on the floor. They seemed to be acting cautiously. Anyway, I'll definitely be back for more pecan ice cream.

I can't say enough good things about this place. All natural and biodegradable spoons! Mint ice cream is made from mint leaves!! Absolutely loved it and we will be coming back even though it's a 20 minute drive (it's worth it).

Desperately trying to seem trendy. The ice cream we had didn't seem properly blended. It was grainy. That's the only way I can describe it. The flavor was decent. The price is genuinely laughable given the quality I experienced. The staff seems to be typical of a Scottsdale trendy location, aloof yet confused as to how to treat a customer. I wouldn't bother going back. There are way better ice cream places in town.

I went here for the first time last night for a friend's celebration and glad I finally discovered this ice creamery hidden on Shea Blvd! They don't offer as many flavors as Baskin Robbins or anything, but they have a good amount of selections for ice cream (I had the Belgian Chocolate which was utterly smooth and perfect), as well as sorbets. I also noticed they make milk shakes ("My milk shake brings all the boys to the yard")... sorry, that just triggered that Kelis song. Don't be afraid to ask for samples either, but don't be the greedy piggy who abuses the concept and holds up the line either! Ha ha Sweet Republic peddles cookies too! And, don't forget some penny candy near the register. I bought 2 Bit-O-Honey's and they were old because I couldn't even bite down on it. :( Lame, so I threw the 2nd one away. No biggie. I have a strong hunch that I'll be back here at some point.

Came here based on 5 STAR YELP reviews. I should have just ordered what the reviewers were raving about and I would most likely been pleased with my order. The service was great, plenty of seating, parking and easy to find. The two tiny scoops of ice cream on my sundae were a big letdown. This is the smallest scoop of ice cream I have ever been served. Unlike others YELP reviewers, I did not find the ice cream to be anything extra special, hence my rating them 2 stars.... And hot fudge squeezed out of a plastic bottle? I went and searched to see "sundae reviews" and turns out other feel the same, but those reviews are not featured. Again, this was a disappointment. Stay away from the sundaes.
Excellent!!!!! Creative, flavorful and great to have in the neighborhood. Really good customer service as well.

We went here yesterday for honey lavender ice cream and watermelon sorbet. It was wonderful to get out for a little break and see everyone practicing social distancing and happy to have customers. It was a real treat. The sorbet was light and refreshing and the ice cream was rich and delicious. They are no longer giving samples so make sure you know what you want when you get there. They have lots of creative choices.
I loved this place! Super clean with a friendly welcoming staff. They take their time perfecting your ice cream and make it fun to watch in the process. Me and my kids would definitely come back!
Had a long drive to try this out and we were not disappointed. The basil lime sorbet and butter caramel are must try.

I know this place is called sweet republic but I feel there is just too much sugar in both the ice creams and waffle cones. Flavours are great hence the 4 stars. Kulfi a nice surprise. Will be back at some point but will get it in a cup
