There is something in here that is sure to satisfy anyone's sweet tooth! Ice cream, malts, candy - you name it!

I got the red velvet ice-cream with a topping of brownie chunks and a toasted homemade marshmallow on the top. I liked my dessert overall.. Ice-cream: good and creamy, tasted amazing. Topping: I took away one star just for this, they did not have a lot of choices in toppings, brownies were not my "OMG i gotta have this" choice but it was "okay let's get this because it's the best among what they have" choice. They can surely improve on the topping. Marshmallow: Great, perfect taste, toasted the right amount. I loved the place in all. Would go again when I am in Scottsdale.
One word...WOW!!! The variety of flavors was super impressive! I'm a butter pecan fan so I chose the brown butter pecan and the flavor profile was delicious! So glad we came in.

Shoo fly pie! Thank you Sweet Republic! I am from Lancaster, PA and your Scottsdale location served up a delicious taste of home. Also, I may never visit without a homemade waffle cone again. Wow, so good.
Have to be honest not that good. Waited 15 minutes to place my order with one person ahead of me. Hot fudge not hot at all. Mediocre at best and EXPENSIVE

Visiting from California. Ice-cream snobbish. This place is pretty good. Seasonal flavor sweet potato with chunks of marshmallows. Delicious and creamy. Smelled like bleach when we walked through the doors but the odor was redeemed by the flavors lol. A must try if you're visiting from out of town or local and live under a rock.

I went in with a $5 birthday coupon and the cashier named Audrey didn't know how to enter the coupon, so she gave us under the amount off instead. They accepted no fault and blamed it instead upon the fact that they "weren't taught how to enter the coupon" and were very rude when confronted and unhappy. Very unprofessional experience.
Pretty good location, we were so happy it didn't have a line coming out the front door. The ice cream flavors were awesomr, so different than all the regular places.

I'll start off this review by saying this place needs to make some adjustments to their staff. I was just in here with my boyfriend and little sister and we were looking at all of the flavors trying to decide what to get (mind you we had only been in here for a few minutes at this point) so I told the man behind us in line that he could go in front of us because we weren't ready yet. The man started to place his order and the staff member (CASEY was his name) said to the man "wow thank you for knowing what you want and not taking a long time, greatly appreciated" in a very sarcastic tone. Clearly Casey was referring to us for taking a few minutes to choose a flavor. If that bothers him so much, he should probably find another place to work because we will not be coming back here.

Oh didn't realize I didn't review this one yet! I've been here quite a few times and love it. I was lucky enough to get a behind the scenes tour of this business a few years ago with Yelp. I learned about the owners and what it takes to make ice cream. Disclosure: I am not an ice cream aficionada but I do like to eat it sparingly. On my latest visit, I was on a vegan diet so I ordered two of their sorbets: chocolate and strawberry. They complemented each other well and were refreshing and tasty. The strawberry tasted fresh and had seeds in it, while the chocolate reminded me of froyo, a lighter version. Service was friendly and employees were wearing masks, no seating available. Glad they're doing well and hope they're staying safe.
It's the best ice cream in Arizona and they do a phenomenal job of packaging it up for delivery through the delivery applications

Sweet republic is wonderful!! This was my first visit to this location. We stopped in for a tasty treat! When adulting all day it's nice to have a place to rewind the clock- and enjoy a flashback to childhood with ice cream!! They have delicious options and all kinds of ways of jazzing them up! Today I had salted caramel ice cream with a waffle bowl! I added a Marshmallow to the top!! It was fantastic!! The service is fast and friendly!
Always great. Appreciate this place for their high quality and delicious combinations.
The mint ice cream was amazing! Tasted like fresh mint. Got it in a waffle bowl yum! I would highly recommend this place for an ice cream treat. Lots of great flavors.
The best ice cream ever. So smooth and delicious. I'm a chocolate fan and the Belgian chocolate is excellent.

Wow, great place. It's slightly expensive, but really not any more so than Cold Stone and I think much better! I would come again and definitely recommend. I had milk and cookies and peanut butter chip, I would recommend both.
Yummy ice cream and great customer service. They also had games to play if you want to sit and enjoy family time.

Moved here from Massachusetts where there are tons of fresh Creamery places. This has a very weird consistency and kind of broke apart. Hard to explain but the flavor was also off. Maybe we were spoiled a little.
Toffee Banofi! The Madagascar vanilla ice cream Is smooth and creamy. Bananas, almond toffee, and the sweet caramel sauce all come together to make this an awesome sundae!
Very overpriced, two small scoops of ice cream for $5.50! The ice cream was ok, but nothing special. They have some unusual flavors, which is interesting. I don't think I'll go back though.
Get the pecan turtle with salted butter caramel sundae and don't regret breaking your diet. This is a cute little place in a strip mall worth a visit.

I really like sweet republic. I am obsessed with the s'more campfire sundae and all of the ice cream always has such unique flavors and what a fun atmosphere. I have never seen an ice cream parlor with a stack of board games for its patrons to play while they enjoy their treats! It's so fun. The problem is this is not where I got on a regular basis for ice cream. It's very pricey($7-$9 for a speciality sundae) and that's what I go there for. This is not somewhere I go just to get a scoop of ice cream, this is for special occasions. I think they are awesome and everything being made In house, down to the marshmallows, is so cool, one day I'll try the sundae featured on the food network, but until then the s'more will have to do!

Our experience here was awesome. Great service and the gentleman who waited on us even made flavor suggestions. The ice cream is truly amazing...might be the best ice cream that I have ever eaten. I would make this a "must do" if visiting the Phoenix/Scottsdale area!

Ok...I have no idea what could be said other than ice cream made from real, wholesome ingredients wins over the opposite. Try samples..there weren't too many weird/crazy combinations but I was surprised when I asked what top 2 flavors are (salted caramel & almond butter crunch) Awesome that you can get your icecream scoop in between cookies for a icecream sandwich. Both in our party that chose that option thought the cookie should be warmed a bit. And...toasted home made marshmallow option pretty interesting and tasty too! Will be back!

I had the campfire smore and my husband had the toffee banofi. He had his exactly as it was on the menu and i replaced my chocolate ice cream scoops with vanilla and the best salted caramel ice cream ive ever had! We were both blown away. New favorite ice cream place for sure. Pleasant even during Covid.
It was ok... only a couple of toppings to choose from and the flavors were nothing to write home about. Not worth the 15 minute drive. Staff were nice though!

They have vegan choices which is amazing in the valley and not just fruit sorbet. Even when the line is long they are super friendly. I truly feel like this is my local ice cream store and love it there!

This was a really good ice cream place with unique flavors. I had the Choco Walnut Oatmeal Cookie and the Brownie Swirl. Both had a great creamy texture with delicious flavor and a good amount of toppings mixed in. The ice cream was great, but the service leaves much to be desired. Luckily the ice cream brought all the happiness I needed so the lack of friendliness and service from the employees did not detract from my experience too much.
Everyone I'm in AZ I stop here. Fantastic small batch ice cream. Campfire S'mores today. Creamy, sweet, perfect finish to the evening! Support this gem!

So so good. I tried a few flavors before settling on the kulfi, vanilla flavored with pistachios, rose water and sweet cream. This was so good that we came back again right before heading back for the airport. I'm usually not a huge sweets fan, but I loved this one.

Delicious, creamy and fresh ice cream and unique flavors to choose from. This should definitely be a part of your ice cream night out rotation. It seems there are always new flavors to try and even a solid pick like chocolate is extra scrumptious but not too rich or sweet here.
Super good Ice cream love that it's made fresh! Friendly employees. Brown butter pecan is a very good flavor
Delicious and fun flavors that rotate every month. The owner is a great ice cream flavor creator!

Fantastic flavors and staff. I got a sundae with milk and cookies ice cream, topped with a roasted marshmallow topping and hot fudge. The waffle cone was delicious too! There are a huge variety of desserts to choose from. I will be back!
Amazing as always! Toffee Bannofi sundae on Sunday with a toasted marshmallow is can't miss! Lovely gal with great service despite being busy and by herself.

Great spot for really good milkshakes. Places promise a good shake and we are usually disappointed. Not here, in fact we come here too often because they are so good. They also have baked good, pies etc. Every item has been delicious.

My daughter and I went to sweet creations after work to get a treat. They had many options to choose from, and my young one was thrilled. We got a 3 scooper (inside secret instead of doing a 2 scoop and 1 scoop). The ice cream was delicious, creamy, and just what we needed. Thanks for letting us try so many flavors!

I had a sweet tooth while in Scottsdale and SR did not disappoint. I ordered the Pecan Turtle sundae. I traded a scoop of the Salted Butter Pecan (comes with 2 scoops) for a scoop of Strawberry Buttermilk. It was a great combination.

Yummy! We love family owned businesses, so we always use Yelp to find unique places to eat. This place did not disappoint, had no complaints. It was delicious, friendly, & clean environment. We enjoyed the experience!

THIS IS AMAZING!!! If you haven't tried it you need to. This place reminds me of a simple version of Serendipity in New York or in Las Vegas. The Salted Carmel was so good!!!!!!! For the amount the gave and costing $10... it's definitely overpriced.

Stopped in for ice cream, having not been to this location prior but had been to their place in Phoenix. Although I was disappointed when I went prior, I thought I'd give it another shot. Perused the ice cream and gelato selections as I stood in line. Tried a couple of flavors and decided again to have the salted butter caramel swirl but decided to have it this time in their cone. YUMMMM!! Maybe it's cause it was in the cone or for whatever reason, this time the ice cream tantalized my taste buds. It had the right mix of flavors in the salted butter caramel pieces mixed in with the ice cream. The waffle cone tasted "homemade" versus those bought commercially. I could be wrong, but I thought I could even smell cones toasting in the background. As I licked each delicious bite, I checked out the menu of other items offered. Pecan turtle, YUMMM! That offers 2 scoops Salted Butter Caramel, butter pecans, hot fudge, salted caramel sauce & whip cream. ULTIMATE SUNDAE: 4 scoops on ¼lb choc chip walnut oatmeal cookie with brownies, almond toffee brittle, hot fudge, salted caramel sauce, whip cream & roasted marshmallow. I think that sounds like something I'd order for two, or else not eat two or three days after eating it. The only distraction I found was how messy the floor looked with various pieces of cone dropped and left. I thought maybe it would be cleaned when the three working behind the counter had no customers. Nope. Would I go again? Yepp. I want to try the sundae or the butter caramel pecan turtle described above.

Good ice cream, a lil' bit different with some spicy kick to if if you want to try something new. Good fluff cottony softness, decent flavor. But if I judge by the classic staple flavors it really doesn't compare to other homemade ice cream places I've been. Still really good, not great.
Super tasty, rich, and creamy Belgian Chocolate ice cream. Pleasant staff with genuine smiles. My four year old loved it.

The deliciousness of the ice cream here makes me want to exclaim "Sweet fancy Moses" ... like the Seinfeld episode. I've been here twice now about 18 months apart and both times I was thrilled with the ice cream. I'm not a huge ice cream connoisseur. Turns out, spoiler alert, ice cream is not very healthy. It's a rare treat, rarer for me. But when I heard that Sweet Republic was famous the world over for delicious ice cream, I cleared my vacation schedule to go. Fortunately, both times I've been there, involved massive calorie burning in the morning (half marathon) so I was eager to eat it. It's a simple place with a wide array of amazing flavors, some quite daring. Recently, I had a triple scoop with brownie, peanut butter chip and sweet corn. The sweet corn was really out there -- a sugary sweet ice cream with actual corn pieces. Had to try it because it's so unusual and I like Mexican sweet corn. Wouldn't order again but I liked the uniqueness. The other two flavors were divine. The people working here have been really friendly and helpful. The place gets a good line but it moves fast and it's well worth it. If I lived in the area, I would go here more often. I'm glad I don't just for the sake of my constant battle against keeping my waistline in order.

Just ok. I've cream has decent flavor, but isn't very creamy. The kid at the counter who served us was kind of lacking in personality. This is different than any of our previous visits so either it was an off night for him or he hasn't yet been fully trained. He did say he'd only tried one flavor so wasn't much help when we asked what the creamiest flavor was. Hot fudge on out sundays was a little sparse too. Just average overall.

I have now been to this location in Scottsdale as well as the Phoenix location. While the atmosphere here is nicer than Phoenix, the quality of the ice cream is the same. Not surprising since it probably all comes form the same place. I would say that it is mediocre. I tried the black licorice flavor. It was good, but definitely not the best ice cream in the valley. I still maintain that the cones and waffles bowls that they serve are better than the ice cream itself.

We've been here a few times now. Ice cream & service is always very good. My daughter loves the S'mores Sundae. There have a few unusual ice cream flavors & the normal standbys if you don't feel too adventurous. We haven't left disappointed yet.

Wow this place was incredible! I'm not usually a fan of ice cream over gelato, but the ice cream here is pretty phenomenal. On top of that the creativity in the dishes they create is amazing. I got both the caramel and the peppermint ice creams in the s'mores cup. This means it got whipped cream, chocolate sauce, and they toast a homemade marshmallow on top right in front of you. The resulting photo is proof of this delectable masterpiece. Tip: S'mores normally comes with two scoops of chocolate ice cream but you can choose whatever kind you want.

Sweet, creamy, and delightful. They have plenty of options of flavors and each one is high quality and true to taste. They use natural flavors so things taste fresh. The marshmallows are freshly made and they toast them right in front of you. You can even get one by itself on a stick. ;) the waffle bowls were just the right amount of delicate and crunch. The S'mores sundae was legit and the staff allowed me to add some other ice cream flavors and change it up.
Some of the best ice cream I've ever had! Really fresh and Delicious ice cream! Always coming back!

Went here twice while visiting the area. Got the Turtle, loved it. Next time I got the double trouble and loved it as well. Ice cream has great flavor. Staff was attentive and good both times. Strongly recommend.

(Lyrics - Neil Diamond - Sweet Caroline) Where to begin, I can begin with milkshakes But then I know my appetite is growing strong Start with a scoop And the scoop became a double Who'd have believed it came along Hot.....fudge sundaes..... Reaching out, trying it, tasting it...... Sweet Republic (bop bop bop) Good times never seemed so good I'd be inclined (bop bop bop) To believe it never would Now Bo Bites..... How shall I start! I love Ice Cream!? Well let's just say I'm one to have a sweet spot for some good ice cream! Sweet Republic has that covered ladies and gents. With funky flavors such as Kulfi, Jalapeno Avocado Bacon Brittle, Basil Lime Sorbet, etc. Sweet Republic has 2 locations I hope this little ice cream boutique grows, even though the Shea location is close enough for me to visit more often than not. However, my gut and love handles say NO MORE! My mouth and eyes say just a small bite of Waffle cones and 2 more flavors! They also serve up some interesting milkshakes and sundaes, which I can't wait to try! Your ice cream could be served up in a waffle cone, cup, and even between 2 cookies of your choice! I came here on a hot summer day and ordered the waffle cone with Salted Caramel Butter and Belgium Chocolate. I'm not too crazy for the exotic flavors; like to keep things simple. Sweet and buttery ice cream slow oozing down my cone as I embrace every bite and lick.....gee I think I just had a foodgasm! Overall, the place is very welcoming like most ice cream shops. It can get real crammed up in this shop since seating is limited, but lets just hope you beat out the crowd. In the end, Sweet Republic's reputation is definitely well deserved and a must visit! - Enjoy
Love this place, best ice cream in Scottsdale. Solid service and an ever changing selection of delicious flavors. Try the bacon ice cream, no joke!

We stopped in here for an after dinner snack. The young guys working there are helpful & friendly. We got a small serving of salted butter caramel, coconut sorbet & almond butter crunch. They were very good & could have easily eaten more!
This place is insane. Ordered delivery and they packed our ice cream with ice so it wouldn't melt. Brownie batter swirl is AMAZING

Plenty parking and seating. Has numerous games that you can play as you sit. Sampled various non-dairy sorbets since I couldn't have dairy and loved the coconut milk sorbet (thick, creamy, not icey). The strawberry and chocolate were good too. The lemon basil? was strong in flavor, but not quite what I craved. My friends enjoyed their ice cream. A little pricey, but worth a try!

Love this ice cream shop!! Shared the Campfire S'mores sundae and it was delicious! I loved being able to see the woman roast the marshmallow right in front of us. The gooey warm texture with the cold ice cream was a great mix of flavors and it worked perfectly together. I will have to come back here when I'm in the area!

I really wanted to love this place but if you have dietary restrictions or allergies you may want to rethink. I'm vegan and am allergic to dairy and eggs and came looking to get sorbet. I politely asked the lady if the Blue Spirulina one was vegan because it's in the same section as all of the vegan sorbets. She said yes and so did the other person working so I ordered it. After ordering it I had a weird gut feeling so I called the other location to ask the same. This person AGAIN told me there was absolutely no dairy in this "sorbet". So, I eat it, only to find my stomach in shambles a few hours later. I DMed the company and they told me it has both eggs and dairy!!!! I have an IGg reaction to these foods and ended up in the ER over it! So incredibly disappointing and quite traumatizing actually. If you're going to have options for those with allergies and restrictions, at least train your staff to know which options are suitable for who. Ridiculous.
Fabulous and unique selection of sorbets, ice creams and sundaes. I had the most incredible basil sorbet!

Doesn't the sweet smell of buttery waffles greeting you as you walk into an ice cream parlor just make your mouth drool? Should I say any more?? Sweet Republic has won "my most favorite ice cream stop" award. This overly delicious sweet and creative ice cream parlor of a place will satisfy sweet needs. (Speaking from a person that should have diabetes by now) ON TOP OF THAT!! Their waffle cones are absolutely, D-E-L-I-C-I-O-U-S. If you have ever had those butter cookies... that is the BEST way to describe their waffle cone. And ANYTHING with BUTTER is FAB-U-LOUS. Who wouldn't want that topped with your favorite ice cream flavor? And if making the trip is not worth enough. They do sell containers of their ice cream so you can indulge at home. I don not know how long that it will last for me. OK my mouth is drooling just remembering it. Ya'll gotta try it. I'm so dead serious.

If I could give them more stars, I would. My family loves this locally owned place for ice cream. They have such great flavors and they are very unique too. I love the salted butter caramel with a toasted marshmallow! My kids love the brownie swirl with a toasted marshmallow on top. They have some seasonal flavors that are always worth trying. Sweet potato was pretty good. The bananas foster was so yummy! Definitely try this place if you haven't!

If you love ice cream this place is for you. I was visiting from out of town when I came across this place on one of the travel blogs. They have some great flavors and toppings to choose from. I went with the double trouble sundae and it blew my mind with every bite. I only wish they had a location in Los Angeles.

My kids and I frequently bike here. They are super friendly and have the best ice creams and sorbets. Pre COVID they would also have board games to enjoy with the the whole family! Never ever disappoints.

Shall we Dance? (*) There's a huge difference between self-love and pity... So, if you ARE going to spend Valentine's Day by yourself eating ice cream directly from a pint - you might as well make those calories count with great ice cream. In which case, you can't go wrong picking Sweet Republic (consistently on the "best ice cream shops across America" lists) as your dance partner. There's an art to selecting your partner in tango. You can't simply send a cheap "You up?" text message. That's a different game... In Argentina, the process is called Cabeceo (Spanish for 'head', again: your mind. gutter. Keep out of...). Respecting tradition, I followed the proper process on Valentine's Day: First, I surveyed my available options. Gingerbread (hmm: a flavor I usually love, but this one lacks boldness). Apple pie (better, but mainly due to Caskwerks Distilling Apple Pie liqueur than chunks of pie). Pumpkin Spice (Nice: cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, allspice, cardamom, cloves...). Huckleberry Swirl (Great: wild mountain berries from Oregon). But, the day demanded something extra special, and so my attention turned to the Coconut Cashew Curry. But, before I made flirtatious eye contact, I quickly pondered whether my attraction was prompted simply by the exotic flavors that have been tempting me lately (Earl Grey Sriracha? Everything bagel?). So, was it just the charm of something very different from what I'm used to? Or, does the flavor itself have substantive merit. No other way to find out than a quick whirl. Ahh... like a sultry siren, there's a mystique and depth to the Coconut Cashew Curry. The curry felt more Japanese than Indian. There's enough cashew mixed in to unveil a sweet but nutty profile. The heat builds up slowly but doesn't burst into flames in your throat. Leading to a complex, sweet-heat finale that's both satisfying and yet leaves you gasping for more. More! More ice cream... Every addict should consider whether he/she is spiraling downward to a situation where one needs a stronger dose just to get the same satisfaction. Well aware of my ice cream addiction and preference for complexity, I decided to mix things up, going with a flavor I haven't had in years (but highly recommended by co-owner, Helen Yung): Brown Butter Pecan. Personally, the desserts I like best, are the ones that make me both feel AND think. And they usually remind me of a pleasurable moment from the past (That Proust guy was on to something. But, poor guy only had Madeleine(s) to tempt him...). In my case, the Brown Butter ice cream reminded me of my favorite Indian dessert: Ras Malai (milk, corn flour, sugar, saffron, pistachio) - which is the highest compliment I can give Sweet Republic, given my impossibly high standards for the Indian dessert (there was a year when I tried Ras Malai at 100+ different shops and restaurants in NYC). But, the association was prompted by the elements: milk, cream, sugar, nuts (pecan in this case)... and mostly the texture. To me: a great Ras Malai straddles the borders of solid and liquid states of nature, and just surrenders completely to the tongue upon contact. Similarly, I think the best ice cream is also one which is slowly melting, and doesn't have to be coaxed to become one with your soul. Completely enraptured by the ice cream, the tango morphed over time to the meditative abandonment of the ego in the Semazen - performed by the whirling dervishes... So, what I mean to say is: Yes. I got completely carried away and ate more than half a pint of the Brown Butter Pecan. But, dessert should never make you feel bad. Even if one gives of oneself completely on a first date. For, you can always walk away your guilt later - and be thankful, that it's no walk of shame... (*) Sharu wi Dansu (Japanese, 1996) - not the pathetic 2004 remake with Richard Gere and J-Lo

My head was telling me to go to the gym but my heart said to eat ice cream. Seeing as I'm writing this review, guess which one I listened to. After an extremely satisfying dinner, ice cream was suggested and off we went to Sweet Republic. It was a mad dash to get in before they closed. The staff here is amazing. They didn't rush us out and were extremely courteous as some of us tried multiple samples of all their amazing flavors. I myself only got one sample before instantly falling head-over-heels. It was love-at-first-bite for the Habanero Bacon Avocado. It reminded me a lot of the Vietnamese avocado smoothies and I was happy happy girl. It had that salty-sweet thing that I enjoy immensely with silky ribbons of bacon in it. There was only a slight heat from the habanero that tickles the back of your throat. It was good. It was so so sooo good! It was so good that when Linh L. got me a sample of the Plum & Honey, I ate it without really tasting it and went back to devouring my Habanero Bacon Avocado in a grotesque and savage manner [Thank you, Aileen B., for letting me get another taste out of your ice cream cup. It was ridonkulously amazing with the AZ Queen Bee Honey!]. I also snagged a bite of Yuko H's Basil Lime Sorbet which is her favorite. It was light, fresh, with a strong taste of basil, and really clean in flavor. Linh L's Huckleberry Lemon and Almond-something were also great. The Huckleberry Lemon was extremely flavorful and refreshing. I also got to steal bite after bite of Toffee Banofi --- which apparently is a beloved of Food Network star Alton Brown's! All in all, I'm a fan! I wish they had a location in Chandler but for the sake of my waistline, maybe this is a blessing. ;)

My favorite ice cream shop in the country (over even Bi-Rite in SF and McConnell's in SB). The flavors range from classic to experimental (but nothing wild like what you might find at Salt & Straw), and each one is rich, thick, creamy and perfectly balanced. The waffle bowls/cones are perfection (never overcooked or soft and soggy) and the toppings are fantastic. The marshmallow is my favorite - toasted to perfection in front of your eyes, atop your scoops! It's worth a trek just to visit the shop. Love that it's also in the PHX airport now, though the selection is far superior in stores!

Too sweet and sugary for my liking, but this is definitely a cute place for families and kids to go to. There are lots of options. I would definitely recommend going here though if you have a sweet tooth.

I stopped in for a sweet treat and picked up a pint of almond buttercrunch and peaches and cream. I also got two scoops: one strawberry balsamic and strawberry cream (???). The strawberry ones were delicious, although I would have liked a bit more balsamic swirl in the first one. The light, sweet, creamy flavors in both were well fresh and flavorful. It was a nice change from chocolate. I devoured half of the almond butter crunch in one sitting and could've eaten the entire pint if I hadnt forced myself to put it back in the freezer. The abc was creamy with nice hints of butter and delightful crunchy toffee bits. I love their merch and almost walked out with a hat and tee. Maybe next time when I run out of ice cream!!

I first heard of this place on the food network and I knew I had to try it. The ice cream was delicious but I thought just a tad overpriced ($25 for a malt, scoop of ice cream in a waffle cone, and a sundae). Overall, it was tasty and the flavor choices were very good.

Dropped by Sweet Republic after a Friday night dinner and was really excited to try the ice cream as it came highly recommended. I was initially really happy to see that they had some of the flavors I love like hojicha and earl grey...but the excitement all faded once I tasted those flavors. I've had hojicha at multiple different places and it's usually something I love to get. However, the one at Sweet Republic did not taste like anything I'd had before. The earl grey was similarly strange in the sense that it was overwhelming and not very balanced. I actually just settled for the brownie ice cream because it seemed like the safest choice out of the bunch. Maybe Sweet Republic is amazing if you stick to the basic flavors like vanilla/chocolate, but it did not deliver in terms of the more diverse flavors. Parking is easy, but the prices seem a bit high for what you get.

The flavors tasted like they have been sitting around for a couple weeks. Filmy texture. My daughter had chocolate & vanilla and was complaining about a funny taste. So I tried to see what was up. Looks like a great place, but we wont be back any time soon.
A+ great flavors and quality ice cream, baked options. There are a lot of interesting flavors like the Jameson! Glad I chose this shop for my vacation!

The polite, helpful and happy staff offered great advice on which were the most popular and their own favorites. All the ingredients are organic. The store was not busy. So for that I gave them 2 stars. My wife had the salted butter Carmel swirl which had little to no flavor and no Carmel or Carmel taste. I had the chocolate walnut oatmeal which I could taste but the ice cream itself had very little flavor. However, I did get to pay over $8 for two of the tiniest round ball scoops of ice cream. So I gave two stars for a great staff and zero stars for ice cream that had less flavor than the cheapest ice cream I ever had.
We have been there a number of times and we also order on DoorDash my children love their ice cream sandwiches with cookies

Went for the toffee banofi but ended up making my own mix......Triple play coconut sorbet, peaberry espresso sorbet, coconut cashew curry ice cream with homemade brittle and caramel sauce. WOW WEEEEEEEE WOW!!!!! is all I can say. For once I can say there is something that rivals gelato. I will definitely be back!

I *heart* EVERYTHING about Sweet Republic!!! And I am even more pleased to see that they are now supplying their delicious ice cream flavors to Whole Foods!! The staff is always friendly, even when I have shown up at 2 minutes til closing. The ice cream always tastes amazing and the flavors are out of this world! The Campfire S'more Sundae is just to die for. And they have Bacon Brittle that I dream about constantly... so much in fact, I will be giving it as stocking stuffers for the holidays this year ;)

We are huge fans! We often forego dessert when eating out and head to Sweet Republic. Be open to trying new flavors, be patient as scoopers attend to the whims of customers inner ice-cream loving child, and be sure to include a cookie or cone or both in the mix! Oh, and a roasted marshmellow! Wait; also the brittles! :P YUM Don't forget to smile people. You're in an ice cream parlor for goodness sake. Put away your phones, grab a game, and share a sundae!

Sometimes when you go to these places that are highly reviewed or have a lot of publicity, you have a small letdown. But honestly I having eaten a lot of ice cream in my day and it was the best Sunday I've ever had. I will be back.

Had the s'mores sundae here which was not all that great considering how hyped this place is. Just because the items that go into this sundae are sweet doesn't mean that they should go together. The Belgian chocolate ice cream is actually good however. Service here is also extremely lacking; manager had an attitude from the get-go. It seems her priority was training her employees, as a simple question I had was the biggest burden to her and she was quick to turn back around and get back to training on how to make cones.

All the ice cream is homemade. The mint chip ice cream has actual mint leaves in it! So yummy! Mint chip and salted Carmel were my favs! Highly recommend a toasted marshmallow (also homemade) on top of the salted Carmel. You will not be disappointed. So glad we listened to other yelp reviews and have this place a shot!
Toffee Banofi. The greatest sundae on earth. Can be split between three adults, easily. That's all you need to know. Go. You will not be disappointed. They also have fun board games to play.

my favorite ice cream in Scottsdale! seriously I found this place like a year ago and saved it for our trip with the intention of no way was I skipping this place. I'm lucky we got here before I got my crazy illness otherwise I might have missed it and cried the whole flight home. I didn't and got to taste the deliciousness! if you are in the area do not miss this place.

This ice cream is delicious!!! I like the variety of different flavors you don't see anywhere else, and the taste is just amazing!!! The cookies are also so good, my husband can't go there without ordering extra to take home. Yummmmm!!!!

After lunch I got that sweet craving for ice cream and decided to venture to sweet republic. Walked in and the you g girl behind the counter must have been the most miserable person. When they offer so many flavors you have to be able to taste some to decide. She made me feel like I was being a bother and I felt pressured and uncomfortable to ask to try more flavors. Other guests walked in and we decided this would be our opportunity to leave as the ice cream store should be a happy place to visit. We went to Scoop n Joy and had a fabulous time sampling so many flavors.
We loved this place! I had a shake (you can select 3 scoops of your choice. I selected 2 espresso and 1 milk+cookies). So creamy, so soft! Absolutely would recommend. Also, very friendly staff.

Alton Brown, host of Good Eats, was featured on "Best Thing I Ever Ate" and said three words..."Toffee Banofi Sundae". When I had a chance to visit the store, I already knew what I was getting. However, I just wanted to sample a few of their other flavors since they all sounded good. They blew me away with how the delicious and creamy the ice cream was. I cannot remember the flavors that I tried since it's been a couple of weeks, but I would have gotten a double of scoop of any of them easily. When I was done tasting the majority of the different flavors (apologies to the worker, but you were awesome for putting up with us), I ordered the main attraction. Alton Brown was not wrong when this made it to "Best Thing I Ever Ate". This was definitely the best sundae I ever ate

I love it here! The service is always great and I really love the dairy-free sorbets. I have a dairy allergy but absolutely LOVE ice cream and have to get my fix with almond, cashew, or soy ice creams that I usually buy from the grocery store. Needless to say, the only thing that could use some improvement here is to add more dairy free options! Right now there are only about 3 choices for flavors on the menu, and if they added more dairy free options I would come here all the time!

i remember coming here years ago before moving back, been here twice now since moving back a month ago. Tried a few different flavors, they have some crazy flavors sometimes, i tried a few and they are hit and miss but im sure other people might like them. cant go wrong with the toffee sundae

Very cute, clean establishment. There are board games so this would probably be a great place for a first date. They have ice cream and sorbet. Most of the flavors are unique so sampling is a must; what sounds good just might not be to your liking. I tried the lavender honey and while edible, I don't think I could have eaten a scoop of it. I was on board with the salted butter caramel with whip and toasted marshmallow- definitely a combination I would get again.

Been wanting to try this place for about 6 months. I finally went last night with the family and I got the Toffee Bonafi and it was delicious. My girls got the brownie sundae and they loved it as well. We sat and enjoyed playing a board game as they have several to choose from. Great place to hangout and enjoy ice cream . They have several flavors and also they're homemade cookies look amazing. I'm definitely have to try the cookies next time.

Easily the best ice cream I've ever had. I love their Campfire S'more Sundae, complete with homemade marshmallows, but most visits I just stick to the salted caramel. It's pretty much the perfect ice cream. Everything they make is high quality, delicious, and they always have new flavors to try. It's become my go to when I want something sweet. Why bother with something that's not worth the calories? Can't recommend them highly enough. Cute little store, great ice cream, great service. Not a single complaint to be found. Great work.

Touristing my way through Scottsdale, I'd bookmarked a few of those "Food Network" locations prior to my vacation. And y'know what? Shame on me, because that technique has led me wrong more times than not. Following a tasty dinner, my wife and I stopped at Sweet Republic for a small sweet treat. Neither of us had enough room for one of the massive sundaes, so it was a single scoop for both of us, and I topped mine with a roasted marshmallow because that seemed like an awesome idea. Sadly, the marshmallow tasted like a cross between melted plastic and butane. Could've been the torch that was used to fast-roast it, but I commented to my wife how it tasted seriously foul. My ice cream was pretty good. I went with the almond toffee something or other. Not the best I've ever had, but not bad in my opinion. My wife went with salted caramel and complained that it was completely tasteless. I sampled it, and had to agree. No flavor at all. I thought the prices were pretty fair. I know other yelpers complain that they're a bit steep, but I think for a small family location like this (especially with all the attention they get) they were pretty reasonable. Service was super friendly and fast too. All in all, I don't know that I'd make it a regular place if I lived in the area, but it wasn't too bad. Maybe they need to work on a few of the flavors, tho.

Love how they are open late, and how they have games (like connect four)that you can play while enjoying the awesome variety of ice cream. Whenever we are unsure of what to get, we go with the campfire s'more - awesomeness

If you are looking for homemade artisanal ice cream then Sweet Republic deserves a visit. They make everything in-house and its evident with the flavors. There is usually someone making fresh waffle cones and the smell radiates the entire shop. The ice cream flavors are clean and fresh. The staff is always friendly.

Simply amazing The Seasonal choices are worth waiting for, especially the Sweet Potato Ice Cream available in November and Almond Toffee Crunch Great local business with friendly staff, and a place worth visiting to satisfy your sweet tooth Make sure to get a Toasted Marshmallow on your ice cream!

Despite how nice he was, the teenage counter boy totally judged me when I ordered a double scoop right after devouring a cup of triple scoop. Not the best ice cream I've had and a little pricier than most places, but definitely good enough for my afternoon recess time when I just want to indulge in being fat and alone. Get: salted butter caramel, peanut butter chip, lavender, white rose, medjool date Add: toasted marshmallow, bacon brittle bits Try: everything (like I shamelessly did)
Really good ice cream! Definitely a popular spot (which means it must be good!) has a great selection & I love that they make all their own stuff. The employees were nice as well.

Consistently good value and service. Ice cream flavors are unique and tasty. Interesting story of how the biz got started after the owner evaluated the meaning of her life and what she was doing after the Twin Towers were destroyed 9/11. Featured on the Food Network. Highly recommended!

Probably one of the best ice cream places I've been to. All of there food their is homemade. I got the campfire sundae. I got it with s'mores pie ice cream with a marshmallow that was blow torch. It was really good. Great staff and inside was nice. Would recommend to anyone that like some good ice cream.

This has been always my guilt free late night desert place. I always order the same thing. Basil Lime Sorbet! They are so basily (that's not a word I know) with a hint of lime, feels light and refreshing. This is what I order when I want to avoid rich ice cream.. Oh trust me I LOVE ice cream. Last night a group of us visited and got to enjoy other than my usual basil lime. Habanero Bacon Avocado tasted very much like avocado, I never thought avocado with ice cream but they were good. I also got to taste plum and honey. Be sure to add their local honey to enhance their flavor. Huckleberry Lemon and Almond was good, in fact, I wanted to take the whole thing. I enjoyed every bite of everyone's ice cream. I suppose I should explore and try other than my usual basil lime next time. Service was fantastic. We showed up 3 mins before closing and they were very accommodating, let others sample as much as they wanted and gave us enough time to fully enjoy our ice cream at the table.
Great flavors hit the spot and better than Coldstone! Prices a little high but worth it on a hot day!
First time visit ! Awesome little place to get a quick little ice cream scoop or two. It an easy order and everything is self explanatory which is great. Definitely worth it ! Thanks again April!

This place is awesome! The store itself is really cute and has a trendy atmosphere with a stellar alternative music playlist. The flavor selection is really great and has a lot of unusual flavors, like strawberry buttermilk and honey lavender. I had the campfire smores sundae and it was amazing! The toasted marshmallow on top was delish, the waffle cone was made right in the store, and the Belgian chocolate ice cream was so creamy and chocolatey. Definitely would come back!

***Sweet Republic features a wide variety of good ice cream flavors (both traditional flavors and unique ones); this gourmet ice cream parlor also delivers their ice cream into all kinds of desserts including sundaes and shakes; housemade goodies like marshmallows and almond toffee brittle are also available*** Sweet Republic is a gourmet ice cream shop in Scottsdale. This store has a wide variety of ice cream flavors and there are more traditional flavors like chocolate and mint, but there are several unique flavors too like sweet corn and honey blue cheese. Sweet Republic is not simply ice cream in a cup or cone though. This shop also features their ice cream in many different types of desserts like sundaes, shakes and ice cream sandwiches. Other items are available too like nostalgic candy and several housemade goodies that make for nice gifts--like packaged bags of bacon brittle, almond toffee brittle and marshmallows. I tried several of their ice cream flavors. I felt their traditional flavors were decent like Belgian chocolate and salted butter caramel. My favorite flavor I had was their sweet corn. It had a great and very noticeable corn flavor. The consistency of the ice cream was very good. The ice cream was thick and dense as well as very smooth and creamy (with no trace of iciness). The sweet corn did have a few corn kernels mixed into the ice cream, which I thought was unnecessary; it kind of distracted from the very even smoothness of the ice cream. yelp.com/biz_photos/swee¦ I also tried one of their sundaes, Toffee Banofi, which was featured on Food Network's Best Thing I Ever Ate. The sundae consisted of two scoops of their Madagascar vanilla ice cream, which was topped with fresh banana, almond toffee brittle, whipped cream, and salted butter caramel sauce. Everything went together very well and all of the toppings were good. yelp.com/biz_photos/swee¦ The only topping to really stand out though was the almond toffee brittle. It had a great crunch and crispness from both the whole almonds and the brittle. The flavor was very good too--a very nice burnt caramel flavor that was definitely robust and strong without being too bitter. Service was good--pleasant, polite and quick. The store has a very nice interior. It is a pretty big space with a decent amount of seating. The store has a few nice decor touches throughout the room. The decor is not as charming as some of the upscale artisan ice cream shops I have been to, but it is still good and nicer than most ice cream parlors. Prices on the sundaes are pretty expensive. Ice cream by the scoop here is not too pricey though Sweet Republic's prices are similar to other gourmet ice cream shops in big cities. I enjoyed both the ice cream and sundae at Sweet Republic. The flavors were good and the consistency had the thickness, firmness, density, and smoothness that you just do not get at a lot of the major mass market ice cream parlors. I think the flavors are more distinct at ice cream shops like Sweet Rose Creamery (in Brentwood), Carmela (in Pasadena) and Jeni's (in Ohio), but Sweet Republic is definitely worth visiting if you are an ice cream fan and find yourself in the Phoenix or Scottsdale area. Sweet Republic is located in a retail plaza that has its own free parking lot. It is easy finding an open space.

I recently moved from California and have been itching to find a great ice cream shop in metro Phoenix with interesting, funky flavors. A friend recommended Sweet Republic, so I went a bit earlier this week to try it for the first time. Overall, the ice cream was good. I wasn't mind blown because I feel like I've had better ice cream (quality/texture and flavor-wise) in California. However, I did buy a walnut oat chocolate chip cookie that was to die for! This cookie has the perfect amount of sweetness and an amazing texture and flavor. Definitely try this cookie if you go! I will likely be back in the future just to buy their cookies. The girls working there were so nice and were really great about letting me sample whatever I wanted. I like that they didn't seem to have sample limits like so many ice cream stores do. I didn't go too crazy, but I did get to try a fair number of flavors. Here were the flavors I tried (in order from favorite to least favorite) in case there are others who take their flavor selections very seriously: -Milk n Cookies: not overly sweet and pretty yummy. I ended up getting a pint of this one to take home! This ice cream has bits of their walnut oat chocolate chip cookie. I will say that I feel like the consistency of the ice cream in the pint tasted different (not as creamy) than when I sampled it in the store, but I guess that makes sense. I probably wouldn't buy an ice cream pint here again. -Brown Butter Pecan: has a yummy nutty sweet and salty flavor. I got a scoop of this one. -Honey Lavender: I am a major sucker for lavender. This one was tasty. Oddly though, I wish it had just been lavender instead of honey lavender. But it was still good. -Blue Cheese and Date: I was surprised because I actually quite liked the blue cheese ice cream flavor. However, I wasn't sure that I would enjoy having a full scoop of it. -Almond Buttercrunch: I liked the idea of almond/toffee flavor in this one but it was a bit cloyingly sweet for me. For a nutty/buttery ice cream, I preferred the brown butter pecan. -Peanut Butter Chip: I am a giant peanut butter lover, but this ice cream just didn't pack enough of a peanut butter punch for me. I found it kind of mediocre for PB ice cream if I'm being honest.

I love this place so much they make all there own cookies, toppings, sauces and waffle cones from scratch they use the highest quality ingredients but what makes it even better is there are no artificial flavors, colors, preservatives or hydrogenated oils in any of there products !

Alright I know I'm spoiled because I come from LA where there are 15 artisinal high-quality ice cream shops in one square mile, so it might not be fair. But I was not at all blown away by Sweet Republic. My biggest issue is that the flavors had an odd texture - they not only left a sandy feeling on my spoon but while I ate it I felt like there was a slippery thick film on the roof of my mouth. I've experienced this before with off-brand whipped cream. It's not a pleasant texture at all. Fortunately the flavor options are great. The Mayan chocolate, almond brittle, and brown butter pecan were delicious. If you put brittle in ice cream I will eat it. I just wasn't a huge fan of the after-texture, if that's a thing.

Seriously good ice cream and customer service! I tried a few flavors (sweet corn, meyer lemon, peaches n' cream) before settling on one scoop of peaches n' cream and meyer lemon in a waffle cone and of course a toasted marshmallow on top! My boyfriend had the Toffee Banofi and it was fabulous. We will be coming again to get a cool treat soon!

Great ice cream and they have games for kids to play while you enjoy it. A bunch of board games. I got the hot fudge sundae with cookies and milk flavored ice cream and brownies on top. I really enjoyed it. I'll be coming here again. It's organic too!!!

I get my nails done in the same complex- LOVE them! I used to work across the street. Today I decided to have my nails done. The etching on the window says " coffee and tea". I order a cookie and a tea. The girl behind the counter is super flustered and stares at me "we don't serve tea here" why the heck do you have someone etch "tea" on your front window when you don't sell it??? Super lame!!

Ok these people really do it right. It's a long line on the weekends, but well worth it. I can't say enough good things about the toasted marshmallow, but just get it! Love the waffle bowls! Unique flavors of ice cream! The vegan chocolate was amazing! Excellent quality! Need one in Chandler!

Had item on Food Network "Best Thing I Ever Ate" Toffee Banofi", I was real appreciative that since I just had dinner that they were accomodating to doing a half size version so I could taste the concoction. Was a wise choice and would recommend anyone giving it a shot. We got there around 830 pm and when we left at 930 pm the line was actually longer. Next time I go will try the S'more. Great place to take out of town people, they will not forget

Delicious creations and great variety of flavors! Decided to finally give this place a try and safe to say, we will be back. I tried almond butter toffee and milk & cookies in a waffle bowl, and my husband had a salted butter caramel milkshake. His shake was amazingly delicious!!! Both of my flavors were great...I'd hold off on the waffle next time- not totally worthy. This place is worth a trip to. Very clean, well-staffed and not too pricy.
I would give this place 100 stars if I could! Best. Ice cream. Ever! The pecan turtle sundae is da bomb. Love the free-to-borrow & play board games but they're starting to fall apart/missing pieces.
OMG - they have the best ice cream ever. You never feel rushed and they let you taste what you want. They have fabulous sundaes - the toffee one is the best.
If I could come here every day I would. Sorbets, delicious ice cream amazing! Campfire smore sundae is what dreams are made of.

Yummy ice cream!! We are visiting the Scottsdale/Phoenix area and we've already been twice in three days. I really enjoyed the eggnog ice cream and peppermint ice cream. Their Mayan chocolate ice cream is my husbands favorite. It has a nice chile kick to it. I'm sure we will visit again before we leave. :)

I got the almond buttercrunch with a waffle cone. Ice cream was delicious. Waffle cone tasted like frosting on a cake. I wasn't a fan. My husband got the almond buttercrunch and the salted butter Carmel with a toasted homemade marshmallow. All three were amazing.

Delicious ice cream! Came here with my mom after reading the rave Yelp reviews and we are not disappointed! The Huckleberry Swirl is phenomenal. I could eat this all day! We're bringing a pint home for the family. My mom enjoyed her Milk & Cookies ice cream as well. The decor is cool, mod and retro. Board games in the back, too! I'll be coming back many times.

I loved the concept of Sweet Republic- everything homemade to include the ice cream, the marshmallow, the waffle cones, the everything. Unfortunately, I wasn't overly impressed with the ice cream. I got the Belgium chocolate and it wasn't as rich and the waffle cone not as crunchy as I was expecting and wanting. Instead it sort of crumbled in my mouth. The thing I did really love about this place was the portion. I asked for two scoops and quickly realized they give two full scoops, not two half scoops like most ice cream parlors do.

Hands down, literally the best ice cream in all of the Phoenix East Valley. They have a great selection of flavors, some more unique than others, but their staff is always accommodating when you'd like to sample. You can really taste the quality in their ice cream, which I love. My favorites are their almond butter crunch, lavender honey, earl grey and their green tea. What really sold me, was their waffle cones! Made fresh on site, and they aren't like your typical ice cream shop waffle cones. They're a lot more lighter and crisp. I visit so often and I wished they did punch cards.. Also love that Sweet Republic is carried at my local Whole Foods store, which is a bonus!
Went back and got 1. Salted Caramel 2. Meyer Lemon 3. 2 bags of bacon brittle to take back to the homies

The ice cream flavors are so good. The sweetness level was just right for me. We had the salted buttered caramel and the brownie swirl. It's a good spot for a quick ice cream run or a place to chat and relax.

First time here! They offer interesting and yummy ice cream flavors. My brother and I shared the Campfire S'mores Sundae - The ice cream was rich in chocolate and the marshmallow was crispy on top and gooey inside, drool. Plus, they torch the marshmallow on top right in front of you! I would totally come here again and bring more friends (:

When one in our party suggested we share, I think my reaction could only be described as a guffaw. Seriously? You want me to share this deliciousness with someone and NOT have it all for myself? Please. I had the toffee banoffee. Banoffee is one of my favorite desserts from the UK, in line behind a good sticky toffee pudding. I was not disappointed. I was fending off even sideways glances at my sundae. And there may have been low growling sounds, but I won't confirm or deny that they were coming from me. The ice cream was creamy and genuinely flavorful from the first spoonful to the last. The toppings were generous and equally fresh and flavorful. The bananas, miraculously, were a perfect level of ripeness - not a spot of brown to be seen. I was a little sad when my spoon started scraping the bottom of the cup. The shop has a fresh and bright vibe, and the counter staff were very helpful (offering taste samples) and super friendly. Yes, it's more pricy than, say, a trip to the local DQ, but it's totally worth it.
Must try the Toffee Banofi Sundae. The regular ice cream is great, but if you want the full experience and moneys worth get a sundae. You wont regret it.

Had the pecan turtle $6.95. Super good Salted Butter Caramel, not overly sweet. Girls behind the counter were helpful and cheerful. My friends liked their Malted Chocolate Chip too. Don't live here but glad we stopped in.

Sweet republic - hands down, it is delicious and good. Get the toffee banofi - leave the place with a full belly, happy. :) Toffee Banofi - Delicious! Sometimes when I get sundaes, they either have too much syrup, ice cream, whipped cream, etc but it's perfect. All the little pieces in the sundae is just delicious. I love the little toppings on top, it's so good. I died and went to heaven. I give this place 4 stars because for $8, I thought the item would be bigger. However, it's a good size - not too much to cause diabetes or too little to leave me hungry. Plus, we shouldn't eat too much ice cream, we don't want to be part of the diabetes epidemic in US but it's soo hard when ice cream is a food we can die for -- we can stand in the middle of the road and eat ice cream in awe as the cars go by us. :) I went during the afternoon on Sunday. I came when it was slightly busy. The wait can be long if the line is long because there's only two people and they help each person at a time but they provide good service overall! :)
Cute little ice cream shop in Scottsdale. The toffee banaffee sundae did not disappoint. Delicious ice cream and a fun atmosphere.

This place is banging, as the kids say. Today marks my second trip in as many days. I'd be lying if I said I "needed" ice cream today, but I needed not to pass this place without stopping. The flavors are creative and delicious. Although I sampled the chocolate Guinness, the rosemary chocolate and the real mint chip (made with local mint! Actually minty!), I went with the salted butter caramel for the second day running. If I lived in the area I would run the risk of being a regular. But since I don't, I will highly tout the delights of this local chain. Pass by at your peril of missing a highlight-of-the-day treat!

Some family members and I had a less than stellar time at the aquarium so we were looking for something to cheer us up and we definitely found the right place. Two of us ordered the toffee banofi sundaes at the suggestion of the lovely woman behind the counter and one ordered a scoop of chocolate ice cream and we were all thrilled with our choices. The portions were more than we could handle but we've definitely found our new favorite ice cream shop.
Amazing ice cream & desserts! Staff is always friendly and helpful, you will not regret coming here.

Went there based on Yelp reviews. It did not disappoint. There was a long line, but the friendly staff showed great teamwork and organization. The line moved quickly. I just wish there was more seating as we had to take our treats to our car to eat. Wife had honey lavender and she really enjoyed it I tried it and you can taste the lavender with out it overpowering the palate. I had both the Belgian chocolate which was great and sweet corn which had actual corn in it. I know it sounds wierd, but it was really great ice cream. I will surely return the next time I'm in town.
S'more topping is the best and it can be added to any flavor of ice cream! We had orange cream and black sesame ice cream with s'more on top! Very delicious! Highly recommend it to everyone!
Had the salted Carmel milkshake and it was soo good! Not too sweet and not too salty!
This place is great. They offer ice cream and sorbet. Always a nice staff. I would recommend this place.

We were traveling with a group of friends and came across this place for dessert. The group left completely satisfied. Everyone had different things and loved it. The most popular thing was the banana foster ice cream and the toffee sundae. Worth a try for sure!

This place had good reviews online so we decided to check it out (we are not from AZ). I got the sweet cream in a waffle cone and it was a generous amount for 2 scoops. However, the staff was a little awkward! It was almost like they were mad at us for coming in half an hour before closing. There were 4 employees behind the counter and none of them greeted us when we walked in, they just gave us a blank stare. The ice cream was really good though!

Customer service was great. The s'mores ice cream sundae was fantastic . The waffle cone was freshly made to perfection!!!!!! I also had the triple chocolate shake. The shake was exactly what I needed! Thanks for making such great ice cream.

I can't believe I haven't written a review for Sweet Republic yet. I initially went for the famous Toffee Banofi but have returned again and again because of their delicious ice cream flavors that are constantly rotating. The Toffee Banofi is totally worth it! In my experience, restaurants that have been featured on the Food Network are typically overrated. Sweet Republic on the other hand, is not! The sundae is large enough to share with someone else. Their salted caramel sauce and toffee brittle are the best and you can't find them anywhere else. I've tried numerous flavors, some of my favorites are: lychee mojito sorbet, banana foster (get it with the toffee brittle or salted caramel sauce), horchata, sweet corn, and pumpkin spice. I've even tried some of the more unusual flavors such as their honey blue cheese and Hop Knot IPA. I've even tried their bacon brittle too, which is surprisingly quite good. The best way to find out about their current flavors is to follow them on Instagram. Go and sample their flavors, they really want you to get the flavor that you're going to enjoy. You won't regret it!

I went here definitely wanting some super awesome ice cream. My brother's girlfriend found the place and it looked great, so I had to make this a stop during a short trip to Phoenix. Benefits of this place... 1. The ice cream was good. If it wasn't, this place would get zero stars. I had the dark chocolate and a vanilla caramel. Both were pretty solid! 2. The line on a Saturday at 9pm wasn't long. 3. Staff was friendly. 4. Round of applause for inventive ice cream flavors. Can't say I wasn't disappointed in their lack of toppings. I also had higher expectations for their inventive flavors. I tried the chocolate Guinness and it was ok...kind of sweet and creamy. I would recommend this place if you jut want some good ice cream. Sorbet flavors looked pretty neat, so I may be back to try the Basil Lime!

my husband & i came to scottsdale to enjoy a staycation. came to sweet republic bc it looked amazing. walked in, no one greeted us for at least 5 minutes. there were 3 other customers as well & none of us were being helped. looked as tho the one worker present was doing online orders? not sure, but not even a "welcome in/i'll be right with you" .. finally a girl came out from the back (still haven't been greeted) & all she says is "do u have a mask?" my husband did & i asked if there was one there & she said "they're 50 cents" ... she then leaned into her coworker & started whispering. fair assumption that it was about us. we walked out while she glared at us. will never go back & never recommend.

This is seriously good ice cream. And, they are so welcoming -- encouraging you to taste your way through the many flavors on your visit. Plus, I love that they source locally and are conscientious of the environment in their decor and product. My first visit, I went with a friend and with each sample taste, I would try a little and pass the spoon for my friend to try also. Then, I got a taste of the salted butter caramel ice cream. I took my little taste and new instantly that I would order a scoop! Quickly, a shameful panic swept over me. In spite of knowing that I was about to order a whole scoop of this delicious treat, I could not bear the thought of parting with the remaining bite. I looked to my friend. To the woman behind the counter. Back to my friend. Back to the woman behind the counter... "Um, can she have her own taste of this one?" Truly, that basically sums up Sweet Republic's ice cream. Its sophisticated flavors like Cheese Course Duo (a pairing of Roquefort blue cheese and local Medjool dates) or Basil Lime sorbet, or the oft referenced Chocolate Rosemary, peak your grown up interest and get you through the door -- the great taste pushes that grown up aside and brings out the five year old inside of you! They even let you chose what type of spoon you want... a standard plastic spoon, an old fashioned wooden "ice cream stick" or a tiny little neon colored spoon!!!
Always such a long wait literally every time, I feel they could afford the labor of an additional staff member. Fabulous creamery, tables are always clean as well.
Great place and the ice cream is out of this world. I spent $15 for 2 servings of ice cream and can't wait to do it again!

I love Sweet Republic's gourmet flavors.. it's a little pricier than average but worth every penny! I usually get my ice cream to go but I sat down to eat it this time around and I couldn't help but notice how cohesive and energetic the workers were! The girl who scooped my ice cream never lost the smile on her face and was super knowledgeable about the product. The ice cream was good but the overall atmosphere made my experience that much more worth while! I'll definitely be sitting in more often.

BEST ICE CREAM EVER!!! Owners are the sweetest most humble ladies! Everything tastes heavenly, board games for entertainment, and next to a park path for a nice long stroll when the weather is right. Sweet Republic will make you never want to go to a Baskin Robin's or Cold Stone again. I haven't since finding this place, why would you settle for the rest when you've already got the best. :)

This is my go to ice cream place. Bring all my out of town visitors here. We were stuffed from dinner so we brought our scoops of ice cream home and stuck them in the freezer. When it was time for dessert, we pulled them out and it was as if we had just ordered them. Yummy!

With Blue Bell off the shelf, Sweet Republic is a good fallback for creamy rich ice cream. The more you care about the quality of ice cream the more you will like this place. They don't have an outrageous selection of flavors and have only a few toppings, but I would scream for this ice cream.

Had a treat with coworkers after our team event. I had the maple pecan and it was delicious! Coworkers also had Belgium chocolate, peanut butter and butterscotch and all yummy! Clean and friendly place! Great for all ages!

We are frequent patrons of this place, and we like to try the variety of flavors, we are four of family and this takes a little time ... this Tiara cashier, not friendly and apparently had a bad day, nothing friendly !! In the 4 times we have been here she's had a bad day ??  The ice cream is great!

3 Ups: 1) Cool interior design; 2) the ice cream quality was superb; 3) though the hot fudge is squeezed from a bottle it's legitimate fudge, not chocolate sauce. 3 Downs: 1) Small scoops; 2) the "special" ice cream isn't written on the main board and it's very hard to see the special board by cashier; 3) wish I'd know they had board games to play, but they weren't noticeable.

Forgive me wedding diet god, for I have sinned... I splurged again last night. But, it was a holiday, so that is my excuse! My job was to bring dessert to our Passover dinner, so I decided Sweet Republic would be perfect. I probably overdid it a bit... I brought 4 pints and and extra 'double' for our group of ten. Don't worry though, we didn't eat it all! I mixed it up a bit this time and brought the following flavors: *Vanilla Bean *Salted Butter Caramel Swirl *Basil Lime Sorbet *Coconut Sorbet *Strawberry Sorbet I think the basil lime sorbet was the overall hit, but my brother and i favored the coconut. It is creamy and tastes exactly like real coconut, it's amazing! No pint went untouched though, and Sweet Republic was the talk of the group for quite some time. I obviously took all of this 'to-go' and didn't realize until I went to unpack it that Helen and Jan had packed in bags with plenty of ice - so smart! Sweet Republic has it going on... if you haven't been yet, it's worth a trip! And now you can also find them at the Old Town Farmers Market every Saturday! Enjoy!

Excellent Ice Cream and excellent service by enthusiastic workers who seem to really enjoy what they are doing. When a business says something is homemade, I tend to say, yeah right. but Sweet Republic really does make their ice cream on the premises, what a treat. I wasn't as adventersome as other reviewers having two scoops, one belgian chocolate and the other toffee. MMMM they were great. I'd been wanting to try Sweet Republic for a long time since I live so close by, now I'm kicking myself for waiting so long!

The Sweet Republic is an outstanding place to get a delicious treat in Arizona. Their ice cream is delicious and also they offer a lot of different flavors. They should offer more options for sorbet for as alternative option for people that are lactose intolerant. Overall this is a outstanding place to hangout with their friends and family!

I'm super happy that this place is not close to home because I would be a chunky monkey. I got a double sundae with the brownie ice cream and the milk and cookie ice cream with hot fudge and pecans. The whole thing was YUM! They have lots of homemade flavors and everything is made with organic ingredients. If you don't want a sundae you can get a shake or homage waffle cone too. Oh, I almost forgot they have the most delish cookies oatmeal walnut chocolate chip, which was in my ice cream, and chocolate chip. Get one for later, you won't regret it.

This place is by far the best ! Their ice cream is insane! The Brown Butter Pecan is my fave along with the Lavender My boyfriend and I moved into the area and we will walk here for a delicious treat!

Over the years, I have heard many good things about Sweet Republic but always felt it was out of the way. The traffic near Shea and the Loop 101 is killer during the day and after work. However, I finally decided to go at 9pm on a Saturday, when the streets should be dead. Good thing they were, because I had to pull a U turn to get into the shopping center that houses Sweet Republic. Outside, there is ample parking and a few patio tables/chairs set up. The inside is well lit with many tables, chairs, and half-booth seating. There are two display cases with freshly made ice cream, an area with delicious toppings, and an ice cream freezer filled with to-go pints. Oh, and there's a game area where you can pull out an old board game and play with your companions. When I first entered, I wasn't sure where to start. While there is a board displaying the flavors of the day and the items they offered (sundaes, shakes, coffee, etc) I felt I needed to look at the ice cream to get a better sense of what I wanted to eat. After a few samples, my husband decided on the coconut and lemon in a waffle bowl. I went with a scoop of coffee with toffee brittle, salted caramel sauce, and a freshly toasted hand-made marshmallow on top. It was delicious! (I'm a sucker for toasted marshmallows and this one was amazing.) There were so many flavors to choose from and so many sundae options as well. I'd love to come back and try all their other offerings. I'm definitely glad I finally gave it a try!

Sweet republic i couldn't wait to try this place hearing all the good reviews from my friends. We traveled all the way from ASU area to try this place out. One star off because of the location being far from students. Taste: lavender ice cream & sea salted caramel: 5 Decor: Nice and clean fun 5 Board games Roasted marshmallow: mehhhhhh pretty for one second a 3 Location: 3

This local business is one of our favorite places in the area for ice cream. They have an adequate number of unique flavors. The quality of the ice cream is fantastic. My favorite flavors are salted caramel and espresso (has grinder coffee beans freshly roasted here in Tempe). If you are looking for some high quality ice cream and support a local business you need to give sweet republic a try.
Wow, this place was great! Loved the ice cream flavors and the shop was nice with board games to play. They will definitely need to move to bigger place!

Decided today was the {D*A*Y} to finally visit Sweet Republic. Visited with my dad and hubs and the deliciousness lived up to the hype. I went simple and ordered the buttery salted caramel and topped it with bacon brittle {yes Bacon Brittle!}. It was rich with the right amount of sweet and salty and the brittle wasn't too hard to begin with or after it was on top of my ice team for a little bit ... The hubs ordered the Toffee Banofi and dad ordered the Campfire S'more. I'm personally not a banana lover but the hubs LOVED it and dad {the biggest ice cream lover in my life} went goo goo ga ga over the smore!!! I did too actually....I mean WHO WOULDNT GO NUTTY AFTER THEIR FIRST HOMEMADE *MARSHMALLOW*!?!?!?!? Ok so yeah, they whipped up the Sundays lickity split (pun intended). There was ample seating and well...I'm sure we will see you again soon!! //cheers//

No wonder this place made one of the top 10 ice cream places in the country! It's a little taste of Heaven!!! I got the Campfire S'more sundae with the Madagascar vanilla and chocolate scoops. I'll admit that I got it just to see the marshmellow on top get slightly toasted with the dessert torch. It felt and tasted like eating a creme brulee marshmellow on top of a giant ice cream s'more. My husband got the Peanut Butter Brittle sundae, which was also nothing less than perfect! It was hilarious because there were two visitors from Atlanta in front of us in line, who has just come straight from the airport to Sweet Republic because they had to try this ice cream!! I guess that show "The Best Thing I Ever Ate" truly does help recognize this unique ice cream shop and the ice cream speaks for itself. I really wanted my husband to try the jalepeno avocado bacon brittle ice cream, but unfortunately this flavor was unavailable on Friday, so I'll try to check and see if it's there the next time we return. On the up side, we were able to purchase a bag of bacon brittle to take home with us. Of course, we didn't wait until we got home to try it. We broke off pieces of the bacon brittle and stuck them in our sundaes. Un-freaking-believable!!! Man! I love this place!

After hitting Grapes on Shea and Scottsdale for happy hour today- review coming shortly (maybe... hey, I've 12 other reviews that need to be written!), I headed to Sweet Republic for a sweet ending. I'd received a newsletter from SR that there were new flavors in honor of Valentine's Day, and I thought what a great reason to pay SR another visit! Of the two Valentine specials, Raspberry White Chocolate and White Roses, I could only sample the latter, as the former contained an allergen. I'm a sucker for floral-scented food and drink, and this SR delight was a winner! I could definitely taste roses, and the sweet cream wasn't too sweet. Loved it! I also sampled Desert Honey (a tart yogurt sweetened w/ local AZ wild desert honey), Almond Buttercrunch, Salted Butter Caramel, Cheese Course Duo, Espresso, and Mango Lassi. I took a pint of White Roses and Desert Honey ($7.50) and a scoop of Salted Butter Caramel to-go and a scoop of Almond Buttercrunch in a waffle cone (2 scoops $4.25 + $1 for waffle cone) to savor! I couldn't pass up a Chocolate Chip Walnut Oatmeal cookie ($3) as it looked so delicious on its cake display stand- one of the proprietors, Helen, offered to warm it up in the microwave. What a wonderful suggestion! I asked if she could tear off a section and warm it up... The warmed bite I took at the store was amazingly good! (I did notice that the rest of the soft-batch cookie, sampled in the car, was definitely saltier than I'd wish for in a cookie. Why didn't I detect this saltiness in the warmed-up section? Perhaps the sweetness of the almond buttercrunch made my tastebuds more sensitive to salt? Hmm...) I really enjoyed the almond buttercrunch and the cone, so much so that I wished I'd skipped on the salted butter caramel- heresy some fans of this flavor might think, but what can I say? I loved extra textural component, and the buttery toffee-sweet crunch, that the almonds provided. I may be back, maybe as soon as tomorrow!, to re-visit the espresso and the mango lassi (and grab a few more of those chocolate chip walnut cookies!). ;) p.s. Couldn't resist and just had to taste a couple scoopfuls of desert honey and white roses before placing the pint in the freezer... Oh. My. God! Run to SR before Valentine's Day is over and White Roses disappear from the rotation! (Just remember to bring your credit card- a visit could get expensive!)

This rating is for the rude service today. My son always orders the same flavors each time but this time he wanted to try few different flavors before ordering. They didn't care to give him any samples and wanted him to order his normal flavor. Rushing us!

Wonderful ice cream! Sweet Republic really stands out with their amazing hand crafted sweet stuff, and their shakes are just to die for. The sundaes are really great, but can get big (and pricey!) so these are great options for sharing. There are always a bunch of eclectic, unique, and seasonal flavors, but sometimes I really just want a good ol' cookies and cream. The basic flavors like that sometimes get left out of the crowd. Great location.

Amazing sweet treats and the service was fast and friendly! First time here and could not be more satisfied. There are a lot of sorbet options and the flavors are true to their name! Must try the coconut and lime/basil sorbet!
WORLD'S BEST WAFFLE CONES! Definitely try the malt vanilla and chocolate chip ice cream!

The absolute best ice cream I've ever had. I had 2 scoops of peanut butter chip with hot fudge and dark chocolate peanuts on top... Wow! They topped it with obviously homemade whipped cream which was amazing. It was a little spendy, but well worth it!

It's a little on the pricy side for ice cream, but worth every penny. The ice cream is delicious, and options well varied, the staff friendly, everything clean. This place is bomb. If they have pumpkin spice...GET IT. the salted Carmel is made in house as is the phenomenal toffee. Worth the drive and expense.
