LOVE Sprinkles cookies especially the salted oatmeal cornflake, absolutely delicious and their specialty flavor cupcakes, s'mores is my favorite. Super disappointed that the ATMs in Las Vegas are only standard flavors and no cookies. Wish the bakery had a pick up option because I am not paying the delivery fee. Sprinkles please open a shop up again in Las Vegas.

I love Sprinkles Las Vegas! The location is really the best part about this spot. It's located directly in front of the High Roller (a GIANT ferris wheel type ride just off the Vegas strip). You can get awesome photos here! Plus, there's a fountain just outside, which makes the atmosphere really nice, especially in warmer weather. You can sit on the fountain and enjoy your treats. Of course Sprinkles cupcakes and ice cream are delicious! You can expect the same quality here as you could from any other Sprinkles location. The service has always been quick and friendly when I've visited, and the store has always been clean. If you're in this area and looking for a quick, easy, and consistent treat, Sprinkles is a great place to pick one up!

Would've been nice to order, even if I at least paid ONE delivery fee since I'm not around to be there. Cupcakes looks great thats why I give 2 stars. Didn't not order anyways. But this is crazy. I'll just leave this screenshot here and let you be the judge of your choice if your looking for delivery.

Love this cute cupcake ATM! It's literally one of my favorite tourist attractions on the strip. It's a vending machine and ATM all in one. It's so adorable and well thought out. The desserts are good, too! But seriously how many of you want a photo with this fun way to shop!

When in Airport, pitstop at the vending machines! Grabbed a box on the way into Las Vegas for a meeting and the cupcakes were a MASSIVE HIT. Surprisingly fresh...I just assumed they had been up in that little box for a couple days...but I was VERY wrong. Fresh and not at all stale. You aren't going to get all the seasonal and super fancy flavors of a store, but you CAN get a box of all the most important favorites like red velvet.

I am surprised I have not left a review but it's probably because I'm too busy eating cupcakes .. I love sprinkles and I am super happy I made it in before June was over .. I got my pride cupcakes and I can't wait to eat them.. If you're at the Linq definitely give them a try .. I'm a huge fan of cupcakes especially their peanutbutter chocolate chip one but... boom! It wasn't there today however I got the pride cupcake , two red velvets and a vanilla with milk chocolate frosting .. not to mention the awesome $5 love is love three mini cupcake pack and of course some Pupcakes for my dogs .. Tanner helped us out tonight but everyone who has helped me here always is super friendly ..

Cute cupcakes, a nice way to satisfy your sweet tooth with some really pretty-looking cupcakes. They are $3.95 each, so a little on the pricier side for cupcakes. There is an area to buy cupcakes and a separate line for ice cream. Hope you don't want both! Cupcakes seem more popular. I got the chocolate marshmallow, which was a nice meld of those flavors. They have a lot of flavors so it was hard to pick. There were only like 4 bar stool seats against the window which were all taken up, so it's not much for eating in, so it would be best to take it to go.

I love these cupcakes! Luckily, San Antonio doesn't have a Sprinkles so I only get them in Las Vegas when I make my way down to the Linq Promenade. The flavors rotate based on the day with some flavors available more days than others. My favorite is the chocolate pb chip. Yum! They are always very moist and flavorful. The best way to eat a Sprinkles cupcake is pop the top off and flip it upside down. Then you get a perfect ratio of icing and cupcake. I usually end up taking some home because they freeze well and remind me of Vegas when I have them. Pro tip: The earlier you come in, the more cupcake options they have.

One of my all time favorites from LA! Friendly service. Cupcakes are on one side and ice cream on the other. Outside there's a cupcake vending machine! Right next to in n out so it's the perfect dessert after burgers.

Cupcake from an ATM... what more can I say? I rush we had more of these everywhere. Surprisingly the cupcakes are moist and taste great. I wasn't sure if they would be as good as the ones from the bakery. We got a chocolate cupcake and chocolate chip cookie. Both were fabulous.

Located at The Linq on The Las Vegas Strip, this place never fails to satisfy that sweet tooth! Whether you want cupcakes, ice cream, or both, this is the place to go! Since I am a fatty I get the Sprinkles Sundae, which is a creation that consists of the bottom layer of a cupcake, a scoop of ice cream, then the top delicious part of the cupcake on top! You can customize it however you like so the possibilities are endless, just don't go too late because their choices become limited due to closing time and they make their shit fresh in the mornings. It doesn't take long unless it's crowded and it will cost you about $7 or so for it. They have other good shit on their menu too but this is what I always order when I'm here. Small shop so once you buy what you want, it's best to just eat it outside, maybe chill by the water fountain and take in the beautiful view of the High Roller and sin city lights. If you're like me and haven't had enough sugar, they have a Cupcake ATM right outside the store! It's pretty dope and fun to use just because, who wouldn't want to get sweets in that type of fashion?! They have many flavors to choose from and it's $4 a piece. I loved the strawberry cupcake and the red velvet. Definitely need to make another trip back here in the near future!

This place is conveniently located next to In-N-Out so my husband and I stopped here for a sweet bite after lunch. The employees were incredibly patient and genuinely kind while we spent a few minutes going over their choices - even offering samples and recommendations. My mini cupcake was nice and moist and I loved the gooey center. My gripe: the price! $2.50 for a mini cupcake is insane. My husband got a milkshake which was delicious but the paper straw was TERRIBLE. It got soggy and was not sturdy enough for the milkshake ingredients to pass through the straw. We had to throw half of the milkshake away because we couldn't drink it. I love the idea of being environmentally conscious but the straw made it impossible for us to enjoy your product.

After going on the High Roller, we walked down the LINQ's promenade. We stopped in front of this cute cupcake and ice cream shop. Everything on display looked so appetizing that we ventured in. The ice cream parlor is to the right and the bakery is to the left as you enter. They have about eight seats on the inside along the wall. We split up instead of doing double duty. The hubby hunted down the ice cream as I picked out the cupcake. The first thing that I noticed as I looked around was the red waffle cones for the ice cream. As it turns out, it's red velvet flavored. I would have tried it out, but the hubby decided on the regular cone instead. He showed up with the salty caramel in a waffle cone. As I headed toward the seats, I had a salty caramel cupcake with me. Ha, we must be salty caramel people! Some of the other ice cream flavors are banana, butter pecan, cap'n crunch, pistachio, coffee, and mint chip. Other cupcake flavors are chai latte, lemon coconut, cuban coffee, dark chocolate, pumpkin, and strawberry. A single scoop of ice cream will run you $3.75. It'll cost you a dollar more for the waffle cone. A cupcake is also $3.75, doesn't matter what flavor. The ice cream tasted better than the cupcake. The ice cream was smooth and creamy. I did not enjoy the cupcake. The frosting was hard. It was more of a fondant than a cream. It was so, so, so overly sweet. The cake itself was plain dry. I would most definitely go back for the ice cream but pass on the cupcake.

Stopped into Sprinkles for a quick ice cream sandwich. Normally I'd go to a Sprinkles location for multiple types of cupcakes but kept things sweet & simple. As in simple I mean chocolate chip cookies & vanilla ice cream. Doesn't get any simpler than that. The cookies are huge and so is the helping of ice cream. The cookies were both crispy and soft which was enjoyable. I never really got the craze for cookies being completely soft. I like my cookies to have some crisp to them so having the outside crispy and the center chewy was a good treat. The vanilla ice cream wasn't too thick and managed not to melt allowing the sandwich to be eaten slow rather than rushed through. It's rare I stop anywhere specifically for desserts in Vegas but if I ever feel the need to again, I'll be stopping in. If I'm in The Linq area of course. Snack 1/28/2018

I only come here for the Chocolate Marshmallow and Red Velvet cupcakes. Please and thank you! It's situated in the Linq Plaza next to In-N-Out Burger. The novelty for me is the Cupcake ATM on the outside of the store. I love this machine, it makes for quick sugar rush satisfaction. However, the lady in front of me was apparently deciding on her last cupcake meal on earth before going back into the state penitentiary, standing there and pondering indecisively for a solid 8 minutes. Oh my gawd, just pick one already! Not wanting to be rude, I kept quiet and braved the long line inside instead. As others have stated, there is an ice cream station on the right side and the cupcakes on the left. The store front meets right in the middle. It makes for a bit of an awkward traffic flow but that's a non-issue for me. My eyes lit up as I saw a row of my coveted cupcakes and asked for four of them. The little boy behind me did the same. I'm glad I went first. I would hate to have to battle a six year old for some damn Chocolate Marshmallow cupcakes. All that was missing was a tall, ice cold glass of milk to go with. They also give you these nifty wooden spoons if you don't want to dive in and get a face full of frosting, which I shamelessly did. Are they pricey? Yes. Are they worth it? For me, I think so. But I rarely indulge in Sprinkles cupcakes so I made my trip worthwhile. Delish.
I got some birthday cupcakes for my birthday here!The cupcakes were amazing and delivery was fast . Its very great how they deliver to hotel rooms!

Sprinkles had been around forever but the quality of their products still remains top notch. Last night we stopped by after a show at the Brooklyn Bowl. We grabbed a salty caramel, red velvet, 2 s'mores, and the Flaming Hot Cheetos cupcake. Each cupcake was moist and had the perfect ratio of cake to frosting. The salty caramel had a good balance of sweet and salty, with the salt granules on top of the frosting. The red velvet was pretty standard but I do like that the frosting isn't sickly sweet like other red velvets. The s'mores were my favorite! They had a graham cracker bottom followed by chocolate cake stuffed with chocolate ganache then topped with toasted marshmallow fluff. A must try! Finally, we were intrigued by the Hot Cheetos cupcake. A vanilla cupcake stuffed with Hot Cheetos, frosted with a white cheddar frosting, and topped with crushed Hot Cheetos. Sounds strange but it was surprisingly good. Maybe not something I'd get again, though. The only gripe I have is they never seem to have enough staff. With the line out the door, there was only one person packing cupcakes and ringing people up. Would make sense to have someone pack the cakes and another to ring up. Maybe it's a marketing strategy to make people notice the long lines. It definitely worked on me and I'll wait for those cupcakes, for sure.

Was super excited to try out Sprinkles cupcakes since everytime I visit the line is far too long for my patience level. The line this time wasn't nearly as long but it might have helped if they had more than one person working. I got the black and white cupcake which is chocolate cake vanilla frosting. Very basic and can't go wrong here. I saved it in the sack the guy put it in and ate it later that night. The cupcake was dry and the frosting all fell off after one bite it was very odd but still easy to eat with a fork. I just wasn't impressed with the freshness and moistness of this cupcake. I'd prefer hostess from a package. They had way too much frosting in my opinion also.

This is located in the Linq promenade on the strip. Great location to attract tourists! Especially with the monumental cupcake ATM! The cupcakes itself are pretty pricey, way too sweet for me, and have a dry texture. Definitely prefer to go to a local bakery instead. Nonetheless, I still come here every now and then whenever my guests want to go sightseeing. Parking is located either in the back by the high roller or at the flamingo or cromwell hotel! (There's charge for parking in all locations).

I adore this place located on The Linq Promenade. The baked goods and service are both equally exceptional. I had the pineapple upside down cupcake. It was cute and delicious. It had a moist rich taste with yummy pineapple goodness in the center. The icing was perfection. They have window seating to allow customers to look out while dining. I also appreciated the environmentally paid decision of bamboo forks, I noticed that and it was a nice touch.

Red Velvet Cupcake - it's been years, but I remember being quite impressed considering it's not one of my favorite flavors in general. Pumpkin Cupcake - The cake was light, not too moist, not too dry and it was perfectly spiced. The cream cheese icing was delicious. Only complaint - not enough icing. They should put some inside! Captain Crunch Ice Cream - It has a light cereal flavor and great texture due to the bits of cereal mixed in! I will definitely be coming back for this one!

By far my favorite stop in Vegas. Their ice cream is fantastic, paired with their fresh cookies or cupcake tops, hellooooo heaven. The service is slow, but it really is worth the wait. If you're in a hurry they have a cupcake atm outside (AND ONE AT THE AIRPORT!). Salted oatmeal cookie, just trust me.

Went to The Linq this weekend and went into Sprinkles for the first time in 3 years. (Haven't been since they first opened) Good service, but for the price of the cupcake you'd expect something better. I got the vanilla cupcake and it was so dry. The frosting wasn't too sweet which was good, but the cupcake itself was so dry. The ratio of the cupcake to the frosting was 1:1.5. It was a lot of frosting, and barely any cake. I still think Sprinkles Cupcakes are overrated

I have long been a fan of the cupcake ATM, but today we went inside. Love the cute decor and all the accessories one can buy in addition to the desserts. So many great choices available at the counter! We bought a 4-pack with the seasonal White Chocolate Raspberry, a Salted Caramel, a Sprinkled, and a sugar-free Red Velvet. I had the sugar-free, and I think the frosting was even better than a regular Red Velvet. My husband proclaimed the Salted Caramel as amazing, my daughter inhaled the regular Sprinkled- and we are saving the seasonal until tomorrow! (If we can.) I feel these are well worth the price ($4). Our cashier was fast and friendly, and encouraged me to join their rewards program, recommending I save my rewards points for ice cream, as it's more expensive! I love the whole concept of a cupcake store, and Sprinkles does it best!

Wow cupcakes AND ice cream?! Perfect for dessert. Plus, I got to try the ATM because I seriously needed to withdraw some cupcakes. How fun! The sugarfree Red Velvet cupcake was awesome and I could say I actually like it even more so than the original Red Velvet cupcake. The crumb is really tender and it has just the right amount of sweetness without any strange aftertaste. I skipped the ice cream but the Hubs and kid went for it. You can sit outside right by the fountain and people watch.

I had heard about Sprinkles for years now, but had never had the chance to try out their goods......until yesterday! After Gordon Ramsay's, we walked down here to get some cupcakes. My wife is all about cupcakes and she was looking forward to this stop the most on our Vegas eating adventure. We walked in and were greeted by a cheery young lady, and we placed our order. We went with a chocolate peanut butter, a pineapple upside down cake, and a triple cinnamon cupcake. They were $4.00 each. Here is how they were.............. Chocolate Peanut Butter- This was my wife's favorite! She is all about the chocolate peanut butter. Very rich and sweet and had a great texture and peanut butter flavor. 5 stars! Pineapple Upside Down Cake- This was fantastic as well. It had a moist pineapple cake base, filled with some pineapple jam/compote and then topped with some buttercream icing. This was my favorite of the 3. I think it was one of their rotating monthly/weekly/daily specials. It was delicious and if you like pineapple, get this one. 5 stars! Triple Cinnamon Cupcake- This was our least favorite of the 3, but even then, it was still pretty fucking tasty! It was a buttermilk spiced cake, with cream cheese icing topped with cinnamon sugar. It had a more dense texture to it than the other ones, and seemed a little bit "old". Like I said though, even then, it was still pretty damn tasty. 4 stars! Service from the lady who got our cupcakes together in the box, and the friendly dude at the cash register were great! $4.00 seems like a lot for a cupcake, but they are large, and well worth it! I would definitely return!

Right when you happily find Sprinkles you have an important choice to make. Ice cream or cupcakes So we did both! Two kids had cupcakes, the other 4 had ice cream! They don't have tons to pick from, here it's quality over quantity! Both kids went for the red velvet cupcake, the only complaint was too sweet Now let's go to the ice cream side. You can sample what you'd like and they have different flavored waffle cones. I have an allergy and they were informative and also Knowledgeable. For 4 ice creams 3 double scoops in waffle cones it was around $26 which to me that was good! The two cupcakes and a 3 pack of mini cupcakes it was $18. Everyone one on both sides are nice and helpful! We signed up for rewards and walked out earning One. Incentive to go back sooner than later.

Personally i LOVE Sprinkles Cupcakes, always so good and baked right. Icing on top is delish with a circle candy on top! Banana cupcake is my all time favorite. Red velvet is great as well, but the lemon blueberry is to die for! Try them all, why not, you wont be disappointed

It's past midnight and still 90 degrees out. Cookies and ice cream sounded like the perfect snack. I'm not adventurous when it comes to ice cream because of my tree nut allergy so I had an oatmeal/sugar cookie (correction: snickerdoodle) vanilla ice cream sandwich. Both cookies were chewy, but a bit salty and didn't compliment the ice cream well. Even my friend thought I make a better cookie. The ice cream was a bit soft, but that's understandable with the Vegas heat. I will have to return to try a cupcake. They looked really good and had exotic flavors.

Probably the only cupcake place that has made a name for itself and still surviving with people who crave miniature cakes. I was craving something sweet, and I never had sprinkles before, so I said to hell with it. I walked in and was immediate greeted by two lovely ladies who asked me if I needed help. I told them give me a minute, and they did. We ended up getting a carrot cupcake and a water. Total came up to $6. Not bad since we are in Las Vegas. The carrot cup cake had little strands of carrots! It was super delicious and something I never had before. They also had a cute ice cream place next door, but you have to go through another door. Cupcakes on the left and ice cream on the right. :)

Sprinkles Cupcakes is a quaint little cupcake and sweets shop located in the heart of the Promenade. I've heard about the raving reviews of the ones here in California which meant I had to check this one out. Walking into the store at about 1:30PM there was no line and the store itself was dead. Expected for a Thursday in Vegas. All the sweets were displayed within a nicely lit glass shelve however there were quite a few blanks spots assuming they had been sold out or reduced the flavors for lack of business on the weekdays. I ordered the Red Velvet cupcake and a Caramel Brownie to go, being handed these cute produced to go bags with boxes showcasing the company's name. Taking a bite into both they were delicious and packed with sugar. Great gift idea, however I'd like to try some different flavors since I was not exactly pleased. Overall though clean store, good service, alright products!

To be honest, the only reason I got a cupcake that day was because I thought it was fun to order something off the cupcake ATM. Cupcakes are usually not my favorite but the milk chocolate cupcake that I got was an exception. It was not overly sweet and the proportion of the frosting to cake was perfect. It may have been the best cupcake we have had. Wish I tried the ice cream too!

Mmmmm... cupcakes, cookies and ice cream who doesn't love them?!? Well, I do! I am a sweet lover and proud of it! Sprinkles is this cute little bakery right outside the High Roller. They have cupcakes, cookies, ice cream, all that can hit your sweet tooth plus treats for your doggy (no one ever seems to have cat treats).. moving on! There's a few window bar seats inside and several table umbrella seats outside. I grabbed a black and white chocolate cupcake, chocolate chip and snicker doodle cookie. For the three it was about $10.00, I think is kinda pricey but I guess you pay for the atmosphere of the strip. The cupcake was moist, perfectly sweetened and unsharable... meaning I didn't want to share, ha! The cookies weren't too hard or too soft, nice and chewy. At the end of the day... Yea, I would go back when in Vegas.
If you haven't been to sprinkles you gotta try it! It's a little pricey but well worth it!!!

I come here for their vegan red velvet cupcakes and chocolate chip cookies. Both are egg-free, which is a rare find in commercial bakeries like this. If the wait to get inside is too long, or you're standing in line for In-N-Out and need a sweet treat immediately, there's a cupcake ATM around the corner!

I've been to every Sprinkles in the LA area and finally got to check out the one out in Las Vegas in the new Linq area. It's in the fancy new Linq area so naturally it's nice. Has one section for the cupcakes, one section for ice cream and then the ATM on the outside. I went in and got pumpkin and my wife got strawberry. Solid as always. The service was great, the selection ample and really a nice ambience to sit and enjoy the best cupcakes there are.

Meh, it was just alright. East coast has better cupcake bakeries. It's just one of those touristy things to do when in Vegas. There's nothing wrong with these cupcakes though. They're moist and tasty, but not the best cupcakes you'll ever have. They're more expensive too, but that's on par with Vegas pricing. Take a picture at the cupcake ATM and move along.

Can you say sinfully delicious. I wish I would've taken more pics of the building but it's located near the High Roller in Vegas. We pre ordered on line so we just had to come pick up, however they do offer delivery. These cupcakes were so darn delicious! This just can't be good for you. Lol. I recommend the Red Velvet, chocolate or Vanilla. The service was very friendly and fast. The manager came out and thanked us.... then this is where service goes beyond... asks us if we have plates, a candle and extra napkins... which we didn't because we are traveling and she hooked us up with all we needed. My sister loved them and was able to blow out her candle and make a wish. I'm telling you service is everything to me and we were treated with great care here. Bottom life is I'd definitely return although my wasteline says run! Follow me on instagram at sweet_maloy.

This review is mostly for the new and very delicious cookie cupcake! Oh man, it is just a masterpiece. It starts off with a cookie crust and delicious chocolate chip cookie cake with butter cream frosting and a cookie crumble!!! There isn't a Sprinkles in Washington so I was so happy to try the new cupcake while I was in town. The red velvet cupcake was dry and lackluster. It did not live up to the amazing red velvet cupcakes at original bakery in Santa Monica. For that, it loses a star in the rating.

I stopped by at the ATM machine. It was a cool concept and very cute and modern set up. However, with not knowing how long the cupcakes being put in their machine, or how the cupcakes were handled. I was hesitant to spend 5 dollar on a cupcake that's been operated on a 24/7 basis. Would rather walk in and buy my cupcakes there then take the pictures outside!

Delicious cupcake! It was super cute and the ATM was definitely fun! Lots of amazing flavors! I would come back! The line wasn't that long when I came! Located at the linq it was a great nighttime snack/dessert! I got the red velvet and was delicious! Great for kids.

I heard about their cupcake ATM machine, and wanted to come here just to try it. But changed my mind when I saw that they had ice cream cookie sandwiches. I got the chocolate chip cookie dough ice cream in between two warmed up chocolate chip cookies, and it was wonderful.

If you like cupcakes, this is the place for you. If you don't, this place will change your mind! It's located on the street on the way to the High Roller. It's small inside with a line on the left for cupcakes and the right for ice cream. There probably will be a small line especially for the cupcakes. The cupcakes are displayed on very upscale looking wooden shelves. They have a decent selection of flavors. Having tried a few I can say you cannot go to wrong with any of them. The peanut butter is one of my favorites. These are American-style, so expect a very thick layer of buttercream icing that is sweet along with a fairly dense though moist cake. For a bit of extra fun try their cupcake ATM outside available 24/7 for your cupcake cravings. Choose from the touchscreen, and the machine delivers a boxed cupcake. Cool! We tried the ice cream too (Rocky Road for me). It was ok but nothing too amazing. The cupcakes are the highlight here.
I love the Sprinkles machine in the Fashion Show Mall!! The cupcakes are soooo fresh and yummy!

I did not believe my eyes when I saw these cupcakes arrive!! They were about 48 cupcakes per box and the variety was perfect! I didn't even k ow they delivered! Their cupcakes are delicious! I loved the salted caramel and the red velvet is not to be ignored either! They are super rich and didn't finish the frosting - but are perfect for birthdays!

I bought two cupcakes, I got strawberry strawberry and a red velvet. I'm not 100% satisfied, or I guess my expectations were really high. I had seen these cupcakes all over social media and I wanted to try it out since I'm here in Las Vegas. Both cupcakes have a huge amount of frosting that is so thick. The strawberry cupcake does not taste like strawberry at all, Kinda more like a carrot cake. The red velvet is pretty good except I don't like the frosting, again it's really thick and doesn't go well together

Insane. I wish I had a quarter for size comparison. This sandwich was almost as big as my head! And SO delicious. I was a little put off by the fact that it was $8.00, but let me tell you, it was worth every penny. I got Captain Crunch ice cream (yes, you read that right). It tasted like the milk at the end of the bowl, and had some chewy Captain Crunch pieces throughout. The girl behind the counter let me sample it first, so if you're skeptical, give it a try! THEN, I sandwiched it between two salted caramel oatmeal cornflake cookies. You can't see the second cookie, but it's under there somewhere. I can't even begin to explain how amazing this was. You could definitely split it with another person, but why would you want to!

Ok...there is legitimately a 24hr cupcake atm right outside of their building! Mind blown! Who hasn't craved a cupcake at weird hours? I had just finished breakfast after our first day in Vegas and spied it. My fiancÃ© suggested we probably didn't have room for a cupcake just then. So we walked on. But 5hrs later on our walk back by I couldn't get the cupcake atm out of my mind. So we went back so I could make my first cupcake withdrawal. The experience was fabulous! I withdrew a vanilla cupcake! Perfect little vanilla cupcake! It was amazing! When in Vegas, you have to experience this!

Even though they only have one vegan option, it is totally worth it to stop in if you are down this way. I thought I had saw Sprinkles listed on HappyCow, so when I walked by I had to run in and check. I asked the friendly cashier and he told me they have a vegan red velvet cupcake. I got one for my friend and I to share. They told us it would be a couple minutes as they were freshly frosting one for us. It came out in a cute paperbag with an adorable Sprinkles sticker on it. My friend and I pulled it out and immediately got excited because they add a candy V on the top for the vegan ones. The added touch of that was enough to sell me as a lifetime customer haha! Now to get to the good stuff, the cupcake was moist, sweet and absolutely delicious. The frosting had a "cream cheese" taste to it that was absolutely perfect. And honestly probably the best vegan cupcake I've ever had and that says a lot because I've had a lot of vegan cupcakes in my day haha! The building also needs mention. The outside has the most adorable flashing lights (of course, it's Vegas) which in itself entices you to go in. The sidewalks outside have adorable "Hollywood" stars that say things like dark chocolate. What a cute touch! Inside is not overly big but it was comfortable for us and they have a line of chairs looking out the window so you can gorge on your cupcake right there.

I loved the whole vibe of this place. The street it is on is bumpin, right next to the ferris wheel. There is loud music outside which made the whole scene outside super cool. We all got ice cream instead of the cupcakes, and my strawberry shortcake ice cream was freakin amazing. It had fresh strawberries and the crunch from the shortcake was too good. One of my friends got the red velvet with the velvet cone. It was good, but I would recommend the strawberry shortcake ice cream. It made me forget all of the money I lost in Vegas. The lady helping us out was super nice and helpful. I DEFINITELY recommend this place!

This review is on the behalf of my dog. Brought him here for his birthday for their special doggie cupcakes. 2:00 on a Saturday afternoon and absolutely no line at all. Got 2 cupcakes which are sugar free vanilla with yogurt frosting. I actually tasted them and they were pretty good. My little man loved them....definitely our new go to place for a treat.

I've been to the one in California and was happy to see them come to Vegas. They have great service and great cupcakes. I get the salty caramel and regular vanilla. My favorite ever is the salty caramel. I've had many salted caramel cupcakes/cakes and thus one by far is the MOST moist and flavorful. The sweet to salty balance is perfect. The frosting to cupcake ratio is perfect. They just melt in your mouth, they are so soft and delicious. They are open late which is great!
Good but in my opinion overrated. The cupcakes aren't anything too spectacular. The cupcake atm is a fun touch and we liked that they had a sampler box.

I love Sprinkles. Their cupcakes are consistently delicious, so you never have to worry about them having an off day. I also liked that this location has their new ice cream shop. I haven't tried it yet, but want to soon. They do sundaes with bits of any flavor of cupcake you want folded in, cookie sandwiches, shakes/malts, frozen hot chocolate, even red velvet cones! Um, sold. The selection at night is pretty scarce so try to come earlier in the day if you can. We stopped by after ridding the High Roller (which is next-door) and got two mini cupcakes (lemon and vanilla). Their vanilla is my absolute favorite as is their triple cinnamon, banana, sprinkle, and vegan red velvet. As someone who is not a vegan, that says a lot. There is always fun seasonal flavors too (right now it's caramel apple and pumpkin) and they also make doggy cupcakes which our girls go nuts for. They now have a free rewards program as well with a ton of cool perks such as a complimentary cupcake on your birthday, any free menu item of your choice each time you hit 15 points, access to exclusive events, bogo deals, and skip the line passes. The ice cream line is always longer here than the cupcake one (being a desert and all), so you should be able to get in and out fairly quickly if cupcakes are all you're after.

Ventured inside and discovered Sprinkles has an ice cream shop now! Diversification at its best. Ordered 2 flavors in 1 scoop cup: Mango sorbet + Coconut sorbet (new!) for $4.28 (inclusive of taxes). Can't believe how tasty it was; and refreshing too. Portion size was a bit small though!
A big fan of their cupcakes. Solely came to try out the ATM. Was able to get my favorite flavor strawberry. Really cool experience

Location is great because it's in the heart of The linq promenade outdoor mall. The reputation of Sprinkles comes from its Beverly hills original location in CA. I've had both give cream and cupcakes taste fine. Being right next to in-n-out helps bring in ton of traffic. Where they can improve is the speed of the service. This layout at this location is set up weird and makes you walk backwards through the waiting line for pick up. Also I don't understand why the server had to pick up each ice cream flavor bucket out of the freezer l?!?!?

After dinner and a few drinks we stumbled across the Sprinkles ATM. Surprisingly, the cupcakes were extremely moist and full of flavor. I got the chocolate peanut butter which had a delicious chocolate cake topped with the creamy peanut butter icing and sprinkles. My partner got the carrot cake which she thoroughly enjoyed. We ate them at the ATM, haha too good to wait

Going to school a few blocks away means that my friends and I frequent the Strip. Whenever we have a sudden craving for sweets, we usually just drive down to the Linq and grab a quick cupcake or ice cream from Sprinkles! Quick, friendly service and they never lets us down. There's plenty of photo opps outside as well, which is always a plus! Follow them on their Instagram! They have plenty of BOGO promotions, just make sure to whisper the secret word of the day to the cashier!

Mwahahahaha. I found this sweet dessert place on yelp and since I was staying at the Linq I HAD to try it out... Too bad when I went there, it was already 11ish pm, so the shelves were pretty much EMPTY. They didn't have a wide selection to choose from so I couldn't get what I originally wanted (next time, chocolate marshmallow!!) so I settled for the Peanut Butter Chip cupcake instead (and I'm not a huge fan or pb or frosting) but holy crap. I had no regerts. The frosting..was yummy. Not your generic store bought frosting. And it was such a delite to find chunks of choco chips in the cupcake. Ahhhh.... I wanna eat another one just writing this! The next time I go to LV, I have to come again (and at an earlier time)!

Sprinkles Cupcakes delivers the most delicious cupcakes, as well as a few other scrumptious treats. This location is right by the High Roller and is by far our favorite cupcake bakery, featuring a great cupcake flavor that's moist and just the right amount of sweetness. Their frosting is to die for, and you can't go wrong with any of the them, regardless of the flavor you choose. We usually like the Vanilla and Coconut but have never been disappointed with any of the other flavors we've tried as well. Staff is always helpful and cheery and lines, although often long, move quickly. A cute feature of this location is the Cupcake ATM, located on the side of the store, where you can get your cupcake fix through a machine 24/7! There's an outdoor seating area where you can enjoy your cupcake and people watch. Every time we are in Vegas we always make a quick stop at Sprinkles!

This place wasn't bad, the cupcakes are little on the sweet side but were quite tasty. They had a decent selection to choose from, they are a little on the pricey side as well. The only thing I didn't like are how they are using chemicals for coloring instead of using natural foods to derive color from. The long line moved pretty quickly and I wouldn't mind returning trying some other types of cupcakes.

Top heavy cupcakes. Loaded with frosting made these cupcakea not my fave. I had the cuban coffee through their atm dispenser for $4.50 and it was not my cup of tea. Went in and bought half dozen. Chic place and clean. Service was nice. Pricey but this is Vegas.

Wow- that's all I can say! I've heard of Sprinkles before, but never had a chance to visit a location. I found one in Vegas and decided to stop it. I ordered the chocolate marshmallow cupcake and the original Sprinkle cupcake. I had to taste both of them and they did not disappoint! I love to bake and these cupcakes put mine to shame! The star of the show for me was the chocolate marshmallow cup cake. It definitely had a childhood "ho-ho" vibe to it. The chocolate cake was so moist, which is sometimes hard to do with chocolate cakes. It's probably a good thing that I don't live near, because I would be in there way too much! Also, the staff was extremely kind and helpful too!

2017 Yelp 100 Challenge! 74/100 Sooo~~ I just stopped by to pick up my free birthday cupcake was pleased with the service. I asked for a box was told I had to pay 0.50?! (When did they start charging for boxes?!) So decided on the free plate and walked for a bit while we gobbled down the carrot cupcake. This location didn't really have ALL the flavors - just simple and some amount were displayed and available. Nothing great ... just a simple cupcake spot (in Vegas) that's all

I can't believe I've never had a Sprinkles cupcake!! These were sooooo delicious. I can't recommend them enough. They also have such a wide array of flavors and extremely fresh. Staff/employees were super nice- especially considering the craziness of a lot of customers and chaos outside in the promenade. Let me recommend the red velvet and the caramel chocolate cupcakes. Yum!

I've always wanted to try sprinkles cupcakes because they looked so cute! I'm not really a fan of deserts but I decided to try sprinkles since I don't have one anywhere near me in Michigan. It was amazing!!! I went here at around 11 pm and they were still cranking out cupcakes and they were selling fast! The workers were very pleasant and informative even with being so busy. They gave me recommendation on what cupcakes they thought were the best Ultimately I decided on the black and white, cinnamon sugar, sprinkle and a red velvet cupcake. They were all delicious! The cupcakes were all moist and fluffy and the frosting was soft and not overly sweetened. These cupcakes were delicious and well worth it! Will definitely be back here next time I'm near one!
tourist in las vegas I pass by to earlier was close I just took pictures I enjoy the cupcakes before I try those cupcakes before in chicago Walton st

Ok we made a special stop at Sprinkles just to get their cupcakes. Being from Los Angeles it was a hard task finding parking at the Linq promenade too! But we finally did and man was it worth it! We walked all along the promenade shopping and drinking before we came back to Sprinkles. Once there I ordered the peach cobbler cupcake and black and white cupcake and OMG I was in heaven! Talk about decadent! We had to walk around more on the Strip just because of them! Lmaooooo! Now that we've figured out parking we'll be back soon! Or maybe just take a Lyft and have cupcake crumbs in the backseat! Lmaooooo

Came here on a Saturday afternoon with a couple of friends. There were a few people in line & 2 people behind the counter taking orders & preparing them. I think there were 4-5 people in front of us & it was about a 15 minute wait. I usually get the sprinkles sundae? The cupcake with a scoop of ice cream. The portion is pretty big so I suggest sharing! I got the dark chocolate cupcake with the coffee almond fudge ice cream. I wasn't a big fan of the cupcake... it was too sweet and it was more of a milk chocolate rather than a dark chocolate. The ice cream was pretty good though. They offer a mini size for the sundae, however, they only have limited flavors for the cupcake. I would probably opt for that one if I come back. You can seat your party outside because they have a few tables & chairs. They also have a cute cupcake ATM if you don't wanna wait in line - super handy!

Perhaps one of my favorite cupcakes, the ice cream 'eh' hence the four stars. Cupcakes 1 Ice cream 0 Always fresh cupcakes, I'm a fan of the change of cupcakes on various days. As for the ATM that satisfies the need for self gratification

LV Sprinkles is always a hit with my kids. We first visited the one in La Jolla a couple years ago and when we heard there was one here when we moved to LV a couple years ago, my kids were beyond thrilled. Personally, I love the cute marketing they do, simple clean wooden displays and bright coloring makes it attractive to the eye. The flavors they have each day such as red velvet or vanilla are popular, but they have a couple new ones each month or different days of the week, as well. Flavors like chai or chocolate-peanut butter, lemon meringue or smores are some of the interesting varieties. I don't always get one, but my daughters adore the red velvet, I have tried the lemon meringue which was a little dry in my opinion, but the lemon curd and burnt marshmallow top was a nice touch. It's a fun outing if you're looking for something to do by the Linq and there's cute stores like Kitson and nice restaurants located all around.

Biggest guilty pleasure. If I'm in the area, I gotta grab a vegan red velvet cupcake. Their cupcakes are always so moist and delicious!! I love that they are constantly adding new flavors every month as well.

For a cupcakery, their cupcakes are pretty inconsistent. Sometimes you'll get one moist or one too dry. Frosting is a bit too sweet for me, and the cakes are just decent. Very subtle flavors in the ones I've tried (strawberry, vanilla, chai latte, black&white, & milk chocolate). I can see where the hype comes from- great location and modern/hip store, though the cupcakes don't live up to the hype. 3 stars because I do love their rich ice creams! Especially the captain crunch one. Other than that, meh it's alright.

On our way to the High Roller down the LINQ's open-air avenue, I literally squealed when I spotted Sprinkes. I didn't go inside the cupcakery which also offers ice cream and cookies. Instead, I opted to use the famed cupcake ATM. It was super fun and cool to use...and no line! The cupcakes are boxed individually and keep very well. Mine survived two days in the hotel room and a bumpy plane ride home over the Pacific ocean. When I finally opened the box at home, my lemon coconut cupcake amazingly still looked perfect and was absolutely delicious! ,

I got a couple of the smaller cupcakes so I could get different flavors. I got the black and white and the red velvet. The cake was moist and the frosting wasn't overly sugary. Definitely better than other cupcake places I've been to because the cake to frosting ratio is perfect. I'm used to places piling on the (way to sweet) frosting to make up for lackluster cake, but this place let both components shine!

I've watched sooo many baking shows and have dreamed about these well known sprinkle cupcakes... what a disappointment today was... cake wasn't dry but had a weird texture to it... I definitely was not wowed by any means... I'd say skip it.

I was the only one there when I went, so I was in and out in no time. Everyone else seemed to have a taste for the ice cream that was next door. I saw an advertisement to get 3 mini cupcakes for $5, but the flavors offered, weren't any that I cared to try at that time. I opted for the Salted Caramel cupcake which was pretty good. I paid like $3 and some change for it, which is the standard price for a cupcake at these places. I got it to go, so it was placed in a brown bag and I had to be extremely careful with it, otherwise it would get smashed. Well guess what?!?! It still got smashed, but that's OK, I still enjoyed it.

I'm glad that Sprinkles made its way to Las Vegas. I first tried them in Phoenix and really enjoyed the taste of the cupcake. Each day they carry about a dozen flavors with a couple that rotate. Most of the flavors are standard like vanilla, chocolate, red velvet, lemon, and carrot. The special flavors that are on rotation are more exciting like key lime, meringue, and margarita. The rotating flavors are why I return. The actual cakes are good. The cake part is moist and delicious. I like the flavor of the frosting and the amount of frosting on each cupcake. I also like that they have a standard cupcake design with the simple sugar dot in the middle. This location also has a cupcake ATM. Awesome! I get that they are just filling this from inside the building, but it's a novelty and I am easily amused by this novelty. Of course this is how we opted to have our cupcake dispensed to us last time we visited. It really fits in with the fun, youthful vibe of The Linq.

I was so excited to finally get to the Linq Promenade to try a Sprinkles cupcake, and I was sadly disappointed. The cupcakes are super size Small and the flavor was very bland. We ordered a Chocolate Marshmallow and a standard Vanilla with sprinkles.The cake was pretty dry and had hardly any flavor. The frosting for the vanilla one was quite funky-monkey(not sure what it was, hard and not like frosting at all?). And, I will add, the price? Not worth it at all $3.75 for a tiny tiny cupcake? No thanks Girls were nice in the store, I guess that is the positive part of my experience there. Not what I was expecting at all, very sad... But, hey it was a beautiful night for a stroll at The Linq.

I love pumpkin season and especially when I can get to Sprinkles! As I was walking to dinner along the Linq Promenade I saw Sprinkles and their ice cream shop next door, which always puts a smile on my face. It was late at night but I stopped in anyway to see what they had left. Thankfully, they had my favorite two flavors. My go to is always the red velvet cupcake but the pumpkin gives it a run for its money. The red velvet is perfect, one of the best versions of this flavor that I've tasted. And the pumpkin? It has just the right amount of cinnamon, spice, and pumpkin flavor. Sprinkles has nearly mastered the cupcake and their consistency across stores around the country is impressive. Each time I bite into one I'm amazed by how fresh, moist, and soft it is. The only two things I don't love are the icing, which is a little thick for my liking, and the prices...of course.
Very happy the cupcake ATM worked at 1am! Got a marshmallow ganache cupcake and a chocolate coconut. It is in front of SLS and the Linq. Want to come in the daytime when the store is open!

I may have bought a cupcake from their vending machine for the novelty of it, but I was pretty pleased with the experience and enjoyed the flavour of my simple cupcake which remarkably was moist and not too terribly sweet. The vending machine operates 24 hours a day and is located outside of their storefront. The storefront seemed overwhelming to me but the vending machine had more limited options which was actually rather appealing.

Was not a fan of Sprinkles in Beverly Hills. Was hoping for a better experience at this location. Well, here is what I I liked. It is located right on the Strip at the Linq Promenade. The Cupcake ATM looks like an amazing feature. Should have tried it, but I did not. Maybe someday. What I did not like. I was not crazy about any of their cupcake flavors that day. Not saying that they tasted bad. Just was not "Wowed". Overall, I find Sprinkles cupcakes good. Not great, sorry. I recommend Sprinkles as a fine 3 star cupcake shop. Nothing more at this time.

The cupcake was tasty and the plate and fork were biodegradable. I was happy about the earth friendly utensils. The cupcakes are always fresh and tasty. I was not happy about the fact they did not accept Discover card. Overall the place was clean, staff friendly and the wait was not so long.

It was a pleasant surprise to see Sprinkles while walking the Linq Promenade. It was the perfect stop for our dessert. We didn't use the ATM but ordered inside since it wasn't busy. The coconut and sprinkle cupcakes were good but not the best. They actually fall on the average side on the scale of cupcake ratings. The service was quick and friendly though. I'll try the ice cream next time, especially after reading a review about the red velvet waffle cone.
I love this place. Never had the ice cream but always getting there seasonal samplers cute fun and yummy.

Cupcakes are cool but if I order for curbside pickup to skip the line that means I don't wanna wait. If I give you all my info with the order and there's a problem or a question with my order I would expect you to call, text, email etc... that way when I get there I just grab and go. I was running late like I ALWAYS am and that's why I called ahead to order. Hopefully next time there is an issue with the order you guys will call, text, email some communication so this doesn't happen again.

I dragged my friend with me to the sneak peek event because I got invited. I was so excited to get in there to taste cupcakes and ice cream!! It must be one of their smallest locations; it's at one corner of a building with barely any seating. I can just imagine customers lining up the block just to get a SAMPLE of their sweets!! Just know, this is the first time I have ever tried Sprinkles! It was a little overpriced, but that was expected, knowing that they were a famous cupcake/ice cream brand! But let's talk about the food: Cupcakes: The cake itself was soft and moist. It was a good color, just like a cupcake should be. However, the taste was not as flavorful as I would have thought it to be. I tasted red velvet and chocolate marshmallow; and I'm pretty sure that I have made a better tasting batter at home. Red velvet wasn't as bad, but taste still fell short. The frosting was a COMPLETELY different story! It wasn't too sweet and was absolutely delicious!!! It was just always spot-on with excellent flavor. Lastly, don't eat that little edible logo. It's gross. lol. But I do like the idea in their simplicity in design! Kudos. Ice Cream: Sadly, I didn't get to taste any cookies, but I got to taste two flavors of ice cream: Red velvet and Cap'n Crunch. The red velvet was just okay, It was like a cake-flavored white ice cream with pieces of red velvet cake inside. The Cap'n Crunch doeee. It was crazy, crazy delicious. It's the flavor of your dreams!! TRY IT. It will make your life. It's more of a buttery, white/yellow ice cream with pieces of the famous cereal crunchin' inside your mouth. Overall, it was a good morning for eating sweets and I will definitely come back for that ice cream! And possibly use the new 24/7 cupcake ATM once it gets up and working to taste those other cupcakes! I'll be back :)

Solid cupcake shop surrounded by restaurants, bars, stores, and of course, the High Roller! Came here twice in 2 days. The first day, I used the famous cupcake ATM-super cute and open 24/7 to fulfill your sweet tooth! A very cool concept, and there's a camera that displays your cupcake's journey to you- although it does have limited flavors. That night I got the red velvet, which is always perfect. Second night got the salted caramel-bomb! Just make sure you have s me water handy.

Totally worth the hype! We are from Texas and don't have a sprinkles in our city. I'm a sucker for anything with a buttercream. I ordered the sprinkles cupcake with buttercream and yum First of all the cake and icing proportions were perfect. The cake was moist and the buttercream was made from real butter and not nasty lard like some places use. I can't wait to visit again and order from the "cupcake atm"!

January 31, 2015 Saturday - 11:15 AM snack 2 adults Atmosphere - 5 stars Food - 5 stars Service - 5 stars Background - Walk the Linq promenade and came a cross Sprinkles. I remember now reading that they planned to move in the complex but forget about it until I saw it. Same with the bowling alley. After watching many episodes of Cup Cake Wars with my wife we had to stop here. Atmosphere - Small, Vivid, Clean, and Crisp. No signs of a bakery on property. I did not ask if there was one there, so not certain. Food Drinks - none ordered. My Meal Dessert - My wife ordered the Black and White cupcake and she shared it with me. I can not describe the level of moistness in this cupcake. You just need to try it yourself. It was a ooooeeeeee gooooeeey sponge of chocolate goodness. Side note there was frosting too, but I really did not focus on that. Service - They had two ladies working behind the counter. One worked with my wife getting her food and the other worked with me to settle the bill. Future - Yes, and I will get my own.

I love sprinkles But I have to say I'm a bit disappointed this time Not sure if they changed their recipe or maybe the cakes were just been there for too long. The ones I got were not fresh, the base of the cake was falling apart and kinda dry.

I'm a Vegas local, so I don't frequent the Strip too often. The only time I go is if I have friends in town and I meet up with them... Which is how I ended up at Sprinkles! My friends and I had just eaten dinner across the street and they decided that they still had room for dessert. I was pretty full, but what the heck! Who turns down dessert?! Surely not I! We weaved our way through the always busy Linq Promenade and made it to Sprinkles! There was a small line out the door, but it moved quickly and we were given menus to look at while waiting. The menu is simple enough. They offer different flavors of cupcakes, cookies, and ice cream according to which day of the week it is. I ordered the Sprinkles Sundae which is your choice of cupcake with one scoop of your choice of ice cream. I chose the classic Red Velvet cupcake and although the Cap'n Crunch ice cream sounded really tempting, I had to go with the Coconut Fudge Almond ice cream! The combination was amazing. The sweetness from the rich buttercream icing paired well with the subtle flavor of the ice cream. I would definitely recommend this combination! Sprinkles' signature Red Velvet cupcakes are also offered in gluten free, sugar free, and vegan versions. You can purchase cupcakes to-go in the bakery as well as the infamous Cupcake ATM located outside. That's right. A freaking ATM that dispenses cupcakes! What! I totally regret not getting one to bring home! I will definitely be returning with my family. Thanks for satisfying my sweet tooth, Sprinkles!
The cream cheese frosting here is the best part. Try the red velvet cupcakes! Didn't care much for the decrotive sugar pieces on top, they're hard to eat.

Well finally got my long awaited Sprinkles cupcake in. It not often am down on the strip in general but since had visitors in town. Perfect opportunity not only to walk off some Bacchanel Buffet across the street. My friends never seen The Linq so killed two birds with one stone. YAY! As always every time walking down The Linq the exterior sign just screams at me fun! Especially at night with all the bright colors, and cool design. It not only on the outside. Soon as you walk in looking at the display of cupcakes. Bold assortment of different cupcakes. Sooo many had hard time choosing my first Sprinkles cupcake flavor. Talk about throwing curve ball never knew they sold mini cupcakes on top of the healthy side gluten free ones. I love the way all the cupcakes are displayed and every one looks like perfect cupcake (same size, icing nice and smooth even all around, and not one squeezed up next to one another). They do seasonal cupcakes so just cause you seen one this trip might not see it again. But if hit right cycle see it again. Another section that does the ice creams but this trip just looked at cupcakes but next time get something from the other half. I ended up settling on the raspberry cupcake. I really thinking red velvet but wanted something different. Raspberry was awesome! Like mention all the cupcakes look like piece of artwork. I feel guilty that first bite not sure best way attack it. I did both frosting by itself and all. The cupcake by itself amazing really taste hint of raspberry in it. Moist. The frosting was da bomb. Again had nice raspberry flavor not over the top but just right on. The only thing that would say not fan of is the price$$$ But then again for gourmet cupcakes the prices they charge is the going rate. If want indulge in cupcake Sprinkles is great way get the fix in. I know next time walking down The Linq will get my cupcake fix on. The service felt was awesome. I never went was packed. I seen that when gets so busy they make line outside and control amount of people in store at one time. Smart but on hot summer Vegas days not many fans. They have full staff so not much waiting going on. The longest wait is trying to decide which flavor want get cupcake fix on. Talk about nice packaging from the boxes. I just ordered one and simple paper bag nice and Sprinkles sticker seal it. Count I will be back again.

This gem is among the many stores at the LINQ and near the Ferris Wheel. My colleagues and I decided to stop here for dessert after dinner at the Yard House (in the same plaza). I ordered the salted caramel cupcake and practically devoured it. Moist cake with stiff but smooth buttercream. One of my colleagues got their vanilla on vanilla cupcake and the other got a shot of buttercream (yes, they sell shots of frosting here!). Hint-- they have 2 doors, 1 for ice cream and 1 for cupcakes. The ice cream door had a ridiculously long line when we were there while the cupcake door was reasonable, maybe 5 min wait.

I was introduced to sprinkles in L.A, so glad they brought it to Vegas. I must add that it is in great location. I can imagine they are s fairly busy store. I went in as a quick trip with my family, my kids chose ice cream over cupcakes! It's a very small store, luckily we didn't have to wait long at all. We went mid day during the week, they only serve certain flavors per certain day. My advice is to Always check the website first to see if they have something you are looking for! We got half a dozen, assorted. My fav is red velvet. Most of all the cupcakes are very rich in flavor. The frosting alone will assure you a cavity! Remember you are at the linq at this location, so I ended up paying about $26 for 6 cupcakes. All in all great customer service, in both ice cream and cupcake shop.
Excellent spot for cupcakes, cookies and ice cream. Reasonable prices and everything is very tasty. Good gluten free choices as well. I very much enjoyed this gem.

So so good !!! Like seriously .. I got the sundae which was a red velvet cupcake and dark chocolate ice cream which was AMAZING !!! .. My husband got an ice cream cone with strawberry and red velvet ice cream which I enjoyed too lol. Our twins enjoyed it as well lol. Instagram: @wykes_twins

i LOVE Sprinkles. No matter where I'm visiting in the states, I always make an effort to search the closest location to where I'm staying. It's one of my musts on vacation. I've been to the Chicago and New York location a few times, but recently visited the Vegas location. Tastes exactly how I remembered. On this visit I decided not to go overboard as I was going to be walking around with them all day and taking them back to Canada. I got a mini red velvet cupcake, a full size vanilla and vanilla sprinkle for my SO. The cupcakes are heavily iced, but I like it that way. They can be too sweet for some people who don't really like cupcakes or sweets. However, I don't mind it. I love cupcakes, and these do it for me lol. I love the variety of flavours they have and how fresh they always taste. My friend got some coffee ice cream on our visit and it was freakin delicious. I wish I had gotten my own, but I didn't want to kill myself with sugar in a span of 5 minutes. Another flavour I really enjoy is their maple bacon cupcake. Trust me. It's out there but they do a grrrreat job with these flavours. Also, please note, the sprinkles in my picture semi-melted off the cupcake because of the Vegas heat lol. They don't actually look like that.

Setup of this shop was a bit confusing they have cupcakes on one side and ice cream on the other but no sign indicating so at least when I had visited. Red velvet was so good! Nice, rich, cream cheese frosting the cake itself was moist, light and delicious. The man at the counter was very friendly as well. First time thing a Sprinkles cupcake, and it did not disappoint!

This is the first Sprinkles location I've been to that service cupcakes, cookies, and ice cream. I've had their cupcakes before...for the most part they are good, but have way too much frosting for my liking. Now their cookies on the other hand are delicious. My only complaint is I didn't get more than one cookie!!! The chocolate chip cookie wasn't overly sweet and had a good amount of chocolate chips in it. The cookie was a tad crunchy but super soft and buttery in the middle. So good! I also tried a bite of the peanut butter pretzel chip, which I surprisingly enjoyed. Generally not a huge fan of peanut butter cookies, but mix it with chocolate chips and pretzel bits and I'm a fan. Service was friendly and the lady helping us was rather patient while C was trying to decide what ice cream topping and cupcake and cookie he wanted. If the line inside gets too long, this location has a cupcake ATM you could use outside (open 24 hours).

Thankful they put a Sprinkles ATM in terminal 3 @ McCarran airport! Was running out of time to grab travel gifts & all the stores in the terminal had relatively sad offerings. Spotted the CUPCAKE ATM & figured it was worth a shot. The most disappointing thing about these cupcakes was that I only bought three. Each flavor was fresh and delicious! I got myself a Pumpkin cupcake, it had cream cheese frosting and I cannot stop thinking about it. Will absolutely visit the ATM again, as it also saved me from having to drag extra stuff through security. SO CONVENIENT!

On vacay in Vegas and in search of a delicious cupcake so I was thrilled to see that Sprinkles was just down the promenade outside the Linq Hotel. The shop is small and cute, the display is adorable, but the cupcake was terrible; dry and crumbly with a hardened glob of frosting on top. Based on the texture, it would be better described as tough vanilla cornbread topped with sugar paste. And there was a clump of coconut balled up on top that tasted like sand. It was sooooo bad. The taste *literally* made me want to go back and get a refund. I couldn't even get any takers for it in a room full of kids so I just tossed it in the bin and chalked it up as a loss. The receipt actually had a BOGO offer on it redeemable the next day but I didn't want to roll the dice and get another $3.95 piece of 'cornbread'. When you enter this bakery, the founder is staring back at you from the cover of her cupcake recipe book display, AND she's my fave judge on Cupcake Wars, so Sprinkles Bakery needed to bring it. Unfortunately I've had better cupcakes from Costco. Hopefully it was just an off day for them but still a bummer. I had a Snickers for dessert instead. *sigh*
Very cute dessert shop! Nothing special on the flavors that they serve but I find their ice cream affordable. Need to try their cupcakes next time.

i walk in and there's a full grown big dog in the store. Since when? So dogs come before people? I am afraid of dogs, they super scare me and usually I have mace with me to keep animals away from me. This place is too small for patrons and dogs. Service dogs is one thing but this was not a service dog you could tell because it was not behaving and not following its owners commands. I had to leave immediately.

No Sprinkles locations in Canada sadly! I've had Sprinkles a year ago in NYC, and was excited to find out there's one conveniently located on the LV strip, very close to the Flamingo. Sprinkles offers the best cupcakes I've ever had - I had the vanilla and my husband had the coconut, and we both loved ours. The cupcake itself is super dense and the buttercream icing (legit buttercream, not the soft whip cream) is very rich. Currently, if you sign up for their newsletter in-store on your phone, you get a free cupcake! One complaint: other cupcake shops I've been to offer a free box for one cupcake, whereas Sprinkles only provides boxes for 2+ cupcakes. Instead, for one cupcake, they just package it in a paper bag which doesn't look as nice and is impractical given how delicate cupcakes with frosting are.

There is major HYPE for this cupcake joint for a solid reason. Their cupcakes are monumentally delicious. Moist, flavorful, sweet, and that cream cheese frosting... ANY cupcake with that cream cheese frosting please!!! Also, next door there is now Sprinkles Ice Cream. And for the intrigued, a SPRINKLES ATM! *Joy*. Just the thought of this place makes me so happy. Except that it cannot possibly be an everyday thing unless your metabolism works as a rockstar.... Also the workers here are extremely helpful . I don't know how many times they must repeat themselves but they gladly do it. Very well detailed, patient, and their descriptions make each cupcake sound even more tempting and appetizing. Add to the fact that they have really cute packaging... Sprinkles is the bomb.com. And now they have doggie cupcakes too!

After I found out that there was a Sprinkles Cupcakes in Las Vegas I HAD to visit the OG of cupcakes. After dinner across the street at Caesars Palace I dragged my Husband across the street and down the block to Sprinkles. There really is no easy way to get there and it's a long walk. It's located in the Linq Promenade and definitely not visible from Las Vegas Blvd as the Yelp map shows. After walking more than halfway down the Linq Promenade (located on your way to the Ferris Wheel) I spotted Sprinkles Cupcakes with its giant lighted sign. I was surprised to see that they weren't busy around 7:00pm on a Saturday so it was nice having some time to browse and not have to stand in a line. The employees were nice and the shop was organized and clean. There are a few seats inside to eat your cupcakes but we chose to take ours and go. I got the Peanut Butter Chocolate Cupcake which was good and I was glad to see it wasn't filled inside. The cupcake had good peanut butter flavor and the chocolate frosting was tasty. I love cupcakes, but couldn't finish this one because it was super sweet. The cupcake itself was a good size, but there was a TON of frosting! My Husband got the Maple Bacon Cupcake and he thought his was OK (he's not a big fan of cupcakes in the first place) and he couldn't finish all his either. I would come back to Sprinkles Cupcakes the next time I'm in Las Vegas because I really like cupcakes. Otherwise I would pass because I've had better cupcakes back home in California.

Yum! The cupcake I had here was such a GOOD cupcake! My daughter and I wandered into this cute place after lunch at In 'N Out right near by. I was pretty full, but there's always room for dessert, right? I only got a mini cupcake (red velvet), but if I had the opportunity to go back, I'd get a big one. It was moist just like it should be, and the frosting for me was just perfect. The cupcakes are also very pretty to look at, and there's a nice selection of flavors. I wish I lived here so I could try them all. My daughter is more into ice cream than cupcakes, so she got a waffle cone with cookie dough. After she couldn't finish it, guess who came in to help her polish it off? It's a tough job, but someone had to do it! And man, oh MAN....the cone itself, just the cone, I'd have one of those any day. It was just a really good cone. And the ice cream was also wonderful. They have a cupcake ATM....how clever! We didn't use it, but what a great way to get a cupcake fix after hours. I love it. I'd gladly go back to Sprinkles the next time I'm in Vegas!

I have heard so many good things about Sprinkles and was excited to try it only to be disappointed. I didn't love it. I went somewhat later at night but you would think that they would have a decent selection seeing as it is the city that never sleeps. Fair enough. I had literally the cupcake with sprinkles on it. The frosting was awful and dry. The cupcake itself was nothing to write home about either. I honestly feel that I have made better from a box at home. It wasn't moist or flavorful at all. Service was good, fast and friendly but I won't be back to spend another $5 on a cupcake.

Hmph. Not impressed. I came in to try the infamous Sprinkles cupcakes and all I could say was 'MEH.' I got the seasonal Pineapple Upside Down cupcake which looked overall fantastic. First, the frosting to cake ratio is ridiculous. Waaaaaay too much frosting, which was like a mountain of sugar overbearing my poor cake. Frosting wasn't all that impressive tasting. The cake itself was OK. I enjoyed the small pineapple bits inside the cake, but it was super crumbly and a bit hard to eat if you didn't have a fork. It was simply average. Nothing that made me say 'wow' this is good or enough to recommend to others.

Cupcakes cupcakes cupcakes cupcakes cupcakes cupcakes cupcakes cupcakes cupcakes cupcakes cupcakes cupcakes cupcakes. Yes you can even buy cupcakes from the ATM on the side of the building. They have cookies and doggie treats WARNING - the doggy treats look good enough for humans to eat but they're not for humans. My go to cupcake is the red velvet - red cake with a hint of chocolate (very moist and rich) topped with a sweet icing. The icing is a bit rich to eat on its own. I usually cut the cupcakes into quarters and divide the icing evenly. On my last visit there was a new chocolate chip cupcake. I was hoping that the cupcake wrapper would actually be a chocolate chip cookie but it was not. Yellow cake topped with icing that tasted vaguely like cookie dough. It was worth trying once but I doubt I'll have it again. Seating can be tricky here there's a few bar seats in the shop. Alfresco seating is available but you're battling the ice cream parlor next-door for seats.
Expensive but soooo goooood and moist. You can never go wrong with Sprinkles cupcakes.

HOORAY FOR VEGAN RED VELVET CUPCAKES! They keep 'em in the back so don't feel discouraged when you don't see them struttin' in the display case. To be honest this is the only cupcake I've ever gotten (don't have a choice) so I can't vouch for the others. However, the vegan red velvet is Sensational Moist Flavorful Spongy Perfect cake/frosting ratio Yum! Service has been quick and friendly both times and the store is usually pretty clean. Price is expected for the strip! Seeing 2 star reviews because of price here make me sick. Definitely recommend this place to all the sweet tooths out there. Oh and if they had a vegan red velvet ice cream I'd probably just die.

They were a little low in inventory on a Thursday afternoon, but we were able to get the sprinkle, dark chocolate, salted caramel, and red velvet. These cupcakes have great frosting ratios, and very moist. Try the little mini shot one for a sample!

Sprinkles is always a good idea! I've had their cupcakes before but it was my first time trying their ice scream sandwich at their Las Vegas Strip location. The store is located in the right in middle of the Strip so it's a convenient stop for dessert. It's also right by a fountain and a ferris wheel so you can eat outside and enjoy the view and weather. They have a wide range of choices for dessert: ice cream, ice cream sandwich, cookie sandwich, etc. I wanted to try the ice cream sandwich so of course I ordered the red velvet sandwich with red velvet ice cream. YUM. Definitely give Sprinkles a try if you're in the area!

This location is literally a couple steps away from YardHouse when you have a sweet tooth after devouring amazing food and drinking beers...! I did not try the ATM machine outside but I did go inside and the girls there are super friendly :-) I got the red velvet with cream cheese and it tasted perfect. It had just the right amount of cream and the cupcake itself was really soft, but not too crumbly.

Sprinkles has everything I love in an overpriced cupcake!! Their sugary, moist, slightly dense, and made with quality ingreidents you can taste. They offer an array of flavors and even have a killer vegan red velvet with frosting made with coconut oil. Very well executed but I would have appreciated other options to choose from. Grab them fresh from the store or give the cupcake ATM a try when an after hour craving hits.

Like In N Out, they have seriously long lines. Their icecream is slooooooooo good. Love their chocolate chip cookies. It just melts in your mouth. Their Sprinkles Cupcake ATM machine is ingenious. We need these machines everywhere.

Cupcakes on a Saturday night at home are kinda a big deal. I'm a fan of cake, but I tend to think most bakeries don't have that really good moist texture in their cakes. Not the case with Sprinkles. Had a sample of various cupcakes and I can't wait to have more Saturday nights full of cupcakes. They are incredibly moist and topped with lots of frosting. Lots of frosting is usually not my thing - it's just too sweet! But this stuff had just the right amount of sweetness and creamy texture. Yum yum yum

I'm sure you're familiar with Sprinkles, but if not it's a cupcake shop that I'm pretty sure was one of the frontrunners of the cupcake craze years ago. They usually have about 10-15 flavors to choose from, some are always available, while others are seasonal or only available on certain days of the week. I don't generally buy cupcakes because I like to bake, and most of the time they are dry, or taste fake, or just aren't very good, but I make an exception for Sprinkles 'cause they are pretty dang tasty. They aren't the best cupcakes ever, but they are very good. They are always moist, and they are generous with their frosting. My friends and I pre-ordered about 35 or 40 cupcakes, all different flavors. They were for several different people, and Sprinkles was kind enough to give us extra boxes so we could disperse them as needed. They also have puppy cupcakes which is about the best thing ever! They are smaller than their regular (human) cupcakes and super cute. My Great Dane loved hers. I've been told you can order a frosting shot, which I've never tried, but am very tempted to do. Lastly, they have a cupcake ATM, which is about the coolest thing EVER.

Well....this is a very time consuming process, one ice cream server moving at a minimum wage pace is a real buzz kill. Either way at the cupcake counter or the ice cream counter it's questionable. Oh wait there's two lines huh? No but ah...were together so can you serve us both? The elder couple ahead of me gave up allowing me to advance...yea. The server was pleasant and helpful, no question but it was slow and saving on labor cost was evident for the day. What was cool was the outside order door. Think dumb waiter with a two way speaker, whatever. Your better off getting a popsicle at the liquor store around the corner. food guy-martin

A Sprinkle here, a Sprinkle there, and a Sprinkle in Las Vegas! After visiting the ones in Newport Beach and Glendale, we went back to where our love for this company started, right down next to The Linq! After being berated by my cousins for never trying the cupcake ice cream combo, I dove in head first with the Sprinkle cupcake with sprinkles and the Capn Crunch Ice cream. After a wait just long enough to have my taste buds get even more excited, my creation was ready! To my dismay, it was just too too sweet. My combo had defeated my expectations and I could not even finish it. For me and my large sweet tooth, this says a lot. Regardless of my let down, I will STILL return as your cupcakes are number two cupcake in my tour of California! Until next time Sprinkles...

Omg... Their cupcakes were sooo good! Fattening, but very delicious. The cream cheese frosting was also very good! I could only eat 1 cupcake (max) since that'll be more than half my calorie intake for 1 day! Haha They can get very busy where the line is out the door, so try to avoid peak hours. It's a bummer they're at the Linq & as it's a little inconvenient to drive & park... But I guess that's a good thing so I'm not eating these cupcakes everyday! Lol

This brings all the feels. First off after having a cocktail and wanting to eat a scrumptious snack the cupcakes are perfect! Plus it's a ATM! That's right quick easy and perfect for on the go celebrations and neatly placed in the box.

Live on the edge and indulge yourself in a delicious cupcake! Heavy on the frosting, moist cake, and spot on with the defined flavor (lemon was incredible)! Price point $3.50 is what you'd find anywhere locally - so for Strip pricing even nice.

Every time I have been drinking at The Linq or nearby I have to stop for a cupcake or ice cream at Sprinkles. Each time it has not been great. The cupcakes are dry, the ice cream tastes old. Usually when you are drunk every thing tastes better. Maybe it is because I always come in at night. I have also gotten the wrong cupcake out of the vending machine twice. First time I thought it was user error but second time I know I did not get what I selected. That being said I am sure I will be back next time I am drunk and in the area.

Basic ice cream. Red velvet cone didn't taste like red velvet. Nothing special but not bad. Cold stone and Blue Bell are both much better. I wouldn't return. Every topping is $1 FYI. I wish I would have went to Ghiradeli. Bottled water was great. Lol

We have always wanted to try Sprinkles but never had the chance. Before our trip to Vegas, hubby had a huge craving for cupcakes and I saw that there was a sprinkles there. One of the days during our trip, we went out to breakfast and ventured out to find sprinkles! Let's just say we got a bit lost once we were in the area (GPS was making me go in circles, haha). But we finally found it! It's a cute little shop and we went inside to order. We ended up getting 4 different flavors! We got the Sprinkles, Vanilla Milk Chocolate, Banana and Vegan Red Velvet (the regular one was being restocked). Anyways! We were the only ones in there at that time and after we ordered, we headed back to our hotel. We made a quick video on trying Sprinkles for the first time and overall in my opinion, it was delicious, but to me it's a bit too much frosting and some were really sweet. I really loved the banana one! That one had to be the best for me. Maybe whenever we are near another Sprinkles, we'll try out their other flavors.
