Finally got to visit a Sprinkles cupcake place! LOVE LOVE loooooove! I purchased a red velvet cupcake thru the cupcake "ATM" and didn't eat it until I got back home; 2days later. The cupcake was was still super moist, yummy, and since it was packed in the cute little cardboard cupcake box, it traveled well back home with me.

We were so excited to try the new flavors of the week and even more excited that I was going to redeem my awesome Instagram win for a free dozen delicious cupcakes. In total I ordered a dozen and a half cupcakes with 5 salted oatmeal cornflake cookies. It wasn't busy when we went in last Saturday afternoon and the girl at the counter was very helpful and friendly but she was having difficulties ringing up my promo code and had to go get the manager. There were a few more people who had trickled in and there was another girl to assist them. The manager came out to assist the employee and did not acknowledge me at all. They fiddled around for a few minutes and couldn't get it to take, the manager Jeanie apologized to the other people in line but not to me. I'm a customer who is waiting too, it's certainly not my fault they can't get the promo code to work and that they only have 1 register. The manager has the employee try again with no luck and I think she just cancels everything and re rings up the order. Finally after about 10 minuets of just standing there I'm able to pay. The manager Jeanie ( i don't know if that's the correct spelling )then walks away from the register and proceeds to thank the other customers for their patience and still says nothing to me. At that point I was dumbfounded and insulted. The girl who had been helping me was explaining to me that she will try to add my sprinkle rewards later to my account and that they couldn't do it now. We always make it a point to stop at Sprinkles whenever we visit Las Vegas and I always ask anyone I know when they visit to bring me back a dozen cupcakes plus cookies. I always go on and on about how these are the best cupcakes ever and always recommend them but this experience left the worst taste in my mouth. I don't know why she was so rude to me, but if you read this post Sprinkles so would sure love to find out why.

First of all I love these cupcakes! I really wish that I could give it 5 stars. The main reason I didn't is the service. Cupcake side seems pretty legit and if you don't want to wait in line you can go to the Cupcake ATM, yes ATM! Where I have an issue with this location, not sure if it's with all of them, is the ice cream side. They do not know how to efficiently serve the customers. They usually have 2 people working it taking one order at a time. One person takes the cash while one person makes each order alone. Most of the time they can't scoop ice cream cause they aren't strong enough and struggle. Usually at ice cream places, yes there's a cashier while others make the orders. More than just one person!!! It's annoying and takes forever to get your ice cream. If you do end up going, I suggest the sprinkles sundae. It's a cupcake of your choice with the bottom and top separated and the ice cream of your choice in the middle. I will be back because I love their cupcakes and I'm picky when it comes to baked goods. Just expect a long delay of receiving your ice cream.

The first step in addiction is admitting you have a problem. Happily, I travel often enough to enjoy Sprinkles at several locations. I was in Vegas to celebrate my best friend's birthday and was unaware of this location. I am addicted to Sprinkles. So much so, that I startled a young family on the monorail that was carrying take out from Sprinkles Vegas. Apparently exclaiming "Where did you get that?! " is not considered friendly. I tried to suppress my excitement and question the poor man. Once he realized I wasn't drunk, he gave me directions. It is located in the Linq, between The Quad and Flamingo. If you are on the strip, follow the signs toward The Highroller/ Ferris wheel, Sprinkles will be on the right by a fountain. It is about halfway down the walkway. Back to the cupcakes, I had heard about the cupcake ATM. I was gleeful when I saw it. Of course, I tried it. It is a little more expensive than the inside the store cupcakes. The touch screen is easy to use and each cupcake is individually boxed and presented quickly. I was on vacation and willing to pay for the novelty.... it is Vegas just go with it. We also went inside. My friend enjoyed her cupcake and understood why I dragged her there. The quality is what I expected as our cupcakes were delicious. I came back before our flight to get some to go!! The ladies packaged them well for travel ( boxed and Ziploc style bagged). There is an ice cream shop attached as well.

Friends in town for a convention...they had to go to "Sprinkles". I had never heard of it, but loved the cupcakes. They were very busy, only one person working in cupcake side. The young lady ha does each customer with patience, and Love.

Sprinkles never disappoints! We spotted it from a distance due to their double dot, Vegas-style jazzed up sign! If you're a frequent flyer, you know what I'm talking about. Anyway there is a separate line for the cupcakes and for the ice cream -- which was great because we wanted the latter and got our ice cream right away while there was a long cupcake line on the other side. They do both Sprinkles regular sized as well as mini-sundaes which we love! They're great portion control as well. Service was friendly, and fast! Ice cream and mini cupcake were great, as usual. There's some seating right outside -- and if that's too crowded, there's a fountain close by to sit along which is what we ended up doing. Definitely recommend!

By far thee best cupcake I've ever had. I choose the vanilla milk chocolates which in my opinion was one of the best decisions I've ever made, the frosting is to die for its rich and creamy not to sweet and not too messy. The cupcake its self was nice and moist with a bit of a tough top which was a good touch. Overall I will always try to stop in get one whenever I see a sprinkles

We all remember that famous line from the movie Jerry McGuire " You had me at Hello " Okay the second most famous line after " Show me the Money " Well it's exactly how I felt when I saw the pink cupcake dispenser. Sprinkles had me there. My heart literally melted. I'm just a sucker for cuteness, what can I say? Instead of going inside the Sprinkles store, I decided to bypass it and go straight for the ATM. At this point, I'm happy beyond words and even get more excited when I go to the screen that has the cupcake flavors listed. Menu: Which cupcake do I get?! - Red Velvet - Triple Cinnamon - Salted oatmeal cornflake - Cinnamon Sugar - Double chocolate - Dark chocolate - Black and White - Vanilla milk chocolate - Vanilla Price: For $4.25 each cupcake, I wanted to get greedy and order one of each flavor but instead ended up ordering just one, my absolute favorite, Red Velvet. Once I swiped the card, the little pink door slowly opened and like magic, my small brown box with the delicious treat inside was waiting for me. The red velvet cupcake was everything a cupcake should be moist, sweet and was perfectly made for my mouth. It was oh so good! After literally devouring this tasty dessert, I walked inside the Sprinkles stores. It all looked so tempting, the variety of cupcakes, red waffles cones and ice cream. Tip: The red velvet cupcake is the best. No need for me to say more. Located: The Link Promenade, directly across from Caesars Palace and next door the Flamingos. Experience: Sprinkles Cupcakes is so good and proves the best things come in the smallest packages.

Heard great things about this place and since it was right outside our hotel the linq, we decided to grab a cupcake. Tried the margherita cupcake which had a delicious sprinkle of salt on top that MADE the cupcake. Delicious!!! $3.75 We got lucky and didn't have a line up and it was a Sunday afternoon! Would definitely recommend for others to try! A bit pricey but give it a shot.

I was excited when I saw they have a Sprinkles that made ice cream but the clerk at the register had no knowledge of how anything was made so I ended up just getting a cupcake. The lady behind me ordered and why did he assume we were together and put our cupcakes in the same box. We said no we're separate then he said we charge for separate boxes.. that doesn't make sense to me.. got back to eat my cupcake and it was crumbly and dry.. smh

This place was one of the highlights to our trip, such a nice place to hit on a hot day when all you want is ice cream. The flavors change everyday so each time you come, odds are you'll have a totally different experience. The cookie sandwich can be really messy and it's not like the best cookie samich i've ever had but a solid contender that's hard to beat. I'm just upset that I had to house the thing since the bad boy was melting at such a rapid rate. The staff was highly friendly, nice to let us sample a few of the many flavors they had to offer. The cup cakes and brownies are a solid choice if you're not feeling coffee. Had one of each and they made a great breakfast even after having chilled in the whip for about a day b4 we munched. Will def be coming back here.

The cupcake ATM was probably one of the cutest things I have ever seen. You can order up to 4 cupcakes at the ATM. I ordered a vanilla cupcake. The appearance of the cupcake was very clean and cute. The taste of the cupcake was good. Overall it was a fun experience to get a cupcake from an ATM. Again, loving the use of technology in businesses.

I believe this might be the one and only cupcake ATM. If you know of another, please LMK. It literally 'blows my mind' when I think about how this multi-million $ business rests on a cupcake. I am truly truly impressed with Candace Nelson and I frequently watch her judge 'cupcake wars'. If I see another 'candied bacon cupcake'..... GRRRrrr!I almost purchased her baking book. But really, what a treat for the senses here especially the color scheme, the bright lights, modern decor. Am I getting a cupcake or did I stumble into one of those fancy boutiques to get 'yer herr done'? I was surprised to receive my birthday cupcake here and also purchased 6 to go and with new puppies on the way, of course pupcakes then scoops of ice cream to tide us over until we get back. I tried pretty much every cupcake and forgot how dense the frosting is. It ends up being my favorite part of the cupcake actually and they do sell frosting shots which I think is just frosting in a cup. Since I dabble in baking, I pay attention to the taste and aroma of the cupcake itself. I found that it has a peculiar after taste/scent which reminds me of 'raw' flour. Some of the chocolate or PB flavors don't have it as strong. Also maybe some sort of cooking oil?! It is fairly moist. I think it is more the experience than anything else (keeping in mind it is on the strip or Bev Hills). My puppies loved the pup cakes and next time, butter pecan scoop. Awwww, but Sprinkles is my living dream...what a gorgeous store!

This place is amazing. I recognize the name from the show Cupcake Wars so I had to go in and see for myself. So many choices and all of them delicious. They even have "Pupcakes" for your pooch and a place where you can create your own cupcake. And what I thought was amazing, a walk-up window after hours whoa

This place is a building of cupcakes. How can you not give it 5 stars. They even sell shots of icing. How is that not a thing everywhere else yet? We were in Vegas for only 4 days and we came here twice. I dont even remember the flavors we go. All I remember was that the staff is friendly and helpful, the store had a lot of pink and cheerful colors, they had air conditioning and delicious morsels of yummy goodness dressed up as a cupcake. Price is just right for the quality that you get. Yum.

Who needs luck in Vegas when there are Sprinkles Cupcakes? I didn't seek out Sprinkles. They came to me ... as I searched for In-N-Out Burger between the Vegas Strip and the High Roller ferris wheel ... there it was ... Sprinkles Cupcakes and Ice Cream. I have know idea what to do if life gives you lemons, but when life gives you Sprinkles Cupcakes, you eat them. You eat them now! I got a classic (and old-timey Sprinkles favorite) Red Velvet Cupcake with Cream Cheese Frosting and the iconic sprinkles dot. I was satisfied. Life was good. So, I got another Sprinkles cupcake, but this time a traditional Black & White Cupcake featuring Chocolate Cake with Vanilla Frosting. Mmmm...life was still good. Not wanting to be a pig, I then went healthy ... with a Vegan Red Velvet Cupcake with a big V for victory over my diet. Life was very good. Besides, it's better to leave Las Vegas filled with Sprinkles Cupcakes than with regret.

After I had dinner I wanted a dessert and this was next to the place I ate for dinner. They offer ice cream and cupcakes so I figured you can't go wrong with that. I went to the ice cream counter and actually waited two minutes for someone to appear at the counter. When she finally arrived, from the menu I wanted the ice cream mixed with the cupcake. You can choose the flavor that you prefer so I chose the cookie dough and the coconut cupcake. I went to sit down and on the other side is actually where you choose to buy the cupcakes. I love the display and they have a huge variety. When I took a bite, I enjoyed every sing bite. It was actually bigger than I expected.

I used to get a dozen cupcakes from Sprinkles from a friend from L.A. who never seems to remember which flavors he gets me. The cupcakes pretty much all look the same which my friend describes as "cupcakes with nipples". They have regular-sized cupcakes as well as mini cupcakes. They have regular cupcakes, sugar-free cupcakes, and vegan/gluten-free cupcakes. There's a separate door/line for cupcakes, and ice cream shop. You can go to The Linq and get your cupcakes or order online. They deliver for a fee. You can sign up for their rewards program. My last bakery box include: 1 banana, 4 banana dark chocolate, 1 black & white, 1 black velvet, 1 chai latte, 1 chocolate marshmallow, 1 cinnamon sugar, 1 lemon coconut, 2 salty caramel, 1 sprinkle, 1 strawberry, 2 sugar free red velvet, 1 vanilla milk chocolate. But my absolute favorite is banana dark chocolate. It's like banana bread in cupcake form with delicious dark chocolate on top. Sooooo good! However, it's one of the flavors that's not available daily. Meaning, you have to check the schedule and see what days certain flavors are available. You can purchase cupcake mixes, cupcake stands, shirts and other merch. I could use some banana dark chocolate cupcake right about now...

Sprinkles ! I sent my husband to get me a cupcake at terminal D. He said there was no Sprinkles music! Now he thinks I made the catchy jingle up (that I sing all the time) But I still love your cupcakes.

Located near the high roller and many other restaurants, casinos, and eateries. You can definitely come to this area and hit everything up. Come somewhere over here for breakfast, casino break, lunch, casino break, high roller ride, dinner, casino break, dessert. Seriously though this is a huge strip off of the strip that has a lot of stuff. I didn't go inside and see the options because I was waiting for food from in-n-our but my mother ordered some cupcakes and they were beautiful. I later tried one and it was pretty good, a little dry in my opinion, but good. I think that the dot decor they put on top of the cupcakes just makes for an awesome picture. (Seriously, see the picture it gave me). I'm not sure if there were vegan options because I didn't walk inside.... but, I would hope they have some because it is not difficult to make a cupcake vegan, at all!!! Anyways, if you have a sweet tooth you might as well stop here. They also have ice cream I think.

Some of the BEST cupcakes Ive had! The sprinkles and red velvet flavors are my fave as well as the salted caramel!!! I have had the dark choc marshmallow and vanilla which are also good but not my fave! But just as moist and soft! I come often :/ since I love right behind them. So bad for me but so good, lol.

I LOVE SPRINKLES CUPCAKES AND ICE CREAM! Living in California, I've had the luck of being near several locations so I was pretty excited when they opened another one in Vegas. This one is a combo of both cupcakes and ice cream, yay! They're connected so if you can't decide like me, you can easily view the goodies in both stores. Their cupcakes are always delicious! I've had the Black and White, Red Velvet (both sugar and sugar free), Peanut Butter, Smores, Margarita, Carrot, and Dark Chocolate at various visits. Their Margarita cupcake (made for a limited time during Cinco de Mayo) is the only one I haven't throughly enjoyed to the very last crumb. I decided on ice cream this time. Sprinkles makes their own ice cream and allows you to have it alone, in one of their delicious waffle cones (regular or red velvet), cookie sandwiches, cupcake top sandwiches, and a number of unique toppings. The cupcake top sandwich is bomb, as you can choose two different of the day's flavors, but I opted for some dark chocolate ice cream sprinkled with red velvet cupcake crumbs. So good, as the woman who helped me agreed! Sprinkles is a famous brand, so the cupcakes and ice cream combos are more than the average similar establishments, but for the occasional treat I think it's more than worth it!

So this isn't a review for the actual store front (which I walked into, and it was beautiful). This is for the cupcake ATM that it attached to the building on the outside towards the In'N'Out. So using the actual ATM is cool as hell. Came here based off a friend telling me I should, and I almost missed it and went into the actual store. They seem a little overpriced, but it was quite the spectacle. You pick the one you want from the menu (salted caramel here) and then you watch the screen as you see your cupcake delivered. Tasted delicious though. Fully recommend coming if you're nearby.
Sad to say that sprinkles cupcakes and atm cupcake is now closed at The Linq location.

Set Up = 5 Stars Service = 5 Stars Selection = 4 Stars Price = 4 Stars Peanut Butter Chip Cupcake = 5 Stars Carrot Cake Cupcake = 3 Stars I love the set up when you walk in. Ice cream to the right, cupcakes to the left. Heck, even a cupcake ATM outside. Just don't let size of this place and the lines fool you. Yes, Sprinkles is tiny, yes it's crowded, and yes they are quick/efficient. 5 stars for service that's for sure. I didn't try any of their ice creams, but that's happening soon. I tried the Carrot Cake and Peanut Butter Chip cupcakes. For those that know me, know that I love a good carrot cake and anything with peanut butter. So here are my thoughts on both.... Peanut Butter Chip Cupcake: This was so good, moist, had just enough chocolate, and packed with a creamy peanut buttery taste. I've had a few peanut butter cupcakes in my lifetime and would honestly rank Sprinkles near the top. If you're a fan of Reese's Peanut Butter Cups, then you'll be a fan of Sprinkles' Peanut Butter Chip Cupcake. My only regret is getting only one. Carrot Cake: The icing was good, but thought that the actual cupcake could have been better. This was packed with a ton of carrots and a little dry. Again, I've had carrot cake cupcakes before and have yet to find one that I really like. Sprinkles didn't impress me with their Carrot Cake. But hey...it's all about their Peanut Butter Chip. If you're at the Linq, then I recommend that you check out Sprinkles and judge them for yourself. I see myself coming back to try one of their ice creams and of course, back for their Peanut Butter Chip cupcakes.
You can get the most awesome cupcake in the world in the Las Vegas airport! There's a Sprinkles vending machine! That made my travel day

Cupcakes are my all time favorite and this place does them perfectly! Every time I'm in Vegas I force my friends to come here & get a cupcake from their awesome Cupcake ATM. I've had a pumpkin cupcake (seasonal), lemon & blueberry cupcake, Sprinkles cupcake (funfetti), and strawberry. They have all been delicious. The cupcakes are always moist & soft & basically just heaven on Earth. I have not tried their ice cream but I'm sure it's pretty dang good too.

SUGAR RUSH in the LinQ Promenade Cupcake ATM-how did we miss this the first time!? This was our first experience with Sprinkles so we didn't know there was a cupcake ATM! We went back the next day and found it outside to the right of Sprinkles ice cream section. These might be a bit drier than the inside ones, so get one from the ATM for the experience, then buy the rest inside. Gluten Free Red Velvet cupcake available-I'm not sure if they rotate GF flavors. I tried this and it was definitely one of the better GF cupcakes I've had. The GF version has an edible-but-don't-eat "G" button on the cupcake to identify it from its flour containing friends. Ice Cream - as if the cupcakes aren't enough to put you into a pre-diabetic state, you can get ICE CREAM here too. Cupcake top sundaes...red velvet cones...unique flavors..but my son just likes plain vanilla so that's all we tried. If you're in the area near Flamingo/LinQ/High Roller and craving something sweet, this is your spot.

Mehhh, nothing to write home about. Truly basic flavors with a great concept. It was reasonably priced and had seating outside, along with limited seat inside. My cupcake did not fast fresh and was a pretty heavy. I prefer light and moist cupcakes but that was not what I got. If I Sprinkles on my travels I will try again.

I was able to spot this place in the air while riding on the "High Roller" ride! So glad they have opened up a location in Las Vegas. Absolutely love all flavors. Very moist and dense! The frosting is not too sweet either compared to other cupcake bakeries. During my last visit, I ordered the strawberry, red velvet, triple cinnamon & coconut. Brought one home with me on the plane and left it in the refrigerator for the day. Unfortunately it hardened & I ended up throwing it out. :( I wanted to experience ordering out of the cupcake ATM but they were all out of cupcakes! Boo. But it was still a great experience going in to order in person! Definitely will be coming back here during my next visit to LV!

I've walked by this sweet little dessert shop many times. When you have a friend with you who loves desserts probably as much as you do, it helps! We walked in on a weekend afternoon. The Linq area is always bustling with visitors and locals alike. The seems to be a constant stream of people in line for a sugar pick me up. The line seemed to move quickly and efficiently. Once side has ice cream and the other is the cupcake display. While in line you can browse their selection of pretty cupcakes waiting to be picked. The options may be a little overwhelming. I say just go for it and try a few. We opted for their infamous Red Velvet and the Maple Bacon. Since we were splitting them we cut them in half. The still had a decent moist cake which I was happy about. So many cupcakes places can't seem to get that one right. I'm not gonna lie... I enjoyed them both and finished them. But I remember thinking the Maple Bacon Cupcake could have been more flavorful. There wasn't anything special that stood out as far as a zing of flavor. Of course I didn't get a chance to use their super special Cupcake ATM but one of these days I might have to try that out. That also goes for their ice cream. I won't drive out of my way but inevitably, I'll be back. My sweet tooth always has the upper hand.

Carrot cake cupcake was tasty but not the best I've had. I hit the cupcake ATM and got a cupcake to have back in my hotel room. Yep it's a total tourist trap but figured I'd give the ATM a shot since how often can you buy a cupcake at an ATM? Also, doesn't get crushed in the ATM so it comes out good as new. Not a must try in Vegas but if you're hungry and in the area, why not?

Best store bought cupcakes I have ever had! I bought the Chocolate Marshmallow and Red Velvet based on another Yelp review and I was not disappointed. They both were fantastic and were gone within 5 minutes. I can't even decide which one was better...

Ice cream service has been a bit slow the two times I've been here due to the employees' undivided attention to detail with each group. They make sure each customer is offered ice cream samples and they answer questions to the best of their ability. Be prepared to wait longer than usual for ice cream. Not all flavors are offered everyday. Daily flavors do include vanilla bean, red velvet, cap'n crunch, the flavor of the month, which is bubblegum right now, and a few others. Pistachio and mint chip are available Monday, Wednesday, Friday, and Saturday. Check the flavor schedule online or at the front counter. Red velvet on a red velvet waffle cone is one of my favorites! I once tried a sprinkles sundae with the bottom half of a vanilla milk chocolate cupcake layered first in a cup, topped with a scoop of mint chip, and adorned with the top of the cupcake. Pretty good, but the ice cream scoop could've been bigger. My first encounter with their ice cream and the ATM was at this location last year and I remember anticipating my cupcake sundae. It's quite the experience standing outside the glass door waiting for a friendly employee to let you in, at least it was in the evening so the warm weather wasn't so bad. You will love this place if you're a fan of the cupcakes. Note: They need to fix the ATM-- it doesn't show the start to finish mechanical process of bringing the cupcake behind the pink door on the screen as you wait.
Clean, Neat, Tasty... Download the app for daily/monthly updates on New Flavors. Great customer service The have an Ice Cream store attached, which is Awesome

If you haven't ever had a sprinkles cupcake, you need to go right now and buy one! They are the best! Their vegan red velvet cupcake is out of this world! No other cupcake on this planet compares to sprinkles!

I've heard about Sprinkles Cupcakes for years and decided to finally try it on my Vegas trip! Glad i did. Although i wasn't MIND BLOWN, it was still a nice treat. The employees were super friendly and it was worth the wait. The packaging is super cute and the cupcakes all look so amazing. I would def recommend stopping by if you have a sweet tooth craving. Great customer service, cute packaging, and delicious treat! *ps try their cookies. those were actually better than the cupcakes!

Great place for a sweet treat I love the creativity and the craftiness that goes into each individual item: cupcake, cookie, ice cream, sundae, sandwich, or shake. Each item is great on its own, but for our visit today we stepped it up and went with the sundae - frosted cupcake top over your choice ice cream with the remaining cupcake bottom underneath. I went with Red Velvet cupcake and Strawberry sorbet... Mistake. I underestimated the extreme sweetness of this flavor combination and couldn't finish the cup. Overall though, great place... But next visit, different flavors is a must

I loved the outside of this place. There's a Sprinkle where I live but this was my first time in here. This place is small & we had to stand outside in the line b/c it was crowded. The sprinkle & red velvet cupcakes are good. These cupcakes were moist & fresh. They are pricey but worth the $4.25. They also have a ice cream shoppe right inside next door. Didn't get a chance to try the ice cream but next time I will. This place is located in The Linq Promenade.

I have never been to sprinkles. I've only seen it on social media. My friends decided this would be our meeting place for our small reunion. It's been over 10 years since we have seen one another. I'm not a sweet tooth but they did some great choices in cupcakes and ice cream. I would bring my children here. They have a cupcake atm aka cupcake vending machine available outside. It is pretty neat to see one of these in person. Stars. 1 star for service with a smile 1 star for many varieties in sweets 1 star for facilities 1 star for overall experience. 1 star for cupcake Vending machine.

Super soft and melt in your mouth cupcakes . I tried various flavors with my friends and we all loved it. The red velvet cupcake was delicious, the cream cheese frosting wasn't too over sweet. Great combination and balance of flavors. The cupcakes came in the cutest box and were very fresh. Very good and professional service also, I signed that day for a reward card and save $5 on my order!

Sprinkles caught my eye every time I walk around linq. Whenever I come by, I crave it. Inside is cylindrical, there is a place to order in the front of a half circle. You order and receive your dessert at the other end of this circle. The inside is small and there are no seats inside. It is attached to another area that sells cupcakes. I personally am not interested in that. Outside are seats available to sprinkles customers only. You can order several items, the best one for me is the red velvet cupcake mixed with a vanilla cream ice cream sundae. It is basically red velvet with vanilla and a red velvet cupcake on top. They also drizzle some frosting on top of that. The prices are cheap, I would say in the 5-10$ range depending on what you order. The other items I have not tried but they aren't highlighted on the menu. There wasn't any free WiFi not bathrooms from my experience. Overall, it is a sweet delight that is to remember.

Sorry to say it was not the best or the moistest cupcake I was very disappointed I took one bite and it's still sitting on the counter my 7 year old granddaughter didn't even want it with the sprinkles and all not a fan at this time maybe I will give it another try when I'm back in town.

CUPCAKES.... need I say more?! Came here on a friends recommendation and I'm glad we found time for it last minute. Came for breakfast on the last day in town. This shop is absolutely darling! In the shops by the Linq. They have a wide array to choose from. They also have an array of beverages to drink while there. I had to go with milk and they have skim, whole and soy. Sadly no chocolate milk. Loved the experience.

Love the location of this Sprinkles at the LINQ! And even better that they serve ice cream here. I got an ice cream sammy...double choco chip and a fudge brownie with coffee almond fudge ice cream in between. YUM! They have a door specifically to order cupcakes and another for the ice cream section. It was confusing at first to know where the line for which section of Sprinkles started. My ice cream sammy was created quickly and it looked yummy and was yummy . While $9 for this ice cream sammy was a bit steep, it's still worth a try. They also have the cupcake ATM on the side of the store, which is cool.

Delicious but.... If you like cupcakes this is a great spot. The problem here is how to choose the best one considering they are not the cheapest of the cupcakes. Well....I have only tried 5 different ones so definitely I still have a long way to go but I have to advise on the cookie dough cupcake!! Superb!! If you are in Vegas you definitely need to check out this spot. Unfortunately they don't have tables to seat so it's take out only..

Sprinkles cupcakes is ALWAYS a good idea! This biz is a sugar dream land and just so. dang. pretty! The location in the Linq center is no exception. After stopping in and getting our cupcakes we found out that they have the highly desired, highly instagrammable cupcake ATM! We didn't find this out until much later though, so sadly no photo ops. The staff here, although with non stop customers streaming through their doors, is super friendly and just straight up pleasant! On the other side of the building they even have ice cream!
Maybe it was too hot outside to eat a cupcake, but I didn't care! Sprinkles is awesome. I try to go when in Vegas or LA and this Linq location was no different. The Cupcake ATM is so fun!

Sprinkles Las Vegas is a cute cupcake and ice cream shop. Choose from an assortment of freshly made cupcakes in flavors such as coconut, vanilla, chocolate-marshmallow, strawberry, peanut butter chip, carrot, and lemon-blueberry. I tried the salted caramel and their best seller, the red velvet. The salted caramel is a denser cupcake, the texture is more like a banana bread. I didn't enjoy this cupcake as much because I prefer an airier cupcake. The red velvet hit the spot. Light and airy, moist, with chocolaty flavor and the right ration of cake to sweet cream cheese frosting. At $3.75 a piece, visually the cupcakes are pretty plain. Frosting is smoothed on with an off-set spatula rather than piped on in fancy designs--but we don't care as long as it tastes good, right? Just don't eat the circle decoration on top, it's hard and tasteless. Sprinkles is a great place to stop by when you're looking for a sweet treat.

THEY ALWAYS HAVE THE VEGAN (red velvet) CUPCAKES. Also, the vegan cupcakes that they happen to have are GOOOOOOD. Is there really anything else you need to know? The cake is moist, the icing-cake ratio is good, they are decadent without giving me a tummy-ache, and it isn't an ordeal to go park & get one (or 3), despite being in a touristy area. I didn't find them THAT expensive?? (Frozen vegan desserts at Smith's could be the same price, nevermind Whole Foods or something...) Also, the poster who mentioned a coconut butter flavor in the icing was DEAD-ON. It is unique, but so yummy. Obbbviously will return. Please get vegan ice cream, though, cuz ya'all obviously service a lot of vegans!! Peeps were ordering some before us, too. (And if you do, can it just be something simple like vanilla or cookie dough, etc.? Sometimes it is hard to find decent traditional ice cream flavors made vegan - see CREAM with their blueberry or mint ice cream....gag).

I came here with a sweet tooth which rarely happens since I'm not a huge sweets person. I ordered the mini red velvet cupcake and it was delicious. The cake is very moist. The frosting was a little too sweet so I had a baby bite of it and it was tasty. I let my sister eat the rest. I also believe this is the restaurant from one of the judges from cupcake wars which made me want to see the hype. It's good but pricy. But don't listen to me about prices of cupcakes since I'm not a huge sweets person. I also ordered the regular coffee and the server dress it for you. I didn't know that and wished that she asked me before making it for me. Other then that, it's a cute little shop outside the Linq casino.!

This is a cupcake atm. It's attached to a real ass bakery so you know they're made within a day or so but the ATM is open 24 hours so the mechanics of it are truly baffling to me. We went at about 8pm (after the bakery was closed) and there was no line at all. The cupcake itself was good, the cake was moist and the frosting wasn't so sickly sweet that it made the whole thing hard to eat, (which is the downfall of most cupcake shops.) There was also a pretty decent selection, if I recall correctly it was about 12 or 15 flavors. Coming to this is really more for the experience of getting a cupcake out of an ATM than because the pastry is so amazing but I still think it's definately worth a stop; you have to walk past it on the way to the High Roller so I'd recommend stopping on the way back from that.
A sprinkled cupcake is the perfect treat for a birthday! Their nearby cupcake ATM is perfect since sin city doesn't sleep!

While on The Linq promenade, I built up a sweet tooth and decided to give Sprinkles a try! The moment I saw their sundae (cupcake of your choice with a scoop of ice cream) I knew I had to have it. I got a strawberry cupcake and cookie dough ice cream. So good. The portion sizes are also huge for their regular sized option. I suggest splitting it with someone or opting for their mini option if you're like me and can't eat a lot of sugary foods at once. Wish the one in my hometown didn't close because I'd give them a visit, like tomorrow. :/ For sure I will be back on my next visit to Vegas!

Went for coffee and cupcakes while in Vegas and was not disappointed. The cakes were moist, fluffy and so flavorful. Also we tried a multitude of bad coffee while in Vegas and this place was excellent! We had the peanut butter chocolate, double chocolate, triple cinnamon, banana, dark chocolate banana, chocolate marshmallow - and they were all so good!
Yes, they make sundaes at the pace of the sloth in Zootopia. Worth the wait. This is just amazing food. Highest quality imaginable. Don't miss this!

I have had many different flavors of cupcakes here, and only a couple times have I been disappointed (which is why I give it four stars). If you are debating between mini cupcakes and regular sized... always get the regular. The bigger ones are a lot more moist. I have tried plenty of the mini cupcakes and sometimes they taste a little too dry. My absolute favorite flavor is the german chocolate cupcake. Unfortunately I only had this one in a mini, but I can only imagine how good the regular sized one was. I also really like the salted caramel, and of course their signature red velvet! My least favorite is the banana peanut butter. The mixture was really weird together. I have had a banana with peanut butter, but this cupcake didn't taste much like it. Overall this is a really great cupcake shop, just try to stay away from the minis. :)

If you love creme brulee, then run to Sprinkles before July 31 for their seasonal ice cream. This was the second time that ice had Sprinkles. I decided I was going to try one of their cupcakes as well as some ice cream this time. I was going to get their Cap n Crunch ice cream, until I saw that their seasonal flavor was creme brulee. I couldn't pass that up. I got the ice cream sundae where you pick out a cupcake and they cut it in half and put a scoop of ice cream in between. Delicious! I tried the vanilla cake with chocolate frosting and sprinkles. My boyfriend got the Cap n Crunch and coffee ice cream in a red velvet waffle cone. Everything was really good. Prices weren't too bad, considering they're on the strip. There's usually a long wait so be prepared for that. If you don't want to wait, you can always go around to the side and use their cupcake atm. That's a fun experience. It's a cute little place. The staff is nice and you can get samples of the ice cream. Everything is pretty sweet, but not in a bad way. You may want to get a drink to go with the cupcakes since they have a generous amount of icing on them.

Ever since they opened at the LINQ Promenade, I've been a regular customer at Sprinkles. I love their cupcakes and even their ice cream. My favorite cupcake flavors are the Triple Cinnamon and Red Velvet, but there are also special monthly flavors that are great, too. Sign up for their loyalty club online, Sprinkles Perks, and get a free cupcake for you birthday, plus other freebies if you're a regular customer. The staff is always friendly and the store is located right next to the fountains at the promenade so you can chill out, eat your carbs, and people watch, too.

I was so happy when I stumbled upon this place on the strip! I've been wanting to come here for several years when they open the first location in Southern California. Super friendly service from the moment we stepped foot in this place. I got the cupcake and ice cream sundae for $6.95 not including taxes. I chose red velvet cupcake AND red velvet ice cream because it's my all time favorite. The ice cream was not too rich and the cupcake was most with the perfect ratio of frosting and cake. We will be back soon! Tip: They also have an ATM outside of the shop!

You can never go wrong with a sprinkles cupcake. I used the outdoor ATM machine on the side of the building. You select your cupcake order from a touchscreen and then pay by credit card. Within seconds the door opens and your cupcake is in a box. There is a 50 cent extra charge for buying from ATM. It is convenient. They have outdoor tables to sit at. I had the vanilla with chocolate frosting. They load on the frosting. The cupcake was moist.

Let's get our sprinkle and sparkle on. Cream cheese frosting. Can you taste your favorite flavor, long for that soft fluffy sweetness. Cupcakes and ice cream in one place all together. Cupcakes will one day be the best way to celebrate our difficult differences. Decisions will be decided. Those that are in power must realize that the cylindrical shaped cups of love are way to powerful to resist. These treasured delights are the moments that are full of such harmony. Happiness can be achieved over coffee, tea, and cupcakes; period. The human race just needs to come to this realization before it's too late. So many delicious flavors and varieties could be achieved. When will they learn. Let's start the lesson without those individuals. We're talking cupcakes today, name the flavor and it's here. Deliciousness in a cylindrical culinary crush. Just walk through the door and let's start the process of ordering. The cupcakes are baked fresh here on sight each and every morning. They should be called Freedom cakes, but the causes that the company celebrates is authentic and geared towards many choices for all individuals to enjoy. The cupcakes always deliver here, never have I had a "bad" cupcake from any Sprinkles anywhere. This particular location is located on the board walk near the Linq Ferris wheel. A prime local right next to In and Out, by the large fountain in the court yard by the Flamingo Hotel and Casino. It's not easily allowable accessibility by car, but their is ample parking out by the Linq hotel. Unfortunately the parking for the Linq is no longer complimentary. The Flamingo Hotels parking garage is your best bet which is free. Now using the Valet at the Flamingo is costly. Either way you make your way to this Sprinkles it's worth the cost. Let no one ever steal your light. Always remember that kindness should be in heart and love light the way.

Yummmm! Got the redvelvet ice cream with the red cone. Perfect for the summer days. Ice cream was nice and creamy and it wasn't too soft. I thought it would've been on the softer side since it's so hot in Vegas. but they kept it nice and firm :) The redvelvet has some pieces of redvelvet cake mixed in. There was a line when we went in, but it gave us time to look at the menu. I over heard other customers and it sounds like they have a points system going on. They have the left side for cupcakes and merch. And on the right side is their ice cream. They have ice cream sandwiches, you can have that cookie or cupcake style. They have Sprinkle T-shirt's you can purchase in different colors and ribbons and candles. They also have their cupcake mix you can buy as a gift or take home and bake yourself.

Sprinkles Cupcakes. Oh yes. (why haven't they come up with a cupcake emoji yet!? =( I need one of those in my life!!!) Located at the Linq Promenade, this is the only Sprinkles in the state of Nevada. I remember those good ol days where I would make a trip down to Beverly Hills and stop by Sprinkles and get a red velvet. Got to rub elbows with the rich n famous ;) no....more like gawk at their beautiful bougie vehicles rolling down the street. Anywaysssss...... I'm not much of a sweets kinda girl but I do love my Sprinkles. THIS is something that I'm willing to sacrifice my calories on. My favorites are: red velvet (of course) and strawberry. I've tried the Cuban coffee and it was just too sweet. Also, on St Patrick's Day, they turn their red velvet cupcakes to......GREEN velvet cupcake!!! It tastes exactly the same as your normal red velvet but being that green is one of my fav colors....this was freakin awesome!!! They have monthly specials too. Like for April, I want to try to cherry blossom cupcake. August: green tea. And I think July: summer cherry.
Great customer service. Fast and speedy transaction. The interior is great inside. The cupcakes were delicious and superior

The best part about this popular cupcake shop is the magical atmosphere that looks like it came straight out of Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory. Unfortunately, once the bright colors lure you in, the products fall flat. Variety of ice cream flavors, some common and some unique. While the consistency is great, the flavor is way too sweet to be fully enjoyed. Put it inside a soft, dense red velvet cone, and you have a stomach that is hardly able to process all the sugar you've just consumed. However, this is a cupcake shoppe, and once I tried their coconut cupcake, they had redeemed themselves. Great ratio of cake to frosting, beautifully decorated, and a moist consistency. If you want ice cream, go across the street, but for a cupcake, do stop here. Made a special trip to stop by the Linq and was disappointed to find they have left.

The gf told me about this place for the sole purpose of getting the cupcake through the atm machine. And the only regret we have is buying only one Salted Caramel cupcake. Because this place was delicious!

Love the rotating recipes. I've not tried anything other than the cupcakes. And they're very light and so is the frosting. Use the fork! And for on the go, pick yours up using their cupcake ATM on the side of the building! I'm here for the June specials-Marilyn Monroe red velvet and pineapple upside down cupcakes.

Items Selected: Pumpkin Cupcake Strawberry Cupcake S'mores Cupcake Black and White Cupcake Fudge Brownie Caramel Apple Cupcake Sundae - Apple Pie Ice Cream, Salted Butterscotch, Whipped Cream, Graham Cracker Crumbles Malted Milk Chocolate Ice Cream Coffee Fudge Almond Ice Cream Banana Ice Cream Salty Caramel Ice Cream Cherry Vanilla Ice Cream Apple Pie Ice Cream Having once waited nearly an hour for cupcakes when Sprinkles' only outlet was a small shop in Beverley Hills, it was just after 11am that convenient valet parking was used to make a quick stop at the friendly Linq location, smiles on servers' faces ever-present with more than a dozen flavors of cake and ice cream from which to choose. Missing its chance to trademark "The Happiest Place on Earth," a sentiment seemingly shared by girls behind the counter and two youngsters with whom I waited in a line of just one before us, it was after a short bit of deliberation that a sizable order was crafted, the boxed and bagged sweets taken home for later indulgence while a delicious Apple Pie Sundae was upgraded to a cupcake sandwiched special, the first bites a tad too sweet with frosting while further mixing uncovered a beautiful sort of balance, the spicecake and graham cracker crumbles melding nicely with whipped cream and butterscotch amidst some of the creamiest fruit-focused ice cream around. Waiting until around 3pm for the rest, four cupcakes along with a brownie and six pints of ice cream given to me as a gift obviously far too much for one man to enjoy, it was with alternating bites that various items were sampled and with the oddly artificial tasting banana ice cream lone exception to items crafted from superior ingredients the results of everything else were decidedly quite excellent, the bruleed marshmallow fluff of a S'mores cupcake mellowing the bittersweet chocolate center atop a crunchy graham cracker base while Black & White riffed successfully on the deli cookie classic, the best bites of ice cream a tough decision between milk chocolate punched up with malt balls and aforementioned apple pie. ***** Rare to support an outsider over locals, and equally skeptical of high prices based on branding and swanky design, it remains difficult to find fault in a company that has continued to improve its standards despite mass expansion, a rare case where a once trendy choice has aged well with the times.

I really don't know what it is about this place, but I don't think it is really that good. There's too much frosting, and it's too sweet. However, this place is like crack to me. I will never pass up an opportunity to come here and grab some cupcakes, furthermore, I am usually the one that suggests it. I know, weird. Hell, quite often I suggest going there to get some cupcakes from their "Cupcake ATM' after-hours. Crap, I'm starting to feen as I write this. Although they have quite an array of flavors to choose from, I usually stick with their Milk Chocolate Cupcakes. My wife in the other hand has probably tried all of their flavors and her go-to is the Red Velvet. I think what makes me not like their cupcakes too much is the fact that they use too much frosting and they've always been a little too dry inside. I prefer my cupcakes a little more on the moist side. Well, that's not the only thing I prefer moist, but I'll leave that one for another day. All-in-all, I don't really know what my infatuation is with this place, but I will definitely be making plenty more after-dark ATM trips. Perhaps I just like to buy into the hype, although I do find the inside of their store to be very cute and simple.

I love Sprinkles cupcakes everywhere and anywhere but this location is cool simply because how sweet the view is. It's located on the strip by various restaurants and shops, and you can see the famous High Roller perfectly. Sprinkles cupcakes are unmatched! I got my favorite flavor of all time, the Black and White, and we tried a "Royal Wedding" sampler as well. All delicious and worth every single calorie. #NoRegrets

The cupcake trend is gone but this chain is still going strong and just opened at The Linq. Thought I'd try a place recommended by quite a few SoCal Yelpers. Did not expect to be as disappointed as I was. Tiny space leaves little room for a line, menu is large and not easy to read at a distance, save for the list of flavors and cute colorful caketopper symbols indicating which flavors are currently available. Service is a trainwreck. Even busy, this place doesn't need 6 people behind the counter, their ordering and fulfillment process makes no sense. Made it to counter, placed order for one single dark chocolate cupcake, plated to eat on location. My name was taken and I was told someone would be with me in a minute. I'm not sure why the same guy couldn't just reach into the case next to us and hand me the cupcake. Paying for my order was hectic. Girl misprounced my name to get my attention, gave me correct flavor, on a plate, with no fork. After handing me plate, asked for my card. Awkwardly set it down, retrieved card, then had to reach again for my ID- for a four dollar purchase, after waiting nearly 10 minutes. Really? Finally snagged a seat to eat. Cupcake frosting was good. Cake itself was dry. Just because I ordered at 9PM should make no difference to the quality of your product. Cake texture and frosting texture didn't really work well together, due to the extreme dryness of the cake and the hardened frosting topping. Opted for a cake without sprinkles, wanting to get the cute circle symbol instead. When I ate it, I nearly chipped a tooth. Given the low quality cupcake received dining in while they were still open (and busy), I'm hesitant to try the cupcake ATM. Can't imagine they retain their moisture well in what must essentially be a refrigerator. Sprinkles, you have a great brand and clever marketing facilitating your business in an amazing new and highly-trafficked area. Step up your game in the kitchen and train your employees on efficiency!

YELP 365 CHALLENGE 2014-(94/365) "The Topping I Don't Like" After our ride on the High Roller, we decided to visit one of the most talked about businesses at the Linq, Sprinkles. I know nothing about Sprinkles except that female judge on Cupcake Wars is the creator, Candace Nelson, I think, or something cool like that. Still in their newly opened phase, there was a line out the door. but it moved pretty quickly. To the left, you can purchase cupcakes and retail items, and on the right you can purchase ice cream, cookies, and cupcakes. Some of the poor cupcakes on the ice cream side were melting as a result of the death rays of the sun directly on them. We got a Chai Latte, Cafe Cubano(Seasonal Flavor) and a Red Velvet. Being a salted caramel fan, I got a scoop on a red velvet cone to enjoy as well. The lady gave me a taste before serving me a cone to be sure I wanted that flavor. Their version seems to have a more generous dose of fleur de sel, but nevertheless, I still enjoyed it as the sweetness of the cone complimented the saltiness very nicely. Our cupcakes were all moist and the frosting flavors were not too overly sweet which was great...BUT......THOSE DARN FONDANT BUTTONS!!! They are like a sprig of parsley on a plate, a NFG...(Non-Functional Garnish) maybe make them out of chocolate because those things are pretty nasty tasting and like biting on a piece of hard plastic. I've watched people's reaction, and they either spit it out, try to take a bite of it without chipping their tooth, or simply set it aside....like a sprig of parsley. The ATM is a cool touch for kids, as I saw Chef Mark LoRusso and his daughters give the ATM a whirl.Prices are definitely higher than other cupcakes in town, but quality of ingredients and the name is why they can charge what they do. ALOHA!!! Shaka Meter: \uuu/ \uuu/ \uuu/ \uuu/ 4

The service was slow, but when I got my cookie ice cream sandwich all was forgiven! The location is so prime & great for people watching! I ordered the Chocolate Chip Cookie sandwich with Cookie Dough Ice Cream. WHAT is that even real life?! Your options are pretty unlimited here and EVERYTHING looks yummy. We sat outside and enjoyed our desserts! Try it! You will not be disappointed.
One time is enough for me. Place is all hype. Taste wise, other bakeries or homemade ones can be better. They are instagrammable, but they don't click to me palate wise. My opinion.

On the Las Vegas Strip, The Linq Walkway filled with stores, restaurants, and fun things to do in Las Vegas. The High Roller Wheel is located towards the end of the Linq Walkway depending on which entrance you enter. It is right next to the parking lot. They have fun restaurants like Sushi Burrito, Gordon Ramsey Fish and Chips, Chayo Mexican Restaurant, and Sprinkles. Sprinkles is one of the dessert places on the Walkway. Sprinkles serves Ice Cream, Cookies, and Cupcakes. You can go inside the store to buy your craving, but if there is too long of a line or you don't want to talk to someone, located next to the store is Sprinkles' Pink Vending Machine. You can buy cookies and cupcakes from the vending machine, but there's not a large range of flavors than ordering inside the store. My friend wanted a Cupcake for her break from work, so I went to Sprinkles. Unfortunately, there was a long line inside the store, but luckily the line at the vending machine had only one other customer. From the section they offered, I ordered the Red Velvet Cupcake. It came in a cute package and the cupcakes had a cute design also. My friend really enjoyed the cupcake. The flavors they serve depends on the day of the week so what you saw online might not be serve that day, so make sure to have back up.

Disappointed. I have been eating sprinkles cupcakes since the beginning. This red velvet had to be the most dry cupcake I've ever had. I can guarantee it wasn't made today. I don't know what's going on but sprinkles has gone down hill as it has spread the country. Cupcakes have gotten dry, smaller & the quality just isn't what it used to be. The icing was even slightly hard! So sad!

Whenever I go to the LINQ, I always have to stop by Sprinkles. I didn't realize how much I went to this place until I saw how many photos I had of the same cupcake. I always get a "Sprinkles Sundae" with their dark chocolate or sprinkle cupcake & dark chocolate or triple chocolate ice cream. I personally don't get anything more than that. It's expensive & I wouldn't buy a dozen, but if I want a quick sweet treat at the LINQ, it's good. They have a schedule for what flavors they have on each day so if you want something in particular, be sure to go on a day that it's there.

Sprinkles cupcakes have been my favorite cupcakes for years and still are! Every time I'm near a Sprinkles, I have to stop by! Located in the Linq promenade, I made my way here after losing some money gambling (cupcakes fix everything). There was a line with about 20 people for cupcakes. There was no one in line for their ice cream. One employee handed out menus so people could figure out what they wanted before getting to the counter. The next employee took the orders and boxed it up. The last employee worked the register. Super efficient! Don't be discouraged by a long line, it will move fast! If they are out of something you might want, just ask- they might have more in the back that haven't been brought out yet. It was cold out so I'm guessing that's why no one was ordering ice cream. It looks delicious though and I have to try it next time!

It may sound odd, but more often than not specialty cupcake places disappoint me but get me in every time. They look great, offer amazing flavors, but once you take a bite you regret your decision. This is definitely not the case at Sprinkles. I was drawn in by the pink walls and cute decor. I asked the woman assisting me if she preferred red velvet or black and white. Without hesitation, she said black and white. Sharing it with 3 of my friends I almost wanted to go back and get a second one for myself because it was so dang good. The icing is a little too sweet and too thick for the amount of cupcake, but I just scrape some of it off. The cupcake itself is so moist I don't know how they do it without making it too greasy. I've been back twice since then- which says a lot considering it's on the Strip which I try to avoid like the plague- and it definitely won't be my last.

Their kid scoops are delicious perfect sized portions for kids! The employees were extremely friendly And even gave our pup an adorable and presumably delicious puppy cupcake! Love this place Reasonably priced - especially for the strip!!

Tried this place for the first time ever since I've heard it about it for years but never got the chance to have. 1. The service is SUPER slow. I got a cupcake and the person behind me special ordered something so they passed me to get rung up. They took 10mins while I bought ONE cupcake and stood there waiting to pay. Would have been faster if the next 3 people paid through instead of waiting for these yahoos. 2. In the evening they run out a lot of stuff so get there early if you want a certain kind 3. They wrap a napkin around the top, I pulled it out of the bag and the top half fell off Overall, cupcake was amazing! But service needs to be faster ESP with 3 people working the front.

I got the chocolate marshmallow cupcake and a strawberry ice cream cone. The cupcake was moist and beautiful to look at, with dark chocolate ganache covered marshmallow cream above the dark chocolate cupcake. The ice cream was super creamy and the scoop was considerably large! They are open late which made satisfying my sweet tooth after a Vegas show possible and fulfilling. I am anxious to try the other flavors of cupcakes and ice creams! I did sample the dark chocolate ice cream and found it to be exceptionally rich and creamy. I also tried some of my wife's red velvet upscale, moist and flavorful for sure!

Great quick stop for a cupcake or some ice cream, especially if it reminds you of home! Well, kind of, since I never made it to their Newport location, my only experience was ordering boxes for special occasions at the office, and those were good, looking pretty and pretty expensive! So it was great to see an actual store, it's probably similar for other people, they have great arrangements for every occasion. Here they have a "no-line" counter on the left side If you only buy cupcakes, or you can stay in line for the ice cream and cupcakes on the right side. We were strolling on the strip, so cupcakes to go was the best choice for us. All the cupcakes look good, and taste awesome, so it's a matter of preference, it's probably best to get more and share them.
Its was yummy ! I got salty caramel cupcake , I should've get more IF ONLY the price is low but I understand it's cost cuz it's at the strip  lols

We decided to use the cupcake atm during a vegas trip back in December. You can go into the shop and order your snack, but where's the fun in that? It was one of those things that you have to experience at least once. You place your order, enter your payment and then you can watch the robot arms grab your treat from a computer screen. The machine emphasizes that no charges are made until your dessert is in hand. They come individually packaged in little boxes that have a sprinkles logo on it. My wife ordered a peanut butter cookie and i ordered a cupcake with a spiced butter cream frosting. Both were a good size and the price was reasonable. I hope to see more of these spots pop up in California. You'd have yourselves a regular if you did. They also have tables and chairs right outside which was convenient.

Sprinkles is well known as one of the OG Gourmet Cupcakeries, and the first to sell cupcakes via an ATM. As someone with a huge sweet tooth and a fondness for cupcakes, I was excited when Sprinkles opened their first Las Vegas location at the Linq promenade. Sadly that excitement was pretty short lived. After 4 visits, I can safely say that the cupcakes are just average. Nothing special about them, they aren't bad but for the price I expect a more moist and flavorful cake. I do love the frosting on the Salted Caramel cupcake though. For me, it's all about the Cap'n Crunch ice cream. It is the only thing at Sprinkles I actually crave, and can not find elsewhere. Sadly I can't even say that Sprinkles does ice cream well, as my husband got a scoop of strawberry and it tasted freezer burnt and ended up in the trash. Service has always been friendly at Sprinkles but I do think the entire ordering process could be streamlined to go quicker. Having separate areas for ordering cupcakes and ice cream is a good idea in theory, but when the ice cream area is packed and there are more employees than customers on the cupcake side that should indicate to management that staffing is off. When I am at Linq, chances are I will stop into Sprinkles for some Cap'n Crunch ice cream, but it isn't a place I'd drive across town specifically to go to.

I am more of a people person so getting my cupcake from an ATM seems novel and fun for the little ones, but personally I like my cupcake given to me by a real person. The cupcake we chose was the Triple Cinnamon one. It wasn't too sweet and quite moist. If I were in the shop, I think I would have picked up other flavours to try too!

I love sprinkles cupcakes. It's funny because I'm not a cupcake fan. There only a couple places I'll eat a cupcake from and Sprinkles is one of them. I was excited about this location opening up because I went to the on in Scottsdale, AZ and I couldn't stop thinking about the cakes. They are pretty pricy $3+ for a cupcake but hey it's Vegas and it's a name brand cupcake. I'm just not so keen about spending $50+ for 9 birthday cupcakes but that's just me being frugal. I don't mind buying a cupcake or 2 every now and then. The sprinkles sundaes are pretty good too. They put a cupcake in a cup w/ ice cream in it (you choose the flavors). Overall yay for sprinkles. :)

Okay, so the first time I've ever heard of Sprinkles is when it opened in Las Vegas. I know, I know, I'm "deprived" or whatever you'd like to call it. Anyways, I went to the Linq with two of my friends with the intention of trying Sprinkles for the first time! Whenever I go to a popular cupcake place, if they have red velvet ... then that will be the flavor I'll be trying. It also helps that people rave about it. First off, they kind of have a "schedule" of flavors for the cupcakes. Certain flavors of cupcakes are only available certain days of the week. There are a few, however, that are available all the time, which includes their red velvet and vanilla I believe. So if there's a certain flavor you want to try, make sure to check their schedule! Each cupcake is $3.75, which seems normal (kind of....) for one of these popular cupcakeries. What's great is that they even have a mini cupcake treat available for you to buy for your dog for $2.50. My friend actually bought one for her doggie :) Awwww. Also love the fact that the plate they give you and the fork/knife are all wooden! It's cute and eco-friendly! When I first took a bite of the red velvet, I'll admit ... it wasn't heaven. BUT it was really good. The cake was really moist and flavorful. The frosting was really sweet and heavy, but that is what you expect from a cream cheese frosting. Sprinkles is probably one of the few places that could make a red velvet cupcake correctly. I've tried a lot of different ones and not all are as moist as Sprinkles so yay! Now I'm a little interested in how their Strawberry cupcake tastes like. I had considered getting one but ... I wasn't sure if I could finish it or if my friends wanted to help me finish it boooo They also have a "Cupcake ATM" outside. From what I heard, it's supposed to be 24 hours? You can order their cupcakes and/or cookies from it. However, the prices of the cupcakes, from what I noticed, is about 50 cents more expensive. I guess because it's 24 hours? Or the novelty of it? If it weren't for the fact that it's on the strip, I would go to Sprinkles more often. Alas, for me, it's not worth the trouble.

Sprinkles is officially open! I was able to go to their sneak peek this past Wednesday as someone's guest and we were able to get four free cupcakes and two free scoops of ice cream. The outside of Sprinkles is so cute and I love that a Cupcake ATM exists. I definitely plan to make my way there during after hours for cupcakes. Just take my money! The inside of Sprinkles is just as cute and I love that it's stated on the wall by the cupcake area that they donate to local charities and food banks. Go you, Sprinkles! I got vanilla bean and salty caramel for ice cream flavors. They were both really good, though I had to cut the salty caramel bite with a vanilla bean bite to balance it out, but I knew that ahead of time which is why I got both flavors. The cupcakes I got were vanilla milk chocolate, peanut butter chocolate, chocolate marshmallow, and cinnamon sugar. With each bite I took, I was in cupcake heaven. I think chocolate marshmallow is my favorite of the four, but I think I'll have to repeat this experiment further. You know, for science. Tip: Double check what cupcake or ice cream flavors are available because not every flavor is available every day. As an example, orange cupcake is only available on Tuesdays.

Sprinkles cupcakes you're my best friend! Your vegan red velvet cupcakes are the most amazing cupcakes I've had to date. I always have to stop in while in Vegas and buy two! This location has a lot of different cupcakes but I've only experienced the V red velvet so I can't review the rest but they look damn tasty in the display case.

I think Sprinkles is the best of the cupcake chains. For the most part they are very consistent. This one is no exception and I had a strawberry cupcake and a black and white, just as good as the original location in NYC. I think what makes these cupcakes so special is the cake. The cakes are so flavorful and moist, I feel like they really stand out. The frosting is very basic, not in a bad way, but it makes the cake really shine. I will go out of my way to come here.....then I realized they have an ATM at the airport yum.

Sprinkles located in the middle of the strip!? Talk about dessert heaven especially with their cupcake ATM for late night sweet tooth's when the store is closed! I'm such a sucker for dessert and call me Queen of Desserts. I went to this location with a few friends and got the red velvet waffle & watermelon sorbet talk about balance. Haha I also had a bite of the chocolate and red velvet cupcake, which I wasn't too big of a fan of since my mouth was still stuck on the sorbet. Haha Overall, cute ambiance and great souvenirs to buy from in Las Vegas Sprinkles!

If you like cupcakes, you have probably heard about this place. My faves are red velvet, banana peanut butter and strawberry choc. I come here at least once a month, despite it's quite far from my house. I joined their perks online and yes it's worth taking your time to sign up. I got probably a dozen cupcakes out of this for free due to the amount I ordered , for me, my friends and coworkers. I mean... who doesn't like Sprinkles??? The parking sucks but once you step into the store, your worries will be magically gone. You will only see rainbows and unicorns along with the cupcakes. It's a 100% true.

They were okay. I follow them on instagram because i stay wanting to try new gf places. I went twice while in vegas this last time and they had the same option both times for gluten free. Lemon blueberry and red velvet. The red velvet was really sweet, a little spongy but doable. The lemon blueberry was nt what i expected. I got it out of curiosity and expected a blue cake. It was way better, think lemon cake w streusel with little blueberries strategically placed. Sooo good. I also tried the cookie, that was really sweet but good. I like the buttery flavor of the betty crocker box better but these have a similar taste. Overall pretty good. Expensive though.

The girls working the counter were really friendly and helpful. But management seriously needs to add more employees to the peak hour shifts. There was one girl working the register and only one other girl serving the orders. I came on a Saturday evening and I literally waited 30 minutes for an overpriced ice cream sundae because the line was so long. It felt like I was waiting for over an hour because the girls standing in front of me in line had the worst BO that I've ever encountered. The location is great and is adjacent to many other eateries and bars by the Linq hotel. While the shop itself is relatively small, there are several tables right outside for customers to sit and eat, which is convenient. If it weren't for the wait time, I would've given the place 3 stars.

Sprinkles cupcakes is such a treat! They have so many different delicious options as well as ice cream options! These aren't your typical cupcakes, I've went twice and not ashamed to say I've tried at least 4 different cupcakes and several ice cream samples. The peanut butter chocolate and cinnamon sugar are my favorite so far. They have different special cupcake flavors for each day and the staff is always friendly. If you see a sprinkles cupcake shop you should stop in, you won't be disappointed!

I am a cupcake-aholic, I admit it. It took me a while to get to Sprinkles, everytime I was at The Linq the line was obnoxious. But the sugar crystals were aligned tonight. Everyone was crowding around the cookies and ice cream which I also want to try but those Gods will grant me access another day. So we got a box of 4 cupcakes=$15 (pretty comparable to other cupcake shops), The Lemon Coconut, The Cinnamon- Sugar, The Dark Chocolate and the Chocolate-Vanilla. We also got a Pupcake ($2.50) to take home to our dog! We found them to be very moist and delicious, the icing wasn't overly sweet, it was just enough to add a little something to the cake. I'm not a huge chocolate fan, but the Dark Chocolate cupcake was incredible, I'd get it again. Friendly, helpful staff. I think they can get rid of those nonedible decorations on the cupcakes...USELESS! Can't wait to try more because I LOVE CAKE!

I love Sprinkles, I used to go to the one in Scottsdale and was super excited when I found out one was coming to Vegas. It's at the Linq so it's kind of a pain to go out of your way to get to, unless you're already there anyway. We already know the product, theses are my favorite cupcakes, but they also have Sprinkles ice cream. I haven't had it yet so I can't comment on it. Recently we walked by around closing time and decided to try the Sprinkles ATM after this group of chicks almost cleared it out. It's a touchscreen where you pick flavors, we went for red velvet and vanilla milk chocolate, swiped the card, and waited for cupcakes. The door opened and there was nothing inside. I was sad... I was sad and confused, so we pulled the guy who was moving chairs around and he explained there is a scale inside the machine so if no cupcakes came out the card wasn't charged. We tried it a second time and this time it said my favorite vanilla milk chocolate was out so I picked strawberry. We tried a second transaction, heard weird mechanical noises, and then saw an error come up on the screen. Since we're in IT, we found this highly amusing. The guy confirmed it was a mechanical issue and went in to get our cupcakes. He found a vanilla milk chocolate! I was so happy, and my card wasn't charged and I felt bad and we kept trying to give the guy cash but he said it was on them and kept apologizing cause we couldn't use the cupcake atm. Really really nice guy, great customer service, and I hope the atm gets fixed because I wanna pull cupcakes out of an atm.

***YELP 100 CHALLENGE 67/100*** I haven't had Sprinkles cupcakes since we moved from California, I've been to this location once but it was for their ice cream. I got an email for a free birthday cupcake so I thought I'd redeem it since I haven't had it in awhile. I guess the novelty has died down since it wasn't busy at all when we went. I got 3 cupcakes plus the free one: Chocolate marshmallow, S'more, Banana Peanut butter and Caramel vanilla at $3.75 each. Nothing really stood out, even the chocolate marshmallow which was once my favorite was just ok, I still like the bitterness of the ganache but that was it. The Caramel vanilla which was a suggestion by one of the girls tasted stale. Their specials for the month: S'more, dark chocolate cake with graham on the bottom and toasted marshmallow frosting was good but then again I like anything s'mores. The Banana peanut butter was banana cake with creamy peanut butter frosting wasn't memorable either. I'll probably be back at some point but there's just too many options out there to settle.

I'm in love with the Linq promenade. It is just so cool - all the bars, restaurants, shops. I believe there is a Sprinkles in Chicago, but never checked it out. I'm not a huge cupcake fan. The fancy ones always look so good, but end up tasting dry. However, the ice cream at this place is off the chain! Seriously, huge portions and so damn good!

My babies wanted to end the night with some ice cream and we obliged. We decided to get them kids Scoops because it was the end of the night. When we got it we thought someone requested a sample it was so small. We paid $2.50 for each kid scoop and when I tell you it was the tiniest scoop of ice cream on a tiny ass ice cream cone.

This place is just ok at best. I've had Sprinkles cupcakes before and wasn't crazy about them, but I wanted to try their ice cream anyway. I opted for a scoop of their salted caramel ice cream in a cup. I was warned by the guy at the counter that it was very salty. I asked for a taste and did find it on the salty side, so I asked for caramel sauce to make it sweeter and more caramel-y. The ice cream was ok - not terrible but not among the best I've had either. As for the caramel sauce, it was on the runnier side and I prefer it thick and more flavorful. There is plenty of seating outside but it was just too hot to sit out there on the day we went. Luckily there was counter seating on the cupcake side of the shop. (Ice cream is to the right when you enter; cupcakes to the left.) We had to wipe the counter top though - there were crumbs galore on it. It made no sense to me that they had a bunch of workers waiting to help on the cupcake side (most were not helping customers as there was a lull in foot traffic) and not one of them could wipe down the counter top. We returned later in the day with a friend who wanted to try their cupcake ATM, but it was out of service. This is one of those places where I can say that I'm glad that I tried it, but I don't feel the need to come back.

Tried out the Sprinkles in Vegas at The Linq which is on the Strip. Easy to find parking because it's near the Flamingo. Sprinkles FB sometimes has Bogo deals, I lucked out when I went they had a Holiday Bogo so Buy 1 ice cream get 1 FREE. I should have asked for samples, but I just went with the peanut butter cup ice cream $3.75 on a Red Velvet waffle cone $1 extra. B. got boring vanilla in a cup. B. also got a coffee but you have to pay on the cupcake side of the store. Tasted ok, nothing special. Cupcake ATM is outside.

This place is amazing! I got the Sprinkles Sundae. You choose a cupcake and then the flavored ice cream. I got the Triple Cinnamon Cupcake with the Salted Caramel Ice Cream. She let me taste the ice cream because it's a bit strong. I love salted caramel so it was perfect for me! Just so you know, the other half of the cupcake is at the bottom of the cup when you order a Sprinkles Sundae! I wish I could've tried more of everything! We got two cookies to go and everything is delicious!

I love this place. My boyfriend loves this place. My roommate says this is her favourite place in all of Las Vegas. In the interest of being upfront - I don't like icing. It's not Sprinkles fault, but it is what it is. That being said, I still love their cupcakes. (I usually choose ones like the cinnamon sugar flavour that doesn't have icing.) I've never had a bad cupcake from them. Their ice cream is also phenomenal. I've only had the cap'n crunch flavour, but it's so freaking good that I have no desire to try any other one. Their brownie sundaes are good, their cookie sundaes are good (get the snickerdoodle!), and their red waffle cones are good. You seriously cannot go wrong here.

Sprinkles offers some of the best cookies I've EVER tasted. Celiac sufferers, rejoice! Their gluten-free chocolate chip recipe is to die for, as the concoction results in a thick and gooey mound of sweetness that will leave you sad you didn't purchase twelve. Additionally, the shop offers an abundance of rich cupcakes and other tasty treats that will supply you with a supreme dessert experience. Conveniently located between numerous restaurants and venues within the LINQ Promenade, Sprinkles is the perfect place to grab a post-supper snack. Whether you choose to peruse their selection indoors or make a quick stop at their infamous 24-hour ATM, you'll be more than happy you took the time to grab a bite of deliciousness!

There's no such thing as a "lucky" blood sugar crash, but while walking around the Linq and riding the High Roller, my blood sugar took a sharp dive. Now, there is definitely no shortage of options, but I insisted on going to Sprinkles and fortunately there wasn't a line. A blueberry cupcake and some milk helped me make a delicious recovery. The cupcakes here are fantastic, the only problem I had was deciding which one to get, I wanted to try them all, sadly there's no way of doing that and maintaining your dignity. But I did take a four pack home with me, the cupcakes stayed good during the long summer drive and when I had the last one 5 days later, it was still delicious. Sprinkles' fame and reputation are well deserved!
