I just got Netflix over a week ago and saw the owner of sprinkles on Sugar Rush awesome show

I think the "Brand" makes them taste better than they really are. Don't get me wrong, they're good, but the price doesn't justify the taste. We came in tonight (a Tuesday) 10minutes before they closed. We grabbed our cupcakes 1st. The girl (Might be named Patricia, because that's what our receipt said (asian/Filipino)) at the counter seemed miserable. She slouched, didn't smile and was just such a downer. That was a bummer, because I was really excited that we made it in before they closed. I had promised my toddler a cupcake after dinner, but he ended up falling asleep before we got to Sprinkles. Anywho she kind of killed our excitement, but luckily the girls (Z Cupcak) over on the Ice Cream side were SOOOO nice, and got us back into an excited mood. They were so friendly like the Sprinkles staff we're used to. Our local shop is in Newport Beach and they are always great! We ordered the Capt'n Crunch flavored Ice Cream. The 1st bite was amazing, but unfortunately the Cap'n Crunch flavor didn't last through out the whole cone. I dont know if it was just me, but it ended up just tasting like vanilla after a couple bites. All in all it was a good visit because my son was happy with his after dinner late night treat. ............ Thank you to the girls on the Ice Cream side for being so "sweet", and making us feel like valued customers.

Their cupcakes and ice cream are okay. The hype is too real about sprinkles cupcakes. Everyone talks about how amazing the place is and how whenever someone goes to cali they have to come back with sprinkles. Now that it's here in Vegas and I finally got to try out what it's all about, my expectations were really high, yet I don't think they were met. They serve certain ice cream and cupcakes on certain days so make sure you keep an eye out for what day you're going. The cupcakes were kinda dry and I didn't really like the frosting on top. I've had better cupcakes and desserts. But this place is cute and have a friendly staff that's willing to help you no matter how busy it gets at the Linq. It's a great location though! Outside seating is fun since you get to see everything going on. I also like their clear glass walls and set up on the inside.

I had high expectations, possibly too high. I was so excited when I heard Sprinkles was coming to Vegas. Tried going to the one in LA, but there was a line and we didn't have much time. There was also a line outside this location, but we (along with others who were also waiting) didn't realize it was for the ice cream side only. We only wanted cupcakes. The "doorman" didn't help avoid this. Once inside, the people working behind the counter were chatting so loudly (there were about 4 or 5 of them) that the one taking my order couldn't hear me. After all that, the actual cupcake was just ok. For $3.75 a pop, I expected a little more. 4 stars for presentation 3 stars for flavor 1 star for service

I used to like Sprinkles cupcakes until today. I've been craving and excited for Sprinkles every time I visit LA & Vegas but this time maybe my palate has changed but the cupcakes and ice cream are too sweet. The salted caramel ice cream would've been delicious if it wasn't overly sweet. It had that salty goodness of the caramel but the diabetic shock from all that sugar made me feel sick. I opted for the peanut butter cup which was less sweet but was very rich. I couldn't finish the single scoop and forced myself to try to eat it all because I paid $$ but I couldn't do it. Onto the cupcakes... the cupcake itself was not that sweet but the cake was dry after a day. It was not in the fridge and left out but I suppose the cold weather made them dry. The frosting on the cupcake was borderline disgusting as it was American style buttercream. All that powdered sugar in the frosting made it have a chalky mouthfeel and the ratio to cake and frosting was unbalanced. It was way too much frosting and had to scrape off 3/4 of the frosting. The red velvet cupcake was good and the cream cheese frosting tasted delicious minus the chalky texture and mouthfeel. I had the holiday peppermint chocolate cupcake as well and I'll pass on that the next time bc it just wasn't that good. Overall cute decor but I'm disappointed:(

Pretty cool place, tons of cupcakes, cookies and Ice cream. I got the chocolate marshmallow cupcake, it was good but just wasn't what I was thinking. I was a bit bummed they didn't have the chocolate peanut butter cupcake, which I think I really would have enjoyed.

Sprinkles was right outside The Flamingo Hotel! I had had sprinkles cupcakes before in Chicago and they were amazing! This shop was spacious and had cupcakes and ice cream. The attendants were very friendly/helpful and everything was very clean. There is a Sprinkles ATM (vending machine style) outside of the shop but the store offers more flavors. My husband had never had sprinkles and is now obsessed. I got the Strawberry Champagne and he got a Red Velvet. Both were so yummy. The cake was moist and the icing was flavorful without being too heavy or over powering. I am sure we will be visiting the Chicago location more often now! If you have never had a Sprinkles cupcake you haven't had the best. Get you some!

This was the first time I've ever tried Sprinkles if you can believe it. I am usually not enticed by cupcakes but it was my mom's birthday so figured it was as good a time as any. We tried the chocolate marshmallow, lemon coconut, chocolate peanut butter, chai tea, chocolate sprinkle and lemon. My favorite was the lemon coconut since I'm a sucker for tart and fruity flavors. I was actually surprised that I liked them. I had low expectations but the cake was moist and had a great flavor. Per usual, I didn't care for the icing, but that's a personal preference. They kept well over the next few days and stayed moist.

I had to. I had to get a cupcake. I had to. And I ate the whole thing. Like I said, I HAD to. Got a coconut something or other. I don't remember the name. I just remember it being so delicious. I didn't share. It was all mine. Will go back again. This could turn in to a problem. They have a loyalty app too. Oh goodness there is no hope.

I never knew that Sprinkles sold ice cream!! I got the strawberry and was delighted by how refreshing it was. There was real strawberries in it and it tasted so delicious. My only qualm was the service. There were two girls working: one doing the register and one doing the orders. I understand that they were busy but I definitely waited longer then I would have liked to before getting my order taken. I feel that since the girl working the register finished fairly fast, she could have taken over scooping. They did tell me they would be with me in a minute, but it was on the longish side. Not the biggest deal breaker but definitely a pet peeve. Unfortunately I didn't get any cupcakes on this trip but definitely next time, along with trying their other ice cream flavors!

Frankly, I don't even know about all the hype or the national fame or whatever. I just went here on a friend's recommendation (and with a bunch of other people, but that's not so relevant). Sprinkles is next to a plaza of sorts within the Linq. I think the easiest parking is probably the giant outdoor lot on Winnick Rd. off Koval, and when you walk through that end of the Linq, you'll get a good view of the giant ferris wheel. The store is pretty nicely decorated, brightly lit, and clean so far. Aside from just following up on the recommendation, the crux of my visit was to capitalize on a sort of BOGO offer: buy a Cuban coffee cupcake ($3.75, standard price), whisper a secret passphrase (out of respect and because this is time-limited, I'll just say that it's on the national Sprinkles Facebook page), and get any other cupcake free. I chose dark chocolate on aforementioned friend's recommendation. Funny thing about a place named Sprinkles. They never asked me whether I wanted sprinkles on my cupcake. Only later did I learn that not only do the sprinkles not come by default (even though they're free), but the dark chocolate cupcake may be even better with the sprinkles, which are apparently more like flakes. Also, it seems that it's not the same person who takes your order as the one who takes payment, so I had to do that passphrase thing twice, which speaks to more communication issues. But let's end this on a positive trend: if you have a sweet tooth, you will love these guys. Cuban coffee was delicious, with the coffee flavor concentrated in the lovely frosting. Dark chocolate was also great, and definitely not too sweet (at least in the non-sprinkle form). And I got to try a bit of a lemon cupcake which was just vibrant with flavor. Good times.

Stopped in for some cupcakes with bae and friends. My friends actually weren't feeling rich cupcakes at the moment so luckily they also have a gourmet ice cream bar inside. I sampled the bubblegum ice cream and while it was crazily delectable (and in season) I still opted for my original intent and ordered the red velvet cupcake. I find it odd that they give you something so potentially messy without a fork or napkins, so I went back and asked for some. To my shock, they handed me a very interesting thin, wooden fork. It was odd in a cute/unique way, but didn't slide off the lips smoothly like a plastic or metal fork. Enough about the fork though - my cupcake was so good. The texture of the cupcake bread itself is very moist, and spongey. That's great cause there's nothing more disappointing than a dried out cupcake. The frosting is intensely sweet and rich. I find myself having to cut back a little on it to even out the frosting to cupcake ratio. The cupcakes are good - but they don't come cheap. Me and my boyfriend only ordered 2 cupcakes (sans beverage) and the bill was almost 8 dollars. They were sweet enough to give our cheap asses a free cup of water to quench the thirst that comes with eating cupcakes. Love Sprinkles Cupcakes for a once in a blue moon indulgence. PS, Neither of our cupcakes had sprinkles on them lol.

3 words: Lemon meringue cupcake. I'll save you the suspense and tell you that you need this in your life. Moist vanilla cupcake with lemon filling and a beautiful dome of meringue as it's crowning glory. I had 3 while I was in Vegas and I definitely would've gotten a few more if I had more time. The store is a cute little boutique of a place with staff that are always smiling. I wasn't really impressed by the variety of cupcakes (a little too "safe" for my taste) but I liked that they had mini-cupcakes for the calorie conscious (like my best friend) as well as some gluten-free and sugar-free options (again, for my best friend). Their red velvet mini-cupcake was good, but I could've done without the little crunchy fondant decoration. It didn't do much in terms of aesthetics... ditto for texture. I also tried a chocolate marshmallow cupcake, expecting something like a smore, minus the graham crackers. Not so much. Instead of coming together in perfect cupcake harmony, instead I tasted everything separately. The chocolate cupcake was nothing special, neither was the marshmallow filling. The best part for me was the chocolate ganache top. Coincidentally, the ganache top was so heavy in proportion to the rest of the cupcake, that when I tried to take it out of the box, the top broke off. Since it was definitely the best part, I ate that and threw the rest of it away. In a rush and need to feed your cupcake fix in a hurry? No problem! Sprinkles has a Cupcake ATM. Yes, you read that right. Instead of money, you swipe your card and get sweet sweet cupcakey goodness without the wait! This is the stuff of dreams, man!

We came here after the high roller at Linq, so my review may be tainted by alcohol. But one of my eating partners wanted ice cream so we stoped off at Sprinkles. Who knew that Sprinkles had icecream? We ordered an icecream sandwich which is hard icecream between two cupcake tops. I think it would be hard to hold it in your hands as they serve it in a cup with a spoon. We followed it with their mini cupcake samplers. The cupcakes were moist with a good cake to icing ratio. Delish all around.
Legit cupcake machine. These were dense, in a good way. Hearty cupcakes! Flavors were on point on my peanut butter cupcake. High quality ingredients definitely made this cupcake.

These were so darn good! Much better than Carlo's Bakeshop. They were super flavorful and moist. They weren't overly sweet. Just righty. We got the Coconut, vegan red velvet, rainbow confetti, and dark chocolate. I think my fav was the dark chocolate. That frosty was so rich and creamy. I wish I could have a right now! They need to put a Sprinkles in Miami like stat! Otherwise I have to travel to Orlando to get one! They also had Ice cream next door which I didn't not try as the line was log for that but it's an added perk!

I wanted to try Sprinkles for years before I actually did. So, when I finally bought a couple cupcakes from a location in L.A. at first I was like, that's it? That is because I tried the vanilla first. Later I had the red velvet and fell in love! I was so happy when I heard we were getting a location in Vegas. Finally! It def makes sense. Our location is the best. It's located at The Linq. Usually when something is on the strip, it seems like a hassle to make a trip to just the one location you need but the location is pretty convenient. If you park in the lot behind the high roller, it takes a couple minutes to walk there, so you can be in and out in less than 15 minutes if there isn't a crazy long line. The store is set up with cupcakes on one side and ice cream on the other. I tried the ice cream once, but found myself eating around it to get to the cupcake that was on the top and bottom of the scoop of ice cream lol. My absolute favorite flavor is Red Velvet. It's the best I have ever had. They have plenty of other flavors that change daily, but I stick with what I love. Another bonus, is the cupcake ATM. If the location is closed or if it's late and they are out of a certain flavor, you can go to the ATM! Not to mention, it's super cute buying a cupcake from it. It's a little more expensive, maybe fifty cents, because they charge for the single cupcake box. It's so worth it though. Sprinkles also offers delivery and curb side pickup from their app or website. I haven't tried either, but it seems like a nice option!

I was really excited to go to my first Sprinkles Cupcakes. The place that started the whole cupcakery trend and launched Cupcake Wars. I was excited to see their cupcake ATM and see what delicious goods they had. Sadly, I was disappointed. The store is open until about midnight and at 8pm it was picked over. The cupcakes were all very basic. Plain cupcake flavors with plain cupcake icings . I was hoping for some elaborate flavors, filled cupcakes with amazing decorations. I got a coconut cupcake because in Indiana, where I live, I get a coconut cupcake at my favorite place. This one was small, a plain white cupcake flavor with some coconut flavoring in the icing. I think I'm spoiled by The Flying Cupcake in Indiana which provides me a giant sized cupcake made of coconut angel food cake, filled with coconut cream, and topped with buttercream and coconut flakes. I wish I wouldn't have been disappointed but I was. The staff was friendly but I felt this place was way over rated

Red Velvet cupcakes are my kryptonite so obviously I had to check out Sprinkles as soon as I got to town... literally. Two Red Velvet cupcakes, and a mini Red Velvet later, I'm ready to give me review.... They were good, really good, but not the best. The regular sized ones were maybe a little dry (but not so dry as to stop me from eating a dozen more...) so if I'd paid for them (more on that in a minute) I may have been disappointed but probably not because it's still a dang good cupcake. The mini one I had, however, was bite sized perfection. If you're not a Red Velvet person, they have tons of other flavors which I should probably try sometime - I mean after all, I've never met a cupcake I didn't like. Beyond the traditional vanilla and chocolate, they bake up specialty flavors that vary depending on the day including Banana Peanut Butter (!), Chocolate Coconut, Cuban Coffee, Carrot, Strawberry, Cinnamon Sugar AND SO MANY MORE!!! Plus, they have seasonal ones like Pumpkin and for the month of May they are doing a special Margarita flavored cupcake. They sell the mini cupcakes for $2/each and the regular ones for $3.75 each. If you think that's too pricey sign up for the Sprinkles Perks program online (it's free) and just like that they will give you a FREE CUPCAKE! Then, they'll give you another one for your birthday. Just make sure to sign up for the program around when you'll be able to go because the free cupcakes do expire. If you're looking for something sweet and are a cupcake lover then you've got to check out Sprinkles. It's located on the Linq Promenade so it's not terribly convenient if you're staying anywhere other than Linq, Flamingo, or Caesars, but with that delicious cupcake waiting, it's definitely worth the walk! OH, and you can get Sprinkles cupcakes 24 hours a day with the only Cupcake ATM in existence - I think.
Famous in LA and now in Las Vegas! And now serving ice cream. Try the vanilla, red velvet and sprinkle cupcakes.
Ordered a strawberry cupcake, but received what turned out to be a spice cake with strawberry icing. Both were good, separately, but not what was wanted.

Yes, you need to go here. It's divided into two parts- ice cream and cupcakes. The shop is adorable, the choices make it hard to commit to just one, and overall this is a great pit stop if you're on your way to ride the Linq, checking out the happenings in the promenade, or just looking for a good cupcake.

I went here for my first time ever a few days ago. I love the location of it--right in the middle of everything in the Linq promenade. Such a cute little store and I had excellent customer service here by one of the employees--Geraldine. I got the captain crunch ice cream with red velvet brownies. Sooo delicious! Definitely recommend. My hubby got the red velvet default ice cream sandwich. No idea what flavor ice cream but it went well together. It had a picture on the menu. Overall, if you're in the area, check out this place for your ice cream cravings!

I love Sprinkles, no matter which shop I visit. I always have to stop in whenever I am near one! The Las Vegas one near the Linq promenade has the cupcake shop and ice cream shop, with the famous cupcake ATM on the outside. My favorite thing to get is the Sprinkles sundae with a cupcake and ice cream in the middle. They have an assortment of both to choose from so it is up to you on what to pair. They do have seasonal flavors so it depends on what time of year it is on which ones you will get to try. During October they had a caramel apple cupcake so I did a sundae, pairing it with the butter pecan ice cream. And of course I grabbed a smores cupcakle from the ATM on the way out! Both cupcakes were amazing and the ice cream was really good too. Definitely stop here when in the area. It is worth trying at least once.
Can't go wrong with a Cupcake ATM machine. These things should be everywhere. They should put them outside of the weed shops.

One thing that makes this place special is I think the way the market is great. They focus on having different items on certain days so people want to try all the different things here. One thing that's cool is where they cut the top off of a cupcake and put ice cream inside and put it back on so it's a cupcake ice cream sandwich. Cupcakes are really good and haven't tried them all but my favorite is the banana and the brown sugar praline and of course red velvet. One thing I hate are the lines here.other than that it's great "Cupcake ATM" it's nice to have this option if you want a late night cupcake when it's closed.

I mean, really, who doesn't love cupcakes? I'm guessing you probably do since you're reading this. If you don't like cupcakes you are crazy! Sprinkles doesn't disappoint when it comes to their cupcakes. They are tasty and feel like they are fresh out of the oven. They have different cupcakes that are featured every day and a few that are available every day. They also have season cupcakes. At this location they also sell ice cream (wahoo!). Their ice cream availability is similar to their cupcakes. I decided to get the sprinkles sundae. This is a cupcake with ice cream in the middle. I decided on vanilla bean ice cream and vanilla chocolate hazelnut cupcake. It really hit the spot and satisfied my craving. The downfall for a local is that it is on the strip, it would be awesome if they opened another location that isn't. But for now I'll take the trip to the linq for these awesome cupcakes.

Never again stay craving cupcakes late night 24/7 cupcake ATM is the best idea for the best cupcakes. Im not a sweet person but this place left me wanting more! Too bad they don't have one in Sacramento

Sprinkles! Aside from the fabulous name this place does not disappoint. It can get a little crowded but the line moves fairly quickly. I tried the captain crunch ice cream and it was SO GOOD. Between the ice cream, cup cakes and cookies they have a little something for everyone including mini cupcakes (so cute). Try it if you're in the area!

We stopped off at this cute cupcake shop on the way out the shopping area around the Linq (and the High Roller). We got a marshmallow filled chocolate (tastes like an gourmet hostess cupcake) and a black and white (chocolate cake with white frosting and chocolate sprinkles). They were both rich, moist and amazing! I didn't eat mine until we were back at the hotel and I was kicking myself we didn't get more. Plus they have a 24 hour cupcake ATM, which is just beyond cute!
What a cupcake and fun of buying it out of an ATM. The cupcakes where Delicious and moist. I highly recommend a stop at the ATM.

One of my favorite places to stop in Vegas for a sweet treat. Cupcakes are always moist with the perfect amount of frosting. My fave is the Red velvet (and I'm not a big choc cake fan & love the red velvet here). The cookies are solid too, but spend your money on the cupcakes is my advice. The ice cream is good, not Salt & Straw good, but above average and worth it if craving ice cream. The ice cream sandwich is a lot of food FYI! My hubby complains that cupcakes are overhyped cake & usually hates them, but even he found a soft spot in his heart for Sprinkles

While visiting Las Vegas I utilized their delivery service to have a dozen cupcakes delivered to my hotel. The online ordering process was seamless allowing me to select from a variety of flavors available on the day of delivery. The delivery price was more than reasonable and the cupcakes arrived punctually at the time requested. The cupcakes themselves were nicely packaged and taste amazing. All my friends thoroughly enjoyed them.
Oh man need I say more.... Salted caramel cupcake and red velvet cream ice cream oh get in my belly!!

I would really recommend sprinkles for dessert they have so many choices of cupcakes and ice cream me and my sister loved it. There are so many dessert places in Vegas sprinkles is the best one for sure I will definitely be there again **This review was written by my 8 year old

Sprinkles cupcakes are for the most part super good. Some of the flavors are significantly better than others. For the most part the cupcakes are pretty moist, which is always a plus if you're a "skip the icing" type of person. The icing has good flavor and isn't too sweet or too buttery. Which either of those is a serious flaw in my opinion. I was really impressed by the peanut butter chocolate, chocolate marshmallow and coconut. The peanut butter one is by far the best one. BY FAR. I was underwhelmed by the black & white and caramel chocolate (this was an off the menu item). The cupcake atm is really fun! Although most of the time there are more cupcake flavors available inside the store. But it's worth it to buy one from the atm at least once!

I really wish I could leave a 5 star review on this place, since I've been waiting to try these cupcakes since I first learned about Candace Nelson. If I had only tried one inside, then it would be 5 star, if I had only tried one from the ATM, it would be 1 star...so 3 is the average. Inside, the sprinkles cupcake was moist and perfectly rich, a great buttercream and sprinkle topping, and the staff was friendly. It was not even $4.00 for my cupcake. A bit later we were walking back to my car and I wanted to get one to go. The ATM only had four choices available, not the total number that the interior had. The cupcake was oily on the bottom, was dry, and the frosting was mediocre, and it cost 0.50 more than inside!

hot summer night need a sweet dessert to cap the weekend, what i ate: - coffee ice cream: cool and refreshing. like haagan daaz but more expensive cause it's sprinkles. - red velvet cupcake: delicious as always pros: - cupcake ATM! no need to wait in line - ice cream AND cupcakes - friendly servers - cute menus (really designed well IMO) cons: - always a wait for the hype - no inside seating. when it's 90degrees at night, you want AC. would i go again? probably not, as i'm not a native.

I'm in love with Sprinkles! The cupcakes are always so fresh and delicious. The staff is super friendly. At the Vegas location they have cupcakes, ice cream, and a 24 hr cupcake ATM. They usually have a rotating selection of cupcakes and they are always really fresh. The only suggestion I would make is to make more dog cupcakes bc every time I go they've sold out for the day and usually that's what gets me going to a Sprinkles. Also, if you have a dog they'll be addicted to the dog cupcakes they sell!

I been to this lil cupcake junt in California. I'm happy Vegas has one. Little cupcakes that taste yummy. They are not over priced. And you can get cookies & icecreme. The red velvet icecreme is boss. I give this place 4 stars.

Who doesn't love cupcakes? Nobody, that's who. If you happen to find yourself in Las Vegas in the new Linq area, drunk and hungry for cupcakes at 12am, you are in luck! After a fun ride on the High Roller we walked back through the Linq heading back to Las Vegas Blvd and what did we happen to see? Sprinkles! We decided that all of a sudden nothing sounded better than a cupcake so we went inside. There was a long line but lucky for us it was for their ice cream and not their cupcakes. We made out decisions, purchased, and sat outside to enjoy our cupcakes. Since it was Halloween/Fall they had a delicious looking caramel apple cupcake so that is what i had. It was good but nothing close to the best cupcake I have ever had. My friends felt the same about their banana and vanilla cupcakes. One of the coolest things I have ever seen was their cupcake ATM. Yes, it really is an ATM that dispenses cupcakes instead of cash. I rather have cash but cupcakes are a close second. If the line is long you might as well use the ATM outside since it is fun and gives you the same thing as inside.

I walked over to Sprinkles for dessert after dinner at Joe's in Caesar's Palace. The plan was to pick up a Red Velvet cup cake for right then and a vanilla cupcake for the next day - I plan ahead when it comes to desserts Lol! There are two doors for the shop. One for the ice cream parlor and one for cupcakes. I initially didn't realize that there were two entrances and waited in the ice cream line. Which was much longer than the cup cake line. They should really make the lines more clear. But now you've been warned - don't do what I did and wait in the wrong line. I finally get to the front of the cupcake line and *insert gasp* there are NO vanilla cupcakes! It wasn't really late at night, so I'm shocked that they let themselves run out of such a stock/common flavor. Not to be deterred from my dessert plan, I ordered two red velvet cupcakes. Considering this was a specialty cupcake spot the price seemed to be equivalent to other cupcake spots. So how did it taste? The cupcake was good, but not great. I wasn't unhappy, but I have definitely had better red velvet cupcakes. The icing seemed to be a buttercream and I am a strong believer that red velvet cupcakes should come with cream cheese icing. Moral of the story - Sprinkles is not my number one pick for cupcakes, but I wouldn't be insulted if someone gave me one.

I was excited when it was announced that Sprinkles was coming to Vegas. I used to frequent their Newport Beach location when I lived in California, and thought they were the best cupcakes ever!! So we waited a few months before coming here. I had heard from a few people that the lines were ridiculously long and that the cupcakes were not very good. I thought ok, maybe they just need some time to get their sh!t together. My husband and I finally stopped in after eating dinner at the Yard House and riding the High Roller. When you walk in, you will notice that cupcakes are on the left and ice cream is on the right. I ended up buying 4 cupcakes, but was kind of disappointed when I ate them at home. The cake wasn't as moist and the frosting wasn't as tasty as I remember. :( However, my husband ordered the sprinkles sundae, which was actually pretty good! Ok, so its just a cupcake cut in half with a scoop of ice cream in the middle. I don't know if the milk chocolate cupcakes were just fantastic that day, or if ice cream just makes them that much better. But I highly recommend the sundae if you are going to spend your $ here! Overall, I am disappointed that they are not as good as I remember. Customer service on the ice cream side needs improvement since none of them were greeting customers and it basically seemed like they didn't care. Plus, the location is inconvenient for us locals who don't really spend time on the strip!

Loved the Red Velvet Vegan cupcake! Of course it's not quite the same as "buttercream" but I believe he frosting was coconut butter based. The cupcake was moist and not overly sweet. Definitely a must stop for a vegan treat!

Yummy!!!! First time I have been to a Sprinkles that served ice cream. The kids had the ice cream sandwiches.... They were huge- too big we threw a bunch away! The cookies were good but I'd say stick to the cupcake ice cream sandwich. I had the chocolate cupcake with salted caramel ice cream. Yummy! It was the perfect size too...

Such a delightfully charming little spot on the strip! No boobs, no shots, no slots, but a naughty diversion of the empty caloric variety! After an amazing show at Brooklyn Bowl, we stopped in here for the first time. The staff were super fast and wonderfully sweet - pun intended - and the choices were overwhelming, albeit it limited as it was a quarter to closing (they close at midnight) and there were things they'd simply run out of on a Monday night. I opted for the mini Sprinkles Sunday, which is a scoop of ice cream, with a cupcake top. My flavor combo was strawberry ice cream, and red velvet cupcake. Sooooo nummy! Also, bonus points for carrying Weinhard Root Beer. It was an adorable and old-fashioned ending to a wonderful Monday night date!

Cup cake was pretty moist better then the ones that I had in LA. The frosting is still really think but hey if you love frosting then this is for you. I think the cupcake ATM is pretty cool. There is four seats inside and some outside but when it's cold you want to sit inside. Cost is $4.25 per cupcake.

I knew the reviews were pretty bad for this place, but I was at the Linq for my first time ever and I had to check out the cupcake ATM. I was surprised there was no line on a Saturday night walking up to Sprinkles. The store is small, one side is cupcakes only and the other side is just ice cream. I chose the triple cinnamon cupcake because the description sounded good. A lightly spiced buttermilk cupcake topped with cinnamon cream cheese frosting and dusted with cinnamon sugar, yum! The actual cupcake left something to be desired. The cupcake was dry and flavorless. For something that is supposed to have triple cinnamon, I barely tasted any at all. I love cream cheese frosting but this one was bland. How can a cupcake that sounds so yummy, be a total fail??!?! My friend got a double scoop of chocolate fudge almond ice cream, that was pretty tasty. I decided to get a kids cup of the Captain Crunch ice cream, and it was good, but I am glad I got a kids cup. The employees were friendly, but I don't understand their ordering process. It is quite silly to take my name when I am the only patron in there, and the same girl walk over to the other side of the counter and put together my order and collect payment. It's also weird that you can't get cupcakes from the ice cream side and vice versa. A sign would be a nice indicator of that, so people don't get confused. I wouldn't come back here again, but it was definitely cool to see an ATM that dispenses cupcakes!

Ambiance There are two different stores in one. One area is strictly for cupcakes. The other area is strictly for ice cream. There is a small amount of seating inside in the cupcake part of the store. The ice cream area does not have any seating. However, there are tables outside where one can sit and eat when available. In addition, there is a 24 hour ATM cupcake dispenser outside. Pretty cool item to have if one wants cupcakes. Food Living in the Bay Area, the ice cream is not available in the Palo Alto store. Their sundae where the cupcake and ice cream go together is amazing. Their cupcakes are always super moist and feel like they are freshly baked. Topping that with some good ice cream makes it that much better. Service This place gets pretty packed for ice cream. It can feel slow at times due to the fact that there can be a lot of people in line. Overall, the staff is friendly and the service is good once we are at the front.

Sprinkles Cupcakes are a nice treat. Really like the cupcakes with cream cheese frosting. When you go to this location be sure to get a cupcake sundae(cupcake cut in half with 2 scoops of ice cream) the ice cream here is delicious. Got a black and white cup cake with cookie dough ice cream and we got a red velvet cupcake with red velvet ice cream both are fantastic. My friend also got a ice cream cookie sandwich looked amazing. There always seems to be a line here and not much seating(would be nice to sit inside on a scorching Vegas day). Come here hungry too

Cupcake ATM??? OMG! I had to find this. I always wanted to go to Sprinkles ever since I've seen people post photos of their cupcakes and I heard about the place. But now that I heard about the ATM, the need magnified. Sprinkles is located in the outdoor Linq Promenade on the way to the High Roller. The ATM is outside by the Sprinkles ice cream side. It has a touch screen and is a little more expensive than if you purchase inside the store so buy one for the experience and get the rest inside. It was so magical after you pay and you wait for the door to rise and you see that small pink box in the white light. It's like heaven opened its doors. Yes, my heaven will be full of cupcakes. We got a red velvet cupcake which was surprisingly pretty moist considering it was probably already boxed and waiting in the ATM lineup to be bought. I didn't care for the fondant on their cupcakes but I guess it was more for decoration. They have two sides, one for cupcake sand one for cookies and ice cream. We didn't get to try anything else since we were full but next time we will. I finally got my Sprinkles! After reading reviews, I wish I got to take some home with me since it sounds like they keep pretty well. ******** Sprinkles cupcakes You have a cupcake ATM My dreams have come true!

Oh, Sprinkles, you were such a disappointment. Everyone raved about you. I love cupcakes. We were supposed to be a match made in heaven, but you were an awkward first and second date. First and foremost, there are two doors: Ice Cream Orders and Cupcake Orders. If you order only cupcakes, you can enter the other door (I was smart enough to ask). As it was about 11 PM at night, the line was still a bit long and the cupcakes were sparse. The counter staff was friendly, pleasant, and informative. I like that Sprinkles offers both traditional, vegan, and gluten-free options. I like that there is a Cupcake ATM for afterhours cupcake delights. I guarantee the drunken, twacked out people watching is 24k gold. Sprinkles is overhyped and overpriced. #sadcupcakeface

This is the first time I've gone to a sprinklers cupcake and I cream spots it also has the outside vending machine for cupcakes. All of their ice creams have the ability to be mixed with their cupcakes. We did a cupcake top ice cream sandwich. The prices aren't too bad for Las Vegas and the service was fast. There's tables to sit outside as well. They also have a line of cookies. All around good place to try.

I ordered delivered cupcakes for a friends birthday celebration. Not only were they packed so nicely but they were absolutely delicious. I hadn't been to Sprinkles in years and forgot just how darn good these cupcakes are.... by far you remain the next.

Here is the thing: Sprinkles ice cream was hyped up so much to me before the visit so I was quite excited to arrive here. Sprinkles is a good place to go when you are craving sweets and is in the vicinity, but I personally would not go out of my way to go to them. To be sure, the cupcake ATM was way cool, and the red velvet waffle cone was novel and quite alright. The ice creams, while having a slightly better-than-average texture, were cloyingly sweet. They have these fun things you can do with the ice cream (i.e. cupcakes with the ice cream), but I had to opt not to do so because it seemed as if doing so would be sugar overkill. The cupcakes were delicious and sweet, but adding the cloyingly sweet ice cream on top of that was too much even for my sweet tooth. Had they been a little cheaper, I would give them a 4-star rating. But as it is, if you want good desserts, you would probably do better to go elsewhere. But if you were in the area, you should definitely check them out. I know I would.

Really good cupcakes. Really expensive cupcakes. Deducted one star for cost/benefit. I enjoyed the cupcakes that I tried and even brought home an half dozen. Traditional and unique flavor combinations and a very dense cake batter mix make for a rich and satisfying cupcake. The fact they are almost $4 a piece (and they are about the size of a standard cupcake; I realize that's a subjective statement, but think of a cupcake wrapper you buy at the grocery store, same size here) make for a double take. My favorite was the chocolate and peanut butter combo. That and the chilled $3 bottle of 8.75 oz of Pellegrino was a nice respite from the Vegas heat. The store also has an ice cream section that I did not try. Based on the cost/benefit analysis in my head, I probably won't.
My daughter was (slightly intoxicated) and SO excited for this cupcake ATM. It was so cute to make her smile and this giddy for $3 (or whatever it cost).

My FAVORITE cupcake place, they always have an array of cupcake flavors that are delicious. I live in La Mesa and I drive up to La Jolla to get these cupcakes. The employees are always very friendly and are smiley and helpful when you ask about choosing a flavor. I was also offered a sample of ice cream that was delicious, I think it was the red velvet. It is nice that they have a vegan and gluten free option as well because my brother is a vegan and my best friend is gluten free. They both told me that the vegan and gluten free cupcakes are flavorful and delicious. My only complaint would be that sometimes the icing is hard and I don't like that but I don't know if they can help that especially when they are busy, if you are in the area I would definitely recommend coming here!

So I finally got the chance to try Sprinkles. It was the Saturday of EDC week and we were came to the Linq to return something when I saw the Cupcake ATM and thought, well why not. I went over to check it out and it looked super sun damaged, so we went inside instead. It was so hot outside we ended up getting ice cream first. I decided to get the capt crunch and salted caramel. They were kind enough to offer a taste of the salted caramel before they served it. Something about it being really salty. So I tried a little and just decided to go for it. I also ordered a red velvet cupcake to go. We grab what seats they had and just started crowd watching. As i said it was EDC week and all the color outfit were out and getting ready to get on the shuttle. It was nice to sit inside with the ac and just grub on something cold. We grabbed the seat in front of the cupcake side. There were only 4 seats inside. I would think they might want more.. They have tons of seats outside but who wants to sit in the sun and have your ice cream or cupcake frosting melt. Not I. After finishing part of my first scoop i deiced to dig in on the salted caramel. I realized after a couple bites why they had me try it. It gets saltier as you eat more. I finished the capt crunch with sprinkles but not all the salted caramel. I want to go back on a day the have lemon available. They only have certain flavors on certain days which i think is pretty cool, unless you go on the wrong day. All in all when I'm at the Linq on a hot day I'll defiantly run in and grab ice cream and maybe a cupcake to go.

Cute little shop! Cupcakes are a bit overpriced and they only have a select amount of flavors based on the day. The location is a major plus because it's in the middle of the Linq. I brought a friend that was gluten free so I wish they would expand their menu so it was gluten free friendly. My favorite cupcake is the coconut cupcake but unfortunately it was unavailable the last time I had come.m!

Personally, I don't think its worth the hype. Everyone always talks about Sprinkles but I've just never really cared enough to go. We were walking around to check out the High Roller when I noticed they had Sprinkles here. The ATM outside was pretty darn cute though. I was going to get a cupcake, but the line was pretty long & so we went to get ice cream. I got red velvet, My boyfriend got Captain Crunch & my brother got strawberry. The red velvet was okaaaay, nothing too special. My boyfriend looooved his Captain Crunch. He said it felt like he was really eating cereal. I thought it would be expensive too but it was about 3-something for 1 scoop. Not too shabby I suppose.

This is a must anytime I'm near one!!! I live in Michigan so when I'm in LA, Vegas or Chicago I also buy the pre maid cupcake mix to take back home . Love there cupcake flavors and LOVE LOVE LOVE creating my own ice cream sandwich. The oatmeal cookie is so salty and I love paring it with strawberry ice cream. Let's not exclude the fur babies either, they love the mini doggie cupcakes!!!

We walked 2 miles to try their Red Velvet Vegan cupcake only to find out they didn't have any.. Very disappointing! Update: My husband and I went back and they had Vegan Cupcakes in stock. The cupcake was delicious, not too sweet which I really liked. I do wish they had these in Colorado..
Best vegan cupcakes I ever had! Coconut cream frosting and red velvet cake, absolutely a must. I don't eat cupcakes often, but if I do, this is the place. Stay sweet my friends.

Sprinkles is the specializer in making gourmet cupcakes. This is the cupcake haven for sugary goodness in a tiny little bite. The themes and concepts are well executed, and unique to this type of business. I wanted to try one cupcake to get the idea of the taste. I ordered myself a Black and White cupcake for sampling (it was not free). The cake portion was perfect-moist with good flavor, yet not overbearingly sweet. The frosting in my opinion was a little too thick and very sweet. I had to scoop some off to the side to truly get a bite of the cake. Try signing up for their rewards program, it might come in handy for any celebration. Service was excellent and I was greeted. Hope I can try some of their other cupcake flavors!

I found this outlet whilst wondering past it to go to another restaurant. I remember hearing the name from a tv show called Cupcake Wars. Candace Nelson is the owner and her claim to fame is opening the world's first cupcake bakery. There was both a cupcake and ice cream store next to each other. Although an ice cream was tempting I went with a cupcake. The service was nice and the lady serving was very helpful. The flavour I chose was a Lemon Coconut Cupcake (madagascar bourbon vanilla cake with lemon coconut cream cheese frosting). It didn't have the bling of most cupcakes nowadays but that didn't matter. The cupcake was so moist and crumbly and the frosting was delicious without being too sweet. The shreds of coconut were lovely too.

HEAVEN! Soo, I was expecting the Cupcake ATM, but when my boyfriend pointed out the beautiful store, let me tell you I felt like a child whose just walked into Disneyland. Im so happy I finally got my hands on a cupcake! They're so rich and moist but yet the sweetness isn't too over powering. Not much to say except you need to try one.
It looks pretty, but taste alright. It was just a little bit to sweet for me. I got the rocky road ice cream on the red velvet cone and it tasted like diabetes.

Had REALLY HIGH expectations. We tried 4- Lemon Blueberry, Red Velvet (biggest seller), Strawberry and Chocolate Marsh-mellow. The Lemon Blueberry was very good and fresh tasting. Red Velvet was also good-had some subtle hints of oatmeal (or so I think) that gave it a nice aftertaste (in my opinion).The chocolate marshmallow was not good in my opinion. The strawberry one was ok- but Im not a huge strawberry fan in desserts (my best friend on the other hand loved it). Overall I think they all had the right amount of moisture but a little too much frosting so eating one all by itself is pretty hard (too sweet). Highly recommend a glass of water or milk if you plan to dig into one of these.

One of my fav. Cupcake shop!!! I'm so glad they open one here.. But wish it's not on the strip, so inconvenient to drive and park just to get some cupcakes. I hope they open another location on the southwest..hehe(closer to home). Tried a lot of different flavors and the only one I and my kids love most is the banana. I haven't try the ice cream yet, one of these day I'll. Don't buy the bring home and bake, it's not the same and a Waste of money!! Taste nothing like the ones they make in the store.

Delicious cupcakes! My kids love the cupcakes here a lot. This is our first time visiting this place but won't be last. I like the cupcake atm idea. It was pretty ordering cupcake from theough the ATM.

I'm pretty disappointed that I chose a cupcake without frosting. It appeared like it had frosting, but it apparently doesn't (the cinnamon sugar cupcake). A cupcake without frosting is a muffin! Additionally the muffin wasn't soft and spongy. Customer service was great.

Dessert is my weakness and Sprinkles doesn't disappoint. They have more then cupcakes, they also have cookies, ice cream, t shirts etc. Not to mention the late night cravings ATM next to the building. Which I had to try out for myself ! Try the Lemon cupcake it's my favorite!

Whoever doesn't give this place 5 stars is off their rocker. (And that comes from a professional psych nurse ;-) Perfect cookies. Ice cream samiches :-) Devil's food cake cones. Amazing cupcakes. It's the almost too sweet but not quite sweet enough perfection. Decadence in its finest.
FYI- vegan cupcakes. Only one flavor though. It was delicious in so many ways. I would give Sprinkles 5 stars if they had more vegan flavors.
I really like this strawberry sorbet flavor ice cream!You can see real fruits in it,not too much sweet.But the waffle is so much sweet.I will have a try other flavors on Wednesday.

This is a pretty cool location nestled near the High Roller and the Link. They will soon have a new neighbor with In N Out opening soon. This place can get very busy in the summer, but today it was rather quiet and only one person was working, hence the line moved very slow. I decided on my favorite, the salted oatmeal cookie. Hands down the best cookie they carry. Has a great chewiness and a touch of saltiness on top. I do enjoy the s'mores cupcakes, but decided on sticking with the cookies this time. I'll be back.

I love cupcakes so I had to come try Sprinkles.... Ordered 5, peanut butter (was awesome!), salted caramel (another win), sugar free red velvet (excellent), vanilla cupcakes (loved it), water bottles were less than $3 each (win win)... Now the reason for only 3 stars... Lemon cupcake, a total flop. Had zero lemon flavor and although they were tasty none could stand up to the cupcakes at my local place, Gimme some Sugar here in Henderson. Overall a good experience, especially for a place located in a tourist trap.
The vegan red velvet was super satisfying. I didn't care for the red "V" on the top. The actual cupcake was heaven!

There is a reason Sprinkles is known far and wide for their cupcakes. Delicious! There is a wide variety of cupcakes and each is baked and iced to perfection. Another fun thing is outside of this location, there is a cupcake ATM that you can order from and receive in a box from a machine. In addition to their great cupcake selection, they have a variety of ice cream options. From a cupcake sundae, to a cookie sundae, to ice cream sandwiches, the options are seemingly endless. The ice cream flavors are very rich and well done. I personally recommend the vanilla - it's so simple, but do much better than your standard vanilla ice cream. The service was great and the prices are pretty reasonable. If you're in Vegas, you must stop at Sprinkles! Pick up a box of cupcakes for the folks back home.
The best dark chocolate cupcake ever. Bad it for desert with an espresso last night. It was a great way to cap a night.

I don't really like cupcakes but I love ice cream, so decided to try the Sprinkles ice cream cupcake hybrid to see what all the hype was about. I have a huge sweet tooth and can tolerate most sweet things very well (and very happily), but this was way too sweet. It was to the point where one bite instantly made me feel parched - I think it's the mountain of frosting on top that did me in.
Omg! Red Velvet to die for! Lol ... Pure yummieness. I will be back asap! Friendly employes. Very clean and organized location. I cant wait to come back!

I'm not much of a cupcake person. I initially came here for the ice cream but I was lured in by the nice presentation of their cupcakes! I had the banana cupcake with vanilla frosting and it was pretty good! Had a deal on my receipt for a buy one get one free offer for cupcakes, cookies or ice cream that I used before I flew back to seattle. The seasonal flavor, apple pie ice cream was beyond outstanding! Will come back no doubt!
I ordered the red velvet cupcake. It is tasty and deliciously calmed my sweet tooth. When I return to Vegas, I'm definitely returning to get some cupcakes.
Mmmm sugar! Pretty cool little spot on a back alley off the strip. They have a cupcake ATM?! Nice! Super sugary desserts and a bit pricy, but you might as well ball out while you're in town LOL.

I could have just read my food twin, Jessica M.'s review, and known better. But did I? NOPE! Fail, major one. I have had two Sprinkles experiences. First, my wonderful boyfriend surprised me at work one day with mini cupcakes and fresh cookies. Like almost still warm, so fresh. The cookies were amazingly good. For sure one of the best I have had. But wait, I thought Sprinkles was a cupcake place? My coworker and I split the minis and they were decent. But did not compare to the cookies. My second experience was after a super cool Yelp event. A few of us decided to try this place for a sweet spot. I got a cupcake, some ice cream, and a few cookies togo. The ice cream, nasty. DID NOT LIKE AT ALL. The regular size cupcake. Eh. It was ok, but not worth the price or the fame. I actually enjoyed the minis more. The cookies the second time around, also eh. They were not as fresh and didn't live up to the previous enjoyment I once had. Is Sprinkles a way cool addition to the Linq area and the wheel? YES. Will it bring in a shit ton of money? HELL YES. Will I return? Proabaly not when there are quite a few mom and pop bakeries with better prices off the strip. This place is great for some, just not for locals. If you are a tourist, go get yourself a $5 cupcake out of the cupcake ATM. That's the cool part, not the actual product.

I have pretty high standards for cupcakes, as a friend owns her own cupcake business and hers are second to none. I've also had not-so-good cupcakes at another Sprinkles, so I was half hesitant to try this location. I'm glad I did. They really redeemed themselves. The last one I had was dry with hard icing. I had a pumpkin cupcake at this one and it was moist (sorry, moist-o-phobes) and the frosting, though thin, was rich. The flavor was spot on. While it wasn't nearly as good as the ones my friend makes, it was worth what I paid for it and it made up for bad experiences in the past. My husband had the chocolate marshmallow and said his was great as well, but his taste buds also might not be as discerning as mine! While it's not a necessity to stop here in Vegas, it was nice to have at the end of the night for a little sweet treat.

I could not have been more disappointed! My friend and I were SO excited to have the famous Sprinkles cupcakes while on vacation in Vegas this week. We each ordered 2 different flavors and couldn't wait to dig in...what a waste of money! All of them were the same quality...we both said they tasted like week-old, stale cupcakes that wouldn't have been good when they were fresh. The frosting was too rich (which for me to say is something) and the cake in each one was dense, crumbly, just unpleasant. We are both huge fans of desserts, especially cake and cupcakes and both of us ate only about a third of each of the cupcakes before we sadly threw them away. We both agreed that we have had MUCH better cupcakes from our local grocery store. They are obviously just riding on their fame and know they don't care if they have return customers. So disappointed.
Sprinkles is great I just wished it was in a more convenient location. Getting to the area sucks but the cupcakes wonderful.

Wanted to give it 1 star but couldn't. Help says they close at 6. I just called and the time is 5:36 and their preformed message says that "our bakery is now closed". Bummer. This is Vegas!!! Why do you close so early??!!!
This Linq Promenade Sprinkles has the signature cupcake ATM to go with their overrated cupcakes, but we at least had a Sprinkles perk to ease the pain of a mediocre gingerbread one.

I love JANEY AND V they helped me so much with my dietary restrictions. These cupcakes are the best! I got the vegan cupcake. These girls are the best workers I've ever encountered in Las Vegas. They are very helpful and sweet when helping me in the store.they are beautiful and elof a di love them if they don't get a pay raise I'll be sad

Triple Cinnamon is a 3, Red Velvet is a 5 so an average of 4. Red velvet was delicious, moist and cream cheesy=perfection. The triple cinnamon was a bit crunchy on the outside and doughy on the inside. It didn't seem to be baked correctly. The flavor was good, as was the frosting. They stop baking at 10 pm so if you want a good selection get there before then. Also during the day the ATM only had one flavor available. I assume it's better stocked when the shop is closed?

Want a sugar rush, this is the place. Cupcakes are good but pricy for some cupcakes. I bought 2 mini cupcakes for my daughters and of course they loved them with all the frosting! You pretty much pay for the name.

I love Sprinkles Cupcakes! I've been to a couple different Sprinkles locations (San Francisco & Near Napa). The other locations seemed to have more options for people with dietary restrictions. The red velvet was the only flavor offered at this location. Normally the gluten free ones change between chocolate and vanilla. All other flavors are on a schedule and some are offered everyday. Delicious! The cupcake was flavorful, cake was light and moist, while the cream cheese frosting complemented the cake part really well. I would like to go back tomorrow for a cupcake...we will see.

First time trying Sprinkles, I had high expectations for this place. The cupcakes are good but not the best, maybe because I prefer the frosting to be not so sweet. The cake is great but if the frosting was more of a butter cream, it would be perfect!

I read about the Sprinkles ATM months ago and somehow missed it on our trip in October. When we came back for Christmas, this was at the top of my 'must visit' list. The ATM is to the right of the shop doors and oddly the few times we passed it, there was never anyone using it. The shop was packed inside and so I was quite pleased. The machine itself is very easy to use and you can see what supply levels are like. I used it at night and loved how the area that your cupcake arrives in is all lit up. I tried the chocolate marshmallow and it was divine. The chocolate taste was super rich and the little dollop of marshmallow in the middle was perfect. I think it came to $4.25 and so it sounds like you might pay a bit more to use the machine? There are plenty of tables outside though and so you can grab a treat and enjoy it immediately. I would definitely recommend visiting!

I really tried to love this place but I'm not a fan. I went here a couple of times to see if I would change my mind on the cupcakes but I was not impressed the first time and I wasn't impressed on the second time. The cupcakes are just typical. Nothing impressive about them. It looks good on the outside but bland on the inside. Kinda like when you see a hot guy and then when you finally get to know him, you wish you didn't . lol And they also sold these mini cupcakes the size of my thumb for almost $3.00! seriously? We ordered one of their drip coffees. I thought that was the best..
Love coming back to this sprinkles! Freshest and most moist cupcakes ever! Love their cinnamon and vanilla cupcakes! Love their boxing and packaging. Perfect for portability.
I had the cinnamon cupcake and chocolate chip cookie cupcake. Both were really good, though I thought the price was a bit steep. Service was good. Great location.

I've heard on more than one occasion that "Sprinkles Cupcakes is just a fad" "They're not that good" "Just another chain" Um, I'm sorry but if someone's says that to you, unfriend them. You don't need that kind of negativity in your life. THESE CUPCAKES WERE TO DIE FOR. Moist. Fresh. Perfect amount of frosting. Not to mention pretty to look at. I was introduced to these cupcakes by two big burly men. That has GOT to say something! And the fact you can make a cupcake ice cream sundae is a freakin' game changer. Excuse me while I locate a Sprinkes location near me like, now.
Amazing cupcakes! My favorite was all of them! Even vanilla was good!!! The cupcake ATM was cool and cupcakes tasted just as fresh as if ordered from inside.

Holy moly these are the best cupcakes I have ever had. I don't even know how to explain how good these cupcakes are. I am not a sweet tooth kind of person but when it comes to these I am all about it. They are perfectly moist inside and the frosting is so eloquently placed on top with the perfect amount. Personally, I prefer the cupcakes that have a cream cheese frosting but I've had both. Since I've been in Vegas this week my husband and I have had the carrot cake, salted caramel, cinnamon, and a mini trio of raspberry chocolate, vanilla, and red velvet. You have to go get some!!!
Best cupcakes in town! Get yourself a 6 pack. I recommend salty caramel red velvet and Gingerbread. But I only know everything. Saddle up hass!

Going into the place the people were nice and the line was long. But... Since they don't close till 12am wouldn't the amount of cupcakes be replenished? There were very few cupcakes left... The major issue would be that at checkout while paying I heard an employee ask if she should bring some out from stock. So there are more to choose from then 4 different ones... Then to my surprise the person, whom was asked if she should restock the shelf, replied with a "not yet". A few people in line who were in front of me and behind me were wondering why there were so few and though they seemed a but down about the lack of selection I was disappointed for the lack of customer service in the stocking side of things; which VITAL sales and the Las Vegas experience...

Sprinkles Cupcakes is the CUTEST cupcake/ice cream place in Vegas. I tried the red velvet ice cream and It was SO freaking good. It was made with butter cream and had huge chunks of red velvet cake in it that made It extra yummy! They even have a cupcake ATM, which makes it definitely something to hype about. If you have a sweet tooth and love homemade cupcakes and ice cream, you must try out this place!

As someone with mild celiac disease, there wasn't much I could get here. In fact, there was but only one sweet I could take to: their red velvet gluten free cupcake, conveniently stamped with a red, bold capital "G" to draw distinction between its wheat laden counterpart, as all of their cupcakes and cookies contain wheat gluten, alike. At $3.75, it wasn't the pricing that marred me, but rather the quantity of tablespoons of sugar in the frosting. It was simply too sweet for me, and that's coming from someone with the sweet tooth the size of Texas.

First time at a Sprinkles! Very cute shop. I like the location. The girls working were extremely nice and helpful. Love all the cupcake choices... It made for a very difficult decision. I went with the banana cupcake with vanilla frosting. It was divine! The cake was perfectly moist and not-too-sweet. The icing, although pretty sweet, was not plastered on super thick. It was just right. I would definitely return! So many others to try. $3.75 is a bit steep for a single cupcake but hey, it's VEGAS BABY!

I wanted to try their sampler deal, which includes 3 mini cupcakes for $5. When I asked he worker, she said, "sorry we ran out." But I clearly saw a lot of minis on the display. I looked and her and was like, ".......?" Then one of the other workers said, "we can do it." So then she said that I can now get the cupcakes. I went in at 12 am, but they closed at 1 am. They were already closing down and putting tables away. I felt rushed while I was eating my cupcakes on the tables, because they were putting away everything around me including the rest of the tables and chairs. My cupcake was a bit dry.. and I got the vanilla mill chocolate one. I have been to the Sprinkles in Glendale, CA.. and that one was way better than this one. I also ordered the mini sundae, which was ice cream sandwiched inside a mini cupcake. The red velvet cupcake was moist.

I love love love Sprinkles Cupcakes! So glad they came to Vegas. Great staff, clean space and quick service, what else could you ask for? One thing I did notice people complaining about was that there isn't much seating, but then again, how long should I take you to actually eat a cupcake, even when you're taking your sweet time? Very flavorful and moist cupcakes with great options everyday

Located in the LinQ, nice store front with clean interiors. Outrageously priced cupcakes at almost $4 each. I love their choc decadance which I shared w/Hubby and ate at their counter. Friendly staff. They sell canisters of their cupcake mix for $14, same price you'd find at Williams-Sonoma stores.

Don't hate me but I much prefer a cookie or a brownie over a cupcake but I have to tell you right now that if I must have a cupcake...I'm going to Sprinkles. Luckily there is a location in Chicago!!! When I woke up on my first morning in Vegas, I saw the new High Roller Ferris Wheel and thought it was the coolest thing I have seen on the strip in a long time! My colleague and I were looking for something to do after dinner one night and he suggested the new Ferris wheel. I didn't really realize the shear size of it until I got closer. I think it was about half way down the Linq right around Sprinkles. I made a mental note of the place on our way to the Ferris wheel and after our insane ride up there, I needed a little something sweet to nibble on so I suggested we stop at Sprinkles on our way back. He had already eaten dessert so I was on my own, but didn't hesitate to walk in here to explore what they have to offer. I noticed an array of ice cream flavors and the line out the door for the ice cream and I jumped in line for a cupcake. I glanced at what they had left and since I couldn't decide what to order, I went for the classic Black & White....a chocolate cupcake with vanilla icing and chocolate sprinkles. I asked for it to-go and received it in a brown bag with a wooden fork attached with a sticker. It was adorable!! I actually had to take a photo on site. The girls behind the counter were just as sweet as can be. They were so kind and friendly. These are the kind of customer service people that belong in a cupcake shop!! All smiles, giggles and they knew cupcakes!! Trust me, I quizzed them. ;) I also grabbed a bottle of water while I was there and my total was about $5 or so. Not bad for a quick snack on the strip! When I got back to my hotel room, I ate my cupcake in bed like a little kid. It was delicious. Very fresh, but there was a slight bit too much frosting, if I have one complaint. I will definitely hit up the cupcake ATM in Chicago next time we're in the city. I have heard all about it from friends and now that I have experienced Sprinkles, I gotta take the hubs!

The HYPE is real! Lol I actually really like this place, although my random craving for sweets is rare! Cupcakes and Ice Cream! What more can you ask for?! Had a scoop of the Cap'n Crunch (available all days of the week) in a Red Velvet Cone! Not too sweet, lil crunchy pieces in the ice cream were delicious! And the cone was amazing, only because I love anything red velvet! Lots of flavors (both cupcakes and ice cream) to choose from! Line gets long but worth the wait! Great place to check out especially if you're enjoying the new spot in Vegas, The LINQ!

Pros: if you never tried their cupcakes... They are super delicious! My classic favorite is red velvet but you almost not go wrong with any flavor to include pumpkin and strawberry. The staff girl there was super cheery and ecstatic about the bakery goods! This is the only sprinkles I know that also has ice cream right next door making it the biggest sprinkles I've seen. Cons: these are definitely high end cupcakes so expect to pay close to $4 for one making them the priciest bakery goods too (but so worth it!) Overall: if you are on this newly developed street, I would highly recommend stopping by!
Ted velvet ice cream cone has red velvet cake baked in the cone! It's the best red velvet ice cream I've had. Store was very cute and clean too. The cupcakes looked amazing

The shop its self was aesthetically pleasing. The employees were very nice and polite. I tried the red velvet vegan cupcake. The cake it self was the right amount of moist. The frosting was a bit to sweet but with the cake it was just right. I would go again to try some more cupcakes.

Who can possibly hate cupcakes? They're adorable, portable, and the right serving size. Thus, I was super excited to find Sprinkles on the Vegas strip. It is located right outside the new Linq casino and definitely worth the hype. I came here right after the July 4th fireworks and the line was crazy long. However, after asking one of the workers I found out that there are two entrance to the place; one strictly for cupcakes and another for the ice cream. Because I just wanted to try their cupcakes I did not have to wait in line. I ended up ordering a box of four cupcakes: the red velvet summer cherry, raspberry, and black & white. I am a huge fan of chai latte and I was hoping to try that. However, chai latte cupcakes are only available on Mondays and Fridays. The cupcakes were amazing. The frosting is definitely what makes it. Yes, it is sweet, but paired with the moist cake it is perfect. The summer cherry is my favorite; so divine. Nonetheless, be aware of Sprinkles' iconic sugar dots; those things are hard as a rock. I felt as if I can chip my tooth on it.

Horrible.. this place is very understaffed for the type of traffic they have..set up is so bad from order to pick up...cant say how it tastes because I have been waiting for 30 min to get my order..feel bad for the employees to have such a negligent owner.

Let me just go into this review saying I had such high hopes for these cupcakes. Unfortunately these were the worst cupcakes I've ever had. Both the vanilla cake and chocolate cake were very dry and lacked overall flavor. The frosting was overly sweet and cheap tasting like a bad grocery store bakery. I can't imagine the specialty flavored would be much better since the two most basic flavors were such a flop.

This place was amazing. While I didn't try the cupcakes, the cookies are amazing, especially the salted oatmeal. The best part is that they warm the cookie up for you. On the outside is a the cupcake ATM which is fun and you get your desert in a nice box. Highly recommend for a sweet treat and the service was great.

The official Grand Opening is this Friday, March 21st, but they did a Pre-Grand Opening today as a sneak peak! For future reference Sunday-Thursday they will be open until midnight, and Friday & Saturday until 1am. WOOHOO! =D I am absolutely excited about how we have a Sprinkles in our hometown now! Whenever I would go to CA to visit, I would bring a box of Sprinkle cupcakes back to Vegas, but now I won't need to. There will be a cupcake ATM that will be functioning in a couple weeks, we be prepared to ZOMBIE IT UP to Sprinkles at 3 in the morning to grab that cupcake out of the pink ATM. =) At today's event, we got to taste a couple cupcakes, as well as a scoop of ice cream from their wonderful ice cream bar. 8) I have always been a fan of their cupcakes, so I'm glad I got to satisfy that craving today, but I have never had their ice cream! Until today! I am not a crazy ice cream person, but I have to say that their ice cream is ON POINT! I got to try the red velvet ice cream, I know, I'm so original, and it was great! Not too sweet =). I did get to snag a spoonful of their Captain Crunch ice cream from my friend, and I'm glad I did! It tasted exactly like it should! I was so bummed we couldn't physically buy the cupcakes today yet, but I'll definitely be back in no time. Who knows, maybe I'll see you guys on Friday's grand opening! =D CUPCAKES, CUPCAKES EVERYWHERE! NOW THERE'S COOKIES & ICE CREAM TOO! TRY CAPTAIN CRUNCH ICE CREAM & A RED VELVET CUPCAKE, IF YOU HAVEN'T ALREADY. SMILE.

Perfect spot to get dessert at the Linq! Went here for a birthday celebration and exactly midnight we celebrated with Sprinkles cupcakes. My friends & I got assorted flavors: caramel, vanilla, and my favorite red velvet. I couldn't help but eat my entire cake, it was so sweet and I enjoyed every bite. Would go back again next time to try the ice cream, but there was a longer line on that side!

ATM cupcake! Genius, the line was long, and the boyfriend noticed this wonderful machine with no line. They had a variety of cupcakes, cookies, and a brownie. Now we live in Orange County so Sprinkles isn't new to us, and even back home there's a line. But let me just go on to say I guarantee the ATM has fresh cupcakes, might even be fresher then any cupcake I've had at their shop in Newport Beach. We went with banana and man am I happy we did. So moist and delicious. I'm happy we shared.

I vividly remember my first bite of their red velvet cupcake 8 years ago at their Beverly Hills location. I'd never had cupcake like that before or since. There have been copycats sneaking their way into Las Vegas over the years with mixed results and never living up to Sprinkles for me. They finally made it and I am psyched! Yeah so 6 cupcakes costs $22.50. I was surprised when the cashier asked me if those were for here or to go but then I saw a guy with 6 of them at a table by himself. Damn, dude. We ordered 3 red velvet, a peanut butter chip, lemon meringue and black & white. Those other 3 were nice and all but it's all about the red velvet. The cake was perfectly moist and the frosting is like no other. Funny how they put the takeout box into a resealable plastic bag...like drugs. I am sure Sprinkles is well aware of their addictive qualities. Even the line on Sunday at 11pm was about 15 minutes. Looking forward to giving the cupcake ATM a whirl when the line is an hour plus.

Go and get the Lemon Blueberry it's a seasonal cupcake! Key Lime, Chocolate Marshmallow, and Red Velvet cupcakes all came home with me in a box. My favorite was the Chocolate Marsmallow-mmmm very chocolately with a sweet sugary bite of marshmallow in the center-the frosting was perfection. Key Lime had meringue swirled on top. It was tart but not my fave. The red velvet was devoured by the kids and the lemon blueberry was delish. The last time I visited a Sprinkles was when they had their grand opening in Scottsdale. Lots of super young kids working behind the counter that didn't know what they were doing-and I wasn't too impressed with the baked goods. So I never went back. But, now with the kids in tow how could we pass up a bakery? I was so happy that despite the number of employees behind the counter service was speedy, friendly and helpful and the cakes were delicious. If you're not into cupcakes the sweltering heat might force you to come in and have some ice-cream or have some cake and ice-cream! Just imagine you're at a birthday party. Located in the new Linq shopping area near the High-Roller you can't miss the huge sign.

The best ice cream ever. Captain Crunch, Red Velvet, Salty Caramel!! Brownies are moist and dense i love it. Salted Oatmeal cookie its like a breakfast cereal in a cookie! Most of the stuffs in there can give you diabetes. But it sure is worth it. Keep an eye on there OTM cupcakes Banana Cupcake with Caramel Frosting is BOMB! If you are lucky enough maybe you get to taste it. Pumpkin with Toasted Marshmallow as well.

SMILES + Cupcake line is separate from ice cream line. Convenient if you want one, but inconvenient if you want both. + Fork and spoons are really unique. Wooden like! + Cupcake ATM machine located outside! So cool. + Smores cupcake was sooooo yummy. FROWNS - Ice cream line can move slow. Especially if there's one girl making the orders and another at the register. OTHER ~ So much cupcake and ice cream flavors, I just want to try it all ~ Located on the Linq promenade. So much fun to walk down!

If ever you are feeling down..head to the Sprinkles Cupcake ATM located at The Linq Promenade. Fun, sugary goodness at the touch of a button! I had never been to a Sprinkles location, let alone a cupcake atm and was all around impressed. The door opened and out came a cute little box housing my red velvet cupcake, which might I add had the perfect ratio of moist cake and icing. How can this not make you smile? It is $4.25 for one cupcake but 1. It is probably the best cupcake you have had and 2. This is Las Vegas, a city that capitalizes on tourism (plus the rent is not cheap on the strip). Will I be back? Oh, heck yes...something about a red velvet cupcake sliced in half with red velvet ICE CREAM seems to be calling my name...

Okay, with all the attention this place gets on social media from millennials (yes, i'm aware i'm a millennial myself), I honestly expected their cupcakes to be completely overrated. BUT they are actually amazing, which is high praise coming from someone who usually prefers any other dessert to cake. In particular, the vegan red velvet was to-die-for. The frosting was fluffy, rich and decadent (not oily at all as is often the case with vegan cupcakes) and paired perfectly with the moist cake underneath. I almost went back the next day!

I went to the cupcake ATM (so cooooool by the way) because I didn't feel like waiting in line inside. There were about 10 choices of cupcakes to choose from and I picked the sprinkles. It looked great, frosting was caked in sprinkles so I didn't hesitate to dig in. Well...it was terrible. The frosting was almost inedible sweet where all I could taste was powdered sugar. The cake portion was flavorless even though it was laced with sprinkles. I ate half and threw it out, wasting a very valuable $4.50 on a less than mediocre cupcake. On the plus side, the packaging was really cute.

I split the Triple Cinnamon and Cuban Coffee with my boyfriend. The Cuban Coffee was too strong for my tastes but he really liked it. Even the cinnamon was a little overpowering after a while. Texture was slightly moist, but more of a sturdy cake. Icing did not have that bad artificial taste that icings tend to have. The ATM was super cute! I would go back but try a different flavor.
If you are drunk and in need of a tasty treat check out Sprinkles Cupcake ATM... 10 out 10 would go back.. also seems like it's open 24/7... we went at 4am :) enjoy!!

Date & Time: Thursday July 19, 2014 @ 1:30pm Location: LINQ Dining Companion: The Husband Scene: Girls in Tank Tops & Denim Cut-Offs Decor: Adorable Cupcake & Ice Cream Bar Service: Efficient Devour: Banana Cupcake & Red Velvet Total: $8

I've been to this location many times while visiting Vegas. The cupcakes and ice cream are always good. I usually get red velvet ice cream in a red velvet cone. The service is great. I want to give a special shout out to Karina who works on the ice cream side. I'm a Sprinkles Perks member and I earned a free perk which was a free menu of my choice. Karina was very patient with me as I decided on what I wanted. I decided to get a Sprinkles Sundae which is one scoop of ice cream plus one cupcake. Karina allowed me to customize my order by letting me add more scoops and toppings. Since my order was to-go she took care of putting the toppings on the side so it could survive my walk back to the hotel. She was so helpful and I appreciated her thoughtfulness with my order.

So as I began my trek of stumbling back to my hotel room from a night of drunken escapades on the high roller the wife said "I want Sprinkles" so I obliged of course to make her happy. The location itself is in the heart of the Linq and at the time had a pretty hefty line, but the staff do go through it pretty quick (minus the people who ask for a million samples to further that lovely pet peeve) so kudos there! We ended up getting the red velvet sprinkle sundae which at $7 isn't actually bad for the portion that's given. I did find the cupcake itself to be a bit on the dry side, but with the ice cream (we had cookies and cream which that blew me away as it was amazing) it mask it a little bit however not enough for me not to catch the texture. All in all it did taste quite delicious and I'd be lying if I say I wouldn't be back again to consume more of that.
