I was disappointed, but I guess this place is most famous for their cupcakes. Maybe I'll try one next time...maybe.
Good ice cream but it takes way too long. Not sure why only one person is ever working here but you need at least 3-4 people. It seems like it takes 10 ministers to serve one person

The service was really quick. We ordered 2 mini red velvet cupcakes and one Cuban coffee cupcake but instead they gave as black and white cupcake by mistake (mainly because they were talking and playing too much behind the counter). Even though they got our order wrong the cupcakes were still good.

Worst customer service. I was browsing through Instagram recently and saw an ad from Sprinkles cupcakes (probably because I recently followed Nothing Bundt Cakes, which by the way are delicious). I have passed by Sprinkles before, but have never had the opportunity to stop in and try their cupcakes. However the cupcakes look: cute. I had been wanting to send someone a thoughtful gift to their work- and to my surprise Sprinkles delivers. I went ahead and placed my order online- the website kept timing out on me. By the time I was able to enter all the information, the delivery time I wanted was no longer available. I had to push back my order by 3 hours. The cupcakes were pricey- $45 for a dozen, $15 for delivery. I called to see if there was any way they could be delivered earlier, since I wanted to ensure they got there before business closing time. They mentioned they would try to arrive 30 mins. earlier. The delivery arrived on time, no complaints there. When the person received the delivery they texted me. I asked for a picture- I was excited for the presentation... They were squished! Definitely not worth $60! I immediately reached out to Sprinkles- they began to question me. How were they squished? Why was the delivery accepted?Maybe because it was a surprise and I wasn't there to inspect the delivery. I sent pictures for proof. After seeing the photos they apologized and said it looks like "the box was bumped". They offered me a comp for more cupcakes- however who says that solves this delivery? Who says I want to pay to get them delivered to me? Expensive and bad experience. I requested a refund instead- NEVER heard back. If you want delicious cupcakes, or if you ever want to deliver cupcakes, definitely go to Nothing Bundt Cakes. Received a delivery myself and the presentation was beautiful. Half the price of Sprinkles and better quality.

This place is worth it. The cup cakes are delicious. It was my birthday and we got the Dark Chocolate and Red Velvet cup cakes and it was yummy. The cup cakes are perhaps one of the best I have ever had.I also tried the fudge brownie but that was okay. The staff is very friendly and patient. They have birthday candles (50 cents) and also have a Happy Birthday sticker. I also loved the fact that they have small cup cakes for pets (dogs) too. LOL. Overall, a nice cute place among the hustle at Las Vegas strip.

Very cute designs and decors on both the outside and interior of the shop. Unlike the local Sprinkles in Houston, TX that serves only cupcakes, this location in the fabulous Las Vegas serves ice cream as well! WOW this is the very first time I have ever tried the Sprinkles ice cream wheeeeeeeee! The boyfriend and I have sampled the red velvet, coffee and pistachio flavors and settled on sharing a Pistachio ice cream float. All three flavors that we have sampled are rich and delicious but the Pistachio is not too sweet and wins the game! The staff is friendly and helpful.

JUST DON'T, we've been coming here since they opened. They raised their price twice in past 12 months. That would be ok if it was the best cupcake ever but it's not. Place was filthy, counter had more than one cupcake smeared on the counter. The tables outside were all dirty, every table. When we went first went here they were like Disney. The people made it nice and welcoming and just seemed like a really special place. That's all gone, it's dirty and the people seem overworked and uncaring. Sorry to say because it was good, pre mouse in the sprinkles window ( on YouTube) btw.

I went here in December and I absolutely love Sprinkles! I constantly come back for the great cupcake and ambiance. I love how their cupcakes are extremely moist and how the frosting is really light. I have tried the candy cane, red velvet, and chocolate. They are all amazing !!

Some parts were quite disappointing. The good: Strawberry cupcake had good flavor. Rootbeer float was very good (no effort for sprinkles, they use high quality bottled root beer prodeced elsewhere). Brownie sundae was pretty good with moist fudgy brownie. The vanilla ice cream has strong vanilla flavor. The bad: milkshakes We ordered strawberry and chocolate and neither were very good. Strawberry lacked sufficient flavor. Chocolate was blah. The ugly: the location was kinda dirty. Inside, I noticed improper hand sanitation from members taking payments then touching food without hand washing... The tables were FILTHY and no sight of anyone trying to clean them...

Came here with my wife to compare this place to Georgetown Cupcakes. We just ordered one red velvet and shared it. I personally thought the cupcake itself was average. The frosting tasted just like any other frosting that you would normally expect. Nothing interesting, unique, or curious about it. The cake itself was also just average. It wasn't too sweet and it was perfectly moist but that is about it. I think our standards were set way too high by Georgetown Cupcakes though!

You either love the cupcakes at Sprinkles or absolutely hate them that's how Sprinkles has divided the folks that I know. Anyway I'm in the "Love It" camp, so when I found this large bright store in The LINQ shopping plaza when staying next door at the Flamingoes I literally stopped by every day. This is part ice-cream shop and part cupcake shop rolled into one. It seems here the ice-cream's are more popular than the cupcakes as I always found a long line for the ice-cream section but none for the cupcake section. If you only want cupcakes there is a small door on the far left that you can use to get to the smaller line for only cupcakes. For the un-initiated there are different cupcake flavors available on different days so if you are looking for a specific flavor it would make sense to check that out on-line before you visit. On the other hand I don't mind trying different flavors so the rotation does not bother me much. Most of their cupcakes are $3.75 which is a bit high yet not in the gourmet ($7+) range. I've also tried a couple of their ice-cream flavors ($3.75 a scoop) but feel that the one you should surely try is Cap'n-Crunch which is available year round. This is basically caramelized Cap'n Crunch cereal sprinkled into Cap'n Crunch flavored ice-cream that is unique to Sprinkles. They also have cookies ($3 each), sundaes, ice-cream sandwiches and shakes. For the best of both worlds try the Sprinkles shake ($8.50) which is 2 scoops of ice-cream blended with one cupcake that is again unique to Sprinkles. Enjoy your ice-creams and cupcakes. I certainly did!!!

Came here after playing a $1 at the Flamingo and before In and Out Burger as it was right next door. This is a smaller location compared to the others that I have been to. I came here to get the $10 holiday mini pack for my best friend and I. Every Christmas we bake cookies and make cup cakes, however, since we decided to go to Vegas we bought our cupcakes but obviously still kept out Christmas tradition. They actually had a lot of cupcakes since we got there early. All the holiday flavors were good with the exception of the egg nog which was a let down. It was just a vanilla cupcakes with a few spices but nothing that reminds me of egg nog. Staff were super friendly and sweet (pun totally intended). There is some sit down space inside but my bestie and I just walked around with our cupcakes since it was a really nice day outside.

Sprinkles! On the Strip, they are still my favorite cupcake. The Vegan Red Velvet tho...this location doesn't seem to be quite the same as its Bev Hills counter part, but the signature white Sprinkles sugar dot let's you know you're in for a treat.
These are great cupcakes. Nice and fluffy and good amount of frosting. Wasn't digging the price but great cupcakes. Also, great customer service. Thats always a plus.
Sprinkles Captain Crunch ice cream is great. I get it every time I am near a Sprinkles. Highly recommend it!

The Shake was tasty, the ice cream was rich, some of the cupcakes were dry and some of the cupcakes were excellent. Shout out to a very friendly employee who gave us her reviews on each of the cupcakes excellent recommendations, Jenelle was great. Give her a raise. SHOUT OUT TO JENELLE

I LOVE cupcakes!!!! When I heard about the Sprinkles hype I had to check it out when I spotted it on The Linq in Vegas. I asked the girl behind the counter which cupcake was their most popular; apparently it's their Red Velvet. Unfortunately, it was mediocre at best. The little candy decor atop the cupcake was hard and tasted like wax. I've had better cupcakes from Ralph's. The cake was a bit dry, the cream cheese frosting was just ok. The gal behind the counter was new but she was sweet. Service was not a problem is was just the cupcake...it didn't blow my mind the way I was hoping it would. Maybe another flavor may help redeem their name. I may have to stop by the one in Beverly Hills if I'm ever in the area.

Yummy in the tummy!! Vegas was sweeter for me due to Sprinkles. We were having a difficult time with our food choices at Vegas but the Red Velvet and Vanilla cupcake made it all good. Even got a few cupcakes on the flight with me to relish at home :)
Love love love Sprinkles! A "must go" stop for any cupcake lover. They have 2 gluten free options, red velvet and lemon blueberry. Both are AMAZING! Be sure to check out the cupcake ATM!

Super good! Had to try this place, who doesn't love cupcakes?! Plus the cupcake arm is awesome! I had the vanilla and the black and white (vanilla frosting and chocolate cake) Cupcakes were moist and delicious! They are a decent size so we split them between three of us. They also have mini cupcakes if you don't want a full size! Such a cute shop too!

Whenever I come to Vegas, ESPECIALLY with friends who have no experienced these cupcakes before, I make sure to stop by this store. One of my favorite desserts in Vegas. Plus the Cupcake ATM is always an interesting show to anyone! 10/10 would go to again

May i have my money back? I will never waste my time or money ordering their bland cupcakes again. maybe in the beginning this chain had a stellar product, but he money has impacted the quality of their cakes. no thanks and no thank you!! never again! if you want a cupcake that will make you slap your self! go to Big man bakes in DTLA!! you heard here first folks!!

We were so excited to try Sprinkles because we were staying by the Linq and knew it would be a short walk. I had heard so many good things and wanted to have what was considered the first cupcake bakery. We arrived and realized that location had closed and when we went onto the website, it showed a google map of what we thought was the new location. It currently shows a location in the middle of the road between the Hawaiian Marketplace and Aria. There is no storefront from what we could gather, only delivery. We ended up using the Sprinkles ATM at the airport on the way home and it was a typical bakery cupcake. I think we would have been more pleased if it would have been a storefront with the specialty flavors but that's all we could get our hands on at the time.

I used sprinkles cupcake ATM. The line inside didn't seem to be moving very fast. I purchased a vanilla cupcake for $4.25 a little on the steep side for a cupcake, but then again it is Vegas. I'm not sure how fresh the cupcake was? Seemed a few days old, but it was a basic vanilla cupcake. Not a whole lot to write home about. It had a TON of frosting, had to scrape some off to enjoy the cupcake. Cute, trendy, travel friendly packaging.

Ice cream gets five stars holy #%*~ this rivals some of the best dessert I've ever eaten. It should surprise no one that since they offered a creme brÃ»lÃ©e flavor I was ALL OVER IT. I don't exactly recall the cost but if it was $10-20 it was worth every penny. As for their signature item the cupcake was good. I'm glad I've finally experienced A Sprinkles cupcake but I'd opt for the ice cream over the cupcake every time. Not to mention I felt the cupcake was overpriced.

Delicious cupcakes. Excited they finally opened one here in Vegas. This location as already mentioned in other reviews is located at the Linq. We stopped by on a Friday night. It was quite busy as one can imagine. The ice cream section was busier than the cupcake area. I got one cupcake (black and white flavor) and one doggy cupcake. Mine was delicious and I can tell my doggy enjoyed his as well. I will most certainly be back. Only docked off one star because it's not the most convenient of locations to get to.

I love Sprinkles back home so we stopped by for quick snacks for the ride home. Nice small location at the new outside shops at the Linq. My friends ice cream broke and fell as soon as we walked out and the employees were kind enough to give him a new one and even offered a cup to put the broken red velvet cone with ice cream in and keep both. Friendly staff. Just like home.
Very cute location! I wish they had more Gluten free options but the red velvet was delicious! I'm definitely taking a few home and I'd love to see more locations.
Love this place. Great cupcakes. Super moist and super yummy. Red velvet and rainbow confetti cake are great

I loooove Sprinkles in NYC so I was THRILLED to see one open late in LV just when I had the craving for a cupcake. They have cookies and ice cream too! The line was long when we went at 11pm but worth the wait. Their cupcakes are a little larger than your standard cupcake. Good icing to cake ratio. Everything tasted great. They even had a gluten free red velvet option!
Really good vegan cupcake! The icing is coconut but still DELICIOUS! Very moist wish they had more vegan options!

Absolutely a wonderful experience! The staff especially Luis and Lydia where so sweet and on their job! They let you try their different flavors of ice cream, and are not pushy or hurrying you at all!!! We got an ice cream sandwich that was out of this world! The butter pecan ice cream is amazing! If you have not been you have to go! Be prepared it is a bit of a wait! But it is soooo worth it!!
I had a small red velvet cupcake, delish. The staff could have been a bit friendlier.
Why don't you update Yelp, and food delivery services that your Linq location is closed! Delivery drivers are still being sent to Sprinkles at the Linq only to find it is closed!

Ooooo I love Sprinkles!! So many cupcake places let you down, not Sprinkles! The cupcakes are moist and delicious, the icing is perfectly made, not to sweet, dense but not over powering, and they just melt in your mouth. So good! They have a ton of flavours but I just love the classic vanilla so much, I've never tried anything else. From the adorable Cupcake ATM outside, to the whimsical, over the top design of the store front that is right in front of a darling fountain, walking up and in to this Sprinkles is just a pure delight! Well done.

So yummy! My 2 favorites that I have tried are pumpkin and banana! I'm staying at the Flamingo and this is dangerously close to our room! Came almost every day of our trip because once we discovered them, nothing sounded better! $3.75 each isn't ideal but we are on vacation!
Really good. Got a snicker doodle cookie, they offer to warm it up for you. Also got the vanilla bean ice cream. It was delicious.

Not the most exceptional cupcake we've ever had. They weren't light and fluffy like I would have expected, but rather thick and heavy with a sweeter frosting than I would desire. Overall, for what we spent I'd choose a different option the next time we visit.

I had the pleasure of visiting the LV Sprinkles Cupcakes & Ice Cream in April 2014, soon after they opened. It's always neat to see how each Sprinkles location differs, and this particular store just screamed "VEGAS," from its light-up signage to the attention-grabbing cupcake ATM. This was the first Sprinkles store that I had seen actually joined--cupcakes and ice cream were not separated--which was neat but also confusing. I think that, because the store had only recently opened, they were still trying to figure things out. I entered from the ice cream side, but I was directed to stand in the line for cupcakes (when I wanted ice cream, not cupcakes). Hopefully by now, the Vegas store has everything a little more under control, because with two entrances, it can be easy for customers to get confused/not know where to go when it comes time to order. I was surprised to see that I didn't have to wait in an enormously long line to order my ice cream (there was a line, but it moved along). I appreciated the fact that there was a good seating area outside the store for customers to enjoy their cupcakes and ice cream -- more seats and tables than I have ever seen at a Sprinkles store. I ordered the seasonal "Cookie Dough" ice cream flavor--one of my favorites; I wish it were a regular menu item--in the "Sprinkles Sundae," complete with my all-time favorite "Peanut Butter Chip" cupcake. I think because the workers were still getting into the groove of things at Sprinkles, the ice cream scoops were a bit larger than what I usually receive ... and hey, no complaints about that! The ice cream and cupcake quality were the same as I had experienced at other Sprinkles stores, which was great. However, I was a bit disappointed with the "Salted Oatmeal Cornflake" and "Peanut Butter Pretzel Chip" cookies that I ordered. Instead of the normal slightly crispy exterior and moist, soft interior, these cookies were on the harder, crunchier side, and the "Salted Oatmeal Cornflake" was definitely saltier than I would have liked. But, then again, gotta have some grace and patience because the store had just opened -- hopefully the cookies are a bit more consistent with the usual Sprinkles taste by now. The BF ordered the "Sprinkles Shake" with his usual combo of "Captain Crunch" ice cream and "Peanut Butter Chip" cupcake. The shake was as sweet as usual--I got a few sips in there--but we both noticed that the texture was also chunkier than usual. At one point, he had to use a spoon to get some of the larger cupcake chunks (definitely different from being able to inhale everything quickly with a straw). But he had no complaints--he said it was actually nice to munch on those cupcake bits every now and then. The friends we were with decided to share a "Sprinkles Shake" with "Red Velvet" ice cream and cupcakes (she really likes the "Red Velvet"). They were extremely pleased with their foray into Sprinkles and said they would definitely get the "Red Velvet"-heavy shake again (though, they were happy that they shared it, saying that it would have been too much red velvet for one person to handle). Overall, I had a positive experience at this LV Sprinkles. I really, really liked its dÃ©cor--the dazzling lights and huge marquee made it stand out from any other store I've been to so far--and the dÃ©cor really made the store easily spottable. I have no doubts that this location stays busy far into the night and keeps up with the Vegas nightlife. I do hope, though, for customers' sakes, that the ordering system is a bit more streamlined and organized to avoid confusion when entering/exiting the store.

Fun, great aesthetics but in the end they don't beat Cupcake Royale of Seattle's cake texture. The vanilla flavor is rich and wonderful but the crumb on their cake just has too much crumb for my likes and could be a tad more moist. Love, LOVE the sprinkle "crust" atop the frosting.
Sampled the Captain Crunch ice-cream and all I can say is YUM! Very rich and dense, and oh-so-yummy! Took an oatmeal cookie to go. Didn't care for it much. Wanted to try the cupcakes... next time!
Good ice cream cupcakes. Nice place and perfect snack for hang out with friends. There is an ATM cupcake, which I thought is interesting and fun. I will return.
I guess I was in Vegas so it should be typical that there was a huge line but man could the line move any slower. Definitely love the Red Velvet cupcake. They also have an ice cream section!

Decor: 4/5 -If you want cupcakes, take the left door. If you want ice cream go to the right door. -There are seating outdoors dedicated to Sprinkles customers (though I see In-n-Out patrons eating at those tabes) Service: 4/5 -One person at the front which is the bottleneck to the increasing line of people waiting to satiate their sweet tooth Cupcakes: 4/5 -My favorite hands down is the triple cinnamon sugar cupcake. The red velvet, cuban coffee, dark chocolate were also good but wasn't a one hit wonder like the triple cinnamon. I would come back again to try the other flavors and even their ice cream and cookies

Cute little area. Several doors and light lettered writing is a bit hard to see when it's very bright outside and your eyes have to adjust. Sucks they don't have common flavors on the regular and the specialty ones take over. On the flip side... This ice cream was DELICIOUS. A bit over priced but, not excessive. Pleasant service people and modern design. Ordered the red velvet ice cream. Shouldn't charge a Dollar for ALL toppings... But oh well. Friend ordered Mint Chocolate Chip and Rocky road.... Heads up Mint is spearmint not regular mint. =)

I sooo love their milk chocolate cupcake!! It's heaven in your mouth.;) I think they are open until 1am, but don't you worry because it's Vegas baby! Almost everything is open 24/7 in The Strip, so they have a 24/7 cupcake atm at The Linq near the High Roller. It's too expensive for a cupcake though. I paid $4.50 for a piece of cupcake when I used their cupcake atm the other night.
Cupcakes were good and order process was smooth. 2 dozen cupcakes for over $80 is really expensive but I needed convenience since I was out of town. Price was my only complaint.

I tried the Strawberry cupcake. It's probably just my taste but the frosting was too sweet for me and I didn't taste any type of strawberry flavor. My husband got an ice cream cookie sundae with a chocolate chip cookie and the cookie was a lot better than the cupcake. If I come back, I will probably only get a cookie!

I have a Sprinkles in my area but I decided to try out this shop too and see how it would compare. The shop is located at the Linq with a couple outdoor seats. The line was out of the door for a Thursday night so try not to come during peak hours! It's still overhyped in my opinion but I didn't even know they had an ice cream shop. I ended up getting the cookie dough which was delicious but a little sweet for my palate. The service was friendly but on the slower side. They even have a cupcake ATM too but I'll come back next time to try it!

With all the hype Sprinkles gets, my expectations were overpriced (I figured about 6 dollars per cupcake) but really tasty cupcakes. I was wrong on both accounts. We arrived and chose the cupcake line. There is a separate counter for ice cream and cookies. I was pleased the prices were reasonable. $3.00 for a cupcake is on par with less trendy shops. I was disappointed that they did not have most of the flavors which were listed on the wall. I settled on a raspberry cupcake as the sign said it was a seasonal favorite while my daughter ordered their specialty red velvet cupcake and we also tried their mini chocolate marshmallow for $2.00. The chocolate marshmallow cupcake was horrible. Neither my daughter nor I could finish it and it tasted like a rum based dark chocolate topping with a strong bitterness. The raspberry cupcake was overly sweet but definitely tasted like fresh raspberries were used in the making of the frosting. I could only handle a small bite of it due to the sweetness. Unfortunately the cupcake was not moist inside and rather crumbly. It tasted stale or store bought instead of handmade. The red velvet cupcake was only slightly moister but when I picked it up, the top came off and the cupcake fell to the ground. I am all for cupcake tops but this only happens with dry cupcakes. The flavor on the red velvet cupcake was good and this is the only one of the three I would ever try again.

I'm embarrassed to say that the employees know me and know what I normally get. Well, actually they know a variety of what I get because I come so often I have to change up the flavors. People always are drawn to the cupcakes but the cookies and ice cream are just as great. I love how they switch out flavors and if you follow them on facebook they have many BOGO offers!

This is my fave place to get a sweet treat, located at the linq promenade shops right past the high roller. My favorite cupcakes are the red velvet and black and white! The frosting is rich and creamy, and the cupcake is soft and perfect. Employees very friendly and always willing to help, the line moves fast because there are lots of workers. There's even a "cupcake ATM" for after hours, like a bank machine except it dispenses cupcakes!!

Had just decided to go vegan two days prior to traveling to las vegas. Looked up vegan sweet treats on yelp and found Sprinkles. Its super cute and girly inside and they have the most moist and delicious vegan red velvet cupcakes. Totally recommend trying this place whether you are vegan or not!

We are locals and came for random cupcake sundaes. They were so delicious. Highly recommend. The service could of been better. They ran out of many cupcake selections. The merchant hasn't adapted to ApplePay acceptance.

What a treat! The choice between ice cream or a cupcake from the plethora of delicious cupcake options was overwhelming. I went with the red velvet ice cream (perfect combo of both) and it was definitely in the top 3 of best ice cream eating experiences my tastebuds have ever experienced. You gotta try!! Some weird vibes from the staff but overall very pleased. We love sprinkles!!!!
Cup cakes are a little too sweet for me, but over all good stop for a late night cup cakes. And the staff there are super helpful.

Oh my goodness!!!! So yummy!!! It was about 9:30 pm and there was a long line, but my guy and I were ready to wait because everything looked so tasty!!! The line moved fast and we left with 4 cupcakes: chocolate marshmallow, vanilla sprinkle, pumpkin and red velvet, we had some that night and the others the next night. They were all delicious and moist! You must try them!
Long wait for an okay cupcake. I've heard some much hype.. But really just a $4 cupcake you could make at home.

I read about the cupcake ATM online and had to check it out. Sooo cool! I put in my credit card; got a cupcake ... Genius! Not only was this fun but it's available 24/7 and the cupcake (salted caramel) was superb. Love this idea.

Friendly service. The pretzel cookie was exactly how you'd expect it to taste - salty, crunchy, and pleasant to eat. For the service and cookie, this place gets a couple stars. The triple cinnamon cupcake was anemic and lacking flavor. Barely a hint of cinnamon, and it would be difficult to even call it cinnamon flavored. The cake itself was dry and the frosting tasted of sugar and diabetes. For a cinnamon cupcake I'd expect more zing.
The cupcake was great I chose to get no frosting on mine. The cinnamon flavor was good not over powering like most cupcakes. it was slow when I went in but the service was good and quick
Fantastic cupcakes. Cute little vending machine. Location is perfectly centered. Grab your in n out and get a cupcakes. Reasonably sized for the price.
Very good cupcake. Not quite orgasmicly good, which the price would lead you to believe they are, but still good. Moist cake, good flavor frosting. I had a chocolate coconut.
I came on two different occasions to get Ice cream and on both occasions they had no waffle cones.seriously? Why open and not be prepared for business

You have to have the Smores cupcake! They only have it on certain days but it is worth the wait. The staff is super friendly at this location and don't forget to sign up to get a free cupcake! I love their red velvet ones too, really all of them are amazing.

They are accommodating at this location, and are friendly. Of course, it's my hometown where everyone is a local. My husband ordered the chocolate malt ice cream and thought it was tasty - but creamier than what he is used to. Not bad, just unexpected. The Gluten Free Red Velvet cupcake will leave you speechless; I've had gluten free cupcakes all around the country but this tops my list of instant satisfaction. And it does not taste dry for a gluten free cupcake. The only thing is the coffee is carafe style. It's cheaper than the coffee normally offered in the coffee shops or the hotels, but it's not impressive at all. It reminds me of pre-roasted coffee reminiscent of tin can servings. If you want a great coffee pairing with this cupcake combo, try the French Roast Coffee at the Nook inside of The LINQ.

Terrible line management. Five employees stood in the middle of the store and only was helping customers. Another was sweeping the floor with eight people standing in line. No "Sorry it will be just a moment", no communication whatsoever. Ended up walking out since the customer service was nonexistent.

Yummy flavor and the red velvet cone was really good. We had the red velvet ice cream with a red velvet cone. Service was good until we found out our ice cream had a long piece of black hair in it. We told them right away and they just chuckled and quickly made us a new one. Didn't apologize for anything but just handed us the ice cream. I'm not looking for an apology I just want them to be aware that there was a piece of hair in it but instead they just laughed about it, I find that a lite rude
very disappointed that I visit Vegas to find that your location in Linq was close and I could not find an airport atm.

I've heard all the raves and was anxious to try Sprinkles cupcakes. Once the newness of Linq wore off a bit Frank and I went over to see what all the fuss has been about. My husband is a sucker for Red Velvet so his choice was easy. I, on the other hand, wasn't in the mood for anything in particular. I asked which was their best seller? "Red Velvet." Ok, second best? "Chocolate Marshmallow." Sold! Most, if not all cupcakes are $3.75 each. The Red Velvet fell flat. The frosting was too sweet and the cake was dry. The Chocolate Marshmallow was the better choice, but it was still pretty dry even with the marshmallow center, and I hated the rock hard candy placed on top. I've had better, and I've had worse, but I won't be singing any praises for Sprinkles Cupcakes.

Sprinkles is at The Linq (between the Flamingo and the Quad). Cupcakes are $3.75 each and an additional 50 cents if you want it in a box instead of a wax bag. They have more than one door. The left is cupcakes only while the right side is both cupcakes and ice cream. They have prices and flavors posted and only offer certain flavors on different days of the week. You can check their website or download the Sprinkles app to find out what flavors they have that day. I just went to the cupcake side on this visit, but plan on trying the ice cream in the future. I ordered a "Doggie Cupcake" priced at $2.50 that is sugar-free and has a yogurt frosting. It had a cute little orange bone on top. My dog, Brownie loved it! She licked the top off first and then ate the rest. I had a "Lemon Meringue" that was very good. The lemon cake had graham cracker lining and delicious tasting lemon curd in the middle. The top had toasted marshmallow that was good, but had a chewy outer layer that was tough to eat, so that was all that was left of the cupcake I didn't finish. They have tables and chairs outside of the store. As I was sitting there eating my cupcake, Candace Nelson the founder of Sprinkles came outside to greet customers. She was very sweet and signed autographs and took pictures with people, including myself! They have a decent amount of tables and chairs outside, but they were pretty filled up and the inside of the store was busy yet the line moved along smoothly. There is a cupcake ATM outside (near the ice cream side) on the patio and it's open 24 hours. The cupcakes are still $3.75 each, but come boxed so you have to pay the extra 50 cents. Hubby had a strawberry cupcake that I tried a bite of and liked, so I got one of those from the cupcake ATM to see how it worked. The ATM is user friendly and the screen allows you to see your cupcake coming to you from inside the store to when the door lifts open on the ATM revealing a pink box. I thought it was cool and even though the store is open late, it is neat knowing you can get a Sprinkles cupcake at any hour. Hours: Sunday - Wednesday 10 am to 12 am Thursday - Saturday 10 am to 1 am

It is such a fun atmosphere out on the Las Vegas strip. You can choose to order a cupcake from the vending machine or you can order a cupcake with ice cream inside. If you like sugary frosting like I do than sprinkles is the place for you. They have different types of cupcakes and ice cream so I mix and match every time I go.

The cupcakes look good in the shop but we will see what it looks like when we get home. Most places automatically put the cupcakes in a box if they are taken to go, not Sprinkles. The girl behind the counter asked if this was for here or to go and then proceeded to just place the cupcake in a paper bag. I asked about a box (like most cupcake places generally just automatically do) and was told that was an additional 50 cents...what...well I guess we will just see how this already expensive cupcake looks after traveling down the strip to get home.

My daughter brought me a cupcake from the atm yesterday from a recent visit to vegas since i never had one. It was cinnamon. It started as delicious treat until i found a long curly hair in it. Yuk! Never again!

I am obsessed with Sprinkles! I've heard a lot of people say that they think it's overrated and expensive, but I absolutely love their cupcakes and think that the price is worth it because I haven't tasted anything I enjoy more. I'd say try it at least once and be a judge of it yourself. My absolute favorite is their red velvet cupcake, but I've also tried many others including their black and white, strawberry, cinnamon sugar, salted caramel, and coffee. All of which I recommend. I love this particular location because it's at the linq and they serve ice cream too! I ordered the cupcake sundae (I think that's what it's called) with a red velvet cupcake paired with coffee ice cream and it was bomb! They also have a cupcake atm right outside. TIP! - Whenever I go to any Sprinkles location I check Twitter, Instagram, or Facebook for any secret words that Sprinkles may have posted for the day. Sometimes you can get a free cupcake or scoop of ice cream!

Sprinkles is a perfect place for The Linq, I almost always make a stop here whan I am playing tourist at The Linq because their treats are fairly priced and it always hits the spot. I always get ice cream here. Hahaha. GET THE RED VELVET WAFFLE CONE! Not just a gimmick, it actually is sweet and tasty! I am always happy with their coffee almond fudge ice cream, so if you're a coffee fan, this will do the trick for ya.
My favorite late night spot in Vegas! The cupcake atm is so much fun and the cupcakes are always delicious! I go here at least one every time I visit Las Vegas. Definitely would recommend!

I remember the first time I had Sprinkles. I'm not from the LA area, so we got a bit lost trying to find the place, and I ended up walking a good three miles to get there; however, when I got there, it was so worth it. If nothing else, I burned off the cupcake calories. Anyway, I got my half a dozen cupcakes and loaded up in the truck to head back home. I couldn't wait until we made it home to try them, and I remember my first bite. So began my love affair with cupcakes. Now, my best friend and I are trying all the cupcake places in Vegas, so of course, Sprinkles was on the list. While we scored it fairly high, it isn't our favorite. Our favorite would be Showboy, which funny enough was on Cupcake Wars. I do love Sprinkles ice cream and that gave them a little boost when we scored them. Sprinkles is actually in third place right now because the cupcakes that day were a little dry and just didn't knock our socks off, or flip flops since we live in Vegas. Would I get Sprinkles if I'm at the link? Of course. Would it be my first choice? Nope. That would be Showboy.
I cant eat gluten because of my baby. Their gluten free cookie and cupcake are the best I ever had... delicious!!

It's good. As much as I love my desserts I was excited to try the famous Spinkles cupcakes. I guess since they are the reason why cupcakes became an overwhelming trend, everyone that has opened up a bakery up'd the goodness level. So what I'm trying to say is that, I've had better. Lol

While the original is in Beverly Hills, I wanted myself a Sprinkles cupcake - red velvet. I once ordered enough to make a birthday tower - something like 3 dozen - for my 22nd birthday. I LOVE these cupcakes, and the taste was familiar, so I was a happy clam. I enjoyed sitting outside eating it, watching people walk by. It was a nice, warm evening, so it was very comfortable.
Delightful cupcakes! Even late in the evening the selection was good. Staff was okay. And they have a 24 hour cupcake ATM!
Awesome!! Even better they have a 24 HR ATM we have only been here for two days and both days it has been a must!!!!

My Favorite cupcake place in town now. Was introduced to Sprinkles from a co worker and have been hooked since. Was there 5/17/19 around 9pm and was served by Tanner! He was very friendly and eager to answer all my questions, and had the best energy! Got 4 of the GOT cupcakes and loved them! Will be back again soon!

I first became obsessed with Sprinkles in Austin. Being vegan, it can be difficult to find a dairy free dessert option. Sprinkles red velvet vegan cupcake is not only the best VEGAN cupcake I've ever had...but the best cupcake I've had in my entire life. It's worth the drive / walk to partake, trust me.

This an amazing place to satisfy your sweet tooth. Tucked away behind the strip in the LINQ promenade you'll find this sweet station. This area is family friendly and moderately priced. The cupcakes are simple yet packed with flavor. And the ice cream is some of the best I've ever had. Combine the two and you're in heaven. I got the sprinkles shake which is two scoops of ice cream and one cupcake blended together. I've never had anything like it before and my taste buds were screaming! The staff is very polite and helpful. This sweet spot matches the fun and relaxed atmosphere that surrounds it.
Every Sprinkles is good. Oh so good. Mmmmmm. (recommend the dark chocolate, and if you want to try a ton of cupcakes, get all the minis). PLUS THERES A SPRINKLES ICE CREAM SHOP TO THE RIGHT.

I finally gave Sprinkles a chance. One star for interior decoration and another star for decent service. I'm pretty picky when it comes to cupcakes, but I came out of here thinking that I could make myself a better cupcake with my own oven/kitchen. The cake itself was really dry and crumbly and I'm not really a fan of thick icing. Maybe I should have tried their ice cream or sandwich, but with just their basic cupcake really lacking, I'm not sure the specialty treats would have been too much better. However, I would say try it out for yourself, see if you like cupcakes made the Sprinkles way!
Love cupcakes and love Sprinkles. I've been to the one in Dallas and wanted my boyfriend to try out. He was pleased with the red velvet. Sprinkles is consistent. Still need to try their ice cream.

New cupcake place here in the walkway between flamingo and the new linq hotel in view of the high roller ferris wheel. Cupcakes are to die for, its a little pricey at $3.50 each but worth it. You can never go wrong on the red velvet.

THE VEGAN CUPCAKE IS EVERYTHING!!! They only have one flavor, but not to worry! It's the best flavor they could have done. The frosting has such an amazing coconut flavor and the cupcake itself was melting in my mouth. I will continue to stop here every time I visit Las Vegas!!

Obviously, you don't know me but let me tell you - I don't like red velvet cupcakes. Really, I don't. EXCEPT THIS ONE. I used to always try to like red velvet cupcakes long before I was vegan bc I wanted to understand all the rage and it's fancy and all this stuff but eh, I just couldn't get into it. Then I started trying the Sprinkles vegan red velvet cupcakes and idk how much they taste like regular ones but WHOA. The frosting it to. die. for. The cupcake itself is moist (yeah, I said) and flavorful but not overwhelming or too sweet, it's subtle but SO good.
I love their frosting. I will be there soon again. Delicious chocolate marshmallows. coffee is not so bad,,

My cousin and I stopped here on the 4th to get me a cupcake because it was my birthday, I was super excited to try them because i has never been there. Later on that night I went to go eat my cupcake and I'm sad to say it was the most driest cupcake i've ever had. All four of the cupcakes we got were dried out, there was an over abundance of frosting and i'm not the biggest cream cheese frosting fan but it was just not tasty. I see mostly good reviews on here so I guess I'll have to go back and try it a second time!!

I love sprinkles. I am from Los Angeles and have frequented the Beverly Hills location for 7+ years in addition to the Irvine location. Never have I experienced such lackluster service as I did at the Vegas location today. There seemed to be no system of operation. For example, both my friend and I ordered mini sundaes (the ice cream side of the store), both with red velvet cupcakes; however, the associate made several visits back and fourth to a mysterious back room to bring out two of the same cupcake at different times. Another associates hair was falling into the ice cream freezer and overall sanitation did not appear to be considered. Furthermore there was limited space for the line of customers. Just disappointed.
Best place on the strip. We got great service and vegan options. Would recommend to all
Tasty cakes, big price tag. Not really any different from any other cupcake joint, but if you need a quick fix for your sweet tooth then it works!

Great service, so many choices. Even a doggy cup cake. My only wish is a gluten free cup cake option and more then one non dairy sorbet. Either way my husband loved his red velvet cup cake with captain crunch ice cream and my strawberry sorbet was Delish.

Hooray for Sprinkles Las Vegas!!!!!!!!!!!!! Love their cupcakes!!! Even my dogs love their "pupcakes"! Everything about this company makes me happy!!! 24 hour cupcake vending machine and gluten free, sugar free, and vegan options! Amazing!!!!!!!

This is the place to go to satisfy your late night sweet tooth. I got the carrot cupcake and it was divine. Great flavor with lots of shredded carrots and really yummy frosting. I didn't feel it was overpriced at $4. Wish I could remember the guys name at the cash register. He was super friendly and nice. Will definitely be back!
Wow, just had a cinnamon cupcake and it's probably the best I've ever had! Tasted just like a snickerdoodle cookie. Don't miss this spit on the LINQ Promenade. It's full of little hidden gems.
Love this place! Customer service is always awesome. Nice and friendly staff. And they also have Red Velvet Vegan cupcakes. Can't go wrong.

Everything I expected and more! We bought a variety (chocolate marshmallow, salted caramel and the milk chocolate) and we couldn't decide which is our favorite because they're all so good! So good! Highly recommend.

I just adore sprinkles, I live in California where we have them around a lot, this one is pretty small but it's really cute & the staff was very sweet..my favorite is the sugar free red velvet..I am not a cupcake or sweets person but when it comes to their red velvet cupcakes I could eat like 10! The cream cheese frosting is delicious..they also have mini cupcakes in case you want to try a few different kinds
The best damn cupcakes I've ever had in my life. MOIST AND HEAVY!!!! I had the Belgian chocolate and the peanut butter. Absolutely amazing. 2 cupcakes were around $7.50. Yummo!!!!!
Love, love, love this place! They have a spunky interior. Some cool ideas and awesome cupcakes and ice creams. I tried their dark chocolate banana cupcake n was left speechless!

Good cupcakes and good service!! My favorite cupcake is the red velvet. I was really happy to see Sprinkles in Vegas! The store is located next to In n Out and other really great restaurants. The sprinkles ice cream store is right next door! They also have a tables and chairs outside their store to sit and relax with your family and friends.

Average cupcake. Honestly, it didn't taste the freshest. Top heavy, as are most cupcakes. I went right at opening, so I didn't have to wait in line, but I can see why the lines build up as the staff does not seem to be the most efficient. If I happen to be in the area with company, maybe I'd get another cupcake, but for the most part, it's just worth it. Not worth the price or the calories.
OMG - I am in LOVEEE - I am usually not a big cupcake fan and pretty much dislike all frostings HOWEVER, I just had a Red Velvet Cupcake and I am in Heaven!!!!

Addicted to Sprinkles! I am so glad that they are here in Las Vegas. You may have to wait in line, however, it is WELL worth it! My favorite cupcakes include - Salty Caramel, Red Velvet, Black and White, Peanut Butter, Coconut, and Coffee. Try their frosting shots if you want just a small, sweet addition to your day. They are wonderful! Their ice cream is also on point! They have red velvet waffle cones that are the perfect vessels for any ice cream sundae at Sprinkles. I can not wait to return!

so i come on a friday at 11:30 pm. and of corse the place is decently busy. and they only have like 3 flavors. really? the cupcake atm isnt working. so its my birthday i get a free one but it looks dryed out and the icing looks scraped off. ::sigh:: super annoying. plus there was only one person working so you have to wait 5-10 minutes

My mother and I walked into sprinkles on a whim while just exploring near our hotel. I sampled the cookie dough ice cream and the captain crunch ice cream. Honestly some of the best ice creams I've ever had . The cookie dough ice cream had big big chunks of cookie dough all throughout the deliciously vanilla flavored ice cream. The captain crunch one tasted just like the cereal and not too sweet with bits of the cereal mixed in. Super smooth and creamy. The waffle cone actually tasted of vanilla and not just processed sugar. My mom got the milk chocolate cupcake . She said she was impressed by how moist it was beautiful texture of the cake and frosting, not too sweet , just the right amount of frosting . She only wishes she got a big "ole" glass of milk with it . And everything wasn't overpriced either ! Next time we are visiting Vegas we will surely be back! Now Candace needs to build a sprinkles in MN !!!

Anyone rating this place above 2 stars, has only experienced cupcakes from a box. I have been following Sprinkles for years. Pretty much since the beginning of Cupcake Wars. The minute I heard Sprinkles was opening I was thrilled. I had to try it! I went on a Sunday and settled of a mini red velvet, mini chocolate marshmallow, Lemon and Vanilla meets Chocolate. I also got a kiddie sundae with red velvet ice cream and a mini dark chocolate cupcake. WHAT a disappointment! Here's a breakdown: Red Velvet: Cake is okay, but the frosting tastes like chip dip Mini Chocolate Marshmallow: Forgettable Lemon: Frosting is good, but the cake, which has no hint of lemon whatsoever tastes like a cross between a dry biscuit, a pancake and coffee cake. Awful. Vanilla Meets Chocolate: See lemon for cake.. Frosting too sweet. All you tastes is sugar Dark chocolate: Grab a cup of milk. Extremely dry and very bitter. You'll like it if you really love super dark chocolate. Red Velvet Ice Cream: Have you ever had an ice cream sandwich? One of the one's you get from the ice cream man. Well remove the ice cream in the middle and crumble and red velvet cupcake in it. Voila! Now you have Sprinkles Red Velvet ice cream. I won't attack the price for these.... concoctions because it is located on the strip. As a self-prolaimed cupcake connoisseur, I will say that this is the worst cupcake establishment in Vegas. It's even worse than Caked, which is hard to believe. I caution you to save your money.

We paid our second visi to this location of Sprinkles yesterday, and I guess I'm a fan! Service was young, sweet, and eager to please while it was surprisingly slow yesterday. We stopped in at around 8:30 after a ride on the high roller and picked up a chai cupcake, lemon coconut, vegan red velet, and vanilla minis. The minis are so cute and perfect for kids if you don't want them bouncing off the walls from the sugar. My favorite was the lemon coconut of our selection, although the chai was also quite tasty with its strong chai spices. Vegan red velvet is made with coconut oil and my friend (who is vegan) said it was very moist and delicious. I'd say the Sprinkles here are up to par with the locations I've visited in California with the exception of one thing: I have yet to see the SALTED CARAMEL cupcake at this location. Salted caramel is hands down, the best Sprinkles cupcake flavor ever, so please carry it soon. Thanks!

Worst cupcake I have ever eaten. We were in Vegas for a week and this was on my list of places to visit. I consider myself a dessert connoisseur and was sad that I was so disappointed. I wanted them to be good. I had the Valentine trio special. It was stale and tasted like purse sugar. I have never given just one star, but this review was important enough that I do. I will not return nor waste my money. Feel free to try them for yourself and make your decision as to whether or not they are all they're hyped up to be.

What food network fan hasn't fantasized about a Sprinkles cupcake? We were waiting by and I made a beeline in. I wasn't sure that the husband was following me, but oh well. I think they had an ice cream bar, but that wasn't what I was checking out. The cupcakes stared back and me and I couldn't decide what to do. I decided cupcakes for me and for me to take home to the kids. I got the peanut butter chocolate, black and white, and the red velvet. We all agreed tasty. Best cupcake in the world? Probably not. But a good, solid, yummy cupcake. Good stuff.

Save your money! I have heard rave reviews of Sprinkles cupcakes. I also watched every episode of Cupcakes Wars which the creator of Sprinkles cupcakes judges (now I think I will rethink her opinions). I got the cinnamon "cupcake"...I use the term cupcake loosely since mine tasted more like a dense muffin. Even if I poured milk directly on it I doubt it would be moist. My friend ordered the vanilla cupcake with milk chocolate frosting, also nothing to write home about. Overall I was thoroughly disappointed since I LOVE sweets. There are plenty of other local cupcake shops that I would choose over this chain. If someone bought me another cupcake from Sprinkles I would try it in hopes of redeeming the name but I will not be spending my money on these MUFFINS again. Sorry Sprinkles....step it up!

Had to try these cupcakes! Now this spot is new in Vegas I wanted to see and taste what all the buzz was about! I'm a red velvet fan! And to try the sprinkles red velvet cupcake was a must! So here's my review! Absolutely amazing the cupcake was moist and very delicious! The icing was good too not too thick and not too sweet just right! I also purchased the black and white cupcake it was very good as well and last but not least the chocolate marshmallow cupcake another hands down for this!

We purchased half dozen cupcakes.. Here's the low down.. Coconut flavor - the cake part tasted like it was made of paper towels.. Strawberry - Again no flavor to the cake.. Icing was good.. Red Velvet - Icing was horrible - Cake was normal! Chocolate - Icing good, Cake was again like paper towel! Im no cake maker but pretty sure cake should be sweet.. its like these had none! Even my sweet toothed 7 year ago hated them! Over priced, Paper tasting!

I just love the ice cream here. HONESTLY, not much of a fan of cupcakes. But they look cute. The machine that gives you cupcakes is an awesome creation. Service is satisfactory. TRY THE ICE CREAM SANDWICHES !! Portions are decent.

I would like to start that I think the cupcakeATM is an awesome idea. Even though the cake part is just par (definitely nothing special) the icing is pretty good. Now service! Awful!!! Where do these people get their training? Where is thier supervision? I don't pay $5 for a cupcake. I pay $5 for the cupcake and experience. If you are still reading, let me tell you that a Sprinkles staff member was tossing around chairs because she was frustrated and hit my 70 year old mother with a chair. I will NEVER pay another cent for a product at Sprinkles.

Came in today and the young man behind the counter was amazing. I had to leave a review for him because his service he provided for each and one of the customers was extraordinary! There was a very large line to the door and as I sat eating my cupcake I watch every customer leave happy with a smile on their faces! What made me want to make this review was because although the line was large and there was customers who were getting upset and had to wait minutes to be helped. He made sure to make them smile at the end of the transaction. Hope he keeps up the great work!
Peanut butter cup ice cream was soooo good! Lots of chunks of peanut butter cups in the ice cream. A small scoop is plenty and the price very reasonable!
YUM!! So good! The sundaes are amazing! Excellent quality ice cream and cupcakes combined together in a bowl. HEAVENLY! Great staff too, very friendly even with a line up of people out the door!

OH MY YUMMY I have a strong appreciation for many things in life and one of them is cupcakes. Sprinkles needs to expand west and get some more locations near me! Or maybe it's best they stay in Vegas so I have an excuse to go back! There is such a great variety here. All of their ingredients are pronounceable it almost makes me want to endorse the place as healthy! This is only my second visit and I "only" got two this time but they were both wonderful. I ate them too fast I forgot to take pictures (no, not both at the same time)! I ordered the triple cinnamon or double something or other, it tasted like a snickerdoodle spice cake with cinnamon frosting. The second was the "sprinkles" flavor which I believe is just their vanilla cake with white frosting and rainbow sprinkles. Both hit the spot. The place is always packed it seems, but the servers stay happy and always seem to be smiling. It's open late and there is an ice cream bar attached that is also quite tasty! A place I will definitely make a point to visit every time I come to Vegas.

I first tried a Sprinkles cupcake in Scottsdale, AZ a handful of years ago and was quite happy to sample several specimens at the time. Successive visits yielded similar reactions: sugar high that mellowed out to a general state of well-being only induced by baked goods. My visit to the Linq location last night was enjoyable enough, but I think I'm done paying almost $4/cupcake. Yes, I'm paying for the "brand name" and slick marketing, but still, that's pricey. I'm glad that Sprinkles offers mini-size cupcakes (only $2!) for those who still want a treat but are trying to be disciplined (like me...sort of). My red velvet mini cupcake was tasty: cake had nice texture, but come on, all I tasted (and cared about because I'm really 3 years old!) was the cream cheese frosting. Yum. Cookies and ice cream are new-ish products, but I can't comment on the quality because I didn't order either item. FYI: One can request "frosting shots!" Yes folks, one can still ask for a little paper cup full of whatever flavour frosting you want, just in case the gargantuan amount of icing on your cupcake isn't enough already (like in my case). So, Sprinkles, you're cute and fun and A-OK in my book.

We stopped at the cupcake ATM one night on our way home form the club, at that point in time I was pretty sure it was the best food I had ever eaten but perhaps my judgement was a bit clouded... We went back the next day for ice cream cones and I got the red velvet option which has pieces of the red velvet cupcake mixed in. The cake pieces were very good and confirmed that I wasn't completely crazy the night before. While the cupcake was good the ice cream itself was lacking, the mouth feel was a little off, I think they could stand to increase their butter fat. If you are staying near the Linq the cupcake ATM is a solid late night option, other than that I wouldn't go out of your way to go here, especially since there so many good dessert/ice cream/candy places on the strip.
The Cookie Cupcake is AMAZING! Also had the cornflake cookie and it was good... and a PB cupcake that was OK... the cookie cupcake is a must while in Vegas!!!!!!

Hot and gross feeling in their building as the sun set. It was cooler outside. They really should run the AC more. The line was long, unorganized, and not moving so we went to Ghirardelli instead for ice cream.

I get excited whenever somewhere as amazing as the Linq adds a dessert/sweet shop to its list of shops. How can this kind of place NOT have a sweets shop, and how can it be anything other than Sprinkles, complete with a cupcake ATM? My plan of attack (pregame before a concert at the Brooklyn Bowl) was this: an apple ale from O'Sheas pub, then trekking a mere 30 seconds to Sprinkles for a few cupcakes. The group I went with had no interest whatsoever, in sampling this hyped cupcake boutique. I, on the other hand, LIVE for trying new dessert places. There was a steady stream of customers upon entering the shop, but I was immediately greeted with a smile, and the girl behind the counter was more than eager to help. I was overwhelmed with choices, and if I had a choice, I'd have bought one of each flavor. My wallet decided against that idea, and I ended up with a chocolate/banana and a black/white cupcake. As I'm standing outside of the shop, in the middle of a busy walkway, balancing my ale and my cupcakes, taking overly dramatic (almost rated R type of eye rolling chew after chew), the group that was with me finally had to sample my sweet luscious cakes. (the cupcakes, sillies). I wish I hadn't offered them all a taste of my cupcakes. I ended up with nothing but cupcake liners and sweet regret. I guess they all enjoyed the sweets as much as I did. But that just means that I have an excuse to go back again. Cupcake ATM, I'm coming for you!
My husband and I each had an ice cream cone. Best ice cream and waffle cone that we have ever had! Line was long but worth it.

Absolutely amazing...down to the plates and forks they provide at check out. So much attention to detail is paid. Cupcake choices are limited based on the day you go but they take amazing. Triple cinnamon was my flavor of choice and it did not disappoint. Very reasonably priced as well. Customer service was great. All in all a good experience and great place to stop if you're in the area.

Being a mama to be, hunger strikes quickly when you least expect it. We were so busy exploring the sights and sounds of the Strip that we lost track of dinner time. Nausea and light-headedness kicked in before I knew what to do. My quick thinking husband said, "Let's get you a cupcake since we can't decide on a restaurant to eat at and we would still have to wait for the food once ordered." He knew me too well. I chose a dark chocolate cupcake with sprinkles (naturally) and it was magical how quickly I felt better of course cupcakes can do that to you even if you're not pregnant and hungry.
Thank you for making gluten free and peanut/nut free cupcakes! The frosting shots are a nice touch too. Great service and sincere care of customers.

Yum!! I've been waiting for Sprinkles to open in Vegas ever since I had them in beverly hills, and I'm glad to report they taste just as good as the original ones! I use to try to curb the cravings with the cupcake stores here but nothing came close to the moist, sweet, and beautiful sprinkles cupcakes. And lucky us we get the ice cream store AND an atm machine as well!

The famous sprinkles...in regards to decor the cupcakes are definitely minimalist. It makes you rethink the cupcakes of your youth. My husband got the cinnamon sugar (without icing) and I got the double cinnamon sugar with icing. I really loved the icing but the actual cake part fell flat (it's usually the opposite with me). My husband who isn't really into sweets loved the cupcake. This makes me wonder is it really a cupcake if you market to those who aren't that into sweets? I might try sprinkles again but will probably do the cupcake ATM for novelty or maybe incorporate the ice cream function of the store into my order.

Review based on Sprinkles' invite-only Sneak Peek event on Wednesday, March 19th! I received an e-mail from Sprinkles last week inviting me and a guest for a taste prior to their grand opening. The tasting involved complimentary cupcakes (2) and ice cream. Very exciting! We arrived approximately 15-20 minutes before the event (2PM-4PM) and there was already quite the line. We were checked off a list and given cupcake and ice cream menus. The event was pretty organized as they allowed a certain amount of people in at one time as to not overcrowd the intimate shop. The boutique is adorable! Bright colors, their script logo, Sprinkles dots, and treats galore. On the left side of their space is the counter to order cupcakes and beverages. The cupcakes are displayed to your right, flavors labeled with wooden blocks. There were also doggie cupcakes ($2.50) and their "store" where you can purchase shirts ($25-40), onesies ($25), cupcake mixes ($14), and a crazy adorable miniature toy replica of a Sprinkles boutique ($16)! On the other side of their boutique is the ice cream counter. There are also two entrances. On the exterior wall, facing O'Sheas, is the very cool Cupcake ATM that is open 24 hours! My guest, Christina, and I bought opted for the Salty Caramel ice cream (one scoop, $3.75) in a Red Velvet waffle cone ($1). I really wanted to try the Coffee Fudge Almond, but they didn't have any! The Salty Caramel was really sweet and much too salty; it was difficult to eat. The Red Velvet cone was delicious! Soft, crunchy, and great flavor. It's a must with your ice cream! We shared four cupcakes ($3.75/each): Chocolate Coconut (Belgian dark chocolate with coconut cream cheese frosting), Ginger Lemon (Spiced ginger cake with lemon cream cheese frosting), Red Velvet, and Strawberry. By the way, I love the wooden utensils with "Sprinkles" etched in their handles! We took these home to enjoy since there are only 4-5 seats and a small table facing outside. The cupcakes were all very moist, but didn't have spectacular flavor. Strawberry was our favorite with the best cake flavor and frosting. Yummy and not overly sweet. I didn't care for the chocolate, ginger, or red velvet cakes. The ginger flavor was just okay and it was difficult to detect lemon in the frosting. The chocolate and red velvet didn't taste like much. I did like the coconut frosting very much. I've had prior experience with Sprinkles cupcakes and they're not my favorite, however, there are certain flavors that I really enjoy. The Strawberry was wonderful and I loved the German Chocolate offered last Fall. FYI: Sprinkles is located next to Brooklyn Bowl, near the High Roller. They're open Sunday thru Wednesday 10AM-12AM and Thursday thru Saturday 10AM-1AM. There is a schedule for their cupcake and ice cream flavors, so if you're looking for something in particular, view their website before your visit!

My husband and I got married on the high roller. We spoke to the manager at Sprinkles a couple months before the wedding and they were agreeable to block off some tables and chairs to reserve an area that our wedding party could go to have a mini cupcake reception. We were so pleased. The cupcakes looked and tasted amazing. The display towers that we used were classy and everything was set up on time and the area was perfectly blocked off for our guests. Jessy the manager had been extremely helpful with planning this portion of the event and made sure all details were taken care of. We truly had an amazing experience and time.

Probably one of the bests cupcakes I've ever had. Super fresh! We went during the night time and they weren't crumbling or falling apart nor was there a small selection. Way better than Frosted cupcakes, and worth the price considering its Vegas, wasn't pricey.
Brittany and Brandy were extremely nice and helpful. They are the reason I am coming back in addition to the cupcakes being delicious. This is me traveling from Baltimore, MD.

Let's be honest-- I love sprinkles. I used to get their cupcakes every time we would go to SoCal, and was so happy that they decided to open up a location here in Vegas. We've been to their location at the linq quite a couple of times, but yesterday's visit was just disappointing. I dragged a couple of friends with me to satisfy my cupcake craving, but what I got instead were two very dry and crumbly cupcakes. I got the seasonal chocolate chip cookie cupcake and my favorite, the dark chocolate cupcake. As soon as I bit into the chocolate chip cookie one, the whole cake practically crumbled in my hand. I had to use a fork just so I wouldn't make a mess. Whatever, I thought it was just that cupcake, but when I came home to eat the dark chocolate cupcake the same thing happened. The cake fell apart, and broke off into tiny little pieces. I mean, the flavors were still there, frosting was still great, but it was just not enjoyable to eat. It just didn't feel nor did it taste fresh. I know I'll be back anyway since, as I've mentioned, I love sprinkles, but hopefully next time will be a better experience.
not very impressed. 12 for 3 cupcakes. not too bad for vegas but the variety sucks qnd the cupcakes were dry and bland to me. my son asked if they were sugar free. fell apart and hard to eat

I have heard so many things about this place... and maybe that made my expectations extremely high... and it didn't live up to that expectation. Tried 4 flavors - Red Velvet, Orange, Lemon Coconut, and Cuban Coffee. Now I have to let you know, I LOOOOVVVEE me some sweets. I love all things sugary and I enjoy baking as well as discovering all wonderful bakeries. These cupcakes had a simple presentation. The cake was moist, but it was not outstanding. 4 cupcakes for $15. Of the 4, my favorite was the Cuban Coffee. I really really wanted to love the red velvet, because I love red velvet, but I didn't. It wasn't bad, but it wasn't great. The frosting was very sugary.. like hard-shell. Maybe I will try the ice cream next time. The location is nice though. Picked up the cupcakes here. Grabbed coffee across the street at Ghiradelli, and sat outside by the fountain on a beautiful afternoon.

They always have amazing service and the best desserts !! I don't come out to the strip much but this is one of my most visited stops when in this touristic location !! Their red velvet ice cream is my absolute favorite

Was very disappointed for a company who is KNOWN for having allergy and vegan options to find out that there is NOTHING ON THE MENU that I can eat- and I don't have life threatening allergies. Won't even be making a visit when I visit Disney or Las Vegas because they don't have cupcakes safte for people with multiple allergies. Such a disappointment.

I have always had an issue with overpriced cupcakes, until now. I have tried some of the Las Vegas cupcake shops and was disappointed in their product. While walking through the Linq I decided to give Sprinkles a try. Being just under $4 dollars a piece I opted for three. The Key Lime, Coconut, and the Red Velvet. I dove right in when I got home and was impressed. Each cupcake felt pretty heavy in my hand and they were packed with flavor. The cake was moist and the icing was sweet but not sickening sweet as some other stores create with their icing. These were definitely an excellent treat and I will definitely come back on another special occasion.
This place has one of the best cupcakes in the business. It was moist and fluffy. It was a bit sweet and a lot of frosting but other than, it was yummy. Staffs were always smiling and friendly

Dear Red Velvet cupcake, GET IN MY MOUTH. My favorite cupcake to date. I love the ATM that's available to satisfy your cravings after hours - though I still prefer to get one through the store... Would rate 5/5 if lower priced

I think I like Miette cupcakes more. These were super hard and dry. Though I had the flourless, it was super dense. I also ordered the lemon coconut, and still dry. The frosting was not soft and fluffy, more like hard and overly sweet. The place is pretty neat though. One side is cupcakes only, the other is ice cream + cupcake experience. Basically you pick a cupcake and put ice cream on it. Or you can have ice cream with cookies like an ice cream sandwich. A bit pricy for me for two cupcakes around $7.50.

Let me set the scene: I'm crushing the ungodly hot hell that is the LV strip with my ride or die collar poppin playas when all of a sudden this oasis comes out of nowhere. What?!? Cupcake ATM. ATM being an acronym for AnotherTimeMoFo, we Gon get ourselves some ice creams. We walk in, greeted with a smile and hope for the world through this weirdly shaped ordering line. Don't through rocks near this place because it's all glass. We watched 4 or 5 elderly women having a hard time finding their way out. High prices no doubt but they aren't crooks out for a cheap dollar. They load you up the ship you outside tithe patio where you orgasm on ice cream loaded with the worlds cupcake. BevMo punks beware- this place is taking over the ice cream world. Is Sprinkles the name of my favorite ice Cream shop or my favorite stripper? Idk but either way I'm satisfied.

I am SOOOOOO excited about this new Sprinkles location. I've been telling all my Las Vegas friends how much I miss living in the Bay Area near the Palo Alto sprinkles and now I don't have to anymore!! Also very excited about the ice cream situation here and the Cupcake ATM! The Linq is definitely worth walking through and make sure you save time for a cupcake

Before my flight home, I decided I wanted something sweet, and what better place than a Sprinkles cupcake. Because I am unfamiliar with the area, I parked at the Caesars parking garage and walked to the cupcake shop. I select my cupcakes and hand my debit card to the cashier. She then asked to see my ID, I told her I don't have my ID , I left it in my rental... because the Sprinkles that I go to often to in Northern California or, the one I've visited in Beverly Hills a few times never asked for my ID. She then goes to ask a shift manager if she can accept my debit card. She comes back and says no she needs a photo ID of some sort. I was extremely heated because I had 20 minutes to return my rental, and had to walk all the way to the Parking garage empty handed. About a few days later I realized I could have used the ATM outside of the shop

This place is so cute! The cupcakes are really delicious and you have so many to choose from. I had the chocolate and hubby had lemon and we both loved it. Moist, not to sweet goodness. ...I'm going back before I leave Vegas

Love this place! Perfect for an after dinner treat while walking around the Linq. Their ice cream is absolutely delicious as well as their red velvet cones! The cupcakes are equally as good and they even offer doggy treats in the form of mini cupcakes.

I finally had the chance to try Sprinkles cupcake and there was not a long line like the ones in California. Maybe it was my lucky day in Las Vegas. On one side, they sell cupcakes and the other side, they sell ice cream. I think it's not bad that it's $3.75 a single scoop, but I rather try the cupcake first. A cupcake cost $3.75 each, which is a good and decent price for a dessert. There are such a large variety of cupcakes, but I had the red velvet and the vanilla. Both were delicious. It's located across from Ghiradelli Chocolates and you can see the high roller ferris wheel while enjoying your cupcake.
This is the best Gluten Free red velvet cupcake I have had! And yes my gluten eating peeps were in love with their six amazing flavors too! Bravo to these Bakers outstanding!!

A must have for me on every trip to Vegas. Every flavor I've had here was great. In the few times I've visited, the service has always been good. It's a little cramped inside, only a few window seats. I've tried the coconut, the double chocolate, the peanut butter cup, the marshmallow and the salted caramel. All were delicious, my fav being the marshmallow. It has a marshmallow fluff inside and a chocolate ganache topping. Yum! Just wish they weren't so pricey. Close to $20 for four cupcakes with tax!!! Location is great along the Linq Promenade. There's plenty of outdoor tables to sit, enjoy your cupcake and people watch. I tried the ATM once and, although it was kinda cool watching the automated arm reach into the store and grab my cupcake, the cake itself was very dry and the frosting was hard. Makes me think it was a few days old and had been refrigerated. I didn't finish it. Definitely recommend, just maybe skip the ATM.

I was so excited to try Sprinkle's, and unfortunately these cupcakes did not live up to the hype. I ordered a chocolate on chocolate cupcake, it was crumbly/dry inside and basically had a similar flavor to a box cake mix. I gave 2 stars because the ice cream was great! Loved the capt crunch flavor, yum!!!! We also tried the snicker doodles, and they didn't disappoint . The ordering system is nonsense, one area for cupcake only and another for cupcake, ice cream, cookies. Why not just have one area for all of it? The employees were friendly but it seemed like they were extremely over staffed in the cupcake section.

As soon as you walk in everyone welcomes you. Employees have smiles on their faces. Ive been here a couple of times. Ive had the red velvet cupcake! Its so good omg! I cant wait to try more! Its a bit pricey but hey its pretty good quality, i don't mind it. I always come to sprinkles when I am visiting the LINQ. Must hit this spot if you are visiting Vegas! They even have a cup cake ATM! Pretty cool if you ask me.

I'm a big Sprinkles fan. This is not my favorite location but this review is based on one visit in October. I ordered two cupcakes (strawberry and peanut butter) and my friend also had two. Mine were overcooked and a bit dry. The frosting was fine. My friend also complained that hers were both very dry and has had way better (more moist) cupcakes elsewhere.

We grabbed treats from here twice. The first time from the Cupcake ATM and the second, from in-store. We preferred the ones from in-store. The cupcakes we got from the vending machine were sticky, warm and a little googly. The ones from in-store seemed a bit fresher; the cake portion was soft and the frosting wasn't overly sweet. This may have been because we chose more "basic" flavors (chocolate/vanilla vs. pecan pie and white chocolate raspberry) the second time around, but consistency across all levels would be nice. There are Sprinkles locations near me back home, but I'll probably stick to my local mom and pop spots.

Tried Sprinkles in Las Vegas. got a vanilla cupcake, was dense and dry..lots of icing..no one liked it..also tried the cinnamon sugar cupcake..was drier than the vanilla and had the consistency of a corn muffin..very hard to swallow..still have red velvet and banana to try but not looking forward to them after the first two red velvet was nothing spectacular..dry again..the banana cake was moist but was very heavy.. will save my money..I can make better cakes than these

This place is so cute, with two entrances- one for cupcakes and one for ice cream and cookies. Clean, colorful, cute, and the ice cream is super good. I had the red velvet ice cream and the cake bits were as perfect as they could be while blended with the ice cream. Would definitely go back. Happy eating!

Wasn't anything too special, though it may be because we got in right before closing. Ended up getting ice cream with a red velvet waffle cone. The cone was pretty good, though because it was late in the day it wasn't as fresh and it could have been. The ice cream was also decent but because of the flavour we got (salted caramel) I couldn't eat much of it so I let me girlfriend eat most of it. Didn't get a chance to try any cupcakes because I was too full from eating earlier but I'd recommend you try and get there earlier in the day.

Got a vanilla ice with chocolate chips cookies and brownie crumbs and whip cream, very rich but soooo good and yummy and amazing on a hot day. My friend got a red velvet cone with red velvet ice cream it was also very yummy. Came back later and got a marshmallow chocolate cupcake so moist and yummy not too sweet but sweet enough. Also got a coconut one, it was really good but the marshmallow one was better. My friend got red velvet cupcake and a dark chocolate one, she said both were bomb. Overall 16/10 will be going back.
Worth every penny. Cake was so fresh.frosting not too sweet. The milk chocolate tasted so real. I wish I had bought a t-shirt.

I'm no cupcake connoisseur. I enjoy watching Cupcake Wars when it's on, had not a clue this place was owned by someone on the show. It wouldn't have made a difference to me. The line was too long for us to put up with, so we chose to utilize the ATM around the corner. What an adorable idea! We got chocolate marshmallow, red velvet and vanilla chocolate...or something like that. They were all delicious. Thumbs up. Finally a place to rival The Cupcakery! Looking forward to coming back soon.

Dear sweet baby Jesus, this place is good! We started out with a scoop of half "salty caramel" and half "peanut butter and jelly" as our gateway drug at this deviously unassuming den of sugary sex appeal. I ordered the ice a fore mentioned ice cream and my girlfriend got a peanut butter, choco chip, pretzel cookie. The cookie was really good. The ice cream was spectacular! So we made our way to the end of this little strip off of the strip and I realized that I had lost all my ice cream. This was an emergency situation and neither of us hesitated to do what had to be done as we immediately returned to Sprinkles for a refill on our Salty Caramel. We returned the following night for a brownie sundae made with, you guessed it; salty caramel. And I finally returned one last time before I boarded my flight so I could bid farewell to my new love!
