took a trip to Jack Frost for a classmate's birthday... it was a little out of the way but the donuts looked too BOMB on yelp not to go. I came here around 7:00am and surprisingly there was a little line- a good sign! I ended up ordering a dozen for about $15. The donuts- I would guess they probably had 30 + different flavors when I was there. They had a variety of cake and yeast donuts, but it seemed like more cake donuts. Some flavors that I remember include salted caramel (counter lady said it was the best selling), maple bacon, german chocolate, pumpkin cheesecake, apple cinnamon, samoa, s'mores, fruity pebbles and captain crunch cereal covered donuts. The donuts are really well made. The texture of the cake itself is good, but the toppings were incredible and super fresh! Like people have said before, I have to take a star off for the unlabeled donuts. I would at least have a list or a sign. It got super tedious having to ask the worker what each donut was, and i noticed that customers in front of me just opted for a variety box where you don't choose what you get.
Super fresh and a large selection to choose from. Staff is friendly and helpful. Best donuts in town

We rushed in 5 minutes before closing and had no clue what to order. It was my first time there, we're visiting from CA. The two young ladies were very friendly and helpful, they gave us some great suggestions. We got 2 German chocolates, a lemon cheesecake and a toasted coconut. The donuts were fabulous! We will definitely be back and we appreciate the great service.
Delicious - preorder and pick up. Fun, creative donuts!
They treat their employees horribly and over charge for the low quality ingredients they use
They have the best donuts. We don't get them anywhere else. The glazed are my favorite although they have many different flavors.

Jack frost has very delicious glazed donuts and donut holes. The other donuts are very pretty, but have too much frosting for our liking. However, they have recently raised their prices again, and they are just not worth 25 bucks a dozen.
Never overly impressed - they don't have any filled donuts. They have TONs of flavors but nothings labels so I never even know what I'm getting

Pretty good donuts, fun flavors, and most seem to be heavy on the frosting if that's what you're looking for. I was glad that it wasn't super busy when I went since I had to ask questions about what each flavor was since non of them were labeled. I ended up with a couple festive chocolate frosted donuts and two raspberry glazed. I would come again if in the area.
Some of their options are strange, but they're always well made and delicious. A bit pricy but definitely worth it. Try donuts with their peanut butter whip mix and chocolate frosting.

If you've got a sweet tooth, this place is THE spot for you. They have a wide variety of options available and their staff is happy to explain what the donuts are. My friend and I looked at their online menu before walking in and found out that they don't match the menu with what's actually at the store. For example, they had their holiday specialty donuts at the shop but they weren't listed online. We went for a half-dozen box which was the right move for three people. We got the following donuts: sour cream glazed old fashioned, powdered lemon, cake donut with m&ms and cream, chocolate iced peanut butter cream jacked up cake donut, raspberry drizzle chocolate cake donut and a holiday reindeer long john with chocolate cream filling. Out of all of them, I'd say the raspberry drizzle chocolate was my least favorite because I was expecting the drizzle to be a stronger flavor. Favorite donut was the chocolate iced peanut butter cream jacked up cake donut. Definitely one to try for those that are fans of anything peanut butter.

It's not what it used to be. The classic donuts are the same. I appreciate that. But the new fancy donuts don't fit JFD. I mean they are fine and tasty and whatnot. But JFD was always delicious because of the recipe and the simple fillings and toppings. That's what made it great, not 4oz of icing piled on top.

I love everything about this place. The selection, the customer service, the donuts, the donut holes, the plain donuts, the ones with icing in really cool designs. These donuts are so good I bought a dozen for a family that had moved into the neighborhood recently and now allllll the neighbors want to be friends! Did I mention how delicious the donuts are? So good.

Its always a treat getting donuts here. There are so many to choose from. Their glazed are so tasty. I also love their fried cake donuts. I don't go here often simply because their donuts are so wonderful I over indulge. Even their stand at the zoo has wonderful donuts. I had expected donuts there to be slightly stale, being out at the zoo, but they weren't.

Wow the biggest donut selection I have ever seen honestly. Nothing is labeled but if something looks good to you just ask what it is and they will tell you! I got the banana cream donut and ate it many hours later and it was still amazing so I bet if you get a donut fresh it is perfect!

Went here on Friday specifically for the Pronuts. I was pretty happy with the PB&J and the Pumkin Cinnamon. The red velvet was definitely a hold over or something because it was dry as heck. BUT I will definitely go back and buy the lot so I can sample all the flavors available. I did the best I could with a few nutritional facts I found online for calorie and macro tracking. Only thing that would have made a better trip would have been nutrition facts on site. The service was great also. Pleasant and patient staff is appreciated.

The doughnuts are ok but not for the price 15.75 for 6 small doughnuts, Lol... thinking back a bit I remember getting a dozen for 2.50, I know times have changed but wow 15.75 for half dozen not worth it.

We have been wanting to try Jack Frost Donuts for quite sometime now - so yesterday we made it happen! We had to take a friend back to the airport and thought after all we have read about them that this would be a perfect place to eat away our sadness :-) Jack Frost offers raised and cake donuts. We had to ask the lady at the counter to tell us what our choices were as they are not labeled. She did an OK job but she did not really "sell" me on any really. I would have thought me saying it was our first time she might have been more helpful but she wasn't. She did not even point to what was what as she rambled off their names. In the end we purchased a mixed dozen and a half in order to sample a variety of styles and flavors. We had some lemon, some turtle, some salted caramel, some maple bacon, some of their cream sticks and some krullers. I am not usually a fan of a cake donut but theirs are different than most. When I normally eat a cake donut they are very heavy and crumbly but these had a bit moister consistency to them. I tried the Salted Caramel and it was not super sweet - just enough icing to give it a little flavor. I would have like it to taste like caramel but it really did not. It did have a bit of salt flavor though. The Maple Bacon was delicious! The icing is really delicious and the bacon had a great flavor and not just like bacon bits being used. It was the one donut out of all of these I think I would want again. My husband and my sister each had a lemon and they said they were good but nothing as special as we had hoped. I was most disappointed in the cream sticks and Neapolitan we got. The fillings used are very grainy and not flavorful in my opinion. The worst one being the peanut butter. It was overly grainy and way too sweet. We also tried their turtle cake donuts and they were not too bad but the chocolate creme on one of them was lackluster. It was a great idea but there was not much chocolate flavor to it so it fell short of its intended goal. The one without actually tasted better because of this. I really wanted to like this place I had heard so much hype about it, but all in all it was very average. I might try it again just to see if it was an off day...but only if I am on that side of town for something else.
Fresh donuts and variety, the best donuts around. I recommend this place. The apple fritters are the best around.
The donuts are delicious and the people are great! We met Jack and went home with 3 boxes of donuts!!

When I first decided to relocate to Cleveland two years ago, everyone told me I HAD to go to Jack Frost. "Surely, this place can't be all that special", I thought. Oh boy was I wrong. My first experience was before the remodel and the line was out the door in the middle of February, but no one seemed to mind waiting in the cold. Once I actually made it inside, I was overwhelmed and amazed by the choices. Who knew icing could be stacked so high on a single donut or that Fruity Pebbles make such a delicious topping? Not this girl, that's for sure. I didn't know what most of the flavors were and had to ask for an explanation. The woman working was very short and to the point, but again...the line was out the door. One thing that really stuck with me was how genuine this place is. They make great donuts from scratch and don't try to be something they aren't. So many independent bakeries try to be hip and trendy, but Jack Frost is sweet and gritty; that's probably why they've been in business so long. I love these donuts so much I got a speeding ticket trying to get there before the rush. Who cares about going to traffic court when you were speeding for a good reason (e.g. Boston cream, German chocolate, salted caramel, etc).

I like their donuts a lot so when my wedding planning got to the cake-picking point Jack Frost was top of my list. I am very disappointed by the flexibility for scheduling a tasting. Every other cake vendor, including the one that ultimately got my $500+ order, was able to accommodate evenings and weekend schedules. Jack Frost was not. The woman I was emailing with ultimately rudely stopped answering my emails trying to schedule a time. I used to take all of my out-of-town visitors Jack Frost for a taste of Cleveland but I am super disappointed by their service on a few of my last visits and with scheduling a tasting.
Love jack frost ! We order from here often! Kiddos love it as do we ! No complaints !
The best donuts in the entire universe. Never had a bad donut here unfortunately these things are a million calories apiece

Back in the Ninety's? I had a doughnut from here. Went to the store all they had was a jelly doughnut. People were buying dozens of these. Not kidding, & who only sells one kind a doughnut !?! 1-2-3 dozen at a time in fact. As fast as they were being made they were sold. It was good ,like Krispy Creme (smaller- not icing covered). Now they have regular size doughnuts with fancy toppings. Memmh, they're decent but not as good as the hype. These are good don't get my wrong it's the hype over them that's over blown. That's just my opinion so try'em for yourself .
The place is nice and clean the staff is very friendly and also it's a neighborhood donut shop I love it I would definitely recommend it
Delicious. Wish I could tip the kind ppl on my card though! They just upgraded their coffee game 10 fold with soooo many options.

Their donuts are baked to perfection and they aren't greasy at all! It pains me to remove a star but their frosting is so dang sweet my family stopped eating there. We had ordered a donut cake and while it looked absolutely incredible, the frosting was completely overbearing. Not many people ended up eating it and most of them just scraped the frosting off.

Wanted to love, but while the flavors were decent it was a tad too sweet for my liking and I like sweets. Beautifully made donuts, appealing to the eye; however, to me, the cake texture of the don't didn't necessarily balance well with all of the flavors. Out of the three purchased, I enjoyed the maple bacon the most. I wanted to try the pineapple upside down but they were out.
Great donuts but not perfect. But I bet some of their donuts are. I saw so many different kinds of all types of flavors. Genuinely plan on more so I can change this from a 4 to a 5.
Dry donuts if you go later in the day so I suggest going early in the morning to get the best of what they have to offer

I Will be completely honest right now, I am gluten-free. I do not eat donuts. However, my husband loves donuts as do most of my friends. No, don't feel sorry for me (OK, maybe a little sorry I do love sympathy ) Anywho... getting to the actual point of this review... Everyone seriously loves these donuts, Like, everyone. A ton of people say that these are their favorite donuts. For basically every one I know who eats donuts this is in their top 3. I probably could give them 5 stars based on all of my friends' reviews. However, I am a GLUTEN GRINCH and I had to remove a star for their lack of gluten free options. I would SO love them to get a GF donut but I'm not holding my breath

In the area from out of town and came in for a visit given the great advice of my fellow Yelp friends. The great reviews are so right. The location is on a corner and looks a bit dated on the outside - don't let this keep you away. They are cash only - so make sure you're prepared. Approx. $11 for a dozen which is a great deal for fresh homemade donuts. We got a dozen of assorted varieties. The glazed chocolate cake were great with a little crisp on the outside. The chocolate frosted cake donuts are super flavorful and love the thick chocolate coating and the wonderful piled high buttercream. The maple bacon was a wonderful mix of salty and sweet with fresh bacon bits and maple frosting on a yeast donut. The yeast donuts are not your ordinary yeast donuts - they are glazed perfect with almost a creamy mouth feel - stick in the microwave for 10 seconds - you will thank me later. German Chocolate donut is a glazed chocolate cake with pecan/coconut frosting and the wonderful piled high chocolate buttercream. My only concern is that there are no labels on any of the donuts which is fine for locals who may visit more often - but makes it difficult to decide without feeling really annoying to the staff and the line behind you. This shouldn't deter you at all though - The donuts are an absolute must try!

Donuts...food equals memories. One of my favorite stories from growing up was when my father would let me go on his bread route with him. He was a driver salesman for a local bread company. And every time I would ride with him we would stop at @jackfrostdonuts in Parma. Consistently rated number one or number two in Cleveland, these are by far my favorite cake donuts. Be sure to check hours and follow them on social media because they do sell out frequently. Today I picked some up for one of my clients. Although one magically ended up in my belly also

Truly some of the best donuts I have ever had! They are amazing! You really have to get there early to get the total selection because they go super fast. A tad expensive, but completely worth every penny. A wonderful homemade donut awaits you. You must try them out!

Love, love, love! These donuts taste great and are decorated super cute. If you love cream filled donuts, this place is for you. There's a mountain of cream on top of the donuts. Don't forget to get some donut holes too, those were gone as soon as I put them out on the kitchen table.

I've only had Jack Frost donuts twice. They are AMAZING. But watch you teeth! They are extremely sugary. I can't even eat a whole donut in one sitting because of how sugary they are. It's almost too much. But if that's what you're looking for, they are big, beautiful, and have such a large variety of flavors... they live up to the hype.

Delicious. This is the best donut store I have found since moving. The store has so many unique flavors and designs that anyone should be satisfied. On top of all of this the prices is great. One suggestion I would make is that if you want to get donuts from here be prepared to get up early. The donuts sell out quickly.
Definitely one of the best donut places to go to an Cleveland they have a bunch of different flavors always fresh it's a must try
Elaborate delicious donuts. They sell out fast so go early if you have something specific you want! The donuts have great flavor and they always have something new and exciting to offer

This was my first time ever to Jack Frost Donuts. I've driven past this location, but with all the uncertainty in the world right now, I needed a pick me up and today was the day! So whoa! So overwhelming! There are like a hundred options! The young lady who helped me was phenomenal. I decided on a donut with peanut butter icing and nuts and also a banana cream donut. My banana one was so very tasty. The donuts are made fresh and apparently they switch them out daily. I was told they have an Instagram page and was invited to follow them. They sell milk, coffee, juice and water also. This place is a gem and I will be back. Next time maybe I'll get a dozen so my family can try all different kinds. Can't wait!

Lots of donuts, lots of cream! I tried the Samoa donut since it's my fav Girl Scout cookie! The donut was okay, but not the best I've ever had. The extra dollop of frosting on top of the samoa donut wasn't necessary. Sort of takes away from the Samoa flavor itself. Frosting was a bit extra. Stop by if in the area, but I wouldn't make a special trip. It's a small shop made just for pickup. No seating inside & did not see a restroom.

I don't normally write review reviews for donut shops but Jack Frost Donuts is the exception. My wife and I were traveling through Cleveland on one of our road trips and stopped in to Jack Frost Donuts as it was highly recommended. We were impressed by everything. The store was immaculate, the staff was friendly and most of all the donuts are exceptional. We had the good fortune to meet Fred who is the owner and he gave us a sample of some of the donut holes. We had a great conversation with Fred and he is an amazing guy who we won't soon forget. We ended up taking a dozen donuts home. They really are the best donuts we've ever tasted. If you're ever in the area you really should try some for yourself.

Just moved back to Cleveland have been CRAVING these donuts. Drove all the way and the donuts were SO stale. This was around 4. I get it, end of the day. But I mean these were inedible. And $9 for 3 of them should at least be quality.

I have been fortunate enough to have eaten these delicious donuts since I was a small child. These are one of a kind delicious and have gotten even better in the hands of the current owner. I was amazed to learn they were still in business when I returned to ohio after a 32 year absence. Tbe donuts are still the best you will ever eat! Be warned, they are rather pricey but well worth the money.

Deliciousness - 3.5/5 Happiness - 3.5/5 I know this is a bit of an institution, but I simply wasn't that impressed. The donuts LOOK great for sure. Indeed, it took me about 5 minutes to finally figure out what I wanted as I marveled at all the options. And you absolutely get a lot of bang for your buck - the prices are very reasonable. But it would have been helpful for them to have names or signs as I basically had to interrogate the employee about what every offering was. But as good as they look, the taste just didn't do much. I have two young children and they didn't even finish their donuts. I felt like they didn't end up having a lot of flavor despite the extreme amount of sugar. I think this is a fun place to visit at least once due to the pure novelty. But ultimately, I'd rather get my calories from something a little tastier.
This is a donut place I always have to have when I visit my home town of Cleveland. They are always so good and so fresh. Se you guys again soon!

Best donuts I've ever had and I've been goin there since I was prolly 5 and I'm now 34!! Used to walk there almost everyday in the summer. And I remember when I was younger the free smiley face chocolate donuts they would give the kids! So sweet!! My fav!!!!

Jack Frost Donuts is your old neighborhood donut shop in Cleveland. I literally came in early one day and a police officer was having a mentoring conversation with one of the young employees. If you just sit in the parking for a while in the morning, you'll see all types of people coming in and out: the lazy grungy dude in his PJs, the businessman in a hurry, the mom with 4 kids, and multiple cops. Anyway, you'll never be disappointed eating fried cake and coffee and I wouldn't miss out on Jack's if you're looking for a Cleveland staple. My recommendations are the German Chocolate, Salted Caramel, and Maple Bacon. The coffee is self-serve and is pretty good.

I don't really like donuts but I heard this place is great, and I'll try anything once, so I decided to pick up a dozen and bring them into work the other day. I had to wait in line and there were people coming in after me as well, everyone was ordering 2 or 3 dozen donuts! I suppose this proved they are indeed popular and tasty! The lady who helped me with my order was personable, the place seemed clean, and the donuts did look quite nice. Oh and just a note, you have to pay with cash or check as they do not accept credit cards. Back to the donuts. I got a variety and my co-workers all said they tasted really good so that is what I am basing my review on. I did eat one and it was A-Ok, but it tasted like a regular donut to me so I can't really rate it on taste since it's not my thing, but I would definitely suggest this place to anyone who likes donuts! A dozen was only $10.95, so super cheap too!

Everyone knows that this place has great donuts. But the people who run it are horrible. I've had 2 friends that worked one day for this place and never received one penny. They were told they would receive a call when they were needed to start working regularly and it never came. Their over night bakers that make your beautiful donuts are paid minimum wage. I will never give them my business again.

Visiting a local friend who told me we HAD to grab some of these while we were out looking at rentals. I had read several reviews and was expecting to be rushed and overwhelmed. The counter guy was super friendly and helped me when I asked a few questions. We got a half dozen and they were the BEST donuts I've ever had. I'm a big fan of cake donuts so imagine my surprise when my favorite was the raised donut with powdered sugar and big gob of icing on top. So. Damn. Good.

Dropped by on Sunday morning just as they opened...was afraid that they wouldn't have all the variety but they certainly did!!! The apple pie cake donut was really good. The cinnamon toast wasn't a soft and chewy consistency as I liked nor expected, but the coffee cream filling was amazing with just the right amount of sweetness. The salted caramel kinda just tasted like a maple bar on a cake donut. They need to label their donuts for the ease of the both the employees and customers though!

Jack Frost is the mother of all donut shops in the known universe! These incredible round concoctions of tasty ecstatic delight are what gastronomical dreams are made of! They harken back to a time when ingredients and food were pure and fresh, and not laden with harmful chemicals, additives, preservatives, high fructose corn syrup, and GMO's! Hell, even the donut HOLE tastes great! Pre-diabetics and fitness freaks need not apply.

I have been going to Jack Frost Donuts ever since I was a little kid. Their donuts have only gotten better over the years. I haven't ever visited during a time where I've had to wait in a line. They offer all different types of crazy varieties that would cost at least double in a large city. One of my favorites is the Fat Elvis. Jack Frost is a serious gem in Cleveland, and if you haven't been yet, you're missing out!
Very creative selection of donuts. We tried an Andes Mint, Smores, Chocolate Cherry and a few others. All were very true to their descriptions in flavor but didn't blow me away for $1.95 each.

I live close to Jack Frost so I pass by quite often. They are always busy early in the morning. I have not been in to buy donuts since the remodel. I only went two times prior to that. I didn't like it then and I feel the same now. I have been to several functions where they served Jack Frost donuts and they were always a bit over the top for my taste. To much going on. I like simple donuts when I do eat them. It looks like a lot of people like all the embellishments but it's not for me.

Went to Jack Frost 04/30/2020. Business open. Store was closed 2 eeeks before due to Covid 19. Store has updated with plexiglass, distancing spacing & line marking. Looks really good & safe as practical under Covid 19 regulations. Will return. Same tasty donuts.

Stopped in for an after-lunch treat and was not disappointed. Lots of options in both yeast and cakey formats and all are super fresh. Loved the consistency, flavor, and frosting of the donuts. Prices were in line with other gourmet-type stores. Only bummer was there wasn't seating or a bathroom in the store.

The donuts itself are phenomenal. The fancy ones look great, but personally, I think it takes away from the donut itself. Such as the s'mores, it looks really appealing but the flavor of s'mores isn't there. One would think they would mix marshmallow fluff and graham cracker crumbs with the whipped topping.... false assumption. I have the same issue with the strawberry cream, if I were blind I would not know it had "strawberries" in it. Hands down, I'd go back for the simple and classic donuts. As far as I know, best donut shop around!
My whole family really likes Jack Frost because they aren't too sweet. Doughnuts are made from good dough, not just air and sugar.

I finally got to try Jack Frost Donuts. I've been following them for months on Instagram, and everything looks amazing. The donuts looked just as amazing in real life as they do in the Instagram photos. You can tell they take pride in the presentation of their donuts. I ordered a box of six - some raised dough, some cake donuts. Honestly I wasn't blown away. They were just okay. The dough tasted so salty for both the raised dough and the cake donuts. Maybe it was just that batch of dough that was used. I would probably come back to try them again just to see if it was just that batch of dough that was the issue. I'll update my review when I return to try again

These are hands down the best donuts in Cleveland for me. Their speciality is cake donuts, which I prefer over yeast donuts any day. They just have good, old fashioned donuts and they've been doing it for years. These are the donuts my grandparents would have in their house after school, and they are still just as good as I remember. They are a local staple and everyone needs to try them!
Raised prices to 24.95 per dozen from 18.95. A 32% increase! Good donuts but not worth that price. Way to stick it to your customers.

Stopped by after lunch to grab some sweets, walked out with more then I should have. Ended up buying 1.5 dozen orders, went with their specialty donuts - like maple bacon donuts, etc. While I liked their donuts, I would recommend you only consumed these once a year, as they are very sweet! While I was waiting, one of the gentleman kept on giving me donut holes to sample and even when I left, he gave me a box full for my road trip, with this kind of personal touch and service no wonder this this place is popular! If you are in town, I would recommend a visit and give their specialty donuts a try.
It's definitely good if you like a denser donut! The flavor combos are creative and delicious! We loved it and will definitely continue to support.
The best donuts in town. The history and the kind service you receive it's an Old Brooklyn staple

So went back today. Got 6 donuts to test. The vanilla cream, maple glaze, chocolate glaze and even the plain glaze for a glazed donut were all different. The glazed donut was still decent, despite the change. However the maple is just awful, thankfully tho the cake donut itself was still good. The vanilla cream improved over our last trip, so that was positive, but the chocolate glaze went downhill. I just can't fathom why they would change a perfectly good product. The donuts remain the same, delicious, soft and fresh. But the toppings need some help. Bring back the old recipe or the old ingredients, we can taste the difference and we are not happy :(

I am so happy that my brother and I stopped by this donut shop on the way to the airport! First of all, the cashier girl (don't remember her name) was super friendly and provided great service. We did stop by around 11AM so it wasn't busy but they still had a lot of flavors still available. When trying to choose what donuts to add to our half dozen, it was so overwhelming to choose. The two most notable donuts we got were the Maple Bacon and the Pumpkin Pie. We chose the Maple Bacon donut as that was recommended by the cashier. I can see why this flavor was the most popular donut! It has the right amount of sweetness and has the perfect breakfast flavor. Highly recommend that if you get this flavor try it with some milk. It is the perfect combination! The other flavor that stuck out to me was the Pumpkin Pie. Apparently, the owner's wife makes the pumpkin pie filling from scratch herself and oh boy, you can definitely tell that it was homemade pumpkin pie filling. No wonder we got the last donut of this flavor. It was SO GOOD!
Delicious donuts and a wide variety of options! You won't be disappointed! We got a dozen donuts. The maple bacon, red velvet, and raised maple were my favorites.
I love Jack Frost! Ever since a friend had them at their wedding, I've been addicted. Would recommend any of their donuts, mmmmm delicious.

Absolutely Love Jack Frost! I stop here a few Sundays a month to take a dozen to my Mom, she lives in Medina and Loves them too! Not only are their donuts fresh, but the staff is Super friendly! Get here early because there is always a line!!

Hands down, the best donuts in Northeast Ohio. I grew up in the neighborhood and I didn't realize how lucky I was to live right next to such a special shop. It can be hard to get to, but it's worth the drive. They have a wide selection of options and prices that can fit any budget, event, or taste. It's always a great day when someone brings Jack Frost Donuts to the office/hangout!
Got donuts there this morning. Place wasn't to busy. Got a dozen donuts and they are amazing. Taste great and service was good
The place had no donuts but about 2 on the back counter, display counters where all empty! We drove up for the Indams game and made a special stop for this place. Do yourself a favor and skip it
I had heard they had the best donuts in Cleveland. I agree. Huge selection. These are not your average donuts and they aren't cheap BUT they are worth every penny and calorie!!
$9.95 for 6 small donuts? So sad it's come to this. Must be some expensive whip creme on top of these. Hadn't been here in years before they became designer donuts. Don't think I'll be back.

I am so disappointed in myself that I have driven in front of this location and have not tried it before! It was just heaven in my mouth and in my belly! My dear coworker purchased them for us so I can't tell the cost of them however I can tell that Rice Krispies and Maple ones are my favorite!!! I have tried simple donuts and salted caramel as well. I have heard that their sour cream donuts are divine so I am definitely going to get some soon!! Thank you for being heaven on earth!
Donuts are freaking amazing and delicious m! Blueberry donut was soggy though but everything else Devine

Another yelp review of mine gone... WTF?!?! Jack Frost is a Cleveland institution. But unlike the many others that "aren't as good as they used to be", JF keeps the quality protected and has actually grown to improve the service. They've grown from a cash only business in a shoebox of a building to a roomier, plastic accepting bakery that has kept the quality and portion size a customer's dream. I cannot even figure out where to start describing these masterpiece donuts. Just look at the many, many pics that people have posted and try not drool onto your phone. Some say they are a little pricey. I'm telling you, you get what you pay for. I'll pay their prices all day, every day for that quality.
These donuts used to be great. However I went there today. I have to say that I am very disappointed The donuts taste old and stale.
First time here did not disappoint! Pretty crowded on a Sunday morning but service was super quick and efficient plus friendly staff. So many options to pick from

My friend was visiting from out of town and he insisted we meet up here. We used to frequent Jack Frost years and years ago. I had not been there in a while and remembered that back in the day, pre-Krispy Kreme, Jack Frost WAS essentially Krispy Kreme. There was nothing else like it in the dounutsphere. True to form, they impressed me with their assortment to this day. They elevated their game. So many options stare you down with a visual taste taste. Each donut is its own personal flavor fest that looks like you should take a picture of it first and foremost. This time, I did not take a picture. I only bought one Cinnamon Donut. Sometimes I like to keep it simple and really appreciated the fact that there were options that allowed me to. Grabbed a coffee with it to go and enjoyed the exercise thoroughly. My friend bought a half dozen of the sweet sweet donut "art." When I say sweet, I mean sweet. I call them dessert donuts. Worth a trip, definitely.
They are not what they used to be. Variety is great, but I rather have freshness. Way over priced
I love Jack Frost Donuts, The customer service is amazing just like their donuts! I Highly recommend their maple bacon donut
This place has one of the best donuts in town! They are always our go to when we want something on the sweeter side for breakfast! They have so many flavors and always have amazing deals!

So I've had more than one person tell me to try this place. I drive by here a lot since it's not too far from my house and since I was out running errands this morning and it just happened to be on my return route I decided eh why not?! I popped in around 10ish and they still had a ton of donuts. While walking in a guy was coming out with a huge bag full of donut boxes, my first thought omg do they have anything left? Haha I was surprised with the amount of donuts they did have. They have a huge selection and the donuts were pretty good. Not greasy with that funky after taste you get from some places. I wanted a plain old fashioned but I think the girl helping me misunderstood me and gave me a plain donut it was fine tho. I also got a raspberry jelly filled donut. Too much powdered sugar but otherwise good. I gave 4 stars because while they were very good. I've had better. I guess I'm just spoiled by the place I used to frequent in California. At least I know when the craving hits where to head to. I got two donuts for 4 bucks and some change.
The best donuts ever made!!!! I drive to Cleveland just to get them !!! They taste as good as the look. Friendly staff and great prices

I don't usually crave donuts, I rarely eat them...but after my first visit here today I'm obsessed with these delicious made fresh adorable donuts. And the shop is so cute. My only complaint is how in the world are you supposed to know what each donut flavor is? I picked a dozen based on looks alone, but would totally appreciate if they labeled their selection.

I love donuts. I was fortunate to have enough time before work to visit Jack Frost Donuts. Jack Frost did not disappoint. The donuts and service were excellent! I should have taken a photo of what I ordered. Unfortunately, these yummy donuts did not last long around me. The donut selection is fresh and vast. Donuts fans beware because you will have to practice self-control here. The donuts look and taste yummy. I recommend Jack Frost Donuts.

My mouth waters at just the thought of Jack Frost. No other donut place even comes close to comparing to this deliciously perfect donut shop. Always so fresh and sugary and amazing. I even had a donut bar at my wedding this past October that was put together by Jack Frost! We put the donuts out late into the reception for a snack and received many compliments about how delicious they were and how creative the donut bar was! Almost 150 donuts were gone in under 5 minutes! When a Jack Frost craving strikes, no other donuts will do!

We are absolutely blown away by the donuts here at Jack Frost. First sure, there donuts already good to begin with, but the toppings and specialty recipes Jack Frost does to them only elevates it to a whole new level. If you are in the area stop in and grab 2, or 3, or a dozen. I recommend anything with their berry toppings, especially their strawberry and chocolate topping. You also can't go wrong with a maple glaze!

One of the best donuts in Cleveland! They specialize in their presentation, but don't let the pictures scare you off if you are into plain glazed. These are my favorite glazed donuts around! Perfectly fluffy with just the right amount of glaze... Goes great with a cup of coffee! If you are feeling adventurous, they even have bacon maple! Something here for everyone! They have both cake and raised donuts, it's hard to tell what they are under the toppings so make sure you get what you want! If something is missing don't be afraid to ask, sometimes they have more in the back!

The donuts, on the whole, are good, but not deserving of the hype. Service was crappy, and I see I am not the first to point this out. Three employees working and none bothered to even greet me. Selection was: this is all we have, deal with it. On a positive note, they are no longer cash only.
The doughnuts are absolutely delicious.. When compared to Dunkin it's like McDonalds VS Flemings Steak House. No comparison. Just try them.. Your taste buds will thank you

There are very few things in life that can make a grown man cry to the point of dehydration. Properly filled doughy plumped creamy confectionary dream deserts are definitely one of them! These little donuts come in various crafted toppings. Each cake is finished to perfection. I have bought a dozen with my family and alone have eaten 6 in one sitting while the car ran defrosting the windshield before heading back home. Did I mention this jaunt is a 30 minute drive from my home and worth every minute of travel and gas?
My JF hiaku ; Jack Frost Makes Donuts Like saying The Beatles sang The Truth lies deeper. -------or------- As Jessie Pinkman would surely say: "DONUTS BITCH!"

I must first say I'm ashamed I've lived in this area for like 6 years and I've never stopped here . Wow what a nice surprise I haven't been this excited over donuts in years. Wow the selection is great they have any flavor combination you can think of. I was astonished when I tasted the donuts nice buttery, tasty, mouth watering goodness . I see why they have been in business as long as they have. The price was a little more then competitors but very well worth it. Kudos Jack Frost!!!!!!
The most amazing donuts ever in life! If you are looking for heaven just try this place.

Jack Frost donuts are wonderfully created reasonably priced designer donuts. I had the fresh made maple bacon donut. Bacon was chopped and fresh cooked sprinkled over a maple glaze donut. Certainly tasty reasonably priced you can not go wrong here. My office loves them and I do too.

Was coming home from an appointment & figured I would stop in & check out what some co-workers have said are the best donuts around. The selection was very limited since because it was 4pm and everything is made fresh from scratch daily but I managed to come up with a good assortment to take to the office in the morning. I'm going to have to venture back in the morning sometime soon to see the full selection of flavors available.

We got these one time as a surprise for a group of friends and breakfast with family which are now basically the same thing, thank you for your fast and friendly service and we really enjoy the food, you are excellent and accomodating.

Wow! Some of the best donuts we have ever put in our mouths. Fresh, delicious, amazing flavor and not overly sweet. They have a great variety of flavors from samoas, red velvet, maple bacon, s'mores, peanut butter to caramel apple. They definitely put some creative thought into their donuts. They did a great job on the renovation of the building it looks very nice and modern. And the owner Fred is a real gem! Keep up the great work Fred, you rock! Phenomenal!

Such an amazing local spot I tell all visiting family/friends to stop into. I remember coming here as a kid with my dad and papa and getting the best, freshest donuts. Holds a special place in my heart, and is just as great all these years later :)
Best donuts hands down but get there early or you may not get any. They have so many flavors to choose from. Their donuts are so fresh and so soft. My favorite the bacon maple yummy.
Just delicious! The giant cinnamon rolls are my favorite along with the maple donuts! Yum!

I absolutely love Jack Frost Donuts. It's a cute little donut shop located in Cleveland. I used to live right at the other end of the street so we make sure to stop whenever we are in the area. My mom was speaking with the owner on Facebook messenger about ordering so we wouldn't have to go in and wait. They told her to call the morning we needed them and they had them ready for us to pickup. My mom did have trouble getting through on the phone but they finally called back. She was able to pay over the phone, as well. They are just so good, I had to eat one right away! I love how there are so many unique flavors. I had the salted caramel and I can't wait to try the s'mores one next. I didn't go in to pick them up, but what I saw through the window is the employees were wearing masks.

I love Jack Frost donuts because they have delicious, large classic donuts that come in a variety of traditional and newer flavors. And the pricing is very reasonable especially compared to other donut shops of similar offerings in the Cleveland area. Bought a dozen to share with friends. Pictured here include maple bacon, fruity pebbles, Cocoa Puffs, Banana cream pudding!
Found this place by chance, so glad I did. Small shop, so you will need to find a place to eat the donuts. I would recommend you find a way to stop here if you're in the area, you will not regret it.

One of my favorite donut places in Cleveland! Super well priced and so delicious. What I love about Jack Frost is the donuts are on the smaller size so you can try a bunch of different flavors and not feel sick after. They have a bunch of unique flavors as well outside of your typical glazed and maple. Highly recommend this place to anyone in the area!

I love how much effort they put into their creations. Their doughnuts are works of art! Even just looking at them is a treat, let alone eating them. My thought for improvement is to label the doughnuts. It takes too much time having to wait for every one in front of you to ask questions. Then it's your turn and you have to ask. They would definitely increase sales with simple labels. Nevertheless, I will be returning!
The donuts look beautiful but they are way too sweet due to way too many toppings. The donut quality is ok but it's a waste when you need to scrape off all the frosting!

Read the reviews and was pleased to say it exceeded the lofty expectations. Every donut is topped with a mountain of frosting and if loving that is wrong, I don't want to be right. I tried the maple bacon donut, M&M, and Orange Crush. The maple bacon was one of the best maple bacon donuts I have ever had, mainly due to the excellent maple frosting -not to sweet and not too "maple-y". The M&M donut was great. I ordered to Orange Crush mainly for the novelty but was impressed by the quality -it's like a Dreamsicle and was fantastic! Will definitely stop by when I am in Cleveland again.

Need an idea for a fun girls' day out? Stop by Jack Frost then head to the Cleveland Zoo to watch wild animals reenact what you just did with your donuts. (That's actually exactly how I found this place lol). Like others have mentioned, you need to bring cash, be prepared to wait in a VERY long line (which seems to go pretty quickly), and bust out those sunglasses when you reach the glass counters so as not to be blinded by these sugary beauties. I enjoyed the apple fritter, maple bacon, and crullers. The salted caramel was also a memorable choice. You honestly can't go wrong with any of them and be prepared to surprise your digestive system with at least 3 donuts in rapid succession. Unlike other donut places, these delights are light, flavorful, and not sickening. The proportions are always correct, so that you never feel like you're being shortchanged on filling, topping, or dough. They really are special and that becomes clear when you meet people waiting in line that have traveled hours (that's right) to sample some of these treats. Count yourself lucky if you live nearby!
These doughnuts are delish!!! This place is a family favorite and highly recommended!! These classic doughnuts are the real deal!

When I bit into my first Jack Frost donut my mouth was like, "SHAZAM" and then I was sugar drunk and probably should have taken a nap. It was the real deal. These donuts were friggin' delicious and the spot is newly renovated and modern/hip. They are so creative with their donuts - there is no shortage of options here. We got a dozen and chose from a plethora of cake and fluffy raised donuts. Personally, cake donuts are where it's at for me - and Jack Frost makes a mean cake donut. I did find some of them to be a little bit over the top sweet, but.... it's a donut... that's basically why it exists. To put you in a sugar coma. I love this place and their donuts and the patient people that let me choose all of my donuts. The end.

Pretty good donuts. Very tasty and fresh. I'm not good at describing donuts, but I had one with white cream and another with chocolate cream. I came at about 3pm and the selection was very minimal. Actually this was the second time I visited. I tried a few days earlier, but they only had six plain donuts left. Supposedly they are open till 8, but they are all gone by early evening. Looks like the locals love this place. I'll try them again the next time I'm in the area and be sure to get there when they open for the best selection. Minus 1 star for the run down dumpy external appearance. Minus 1 star for lack of selection 5 hours before closing.

Here's how I found Jack Frost... I was coming back from a business trip and had been away from home for a few days. I couldn't wait to see my kids and wanted to get them a special treat. Before I even picked up my luggage, I found this gem on Yelp! I purchased a variety like German Chocolate, peanut butter, salted caramel and more. They were more like beautiful little cupcakes. I don't have a sweet tooth, but it was all I could do to keep my hands out of the box for my 40-minute ride home! My kids wanted to know when I was going out of town again! I can't buy donuts anywhere else now. Highly recommend.

Just stopped in for the first time. I'd say skip the fat and calories and just grab a cup of coffee. This place is a diabetic coma nightmare. Wow is this place over rated... NO labels on anything, I just saw cases of frosting on piles of dough. I got a bacon maple and Boston creme. The bacon was chewy and I threw more than half of it away. Boston cream just fell apart in a heap of gross mess. The frosting on the donuts was so gooey it was it a mess to eat (maybe try some meringue powder in the recipe to help it set). As far as the experience: I told the woman it was my first time and had no idea what anything was, so she just said "point to something and I'll let you know what it is"... -_- Made me want to turn around and go get an apple fritter from the market (which is what I went in for in the first place, but they did not have). I also asked for a coffee and stood there like an idiot expecting her to hand me at least a cup or something, but she just walked away. I figured out on my own their coffee is self serve and they run off the honor system with what size cup you pick up. The Columbian Supremo coffee was their one redeeming factor. That's one of the better cups of coffee I've had since moving to Cleveland.

I lve these donuts. They are small so you can eat a couple of them. The filling is generous and flavorful. The maple donut is my favorite. I live in Wisconsin and I stop here every time I'm in Ohio. The shop, itself, is nothing to write home about but do not judge a book by its cover...

Yep - this place deserves every star I gave it... and every star everyone else gave it. I've had the donuts before (when people at work had them) and always meant to go in and grab some of my own, but never made it there till this morning. I know some people have an issue with the location / old building - but people... Jack Frost only cares about the quality of the donuts! and it's apparent - they're SO good! Got a half dozen this morning..... and an apple fritter..... (don't worry, I'm going to share!) Donuts included: blueberry, pumpkin, peanut butter chocolate, caramel apple, reeses peanut butter cup, and salted caramel. Pumpkin= amazing. Blueberry = amazing. The apple fritter is the size of my head... if not bigger! The 6 donuts were in a smaller box... apple fritter, in a box made for a dozen (granted, it didn't take up the entire box, but still... huge) All in all, spent $9.25 and it was mainly because of the fritter. 1/2 dozen is less than 6 dollars! Amazingly fresh donuts... amazingly cheap prices... sweet people behind the counter - what's there not to love?!? (PS bring cash or a check- no credit/debit here)

Jack Frost went into the powder room to get a makeover and re-emerged in the 21st century. I'm a little bit sad I was never able to appreciate the OG Jack Frost, but this is a shop that's ready to tango with a new generation that does not carry cash, is obsessed with Instagram, and listens to Pharrell. No, they still don't have signs out in the display case or on the racks that identify what each donut is. But there is a TV screen that flashes through different donut flavors every few seconds with their names. Still, your best bet is to point to whatever elaborate creation catches your eye and ask your counter attendant what it is. I don't think it makes sense to get any less than a half-dozen donuts because it'll set you back just $6.95, and how could you settle on just one flavor? I'm not even a donut person, but S'mores, Banana Split and Strawberry Cheesecake are just a few of the confections that got my salivary glands pumping full time. The donut base is light and fluffy and sometimes overwhelmed by the huge top hats of frosting, but you can't be Frost without the frosting. Surprisingly, the toppings aren't too sweet and never overpower the carby goodness within. For Mother's Day, they'll be offering Cassata-filled Donuts! If you're thinking, "Are those fancy things even real donuts?" I ask you, "Does it matter?" Don't get too huffy though, they have good ole' crullers, fry cakes, and glazed donuts (heck, the whole stores smells of 'em) for the old-fashioned donut snob in you. Having been around since 1937, I'd imagine they know what they're doing by now. Yes, they accept credit cards now! Along with their shiny new red awning, TV screens, and backsplashed wall tile came a credit card machine. The whole process of getting our donuts was pretty efficient, but I can only imagine the chaos that was going on in the kitchen as they were constantly rolling out batches of donuts, and the attendants were walking back and forth to get each person their order. Even with the rush on grand re-opening day, the staff were all smiles and didn't rush us at all as we picked out our six donuts. They had even hired a policeman to keep order in the tiny parking lot. As we were paying, I did find myself wishing they had knives and hand sanitizer to because we later resorted to using coffee stirrers and multiple hand washings to share three donuts. The inside space is quaint and there's no seating, but there's a large window with a ledge that kids can sit down on while waiting. You can take some of Jack Frost home not only in your belly, but also on your hat and on your chest as they sell baseball caps, shirts, and coffee mugs. Should you ever find yourself in Old Brooklyn, sweeten up your visit with a stop at the revamped Jack Frost's. Let me know if they have the Kit Kat donuts, because I'll be joining you shortly.

So I stopped here early in the morning because I heard that after 10 you can't get anything good. They were correct. I got there just after 7:50 and the place was mobbed! The sweet smell of sugar and caramel and frosting, filled my mouth, my nose my everything, I wanted to bathe in the aroma. It's a small place, but perfect little donut shop. We got a half dozen assorted, glazed of course, some sprinkled with bacon, the rest I let the clerk decide what to give us. Price wise it was a little higher than Krispy Kreme or Dunkin but for me it was worth it because they were as fresh as can be and you can tell they put full quality into making these donuts. All in all I was impressed, the service was good and quick, they had fully stocked donut cases and I will be back!

Mouth watering doughnuts and great service. I ordered a dozen and half various flavors for a work party and it was huge success. They such a hit , i had to lie and tell everyone I made them ( thinking I might get a raise or a promotion) but didn't . My favorite was the red velvet doughnut . It was extremely fresh and the frosting was to die for. The service was excellent. The workers greeted you right when you walked in and were extremely knowledgeable. This place deserves 6 stars. Cheers !

Jack Frost is one of those Cleveland staples that everyone knows. I've been coming for a while now, even as the donut scene in the city has gotten more crowded with more options. Donuts are a favorite of mine, as I usually find myself going to get a box 3-4 times per month. Within the donut scene of Cleveland, Jack Frost is usually my go to place when I'm craving something with alot of icing. They have some classic/ plain options as well, but the majority tend to be dressed up well with icing and various toppings. There's usually plenty of parking, and customer service is always really good. They open early, so it's a great option on the way to the office. I've been the last few visits for the $1 "Hot Dog" donuts which are usually a special during baseball season. If you haven't been, would highly recommend.

We absolutely love Jack Frost and have been coming here for years. The service is always great and they always have such fun and creative flavors. Parking can be a little tricky and if you go early in the day, there will likely be a line, but is worth it. Word to the wise: these donuts can be really filling due to the amount of extras(fillings, toppings, etc) so you might want to think about sharing! Definitely recommend if you're in the area!

So excuse my almost all the way eaten keto friendly donut but I'll have to say it was delicious! Very dense and flavorful. This was the banana maple bacon. The frosting is what was the banana flavor and it reminded me a lot of banana pudding but thicker. Highly recommend! Now I don't feel so guilty that I ate a donut this morning. Lol
Had to try them from a kiosk at the zoo, but I am glad we didn't miss out entirely on our trip through Cleveland! The donuts are the best parts of a donut and a cupcake combined!

This place is the real deal. It's a donut shop that has been around for some 80 years with history and cachet but without the prices and attitude of those trendy donut shops closer to the hip parts of most cities. Jack Frost Donuts is quite a ways from downtown, where Pearl and Fulton meet to form a triangle near the Outerbelt Freeway (I-480) in a fairly nondescript middle class neighborhood. The physical plant obviously doesn't date back to when Jack Frost Donuts was founded in the 1930s. Their store is newer than that and it's modern, bright, and has sufficient parking. Note that there is no seating inside. You can always sit in your car and slam dunk their baked goods down the hatch. Or, like most normal people, you can take their baked goods elsewhere and ingest them in a more civilized manner. The thing about Jack Frost Donuts is the novelty of the offerings combined with reasonable prices. The service is efficient and they don't seem to tire of people asking what's in a particular donut. I'd say some of the donuts approach gourmet donut status, yet they are not priced as gourmet donuts. Again, this place is not that close to downtown. It's on the belt road that skirts it at a distance. You can come here while shopping big box retail nearby, on your way to or from the Metroparks Zoo, on your way to or from a seedy adult bookstore or strip joint on Brookpark Road, on your way to the office, and/or on your way to the airport, for which the exits are about 4 ramps going west along I-480. It is also important to note that there is more selection at the beginning of the donut day. Also, where Pearl and Fulton come together, or near there, there is a no right turn on red at one of the lights. Heed that ... and enjoy these well crafted donuts that are available to you without an ounce of pretense in either the service or the pricing.
Excellent service. Fresh and affordable. It the only place I will ever get donuts again

5 stars, always a 5! Best around. My only wish is that they would make more cream sticks, always out by the time we get there. But you can't go wrong with any selection. I've been a fan for over 50 years. I can't believe I'm that old already, but its true! Still have the smiley face donuts we got as kids a true Cleveland Gem!

We wanted to take a treat home to our family from Cleveland and thought donuts would travel well on our 4 hr drive. I looked up donut places and decided to try Jack's. When we arrived, I was happy there was a private parking lot. The inside was clean and the donuts were on full display. There was a table-top small case with donuts that were specifically gluten free. The main case had a large selection to choose from, but I had to ask what they were because nothing was labeled. I was disappointed to learn that none of the donuts are filled. All of the donuts are either a yeast or cake base with different toppings of glazes, nuts, drizzles, whipped frosting dollops, etc..., to change up the overall flavor. While the donuts are tasty and definitely better than a standard Dunkin Donuts or grocery store, I missed having a donut plump with filling. I did appreciate the variety of flavors outside the norm. A place worth checking out.
I love these doughnuts this place is so creative they sell out fast so get there early. Ive been going there since I was a little girl I am now 38.

I love donuts and when I travel I try to find a local donut place to visit and this was the one for Cleveland. It was quiet on a Monday morning so that was probably a good thing, as I was overwhelmed by the sheer number of donut choices I had! Thankfully, the girl working the counter was super enthusiastic to tell me what each flavor was and in the end, my dad and I ended up choosing a S'mores, raspberry glazed, and a Boston Cream. All the donuts were good but the raspberry glaze was notable to me as it had great flavor... just the right amount of sweet and tart at the same time. I just wish they had more raised donuts instead of cake donuts as I prefer those a bit more, but overall, solid donuts!

I get why this place has an insane number of 5 star reviews. Salted caramel donut Glazed Cherry Cake Donut Maple Bacon donut with maple whipped cream Sweet insantiy. All for less than 10 bucks a dozen. EAT THAT DUNKIN DONUTS!!!! I will admit though, I considered giving this place a 4 - 4.5 star review because no matter what you do, no matter your self control, no matter what insane diet you're on, you're going to stuff your self silly with sweet deliciousness (to the point where you lie groaning on a couch, holding your belly, in pain, but still super happy, as you write a yelp review - not that I'd know from experience). Sigh. I wonder if I should have bought the dozen instead of the half....
Best donuts in Cleveland! The remodel is very nice, and is very aesthetically pleasing. People who say it fatty and high in calories don't understand donuts, imo.

I like Jack Frost because whenever I bring them to work I am instantly a hero! And now I am a doughnut snob because whenever someone offers me a doughnut from one of the chains it's all I can do to not let them see me roll my eyes. This. Place. Is. The. Bomb. (Good coffee too!)

Hands down the BEST donuts. I had them with my friend once and it was delicious. The taste is immaculate, and I always want to come here again and again. Staff is wonderful and I loved the chocolate donut.

God bless Jack Frost donuts. After seeing the Plain Dealer articles and reviews from the 2014 NEO Best Donut competition (I can't believe I didn't know such a thing existed until now), all I could think about was the maple bacon donut. It did not disappoint. My first visit to their shop was a true success. I walked out with a dozen donuts, enough to share with family and friends, all for less than $10 (1 dozen: $9.45!- bring cash!! ), and had a pleasant conversation with the staff. First purchase included flavors pumpkin spice, chocolate peanut butter, apple cinnamon, chocolate cake, salted caramel, maple bacon, and a French cruller. The maple bacon is one of the best things I've ever eaten. Perfectly sweet and salty. My parents, who are uneasy about straying away from the standard glaze, went crazy for the chocolate, salted caramel, and pumpkin spice. Freshly baked, fluffy, frosting and toppings galore (but never too much!), the donut shop one dreams of. I was surprised at how balanced the pumpkin spice was- it was flavorful and sweet, but not tooth ache causing or overpowering. So much that one could inhale a few of them in a sitting. Can't wait to go back. After I run off this batch that is.

The line is long here, but it's worth the wait. I will call ahead next time. The people who ordered ahead of time didn't have to wait in line and were told to go to another entrance. The line moves slow. I don't think it's an issue with the employees, the people ordering seem to take awhile. I'm not sure why since we were in line for so long. You would think most people would have things picked out already by the time they got to the front of the line. I guess it takes longer than you would think to pick out donuts. There were more donut selections in the back. So, maybe that's what the hold up was today. The people working there kept mentioning that customers are welcomed to call ahead. So, I don't think the line was moving slow today only. I think the customers become like kids again and get mesmerized by the many selections. These donuts taste like they are truly made from scratch as advertised. I won't bother eating a donut from anywhere else again. This place is king! Also, these donuts are super sugary and I usually like icing. I ended up scraping some icing off. But I am not complaining. I have a sweet tooth and this was sweet even for me. I am so glad that I don't live close to this place. However, I will make a special trip out here from now on for breakfast treats on holidays. Seriously, check this place out! I thought this place even blew away Krispy Kreme

I'd heard legends about Jack Frost Donuts but thought, 'they're donuts how special could they be?'. For anyone else thinking that same thing, erase that idea immediately! They say that we eat with our eyes then our mouths. Jack Frost makes beautiful looking donuts, pretty enough to adorn any party or buffet table. The big payoff to the donut is the taste, icing that melts in your mouth and a cake that is light, fluffy and delicious. Don't get me wrong, I'm not saying that these donuts can change your life, but these donuts WILL change your ideas about donuts. I've never seen donut flavor combinations like they have before, they are more like flavors you'd see in a full-size cake. Cassata donut (Cleveland style), Chocolate Decadence and my absolute favorite German Chocolate (just like mom use to make using the recipe from the Baker's Chocolate wrapper). I'm an east-sider and the trek to Jack's on a Sunday morning is about 20 minutes one way. For me on those mornings I make the trip it's the best 40 minute round trip of my weekend.
Plenty of awesome doughnuts to choose. My favorite ate the sour cream fried doughnuts. Love the blueberry fried doughnuts equally. Plus you can't go wrong with the glazed doughnuts

Got delivery via postmates. Order arrived with missing half the order bc delivery driver said they were out of the apple fritters. This is both a jack frost issue and postmate issue. Restuarant should notify consumer and or the delivery service they dont have an item before showing up at your door with only half the order so that the order can be adjusted. Only reason we ordered were for the apple fritters, we added a few single donuts to make the delivery worth it. Single donuts arrived and no fritters and still trying to get refunded. What a joke.
Donuts are amazing. Kinda pricey but worth it. Customer service could use some improvements.

Stopped by the store Friday am to pick-up a dozen for an attorney friend and a dozen for the family. Waited 20 minutes since only 1 person working the counter. Donuts are fresh and very tasty but when you find not 1/2/3 hairs but a whole clump of hair in the middle of your donut frosting, makes you lose your appetite for anything!! Have never had this happen before and we stop there often, just a heads-up for the owners..

Found this place on again my trusty Yelp app. My thing is finding places where the locals eat etc when I travel to places. I was in town at Cedar point and had a day to explore Cleveland. This was one of my spots to hit up and on my visit list. This place was not hard to find for it was on the corner of two intersections. You can not miss this because it looks like it was recently built. There is a small parking lot on the side of it which should be adequate because your normally in and out of the place quickly. We got there a little bit after 12 but the selections was very slim already. I was kinda of bummed because the person at the counter said that the day before, there was way more choices and had tons of extra during closing time. The choices we got was a blueberry glazed, maple one, raspberry jelly, and one where they put a chocolate dollop on, i forgot which one was that. When they say each batch is made from scratch, they are not kidding. Most of these donut places taste pretty much the same, but Jack Frost donuts was not. They actually tasted like from scratch Me being a scratch baker, you can taste the difference from scratch and when its just a mix. All of the choices I got were very wonderful. The one I liked the most is the one with the chocolate dollop. There was a older gentlemen with a veteran hat which I think was maybe the owner? He noticed I was from NY because of my license plate on my car, and asked how did I find out about them, and I told them Yelp. I will most definitely be back to Jack Frost Donuts when I am in Cleveland again 100% for sure.

Amazing little donut shop! So many fun and crazy flavors. I got a Samoa and a Boston creme. Both freaking delicious! I went kind of late, I think 10ish on a Saturday morning so there was no line! Cheap, too! Can't wait to go back again, next time with more people so we can get lots of flavors and share them!

I have lived less than 10 minutes away for nearly 4 years, heard many good things about Jack Frost, but never had gotten around to visiting. We came here last weekend and will definitely be returning again. There were so many great options that it was difficult to only choose a dozen. We ended up with 2 smores, 2 Carmel Apples, 2 boston cream, strawberry shortcake, powdered lemon, banana split, chocolate with peanuts, chocolate with peanut butter cream, and sprinkles. All of these options were exceptional. The only thing I didn't like, was I didn't see all the options listed in the store, but I now see that they are available on their Facebook page. Even though we now live a little further away in Parma, this is a place I forsee us returning to without a doubt.

Hi Friends, Dunkin makes Donuts, Jack Frost makes art in fried dough. There are as close to donut heaven as there is in earth. Made From scratch, there are the classics, as well as some really creative options. I'm told they sell out quick, so just because the shop stays open till 8, get there earlier. As I Was leaving the line was already snaking out the door. And the coffee mated perfectly with the donuts, a simple task that often times gets missed by sweets shops, because they focus more on the food. Pairing coffee is a fine art that Jack Frost nails. There is no seating, it's a takeaway joint-- but with so many parks in Cleveland, plus that little lake on the edge of town, you can find plenty of spots to enjoy these sweet treats See y'all at the crossroads
Great place with sweet goodies!! I've been going there all my life!! It's a family thing to do !!

Unique and tasty I'm not sure why I waited so long to try their donuts. Nice clean store. They had over 50 donuts in the case and I asked the lady how you know what they are. She went donut by donut and gave me a description as I picked an assorted dozen out. You definitely need a dozen to get a variety of flavors.

As a Warriors fan with roots in the Bay Area, I seldom compliment anything from Northeast Ohio. (see other reviews) Nonetheless, the donuts from Jack Frost are quite possibly some of the best I've ever had, better than Krispy Kreme, better than Dunkin's. My goodness, these things are absolutely delicious...so addictive, you'd think they laced it with fresh crack from Crackron. The presentation is quite attractive as well. I usually just get a variety, and I don't think I've ever had anything bad. If you're in the area, definitely come by and visit this place!
Some of the best donuts I've ever had. I highly recommend this place. Great variety and great tasting donuts. Friendly and amazing staff. A must if you're in Cleveland.
The donuts are not as good as they used to be and they are now $12.95 a half dozen. Not worth the drive that's for sure!

My wife and I visited here this past week hoping to try a new donut shop for our anniversary. Jack Frost was far from a disappointment. We paid barely anything for a half dozen. There were a huge variety of flavors to pick from. Our experience was good picking the donuts up too. Customer service was quick and polite, which made for a delightful experience. The shop was clean to add the cherry on top. If you are in the Brooklyn area, this place is a gem.

Had to try this out since it's so close to my workplace. Got there 10 min before opening and there were already 3 other people waiting in their cars for the store to open up. The store is well maintained and nice and bright inside. All the donuts are beautifully displayed in the front. Like other reviewers have noted, the donuts are not I got 1/2 a dozen donuts for $8.50 (cash only). I just asked them to give me their favorite donuts because I did feel a bit rushed with the line forming behind me. The donuts all looked SO cute and actually tasted really good. They are smaller than your regular sized donuts- which I liked. Definitely not the BEST tasting donuts in cleveland, but i would return again because these are the perfect donuts to take to work.

I have lived in the Old Brooklyn neighborhood for many years and Jack Frost donuts is a staple among all the locals. Ever since the remodel the prices have doubled in price. It's just not worth the product anymore. What a shame

I went there today for the first time. I told the one worker that I was new. She seemed annoyed that she had to explain which donut was what. Maybe if they had signs or descriptions, it would help eliminate the annoyance of everyone asking what's that? The donuts were good, but honestly I wasn't blown away. My husband and I tried the glazed, Samoan, maple, PB, lucky charms. They might have been fresh, but I don't think they were. The lucky charm one especially. Just seemed like it was sitting around awhile. The donut dough itself is thick and more like a cake. I was hoping the glazed one would top Krispie Kream but two totally different tastes. They are not light and airy. All in all very good donuts, the concept is cool, just feel like the hype makes it more than what it is

Time & day of visit: Saturday around 11:30AM, in and out in 10 minutes. Location: I am from Akron so ultimately, I am not familiar with the area but it is easy to get to from the freeway. The parking lot did fill up very quick by the time we were leaving. I actually have a friend looking at moving to the area and I am SO thrilled for the simple fact I can stop at Jack Frost on my way to visit. Service: It was wonderful. They do not label their donuts so I had to ask what a lot of things were but they were so helpful and friendly. They were also nice with recommending a couple things for us to try since it was our first time. Donuts: AMAZING. I believe for 20 minutes after I ate 3 donuts I was in a slight sugary, full belly, amazing, sleepy coma. And it was worth it. I just loved the salted carmel. I also had the chocolate sprinkles and wow. The donuts were a little crunchy on the outside but so light and airy on the inside. Also the frosting was amazing. It any was left on my hands, box, etc, I'd be licking it all. Overall: A must stop for donuts.

Jeeze oh Pete you'd thot I brought in a box of lobster tails last Friday morning????? There weren't many people in the office for Good Friday so I grabbed just short of two dozen thinking I would be taking home a few when the office closed... Yeah right... They saw the label on the box and went all Spider Monkey crazy and NOTHING was left after about an hour.... Holy crap coworkers....Sure I got the obligatory "thanks buddy" and "oooh I LOOOOOOOOOOVE Jack Frost"! But you'da thunk that these people hadn't EVER had a doughnut before... So now I sit here rethinking putting out extra Easter candy as the Maelstrom might return... I think I will be fine though as commercial candy does NOT compare to Jack Frost Donuts.... Right?

Terrific doughnut stop! Easy to locate. We got a nice assortment and we were pleased with each. The tiramisu doughnut was piled high with creamy white icing. They are very generous with all icing! My only complaint was that there was not a visible menu of the days' doughnuts. Overwhelming choices led to many questions from us and we felt pressured to make a decision with the line behind us.
You can see what's "Inside" your donuts because its all on top!!!! Great selection awesome taste.
Best donuts on the earth! Fresh daily, amazing combinations and award winning! LOVE, LOVE!!!!

Such a cute spot ! They remodel it and I made it in time to see it in Cleveland ! From my in laws, I heard that this was the donut spot to go too! The decor inside is very cute and modern but there is not real seating. It is quite small. The parking lot was very small as well, hopefully they can figure out the parking space. I had to park and walk across . There was construction during the time I visited. The shop was welcoming with the colors red and white ! I got there at 3 pm and there was really not left but I still grabbed some donuts. I can never leave a donut shop empty Hanford. The French crueller was delicious and the maple frosted with bacon was awesome as well ! The other few cake donuts was ok but i wouldn't get it again next time! I would definitely come back next time ! The girl that was there told me they bake everything one time in the morning only!

Being from out of town I never heard of Jack Frost Donuts but wanted to take a treat to my customer in Walton Hills. When I walked in with these I became a hero :). These were creative and beautiful and the taste was better than any I have had anywhere. Loved it!
Tasty donuts at a fair price. Maple bacon was my fav. Also liked the sour cream filled. My lady friend liked the jelly filled. The the sour cream donut would pair nicely with coffee.

**THE FOLLOWING REVIEW HAS BEEN REVISED** I got married last week and my husband and I had intentions early on of getting these fantastic donuts for our guest gifts at our reception. We used a different local donut shop(George's Donuts in Hudson) instead. I tried every means of communication to order them, going back months. I was calling them a couple days a week going back months before the reception and leaving messages, even e-mails to the manager's personal e-mail address I was given. I never got any response whatsoever. Eventually I sent my fiancee up there in the early am (the manager is apparently the only one who can take wedding orders and is only there very specific times of the morning), and talked with the manager, who promised to call us in a couple days to set up the order. This NEVER HAPPENED. It was becoming a workplace comedy with my co-workers who watched this happen for months. Overall, I wasted a lot of time, effort, and unnecessary pre-wedding stress trying to get them to work with us and was completely blown off. I very seriously do not think they must need the large order/money and free advertising we offered them. It's a real shame. I have loved their donuts, but I have a terrible taste in my mouth when I think of them now. (The above review was edited to reflect that we were dealing with the manager, not the owner as we originally thought.) Since this review was posted the owner and his wife both contacted us personally to find out exactly what went wrong so that it could be dealt with, and hopefully never happens again. They went way above and beyond to try to make amends and offer their sincerest apologies for this unfortunate series of events. This exceptional attention to customer service and loyalty has caused us to revise our review from one to four stars. We are certainly happy to have this resolved to everyone's satisfaction, as we truly love Jack Frost donuts, we have been customers for years and will continue to be so!

I've only been here once, but I picked out a BUNCH of doughnuts while I was there. The young lady that waited on me was very friendly and patient. I told her I was a noob, and she ran down the entire contents of the cases for the day for me. Each and every doughnut I tried was really good, especially the cream stick. Dunkin'...take notes on how to make a real cream stick. The only one I was a little underwhelmed with was the chocolate krispies doughnut...and that's only because the krispies were soggy from the frosting. Otherwise, great doughnuts, and well worth the trip from the Niles/Youngstown area.

I have never been here before, and I have to say it was one of the worst customer service experiences I've had.
