Not sure if you can be vulgar about a description, but these are better than sex. No shit. Best donuts ever.

I think the donuts are good but service is unfortunately lacking, went there yesterday and seemed like I was being a burden for buying a dozen donuts for 11 bucks! I don't think that's how I should feel after walking out of a place. I do rate them 2nd as best donuts I've had in Cleveland.

Thanks to Yelp and Cleveland HotList, my hubby and I stopped by Jack Frost during a road trip from NC to Niagara Falls. The nicest, friendliest father-daughter duo! It was a true pleasure to meet them. Now to the donuts: You must understand, we are from Krispy Kreme country. Dunkin is everywhere as well---but KK is king in our area. After eating these donuts (and I'm a big donut fan), I wish there was a way that JF could come to my part of NC. Myself and everyone else would forget the name of those other two donut places. In fact.....what were their names again?????

Oh the sweet, sugary, blissful JOY that is a Jack Frost donut!!! The donut itself is divine, and the toppings must have been kissed by angels. They are the best treat Cleveland has to offer. And as a coworker declared when I brought them to work-- that isn't a donut, that is a pastry!!

The BEST donuts I've ever head, hands-down. They're so sweet, and very filling! If you plan on getting box for a special event, definitely call ahead to make sure they'll have the flavors you want, because they sell out fast. Ask them for the specialty flavors of the week/season, because they have some really unique ones! A box of Jack Frost Donuts are the perfect treat for any occasion. Also, make sure you have cash. Very small parking lot, only fits about 2 cars at a time.
The best donut place in Ohio hands down! Awesome and unique flavors enormous donuts for a cheap price! Never a disappointment

The best donuts in Cleveland. My family has been going here for 20+ years and the donuts are as good now as they always been. Personal favorites are the cake Donut with chocolate frosting and white topping and the Cinnamon Twists. Seriously awesome donuts!!

This place was so good! Like omg best doughnuts ever! We bought a dozen doughnuts for $10.95. The salted caramel doughnut and the maple bacon doughnut was our favorites. Overall my whole family thought the doughnuts were the best we have ever had.

Possibly the best donut shop in the world. In all world travels, have only found one other donut shop anywhere that even comes close to the succulent fried dough of JF Glaze. If you are ever in Cleveland, make the time to stop by and try the best donuts in the world. But, beware if you eat more than 3, you will be hooked. You will find yourself coming back to Cleveland just for their donuts!

My boyfriend took me here 2 Sundays ago. First of all I can't believe I have lived in the Cleveland area for this many years and did not know about this place. Part of the allure is before you even step foot inside; you can tell it's a hole in the wall mom and pop place by the sign out front. Upon entering it is a donut lover's paradise. Offering many creative flavors, presented beautifully, and the service is great too.

My husband heard a lot of good news about this place so we decided to check it out. Maybe we went at a bad time but I was left unimpressed. Two of our donuts were dry and the other three were pretty forgettable. I ate half of mine (the maple cake) and threw the rest in the trash. Almost tasted stale! The other one (rainbow sprinkles) was pretty average. My husband enjoyed his donuts but didn't think he'd be coming back again. Maybe donuts just aren't my thing but I don't know what all the hype is about.

The best donuts in the entire universe! To die for. Cheap, family owned and so tasty. Only downside is that it's cash and maybe checks only. I live for the key lime and pumpkin cream donuts. Outstanding! The staff is very kind and I love the vintage dive feel of the little shop. They're very old school and worth the 40 minute drive!
Love the donuts, way off the beam on calories BUT hey if ur eating a donut why care about calories? I am only giving 4 stars cause they don't have their nutrition info on the donuts
Maybe I caught this place on the wrong day, but we didn't get anything great here. Good donuts, but nothing I would go out of the way for. Very friendly service, so that was a plus.

Wish I could give 6 stars! Amazing donuts. We got there around 10 am- rookie move as selection picked over and they apparently don't replenish- what they have is what they sell. Still had enough interesting varieties to make it worth the drive. Don't overlook the glazed- simple but better than any we'd ever had. The kinds with lots of frosting were, as expected, a big hit. Good service, great donuts- what else do you need??
I enjoyed the doughnuts I had at JF. However, IMO, not the best doughnuts in the Cleveland area and they are pricey for a smaller than average doughnut. Still would prefer, but I do prefer others.

this was a major surprise on my food adventure back in my hometown. and it was amazing this service AWESOME!!!! The coffee was INCREDIBLE!!!!! and the donuts man the donuts ....... left me speechless the blueberry cheesecake donut please never take it off your menu I beg you. the maple bacon awwwww man who knew maple icing and bacon could taste so good. THANK YOU STAFF AT Jack Frost THANK YOU I WILL BE BACK EVERY CHEAT MEAL.

Had such a great experience with the young lady (unfortunately, I forgot to ask for her name) that was working around 5pm on 9/23/17. She was so sweet and not to mention the donuts tasted amazing. Definitely just earned a customer for life.
One word.... AMAZING!!! I've tried a lot of donuts - these are worth the trip from Medina!
I have been going to Jack Frost since I was a kid. They are the best donuts in the city and well worth a trip to try them. If you haven't had a Jack Frost donut you are truly missing out!

I have been missing my favorite donut, a simple maple creme filled, chocolate iced. Seeing all the rave reviews about Jack Frost on here, the significant other and I headed over this morning to grab a dozen and enjoy our sugar comas, i was hoping to find my long lost favorite, but alas, i did not. They don't label anything which I was expecting but even though they really weren't busy, they were very brisk with us, making us feel like they wanted our order and to get us out, so we didn't ask more than one or two questions. Now, aside from that, these are good donuts. Nothing to write home about, but good donuts. The one big problem we had is that their "filled" donuts are not filled at all. They just don't punch holes in them and glob filling on top. We are not fans. I had a maple ceme filled, mind you it was maple frosted with white creme piled on top. So much cream I had to knock half of it off to be able to stomach it. The other I ate was a chocolate glazed cake donut, my other favorite, and it was good, but the ones I can get at sheetz are just as good IMO. Either way, we'll probably look for another donut shop that suits our tastes better, but they are better than dunkin and you really do have better choices as well.

With reviews like these, how could you not go? We were also surprised to see it was super close to our favorite sweet shop, B A Sweetie up the street so this was a no brainer. We got a half dozen. 2- chocolate peanut butter, 1 chocolate chocolate cream, 1 chocolate white cream, 1 maple bacon and 1 smore. I thought the smore looked like it had nuts on it but the hubby said it was graham crackers. When we got to the car we confirmed it was nuts. Since where are there nuts on smores? No graham crackers at all. We think given the caramel drizzled on top that it would be more aptly renamed a turtle donut. The hubby liked it though. I didn't care for the cream so I scraped mine off and we both were pretty turned off by the texture of the peanut butter cream. We're used to Buckeye Donuts and Jolly Pirates version and this just was too peanut buttery for me so I scraped mine off while the man enjoyed his. I have to say despite not liking the cream, we agreed the chocolate iced donut portions were really good. The maple bacon was awful and we didn't finish it. We agreed the bacon tasted fake like bacon bits over real bacon. The smell was really off putting before we even ate it so we won't be getting that one again. The donuts were decent but we just wouldn't say 5-star good. So, more for Clevelanders! FYI- Cash only.

This place is awesome. It was great 20 years ago and it just keeps getting better. We are always raving about the doughnuts of course, what's not to love , we should at least mention the awesome coffee . Best place to stop for a cup. With or without a doughnut
Had the maple bacon donut and shared 1/2 a glazed one with my girlfriend. So yummy! Best in Cleveland--hands down!
I've tried Donuts at this place after hearing about them from my co-worker and it was totally worth it. These are by far the best Donuts I've tasted. I definitely recommend this place.

my first time here. after reading the reviews of how good these donuts were i had very high expectation ,and let me tell you jack frost exceeded all them. these donuts are moist the fillings are perfect and the maple glaze is just wow. its worth a drive from anywhere ill def be back many times to come.

We drove here for breakfast after a one night stay in Cleveland. I searched for a local favorite and came across this little joint. The freshest donuts with so many choices. We immediately fell in love.

Just went to Jack Frost after moving back to Cleveland after 17 years away. Went there in the 70s as a little girl, and I was so happy that the shop is still there, and the donuts are amazing! How nice to come back to a small business that doesn't disappoint after so many years. The donuts have just the right texture and flavor. Very fresh. And they have specialty ones, like a cassatta donut with vanilla creme and fresh strawberries. I could have sworn they once had some stools, years ago, which they don't now. Not much space for that, which is too bad. But never mind. Go to Jack Frost!

I recommend you give Jack Frost a try next time you have an excuse to pick up a dozen donuts. The store only takes cash, so plan accordingly. The good: They have a great selection of fry cake (which seemed denser) and traditional (less dense) donuts. Their basics (glazed, plain, frosted) and cream or jelly filled/topped ranged from good to excellent. What I really loved about it is that they have a HUGE selection of all kinds of flavors from the bold (e.g. maple bacon) to more traditional (e.g. toasted coconut). Their flavors are not labeled or listed anywhere in the store that I noticed, making the experience somewhat overwhelming your first trip. Luckily, the person behind the counter was really friendly and walked us through all of the flavors, so it was not really an issue. The bad: Logistics are an issue - it is in Old Brooklyn, and if you don't live there it is a trek. It is worth noting that they are right down the road from the B.A. Sweetie Candy Company. If you have never been to BA Sweetie's, it is worth stopping by. While this extra stop somewhat mitigates the distance traveled, it is a *lot* of junk food to but in one trip. Also, the store has a tiny parking lot and is at a weird intersection. While the product Jack Frost makes is pretty good, they seemed to be on the sweeter end. Luckily all of those downsides can be addressed through planning and a bit of self control.
I grew up in Old Brooklyn and these donuts have been a part of my whole LIFE. I love donuts and these are simply the best.
The BEST donuts. No comparison. No argument. No matter where I move in the area, I always find my way back to Jack Frost. Always a treat.

Best donut I've ever tasted. From the look on the outside you won't expect the donuts to be so good. I live in Maryland now and I always think of the donuts. I try to stop by every time I'm in Cleveland. The bacon donut is just WOW, a must have.

deep fried happiness can a donut change your day? doughy pleasure balls You will enter donut nirvana. A janky little shop where Fulton, Pearl, and Brookpark converge is the epicenter of all things donut. Light and airy crullers. Perfect cake style donuts that taste so perfectly fresh. No unpleasant "wang" of preservatives, not overly sweet, and truth be told, too damn good to dunk in coffee. I'm surprised that there is not a line to get in. Carry on...

as i was walking down the street one day, my sniffer picked up a scent. could it be a burger or a cake I pondered. aha! it was a donut scent I picked up on. my big kangaroo feet carried me as fast as I could to get to the source of the smell. I rounded a corner and saw it. a big building. It looked like any other but inside I knew was something special. I pounced through the doors and was assaulted with smells like no other. so many good smells in one place overwhelmed me and I screeched and ran. I finally worked up the courage to go back yesterday and crawled up to the counter. I ordered and when i took my first bite I screamed so loud my cat heard me (she told me about it later) and I clicked my heels and off I went. It takes a while to build up courage but once you do it's worth it
The best donuts you will ever eat. A little piece of heaven! I recommend Jack Frost to everyone!!!

Full disclosure to start off. I live 150 feet away from this gem and I don't weigh 500lbs yet. Probably because I purposely don't keep cash or checks on me and I make myself run about 15 miles before I let myself have at this place.Scrounging up 95 cents from the couch cushions, junk drawers, and under my car seats is oh so worth it. The smell is killer and when I used to work until 3:30am, I would wait for them to open up at 5 to get one of their cinnamon rolls. If you didn't know about those, you know now. They only make a few and once they're gone, prepare to wait until tomorrow! I have dunkin and panera not far away and I would gladly forsake all dealings with them to keep some Jack Frost in my life.

The best donuts I've had in a very very long time! Crisp outside and beautifully flaky inside! I've only had the cake glazed donuts (raspberry glazed, chocolate cake glazed, chocolate glazed, blueberry). The glaze was a bit thick, but still excellent! Also the first time I've ever seen a cop in a donut shop.

Best donuts ever! My only complaint was the workers and that they don't have the flavors of the donuts listed.I felt very rushed and was afraid to ask what flavors were available because she seemed so annoyed whenever I asked a question so I ended up just getting random ones. They were still good, but I'd like to be able to choose the flavors I want. I will definitely be back though next time im in the area.

WARNING: If you are serious about your diet, are diabetic or have other reasons to avoid indulgent sweet temptations don't read this review! I come from the land of Krispy Kreme- not those foolish boxes of stale doughnuts sold at gas stations and supermarkets but the real deal. I'm talking conveyer belt of yummy gooey goodness available 24 hrs a day and a bright red sign alerting the neighborhood that they are indeed, "Hot Now!" While I remain a fan of the Krispy Kreme I have to say that Jack Frost is in a completely separate category. Maybe that's why they use the different spellings. These are very different tasty treats! My coworkers introduced me to Jack Frost and it was love at first bite. The icing coming out of the top of the donut ads a bit of sweetness without being TOO much. It's a lovely addition, too. I've had a number of flavors and frankly I can just remember that they were yummy!!!! I have had the chocolate donut (a cake-y one that was german chocolate cake themed) and didn't love it. Had I been new to the JF scene I would have said it was great, but; being the experienced JF devotee I knew it wasn't the top product. Jack Frost does the light colored (plain?) donut best. It's almost fluffy and airy when you take a bite so you can really savor the quality flavor of it. Then (if you've chosen one with the poof of icing) you get a nice soft yet flavorful taste of the vanilla or chocolate, etc. that compliments the donut and top layer of icing. One donut that doesn't seem to come with the icing poof is the maple bacon donut. Yeh yeh yeh- bacon's blowing up/ blown up/ is over but you've gotta give this a shot. Seriously. Consider taking a hiatus from any vegetarian/ vegan dietary commitments you might have made. They do maple great in a number of ways. Something to remember: Jack Frost does not take credit or debit cards. They have taken a check (and the dears actually took my out of state check- I can't bring myself to buy a new box because these are perfectly fine for paying rent which is really the only time I ever use them) and they'll take cash of course! A dozen donuts will set you back a little over $8 and you'll get your money's worth!
Hidden from the beaten path, the area will look suspicious, but just wait till you put your teeth in one of the best doughs on earth. Highly recommended!

If you like frosting, Jack Frost Donuts are the best donuts in the history of the world. There's so much frosting that it covers your nose when you take a bite. Really excellent, rich and thick and bursting with flavor. I love their donuts with candy bits, like the M&M ones. Oh, and the donuts themselves are great too. I wish there was one on the east side, because its Parma-ish location is kind of a schlep.

not bad, not amazing. got up early to get some so they were fresh, got a wide variety, none of them really knocked my socks off but were pretty good all around. weird part was the woman behind the counter when asked what kind of jelly donuts they had said "anything you want", and when pressed but what kinds do you HAVE, still stuck with "anything you want" ... is there some midwest standard jelly donut flavor selection I was expected to know or something or was this woman just being dumb (or rude?) ... I still don't know.

I'm a donut gal. Now, this may interfere with living a 'healthy lifestyle' but I really don't care. These delicious treats are my lifesaver after a rough workweek! This place is a gem because of the wide selection of donuts (and low prices). My favorite is blueberry, but maple is a close second!

Excellent donuts, better customer service. I was there Monday mourning and they did not have my favorite, they made them in 5 minutes even though they were short employees. You rock Dee for making these for me.
This place has been a staple for my family for decades. The best donuts ever. Most of my family has moved away, and this is their first stop when they get in town.

oh jack frost, how lucky i am to have you right down the street from my house. nostalgia has got to be one of the key ingredients in these donuts. you can almost taste the love that goes into these and i can promise that someone's great grandma is involved here. perfect, don't change a thing.

Today, Father's Day, was our first time at Jack Frost Donuts. It was to be a treat for my husband who had been wanting to go for a long time. We've heard great things for awhile. So I planned this and nothing else for Father's Day because he was going to be spending the rest of the day on a ladder in the heat painting our house. I thought it would be nice to let him sleep in but when we showed up at 11am there was nothing left. My husband had for the first time in 7 years of marriage actually been so excited about this present that he smiled and high fived me. Never have I gotten anything but a "meh" from him for ANYTHING before. But when we walked in and were told they were sold out four hours after opening with no plans to restock their shelves for the rest of the 9 hours they were supposed to be open, my husband was so disappointed. and so was I. I had finally done something that he really wanted and it was ruined because they run a crappy business. They don't even have a website or a menu!! When we walked in, the girl at the counter asked us if we had pre-ordered? Were we supposed to? How would we know to do that? Where is that requirement posted???? We will NEVER go back. They may have trendy donuts that everyone is going bonkers for now but they suck at customer service and they lost me today. Screw it. I'll buy a dozen glazed donuts at the store, shoot whip cream all over them and sprinkle a bunch of Reese's Pieces on them. Done.

After reading all the great reviews, went today, and everything was great. The selection was the best I've ever seen in Cleveland. We live less then a mile from this great donut shop and had never stopped. Won't be driving by anymore.

This place really is a gem. Very creative flavors, nice owners, always wanting to accomodate their customers, etc. They just seem like 'real' donuts, for lack of a better term. They aren't oversized or too sugary or slathered with too much icing that you don't even want to eat.....many of the flavors are a good balance of sweet and salty. I'm partial to the raspberry cruellers - but I've never had a bad donut there.

I've been meaning to go here for a while, as I had heard from a number of people what incredible donuts they had! Unfortunately, the location is a bit far for me, but the experience was worth it! Jack Frost is not a place that would stand out when seen from the road side. The store's outer decor likely meets "hole in the wall" criteria, which makes it all the more charming when you walk in and see the plethora of donuts awaiting you. A wide variety of donuts were available, most frosted and filled in all sorts of manners, and every one looked appetizing. I had a very hard time picking the dozen donuts I ordered, but luckily the kind and patient staff was very willing to help me out with my picks! And the donuts themselves were quite tasty, soft, and sweet, albeit perhaps a little overly frosted. In the end, I was quite satisfied with my trip, and if I am in the Parma area in the future, I would definitely make a point to stop by again. You should to!!
LOVE this place. It's the only one and i wish there were more. We visit every time we are in Cleveland. Don't go in if you are not willing to forgo your diet. Well worth every calorie though!

I've been to Jack Frost Donuts quite alot and have to say, each and every time have been a wonderful experience. I love all the creams! The more cream the better! The girls that work there can create any kind of donut! They are to die for! My favorite is the cream sticks. They are fresh every time I go. Best donut shop on the earth!

A Cleveland institution. The donuts are the best in town or at least on the West Side. As a kid I loved the chocolate donuts with the smiley faces. They are excellent the first day, but don't bother to save for tomorrow, as they get dry fast.
Terrific shop. Fast service, interesting flavors. Very worth it!

So after reading all the hype I thought that these donuts would be wonderful. They are absolutely terrible. They look good but the taste does not deliver. I got a chocolate cream and a PB cream filled donut. I did not finish eating either of them. The creme was NASTY. These donuts are obviously made with sub-standard ingredients. The donuts were not sweet at all like a donut should be. NEVER AGAIN.

Never disappoints. Get the waffle Cone! Always a line so trying to come on a weekday if you are visiting from out of town is a solid decision. They let you try a flavor or two so I would do so before committing. The brickleberry is always a great choice!

WOW. Always worth it. How can you not love Jeni's Splendid ice cream?! Every time we're visiting the Charlotte area, we make sure to make room for some ice cream. There's a ton of different locations, some better than others due to the flavors at each. But let me tell you about the must-haves. Jelly donut and coffee ice cream is like having breakfast right? That jelly donut was to DIE FOR. I think it's a seasonal flavor so count yourself lucky if you've been able to get it. I love coffee ice cream and this one is just *chef kiss.* Hubs got the Gooey butter cake and Jelly donut - again, there's no disappointment here. Gooey butter will be on my next mix. Also, the Everything Bagel flavor is spot on to the bagel, seems strange but surprisingly delicious. It's a must try even if you don't buy a whole scoop!
Tasted the weirdest ice-cream flavor here - Bagel and Cream Cheese. I guess, they had bits of bagel in the ice-cream too. Became an instant fan of their brambleberry crisp!!

Was so happy to be visiting a city that had a Jeni's scoop shop! I have bought pints from the supermarket but never had a fresh cup! The line wasn't bad for a Sunday afternoon. I tried darkest chocolate and Texas sheet cake (dairy free). So good on a hot day!

Fantastic ice cream, some of the best in South End. I love stopping by and grabbing a half scoop (or three!). My go-to favorite is gooey butter cake. Salted peanut butter is also great. Tonight I tried the limited time everything bagel which was slightly gross, but I was still glad I tried it! Just an odd flavor for ice cream. I love the out of the box flavors...I always look forward to trying the newest one!

INTRO: Jeni's Splendid Ice Cream is one of the greatest ice cream shop franchises currently in existence in North Carolina. Their ice cream flavors are extremely diverse and unique. Here are some of their flavors: Brambleberry Crisp (oven-toasted oat streusel and a sweet-tart "brambleberry" jam of blackberries and blackcurrants layered throughout vanilla ice cream), Gooey Butter Cake (cream cheese ice cream layered with crumbles of soft vanilla cake and swirls of made-from-scratch caramel-butterscotch sauce), and Brown Butter Almond Brittle (brown butter almond candy crushed into buttercream ice cream). ICE CREAM: Your taste buds are guaranteed to have a party as soon as the ice cream enters your mouth, and your eyes will instantly light up. The combination of the silkiness and creaminess of the ice cream, coupled with the bursts of pockets of intense flavor, will have you in line for another order as you're finishing your first scoop. VENUE: A neat ice cream shop that faces Hawker's Asian Street Food. There are both indoor and outdoor seating arrangements. There aren't that many spots to sit inside (a few bar stools), but there are numerous tables and chairs outside. PARKING: Street parking is available, as well as nearby parking garages. WORTH IT? Yes, but their prices are much more expensive than their competitors. I understand the importance of supporting local businesses, but at what cost? (Overall, 7.5/10)

Usually more of a soft serve girl, but the everything bagel ice cream changed my mind! It was savory and sweet, and my new favorite flavor. Love that Jeni's does unique flavors, always makes for an exciting trip. The line can be long, but it moves pretty quickly. Don't let long lines deter you, so worth it! And don't forget a pint to take home.

This post may be an unpopular opinion....but hey I don't really see why the hype is Every time I've walked by Jenni's there's been a line and this day the waffle cone smell got me! They are a smaller ice cream shop that offers a variety of non traditional flavors including dairy and gluten free options. Since it was my first time i had the trip of flavors on a waffle cone: Buttercream Birthday Cake Honey Vanilla Bean and Salty Caramel. The salty Caramel had theee worst after taste and the other 2 were "ok". That waffle bowl was grossss..sorry it was. I think Cold Stone is better. Maybe I'll try a different flavor to go next time

Probably the best ice cream I've had in North Carolina. Really cute interior and smells AMAZING, probably from the fresh waffle cones. Speaking of, the waffle cones/bowls are a must have! The texture is crunchy without being too brittle/dry, I would highly recommend getting one. We ordered milkiest chocolate, coffee, and caramel. The chocolate and coffee were my favorite, and the combination of both flavors was amazing. It was so good we went back the next day for more. The staff here are also very kind and personable, both times we went it was a good experience. Highly recommend!

It's hard to find a time when there isn't a long line around this popular ice cream shoppe in south end and it's easy to see why. Great tasting, some all time favorite and some seasonal flavors. Friendly staff. Nicely lit shoppe with open windows when the weather is nice outside. The icecream flight is an absolute steal. You get to try 10 different flavors. Technically these are half scoops but it was plenty for 4 adults to share!

Definitely definitely worth standing in line for it. The ice cream is absolutely delicious! It's creamy, it taste amazing and the service is excellent. I was really thinking about making the line but it kind of went by really really fast taking into consideration the amount of people that were in line. I have a coffee ice cream and it literally taste like a cafÃ© con leche. Definitely worth it

This was some sensation ice cream. Jeni's really hit the spot after i had dinner at Hawkers. I'm not usual much of a dessert person but this ice cream is something special. I had the strawberry ice cream and it was delicious. The strawberry was cut into nice little chunks so the flavor wasn't overwhelming. The waffle cone was just crunchy enough but not too brittle.

The famous jeni's! While they have some locations around the US, this is the first time I've been. There was a line, and it moved slowly, but they have unique flavors that made the wait worth it. And their waffle cones smelled and tasted really good! It's expensive for a single ($5.25) but you can do two half scoops to try 2 flavors

Unique flavors and delicious. We got here late on a Friday night and the line was out the door but moving fast. Got 2 half scoops (lavender and coffee coconut milk). Lavender ice cream was my favorite.

When someone tells you this is the best place to buy Iced Creams in town, listen to them!! Overall good customer service and the waiting time was next to nothing, but the real cherry on top here is the unique varieties of flavors they have here. For example mouthwatering experiences like bramble-berry crisp or my personal favorite gooey butter cake iced cream are too die for!! Jeni's has been going a slow but steady downfall at least in my location as they have been out of toppings at a constant!! Please add more varieties of toppings too i would love to see new treats! Overall great place to visit would recommend to any iced cream lovers out there!! Sadly must give this 4 out of 5 stars for the lack of toppings
We go here often and LOVE it. Here are our ratings for the 3 flavors we got this time: 1. Brambleberry Crisp 2. Cookies in Cream 3. Brown Butter Almond Brittle

You guys in the Upper South End area are so lucky. Between all of the trendy restaurants and bars, now you have an amazing Ice Cream spot too? So, Jealous, over here. I can't complain too much, I live in North Charlotte, my office is in South Charlotte, and my job involves traveling everywhere in between. So I get to see and visit any noteworthy business in the QC with relative ease. Jeni's is no exception to the list of 'noteworthy' places in my book. Between the kick-ass ice cream flavors and the friendly staff that know way too much about their product (and just ice cream in general), this place is a prime example of what every business should strive to be. So what makes them stand out? The flavors really are "next-level" exciting. Between Brambleberry Crisp and the Goat Cheese w/ Cherries, I couldn't tell you which one I crave more. That's right, I said goat cheese! You're probably thinking that goat cheese doesn't belong in Ice Cream. Well, why not? Who's this absolute authority that says what can and can't be Ice Cream? Forget the norm and live a little, darn it! Hats off to the staff. Everyone in the building is quite adept at the craft. How about finding out that "Darkest Chocolate" flavor has so much chocolate that if it had just 1% more it would "legally" have to be called fudge! They have a little morsel of knowledge for every flavor they sell. They also make fresh waffle cones. You can literally smell the caramelized/nutty/sugary aroma from three blocks down Camden. Everyone on site is as nice as can be, you can try any flavor you'd like and they even have metal tasting spoons. Some flavors are amplified versions of true classics, and some are truly unique creations that push the boundaries of what Ice Cream can be. Maybe it's best that I don't live around here or I'd be as big as a house in mere months. Just a small drawback is that on my last two visits, they've been out of one or two of my favorites. When the "Flight" of minis comes with three different flavors and a wedge of waffle cone, missing two flavors you're looking forward to is a real bummer. That being said, any substitution I've got here is always top notch. I've never got a bad scoop here. Splendid is such a good description for Jeni's. You won't be disappointed here.
Ice cream was soooo delicious! I got the watermelon taffy very sweet like I like it!!

Great service , was complimented as soon as i entered. I love small chats with staff members they do make your day a lot easier. And uplift your mood. I hope i return the favor in making their day good. It really matters on good customer service. Glad i came here. Icecream is a good feeling to the soul lol. The service was great 5 stars definitely . Charlotte has this little hidden charm i admire.

After a disappointing dinner nearby, stopped in to grab some treats to go. For once, I lucked into a super-short line! And Yes, they had Covid measures in place...social distancing in line, masks and all. I got my fave flavor, Brown Butter Almond Brittle...an order of Trio (3 scoops...not so small!), w/ their amazing homemade Waffle in a mini tray...for only 5 bucks! As always, parking is a drag in this area, so my husband just circled around while I got the treats (to share), then just picked me up from the road. Thanks, Jeni, for making our date night a tad sweeter!
Definitely an overrated tourist place. Also I prefer to go the the small businesses in Charlotte that don't charge $6 for 2 scoops.

Let me just say, it was worth the wait! I took my daughter for ice cream one day & my was so good. There was a pretty long line but we might've waited about 20 minutes max. We both enjoyed our order. There's minimal seating inside but plenty of tables outside to eat. Not too much to say other than it was good!
This place is legit! Good location, extremely good ice cream (tried the Wildberry and Almond brittle combo) Flavors are very fresh and the waffle cone smell mesmerizes

I kept hearing about Jeni's and seeing the ice cream at Harris Teeter and never realized what the hype was all about it. I finally got to try it in Charlotte and WOWWW! I see why there is this crazy hype! The line was wrapped around the block but moved really quickly. The ooey gooey butter cake- oh my lord. Like actual heaven in your mouth. The associates were so helpful and I was struggling so hard to just stick to a couple of flavors. This ice cream is 100000% worth the hype!!!

I've never been a big ice cream person, especially when it comes to the "gourmet" variety as it has never lived up to the hype for me. That completely changed when I after my first visit to Jeni's! I was on my way to a pub nearby and was walking to my car when I saw a line wrapped around the bldg. That caught my attention. I asked my friend at the pub about Jeni's and they said totally worth it, so I went after my meal for dessert there. Thankfully, the line had died down a little bit. I have to say, from the minute you are greeted it's just a great experience! The friendliness of the staff, especially when you tell them it's your first time, is just fabulous! They let you sample to build your "dream cone" and make solid recs based on your tastes. I have to say, I was not disappointed when I devoured my cone! The flavor and texture just spoke to the quality of the ice cream and I left with a smile on my face. Definitely my new ice cream go to in the Queen City!

Eclectic flavors, homemade waffle cones. Does it get any better? If it says anything, we were still getting ice cream at this place through winter. The Gooey Butter Cake, Darkest Chocolate, Coffee with Cream and Sugar and Whiskey Pecan are only a few of the heavy-hitting highlights here. Grab yourself some Hawkers for dinner and Jeni's right next door for dessert!

The first time I tried Jeni's, I really didn't like it. I thought they were trying way too hard to be different and to stand out. BUT now I really really like it. Their flavors are different, but such good quality. Their waffle cones are hit or miss. Sometimes they are really good, and sometimes there's a weird taste like the batter is old or something is off. Staff is always friendly. It is a bit pricey, but for quality, homemade ice cream, it's a treat!

As soon as we saw Jeni's, we had to stop. Taste so many flavors...they all were good! I got a standard (two half scoops) on the house made, thick waffle cone: Atlantic Beach Pie: sweet cream ice cream, lemon pudding, and crushed saltines, and my favorite of all-time, Brown Butter Almond Brittle. Eric R. had the white chocolate macadamia nut cookie and the brambleberry crisp. We were happy in our ice cream heaven!

Hands down the best ice cream I've had in NC. Thee BEST! I just may have to go and purchase a pint. Never have I had such creamy, developed, not too sweet, flavors of cream creating sweet love in my mouth.... too much? The brambleberry was delicious but the peach biscuit joint was perfect. The perfect combo of sweet and salty. Even my dude, who typically gives food the "okay" shrug had to admit this was top notch ice cream. He even finished my cone. Oh! The cone! The waffle cone was buttery, flaky goodness. The perfect capsule to hold my sweet, luscious creamy delight. I can see why there's a line out the door. I can also see the line draws people to this spot. I mean let's keep it real; if you drive by any place with a like out the door and down the block, you're going to think the place is hittin it, or someone is giving something away for free. Am I right? This is my ice cream joint from now on. This is it. Don't bother convincing me otherwise.
As with all other Jeni's, this one does not disappoint. Do not skip the waffle cone - it's unlike any one you've ever had. I'm a firm believer in ice cream, and Jeni's is always my number one choice!

Lots of good flavors and also has seasonal flavors that they change up frequently. There are a few dairy free options that are good as well. The atmosphere and customer service were good. My only complaint would be on some week nights there may be slow moving lines due to too few workers on that night.
We tried the Flight, which is 10 1/2 scoops of different flavors. Perfect amount, awesome flavors and for only $20 it was great. Would definitely go back anytime i'm in Charlotte!

The queen of all ice cream any and everywhere...........then end. There is nothing close......nothing! The flavors are the most creative, the most flavorful. I mean seriously how do you come up with the masterful combination of brown butter almond brittle(my favorite) or brandied banana brulee? So not only are your combinations ridiculously delicious, but you mean to tell me that while I'm deciding which creative masterpiece I'm going to have, you have someone making buttercrisp waffle cones for me to enjoy it with? This has to be a dream and I'm crushing on this Southend jewel.....it is not a coincidence that on any given weekend you will stand in line, so try to visit during the week to avoid the lines. Also, my seasonal favs are boozy eggnog and sweet potato with torched marshmallows........I can go on and on but I'll stop writing so you can get over to Jeni's:-)

I've been to Jeni's a few times and I always enjoy it. The line is always long but this last time I got the rare opportunity to find it short! My latest scoops were Brambleberry Crisp and Salted Peanut Butter with Chocolate Flecks and it tasted sort of like a peanut butter and jelly sandwich. I also love their dairy free options like Texas Sheet Cake or Cold Brew with Coconut Cream. You can never go wrong here!
Seriously the best ice cream. The cake batter flavor is to die for. Quick moving line but would be nice if there was room to stand inside to wait when it's raining

If you're in the area, you have to stop by this ice cream shop. Even if you have to go a little out of the way, it's worth stopping by. It's seriously good! I've tried the salty caramel. It tastes salty but then you are hit with the sweet caramel - the 2 melded together is heavenly. The flavors are very prominent and you can actually taste the caramel. I've also tried the brown butter almond. It tastes just as it sounds. I'd have difficulty choosing between the two but luckily, you can choose 2 flavors. The staff said they stopped giving samples to try but if you don't like the flavor, you can let them know and they can exchange it for you.

great ice cream and great location! the only down side is it's more on the pricy side. we got the order of the Trio, i believe it was $6. one friend of ours got a pint of the pineapple upside down cake flavor (sorry not pictured) and I got to say that might be my favorite flavor so far! most jeni's ice cream are more on the sweeter side but the pineapple upside down cake had a hint of sourness to it. it was just amazing I would highly recommend!

FREE ICE CREAM ON JUNE 21! But also, Jeni's is delicious. I've been to my fair share of ice cream shops (you could call me an ice cream connoisseur), and Jeni's definitely ranks among the best. The bad news is that they stopped doing free samples as of June 2021, but the good news is that they all looked very good. I got a trio with FrosÃ© Sorbet, and other flavors. Needless to say, my favorite was the FrosÃ© Sorbet. Not too sweet, perfectly tangy, and an ideal cold treat for a hot day! I would skip the waffle bowl, though. Not quite worth the extra $1.25.
I loved this ice cream, just the smell of this place is fantastic, reasonable prices too!!!

Ice cream? Yes, please. I lucked out with a parking space nearby and was able to get in to Jeni's quickly. The restaurant is clean and the ice creams are displayed behind glass. A list of the current ones are on the board with a menu. Easy enough. Choose one full scoop or two half-scoops for the same price, so I went with the two. Sweet Potato with Torched Marshmallows and Salted Peanut Butter with Chocolate Flecks. Both were delicious. A little sweet but the random soft chewy pieces of marshmallow and the random crunchy bites of chocolate were awesome. Great flavor. Great unique flavor choices including "Bangkok Peanut" and "Goat Cheese with Red Cherries" sound interesting. It's a cute shop with seating inside and out. South End needs cute spots like this. [Review 9930 overall, 1509 of 2018.]

I remember when Breyer's ice cream first hit our grocery store. Wow, what a treat. No more. Just another scoop of crap competing with other purveyors of crap for your extra cash. Enter Jeni's. Creamy, velvety and tasty it really is splendid. And pricey. So what? Something this good will cost you extra change. Pony up and enjoy the decadence. They say that creamy ice cream, like Jeni's, is due to more egg yolks (i.e. fat) and less air being whipped into the mix. Let us all clasp hands and pray that Jeni's will resist the temptation that has sidelined so many into mediocrity, e.g. Breyers, HÃ¤agen-Dazs, Edy's, and Dairy Queen (ok, they don't belong on the list). Jeni's Splendid Ice Cream. All the way up on my "Give 'em a whirl meter." Indulge here.

Jeni's is my favorite ice cream shop, so I was excited to learn they were opening a branch in Charlotte. It's pretty common for there to be long lines, so it was no surprise to have to wait here since it just opened. But the wait is most certainly worth it!! It moves fairly quickly, and the servers are all very friendly and patient as per usual with Jeni's. I almost always order the 3 scoop tray, but you can add additional scoops for $1 per scoop. The half scoops they give in the trays are still very generous! My favorite flavors are the goat cheese w/ cherries, frosÃ©, and brambleberry crisp. But they always have new and unique flavors available. I love travelling and trying new restaurants, but I always seem to end up coming back here for more of their delicious ice cream :)

Finally got a chance to try Jeni's Icecream. As usual it has long queue but as we wait in the line the smell of the freshly baked cone is very amazing. Based on several tips did try the Gouey butter cake which was good and I must say the darkest cake is definitely dark. The single scoop itself seem large to me.

I can't say how much I loved this ice cream. I typically only eat vanilla and butter pecan sho I wad very skeptical that I would find something. The place is small but super busy. The young lady that helped us was sort helpful and patient. I tried the Brown Butter Almond and fell in love. She said that was the closest to butter pecan. Then offered me to try honey vanilla bean which was the closest to vanilla. Both of these flavors knocked my socks off. My husband who said he didn't want anything had a sample of a flavor that also had almonds in it and ordered his own immediately. We took our ice cream and sat outside to enjoy. I will be back when I'm in the area. That place is all the hype and more.

Great customer service!! Due to covid, they weren't offering samples, but the cashier described the different flavors pretty good. None of us had been here before! I got the standard size with Gooey Cake and Butter Cake. They go well together but the Gooey Cake is my FAVORITE!!! We grabbed a table outside....and (don't tell anyone), we went back for seconds

We got the Trio flight with an additional scoop since it was hard for us to narrow down to 3 flavors. My favorite is the Brown Butter Almond Brittle and the Honey Vanilla Bean. Brown Butter Almond Brittle has the most texture and has a vanilla base, which I love. Honey Vanilla Bean is a slight twist on a classic and it's not too out there so if you're a creature of habits, then this is for you. Brambleberry is more on the sour and tart side. It has some texture like a nice blueberry cobbler. Salted Peanut Butter is great for someone who loves peanut butter since the flavor is strong. The salt adds a nice dimension to the flavor profile.

I have been here several times now, and I have to say this place is pretty darn good. I feel like Jeni's takes the place as top ice cream place in Charlotte. Even in February there is a line out the door for ice cream. What I like about Jeni's is that they don't have the standard chocolate, vanilla, cookies and cream...etc. Jeni's has flavors like goat cheese and cherries, which I have not had the guts to try yet. But don't worry they have other more traditional flavors for those who are not as adventurous. Definitely recommend this place for a sweet treat, but if it is this busy in the winter I can't imagine how long the line will be in the summer time!
Ice cream is pretty small and fairly pricey - they have unique flavors like honey comb and lavender but there are better options around the area for larger portions and creamier!!

Good ice cream but the line moves really slow. I understand the need to sample but there becomes a point where you just have to move on. It's ice cream folks, it's all good. 30 minutes in line was a tad too much for me though. I had the brambleberry and powdered jelly donut. They were great! Huge shoutout to Jessica, the girl behind the counter. Probably one of the most friendliest people I've ever met.

So I've had this ice cream in the grocery store. Didn't realize there was an actual ice cream parlor in Southend. Here's the thing. You can literally smell it before you see it. When was the last time you walked by an ice cream shop and you smelled anything? The smell grabs you and pulls you inside. Heavenly. There was a line outside. A LINE! The anticipation only mounted. Line moved pretty quickly though. Once inside the hard part was picking one flavor. Ended up getting a $12 pint of buttercream birthday cake. It was for a limited time do I didn't want to miss it. Alright y'all there are chunks of birthday cake in the ice cream! Yes! Can you taste buttercream frosting? Absolutely! My friend got the brown butter almond brittle. Haven't heard from her yet. Don't expect to sit down inside and eat. It's a grab and go kinda place but there is some seating they provide outside as well as seating around the area. Can't wait to bring my fam back one night for a special treat.

Ice cream, you scream, how about we all ask for ice cream using our inside voices because we live in a polite society where we respect other people's space?? ...and when little people say they want chocolate don't shame them into trying all the flavors. Really, it's ice cream and chocolate is good, and ultra mega chocolate is ultra mega good, and the milkiest chocolate is all you'll ever need. that being said, the goat cheese and cherry has a certain cache with me because unlike some actual goat cheeses, you can really taste the goat! the grassy, clovery notes are not just present, they sing! and I could get all ridiculous about the aroma of freshly coned waffles filling Charlotte all the way down to Carowinds... but really, the milkiest chocolate. it's so good.

I normally don't eat ice cream because I'm lactose. My friend told me they have non dairy options. I tried it and loved every moment. No stomach issues after. Can't wait to go back, in the summer tho.

It doesn't matter what time of the day it is this location is always hopping. Thankfully the line moves quick! There's lots of good people watching to be done in south end. If you don't know what you want, ask for a sample. The staff is super patient and they want you to enjoy your decision. There are so many wonderful flavors! I think mine are the bramble berry and the sweet cream biscuits and peach jam. They even have some dairy free flavors I was able to take out for my lactose intolerant mom. Her cold brew coffee ice cream was amazing! They have seasonal and limited time options as well.

Delicious ice cream! Expensive but a nice treat if you like ice cream. I must say, I was excited to finally try this place when it came to Charlotte (we even have her recipe book and make her ice creams at home from scratch) but when I came to the shop the service was less than great. The first lady helping us was nice but we went on to be helped by the other server who did not smile once. She did not seem like she wanted to be there! That definitely made me less interested and excited about my purchases. Maybe let's teach the staff to smile more.... But all in all I would come back because of the ice cream. I had the boozy egg nog (half off) and the bananas foster/creme brulee one. Yum!!!
Thee best ice cream and "waffle chips" I've ever had! I see why the line is always so insane. We luckily missed the long line but I'd probably wait in it next time anyway! Delicious!

I love Jeni's because I am notorious for getting the same "mint chocolate chip and mocha chip" combo but here, there are flavors I've never tried before because they stick with originals. Although, it adds to my indecisiveness (but that's what taste tests are for), every flavor I go choose is delicious! I got the cream puff, dark chocolate truffle and my personal favorite the salted PB and chocolate chip ice cream as the Trio. I have yet to be disappointed and I would just like to personally thank Jeni's for coming to Southend!

I'm in love with this place.. The ice cream was unique and I love it. I have the goat milk and cherry scoop with their cone. The ice cream was sweet, the cherries are a little tart and the cone is pleasantly nice and sweet. They would give you unlimited samples with a metal spoon. That would help with NOT disturbing the true taste.. I tried the cream puffs but my lawd it's sweet.. So I'm glad the sampling are there. Can't wait to go back!

I love this ice cream! Although sometimes there can be a line, it usually goes really fast. I usually order online and pickup at the window which is a much faster! I will always recommend this place for the best ice cream in town!

About a month ago we had dinner in south end and saw that Jeni's had a line out the door in 40 degree weather. Must be good ice cream for people to willingly freeze. Fast forward to today, warmer weather and Jeni's hit the spot. Of course, there was a line but don't worry it moves quickly and definitely worth it. I got the trio of goat cheese with cherries, toasted peanut butter with jam and brown butter almond brittle. Each one was delicious. They have some of the best ice cream no lie.

Found this place while riding the train from Downtown Charlotte, and boy did I enjoy this place. Make sure you get here on time, as there is often a large line forming outside this establishment. The staff is very knowledgeable about their product, and very quick to suggest different combinations. The take is amazing and I was glad that I got to enjoy this location.

Very good ice cream. Great service. I would love to give them 5 stars but they didn't have the flavor I was looking for that day AND I wish they'd bring back some flavors from time to time (think Bagel )

My favorite ice cream place in Charlotte! I love their unique flavors. My favorite flavor is their Wildberry Lavender. The location is in South End. There is minimal seating inside and a few tables outside. Parking can be a little difficult on the weekends but I love how it's walkable to many places in South End. The line can get kind of crazy but the smell of the fresh waffle cones might convince you to stay. My friends and I always get the trio where you can pick 3 flavors and share. Service has always been great with smiling faces. Can't wait to see what other flavors they create!

Jeni's is ALWAYS on point. Midwest grown and slowly making its way from coast to coast! I first heard about Jeni's several years ago when I met a girl from Ohio when I lived in San Francisco. We became friends and both being from the Midwest we shared some of the things we loved and missed... one of those things for her was Jeni's ice cream! So you can only imagine how excited I was when I was living in St. Louis a few short years later and they opened a location. It was as good as my friend hyped it up to be!! Sadly (well not now, but at the time) I moved to Charlotte and there was no Jeni's. SIGH. Fast forward a year and a half later and BOOM! Jeni's has arrived! I couldn't wait to get in line and once again see if it lived up to the hype... which it did! The flavors are so unique and delicious!! Since it's summer they ended up having a few seasonal flavors, one of those being frose!! It was a delicious sorbet type treat and the one I ended up going with! That is after I tried half the flavors! Again, this isn't your normal ice cream shop and you should enter with an open mind and empty stomach! They'll let you try as many flavors as you want, don't be greedy though, if you find what you're looking for (or if your stomach is telling you yes) GO FOR IT!! They do half scoops which are comparable to a small/kiddie scoop at a regular ice cream shop. $4 for a scoop or three for $6... no brainer, go for THREE! And don't forget fresh, homemade waffle cones or waffle pieces come with every scoop!! If you're looking for that cool delicious treat for your summer evening, hop on over to Jeni's! Or anytime for that matter!
Always the best!! Be sure to sample their limited edition flavors! They don't disappoint!

I have a love affair with Jeni's that started a few years back when I discovered their pints at whole foods and would shell out 10 bucks weekly for a pint of brown butter almond brittle. So imagine my excitement when I found out Jeni's was opening a Charlotte location. Parking is usually horrible, so be prepared to walk quite a few blocks. But it'll be worth it when you walk into the store and are enveloped in the warm aroma of freshly made waffle cones. There's a huge blackboard menu listing all the flavors, including seasonal ones. The ladies behind the counter are super nice and did not seem the least bit annoyed when I asked to sample 6+ flavors (this was just the first time I was here and there was nobody behind me, ok). I liked everything I tried, so choosing 3 was a difficult choice. My favorite was the gingerbread cognac - the gingerbread chunks and strong cognac flavor paired so well together and was texturally what I need. Also enjoyed the white chocolate peppermint, with white chocolate chips intermixed. Both of these are seasonal. Also really like the peanut butter and strawberry jam flavor - which is dairy free! I wouldn't have guessed at all. Roasted pb and tart jam swirled into a creamy base. I like the fluffernutter flavor for similar reasons. I'm into the cool and unique flavor combos, but I went with a few ice cream purists who just got plain chocolate - the darkest chocolate is quite good. So there's something for everyone. The trio is the perfect size if you want to try multiple flavors. Comes with small pieces of waffle cone. Kind of expensive, yes, but definitely worth the money. Some window bar seating inside and tables outside. Will return every chance I get.

Love this place- and the fact that they made the waffle cone right when it is ordered and not just sitting there. Bought some pints to go. The only star missing is because of lack of parking in the area rather than the place itself.

It was a nice day to head to Jeni's, we never go because the line is always out the door but today we made it before the rush! I got to enjoy the trio with the milkiest chocolate (as an avid chocolate lover is my fave), wild lavender (my 2nd), the raspberry donut (a limited time flavor which I was not too fond of the after taste). All were great in their own unique way. Watching them make the waffle cones was a joy because they sure did taste delicious. I can't wait to come back and try them on a super hot day!
Great ice cream. I had the mint chocolate chip ice cream. It was the creamiest ice cream I ever had.

Whenever I go to Charlotte most of the time I make my way to Jeni's. My friend recommended this place to me & I'm amazed how delicious their ice cream are. It's very flavorful, creamy, & the texture is just right! My usual is the Texas Sheet Cake & I instantly fell in love; first off it's dairy free (& vegan!) b/c it's made out of coconut milk while it also has chocolate cake crumbles & bittersweet fudge. This time I got the honey vanilla bean & my friend ordered wildberry lavender. Both were still yummy & it's even better when getting the cone!

I scream, you scream, we all scream for ice cream!!!! I discovered Jeni's while living in GA, and was so happy to find the south end location here in Charlotte. Jeni's is the epitome of small batch, artisan ice cream. The ambience: Uber cute, tiny shop off Camden road in the heart of south end. It's across from Hawkers (also amazing). The bright Jeni's Ice Creams sign can be seen from up the street. The line can be seen from there as well! There's almost always a line. The food: ICE CREAM!!!!! I love the variety of unique flavors they offer at Jeni's. Everything from basic vanilla (bean) and darkest chocolate to sweet cream biscuits and peaches. There are also non dairy flavors, most with a coconut base. There's even frosÃ©. You can sample as many flavors as you'd like, and build your ultimate frozen treat. They have single, double and triple scoops. My fave is the trio. Three half scoops of any flavor. Accompanied by an amazing piece of waffle cone. I came on my birthday, the gave me a free trio, with a full waffle cone on the side. Score! Stop by, be prepared to wait, but it'll be worth it.

My brother took me here after our candle making class just around the corner and I have to say although they didn't have many non-dairy options I did find one that was pretty good my only complaint was it was too sweet for me. But overall everything was very clean and organized and I did appreciate how all of the associates had great customer service. The overall decor is very cute as well! I thought the box of water was cute too!
Best Ice cream in the city! Gooey butter cake is amazing and the handmade waffle cones put it all together.
If you haven't gone you are deprived. Go now! :) the ice cream is wonderful the customer service is awesome.

Boo and I journeyed here at random on Sunday, and came right back on purpose Monday, so there's that! On a beautiful Sunday afternoon like we had here this past Sunday, the line was longgggg, but well worth the wait! You can try all the flavors that interest you! Our favorite hands down is the Gooey Butter Cake- D E L I C I O U S. Runner up is the Brown Butter Almond Brittle. I loved the Rainbow buttermilk flavor, the dairy free Texas Sheet Cake was good to if you like lots of chocolate! This will probably be our summer spot :)

Some days you just need ice cream. Yesterday was one of those days. I've never been to Jeni's before, though I've walked by it on King St in Charleston. There's always a line there, and I'd heard a lot of buzz about it coming to Charlotte. My sister (who lives in Charleston) had always told me it was overrated, but I knew I needed to try it for myself. After a lunch in South End, I convinced her to go with me to share some dessert. There wasn't a line when we got there, though we did have to wait for the people in front of us to sample quite a few flavors. We shared a flight of minis. I'd never had an ice cream flight before, and I'm sold. I loved getting to try different flavors, and scooping some of it up with the pieces of waffle cone was a great touch. We picked Frose, Lavender Wildberry, and Gooey Buttercake. The Frose was absolutely incredible. It had a strong pear flavor. The Gooey Buttercake was also fabulous. Very sweet in the most satisfying way. The Lavender Wildberry was only okay, somewhat of a disappointment to me. The texture of all of them was slightly differently but very good. My sister said to always order the Pear and Riesling when it's on the menu. It's a cute little place. I liked the decorations inside. There aren't many seats inside but there was a lot of space outside. All in all, I won't wait in a line for it ever. I think it's too expensive ($6 for the flight), but I will pay that price occasionally. But it's darn good ice cream.

Jeni, Jeni, Jeni oh how Splendid your Ice Cream truly is. As you walk by and think to yourself "hmmmm ice cream looks good" you'll suddenly be hit with a face full of aroma that could only be described as sweet, buttery bliss. So you decide to take your chances and stop inside. The designer flavors and Dairy-free options will make your taste buds glad you stopped in and for that aroma, well you can put your ice cream in a freshly made cone have it in a bowl with a piece of waffle cone on top. Either way the cone is a must try and there are plenty of flavors to keep you coming back.

You WERE our favorite Ice cream spot in Charlotte until a few weeks ago. Hey Tutu, you don't get to be rude to my wife and continue to get our business. There's just too much competition out here for you to get comfortable, especially in the two most crucial areas: Quality and Customer Service. Bye Felicia!

Jeni's is a feel good ice cream shop for the whole family. It features very unique ice cream flavors! I always order the Texas sheet cake which is the perfect combination of cake and ice cream, what's even better is it's Dairy free. Yay!!

This is the second time that we have been to Jeni's. The ice cream here is pretty good but they make fresh waffle cones that you can smell down the street. My favorite is the brambleberry crisp but they have a number of good flavors. I haven't tried any others as I stick to my favorites. This is a cool little place that has a line almost any time of day. The lines go pretty quickly so don't be discouraged. I really enjoy Jeni's and stop here anytime that I am in the area.

Isn't it awesome finding an ice cream shop where no choice is a bad choice? It may not be your flavor and it may not be your favorite but all of the ice cream choices are full of quality taste and live. I highly suggest the coffee ice cream but I am highly partial to it. My second favorite is the lavender. It just reminds me of summer. I would suggest going after a dinner or even after stroll. But just remember you'll be back for more.

So many options! I can't even stand it. I asked how many I could try and the lovely girl behind the counter told me "1,000". Perfect. She was so nice, and let me try as many flavors as I wanted so I could narrow down my choices. I settled on the gooey butter cake and OMG, I'm in love. It was so delicious. I really like everything I tried, but this was magnificent. The waffle cone was good, but a little rich for me, so next time I may get a different type. The staff was awesome! I will definitely be back! Great experience.

I have been here numerous times now, soooo review time! First off, the smell of Jeni's fills the block and it just draws you in! Follow your senses and go inside! Once inside, you can sample some before you decide on a freshly made waffle cone (with one or two scoops) or bowl. Since, I usually can't decide on one flavor I like to share the three half scoop half bowl with someone. They now have non-diary options, which are just as good as diary. Jeni's rotates flavors, so be pre-pared to keep coming back! There is limited seating inside and outside. If you plan on coming here on a weekend, plan to wait. I have seen the line 40 people deep. There is limited street parking available near by. Follow the smell and line of people, to Jeni's in Southend! :)

Saw the lineup and almost drove away. But then decided that it must be good if the line was that long. Glad we went because it moved quickly. Before we got inside, we could smell the waffle cones they make in house! Get the waffle cones!!! We decided that this was the best ice cream we have ever had. I had the brambleberry crisp scoop and the brown butter with almond brittle scoop in a waffle cone cup. My girlfriend had the salted peanut butter with chocolate flakes and salted caramel in a waffle cone cup. Id bet that any flavor is delicious! We will definitely go back for more.

I continue to awe at the amazing flavor quality of Jeni's ice creams! You can tell so much detail and care goes into each flavor. I'm so happy Charlotte has three locations (with this one and NoDa being a bit bigger than Park Rd Shopping Center)! Literally any flavor you get is amazing. I don't have a favorite because I love getting different flavors each visit -- and that's easy to do because there's always new seasonal flavors coming out. And can we talk about the drool worthy aroma that hits your nostrils as soon as you walk in?! I love the smell of freshly made waffle cones. I love that you can also see them roll fresh ones behind the counter. All of the locations are decorated with the same vibrancy -- it makes for a great atmosphere. This location has a good handful of seats inside and outside, so you can beat the heat if you're lucky. The fact that Jeni's is always so welcoming to Yelpers is also another reason why I adore them so much! They care about their customers and the products they offer them.

This ice cream is AMAZING!!! The line to get ice cream is always out the door...sometimes around the corner. It's that good!! They have so many different flavors and types - dairy and non-dairy. Don't be fooled - the non-dairy is just as good as the dairy! The smell of the homemade waffle cones draw you in and prepare you for an experiencel! The location is great - in the middle of SouthEnd on Camden. Parking is located in the street, but it may take a while to find a space, as there are many other establishments around. Uber or scooter is easy. Must go to Jeni's!

There is something special about this ice cream no lie. Once you walk by the store and smell the fresh waffle cones being made its like light to a fly we were trapped. What they have there is truly a trap that my wife and I were caught in. The staff was very friendly as we tried a few samples and came to the big decision one of everything. The cone is sweet but a hint salty which was mmmmmm I had the honey and vanilla. The only problem I had was it went too fast, and I took my time eating it. Well done as the staff was friendly clean as I noticed the cashier correctly washing his hands after each transaction well done. A++, Jeni we want in to be investors right off the light rail this place is a definite winner in any day after the game or hot day. Plenty of room inside or out time to bring the sweet tooth out.

Rule: if there is no line, go and grab ice cream! This was the original Jeni's location in Charlotte and still super popular. The staff are super friendly, masked-up and ready to go. The stand alone building only has counter seating and the line moves through pretty fast. Lots of outdoor tables to sit at or the large concrete steps behind the store. I really only went in here to get a few pints to take home, so I'm not sure how they are handling samples during Covid, but they always gave you separate sampling spoons and the the staff always wore gloves before the pandemic. Southend is pretty lucky to have a cool spot like Jeni's to enjoy after going to one of the many restaurants nearby.
I love the variety of flavors and this place is so perfect for a little date or a meet up point for friends.

Deliciously creamy ice cream with unique flavors. Great staff! Parking is easy and there are a few seats inside. Two favorite parts. (1) you can order "half scoops" so you can try multiple flavors :D I got 3 half scoops to try multiple flavors. My favorite flavor was Candy Bar one. (2) they have GREAT dairy free flavors. Best dairy free ice cream I've ever had.

If you have been to a Jeni's before, you know what to expect in quality. You also know to expect a long line on a beautiful spring day. If you haven't been to a Jeni's before, you are in for a treat. The flavors alternate and are not your typical vanilla, strawberry, and lemon sorbet flavors. Some of the flavors they currently have are cold brew with coconut cream, texas sheet cake, and brambleberry crisp. If you want something refreshing and not too sweet, I would recomment the FrosÃ©. It is rozen rosÃ© with pear, strawberry, and watermelon, and very refreshing.

A Charlotte ice cream staple and a must go to stop for ice cream! Jeni's has tons of unique flavors that you can't find in your typical grocery store! Today I tried the Whiskey and Pecan flavor for the first time and I loved it!!! The whiskey flavor was subtle and added the perfect touch to the ice cream!

Oh my goodness. I was blown out of the water by this locations delicious ice cream. I recommend getting their "trio" as you can get a taste of a lot off of their large menu. One flavor that stood at to me and is definitely worth trying is the "Gooey Butter Cake". The shop is also located in a beautiful part of Charlotte that is perfect for any day out.

I initially tried their ice cream at Publix with a small pint of "Popcorn & Peanuts, an heirloom popcorn ice cream with notes of bright, buttery popcorn flavor and honey plus sweet and salty caramel toffee-coated peanuts mixed in. It wasn't good! A few months later I decided to try them again, but at their Charlotte location and I was impressed! The first thing you'll notice is the smell of freshly made waffles and a wide assortment of unique flavors. Unlike the gluttonous "Va Da Vie" that prohibits sampling, Jeni's allows you to sample their ice cream with no visible signage stating otherwise. I've since been to Jeni's twice trying their Salted Peanut Butter with Chocolate Flecks, Coffee with Cream & Sugar and Brown Butter Almond Brittle. They are all delicious! My only issue is that they're exaggeratedly expensive! You can't convince me as to WHY ice cream is expensive, because at the end of the day it's freakin ice cream! They don't play around with their "One Scoop" serving either, "One Scoop" is just that, "ONE SCOOP" Their pints are 12$ which is absurd but I guess they're trying to establish themselves as "high end" ice cream, and people LOVE overpaying so I guess it's working. Definitely not a place to bring the kids or the family as it will cost you the same as a Disney Cruise. LOL!

This is a bittersweet post because my favorite ice cream place of all times for the past 11 years has now been trumped by JENI'S!!! All I can say is WOWWWWW! She is a chemical genius!! Literally she uses her secular chemical engineering education to satisfy our sweet palates! I tried almost every flavor and they were so creamy and heavenly! My favorite was the gooey butter cake which literally had a freshly hand made butter cake mixed throughout the ice cream. My husband had a flight of three flavors and wanted more right away. We are visiting from Houston and KNOW this would kill out there! So Jeni if you are listening, please bring this gem to HTown! The people need better ice cream!!!! Please please please and thank you!! Oh and you can order them shipped to you online in pints from her original location in Ohio. $12 per pint and you have to order at least 3 at a time which when you taste them you will see is not a problem lol they also sell her ice cream in select Publix grocery stores.
What's not to live? FrosÃ¨ is my jam. Love the pick up window and the new selections of seasonal flavors.

I fell in love with this place when I lived in Ohio. I am so happy there is one in Charlotte, so when I visit, I can indulge. Basically, this is the most fabulous ice cream you will ever eat. You cannot go wrong with any of the flavors. I like to do the mini trio and go all the way! Names with words like Butter, Gooey, Sweet Cream, Goat Cheese... and freshly made waffle cones too! This place gives me life! Treat Yo-self at Jeni's!

This Jeni's location just opened, so the line was out the door and down the sidewalk. We persevered anyway, because I've heard such great reviews and tried one of their pints sold in grocery stores. The space is pretty small, but service was fast. Scoopers were friendly and ready to serve. The best deal on the menu is definitely the trio of half scoops with additional scoops $1 each. We got five unique flavors, and my favorites were the rainbow sorbet and frose (both amazing to combat the heat). The trio comes with waffle wafers, so double yum! There are window counters inside and outside, but just be warned, there aren't any public restrooms! Really look forward to trying their other flavors. If you join their email list, they also offer free ice cream on your birthday, yay!

This is a cute little ice cream shop for atmosphere, but the actual ice cream was kind of just 'ok'. The waffle cone, in particular, was almost inedible from the amount of salt in it. Also, because I have pins in my ankle from a motorcycle accident, I generally like to sit down when I go out to eat, and there wasn't any place to sit comfortably. There are two small benches right outside the shop, but they were right in the blasting sun; the tables outside are for the neighboring coffee shop. So, I wound up walking over to the other side of the street and sitting on the curb in the shade. It was alright for that one time, but I probably won't visit again.

I don't mind this place but be prepared to wait in line! For a one scoop cone on a cake cone is right around 6 bucks! 6 bucks for a one scoop of ice cream is really starting to push it.. Regarding the ice cream, it's very good. They let you sample which is nice! They have funky flavors but most are very tasty. I had the FrosÃ© on a cake cone, and wow it was like drinking frozen wine! Very very good. Cone was stale however, not that great. They do make their own ice cream cones which I appreciate, they are made right in front of you. I would suggest going for that over the cake cones. I tried the darkest chocolate too which I loved! I would give this a try again and sample some more flavors. It's a cute store but very crowded right now!

Love Jeni's ice cream! They by far have the best non dairy/vegan ice cream in the area - Texas sheets cake. That being said, I personally am not a true fan of the other two flavors that are non-dairy and wish that they would offer more options! You can also order Jeni's on DoorDash and Uber eats which is awesome

Oh Jeni's ice cream I love you so, founded in Columbus, Ohio and several locations across the country. The Charlotte location is in the hip South end neighborhood which is filled with variety of restaurants, shops, Apt's & condos. This is one of the smallest Jeni's I've visited & they have Jeni's standards plus a few limited edition flavors. My Dad enjoyed the summer favorite Strawberry Buttermilk, my Mom milkiest chocolate & me went for a double of Texas Sheet Cake and Darkest Chocolate. Jeni's Ice Cream is always a wonderful treat during my travels don't miss it!

Bangkok Peanut: a seasonal summer flavor of peanut, coconut, and just the slightest bit of heat. It is still sweet like an ice cream and had little flecks of coconut. I loved it. Coffee with Cream & Sugar: hands down the best coffee ice cream I've ever had. The taste makes you feel like you're holding a great cup of dark roast. The cream keeps it balanced from becoming overpowering. Wildberry Lavender: tasted more orange then lavender to me and would pair well with Milkiest Chocolate. Also, the color is gorgeous. The Jeni's Charlotte South End spot is small and lines during opening week can exceed 1 hour. They are open 11am-11pm every day, so be sure to plan your visit. It is absolutely worth the wait!

Everytime I've come there has been a line all the way past Hawkers. Standing there you can overhear people laugh at you for waiting so long just for ice cream. Little do they know that this is the best and most consistent ice cream in Charlotte. I have tried several samples but I always end up ordering some variation of scoops with the Milkiest and Darkest Chocolate. The Milkiest chocolate is simple and delightful and most certainly can be appreciated by all ages. It isn't chalky or malty or fake like some other ice creams. I love to start off with this simple and sweet flavor then have others follow. The Darkest Chocolate it silky smooth and rich. There's so much coco that if they added any more to it they'd have to call it fudge. I noticed it doesn't melt as fast as the Milkiest so I usually have them put it on the bottom of my cone. They make their waffle cones and waffle bowls and with the line moving as fast as it does you can expect it to be fresh. It really adds to the already wonderful ice cream. I love Jeni's. :3
Yummy so good! Love the assortment of flavors. Gluten free here so make sure to order your cup of ice cream without a wafer wedge . Nice staff
