So in love with this place! They have the most interesting ice cream flavors. There's surely one that will please you. My fave is the cherry goat cheese. Sounds strange, right? But oh it works! Customer service is awesome too. They'll give you a sample of whatever you ask for - there's no limit. And they have the cutest little spoons to eat with. I loved them so much, I bought some spoons to take home.

If you're ever wondering where to get the best ice cream in the city, I'd highly recommend stopping by Jeni's before you head back home. Situated right in the middle of Southend, it's surrounded by sprawling restaurants, breweries, and eateries. Why not swing by after lunch or dinner and get some delicious dessert? That's the thought on everyone's mind; you'll always witness a large line no matter what time of day it is (with the night time being the most packed). It's a small little shop right next to Hawkers with minimal seating inside but lots of tables and chairs outside. Even though the lines can get massive at times, it always seems like it's worth the wait! As you get closer and closer to the entrance, you're greeted with a waft of fresh waffle cones being made constantly. The smell is inviting and definitely is a significant part of the experience. Once inside, you're greeted by a scooper and asked to pick and choose what flavors you want to try out and which ones you'll ultimately get. I'd recommend the Frose or the Wildberry Lavendar but I'm sure there's a choice to satisfy anyone's tastes! Once you check out, you can usually find seating outside on their tables or waltz over to the open area of Hawkers and sit there too. I usually like to chat with my friends while people watching, as there are usually lots of pets and little kids running around (making the atmosphere extremely welcoming and family-friendly). Ultimately, with the combination of how delicious Jeni's ice cream is, as well as it's welcoming atmosphere it's a sure winner during the peak summer months as well as any other time you decide to go. It's definitely one of the best experiences you could have, and I'd definitely recommend it to anyone!
Great dairy free and vegan options! Love the half scoops. The line moved quickly and allowed for social distancing . The dairy free flavors were just as good as the dairy

I have never heard of Jeni's ice cream! My niece however from Ohio has frequent hit them in her hometown. So of course she found this place in Charlotte while we were visiting together, and we had to go here after dinner! They were crowded... A very long line outside and inside. But no complaints! It gave us time to chitchat and the lines seem to move along pretty smoothly. I'll try the Wildberry lavender ice cream it was to die for! I loved loved this flavor!! I definitely tasted hints of lavender weaved within the wild berry flavors. I believe it was a mix between a sorbet and yogurt. Everything about this ice cream has me reminiscing about it!! Very nice cool ice cream joint with an assortment of mouth watering flavors.. like Mexican Hot Chocolate, and Skillet Cinnamon Roll! Yum!! I'll have to see if they ship nationwide because that lavender flavor is calling my name!!!

No wonder why there was a line - this place makes delicious ice cream! Had a lemon & blueberry parfait with brambleberry ice cream. A perfect pairing. Love they use compostable spoons and dishes. Would recommend!

Rainbow buttermilk frozen yogurt: super tart, strong sour flavors, pretty overbearing had to fight it with my tastebuds to eat it all, wouldn't recommend if you like sweeter flavors Rocket pop: less sour still was wondering how theyd get the sorbet creamy but I don't think it played out well. wouldn't really recommend it Wild berry lavender: finally something calming and relaxing to the younger much needed was the best in the trio we got and we saved it for last so we could end the night in a happy note instead of sour haha Gooey butter cake: always gonna be my favorite can't go wrong w a sweet cakes ice cream especially with the salty cones Almond brittle: little too sweet for me but a nice second if gooey butter cake isn't available but you want the same vibe The staff is nice and the ice cream is smooth

Ah, Jeni's ... it was hard to buy into all the hype when this upscale, Ohio-based, creamery opened it's first shop in Charlotte's trendy South End. After all, how can a fancy ice-cream shop make any headway in our diet-conscious, calorie-obsessed, fro-yo world? But fear not ... if any ice cream shop is worth all this attention, it's definitely Jeni's. After a couple of recent visits, my kids and I would easily put their flavors among the best we've ever tried. My personal favorite is the fabulous Fluffernutter Pie, with roasted peanut butter and vanilla marshmallow pieces in a creamy masterpiece of a cone. The Gooey Butter Cake is a close second, and my kids can't get enough of the Milkiest Chocolate. Sure, you can pick up Jeni's pints in almost any Harris-Teeter, but nothing beats a visit to one of their 3 Charlotte Scoop Shops on a warm summer evening -- or any time of year for that matter. A creamy and delicious treat that's worth the drive!

Discovering Jeni's has completely changed the ice cream game for me. Every time I've gone to a store or bought a pint from Publix it's as if I've found a new favorite flavor - seasonal and staple flavors, I've never been disappointed. My go to has been to do both Gooey Butter Cake and Brambleberry Crisp together, it never disappoints. I love this location, and while there is always a line down the street, it's always quick and perfect for a sweet treat after visiting one of the restaurants nearby for dinner.

Me and my family stopped by Jenny's Ice Cream the day before Thanksgiving for some desert after we ate lunch at Optimist Hall. Upon arriving we were greeted warmly by the employees who were very patient with us while we were ordering as we couldn't quite make up our minds. This is my wife's favorite ice cream shop and I definitely see why she loves this place. I ordered the cookies-n-cream and I don't know exactly how they make their ice cream but it was well worth it. COVID has made it difficult for me to do reviews since I normally love the experience of going to the actual restaurant and meeting the staff and Jenny's gave me a good since of normalcy. I really enjoyed my time there and the ice cream was very delicious! Definitely made a new fan.
I like the variety of flavors. There are also dairy free options which is great. I like that the dairy free options are not your typical traditonal flavors.

Maybe it was the PreHYPE...but the ice cream was merely OKAY to me. I heard about the 20,30,45 minute waits so my expectations were super high!!! Standing in line at 5:30ish on a Friday was not bad. We started outside about about 10-15 minutes later we were inside and ordering. I will say, the flow of customer service was pretty good. There was alot of employees working(approximately 5-7) and they were all extremely friendly and helpful. I went with the Sun Popped corn, 2 half scoops and afterwards i somewhat regretted it. The ice cream tasted like popcorn and it was good but not to the point like I've heard everyone speaking of. I definitely have a better ice cream spot over this one. The ice cream was good but not to the point of standing in line for more than 10 minutes for. It was nothing special about the flavoring. It was good but no better than any other ice cream spot in Charlotte. The Atlantic Beach Pie ice cream was way better than the popcorn, as well as the Strawberry Buttermilk. The Strawberry Buttermilk was good, minus the sprinkles.

Finally got to visit this place the other night and the line wasn't that long this time, so we parked and walked in and immediately smelled waffle cones and ice cream. There was SO many options to choose from it took a minute to decide but in the end we got some great options . . We went with 1 Brambleberry half scoop and 1 Gooey Butter Cake in a waffle cone and 2 half scoops in a bowl of Gooey Butter Cake and Roasted Peanut Butter & Strawberry Jam (my favorite from our choices) . . Over all my experience was great! Fast service and great ice cream, while I loved our choices I gave it a 4 only because I haven't tried more options but it was an excellent ice cream shop and can't wait to try more!

I'm super picky when it comes to ice cream but Jeni's has my favorite flavor of all time (rainbow). I love the smell of the cake cones when you walk through the door and the fact that they'll let you try a ton of flavors without rolling their eyes. There's always a line out the door but it goes by super fast and it's completely worth the wait. Jeni's in southend is now a staple in Charlotte. If your just visiting you have to try it!

I'm just here for the Brown Butter Almond Brittle, the best thing since sliced bread. After attending a Yelp event where my only regret was not choosing three servings of this ice cream. Needless to say that I found myself here again not long after. Don't be intimidated by the line outside of the door at Jeni's. It's only that way because there isn't much room inside for a line. They should consider getting those line makers that they have at the movie theatre so people aren't outside in the blistering heat. The lines move quick and the staff is very kind and diligent about moving customers down the counter, as there are three identical ice cream stations. I later went on a mission to find the ice cream in stores. Pints were $8 at Publix.

On a hot summer day, Jeni's is the best place to be! We were walking around waiting for a restaurant to open (re opened at 5:000pm) and I stumbled upon Jeni's! From the outside the building is super bright and inviting! When we went in and even from outside it smelled amazing! They make their own waffle cones in house and the flavors of ice cream are so original! The decor inside gives you a fun and light environment and the employees are very helpful in flavor selection! The sample spoons are super cute too! We ended up getting a flight to share, which was three mini scoops and a waffle wedge. We got the wild berry lavender, gooey butter cake, and the strawberry buttermilk. My favorite out of the three was the gooey butter cake! It was SO GOOD! I absolutely loved it. Please do yourself a favor and get here and try as many flavors as you can. Yum!

Who doesn't love ice cream, but this homemade ice cream takes the cake!!! There are so many fun flavors that are different from the usual chocolate and vanilla. I tried the lavender, but ultimately for the blackberry crumble which had berry bites with pieces of crumble scattered throughout. It was light, refreshing with great texture. There were some seats inside but mostly outside on stools and a few tables. I went in the mid afternoon so it was pretty hot and limited shaded seats outside but want to come back to try another flavor!!!
Best. Ice cream. Ever. We made a day out of it and took the light rail here. Loved the trio with three different flavors. I absolutely loved the ooey gooey butter cake!

I'd give 3 stars for the ice creams and 4 stars for the waffle cone. The service only deserves 2 stars. I came in on a nice and sunny Sunday afternoon and I had to wait about 15 minutes to order and the line wasn't even that long. There were only 3 people working. One person is the cashier, one is the waffle cones maker and only one person waiting on the customers. You can imagine how slow the line moved with some of the customers wanted to sample the ice cream and only one person serving! I ordered the coffee and cream, salted peanut butter with chocolate speckled and Lavender. The Lavender is the only flavor that deserves recognition. I think Jeni's ice cream are just like any other ice creams. Their texture and flavors are ordinary.

Oh yes, this place lives up to the hype and I don't even really like ice cream. I was always so intrigued with this place since it was always so busy. We were able to come here on a monday afternoon after lunch time. We didn't wait long at all. They have a great selection of flavors. Very unique and interesting. I tried a few but decided to go with two half scoops in a bowl. I got the honey vanilla and strawberry buttermilk. The honey vanilla is fantastic. Creamy and sweet with a touch of honey. So fresh. The strawberry buttermilk is just as fantastic. You can taste fresh strawberries. The staff was very friendly and sweet and gave cute tidbits about some of the flavors that you sample. The prices really aren't that bad for what you pay for. I highly recommend!

I came here for the Yelp Elite event Sunday evening. They closed the place just for us, and you could feel the tension in the air as the "regular schmegular" people walked up smiling, only to walk away in disgust. Oh well... I don't know if it was the fact that we were excited to try the ice cream, or that I'm sure many of us were having dessert BEFORE dinner! That NEVER happens in my world, but we all descended upon the place at once and the line was out of the door. Unfortunately, the weather did not care that we were standing outside because the rain began to pour down on us and we had to move our party inside. If you know anything about this place, it is small. So it became uncomfortable rather quickly, but as for me, I kept busy talking with a new friend from Florida and trying to narrow down my three top choices. I thought I was being proactive when I went online to look at the flavors and decide then, but the flavors were different. Just like many of the other ice cream shops, you are allowed to taste flavors before making a commitment. I tried the goat cheese with cherries and sweet corn with blackberries. In the end, I decided on the Gooey Butter cake first in the cone, followed by cream puff, and topped with goat cheese with red cherries. {Insert long, deep sigh here!} First of all, the flavors were strategically placed in the cone in a specific order because I had a feeling about that butter cake...everyone raved about it and whatever flavor is at the bottom of the cone, you get to enjoy most. See what I did there?!?! Let me just say that I live in the University City area and I would have zero problems driving over just for ice cream. On that note, go get some, it's totally worth it.

Phenomenal ice cream flavors delight your taste buds!! I decided to live on the wild side, waffle cone with three scoops--one dairy free double chocolate coconut ice cream, two dairy flavors--goey butter cake ice cream with cake bites & salted peanut butter with chocolate ice cream! Salted peanut butter was wonderfully delicious! Imagine your happiest creamy ice cream flavors with buttery notes and rich delicious textures. I loved them all and they're amazing! Truly worth the price and the quality flavors! I parked on the street, pay to park. It was afternoon so the line wasn't long.
Great vegan ice cream options and tastes delicious! Wait can be long during peak hours.

Is a review even needed?!? Everyone knows Jeni's is CRACK IN THE BEST WAY. Their flavors are surprisingly delectable and those waffle cones are so good they make me want to cry. Whoever Jeni is... she is an angel on earth!

If you want to taste the best ice cream in Charlotte, try Jeni's. This is truly my guilty pleasure. I love the smell of the freshly baked waffle cones when you come in, the black and white decor with a splash of orange, and the variety of ice cream options there are to choose from! Fun thing about Jeni's is that you can sample as many flavors as you want, no questions asked! My absolute favorite flavor is the Texas sheet cake. It's surprisingly dairy-free and oh so yummy! No matter what other flavors I try, this one usually makes the cut. I love to get a trio and add two flavors that are not my norm along with Texas sheetcake. Recently over the holidays, they had a whiskey pecan (I think) and a cognac gingerbread... OMG!! The cognac flavor was everything!! I even bought a pint to take home. I hope that they bring that flavor back next year, it was very tasty! In the summertime I am pretty much a regular at Jeni's. I don't see 2020 being any different.

Hands down my all-time favorite ice cream spot! I first came into contact with this slice of nirvana in Nashville & was beyond thrilled when the Charlotte location opened. With a number of innovative flavors like Brambleberry Crisp, Goat Cheese & Cherries, Roxbury Road, Milkiest Chocolate, & Whiskey & Pecans, there's definitely something for everyone. Dairy-free options are also available.

I am more of a simple ice cream type person (vanilla and cookie dough) the ice cream here has different flavors that I wound typically not try but they are always yummy and they let you sample. One negative thing is the lines are always long!

I had a great Saturday in south end. Finally got to visit Jeni's. The aroma is amazing as soon as you walk in the door . The smell is freshly baked ice cream cones. Reminds me of a bakery. There are regular flavors and seasonal flavors. Different serving styles from cake cones to waffle cones to cups and bowls. The staff is extremely friendly and helpful. I love service with a big smile! There's always a crowd of people there. It's a big gathering place because ice cream makes everyone happy

Great ice cream for sure. Worth an hour wait? Ehhhh probably not. The ice cream is tasty and creamy and the cone was fantastic. I got turned on to this brand in FL. They had some wedding cake ice cream that was a special flavor and it was absolutely amazing. But, I have to say that while it is good I can't say it's worth the line they have outside this location. Not their fault but I dinged one star for the line outside.
I will pay just for the smell alone again. Anyhoo the staff was very patient while we slobbered over every flavor and our checkout was fast and easy
It's always nice to find vegan options when an ice cream craving hits! I'll be coming back for sure next time I'm in Charlotte Hopefully more dairy-free options will be available soon!

TLDR: The ice cream is made with ingredients source from Ohio local farms. The flavors are unique yet simple. The waffle cones are made fresh daily--and one can definitely tell the difference. If you want ice cream, consider Jeni's.
Pros: Lots of flavors Fresh tasting Friendly customer service Delish! Cons: Long wait Expensive Overall, not sure its worth it for ice cream. Although it's good, not worth the price or wait.
My experience was awesome I just wasn't used to the different flavors they offered. But if you're into not so conventional flavors this place is perfect!

Great ice cream. I had the goat cheese and cherry ice cream which had a nice sweet and tart flavor to it. Others in my party had the Texas Chocolate Cake ice cream. They didn't even notice it was dairy free and loved it just the same. In fact they didn't believe me when I said the sign said that flavor was dairy free. That's when you know they've got the flavor profile right! There weren't any tables out because of CoVid and parking is limited so plan accordingly. Some people were eating their ice cream on the steps outside the building but not the most comfortable option. We just ate as we walked back to our car. Still fun given their unique flavors!

Kind of pricey but very good. The staff was very knowledgeable about the flavors and explained the ingredients of each one that we tried to us. I ended up trying the eggnog flavor which was very delicious and served with two little cookie like things that were also very tasty. I came about 15 minutes until close with a little line of people and only one employee but the line went pretty fast. Next time I'm in the area I'm excited to come back here and try more flavors. Note: I'm not sure if there is a lot but there is street parking.

The best yet! I have officially found my favorite ice cream spot . Jenis is fairly new to Charlotte i believe maybe going on a month and a half now. Everything about this place i love. The cool set up outside with the bright orange chairs and lights, the fact that they make their waffle cones fresh thats one of the first smells you smell throughout the building. I opted for the Trio flight where you can choose 3 scoops 3 flavors . Flavors i chose was the frose,brown butter almond brittle, and almond coconut . I was a little disappointed because the one flavor i wanted to try they were all out of which was the wild berry lavender. I enjoyed all 3 flavors, the thing about this ice cream to me is its unique flavors, the taste quality, and the ice cream was not overly sweet like most.This is now on my top ranking ice cream spots.

So glad we waited in line for this place! The line kind of took us for surprise. However, we are nearing the end of summer & school will soon resume. This the fleet of teens, babies, & your daddy. Upon getting to the top of the line, the employees were so excited even after getting through the lines. They were encouraging that we taste all the flavors we were interested about. Again: keep in mind the lines were long. They were not pushy at all. My roommates & I opted for the waffle cones you can smell from outside the establishment. It's very sweet. I love sweet but it's definitely sweet. I got a standard ooey gooey butter. I'm still on cloud nine you guys. Then my bf couldn't finish...so I devoured his strawberry buttermilk. Living my best life. All in all, go to Jeni's. No doubt you will find something for you & the family. Enjoy you guys...

We were hesitant to go because I didn't want to be disappointed if it didn't live up to the hype and also because we are devout lovers of Two Scoops. But I'm so glad we finally did!! It was a rainy night, but we were super lucky and found a spot on the street right next to the building. There was a line, but it moved fairly quickly - there were plenty of people working and they didn't rush you, which is awesome because there are lots of really cool flavors to sample. I ended up going with 1 scoop of the Salted Peanut Butter w/ Chocolate Chunks in a FRESH waffle cone and I do mean fresh! I would say that it was the best ice cream/cone combo I might have ever had. The BF got 2 half scoops, one chocolate and one mint choc chip in a waffle cone - he loved both of them. My one scoop was more than enough for me. I hope they open one of these in North Charlotte soon, but in the meantime we're going to look for it in the grocery store!!

My favorite ice cream in town. You can smell the cones from a mile away. A little pricy but it's worth it. I recommend the brambleberry crisp and the brown butter almond brittle. My friend got Millie at chocolate but he didn't think it was a religious experience like I usually do so id skip that one.

I love Jeni's... they are consistent and always so friendly. Their ice cream never disappoints but these waffle cones they have... GIRL! These are fresh made and so good!! Trying the rotating, unique flavors is nice too. I like that they use real spoons for taste testing. I tried a few but landed on peanut butter. Wish I could have Jeni's everyday!
!!!!! Best ice cream ever ! No lie - I thought this place was all hype but after coming here, I'm literally hooked and obsessed.

Love the unique ice cream flavors, they offer flights so you can get a sampling of multiple flavors too. Check out the seasonal offerings as well. Staff is super friendly and knowledgeable of the flavors. They also offer pints (pricey though), water, and apparel items too.

I love, love, love this place! I was first introduced to Jeni's in Columbus, Ohio in 2011 and I've been a fan ever since! It's worth the wait just to get your hands on a unique and tasty treat. My all-time favorite flavor is wild berry lavender -- I asked my husband for this flavor constantly when I was pregnant (eventually he came home with a pint)! My current "obsession" is the Gooey Butter Cake. I seriously CANNOT get enough. Do yourself a favor and get the waffle cone -- you will NOT regret it.

Every time I go to Jeni's the experience is incredibly consistent. The service is always friendly and chipper, the staff behind the counter are ready to give you samples from the second you walk through the door. There are two things that really stand out to me about Jeni's 1) The flavors are so diverse and different from your local ice cream shoppe. If you're in the mood for the regular old lineup, this isn't your spot. It's just so creative. 2) They truly have something for everyone. Gluten Free? Done. Dairy Free? Done. Gluten and Dairy free in one delicious flavor? Done. On top of the excellent product, the shop is cute - I love the neon sign begging you to come in. There is an outdoor patio to enjoy you treat while you people watch as well.

OMG this is some of the richest and decadent ice cream I've ever had. We eyed this place on our way to dinner and we all agreed this would be dessert. On a Monday night there were about 10 ppl in line when we joined. By the time we sat down with our Standard cup (2 1/2 scoops), I chose gooey butter cake and darkest chocolate and my friend got P&J and chocolate cake. Both were deliciously served in a waffle bowl that was cooked in an old fashion waffle iron in front of us. Prices are very reasonable ($6 for 2 1/2 scoops and a waffle bowl). Can't wait to go again and try the flight of ice creams

Trendy, delicious, friendly, & unique. That's it. That's the review. Seriously. The hype is real when it comes to Jeni's. Love the South End vibe & wanted ice cream after lunch & of course Jeni's is the place to be. It's usually packed but went around 3ish on a Monday and it wasn't busy as it usually is. I strolled in, no tasting of flavors no sitting inside, but you can ask the friendly worker what flavors they recommend. I went with Brambleberry, Ooey Gooey butter cake, & Almond brittle. If I didn't have lunch I would've gotten more flavors to be honest. Lol. The flavors she offers are unique and delicious. I have nothing negative to say about this place. I always want to buy her ice cream in the store, but it's so expensive, but I guess you gotta pay for quality! I recommend you try Jeni's either in store or at one of her many locations.

Really yummy ice cream with a high price tag. Not as expensive as some of the gelato places... But I got two kiddie scoops and 1 small and it was $15... The flavors are very interesting and it's very creamy. Cool spot to have ice cream at. It's in a great location however weekend parking may be tough. We found parking easily during the week, early afternoon. The confetti heart mural is behind the ice cream shop... fun spot for pictures with your cone!
No no and no I don't get the hype the ice cream wasn't all that and they can keep that digging into the buckets arm deep and handing that to me to eat. It's just a no.

The ice cream is very rich and decadent, one little scoop definitely goes a long way for rich flavor ! This was my first time visiting , and I'm guessing because of Covid , the lack of customer service was thrown out the many glass windows ? I received no guidance on flavors, sizes, nothing . Normally my reviews are detailed but I'm going to keep it casual , if you love ice cream , this is a place to definitely try because it's different. However , I'm not too keen on the gourmet flavor profiles , nor are my kids. Did we enjoy what we had yes, did we wish we got a larger portion no. I feel like it leaned more on the savory , heavy, creamy side than a nice balance of sweet and creamy . Pictured is an orange sherbet blend? I honestly don't know for sure , I felt rushed ... an almond cream and a butter cake ? They both tasted exactly the same, one just had nuts the other cake . Maybe my taste buds were a little off from my indulgences at Hawkers , but I'm not part of the fan wave for this spot .
It's the best ice cream in the world. A million new and interesting flavors, and all are 10/10!

Jeni's has got it going on! What a delightful little ice cream shop/creamery with flavors you've never tried before, as well as the classics. They have options for a trio of flavors or a flight of ten flavors to make an entire experience out of your visit. I debated for so long but finally decided to try my favorite ice cream flavor. If this place is really the best, I figured I'd have to get my go-to to see how it compared. I certainly was not disappointed. The mint chocolate chip was dreamy and the homemade, buttery waffle cone with a hint of salt took my late night treat to the next level. I also got to try my friends' flavors, where the wildberry lavender stood out as something I had truly never tasted before. There are tables outside to sit if it's not too busy and you can find a spot. Save room at dinner so you can taste lots of flavors here. Worth going out of your way for!

This is such a wonderful little ice cream spot! The staff is so friendly and patient. But the ice cream...oh my! They have every flavor of ice cream that you can possibly imagine, and more! Their ice cream is everything that good ice cream should be, with it's fun flavors and wonderfully creamy texture. And don't forget the waffle cones...you definitely want the waffle cone; they are ridiculously good! They have plenty of outdoor seating for you to grab a seat and enjoy your treats. After trying this delightful little ice cream shop, I can definitely say that I will be back many many times!

This is one of my favorite ice cream spot in Charlotte.. they have all type of flavors and including gluten free ice cream as well. It's located on south blvd near down town. Sometimes the line can be very long but trust me they will move pretty fast.
Delicious ice creams with lots of unique flavors and lots of choices. I've never had a Jeni's ice cream I didn't like!

Jeni's never disappoints. This South End scoops shop is a true tastebud experience. The special thing about this place is the cool flavors. While you can order vanilla and chocolate (I can vouch. It's really good!). You really come here to try the cool ones like cherries and goat cheese or Texas sheet cake. My personal favorite is the brambleberry crisp, but the menu is always changing with seasonal flavors so I love trying something new every time. The inside of the store harkens you back to a "modernized" old fashioned ice cream parlor, with all the staff wearing aprons. The staff is super nice, and they let you try as many flavors as you want. You even get to taste on real metal spoons, which is a lot of fun! They thoroughly describe the flavors, and make you feel like you're the only one in the store even though the line wraps outside the door for about 15 minutes. It's definitely a 'treat yo self' kinda place because the ice cream is rich, and is justified by the price. Overall, a can't miss experience if you're in the area!

Delicious ice cream but expensive! They have a good selection of dairy-free and vegan options. Unfortunately, they are pretty expensive for an ice cream parlor. I paid $12 for a pint to go. I think that's a bit much considering Ben & Jerry's also makes a vegan selection for under half of that price.

Best Ice cream that has ever graced my tastebuds!!!! My favorite is Almond Butter Brittle and Goey Butter Cake!!! Try it!!! Even if the line is long, it's worth it!!!.. Oh and they do offer Vegan flavors that my vegan friends LOVE!!
The line was semi-long so we knew it had to be good, and it definitely was. The shop smells like fresh waffles, and the staff were extremely nice. Brambleberry crisp was my favorite.

What a bright addition to Southend! I've been wanting to get to Jeni's since it's opening this summer. We decided to stop by to warm up date night and I'm really glad we did! The store was super inviting, with friendly staff ready to help. There was someone making waffle cones that I knew I had to try and another person describing the many samples to us. We decided to share the trio sampler ($6). My favorite hands down was the Brown Butter Almond Brittle. My goodness! It was delicious. We went with the Goat Cheese and Red Cherries was a close second for me and then the Brambleberry, also yummy. The trio came with the piece of the waffle cone I wanted so badly. The salt in the cone wasn't quite what I was looking for, but it was good.

Long lines can be deceitful but these ice creams are all worth the wait, even in the heat. Great place to grab some tasty treats. The almond brittle and froze are divine. But you honestly cannot go wrong with whatever flavor you choose.

What a fun ice cream place! But be warned: this place gets SUPER BUSY on a weekend evening, so be prepared to stand in line for a very long time. We probably waited in line for over half and hour. But they have a very wide selection of unique flavors, and the quality of the ice cream itself is quite good. There is minimal seating inside, and only a little outside. But there's a wide open "courtyard" right next to it so standing around or on some steps is a good option.

I have been here two times since it opened. Both times I have gone at lucky times and only had to wait maybe 5-10 minutes in line to get the sweet nectar of life, aka jeni's ice cream! Take as many samples as you can handle, and if you cannot decide, go with the trio (3 half scoops of your choice and a waffle cone triangle)! The outside space is not shaded too much if you go on a hot day, but there are stairs to sit on, a bar style seating row and some tables outside of the shop. If possible, walk or scooter over as parking is scarce on the street and surrounding lots. Definately recommend going to jeni's at least once to give it a try!

The smell of fresh waffle cones being made hits your nose as soon as you walk in and it feels like I'm home! I'm so happy that there's so many in Charlotte now! There's a wide variety of ice cream to pick from and if you can't commit or you're indecisive, then no worries, you can sample the flavors before you get them. I'd recommend getting the two half scoops, which seem like two big scoops and definitely get the waffle crisp! It's soooo good; they're never stale and always crunchy with a hint of saltiness. The only sad thing was that they were out of the waffle crisps when we went, but the cream puff and green mint chip was a good combo!

My family and I went to Jeni's after dinner at a neighboring restaurant. Overall, I liked the ice cream, flavor options included both commonly known flavors and some unique flavors too. My three star rating was a result of the employee that "helped" my family. She was more concerned with yelling at customers to "keep the door closed". The line was out the door and it was a hot day so the door left open made it a little stuffy in the shop. I understand why she was doing it but she was distracted and unconcerned of helping my family.
I love Jeni's so much. I always have a hard time figuring out what favor to get because everything is so good.

SOCIAL DISTANCING EDITION: This is one of the few places I feel I don't have to review! Jeni's amazing ice cream speaks for itself! This was my first time visiting Jeni's since the recent changes due to social distancing. They've adjusted, as necessary and I'm quite pleased with the steps they've taken! When you arrive at Jeni's you're prompted to wait in line outside of the establishment. There weren't many people staying 6 feet between each other in line but I don't believe that is something they can necessarily control. There are menus posted outside of the store so you can see what's available and make a decision before you arrive inside. They only allow one party in the store at a time. When you arrive you order and pay for you ice cream as soon as you walk in and then they have a waiting area on the other side where you grab your ice cream. The process was quick and I was in and out within 5 minutes. All of the associates were wearing masks and they have hand sanitizer available for you at the pick up station. I believe their menu is limited (or it may have changed) as my go-to flavor wasn't available. This time I went with the darkest chocolate ice cream and it was incredibly rich! Jeni's has a myriad of flavors and they're all so rich and creative. If you're looking to grab a scoop in a safe and clean environment I recommend going by Jeni's!

We kept passing by Jeni's when in the area and wanted to give them a try, and finally did one evening after a meal at Barcelona. If you go during prime time, there will be a line, but it moves pretty fast. Jeni's has a simple menu, with one scoop, two half scoops, or three half scoops. They don't offer sundaes, hence the reason why the line moves pretty fast. A butter waffle cone or bowl is $1.25 extra. GET ONE OF THESE. They have a lot of ice cream flavors, some more unique than others, and they even have few dairy-free varieties. I got the "standard" in a waffle bowl with two half scoops of coffee with cream and sugar, and darkest chocolate. The half scoops were more like full scoops, in my opinion. Both were good, but the chocolate somewhat edged out the coffee. But oh my, the waffle bowl was the best I've ever had. They really do put butter in it, and you can taste the difference. My husband had the triple with three half scoops of milkiest milk chocolate, salted caramel, and dark chocolate truffle. Again, they were all good, but the milkiest chocolate was his favorite. We'll definitely return!

Do yourself a favor, and go to Jeni's!!! I had only been to Jeni's in D.C., and I was so excited to see one when I visited Charlotte. They always have a fun variety of flavors, and they offer a couple dairy free options as well. I'm not usually dairy free, but I ordered the dairy free Texas sheet cake because it looked delicious, and I am so glad I did!! If you like chocolate (with a hint of coconut from the dairy free alternative), you'll love it! I also ordered the salted peanut butter, which was a little sweet for my liking, but still tasty! Highly recommend a visit to Jeni's!!

This is a great location to get your fix that only craft ice cream can provide. The staff is super friendly and helpful, the place is clean, and the outdoor seating is quite convenient (and plentiful). I've only tried one flavor so far (Darkest Chocolate) and I'm hooked! The waffle cone is delicious and didn't taste overly sweet which is a win-win! Looking forward to checking out more of their flavors. They all sound so good!
Amazing ice cream and the waffle cones are the best! The ice cream was so creamy and delicious.

am totally in love with Jeni's Ice Cream. My absolute fav is the Sweet Potato with Torched Marshmallows. This is one of the fall seasonal flavors. This is the first location in the Queen City. There is always a line of some sort at this location. So expect a wait. During my most recent visit it was during COVID-19. I was very happy they were open and that they allowed you inside the building. I feel like half the experience is watching them make the waffle cones and smelling the delicious smell of the cones. Pre Covid you could sample any of the flavors now you can't sample any flavors. While I totally understand and comply with their decision, I did end up with a flavor I probably wouldn't have if I had sampled it. The other sad thing about this visit was that they gave us that flavor in both our cones when it was only suppose to be in the one cone. So we didn't know we were missing the flavor we wanted til we were gone and halfway finished with the cone. Lastly I didn't think anything of it but I noticed my total was higher than normal. With trying to maintain social distance and not screwing up their new way of servicing customer I didn't question the price. Afterwards I noticed my text receipt and we were charged extra for waffle cones. The issue is we didn't want waffle cones. We both prefer the dish of ice cream with the waffle crisp on the side. We were so hot that day and happy to have gourmet ice cream that we didn't even blink when we saw the cones. But the cashier just rang us up for them. With all that being said just be very mindful while ordering. Know that you will enjoy the flavor you are picking and make sure y I clearly state how you want your ice cream served. Jeni Splendid Ice Cream 1920 Camden Rd Charlotte, NC 28203 Saturday July 11, 2020 3pm

This is an amazing ice cream place, as the long lines on warm evenings will attest. It's worth the wait. They have quite a variety of unique flavors. The ice cream is incredibly rich and creamy. I tried a "gooey butter cake" flavor, which was delicious with a ton of real butter flavors. Great place for a special treat, and only steps away from the Lynx light rail.

Was super psyched to try the brick and mortar Jeni's after binging on the ooey gooey butter cake ice cream on my couch many a night and it didn't disappoint! Y'all know I am the FLIGHT QUEEN because sampling all the things is the way. I opted for the trio which was perfect in size - I chose the brambleberry crisp (this ended up being my favorite!), the Boston cream pie, and the pumpkin cake roll. I love how it's served with a delicious, fresh waffle cone piece. I was scooping ice cream onto the crispy deliciousness. That totally made it! They have a lot of dairy free options which is great!

A great ice cream recommendation I was given! I had seen/heard of Jeni's before but never got around to trying it. I am very happy I finally did so! They have a decently wide selection of flavors, at least 1/3 of which are unique and I have never seen/heard of. They provide options where you basically get flights of ice cream, which is super great to share amongst friends and/or family! One option is the trio where you can choose up to 3 flavors of your choosing whereas the other option is literally a flight of 10 of their most popular flavors (substitution allowed). If you're a huge ice cream fan and want to try basically all their flavors, you won't go wrong with the flight of 10. When I went they had 13 flavors available... That being said, with the flight, you'd basically be tasting all their flavors! My personal favorite were probably the Lavender and Whiskey Butter Pecan. The Lavender flavor wasn't overwhelmingly aromatic, which I really appreciated. The lavender flavor was probably more on the subtle side, which was very well complemented by another, almost citric-like flavor that overall made the tasting experience unique and phenomenal. The Whiskey Butter Pecan tasted exactly as it sounds. The alcoholic kick wasn't overbearing at all; to me, it really brought forward the butter pecan flavor. The quality of the ice cream resounded Artisan in my head with eat mouthful. You can definitely taste the difference between their ice cream and for example, store bought ice cream (a blasphemous comparison, I know). They even describe their ice cream production standards on their napkins, which I think is very creative. If you haven't tried them already and are in town, definitely do try to make a stop to try the ice cream here!

Delicious ice cream worth the wait in line. Freshly made waffle cones and serving sizes are just right. Great flavor options. Was happy to find I can purchase pints in my local Whole Foods here in Massachusetts.

Went here with the girlies for the first time on sunday to help Sarah get over her cheating ex and it was such a good idea. Some of the best ice cream that we have ever had. Might need to make this a weekly thing and come every sunday! Only suggestion is that milkshakes should be an option.
It's ice cream, it's in my mouth, money is out of my wallet, and I am happy. Rich flavors, high in fat and sugar. Part of your balanced diet, go get some.

I came here last night for my birthday since they are my favorite ice cream spot in Charlotte! They are a ton of different flavors to chose from! The best part is that you can get a flight of 3 different scoops, or even more so you can get a little bit of a few of your favorite flavors. I got the cream puff, bramble berry, and goat cheese with cherries. They were all delicious! The staff is super friendly and knowledgeable about each flavor as they will allow you to sample as many as you'd like! If you go on your birthday, your ice cream is free too! Sometimes they get crowded and have a long line, but it is worth every second to wait! They have fresh made waffle cones as well that smell and taste delicious! I cannot wait to go back.

Jeni's in south end is a MUST to end the night. It's my go-to dessert stop when I'm around the town. What I enjoy about Jeni's is that is they have dairy-free options for people like me . There's time where they have more options than other times, but the Texas Sheet Cake is always an option! It's chocolatey, delicious, smooth and has cake chunks inside. SO GOOD! The Local Scoop is my other ice cream shop in Charlotte with dairy-free flavors I can enjoy, but after giving Jeni's a few shots, I think this one one my heart over. Despite the long line, it goes by fast and gives you time to think what flavor you want to taste. Yes, they let you taste the flavors before you order since some of the flavors are out the of the usually, especially like Goat Cheese and Cream Puff. Jeni's has two other locations as well, and also have pints available in stores. That shows how good it is. I think the price of ice cream is pretty high, but it's worth it.

Legitimately the best icecream I've had in my life. The sun popped corn flavor was unimaginably delicious; the buttery notes with the touch of salt and the sweet was the absolute perfect balance. I adored the black current and lavender one as well; it was bodaciously bursting with sweet and tangy berry notes with a floral background from the lavender. The creativity with the flavors are astounding! I would have sampled them all if I could have! Even the little waffle cone chip that garnished my bowl was to die for. Seriously, give this place a try if you're ever in the area. You will not be disappointed-I sweat to that.
Too many fake ingredients and too sweet. Certainly over hyped. Many other great ice creameries in Charlotte with better ingredients

Jeni's is just what Charlotte needed. It's in South End of Charlotte which is such a great location as there are many locals and is a popular area of Charlotte. The ice cream is absolutely creamy and smooth, refreshing, flavorful and truly splendid. There are soo many to choose from and the flavors are unique as well. Very much different from other ice cream places in Charlotte. Jeni's is pricey, but you pay for the quality and I think it's definitely worth the price. The waffle cones are amazing and they're freshly made. My favorite flavor is the Brambleberry Crisp- you have to try this, especially if you love berries. Definitely try Jeni's if you're in the area and looking for a cold/sweet treat.

When we got there we waited out front of Jeni's, only getting the incredible wiffs of ice cream and waffle cone when the door opened. Finally, we headed in and were able to try a sample of any ice cream we wanted, and as many as we wanted! I tried a ton, in which every single worker had information on how it was made, how it tastes, etc. It was so fun hearing about each one and knowing what to look for when trying the samples. I ultimately settled on Salted Peanut Butter with Chocolate Flecks, and Milkiest Chocolate on a waffle cone. It was a great combo! Each flavor was so rich and tasteful, and the waffle cone broke apart wonderfully (not too messy) and tasted great! Jeni's has options for everyone to try! With their excellent customer service, and amazing tasting flavor I'm sure to be back! I dare you to try and walk past, take a wiff, and not give them a try. So good!

After visiting south end Jeni's lives up to the hype. They let you sample as many flavors as you like till you make a decision. I had the brambleberry I thought it was delicious. There flavors change seasonally. Next time I suggest trying the butter cake!

Just do yourself a favor and head to Jeni's when you're craving something sweet. I love this location but be prepared for a line! My personal favorite flavors are Cream Puff and Cold Brew with Coconut Cream (dairy free!).

Didn't realize why the line was coming out the door on a Sunday late night, but now I know why! This place has crazy flavors.. unfortunately, the two flavors we wanted, Milk choc and the gooey butter cake were out, so we went with the Almond brittle and dark choc. Both were good. For Almond haters like me, it tasted less nutty and more toffee like, which I'm a fan off! Reasonably priced as well, about 10 bucks for 2 orders (1 scoop each, in a bowl). The line was really long, and so they had someone come out to take orders from customers who already knew what they wanted, which made things faster. Nice patio outside to eat and munch on some ice cream as well.

So, I hadn't ventured back to Jeni's since our Yelp preview event, because I knew how crazy busy it was gonna be! Luckily, I took my lunch break last week & took the light rail down to the shop. So convenient to get off the East West stop & a short walk! There was a small group in line, but thankfully, they had two servers & I was able to place my order quickly. It was a nice, sunny day, so I ate my cone on the way back to the train stop! Friendly servers, amazing flavors. Love the pint to go cooler & bags to purchase, so you can take those pints with you. Shop is small, but so cheery & inviting. Parking is bad, so keep that in mind.

I don't get the hype. Came in after walking by a few other places Bc people rave about this ice cream. My gf had a chocolate cone and I had the berry crumble something or other. She didn't even finish hers, and mine was good but not great...And $13 for 2 single scoops of ice cream? Thanks, but no.

Terrible, won't be back. Huge line, for I'm not sure what the hype it about. Every sample sucked. I ended up getting the cake ice cream. I couldn't get past the clumps of cake though. My friend didn't really enjoy hers either.

You know you are having a real good ice cream when you are able taste the milk in it! This is one of those places where you can taste some of the great ice creams in Charlotte! They have a ton of flavors to choose from. If you are going to try out a new flavor, make sure you ask for a sample. I initially wanted to try the wild berry lavender due to the dark purple color but didn't like the strong aroma of a spice in it. I ended up with Roasted Almonds with Brittles which I ended up loving. The lines are huge but the service is quick. If you don't mind waiting a couple of minutes you are in for a great dessert. In fact I ponder over how many people who dine at the great restaurants near by would have dessert at their restaurant rather than having an awesome milky ice cream at Jeni's. Definitely worth checking it out.

I've had Jeni's in DC before and honestly I could have tried new flavors but I went with old faithful: brown butter almond brittle and gooey butter cake. I noticed the single scoop is the same price as the two half scoop ice cream, But I feel like you get more ice cream with the single scoop. Let's see if I can resist getting two flavors next time and test this hypothesis.... Aside from that, the location is prime. TONS of space for hanging out in the south end with outdoor tables and a big patio. This is one of the coolest vintage ice cream places I've been to.

Long lines. Long lines mean something. And for Jeni's it's always a good thing. You might have seen the owner taste ice creams on YouTube and accurately name out which one was more expensive, or you had Jeni's in a different city. No matter how you know this brand, let me tell you, this place keeps its quality and I'm glad that it's landed in Charlotte. I've originally ate Jeni's in Nashville and it was a repeatable place that we went to when we visited Nashville. Yes, I'm not a sweet tooth, but the SO is. So, it is what it is. I can talk though that my experience here was pretty close if not the same that I had with Nashville. The differences between the location here was that it's outside. Yeah, Jeni's here is pretty much a little small pop up store right in the middle of the courtyard. So when you're waiting during the summer you're pretty going to be baking outside but it's pretty nice considering you're with other people: kids, dogs, families, etc. Jeni's has different flavors, and they are all good. I would recommend to get a smaller size, as the amount can be overwhelming if you have too much. Remember, I'm not a sweet tooth, so if you are then I guess go crazy? The flavors of the ice cream changes every time that we go to one, so to be honest there's not really anything I can suggest in case it might be something different the time of your visit. Jeni's worth the wait in the lines and once you're inside: TEST EVERYTHING. Believe me, they won't mind and they want you to choose the best possible option for your palette. And the waffle crisps are amazing if you don't want the cone (because it's gets pretty messy if you don't devour it quickly).
Amazing ice cream! One of the best in downtown Charlotte! Service was quick and fast even though the line is always usually busy!

Been to jeni's a couple more times over the last 2 months, to the park road and the South Boulevard location. Both experiences were great and the employees were especially friendly, specifically tonight at the South Boulevard location. The one guy who helped me made great recommendations for me and my friends so we could find what we wanted.
Do I have to go at 9am to get gooey butter cake? Why always sold out? Cream puff is good choice

I'm pretty sure this is the most amazing ice cream in the whole world. I had it before in Nashville and was thrilled when I heard we would be getting one in Charlotte! This location did not disappoint. It's located in a busy area off Camden Road in South End and always seems to be busy. That being said, the line moves quickly as the people behind the counter are efficient and eager to help. They are actually some of the kindest people I've ever met in customer service.. it must be all the ice cream they get to try! The flavors at Jeni's are out of this world! The peanut butter with chocolate flakes is killer as is the goat cheese and cherry. You also can't go wrong with the brown butter brittle or the bramble berry crisp. Honestly, you can't go wrong at all other than not getting anything. I also recommend getting it in a waffle cone which are made fresh right in front of you. There's nothing quite like it!

This is a late review. When you find yourself in the Southend of Charlotte and are in need of an ice cream fix well....... you can't go wrong with Jeni's. Generally, the ice cream flavors are good but in my opinion they are not exceptional. Additionally, don't be in a rush because on sunny days the line is long and it moves at a snail's pace. Honestly, this location needs to take a page out of the Chick-fil-A handbook and learn how to properly move a line. It would go a long way in improving the customer experience.

Great ice cream as usual! They even had someone in the line taking orders if you knew what you wanted ahead of time (which we didn't) but it is still great to see an express option because of how long the lines usually get. Jeni's is also VERY allergy friendly. My wife had a lot of food allergies but every time we go by they are still always able to accommodate and make her feel important. Check out Jeni's if you are coming through Charlotte! Awesome location and great place to visit in the summertime.
Tons of interesting flavors made with top quality ingredients. They encourage tasting as many as different flavors before you decide. Love this place!

This is some top quality Ice Cream! The flavors and ingredients are so different yet something for everyone, and you can just tell the ingredients are fresh. I tried the FrosÃ© and the Lavender berry something - I cant remember. But both were AMAZING! Depending on the time you go, there can be a long line but we only waiting about 8 min.

If you're looking for some funky and unique flavors, Jeni's is the place to go! While it's on the pricer side, the ingredients are great quality! If you're indecisive (like myself), the three half scoop option is the way to go. My favorites - goat cheese and cherry and the brambleberry crisp. A seasonal one I had at an Ohio location was popcorn flavored. If they ever make it again and serve it in Charlotte, worth at least a taster. Be prepared to wait in line no matter the weather! There's usually a line out there door. Despite the crowds, all the workers always have a smile on their face, are happy to give samples and answer questions. You won't leave without a smile on your face!

Jeni's is always delish! It's a little more upscale than your traditional ice cream spot, making it a great way to end date night or dinner with friends. The atmosphere is great and I like the decor. I love the unique flavors and I always try something new when I go. It's not the spot for someone who is picky or likes their ice cream plain, but it's great if you don't mind being a little bit adventurous.

This is probably my favorite ice cream shop in Charlotte! awesome unique flavors and really helpful staff. Retro vibe but not terribly overpriced. I just hate the line every time, wish they would staff according to the demand. I would definitely check it out if you're in the area. I mean ice cream flights.... how could it be bad

Super excited to try this place out! Their ice creams look great! So excited for this location. I'll update my review after they open to the public Update: 7-30-18 I came here over the weekend with my fiancÃ©. We really enjoyed the goat cheese and cherry. Our only issue was the the stools are too short for the outside bar. Makes for a really uncomfortable sitting experience. I can't wait to try some more flavors. It is also in a great location. But don't forget about the old timey Pikes Soda Shop!
Even just the smell of Jeni's confirms it's gonna be good! Delicious ice cream and great job with touchless transaction. YUM

Very much craft ice cream with some very unique flavors. I enjoyed it, but there is a lot going on, maybe too much in the flavors. Biggest pros were the fresh waffle cones (although they were very buttery) and the very friendly employees who had a well prepared statement about each flavor and made them all sound delicious. Biggest cons were, well the ice cream itself. Some of the flavors kind of gave me a food truck "we are trying really hard to be extremely unique" kind of vibe. Bangkok peanut ice cream is actually very spicy with a strong cayenne flavor. The sweet corn with blackberry tasted exactly how it sounds. I am definitely a fan of the brown butter almond brittle but a whole scoop of it is just too much. All in all, I would go back but I wouldn't seek it out or go out of my way, I certainly wouldn't wait in a line for 30 minutes again.

I. Love. Jeni's. I went to school at Ohio State, so I was incredibly excited when I heard Jeni's was coming to Charlotte. I love a lot of their flavors. Goat cheese and cherries and brambleberry crisp are both great. I love that they let you sample as many flavors as you want (although this does add to the long line). I love that they use metal sample spoons. I tried the frosÃ© this time and it was amazing. I think it's my favorite flavor I've had there. The fruit flavors really come through. Their waffle cones are homemade right in the shop and they are to die for. If you haven't tried Jeni's yet, I suggest that you fix that immediately. It's definitely worth the long line!

No such thing as a bad choice at Jeni's. I got one scoop of FroÅ›e Sorbet and my boyfriend got one scoop of Brambleberry Crisp. Both are very delicious. Absolutely nothing negative to report about this place! Go check it out.

I'm a fan of Jeni's, but I'm only giving them 4 stars because the hype gets old. Yes, the flavors are unique, but the line is forever long and at $5 a cone, you lose a star by default. The location is great for the walkable SouthEnd, but if you're venturing from afar, be prepared to hunt or stalk a parking space. Adjacent metered spots are free on the weekends. The ice cream is delicious. Lines consistently linger well down the block, but move fairly quickly. The menu is posted on the door for those that don't have the 20/20 vision to see the marquee menu from the line. Glancing at the menu from the door is still ample time to make a decision, so don't be the one to get up to the front and not know what you want. That's just a douche move. If you're unsure, at least have it narrowed to a top three. They will let you try samples in order to make your final decision. Ice cream flights are also apparently a thing these days. If you really cannot decide, grab a flight of 3 or 5. A flight is also a good way to make your ice cream "family style." Inside seating is limited via barstools. A few bar seats are available outside, as well as a few outdoor tables. Many like to sit on the nearby steps leading up to Hawker's as well. Jeni's is blowing up. You can also hit them up in NoDa, and soon they will join the Park Road Shopping Center. I Gooey Butter Cake for the win, BTW. Ice cream is also free on your birthday, though they do not heavily market this.

We waited in line for about half an hour - likely because everyone inside is taste testing all their flavors. It's new so that's to be expected. Since Publix sells their pints now I had a general idea of what to expect. I knew I wanted to try a flavor that wasn't available at the grocery store. I ended up with cream puff and in order to let the people behind me get their flavors faster I didn't try any other flavor. I got it in a cup because I was quite full from dinner at copper and I think a waffle cone would have really pushed me over the edge. The flavor was super light and fresh. The one scoop was perfect for me since I was pretty full. We sat outside and people watched. Pretty legit evening. The servers were nice and accommodating. They also sell boxed water and I was super thirsty so bought that. They sell pints there for $12. Would not recommend buying a pint there if the flavor is available at Publix because the pints at Publix are only $8.

Yum yum! I loved the feel of the store and the flavors are unique and fun. Reason for four instead of five stars are the kids cones were fairly small for $4.25. This is definitely a spot for a special treat.
Jeni's oh jeni's !! This place is to die for! Even if you don't like sweets, you'll still fall in love with this place! The ice cream is so creamy and rich ! Full of flavor!

Treat yo self! This is the best ice cream I've ever had. I'm straight up addicted to brambleberry. It tastes like blackberry pie and ice cream wrapped into one. I get this flavor at the grocery store too, as it's carried at Whole Foods and Publix in Charlotte. I tried the peppermint ice cream which is a seasonal flavor, and it's good just not my favorite. There is no bathroom in Jeni's, but there is a public bathroom just down the stairs next to a doughnut shop. There's a water fountain in the bathroom area to fill up reusable water bottles as well. Parking is limited, and in the warmer months there is always a long line to even get to the door of Jeni's. I'd say it's worth the wait though for their awesome flavors and freshly made waffle cones/bowls. Check them out!

The line outside is an indicator of the splendidness that awaits you on the inside. Everything you and your grandmama can think of is a flavor here. From Brambleberry to Texas Sheet Cake, to Cold Brew Coffee. Jeni's has you covered. What's better, you can get half scoops to try multiple flavors, if you're like me and want ONE OF EACH. (Someday, someday.) Today I tried the Blueberry Lavender (so so good!), the Biscuits and Peach Jam (so so so so good!!), and the Goat Cheese and Cherry (mmm drool, so so so good!!!). I'll definitely be back. Jeni's is the best ice cream in town!!

Jeni's has delicious ice cream, don't get me wrong. Jeni's is an adorable ice cream shop offering a variety of ice cream flavors and fresh waffle cones (possibly the best waffle cone I've ever had). The shop is small, and you'll likely wait in a very long line that may or may not move quickly. They offer really unique flavors, which is one thing I really love. I'd had the frose, salted peanut butter and chocolate, and the wildberry lavender -- all three were delicious. One time, the scoop I got was SO big that it was too heavy for the cone and broke the cone. I got a bowl and ended up making a cone / ice cream mashup and I didn't hate it :-). Jeni's is kind of expensive, so beware. It's delicious and I recommend trying it!

After Hawkers, Jeni's just draws you in. Friendly team members help you with the amazing, different flavors. We had the Brambleberry Crisp and the Brown Butter Almond Brittle in a waffle cone. HOLY MOLEY!!! The waffle cone was sweeet and not the mass production ones from other places. Flavors were different and better than the "boring" normal flavors i.e. vanilla, chocolate. They didn't even have my go to......Cookies and Cream. Didn't need it. Yum! Jeni's we'll see you soon!

Thank you for coming to CLT! I moved here from Columbus, OH, 3 years ago and Jeni's is one of the absolute favorite things I've missed the most! So glad to have Goat Cheese and Red Cherries back in my life!

Not every ice cream is worth a 45 minute wait on a warm Saturday evening in June. Jeni's is the exception. Let me note that we started out fans of Jeni's from our frequent visits to Columbus (birthplace of Jeni's), so we already knew the quality was real. When the shop opened here, it became an instant "must go" and did not disappoint. They're always very good at allowing taste tests, which I highly encourage; some flavors are not what you expect, which is how the lavender has become a favorite. I think, in truth, most of the flavors are my favorites. My husband is dedicated to the chocolates but last time found Atlantic Beach - the lemon ice cream with bits of saltines that is new this summer - and thought that was surprisingly fantastic. Take your time, taste things, enjoy it. Jeni's is much better as an occasional indulgence, in my opinion, and thus not to be rushed. And you deserve it.

There was a line to get ice cream but I can understand why. The smell alone was so appetizing, I went with the dairy free options. Cold brew with coconut cream and Texas sheet cake on a sugar cone. The cold brew was my favorite but gosh it was delicious!

Finally got around to checking this place out after all of the hype and let me tell you, it did not disappoint one bit! When we got here there wasn't too long of a wait so decided to try to it out. I went with the two half scoops for five dollars on a waffle cone and it was amazing! The brambleberry crisp & gooey butter cake was SO GOOD! Definitely can't wait to go back and try more flavors! Love a place that lives up to the hype and makes waiting in a line worth it. Service was speedy but friendly. Five stars for sure!

Before going I assumed this place would be overrated, but I was so wrong. It's a great mix of classic and inventive flavors. I'm not a goat cheese fan but I have gotten the goat cheese with red cherries several times! Also do not sleep on the waffle cones - SO worth it. The line looks crazy long most days, but moves fast. Jeni's re-sparked my love of ice cream and continues to change the game while still perfecting classics.

I love Jeni's! Every single visit the staff have been so kind and accommodating. They explain every ingredient and let you sample as many as you like. Live tried so many flavors. My favorites hands down are brambleberry and sweet cream. I literally can't get enough. I am so glad we have this place in Charlotte. Gimme all the ice cream. Please and thanks!

OMG! What a great spread of flavors! My friends and I stopped here after a birthday dinner in the area. Everyone else had been here already except a few of us. The unanimous decision was: GOOEY BUTTER CAKE ICE CREAM So flavorful. It has a caramel type flavor with pieces of cake inside. I paired this with the Brandied Banana BrÃ»lÃ©e for the other half scoop. What a great match! I will definitely be back for a cool treat!

I've always wanted to try Jeni's out and I'm so glad I was able to! The flavors that they offer are so unique and artisanal and they had a good amount of choices for dairy free, which is extremely important since 40 million Americans are lactose intolerant! My only complaint is that it's a bit pricey, but if you're going out to eat ice cream at an establishment that makes it fresh in house and has such unique flavors you can't ~really~ complain.
BEST ICE CREAM OF ALL TIME!! the salted peanut butter is the best flavor and the waffle cones are fantastic!
Great selection of ice cream. The wait was a bit too long to get the the front of the line. The price is on the high side.

So I was a first timer on my Birthday. Tonya was my sugar mama here! Even the outside/exterior of this building piques your interest - the colors and patterns just draw you in. Normally there is a line out the door but don't let it scare you off - if seems to go pretty quickly. What I had: One scoop Brandied Banana Brulee, one scoop Coffee with Cream and Sugar - one so decadent and over the top and another so smooth and pure, both just awesome. Let's just say we may have had an ice cream dance party in the middle of the store (with cones in hand). At that point I'm not sure if they were in the back, getting ready to close or if our fantastic dances moves were just too intense for them - ;)

Boy do I love me some brown butter almond brittle! I always buy the pints at Whole Foods so when we were in Charlotte one weekend, I knew I had to get a fresh scoop at Jeni's! We went on a COLD day in December but that didn't stop us (and a LOT of other people) from getting our ice cream fix. I took a star off because for some reason the waffles being made in the store gave off a strong black pepper scent...at first I thought it may have been a neighboring store/restaurant, but I confirmed it when I got my waffle cone and took a whiff..it was certainly unexpected.. Next time I'll just skip the waffle cone and get my ice cream in a cup!

Ice cream is kind of our thing. We're tried places all over the world. And, I have to say, Jeni's is our new favorite. I really wanted to get a scoop of every flavor- there are so many unique ones to chose from! We loved everything we ordered and are already talking about what we plan to try next time. This ice cream is definitely worth waiting in line for (which you will!)

Super fun on a warm day!!! A few friends and I were walking around the area and the smell drew us in. The sweet smell of fresh waffle cone is hard to resist. The shop is fairly small but that doesn't stop the line from forming. We all indulged and couldn't have been happier. The patio will likely need more seating as the weather warms but we were able to find a seat. The ice cream was delicious and the cone was worth the extra cost. Tons of options for flavors so everyone should be able to find something they love. I think the only improvement would be to have more trash cans available or checked more often (hats hard when they are so busy). I certainly would stop again and try more flavors.

I mean. Yea. It's Jeni's. The ice cream rocks. The employees are super super friendly. The space is small and they can have a line (pardon - there WILL be a line. Expect a line), but that won't make me knock a star off. There's a line because Jeni's product is worth waiting in line for. The Lady and I, after trying Jeni's for the first time out of a pint from Earth Fare and then trying her scoop shop in Nashville, were SO excited when we heard the news that Jeni's was coming. The flavors are still innovative and it's so nice to finally have an option to a) have a Jeni's cone - try it, and b) not have to commit to purchasing an entire pint. But let's be real, after trying it, you're going to want to commit to purchase an entire pint. And then you'll invite us over to help you demolish it. Right?

The line is long and yes, it is worth the wait. This place features unique ice cream flavors that are nice and rich. Try all the flavors you want (they don't even make you feel bad about it!) but choose wisely because your partner may not share. Pro tip: Sit at the bar at Hawkers and watch the line or go near closing time. You have a better chance of avoiding that line.

Had been waiting to try Jeni's ice cream and was not disappointed. We went at just the right time and didn't have to wait in a line out the door like I've seen so many other times. The waffle cone was amazing - just the right amount of crisp but not too crunchy/hard. The ice cream was great - I got two scoops and loved that the ice cream was soft enough to bite and not too frozen. I'll definitely be going back.

After driving by many times & seeing the long lines, we were very excited to see basically no long Sunday morning, well about noon over labor day weekend. We told the employee we'd never been before and she was super nice. She began pulling out mini little silver spoons and offering us samples. I ultimately went with the salted caramel & milkiest chocolate scoops. The texture was my favorite part, it's tough to describe. Very creamy and smooth. My fiance loved the gooey butter cake. For the two of us it was about $12. Pricey but a fun experience. We'll be back!

Worth the hype! The service was so friendly and the ice cream was delicious! There was plenty of variety to choose from. I would suggest you get a waffle cone. They are made fresh right in front of you and make the whole shop smell so good! I got the brown butter almond brittle and it was amazing! I am so happy I finally made a trip here. Absolutely delicious!!

Delicious! I got a trio to sample three different flavors and a fresh made waffle square. I got a goat cheese with red cherries, gooey butter cake, and dairy free cold brew with coconut cream . Everything was amazing and it is located in a great place and sit outside to enjoy the sun. I will definitely be back for more!

If you don't like Jeni's we can't be friends. The best ice cream you'll ever have and I don't have to drive to Atlanta or order online anymore. There is a line but it moves fast as its just ice cream folks. Get the sampler - three scoops and a waffle cone chip! Favorites: Goat cheese and red cherries Brown butter almond brittle Milkiest chocolate The vegan cortado one!

I was so excited to come to this place! And I am so glad I did. The line was long but well worth it. I have visited Jeni's a few times and I just love the look and feel of this place. Although the customer service is not great, they are by no means rude. My favorite flavors are the gooey butter cake and the brown butter almond brittle. All of the other flavors are so delicious and creamy. The waffle cones are amazing! I am not a waffle cone person, but the smell of these freshly made waffle cones alone will make your mouth water. They have cute banners placed on the out side that make for a great photo spot too.
Delicious ice cream! I loved the variety of options. Nice staff. Samples offered. Very allergy-friendly, too.

Dairy free flavors are really good BUT personally don't think they compare to the normal flavors. I got diary free cold brew with coconut AND a gooey cake batter on a waffle cone. Love that they use metal spoons and compostable containers!

Was out for a run and saw a line forming in front of Jeni's. Couldn't pass up free ice cream on opening day. I would have been happy with a scoop, but they let us get anything we wanted! I ended up with a flight of brambleberry, almond brittle, and goat cheese with cherry. Soooo good. Thanks Jeni!

I've been to Jeni's more times than I can count, and it is my absolute favorite ice cream spot in the city. It's not just the ice cream that makes it so incredible, although it is perfectly creamy and just sweet enough. It's the butterscotch waffle cones that make this place so amazing. While it would be a travesty to come here and not order ice cream, I've joked on numerous occasions that I would be happy with just the waffle cone. Yeah, it's that good. The combination of the cone with the ice cream is simply out of this world. It's worth it to wait in the line outside, especially since I've always found that the line moves very quickly. As for flavors, my favorite is the Salted Peanut Butter with Dark Chocolate Flecks. I always sample other flavors and somehow still return to this one. The peanut butter flavor is strong without dominating the dark chocolate, which is slightly bitter and pairs nicely with the overall sweetness of the dessert. However, I do also enjoy the Dark Chocolate Truffle and the new Texas Sheet Cake. No matter what flavor you choose, just be sure to get it in a waffle cone!

Not sure what the fan fare is about. It took 20 minutes of waiting on a Sunday night to finally order ice cream with staff members who didn't seem happy to be there. We had half scoops of whiskey pecan and pumpkin spice. The whiskey pecan could be okay if the pecans were fine ground or small chunks. Pumpkin was disgusting. It was like any other hard ice cream just weird flavors. Very expensive!

The ice cream was very good. We did the choose 3 flavors deal which was actually priced very reasonable I thought. They have plenty of seating outside, we were just unfortunate enough to go on a rainy night which turned into a torrential downpour! Other than that the ice cream was good. This was the only place we found that was still open until around 10:30pm on a Saturday night! Overall good ice cream, good bang for your buck, just don't go on a rainy day.

Amazing!!!! Needed and ice cream fix at around 3:30 on a few weeks ago and this place is by my work so no wait at this time either. I had the amazing bramble berry and a scoop of honey lavender in a waffle cone it was AMAZING! Definitely a great spot to indulge

Brown Butter Almond Brittle! I recommend getting the 3 half scoop ice cream flight. Make sure you are full of patience. You will need to sample every flavor and so does the person in front of you. The night we went there was no line. Halfway thru our samples, someone got in line behind us and we took 10 more minutes before we were able to settle on 3 flavors, relationships lol. Now we went after dinner this fall, I can't imagine the capacity of ice cream foodies that Jeni's accommodates during the summer. Jeni's is a great end to a date night in the Southend.

You know it's good when you want some even after stuffing yourself at all you can eat Korean barbecue. The ice cream here is amazing! The best part is the unique flavors they have and how good they all taste. I split 2 half scoops of the brown butter almond brittle and wild berry lavender with my boyfriend and it was perfect! Their cone is so good and perfectly crunchy- you can definitely tell they make it in house. I like how non-rushed the staff is even though there's a line out the door. They don't rush you when you're trying to figure out what to eat and allow you to sample the flavors beforehand. Highly recommend coming here after any meal in the area- or come here just for the ice cream!

My go-to spot for icecream in Charlotte. The flavors melt in your mouth! I always get the Gooey Butter cake and the Brambleberry Crisp.
