The lines are long during the weekend, but it is totally worth the wait and move quickly. The staff is always so nice and helpful and the outside seating is wonderful for groups and families. They have so many flavors available for all taste buds!

While waiting for our reservation at a nearby restaurant we came upon Jeni's ice cream. We were attracted by the gorgeous design of the building. Let me tell ya, this ice cream was beyond splendid. This place beats your average Cold Stone and Baskin Robins. When I walked in you could smell the delicious waffle cones freshly made. The employee made a great suggestion with the Gooey Butter Cake which to me kinda tasted like a dulce de leche. I also added a scoop of Honey Vanilla Bean that was mouth watering. It has a great vibe, the decor is cute inside and out. Definitely coming back with friends when it gets warmer out! So glad I found this spot!

This place never disappoints! Best ice cream hands down! I've been here so many times and have always had great service. Always clean as well. They have added to safe guidelines with COVID now, I felt safe for sure. My favorite flavors are brown butter almond brittle and bramble berry. You HAVE to get the waffle cone, they make them fresh.

Love the unique flavors at Jenni's really try stepping out of your comfort zone because the brown butter almond brittle is one of the best flavors on the menu! The good thing is you can get half scoops and try as many flavors as you want! But always get the gooey butter cake it is amazing!!

The line is worth the wait. It's the same as Jeni's ice cream in Nashville, TN. And it's equally as amazing. You can choose single scoop, double scoop, or the best choice for the indecisive - 3 half scoops. Their waffle cones are amazing, their brambleberry crisp is amazing, the smell is amazing, basically everything is amazing.
Not a bad item here. The waffle cones are bomb and the ice cream has a really great texture

Tonight I went to Jeni's (which I LOVE the ice cream) but I paid for a double(plus tip 10$ total) and got a single (2 bites of ice cream)... Obviously the line was super long and it's during covid 19 so they were busy and I didn't have a chance go back to the register. I'm so upset.

This place is so dope (that's what we say in NY) on so many levels! 1. Location. Plenty of on street parking 2. Jeni's itself is just super cute and adorable. Love the set up outside and inside as well. Very welcoming. Lots of lightening and just super airy and open. 3. The staff is amazing! Super friendly, warm, and inviting. I can't wait to go back! Love their honesty. If they didn't know something they didn't pretend to know. They went to ask the manager. 4. Being allowed to sample as much as as little as you pleased was a HUGE surprise but greatly appreciated. The portions were super gracious. 5. THE FROSE is life! All of the ice cream I tasted was amazing but man oh man the Frose!!! I am just speechless. Honestly thought the first time I had Jeni's was in Charleston just a couple months ago. Best ice cream I ever tasted. While there, one of the workers asked me where I was from and when I told her Charlotte she told me they would be opening a location there this year. I never dreamt it would be this soon. The opening of this place has totally made my summer. We were all warmly welcomed and the atmosphere was just super chill, laid back, and friendly.
Great ice cream. Skip the long line and order from a girl outside for the pick up window

On an unusually warm Fall day, I swung by here to see what Jeni's offered. I knew I wanted a scoop of milk chocolate and maybe try something else. The scoops look small but are deceiving, at least I think so. I got two scoops in a bowl and did not finish. I know. I'm sorry! I did get the milk chocolate and a cream ice cream with pound cake and caramel swirls in it. That was actually too sweet for my taste buds but I'm a girl that would prefer a hunk of cheese over something sweet. The mouth feel was right on; rich ingredients used to make a premium product. Nice job! It was clean too. Someone was outside scrubbing down the trash can for goodness sakes. I felt like I should have tipped him.

Don't let the long line scare you away! Had my first ice cream cone here today, and loveddd it! The waffle cone was the best one I've ever had and it's made fresh in front of you. You have the choice of a waffle cone or cup (would recommend the cup if you don't want things to get a little messy). I chose the 'boston creme pie' and 'strawberry buttermilk'; both were great but boston creme pie was my favorite out of the two. Don't be afraid to ask for samples :)

Jeni's always has a super long line especially on nice days but don't worry it moves at a decent speed . My friends all say good things about the ice cream. I cant attest to that because I don't eat ice cream but I did try a specialty soda , the cream soda and it was good but really sweet. Nice employees .
The best ice cream in town. Flavors are unique. Love the variety of dairy free ice cream.

Jeni's has high quality ice cream. It's meant to melt on your tongue so get a waffle or cake cone! The employees are very friendly & helpful helping you decide what flavor you'd like to have. Dark Chocolate Truffle is made with coconut cream - it's dairy free and MY FAVORITE. My second favorite is Coffee with Cream and Sugar - delicious!

If you're looking for non-chain, homemade ice cream shop with a little twist stop here. My favorite is their brown butter almond brittle. It's a sweet cream based ice cream with bits of almond brittle in every bite. Another fan favorite, the gooey batter cake. Those are both just the perfect amounts of sweetness without being over baring. What makes it even better is you can get just one flavor or multiple scoops each a different flavor for the same price. One cone not enough? They've got pints of all their flavors to take home and enjoy later too.

Jeni's ice cream is awesome, but the service we received on Tuesday was horrible. Why close at 11, if the three staff members you have scheduled are complaining about having guests walk in at 10:10 PM. They made it obvious they were unhappy about us walking in 50 mins til 11. They even mumbled "bruh are they serious". I work in the service industry as well and I would never allow staff members to treat guests this way. The first guest is as important as the last

The flavors- wow. Such an original blend of flavors to choose from! And I'm the most annoying ice cream buyer ever by wanting to taste EVERYTHING before buying but the staff was perfectly welcoming to it! I asked for the trio of 3 half scoops but the staff was not stingy and were delighted to give me 3 HUGE scoops of ice cream for the price of the trio so nice! But just know it's A LOT of ice cream! Loved this place!!!!

Okay - seriously, BEST ICE CREAM EVER!!!!!! The staff could be a wee bit nicer, but they are constantly busy and I've witnessed them keep their cool when dealing with super difficult guests. So I totally understand why.. I could only imagine how tired they are.. keep it up you guys! Ps - Owners, Give your staff a lil raise - they definitely deserve it and you all can definitely afford it.

This was a delicious treat that I cant wait to try again. The best deal is the Ice Cream Flight or Trio -- tasting three flavors along with a waffle cone wedge all for $6.00. It's more than enough ice cream and let's you taste any three flavors. Even if you don't get the trio, you can sample any flavor before purchase. My favs -- Brambleberry Crisp and Gooey Butter Cake. Next tastes will include the dark chocolate option.

The ice cream is the best. There are lots of unusual flavors to choose from. My last trip I had goat cheese and cherry. The creaminess is well balanced. The smell of the fresh made waffle cone brings back memories of childhood ice cream cones at the lake. I have recommended this shop to friends and they always thank me. My one friend now has it delivered to her home. Oh my goodness, I hadn't thought of that!

Where do I even begin? Think of the most amazingly creative ice cream combos and you've got Jeni's. From non-diary ice cream to cream puff flavored ice cream, Jeni's is sure to please. Located in a cute little shop outfitted with retro patterns, Jeni's offers unlimited samples! Seriously, try them all! Moreover, Jeni's has a great two half scoop deal for $5 (featured in the photo) with so much ice cream it's basically two full scoops! Highly recommend a combo of honey vanilla bean and brambleberry crisp.

Oh my goodness this had to be the best ice cream place on the planet. So delicious, service was great (I even got a gift card for a free triple scoop just for closing the door so the AC wouldn't escape!). But even with the amazing gesture the main reason for this 5 star is for the delicious and one of a kind flavors, the great customer service (me and my family tried so many flavors and they were so patient). The waffle cone out of this world. I had the coconut and cold brew, the peanut butter and the gooey cake. Also tried the lavender, snowflake ( supposedly made by famous person). The outside area was a perfect setting for the deliciousness

Go here. Wait on the long line and eat some of the best ice cream ever. It's so good. And perfect beyond the traditional ice cream. Also the dairy free options are amazing. Perfect for date night or girls night out. Also check out the awesome heart confetti wall around the corner. This place won't disappoint.
Awesome!! My favorite is the salted peanut butter with chocolate flakes!! We live in Charlotte, and every time we go to Jeni's, the line is so long!!

Best ice cream I've ever had! Ice cream usually isn't my dessert of choice, but this place was a total game changer. Amazing, unique flavors with homemade waffle cones that are fresh! They even have an option to try multiple flavors by ordering an ice cream flight. I love the brambleberry crisp and the goat cheese and cherry flavors. This place is great! Expect a long line and to wait a bit, especially on weekends..but it's so worth it! Not a ton of seating options inside, but a few tables outside.

The gooey butter cake ice cream is all you need to know. When you walk inside it's very cute and bright and it smells heavenly! If you go on a Friday late afternoon you really won't have a long wait which is nice. The staff was super friendly--perfect treat for a hot day.

The ice cream here is pretty good, but what ice cream place has bad ice cream when you really think about it? Definitely worth going to if the line isn't out the door, but if it's longer than 10 people out the door I would not say it's worth waiting for, unless you're really hell-bent on having ice cream.

I was underwhelmed by my experience at Jeni's and so were my family members. First of all, the line is incredibly frustrating to wait in. It was hot and service was slow. I know scooping ice cream takes time, but for the time it took, it was not worth it. My husband and I both sampled several flavors and did not like many of them. My husband said that both chocolate flavors he tasted had bizarre aftertastes. I tried vanilla and honey and didn't taste any honey. I did end up getting cream puff flavor which was fine, but nothing to crave or rave about. The flavors have the illusion of being interesting, but are not great flavors. This, of course, is just my opinion. But I feel the appeal is in the boutique shop style and reputation rather than actual quality. We also felt it was far too overpriced for what you get. I much prefer Golden Cow Creamery down the road. I have no reason to revisit Jeni's again when there are better ice cream shops in Charlotte.
You can smell the freshly made waffle cones a block away. This ice cream shop had fun, crazy flavors and also your more traditional ones. I love that you can get an ice cream flight!

My partner and I were interested in the non-dairy options they provided. I had the dark chocolate truffle & he had the caramel pecan sticky buns. Both extremely delicious I was super surprised. I'll definitely be back when I'm in town.

First time at Jenni's, ordered 1/2 scoop of the rosÃ© sorbert and the coffee with cream and sugar in a cup ($6). I really enjoyed both flavors I didn't get to try their cones. I like the rosÃ© sorbert over the coffee flavor more. They have no restrooms but they have plenty of outdoor seating. The building is super cute and there is a mural around the corner from the ice cream shop. It's in a really nice gentrified area of Charlotte with a lot of other restaurants and shops nearby. I parked maybe a block away and paid $5 there is also street parking. Last Sunday when the temperature was really hot- on a winter day the line was out the door. Make sure you get there early if you don't want to wait a long time. The workers were pleasant. They do have free stickers if you have a little one or just like to collect stickers.

Over the summer, I eat ice-cream/fro-yo almost every day. I wanted to try a new location and had heard that Jeni's has unique ice-cream flavors. I love that it was only a two minute walk from the West East light rail station. Initially, my friend and I were very overwhelmed by the various unique flavors. Everyone was kind, and an employee informed us that we could taste test as many flavors as we wanted (they had cute metal spoons instead of plastic for testing). Ultimately, my friend chose Cold Brew with Coconut Cream, and I chose Brown Butter Almond Brittle. The ice-cream was wonderful and the waffle cone did not disappoint as well. We will definitely be back!

A Sunday afternoon stroll brought me to Jeni's to see what "All the hype" was about. There is always a line and I had heard good things. The place itself is adorable and it wasn't quite raining yet so that was a plus because if you are waiting in line, and it happens to be along line, you will be hit by the elements. That aside, we walk up to the counter, but even before you get inside you can smell the cones sugary sweet smell. The list of flavors is long and very creative. An unfortunate truth, I can't really have ice cream, lactose and I are not friends but I love it. Fortunately, they three very interesting options. I chose the infused coffee and coconut milk - A*M*A*Z*I*N*G! I did taste the chocolate and the goat cheese with cherries which were equally as good but the Coffee and Cream spoke to my heart. I opted to have it in a cup and the very sweet, very attentive attendant that work there made the smart suggestion of putting pieces of cone into the cup (thank you). So this goes without saying, the staff is great. I was SO pleased I made this stop. I highly recommend the full experience. You can apparently buy pints in certain stores around town but you truly have to go in person.

Love love love this place the ice cream is so unique and tastes unreal. The line is always super long but goes by so quickly. Customer service is 5 stars, they let you try whatever you want but are also able to get you what you want fast!! Will definitely be back

I went to jeni's for the grand opening in south end where they were giving our FREE ice cream. I was in line for like 1hr 30mins but it was sooo worth it. The employees let me try as many flavors as I wanted even with the huge crowd & when I say free ice cream I don't mean like a little cone with barley any ice cream. They actually let us get anything we wanted on the menu which I thought was pretty neat. They are about to open a 2nd location in NODa which I'm really happy about & they also sell pints in Harris teeter & Publix now.
Pretty sweet location. Honestly, I don't see the big deal with their ice cream. It's good.. but not out of this world.. the cone defiantly makes it a little better
It's pretty good! The downside, there is always a long line. It is just basic ice cream.

There's always a line but it moves super fast and its definitely worth the wait! They have an assortment of unique and tasty flavors that are different from the average ice cream places around town. They also have dairy free options that are delicious as well. They let you sample as many as you want, and they make the waffle cones right in front of you which is a cool touch (and makes the place smell amazing the minute the door opens). Will definitely be back!

I have to say that this is some of the best ice cream I have ever tasted...... and I am a big ice cream fan. I was there opening day and the line was insane. It took some people hours to get served, but this is to be expected at a grand opening of a popular place. The flavors I loved were plentiful, so most likely you can find something that appeals to you. I am told they will be changing flavors from time to time, which is good, because they were missing some flavors that I have seen in stores and on their website. Lastly, the big negative to me is the pricing. Wow, $12 for a pint is wild. In the stores, I have seen it priced 1/3 less......... still very expensive for a packed pint of ice cream, but when you want it, you want it. So to me, its a special treat, because of the cost. But hey, treat yourself from time to time and have some.

Jeni's is great every time! The cones are fresh, even the cake and sugar ones. I think it's entirely worth the $5 for a single scoop, line or no line. We rode the Lynx Blueline down just for ice cream and hopped off the East/West stop. Favorite flavors are coffee/cream, wildberry lavender and goat cheese/cherry. If you like sweet and salty at the same time, then Jeni's is just for you. Salty caramel, salted peanut and chocolate are always on the menu. I can't wait for the next rotation of flavors when they come around. I would love to see the pistachio honey again.

I always love coming to Jeni's but you just have to come here during non peak times if you don't wanna wait in line for 30 mins. They also ran out of waffle cones last night but I've been here many other times and that's never happened. The workers are super friendly, let you try flavors without feeling too rushed and it's always some bomb ass ice cream. I will probably forever be a two scoops fan but that won't take away that the ice cream here is delicious and their waffle cones are legit

So anyone who has been to or is from Ohio was super excited about this opening here in good old Charlotte. Again like a few new places I waited until I went a few times before I reviewed it. If you have ever been to the one in Columbus Ohio you were probably like me blown away! Now that brings us back to the one here in Charlotte the service is great which is important but I am a but disappointed with the lack of selection. With that said I did have their boozy eggnog on my last visit and it took them from 3.5 star to a solid 4 star. Actually as I write this I think I might have to go back today and get a pint before it is gone! On another note is was my wife's birthday on our last trip and as we were paying I saw a sigh saying if it was your birthday it's free which was a very nice surprise! I will definitely be adding this to my next birthday itinerary!

I didn't think it would live up to the hype, but it does. Totally does. Their flavors are incredible and seem to be made with fresh ingredients. I love the number of flavor options. It seems like there is always something new to try. I love the option of an ice cream flight. 3 half scoops and a piece of waffle cone for $6. The staff seems happy to be there and are very willing to help you choose.
This is definitely not your typical ice cream joint. The flavors are unique and so so good. They also have one of the coolest signs around. Definitely checkout Jeni's if you haven't already.

The ice cream is unbeatable. Goat cheese with cherries is my favorite. The waffle cones taste and smell amazing. You can get two "half" scoops (plenty of ice cream) in a waffle cone for $5. Two drawbacks: the line is almost always long and the pints are overpriced. So go at an off-hour or buy the pints at the grocery store for cheap.

It really is as good as everyone says it is! I got ooey-gooey butter cake and it was awesome. The staff was friendly and let us taste as many favors as we wanted despite the long line. Will definitely be back!

Usually there is a line in the evening, but it moves fast and it's worth it. Fresh and creative ice cream flavors leave you with the reminiscent sense of enjoyment of a cold creamy ice cream on a hot summer's evening while enjoying a flavor and taste that is new and unexpected. Prices are very reasonable for the quality, creativity and service received. There is no doubt why there is a line every night and I expect it will continue this way even after the fresh hype.

Delicious! We live in North Charlotte and stumbled onto this gem while bouncing around the South End. It was so delicious that we ventured back two days later! We loved the estate vanilla and brown butter almond brittle. The manager and employees are all awesome and the line moves fast and is worth the short wait!

*one of those crazy people who waited in line for 20 minutes during the soft opening at 9:00 p.m. on a Friday night* yes, it's good. yes, it's really good. and really fresh. their dairy free chocolate is incredible. it is so rich and satisfying. I've had bites of Justin's dairy concoctions which have included: lavender, chocolate chip, and salted caramel. from memory, they haven't had mint chocolate chip yet, but I'm sure they will at some point! we've been twice now, but on the third time, when the line was over 20 minutes, we decided to bail. thrilled that CLT is one of the few cities that Jeni's has expanded to. it's such a bright (literally!) spot in South End which makes our neighborhood even better.
Great ice cream! The line is usually long, but a lot of the times they have an employee that will take your order with a handheld device, making it much quicker.

Ice cream was straight. Wasn't the best thing ever. Line was long since it's new and trendy right now in CLT. The waffle cone was mediocre. Service was good. The staff seemed happy to work there and there's a happy atmosphere at the place since everyone was so excited about the opening.

Like - how cute is this ice cream shop? I really enjoyed a stop here with my baby. The place was packed, but fast. It's family and date friendly. Kinda unrelated, but I dropped my wallet on my way there, and after I retraced my steps and went back to pay the guest behind me had anonymously paid for my cone. What a treat :-) I'll be stopping by often on my walks!

Splendid is an apt description for the ice cream at Jeni's! I've been twice now, and both times have had the same thing: two half scoops, one of sweet cream biscuits & peach jam and the other of gooey butter cake. The sweet cream one is truly delightful. The base has a slight tartness (maybe buttermilk?), with ribbons of peach jam and chunks of what tastes like shortbread. The gooey butter cake is similar to dulce de leche with the addition of large cake chunks throughout. The ice cream is incredibly creamy and rich. The portions are small, but satisfying. There may be a line, but you know what? Stand in it. It's worth it.

We have heard so much about this place and we had to check it out! The location was perfect. Plenty of off street parking spaces. Walking distance to restaurants and shops. So many options of ice cream with reasonable prices. We tried Gooey Buttercake, Brambleberry and Goat cheese with red cherries. So good!! We'll definitely go back and try everything!

I was not impressed. I really wanted to like the ice cream. I am a big fan of cold creamy concoction especially in the summer. It was just too over priced and did not seem like a good quality ice cream. That being said, I will try it at least once more.
Ice cream was good and housemade cones were good. Line was long but went really fast. Fun atmosphere. We will go back for sure!

I have been hearing about this place for a while and finally got around to trying it. The line was relatively short when I stopped by on a Saturday night and it moved rather quickly. First off the ice cream is good. (Do not get me wrong, it is good.) The employees are super nice and helpful, letting you try several flavors before you decide on the one you want! BUT (personal opinion) I think the ice cream is a little pricey and overrated. Just my opinion. It is good, however I have had just as good ice cream if not better for half the price.

Great ice cream! Only down side is that it doesn't have stuff you can add to it and the line gets very long. I do recommend it though. The flavors are unique and the cones are freshly made! My favorite is the Boston cream pie!

I don't care if it seems trendy to like Jeni's. I've been following her for nearly a decade, eating ice creams made from her cookbook until they were available in stores. I've tried nearly every flavor. You truly can taste the difference in the quality ingredients she uses, which means other "fake ice creams" at the grocery store have lost their appeal. I'll take the real stuff, the best stuff. And that's Jeni's.

There are a ton of flavors to choose from. I love that portions can be ordered in half scoops. I got a half scoop each of peanut butter and jelly (dairy-free) and chocolate truffle (dairy-free). There were both coconut cream based and delicious. They offer compostable cups (and spoons) or a waffle cone. I highly highly recommend visiting one of the many Jeni's locations.

I'm sorry but nothing is worth waiting that long for! Wait in line in the hot sun for 20+ minutes to get something that only takes 5 minutes to eat seems insane. I truly think is more of a Fab than anything else. Apply that to anything else in life and you wouldn't do it, so why here!? Plus this is the saltiest Ice-cream I've ever had. I truly hate that Pike's closed and lost business to this place. That was a historical place in the QC.
Came here for dessert after dinner, and the vegan ice cream was amazing. Tiffany was super sweet and helpful! I'll be back ;)
Very fun and different flavors! Super yummy and loved that it came with a little bit of the waffle cone. Lots of options for everyone! Loved it would come back again when I come back to town.

Call me an addict for Jeni's ice cream but I'm so happy that I am not alone. This brick and mortar location is perfect for all of my fellow Jeni lovers to coven, ohh and ahhh over what each other paired up and talk about how much we love all of the creamy concoctions. Goat cheese w/cherries is my favorite paired with Brambleberry and chocolate.
LOVE JENNIS !!!! I would die for them ! Little pricey but very good , I recommend the Lavender one.

The wait is finally over! I've been hearing everyone rave over the famous Jeni's ice cream and I hate to say they were right. I'm so thankful they found themselves a new home in Charlotte. I was able to sample as many flavors as I desired and each flavor was given to me on a metal sample spoon while each employee described what I was tasting in each bite. I had the choice of a single scoop in a waffle cone,3 scoops in a cone, or a flight. I opted for the flight because I had so many different flavors I loved and couldn't decide what would go best together on a cone. Though I didn't get a cone they did supple a waffle cone wedge to go with the flight, which I enjoyed. Their waffle cones are made in house and you can tell. All the flavors are very unique and throughly thought out. I ended up getting wild berry lavender, frosÃ©, and goey butter cake. Those three were my top 3 but I honestly could have had all of them. Thank you Jeni's for coming to the CLT!

Oh my goodness! I'm in love! Had the three 1/2 scoop taster with Goat cheese/cherries, toffee, and butter cake. All of these are absolutely delicious, but I favor the goat cheese with cherries. Yum! The staff is very courteous and will let you taste until you find your perfect match. I'm a fan!

My first visit to a Jeni's was back in 2016 st their Charleston location. In my review back in 2016, I wished that Jeni's would come to Charlotte and well, I got my wish! Jeni's is jumpin. We were lucky Tuesday night because there wasn't a long line wrapped around the building like it has been all summer long since they opened. Jeni's is a higher price point for ice cream but it's worth it. Everything they make is homemade. This visit I got the trio scoops with salty caramel, wildberry lavender and the dark chocolate. The wildberry is sooooo delicious. You can really taste the lavender in it. The flavor is great to have on a hot summer day. They have tons of unique flavors and for the fall, they are showcasing some pumpkin flavors. A single serving will cost you $5 and you get two scoops of whatever flavors you want. If you're not sure what flavors you want, don't worry, you can sample anything you like. They also serve your ice cream with a cute little waffle cookie. They have pints they sell in their store for $12 but you can also get some pints in some select flavors in some of the local grocery stores like Publix..

This place is worth trying! Not your normal type of ice cream. Several high end flavors. I had one scoop of the goat cheese with cherries and wildberry lavender in a waffle cone. SO GOOD! My boyfriend had roasted peanut butter with strawberry jelly, brambleberry and Texas sheet cake. Made with Grassfed Milk. They also have dairy free ice creams as well. You will not be disappointed!

Yum yum yum! Tried this place finally today and it was so good!! I had the gooey butter cake flavor and was just so delish! Walk in and it smells amazing, like fresh waffle cones..what you want to smell going into an ice cream shop. The building is just entirely too cute, it's in a great location right off the light rail and within walking distance of so many restaurants, so going there for dessert after dinner is extremely doable. Thankfully since I waited for the summer time hype to die down I didn't have to wait in the long lines that I have seen riding by it before. I can't wait to go back and try some other yummy flavors. :-)
The absolute best ice cream I EVER HAD!!! Whew I don't even like ice cream like that but this shop has amazing flavors. I ordered the butter cake and OMG it was delicious!

Jeni's denied my 6 year old ice cream. No cash excepted, nice to know once you wait in line for 30 min. Even offered to let them keep the change out of a $20. It's real nice that Jeni's can't take care of those that take care of them. We have supported them 2 times a week since they opened, never again!
Good place for ice cream on a nice day. The line can get pretty long, but it typically moves quickly.

Some of the best ice cream in town. Weekends and after work hours this place is always packed. Best time to go is weekdays before 5 if you can. Texas sheet cake is their dairy freee Chocolate which sounds suspect but is actually delightful. It is my favorite flavor. For your first visit i recommend getting the trio for $6. It is 3 half scoops and a sample of the delish waffle cone. Yummy!

Great ice cream but the line is not worth it. If you really need it, go buy a pint at publix. When the hype passes and the line dies down I will go back though. I like the small portions of different flavors so I could try more.

Once I sat in the pouring rain for about 15-20 mins waiting in line. As I left, a gentlemen asked if it was worth the wait. I said it was also worth the rain. Best Ice Cream ever. I love the gooey butter cake and buttermilk. They're amazing flavors and you can taste each individual ingredient.

One of the best ice creameries in the US! I've never had a flavor I didn't like! The associates are friendly and always happy to help me try different flavors. My favorites are sweet cream biscuit and peach, salted peanut butter w chocolate flecks, brown butter almond brittle, salted caramel, sage buttermint, lemon & blueberry parfait, goat cheese, peanut butter & strawberry jam. Also love that they have waffle cones and waffle bowl options!

I am a big fan of ice cream, and have always loved house made ice cream, but Jeni's has the best!!! Such a wide diverse range of flavors gives everyone many options to try new flavors. The line can get very long at times but it is most definitely worth it!!!
Almond brittle and cream puff are on point!!! Nice, clean, bright atmosphere. Super friendly & patient staff. You can even get to-go pints - that's just splendid! Highly recommend for a sweet treat.
Had never been here, and wanted to try! Waiting is the worst part, as it's a small location, but the ice cream itself is worth it. Bramble Berry Crisp is the best!

It was a nice clear evening. The air was cool and flowing gently. Suddenly, the most amazing smell pe etrated my soul. I asked a passerby what the smell was and they informed me that it was Jenni's making waffle cones. I had heard a lot about Jenni's Ice Cream. I even did a brief study on the founder and how she began the company. I'm not a big ice cream eater so I didn't have any major urge to try this spot. The smell got me. I took a moment and read the menu from outside. An employee came out and I invited me in for a sample. I should have never stepped inside. I sampled things I would have never picked by choice. People were literally call put their favorites for me to try. Everyone was excited that it was my first time. After the first sample I started to understand why. Brandied Banana Brulee changed my entire perception of the possibilities of the vehicle that ice cream could be for flavors. My entire world was opened up and I dove I head first. I even loved the goat cheese and raspberry flavor. I hate blue cheese for some reason this was delicious. It is now my mission in life to try every Jenni's flavor I can get my hands on. By "try" I mean eat triple scoops of each. You should join me on this creamy journey of remarkable deliciousness. See you in line.

The only negative thing I can say is that the line is way too long for what your getting. Sure, I love ice cream. Im still not waiting. Is it good? Yes. Is it worth waiting 30 minutes and $4/scoop ? Not a chance. Bring back Pikes please. Charlotte is losing her identity.

YUM! If you have never been to Jeni's you had better crawl out from under that rock you've been under LOL. Jeni's is the go-to place in Charlotte for ice cream. It is sooo good. Be warned, the line is almost always 20 people deep and snaked outside of the building. The line does move quickly and I've never waited longer than 10 minutes to get to the counter to order. My go to flavors are the gooey butter cake, salted peanut butter, and the brown butter almond brittle. Love their waffles cones - they are fresh and you can watch them make them in house! It can be a little bit pricey especially for pints but it is certainly a treat with flavors you won't find elsewhere!
So glad Jeni opened a location in Charlotte. Amazing, tasty ice cream Several unique flavors, my favorite is the brown butter almond brittle, so tasty and crunchy. Amazingly delicious

Most overrated ice cream in the city. It's not bad, by any means, but definitely not worth standing in a line for. They've got maybe one great flavor. Plus, it's overpriced and not worth the small portions. Save yourself the time. There's at least two other ice cream joints that are worlds better in close proximity. You may not get the super cute selfie in front of the sign like you can at Jeni's, but at least you're actually paying for good ice cream instead.

I am obsessed with this place. I go there at least 4 times a month since it's opened. I love the flavors. My favorite flavor is gooey butter cake. The lavender, cream puff, and brambleberry crisp are also great. There's not always a line, but totally worth it even then. The staff is always friendly and you can try all the flavors you want, they never get frustrated. The line goes by fairly quick.
This is our go-to treat. Jenni's has amazing flavors- regular and seasonal/limited edition. I have never had a flavor I didn't like!!! Generally, there is a line, but it goes pretty fast.
It's over priced and the flavors aren't very good. Walk a little further and you get to two scoops. It's flavorful and reasonably priced. Don't waste your time at jeni's.
There ice cream is definitely above average, but I resent having to take out a loan to pay for it. There is better ice cream for much less

My favorite way thing about this place is the smell !!! Lines are long but it moves pretty fast. Please do yourself a favor and get the gooey butter cake flavor, it has vanilla cake pieces in it. Servings are pretty big. Amazing service as well!

They have a variety of unique flavors. The line was long but it was pretty fast. They let you try the flavors before purchasing. I had the brambleberry crisp ice cream. It was so good. It was about $7 for one scoop and a waffle cone bowl. The scoop was huge it equaled to about a little more than two regular scoops elsewhere.

We went into Jeni's after going to Superica (which was to die for!). They let you have samples which is great for a upscale ice cream place. Love that they use metal spoons! I got the darkest chocolate and it was good but rich. My girlfriend got the Brown butter almond brittle and gobbled it up! I also got a slingshot iced coffee at check out for the morning! All in all it was a great Sunday night adventure!
Sooooo many choices. The line is long. But it moves at a decent pace. Worth the wait. Delicious ice cream.

I visited Jenis on a Sunday around 4. The line was not too long. I love the look of jenis and it's placement in the design center is great. There's plenty of spots to sit around Jenis. I had the vanilla ice cream as they were out of my first two choices. The vanilla was amazing. Easily the best vanilla ice cream I have ever had! We had no trouble finding on street parking but I would suggest walking, scootering, or ubering there as there are not many spaces available.

I feel like we all know Jeni's is delicious. They have extremely unique flavors and high quality ingredients. That said, it is expensive. If you go here you probably know that going in. Two single scoops (half of each flavor) in two waffle cones ran us 13 bucks. That.is.a.lot. However, this place is a special occasion ice cream shop... probably not a 'lets take all 5 kids" ice cream shop. They probably won't dig most of the flavors anyway. I will come back for a treat every now and then! Let me tell you though ..Two Scoops Southend is on the same road...and it's located and delicious and a bit less $$$$. Jeni's has plenty of competition for sure.

I've been a Jeni's fan for a long time, I used to get it a lot when I lived in Chicago so I was stoked when they opened one in CLT right after I moved here. As with other locations, the inside is bright and inviting and they have awesome flavors. Really I have yet to try a bad one but my favorites recently are the gooey butter cake and cream puff. The cream puff might actually be my favorite ice cream of all time. This location can get busy but the line moves quickly. The staff are friendly and happy to let you try any flavors. I know people think Jeni's is expensive but nowadays, I feel like any quality ice cream is. I also think the Jeni's portions are very generous, so that helps with the price. I always get the "standard" 2 half scoops for $5 and honestly it's enough that I could share it with my husband instead of each getting our own cone (but where's the fun in that, right?). There's a lot of street parking around this location and it's the perfect spot to grab an ice cream and walk around.

Wednesday, Aug. 8, at 4:15. We drive to the ice cream shop, pay for metered parking, walk up and discover it is closed! So fun for my three kids! This is what summer is all about! Closed to prep for a special event. No sorrys, no coupons to come back and try it again. Just a hand-written note and no ice cream. How do you expect to earn customers when you randomly close with no notice? I understand you have special events but you should offer something to people trying to spend money at your ice cream shop during posted business hours.

What can you say except this awesome little place serves up some great and creative ice cream flavors that are worth checking out! I always go for the two half scoops (as they are huge) and be sure to get several samples before selecting your flavors. My last trip there I got brown butter almond brittle and sweet potato with torched marshmellows. Both were solid with the brown butter taking the cake. Also be sure not to sleep on the waffle cone as they both smell and taste delicious. Even now when winter is coming, I'll expect to stop back by here sometime soon.

Such a treat to finally go to Jeni's after hearing and seeing so much about this place and the amazing ice cream. And that it was...amazing. First things that gets me is the unbelievable smell of fresh waffles. Of course there wS a line a but the wait was not terrible. It actually helped me decide what flavors I was going to ask a taste of. I figured I'd opt for the flight of ice cream but smelling the waffles and watching them turned into perfect cones I didn't think the waffle wedge they gave with the flight would be enough. I wanted that waffle cone! So I went for the two scoops. I had Goat Cheese & Red Cherries which was super interesting and I loved every lick. I paired it with Milkiest Chocolate well because I'm a sucker for chocolate. Although quite chilly out tonight I thoroughly enjoyed my ice cream and plan on revisiting many more times to work my way through the rest of the menu. I did steal a little of the hubbys Gooey Butter Cake and that was amazing as well. One tiny nit-pick is I thought the cone was a bit salty. But not salty enough to turn down another.

After visit #2, I'm still not sure why this place is rated as high as it is. The decor, location and staff is 5 star, but the ice cream is just not that good. The first visit I sampled three different ice creams before deciding not to purchase any, since the flavors were not my favorite. However, my mother purchased the chocolate and it was just meh. We ended up throwing half of it out. I decided to give them another shot since we came at an odd time. My husband and I both got some ice cream. His pick was the vegan PB&J and he enjoyed it, but nothing fantastic and I got the Butter Cake in a cone. The cake tasted stale and the flavor was just off. I know that it is handcrafted ice cream, but I prefer to go to the grocery store and purchase some good old Ben and Jerry's.

The cream puff flavor is the best! There tends to be a line so try to go middle of the day on weekdays. You can also order online and request delivery if you order pints. I love that they let you sample a few if you're unsure of which to order. ~$5 a scoop so make sure you eat every bit!

Wow. This place is amazing. Not only are they super fast but oh my god do they have the best gluten free and dairy free ice cream. Was visiting for work and I am tempted to move to Charlotte for their dairy free peanut butter and jelly ice cream. I had a friend try who is not dairy free and he insisted it was the best he had ever had and could not tell the difference.

I was next door eating at hawkers and Jeni's is right next door, so it was only right that I went and had ice cream for dessert. I had a half a scoop of coffee with cream and a half of scoop of gooey butter cake, in a cup. The half scoops seemed like full scoops to me but I wasn't complaining. Both flavors were amazing! I appreciate them letting me try as many flavors as I wanted before making a decision. I wasn't expecting to eat every bit of the ice cream but I definitely did. This will be a major hotspot during the summer!

One night, I was on YouTube watching food videos, as one does. I watched a video in which an ice cream expert guesses between cheap vs expensive ice cream & the ice cream expert was so knowledgable and personable, it's obvious ice cream is her passion and she takes it serious. I was delighted to find that one of her ice cream shops stands just minutes from me in Charlotte! I immediately headed to the location the following day and my expectations were exceeded. The sweet smell of the fresh waffles being made wafted over when I was almost two blocks away, making me almost sprint to get there. The building is aesthetically pleasing, immaculate and instagramable. The customer service was top notch, we were welcomed and invited to try as many of the inventive, delicious flavors as we wanted. I settled on the trio scoop for the reasonable price of $6. I got Strawberry, Brambleberry and Gooey Butter Cake with waffle cone on the side. It was stupendous, no flavor was restrained, the ice cream is fatty, creamy, smooth, not overly sweet. The best ice cream I've had. They had more than enough indoor and outdoor seating to choose from although it was small. Also, can't forget the vegan and alcoholic options. A must try!
Visited with my girlfriend recently and loved the ice cream! My first time visiting and can see why there is usually a line out the door! Great job keep it up!
Good homemade style ice cream. There is often a long line. Pro-tip: your local Publix sells a limited selection of Jeni's pints for a few dollars less.
Very good and awesome unique flavors. I will be going back. Awesome service and great location!

Yummmm! I had the Sweet Cream and the Milkiest Chocolate and Brown Butter Almond Brittle. The Flight of half scoops was just enough! It's a cute place that invites u in to try their imaginative flavors. My dairy free twins were very happy. And I loved the list Of allergens contained and the gluten free choices. We will be back ASAP!

Jeni's is my favorite ice cream shop. Although the wait in line, specifically at night, is about 15 minutes - the wait is worth it and the employees handle the crowd fairly well. The flavors of ice cream are creative and your tastebuds do a little dance after each lick. My favorite flavors are the Brambleberry Crisp (similar to a blueberry muffin) and the Lemons & Blueberry (which is tart but delicious with a rich flavor) !!!

Sooooo many different flavors to choose from. Did the standard two half scoops and it felt like two full scoops of ice cream !!! Such a wonderful and knowledgeable staff going through the details of every ice cream. I love they reuse the sample spoons. Save the planet ya know.

I LOVE JENIS!!!! You really can't go wrong with any of the flavors here. Although I would recommend they hire more friendly workers for the front at this location, the ice cream never disappoints! Their Lavender flavor is absolutely bomb and I crave it 24/7!!
Very cute and simple looking shop. The ice cream taste fresh, creamy and very great combination of flavors. I'm happy to have a shop like this in Charlotte, highly recommend.

Came here on Tuesday. First time. The ice cream was GREAT, the location is good, & the place was over all clean! My only issue was.., they had maybe 6 people working because they CAN get very very busy. This time, around 5pm on Tuesday they were not very busy so some of the people working were just standing around. (Which again, Idc not a big deal) my friend & i ordered our ice cream & sat down on the bar stool area that faces inside the ice cream shop. One of the employees took a taster spoon and samples a flavor, ok nothing wrong with that. He then used the same spoon and dipped it back into the ice cream to take another sample, so double dipped into the ice cream he was serving the customers. I continued to watch him & he did this TWICE! SAME SPOON!!!! NOT sanitary & I'm not sure they should even be eating as customers are walking up to order . Makes me think twice about coming back. If this is happening right in front of customers, whats happening behind the scenes ? (granted, because we were sitting outside facing the inside of the store, maybe he didnt think anyone was watching?)
Amazing flavors. Great service even though there was a line. Fresh made waffle cones smell and taste amazing. Try the trio and share it.
This ice cream is the best! As are the homemade waffle cones. It's always clean and everyone is friendly. Nice location too!

Yummy in our tummies. Fresh and homemade waffle cones. We had just beat the ridiculously long line and were able to grab some inside seats. The flight trio is a way to portion control and be adventurous at the same time. Have a few vegan options which was wonderful! The two ladies worked the line and I thanked them for their attentive and speedy service. We will be back because who does not enjoy really tasty ice-cream. :)
Great tasting ice cream with a variety of flavors to choose from. Staff is quick with service and friendly. Prices are reasonable.
Worth the hype, delicious ice creams with great flavor combinations. I love the following flavors: brown butter almond brittle, goat cheese with cherries and bramblecrisp.

I've been to Jeni's twice now and they have delicious ice cream. The reason for the low stars is because both times I have visited, the staff have made me feel like I have inconvenienced them by being there. It's incredibly awkward. My first visit I was "greeted" with a frown and eye roll. I didn't even want to ask for a sample because it was that awkward. My second visit was just the same. I took my sister there and she even made a comment on the service. We ordered the trio and went to sit outside. I soon realized we were given a wrong flavor but did not want to go back into the store and deal with the staff and neither did she. I am wary to go back because of my unpleasant experience both times.

Shout out to the amazing manager working tonight who took hella good care of me and my family with a smile on her face. Give that woman a raise cause damn she embodies exceptional service with a great attitude.

I've been so excited about visiting since seeing Jeni's Ice Cream all over social media. The ice cream parlor itself is so cute and trendy. I love the sleek designs of the outdoor seating and brightly lit sign making it really stand out! It's also conveniently located off the of the light rail and around tons of restaurants making it a great place for dessert. When I first opened the door to enter, I was hit with the sweet smell of freshly made waffle cones and homemade ice cream. I want to take that smell and turn it into a candle that I can just burn every day in my house. The ladies working were so wonderful and knowledgeable about each and every flavor! They let us try a few before setting on one to commit to. I ended up with the Bumbleberry Crisp and the Salted Peanut Butter in a waffle cone. It was really good and even if the two flavors didn't necessarily compliment each other, with any Jeni's ice cream you can't go wrong. You can also pick up a pint to take home so you can have some for the rest of the week!

Super, super cute place. Still had a line out the door when we went. I just wasn't in love with the flavors I got or the flavors my boyfriend got. We both got the two half scoops, and the cone was delicious! I ordered the salted peanut with chocolate chunks and milk chocolate. My boyfriend ordered salted caramel with the dark chocolate ice cream. The dark chocolate was delicious! The rest was just a bit too salty for me. Overall, not my favorite ice-cream in Charlotte and probably won't be back.

I don't get it. The cream is good not great. There are no toppings. The prices are high. The lines are long. The service is mehhhh.... the staff is not engaging, they don't offer expertise on the product or its ingredients. They are not much help in selecting a flavor. They yell at you to shut the door. There is limited indoor seating, given the crowd they attract. The merch is also mehhhh. The only good thing is their ice cream is heavily monitored for listeria.
Lines are long but worth the wait. Ice cream is amazing and the waffle cones are freshly made.

I was looking forward to trying this place after reading so many reviews and blog posts but the server made me feel like she hated her job and rushed me. As it was my first time being here, I did want to taste test a few flavors before committing to a purchase. The server gave off an annoyed and unkind demeanor. With that being said, I ordered the salted peanut butter but I really wanted to try the frosÃ¨. (The server told me the flavors were the same in the other section but it wasn't because that's where the frosÃ¨ was and I didn't see it). I will be returning because I REALLY wanna try the frosÃ¨, hopefully I get a different server.
Terrific ice cream spot! Long line but moved fast. Five stars definitely due to having four dairy free flavors!

Tried this place for the first time on a warm Sunday night. In short, this was the best ice cream that I have tried in Charlotte. I had the Gooey Butter Cake Ice Cream which was amazing! This is a must. I also had the Cream Puff which was also very good, but paled in comparison. My wife had the Sweet Potato with Marshmallows which she loved and the Pumpkin 5-Spice which she said was average. The store itself was very cute. It was $5 for 2 half scoops which was well worth it. The "half-scoops" were actually quite big. In the future, I'm sure I will get the Gooey Butter Cake Ice Cream and then rotate my other scoop with one of their other great flavors.

Being a Columbus native, I was beyond excited when I saw Jeni's was coming to CLT. I stalked their instagram and facebook waiting for them to announce their official opening day. Needless to say, I was there the day they opened their doors and stood in like for 30 minutes and it was well worth it. I've been back 3 times since then. My favorites are cream puff and goat cheese and red cherries. My son loves the milkiest chocolate and considering I'm not a chocolate ice cream fan I have to say it's very tasty. In my opinion it's definitely better than 2 scoops and Golden Cow. But everyone has their preferences.
Some of the best ice cream, I've ever had! Love the unique flavors. I had the Honey vanilla and the Gooey Buttecream, and they were both delicious!

I have been waiting for the very second Jeni would come to Charlotte and by god it is here. No more only enjoying when I'm out of town! The ice cream is fantastic. The service is consistently friendly. The scoop shop is always clean. I will wait in line, I will park at a distance and walk, I will wait in the rain, I will try new flavors, I will support this little gem for as long as I live in Charlotte. Thank you for coming, you are amazing! AND BY GOD, GET THE BUTTERCRISP CONE. By the time you're on your last two bites it's like a salty sugar cookie absorbing the last drips of your chosen flavor.

Let me start by saying this place smells like cake... I knew it was going to be something great from the very start with just that! As soon as you walk in... after being in a line of dozens of customers (good sign), you are mesmerized by the massive menu in front of you & the smiling faces behind the counter. Jeni's has so many options it's pretty ridiculous! Then... you get to the counter & my girl is over here making waffle cones right in front of your eyes! SO fresh! The smell is amazing... Then you see massive tubs of vibrant ice cream. My heart lead me to the coffee coconut cream single cone & my son's heart lead him to the milkiest chocolate single cone! The taste was exactly how I imagined, rich, & the texture was so creamy! Unfortunately my child is a serial cone dropper (happens anywhere we get ice cream)... but the lovely lady working the register replaced it with no hesitation! In fact, I didn't even have to ask! In a nutshell, thank you guys so much for the very delicious ice cream on such a hot day like today! Cravings satisfied!!! We will be back!

I was so excited to discover this place while in Charlotte!!! What bought me here was the smell of the homemade waffle cones and bowls, what made me stay is the list of dairy free ice cream (made of coconut milk). Very yummy all around!
Great ice cream shop over in Southend! I love that they change out the flavors and have very unique flavors like lavender. Highly recommend checking out if you enjoy interesting flavors!
Long line because it's new so plan ahead! And be prepared to wait but line moves quickly. Strawberry ice creams was the best strawberry ice cream I've ever had! Lots of options

The place is in a cool little area but the ice cream wasn't that great. It was okay but nothing special. It was tasteless. The salted caramel had way too much salt. This just could have been a bad batch. Probably wouldn't go back.

Yum! Top quality ice cream. They have seasonal flavors and everything I have had has been divine . They have really interesting flavors such as sweet corn and goat cheese and cherry. I love the brown butter almond brittle and ooey gooey cake. Also if you are vegan they have great flavors too according to my friend who recently turned vegan.

I was finally able to try this 'splendid' ice cream during Jeni's ice cream truck tour. Four of us stood in line for 30 minutes and it was worth it to try a free scoop of the Brown Butter Almond Brittle, Brambleberry Cobbler, Gooey Butter Cake and Darkest Chocolate. All were rich and delicious. I will definitely make my way to South End to try the other flavors.

A pretty good ice cream spot! My husband and I have passed by Jeni's plenty of times just to see a line out the door and down the road. We've always wondered what the hype was about. Tonight we stopped in after dinner to give it a shot. For $5, we each got 2 half-scoops of ice cream in a bowl. The staff was friendly and let us try a few samples before deciding on a flavor. I went for the dairy-free chocolate and chocolate-chip mint. My husband went with regular dark chocolate and orange chiffon. My mom got the gooey butter cake and the bramble-berry. In my honest opinion, everything I tasted was good but I still don't understand the hype. I definitely would have been disappointed if I'd've waited in a long line for it. I also thought it was a little overpriced. But, like I said, the flavors were good! And the dairy-free chocolate tasted just like your typical chocolate ice cream. No complaints here (besides the price) but I just don't understand the hype.

I'm not even big on ice cream. I love frozen yogurt and sobert. When Jeni's first opened, the line was down the block every night! I go during lunch time so I can have time to try and few flavors before committing. They have new flavors that come out for the season! Best ice cream I have ever had.
Gooey butter cake and goats milk and cherries are crave worthy. The staff is helpful and patient. And you're not stuck in the sun now that they've added umbrellas.

Innovative flavors that work out perfectly! I would say we order flights of savory flavors & fruity flavors! Lavender was the winner of the fruity & Bangkok was the winner of our savory. Note the Bangkok has a kick of spice so be ready for that! Definitely worth the wait in line!
Line can get long so best not to go during peak dessert hours! But it's definitely a good end to your night!

The good: delicious ice cream The bad: very expensive ice cream. I might as well get a whole pint of Ben & Jerry's from Publix down the road for less than what it costs for one scoop here. When compared to pretty much any other ice cream shop, Jeni's prices are more expensive. What also upsets me with Jeni's opening is Charlotte's obsession with trendy chains has really negatively impacted actual local ice cream shops within a 10 minute walk (Golden Cow Creamery and Two Scoops). I wouldn't be surprised if both of these good local ice cream shops close within the next year based on how people seem to be fascinated by Jeni's. Shame on these people for not supporting local businesses. Shame on Jeni's for opening up their shop near where local competitors already had a presence. Support Mom & Pop, get your ice cream from Charlotte based shops!

Walking up to Jeni's I felt a sense of southern hospitality and charm. In the heart of South End, the location and ambiance is top notch. I was practically knocked over by the amazing smell as I entered the shop. Their homemade waffle cones are to die for! Literally the best I've had (and I love some waffle cones). They offer so many ice cream flavors. Some on the traditional side and some creative and unique. I love the gooey butter cake and the salted peanut with chocolate flecks. Regardless of your taste, there is something for everyone!!

Okay seriously the best ice cream ever! Worth the wait in line. You can't go wrong with the gooey butter cake & salty Carmel! Also the Bramble berry crisp, & brown butter almond brittle are amazing! Wow!
Ridiculously delicious!!! The lines are always insane and they only have 2, maybe 3 people working at a time but that doesn't stop us from going!

I just moved to NC and I must say this is the best ice cream I have had. They customer service is always great and even with a line all the way out the door you only wait 10-15 minutes. They also have dairy free options which I love.
Jeni's NEVER disappoints. I love this place. Live 40 mins away and will drive here for the dairy free Texas sheet cake and those handmade waffle cones!

What a great new place for the South End! This area is getting to be where the best places to eat reside! The line was pretty long but it moved quickly, building construction blocks along along the sidewalk didn't help, but that will be done soon (hopefully--it's everywhere). The ice cream is so flavorful. And the varieties are great. It was a wow of a dessert. If you cannot decide what flavor, then order a bowl of 2-3 half scoops, the amounts are good but not too big. And they separate them with waffle cookies so they don't run into each other. I recommend wild berry lavender (intense flavor), and butter almond crunch. Yummy! Nice service, too.

Soooooooo good! I was supposed to go to this place since it opened but the line was always out the door and down the block! Seeing as most of the time I have my child with me I know he has no patience for the line. It's December and I just so happened to be in the area so I figured I'd try my luck and I'm so happy that I did! First and foremost let me say I love the decor. The lighted up name is the perfect backdrop for pictures. Anyway there was no line this evening. I wasn't sure which one I wanted to try but the workers there were so awesome. I tried about 3 flavors before I chose my two scoops. The woman who took my order was such a cool sport. She even let me take a little video for Instagram. Now on to the flavors! I decided on Goey Butter Cake and Boozy Eggnog. Ironically I hadn't tried the Goey Butter Cake but it looked good and tasted better than it looked. Typically I don't go for Boozy ice cream because I'm always scared that it will be too Boozy and taste gross BUT this flavor made me a believer! Did I mention I've never had eggnog either! It was amazing! I want to go back for more of that flavor because it's a seasonal one so I need to rack up as much as I can! Okay I think I've babbled enough and you get the point. If you have a Jeni's by you do not hesitate! Run and get your ice cream lol.

Finally got to go to Jeni's last night! We were so pleased with the staff, cleanliness, and of course THE ICE CREAM. I loved their unique flavors; the goat cheese with cherries was SO delicious and unique. I was also impressed with the knowledge about every ingredient in their ice cream. I got brown butter almond brittle ice cream as well as salty peanut butter with chocolate chunks. Both were SO creamy and smooth and had such good flavor. I loved the fact that they have metal tasting spoons to cut down on waste and offered as many samples as I needed to figure out what I wanted to get having never been there before. I will be back!

Very good ice cream but I was not blown away by it considering the line. The place is small and the line spills down the sidewalk. The smell is what really gets you as they make fresh waffle cones right as you walk in, yummy! I appreciated the creative choices but was not wowed by the flavors.

When there's a long line, it has to be good right? This place did not disappoint. Interesting flavors and ice cream that taste clean. I tried the peanut butter and the almond brittle in the standard ( 2 half scoops in a waffle cone) which was just the right amount of sweetness on a hot day.

came here on a Tuesday afternoon, there was no line thank God! they have nice flavors, it smells really good in the surrounding area, like fresh waffle cones and sugar. cute photo oops near by. they have a lot of unique flavors, I got the butter cake I believe. they're a little pricey and lines can get crazy long.
Got the 3 scoops flight. So good and refreshing! Line will probably be out the door but it's worth the short wait.

The vegan chocolate ice cream was so good, I bought a pint to go. ...probably the best non-dairy I've cream I've ever had! The kids loved their dairy ice cream flavors as well, and think it's the best ice cream in Charlotte - in their opinion, probably only bested by the Creamery at Penn State, State College, PA.

You can smell the sweet waffle cones a block away! Jeni's Ice Cream brings a lot of signature items to the table that won't leave you disappointed along with dairy-free options. Furthermore, her waffle cones are made daily, fresh off the griddle. As a consumer, I can appreciate her attention to detail because the flavors and all the elements are equally well thought out and executed. My favorite ice cream is the Gooey Butter Cake. It's made with cream cheese ice cream layered with Vanilla Cake and butterscotch sauce scooped into a waffle cone. Next time you are in the area pay Jeni's Ice Cream a visit, I promise you won't regret it!

I tried the wild berry lavender in a cup. It was delicious and they gave me a waffle cone piece on the side which was a great touch! They also provide self-serve water which I greatly appreciate. Only problem was that when I was there I had to go to the bathroom really badly but they don't have one :/

First time back to Jeni's since the Yelp event and just as I had hoped the quality is still amazing. This place has some of the best ice cream I have ever had and I mean that wholeheartedly. Not much of a line today, but I can't imagine 1:30 on a Monday is really peak hours. That said there were still a few folks ahead of us in line. My wife sampled a few flavors (her first time here) while I went ahead and ordered my two half scoops in a fresh waffle cone. Darkest Chocolate and Gooey Butter Cake is a great combination! It just blends so well with that cone. Smooth and creamy and those little cakey pieces, so good. The girls behind the counter were happy to help with samples and orders and kept everyone moving along. Overall a great little experience for some spur of the moment ice cream. If your planning on coming in the evening or on the weekend you might be in for a little wait but I promise its worth it.
Can I give this 6 stars? Perfectly balanced flavors especially with the freshly made waffle cone. Definitely addictive.

Super creative flavors to choose from. If you're more plain Jane then this may not be the spot because they don't have the more traditional flavors on their menu.. Everything was pretty good and fast paced up until the guy cashier rang me up. No greeting, nothing.. Just 36 dollars and that was all I ever heard from him lol.

this is high quality ice cream. i have never heard of most of the flavors they serve at jeni's but i find that fascinating. there is usually a line so if you're not prepared to wait then come during the day because they are less busy then. the price may seem high but it's completely worth it. you get some pretty good size scoops. i love jeni's, 5 out of 5 stars.

Such good ice cream! They have so many flavors (some quite u Kaye like goat cheese cherry and lavender berry), they let you taste what you want before making your selection. The cones are made in house and are delicious. I got bramble berry crisp and brown butter almond brittle and they were amazing. A bit costly (my two scoop cone was $6) but so so so worth it. You can also get regular cones if you don't want the house made kind and it's a little cheaper. Highly recommend!!
Just moved here from Chicago and this was my Fav ice cream there! When they opened one here I was jumping for joyyyyy! Too good to be true-go here!

Jeni's is good. Really good. Compared to my other favorite ice cream shops in charlotte jeni's takes the cake. Prepare to stand in line for a while if you go at a busy time. The line doesnt move all that fast, but trust me it's worth it. Waffle cones are made in house which is always a massive plus. Choosing from the flavors was no simple task and is most likely the reason for the slow line. You can try as much ice cream as you want too. The ice cream itself is creamy, rich, and exploding with flavorful calories. All in all this place is chill. Open one in plaza. Thanks.

Delicious ice cream! Been here twice now, and each time I tried a different flavor which didn't disappoint. Brandied Banana BrÃ»lÃ©e was so good! Gooey Butter Cake is a great option as well! Great ice cream place in South End with not your typical ice cream flavors!
The brown butter almond brittle ice cream is like crack. It is so addicting and so delicious! I sometimes forego lunch and get a wafflecone instead!

This is the best new addition to the ice creamery landscape in the city. The flavors are unique and delicious. Their prices are in line with the rest. Expect long lines in peak hours but worth the wait BRAMBLE BERRY CRUNCH is delicious.
Absolutely the WORST customer service. Will not be wasting my time here again. The girl needs a personality and social skills if she's going to work here.

This place is DEFINITELY worth the hype - the gooey butter cake was perhaps the best ice cream I've ever eaten. The interior was clean and smelled great and the staff was super friendly! My only suggestion would be to alert the staff of how they hold the cone when scooping ice cream, my server had it pretty close to their hair (but not touching it) by accident because they were focused on scooping. It didn't bother me personally much but I definitely would be a little hesitant if it had made contact.

Jeni's is such a fun Bumble BFF day date. New friends + Ice Cream make for a great time! You can even take turns taking each other's Instagram pics (that's what BFFs are for right?) I love the Brambleberry Crisp in the classic waffle cone made right in front of you!

For a sweet tooth, it's a must visit place ! For the flavors, I went for the pineapple upside down cake and the gooey butter cake. Both the flavors were a delight! We visited their South End Charlotte location and parking was a bit of an issue. It took us 15 mins to get a parking space. But it was worth the wait! I would definitely visit again!

This is the best ice cream. We used to get it mail ordered to us from Ohio. The flavors are so unique, and we just love the texture of their ice cream. When you walk in, one employee is hand making waffle cones. There isn't much to say about this place, except about how amazing it is!

Ice cream flavors are unique and traditional. I have purchased her cookbooks to make the ice cream at home and recipes taste similar to the original. The only disadvantage is there is no convenient public restroom on site.
This is my favorite ice cream shop in DC. Great flavors and excellent customer service.

Love this shop! It's so cute and the staff is very friendly. They explained what each ice cream was made with as I sampled it before deciding on a flavor which was nice. They offer a bunch of great and unique flavors and their waffle cones are delicious. I also love that they offer a sampler flight...what a unique idea!

Was so excited to hear from a friend online that we had a Jeni's here in Charlotte. It's always one of my stops when I travel to Nashville, TN. I happened to hear about it and go by the store during the day before it officially opened, so I got in easily and was even able to sit inside. Without question, the goat cheese and cherry was amazing (along with milkiest chocolate and brown butter almond brittle). I took my mom back for opening day, but the line was too long for her to stand and wait. Will definately be back every chance I get. Fingers crossed that they decide to expand to the Park Road/Myer's Park/South Park area.

Overpriced ice cream BUT WORTH EVERY FREAKIN PENNY. Beat the after brunch or after dinner lines and just go there FOR lunch or FOR dinner! Every flavor I've had has been absolutely delicious, and the people working here are always helpful and patient.

OMG ! Orgasmic to say the least. For sure, one of my top 2 favorite brands of ice cream of all time. could very well be the best I've ever had. Jeni's is truly amazing, and well worth the 30 minute wait I endured on a Friday night for the flight of flavors. I made sure I was there early the next afternoon to beat any potential rush! My flavors of choice were the Brambleberry Crisp, Goat Cheese with Red Cherry as well as the Frose and Almond Brittle (If that's the correct name). I came in with conservative intentions only to leave with an exotic spectrum. I highly recommend the flight. You can experience a multitude of flavors in one pop. Don't deprive yourself. Jeni's is it!

Love this place!! Been here twice! Got the goat cheese/cherry ice cream each time!!! Soooo good! I also like how the shirts that are sold here are super soft and not rough and cheap. The root beer tastes old fashioned! Delicious! Service was friendly each time as well! Waffle cones are fresh and homemade!! Go Jeni it's your birthday!!! Go jeni!!! GO!
The smell of the fresh waffle cones hits you the first step inside, instant childish smile ensues. Great flavors. Can't wait to go ab
I love the ambiance of this little place in southend. The people are very friendly and give great service. It's a little pricey like $7-8 for waffle cone but the ice cream is fantastic.

We love Mitchell's and this is such a great location. It is bright and open and you can see the ice cream being made in the back! Today we took a fun tasting tour and got to learn a little more about how the ice cream was made. Our favorite is the Peanut butter fudge sundae with peanut butter chocolate chunk ice cream! But today we tried the black raspberry chocolate chunk and double chocolate chunk...both were so creamy and delicious!

Mitchell's makes some of the best ice cream hands down. There's always so many flavors, seasonal and regular, to try. The offer vegan flavors, sorbet, shakes, and cakes as well. Even if there's a line out the door, it's 100% worth the wait to get a scoop or more.

You literally cannot beat Mitchell's ice cream. I eat it daily (hate to admit it?).. I buy it at the local grocery stores as well. Favorite flavors include the seasonal campfire s'mores and cold brew. Also love ALL the vegan flavors.. even the "plain" chocolate.. seriously the best chocolate ice cream I've ever had. If you haven't tried Mitchell's yet, you are waaay behind the times. Get there ASAP!!

Yummy! Loved the ice cream and service here. Staff was friendly, nice, answered questions, and worked efficiently to fill orders for the many customers that were there the same time I was. Popular place on a Saturday afternoon! If you coffee, get the dark roast ice cream. So creamy and delicious! Wow! Very impressed with both their coffee flavors. Ate a scoop of each. Spouse enjoyed their turtle sundae! Mitchell's ice cream is fresh-tasting, smooth, creamy and delicious. Worth the trip!
The best ice cream I've ever tried! So good, I love it with the waffle cone.. this place is just amazing and you have to try
Wow! Great ice cream place! All flavors made by hand! Take almost like gelato! This place is great for family and kids! So many good good flavors hard to choose!!!!

Loved this homemade ice cream! We got the tasting trio with campfire s'mores, wild berry crumble and raspberry chocolate. The wild berry crumble was amazing!! Staff was very friendly and helpful. They let us try a couple samples since we were overwhelmed with all the tasty options. There was plenty of indoor and outdoor seating so you can relax and enjoy the delicious ice cream
Wonderful variety of flavors, lots of vegan options, fairly easy curbside pickup, and the tasting trios are ENORMOUS. So fun choosing the flavors that would go well together.

This is a fantastic ice cream place. The inside is incredibly clean and has a great decor. I sampled multiple flavors and they all were amazing. The wild berry crumble was so unique and tasteful though that I couldn't not pick it. All of my family got different flavors as well and they all loved them.
best ice cream in Cleveland. Love the owners and so happy for their success.
yummy ice cream, beautiful ceiling, funkier flavors are worth a try (like the strawberry jalapeÃ±o) -Taster trio scoops are very generous

When I moved here, Mitchell's Ice Cream was the first thing that I discovered that wasn't just good "for Cleveland," but was good "for the world." It's so delicious. Lots of old standards and nice rotating seasonal flavors. I go here like once a week. It's the jam.

The one spot locals told us to visit was Mitchell's Homemade Ice Cream. Lucky for us (and everyone) there are several locations throughout Cleveland thanks to its popularity. After visiting West Side Market in Ohio City, we stopped into the location nearby. This location is in a HUGE space. The front room has many tables, including window tables fit for children. Crayons and paper are scattered on every kid table, which our toddler loved. The back room has more tables and an area where you can watch them make the ice cream. The ice cream itself is really good, rivaling Jeni's Ice Cream (also from Ohio). Mitchell's offers dozens of flavors from standard to more creative like S'more Campfire. I went for their chocolate chip cookie dough ice cream and it was excellent. I ordered the kid sized and it was more than enough. Portions are big!
Best ice cream we've had in a long long time. Great flavor selection, lots of servers and decent prices. Wish we lived closer to come back!
I have taken many friends to Mitchell's from out of town. They all agree there is nothing quite like this place! The freshness and quality and taste and experience is incomparable!

One of Cleveland's best and most well-known food brands, Mitchell's Ice Cream has a reputation that far exceeds this Ohio City flagship, if its numerous outlets throughout Northeast Ohio are any indication. Here in Ohio City, they occupy what appears to be a former theatre space, judging by the prominent marquee outside, which has been constantly busy every time I've walked by. With good reason. There are dozens of ice cream flavors to choose from. The several I tried most recently - wildberry crumble, peanut butter chocolate chunk, and toasted pistachio - were super creamy and super delicious. Almost on par with Bi-Rite and Humphry Slocombe of the Bay Area or Toscanini's of Boston, but I'll have to do side-by-side taste tests just to be sure. To handle the crowds, there was an army of staff behind the counter operating smoothly, efficiently, and quickly.
