The line kept moving steadily and I didn't have to wait long even though I was stuck behind a large party that positively dithered their way through the flavor selection and checkout process. Folks, if you're already waiting in line, then instead of chitchatting idly and posing for ugly duckface instaselfies, it helps to take a peek at the flavors before you get to the counter, whether by spying what's clearly on offer inside the cases or by looking at prominently displayed menus. Otherwise, if you know what you want, you can treat yourself to views of their production and lab areas, visible through a large windowed wall behind the counter. Or pound out some reviews on your Yelp app. Also, I have to give Mitchell's a shout out. Having moved here recently, I was apprehensive about leaving the Bay Area for a red state. I've gotten more than my share of nasty stares from folks all around the region who look like sleeper-cell domestic terrorists, and I've also been cut off many times by otherwise super-slow drivers who suddenly get ultra-triggered when they see my out-of-state license plates. But I've also been heartened by how Ohio City is *somewhat* inclusive, diverse, and welcoming - at least performatively so - judging by how many businesses decked themselves in rainbow colors for Pride Month recently. Mitchell's was one of these. Thanks for demonstrating your support!
Mitchell's is one of the best ice cream places. There is always a wonderful variety of flavors to explore, seasonal or regular. The vegan chocolate is a must-try!

THE BEST PART ABOUT CLEVELAND. The OG location out of an old movie theatre where you can see them make the ice cream through the windows. Amazing ice cream, plenty of flavors. Honestly, not much else to say about it. It's creamy, never icy. It's never overly sweet or skimping on mix-ins. The flavors never taste artificial and the fruit ones are especially fresh. They have seasonal flavors as well. If you buy to go pints or quarts they'll give you some small cones to take home as well. Personal favorites include banana cream pie, peanut butter pretzel yogurt (I'm surprised a yogurt one made it), and wildberry crumble.

So approaching this place, you immediately wonder if you are going to see a movie or grab some ice cream. Definitely a cool entrance. The ice cream is pretty stellar and the staff is friendly and pretty amazing. I can see why this place is as popular as it is. I definitely have to give this place my recommendation.

Always good! Would highly recommend, they provide a quality product, with great customer service and pay attention to detail! No matter which location I go to, and I'm inclined to go to several! Mitchell's ROCKS! Thank you Mitchell's!

This. Ice. Cream. Is. Amazing. I recently was in Cleveland for the first time and made sure to ask the locals where to find the best ice cream in town. My question was met with a resounding "Mitchell's!!!". I decided to check out what I figured had to be overhyped ice cream shop. Boy was I wrong. I ordered two scoops, one Chocolate Peanut Butter Cup and one Turtle Brownie and that ice cream changed my life. The ice cream was creamy, rich, and absolute heaven in a cup. If you are anywhere near any Mitchell's location, it is a MUST visit - I promise you will have no regrets.
Best ice cream on the planet!!!! We often buy it and freeze it too To save it for a rainy day. Love the store too, very welcoming. the location we go to has a train going around the ceiling.

They are open for pickup only when I visited during COVID-19. I got to try one of their specialties, the Cleveland brownie sundae. It was nice and very refreshing. The portion is very generous. The service was good.
So stinking good. Just go. Just stop reading this review and go. The smells alone are unreal.

Best ice cream in Cleveland, hands down! Homemade in Cleveland, TONS of flavors (including seasonal flavors), and lots of locations in the Cleveland metro area. The workers are all friendly and happy to help you. They will give you as many samples as you ask for (and trust me, with so many flavors, you will want to try various samples to help you make your decision). I love that they offer a "taster's duo" and "taster's trio" which allows you to order two (duo) or three (trio) different flavors without having to get full scoops of each flavor. I usually go for the taster's trio so that I can get my usual Caramel Fudge Brownie + 2 seasonal flavors that are rotating on the menu at the time. If you're in the Cleveland area, go get some Mitchell's ice cream! You will be so happy you did!

Always a treat when I get Mitchell's! Seasonal special was lavender honey, amazing! Personally could do with a little less honey but that's just me! Mango sorbet is always refreshing and smooth! One of the classics I often get!

This ice cream is worth the wait! I knew after reading all the amazing reviews I had to give this place a try. We waited in line and had a chance to look over the menu and make our selections. I sampled the wild berry crumble and fresh strawberry. Both were delicious! You do not want to miss a visit here if you're in the area!
Best pistachio ice cream ever! Highly recommend this place. The milkshakes are phenomenal.
This place is amazing! I come here every Sunday to end my week with a bang, I recommend the fudge brownie!
The best ice cream I've ever tried. The price is nice and so many different flavors of ice cream. I like it! I will definitely come again.

So nice, I visited thrice! Greeted immediately upon entry. Very spacious, clean, bright and inviting. You can see them making the ice cream in the back which is neat. The flavors I tried and absolutely loved were the wild berry crumble, toasted pistachio, and salted caramel. The first time I mixed the crumble and pistachio in a waffle cone, my second time I did a sundae with salted caramel (so good!), and the last time I just did the wild berry in a waffle cone. Each time, fast and friendly service. Definitely a must try!
So many selections of tasty ice creams and cool decor inside. It's also fun to watch ice cream factory from second floor seat-in area through show window.

Hands-down best ice cream I've ever had. The fresh, local ingredients and careful preparation make their ice cream not only a delicious treat, but also a refreshing one! Every location I've been to has been consistent (which is hard to find with a chain), but the original Ohio City location definitely has an awesome atmosphere!
Good variety of ice cream especially for the prices. Professional and polite, respectful service. Seating inside and outside a good experience overall.

The best thing about Mitchells? Their vegan chocolate ice cream is literally better than any dairy-based ice cream I've ever had. Hands down. It is so creamy, velvety, and chocolatey - and all of my friends have said the same thing once I make them try it. That being said, I've also never had a bad flavor at Mitchell's. Their seasonal flavors are always on point (e.g. the coffee porter, the mint chocolate truffle, etc), and their classic flavors can't be beat (black raspberry chocolate chunk, pistachio, peanut butter, cookies and cream, bing cherry chocolate chunk, etc). Their staff are also super nice and knowledgeable about the flavors, which is fantastic when I can't decide what new flavor to try. Case in point: one day I wanted to try a new non-dairy combo, and per the staff's suggestion, I got the best smoothie I've ever had - a vegan chocolate, raspberry sorbet, and banana smoothie sent from the heavens (picture attached). When you come here, you honestly can't go wrong!
HOLY MOLY this ice cream is amazing! I'm kind of an ice cream snob and this is one of my all time favorites. It tasted fresh, flavorful, and smooth but also filling.
Wonderful ice cream! Definitely find the time to stop and treat yourself while you are in Cleveland.
Ice cream is good but it would be great to have different vegan flavors except for the same 2-3 for the past few years.

SO into Mitchell's I immediately had to write about it. First and most important--this ice cream is THE BOMB. I know this probably going to sound like a bold statement but it might be the best ice cream I've ever had. At least the best Rocky Road and the best Banana Pie ice cream I've ever had. I did a taster's cup of the two flavors and they paired perfectly together and did my mouth very well. Creamy, the right amount of flavor and mixins, natural banana (the artificial stuff is the worst) and a good, deep chocolate base for the Rocky Road. Yes yes yes. The staff here is real nice and the gal was very patient as I struggled to pick a flavor (it's pleasantly overwhelming). Tried the two I went with and was sold. The space is so cute--the marquee out from repurposed from the old theatre that I think they've converted to the shop (locals, don't hold it against me if I'm wrong on that). The space is really huge with tons of lovely natural light plus communal tables for seating. There's even a row of lower counters and small chairs for kids. Behind the counters are huge windows where you can see the ice cream in production. Which is pretty neat if you're into that sort of thing (which I am). Take a pint to go (I wish it would last for my 3 hour drive back home) and get some of their peanuts/chocolate sauce/etc to go to make your own sundaes at home. They also have cakes and cones to take home as well. Or just eat in and go to town on their myriad of awesome flavors.

I live across the street from here and it's dangerous considering I'm an absolute ice cream slut. Love their seasonal flavors and trying new flavors whenever I go. The line gets long but they usually knock it down pretty quickly. Fun fact: they have ice cream cakes that are really good as well! I somehow didn't know this until recently and snagged one for my girlfriends birthday. They even putting writing on it for free if you go when they aren't too busy
I would give them five stars but the turtle sundae at honey hut is better. But it's still a good place.
I'm not fond of this ice cream. It tastes thin to me. Maybe not enough milk fat. A lot like old fashioned ice milk.

Wow..Wow...Wow....man if this place isn't an ice cream lovers Dream. Just outstanding, great flavors, great taste and they make sure the flavors have a good amount of ingredients (ex..berry, lemon cookie, brownie etc). We loved it soooo much that we went twice. Highly recommend but be patient as the lines can get long.
Absolutely the best ice cream in Cleveland. They have so many flavors to choose from. It's also really cool to see them make the ice cream at the west 25th location

I accidentally muttered "I need some alone time with this ice cream" when I took my first bite of this ice cream. And if that doesn't define how good Mitchell's is I don't know how else to! For real, the ice cream here is rich and dense. I was flabbergasted at how they could have the flavors be so good but not overwhelming. My friends had a good laugh at my statement but I truly meant it. It was a delight to have the caramel fudge brownie flavor melt In my mouth and I haven't tasted anything like it. Will be back in Cleveland in the next year and can't wait to try more of their flavors!

It's good ice cream. I'm just here to rate the rotation of flavors. New vegan ones! So I had to have my tried-and-true praline pecan. The pumpkin spice was too gordy and the autumn apple was an acidic big miss.
I wish I could eat here everyday,lol. Amazing menu and setup, this place is A+ Always take guests from out of town here for this amazing ice cream!

I've been hearing about Mitchell's Homemade Ice Cream for a long time, and it totally lived up to the hype! We stopped by on a recent weekday, and even though it was an odd time, they had quite the crowd. That being said, they were efficiently moving people through the line. They also offered floats and sundaes and local soda pops, but we were on a mission! Just ice cream for us today, please! So we picked our ice creams, Campfire S'mores for me, my wife went with cookies and cream and a scoop of coffee, and some blue ice cream for my kiddo. I apologize, I don't remember what that one is called, but it's literally glowing bright blue (funny how kids always seem to pick this option!) Anyways, mine was creamy and delicious, with a Graham cracker crumble added right in. My wife gave me a night of the coffee, and it was a perfect balance of butter coffee and creamy ice cream goodness! I was not offered any cookies and cream or the blue concoction, so I can only assume they were enjoyed very much. Based on my kiddo groaning in disappointment when he realized he had eaten all of his, I think he enjoyed it very much! But then the coolest part of the whole thing for me, we walked towards the back, and there was a hallway. Down the hallway, they have a wall Ethan is all windows, and we were able to watch as the staff mixed and made various ice creams! Really, really cool! My son was super excited watching them. Please give Mitchell's a try when you are nearby! Definitely worth the visit!

I really liked that you can see the ice cream factory in action. And my peanut butter chocolate was good. And the size of a single scoop is huge! And the price fair. But both my wife and I felt the ice cream was a little too sweet. And for that reason if we were going out for ice cream again in Cleveland we would try another place. I suppose if we had split a single scoop it would have been ok.

LITERALLY THE BEST ICE CREAM I'VE EVER HAD! My fiancÃ© and I visit Cleveland pretty often as we're big Cavs fans. I always have to stop by Mitchell's whenever we're here. I'm a huge fan of their fudge brownie caramel and birthday cake. During the Christmas season, the amaretti one is to die for!!! There is plenty of seating downstairs and upstairs. Also, you get a great view of the factory when you're upstairs!

Just happened to be in the area and stumbled upon this place! I'm a sucker for homemade ice cream so I had to try it even though I'd just eaten lunch. It was surprisingly empty this Friday afternoon. I'm basically never in Cleveland so I wanted to try a few flavors while I had the chance. Overall, all were very well-flavored, creamy, and just the right sweetness. I got the "Taster's Trio" with the Vanilla Bean, Fresh Mint Chocolate Chunk, and Fresh Strawberry. Vanilla is always a good benchmark for any I've cream shop and Mitchell's is excellent! The mint chocolate was nicely minty and according to their website it's all natural mint which is what I look for (I generally stay away from artificially colored/flavored mint ice cream). Strawberry was also fantastic; this didn't make a difference to me but theirs didn't have chunks of strawberry like some other places do, for whatever it's worth. Portion is pretty generous too. Overall great experience. Services was prompt and friendly. The shop itself is very clean and organized. I don't live around here so I don't know what the ice cream scene is like in Cleveland but I can still confidently say it's with the trip if you're in the area.

Mitchell's ice cream is the best ice cream I have tried in Ohio! I love the array of flavors and the variety. My favorites are the key lime pie, banana cream pie, and amaretto cookie (when it was still available). Going to miss this ice cream now that I've moved away from Cleveland. Also loved that pints of this were sold in a giant Eagle close to where I lived.

I was really craving ice cream and visited this place. It had really good reviews. I ordered the praline which was really really good. I also had a scoop of the brownie with caramel which was OK. The service was very prompt. Also my boyfriend got the brownie sundae and he added cookies and cream ice cream to it. He really loved it.

I started to go to Mitchell's in grade school when it first opened. 15 years later, I am still such a huge fan, including all their locations. The W 25th location is different then all the others because although it doesn't feel as homey as other locations, it does still have the amazing ice cream. What's cool about this location is they made it fit the feel of West 25. Industrial but still true to their brand. You can see how the Ice Cream is made, you're able for tours, and obviously, there are plenty of flavors to try! What's great about Mitchell's too is they offer a handful of ice cream that are dairy free, but don't lack flavor in one bit. Overall, this is just another great location of Mitchell's that offers delicious ice cream and customer service!
THE BEST ICE CREAM IN CLEVELAND! Hands down. Be sure to try their seasonal flavors: right now they've got coconut, mint cookies and cream and s'mores. AMAZING!!

I stop by there after dining nearby, they really had the social distancing stuff going on I thought that was pretty cool. I realize though that part of the ice cream experience is the social aspect of it. However I cannot take away from the deliciousness of the salted caramel milkshake that I got. It actually beat out the peanut butter milkshake that I used to get about three hours south of here. Overall I say to snaps up Mitchells

I have lived in another city where I did not eat my favorite dessert, Icecream, because there was just not good selection. I have to say the first time I built my bravery to try Mitchell's I was pleasantly surprised. Now it is my second favorite Icecream company! Simply delicious!
Good stuff. Nothing else needed. They make good quality ice cream. Ask anyone from Cleveland, and they've been there. I love the peppermint candy cane one in the winter. Really unique.

All I can say after visiting Mitchell's is, you have not tasted real ice cream until you have tasted their homemade perfection. After trying it, I will find it hard to get a half gallon from the store, or go to a place that sells ice cream like that. Mitchell's is the real deal, and if you are in Cleveland, passing through Cleveland, or even just relatively near the area, do yourself a favor and go try it for yourself. They have a huge selection of homemade flavors. My brother, who lives in the area, says that many of their flavors are seasonal which makes for a fresh and exciting experience each and every time you visit. Although they have a variety of more standard flavors that you can get all the time. All are homemade and delicious, they will let you sample before you choose if you are having a hard time deciding. We visited in the fall and opted for an apple crisp flavor which was good, but the real winner was the wildberry crumble. It was out of this world! I still dream of this ice cream, the real fruit mixed with the ice cream, crispy crumble bits was just delicious. My brother and sister-in-law suggested getting a waffle cone which I would recommend as well to hold all of the big portions, and 2 scoops was good but plenty. By far the best ice cream I have ever had. Do yourself a favor and try it for yourself! This will be a must stop each time we visit Cleveland!

I will honestly never get Cleveland's obsession with Mitchell's. I would say Graeter's and so many other ice creams are much better. It just is mind boggling to me why everyone acts like this ice cream is amazing. All other locations of Mitchell's for me are a solid 3 stars because the ice cream is average. Nothing to write home about; also not terrible. I REALLY do not like their chocolate or vanilla ice creams and when you can't get those right, it's hard to make a fan out of me. However, I've recently tried the shakes and I got a Peanut Butter one at this location and I enjoyed it. However, I hate that they only have one size of a milkshake. It ends up wasting money and food when you only offer one size, which would be most other place's medium or large. It's just too much and I can't even imagine how many calories are in that thing. Yikes! This location gets a 4 star review from me because it is the flagship location and is a cool place to take out-of-towners after a bite to eat or drinks in Ohio City. So all told, ice cream is a solid 3/average. This location is fun though and has good, efficient service.

Good ice cream flavor selections, warm customer service and you can actually see the factory behind the counter. Limited seasonal flavors offered, price reasonable. We had cookies and cream and cookie dough.
Seriously, how can you go wrong here? Delicious flavors, all the right sundaes etc, enthusiastic staff, and delicious ice cream. Did I mention the ice cream?
I go to the Mitchell's in Rocky River, Ohio. Ice cream and offerings delicious. Staff is excellent in customer service. Portions great. Love Mitchell's!
Great Ice Cream every time I have been there the ice cream is awesome the customer service is great 5 stars all the way
The Ohio City store is so much fun to eat at and watch them make ice cream. They have fantastic ice cream.

Had my favorite, a scoop of Key Lime ice cream, complete with graham crumbles. It's delicious and fresh. Everyone ordered outside. (Cones are not available right now.) The order comes out in a bag with your scoops in cup containers. Very efficient and friendly. In Ohio City.

I love the OG location of Mitchell's. It's spacious and you can see the workers make the ice cream from the glass window. I feel like Mitchell's is such a Cleveland staple, and is so beloved by many of the locals. You have to come here at least once if you're visiting!
One of the best ice cream shops in Cleveland and the surrounding areas. The always have vegan options.

I used to go to the Warrensville VanAken location but the attitude of the young white male that works there is DEPLORABLE! The last time I went was early February and he was a text book RACIST at heart. He was extremely friendly and professional to the white family in front of me which made me feel that are experience was going to be just as friendly and professional. Nope. When I walked up to the counter he didn't say "hi welcome to Mitchell's. How can I help you." He just stared at me. I stared back. He finally said "what can I get for you?" I placed my order and when it was time to pay for it he didn't take my money until I sat it on the counter and he placed my change on the counter. I'm done with this RACIST location!!! I now patronize the BEACHWOOD location. They very friendly, professional and it's worth the drive!!!

Mitchell's has some really good ice cream. I mean, it's no East Coast Custard, but the variety almost makes up for it. There are tons of unique choices each time, and plenty of old standbys. The Ohio City location is cool. Nice and roomy and bright, and the train that goes around the restaurant is soothing. It is best to go to the second floor, where you can watch them making ice cream. And a perk is that it stays open til midnight on weekends. Score after a few beers at Nano Brew!

So far this is the only place to rival my favorite Ice cream shop I've ever been to. I will definitely be keeping this on my radar when I make it back to the Cleveland area. The salted caramel ice cream is pretty much perfection.

If you cannot fight temptation - better not go anywhere near Mitchell's Homemade Ice Cream (we go to the Eton store). Their ice creams are little slurps of HEAVEN . You can tell that they use the BEST ingredients in their homemade ice creams - and the components added are the BEST quality (ie: nuts, fruits, candies, cookies, etc) I've not been there since the lock down for COVID-19, but they are probably available for carry out! TREAT YOURSELF to something so delicious, you'll wonder why you hadn't gone there already!!

Delicious ice cream! I came here after a baseball game. It's very bright and clean looking. You can walk to the back and see where the ice cream is made. They have huge machines that look like kitchenaid mixers. I had the coffee chocolate chunk (I think that was the name). If you love the taste of coffee - this is a must! It had huge chunks of chocolate and was very creamy and rich. If you buy a container of ice cream to take home, they even give you some sugar comes to take home! Ah, if I lived here, I would definitely gain weight because I would be here all the time!
Ivan shopping at Michelle's homemade ice cream for the past three years and I love every minute of it I have a lot a variety with ice cream it was so super delicious I would go back

I'd give more than 5 stars if I could. I am married to a man who Lives for good ice cream, as avid travelers we have eaten ice cream all over the world and the best we've had to date? Mitchell's in Ohio City. While on a 30 hour visit to Cleveland we came here twice. We tried: (pls do not judge) Pistachio (hands down best pistachio EVAH!) Peach (fresh tasty super peach flavor!) Chocolate chocolate chip (rich with ample chunks of dk chocolate) Salted caramel (good but not my favorite) S'mores (chock full of homemade graham crackers) Banana cream (S U P E R B not even kidding try it) Rocky road (great balance of crunch salted almonds, chocolate and marshmallow) Key lime (SO F R E A K I N G GOOD- no joke if you are remotely a key lime person treat yo' self! ) Caramelized Chocolate - sophisticated taste There was a whole dressed up wedding party there doing wedding pics while we were there - I totally get it now. Cherish the gift of Mitchell's Cleveland.

Yoooo, Mitchell's is the BEST. It's family owned, heavily involved in the community, & makes the best ice cream in town, hands down. Their pralines & cream ice cream is so freaking good, with caramelly ribbons spun through each scoop. The shop is always clean, its staff always friendly, & it's always cool to peek behind the scenes through the glass dividers to see exactly how the ice cream is made.

This place is an adorable, hipster-feel, able-to-see-the-factory, GREAT PRODUCTS all around cool icecream shop. My first time here, I can see why my Cleveland-native friends mandated that we go here. All of the flavors I tried were really yummy. And it was even better because the workers literally urge you to try as many as you want, so (1) you don't feel bad and (2) you can make a good decision on what to get! I ended up getting the taster's duo, in which you can choose 2 flavors in junior scoop size. It was a good amount, and I was even sharing with one person. I got the caramel fudge brownie and the banana cream pie. Both were to die for. And this was even with it being 30 degrees outside. SO YUMMY! A must try, definitely.

This. Is. The. Best. Vegan. Ice cream. I've. Ever. Had. If you're ever in the area, I would not recommend leaving the area until you get a scoop (or five) here. Walking in, you're greeted with basically the Willy Wonka factory of ice cream shops. They give tours to folks who are interested, but we can here for business. Usually when I go to an ice cream shop, I only get like one or two vegan choices. This spot had a fruit flavor, chocolate, and sea salt caramel. Every single was was so incredible and clearly freshly made. Best part- everything is made with coconut milk so my nut free friends are also happy. I asked for one scoop, but they were so happy to see my job, I got the largest one scoop I've ever seen. My friend with me raved about the blue cosmo so if you don't have any dietary needs, highly recommend trying it. Enjoy!

My husband and I recently visited Cleveland and after walking around for a little bit stumbled upon Mitchell's - a local chain of ice cream stores - while strolling in Ohio City. Less than 12 hours later and we were eating Mitchell's again at another location in Shaker Heights - it's that good. This location seems to be the original - it's set in an old theater, which is cool, and has a lot of cool features. It's clean, decorated in a bright and airy way with tons of natural light and ample seating (with small chairs/low counters for the kids to have their own seating), a cute model train that circles the shop, and in addition to that you can see the staff actually making the ice cream and sweet treats in the large open kitchen behind the display cases. There's also a second floor with tons of seating and another area to view the ice cream-making process in the kitchen, from a birds' eye view! The ice creams we tried were all super creamy, with a mix of standard, creative, and seasonal flavors. My husband got a super fudgy vegan chocolate mint truffle flavor and the porter chocolate chunk (exclusive to this location, with beer from a local brewery with giant dark chocolate chunks), which I was super impressed with. I'm not a beer drinker, but this porter chocolate chunk tasted like the best porter you could imagine. I had a junior scoop of the pralines and cream, which was delicious and classic! The price point is super reasonable and I could see myself coming here often if we lived in the area. The scoops are generous and filling. Definitely make your way here if you're craving ice cream and in the area - highly recommend!

Delicious ice cream! I really liked the cherry chocolate chip, and loved that they use real cherries and not the nasty cough syrup kind. They seem to be taking covid seriously. This appears to be a really popular spot and I can see why.

I came here on a rainy day because why not right? I got the black raspberry chocolate chunk in a waffle cone. It was delicious! The chocolate chunks were nice and soft and the ice cream had a great black raspberry taste. There was a line when I went but it went by quickly. There are many flavors to choose from. I asked two guys in front of me if they had any recommendations and one of them said that the black raspberry chocolate chunk is one of his favorites. He was right.
Key lime ice cream is the best!!!!! You really can't go wrong with any flavor! Staff is amazing as well.
Best Ice cream In town... bing cherry chocolate chip, key lime pie are just phenomenal. Been coming around for years and have yet to find a reason not to keep coming back

We are thrilled to have this ice cream parlor in Cleveland. I love that they use natural ingredients and the cherries are REAL. The ice cream is tasty and there are a wide variety of flavors, including vegan. It's a little pricey, but worth it for a treat. The staff is friendly and move quickly.
One of the best ice creams I've ever had in my life! I've only tried the banana cream pie and they are very generous with the scooping!! Also the interior is beautiful and bright.

Oh goodie! This place is super cute and huge! It used to be a old theater and now it's an ice cream factory! We got the sampler (2 scoops) cherry chocolate chip and mango sherbet. Soo tasty. There's an upstairs that you can hangout and watch the how they work through a glass. Would recommend it!
Make sure to visit 25th store and take the tour ! I've cream flavors to suit everyone

Its not often I try and new Ice Cream place and get conflicted on where it stands in the top 5 ice cream places I have been; and I have been to plenty.. and I must say this place is among the top 5. The flavor and quality really come through. Come to thing of it, most of the best ice creams I have had, are based in Michigan, Wisconsin and Ohio area. Any how, I was passing by Cleveland enroute to Pitts and stopped by to see what the deal is about. Their vanilla, Chocolate, and Banana flavors are just awesome. So good, came back 2 more time, so you get the drift. If you are around the area definitely wing by. Its worth the hype.

We did a Google search to find the best ice cream in Cleveland, and it directed us to Mitchell's. What a fantastic recommendation. We had cotton candy ice cream, which took me right back to my childhood, and strawberry cheesecake ice cream. The girls that worked there were so friendly and allowed us to sample different flavors. Overall a wonderful experience!

In the 48 hours I was in Cleveland, I went to Mitchell's twice...which I think speaks for itself. The ice cream is AMAZING and you get unlimited samples. I tried the Wildberry Crumble, which was wonderful. What's really cool is that you can see into the "factory" and watch how everything is made. The store is held in an old theatre, which really adds to the charm too. Even as a visitor, I could tell that Mitchell's is a definite favorite for locals and tourists; the place was always packed. Fun Fact: The "C's" of Ohio have competing ice cream stores: Cleveland-Mitchell's Cincinnati-Graeter's Columbus-Jeni's
Best ice cream in Cleveland. Their staff is friendly the curbside pickup due to COVID is convenient and efficient. Highly recommend!
Good lord this place is simply heaven. I will stop at every Mitchell's I ever see no questions asked.

This ice cream is the BEST. We wait every holiday for the peppermint ice cream and it never disappoints! And the double chocolate or chocolate chunk (I think that's the name) is out of this world. You can't go wrong.
This great gourmet ice-cream place was a great Cleveland find. I got a scoop of Lavender Honey, Toasted Pistachio, and Fetish Sessions Maple Walnut ice-cream.
The best ice cream. Parking situation is a little rough because of location near west side market. But definitely worth it. Fast paced line, lots of options, and plenty of seating.

Price: 8 Quality: 10 Service: 10 Atmosphere: 10 Overall: 9.5 Usually coming to ice cream places my brother doesn't get anything but the vegan chocolate ice cream here was so good he got a whole waffle cone full of it! I got the black cherry chocolate chunk which was TO DIE FOR! My mom and brothers Gf got peanut butter chocolate chunk- both were amazing!! We will be returning before we leave OH and we will miss it when we head home! If you only have time to visit one ice cream place in OH Mitchell's is the one to visit!!
Best ice cream in Ohio, Nay.... the US..... Nay... the world. Seasonal flavors that will render you speechless. Truly scrumtrulescent.

Decent ice cream spot in Cleveland. Apparently this place is popular that a long line is outside the door! I was just another out-of-towner seeing what else seems cool on the trendy/hipsterish West 25th street. I went in there before it got busy, when there was no line. Mitchell's has dozens of flavors. I really wish they would've displayed all of their flavors ON THE WALL instead of some dinky laminated menu which would have caused me to get to the back of the line. All the other ice cream places do that, I'm just saying. Hint hint! I did settle for the Banana Cream Pie, which was delish. Would have loved to try their over flavors, which can be found at a lot of other ice cream spots anywhere. I asked the cashier (who wasn't that friendly) what Mitchell's signature flavor was but she didn't know. Still, it's a nice place in a historic building.

Mitchell's has a few locations in the area, but this one is my favorite because 1) there's plenty of space to hang out with a bigger group, and 2) you can actually watch them make the ice cream in the factory! I've never had a bad flavor here. I'm partial to the banana cream pie flavor - if you haven't tried this flavor yet, do yourself a favor and get a scoop next time. I'm also a big fan of the raspberry chocolate chunk and the amaretto cookie flavors. They're pretty heavy-handed with the scoops, so one scoop is more than enough for me. The only downside to this location is that there's always someone outside asking for money. Today, two different guys came through the building asking customers if they could spare any cash. Just expect that when you come down to West 25th St area. Other than that, I would highly recommend giving this place a try! You won't be disappointed.

I've been to Mitchell's and their other location for a very long time. This Mitchell's in particular is the best. They have all the workers behind the counter with all the packaging of the ice cream. The ice cream is one of Cleveland's classic. And lastly if I'm not mistaken, this is the only place that has the porter coffee ice cream. It's one of the Great Lakes brewery flavors I've only gotten here at this location. The only downside to this place is the parking situation. But other than that, I would recommend this place to anyone visiting Cleveland.

We stopped for ice cream last Friday evening. The variety here is excellent with flavors you don't find elsewhere. I shared two scoops with my wife: strawberry rhubarb crisp, and pralines and cream. These were both exceptionally good. This is an institution in the Cleveland area, and there are a couple of other locations. This is definitely worth a stop when you are in the mood for a treat.
I love Mitchell's. The taste is always a consistent high quality. Flavors are delicious
Love Mitchell's! Best ice cream in Cleveland. I love the coffee chocolate chip If youre in Cleveland and have a sweet tooth you should swing by and check it out!

This is the Mitchell's magic mothership! The factory! One of the best ice cream makers in North America, right up there with McConnell's of Santa Barbara. In an old theatre building in Ohio City, just across the bridge from Cleveland, they have a store in the front, and almost nothing to tell you to walk around to the side and see ice cream being made back there, behind a pristine glass window. So many great fresh flavors! I really don't eat ice cream much, but I will get a sampler sized cup of their pistachio any day of the week, if I'm in the area. The mouthfeel, and the quality of their ingredients make every bite worth the price, and the long lines that are often found at their stores on a sweltering August day. Ben and Jerry's Vermont Flagship. Here. McConnells in Santa Barbara. The three stations of the Holy Grail of Ice Cream.
I personally don't see what the hype is about honestly. I would rather have anyone else.

This isn't a review of the store per se. I just polished off what I thought was a pint of key lime pie, and it was delicious. However, that's where the love affair ends. My "pint" was 1/3 two big air bubbles so, yeah, I feel pretty ripped off for my 7 bucks.
They have oil free vegan options! I love the sorbet and the salted caramel! They are so efficient with the service too!

This was my first time bringing my son. I adore ice cream and since we were in the area, I knew exactly where to come. The restaurant was busy as it was a busy holiday weekend and people were out enjoying the amazing 80 degree day. The restaurant was clean and it was really cool to see the big production in the kitchen of all the workers making ice cream through the various stages. Our ice cream was so good! The two single restrooms are gender neutral now, if you care about that. Shorter wait for me now as it used to be a line for the ladies and none for the guys. Courteous employees and amazing ice cream. Be prepared to spend $5 or so, but totally worth it.

When it comes to NE Ohio Ice Cream Mitchell's Homemade Ice Cream should be on everyone's list for top ice cream in the area. In my opinion, there is nothing else like Mitchell's. With over two dozen flavors, fully stocked at all times, it's almost impossible to leave and not find something you like. Although every "famous" ice cream shop has a "signature" ice cream, I'm not familiar that Mitchell's does. Every single time I've been here I've tried a different flavor and every single time I had nothing bad to say about it. If it's either the brownie sundae, milkshake or traditional ice cream cone, you will not be disappointed with that this place has to offer. The coolest part is being able to look behind the glass windows and see the daily operations of ice cream making. Grab some ice cream and watch the employees make it fresh right in front of you. You will not be disappointed

Always fresh!! Always good! Customer service was just aiiight. I've been treated weird there, given a few side looks.yep cuz I'm black! Has happened a few times too. And the manager was super rude! He took a call at the register while I waited patiently to pay for my ice cream, but a white woman walked up and he quickly got off the phone ready to help, but he already knew... don't even try to skip over me and wait on her, he didn't and I paid and left! Jerk

This review is for my 6 yr old since I'm, meh, on most ice cream. Like most 6 yr olds he has no sense of direction, that is until we are in a 5 block radius of Mitchell's. Then his internal GPS switches on and he can give me all scenarios on how to get there. His brain has also locked in on all the names of the ice creams, the samples he's tried and if he had previously gotten them in a cup or cone. Mitchell's is his first choice for ice cream and will repeated ask before bed, "When's the next time we can go to Mitchell's?" On the parent side, I like the bright and airy space, the ever friendly workers behind the counter as well as the ice cream makers behind the glass that let us stare at them while they create their magical ice cream.
Was just passing thru the town. Ice cream was so good I would go back whenever I am in town.

Anytime I visit Cleveland, Mitchell's Homemade Ice Cream is a must stop for me. Mitchell's offers an array of homemade flavors ranging from creamy vanilla & cookie dough to caramelized chocolate chocolate ice cream. What. My favorite thing they offer is the tasters duo which is two different smaller scoops of ice cream if you cannot decide, however it's still a good amount of ice cream. If you're looking for the real deal on ice cream, Mitchell's is where it's at.

Really cool spot. I tried the Campfire S'mores flavor - it was incredible! It even had a touch of smokey campfire flavor. Nuts! The building itself is a work of art and it's cool that you can watch them actually make the ice cream right then and there. Was worth the stop. And the line.

Literally this is the best icecream you can eat in Ohio. I tried Brpwnie Sandae and got a big bown for $6.5. I don't mean the price worth it! No! The price is surprisingly low for the quality and taste you get.

By far the best place I've ever had ice cream. All fresh, and homemade. At this location you can see the production facility where the ice cream is all made. They do an outstanding job of always having different, seasonal options available. My personal favorites have been the strawberry rhubarb crisp and the key lime pie, both summer seasonals. My fiance is a big fan of the campfire s'more, another summer seasonal. I always get the waffle cone, because the servings here are pretty large, and seem to fit in the waffle cone a little better. Be prepared to wait a little to get your ice cream because there is almost always a line here, but it keeps moving. It is a little more than you plan to pay for ice cream, but definitely worth the price. You can buy ice cream to go, where they will give you dry ice and a small cooler to travel, we have used this to send a gift to family in Buffalo, NY. Best ice cream I've had anywhere. Always an option to stop in while we're visiting West 25th.

Probably my favorite ice cream in Cleveland, by a hair though. Love the variety of flavors and seasonals. Best of all though, I love the ice cream cakes. YUMMMM. Staff is always great and somehow I always manage to escape the huge lines that always form. Pro tip 1: you can order custom cakes (any ice cream you want) for pick up and depending on the day, they might be made fresh! Pro tip 2: if you/your friends don't mind sharing, getting a prepacked pint or quart is a really good deal. They even throw in a few sugar or cake cones for free!

Oh Mitchell's, how I love your ice cream! I particularly love the seasonal flavors that this place makes. On my most recent visit, there was an autumn apple ice cream on the seasonal board - a cider ice cream with caramel swirl and almonds, that I had as a caramel sundae. It was delightful. My only complaint is the amount of nuts used in the recipes - for those with nut allergies (not myself, but one of my friends who was with me), Mitchell's can seem limiting. He ended up with a scoop filled with brownie chunks that he was very happy with. Scoops are generous, the ice cream is rich & satisfying, and I have never been unhappy with a choice I've made at Mitchell's!

Yum! This building is COOL and smells DELICIOUS. The ice cream is delicious to boot with great flavor options and VERY FAIR prices. You can even walk by the room where they are making the ice cream fresh--you see them chopping mint, making chocolate, stirring in cream. You actually see more actual ice cream making here than you do at the Ben and Jerry's factory tour up in VT! Great old building and great ice cream.
Place is always packed so naturally had to try it , had peanut butter shake was great

Mitchell's is a local ice cream company. They carry only the best ingredients. They offer vegan, gluten-free and traditional ice cream's. I love the fact that they have seasonal flavors which means it's going to keep you coming back at least every quarter to try the new seasonal flavor. If you'd rather just buy a pint and go home they have that option here too. One of the great things I love about many of the Mitchell ice cream stores is that many times they'll have a large viewing glasses to actually watch the production of ice cream being made.

I'm a huge Mitchell's fan and I'm a vegan - that should really tell you something since they only have 4-5 vegan flavors (2 sorbet, 1 seasonal) in their giant selection of amazing flavors! This location is especially great - located in an old movie theater, in one of the hippest neighborhoods of Cleveland, where you can watch the ice cream being made while enjoying it yourself! They also have upstairs and outdoor seating. That should be enough to convince you to run right over and get a scoop! (or two.. or a pint to take home..)

Creamiest ice cream I've ever had! So delicious and so many flavors! The team of employees is huge, always with a smile and always ready to give you a sample scoop to get an idea of which flavored are the best. I went with coffee and fudge this time and just a junior size scoop was enough for me. The place is large enough to accommodate any size group with upstairs and downstairs seating. My group of five loved it. The line moved so fast even though it started out the door! Perfect for a family treat or to satisfy a late night craving. Some flavors rotate so I'll be returning for sure now that the weather is getting warmer. Although I can't lie I love it in the winter too. The back of the shop looks like a Willy wonka factory where you can get a glimpse into how the ice cream is made. Very cool setting and it always looks so clean. I want some more right now haha

Mitchell's is worth the calories! I hadn't been to this particular location before, so I was surprised by how huge it is! I got the taster's duo with the caramel apple and amaretti cookie flavors. Both were excellent and had great texture. My fiance got one of the sundaes, and he was happy with his also. I've never been disappointed by anything I've gotten at Mitchell's, and I'll definitely be back!

Delicious ice cream. They give you a lot of samples. Their yogurt based ice cream is amazing! Not too sweet and you can really taste the flavor. They are nice and allow you ask lots of questions. The seating area is nice too. Plenty of space. Very open.

I was from the school that all ice cream was created equal. After my visit here, I stand corrected. First, the line was long but they keep it moving with Chic-fil-a-like efficiency. The shop was very clean. The staff was very friendly and attentive to all customers that I saw. The shop is located outside of downtown and there is limited street parking available as well as paid parking lot. I ordered a toasted pistachio sundae with pecans, whipped cream and caramel, with a cheery on top. I do not know what they did to there ice cream, but it tasted much better than other places' ice cream. If it could not get any better, the prices are super reasonable compared to other ice cream joints.

This Mitchell's is really cool because of its unique entrance (see pics) and the ability to see the ice cream being made in the factory on site. The icrecream is always good and you can't go wrong with a sundae either. Watch out for seasonal flavors too! I really like the carmelized chocolate in the summer. It's a hit it miss with service- sometimes you get a nice person, sometimes you don't. Usually you get a good portion, but sometimes you don't. Parking can be tricky at this location, so you might find it best to walk BUT there is some street parking and a large paid parking lot in that back.
Best ice cream in Cleveland by far! My favorite is the wild berry crumble and the coffee!

Okay Mitchell's, I see you. This place was so yummy. The peach ice cream was DELICIOUS. The single scoop is actually huge and helps justify the higher price. Everything I tasted from friends was also yummy. BIG TIME RECOMMEND!

This ice cream spot was amazing. My girlfriend and I were just driving around, while visiting Cleveland, and we stumbled upon this place. The outside entrance of the building looked so cool, that we had to try it. Plus it was a very hot summer night, and some ice cream sounded about right. We noticed right away there was a long line to order, so right off the bat we knew that was a good sign. I ordered a waffle cone with chocolate peanut butter cup flavor. It was delicious. I loved their peanut butter chocolate combo. My girlfriend went with a cup with three different scoops. She had cookies and cream, wildberry, and smores. Each flavor was excellent and so good. Their ice cream really hits the spot. Some of the best ice cream I ever had. This place is a must visit, if your in the mood for some good ice cream.
Definition of fun and fresh! There are so many flavors! GREAT staff and plenty of seating! Thank you for the experience.
Great place for great ice cream, their Honey Lavender flavor is my absolute favorite! The location is on a busy-ish intersection and the parking lot is minimal, but I'll walk a block to get to them.

Oh I love love love love this place my favorite ice cream in the world is the raspberry sorbet goodness gracious and the place is so clean the employees are so nice and so friendly and the prices are very reasonable

God, I love this ice cream. The flavors aren't like,, wild, but they're quality. They have depth, they've got dimension. Mitchell's has been a staple in my life in Cleveland for like 6 years and anyone who visits Cleveland HAS to stop by Mitchell's. Even their super simple flavors like cookie dough are amazing. In fact, that's my favorite. BUT if you like chocolate and fruit flavors, the bing cherry chocolate chunk is stellar

I can see why the lines to this place are so long! This creamery is the perfect way to cap off a meal. I love how you can see the ice cream being churned and molded in the back of the store. I also love how white and clean the interior is and the rustic picnic tables outside. I personally love all the fruit flavors like strawberry, blueberry crumble, black cherry (though I wish this had less chocolate in it... for me it's overwhelming but I am not a big chocolate fan), and any of the sorbets. I also always get a fresh waffle cone I would definitely say get a junior size. Even that is plenty and can be shared.

I stopped here randomly because I saw that it was busy and I was not disappointed! I got strawberry ice cream and it was so good! The ingredients tasted fresh. There was a good selection of flavors to choose from and I liked that this place was more local to Cleveland. I hadn't heard of this place before but I would come back! One thing I didn't like, though, is that they got my e-mail when I checked out and they kept sending me a stupid amount of e-mails. How many ice cream updates can one shop give? Other than that, no complaints!
Mitchell's is the ice cream capital of Cleveland. The ice cream maintains a creamy texture while incorporating a variety of flavors. My personal favorite is the pistachio!!!

Ice cream was so yummy. I had the Carmel brownie ice cream. I should've gotten two scoops, it was so good! The line was long but moved really fast. The staff there was friendly and worked quickly to get us all served. We were able to watch them making ice cream. The workers were friendly, waving to the kids and mouthing through the sound proof glass what they were working on. Definitely a place to stop while in Cleveland.

Ok, let's just face it, I'm staying fat forever because it's not worth giving up places like this. I'm a huge ice cream fan and Mitchell's did not disappoint. Had a triple: Rocky Road, Salted Caramel and PB Cup. Favorite was PB Cup! Looking forward to bringing the kids here!

Wild berry crumble and Banana Cream Pie are LEGENDARY! I also had some other awesome flavors recently too! YES! Almond cookie & the beer flavored one! Absolutely stunning! Very creamy and delicious! Two of my favorite icecream flavors and I'm excited to try more! Banana cream pie is super accurate! Lots of flavor options, great service, you can buy pints! It's homemade (and you can taste it) what's not to like!? The atmosphere in here feels like your in a chocolate factory BUT ICECREAM! Even better! Very modern and clean! I love this place! Very inviting with awesome flavors!

It's rare to find ice cream better than Mitchell's! The location is adorable-an old theater. The marquee on the outside announces the seasonal flavors. Mitchell's always allows you to sample any and all ice creams that you're interested in. My favorites are key lime pie, coconut chocolate chunk and porter chocolate chunk. If you take a pint or a quart to go, complimentary ice cream cones are included. You can enjoy your treat on the second floor overlooking the kitchen where cooks are constantly working to make ice cream. Their hours are also great. They're open late so you can stop in after dinner, the bar or a concert. Mitchell's is a stop everyone must make when they're in Cleveland!

Mitchell's Ice Cream is the best ice cream shop in Cleveland. The staff is always friendly, the samples are always generous, and the flavors are to die for. I always look forward to the seasonal flavors, but love the classics like caramel fudge brownie as well! I have friends who are vegan and lactose intolerant and their favorite flavors are the vegan (coconut-based) chocolate and vegan salted caramel. Even if you're not vegan, these flavors pair super well with other chunkier, non-vegan flavors in a double scoop or taster's duo. As for the ingredients, they are locally sourced from farms near Cleveland and the owners actually know the producers on a first-name basis and visit their farms! Some insider tips: -Sprinkles, chocolate shavings, and pretzel rods are free to add to any ice cream dish!! -There is a comments box where you can suggest new ice cream flavors! -If you can't decide on a flavor, get the taster's duo! 2 scoops for a better price than the double.

Cool spot for late night ice cream! Came around 9:30pm on a Wednesday night and there were a bit of people coming in still. They make all their ice cream right behind their register and you can check them out too on their 2nd floor viewing deck! Staff was nice and let you have a few samples. Very creamy and a lot of flavor. Not too sweet either! Great selections of flavors and about 5 vegan options (chocolate, chocolate hazelnut, mango sorbet, raspberry sorbet, salted caramel praline)

I like the Vegan Ice cream,its so delicious. The staff is always so personable and helpful. They also a very nice upper level area that we have used in the past for events. The window where we can watch the workers in action making the ice cream is always a treat to watch, especially for younger kids who are intrigued by how things are made. It's a great spot for families to have a delicious homemade treat. It's a great asset to the West 25th Business Community. I only wish there was a location on the West Park Neighborhood area

I've cream is my down fall, I can never get enough of it, Lol.... Mitchell's has a newer store is Westlake Ohio, awesome place. You can sample the many different varieties of ice cream they have, your taste buds usually sample 2, while your eyes sample the selection of different flavors of ice cream in front of you. Many to choose from! On several occasions even during the holidays we get the black raspberry cake! Yes they make some pretty awesome cakes too! We have tried only a few of the other cake's all just as good! I definitely give them 5 Star's doesn't matter if I'm at South Park mall in Strongsville, or there store by the square, or rocky river store! I give them 5 star's! Thanks Mitchell's!
Simply amazing! Probably my favorite company to get icecream from.
Such great flavors and the staff is always helpful! This is the best store yet. Love the location and options you can get.
Maybe the best ice cream I have ever had. Absolutely delicious and wonderful staff. Would highly recommend

Are you kidding me? Where has this place been all my life? While visiting Cleveland for the weekend, my son and I decided to trek downtown so check out its 'renaissance' and we weren't disappointed. We decided to catch the sunset and city view from Edgewater Park and then opted to have dessert before heading back to the hotel. A quick search of the area suggested Mitchell's so we headed over. Love the area it's in (Market Square, near as I can tell) and the marquis out front. From the street, you can easily see you're in for a treat as it's bright, open and airy; an old-school ice cream parlor feel but with a modern vibe. Fortunately there was a small, but fast moving line when we entered. Being novices, we were happy to find a menu near the door so we could be prepared when we hit the counter (Seinfeld 'Soup Nazi' episode came to mind). Instead, the staff was all so happy and helpful and we decided on a waffle cone with a scoop of salted caramel and Mint chip. Yum Yum and Yum again. We discovered my son doesn't care for the former but we both the loved the latter. So creamy, perfectly minted and with magical chunks of chocolate. I found pricing reasonable at $6.50 for the portion size. The creamery is set up pretty neat with a large window behind the counter though which you can watch the kitchen in action (it was late so there wasn't much going at the time) but it's worth the trip upstairs for the birds eye view. I can't imagine going anywhere else for ice cream while in Cleveland. And from what I could tell, their flavors rotate and there are alway plenty of choices. Don't miss this spot!!

On my trip to Cleveland, I had the opportunity to stay at the Hilton Downtown on Lakeside. After dinner, I stopped in their snack mart for a treat. How the stars aligned this night. I picked up a glorious cup of Mitchell's Homemade creamy heaven from said mart, and it was love at first bite. I consider myself an I.C. expert, and this is one of the best I've ever had. The chocolate peanut butter blew my mind - the ice cream is velvety, the chunks were plentiful... and you can absolutely taste the quality behind the ingredients. I visit Cleveland pretty frequently for work, and I will be SURE to bring my coworkers to the physical shop next time I'm in town. What a sweet, sweet find. --- UPDATE: I went to the factory in Tremont (I believe) when I was there last and was BLOWN AWAY. The amount of flavors they have is insane. You literally cannot go wrong with anything you order.
Mitchells is #1 in Cleveland. That's all I can say. The flavors are unreal. The freshness is crazy. The amaretto cookie is just stupid tasty.
Best ice cream! Every flavor is delicious! I always highly recommend the chocolate peanut butter cup or the chocolate raspberry truffle!!

*COVID19 Edition* We were walking around Ohio City when we saw the impressive line out the door for this place, and after some internet snooping, I figured this place needed to be tried. Oh we were so happy we did. We ended up getting the Cleveland Brownie Sundae oh it hit the spot. The ice cream was great, just the right amount of sweetness. The brownie was warm, melty, chocolately, and not too heavy. The whipped cream, hot fudge, and pecans were just the perfect combination that kept it from being too sweet but also an amazing mix of textures. You know I'm going to be here whenever I'm in town. Is it 30°F? I don't care. Get in the car. We're going to Mitchell's.
Love this place. Best ice cream in cle. You won't find a better place to get ice cream. When I walk in I just feel and smell and great joy

i LOVE this place. You walk in and it literally smells like waffle cones. Having grown up working in an ice cream shop, that smell is SO beautiful. I got the cookies and cream and the coffee chocolate chunk. Both were super yummy. The line was a little long when we got there but the workers are super fast, even while being friendly and attentive. Will be back!

Two words. Vegan ice cream. It's better than the milk based ice cream. Luscious, decadent, presumably eco friendly. All served with that local Mitchell's smile. When it comes to Cleveland ice cream. There is no comparison. Get you some!
OMG - they are all good but Banana Cream or Key Lime Pie ice cream is a unique treat! YUM

Great ice cream store at Pearl and 82. Long lines disappear quickly as they always have plenty of staff. Huge selection of flavors. We recently got chocolate vegan made with coconut milk. Delicious! Perfect hot weather food.
This is the BEST ice cream in cleveland, no joke. All of the employees receive all star training, they're fantastic. The autumn caramel apple flavor is a must have every fall

Had a craving for ice cream and knew this place was the go. It was the weekend so they were slightly busy with limited capacity indoors, no tasting the ice cream flavors and no diving indoors. I was got the wild berry crumble with hot fudge, strawberries and m&ms and definitely hit the spot. They allow for you to order online and pick up curbside but that way you don't have the choice of sundaes, etc. Service was quick and efficient. Will definitely be returning.

Vegan Ice Cream!!!! And it's good!!! I had the salted Carmel pecan ice cream. It was worth the wait in the long line. Also you must get a waffle cone! We have walked by Mitchell's probably 50 times since we moved to Cleveland and never stopped. Now I don't know if I can walk by without stopping.

Just great ice cream! Tim Roof sundae was the best turtle I've ever had! Very cool story. Make the ice cream in the open kitchen behind the store. Whipped cream was magical and the cherry was maraschino, but dark. Oh so tasty! Don't miss this place.

Love Mitchells! So many delicious flavors including several vegan options! Parking is pretty good in the back, and it's not far from many bars and the west side market which makes it very convenient. Decently priced. Highly recommend!

This place doesn't just have vegan options; they have VEGAN OPTIONS! Super creamy, dark chocolate ice cream and caramel with pecan dust so that it's evenly distributed throughout the ice cream: GENIUS LEVEL. Friendly person who helped us even gave us free cones because we were taking pints to go, which seems to be their custom. Bonus points for the stunning marquee outside.

There are lots of places to get an ice cream fix around Cleveland, but Mitchell's is the next! This location is the mother ship, and where they make the frozen greatness. Don't let the line make you hesitate, it always moves quickly!

I have been to Mitchell's before but never toured it! Today I went to this location for a work event. We had an awesome tour guide (I'm drawing a blank on her name) who taught us all about the history of Mitchell's and the building. Did you know that Mitchell's uses solar panels to power some of the W. 25th location? They also collect rain water sanitize it and then use it for their plumbing? I thought that was really awesome and had no idea they were so environmentally conscious. Anyways we got to watch them making different kinds of ice cream and homemade brownies. At the end of the tour we went upstairs (they have an elevator for those who can't take the stairs) and got a better look of the production room. We then got to sample ice cream that was made just this morning - autumn caramel apple and bing cherry. I'm not a cherry fan so I only had the caramel apple flavor but it was delicious! It tasted like apple cider with caramel. We also got to sample some homemade toppings - brownies, cookie dough, and crumble. I ended my visit with the "Cleveland Brownie Sundae" this thing is huge! A brownie, vanilla bean ice cream, hot fudge, pecans, whipped cream, and topped with a cherry! It was delicious... next time I'd probably try it with chocolate. It was such a great experience! You can schedule your own tour on their website :)

Mitchell's is one of the best ice cream shops in the nation! Whenever I try new ice cream shops I am always craving Mitchell's. The variety is perfect and the specials are always great. Pistachio is a classic but honestly there are no bad flavors. Service is wonderful and although in the summer lines can be long it's worth the wait!

On our way to Niagara we stopped overnight in Cleveland. This ice cream shop was near the bed and breakfast we stayed in, so we decided to stop in. I'm glad we did because it is by far the best ice cream I have ever had. I chose a coconut based ice cream and my husband chose the seasonal peach ice cream. Even though mine was dairy free, it was just as creamy as his peach ice cream. I would love to know their secret to creaminess! It's hard to find a non-dairy ice cream that is rich and velvety on the tongue. I wish they shipped their ice cream across the nation, because I would definitely buy it! Next week we are hoping to stop back in on our way to Niagara.

I came here after trying Mitchell's for the first time the previous night at their University Circle location. I LOVE this location in particular. The way the signage is done on glass and you can see the ice cream being made...incredible! The ice cream is absolutely DIVINE. Mind-blowing. I'll be dreaming about it for the rest of my days and returning on every trip to Cleveland. I'd love to see this company expand to Cincinnati. I can't get enough Wildberry Crumble!!

Uncle Bryan came into Cleveland from LA for family wedding. This was his ode to Mitchell's, sent to nephew Alex.... I'm sensing a little bit of jealousy there Alex, which is understandable for the best ice cream place IN THE WORLD. I'm at two visits and own one t-shirt. Break down: FIrst visit July 22. Wowed by theater-setting, the abundant light from all-encompassing windows, the warm customer service, unlimited spoons and overall cleanliness and well-lit interior. Slightly dizzyby the selection, I tried Lena's lavender honey which was delicate and beautiful. Strawberry jalapeno? The audacity. I went with banana cream pie, and was mesmerized by the fresh bananas, the homemade marshmallow ribbon. And wait, is that homemade shortbread crust in the ice cream. Why yes it. At this point, it is among my top ice cream places ever. Then I am led to the upstairs, where I can watch workers happily working in a spotless kitchen fromalarge window - cutting up shortbread, brownies. Amazing. I took that picture of the setting sun. We sit on picnic benches and enjoy blissful moments of high summer. July 24. Notoriously discerning food critic Xavi attends, and pictures of his utter happiness eating peanut butter ice cream are sent to me. Trip II: Post wedding July 25. I return with reluctant nephews and Topher. Having always placed pistachio as my go-to ice cream, I make the plunge with toasted pistachio. Explosions. Eben marvels as he is given an Eben-sized single scoop filling a waffle cone. We take in the workplace window of joy. Even through the haze of White Claw, the nephews are impressed. I mention at the front slight disappointment that the train is not working. And the guy behind the counter hits the switch, and the train starts moving. Nephews deny ever being reluctant. My only quibble is that t-shirt is not a large, either that or I have one too many Mitchell's.

I love this ice cream. I have been here before being vegan and after being vegan. It was better before being vegan though I must say. I love that the strawberry and banana flavors are so real. The fruit is real! You're not just eating some artificial flavoring. Their vegan options are a little limited unfortunately. There are a couple of non-creamy sorbet options, and a couple of creamy options. They're good! They're just not what I like. I do have some friends who do really like their creamy vegan options - I think it's vegan salted caramel and vegan chocolate. But those are just not flavors that I enjoy. The mango sorbet is super tasty and tastes like you're biting into a super juicy sweet mango. But to me it's almost too sweet. I'll definitely want to try more vegan options when they come out!

When telling friends that I was heading to Cleveland for a visit every single one of them said I just had to check out this ice cream place. It's a great addition to the Ohio City neighborhood (not too far from the West Side Market). The ambiance is fantastic in this great remodel of a restored movie theater. It's bright and cheery with both indoor and outdoor seating. The ice cream (so many flavors!) are all made in house with the factory visible behind glass walls. The servers are more than happy to provide many tastes with tiny spoons until a choice is made. I had a scoop each of the mint-chocolate-chip and the double chocolate... which when melded together made the most deliciously decadent frozen treat! Definitely a must-go for any ice cream lover!

This place is lovely! We just went to the new one in Van Aken! It sells all the classic flavors like sea salt Carmel, cookie dough and rocky road. They have large Sunday's and delicious milkshakes! This is a super fun place to bring kids or just get a quick treat!

The best ice cream shop I've ever been to! The good smells hit you walking in. Often times there is a line out the door in the summer but it moves fast. Behind the huge counter are huge glass windows where you can see the factory where they make the ice cream. Very clean and modern inside with plenty of seating making it a comfortable place to hang out with friends. Highly recommend!

Great ice cream! Lots of fun flavors like coffee chocolate chunk and vegan salted caramel pecan! They have reduced fat yogurt flavors, sorbets, smoothies, and shakes. You can add toppings like peanut butter and strawberry to make your own sundae or they have plenty of prepare sundaes to choose from. The sundaes range from $5.25 to $5.95. Would definitely recommend trying even if you just get a single scoop.

I love Mitchell's. There is ALWAYS plenty of parking. They are all clean. Love the sundae combinations!! The Buckeye Brownie is the MOST amazing. The mint chocolate chip ice cream is so crazy good! No crazy dies. Real mint is used. My other weakness is the banana cream pie ice cream. You can get pints to-go. Be sure to get the free cones with your pints! They have the cutest water dispenser! PS. The covid 19 inspired Curbside ordering and pickup is BRILLIANT!!

Ice cream here had always been amazing. Vegan flavors are all worth a try. Always appreciated them offering good non dairy alternatives. Most people know how good their ice cream is...but a new discovery and the point of this review is how downright amazing their ice cream cakes are. I've only had the black raspberry chocolate one but have heard others say all the flavors are equally as good and also hearing you can make custom orders. The ice cream cake is unlike any other I've had. The cake portion is dense, not what I expected at all more like a brownie bite that comes in ice cream. The frosting is fantastic. The proportion of cake it ice cream is perfect. Def would recommend everyone try. They usually always have them in the display case for a last minute pick up!

WOW !!! I've never had homemade ice cream that was vegan, inexpensive and taste so good! My family and I are in Cleveland, Ohio for our first time and wanted some Ice cream and what better place than to come to Mitchell's ! Five star, I highly suggest you take the time to come check it out, taste the many flavors they have to offer and watch their factory in person in how they make the ice cream! 100% sanitized and clean inside

Best ice cream in the city for sure, hands down, ain't no doubt about it. Due to Cleveland weather being bipolar, Mitchell's ice cream is good during the middle of a winter storm and the hottest summer day. No matter the time of year, once you have this ice cream, you'll always be craving it. Multiple creative flavors to choose from always make going feel like your first time. Okay, I'm done ranting about ice cream heaven, and I mean Mitchell's. This ice cream and its facility are just simply superb.
ABSOLUTELY LOVE IT! Will always go to this place. Not close to it anymore but would still recommend it

A restored, adorable building full of delicious ice cream flavors. Famous flavor: caramel fudge brownie (And you bet I got it.) The decor is girly and chic, and there are other great-sounding, chocolate-filled flavors such as peanut butter cup and chocolate fudge brownie. There are plenty of spots to sit, including a row of cute, colorful seats for little kids to sit in and look out the windows. This ice cream shop is also located on a trendy street with loads of food options as well.
Best ice cream around. Great choices. All the workers have always been friendly and helpful. My favorite place !

I mean, it's Mitchell's, how can you go wrong? :) I've been to multiple locations - including West 25th, Beachwood, Rocky River, and the one on the Case campus ( Case alum). The West 25th is my favorite location as I live on the boarder of Ohio City on the West Bank of the Flats, and it is a great spot to walk to in the summer and even winter :) I usually order my husbands birthday cake from here in the Oreo flavor, which is his favorite. Personal favorite flavors are the wild berry crumble and the butter pecan.

Best ice cream I have ever had. And I've had a lot. Really like the place too...looks like an old movie theatre on the outside. Nice indoor and outdoor seating. Very cool flavors to choose from and you can even watch them making the ice cream in the back!

I can't believe I haven't reviewed this location but this place is amazing -- come here and enjoy. This is their flagship location and I love this one because you can walk up and down the Ohio City shops and the cute neighborhood area while you're enjoying your treat, or they also had indoor tables (no outdoor dining, at least not this summer). Their staff are very friendly and when this place gets long lines during warm weather, they handle it like pros and get people through so you're enjoying your ice cream desires in no time. Their prices are very reasonable, and at this location you can rent out the second floor for a private party. Their rainbow sprinkles are awesome and plentiful. What they're great at are the fun flavors they think of. Anything that you see that has chunks in it (e.g. cookies and cream) has the perfect amount, very generous. I think the best part is that even the vanilla flavor in the ice cream itself is good. Their strawberry rhubarb crisp flavor in the summer (usually coming out in June) has a cult following amongst my friends, and rightly so. Rightly so.

I love the Mitchell's in Ohio City! They have so many more flavors here. There's also tons of places to sit. I love how you get to see how the ice cream is made. It really captures that fresh and local feel that Mitchell's likes to aim for. Their serving sizes are so generous that a single scoop is more than enough. My favorite flavor is pralines and cream.

Mitchell's, damn you and your delicious frozen confectionaries. I go here more in a month than I have been to see my primary care physician in the last year so who knows if my body is slowly deteriorating due to my constant visits to your fine establishment. Regardless of how your tasty treats are affecting my body, I can't seem to keep myself away. I wish they sold their whip cream to the public because that shit is addicting. I'd fill my bathtub with that shit if I could. Also, your vanilla bean ice cream is like devouring the sweet snow on the top of Mt. Everest. It's simply divine. I love this place more than I love my husband so please keep existing. I love you Mitchell's.
Best ice cream EVERRRRR!! Love going to the location on 25th. Cool vibe, cool people & great quality ice cream made right in front of you. My fav hands down!

Went to Mitchell's last week because I had been told that the ice cream was free due to the Cavs championship win. I ordered and had my two employees with me. When we got to the register, I was informed the free ice cream was only from 8-11pm. The lady at the register could tell I was sort of bummed and she said I didn't have to purchase the ice cream and I could give it back. I looked at her floored and said, but I touched it. She said no problem. I ended up still getting it and paying for it, but I was really impressed that they were willing to take the ice cream back even though this was clearly my fault. I indulged on my salted caramel ice cream while we are the champions played on repeat. It was a great day in Cleveland.

Great ice cream, whipped cream is delicious. And the service was great everyone was so nice! I've been referring all my friends to come try it since I did! Definitely recommend the Buckeye Sundae!! O-H!

Super ice cream and cool place. Made from local everything. Very creamy. But also great for little ones. Big windows to watch them make ice cream. Make sure you go behind Mitchell's and see the glass blowing shop. Buy a bowl there and you get a scoop of free ice cream!

Always a gem of a place. The ambiance alone will make anyone giddy. It's such a fun place with the most unbelievable flavors. My favorite thing about this location in downtown Cle is the fact you can overlook the ice cream being made when you head upstairs. The location has art all over and is so clean and inviting. My favorite flavors are the bing cherry, the banana cream pie and when I'm feeling a little healthy, the vegan caramel pecan. Love love love Mitchell's and it's seriously always such a treat.

Went for a run and ended up here instead of finishing my run- and I didn't feel guilty about it. It is crowded and there is always a line- not a place to take your time sampling flavors (kids will definitely give you dirty looks). The taste of the ice cream is rich and unbeatable. I wish the space was a little bigger and less crowded so you have time to enjoy the experience.

Their ice cream is so delicious,my favorite is salted caramel,huge portions,single scoop enough,it costs 3.90 They have many locations in Cleveland,the service is great,free samples,lot of variety of flavors of ice cream. Good place for kids and family

Handcrafted? Check. Small batch? Check. Local grass-fed dairy? Check. Fresh ingredients? Check. Adorable, refurbished building? Check. Mouthwatering flavors? Check. Seriously, what more can you ask out of an ice cream biz?

Very clean and nice store. They have great selection of fresh and unique flavors. The staff are very nice and answer questions very patiently and politely. I tried their pistachio and passion fruit flavors which were nice and refreshing . I recommend getting taster's Duo or trio to try multiple flavors!
