Where do I start with other than it's some of the best ice cream you'll ever have! They always have so many different flavors so it's impossible to find something you won't like. They always have speciality ice creams based on the season which is awesome and cool to try different flavors you've never had. Carmel Fudge Brownie is typically my go to if I don't like the speciality ice creams.

Strawberry-jalapeno ice cream! The color was pink as expected, with a summer-strawberry aroma. The first taste was fruit-forward, all strawberry with a full-bodied creamy mouth-feel. Then the quick bite of jalapeno hit, just enough to be fully spicy, but not so much as to burn and grab for water. A great ice cream starts in the kitchen, and this chef's passion for the craft played out in my waffle cone. All kidding aside, these guys can make ice cream! Mitchell's created a great memory for our trip to Cleveland.

This has to be the best ice cream place I've ever been to, and coming from a pregnant woman, that says a lot! It was a really cool environment inside with the factory right behind the store where you can look in through a glass wall. I got a root beer float and they use homemade whipped cream which was absolutely INCREDIBLE. Best ever. Hands down. Staple of downtown Cleveland!

I love how big this Mitchell's is and the clear windows that allow you to see the factory work behind the ice cream making. I have not tried that many flavors here but I can tell you that I have never been disappointed after coming here 3 times. I tried the cookies and cream, campfire smores and caramel fudge brownie. The portions are large so you are definitely getting your money's worth. I end up always getting a junior scoop because I can never finish anything bigger. I have taken all the guests I have in Cleveland to this ice cream place because it is the best I have had in a long time. I would try to find parking close by because there is nothing directly next to Mitchell's.

If you want the best, you have to know where to look... so look no further than Mitchells! Across the corporate landscape, quality is a virtue that too often becomes lost in the throngs of mainstream establishments, where places such as Dairy Queen and Cold Stone are sometimes the only examples upon which people base their expectations and mold their standards, but they are not adequately designed to be viewed as such. Set in a refurbished 1940s era cinema house, and later a popular nightclub, this Mitchell's location is the preeminent spot for late-night sweet tooth influenced ice cream cravings, with an abundance of flavors and hand crafted decadence in every scoop! What makes this Mitchell's location truly unique is that is provides customers with an up close view of how the ice cream is made, with a complete production kitchen in the back, in full view from the front and second level. At Mitchells, superior taste, quality ingredients, and decadent ice cream are the elements that make it an extraordinary adventure into the culinary world of excellence. So go ahead, take the dive, or better yet, indulge yourself with a scoop, or two, of heaven in a bowl!

I'm updating my review below since I found some videos from when I came here in October 2017 which made me remember what ice-cream I ordered. I ordered the Caramel sea-salt ice-cream and it was so delicious. Not too sweet and not too salty. It was just the perfect balance. The caramelized brown sugar and French grey sea salt are really great. Up next, I want to try the vegan version of this ice-cream which happens to have nuts in it but no dairy milk. It is called the Vegan Salted Caramel Pecan ice-cream. This Flagship store is beautiful and big with the massive windows and bright lights inside. For a small fee, you can actually book a tasting tour where you will be guided through the kitchen and watch homemade ice-cream being made.

Wow some of the best ice cream I have ever had in a neighborhood with great murals. If you get an opportunity to try wildberry crumble, please do. It will honestly change your life. They come out to my CAR and took my order, and brought it out. These employees are dolls.

Best. Vegan. Ice Cream. Ever!!! If you are like me and don't do dairy (I'm not vegan, just dairy free), go here and get the vegan salted caramel pecan. You can thank me later And if you're questioning my ability to judge ice cream as someone who can't do dairy, know that it's a newer intolerance. So I do know what legit ice cream tastes like.
I can't even emphasize how this is the best ice cream I've had. I've been having it since I was a kid, the taste of blue cosmo and pistachio brings me back to innocent times.
Up there with the best ice cream I've ever had. Highly recommend the peanut butter fudge sundae - HUGE portion and they do not skimp on the toppings. Will definitely be back!

During these weird times, the awesome staff at Mitchell's will meet you outside of their facility to take your order. Me and my girlfriend got a vanilla shake - and a chocolate-peanut butter shake. Mitchell's puts complimentary (they'll ask to make sure you want them) chocolate shavings and a cherry on top. The shakes are extremely reasonable as far as price goes - especially if you consider the quality. The shakes were so rich, and so thick and tasted amazing!!

Nothing much to say here other than its the best I've cream in Cleveland, and in my opinion Ohio! From their flavors to consistency, I've had better ice cream here than both Graters or Jenny's. My only wish was more varied seasonal flavors as they've had similar yearlong rotations recently.
Great customer service. Fantastic ice cream and very friendly atmosphere. Very kind employees. Extremely clean! - totally a five

Delicious!! The ice cream is yummy and they have new, interesting flavors!! The workers aren't very friendly, but they are efficient at their jobs!! Eat ice cream!!! It's good for your emotional health

Fantastic! Great flavors coupled with gorgeous creamy, custard texture. Spectacular, bright space. Huge kitchen is on full display, awesome and immaculate, like an ice cream version of the Willy Wonka factory. Staff was friendly, very helpful on allergy issues, and happy to let you taste before you decide. Go whatever the weather. It was snowing on our visit and totally worth it. Delicious.

I don't think I will ever tire of Mitchell's ice cream - at least I haven't after eating it for three days in a row. This location is definitely the most fun for kids and families. It's located in a massive, theater-style building and one of the first things you see walking in is the toy train diligently chugging loops along ceiling. Behind the counter and visible through glass panes from the side and above is the actual factory of magic where workers (no Ooompa Loopmas, sorry!) toil away making batches on batches on batches of ice cream. The window seating on the first floor is all kid-height-friendly, and there are crayons and paper scattered around for the artistically inclined. The room upstairs can be rented for birthday parties and has a nice view of W. 25th Ave. Flavors, flavors. Try a few and then ask the employees what they think pairs well with what you've liked so far because you probably won't have the time to try all of them. Not at night with the line of people glaring at you at least. Some of my favorites at this location are the Black Raspberry w/ Dark Chocolate Chunk (chunk means you might find some HUNKING chunks), the Porter, and the Peanut Butter w/ Chocolate Covered Pretzel Yogurt. And always, always in their homemade waffle cone. The $1 is well worth it - it's got a perfect crunch and light, wafery flavor. You can order in advance and get cakes to go at this location. The blackboards aren't really helpful menu-wise, but you still CAN get shakes and other concoctions at this location. If you're conflicted between flavors, you can also ask for Junior Scoops of ice cream, which are smaller than their traditional scoops. For the die-hard Mitchell's fan, available for purchase are engraved ice cream scoops, T-shirts, or train conductor hats to elevate their fandom.
What a treat. Trios of guac, trios of salsa, phenomenal cocktails, incredible service outstanding happy hour
Wild berry crumble yum. One scoop is plenty for one. Line can be a bit long but wait isn't too bad
So glad they are back open for curbside pickup. Ice cream is great, as always. Favorites are the wild berry crumble and mint cookies and cream. Cleveland staple!

Pretty amazing ice cream and sorbet. The flavors are surprisingly captured very well , especially the key lime pie and the mango. Really unique flavors and great options. I bought two scoops and it was a bit much, single scoop should suffice unless you are looking to try multiple flavors. Mixing tart and sweet flavors is always a good choice. They also sell it by the pint separately if you really like it! Great service and not much seating , would come back !
Excellent ice cream and excellent customer service. I'm glad that they carry non-dairy options but they seriously need to add more. The Vegan Chocolate is the best. .

Great ice cream and service. Our only downside while waiting in line was the panhandler that was working the line. He was also seen walking around inside and approaching customers. The employees should of shown him the door.
Mitchell's ice cream was a fantastic experience. Serving one of America's greatest desserts ice cream. The help was wonderful and the product was top grade.
I loved the ice cream, it was really good. Mitchell's Homemade ice cream has a verity of the best ice cream.

You can never go wrong with a scoop of ice cream from Mitchell's. I love that the owners (brothers) keep everything local and that you'll never be able to find their ice cream outside of NEO. You can tell everything is made from scratch. I love the caramel fudge brownie ice cream and those homemade brownies are on point. I've been tempted a few times to buy just the brownie. I am also a huge fan of the Amaretto cookie (winter time) and the campfire s'mores (summer time). My dad loves the bing cherry and says he can't ever eat another ice cream again. My fiance loves the banana cream pie because where else can you order that on a reguar basis. I've never ordered a sundae because I don't find it neccessary to add sauce to already delicious ice cream. I make sure to tell every out of towner to make sure they try Mitchell's before leaving Cleveland.

Loved it! As soon as you walk into the building, you smell the buttery cones. The ice cream is flavorful, creamy, just altogether fatty. I chose the duo and ordered banana cream pie and the dark roast coffee. I think this was a great combo and I enjoyed every last bit of it. The banana cream pie had chunks of banana and pie crust, it was just like eating the pie itself. If I lived in Cleveland, I would only buy Mitchell's, they're THAT GOOD. Mitchell's has some seating available in their brightly lit shop and the line goes fairly quick. I'm pretty sure that everything Mitchell's offers is delicious and rich. My only con is that they don't offer crumbled waffle cone as a topping. How do we try and get a store opened up in NOVA?

As always, Mitchell's never disappoints when I want high-quality ice cream. What I love most about this location, in particular, is that customers can also purchase tickets to tour the facility, learn how ice cream is made, and discover the history behind Mitchell's Homemade Ice Cream. The tour also comes with an ice cream tasting, as well as a voucher for a scoop of ice cream. (So essentially, you "get back" the money you spent purchasing the tour ticket.) All in all, no matter how interested you are in the ice cream tour offered at this location, do yourself a favor and GET MITCHELL'S ICE CREAM!

My friend brought me here while I was visiting from out of town and I'm so glad she did! This place is amazing. The ice cream is so fresh. They have so many unique flavors it was so hard to choose. I loved how they have the option for half scoops so I could try more flavors. It also smells so good from the fresh waffle cones.
Great place 100 percent recommend. Love the options of ice cream, and a he yummy ice cream. All of the staff is so nice. Love me some Mitchell's.

We had to go to this ice cream place while in Cleveland. We like to go to homemade ice cream places all over the country. It was neat that it was in an old theater. It was also cool to see them making the ice cream behind the glass, if you go upstairs you can get a better view of it. I forget all the flavors I had but I had 3 different flavors in a waffle cone. I think I got some type of chocolate chunk, and a coffee chocolate. It was very creamy and delicious. The waffle cone was fresh as well. Wanted to make a 2nd trip back but didn't get to it, but we got a couple cups of Mitchell's ice cream at our hotel.

Some of the best ice cream we've ever had nationwide and at prices that we hadn't seen in years! After a trip to the West Side Market, my wife and I swung by Mitchell's on a warm summer Saturday afternoon at 12pm, which seemed like the perfect timing. The ice cream shop had just opened 30 minutes prior and there weren't many people inside, so we took our time exploring the menu and flavors. From the moment people spot Mitchell's you can tell it's just different. For one, the outside looks like the entrance to a movie theater. Once customers make their way in, they're greeted by a huge glass window straight ahead where you can see into their ice cream making facility. However, what customers really need to focus on is the writing and menu on the glass window, which is not only written in a light white, but incredibly hard to see. I won't dock them any stars for that snafu, but maybe making it a bit darker would have helped, however I get that they want to showcase the factory behind the glass. Anyway, we surveyed the flavors at the ordering counter and the options. We tend to make the mistake of over-ordering, but also what to try as much as we can, so what better option than the Taster's Duo, which is supposed to be a single scoop of 2 different flavors. After being enlightened by the very helpful employees there about their most popular and favorite flavors, my wife ordered the Strawberry Rhubard and Fresh Peach on a sugar cone, while I ordered the Toasted Pistachio and Caramel Fudge Brownie, with the latter supposedly being their most in demand flavor. The verdict? EXCELLENT. The ice cream wasn't too soft and had very good texture to it. The flavors were really good and we loved each and every bite. The Strawberry Rhubard and Fresh Peach were fruity, but savory. The Toasted Pistachio and Caramel Fudge Brownie were sweet, but not overpowering. The Caramel Fudge Brownie had large chunks of brownie inside of the ice cream, which I loved. Overall, the ice cream was delicious and perfect. What was even better was how generous the scoops were. We ordered the Taster's Duo, which was supposed to be 2 half scoops, but when we received our cones, the ice cream was overloaded. It looked like they had given us 2 gigantic single scoops of each flavor we ordered. In addition, the Taster's Duo was just $3.95, which is unheard of these days for ice cream from a shop. I guess we felt we really got our money's worth too because we basically got 2 scoops instead of one. We loved the price point here, but we loved the flavors, serving size and delicious ice cream even more.

Very charming location, renovating an old movie theatre like this was brilliant. Tons of amazing flavors and a very friendly staff. Definitely worth the price. Don't forget to go crazy and get a pint of something else to take home!

The BEST ice cream you will ever have! I was born and raised in Youngstown - so Handles has always been my go to. Now I won't even eat Handles because it doesn't compare! The wild berry crumble is SO good!

Oh, Mitchell's! How I love thee! We've only lived in the area since June. We found Mitchell's on the way to the lake sometime at the end of June, and we've been back three times within the last 2-3 weeks. Number four may be tonight. The coffee chocolate chip is calling my name... Did I mention I don't even usually like ice cream?
Straight up the best ice cream ever ! Great flavors , nice staff . I know good ice cream and this is it . If your in Cleveland it's a must .

As a Cincinnati native, I did not believe I would ever find an ice cream that I loved more than my hometown favorite ... until Mitchell's. The entire atmosphere of the shops, the flavor selection, the intentionally curated local ingredients, the list of reasons to say "yes" to Mitchell's goes on and on. I cannot recommend it highly enough! Favorites: Wild Berry Crumble. I dream about it. No seriously, it's a problem.

Mitchell's is one of the Greater Cleveland area's greatest staples, and they have a flavor for everyone. Mitchell's is not only delicious, but offers ice cream made with the BEST ingredients, all locally sourced and high quality. They pay their workers a fair wage & those workers are always positive with smiling faces! They are always gracious when I forget to ask for whipped cream (the best whipped cream, btw). And they offer pints and quarts in the store to take home & enjoy on the couch! They also offer water out on the counter for people to self-serve which is SO great...Mitchell's keeps me coming back for more, at least once a week.
great ice cream! Interesting flavors, you should always try something new!
Disgusting ice cream and way overpriced! Got a milk shake which was ok at best and a quart of strawberry ice cream which tasted horrible, could not even eat more than a scoop. Overrated.

Mitchell's is a Cleveland staple and a must! Any ice cream fan will love Mitchell's and appreciate the quality ingredients that go into every ice cream. I opted for the coconut chocolate chip is a big coconut fan as well as the smore ice cream. I've had several smore ice creams lately that really missed the mark but Mitchell's did a great job of capturing every element of a smore and really made you feel like you were eating ice cream around a campfire. I highly recommend getting the taster scoops which allow you to try several kinds of ice creams because it will be hard to choose only one if you're not looking for too much. It's nice to be able to watch and check out their ice cream factory while enjoying ice cream.

This is hands down the best vegan ice cream ever. The other flavors are delicious as well. This location has a second floor where you can watch them hand make the ice cream. We watched on as they crushed graham crackers, swirl, and layer with lime ice cream to create key lime pie. We have tried salted caramel, wild berry crunch, peanut butter chocolate chip and the fudge brownie flavors. All delicious! Just wish they would come to Cincinnati!

Stopped into mitchell's while traveling through Cleveland and what a gem! I got the maple walnut and key lime pie and both were fantastic. While there we got to watch people make the ice cream which was a fin experience. One of the best ice creams I ever had a must go!
I'm team Mitchell's over graeters any day. Raspberry chocolate chip will always be my go to favorite.

I've never tasted ice cream like this! Maybe I've deprived myself recently in enjoying sweet treats like ice cream OR maybe this place is THAT good! I think the latter! I ended up getting a scoop of the Caramel Fudge Brownie and Pralines and Cream. But not before I tried an array of samples of most of the flavors on their menu! I know, it's a lot but when am I going to be in Cleveland again? I needed, no, I wanted to indulge in ice cream heaven. The Caramel Fudge Beownie and the Pralines and Cream had a great balance of sweet and savory, crunchy and chewy, creamy and thick and my senses were on a ride. It was the most exciting scoops of ice cream! I enjoyed every bite to the last lick. I'm so happy!
So delicious. Many great flavors. High quality ice cream. Mitchell's might be the best place to get ice cream.

This is a MUST in Cleveland at any location!! Their homemade ice cream is always amazing and the Cleveland brownie sundae is our favorite!! My daughter prefers hers with peanut butter instead of fudge sauce.

We stopped by Mitchell's when visiting Cleveland and it did not disappoint. The handmade ice cream shop is in an old theatre. It was very clean and well kept. I had the wild berry crumble and it was top 3 best ice cream I've ever had. I got it in a waffle cone which was fresh and had a great crunch to it. We will definitely be back when visiting Cleveland.

**Vegan Friendly** Who doesn't love local homemade ice cream?! This specific location has a viewing side of the factory, and it's a great highlight for your inner child, or children! The line was out the door on a Saturday afternoon, and was worth every single penny. They have a variety of ice cream, sorbet, and yogurt. They also have seasonal flavors, and a handful of vegan options! You truly cannot go wrong with any flavor. They also have to-go pints, and when you purchase a pint, you get free cones to take with you!

There is not much that needs to be said about Mitchell's other than their ice cream being the best in Cleveland! Out of all the ice cream shops I have been to, Mitchell's is my favorite! I have tried almost all of the flavors and I have never been disappointed. The texture, flavor, and goodies inside are always perfect! A few of my favorites are pistachio, salted caramel, caramel fudge brownie, and wildberry crumble! The seasonal flavors are always SO SO GOOD! Also, the Ohio City shop is so neat! It's really cool to see where the ice cream is made! Everyone is always very friendly and helpful!! I highly highly recommend Mitchell's Ice Cream!

I'm a huge fan of Mitchell's. Since moving away from Cleveland, I don't get to have it very often anymore. We were in town visiting my parents and I had to stop here after eating dinner next door. It was my first time at this location. It's much bigger than the one I normally go to. It's very open inside with tables. You can see the whole process through windows in the back. We were in a bit of a rush, but the line went really fast. I love their flavor selection. I decided to go with seasonal flavors this time and got a tasters duo with egg nog and cinnamon. I was expecting to like the egg nog the most, and it was good, but I loved the cinnamon. If you've never tried Mitchell's, it's definitely a go to ice cream place in Cleveland, so check it out!
Five stars I get it Tons of variety, amazing sugar and waffle cones. Nice staff, 2 levels and a cool kitchen (watch it all happen) A+ Ohio city area of Cleveland, my favourite part

Mitchell's ice cream is consistently delicious and creamy, and it's reasonably priced too. I love this location because it's so spacious and you get to watch them make the ice cream. It shows you just how fresh and local it really is. Every flavor I try is delicious, and I love how they have smaller portions, like a junior scoop or a taster's duo. The milkshakes are so filling and perfectly made, and they come with homemade whipped cream and chocolate shavings. I've also enjoyed their smoothies, especially the Sunny Day smoothie. If you're looking for something a little more substantial than a scoop of ice cream, I would recommend trying one of their many sundaes. My personal favorite is the banana split, which is the perfect size if you're still pretty hungry after dinner. All-in-all, I love Mitchell's ice cream, and this location is my personal favorite :)

Best ice cream ever! Beautiful store front and love that you can watch them making all the ice cream in their huge facility in the back. They have a nice selection of fresh hand crafted ice cream, using local and seasonal ingredients. Not only do they have rotating seasonal flavors they also have sorbet, yogurt, no sugar added and vegan flavors too. The texture, creamyness, deep rich flavor and mix ins are absolutely delicious. My favorite was the gooey caramel frudge brownie! You can get a single, double and even a triple scoop in a cone or a bowl or in a flight. They even offer shakes, malts, sundaes, smoothies, cakes and pies. Definitely a sweet tooth paradise. Be prepared to wait in long lines, everyone loves Mitchell's.

Ice cream made in-house? YUM! You definitely can't go wrong here. They always have new seasonal flavors and the location is big and spacious. You can even see them making & packaging the ice cream in the back! If you go during the playoffs, be sure to get some Cavs sprinkles to show some team spirit!!!

I crave Mitchell's Homemade Ice Cream, thankfully they sell it in liters. The location is perfect with such a cute vibe. Best ice cream place in Cleveland. I always get new favors and they never disappoint.

I was introduced to Mitchell's a few years ago and I have never gone back. Mitchell's ice cream is a gem of a shop. All the ice cream is home made and this particular Mitchell's has the little factory on the inside that you can see through the glass behind the counter. The store is huge. The lines are always wrapping out the door, that's how popular this place is. I've tried a few things from Mitchell's, my favorite has to be the mint dark chocolate chunk ice cream. What I like about it is that there are nice big chunks of dark chocolate in the ice cream AND the ice cream isn't dyed green. It's plenty minty without being overbearing. I usually like to get the ice cream in a sundae with hot fudge and extra whipped cream. I love their whipped cream and would totally buy a canister of it and eat it in one sitting. I love ice cream and Mitchell's is the place to be for ice cream.

Mitchell's has a strange combination of delectable sweets along with a sterile lab look right behind the cashier. It's an interesting concept to have glass walls so everyone can peer in to the workers dressed in white coats and masks working to make delicious ice cream. There is also a second floor which made it feel a bit more like a zoo. But who am I to complain about an ice cream zoo. They have different and unique varieties of ice cream so I will definitely come back here if I ever visit again!

Can't go wrong on a Sunday afternoon with Mitchell's iceceam. Love that you are able and they are willing to let u try a small sample before making decision. The smell of the waffle cones and the chance to look at behind the scenes the staff work on the craft is a plus. Husband ordered tin roof sundae and I had a standby mint chocolate chip hot fudge sundae or friend ordered traditional banana split and his wife ordered peanut butter on waffle cone. The place is clean and loved looking out the window.. We were taken aback by the panhandling inside with someone going table to table. Expect that outside.. they were busy so I'm sure that the staff didn't see that someone was going table to table..
It's beautiful here. Take some comfort in the hundreds of 5 star ratings. You'll love it too. :-)

Mitchell's campfire s'mores Ice cream might be my favorite ice cream of all time. It's got ribbons of marshmallow fluff weaved through it that literally taste freshly toasted yet melty at the same time. It's amazing. This Ohio city location is unique in that you can walk back and upstairs and watch the production of ice cream! It was very cool to see the behind the scenes!
Excellent service, amazing ice cream! My husband and I get it every summer when we go to a baseball game.

Ob my gosh! So yummy and fresh. I love that I can look up the ingredients and see exactly what was in my ice cream to avoid my food allergies. They were out of a few of the ice creams that we really wanted but the other flavors we chose weren't a loss. I loved that while you are ordering in line you can see the team working in the kitchen making other ice creams. I ordered 2 junior scoops and it was a ton of ice cream plenty for me. My husband ordered the regular 2 scoops and said he should have probably just done the junior but he ate it all. I loved the vegan and dairy free options. Something for everyone here.

This place has a solid 5-star and had a consistent line out of the door on a weeknight - file under "places to try when in the area". Adding to that, the ice cream was delicious, the decor is nice (there is a model train going around the shop, can't beat that), and service was friendly. Would return if in the area in the future.

Wow. This place is it. Transformed from a movie theater, this ice cream shop is reportedly one of the best in Cleveland, and you can definitely tell why. The lines are long, but move fairly quickly. I got the raspberry crumble ice cream and it and actually tasted like a colder and creamier version of a crumb cake. You can even go up to the second floor and watch the employees in action. I will definitely come back next time that I'm here! There's a reason this place is a must-go-to in Cleveland.

So, when can we get one in Detroit? We stumbled upon this place after going to West Side Market and even though we were both stuffed, we decided to stop for a scoop of ice cream. Best choice ever! They're got a nice selection of ice cream and it's served at the best temperature...slightly melty so you can taste all of the flavors. I had the double chocolate which had massive slices of chocolate in it! In addition to having great ice cream, the shop is super cute and you can even sit and watch people make the ice cream in the back.

Simply the best! Wonderful ice cream and fast service. You must take time to view the kitchen area from the second floor. It's incredible to see the process. When I visit the area again, Mitchell's is definitely on the agenda.

This Mitchell's location is really neat, in an old theater building. There is plenty of seating inside and also an outdoor patio. Who doesn't love Mitchell's ice cream? There are many other restaurants and shops in the area if you are out exploring the city.

All I can say is YUM! I read about this when I was looking for things to do in Cleveland. Never thought I would enjoy the experience as much as I did. It was a beautiful spring day when we visited - perfect for ice cream! I love that it is located in an old movie theatre. The staff were incredibly friendly and let us try a few of the unique flavors. So many of them sounded good. I actually ended up eating my first taste - the Wildberry Crunch and my friend has the Peanut Butter Pretzel yogurt, which tasted like ice cream. We each got a single scoop that was huge and worth the small amount it cost. Great experience. Probably a good thing I don't live in Cleveland - I would be here every day!
Best ice cream I've ever had. It's so fresh and soft and the flavors are unique. The lavender honey is my new favorite.

There were so many options on the menu, I felt so vanilla for just getting a milkshake! To be fair, it was the best peanut butter milkshake I have ever had. My daughter had the peanut butter fudge sundae and loved it, we also tried the coffee ice cream and I've honestly never had coffee ice cream so rich and flavorful. We love Mitchell's!

I love Mitchell's. This 1 is my favorite. They have Mitchell's same great service at this and all locations. This is my favorite for being able to see the behind the scenes action either on the side or from above.

I've been here twice so far. It's very clean and spacious. The small seating room on the left when you first come in is nice for those who want a little more privacy. This time around I got the raspberry sorbet. It was good, but I don't see what all the hype is about. I also tried the toasted pistachio before and wasn't a huge fan. I wish they had more unique flavors. Maybe I'm just more of a frozen yogurt person.

This place is wonderful!! They always have amazing new ice cream flavors every time I come in. They even have some dairy free vegan options. My favorite seasonal flavor so far was birthday cake but they aren't offering it anymore, at least for now. I've never been disappointed in what I've gotten though! They allow you to sample before you order so that's perfect for picky eaters. And everyone that works there is so nice and friendly!! Overall, excellent experience every single time.

Quality 4/5 Value 4/5 It's never too cold for ice cream for me! So this place has really rich ice cream. I tried the Christmas ale and the berry flavours. In retrospect one scoop would have been enough but my eyes were bigger than stomach. If you like rich creamy ice cream, this place is amazing. For me, my favorite is still thrifty mint chip (for ref of what rich is to me). It was 6.xx for a double scoop w waffle cone. Not too bad for some pretty darn good homemade ice cream.

Woah, this is some of the best ice cream I've ever had. I got a scoop of the Key Lime Pie and it was everything I wanted and more... creamy smooth ice cream, a bit of texture from the crust pieces, and just the right bite of citrus. Oh, plus the waffle cone I got it in was pretty much perfect too! Bonus points for it being in such a cool old building, having windows to the production area, and for having a little toy train in the ceiling for some reason. Seriously delicious. If you're in the area and looking for a treat, stop here.

I almost always have to stop and get ice cream here when I'm in Ohio city! The only time I don't is when I'm on a diet lol! Anyways I visited this past week and I am always amazed at their attentive service. They allow you to try as many flavors as you want and don't get upset. I love the glass walls and how you can go upstairs and watch how they make their product! Very cool! Usually I don't pay attention to sorbets or vegan ice cream options because I usually go for the creamy ice cream - I have no restrictions when it comes to ice cream. But my friend wanted to stop in to get vegan ice cream togo and what do you know.. they had 2 vegan options chocolate and a salty caramel. He bought 1 of each pint and they even sold Vegan cones!

Oh my God. I thought I'd died and gone to heaven when we stumbled across Mitchell's. It is cleverly located in an repurposed old theater in the Ohio City portion of Cleveland. When you walk in, there is an overwhelming smell of sweetness from the waffle makers making waffle cones. They have a laminated menu with all of their many varieties on it so you have time to choose your flavors while you're waiting in line which move very quickly. I had a scoop of pistachio and a scoop of black raspberry chocolate chunk. Pistachio was incredible and they don't put any artificial green color into it. Yay! There are glass windows behind the serving area encounter so you can watch the production facility in action. Even though this was Labor Day they look like they were fully staffed. After tasting their ice cream, I Now understand why. They also have a small dog-friendly patio to the right of the building. I also found that they package there ice cream in pints and we found it in one of the local supermarkets. Unfortunately hit we had no way to keep it frozen on the ride home. Guess we'll just have to go back to Cleveland.

Whoa. End of review. Just kidding. My Cleveland friend brought me here while I was visiting. She described it as a cross between Graeters and Jeni's, the former which I could care less for and the latter which I could almost die for. So my expectations were stagnant right in the middle of Canterbury. Boy, what an impression presence makes though. Walking from the parking lot of the public market appears these giant green leaves and a sparkling white building that looks modern yet retro. Going in through the side door and an explosion of amazing ice cream making smacks you in the face. They have these gigantic mixers that you could use to mix babies and kittens and puppies in, add some sugar and cream and you've got a new flavor. The whole place is pristine and the smells...Seriously nothing beats the smell of a great ice cream shoppe. The line was pretty long, but because it's ice cream, a long line doesn't really mean anything besides deliciousness. We got from the outside end of the line to ice cream scoop central in about 10 minutes and I was trying everything that caught my attention. Fearing holding up the line, I got a kiddie size of the fire roasted sweet corn on a sugar cone. This is the stuff of heaven man, any wacky flavors that can be ice creamed and is on point wins in my book. I'm not sure it beats Jeni's on wackiness, but its even with Jeni's on value for sure (Jeni's is expensive though much more adventurous). I wish I could lie there...

Mitchell's is the place to be whether it is the winter or summer! This ice cream chain in Cleveland is so special. It's homemade batches are filled with flavors you'll cherish long after they melt in your mouth. The cost is a little high, but not terrible considering all the ingredients are fresh and most local! Support this gem and enjoy some ice cream :)

When I was a little kid I had no problem eating a pint of ice cream in thinking nothing of it. But as an adult, with a waistline, I've pretty much given all sugary delicious dairy products the boot. This is turned into a distaste for mass-produced ice cream for me. Pretty much of you can buy it at the supermarket and it says ice cream I won't even bother reading it it's not worth the calories. We are in the west side of Cleveland and had just finished up a dinner with the kids and decided to stop in to Mitchell's ice cream. I have a co-worker who does nothing but Rave about this place at any given opportunity so we figured we would give it a try. This particular Mitchell is built inside an old theater or movie theater I'm not sure which one it was from the early nineteen-hundreds and they did their best to preserve as much as they could in there which is pretty cool. The counter with all the ice cream has what I thought was mirrors behind it turns out it was a glass wall that you can see into the bakery and kitchen where they manufacture all their ice cream and Cones which is super cool. That and you can go up stairs to the second floor look down on the kitchen and this is all open to the public. I got an ice cream sundae and I can't remember which one it was but they had peanuts and hot fudge and also so delicious goodness. This was the case where my eyes did not deceive me it was as large as I thought it was for 499 and I was able to share this with my wife and neither of us were able to finish all of it. If I'm going to bother wasting calories and ice cream I will definitely do it only one place Mitchell's.

I would totally eat ice cream for breakfast, lunch and dinner if I could! Mitchell's has hands down...THE BEST tiramisu and key lime pie ice cream. Their blueberry crumble was good too. Can't really go wrong with any of their ice cream flavors, and the ice cream contains a lot of mix in's.

Talk about an ice cream experience! Personally, I love taking family members here when they visit. We can walk around 25th street and enjoy some amazing ice cream. I love that they have a variety of flavors (including vegan), it's in an old theatre, and you can watch them make the ice cream! It's a big building so there's lots of space to sit or move around, and you can rent out the top floor for events. Most importantly now, the ice cream. It's so creamy and flavorful, and the ice creams that have bits in them (cookies, brownie, etc) have the perfect ratio of toppings and ice cream. Trust me, you'll know what I mean when you try it. My advice, stop by a local Cleveland coffee shop first and get some hot coffee to go with the creamy satisfying ice cream you'll get from Mitchell's! Even in the bitter cold of winter, you'll find yourself craving some late night Mitchell's (they're open until 10 on weekdays and 11 on Friday/Saturday).

Really delicious. They let you taste different ones. Rhubarb crumble was good but too sweet. The caramelized chocolate seemed ordinary to me. But the vegan butter pecan, made with coconut milk, was amazing. And I also liked the peanut butter chocolate chunk.

This is a must do stop if your in Cleveland or passing through. Homemade ice cream, coffee & smoothies. We all had ice cream including a campfire s'mores, chocolate peanut butter cup, cookies/cream & turtle sundae.

My favorite spot for ice cream! Love that most of the ingredients are organically sourced - love that they offer vegan options as well! Vegan Salted Caramel Pecan is my go-to staff is always super friendly as well!

I'm not going to write about ice cream. We already know they make amazing ice cream And perfect sundaes. I'm going to write about the experience. At the start there's this gaggle of scoopers just waiting to help. And they're all so happy, and have ideas about good mixes, and did I mention they're all happy! And the best part is you can watch them make the ice cream while you eat. Go upstairs, or wave to the workers as you walk by the windows in the side. They wave back. And they smile. And they're all happy. An entire place of happy people!

I love Mitchell's. I wish yelp would switch to either a point system, so I could give a 4.8, or allow us to give 1/4, 1/2, or 3/4 stars, so I could have left 4-3/4 stars I always get the hot fudge sundae, with different ice creams. I always get it to-go, and ask for the toppings on the side, and they are very accommodating! The only thing, they're a little stingy with the fudge, especially given the amount of ice cream you get. That's why they didn't get that fifth star .So I request extra fudge topping, and though I'm happy to pay a little for an extra container, sometimes they charge, sometimes they don't. I live pretty close to the W25 St. headquarters, and always go to that store. I like that they left the lobby the way it was! The only problem, and it is a HUGE one, is the extremely limited parking. I am disabled, and there's a HP spot around the corner, but I have never seen it unoccupied, so I have to park further away or just go home, depending on how well I can walk that day. I would have docked them a star or two for that, because they chose to open in that location, but that's life in the city! Every business in the area has the same problem. I did explain my disability (above knee amputee on crutches) to an employee and asked if I could park in the back for a few minutes to get my to-go order, and was told no. I don't see why they can't put an HP spot there, for to-go only. I think that would be a reasonable accommodation.

Omg. We never went here until recently and it was amazing. So pretty inside as it is an old theater. Open, spacious, and so well lit and modern. You can see the ice cream being made in the back as you order and it's so fun to watch. As always, Mitchell's delivers and when we went my kids ended up with sundaes and I had some praline in a dish. It was amazing and I devoured it. Prices are standard as far as superior ice creak goes. Staff was great and it was an excellent experience. You cannot beat being here in Ohio City for this as the whole place is electric and so alive .

This place is so cool! It's very clean looking, the walls are all white and you can see the area where they make the ice cream which makes the room look bigger. There is also a cute train the runs around above the seating area that's fun to watch. The great part is that there is plenty of seating as there are two floors open to customers. The actual ice cream is delicious!! It's not too creamy and tastes very much like the flavor you chose. I chose cookie dough ice cream, cookies and cream, and banana- it was perfect and affordable!

My current semi-permanent halfway-temporary home (mostly temporary actually) is Los Angeles, California. LA is cool. I had no urge to leave such a place. But I was able to take a break from the groovitude for a trip back to Ohio. LA to CLE? Umm, Cleveland is pretty bleak isn't it? Not so. I now realize that I love this town. Why did I have to go to LA and back to fully realize that? I have no idea. But I do love it. Cleveland has different vibes. It's different, not better or worse. Of course the reason for this speal of speech was Mitchell's Homemade Ice Cream. Wow. What a great place. Apparently this used to be a theater of some sort. So it's big. And white. Like ice cream. It's got a very clean design going on. Typical ice cream parlorish but with more character and more Cleveland. There's a long counter in front sporting all the ice cream flaves. Thirty or so of them. Immediately behind the counter is mucho glasso through which you can watch the ice cream makers hard at work. There's even a good sized upstairs with an even better view of the process. Is that the coolest part of it all? Of course not. That would be the ice cream. Why would you even ask? Yeah, homemade ice cream. Ain't that something. And that's not even a joke. I will speak for the Vanilla Bean and the Caramel Sea Salt. I've had ice cream of more taste and creativity at Piccadilly, but there's nothing like some good old homemade vanilla ice cream. The Caramel Sea Salt was salty; in case you didn't catch that already. It was very good though. Probably even worth the sugar and dairy. This place is CLE. This place is cool. And so is the ice cream because of it wasn't...it would suck.

What an amazing place! The staff was friendly and helpful! Oh Lawd though-lol!!! Their ice cream is the best ice cream I have ever had! My sister is an ice cream connoisseur, she would make me-take her or drag me to every ice place. So I've ate ice cream in Europe and the States-all the best of the best! But hands down this takes the cake! The texture is so creamy, the consistency is spot on-the flavor is natural and is not sugary or overwhelming. It tastes exactly what perfect ice cream should taste like! Do yourself a favor-treat yourself to some fine ice cream! You will be amazed both with their product and the atmosphere of the place in whole! ***mic drop*** I'm out!!! Going to get some more ice cream!!!!
I always get my monies worth at Mitchell's!!! The Flavors are always on point. Customer service is always great. Key Lime, Mango, Raspberry is my favorite!!!

Cleveland is so lucky to have Mitchell's. I think we sometimes take it for granted because we are used to seeing it in the grocery store, but truly, whenever I visit this flagship location, I'm reminded how awesome it is. This is a great place to bring an out-of-town guest. Oh, Mitchell's, how do I love thee, let me count the ways... + Fresh ice cream. Keyword: FRESH. Ice cream has a big difference when it's made with fresh ingredients. My absolute favorite is the key lime pie-- it's a crumbly, tart delicious batch of goodness. All the flavors are f-a-n-t-a-s-t-i-c. Salted caramel and chocolate covered pretzel are my other favorites, depending on mood. + Non-dairy and vegan options (I know nothing about this life, but pretty cool that they offer it, right?) + Accessible grab-and-go pints if you feel like pretending something is for your "boyfriend" but really you just want more ice cream for yourself for later. + Two floors of handicap accessible seating!! You can take the elevator or stairs to the second floor and enjoy a totally spacious alternative seating area. + You can watch ice cream being made! They have a huge glass wall that can be observed on either the bottom or top floor. It can be very entertaining for little ones to watch the big machines at work through a 2-story viewing glass. The staff at Mitchell's is also super helpful and they handle long lines like champions, even when people are being super difficult. I also appreciate that Mitchell's is involved in the community. I see their name attached to community initiatives all the time. For me, I love a business even more when giving back to their community is a core part of their values.
Awesome ice cream place in Ohio city. Its Mitchell's how could you not like it? The downside is this place has a line out the door on weekends so get here early.

I had my son's first birthday party at the Mitchell's Ice Cream Factory and rented out the the Rialto Room. It was spectacular! There is so much natural light in this room, which makes it the perfect event space for a baby shower or birthday party. Johnny is the main event planner and he is so easy to work with. The staff here are amazing -- they were all so nice and quite organized. When we arrived, everything was perfectly set up. I hardly had any work to do when I got there. They also do all of the clean-up after the party! A half hour after our guests arrived, a staff member brought out a menu for our guests to choose their favorite ice cream flavor and brought it out about an hour and a half later (we had about 50 guests). That worked out fine bc we had catered dinner from Nate's Delhi and had ice cream and cake for dessert! Needless to say, the ice cream here is the best in the world!

I think that might have been the best ice cream I have ever had. Flavors were great too (I had s'mores and coffee), but the underlying ice cream base was spectacular - super fresh cream and just the right consistency and richness. Wow. It's a good thing they don't have this where I live. :-0 Cool to be able to watch them making various flavors from the second floor space overlooking the production area. Definitely worth a visit.
love this ice cream the cherry chocolate chuck if my favorite

This is my friends and I's favorite place to get dessert while we are out. There is a big parking lot behind Mitchell's with the first hour and a half of parking free, making it a pretty easy place to get to downtown. My personal favorites are the raspberry sorbet, mango sorbet, and the butter pecan. The interior of the W 25th location is very neat with seating both downstairs and upstairs, with glass walls allowing you to watch the ice cream being made. I also love to go here with my family, as everyone loves the treat and being able to watch ice cream being made!

if you only have time for one ice cream place in Cleveland, you MUST go to Mitchell's. You don't have to go to this exact Mitchell's (though this is a cool spot) as all of the Mitchell's I've been to have been EXCELLENT, but if you're into ice cream, Mitchell's is a must. The ice cream is fresh, creamy, and flavorful. I love the key lime pie and lemon black raspberry, but all of the flavors I've tried have been good. Like, you know it's good ice cream when my lactose-not-so-cool-with-it self is willing to risk it every. single. time. And is also willing to go for DOUBLE SCOOPS.

Not only does Mitchell's have the best ice cream around, this location is just the best. I love the open concept where you can see the factory setting behind the counter & two level seating for guests. There is a nice outdoor area to sit when the weather is nice that is a go-to in the summer time to hangout & enjoy your delicious ice cream. Favorite flavor: double chocolate chunk!!

My Dad and I were both in Cleveland travelling for work and met up over dinner, but the highlight was walking down the street afterwards to get Mitchell's ice cream. Actually, we picked the restaurant because it was close by. You see, my hotel has a freezer full of Mitchell's so I've been sampling their flavors for a few weeks now. My favorite is the Pistachio, I also haven't been disappointed yet with anything I've tried. If you're around, you should absolutely stop by their location it is worth the trip!

I LIVE LAUGH LOVE MITCHELLS! For AGES I have gotten my ice cream here, and it is the real deal! The staff is adequately trained and kind. The kids love watching the train go round and round, and it is just a very enjoyable family favourite! Please go here!
The service is amazing very friendly. The Cleveland sundae omg so good and that brownie was yummy. When I visit Cleveland again I will come back..
This place has best homemade ice cream. If your ever in the Cleveland area, I would recommend coming here. There are so many choices of ice cream. You can try samples if need be.

Always heard about Mitchell's, people raving about it. Whenever I pass it by, I see lines are out the doors. "This must be darn good ice cream/frozen yogurt" I keep saying to myself. Well, I finally got my opportunity to try this high demand ice cream...no lines, straight to the front. I decided to try the taster's duo...my choices? Campfire S'mores and Blue Cosmo. It was definitely a weird combination mashed together, ugh especially when it started to melt. I actually thought I was going to be wowed...kind of like when I have my Cold Stone Creamery Oreo Overload this is so amazing reaction. Nope...didn't happen for me. I was just ice cream...ice cream that I can get at the grocery store. Didn't quite understand what the big deal about this place. I feel that it is extremely overhyped. Price wise...inexpensive, which is a good thing. I guess when it is not crowded and you are craving for some ice cream while you are out and about in Ohio City I guess you can take $4 bucks and get a frozen treat. Otherwise, I'll just stop by the store and grab some ice cream and go home.

Fresh ice cream, great service, served in a bright/open setting: that's the Mitchell's experience! This location, in Ohio City, is right in the middle of great restaurants and shopping, and it's the place we go to for dessert after spending a few hours dining and exploring the area. The store-front is located in front of their large processing facility, so you can see the actual fresh ingredients going into their product. Nothing to hide hear: you can literally stand along a glass wall and watch ice cream being made! While you're there, don't forget to get some to go home with -- they'll even sell you some dry ice to make sure it makes it home safely. Seriously, I cannot get enough of this place. You should go NOW!

When I first moved here, I didn't understand the hype over Mitchell's. Fast forward three years and about 1000 truck loads of ice cream later, I get it... and I can't ever get enough. I was pretty pumped when the Ohio City location opened. It's close enough to my downtown apartment that if I'm ever craving ice cream, it's a short drive away, but it's far enough that I can't walk over on a nightly basis for some creamy goodness! I go out / go out to eat a ton in OC, and always end up getting ice cream either post lunch/dinner or between bars. My absolute favorite is the Great Lakes Porter Chocolate Chunk! I can also make do with Pralines and Cream, Coffee chocolate chunk, or peanut butter chocolate chunk. Or, better yet, I love ordering the taster's trio and getting a sampling of three of the above! I love this location because it's big and spacious. If you're not planning on walking around W. 25th with your ice cream, there's plenty of seating (upstairs is usually open if the first floor is full). I love that you can see the huge kitchen as they create their delicious ice creams! And, now I'm craving ice cream... be right back ;)

Now playing: unique flavors made fresh! Seriously, I though this was just an ice cream shop, with a theater facade. I was not expecting a bird's eye view of the entire production process from start to finish. As a nerdy food service manager myself, I really appreciated this level of insight and transparency. Tangents aside, the ice cream was truly the star here. I had the amaretto cookie and mango sorbet. Amaretto cookie was phenomenal, the almond flavor and crisp cookie bits were just something you can't find anywhere else. Mango sorbet was pretty good, too. Although I'm less of a sorbet guy than full fat ice cream. Their serving sizes are also quite generous, so you are getting your money's worth. Come for the ice cream, stay to gawk at the workers/appreciate the ice cream making process.

As far as ice cream goes, this is where it's at! This review is brought to you buy someone who isn't even that into ice cream. If you gave me the option of desserts, ice cream would be at the bottom of my list. BUT, not this ice cream, its more than just ice cream, its magic! My favorite flavor is the Banana Cream Pie! It has homemade marshmallows, organic bananas, and homemade shortbread cookies layered throughout a delicious banana flavored ice cream. Sometimes i like to pair it with the chocolate peanut butter cup ice cream. This location is where they make their ice cream, and you get the joy of watching them make it if you see fit. You can walk around on the main floor, or take the stairs, or elevator up to a loft area and watch them do their magic! Worth the short walk from the Westside Market, or really from anywhere. Go check it out!!!

This is probably our favorite ice cream spot. Everything from the flavors, the establishment, and the employees; is an all around great experience. We tend to take family and friends who are from out of town to experience Mitchell's at its greatest location. Everyone always seem to love it. My favorite is their pistachio ice cream and the coffee chocolate chunk. Their smore's ice cream, which comes out during summer time is amazing as well.
They have a variety of tastes but my all time favorite is the peanut butter chocolate chunk. Just be aware that their scoops are very big

Great place to get different flavors of ice cream. The staff is very friendly and will let you try different flavors. Has a couple of tables outside, which makes it a nice place to go to in the summer. Parking is might be hard to get at times.

Well worth the stop at any of their locations! The smell as you approach the doors is intoxicating as you catch the scent of the delicious cones! The ice cream to follow does not disappoint. I used to think not much could compare to Graeters or Jeni's in Ohio or Salt & Straw in Portland, OR...but this may be sliding into the top spot. Creamy and delicious ice cream and fresh cones...I have not been disappointed in my five stops thus far. It is a must stop when in the area.

I lived in Cleveland from August 2011 - Feb 2018. I am not exactly sure when I discovered Mitchell's - likely when they opened in Ohio City at this location - but I consider all previous years totally wasted. Mitchell's is the best ice cream. I have since moved away from the 'Land and withe the exception of my friends I miss only 2 things - my jacuzzi tub and Mitchell's. Favorite flavors include - Wild Berry Crumble, Butter Pecan, Toasted Pistachio and Praline Pecan. I often took pints to-go but pro-tip - they will give you 3 cones (cake or sugar) with your pint, as well as complimentary topping sides - i suggest the shaved chocolate. Also - make sure to get a pretzel stick - pretty sure they are complimentary. And then buy a brownie.

Awesome ice cream, lovely staff and a flipping viewing gallery! This place ticks all the boxes especially after a couple of beers in one of the nearby microbreweries! Four words - Reese's Cups Ice Cream

Holy ice cream freshness! Stopped here on a whim and was blown away by the freshness. Tried the caramelized chocolate ice cream as a sundae topped with hot fudge, fresh whipped cream and a homemade cherry that was more luxardo than maraschino. So good. Savored every bite while overlooking the workers making fresh ice cream.

Absolutely insanely delicious. The key lime is fantastic. I loved the peanut butter chocolate, it may have ruined all other peanut butter ice cream for me. Friendly staff, reasonable prices and you get a view of the factory!

DELICIOUS ice cream. Available in pints in grocery stores and also at the Mitchell's flagship in Ohio City. Both are well worth it. The store is lively and has tons of great flavors. And the ice cream still tastes great in pints from the grocery store. Chocolate peanut butter cup is particularly delicious, but all their flavors with chocolate are great.

Mitchell's has the best ice cream I have ever had!! I have been to almost every location in Ohio countless times and I have always been satisfied by the ice cream and service. Every employee is very well-educated about what flavors would suit each individual. The staff is very patient when customers try several flavors before choosing one. My favorite thing on the menu is a small sundae with Mint Chocolate Chunk ice cream, hot fudge, whipped cream, salted pecans, and a cherry on top. The ingredients are always fresh and I never feel lethargic or overwhelmed by the sugar content after eating at Mitchell's. I love the Ohio City location the best because you can see the factory behind a glass wall and it always looks so clean and bright. Other than ice cream, the Sunny Day Smoothie is delicious and not too sweet! Honestly, I would love to give Mitchell's a 6 star rating if I could.

Wow, what a setup! Mitchell's Homemade Ice Cream is impressive as soon as you lay eyes on it. It's retro marquee draws you in and then the pristine look let's you know that this is no ordinary ice cream shop. The menu featured flavors, both traditional and funky. And the homemade aspect of this is clearly in its name. I went with the taster duo - half scoop of chocolate peanut butter cup and half scoop of one of their featured flavors, geauga maple walnut. Both were equally delicious. Mitchell's offers the essential toppings - whipped topping, sauces, and a few candy and fruit options. Once you get your ice cream, you can hang out in their large dining area or take a stroll down west 25th street. This place is going to be booming in the summer so make sure you take some time to check it out! Update 9/14/14 - dogs are not allowed :( have to reduce my rating. I knew it was too good to be true! Building owners won't allow it.

Love love love their ice cream!! I normally get their pistachio flavor. It's rich and creamy. They have lots of flavor to choose from. They also have free waffle cones you can take home. In the back there's a glass wall where you can see all them making the ice cream! They also have outdoor seating.

On my recent trip to Cleveland, my friend kept suggesting taking us to Mitchell's before we came back home to Pittsburgh. It was the last thing we did and a GREAT ending to our weekend in the city. This location is perfect from the space to the ice cream. The first thing I noticed was how you can see the ice cream being made behind the glass from where you order your ice cream. It reminded me of Willy Wonka. Employees were definitely working hard and it was cool knowing where your ice cream is coming from. Aside from the kitchen area, the building is huge! I think my friend mentioned it used to be a theater. There are two floors and each has plenty of tables and chairs to enjoy your treats. It's decorated very plain, yet extremely modern. The ice cream is some of the best I've had! They had countless flavors, some unique and some more traditional. I had peanut butter chocolate chunk. It was peanut butter flavored ice cream with chocolate chunks mixed in. One scoop (they were very generous) on a cake cone was a little over $3. Great price! Just enough to satisfy my sweet tooth!

a willy wonka dreamscape in ohio city. the model train rolls around the suspended track. and the staff are buoyant with the joy of scooping the most amazing ice cream you'll ever have. the majority of ingredients are local and seasonal and the milk and cream are hormone free. everything here adds up to happiness.

Best spot in Ohio City to stop and get some ice cream! One of my favorite things to get here is a milk shake using the double chunk flavor with whip cream and chocolate flakes. The other great thing about Mitchell's is the amount of different flavors. Mitchell's is always coming out with something new. So, you never get bored. Tip: During the weekends and some week nights the store can get a bit crazy with a line out the door. If you just want a scoop or so of ice cream you can skip the line by going and grabbing a pint. I have done this on several occasions when the line has been horrible. Mitchell's is a great ice cream shop that has an amazing atmosphere. Since moving here it has become one of my favorite places to stop and bring people to.

Love this place. They have a variety of unique flavors and nice decor. Any place that can serve homemade pistachio is an auto-fav for me. Seasonal flavors are also on the menu. Like other ice cream establishments, they serve by scoops and your choice of cups or cones. I asked for the large three scoops which is not necessarily on the menu b/c it's a lot of ice cream. I LIKE ICE CREAM. As for the place, they have a decent amount of seating indoors and some outdoors. Inside, you can see the kitchen through the windows in the hallway to the bathroom. They can host private events on the second floor and even have a model train going around on top in the seating area. I wish the train would serve the ice cream as it makes its rounds along the tracks. Definitely a great place for family, friends, or dates.

What's not to love? I mean, Mitchell's is so good that one of the bartender's at a nearby restaurant shared that they don't bother having a lengthy dessert menu because "Everybody goes to Mitchell's." And he's right, that's exactly where I ended up when it was time for something sweet to end the night. I highly..highly...highly recommend the Dark Roast Coffee flavor. I mean, simply put, if you love yourself you'll get it. One scoop is more than enough. I can't vouch for any other flavors yet because I love the coffee so much that it's all I ever get. Nevertheless, I can't imagine that anything about Mitchell's would ever disappoint. Loosen a notch or two on your belt and go enjoy!

Some of the best ice cream ever. I don't normally like chocolate ice cream, and their vegan chocolate ice cream was amaaaaaazing. Their mango sorbet was also made of great quality mangos, so it was absolutely delicious- a rarity in America. Their other flavors are amazing, but I had to mention those two because they're unusual. Go!! You also can't beat the free comes you get when you buy a pint.

Yes yes yes, the place to be for dessert in Cleveland, wooo! I ordered the Chocolate Mint and the Pecan Praline. I saw the Mint was not green, they said because they don't add food coloring, extra points for that! The Pecan Praline was out of this world, stopping here again on my next trip to Cleveland!

Love love love homemade ice cream! This place really does remind me of a local one back home with the exception you can see the production floor behind the counter when you place your order! How cool is that!?!?! The ice cream is very fresh and very flavorful for sure! I absolutely love the creamy,tasty texture melt in your mouth ice cream Mitchells offers you for sure! Support your local homemade ice cream places where ever you are! There really isn't anything like them! I'm a fan and I'll be back here for sure!
Fantastic ice cream with a large portion. I tried the chocolate cookie flavor and plan on getting it again if I ever return to Cleveland.

Love this place! People who work here seem like they love their jobs lol. Everyone is super nice and friendly. Awesome selection of ice cream, all types of interesting flavors. You can try samples of every flavor if you want before you make the tough decision on which to order. The adults and kids alike enjoyed watching the workers in the back made the ice cream just as much as eating it! Mitchell's has a glass wall so you can see whats happening behind the scenes. They have tables where you can sit and hang while you eat ice cream upstairs and down. The place will always be busy if you're there on the weekend, but it's large enough to sit comfortably. If your in the neighborhood it's a must try!
Praline and cream was to die for!! So much caramel! It was so much fun to go upstairs and watch them make the ice cream!

Four words : VEGAN CHOCOLATE ICE CREAM. Seriously one of the best kept secrets in Cleveland. You don't have to be vegan to like this (I would know). I've turned my friends and family onto it as well and they usually make it one of the flavors in their cup. They usually have two vegan flavors on rotation and they seriously are the best dairy-free ice creams I've had. Honestly, they're better than most "normal" ice creams and is super velvety. Definitely take my word for it and try a spoonful next time you're in - even my disgruntle steelworkers like it. Okay, okay, I'll stop. Other perks of Mitchell's, aside from the amazing ice cream, is that it's a prime example of a gorgeous local business. I love the aesthetics on the inside. It's in some old theater and you can look up and see the old wooden beams intersecting a giant glass wall that let's you watch the workers mix up batches of ice cream. I've watched them wash and prepare fresh strawberries which is so refreshing in a world full of artificial flavors. I will say if you get the vegan chocolate grab a cup cause it's pretty melty and the servings are so big I usually take it home and stick it in the freezer. If you're at the market or eating in Ohio City definitely swing by for a sweet treat!

Adding to the chorus of praise below, Mitchell's is a Cleveland legend...worthy of the highest accolades. If you haven't been to their storefront or bought their pints at the grocery store before, charge ahead full speed and don't hold back. This is a splurge. (Side note: when doing your Yelp research, ignore the 1-star tantrums of those clueless Yelp users who do us no favors by rating a business based on a 5-second interaction with a clerk or a perceived slight they felt from the floor-sweeper. Amongst those of us who actually eat the ice cream, I'd be willing to bet there is almost a universal 5-star consensus). On to the product, on creaminess alone, Mitchell's rises above just about any ice cream you'll find on store shelves. The flavor selection isn't as wild and experimental as some outfits these days, but you'll find stunningly good versions of your favorite avant-garde ice creams from the 80's and 90's - cookies and cream, butter pecan, cookie dough, pralines and cream etc. You'll also find yourself muttering in awe at how well Mitchell's is able to extract the flavor from a given ingredient and infuse it into an ice cream, creating simple and exquisite classics (coconut, pistachio, coffee, smores etc). Their pastry-infused ice creams are especially awe-inspiring (banana cream pie, apple pie, strawberry rhubarb pie, caramel fudge brownie); the baked goods they use in these concoctions could win contests on their own. What I love about Mitchell's is that it's not just the tastiest ice cream out there, it's also the purest. When you pick up a pint and read the ingredients, you won't see a laundry list of unpronounceable ingredients and stabilizers, xanthams, guar gums...etc. etc. Instead you'll mainly just see the wholesome and time-tested basics that gave ice cream its international fame: cream, skim milk, organic sugar, sea salt, vanilla, egg yolks.

It's fast and it also has good service. The workers their are polite they do it fast and Nicely done. They have any flavors you can think of. But I have to warn you some of the time it is pretty crowded. it's all worth it. they even give you samples when you want to try the flavor you picked. If you want they even have shakes and you can watch them make there homemade ice cream because there is a glass window of there factory!

Mitchell's Homemade Ice Cream was a great mid day treat on our trip to Cleveland. They have so many flavors! I enjoyed the Coffee Chocolate Chunk and my husband had the Porter Chocolate Chunk. Both flavors were pretty good. I'd stop back if I'm ever in the area!

Love the location on W.25th. My son and I sneak out of the house every chance we get to grab a scoop! Consistently friendly and delicious, Mitchell's is one of Cleveland's best when it comes to Ice Cream!

By far the best ice cream. You can see it being made in front of you. It is so soft and delicious. I eat dairy free so I only have two options here, but boy the vegan chocolate is AMAZING. I love it more than regular chocolate. It tastes just the same and doesn't have an odd texture. They have great toppings, like fresh strawberries. The pricing isn't bad at all and you get a good portion size. The staff are always so friendly.
Over 300 reviews and still 5 out of 5 had me curious and this place did not disappoint! Super good! Love it!

Delicious ice cream! They have a wide assortment of flavors- many of which are dairy-free friendly- and they often bring in new flavors. I strongly recommend their smoothies! They are fresh and delicious.

Their vanilla bean, wild berry swirl ice cream is TO DIE FOR!! It's so good! They have many flavors to choose from and everything is made on site. You can walk to the back of the store to watch them make the ice cream from scratch. I love that this place was built in an old movie theater because it gives the store front a very unique look. Staff was friendly and didn't mind giving lots of samples (there were so many options, I didn't know which one to choose!). I will definitely be coming back here while I'm in Cleveland!
Found this place by accident! Amazing ice cream! One "scoop" was huge in a cup. Got the peanut butter and it was perfecto! If i lived near here i would definitely be 10lbs more!

I've only lived here for 2 weeks and I've been to Mitchell's twice already. It's a great location for getting ice cream after eating in Ohio city or visiting the market. The ice cream is of course delicious and we enjoyed going up the stairs to the top level where you can watch them make the ice cream below.
Never disappointing. Always delicious. Staff is friendly. Super cute and simple inside. It gets really busy so prepare to wait in line, but it is worth it.
This place is awesome! Real flavor with actual chunks of whatever flavor you are eating!

This is an awesome place to enjoy some really good ice cream. Really like the dÃ©cor of the place. It's so nice one can see the ice cream being made in front of one's eyes. Head to second floor to have a nice bird's eye view of the factory. Plenty to great flavors to choose from , definitely a great spot.

We happened to park behind Mitchell's on our cross country roadtrip! We were so happy. Hands down one of the best ice cream I've had. Their handmade ice cream is so creamy and smooth. The vanilla bean was so good. They use quality ingredients, give huge scoops, and are pretty cheap ( though I'm biased being from nyc). Even after a massive scoop you don't feel nasty or lethargic because it tastes so fresh! I also love how you can overlook the ice cream being made. The location is so clean and full of art.
was visiting from texas and this was the one place we stopped and i'm so glad we did it was delicious! super creamy and the cutest store

Beautiful space serving delicious frozen goodness! You want to have a elegant slumber party here! Ice cream can be tricky for me...digestively if you know what I mean...not Michell's! I popped in this past Friday and tried the toasted pistachio and vegan sea salt caramel...so delish. The vegan flavor finishes off slightly coconutty...I loved it and am so shocked at how similiar in texture, taste, and flavor it is to REAL ice cream. I am a vegan believer...well at least here anyway!

Amazing! Stopped in after checking out a few of the local brew pubs while enjoying an evening in Cleveland. This place surpassed all expectations that I had of an Ice Cream shop. I tried the Smores and my wife got the salted caramel they were both amazing though the caramel is a much better option. The aesthetic here is pretty cool as well being in an old theatre, keeping the marquee. Once inside you can see the vats and kitchen where they make the ice cream which is pretty awesome as well.

Located in old Theatre building, quite earth friendly, with solar power and a soft footprint for the environment. Ah but the ice cream, cookies and cream. Chocolate with chunks of chocolate, has a nice flavor not overly sweet. The vanilla ice cream with a huge cake cone Yum. You may stand either on the second floor and look down on the ice cream being made. Also on the first floor glass walls from which you can look into the room. Outside tables and wonderful place to enjoy you cool treat on a hot day.

Came here a few weeks ago on a weeknight, loved it. I tried the salted caramel (very smoky, but good) and peanut butter cup (even better). They have plenty of options and offer free samples to taste before selecting your flavor, which is helpful. Love the space inside. Definitely recommend.

This isn't just about great ice cream but a great venue as well. The clean, well-lighted, production area behind the glass also reveals the vintage architecture that gives a nod to Cleveland's industrial past. There is plenty of seating on two different levels and the modern decor provides a striking contrast to the building. As for the ice cream, Mitchell's was offering rhubarb the day of my visit. If you are a fan of rhubarb, you can appreciate what I'm saying. Who does rhubarb ice cream!?! It was some of the best ice cream I have ever had! If you're visiting the area, be sure to stop. The hotter the day, the better!

This was my first time here, we are visiting the Cleveland area for a mini vacation. We went on a Saturday and when we passed it for dinner, there was a line out the door and when we came back from dinner, there was still a line out the door. The line moved quickly, they had laminated menus near the door, which helped moved things along. My kids have allergies and were so excited to try their vegan options! They got chocolate and the other one got the salted caramel pecan. I tried a bit of both and the salted caramel pecan was delicious, the chocolate one was on the darker side and great too! I got the roasted pistachio and praline and both were amazing! They had a summer favor of banana cream pie I really wanted to try, but they had run out. The factory was behind the serving line and there was actual seating back towards that area, but we didn't know about it until we were leaving. You can tell they use the best ingredients and I would highly recommend!!!

Mitchell's is such a bright spot in Ohio City. Literally. It is so bright and clean inside, you can't help but smile. The staff is incredibly friendly and just nice. Such a nice change to be able to watch your ice cream being made! The ice cream was delicious (I went with the peanut butter chocolate chunk), but it was hard to decide with all the fresh, new seasonal flavors. The only challenge is parking, but all of Ohio City has the same challenge.

Advice: A single scoop is big enough to share. See if you can ask for a half scoop of one flavour and a half scoop of another if you originally wanted to try two different flavours. We got a scoop of caramelized chocolate and a scoop of the wild berry crumble and one scoop each was too much for the both of us. The ice cream shop is an old theatre converted to an ice cream manufacturing facility and store front that's got a great facade, drawing in a steady stream of customers on a warm summer's day.
Here to visit Cleveland and Mitchell's was highly recommended. They did not disappoint! Best homemade ice cream ever!
Good value for what u get. Huge portions affordable price. Would highly recommend! Great service from staff! Not as good as sweet moses but still recommend

The ice cream was that good. They had interesting flavors - both regular and special- and high quality ice cream. The line was out the door but moved quickly. Prices were reasonable- I think $5.50 for a milkshake I couldn't finish
