I couldn't be more of a fan of Mitchell's. Fresh, vibrant flavors from great, local ingredients. Anyone who says this place isn't the best ice cream is entitled to their opinion, however wrong it may be.

Banana cream pie I have died and gone to heaven. I'm a picky ice cream eater, but being that I work in Ohio city I figured to give them a whirl and boy and I glad I did! Great atmosphere, west 25th is the up and up neighborhood, and Mitchell's is where it's at!! Pricing is a little higher than the usual ice cream shop but it's totally worth it.

One word, AMAZING! Definitely my favorite ice cream place. The inside of this location is modern and sleek. They have a train that travels around the store that my daughter loves. They also have a little table that goes along the windows for the kids and they have crayons to draw. Today we got a pint of campfire s'mores and raspberry chocolate chunk. They are both delicious. I love that they don't skimp out on the add ins in the ice cream. The campfire s'mores has a delicious graham cracker taste and it's swirled with marshmallow and BIG chunks of chocolate.

I'll have to admit when my friend said "Mitchell's is the best!" I was like "uhhh no Handels is!" But when I came and tried it I was so happy and surprised how much I love it here! The waffle cones are amazing and the only thing I get now. I love that the workers have no problem letting you sample the ice cream before you choose! (Wild berry crumble is one of my favorites!) I really like when you buy ice cream to take home they offer you free complimentary cones to choose. Like I said I still love Handles but I'm always up for a trip to Mitchell's! And thanks again to the workers for ALWAY have smiles on theirs faces and being so accommodating!

Great location, very clean feeling and airy. Fast efficient and very polite service. Indoor and outdoor seating, and you can actually watch them making the ice cream behind the counter. Cool location.

This is my fave location. You can see ice cream being being made from the windows. You can also sample before having to make that important commitment to a flavor. The upstairs helps alleviate congestion issues and the train around the downstairs seating area adds charm. It's very family friendly and worth a visit. Parking as of my post is kind of a mess, while construction occurs behind Mitchell's.
Mitchell's was incredible! Cookies and cream ice cream was delicious and only set me back $3.75. Prompt service and ability to sample multiple flavors.
Their vegan ice cream is on point. I order it every time and I'm not even vegan! It's made with coconut milk and unbelievably creamy! A must try!

Cool spot for late night ice cream. I received my birthday cake from here. Im not fond of chocolate but i loved my chocolate ice cream cake. And the lingering essence of warm waffle cones in the air once you get there can have me sit there all day.
Yummy! I had the salted caramel after the nice young man behind the counter asked if I would like to try anything. Friendly service and yummy ice cream. A single scoop was huge.

I am very fond of their ice cream. The location is fantastic, it is in a very large building that can handle that masses of satisfied customers that are returning for their fix of cream of ice. The snow does not stop my taste sensations from making me drive to Ohio City to collect myself my keep. Parking is never a pleasure in Ohio City but you get used to it and you learn some of the secrets. I would have to say that a large free garage would be the most amazing investiment for Ohio City but I dare to dream yet. I had a Smorz flavor that I am in love with and I don't care who knows it. Their pumpkin was on point as well but I decided to venture away from being a basic person to get something equally as basic sounding but socially couth. The service is fantastic and I always leave with a smile. Overall, the be brief you will like it and it is worth the time to come. An added attraction is looking into the back and seeing the magic in action as it is created. Tip: Free samples will help your heart and brain find the truth to what it is that you desire.
awesome ice cream !!!! so many tasty flavors to choose from. sometimes there can be long lines but it moves quickly. they are very generous with samples too !

Old school ice cream parlor feel with a very friendly staff. Ice cream is fantastic and it was really neat seeing where they make the ice cream for all 8 locations. They even have a nice patio to sit outside and enjoy your ice cream!
Great ice cream, reasonable prices, and really helpful staff! Even the vegan flavors were great and I don't do vegan. They're also really generous with samples.
Today we were in this place and it has been great experience. You can see the factory trough a glass and the ice cream is delicious. My favorite berry chocolate chunk.
A trip to the Westside market and Ohio City is not complete without a stop at Mitchell's ice cream probably the best ice cream I've ever had I wish they had locations in other cities

I had two different vegan ice creams, the chocolate and salted caramel pecan.... the best ice cream I've ever had, vegan or not. The inside is so cute. And the workers were so patient and helpful. Loved it.

It's ice cream, I mean, how can you give ice cream a bad review?!? Ok, I know, there are other things to consider, and I have considered them and still give this place five stars. So many flavors, so little time. I've been here more times than I'll admit (although my waistline shows it), and always try something different and have never been disappointed. Because we usually stop here after dinner, I usually get a single in a dish and still can't finish it, but then I'm all, 'leave no ice cream behind...' and then I force myself and get a stomach ache. This is my problem, not Mitchell's. All this to say that the portions are generous. Decor is cool. It fits in perfectly with the whole W. 25th vibe, and I love the train overhead. Also, thank you for putting in a water dispenser with cups. This is so much better than other places that have a skeezy looking clouded pitcher of water that's been setting out for who-knows how long! I shouldn't have written this review, now I want ice cream.

Came here and was very impressed. They have a lot of flavors to choose from. I can't have dairy anymore and there were a few options to choose from. I have the two vegan flavors with peanut butter syrup and it was heaven in my mouth. My other half had the banana something and it smelt so good. He said it was so good. Pretty cool that they have a train running from the ceiling. Staff was very friendly and happy.

I LOVE this new location. The kitchen isn't up and running yet but it looks beautiful. I love that it's open for everyone to see because (a) that's neat and (b) it promotes cleanliness. I hope they do tours once they're fully switched to this location. I had the vanilla brownie caramel and my boyfriend had coffee chocolate chip. Both were delicious. I love that they offer sugar cones as an option. This experience was fabulous, as usual with Mitchell's ice cream!
I've never had anything here I didn't enjoy. Don't miss the seasonal offerings -- the strawberry rhubarb crisp is my favorite. It does get crowded; sit outside if possible.

Ice cream is pretty much a solid choice anywhere you go, but Mitchells is my go to option all the time! Not only is it awesome that you can watch them actually making the ice cream there in store, it tastes equally fresh and delicious! They have a number of different flavors in store-- and also plenty of options that you can purchase by the carton to bring home as well. Prices are incredibly reasonable for how much you get and the staff is always very friendly every time I go!

The line is always long, but the workers are always friendly, even late at night. If you're new to the place, no there isn't a posted menu, but there are some paper ones on the table to the left of the doors. If not, walk up to the left of the line up by the counter and grab one. Call ahead to make sure they have vegan ice cream in stock. They only have 2 flavours at a time and when I stopped in on two occasions they were out of coconut milk so they couldn't make any. Third time was a charm however and it was worth the wait! They did have 2 sorbet options however which were just as good. Sorbets, vegan flavours and all regular ice cream is sold by the pint and quart at prices cheaper than store brands, which makes sense since they make it in the back room. You can watch them cook from the hall to the right of the register or from the second floor.
Just wow, so yummy. I did the pralines and cream. It was totally on point. The place is fun. We liked watching them, make the ice cream.
Some of the best ice cream in the world. Period. And definitely the best in The Land! Favorite is the Caramel Sea Salt!

Definitely an old style ice cream business. Employees treat customers like family. We had the cleveland sundae with a brownie and it was pretty awesome. Prices are about average. Facility was very clean. Thanks from Alaska family.

When entering Mitchell's Ice cream shop, you'll immediately be greeted with an aroma of sweet fresh baked waffle cones and sugar in the air; so be prepared that you'll start salivating right when you enter. I finally went on the tour, it's really one large room to see, but they do go into the thorough explanation as to how their ice cream is made and all of their procedures that separate them apart from their competition. Their quality is on par with HÃ¤agen-Dazs. And they explain a bit about the family, the local location and local distributors. The art around the shop is by the Mother of the owners, Bea Mitchell. Cute place, excellent location, and most fabulous cookies and cream ever!

Yaas! Yaas! Let's all scream for (vegan) ice cream!!! Went here, the staff were so friendly and nice. The inside is clean and well decorated, keeping the feel of the old movie theatre it used to be. The train running is also adorable. I tried the two vegan ice cream offerings (as well as some not vegan ones) the vegan ice cream is delicious! Get the chocolate, you won't regret it. The BEST chocolate ice cream I've ever eaten in my life. (and I've eaten my fair share of ice cream) The sea salted caramel was also delicious. Key lime pie ice cream? yes please. Go here for dessert in Ohio City! You can sit outside or inside! Bring your dog!

Clean, lots of ice cream choices including traditional and unique, ability to sample flavors, nice employees, indoor/outdoor seating, line moves very quickly, free water....I mean what else can you do! It's perfect. Loved supporting this local Cleveland ice cream shop :)
A little pricey but extremely good ice cream! My favorite is the caramel fudge brownie! It always seems sort of busy on the inside but the line usually moves very quickly.

Mitchell's is a "Can't Miss." They have a great selection of flavors, and you're able to taste any/all that you need. I've had a half dozen different flavors, and there hasn't been one bad choice. Really, they're all delicious. The service is awesome, too. Everybody has been really friendly & easy to talk to. They're happy to give you their suggestions of delicious flavors, and, as I mentioned already, they let you sample any of the flavors. The dining/eating area is clean, simple, and communal. They keep it clean, it looks great, and what more can you ask for!? As my tip points out, I would definitely suggest heading upstairs! For some reason they don't have chairs/tables up there, but they have some interesting art and really big windows that overlook the kitchen. It's pretty fun to look down and see what all the workers are doing. Skip the elevator and take the stairs though. The elevator is VERY slow, and you should probably burn off the calories you're eating anyway.

I ordered the Cleveland Brownie Sundae and it was great. This is a good option for those who want lots of ice cream and other good stuffs inside. I don't recommend this if you just want a small amount because the container is huge. They have table inside and outside and the only thing I think they need to improve is the variety of flavors without dairy.

while at the West side market, we began walking in the area and wanted ice cream, The West Side market does not have any ice cream vendors but someone directed us to Mitchells. This is a former movie theater which has been converted to an ice cream parlor with private rooms for functions upstairs. The staff was most helpful [Rachel, Zaid] and took out orders right away. We actually made two trips there since the ice cream was so good. I would recommend and return.

Wow this place is busy! The lines were out the door when we got here. It is so cool that you can see right into their huge kitchen - which by the way is immaculate! Several employees were working preparing ingredients for more batches of their made from scratch flavors and they all were dressed in clean uniforms. I was impressed by this operation! They have so many flavors and are very generous on giving as many samples to taste too! I settled on a single scoop of butter pecan in one of their homemade waffle cones. Oh my the scoop was humongous! I was just not able to finish it! They offer sundaes and shakes besides ice cream, and sugar free and vegan options too. This is definitely a busy place, but their lines move quickly. I found them reasonably priced for the quality and quantity they give you! Stop by and try Mitchell's for a delicious ice cream treat!

Don't be intimidated by the long line- Line was long but it moved fast, and totally worth it. The workers were really nice too and let us sample a few flavors because there's so many to choose from! Ice cream flavors all so good really can't go wrong. Plus it's cool to see the factory in the back! Wish we had a place like this where I live.

Absolutely the best ice cream I've ever had! I'm always surprised at how much business this place gets even in the middle of winter. They have an awesome space which is a renovated movie theater. You can peek into the back through the glass wall and watch the employees make their glorious product. Every flavor I've tried is amazing. The ice cream is super rich and satisfying. My favorite is the toasted pistachio. Definitely recommend that everyone tries their ice cream!
Closed at 9PM on the 4th of July! Fireworks hadn't even popped off yet. Walked in and were yelled at -- "We're closed!" -- without a hint of apology. Took my talents to Mason's Creamery instead.

Yum! So many choices. They give you tastes to help you decide and since I'm gluten free they advised me as to which flavors were safe. I decided on the fresh peach and the coffee chocolate chunk in a double smaller scoop.

I'm guessing that Mike is one of the owners and he served me today. Such a cool looking place! The ice cream was incredible! Creamy and rich! I sampled a few different flavors that I loved all of, but chose campfire smores and strawberry rhubarb. I wish I lived closer so I could come here more often.
First time visitor. Turtle brownie, chocolate chunks, wild berry crumble and lemon black raspberry....told my kids to spread some of my ashes at this place!!

Really good! Has some yummy chunks within, and I enjoyed the texture, but more so the flavours. You can see them making it through the glass behind the counter and the kids corner that Bek and I had a lot of fun drawing at haha. Lovely little place

Run. Don't walk. Run. This ice cream is what my dreams are made of. The strawberry rhubarb is amazing...the homemade pie crust pieces...perfection. The cookies and cream is literally the best I've EVER had. I also really like the sizes. I had the tasters duo and it was the perfect size to satisfy my sweet tooth without feeling guilty or weighed down.

Thank you for making fresh ice cream that isn't filled with gums and using local milk! It makes me feel so much better feeding it to my daughter and I love being able to buy it at my local Heneins, Earth Fare and Whole Foods. Just perfect for those teething toddlers! Plus you have those Vegan options which is just perfect for all our Dairy Free friends and family.

Clean, lots of natural light, airy and spacious. Go upstairs so you can watch the employees make ice cream! Free samples :D As it so happened, my family passed by when a home loan/refinancing company was advertising around Ohio City and they gave us coupons for free scoops. How can I say no to free ice cream?! Life is good. I forgot what the flavor was called (it was an unusual name), but it's blue with marshmallows and is supposed to taste like cotton candy. GET THAT ONE.

I love Mitchell's. Probably some of the best ice cream in the CLE. They have seasonal flavors & try to do local providers. I love this aspect of Mitchell's. The servers are ALWAYS happy to give you samples. (My beau hates this though because I feel the need to try, and try, and try.) Honesty, if you like Ice Cream and you're in CLE hit up Mitchell's. Their new location in Ohio City is nice and has gorgeous windows to look out onto W. 25th!

I feel I should give a disclaimer before diving into this review: Mitchell's might steal a little piece of your soul. You might walk through the doors under its stylish theater sign and emerge from the store a changed person. You might hunch over every bowl of ice cream for the rest of your life and sigh because it's not the same. If you're okay with this, read on. Walking into this Mitchell's store is kind of like walking into a real-life, less terrifying version of Willy Wonka's chocolate factory, because there are huge windows behind the counter that let you see into the kitchen. There's also a miniature train that does laps around the ceiling of the store. It's shiny and bright inside, with high ceilings and plenty of seating (though this may fill up at busier times). I mean, it could just be my great love of ice cream, but this place feels magical to me. The employees here truly deserve a special mention, because they're always outstanding. I've been here many times (despite living ~40 minutes away) and I've never had a bad experience with service. Everyone behind the counter is always smiling, and they'll gladly give offer you samples. They're friendly and pretty fast no matter how busy it is (and it does get busy). I always make sure to throw a few dollars in the tip jar. Mitchell's ice cream is made from a lot of ingredients sourced locally or from farmers who use sustainable practices (for coffee, vanilla beans, etc), which I think is admirable. Also, it is freaking delicious, and you really can't go wrong with any flavor (of which there are many). You'll be happy whether you want a high-quality version of something traditional, or something with a little more pizazz. The roughly $3 - $5 you'll pay for a serving is well worth it to me, and their portions are quite generous. They also have vegan flavors, smoothies, frozen yogurt, and sorbet! Favorite flavors: Caramel Fudge Brownie - Vanilla ice cream jam packed with delicious brownie chunks and a ribbon of creamy caramel. It's evident here that Mitchell's does not mess around with their add-ins. Cookie Dough - See above. I've spent a good portion of my life on an epic quest for chocolate chip cookie dough ice cream that actually has adequate amounts of chocolate chips AND cookie dough, and this does. No need to waste your time sifting through plain vanilla ice cream on the off-chance of finding a chunk of dough, because with this you get some IN EVERY BITE. I wish I were eating this now. Fresh Mint Chocolate Chunk - What can I say? I like the classics. Real mint, real chocolate, no artificial green color. Enough said. Peanut Butter Chocolate Pretzel - Peanut butter frozen yogurt with little chocolate covered pretzel bites. Technically not ice cream, but still a perfectly good choice. I mean, what else can I say? You should go to Mitchell's. But you probably already figured that out.
The vegan dark chocolate was amazing. Other flavors were so creamy and good. Love seeing the ice cream being made. Fresh and local ingredients. Love this ice cream kitchen.

So many delicious flavors to choose from. Quick service. Prices are ok for the amount of ice cream you get. Good location! Lots of seating inside with outdoor seating area as well. Great for people watching and there is ALWAYS something to see on W.25th haha!

Whenever I visit my hometown, I like to try new places (new for me). This past summer I wanted ice cream so we headed over to Ohio City to try this place. Best decision ever. They have so many creative flavors and use quality ingredients. There was a bit of a line but it moved quickly and gave me time to decide on a flavor....or two. I was able to sample a few of the flavors before deciding on key lime and black cherry. They were both excellent. It was actually too much ice cream for me (which never happens) so next time I'll stick to one scoop. I didn't realize the place was so huge but we just followed all the other people upstairs to see plenty of tables and chairs, along with a view of the factory. Loved that. I can hardly wait to go back.

Went with the family this is a very fresh clean spacious facility with tons of seating and you can watch the factory make the ice cream. The staff was very friendly and helpful. They accommodate for allergies (non dairy , gluten free, corn free , ect.) And it tastes great . We got a 1/2 gallon to take home also they have dry ice and freezer bags you can buy to get it home without melting. Will definitely be back

We were here 5/19/2017 for a small event with "Minions" from "Despicable Me movies". While were we waiting I could see into the kitchen where Employees who were making the ice cream wore, hairnets, beard-nets and gloves. This made us very happy to see and also that use local dairy products from Ohio Farmers. We were disappointed about the Employees at the Ice cream Counter were not wearing hairnet or gloves. Mitchell's Ice Cream is the Best ice cream I have had. I ordered Bing Cherry and chocolate chunks. The cherries tasted fresh and the chocolate chunks were large.

The worst part about Mitchell's is the long line, usually starting as soon as you walk in the door. The rotation of seasonal ice creams is a great feature, and they work, wether it be winter, summer, spring or fall. Cone or cup will be the easiest decision you make, once you hit that glads counter and see all the flavors your next road block will be one scoop or two

Any season, any time - the staff are genuinely friendly and helpful. The entire location is always clean. The bathrooms are always clean and well stocked - again, any season, any time! I love watching the ice cream being made from the 2nd floor! We always bring friends from out of town here - everyone always gets a kick out of it, and we never seem to tire! The cherry on top - the staff and clientele are very diverse. This is so very appreciated. Many other Mitchell's are in affluent predominantly white communities, and the staff and clientele are a mirror reflection. Let's just say not all our experiences have been warm and fuzzy experiences at other Mitchell's locations. But this one - on point! Oh yeah - the ice cream is WONDERFUL! (ha!)

Delicious ice cream - environment is friendly....little loud but not too bad. I had an ice cream cake there and it was tremendous! You can check out the area that they actually make the ice cream which is nice as well. Has a nice feel and temperature inside... And the entire building looks nice and clean. If I am ever in the area again, I'd love to stop by this place for a nice treat, again!

This is for sure the best ice cream! I had the chocolate peanut butter cup ice cream and I was sold immediately by what a good size the peanut butter cups were! It might sound silly, but I know we've all encountered the disappointment of getting something with peanut butter cups in it and they are the size of a pea and you can barely test them! The ice cream itself was also rich and delicious! I loved the atmosphere here as well! It was really cool to look back and see where they make the ice cream! Service was fast and friendly! Also, it was very affordable. I was expecting it to be more expensive for some reason, but was pleasantly surprised!! Can't wait to go back!

I know this place doesn't need another positive review but I'm giving one anyway. It's awesome! There are so many great flavors of ice cream here, it was tough to make a decision as to what to have. However, I realized that it doesn't matter what you have because it's all fabulous. I got a mini-scoop and appreciated that they offer a small option for when you just crave a little treat. I don't often have excuses to come to Cleveland but I'm going to try to do so in the future, just to go to Mitchell's - fantastic!

Absolutely nauseating. If you're looking for very rich, in-your-face flavor - this is the place for you. Their pints aren't any better. RIDICULOUSLY overpriced for ice cream. Not sure if the Clevelanders who enjoy this are all acting, or if they are too intimidated by the name and reputation to divulge how this ice cream really tastes. Only tolerable thing is the frozen yogurt which is equally expensive but not as rich.
Always impressed when I come here ! Friendly staff that are extremely patient with my indecisiveness. It's just all so good it's hard to decide!

The best ice cream anywhere. Dairy and vegan included. The dairy ice cream is rich and creamy and has an incredible depth of flavor. The flavors are adventurous (strawberry jalapeno). The best thing? The vegan ice cream is the best vegan ice cream I've ever had. The vegan chocolate is insanely rich and chocolaty. My non-vegan friends were shocked to hear that they were eating such delicious vegan ice cream. The new Ohio City location is spacious and beautifully designed. I love that you can watch the ice cream being made.

Great concept of a two-story ice cream shop in their ice cream factory. The ice cream certainly tastes homemade and the flavors they come up with are always worth a try. The only flavor that I didn't care for was the Christmas Ale ice cream. Way too heavy and decadent for my taste. The staff have the patience of Job with no one being able to make a quick decision. There's just too many good choices.
The parking here is crazy! There's always a line out the door in summer, but can you blame anyone?! The ice cream here is delicious with tons of variety.

In the past week, I have had their pistachio, s'mores, key lime, and strawberry ice cream plus a slice of their ice cream cake. It's unbelievable. Guarantee your mind will be blown. Plus you get to see everything being made in this location which adds already unique, welcoming environment. If you are not lactose-intolerant (although I imagine there's probably some vegan kind), there really is no excuse for not trying this out. Someone once said that calories don't count in ice-cream, tacos, and steak, so I'm banking on that.

So cool! I was visiting friends in the area and they brought us here. I loved how you could take a peak out back and see them making the ice cream! The variety of flavors makes it fun and this was some of the best ice cream I have ever had. I got the black raspberry ice cream on top of a brownie, the brownie alone would have been enough. The ice cream had so much flavor, I was really impressed. If I am ever back in Cleveland this will be at the top of my list!

The best ice cream you will ever stuff into your ice cream loving face. Seriously. I love that I live pretty close to the one in Rocky River. When we have dinner with friends and they come out to Lakewood, we usually end up at Mitchell's. Some people do a night cap, we do a night cone ;) Fall is the best for flavors. They have Pumpkin Spice which is utterly stupendous. And there is a Caramel Apple one that I put on top of the Pumpkin Spice and then I spiral into a spicey-fall-flavored coma and I Just Don't Care. So good. Yes. Ice cream. mmmmm
If you like ice cream get here as soon as possible. Top notch home made ice cream. This was my first visit while in town. The peanut butter chocolate pretzel yogurt was to die for.
Toasted Pistachio and Banana Cream Pie tasting duo. Delicious! Service was fast and it's cool to go upstairs and watch the ice cream be made.

I'm Mitchell's Ice cream rocks. I love the campfire ice cream, it is seasonal and out of this world good. I love most all of the things I have tried there, but was a little iffy about the roasted garlic lol. Probably would be great with chicken and waffles. My other Davis the key lime pie ice cream, and the milk shakes are spot on. If you have not gone here beware, this place is addicting!!

First off, the thing that caught my eye about this place was how it looked so much like a movie theatre from the outside! My husband and I decided to spontaneously check it out and we were impressed. It was very spacious and lots of seating, even on the second floor where you can look out to the production floor of the staff making the ice cream. I ordered the Chocolate Peanut Butter Cup and it was just okay for me, it was a bit too sweet but props for adding real PB cups to the mix. I would definitely like to check out their other flavours in the future.

I'm not sure if I've ever been to a Mitchell's. I like this location because you can walk around Ohio City and then go get ice cream. There is a train that goes around the room above you. There are also party rooms upstairs, but they were reserved. We got a double scoop. 1: Caramel sea salt: It's soft, at first, thought we were gonna get extra because of the softness, but then he put some back. 2: Pralines & Cream: this was amazing. The combination of the two was great. Overall Impression: I'd go back. I wouldn't wait in line for +15 minutes, but I'd go back.

How come all those boxes in the kitchen say "Baskin Robbins?" I kid!! I've always loved Mitchell's ice cream, and now we finally have one in Ohio City! The kitchen is not up and running yet, but you can at least view the massive space from the various viewing windows. They even have some art posted in the upstairs. Pro-tip: If you're going upstairs, don't bother with elevator unless you can't do stairs. The elevator is super slow. At any rate, the art isn't my cup of tea, but it's worth a view since my opinions are like butt holes. The ice cream is, of course, the main attraction. They have a huge selection of flavors and, if you're really unsure of yourself, you can try all of them. I tested their patience by tasting a ton of flavors and they didn't even flinch. Every flavor was full of awesome, except for the salted caramel (blasphemy, I know). That flavor always tasted burnt to me. The chocolate salted caramel, on the other hand, tasted great!. I ultimately got two scoops of a peanut butter fudge ice cream flavor in a waffle cone (hell yeah!) while my buddy got a fancy sundae. Both were awesome. Overall, service is super good--everyone is really friendly and happy. It's kind of like the service at a hateful chicken (that's Chick-fil-A), but without those scary forced smiles. These folks seem genuinely happy with the job and it shows. There's a few tables for eating in-house. If it's packed, you may have to sit with some folks you don't know. And that's kind of the appeal. Overall, I'm a fan. This is surely going to cause a rift between Ohio City and Gordon Square when fans of Sweet Moses riot against the fans of the new Mitchell's. Both are great, but expect this to be the spark that sets off a massive battle pitting ice cream lover against ice cream lover, brother against brother. I'm told that one day, someone will get a scoop from each place in the same bowl, and peace will be restored.

AS GOOD AS IT GETS!! Checked out this place on a business/pleasure weekend and OMG!! The chocolate fudge ice cream with peanut butter cups and peanut butter with chocolate covered pretzels frozen yogurt were amazing!!! So much so we went back the next day for another round!!

Always a treat to pop into Mitchell's for a taste of something new, fresh, and quintessentially Cleveland. Was hoping for the Geagua Maple Ice cream - however it was not on the menu. We tried the Guinness dark chocolate - however it was more Guinness and barely any taste of true chocolate. So we settled on a tasters duo - key lime ice cream & bing cherry dark chocolate. The Key Lime literally tasted like true KL pie - crust bits and all. The Bing Cherry Dark chocolate was purely exquisite. It was the best of both worlds - fruit and dessert...always good service and fun to watch the factory behind the glass.
The vegan ice cream options are really good! My wife's favorite is the key lime. I will really miss this place if we leave Cleveland.

Within a months time I've been to this place three times ( I thought it was more than that) but I love this place! I love the Pistachio ice cream and the Butter Pecan is not like anything I've had before, it's actually salty and I love it! And I'm usually not the one to like sweet and salty together but that it's Good! I've tried a few others and the vanilla and mango are not my favorite but who cares when the other flavors are so freakin' freakishly good! Also, I don't know what's going on with some of the ice cream flavors having a huge chunk of chocolate at the end. Me personally, I think it's a wonderful surprise. But I can't bring myself to break away from my two favs. Soft serve who? McDonalds what? So worth my $5!

Amazing ice cream, great interior - loved this place. Over a weekend I went three times! I tried the pistachio, chocolate and peanut chunk, and toasted hazelnut. All the flavours I sampled were really good! It's definitely a must go-to place for ice cream in Cleveland!

Went to Cleveland for a day trip and this was on the top of our location list. Thoroughly impressed with the flavor options that were offered. We got Key Lime Pie & Peanut Butter Frozen Yogurt. The flavors were very robust and love that these ice creams were made with fresh and local ingredients. Will absolutely visit if in the area again.

The best ice cream in Cleveland. I really enjoyed the vegan chocolate, which I was pleasantly surprise that they had vegan options available. Very modern and clean, with a variety of different homemade flavors. A must for anyone who likes good ice cream.

Truly one of the best, if not the best, ice cream I've ever had. 11am and we were walking around Ohio City and knew we had to try it. Never too early for ice cream. It was worth it no matter what time of day. Amazing flavor selections; amazing quality; amazing service; and all in the most amazing atmosphere. This is a can't miss experience for anyone local or visiting - perfect for the whole family or a nice end to a date night. I had peanut butter chocolate pretzel yogurt; my wife had smores ice cream, and my dad had blueberry pie crumble (which ended up as my fav). My mom had pecan something. All were amazing!!!
Overall great experience! So fun seeing the factory and the ice cream is amazing!! Employees were so kind and very helpful!
Fun atmosphere and great ice cream. The worker gave me the wrong ice cream by accident but it's okay because everything is so good. Would recommend.

Mitchell's is amazing! I have never been disappointed. Their coffee with chocolate chunk ice cream and their cherry with chocolate chunk ice cream are my favorite but that's just because I can't try anything else new since I'm addicted!

I was at Mitchell's ice cream on West 25th when I saw too young teenagers or that taking 6 ice cream cones outside sitting them on the table photographing them and then right in front of a homeless man how asked about them through all six in the garbage without even tasted one of them they were also employees of Mitchell's ice cream

What more can I add to the already sufficient reviews left for this fine establishment? Relatively new to the Ohio City scene, the fact that it's already synomous with the neighborhood is a testament as to how truly beloved Mitchell's is. Clevelanders are all about anything local, so by nature Clevelanders are fiercely loyal. But real talk, it's clean, spacious, friendly - Willy Wonka himself would be proud! Ice cream flavors for days! Go treat yo self to a salted caramel milk shake. I know I'm gonna!

We stopped in here after having dinner across the street at Great Lakes Brewery. It was a nice night and a fair number of people were in the store, but there was plenty of seating, both indoors and outdoors. We got the taster's duo - one scoop of the Strawberry Rhubarb Crisp and one scoop of the S'mores, both seasonal flavors. We LOVED the Strawberry Rhubarb! The S'mores was good, too, but in comparison, the Strawberry Rhubarb wins. I'd come back just for that. The taster's duo is around $4, about the same price as the smaller waffle cones. It looks like you might get a bit more ice cream if you go for the cone, but I'm not complaining. What we got was super tasty!

I'm a Mitchell's sucker. I just have to see that big "M" logo and I lose all focus. Seriously like a kid--I get an idea and can't let it go--once I see the "M" I HAVE to have some Mitchell's! This location is pretty freakin' cool. Not only is it big, which is a nice change from the Uptown location that I love as well, but it's also basically a field trip in an ice cream shop. You can see down into the awesome kitchen from the front of the shop, but if you walk down a hallway and head upstairs, you can get a birds' eye view of the magical ice cream production. There's also a train running around the top of the main "dining" area--that's right. AN ICE CREAM TRAIN. And there's a small "bar" along the front windows with little coloring stations so kids can make art while getting their sugar buzzes on. The ice cream itself is fabulous. The options seem endless and you can add fun toppings or get a pretzel for a sweet and salty treat. I highly recommend trying the banana creme pie with strawberry topping--so light and fruity and the graham cracker crust adds a nice crunch. I foresee a lot of visits here after a couple of beers induce an ice cream craving.

Got this for dessert after lunch at Townhall. SO GOOD! I got a single scoop of berry crumble in a cup and I seriously think it may be the best ice cream I've ever had, and I've tried a lot, trust me! The single scoop was a good amount, definitely would've overdone it with two. But the ice cream itself was so tasty--vanilla bean ice cream with swirls of Blueberry and raspberry, I think. Who knows--may have been strawberry or blackberry too/instead! All I know is that it was "berry" delicious. And the crumble...it was seriously like eating a slice of mixed berry pie ala mode. We were going to the science center after or I would've got back in line for a quart to go. I will need this ice cream again in my future. The cones also smelled so deliciously sweet, but they were huge and I knew I'd be on sugar overload had I got one. Perhaps next time...

Upon walking into any Mitchell's, the incredible smell of waffle and ice cream is completely overwhelming. I mean seriously this smell will change your life. Beyond that , the choices of ice cream and sorbet are second to none and the fact that you can try before you buy makes it all the better. Each month a new seasonal flavor is presented. My all time favorite is the Birthday Cake. Sometime I'll get a double scoop of a flavor but I highly recommend getting a milkshake made with your favorite flavor. It comes with homemade frosting and chocolate shavings. I suggest getting the Birthday Cake Milkshake. Also the homemade waffle cones are fantastic. I'll continue to visit Mitchell's for as long as I'm in Cleveland.

WOW! We're from the land of Ben & Jerry's, and our family (including two teenagers) thinks this is the best ice cream we've ever had. The flavors included strawberry rhubarb crisp, honey lavender, black Raspberry chocolate chunk, and bing cherry chocolate chunk. In addition, they use environmentally sensitive practices for maintaining the building. Worth taking another trip to Cleveland from the Champlain Valley.

Mitchell's has the best ice cream in Northeast Ohio. Their seasonal offerings are always fresh, tasty and unique. The eggnog ice cream offered during the winter season is life changing. The customer service is always phenomenal, I have never left a visit to Mitchell's disappointed. I would forever recommend visiting Mitchell's for ice cream needs!
Love, love, love their Key Lime Pie ice cream. Just took a tour of the place. Awesome! They said their coming to Cuyahoga Falls 2017!! Better than Strickland's (sorry), better than Dairy Queen!

I'm lucky enough to go to school ten minutes away from their Ohio City location and Mitchell's is a Friday tradition for my friends and I. I usually get a taster's duo of raspberry sorbet and chocolate ice cream but I'm also very partial to their coffee flavor.

Since this Mitchell's opened up in our neighborhood, we have been regularly going here. Maybe a bit too regular...... I'm happy that W 25th has a place/space that is accommodating to all ages and backgrounds. Everyone loves ice cream! I have to admit that I wasn't a fan of Mitchell's before this location. Many of the locations were out in the burbs and I didn't find it worth it to trek out there. I was surprised and happy when I found out they were moving their headquarters to cleveland proper- they do love Cleveland and are northeast ohio born and bred. The new HQ is beautiful--clean, light, and with modern decor. A total revamp of a former movie theatre/club (lol). They also keep their playfulness: their signature model train runs along the ceiling of their main room. The ice creams that Mitchell does well and are my favorites: Toasted Pistachio Cherry Red (buttermilk vanilla, tart cherry) -seasonal Toasted hazelnut - seasonal (highly recommend with free pretzel) Caramel Sea Salt Rum Babka - seasonal Their vegan ice cream is just ok... Good attempt I guess. They usually only have 2 flavors available. Other places do vegan ice cream better... But it's cool that Mitchell's is a place for vegans too!!

Perhaps you're like me and dessert places have fallen short of your expectations on so many occasions that you're starting to think that ice cream *actually* just isn't that great. If so, stop settling for mediocrity and come try the strawberry rhubarb at Mitchell's. It will renew your appreciation for ice cream.

So sooo good! Had the toasted pistachio and bing cherry chocolate chunk ice cream. To-die- for-delicious! The staff was attentive & nice. There were plenty of seating options and you can see how the ice cream is made through big windows. Felt like Willy Wonka and the chocolate factory. Basically a dream come true. :)

I come here probably more frequently than I should. The is nice and the tables are spaced far enough from each other. You also have the opportunity to see the workers packing and making the ice cream in the kitchen. Their ice cream is always rich and creamy and I also love their sorbets. They also have freshly made whip cream that they put the milkshakes! Highly recommend coming here if you are in the area!
This is the best ice cream I have ever had and easily beats out popular places in the US, both east and west coast.
Great ice cream spot. The portions are huge and delicious. There was a really trendy feel to this place.

I can no longer do any form of dairy, so when family or friends go for ice cream, I generally settle for sipping on a totally unsatisfactory slushy or simply watching them with envy. Not so at Mitchell's! While others have to make do with plain old ice cream (which, I understand, is fabulous!) I enthusiastically dive in to one of Mitchell's vegan flavors, which are made with coconut milk and hold the same luxurious mouth feel as a regular dairy ice cream. I usually go with a Tasters Duo, with vegan chocolate on the bottom (so I can finish with the best) and one of their rich sorbets on top to whet my palate. One of the coolest dimensions of this flagship location is that when you go with kids -or adults who want to behave like kids-there is much for them to do. We head upstairs and enjoy our cones sitting in front of the full glass wall that overlooks the ice cream factory and watch them create more batches of the delicious stuff! Tip: if you dine at one of the many fabulous restaurants in the Ohio City area and are feeling a little full after your meal, why not leave the restaurant ,take a short walk around the neighborhood to let your dinner settle, and then head over to Mitchell's for an ice cream cone to top off your evening!?

Intensely flavorful and delectably creamy -- how does it possibly get any better than that?? Gelato-intense flavor infused into ice cream that is the perfect midway point between hard ice cream and soft ice cream -- lickable without a hint of dripping. Just pure flavor in creamy deliciousness bite after bite. And the servers are so nice!!! Omg if only I lived in Cleveland.
Its good ice cream. Has that classic feel to the shop, but at the same time its not very... jump out at you special.
The peanut butter and chocolate ice was amazing!!! Fresh and warm waffle cones to go with it!!!

This review is just for their vegan ice cream - which is great! Mitchell's has awesome options for lactose-intolerant folks. I recommend their salted caramel and their mint chocolate truffle. Yum! Thanks for offering creamy desserts for non-dairy folks. :) Update: their chocolate hazelnut vegan ice cream is like nutella...but better. Didn't think that was possible? It is! :)

Personally after having Lola's for dinner I couldn't find more room in my stomach for dessert, but my sister insisted in checking this place out. It looked like a freaking factory. You order your ice cream on one side of the glass and the other side you see workers toiling away making your ice cream. I couldn't decide if I liked the feeling of this place because it felt very industrial and kinda cold. The ice cream was good and the portions were generous. However, I've had better ice cream and I didn't feel like this really hit the spot. We tried a good number of flavors and nothing really stood out. I vote Jeni's and because I'm not really from Columbus you can't say its Columbus pride. But I knew it was a bad sign because my sister, who loves loves loves ice cream, didn't even finish hers! Instead she left it in the cup holder next to my phone, waiting for me to dip my fingers in the slurry. Yuck.

Mitchell's is amazingly fantastic. It's hands-down the best ice-cream I've ever had, and I freaking love ice cream. Grocery store brands are nothing in comparison. ALL of the flavors are great, even the ones I didn't think I would ever like. Strangely enough, for me, personally, the mint chocolate chip is eh and sort of disappointing, but everything else is ridiculously good. My favorites are the rocky road, coffee chocolate chunk, key lime pie, wild berry crumble, raspberry chocolate chunk, butter pecan, and the raspberry sorbet. (:

Best ice cream in Cleveland! I highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the city. The ingredients are fresh and the ice cream is made locally. My favorite is black raspberry and chocolate chunk but there are so many other amazing flavors. They give samples if you are struggling to decide.

Dear Minister Mather, I had recently reported the likelihood of Goody Glover to be a witch, which you confirmed and took proper actions. Therefore you understand my ability to discern between witches and common men with astute accuracy. It is then with fear and great concern that I must report this establishment of witchcraft. I am nay knowledgeable of the quantity of individuals involved nor the extent of their involvement but there are witches among them. My venture here was extraordinary in a way God hath not intended. They served buttered corn in the form of ice cream sir. The same vegetable I place in the fire and glaze with freshly churned butter was being served to me in a spoon. Unbeleivable sir. To be safe of their hexing I ordered a flavor with fire in the name...campfire smores. Sir I lie to you not when I tell you I tasted the charred melting marshmallows in the very fibers of that cream. Sir I SWEAR I smelled the aroma of the warm fire crackling on a fog filled night. They have vexed me sir! SIR I have been vexed! To the stake with them Minister Mather! To the stake! Warm Regards, Goody Electron

Great place for homemade ice cream. Location is on the Ohio city strip so if you don't want to eat your ice cream in store, there are places to walk to. The ice cream is tremendous, smooth in texture and tastes great. Being homemade ice cream, this location features the "magic shop" where all the ice cream is made while you wait!
Soooo amazing! I got the caramel fudge brownie!!!! It was significantly better than I was imagining!!!

Initial side note: Mitchell's Ice Cream can't be compared to East Coast Custard. They are two completely different frozen deserts. Ice cream as we know it is primarily made with more air and more cream (fat content), while custard has a significantly higher egg yolk content and less air. It's like comparing red grapes to green grapes. Yes, they're both frozen desserts, but significant variations exist between the two. As a second side note, gelato is has lower fat content than ice cream and has less air. My first time I was in a Mitchell's Ice Cream was on the CWRU campus. The first thing I said to myself was, "Huh. They sell dry ice. THAT'S AWESOME." But it's funny. After I left Cleveland 7 years ago (not at my own volition, to be honest), the city decided to get good, and it's been getting better ever since. And when I started to visit the West side, I finally realized that that's where all the real gems really are in the city. But I digress. That's not what this review is about. It's really about the ice cream. It's funny how ice cream is. You grow up eating the crummy store brand ice cream, since it's the cheapest, then the not as cheap brands (like Edy's and Breyers) full of not-so-straightforward elmulsifiers, then you go to college and start growing up and you try the better national brands, like Ben and Jerry's, UDF, Haagen Dazs (of which the latter is way too sweet, by the way). Then you start trying out local stuff. That, my friends is where the fun starts. At least in Ohio. In Cincinnati, you have Graeter's Ice Cream. It's made by the "French pot process" but the flavors are pretty conservative and traditional, but they do it well. Then you have Columbus' Jeni's Ice Cream where they make adventurous flavors you never thought would ever go together work, requiring nerves of steel to order their favors, but it's more of a boutique ice cream parlor (lighter, pricier, and smaller portions). Mitchell's hits that awesome sweet spot in the middle. Not only does it do traditional flavors well (and better than Sweet Moses, IMHO). Their ice creams don't skimp on flavor or ingredients. This is especially so with their seasonal flavors (and specialty flavors), which elevate these folks to a whole to a whole new and phenomenal level. When they have seasonal fruit flavors, they use actual fruit in the ice cream, and you can see it being be put in the ice cream as they make it behind the service area. You see them open boxes of chocolates with stickers that say "Product of Belgium". Lavender honey ice cream tastes like honey (and lavender) (though some may find it a bit too sweet) . You want s'mores in your ice cream? No problem, you'll find milk chocolate, graham cracker crumble, and marshmellow fluff. Then you have porter dark chocolate. Yes. Great Lakes Brewery's very own Edmund Fitzgerald Porter in ice cream form with dark chocolate chunks. Really, you can't go wrong with any their flavors, and they give generous portions. If your brain stops working at being able to choose from the the easily 20+ flavor offerings at any one day, the staff is more than eager to let you try the flavors. Remember that dry ice I mentioned earlier? It's to throw into coolers so out-of-towners can take the ice cream home with them, never melted and refrozen. And I would totally do that if I had a cooler (which I don't), when I would return to Cincinnati. In all honesty, they've become the ice cream standard in Cleveland, and to the Cincinnatian who worried about ice cream cred in his review: Your cred is intact. Mitchell's is indeed better than Graeter's. As a warning, the W 25th St. location doesn't have straightforward parking -- it's street parking immediately around the parlor. It's a very busy area with restaurants and bars. So, parking there may be a challenge.

Yes! Best ice cream in Cleveland. Tons of delicious sounding, unique flavors. I had the tarimisu, which I believe is seasonal, but I definitely recommend it if it's available! I went on a Wednesday night in Jan at like 9pm and it was packed, so I imagine this place gets pretty crazy in warmer months or on weekends.
Hands down the best ice cream in town! Long line moves quite quickly. Chocolate and the mint chip were both delicious!

This may be the best homemade icecream in Cleveland! Along with all the traditional favorites they have year round such as cookie dough and mint chocolate chip, they have a great selection of seasonal flavors year round! With so many options, you never have to get the same flavor twice. I really like how they use locally grown, organic ingredients instead of packing their icecream with imported ingredients and preservatives. I highly recommend the mint chocolate chip! You are also free to walk around and observe the icecream making process. Get to scoopin!!!

Delicious ice cream and so fun to watch it being made! I love that they use local and organic ingredients as much as possible (slightly healthier junk food, right?). And it's great that they have dry ice so we can buy quarts to take home.
Amazing online customer service!!!! We ordered a GC for a friend (little boy) who had a tonsillectomy - they sent it out asap and he got it the very next day. Thank you!!!
I really like this ice cream shop! The ice cream shop is so cute! I love the flavors!!!! I just love the area where it's located! I love the cookies n cream and birthday cake flavors the most!
Amazing ice cream. The staff is so nice and friendly greeted us on our way in and out.

Really great ice cream, nice to see where they make it walking out back door. Only drawback was parking. Went there on a Wednesday at lunch time, took longer to find a parking spot than to get ice cream

This ice cream is delicious. I had the the best caramel sea salt ice cream ever. It almost makes me think I'd like to live in Cleveland. I went back the next day and had the raspberry chocolate chunk. It was amazing. On second thought, it's probably a good thing I don't live in Cleveland. It would be ruinous for my diet.

Possibly the best ice cream I've ever had anywhere--and I've tried a LOT of ice cream. You cannot go wrong with ANY flavor at Mitchell's! The caramelized chocolate was INCREDIBLE and the key lime pie was the best I've had outside of Key West. Friendly, fast service and great portion sizes.

I love boutique ice cream shops, and heard great things about this one. Ordered the Salted Caramel and Honey Lavender. Now, I am no ice cream addict, but I have tried these 2 flavors from the most popular ice cream shops on the West Coast, and overall I was impressed with the Honey Lavender. The herbal flavor isn't for everyone, but it's a great flavor if you want to be adventurous. Sadly the Salted Caramel was way too salty for me. It almost tasted a little smokey/burnt in my opinion. That said, I would definitely go back and try some other flavors.
Vegan salted Carmel is the best thing in the world! We come here too much in the summer, but it's ok because it's such a happy place! Long live Mitchell's!!!

A great refugee after galavanting around the downtown area! Housed in the transparent, Scandinavian style interior, you can find amazing decadently smooth homemade ice-cream made here. I recommend trying the Black-Cherry flavor! In comparison, with SF Bi-Rite ice cream, this place has its place on the world's must try ice-cream as well!

Mitchell's is fantastic! They have a huge variety of flavors and the staff is friendly. It's no surprise the line is usually out the door (don't worry - it moves quick). There's great indoor seating, as well a nice patio looking out onto West 25th. They make the ice cream on site, and have giant windows so you can watch them make it, which is pretty cool! Try the waffle cone... you won't be disappointed!!!

I scream for a Ice Cream, open late. Great Ice Cream place to take the kids, nestled on W 25th north of the Market. Very friendly staff and quick excellent service. Very clean, I couldn't find dust in customer area I do a finger test everywhere I go. Hoping they open a couple more.

Absolutely by far the BEST ice cream I've ever had. It is so mouth watering creamy and flavorful. Tons of delicious flavors. I'm not normally an ice cream person and I got 3 scoops it was SO good! I recommend this place as a must for desert or treat!!! Yumtown!!

Went in here after dinner to have a dessert, came in for the special beer ice cream. So i thought, but they were all out. Went ol tried and true mint choc chip and butterfinger chunk. Wow...i mean two amazing things in my mouth....at the same time. They may use a little too much cream, but its still great place to relax on warm day/night and watch the people or the train that runs through the ceiling.

This place is beautiful! Large window to see into the factory. Clean and smells great! We had the seasonal ice cream in the waffle cones and it was fantastic! The ONLY problem is the long wait. There was 1 girl working and 2 customers ahead of me. Other than that, this place is a must!

Fun for kids. You can see the whole ice cream production area off to the side. A train runs above the eating area. Crayons at low tables near the window. The one scoop dish was very large and me and my five year old almost didn't finish it. The ice cream was good too!

I am usually not a fan of ice cream, especially the creamy rich kind, but Mitchell's is amazing. Been to three of their locations - Ohio City, Beachwood (in the mall), and University Circle. All three are excellent. The pricing is great - about $3.65 for 2 big scoops. 2 scoops is enough to make me full enough to not want to eat for awhile, lol. My favorite flavor is the honey lavender - not too sweet and has the nice lavender fragrance. Second favorite is the salted caramel - but this one I can't eat too much of just because it's way richer than the honey lavender. Anyways, I have sampled many of the other flavors there, and whatever you choose, you can't go wrong.

really nice, spacious, and clean ice cream shop. there is a big seating area for customers to sit at after they purchase the ice cream. they made their ice cream on site and they claimed all the ingredients are fresh and homemade. there is also a large selection of ice cream flavor more than most ice cream place offers. i ordered vanilla bean and mango sorbet. i also tried taste other flavor. overall, its ice cream is really creamy. to me why i gave a three stars instead of five stars bc to me the ice cream is too sweet and too creamy to me. if u have a really sweet tooth then this is probably the place for u. to me i felt there is too much sugar and butter added to its ice cream and kinda over power its original flavor like mango. such as the salt caramel i tried it is on the salty side. overall it is a nice ice cream place but just not for me.

Pretty nice place to visit on a warm day. I wasn't impressed with my root beer float but I did like my waffle cone and chocolate ice cream. I'd come back when I'm in the area and if it was warm enough for me to crave ice cream.

My family was visiting so while showing them around I stumbled on this spot. It is amazing, very clean and busy. But the ice cream is amazing and the location is huge and you actually get to see the ice cream being made in the back.

Honestly nothing beats Mitchell's ice cream in terms of quality ingredients and amazing taste. I've been to several different locations but since I now live closest to this one it's great to have one right down the street (and dangerous to the waistline.) My favorite is the vegan salted caramel pecan but any of them I try I love. The staff is always very friendly as well.

Can't believe I haven't reviewed them before! I stopped in yesterday during the Ohio City Street Festival and got a tasters trio: pumpkin spice, apple caramel, and caramel sea salt. Yummmmmm! Seriously for $4.95 I got three HUGE scoops of very delicious ice cream. The line is out the door pretty much all of the time, but don't let that deter you. The workers here are on their toes and the line moves very quickly.
The chocolate coconut milk ice cream is the best I've ever had!! My mom raves about you caramel pecan (vegan.) We are both allergic to dairy products.
Ice cream was absolutely delicious. There is a great view of the kitchen to see the making in action! Would highly recommend this place for a family dessert.

I finally had my first Mitchell's Ice Cream experience. Many of my Cleveland friends have bragged about their ice cream, so I had some high expectations...and they were definitely met! My first time there I ordered the Caramel Sea Salt (caramelized brown sugar and sea salt). It was delicious. The prices are a bit steep for a scoop of ice cream ($3.35) but when you get to the front of the line and see how big the scoop is and how tasty it is, it's not such a bad price after all. My second time there I ordered chocolate peanut butter cup, again a heaping scoopful. The chocolate ice cream itself wasn't anything special from any other high end ice cream, but there were so many big chunks of peanut butter cup, enough for every bite. My boyfriend ordered the chocolate malt ($4.95) both times (btw he tends to consider himself a malt aficionado). The first time they gave him a chocolate shake by mistake. It was good, but it was made with chocolate ice cream (I guess chocolate malts are not made with chocolate ice cream) and wasn't the malt he'd ordered...so he was disappointed. The second time we finally got the malt (this time made with vanilla ice cream and chocolate syrup). He said he liked it, although not the best. To me the malt flavoring wasn't very noticeable and I think Sweet Moses makes better malts. Mitchell's put more malt flavoring in your malts! They use Hartzler's milk, I have never had their milk, but their egg nog is to die for (save that for another review) so I can only assume their milk is something special. Also it seems that most of the premium ice cream shops in Cleveland tend to use their milk. The store and building itself is also pretty impressive. You can go upstairs and view the entire kitchen from above, watching them make ice cream is cool. Also you know there's no funny stuff going on in there if you can see everything. Be warned, the lines can be long and seem impossible to get to the front in any reasonable time, but rest assured, there are a lot of people working the counter and those lines move really fast. Oh and they also let me bring my dog in with me to order my ice cream. I love places that are dog friendly! So many more flavors of ice cream still to try...a few blocks from home...I will be down there a lot this summer. Let's just hope my waistline can take all these visits.

Yelp, you've failed me. At 10:05 pm after a horrible meal at Flying Fig (review forthcoming) I was excited to see that there was still hope for the night to be saved by sweet, sweet ice cream. Because, you know what they say... When life gives you lemons...eat ice cream! Let some other sucker make lemonade. Anyway, sweet comfort in site, I reached for the door handle anticipating the sugary perfumed air about to greet me, but - THE DOOR WAS LOCKED!!! So Yelp, thanks for the tease, please update this location's hours ;) Oh, as for the ice cream, it's top notch, when you can get it. In my book, right up there with Portland's Ruby Jewel and Salt n' Straw.
Best. Ice cream. Ever. And waffle cones and ice cream cakes and service. So yeah, best. You should go there.

Great ice cream - 5 stars but 1 star for service. 3 people "working" in the store but only rarely did they notice that there were customers waiting for ice cream or to pay for it. They were washing dishes, or filling containers or whatever they were doing with their back to the customer counter. As the line grew they took no notice. And when they finally waited on us it was almost like we were bothering them.
Delicious! Great ending to a family trip to West Side Market. The interior is fresh and inviting. So glad it replaced Moda. I think and hope it will do well here.

Excellent ice cream! ! They were so kind when I came to visit, 6 months pregnant and craving turtle ice cream. Their chocolate based pecan Caramel ice cream didn't hit the spot. But they made my own little sundae so I had just what I wanted! Great flavors. It was fun to see the factory in back and the cute train above!

Boasting an astonishing variety of lovingly prepared ice cream and related tempting sweet treats all served fresh in a crisp, state of the art environment, Mitchell's is a world class establishment through and through. Though they have gradually attained something of a celebrity status in recent years, the fine folks at Mitchell's sacrifice none of their grassroots integrity in pursuit of turning larger profits. And their flavors just keep on getting tastier. The pralines & cream, while a bit of an underdog, according to one staff member, may be the best ice cream I've ever had the extreme good fortune of tasting. The 25th Street location is a gem: a sort of space age Wonka's workshop looms behind the order line, offering guests a firsthand view of just where the magic happens. The staff are upbeat and generous in their portioning. Overall, Mitchell's is a worthy contender for most consistent sweet tooth satiation station in Cleveland. Pete & Mike should be proud.
Omg. Ice cream is flavorful and creamy. Line moves pretty quickly. Worth every penny. Family friendly.
One of my favorite ice cream places :) I come every time I'm in town. All the flavors I've tried are fantastic, and they give you free cones when you buy a pint.

When you walk in the smell is amazing! No matter how long the line-up they get you through pretty courteously including the opportunity to taste along the way. I have only seen one of their employee's be a little on the "snotty" side of things so not bad considering the amount of people. Lots of flavors to choose from so you shouldn't have an issue. Besides ice cream you can get other assortments of sundaes or banana splits or just buy a pint or two to take home with you. For my taste buds it is good.

Visiting from California and saw place with long line but moved quickly. We had four different flavors. The vanilla bean was my favorite and then the strawberry (a unique taste). The mocha and lemon raspberry were great too but just depends on what you like. Great atmosphere with sitting downstairs, upstairs, and outside. Loved that you can see the factory working while you eat your ice cream.

I love this ice cream. The texture is perfect, it's super creamy, and there are a million flavor choices. Not as crazy flavor-wise as Jeni's, but also, like, half the price. This location is very cool because it's inside a renovated theater, the factory is right behind the counter, and it's next to other great restaurants and West Side Market.

Mitchell's is one of the things about Cleveland which will make it hard to leave when the time comes. I am not an ice cream person, but when I am, I am a snob. If it isn't great, it isn't worth it. First, I love that they are very open and honest and meticulous about where they source their ingredients. Everything that can be purchased locally, is purchased locally. Second, I love that they have interesting and unique flavors. The Edmund Fitzgerald Porter ice cream is my favorite that I have ever had. It is not uncommon to find a pint of it in my freezer. I've also been stunned by the decadence of the caramelized chocolate. I don't love chocolate ice cream, but this is just amazing. Not too sweet. I've also tried most of their seasonal flavors--berry crumble, peach, apple cider concoctions, pumpkin spice, juniper/olive oil/orange--all amazing. They taste exactly the way that they should taste except better and creamier. Third, having cut dairy almost completely out of my everyday diet, their vegan ice cream is fantastic. Their vegan ice cream is better than most regular ice creams. It is wonderful, rich, creamy, good flavors, absolute excellence. The cookie dough ice cream has massive chunks of cookie dough in it. The peanut butter chocolate concoctions have loads of peanut butter and chocolate. It's a beautiful thing. The portions are generous (I usually get a junior size or a pint to go). If you're in the area, indulge. Mitchell's is fantastic.

Great ice-cream! (Key Lime Pie, S'mores, Mint-Chocolate Chip and Chocolate peanut butter cup were all eaten during our stay in Cleveland) lots of options - even a dairy free option. This location had a lot of seating, there is some in the back of the building, and some upstairs. Also it was cool to see them making the ice cream. They also have a selection of soda and water, but you can also get a free water cup. Once we tried this ice cream we kept looking for it throughout the Cleveland area and got it whenever we could. Yum!
Just about the best ice cream you can find. It's a bit pricey but great for an occasional treat. I had the banana cream pie which was incredible.

Other than gelato in Italy this is the best ice cream I've ever had. Mitchell's uses the best ingredients and they don't skimp either. I love the toasted pistachio and the sea salt caramel and recently tried the rocky road and the black cherry chocolate. All incredible.

4.5 stars. Really cool ice cream location - a renovated old school theater. I actually didn't order anything from here, my buddy did and I proceeded to try a bite - then it went down hill from there for him as I crushed more than half of it (yeah, he was kinda pissed). He opted for butter pecan which would not had been my first choice. But let me say it was the best butter pecan I've ever had. This ice cream is sooo rich - probably the creamiest and thickest I've tried. This truly is a dessert ice cream and not the refreshing variety. Either way, well worth the visit and I will get my own next time (maybe).

Ice cream was delicious, excellent choice of flavors, was hard to pick one. Good amount for what you pay for. Service was top notch too, friendly and high spirited people behind the counter. Inside was pretty cool as well and love that they are open later.

I visited Cleveland for a week and decided to come to this ice cream place. Firstly, the place it's self was beautiful, it looked so modern and Instagram worthy. I couldn't help but to take pictures and send them back to my folks in Toronto. But the ice cream? Oh man. The pistachio ice cream was amazing I almost cried. I also tried a couple other flavours and they were all amazing. Not to mention the workers were extremely nice and friendly. Defiantly coming back here when I visit Cleveland next time!

Homemade Ice Cream made in Cleveland with locally grown ingredients. The ice cream was perfectly creamy without being too sugary and sweet. I recommend trying their brownies! They are amazing! Better yet get the Caramel Fudge Brownie Ice Cream.
Recently enjoyed gelato in Rome. But MITCHELLS is the better! Great cleveland experience! Highly recommend to anyone visiting. And if you have kids... they have a train to watch!!!

What is not to like? On a day where the sun starts to sizzle taking away the crisp dew that was there the morning before, Mitchell's hits the spot. Courteous staff, homemade, beautifully crafted ice cream, and the ambiance make for a stupendous way to cool down. A must stop for visitors to Cleveland.
The best cookie and cream ice cream I have ever had. Ask for a free pretzel w your ice cream! Scrumptious!!!!
Edmund Fitzgerald Porter Chocolate Chunk ice cream...need i say more! Amazing ice cream. Come soon and come often.
So delicious! It's a large creamery that you can watch the ice cream being made. Extremely clean. I had the salted toasted Pistachio. They make the waffle cones while you wait. They smell so good!

The hype is real. Had dinner at Lake Front and was happy to see there was a MItchell's for desert. Was even more lucky to be by their new flagship location. Groovy inside and very kid friendly. Lots of flavors, great service and yummy ice cream. Price is a little higher than average for ice cream, but it was worth the extra dollars. Had four different flavors (sugar free chocolate, mango, blue cosmo and chocolate pretzel yogurt. All were great. Well worth the stop when you are in the area.

Every place that I've lived has had their own "best ever ice cream" - Herrell's, Fenton's - but I think that Mitchell's is actually the best! Great ice cream and great flavors - the banana cream pie ice cream is to die for.

Well folks, there really is no better ice cream anywhere.The texture is by far my favorite -- it's so rich and creamy, but it holds together well. I love all of the flavors, although my favorites have shifted over time. I grew up on Mitchell's, and I'm proud to say that I can map out the various phases of my life based on my preferred flavor of Mitchell's of the time. When Mitchell's first opened, in my pre-teen years, it was the sugary, fruity goodness of Cherry Vanilla (which they no longer have, at least on the regular.) From there it was Cookie Dough, then Key Lime Pie, then a period of relative moderation when all I wanted was the Mango sorbet. Eventually I came to realize the absolute perfection of their Butter Pecan. You can taste the brown sugar, and the obscene amount of butter, and the little bit of salt from the nuts. I never even considered Butter Pecan ice cream before I had Mitchell's -- but it puts all other flavors of any ice cream to shame. I'm always excited to try their new/seasonal stuff: most recently they had an olive oil, orange and juniper variety. Definitely a more subtle, grown-up taste -- but you know, I've grown up and so has my favorite ice cream shop. This new store/warehouse in Ohio City is gorgeous, but honestly if the Mitchell's Brothers were serving their goods out of a horse barn I'd still be addicted to it.

OMG, this is the best ice cream that have ever had. Thank god Mitchell's isn't around the corner from where I live. My absolute fav is the pistachio,ummmmmmmmmm. My daughter had me addicted to this place. The staff is always friendly & the store is always neat and clean.

Delicious ice cream with generous portions! Nice, clean environment and the same goes for their factory where they make the ice cream. You can watch from upstairs. Had the banana cream pie (?), peanut butter chocolate chip, and pistachio. Pistachio was my favorite. Can't wait to try the other flavors.
Mitchell's icecream is the best.....pralines and carmel salt together is out of this world!

I love Mitchell's ice cream. I think it is way better quality than Jeni's. Yep, I just said that. This store is really a bit sterile...but I love the view of the factory and the choo choo train overhead. When I saw that the Porter chocolate chunk was out of stock, they offered to pack me a quart if I could wait a few minutes. They rock...
On a street packed with bars that close at 2am, this place closes at 11pm on Saturday. Genius. Good ice cream though.

Happiness is standing in line at mitchell's and waiting for a scoop of toasted pistachio. Or if you're in the mood for something decadent, theres nothing like diving into a scoopful of the chocolate peanut butter cup - the combination of the silky chocolate ice cream and chunks of peanut butter cup is nothing short of sinful. I would eat this off the floor. Some of the best ice cream I have ever had. Trust me I've had a lot of ice cream

Mitchell's is an ice cream shop that serves delicious, inventive fresh made ice-cream. It's so fresh that you can actually watch them prepare it from the observation point on the second floor. They let you try many flavors before ordering so that kinda makes it really hard to order. That's probably Mitchell's only downfall. Servings are large and prices are affordable.

We waited in a very long line because had heard the hype about this place. Only two not very friendly ladies working and they were overwhelmed I could see. Okay, then they ran out of lids and she could go downstairs "if I wanted her to"... Well no, not with a line out the door. Anyways, ice cream was pretty decent. Vanilla, chocolate chip cookie dough and black raspberry truffle. Would I wait again like that for it? No, probably not. I'd go to Mason's Creamery on Bridge Street where ice cream is just as good if not better, and the service is so much friendlier.

Best ice cream Ive had! I had the raspberry with chocolate sprinkles which are actually chocolate shavings! Very flavorful and rich. Well priced and great hours, with a very friendly staff. The couple in front of us probably tried 5 or more flavored before deciding and no issue or frustration by the worker. They need to build one in NJ (or ship!). A must do if you are in Cleveland and love sweets!

I went here for the first time on a Saturday and was surprised at how quickly my party was able to order our ice cream. The people working were all friendly and the ice cream was very good. Definitely worth the hype I heard about it. The GLBC porter ice cream was delicious as were the other flavors we enjoyed. Although I usually avoid 25th street I think I Will have to make more stops just for the awesome ice cream!
Quick and polite service, great selection, very delicious. I liked the sea salt caramel by far the most, but the real brownie pieces in the other ice cream I got were very very tasty also.

I am an ice cream lover and actually very snobbish when it comes to good ice cream My wife and I in our travels always look for local favorites wherever we go and let me tell you, we both believe Mitchell's by far is superior to any we have tried. We are temporarily living in Columbus and Graeter's is the end all here- not anywhere close to Mitchell's in terms of its creative flavors and good tasting, creamy, and flavorful ice cream. My favorite flavors are Rocky Road and the Bing Chocolate Cherry chunk- never can decide which to have so I always get the Taster's duo. Cleveland's- feel fortunate that you have Mitchell's- some cities we have visited have no locally made ice cream at all- their idea of good ice cream are chains. To the Mitchell Brothers- PLEASE think about expanding to Columbus- we miss you!!!!
Not much of an ice cream person, but I love their ice cream and sorbet! Try the Carmel Fudge Brownie :)

This place is a big surprise in the city! Shop is clean, nice view on the factory behind the windows. Ice cream is tasty (at least all flavors we tried). Quick service, do not be scared by the size of the line...
