Got a birthday cake here for my mother and we all loved it!! Best cake ever. We also got their cannolis and they were delicious. We plan on picking something up from here for Christmas Eve. Highly recommend going here!!

Stumbled across this hidden gem of a bakery last night. The strawberry cream horn not only has strawberry flavored filling but fresh strawberries also. The mint chocolate cheesecake was delicious also. There were so many other things that I can't wait to try like their many flavors of macaroons.
We are long time customers of Villani's but after experiencing such rude staff the other day we will not be back. The shaming that goes on here is outrageous!

The chocolate cake, chocolate peanut butter cake, and carrot cake were very average and the carrot cake was dry. They charge $70 for the entire cake, which is completely overpriced for the quality. We ordered by the slice instead for $6.50 per piece. The rainbow cookies were good, but also overpriced at $1 per small ~1" cookie. Also got the cream horn and that was good but not the best we've had. The sfogliatelle and cannolis were good and more reasonably priced. As one of the few Italian bakeries in Charlotte it was nice to see sfolgliatelle as an option. I would like to try more of the Italian goodies next time since the sfogliatelle and cannolis were pretty good, while this time we mostly ordered cake slices and were a bit disappointed with the taste and quality.

Cake Lovers, do NOT forget Villani's!! My best friend had his wedding this past weekend. I was in charge of the wedding cake. Due to covid I was in a little bit of a crunch. They didn't want to provide guests with cake slices, so the bride suggested mini cakes. I met with Amanda (twice) to discuss what the best option would be during covid. First off Amanda is AMAZING. She emailed me, met me twice, and even texted me the day of the wedding. When we met for the cake testing, she let me try many different options which also included different icing. uh it was beyond delicious! We discussed options and finally decided on three cakes. One for the wedding, one for the bride, and one for the groom. We also decided on macaroons. Second off Amanda is AMAZING! I basically let her do whatever design process she thought was best. I trusted her and she did not disappoint. The cakes looked fantastic, even with the creativity, and covid Amanda was still 12/10! Both her and her husband delivered the cake on the wedding day. She made the cakes the SAME DAY because she wanted them to be fresh AND boy were they! Everything was so amazing, from the colors, the designs, to the actual cakes. They all tasted as good as they looked!! From her sweet personality, overall cake knowledge, the amazing design skills, and the flavor of the cakes I don't think I'll go anywhere else for cakes! I couldn't recommend this bakery more!! Don't miss out

Not only does this place have delicious pastries galore but the gentlemen working there are so friendly and helpful. The place has great parking, and I feel safe going in. They only allow 2 people at a time. Mask are required. Thank you for that. We had numerous bakery items and everything was delicious. The brownies and cake were so delicious, moist, and had such delicious flavors. Will be back to taste more.
Truly the best bakery in Charlotte. I've never had a better cream horn than here. Amazing cheesecakes, and the lobster tail, a MUST try!
Found this gem while we had a few hour layover. Everything we tried was amazing! The bacon cheddar biscuits are a must.
Lobster tails! That's all I gotta say. Haven't had a good one since I left B & W Bakery in NJ. These were perfection. Can't wait to go back.

These folks can get it right when it comes to Italian delights. It's not a cheap date but how does one value the heavenly tastes of freshly made Sfogliatella, aka 'lobster tail' filled with Crema Pasticcera?

Note: this review is based on the ridiculous wait time. The product is actually good but you have to be kidding me With how long your wait time in line is. This is the second time I've waited in line and left without purchasing anything. And covid is not an excuse. How long does it take to purchase pre-made pastries etc from a case??? A very long time apparently. Sadly as much as I want to keep supporting local, this place lost it for me today.
I grew up in the Bronx and know good Italian pastries. These are mediocre at best.

Thank you Villani's Bakery for making the most delicious wedding desserts! We were the happiest bride and groom to be able to eat all our favorites from the best bakery in Charlotte. Villani's always has pleasant and fun staff who make the excitement of decadent desserts an even better experience then you could imagine a case full of sweets could be.

I can't believe I have lived in Charlotte my whole life, and east Charlotte the last 10 years and never stopped in here. I've driven past it often and always wondered. Well I finally did stop in and on probably the busiest day, the day before thanksgiving. I was very impressed with how organized the shop is considering it was so busy. This was about 4 pm and they had cakes and all kinds of cookies, brownies and sweets. They also handled each customer efficiently, and with love. I had plenty of time to gaze at everything they had so it was hard to make a decision. So I ended up with a cinnamon roll, which by the way is more like a giant muffin of cinnamon gooey goodness from heaven. I also got 2 brownies! One middle and one end, both are delicious by the way. My most fav of all though was the pistachio cheesecake slice. This must be the best cheesecake crust I have ever had! I will most def be back. The full cakes run about 70 bucks, which is a great deal when you see them, plus the taste alone is worth it.

OK. where do i start! I don't have any pictures to post bc it was THAT good! We stopped by this little bakery because the line of people outside caught our eye. WORTH THE WAIT, the napoleon pastry dessert is out of this world!! The cream is the best part Do yourself a favor and grab this dessert, you won't be disappointed! We grabbed a variety of desserts and they were all good as well!
Hugh croissants, tasty macaroons and decent lemon tart, all very delicious. Only 2 people allowed in the bakery at a time due to covid.

YUM , Let me start off by reminding reviewers I'm gluten free soooo the delicious cakes, cookies, bagels , and other assorted pastries here I couldn't indulge in, but my family could and we all agree finger licking desserts . My flourless lemon cake was such a treat, it's so hard finding a good gluten free dessert, especially a moist, flavorful cake , and I was thrilled that my favorite lemon was available. This will definitely be my go to bakery when the need for a treat arises. The cake slices for the red velvet and chocolate cakes were HUGE, more than enough for two people to enjoy together, but if you have a serious sweet tooth I can see you devouring the entire slice because they both were perfectly moist and delicious . The service was friendly, fast, and both attendants were smiling . There wasn't any seating inside and only two tables outside so this appears to be more of a pop in and go shop. I loved the simplicity , made the desserts the main focus. If you're a coffee drinker there was coffee available as well, not sure on taste factor, did seem a bit pricey for regular black drip. I wanted to try the macaroons but I will save that for the next visit ... we will definitely come back . My kids want to try the strawberry turnovers and chocolate chip cookies as well.

People rave about this bakery. Only 2 people allowed in at a time. You must wear a mask. We bought many things. 2 chocolate cookies, a small sprinkle cookie, a piece of carrot cake, a some-more bar, a Sfingi cream puff, and a lemon bar. I asked for an oatmeal cookie also but it was not in our bag but we weren't charged for it either. The total came to 32.99 with tax and a tip. All of it was dry, not sweet at all and overdone. No one finished their treat even the 3 year old. The small frosted cookie with sprinkles tasted like it has anise it. This bakery reminds me of an English bakery taste. We ended up liking the lemon bar and carrot cake best. There were at least 10 people waiting outside to take their turn to go inside. So many people do appreciate the less sweet dry taste.
You will not be disappointed. Napoleon is fantastic, lobster tail is awesome and huge! The owner is from Teaneck, NJ, my neck of the woods so he understands customer satisfaction.

Everyone behind the counter is always so friendly and helpful, the olive oil cake is to die for! Almond croissant and sfogliatella are my usuals, but you can never go wrong with a cannoli. Wish I could have a constant stock of those massive chocolate chip cookies!
Great service and amazing deserts. Lemon pound cake tastes like my grandmother's!! Love the carrot cake too !

I've been wanting to stop in for a while and keep forgetting until last weekend. There is so much to choose from. Prices are not cheap but this is quality, hand made bakery items, not Harris Teeter bakery. I was torn between the lobster tail and a strawberry cream horn. Based on the advice of one of the workers, I went with the lobster tail and regretted it. It was supposed to have whipped cream and pastry cream but all I tasted was whipped cream. It was a little on the bland side and I'm not one for anything super sweet but this was only ok. My husband had the cannoli and it was fantastic. I felt like it had a touch of cinnamon in the filling which is the first that I have had that flavor in cannoli filling and I loved it. Would absolutely buy that again. We will go back but I will skip the lobster tail. There are so many other choices anyway!

I am sold. This place is cute. These baked goodies are amazing and I haven't even tried them all. Somewhat hidden and off the main course in Plaza Midwood, sweet little Villani's is waiting for you to try. It's a quaint bakery. That's it. You can't sit down inside, but don't let that bother you, it's still worth stopping by to pick something up. The lemon bars : the best I've ever had. I used to get lemon bars from a more upscale grocery bakery and thought I was doing something right, but Villani's proved me wrong. Not only are their lemon bars cut larger, but you can tell the ingredients are better, and the dessert is baked better, doesn't come apart, doesn't melt easily or get gooey. SWEET BUT NOT OVERLY SWEET. The red velvet cake : it's a great cake. It reminds me of a cake you would taste a wedding . The cut is huge , and beautifully iced with a cream cheese icing, and again... SWEET BUT NOT OVERLY SWEET. Amaretti : something I never had before but enjoyed. When I saw this delicious little thing , I didn't know it was a amaretto macaron, I just thought it was a pretty cookie that I might enjoy. It's nice to have something every now and then that isn't traditionally 'American' and the Amaretti is just that. If you enjoy other European desserts, they have things such as cannolis, different flavors of macarons, Napoleans, etc. Plus more cookie flavors, muffins, puff pastries and TEA and COFFEE. Don't let it's small size fool you, there is a lot going on in there and you should check it out.
Love love this bakery! It never disappoints! All their treats are so yummy and good quality.
They have a variety of pastries available and the staff are so friendly. The location is perfect if you would like some outdoor time. Definitely recommend

I've enjoyed this bakery in the past several times but was treated so rudely at my last visit, i left without purchasing and I won't be back. Very disappointed in the young staff's behavior. Kindness and respect are clearly unimportant to them.

Villani's has been a sanity-saver during the pandemic! Tasty treats and great health/safety protocols go great together. I've been calling ahead to place my order, providing my payment method, and then picking up at their takeout window 10-15 minutes later. They have a very active Instagram account which allows you to keep up with their rotating cheesecake and macaron flavors and- trust me- it will keep you drooling!

I'll keep this simple: THIS IS CHARLOTTE'S BEST BAKERY. Nowhere else comes close! What to get: sfogliatella, flourless chocolate cake, pistachio cheesecake (SO PERFECT )....basically anything; it's all excellent!

It's not a sketchy dog groomer anymore with bars on the window. Get the cake!! It is an enormous piece for $6, moist, killer icing, not too sweet but such a treat yourself treat. I hope to try the extensive macaroons selection next and get a corner piece brownie - equal parts crispy and gooey. The one pass for me was the cookie bar, the cookies included weren't my favorite.

Hello guys! I decided to pay this bakery a visit due to delicious macarons that they had in the pics. They did not disappoint by the way! But they have a cute little store. You might ride past it if you are going too fast but otherwise you won't miss it. It was my daughters birthday weekend so I wanted to get her some macarons because she loves them. They did not have a big selection but there was a variety to choose from. I then noticed the massive cakes that they had displayed. OMG! They looked so delicious. I wanted a slice of the chocolate cake because that is here favorite, but could not get it because there was actually a fly in the display case. Got to be more aware of the flies! They are sneaky! And we really wanted that cake! But she chose the red velvet instead. Now I am from Georgia so red velvet hits a little different for me. With that being said I did not really like it. I ate some but not all. But the macarons were great! We got the Nutella and the almond. Will definitely go back for those very soon! My daughter also decided to try the some kind of rainbow cookie. She loved it but I did not. I also noticed that they had cheesecake in the fridge as well. I'm definitely interested in return to try their other delectable delights!
Great bakery! Love the variety of the macaroons! What I love about this place most is they are open late! When your craving a much better than grocery homemade pastry or slice of cheesecake.

After trying almost every dessert place in town I can say hands down Villani's is my favorite. Their cakes are moist, not too sweet and offer an incredible variety. I also love their bialys and making egg and cheese sandwiches out of them. My husbands favorite is the peanut butter with chocolate ganache, I usually try and get something different everytime we go. Their customer service is always very friendly and they areopen later than most places so it's the perfect spot for the late night cravings.

I literally walked by this place, didnt know it existed, and impulse bought a few items. This place is super small and oddly tucked in a weird place by the highway intersection. Amazing babka. The right amount of sweetness. Chocolately, like a lovely orange ring in the backdrop. Doughy center pieces with a crusty outside. I couldn't stop eating it! It was so good, I ordered it twice while I was here! The oatmeal raisin pecan cookie is a dense, oatmeal heavy texture with plenty of raisin flavor. The pecan was not noticeable, nor do I think it was there as Texture. Although I got used to it. On first bite I thought there was a little more nutmeg then I expected. The macaroons we're little crumblier than I like. They definitely have a nice crust at their foots, but the tops crumble way more than they should. He's held up for the most part with three bites. The peach Strawberry was my favorite, with this fruity, refreshing feel. The dulce de leche was ok, but very light in its flavor.

I've been here several times and I've enjoyed some of their desserts, especially the oatmeal cookies! They're very friendly and the service is great! The dessert are very hearty which is nice considering most places serve very tiny portions when it comes to dessert. I am however not pleased with their macaroons as they all taste the same and have a stale taste to them. The Tiramisu is delicious! As are most of their cakes! They have their own small parking area so you can run in and out whenever you have a sweet craving!

Wow. I mean WOW. walking in and seeing Italian cookies spread out across the top of one of the displays took me back to ny/nj. From the crumb cake to the brownies, to the cookies and muffins, it smelled so good in there. The variety of macaroons and other assorted goods made this place well above average . The price wasn't too bad either. You could tell they really had a passion for what they were doing. And this place does something that most bakeries don't, stay open past 6pm. After dinner we are always looking for a good bakery to go to, and most are closed down and home watching jeopardy before you even get a chance to yelp them and see if they are open. I can't wait to come back here and try one of everything!!

Nice bakery with wonderful and friendly staff. This was my 1st experience and 2nd experience with Macaroons. Our 1st night in town we decided to have a quick dessert at this bakery. We took a shot in the dark and picked the closest bakery to our dinner location. Armed with good Yelp reviews we decided this was the spot. The young woman behind the counter was helpful and made recommendations. The peanut butter and jelly macaroon was so delicious it caused me to question Why I never tried macaroons before. I tried key lime, vanilla, and a few others. The PB&J was so tasty we went the next day for more. Unfortunately the 2nd time was not so great. The cookie was a little dry and was a tad bit stale. Overall, I do recommend this bakery and i am willing to try again on my next visit to beautiful Charlotte.

Decided to try something new on my way to work and this unassuming bakery piqued my interest. As others have said, there isn't really anywhere to sit so don't expect to hangout at the location. However, the friendly service and delicious treats make up for any inconvenience. Ordered a cup of coffee and a mixed berry muffin - the coffee cost as much as the muffin - $3+ for black drip coffee is a bit too rich for my blood. The muffin was full of fresh berries and was extremely moist unlike Sunflower next-door who perpetually seems to overcook their pastries. Overall great spot, but would do a lot better if they got their pricing in line with local competitors.
Great assortment of your favorite Italian treats. We took home about 8 different treats and each one was a pleasure. Not cheap but that will help keep your calories and finances within budget.

I visited this bakery today for the first time after living in Charlotte for 4 years. I highly recommend this place! The staff made me feel as if they have known me for years. Super friendly. Great desserts! You have to also try the strawberry lemonade that's hand squeezed! I'll definitely return!

I really wanted to like this bakery, but I just cant. We actually went twice, thinking the first time was just a one off...but no. The french macrons we're just awful. One had a slight freezer burn wang, and the other this weird texture. The rainbow cookie had no taste whatsoever. The cookies are scones, not cookies, and kind of bland. The vibe is cool; hip music and young people, but i got the feeling they're trying to be more of a "cool" bakery than a "good" bakery.

I'm so disappointed at their customer service. I had other friends tell me of their bad experiences but I never had anything bad to say about this place. I still think their desserts are great but if the customers are being treated so horribly for asking a question and placing an order, who will buy those delicious desserts? I'm so horrified by my experience and the way I was treated by one of their employees that I am so hesitant to go back to buy a piece of cake! If you can look pass that and ignore the rudeness of others, please try it out! Following is my comment on their Instagram: Delicious desserts! Any time we have family over, we always order from this bakery. My kids love their cheesecake and almost every week, we get desserts from here. Unfortunately, their employees are extremely rude and have 0 idea of what customer service is. My family and Ive been loyal customers since last year and really want this local bakery to succeed during these hard times, but I was shocked the way I was treated by one of their employees (can't remember the name, either Cory or Jacob) on Saturday evening when I took my guests to get some dessert. The owners are good people and they care so much about their employees, and I know this because I had a conversation with Paul Villani regarding a special order I placed in December and how he was so genuine and caring towards his employees. I hope their employees would care just as much about them. Honestly, I care so much about their business and truly love this place, I still tipped the guy 15% after his disgraceful and humiliating comments. I wish you all the best Paul & Amanda Villani but I will not be coming to your bakery any more until you show the same care and genuineness to your customers as you do for your employees. You lost a loyal customer!

I am utterly in LOVE with Villani's. Their tiramisu, which I've had multiple times, is one of the best desserts I've ever tasted. So flavorful and decadent, but light enough that it's won't make you full after a few bites. Easy to say I'm obsessed with it. The lobster claw is just as delicious but also fun to eat. The GF chocolate cake is almost fudge like and extremely addicting, a great option for gluten sensitive individuals that will not disappoint! The chocolate PB cake is intensely delicious, could share one slice between two people. They always have a hugely diverse selection of delicious goodies, so don't be afraid to go in the afternoons as they will still be plenty stocked. The staff is always welcoming and friendly, and they've taken mask wearing and social distancing protocols very seriously to keep the community safe. I can't rave about this place enough. One of my favorite spots ever!!
Tried their pastry... Very very good. We had their Napoleon and Tiramisu ... both are very creamy. Will go back and try other pastry soon

Visited today for the first time. All-around, nice spot! Surprised my fiance for his birthday &put together a variety of treats for us &the family (originally from Rome, New York) We got some sfingis, sfogliatella, cannolis, &key lime cheesecake. Bennisimo! Due to COVID, only 1 person in the building at a time. We got there right before the line was forming on a Sunday. I picked out a few things &he picked out the rest. Service was great! Presentation was great! Will definitely be back. Only reason for 4 stars... The sfingis were left out by accident (we returned) &The cannolis were not filled entirely (not a big deal, just wanted to share our feedback) Thanks!

This place is great! Plaza Midwood doesn't have much in the way of sweet treats/dessert at the moment, so this is definitely a welcome addition. I had a piece of the flourless chocolate cake and my boyfriend had a Smores bar. My cake was rich and creamy, and the Smores bar went down in about 2 bites - my boyfriend said it was "good." I'm looking forward to trying the macaroons here, next...as with any bakery in Charlotte, I wish they had more/labelled gluten-free options, but that certainly doesn't discredit the fact that it's wonderful to have a lovely Italian bakery in town. We also had their cold brew coffee and that was nicely sized at 12 ounces (some places give you a bucket of cold brew and that never ends well). I had a lack-of-caffeine headache going on and that knocked it out real quick. We'll be back soon, Villani's!

Villani's has been such a fantastic addition to Plaza Midwood. I am very picky when it comes to fresh baked goods and BOY do they deliver. First off - the owners are so nice. They really embody the meaning of a "neighborhood staple" and want to get to know every customer and share their love for fantastic baked goods. Second - I love the location. Sharing a parking lot with Rico's is perfect. It's a perfect pit stop between Central and 7th, so in case you get dinner in Elizabeth, grab a pastry at Villani's before hitting the Plaza bars (they're open until 10 every night! What!) Third - OHHH these pastries. They are just so good y'all. So fresh. Plenty of traditional, expected options with plenty of fun, funky twists. Go check it out. Strike up a conversation with whoever's behind the counter. I guarantee you'll leave with a smile!

You hate to spend $8 for a slice of cake and not enjoy it. The people are wonderfully nice however the cake definitely fell short of expectations. I asked what type of frosting it was and they said buttercream; however, this is not traditional buttercream with a good flavor. The cake is not vanilla. It has a slight metallic flavor like something went wrong during the baking process and it was slightly over baked. I am very disappointed in the quality of this cake.

Yum! Went tonight in a recommendation. Only 2 customers allowed in at a time due to covid so we waited in line. The line moved fast. The staff was very friendly and we didn't feel rushed. There were a ton of options! Cheesecakes of the day were good - I got blueberry lemon which was really flavorful and the crust had a lovely crunch/crispiness to it. The cream in the lobster tails was yum! Brownies were moist. Will return!

I stopped by on a Friday morning for some breakfast pastries. Quick, friendly service! The strawberry cream horn was very good (fresh strawberry flavor, flaky pastry) and the almond croissant was huge. Not a huge fan of the Italian cream cake (found it too sweet with the cream cheese frosting). Will come back to try more things!
Can be a hit or miss. The flourless chocolate torte was excellent. But the brownies were very pale and didn't taste chocolate-y. It just tasted like a very sugary blondie bar.

The world's best bakery! OMG! The pound cake is addictive. The only place in Charlotte I can find pure lavender (without lemon) macaroons. I'm afraid to taste anything other than what I've already had because Lord knows I don't need to find some other dessert to get addicted to. The only constructive criticism I have is they should not have food they are selling to folks be uncovered, in the open air, right at sneeze level in front of other nasty customers.
Amazing! Period! Super clean environment with very nice and delightful service. Perfect sweets after a dinner date! SO SO SOOOOO GOOD!
Wow!! Amazing desserts. Loved the red velvet cake and smores bar. With that being said, everything looked delicious. I can't wait to come back and try more of their delicious offerings.

Wow! This unassuming tiny building packs in some amazing sweets in their cases! We have been quite a few times and have yet to find something we don't like. The staff is always friendly and helpful. Last night, I bought a whole Italian Cream Cake for a party and it was a hit!!! Our guests could not believe how delicious the cake was and HAD to know where it came from. I gladly let them know - Villani's!

This review is overdue! I went here on my birthday on July 4th, the cake and the staff were amazing! The girls were super sweet and helpful and the cheesecake I got was amazing, it was funfetti cheesecake, you HAVE to try it. My husband got a slice of the chocolate peanut butter cake and he loved it. Also, the girls put a candle in my slice which I thought was super nice!! When we go back to Charlotte we will most definitely be back.

Everything at Villani's is mouth watering. It's an adorable little shop that you might just miss if you're not looking for it. We came in wanting to grab some treats for the weekend and the staff was patient with us as we decided. We got a chocolate chip cookie, a slice of red velvet, and a napoleon. We're from NY area and it was so nice to find a great bakery here with Italian favorites. The cookie was large and chewy, which I love. It also wasn't overly sweet. The napoleon was classic and all around delicious. I was also a big fan of the red velvet. It's my favorite flavor and I find it really hard to find places that don't make it too sweet, this one was just right. There's so much we need to come back to try-they had rainbow cookies, cannolis, cream puffs, macarons, croissants, and so much more.
Just got takeout from here during COVID, I sure hope they survive. Such good pastries and desserts!!

This place is certainly a diamond in the rough. Chances are if you never saw it on yelp, you would have never noticed it. I kid you not when I say that their red velvet cake is the best I've ever had I'm my entire life. No red velvet cake comes close to villani's. Every other item I have tried there has been out of this world delicious but I frequently dream about their moist red velvet cake with its perfect cream cheese frosting.

Everything I tried was disappointing. The Cake Their Vanilla pound cake, red velvet cake, and Italian cake are nothing special. All three slices were quite dense. The icing was probably the best part of the red velvet and Italian cakes. I was hoping for at least one type of cake to be moist and on the lighter side. The Macarons I tried the pistachio and cookie dough macarons. They were hard and did not taste fresh at all. That crispy light texture of the meringue was a hard, brittle, dense type of texture. I will continue my search for a great bakery! This is not it.

Behold the almighty. If you know, you know. I'd like to introduce the Pistachio Cheesecake. This is a podium finisher gold medalist type of winner. Before coming to Villani's, I've never ever seen/heard of Pistachio Cheesecake. Being aloof, it took me a solid second to even give it a thought, not even coming close to giving it a chance. Slowly falling off their cakes since they hired a new pastry chef (their carrot cake used to be immaculate, but has since changed) I was running out of options. I've tried almost all their cheesecakes: blueberry, snickers, funfetti, raspberry, and butter pecan (banana cheesecake is on my hit list). And there it stood, solo solider, the Pistachio Cheesecake dialed into my eyes. I reluctantly inquired to a member of the bakery team and he said it's his favorite item and probably one of their best offerings in the entire bakery. Whoa. Wait what. This entire time I've been disacknowledging this delicious MVP and treating it like the last pick on a playground kickball team. I'll cut straight to the rating: 11/10. The subtle sweet + soft texture gets me every single time. This isn't a bang, rapidly in your face type of sugar rush like you get from other cheesecakes. The Pistachio Cheesecake is in its own lane, the far right. The best part - the graham cracker crust. Oh my goodness, combo the hard crust with the almost thick creamy like plush cheesecake and it delivers a sensation almost any human beings tastebuds would desire. Topped off with pistachio nuts themselves, this entire craft fuses together so delightfully. Again, it's a slow sweet injection that leaves you forking through the entire scrumptious slice. It's a mandate that I get two slices every visit. Due to its greatness, the demand is out of this world. By far the most popular treat at Villani's, I've struck out so many times in hopes to capture this gem. Crazy how at one point I wouldn't even give this thing a glance, and now I'm on a treasure hunt each visit in. Each time I walk in, Villani's team knows exactly what time it is and what I'm after. I can tell immediately upon opening the door by looking at their faces if I flipped heads or fails. I love how they get just as amped as me when it's a green light. It's hilarious. Big noteworthy: the staff at Villani's are exceptionally great people. I've been a fan of this bakery for a few years now and it's grade A+ customer service, fabulous personalities, friendly, nice, pleasant, charming, funny, all of the above. I've never been to a place like this, where every employee and I mean every single one of them are super socially cool individuals. You have to appreciate and applaud Villani's on that aspect and I believe that's by design. Personnel is so critical and it really creates all of the difference in Villani's makeup and brand. Honorable mention: The Napoleon. Best Napoleon I've had to date and nowhere else comes a close second. Their custard cream is stupendous. Other items that are big time that deserve recognition: brownies, s'mores bars, triple berry muffin, tiramisu, lemon bars, and pecan pie. Truly a boy meets wonder moment that first day being introduced to the Pistachio Cheesecake. Life altering for certain. If my parents or anyone else ever asks where we met, I can proudly say, "At Villani's".
Everything is made fresh and you won't leave disappointed. There's also a dog bowl outside for pups on walks on hot days

By far one of my favorite bakeries around the city. Everything is delicious, my favorite is their variety of bialies the have to offer. Their desserts are not extremely sweet. During my morning commute, I may pick up breakfast and dessert. There is no seating, so be prepared to take your treats on the go. Next, I have to try their pistachio cheesecake.

I love this bakery. They are always so friendly and efficient. I have ordered a few cakes from them for birthdays at work and they have always been amazingly delicious. The cakes are expensive but I feel like they use quality ingredients. I also have found that the cakes feed way more than the serving size quoted. I also really like their macarons. They have some interesting flavors like fruity pebbles, s'mores & capt'n crunch! They also have nitro cold brew. They are worth checking out.

Villani's Bakery is the best bakery in and around the Charlotte area. If you are looking for specialty items like Lobster Tails and Sfogliatella look no further. Their lobster tails are the best I've ever had, anywhere. The filling is fresh and delicious and made from real cream and real cheese. Their Sfingi pastries are super delicious (also known as St. Joseph Cream Puffs or Sfingi di San Giuseppe.) I could go on and on about the many other delicious pastry items. They have excellent coffee and espresso as well. There are picnic tables so you may sit and enjoy your delicious finds. If you go in the evening, there are pretty lights for you to sit under. This is a great date spot. :-)

The flourless chocolate cake was to die for. We hid it from my brothers to make it last longer. hehe I will definitely be back. My mom is gluten free and loved the cake. It was decently priced for a gluten free treat! I just wish they had seating...but that would make me want more goodies too!

This one's real easy, top marks all the way around! The macaroons here are easily some of the best I've had, second only to the infamous LadurÃ©e and maybe another bakery I've been to. The usually have about 15 different varieties to choose from and always changing. The cakes here are also impeccable, personal faves are the carrot cake and some of their chocolate variants. Everything is made in house and all in all, one of if not the best bakery in CLT. Check it out!

Came to Villani's to get some sweets after lunch. The establishment allows 2 customers in during COVID. Staff is extremely knowledgeable and helping. The place is really clean and smells exquisite. Gilbert assist me and he was really nice and provided a great recommendation. Will return soon!!!

I read all the reviews so we decide to make the half hour journey,really wish I did not ! First no Italian bread then I pat $2.75 for one macaron cookie which seems not to have made it in my bag then paid $2.75 a piece for French horns which were terrible needless to say Never again !

Love villanis! An excellent little bakery with delicious coffee and pastries. Plenty of parking, outdoor seating is available, and the staff is friendly and knowledgeable about all their sweets. :) Would especially recommend the chocolate cake!
If you want the best eclairs, cream puffs and Italian cookies then this is your spot. It is excellent!

I love going for the baked goods. The drinks on the other hand always come out inconsistent. The specialty drinks are always luke warm and only taste like milk. It seems like this is a recent change as I used to love coming for the coffee.
What a cute Bakery!! I got the olive oil cake and a latte and it was absolutely delicious! The staff were all very nice. I will be back!
This lemon blueberry cheese cake was absolutely perfect. If you're in the bakery and you see it, get it.

Originally went to their Concord location occasionally and was thrilled when they moved their location to Charlotte. Forget Amalie's--these sweets and the people are even better. They have the best brownies I've ever had. Also enjoy their macarons, cream horns, and olive oil cake. The staff are also very friendly. I've never had their coffee but it always smells really nice.

Villani's is so good! It is a rare treat to find a bakery with really high quality, artistically crafted stuff. This place clearly has a baker that knows what they are doing. The raspberry haystack was phenomenal. The texture of the pastry was perfectly flaky with a subtle buttery taste. The powdered sugar dusting topped it off nicely. The only critique is I would prefer a little more sugar and a little less seeds in the raspberry filling, but that is just a matter of personal preference. I also had a cannolli which was great and a sfingi. The almond ricotta filling in the sfingi was perfect. Overall, I was pleasantly surprised by this place. I will 500% be back!

We've been a couple times now and there's some definite pluses and minuses to this bakery. Pros: Great location with a huge variety of baked goods, especially cheesecakes and harder to find Italian baked good options. The service is very prompt and friendly. Their hours are longer than nearby bakeries, making it great to snag a late night nibble or coffee to go. Cons: There really is no place, either inside or outside, to sit and enjoy your food. Since their business seems to be oriented to couples and families walking around the neighborhood for the most part, it's odd that there aren't benches or picnic tables at least to sit and eat. The quality of some of the items does not seem to be as consistent as Sunflour a few blocks away. For example, the cream/custard filling of certain items looks almost pudding-like and the cinnamon rolls sit open air, making them look dried out. The other issue is pricing. I'm sure since they are new to the neighborhood, this may hash itself out, but as of now, they are significantly ($1-2 per item) more than nearby bakeries (again, Sunflour, and Nova's). $4 for a muffin or chocolate chip cookie is hard to swallow (though the baked good not so much :-). Look forward to popping in every once in a while to see what's new, but will probably wait and see before making it the go-to bakery in the 'hood.
Love this little neighborhood bakery! Their treats are always tasty and a different variety each week. Try to red velvet and carrot cake Friendly staff too!

I went in and ordered a peanut butter cookie, and 5 of the smaller cookies that they had on top of the counter, and all I can say is that they were all lacking flavor. The small cookies on top of the counter, were way too thick, I felt like, while lacking flavor. I didn't try anything else, but I doubt it would be good. Honestly I thought I could buy better cookies at Publix.
Best bakery EVER! Their red velvet cake is the absolute best dessert. I've had it at least once a week (sometimes more than that ) for almost a year and it is consistently amazing.

Could not wait to go for my birthday & drove an hour to come but they wouldn't allow my boys who are 14 & 16 come in with me so we had to leave. Their business their decision. Just a warning to all would want to go because the sign says children are allowed with parent but when we entered we were told if over 11 they have to come in by themselves.
You better be ready to buy all the old cakes before you can get the fresh ones, cause these people will force you to pay for their trash !! I've been there 2 times , first and last !!!!!
Great place for baked goodies. Try the bialys! Always good service from the staff. No place to eat inside but the picnic benches outside make for a great place to enjoy your treat.

Villani's has the best coconut cake I have ever had. Not too sweet buttercream frosting, the cake is a great texture, and it is a great size. Their strawberry cream horns are also awesome. Lightly sweetened whipped cream with fresh strawberry mixed in, yum. This might be a seasonal flavor, but I hope not. The cheddar biscuits are also great. Can't wait to try more things here!

This is a tiny and amazing bakery in the Chantilly area. The bakers put out an impressive authentic display of pastries, cookies, pies and cakes. I'm sure I'll be back for many more visits! Recipes are spot-on, added ingredients and fillings are generous. We grabbed an almond croissant, cinnamon roll, and apple cheddar scone. We also picked up a bag of chocolate pizzette cookies, which are the most perfect cookie for coffee I have EVER had. It was hard to stop! This a superb bakery and worth your trip, no matter where you are in the Charlotte area. When the weather is warmer, there's a little seating outside, but this is primarily an order to-go location. They also serve good coffee and nitro cold brew (I got the nitro with coconut milk - very good). Many specialty Italian coffees are available. I have no doubt Villani's will remain a serious contender in the Charlotte culinary landscape. So happy they have moved to the middle of town, and so happy to have found it!

I'm glad Villani's seems to be here for the long haul. It's located in a bit of an odd lot with Rico's Acai and a barbershop, but is convenient for Elizabeth and Plaza Midwood folks, especially being that there's plenty of parking and it's one of the only bakeries in the area. Each time I've gone in the staff is incredibly helpful and kind. I usually go to pick up some breakfast sweets, but can never decide on what to get. It's a small place, but they certainly make use of the space provided and pack it with all different kinds of fun or classic cheesecake flavors, biscuits, scones, macarons, semi-sweet italian breads and cookies you can't really find anywhere else close by. You name it, they've probably got it! Not to mention everything they make is GORGEOUS. I couldn't help but to take photos last time I was there and even pulled out my professional camera to add some shots of their treats to my portfolio. My only critiques are that the orangeade is a bit watery and one of the pastries I got once had an amaretto flavor a bit strong for my liking, but the service here is unbeatable and I'm definitely coming back this weekend.

I picked up a regular cream horn, strawberry cream horn and a cinnamon muffin to share with my family. The strawberry cream horn was the single most delicious thing I have ever eaten in my whole life. The other items got rave reviews as well. The prices are very high, but the quality surpasses the price for value. I'm not kidding you, this place is super natural kind of amazing, like the pastry chef must have wings tucked under her jacket. I wish I could give it more stars and could afford more calories in my diet. I'm considering maybe just eating a cream horn every day and giving up all other food. Divine, delectable and damn delicious!

Today was my first time going to Villani's, I was craving sweets and wanted to try something new. First I'd like to say that the customer service I received is AMAZING. The two young ladies in the front helped me and didn't rush me. They were so sweet and the cookies and cinnamon roll was DELICIOUS. I'll definitely be a long time customer now!

My friend and I had been anticipating coming to Villani's for our love of cannolis, and it was everything we expected and more. The cannolis had a light cinnamon flavor and an excellent creaminess. Along with our cannolis, we got four macaroons- mint chocolate, pistachio, birthday cake, and mocha. They are definitely some of the better macaroons I have had in Charlotte. They were a great size, where you can really try many of their creative flavors. I can't wait to go back to try more.

Where do I begin?! I've been devouring these desserts for so long, even before their Concord store front. That's right folks: they've been making desserts for local restaurants before you even knew they existed. I have fought through a day-before-thanksgiving bar crowd to order one of their chocolate peanut butter cake slices togo from Whiskey Warehouse. Their macaroons are made in house and the flavors change daily. The bialys (my favs are the everything and the jalapeÃ±o cheddar) are a great, cheap morning snack on the go. Locally sourced nitro'd coffee on draft. Oh and then there's the owners! They're Plaza Midwoodians and have been from some time. They pour their New York/ Italian souls into their food, however, and it's evident. These folks care so much about everyone who walks into their door and are happy to share their story and their love for their product with you, so don't be afraid to chat them up. I've never met such kind people before and am so glad they're just a hop away from me now! Seriously go here. You won't regret it!

what a great bakery... lots of choices. We purchased cheesecake, cream puff, another pastry and cookies. Everything was delicious and we will definitely come back here again. can't wait to sample some more sweet treats

I am SO sorry we stopped in here for the first time on Saturday. EVERYTHING in the store looked good, and everything we had was wonderful (NY style cheesecake, chocolate cake & key lime pie). It's gonna be really hard not to keep stopping there now we've started!!!

Today I visited Villani's for the 2nd time. Was going to get a Poppy's bagel from Teeter but then remembered this was right near by. I got a bialy for the 2nd time too. This time, the Everything. Last time, the Sea Salt. Love them both lightly toasted. The edges get just crisp enough and the middle stays soft. Think a great bagel with no hole and the size is perfect. They offer dozens of flavors of beautiful macarons which are displayed in a case much like precious jewels! They have cake by the slice, muffins, cinnamon rolls, biscotti (which are not as hard as a rock like some can be), scones like a cheddar apple, croissants and cookies. I'm sure I'm missing something. So the chocolate chip cookie is special. It's almost scone or biscuit like and I say that because it's mounded high, is airy but is crunchy on the outside and if cut open you can see a bit of doughiness that seemed to have got the best of the oven. Check my pics. Just a heads up that there is one outside bench for seating and I think a table or two inside. It's a pop in and go back home kinda place. Fine with me. Leaves them with more room to bake. Other Yelpers have written that it is pricier than other bakeries but I think the prices are on point considering all the hard work. If it was cheaper, I'd be fatter!

Got a fabulous custom made bday cake today for a friend! Absolutely delicious! Have had other baked items there and all were on point! Great local couple owns it and knows what they are doing! Stop in if you want a real bakery here in Charlotte.
There are other potentially more well known bakeries in town but this place has the best macaroons, Bialys, and biscuits in town. My favorite macaroon flavor: cookies and cream.

I called the bakery Friday morning to order a cannoli cake. I was told it was $65 for the cake and it would be ready on Sunday at 12:30. Got to the bakery and it was indeed ready and looked amazing!! Was very happy with the cake but was charged $5.00 more for the cake than I was told over the phone. So decided to buy a few cookies for Mom's anniversary and my boyfriend being from NewYork wanted to try the rainbow cookie before buying them Because it was his Mothers favorite. The girl behind the counter asked the guy at the register if he could have a cookie and he said "well, you're going to have to buy it". Well we planned on dropping $100 there easy and he couldn't try the cookie? Really? Guy behind the register charged us $1 for 1 cookie. May have given 5 stars if the the customer service was better. Will let you know how the cake tastes later but looks really delicious

This place is pure magic. The gentlemen helping us were attentive and helpful with their recommendations. I enjoyed a MASSIVE piece of chocolate cake with a chocolate peanut butter ganache that was out of this world. I could only eat half. I also got a lobster tail which was delicious as well. Far superior than the other bakeries in town. Will definitely be back.

Villani's Bakery is a gem of the neighborhood! A shocking variety of goods are baked daily, all in-house and made from scratch, by a small but talented staff. Some of my favorite items are the bialys (like bagels but better!), the almond croissant, and assortment of cheesecakes (it's incredible how many flavors of cheesecake are offered- they rotate almost daily). They also have great coffee, which is a must for me if I'm eating something sweet. In my opinion, the only thing that beats the baked goods is the exceptional customer service. I have never been disappointed by the incredible staff... they make it a special place! If you haven't tried this place before, it should absolutely be on your list.

Villani's has amazing everything. You should definitely try a slice of Italian Cream Cake. Yes, it's $7, but it's huge. Not to mention delicious. They make a rich cream cheese frosting, not one that tastes whipped with air. The oatmeal raisin cookies are perfection and the cheesecakes are wonderful. They also stay open until 10 o'clock. I love that.
Great Bakery located in Charlotte! Best Croissants around and lovely staff! The Italian Cream Cake, Macaroons and Latte were Exceptional!!! Highly Recommended!

I wish they had indoor seating to make this more of a place you can hang out, and I wish they offered smaller whole cakes so that I could come here for birthday cakes without spending $70, but I am giving Villani's a 5 star review because their desserts are simply incredible. My husband and I are obsessed with sweets and have been to every bakery in the city. We have never been so impressed with the taste of our desserts as we were with Villani's. I got the chocolate orange babka and hubs got the pistachio cheesecake. Normally I can't stand cheesecakes, but it was so fluffy and so tasty that I ended up eating half his slice. Plus, the cashier was incredibly nice and gave us good recommendations. Go. Go now.

Great customer service, cinnamon roll and cappuccino! I had my barking dog with me and they were kind enough to help me with my order from the door. Hoping to try other items on the menu but so far I enjoyed my purchase. I'd like to see a rewards program. It's definitely an in and out bakery as there is no seating. Just enough parking for a few customers where they share space with Rico's aÃ§aÃ­. Hoping y'all do well. Good luck!

I was craving something sweet and came across this cute bakery with many sweet treats inside. I can't remember the exact name of the pastry bought, but it was filled with whipped cream with powdered sugar on top. I also bought a strawberry cheesecake.
Delicious treats , friendly staff , The Villani's team went above and beyond to assure our special birthday order was ready and perfect at pickup

I cannot rave about this place enough. We went on a Sunday morning to pick up some breakfast pastries. It was a quaint and small shop but the selection of baked goods was out of this world. We were so tempted to get everything from the pastries to the cakes to the macaroons but forced ourselves to just stick with the chocolate croissant and the very berry muffin. These did not disappoint. The chocolate croissant was massive (yet I still could have eaten more because it was so good) It was so flaky and had the perfect amount of chocolate it in. The muffin too was the perfect texture and bursting with a rich berry flavor. The only bad thing about this place is there isn't anywhere to sit inside so you can continue to enjoy the delicious smells of the bakery.

First time here, I would have to say the staff is friendly and welcoming. It's a nice addition to plaza midwood. I ordered an Ice latte and a chocolate chip cookie. First off the Cookie was massive which isn't bad, was looking for a smaller cookie. The cookie didn't wow me but it was good. You could share the cookie with someone. The Latte was good, I would have to drink it again to really get a good sense how the espresso taste. There is room for Parking and they have benches outside. Would recommend. I would like to see smaller cookies.

I was surprised by the variety of items they were selling. We got three items and all were very tasty. The croissants were huge. Not as light and buttery as what I am used to. The prices were reasonable for the quality of the product which was above average. I would like to try their cakes next time. I do plan to go back.

I have now visited Villani's 4 times and every time Has always been a great experience. The Italian cream cake is excellent. Other items that I would recommend are the Lemon Bars and Oatmeal Raisin Cookies. This is now my go to bakery.

Best triple berry muffin I have ever had. Moist and fresh. The customer service was excellent I will go back. Not much to off in the coffee dept such as iced drinks. But I would highly recommend the baked goods.

What a charming bakery! They really have delicious desserts. Love their lemon bar, sfingi, pistachio cheesecake, lobster roll, cream puffs. Their tiramisu and Napoleon are also delicious. There is no place to sit but you can't wait to go home and stuff your face with sweets after coming here ! Owners and cashiers are super nice. Come and support your local bakery !

Absolutely obsessed with this new bakery! Their macarons are incredible and brownies are to die for! The staff was so friendly when I walked in and the building cute as can be! I've driven by it every day for a while and have been meaning to pop in, SO glad that I did! It's such a gem, highly recommend trying their maple bacon macarons. They're seriously amazing!! I will absolutely be back, sooner rather than later! Thank you for making this such an enjoyable first experience!! 10/10 Would Recommend!!
This place has very friendly service but the cannoli is way over priced. It was not sweet enough for my liking. Also it cost extra for extra pistachios.

Villani's has amazing pastries and coffee. I highly recommend their huge chocolate chunk cookies, which are layered with cinnamon and vanilla notes and definitely big enough to share. The apple cheddar scones are perfect for when you're looking for something a bit more savory. My favorite item is the coconut nitro cold brew- it is so creamy and flavorful, yet only has 35 calories. The employees are very friendly and helpful. Overall, this is a perfect bakery if you're looking to pop in and grab a coffee, treat, or cake.

Best bakery in Charlotte and I have lived here for 20 years! Went first time and got several items to share/sample. Amazing cream puff, tiramisu, chocolate croissant, macarons etc.!! Went back a second time to try the cake before ordering a whole one for a bday party. Chocolate Peanut butter slice was delicious...whole cake for party=delicious. Have since tried red velvet and Italian cream cake...all fresh, tasty and so good. Have been there 5 times in a 4 week period and are impressed every time. My 10 year old is also a huge fan! Would highly recommend if you enjoy sweets.

Great assortment of cakes, cheesecake, cookies, bars, breakfast pastries & anything else you could want. Service is always helpful. They're open really late which is such a nice surprise. This place is a great way to put a long, crappy day behind you (no matter how late the crap runs).

They have amazing cake! I got the Italian cake and a napoleon. Both were amazing! The fruity pebbles and Cinnamon Toast Crunch macarons were delicious as well. The staff is very friendly and helpful as we went here for the first time. I can't wait to go back and try more!

I love the simplicity of the building, the customer service, the ease of parking and of course the desserts. This is absolutely my go to spot for pastries. If I need a hostess gift I go in and get a box of assorted treats. My kids love the croissants and lemon bars. I especially love the smaller cookie/biscotti assortment.

stopped in for a dessert, and we did not expect to be wowed with every dessert we could have ever dreamed of. super tiny bakery filled with the most delectable desserts ever! they even had a ricotta cheesecake which is hard to find! I am already dying to go back for more.
Good food good - I got savory cheese biscuits and some sweet stuff and it was all FABULoUS! So glad this place is there. Thanks!!!

I walked in one day wanting a slice of cake, ok so I can't get with paying $7 for a slice of cake. This is ridiculous. There was also a customer who walked in after me with a dog on a lease. Really? Why would anybody bring a dog in a bakery? I don't understand why someone think that's ok. On the plus side the young lady behind the counter told him he had to take the dog outside. I didn't buy the cake I thought it was to expensive. Unfortunately, the whole experience put a bad taste in my mouth. I won't be back.

Villani's Bakery feels like home! Paul and Amanda Villani go out of their way to make sure that your experience is perfection. From their monster cinnamon rolls, to their bialys (think bagel but better), decadent cakes, and more, you won't leave disappointed. Top it off with their nitro coffee and you will already be planning your next trip. It is the best Italian bakery around. They have even started a pick up window and their menu is easily found online so you can browse if there is a line. If you are in Charlotte, add some happiness to your day by stopping in at Villani's Bakery!

Went here for a rainbow cookie. This place claims to be an italian bakery and rainbow cookies are a staple in italian bakeries. This was quite literally the WORST rainbow cookie i have ever had. I'm not being dramatic. It tasted NOTHING like a traditional rainbow cookie. It tasted like a bland flavorless cake with a hard chocolate coating. It was awful, i took one bite and threw it away. It certainly was not a rainbow cookie in any sense of the word do not go here if a rainbow cookie is what you are looking for. I can't speak for their other desserts.
This bakery so so cute! Awesome addition to the neighborhood. Staff is friendly and the recipe for the traditional cheese is delicious. The texture is a good balance of thick and creamy.

I had early wanted to try this bakery based on what I had heard and Yelp reviews, but it is not exactly close to where I live. I was headed to the area to meet and friend for dinner and thought it would be the perfect time to stop in and pick up a couple treats for dessert. I got a slice of carrot cake and a slice of chocolate chip cheesecake. Oh my! Both were fantastic!!! I actually got the carrot cake for my husband, but it was huge, so I cut of a piece for myself too. I so wish I did not have to share it! The cheesecake was to die for too. I love cheesecake and this one was fabulous! I just wish this bakery was closer to me. It is probably a good thing it's not!

Our 1st visit to Villani's Bakery was as excellent as multiple visits after. Variety of items assures you will find something yummy, no matter your preference. Customer service is shockingly consistent and always delightful. Italian Cream birthday cake for my husband was delightful to look at and eat, amazing! I've found non better in Charlotte! Thank You Villani's and Welcome to Plaza Midwood. Ron Wright

I love little bakeries! Things that are handmade fresh and not thawed and stuck in a window. This place is a great bakery with a small town feel:) I love Italian treats, and can be a tad picky! So, as you read, keep in mind I have crazy high standards in reference to Italian desserts! The Napoleon- yum! 4/5, Tiramisu- 3.5/5 :) other desserts I have tried- apple cheddar scone, cherry and apple turnovers, croissant, macaroons, cream puffs, cream horns... all yummy! Definitely a 4/5 overall! Would recommend this place to pick up desserts for any gathering:)

This place was so cute! The people working there were so sweet and helpful. The chocolate chip cookie was soft and dense. The birthday cake macaroon was delicious and fresh, but the Earl gray macaroon was a bit stale. Overall, I loved it!
Walked in and greeted warmly as the last time! Dessert is amazing every time. Love coming back and this time brought my hubby. Clean and ample parking
My God, the lemon ricotta cheesecake...not for sharing.

Just ate here for the first time. Best service and food I have ever experienced at a bakery. I had a lemon bar and the wife tried a few macaroons. Both were perfect and so fresh. This place is awesome!

Five stars isn't nearly enough for Villani's. No matter how long it's been since I've visited, the owners (Amanda and Paul) always make me feel like I'm right at home. This cozy bakery has such an inviting atmosphere. Of course, since this a bakery, the quality of the baked goods matters too. The food is where Villani's truly shines. If you don't try one of their macaroons, you're doing it wrong. Simple as that. I love the cinnamon rolls and the Italian creme cake too. I've been many times and I've never been disappointed. If you're in downtown Concord, this is a place you must visit.

HIT -AND- MISS My Wife & I are former NY'ers of Italian descent, so we were excited to try Villani's. The Bakery concept is nice; the server was really nice, and they have several items - though the availability of items rotates. Part of what I had deserved 5 stars, and the other part of what I had earned a single star. The rainbow cookies were five star perfection, as was the pastry part of what comprises their St Joseph's pastry (which I think the clerk referred to as Sfingi). How do you describe the perfect rainbow cookie? Villani's. Likewise, the Sfingi pastry was fluffy without being too light; a perfect balance, and tasty - a five star pastry that could go head to head with anything in NY. Literally. May I also add that everything was fresh, which is also uncommon. The filling of the St Joseph/Sfingi, and the filling of the cannoli, was a disaster. In my life I have tasted different types of cannoli filling made from ricotta, with different bakeries flavoring the filling with nuts, chocolate chips, etc. I have had cannoli filling that is sometimes too sweet, and cannoli filling that leaned towards ricotta tasting. The cannoli shell at Villani's tasted like a fried noodle from a Chinese restaurant, formed in the shape of a cannoli shell. Both the Sfingi filling, and cannoli filling, tasted like unsweetened heavy cream with a touch of cinnamon. The consistency was good, but the taste was very unexpected. In my 40 something years of eating Italian desserts, I have never had anything like this, and I didn't find it tasty. So...IMHO, Villani's was a hit and miss; what Villani's got right, they got right in a way that's worth bragging over. Unfortunately, what they got wrong was likewise extreme. 2.5 stars, rounded up to 3 stars, as I believe that Villani's makes a deliberate effort in serving up fresh, quality, items. The cannoli shell and filling were a HUGE miss, unfortunately.
Nice little place with great desserts! The Keylime pie was the real deal just like you were sitting in Key West. And the chocolate eclair puffs were the perfect amount of sweetness.

I have been waiting so impatiently for this place to open, and finally got to try them. I was BLOWN AWAY by the quality of these delicious treats. We got the coconut cake and the ricotta sweet cream filled puff. both light and delicate in texture. The perfect amount of sweetness in both. The cream puff had a beautiful taste of amaretto and ricotta. the cake was perfectly moist, with great coconut flavor and buttercream that had the perfect airy texture. The cake was only $6.50, such an amazing price for this level of quality. The staff was super friendly and fun. They also have a great variety of croissants, cheesecakes, and macarons. I cannot wait to go back!!!
Best bakery anywhere. Amanda and Paul are wonderful people. They have a special blend coffee that is the best. Do yourself a favor and go see these folks. You won't regret it

I love this bakery. I fell in love with them when they were in Concord and now I drive all the way into Charlotte to see them. I always go in for a slice of Chocolate cake... (yes, worth the 30 minute drive each way)... and I walk out with 3-4 other things. Often I buy things that are outside of my normal food comfort zone and have loved everything I've tried. I can't say enough about them. (Also, come back to Concord. haha)
I have never been let down. They have the best sweets in Charlotte. I had their cannoli cheesecake a month or so ago and am still dreaming of it.
Love this spot! The pecan praline cake is soooo good!! Friendly staff and very welcoming!

I'm addicted to the Sfingi's!!! Absolutely love them!! This is the best bakery. Hands down! Everything that I've purchased from here has been delicious! I highly recommend this place. First taste and you'll be hooked.

This place is awesome. The macarons are perfect and with wide variety (love the key lime and mint chocolate chip especially) the muffin is basically perfect. The tiramisu is cocoa mascarpone cream deliciousness. They wait to fill the cannoli until ordered, making them even better. The coffee is solid and smooth. We can't stop going here.
I had a piece of peanut butter chocolate cake as a present. It was awesome! Enjoyed every bite

Thank you Villani! I live in MA and ordered a red velvet cake for one of my closest friends for her birthday. Staff taking my call-in order was very friendly and helpful- felt confident I was making the right choice choosing Villani's. My friend is very picky about red velvet cake- she said that she hadn't had a good one for a long time. But she LOVED Villani's red velvet cake! When she called to thank me, we discussed (1) whether she really needed to share it with her family and (2) whether she could slice several pieces and freeze them so she could savor the experience for longer! :-) Many thanks again to Villani for helping me make my friend's birthday a success. I look forward to visiting the bakery in person very soon!

I had been here a few weeks ago and I'm happy to say it was excellent.I purchased some items such as lemon blueberry cheesecake, chocolate croissants and macaroons and their were excellent. Their items change daily and has many surprises.

This is bakery heaven! The angels should show up and start singing! We arrived about an hour before closing and the staff was very attentive and helpful. Love this southern hospitality! I had never tried macaroons and I was determined to try them. I'm glad I tried them here. They really sweet, but delicious. I had lemon and strawberry and the fruit flavors were so good. I also bought a pistachio cannoli. That was to die for! It had a hint of cinnamon in the filling and the shell was deliciously crispy. This was the best cannoli I had ever had! If I come back to Charlotte, I'm definitely revisiting this spot. I think I spoke with the owner/manager and she is so pleasant.

Ahhhhh!!! I'm so happy I found this place. I went and got a little bit of everything. Lol. Everything was amazing. I went around 9:30 PM and the cashier was so sweet. She went thru every single macaron flavor with me and was patient while I looked around. She wasn't rude that I came in late (usually people anywhere 30-60 mins before closing are rude). I will defiantly be coming back here and I look forward to it!
FULL 5 STARS!!!! This place has amazing macaroons with a great variety of flavors, I recommend the strawberry it's so good! If your looking for a bomb desert place THIS IS FOR YOU.

Small Business Saturday in Concord. So glad I tried this place. The Italian cream cake is loaded with pecans and sooooo good! - a surprise for the hubby. The cannoli is well balanced and perfectly cinnamony - all mine!!! Friendly and warm service. Highly recommended!!

Had a meeting in the area and someone recommended this place for coffee. The bakery is located in downtown Concord. I love this area because is quaint, walkable and it appears as if most of the businesses are small, local business owners. This bakery is located inside a sort of mall area. Upon entering a business the first thing I look for is to be greeted immediately with a smile and an appreciation of me coming into your business. The owners were in the back and didn't notice me at first but as soon as they did I was greeted with a smile. I ordered a vanilla latte and a slice of freshly baked banana bread. It was SO good! Another female completed my transaction and she was very friendly. I'm not in this area often but I'll return to this spot when I am.

This quaint little bakery is a delight. From their generous cake slices to their cinnamon buns it's ALL delicious. Everything is made in house, and from the look and taste it doesn't disappoint. The price point is what you would expect. $6-7 for a cake slice and $4-5 for rolls , buns and other fancy treats. They have coffee as well and some cute tables outside if you want to sit and eat. Next time i need some Breakfast or sweet treats for a party this will be my Stop! Staff was super friendly. Definitely stop in!
Amazing owners and amazing bakery! I had the Italian cream cake and it was the best cake I've had in a loooooong time. Not too sweet - so you can eat the whole piece! Great service, too.

Hands down best cheesecake I've ever had. I've had the red velvet cake which was also excellent, but the cheesecake was out of this world. I can't wait to go back and try the funfetti cheese cake and some of their breakfast items! Great service and help from the staff as well.

Stopped in here after dinner on Saturday. Spent quite a bit of time talking to the owner. Nice guy! The best cannoli we have found since we moved here from NY! Cream puffs were great. Had something we've never had before called a lobster tail.... Not up our alley. The almond crinkle (?) is amazing.... Can't wait for more!

Great bakery! We were impressed with the variety of offerings as well as the quality. They had a lot of yummy cakes (red velvet, carrot, chocolate peanut butter ganache), cream puffs (big, w/ real custard inside, not whipped cream), thick soft chocolate chip cookies, macarons, napoleons, muffins, bialy (unexpected and tasty!), biscuits and so much more. I only listed what we got and all the items were perfect. The prices are reasonable (big portions, high quality) as well. We also got tea and a drip coffee which were also great. I think they use specialty beans. Definitely worth a stop!
Had a few macaroons- the salted caramel was my favorite. I will definitely be back to Villani's to try more of their desserts!
I am a huge fan of cheesecake, so don't take this lightly....this is easily one of the best pieces of cheesecake I've ever had. Would recommend 10/10. Friendly staff too.

The cookies and pastries are delicious. Prices a little higher than others I have tried. But for great tasting and homemade goodies your going to pay a little more.!!!..... but I love everything that I have tried.
Finally a dessert place that's good and stays open late. I had the chocolate cake and chocolate chip cookie and both were amazing!!! Staff was friendly and helpful and I can't wait to return
We happen to stumble upon this gem of a place! The coffee and baked goods were delicious!! Only thing I wish they had was inside seating!! We will definitely revisit for more goodies in the future.

There's just not enough stars to rate these two! From the carrot cake, carbomb cupcakes, to pimento cheese filled croissants....if you have a special occasion, birthday, a holiday gathering, or just want a great treat-- put this one your list! Amanda and Paul are always helpful and such a pleasure to work with. You'll definitely want to go back again and again. And again!
This place is amazing in every way. I love it so much. The people are great. All of the baked goods are incredible. I bring new friends here all the time
Oreo cheesecake and macaroons were delish! Must try it for yourself! Staff is lovely as well. will definitely be coming back!
Everything I've tried at this Bakery is amazing!! I only wish they also had some seating area indoors.
Fabulous place! The owners are super friendly and accommodating and the baked goods are delicious. Highly recommend!

This is the best bakery in Charlotte. We love the Chocolate Croissants, biscotti, Napoleons. Everything we've had is delicious. Not to mention, their coffee is some of the best I've had in the city. So happy to have Villani's in the neighborhood.

I am very glad I found out about this place. This was my second time there. First time I got the Italian Cream Cake. It was superb. Tasted as good as the one passed down in my family for generations. This time I got the Lemon citron cake. OMG!!! It was just the right balance of sweetness and slight tart from the lemon. Can't wait to try more treats from this place.

Amazing cakes! They have a lot of variety of desserts. Their cakes are amazing!! They have an AMAZING chocolate cake. Probably the best I've had in my life, I'm not kidding. Also wanted to try the red velvet which looked good. Will definitely come back to this place

Excellent cheesecake. Order ahead from whole cheesecake... it's worth it! I've also had scones & muffins (trying not to eat cheesecake for breakfast!) which are also very good. Odd location between 2 neighborhoods but convenient from both & plenty of parking.

I was really looking forward to trying a new bakery. I love bakeries and seek them out everywhere. We ordered two 16oz House iced coffees, a cheddar jalapeÃ±o Baily (bagel), chocolate croissant and a black & white cookie to the tune of $19. I will say the baked goods were good. I liked the bagel. But the cookie was slightly stale and the iced coffee turned to watered down coffee by the time we got to the car. I returned them and asked for two regular coffees, there was no issue there. Now, coffee is certainly supposed to be hot. But this coffee was HOT. We waited twenty minutes before it being hot enough to sip and ended up just tossing both full cups after a half hour. So all in all it just wasn't worth it. (This was the Pecan Ave location) I am adding more to my review a couple days later: after checking the online receipt I was emailed I noticed I was charged an extra $1 for cream cheese for my bagel. The cream cheese comes in a small packet that resembles something for mayo at fast food spots. And I got charged $1 for that? Yeah, will not be visiting again or recommending.

I visited twice this week while my daughter was in camp. I would make the drive to Charlotte from Huntersville to visit again. So many things I still want to try. The tiramsu, cream puffs and chocolate chip cookies were amazing!
Try the Carrot Cake. Rich, moist, and delicious. Everything is made in-house from scratch and its shows. Highly recommended for cakes cookies and Italian breads.

This place is so tasty! Really beautiful presentation and even better taste!! The owners are really friendly and made us feel at home when we went in. I definitely recommend this bakery if you're looking for quality desserts in concord.

Friends brought many pastries to our New Year's Eve party. Everything was very fresh and delicious. We came from NY so we know good Italian baked goods. We tried other bakeries in our area, This is the best so far.

Napoleon cream is soo good, light but rich. The lemon shortbread crust is thick and the bar is the size of my iPhone X. My son sucked the creek filling out of the cream puff before eating the rest. We didn't try the Italian cookies but they looked amazing!!!!! Definitely going to go back for them.

Great to see a local independently owned business doing so well! We don't live in the area anymore but always make sure we stop by Villani's when we are in NC! Freshly baked goodies and delicious coffee, love to see all the treats on their Facebook page too - makes me wish we lived closer!!!

A must stop for fresh (watch them making everything behind the counter) pastries, cakes, macaroons. Don't miss their custom blend coffee; which is roasted locally by Boquete Mountain Coffee. The owners are husband and wife and are always here - very nice people! Such a quaint place inside the Union Square atrium downtown Concord. Sit at a cafe table inside with a great cup of fresh coffee and a delicious dose of sweetness. Support local!

Customer service was amazing! The owners were both there cute couple. We talked for a long time about how they opened and their deserts. I had a moon pie and it was amazing just like I used to make with my grandma. It may be hard to find but it is worth it!
Great coffee!! Pastries look delicious! The owners are extremely friendly, highly recommend this spot!

I had the Red Velvet cake and it was really good. Also got the berry muffin for tomorrow. Everything looks good, but a bit expensive. More of a treat than a weekly stop. The muffin was really good and fresh. My wife had lemon cake and enjoyed.

The people were so nice and you could tell that they put love into each of their pastries. It was a little loud when other customers would drag the chairs, and the acoustics made the sound bounce, but overall a good atmosphere to enjoy a cup of Joe.
Love this place! The owners are friendly and down to earth, and the foods are delicious. The tiramisu and the pimento cheese croissants are not to be missed
Love stopping by for afternoon snack! The owners are very friendly, and everything tastes so good! I recommend the lemongrass tea and the quiche!

I stopped in on a Saturday morning and bought one of their strawberry swirl cheesecakes for my husbands birthday. It is seriously the best cheesecake I've had in Charlotte. The crust is PERFECT. I also ordered a slice (which is huge) of their peanut butter chocolate cake, which is rich and delicious. I can't wait to go back to try the cinnamon rolls! Great customer service, too!
Our family favorite! Love the red velvet and carrot cakes. Kids love the lemon bars and cookies. Paul and Amanda are wonderful, warm and friendly. So glad they have come to Concord!

The best thing that has moved into Midwood in years (and trust me, there is a lot going on here)! The people are awesome, the music is great, the coffee is strong, and the desserts are amazing. The chocolate cake, red velvet cake, napoleon, Boston creme cake, and their cheesecakes (all of them) are amazing. You cannot go wrong! They are open till 10pm so swing by for an after dinner treat. It will be amazing and fairly priced.
