While I am visiting the Midwest, I will have had my share of ice creams and frozen custards - hey, remember, this is America's Dairyland! - and by the end of my trip, I will announce my winner!

Best. Ice Cream. Ever. I can't believe, given the option between going here and going across the street to the Evil Ice Cream Parlor Which Must Not Be Named, people actually choose the latter. The Chocolate Shoppe has some of the most delectable ice cream flavors known to man. They have many different flavors each day that rotate out, so you're not always seeing the same stuff each time you go in. If you're able to, try Fat Elvis (my favorite: Banana ice cream with chocolate and peanut butter) or Zanzibar Chocolate (it's hot & sexy chocolate-on-dark-chocolate action). They'll sometimes have soy ice cream, too, which I think is great. One of the reasons I like them above all other ice creameries, though, is their disclaimer on the wall. It reads: "Nutrition: Don't even ask. This is the best ice cream made in Wisconsin and it tastes so good because it has gobs of rich Wisconsin cream, and tons of real ingredients, for boat-loads of delicious flavors. That means it's not low-fat, low-calorie, or low-anything, and that's why everyone loves it. You want nutrition, eat carrots." Hee hee!

ZANZIBAAAR! Oh my GOD the chocolate ice cream is AMAZING! We have a joke among my (very much adult officeworkin folks) that we have a serious commitment to ice cream. And when you are seriously committed to ice cream Chocolate Shoppe Ice Cream delivers on the promise of what great ice cream can be. Seriously, I'm droolin just thinking about it. Go get some before they close for the season!
Excellent icecream shop ! Dropped in with my kids last weekend!

It's a must whenever you're in the area. It's fresh and creamy. So what if it's not low on anything! Indulge yourself and you won't regret it! The staff is so friendly too. They're willing to give you a taste of any flavor they have.

I'm a Wisconsinite who doesn't really care for ice-cream (yes, we do exist) and I love this stuff. It's probably the only ice-cream that I will eat. I had Chocolate Shoppe Ice Cream as a treat when I was growing up. If you're not a local and can't stop by here often, you HAVE to try their Blue Moon and Zanzibar. Blue Moon is a unique flavor of ice-cream that's virtually impossible to find outside of WI. And they are known for their Zanzibar. Even the classic flavors here are delish. Their cookie dough is smooth and creamy with flecks of chocolate and soft and tasty chunks of cookie dough. They offer lots of flavors, sometimes it's hard to choose. The service can be hit-or-miss and on summer weekends the place is packed. This is TRUE ice-cream. It's creamy and thick and delicious. Don't think about how many calories you're eating, just enjoy and experience it.

Got here about ten minutes before they closed on a Sunday night. Still serving - whew! WOW flavors everywhere! So many choices, it's probably impossible not to find something you like. And then you have to figure out if you want a cookie bowl, pretzel cone, dipped waffle cone, or plain sugar/wafer cone - overwhelming to say the least. Once I finally decided, I got the Z'Oreo ice cream in a pretzel cone, which was very good for me since I don't have a huge sweet tooth. Ice cream was fresh, tasty, and creative - there were bits of Rice Krispie in mine along with Oreos and something else I can't remember. Very good! Minus one star for rude staff. My friend asked if she could do four small scoops instead of two large in order to try more flavors, and the kid behind the counter said he could lose his job for doing that. No need to be overdramatic, bud.

This place is insanely good! Honestly Ice Cream is Ice Cream its the additional things that are what I look for. Thus, it's no wonder that this place would tickle my fancy. I love marshmallow topping, not fluff and not actual marshmallows but the liquidy marshmallow syrupy goodness. That is what they have at Chocolate Shoppe, Thank God! Also the fact that they have bomb ass italian ices is a definite A+ in my opinion!

The ice cream was tasty. I had a flight with four flavors, Vanilla, ginger, blue moon and a cappuccino. The Ginger was the best of the bunch followed by the vanilla then the blue moon ? which tastes like fruit loops. The portions are typically very large but with the flight it more manageable. When I visit they were serving bar style and it was crowded so it seemed a bit chaotic.

This is one of the worst customer services I have had in awhile. My family was visiting me for the weekend and we went for ice cream on Friday night. We knew that the store closed at 10, but still walked in at 9:58. Immediately after we walked in one of the girls working behind the counter yelled "Sorry we're closed" in a very rude tone. We went to the counter and asked what time they closed, and the girl said 10. Since it was 9:58 we still ordered our ice cream. The two girls working behind the counter glared at us the entire time. We got our ice cream and left. There were three tables eating ice cream and as we were leaving one of the girls shouted at the tables that it was time to leave. That is not the way to treat customers.

We came here around 8pm on a cold Saturday evening and there were a surprising number of people here despite it being about 10 degrees outside! I was impressed with the interesting variety of flavors, but after a few minutes looking everything over we got the heaps of love and the honey ginger. The heaps of love was very satisfying and rich, with some nice chunks of cookie dough and swirls of fudge in each bite. The honey ginger was good, too, though a bit meltier in consistency. You could definitely taste the ginger in it. I think it would have been great with the green tea flavor that they also offer. Overall, pretty solid selection of flavors and yummy ice cream.

We purchased 18 gallons of ice cream from the factory for our daughter's wedding - and it did not disappoint! Multiple guests commented on this ice cream being the best! But there is so much more to this company than the ice cream... 1) The groom has an extreme nut allergy and gluten intolerance. Christy was so kind to walk me through the processing of their ice cream and to assure me that there would be no issues. So the groom got his favorite flavor of Birthday Cake! 2) My in-laws blew a tire out on their drive up to Madison, so they could not make the designated 11 a.m. pick-up. They sat in a tire shop most of the day waiting for a new tire. The team at the factory store was super nice to let them know that they would wait for them! Thankfully, my in-laws arrived at the store right at 4:00 pm - closing time! 3) Buying the ice cream in bulk was such a better deal than trying to buy from C***S**** - and the quality is so much better! I will forever be a fan of the Chocolate Shoppe - this company is doing so much more than just selling awesome ice cream! Thank you!!!

I think that Wisconsinites take good ice cream for granted. We just figure that no matter where you go in the country there are going to be ice cream parlors just like this one serving more or less the same product. Sadly, though that would make the world a better place, this just simply is not the case. Chocolate Shoppe is woven into the fabric of the state. Head up north and stop off in any small town and this is likely the ice cream you are going to find at the local ice cream shop. Go anywhere else in the upper Midwest even, and you'll likely just find soft serve and maybe a few flavors of the same Blue Bunny stuff you can buy at the grocery store. The variety of flavors is always amazing and it is damn near impossible to not find something you'll enjoy. The line can be long on weekends and hot days, but it is well worth it. And I love seeing the line here longer than Cold Stone across the street! And to think there was some concern that gimmicky excuse of a national chain would even dent the mighty mighty Chocolate Shoppe! PSHAW!

You don't go to an ice cream place to lose weight or get a filling meal--but you do go here when you want to be satisfied, cooled down, and satisfy any chocolate cravings. I've been here a lot of times before and my number one favorite is the "Malt Amore" flavor which has malted milkballs in chocolate ice cream. Delicious! But today, I got the "Kitty Kitty Bang Bang," which is a cheesecake-flavored ice cream with some cookie pieces and raspberry flavoring in it. It was so creamy and soft that it really puts a lot of other ice cream places to shame. The service is a little lackluster: it's mostly run by students who don't really give a shit to be there on a Sunday afternoon. The guy I got today was kind of rushing despite the fact no one else was in line to get any ice cream, and as a result, I'm putting the rating at 4 as opposed to 5 stars. Despite this, the place really is solid and I do enjoy it a lot. Since this place is literally right around the corner from my apartment, I'm in trouble. But oh, will it be a delicious, wonderful trouble.

The Chocolate Shoppe provides quintessential Wisconsin ice cream. As they fully claim, it's not health food and not meant to be taken as such. It's simply good ice cream of a wide variety of flavors. They also have malts and ice cream sodas, as well as coffee. Basically, a great place, and an absolutely necessary place during the hot summer months.

there are times when trying to go vegan is really hard and there are times when it's super easy....chocolate shoppe makes it easy and YUMMY! On a hot day in October, (a gift in itself), it's so nice to sit in peace park with a rich and creamy, dreamy soy cone (a lick-after-lick gift). It was the oreo flavor with bits of oreo cookies - not the hard crunchy ones from the package you buy in a store but soft, like your grandma baked for the oreo company before it got really big and the cookies were added fresh outta the oven after they had cooled down just enough. If you didn't know it was soy, you wouldn't know it was soy....you know?

When I'm on State Street this is my third choice place for the cream. I love me some Coldstone. But Coldstone on State doesn't have much for seating. Although I did see them remodeling recently. And there's a Gellato place nearby too that is ridiculously fun to try. Anyway, the Shoppe had me at strawberry cheesecake ice cream, which is my favorite. The downside is they don't always have it. And they don't have graham. Grrrrrrr. One falling star for that. But there are chunks of cheesecake in it. I go with the chocolate flavors next but they have about two dozen flavors to choose from. Seating is good and I can recharge my phone and watch the State Street crowd.

Its not health food, its super creamy delicious ice cream!! The door county cherry is my favorite, cherry ice cream with real halves of cherries and chocolate chunks!! Fat Elvis, when available, is so creamy and delicious, you'll want to eat a whole pint. (Don't do it, but you'll seriously be tempted to)

I stopped by on a Sunday afternoon and got two scoops. Oatmeal cookie and heaps of love. The ice cream was rich and super buttery. There was actually a sign on the wall advising those seeking health food to eat carrots. I found the attitude refreshing. I found the ice cream super buttery. i found the chunks of oatmeal cookie and heaps of love to be treats.

Great service, great ice cream and great atmosphere. It really doesn't get any better than walking along State St. with some delicious ice cream. They have so many flavors that any picky eater would be happy here. I have been very excited to even see some flavors I've never tried before, like Green Tea and Honey Ginger, which are to die for! I've had just about almost every flavor you can get, most recently I enjoyed a dish of the Horchata and just last night had some Zanzimint (Dark chocolate with mint). Both were as delicious as I expected. The service is pretty fast and they are always happy to give you samples to help you make your choice. I am gluten free so I haven't tried the cones but they look like they are homemade as you can see the waffle irons in the back of the store. They also sell chocolate covered bananas which are a staple for late night studying. Great place!

Nutrition Information: "Don't even ask. This is the best ice cream made in Wisconsin, and it tastes so good because it has gobs of rich Wisconsin cream, tons of real ingredients for boat-loads of luscious flavors. That means it's not low-fat, low-calorie, or low-anything, and that's why everyone loves it. You want nutrition, eat carrots." Um, yes. Bring it on, and go big or go home! They've got good portions (good meaning enough to sate that crazed ice cream craving), friendly staff, and decent prices. The flavors are pretty original, too, with my particular favorites: -Dark Side of the Moon (Blue Moon mixed with Zanzibar [dark chocolate]) -Fat Elvis (banana ice cream, pb ripple, fudge) -Yippie Skippie (pb ice cream, salted carmel ripple, chunks of brownies, choc covered pretzels) Rec: Split a banana split with a friend, hold the bananas. :)
just found out they use fructose corn syrup in the ice cream, very disappointed in them. Why do they use that?

Vegan coffee and oreo soy ice cream. I'm pretty sure that's all I have to say. Just let that image sink into your brains and get yourself to State Street if you want to enjoy some refreshing, creamy, dairy-free yumminess this summer.
MMMM chocolate zanzibar! I also tried the cookie dough and pbutter which were great. I think this was really solid ice cream. Super rich and creamy and all around delicious. YaY for Wisconsin dairy!

Definitely my favorite ice cream shop in Madison. The flavor varieties are usually pretty on point, and they mix them up often enough to keep it interesting. Ordering is a bit of a train wreck- it's usually whoever is at the counter and looks the most ready to order, so you sometimes have to fight to make eye contact with the server in order to actually be served. There is a good amount of seating, but I usually just end up getting a waffle cone to go, because there are usually too many people in there for my liking. Prices are good; definitely cheaper than something like Orange Leaf.

This place needs to be called out because what happened to us tonight was not okay. My friends and I were ignored by the server behind the counter (tall, lanky guy with dark-blonde curly hair working on 10/4 at 7PM). He clearly saw us waiting patiently for him to finish with the party he was serving. When he continued to ignore us and serve 3 Caucasian groups that had walked in after us, I came to the sad realization that we were being ignored because we were non-white (I'm Asian and was with Asian and middle eastern friends). When I tried to bring to his attention that we were actually next, we continued to be ignored. This ignorant and disrespectful occurrence left a sour taste in my mouth and ruined our night.... no place is worth patronizing for this display, no matter how good the ice cream is. We left empty handed and will never come back.

This ice-cream is AMAZING!!! I make my own home made ice-cream and my husband and I travel a lot, so we get to taste lots of store-made and other kinds of ice-cream. This is one of the BEST. The campus ice-cream is good, but this is REALLY phenomenal. We sampled four flavors before choosing two and they were all delicious. They make it with cream and all the things that ice-cream is supposed to be made from, not from a mix. I highly recommend this ice-cream and I think you'd be hard pressed to find anyone who would not fall in love with it at first bite. Delicious rich creamy flavor, friendly staff, really nice selection of flavors, mmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmm!

Fantastic ice cream that comes in all kinds of flavors. My favorites are Yippee Skippee (highly recommended for the peanut butter lover) and French Silk. I tend to get the same thing every time I go, but they are more than happy to give taste-tester samples if you are unsure of what to get; just be sure Larry David isn't behind you in line.
I ordered the frozen hot cocoa 10/10!!! Must have. We also got the Nob Chill Hill. It was okay. We didn't like it. 3/10

Ghirardelli's originally started in San Francisco where we lived near the Square but was here in Las Vegas for 7K 1st Convention and after Sessions of greatness learning and ways to Reaping Benefits walked the Vegas Miles with our 7K Ohana Group to Bellagio Water Fountain show then to Volcano Lava flow at Mirage got hungry for ice cream came up on this Ghirardelli's Ice Cream Shop at LinQ mostly everyone ordered a large Sundae but with my limited sugar intake tried to order small shake but to no avail since there blender was broken lol I think they just didn't want to make a time consuming orders since the line was out the door disappointing that only one cashier one scooper don't know what other two workers were doing standing around this night or every night?!? Service was not very accommodating tarnishing the Great name of Ghirardelli's Ended up only with a scoop of mint chocolate chip disappointing that with no room ate ice cream standing up outside lol

Attitude from the top down, rude manager, rude employees. No greeting, they stare at you. No how can I help you, they stare. You order, they tell you a dollar amount and hand you a receipt. Too bad, Ghirardelli is a top name, a few employees ruin it. Addition to my review, within a short period this same day, I received a message from Ghirardelli Corporate Customer Relations, concerning this. I am grateful that they've demonstrated this is not how Ghirardelli wants to be represented, and that this is an employee issue, and not reflective of their business overall. Ghirardelli is still a top notch brand.

In every major city we visit, we look for this store. Ghirardelli is the best chocolate and therefore the shakes and ice creams they make are the best too. This location was no different. We had the frozen hot cocoa and chocolate shake and they were both so creamy and chocolatey. There was a long line, but it moves pretty quickly and the wait is definitely worth it.

This place definitely lives up its reputation. There was a bit of a line when we got there but it moved quickly!! Don't let a crowd deter you from waiting for your delicious chocolately goodness because I am telling you it is SO worth it!!

Went to grab dessert at night and figured why not try the gourmet chocolatier shop here as it's close to the Linq, where we were staying. Unfortunately, their machine broke or something which meant my cravings for a shake were crushed. Didn't think I came to a McDonalds, but alright. Four stars for a slightly above average experience despite not being able to snag a shake. More like a 3.5 probably. Line was extremely long but the staff were great. Location is amazing as it's in the heart of the strip and on the promenade. Prices and value suck but you come for the experience at least once. Anyways, the ice cream scoops are generous and I regretted opting for a triple scoop. I contemplated throwing away my bowl because it was so much but as an ice cream fanatic, I couldn't bring myself to do that. Friend got a scoop in the sugar cone and the cone was challenging to hold because the scoop was ginormous. Another friend opted for the Drinking Chocolate. Well, it's literally melted chocolate, extremely dense with chocolate. It was a debate between that or the hot chocolate and he noted he would get the standard hot chocolate in the future. The Drinking Chocolate is for true chocolate fanatics, not just anyone.

Honestly, nothing special about their ice cream. It was just a little less sweet and a little more creamy than other ice cream places that I've had. Nothing else was that good or bad. It's just ice cream but if you really like sweet things then maybe don't get the cookies and crÃ¨me and strawberry.

If you got sugar diabetes....take your meds!!! This ice cream sooooo damn good & sweet!! I've had Ghirardelli chocolates before from the store....but this....THIS...Ice cream sundae, sent me to heaven!!! I opted for the ocean sundae (chocolate, caramel, whip topping, and I got....GET THIS....butter pecan ice cream substitute instead of ole plain vanilla) When I tell y'all.........ain't NOTHING better than this! Worth every calorie!!!

Came across this place while walking towards the Linq high roller observation wheel at Las Vegas. We ordered treasure island - warm brownie sundae and were not disappointed! The sundae was generously topped with chocolate sauce and had a warm chocolate brownie and whipped cream! The brownie was baked freshly so it took a while to get our order. The sundae was super amazing and filled our tummies right away! They have a small seating area inside the store and multiple gifting options.

After numerous visits to Las Vegas and staying on the strip, my husband and I finally made our first visit to this location of the Ghirardelli Ice Cream & Chocolate Shop. A late night ice cream craving creeped up on us while we were staying a night at The Linq and, after doing a preliminary search of what was open in the later hours of a Tuesday night, we stumbled upon the Ghirardelli Ice Cream & Chocolate Shop. We definitely have been snoozing on this place as our ice cream concoctions were nothing short from amazing! Located in The Linq Promenade, it was a brief and easy walk from the hotel to the shop. As we drew closer and closer to the Ghirardelli Ice Cream & Chocolate Shop, we saw multiple groups of friends, families, and couples walking by us with a smile and their decadent ice cream treats. Despite us visiting after 11pm on a weeknight, the line to order was almost out the door. Who knew the Ghirardelli Ice Cream & Chocolate Shop was the poppin late night spot? My husband and I each ordered our own separate sundae: the World Famous Hot Fudge Sundae and Gold Rush Sundae, respectively. Both were extra rich (in all the right ways) and oh so tasty. The Gold Rush captured all of my favorite things in one treat: sweet, salty, caramel, and white chocolate. It is a great choice for anyone who may be like me and isn't a big fan of chocolate and who also likes that stark contrast of sweet and salty. I couldn't recommend it more. Just as a heads up so no one experiences sticker shock, the prices are a little elevated I'm guessing due to its location directly on the strip. Know that you can't go wrong with your order and to be honest, those mini sundaes could be shared with someone else. Other than that, our visit was positive and a solid five stars.
We had espresso flavor on a waffle cone. It was good. Kinda expensive. Service was good.

It was a very bad experience. I asked for two hot cocoa and it was hot water. The service was bad no interest to do arrangements or even try to provide a service. I've get there at 11:30 they took 30 minutes in our beverage and it was the time to close. They were only trying to get us out of there when we tasted it it was hot water. We came back and they were close and no intentions to Open and see what happened. I definitely not recommend this place.
Fun place! Small store but had tons to see. Just ordered the regular hot chocolate and it was the best!

Holy heck. Best hot fudge sundae I've ever had. And the guy at the counter was super nice and friendly and I guarantee doesn't get paid enough to deal with the drunk slobs that walk in(myself included). This was such a cute store and place and the service was amazing. I'm a huge sucker for Ghirardelli so I might be biased but also cmon. Just get the damn sundae and stop counting calories rn.

Mood- my sweet tooth Upon entering was quickly greeted. The staff was so friendly. Menus are posted on podiums as you enter. They have decadent candy delights on the right, and everything from ice cream to coffee on the left at the counter. There is plenty of seating from tables to counter style with tall chairs. Ordered the sea salt Carmel hot cocoa, and a banana split sundae style. Neither disappointed at all. Would def recommend - also you get a complimentary chocolate when you order something. Location is Linq promenade- parking is either garages or lots

While we wait 4 order others after us r served, I go up and ask, they gave our order to someone else, they say they'll make it right away, they serve others their orders while I'm waiting, another customer order was messed up, they let her leave with free ice cream, I get my order finally, I ask for refund for their screwups and wait, they say if they refund then I have to give ice cream back, I tell them I just witnessed them give someone else free, they say its bc her order was messed up and didn't want to throw it away, I walk away realize 1 of our items is not what was ordered on receipt, go back up, they make the right thing, still wont refund, they kept my receipt. Service is BAD!!!!

The ice cream was not bad, but I think I would've chosen to spend my $10 elsewhere. I was waiting in a cramped line when I noticed one of the workers in back of me said "I said excuse me 10 times" as she rushed to the cash register. Immediately my friends and I were turned off. In fact, I was scared she might spit in my food for not hearing her say excuse me 10 times. I made sure to keep a close eye on the workers, as ridiculous as that sounded. I normally wouldn't even bat an eye if someone couldn't hear me speak my order the first time. I don't even care if they ask me multiple times. I make sure to speak louder and clearer. And when my order comes up it wasn't even the correct order. And I just asked nicely that I ordered the chocolate dipped cone, not ice cream in a cup. He transfers my ice cream into a dipped cone instead of the cup, but he doesn't hand it to me. He pushes it across the counter so it'll reach me. There was no protective paper covering on the bottom of the waffle cone. Honestly not a big deal for some, but I thought it was a little unsanitary... especially after the bad experience we were already having. He could've just handed it to me. But hey, at least nobody spit in my food!

What a lovely stop in the area near the Linq in the promenade and near the High Roller. We had just come from the High Roller and I was trying relax after that. This place is a mecca for chocolate. We decided to by the Ghirardelli squares and they were sold by the pound so then we felt compelled to buy a pound. In retrospect, don't do this. Get a few and be done. We had chocolate every day for days. Probably not what the doctor ordered. It was oh so good, however. We also had hot chocolate there. That was very tasty. They want to put whipping cream on everything so if you are not into that catch them quick or you will have so much whipped topping people may mistake you for St Nick. In all seriousness, this is a cute spot with tasty delights I can see why they included this in the shopping promenade. I will definitely stop in again.
2 scoops on a waffle Come. It was amazing! Perfect potions very shareable. Clean and great service

After walking around, touring LV sites on a hot 109 degree day, a couple friends and I decided to stop here to get some ice cream. I ordered a scoop of cookie dough ice cream in a chocolate dipped cone. It was absolutely delicious!! The perfect treat for a hot day! The ice cream was delicious and super creamy. I'm from Maryland so I'm super depressed that we don't have a Ghirardelli ice cream shop here, I've searched everywhere! Location- We we're staying at the flamingo hotel, so this ice cream shop was less than a 5 min walk from our hotel. Located right on the strip. I'm not too sure about parking etc. because i don't live in Vegas and we walked from our hotel. This ice cream shop is the only shop that offered free water... there were several occasions were my friends and i were literally almost dying of thirst and no restaurant/shop offered free water... even if you purchase something. They offered it right in the restaurant in a dispenser with cups, which was very nice of them. Staff/customer service- the staff were very friendly. My ice cream cost less than $5, if I'm not mistaken. My ice cream took less than 5 minutes to be ready. You also get a free piece of chocolate with a purchase (dark chocolate). There are about 5-6 tables at the shop which you can sit at. Both times i went, there were seats available.

Sorely disappointed. The hot fudge sundae was lukewarm at best and turned my stomach upside down. We tried to non pareils and the box didn't close and the woman at the front was flippant about it when we asked for a different one which she didn't and just stuck a sticker on it. And the box still didn't work.They haven't had brownies for 2 weeks but no where did they have a sign which indicated that. Only reason I gave 2 stars instead of one is that I like Ghirardelli chocolate but rest of the experience was subpar. I realize places are understaffed and it must be a challenge to find good employees.

Where has this ice cream been all my life?! Absolutely- delicious! The texture and flavor is unlike any other. I had a chocolate scoop paired up with a chocolate dipped waffle cone... because I obviously love chocolate, and it was chocolate heaven for my taste buds. Now let's talk about customer service. The BEST customer service received on my entire trip. We were greeted promptly at the door. We got free chocolate samples. Someone was ready at the register. I enjoyed the atmosphere so much, I decided to sit down and have my ice cream inside the establishment. Which was well kept and welcoming. #TeamGhirardelli
delicious as always, but it would be great if the heaters during cold weather were on as people had to wait for the orders outside

Want to top off that delectable honey-spiced Fried Chicken at Brooklyn Bowl, a plate of Irish Nachos studded with jalapenos and just oozing cheese at Tilted Kilt, some seared Ahi at Yard House, or a Bacon Mac-N-Cheese Burger at Guy Fieri's Vegas Kitchen & Bar? If so, just show some restraint, don't order dessert, pay your check, and then saunter over less than a block to Ghirardelli for a real super treat, like a traditional Hot Fudge Sundae, or something even more sweet and elaborate. That's the way I do it when I'm at The Linq and desire the finest finish to an already fine meal. You might even be lucky enough to save a dollar on a Yelp check in! The Hot Fudge Sundae will come with two large scoops of Vanilla Ice Cream, oodles of easily scoopable sweet and viscous hot fudge, real Whipped Cream, a cherry on top, and a few diced almonds showered from above. I just wish there were more almonds. But if you are looking for real hot fudge, or some other chocolaty confection this is the place. Mmmmm!

Update: Ghirardelli contacted me regarding our experience and apologized for how we were treated. Since they have shown their determination to customer satisfaction I wanted to change my rating to 4 stars. I hope that with the changes made people will be treated with respect. TERRIBLE SERVICE! I walked in ready to buy a bunch of chocolates. I had my mask on but my husband had a drink so he wasnt wearing one. The guy behind the counter very rudely told my husband to put his mask on. When my husband turned around to show him he was drinking, the guy told him to either put his mask on his ear or to leave the store, meanwhile there were 5 other people eating and drinking that he did not tell this to. We have no problem wearing masks but this was ridiculous and no one should be treated like this, especially loyal customers. We walked out and will not be back here.

One of not too many places where you go to get your sweet treat in the area. Always line of people out the door. Can't use tables inside as too many people waiting in line. Today I came for my sundae. After waiting in line for some time, placed my order and was informed by the cashier that whip cream machine is not functioning since this morning! It was 30 minutes before closing time.Seriously?! All day quality was compromised and not even discount?! Not good practice, Ghirardelli. You can afford to make it right for your supporters. Very disappointed!
Great ice cream. Got vanilla and chocolate with chocolate chips. Delicious. The caramel with vanilla is super sweet.

Of course, the BEST chocolate/ice cream shop in the USA is right here in Las Vegas at the Linq. If you can't go to the original in San Francisco, then this is the next best choice. Besides, you don't have to contend with the Bay Area rain.

Best ice cream treats I've had in ages!! We've tried the salted caramel brownie sundae and the create your own sundae in a waffle bowl...multiple times...OMG. The ice cream is so decadent and so are the toppings. Absolutely addicted to this place to the point we will skip dinner just to get a sundae instead. The employees are nice and do a great job. Check it out!
Blonde lady taking orders is rude and should not be representing your business I know your product is amazing bit lady was just not a people person!
Be warn... its all sugar free here. Free sugar all you want. it so good that you wouldn't mine the price versus the size.

Decided to check out this store and I actually had no idea it was also an ice cream/coffee restaurant. When you come inside the smell is amazingly delicious and they give you a free piece of chocolate to try. I decided to get a large cookies and cream milkshake ($9.20 after tax). The milkshake was tasty, but not the best milkshake I've ever tasted. It's also advertised as "thick shakes" and it was anything but, very runny. Maybe too much milk? Other than that the employees were nice but everything is so marked up it really killed it for me.

One thing I hate about living in Toronto is our absence of decent sundae joints, so I make it a point to stop into Ghirardelli anytime I'm in the States and near one. Upon walking in, I was handed a sample of their new caramel pumpkin spice chocolate and it was absolutely phenomenal. But of course, I was there to eat a sundae, so I went ahead and ordered the Ghirardelli Square World Famous Hot Fudge Sundae ("vanilla ice cream overflowing with our handmade hot fudge, whipped cream, chopped almonds and a cherry"). It arrived a few minutes later and although I was initially disappointed that it came in a plastic cup (rather than their usual glass), I was immediately reminded of why I love this place so much. Everything in their sundae works perfectly together, and I don't think I've ever eaten such a rich, flavorful hot-fudge sauce in my entire life. Actually, you know what? I'm glad there isn't a Ghirardelli in Toronto, since I'd probably be there on a daily basis.

I grew up in California, home of the original Ghirardelli chocolate factory so must admit to being spoiled. When you went on a tour of the factory at the end you got an entire chocolate bar. Seems as though this place could give customers a piece of candy. The portions have gotten smaller and we found that the hot fudge must have been so warm it almost melted to the sides of the plastic cup. Who eats a hot fudge sundae out of plastic. That said they do have the best hot fudge in the world and the ice cream is smooth and creamy. You can certainly share a sundae believe me.

Came here this past weekend and unfortunately they had really bad service. First of all they were all out of a lot of items! The menu was not updated! The workers were very rude and unfriendly! I have been to the Disneyland location in the locations in Hollywood and San Francisco and they are not like this! The worker was rude I asked to change my flavor and he had a smart remark saying that he only had two hands. This is unacceptable behavior as a worker! I will not return here at all!

We both got hot fudge Sundaes and they were delicious. The price wasn't as satisfying though but its Vegas and Ghirardelli. It's a small location but you can sit at the bar and watch them make your item. Free water in the corner which is nice, for some reason I always crave water after ice cream.
Delicious chocolate shake! $7.04 for a small shake so a little pricey but definitely worth the deep chocolate taste!

I appreciate when companies take the time to reach out to unsatisfied customers! I don't want ppl to think ghirardelli ice cream isn't good, cause it is... one bad cone shouldn't stop others to check out the greatness. Get the famous hot fudge sundae you won't be disappointed.
Looked good but beware the line to order. The shop had one person slowly making shakes one by one on a busy Sunday night, while another staff just stood outside doing nothing....

Great ice cream shop. Always come here for the sundae with hot fudge. For some reason the hot fudge here is one of a kind. Really rich and sweet chocolate flavor. The ice cream is also good. Other types of chocolates are not as good here but would recommend any of the ice cream items.

So good, go treat your yourself! So decadent but bring a friend to share!!! The sundaes are semi customizable, we traded 2 scoops of cookies and cream ice cream for one vanilla and one strawberry scoop. So nice!

Do you like chocolate? Are you a fan of Ghirardelli? Then this is probably a spot for you. They have lots of sundaes, hot chocolates, and other things. It's part store and part ice cream shop. The staff are friendly. There's never a line or wait. The best part, to me, is the variety of chocolate squares. There are choco squares available in the store that aren't available for sale elsewhere. And there's usually always a free sample to be had. I'm not overly impressed by Ghirardelli. But lots of folks are, especially those who won't have one easily accessible.

A San Francisco native, this place makes me very reminiscent of my hometown. My boyfriend and I split the banana split (The Golden Gate) and it was absolutely wonderful. Vanilla ice cream with pineapples, strawberry ice cream with strawberries, and chocolate ice cream with hot fudge, covered in whipped cream and nuts and topped with bananas in the side. Totally satisfied my gigantic sweet tooth cravings! And just as much quality as the one in San Francisco! They also have an amazing selection of chocolates that my boyfriend was kind enough to buy some for me! I can't wait to try them!
Vegas location was horrible!! Understaffed, messy, Ice cream was sub par.... Way to much whip cream.. one big mess.. avoid!!

A San Francisco classic located in an alley way in the middle of the strip. Typically known for its chocolate, you'd regret sleeping on the ice cream. This was our last stop in Vegas before heading home and it was the perfect treat for breakfast haha. We got a double scoop of Rocky Road and Cookies n Cream in a freshly baked waffle cone (still hot off the press). The Espresso Chip was also tasty if you like the coffee flavor, but is even sweeter when stuffed inside a chocolate-dipped cone. The rest of the store offers an assortment of different chocolate options. If you're picky enough to care, they even get into the specific percentage of cacao in the different pieces. You'll definitely be paying a premium for the chocolate gifts bags, so my suggestion is to stick with the ice cream.

Daughter wanted a brownie sundae. $17 Lyft ride here yesterday (Sunday) and they were "out of brownies"...really?!? Young man behind the counter could have cared less and did nothing to ease her disappointment and my irritation, besides saying, "we can substitute with cookies." No apology, no attempt to make us happy, just shrugged his shoulders and looked annoyed that we were annoyed. What a waste of time and money.

Rude employees! The person at the cash register wasn't willing to help with the order. They just kept starting at us until we ordered something. One of them just threw the ice cream scoop at us and didn't even apologize. It fell sideways and then just handed it to us and walked away.
I love their stuff. Cute shop and lots of chocolate to choose from. Mix and match your own box. Friendly staff and small seating area inside. We enjoyed the hot chocolate and brownies.

To start off the ice cream and desserts are all very great hence for 2 stars but the staff and the how the store is run is very disorganized. The last 2 times we came and had to wait about 40+ minutes to get order and today we decided to walk in at 10:20 for them to tell us they are closed and not letting anyone else in. Why advertise that you're open to 11 if you're going to deny people this early. Advertise that you close at 10:30 then not 11. Definitely needs to have more staff on hand to help.

Can't review the food because they wouldn't let me in. Got there exactly 15 minutes before they closed, had walked 1 mile so I could get a brownie, and the girl at the door stopped me and said "we're closed." then shut the door. Beware, they reserve the right to refuse service for any reason.
$1 off any sundae with check in! This place is mandatory at least once on our trips to Vegas! Especially on a hot night when you want a brain freeze to cool you off!

We always visit ghiradelli in vegas, and it's always wonderful. Friendly and fast service, and super sweet ice cream treats. They keep their store clean as well. The brownie hot fudge sundae with salted caramel is amazing! I love how they always have free samples of their newest chocolate squares, too. We also shared a chocolate chip cookie sundae while we were in vegas, and it was just okay compared to the brownie sundae.

The irony... I used to live in San Francisco and not even once have I gone to Ghirardelli Square! I was walking around the Strip and stumbled upon Ghirardelli and just so happen to craving for something sweet. The sundae did not disappoint and it's enough to share with literally 4 other people. It really hits the spot! I'm just drooling thinking about it now... Be prepared, it is pricy... but worth every penny! Vegas is for indulging afterall, right?

This is now one of my favorite places in San Francisco. My son took us to this spot on our last visit to him in Oakland , and believe me it was well worth it. If you are a Ghirardelli chocolate lover already then this place is the cherry on top. The smells are amazing. The ice cream shop located in the store on the upper level is, I have no words to describe it. It was a cold day and we decided to have hot chocolate. The best cup of hot chocolate I've ever had. While we were there they were giving out sample candies for Valentine's Day. Again heavenly. The building is historic and evokes memories of a time passed. Picture opportunities galore and cool spots to just hang out and talk. If you're in the Frisco area bear pier 39 look them up and stop by for some good old fashion chocolate.

Ghiradelli shops are very consistent from store to store which is what I love the most about them. Only wanted the free sample chocolate they were giving, but you cant walk into this store and not order anything. Everything is just too damn delicious. Who can resist? This location is a bit tiny but does the job. They have a pretty good reputation so it was packed but we didn't have to wait long at all. They took our orders quickly and we got our desserts even quicker.

Worst experience at a Ghirardelli ever! As I was waiting for my order we seen some roaches crawling under the tables and on the walls. I quietly mentioned it to one of the workers because I have seen other people explode in a store after seeing a roach and was trying to avoid that for them. He told every co worker there and they all started laughing. After he went to kill it he walked away and mocked me saying "OMG there's roaches, as if they're gonna hurt anybody" Did not even finish the ice cream I was disgusted by the service.

While I do enjoy stopping by here to collect the free piece of chocolate you receive upon entering the store, I was never interested in trying any of their sundaes. I know they don't make their own ice cream and their choice of using Dreyer's isn't particularly enticing to me. However, hubby and I were spending any evening on the Strip, we were craving ice cream and we were far too lazy to walk to where we really wanted to go. So we made it work. We looked over the menu and decided to share their large Brownie Sundae - but instead of vanilla ice cream, we chose cherry. We requested no caramel and asked that they use their dark chocolate hot fudge. Wow. So good! The ice cream does have a very smooth texture (just the way I like it). And it isn't overly sweet or flavorful, which paired perfectly with the crazy-richness of the dark chocolate hot fudge. But what made this Sundae extra amazing was the Brownie. It had the perfect balance of being moist and fluffy. It also had a amazingly strong chocolate flavor. Mmmm! I can't wait to go back! Friendly service and yummy treats!
Place was little busy but service was fast. We got in and out with what we wanted. Would come back here again next time we are in town.

I came to the Linq for something else, but saw the Ghirardelli Ice Cream & Chocolate Shop and decided to stop in. As soon as I got near the entrance, a friendly employee offered me a free Ghirardelli chocolate square, dark & sea salt caramel flavor. I took it and thanked them as I walked inside. There were plenty of chocolates everywhere, but that was not what caught my attention. There were a bunch of sundaes you could choose and my sweet tooth couldn't say no. I especially couldn't say no when, after I checked in on my Yelp app, there was an offer of $1 off any ice cream sundae. Done deal. I ordered a sea salt caramel sundae (Ocean Beach) and the employees were quick to get it made for me. Ocean Breeze is "vanilla ice cream smothered with creamy caramel, freshly homemade hot fudge and sea salt. Perfectly topped with whipped cream, creamy caramel, sea salt, and a Ghirardelli SQUARES Milk Chocolate." After I took a picture of it since it looked so good, I dipped my spoon into the ice cream and took a bite. It was just as yummy as it looked. Ghirardelli is a little pricey for my tastes, but I wouldn't mind coming back here every so often for a sundae. The free chocolate doesn't hurt any either.

It still bothers me that I spent $10 on a horrible dessert. I had some brownie sundae w/ ice cream, whip cream and hot fudge. The brownie was rock hard and was impossible to remove as it sat at the bottom of the 'sundae' cup they served it in.....

It's easy to find when u out of the Linq hotel,just go straight to the road,on your left hand side.The staff is nice,he offered me a piece of chocolate as a sample.They will ask your name after you ordered,well they typed my name wrongly.The ice-cream is really really sweet,you will feel thirsty after eat them all.But the strawberries taste really good.The strawberry with chocolate on the top is huge,like sweets at Disney.After all it's worth to have a try.

How can a famous and really good Chocolate and Ice Cream shop possibly get a 1 star review? Read on... We had a craving for the brownie sundae and a lava cake. We had been here before so there was no hesitation to come out this way from where we were staying. We were wrong. After a LONG wait (only 1 cashier open), we were informed they have been out of brownies for 2 weeks and they no longer have lava cake (even though they have a picture of it on the wall. We got the regular sundae, which is normally really good. Not so much this time. Something is off. I understand Covid and the issues it has presented to employers, but the attitude by the employees was awful. After ordering, and while waiting, we did some shopping for the chocolates. We purchased some bulk nonpareils-The container we used did not close properly. We asked the employee and her response was, "yes, we know those don't close properly, but we have a sticker." I doubted a sticker would keep a plastic container closed, so I asked if we could use another container. She said yes, but they would charge me for another container! So they knowingly give out defective containers and then want to charge for another container? What??? I guess it is another revenue stream, sort of like checked baggage fees at the airline or resort fees at the hotels. So I passed and waited to pay and I had to stand in line again, as they couldn't (wouldn't) ring me up at the "gift" register. After another 20 min wait in line, got the nonpareils and thankfully, put them in a bag... Why thankfully, you ask? well, the sticker didn't hold, and the candies went out of the aforementioned defective plastic container, and into the bag. Not sure what happened this time at this location, but we will be hesitant to return. Locals and Tourists beware!

If you want a quick ice cream pick up, this is a great location to go to. It's a very relaxed ice cream date spot located in the Linq area. It think it's a great quality ice cream and chocolate sauce. But gave it a 3 star for the price being too over priced. It's a chocolate shop at the same time. There's only a few tables, but it does not get crowded enough where you don't have a place to sit.

I feel the staff was off this time, I wasn't greeted nor given a sample, but I will overlook that issue this time. The ice cream is extremely delicious here, I only get scoops on a cone, even though the sundaes look yummy as well. All the sundaes have fudge on them, and to me it can be too sweet if there's too much as depicted in the image. Sure I can ask for less, but I would rather not have all that sugar and just go with a cone. I got butter pecan and black cherry vanilla, both are creamy and flavorful, and will satisfy that sweet craving alone.
Big menu and good ice cream. Very rich though but good. Thats all but yelp wants too many characters

Ghirardelli is a staple in San Francisco, Monterey and even Chicago. When I learned there is a location in Las Vegas I made it a priority to make it over. Certainly didn't disappoint, the Ocean Beach sundae is amazing. This was also the best ice cream I had in Vegas.

The manager took our order here and she was nice but also not super cheery or talkative. The other employees that gave our drinks to us were very nice and welcoming and talkative. We ordered one mocha with one extra expresso shot and a white mocha and a bottle of water. Every thing tasted great. Some of the negative things are when we ordered a water the manager didn't hand it to us we had to come back when we realized we didn't have it. The drinks including the water were super over priced. Dutch or Starbucks would have been cheaper and taste the same. We also asked if we could purchase some chocolate strawberries and come back and get them before closing so we wouldn't have to bring them every where that day. But the manager stated no she wouldn't do it.

This place is amazing. I forget what it's called but it had vanilla ice cream, cookies and cream ice cream, two brownies, hot fudge, caramel and chocolate sauce. I looooove good ice cream and this may be the best I've ever had. It was that good. As was the brownie. The two guys running the counter were great! Super friendly and gave awesome recommendations.

Chocolate everywhere and they offer you a free sample when you walk in. Ordered cookies and cream shake and it's so creamy. There's lots of seating so you can relax in comfort. There are so many dessert place at the Linq but this one is a must stop for chocolate lovers

Felt like we were back home and visiting Pier 39 with a walk down to Ghirardelli Square. Chilly February night so we decided to grab hot chocolate before walking back to our hotel. I ordered a large classic hot chocolate, no whip. My friend (the birthday girl) got a salted caramel hot chocolate that comes with a dark choco square on top of the lid. Liquid chocolate goes down smoothly and isn't too sweet. Perfect for cold weather and the cup keeps your hands warm. Sundaes galore! They all pay tribute to SF. You've got the painted ladies that include mint chocolate chip, espresso, and midnight brownie; Treasure Island (warm brownie); Muir Woods (black cherry vanilla); Presidio (strawberry hot fudge sundae), and more! Lots and lots of chocolate squares for sale. Eat a few yourself or buy as souvenirs to take home. Indoor seating to enjoy treats and they provide drinking water/cups. Polite employees, good service.

This place has a lot of varieties. Even I. As a diabetic have some low sugar choices. Worth the wait too. I don't understand why people are upset that they have to wait in line. That's how the world works. And yes. One cash register is open. Have you seen how small the place is what a bunch of entitled tourist.
This place is truly a must stop spot! The chocolate is melted fresh and the flavors are matchless. I had the coffee sundae which was a great pairing of my favorite two items!!!
Friendly staff, lots of different options on the menu, and it's located in the Linq area. They are really busy but the tables and floors could use some cleaning. Delicious ice cream.

I came here during Memorial Day, and there wasn't a line in the afternoon, though most of the tables were full. Nice to be greeted by a smiling worker once inside and handed a sample of "mini"! No wall menu, only pretty pictures of ice cream: the menus are self-take and stacked near the entrance. I actually sat down first and looked for a wall menu, which I presumed was typical of chain dessert shops like this one, but then realized my mistake (kinda wasteful to have paper menus though, most people I saw got them dirty and/or bent and they ended in the rubbish). We ordered the Hot Fudge Sundae with dark chocolate hot fudge in a chocolate-dipped Waffle Bowl. Can't really go wrong with vanilla ice cream, hot fudge, whipped cream, and a maraschino cherry, but I wished there had been more more chopped almonds. The ice cream and toppings were all delicious, though the ice cream was a bit frozen and too hard-packed, not as creamy as I would have liked. Unless you absolutely love waffle goods, I'd recommend skipping the bowl since it was very sweet, especially when it's already meant to be paired with ice cream. It provided nice crunch and texture, but at the end it was just too much, even with two of us sharing. Afterward, I dragged myself out of a sugar stupor to browse the corner of the store where they sell Squares and Minis by the ¼ pound and as-much-as-you-can-stuff-in gift tins ("Box must close completely!"). There are various Ghirardelli-branded gifts and walls of chocolate-dipped everything.

Really good ice cream and chocolate. I had the make your own quake shake that was really good. You pick 3 individual square of chocolate from their selection of chocolate; give it the cashier and they will mix it into a thick milk shake . Yum yum. Little pricey but worth it.

I went here for dessert with a friend after dinner at Yardhouse. As usual, we were given small sample bits of chocolate (Milk Chocolate Caramel, this time!) and it is delicious, as always. I appreciate the complimentary water cooler in the back of the store, which was much needed after this sample and the Las Vegas heat. The man at the door was quite lovely and offered to answer any questions or help with our dessert selection. While I was stuffed from dinner, my friend ordered a simple vanilla soft-serve with butterscotch topping...this took 10 minutes to receive. Now, the butterscotch was quite generous and delicious, but on a slower Wednesday evening with several (2-3) employees 'lounging' at the cash wrap, while one made all the sundaes I was disappointed in the service for such a simple order. Even so, that chocolate can't be beat!

Who doesn't love Ghiraradelli ?!? This Vegas location is across from in and out near the Ferris wheel. I shared a brownie sundae with my husband, it's super sweet and rich but delightful. The brownies were soft and baked with goodness. Three scoops of vanilla ice cream with placed on top of the warm brownies and a chocolate syrup to drizzled on top. We were able to use our yelp discount with no problem. Also when entering we were greeted with a free chocolate square, pretty much their signature greeting! The location is a nice size plenty of tables to sit and enjoy your ice cream. The service was quick and friendly and everything looked really nice and clean!!

DELICIOUS! Walking around the Linq, we wanted to stop for a cold treat. We first stopped at a gelato shop down the street and the prices were outrageous ($5+ for a small single scoop) so we decided to split a Ghirardelli sundae instead, which is kind of pricey but totally worth it and could easily be split between two people. We left very full. Plus, there's free water cups. And you get a sample of chocolate. And our sundae had another chocolate square on top. And it smells amazing in there. The staff was excellent and there was plenty of seating inside. There are plenty of options and varieties of sundaes, milkshakes, etc to try, plus there are sets of chocolates to purchase.

We had to stop in here since my husband and I loved the other locations (Monterey, San Francisco & Hollywood). The other scoop shops in this chain offer dine in options with glassware, but this location only allows you to get your ice cream in plastic containers. Not a big deal, just pointing out one of the differences that I noticed. Prices here are a bit high (as are the other Ghirardelli Shops), but the quality of the ice cream is quite great. My husband was a bit disappointed that the peanut butter sauce sundaes are no longer on the menu, but there are still many great choices. Service was good, it took a bit of time to get our malts, but not unreasonably long. Pretty tasty, but there are probably more cost effective options to take a family too.
Was a very good hot fudge sundae. But it should be for 14 bucks. Little hard to find in the sea of shops.

The ice cream and chocolates here put the Vegas Buffet Desert fare to shame. Ghirardelli is my all time favorite and a must stop. This location is no exception. Great customer service here and true to all Ghirardelli shops, they gave us a free chocolate to eat while we browsed the menu. Don't let the caloric number listed on the menu deter you. I actually took 1 star off because they put the nutritional info on the menu - way to ruin ice cream & chocolate bliss! Because the numbers listed for calories scared me, I ended up just getting one scoop of ice cream and a topping. But it was still delicious. Butterscotch. Mmm. Next time I'll just have lunch here and have the one with the brownie, whip cream, ice cream and cherry on top...

This place is awesome for some ice cream while you stroll down the linq. I will warn it's a small place and because it's on the strip it's always very business if you want to go in the morning like 10-11 it's not busy but no one wants ice cream that early unless you are me. The serve is great they are very friendly and welcoming and you get free chocolate, the product is great never disappoints but it can be pricey.

Okay this place is a tad obvious to get to if you park in the garage nearby. However we found it and there was a line. They let a few people in at a time and then the guy stopped us and said it would be half an hour. Not sure why as there was only like 6 people infront of us. Anyway finally got up there and I ordered the treasure island. I sadly had to throw more than half of it away. The brownie was the best part, after that it was solid fudge stuck to the cup. the spoon they gave wasn't even strong enough to get it off. The ice cream had no flavor and was too hard to even take bites of. My friend got the ocean beach and she seemed to like it but I didn't try it so my review is based off what I had. I would like to UPDATE- the manager reached out to me and took the review very seriously, which I appreciate so much. I never write reviews to receive anything but I love an honorable business that stands behind its product. They did not ask that I update but I wanted to for how prompt and kind they were. I believe that when I return, I will have a much different experience and I look forward to that!

I don't understand how this place has as many stars as it does. PLEASE do not go here! I am saving you a TON of money. There are literally hundreds of other places in Vegas that have wayyy better ice cream for the price (including the grocery store.. or your local 7-eleven...). My wife and I came here based on high recommendation from a friend. We were told to get the brownie sundae - Lands End. But they didn't have brownies.... I guess I should have offered to run to the local Walmart to grab them a box of Ghirardelli brownies... so instead we got the cookie bits sundae. The ice cream/sundae: I'm not joking - it was completely flavorless. Everything was. From the vanilla and cookies and cream ice cream to the hot fudge and cookie bits. Shockingly flavorless. The "hot fudge" wasn't even hot!? The service: The person behind the counter was rude and completely unhelpful. When I asked for the the Lands End sundae, they responded like I was out of my mind for even asking for such a wild thing cause obviously I should have known they didn't have brownies! It felt like my wife and I were such a burden on them for even being in the shop. The price: It was $15.00 people!! I'm telling you, go to McDonald's for their $1 sundae and you'll have a better experience.. at the very least, McDonalds fudge will be hot.. I PROMISE you, don't go here. Go somewhere else. Your taste buds, family, and wallet will thank me.

It was my good luck that the day I happened to walk in, it was National Sundae Day and they were offering half priced hot fudge sundae's for that day only. Good thing it was half price! The normal price is over $12 for a sundae, which I think is outrageous. I was happy to pay $6 and change. The hot fudge was thick and decadent, but I've definitely had better ice cream. As I sat and ate, I watched as people walked in and were given a free Ghirardelli chocolate square. Where was mine?

Salted caramel hot cocoa was one of the best thing I've tasted. It's been days since having one and I can close my eyes and still taste it. It was that amazing. If Charlie actually did go to a chocolate factory, I'm guessing he smelled the same aroma that hits your nose as you enter this store. So very magical. Everything is super expensive. But damn... that hot cocoa is so worth it.
Chocolate lovers shake was fabulous. The young gal that waited on us was very friendly.

Latrice was so amazing with her excellent customer service. I could tell she was smiling under her mask and even though there was at least 30 customers back to back she kept doing her best to make sure everyone was in good spirits. stars cause it was a long wait but she did the best she could

There was no line and it STILL took over 30 minutes to get one smoothie. My friend got a hot fudge Sunday and their "world famous hot fudge" wasn't even warm. The employees moved at a snails pace. I paid $10 for a berry smoothie. It's obvious the employees don't care, they don't have any regard for being efficient. DON'T GO HERE!

Chocolate lovers dream! It's a cold night in Vegas and we were walking around soaking in the sights when we spotted the Ghirardelli store. We decide to check it out mostly to get out of the cold air without our jackets that we left in the hotel. It is located in the alley by the Linq and the Linq high roller Ferris wheel is located at the end of the alley. We order the sea salt hot chocolate that comes with a little sea salt Ghirardelli square on top. Perfect! It was the perfect thing to drink while walking back to our hotel. I made a decision to order the brownie that looked killer to nibble on later in the day, they warmed it and it was devoured before we even left. Very rich! There was a island of the mini packets of Ghirardelli that you can grab a bag and fill with the different flavors you want to try, as well as already packed bags. There was several employees walking around giving samples of these mini squares. There was a cute little ornament they were selling and the employee told me they were selling a bag with a full bar of the peppermint chocolate flavor for the same price. Side note: I have to make so much effort to not gain $30 lbs because this is my favorite flavor! We ended up leaving with so much free chocolate! During hitter months they sell ice cream which I still saw so many people ordering even with it being cold outside!

I felt a little embarrassed that I was a San Franciscan visiting a Ghirardelli Shop in Las Vegas, but since the sundaes are great, I didn't feel too bad. I had the Mint Bliss and was satisfied with a great minty and chocolatey dessert. The rich fudge sauce they use (the dark chocolate is my favorite) is really what makes their sundaes great. I visited this spot on a very hot (107!) summer day in Las Vegas and it was a perfect way to cool off with ice cream in an air conditioned shop.

This is my favorite ice cream spot on the planet. Our friends brought us here and I ordered the Sundae in the chocolate dipped waffle bowl with chocolate ice cream and dark chocolate fudge. The angels sang the entire time I ate it. I like it so much that I'm going to give them five stars even though their prices are literally the most ridiculous I've ever seen. The average is $13-$15 for a sundae or split. I guess you can charge what you want when you've created perfection. The service is always friendly. We come in with large groups so it would be nice if they didn't have those tiny tables but again, the product is just perfection. I'm just going to pay the over inflated price, enjoy my perfect ice cream and shut up...
I recommend the salted caramel hot chocolate! The store could get really cramped with crowds, but staff was friendly and got orders out pretty quickly.

I thought this place was kinda gimmicky because it's on the Las Vegas strip and it's way over priced, but I have to tell you, this place is awesome! The brownies are so soft the chocolate fudge is tasty and the ice cream is top quality! They also make good coffee and the hot cocoa is pretty delicious too!

If you come in here expecting a replica of their original shop in San Fran, you'll be sadly disappointed. However I can't really blame them for the plastic cups and silverware, the shop is right on the strip so you know every drunk bimbo and his cheap date are stumbling in here to spill their ice cream all over the place. Let's not even think about getting glass involved. But really, how dare they make the cups smaller! They've got a real speedy, coffeeshop-like set up that ensures you receive your order fairly quickly, despite the lines. The store is small and mostly filled with merchandise displays, so best bet is to get your little to-go cup of ice cream in it's idiot-proof container and continue your meandering around the Linq, there's not much room to sit inside. The ice cream itself was pretty great. But it's ice cream, no one can screw that up. They have a bunch of different combinations on the menu that are named in reference to Sin City itself (that's right Golden Gate banana split, get wrecked) and all come together as delicious sundaes that won't cure a hang over but will sure make you slightly happier and pack on a few pounds.
Love this place. The Mint Bliss is awesome. The servings are big enough to share. We used our $1 off a sundae from Yelp and have gave us a $1 off of both. Servers were very friendly.
I got a small chocolate shake, which was good. The chocolate ice cream is very rich. It was $7.00 for a small and I find that to be a bit pricey. The place it very cute and clean. Staff was friendly.
It's nice and clean the place but when I ordered ocean beach I asked for no whip cream and no salt and they put salt and whip cream !!!

Enjoyed their classic hot fudge sundae last night. Delicious as always. I typically get these at Giants games in San Francisco. I never thought I'd be paying more for these anywhere else than at the ballpark, but Vegas managed to do that, $14 each. Oh well, I'm on vacation. Nevertheless, it's always fun to visit a premium chocolate shop. We didn't buy anything else besides a couple sundaes, I'd have had to sell an extra kidney to do so. You're better off financially buying their product at Costco. Staff were friendly, pleasant ambiance.

Probably a 3.5, had a brownie sundae, which was pretty tasty. Cost wise, if you check in on Yelp, it's a $1 off. I think total is in the $10-12 range. The size is ok, you can share. My main negative was that they close on the dot at midnight, we got there at about 11:56 and they barely let people in and obviously were upset people were coming in. They probably rejected 10-15 customers from 12 to 12:10. They need to go til 1am, plenty of stuff open around there at that time of night.
This is like a 4.5. Strawberry ice cream, hot fudge and whipped cream. I chose not to look at the calories. ;) Totally decadent!

What's not to love? The ice cream treats are big enough for 2 people. We had a banana split & it was great! The customer service was excellent as well. My only complaint is that the chocolate is more expensive at their store than at tue grocery store. I never buy candy directly from the Ghirardelli store.
This was probably one of the greatest dessert ice cream I had ever had. It was smothered in chocolate syrup and nuts.

Best place to sin. I was amazed to see Ghirardelli in Vegas. You have. A large variety to eat from . We took the Sunday's and I took the dark chocolate Sunday.. Make sure to go here hungry as after having one of these babies you'll have to say good bye to food.
Warning warning do not get the malt unless you like salty and sweet . My waffle chocolate dipped cone was off the chart , I was mourning every bite !

I was too excited to see Ghirardelli as they are hard to come by, however, all my hopes and dreams were ripped away with the staff from this location. The staff was not friendly and very slow. They had no sense of urgency with a room full of waiting customers. No smile, no greeting, no energy. The ice cream itself is always great 5/5 recommend! All the sundaes are devine. The whipped cream is my ultimate favorite. They are never shy with any toppings! However, one shouldn't wait 20 minutes for ice cream. Sometimes the staff overweights the overall experience. Come to this location if you do not mind poor service and have time to wait.

In the middle of the touristy LINQ part of the strip, right near the High Roller. Pretty pricey for an ice cream sundae, but big enough to share and very delicious. Got the Cookie Dough Sundae and I believe it was around $13. I've also been to the Ghirardelli in San Francisco and this one was a lot smaller and a lot less crowded - probably waited about 10 minutes for my sundae. Definitely stop in here for an afternoon or night snack after lunch or dinner!

Cute little shop. They have everything Ghirardelli has to offer. Great selection of chocolate. My only reason why I gave this a 3 star was the long wait. It's such a small shop there needs to be a better cashier system.
Only popped in to find hot chocolate. Found the staff extremely rude. store is small not very wheelchair friendly.

Ghiradelli is located in the very busy LINQ Promenade. The shop is fairly small considering the amount of foot traffic that goes through the area. We lucked up and found a table for our party of four. This place is pricey, so beware. I ordered the Treasure Island (add half a chocolate chip cookie). I shouldn't have added the cookie. For an extra $2.50, I got a hard and tasteless cookie. Now back to the Treasure Island. It came with half a brownie. The brownie was delicious. The ice cream was nothing special and I hate the fact that the ice cream solidified the chocolate sauce. I've been other places where the chocolate sauce was able to maintain the consistency. All in all, the brownie was the star of the show and I would probably return for just the brownie.
Omg be prepared to Wait 30 minutes for whatever you order, the workers take foreverrrrrrr to make 1 shake

I can't say enough about all other Ghirardelli shops. Unfortunately, we were stopped from even entering the line in this location by one of their minions who said they were 8 pages deep on orders and they wouldn't even take our order. This was as 9:30 at night on a Thursday!!! If they can't handle some basic orders, the management needs to work on their MANAGEMENT!! Step up your game and get your shop in order!! Bring in more workers when you know it's going to be busy - it's spring break!!! COVID can't be your excuse anymore. Figure it out!!!! Very disappointing management!

Sundaes are a bit vanilla for me... I prefer something with substance as well... the banana split has the banana. The brownie sundae has the brownie. Where's the cookie? Where's the texture? The chocolate square is supposed to be that, I guess. But... I wasn't disappointed with the salted caramel sundae I got from Ghirardelli. Mmm. Such a rich, distinct flavor like no other salted caramel I've ever had. I enjoyed every bite. Expensive for a sundae ($13), but it's Vegas. And it's Ghirardelli. Cute shop right along the LINQ Promenade.
I give this place a 5 star because I got what I needed:) Service was good.

Worst experience ever! Customer service was terrible. There were 3 of us and only my order was made wrong. I ordered a chocolate milkshake with out whip cream. I asked her if she could scoop off the whip cream... OMG She yelled at me and said SHE had to remake my milkshake, I told her it was ok I'll take it and I'll take off the whip cream myself and she flipped around and Yelled again NO because it wasn't right SHE had to remake it. She was so very rude!

Love chocolate? This is a the place to be! The left of the store is the sundae shop where most run $10 but you get $1 for checking in on Yelp or get 10% off if you purchase chocolate first. We didn't have a chance to try one, but they looked delicious and we were told good for sharing. They even have a family sundae for $38! When you walk in, they gave us a free peppermint sample. The right of the shop is the chocolate. You can buy in bulk for just under $10 for half a pound, so pricey. But you can pick and choose what types you want, and so many good ones to choose from. There are also small bags of one kind of chocolates and if you buy 4 bags, you get a deal but still more expensive than buying the mini chocolate bags at Walgreens. I couldn't resist the hot chocolate pouches for 3/$12, I hope it tastes as good as the packaging looks. If you are looking for gifts, there are tins with assorted chocolates. Since we couldn't decide from all the different types, we got the big bag of 80 chocolates (more than 2lbs worth) for $27. There was a deal if you buy 2 bags, you get $5 off. These big bags come in a variety of bags, including mixed and Christmas chocolates. The staff were very helpful to tell us about the differing bags, and various products. The location is the between LINQ and Flamingo heading towards the High Roller. Even if you don't buy anything, come for the free chocolate square if you are in the area!
Awesome as always! We got the new cookie sundae, very good! Great location!
Amazing chocolate and ice cream, in a fun little corner off the strip. Nice gift shop also.
Cedric was awesome ! This shops gives free samples as soon s you walk in They have friendly employees
13 bones for a Hot fudge sundae. You killin' me vegas. Then again, the wife seemed completely happy with it so I got to play craps for another few hours. Win win? 4 stars.

I usually never write reviews but this place pissed me off today. I ordered a sprinkle cone with coffee ice cream and as I'm eating the ice cream I take a bite and in that bite theirs a plastic peace that looks like a broken peace from a plastic clear fork. Now I go up to the counter and show it to one of the girls their what does she say she says we don't even have anything like that in our shop. First of all that's how you take care of your customer? Clearly it was in their ice cream and lucky I didn't swallow that peace and cut my throat I was in shock. Afterwards she told me that she said she was sorry and could replace it for me after I ate like half of it. The least you could of done was give me a refund for what I went through. I've never had that happen to me and as soon as I saw that she didn't offer a refund I left without bothering to even ask for one because I feel like she should of insisted. I will never eat here again.

Free sample when you walk in, but that's where the customer service stopped. We knew we wanted a sundae and quickly decided on their classic sundae, there's no line, no one appeared to be waiting, 4 workers chatting it up with each other, none of which looked like they wanted to wait on us, finally one of the girls made her way from the back of the circle and asked what she could do for us. We placed our order, our sundae was done quickly, it was super small for the price, the melted fudge on it was good and plentiful, they skimped on almonds and the ice cream it self was your average supermarket variety. We ate it all though and took advantage of the window seating that faced the Linq's thoroughfaire, great for people watching! I'll only return for the free samples!

If I could give NO stars I would. We got there at 10:50pm, trust me we ran. I bolted in and apologized to the manager for being so late. All for him to tell me "no more orders we're closed. I've already closed the registers down." DON'T FREAKING ADVERTISE HOURS TILL 11pm AND CLOSE AT 10:50pm!!!!!

This is a great place to relax and grab your sweet tooth fix while your visiting The Linq! Their sundaes are awesome and they give you a "mini" to try when you first walk in. The service has always been great - even when they're busy. At times they can get super busy and there isn't a whole lot of seating inside so once in a while we have to pass and head somewhere else. That's the only reason for four (not five) stars.

I absolutely loved this place. I mean how can you go wrong, there is chocolate, ice cream, and every little caramel and fudge in-between. The chocolate is top notch as you would expect from Ghirardelli. The location for us was really convenient as well since it was just across the street (maybe a 10 min walk) away from the Bellagio where we were staying. The only one complaint I would have, and the reason I knocked off a point from this being a perfect 5 stars, is that I think $11.95 for a fudge brownie sundae no matter what the quality is a bit steep. But I digress, if you have a sweet tooth its most definitely worth a stop here to get your fix.

This Ghirardelli's is at The LINQ. I tried their Sea salt caramel sundae for the first time and it was delicious to taste the sea salt with vanilla and hot fudge. I like their customer service there because someone always greets you when you come in with a chocolate sample. Overall a good little dessert place if you're craving anything chocolate!
It's Ghirardelli. Need I say more? For the uninitiated, a piece of advice: you need at least 2 people, preferably 3, to share one of the sundaes!

So excited when we asked then ordered based on the wall pic two "Strike It Rich" with carmel to replace the butterscotch and a third order. What we got was two "Gold Rush" with syrup, we think.
