I feel a little dumb giving a place two stars because they don't like up with my taste but...I can't be the only one, right?

Decided to give this place a try after eating at Momofuku. The soft serve literally tasted like the leftover milk after you finished your bowl of cereal. I ordered the cereal soft serve with cornflakes. The cornflakes is very crunchy and a bit saltier. Very addicting combination.

A.MA.ZING. A must if you are in Vegas!! It's little place that packs a punch on originality. My boyfriend took me here on my birthday. We got a slice of their birthday cake, cookies, and their cereal milk. Everything was perfect and completely unique!

I was waiting for food at the Eggslut line and was craving coffee. Purchased the latte and wanted a hint of sweetness so the barista added a little bit of the sweetener so I wouldn't have to put sugar in. It was a perfect as we were waiting in line for food. Friendly associates with a bar that had a vintage vibe. It's located on the second floor of the Cosmopolitan. You'll see it right when you head up the escalator.

So many incredible treats! Tried the crack pie, birthday cake truffles and the corn cookie. Wasn't able to to get their famous ice cream but planning to in NY. Definitely a dangerous place to go if you have a sugar addiction like myself.

CEREAL MILK SOFT SERVE ICE CREAM WITH CORN FLAKES ($7) - the soft serve flavor of cereal milk was on point; that being said some may think it's too sweet - the corn flakes had a hint of salt to accentuate the flavor of the corn flakes - the overall dessert was a bit expensive and too sweet for 1 person to finish CORN COOKIE - cookie was super soft, moist, and purposely had corn and hence corn flavored. - despite good consistency, the cookie was too sweet and didn't leave me craving for more Overall, not the first place I'd recommend for dessert. The soft serve and cookies left me craving water or something to cleanse my palette. Ironically there was a juice bar near Milk Bar...If you must try this place due to hype, consider sharing the soft serve dessert because your wallet and health will thank you.
Gross!! Got a cookie, pie, and milkshake and all of them had a weird taste. Like cardboard or something.

Milk Bar is located on the second floor near the Chandelier Bar. You can't miss the bright pink sign that says "Milk"! Unfortunately, there's no seating there... I was so excited to try Milk Bar, since I've never been to New York before. However, I was so disappointed during my visit. I tried their Crack Pie soft serve with cornflake crunch, which was over $7... The portion was so tiny and the soft serve + topping tasted too salty that it wasn't enjoyable anymore. I threw it away after eating barely half of it. I rather go somewhere else to get soft serve.. However, the staff is helpful and nice though! They suggested some of their popular stuff and allowed me to sample some of it. Maybe I'll give this place a second chance next time I'm in Vegas...

They must put crack in the birthday cake milkshake lol. That thing is seriously the most delicious dessert I've ever had. God knows how much sugar is in it but wow. I get the regular size ($10), and there is a smaller version as well. I don't get alcohol in it I feel that would take away from the taste. I've also had the birthday cake truffles (they come in a pack of 3). They are like little balls of heaven. The line is never too long and moves pretty quickly. The staff is very friendly. Must check out.

I got the birthday cake. The birthday cake is delicious it's not too sweet but just the perfect amount of sweetness. I don't normally like icing on the cakes but this icing is very good. If you like funfetti you will definitely like this cake. Service was good very quick and friendly.

First of all, I LOVE CEREAL. It was all I ate as a kid. The cereal milk soft serve is summer of 1998 on a Saturday morning watching Street Sharks and Double Dragon, distracting me from my cereal and letting the milk soak up all the sugars to become a little extra dessert at the end of the "meal". Textures of the ice cream and corn flake bits were premium. Appreciated every bite. Will be back!
Crack pie lives up to the hype. I didn't try anything else - but the name is fitting. It's amazing.

I, like many others, had to give in to the hype and come here. I was disappointed. For the past few years my husband has ordered a milkbar cake for my birthday, I have made several of the desserts at home and I think Christina Tosi seems fun and spunky.....but this place is not worth the stop. I had a chocolate cereal milk shake, husband had the strawberry corn milkquake plus we got two of the cookies we had not yet tried. Total cost $26. Each of these milkshakes/quakes were ok. The cookies were a huge disappointment. They tasted store bought (think Grandma's brand) but far pricier. Been there....done that....would not go back. Sorry, Christina.

i was super excited to try this place after watching christina tossi on chefs table. all the stuff sounded SO NOMZ. on our recent trip to vegas, i told my bestie i wanted to stop by and try milk bar. we made a special trip to the cosmo and i bought one of each cookie and 2 crack pies (since it is highly talked up in chefs table). i must admit that chefs table was right in conveying that tossi loves sugar, the stuff i bought was SUPER sweet. it has to go with black coffee or tea or something. standalone, i thought it was too much. and i really don't get the hype of the crack pie.. tastes like butter and sugar?? which i know those are the ingredients, but whats so special??? anyways, i am curious about the cereal soft serve and other items on the menu, so maybe i'll stop by the LA location one day. also, i just remembered the workers there weren't all that friendly. i was all excited cause it was my first time at a milk bar and asked if the crack pie would survive in our 4 hour car ride home. i was answered with, "you know theres a location in LA". yes, i know there is a location in LA but this is my first time and i happen to be in LV and i want to buy everthing! hallo! anyways, maybe chefs table hyped it up too much but i was disappointed :/ *cosmo doesn't charge for parking if you leave within the hour, thank God for that!*
This place is pretty pricey for cookies, but they have gluten free options (which I enjoy). Wasn't a huge fan of the BFC but the gluten free bday truffles were DELICIOUS!

Crack pie was very good, but so rich--plan to share the slice with someone. Compost cookie was not a hit with us--very strong coffee taste, which we did not care for. Overall decent, but not likely to go out of my way to visit.

I went to Milk for my Birthday Feb 7, 2019 to have a live of the Birthday Cake & Red Velvit ice cream When we got the cake & went to eat it . Was frozen in the middle. A little disapointed that I was eating a frozen cake :(
I needed a cake last minute to celebrate a friend's birthday and Milk Bar did not disappoint! Customer service is amazing at this location. Everyone enjoyed the cake.
We had a piece of the crack pie. It was okay. But hardly the crack I'd anticipated. Everything seemed really prepackaged and the place had none of the character of its NYC locations

D- : Cookies were terrible! So stale! We bought 2 of everything (to give to our neighbor) because there was such a line and we bought the hype. Mistake. Pretty sure neighbors thought we bought 3 day old discounted cookies to gift them, sigh. Try one before you got nuts on their packs.

I was first introduced to Milk Bar after trying out their truffles in a gift box and loved the whole concept and packaging. The truffles were a little too sweet for me, so I was hoping the cereal soft serve would be better - and it was! The soft serve tastes EXACTLY like what you would imagine cereal milk in ice cream form would taste like. It wasn't overly sweet, and I liked that the cereal topping (extra $1) provided a nice crunch which complemented the soft, creamy ice cream. I do wish that the cereal topping was less salty. I don't know what they do to it, but it would taste so much better if they left it plain and simple - crunchy, corn flakes. Don't salt the cereal guys! I cannot give this place a full 4 stars simply because of the price. Paying $7 for a very small soft serve is simply CRAZY and not worth it.
Great service! Unique flavors but wasn't too crazy about it. Ordered the baby bday shake about $8. They are okay.

It's a great concept. The menu is creative and fun, and the product is tasty, although very sweet - and this is coming from an American. Beware of massive sugar highs and even bigger crashes lol! Firstly, Ingrid (I believe), has great customer service skills. She easily sold us on her favorite menu items, and was willing to answer my partner's many questions. She definitely had fun with us, and vice versa. She sold us on quite a bit of treats, and since we are locals, we don't mind taking stuff home. A box of a dozen cookies and a Crack Pie - because who doesn't get the Crack Pie? She had a lot of great ideas for enjoying the cookies. The Corn Sugar cookie warmed with honey? Yes, please! Now, my only complaint is the price point. I completely understand Strip prices, considering I live in Vegas and have worked on the Strip for years. However, $35 for a dozen average-sized cookies? That alone will ensure that I don't go back on a regular basis, even though I'm in the area quite often. It'll be a nice treat when friends or family come to town, maybe. But it's not going to generate any return business from myself, or many locals, really. It's too bad, because everything else was on point.

I seriously felt like shedding a tear once I heard Milk Bar was moving closer to me! It's a must stop when I am in NYC. The Cosmopolitan is a great match for location choice. The quality of Ingredients is apparent in each yummy item. I got their Greatest Hits. Crack Pie is crack. It's so decadent without being sweet. Compost cookie is amazing, as are the other cookie offerings. Bday and Chocolate Malt truffles are so good! Wish they offered the chocolate chip passionfruit ones in LV though. Cereal Milk ice cream and all of its shootoffs are so good! There is a place near me called Afters that had a cereal milk ice cream which came AFTER Milk Bar and it fills a need when I get the craving but in no way is it on the same level. Prices are super high but at least the quality matches. Bring Milk Bar or Orange County or LA please!

Been wanting to try this place forever! Finally got a chance and it didn't disappoint. Cute little storefront inside Cosmopolitan. It's right between the Juice standard and momofuku just in case you pass it. Everything is pretty much cereal based. Soft served ice cream, cookies, cereal toppings, and different pies. Plenty of options to choose from and different ways to make it. I had the milkquake which is soft-served ice cream with pie or cookie chunks blended in. I had the crack pie which is a salted caramel flavor and it was spot on for flavor. Only thing I would ask is to make the chunks of crack pie smaller. For me the milkquake size was big enough for two people. My husband and I shared one and we didn't even finish it. I would definitely recommend this place!

Most disgusting desserts I've ever had. Ordered the combo with the cookie, pie, truffles, and ice cream. Had to spit it out and request a refund. EVERYTHING is pre packaged and not fresh except for the ice cream which wasn't good either. I asked for my $25 back and they did a refund. :(

Stopped by the Cosmo location after the Vegas half marathon to refuel and our ensuing feast was worth every mile!! Love the compost cookies and birthday cake shake plus the cereal milk soft serve! Friendly service, great location, totally lives up to the insta hype!

What?!? 7 bucks for a non special super small milkshake? Went to Gordon burger joint got a milkshake which was way better way bigger and for the same price. Step your game up. Can't believe this place has business since it's so simple. Could get a better shake from any fast food joint. Pass this place up
Nice treat. They are doing something no one else is doing. Worth a visit or two. Usually a line due to popularity.

The wait was so short and I've been living in NYC and missed cereal soft serve so much. It tasted great as in NYC but I was bit questioned about their cleanliness and how ingredients are organized. I had sprinkles and chocolate chips in my soft serve when I only added cereal crunchies. Other than that it was very good.

This place was really good, however i feel definitely over priced. Crack pie is literally the best thing ever but unfortunately the serving size they offer for what you pay is WAY too small. Even considering 'Vegas' prices.. still good though and worth a try!

It was ok! Idk what the hype is all about. I will admit one thing the cookies are awesome! And the crack pie is good. Well I guess 2 things.. haha Today we tried the ice cream for the first time.. and I honestly did not enjoy a bit of it.. the name was Inviting Cereal Milk ice cream... gave me a flash back of my child hood watching cartoon and having my bowl of cereal and always making sure To savor the left over milk... lol But it was just what ever.. for an additional charge There's is topping to add I chose to have the cereal crunch topping.. both combined together it left a salty after taste I couldn't ignore.. I had maybe a quarter of it and tossed it out... I'll stick to the cookies

Was skeptical to try Milk bar again after my subpar experience in NYC, but I decided to give it another shot. I'm glad I did, I liked it so much more this time around that I ended up going twice. The first time I got the crack pie soft serve and bday cake truffles. So yummy. The second time I got the fruity cereal milk soft serve, which tasted like fruity pebbles and more bday cake truffles since they were so good the first time. Personally, I'm not a fan of the cereal milk soft serve, which is what everyone usually gets with the corn flake crunch. I think that the crack pie and the fruity cereal milk have a lot more flavor and definitely recommend getting those!! The line goes pretty fast since they have a lot of people working behind the counter. Also, if you can't decide which flavor of soft serve to get, just ask them for a sample!
Awesome milkshakes!! Huge calorie overload but nice to enjoy once in a while! I even got one if their smaller milkshakes and had to throw in the towel. Food was great too.

Pleasantly surprised! With the mixed yelp reviews I was hesitant to try it but certainly glad that I did! We got the b'day truffles, the chocolate malt shake, and the golden knight fancy shake! And they are all off the hook! Crack in a cup. We will be back the next time we stay at the cosmo!

I was really excited to try Milk Bar. I watched The Mind of a Chef awhile back and my favorite segments were of Christina Tosi. We don't have a Milk Bar here in Vancouver and so when I found out there was one in Las Vegas I told my sister that we HAD to go there before we leave to pick up some cookies to take home. My sister and I made a special stop at Cosmopolitan just for them. I bought one of each kind: compost cookie, blueberry cream cheese, chocolate cornflake marshmallow, double chocolate, and corn. They weren't cheap that's for sure and with the exchange rate even more so. Thus I had some high expectations. I was a bit nervous though seeing them pre-packaged and not baked on site but hoped for the best. I was sadly disappointed. I shared the cookies with my husband and parents. Out of all of them I preferred the compost cookie but it was meh at best. Maybe it was because I was expecting a bit of crunch from the pretzel and potato chip pieces but there was barely any crunch. Second favorite was the corn cookie, but had wished for a stronger corn flavour and maybe some texture from cornmeal. The blueberry cookie was okay. It was soft which was nice, but it just tasted really sweet and the blueberries tasted fake to me (we're a bit spoiled here with fresh blueberries all summer long). The double chocolate cookie I did not like at all. I've baked Tartine Bakery's recipe for salted chocolate rye cookies. That is a damn good chocolate cookie. This cookie lacked any depth of flavour and just tasted like cocoa with a bitter after taste (if that makes sense) that I could not get out of my mouth. The chocolate cornflake marshmallow was good. The cornflakes added a bit of crunch and the marshmallows took me back to my childhood because it tasted a bit like the marshmallows you found in cereal. Who knows...maybe if they were fresh baked, right out of the oven, it would be a different story. But, unfortunately the taste did not live up to the hype (or the price).
Way too expensive and totally underwhelming. Was expecting way more from this place because of Tosis reputation. Thx gooey cake slice was so tiny and lacked any real flavor. Such a waste of money

Got "milked" for $20 and came up sour. Literally threw everything I bought in the garbage. Not sure who is handing the "awards" for this but....no! The experience was like waking up excited for the last bit of your favorite cereal and pouring some cold clumpy sour milk in the bowl. Yeah it's that great.

I finally decided to give Milkbar a try and realized why I was avoiding it in the first place. You are paying for a name and something that has trended on Instagram. Perhaps, at her original Bakery when she was making the products herself, they were balanced and delicious but here I have some person shoving a cold pie in my hand and my first bite was nothing but the taste of sugar and then my second bite was more sugar and then on the third I finally got hints of butter but for the most part it's fairly flavorless and for $7 that's just ridiculous. The overall texture is nice but feels like it's missing something. There's no contrast or balance at all. It tastes like something a two-year-old would make. Save your $7 and go buy a pack of gummy bears, that's what I ended up doing and the gummies were tastier.

Located at the Cosmopolitan, very small place, you can sit at one of the common areas. We had the crack pie and their b-day cake. The crack pie was good a bit sweet and small but good, the bday cake was ok and a decent size, however; we thought it'd be something different/special from any other bday cake we had, but it was just ok. Both items are pricy, will have again the crack pie and try something else next time.

I love this place. I love it in NY, and I love it in LV. Crack pie - delicious. Cereal milk soft serve with cornflakes - delicious. If you have a sweet tooth and come looking for sweet desserts or huge selection of ice cream, or a unique fusion of flavors like other places offer, you won't find it here. But they have cereal milk soft serve that can't be found anywhere else that I find myself craving. They have simple but delicious cookies, like their blueberry one. Their desserts are borderline savory, but I love it like that! (except their crack pie, that's way sweet)

I came to Vegas for a conference and a colleague kept telling me you have to go next door to the Cosmo for the "Milk Cereal Soft Serve". The last night there I finally said ok let's try it. Best decision ever I had the fruity pebbles milk cereal the concept is they make the soft serve base out of what would be your left over Cereal milk... It was delicious and the best part was it had a little bit of a saltiness.

My faveeeee place!! I will always always make a stop at Milk Bar, whenever possible. I would even drive out just to stop by! Favorites are the cereal milk ice cream (with cornflakes), crack pie, the corn cookie, and the blueberries and cream cookies. I have heard the crack pie soft serve is also amazing, and that's what I'll be getting next time!
Pretty delicious. Cereal milk flavored ice cream wasn't super sweet which was a nice change and the cereal was a bit salty. Nice combo. It was a bit expensive but IT IS VEGAS AFTER ALL!

I have had this place bookmarked for a very long time and finally had the chance to give it a try. I tried out their cereal milk soft serve with corn flakes and just like it was described it tasted like milk and cereal. Didn't leave a great impression. Quite overpriced for what you get.

So this is embarrassing...I returned the cereal milk ice cream because I didn't like it at all! I think the problem for me was that it wasn't sweet enough to counter the saltiness, so it just left a salty-sour milk aftertaste in my mouth. But the employees were so nice about it and didn't make me feel bad, which I really appreciated. Instead, I got my usual crack pie and I'm very happy with it :)

Unbelievable. Having heard of Christina Tosi, this was on our horizon to visit, however, we were usually too full from other restaurants in the area to just stop by. We were fortunate, because after dining at Momofuku, the dessert was from Milk Bar. I've always wanted to try Milk Bar, so it was perfect. We had the Crack Pie a la Mode. O-M-G. Crack pie is what it is called - CRACK. But the cereal milk ice cream. I can't tell you how much this was a Ratatouille, Anton Ego moment. It's not cereal flavored ice cream, it's really the bottom of the cereal bowl while watching Saturday morning cartoons.. WOW. No question, we will return.

Loved this place! While standing in line trying to decide what to order, the woman behind the counter asked me if she could help me choose. I told her I was deciding between a cookie and soft serve, and once I decided on the soft serve she handed me a cookie on the house! The cereal milk soft serve with the cornflake topping was delicious and not too sweet. The cornflake marshmallow cookie had a very different taste from what I was expecting, but it was moist and delicious. The only downfall of this place is the price ($6 for that tiny soft serve), but the free cookie made up for that I guess! I would definitely recommend trying this place

We ordered the Cereal Milk Soft Serve with cornflakes and two other shakes. I fed my 2 year old son the Cereal Milk Soft Serve at 12:30 am. He woke up at 5am vomitting. He threw up three times since this morning. We are on our way back to California to bring him to Urgent Care. I also noticed this morning the guy handing out the orders really smell funky. Severe bad body odor. Should they be putting some attention to their staff's hygiene specially they are handling food. Traumatic First time experience here. Not coming back for sure.

Okay, I know this location is pricier than others but I'll happily pay because it's the only location on the west coast. Anytime I'm at a Cosmopolitan, I try and stop by for cookies. I love the cereal milk soft serves and shakes (and just the cereal milk in general). The blueberry cookies are a family favorite (as are the compost cookies). I've tried the box mixes and while they're okay, they really aren't the same. Spend the extra and buy them fresh!

I have wanted to try Milk for along time. I was so excited to find out there was a location in Vegas. I have heard so many good things about the cereal flavored ice cream. I got the ice cream and a piece of vanilla confetti cake. The cake was awesome! The ice cream not so much! The ice cream was not very sweet and salty. I didn't like it at all! I feel it's very overrated. My biggest complaint is the price $6 for ice cream and $1.25 for some added cereal topping. The cake slice was $14. Now I know we are in Vegas and everything is over priced, but it really wasn't worth it. I ended up being disappointed .

I was so happy to read about this being in Las Vegas as well... I always loved the one in New York City and everything is pretty much the same here, except some awesome shakes that are only in Vegas! The famous pie slice and the corn meal cookies are always a must!

Right outside of Momofuku in Las Vegas, it was very quiet Christmas weekend, so there wasn't any line, although there were plenty of people taking pictures and ordering food. Yes it's bit pricey, but Las Vegas can be expensive. And if I were to order these item as desert in a diner, cost can be justified. I got the cereal milk ice cream with corn flakes, crack pie, and birthday cake truffles. I didn't care for birthday cake truffles. But loved the crack pie. It is a crack pie and I did a search to see that LA had one. Cereal milk ice cream was hit with my wife and my younger one. My older one didn't care much for it. My wife also wanted to know if there was a LA location to get the ice cream.

I feel like this place is a novelty, with very bad and overpriced desserts. I got a crack pie soft serve with cereal sprinkles as a topping. It was sweet, more sweet, and even more sweet. It was so sweet I felt like I was going to become a diabetic just from eating a tiny cup of soft serve. I ate probably two spoons and had to stop eating. I threw away the rest, as it was just way too sweet to eat. A friend behind me in line tasted my soft serve and decided not to order anything -- that was a wise decision. I also ordered a cornflake chocolate chip cookies, which was just like the soft serve, sweet sweet and more sweet. The cookies were already prepackaged in bags, and I'm not sure whether they are actually made on site. I asked for the cookie to be heated, which essentially meant they stuck it in the microwave for a couple seconds. It wasn't actually heated nearly enough. Oh, and did I mention that a tiny tiny cup of soft serve cost you six bucks, and a sprinkle of serial cost an extra two bucks? Totally not worth it. Go somewhere else.
Got the soft serve with cornflakes. It was OK. I liked that it wasn't too sweet but other than that I didn't really care for it, unfortunately.

I had crack pie! It was delicious. I wish it had been a freshly sliced pie, instead it was pre sliced in a cardboard container. It was teeny tiny. I was surprised at how small the slice was for the price. I probably would not go again, but I can now say I had crack pie.
Somehow the birthday truffles tasted better in NYC. Still a close second. The milk and cereal soft serve was on point though and totally hit the spot of our 3 year craving.

Oh hell no this shit is plain and overrated! Yuck! The soft serve is so bland I was so shocked. Not worth it. I was exited to eat here after seeing them on tv. What you see on tv isn't always true! So over hyped!

Got two mochas. They were overpriced, small and tasted like warm milk. I asked for a refund and the cashier got offended. Go get your coffee somewhere else. There are plenty of places at the Cosmopolitan

This is like expired piss. You would think milk is cool as thing gradient in the ice cream what actually makes it taste sigh expire dog ship so if you want to get aids go your will you can get the shakes which actually let but size as his like bucking horse ship.
The cereal milkshake was one of the best shakes I've ever had and the crack pie well given the name you should know what to expect! Great customer service as well.

Crack pie is really good!!! Definitely worth it every once in a while for it being $6.50 each and kind of the size of your palm. The compost cook was pretty good. A little on the harder side and would only get it to try it.

Super disappointing. I have been hearing about Milk for years from a blogger in NYC who raves about it. Not sure if it's different in NYC, but in Vegas everything was prepackaged. I thought it would be like a high end bakery, but instead I felt like I was getting over priced and not very good convenience store snacks.

Not worth it. Wasnt planning on trying the place but was desperate for breakfast since the eggslut line was super long. Ordered cornflake marshmallow chocolate chip cookie and the bday truffles. Prices are ridiculous. My cookie was just ok. Way too salty and not enough chocolate. The marshmallow seems pointless as it gives the cookie a weird chewy texture but not the good kind. The truffles were good but super sweet you can only eat one and need to down water after. Pretty much cake pops without the icing. Not worth it.

I wanted to be wowed and just wasn't. Well the bagel bomb was good it was way over priced for what you got. We also a slice of crack pie and was shocked at how small it was for $6.50. All food seems overpriced in Vegas I was just hoping for more. The hot chocolate was good but nothing special. Maybe cake is where it is but we will never know. Also we went in the morning and cashier was either high or hung over but she wasn't on this planet.

Oh my! The cereal milk soft serve is exactly that--and so good. Also the chocolate chip with marshmallow and corn flake is 2 die for. Will be dreaming of my next one. As for the crack pie...it is just that. Very sweet so I'd say get it to share. An entire piece to yourself might lead to diabetic coma. But what a way to go!

I've tried two things here. Cereal Milk ice cream and Latte. Both are amazing!!! Cereal milk ice cream was good. Very unique taste and very addicting! omg. I'm in LOVE with latte with cereal milk. I loved it so much I had two a day for 4 days straight (my entire stay at Cosmopolitan).
Located right next to Momofuku. We tried the compost cookie, birthday cake truffles. It was so tasty and not too sweet at the same time. Would go back. I recommend you try it.

I'd always wanted to visit New York just to go into Milk, I'd drool all over their instagram pics, so when I saw they had one in Las Vegas, I was jumping for joy, so I happened to be there at the time. I purchased a hot chocolate with marshmallows, quite good, compost cookie and birthday truffles were ok. The staff at this location seemed unenthusiastic, I felt like a burden to them, and weren't helpful at all. Overall, felt disappointed by my experience.

Oh boy! That place is good, but not if you are watching your weight! Their specialty is cereal milk...yes that milk that we have in a bowl after finishing all the cereal. Milk nicely packaged it for you in a bottle, or a to go cup. It's amazing, but in small quantities. I also liked their chocolate balls - rich but tasty. If you however want a healthier alternative try juice place next door.
Crack pie latte. I have no idea what flavors they used but it was hunts of butterscotch and a melted Heath bar. Delicious. The blueberry and cream cookie is good for dunking.

How dare you charge $14 for a single slice of cake and not even try to make it taste good or fresh. I am personally outraged and count this among the worst transgressions in a year of terrible injustices occurring daily. Honestly if I wanted something tiny that tasted like shit and wasted my money and left me disappointed I would call my ex.

My husband, friends, and I were super excited when visiting Vegas and stumbled up the escalator at The Cosmopolitan to the Milk Bar. I am a HUGE Tosi fan and was expecting to be wowed! My husband and I ordered a full Birthday Cake to-go. We waited ~30 minutes for the cake. They boxed it up for us as we wanted to enjoy the cake back in our hotel room. I was so disappointed once we dug in. The cake tasted sour (mainly the frosting). It really had this spoiled sour taste. This has left me questioning their quality control. Did they make the frosting with spoiled milk? We don't live in Vegas so maybe I'll have to give the LA store a try someday. Or maybe we'll get one in San Francisco someday.
This place is so delicious, i saw the Netfilx episode of the shop and i had to come all the way from LA. The ice cream is really good and so is the crack pie! Its a must go when in Vegas

I give the Confetti Cookie 4 stars - delicious! The Chocolate Chocolate cookie's flavor leaned a little too heavy on the dark chocolate side for my husband's liking (and for mine). I tried the Cereal Milk White Russian. I think it would be better without the cereal milk flavor. Husband had a chocolate cereal shake and found the cereal milk flavor to be too overpowering. I guess it's just not for us, but if you are someone who lurvvs cereal milk, then this place might be perfect for you!

Have wanted to try this place for a while but honestly it wasnt worth it. Tried the cereal milk soft service with corn flakes it was ok but definitely not worth going down to the strip to have. Ive had better soft serve down the street from my house. Bit expensive for the taste and the hassle of going to the cosmo.
Not bad, got the crack pie. I think I expected more from all the hype. Very sweet, but good.

Super cute, super tasty! Staff was very patient and helpful while I asked any questions. They offered samples and explained things in detail to help me make the best decision! We got the fruity cereal milk quake and it was AWESOME!

I am sorry to say it but I was underwhelmed. I saw the story of the advent of Milk Bar on Netflix and was truly inspired and couldn't wait to indulge in Milk Bar's treats. I had the cereal milk soft serve and it was just so-so, needed some sweetness. Also, had the crack pie which was tasty but nothing more than a gooey butter cake, which I am very familiar with. Also had the composite cookie which was also good however, having a warm-fresh out the oven rendition would be far more impactful to my taste buds. All in all, I feel like items are over priced, small in portion, with a taste that is common without a "kicked up notch". Wanted to love it so bad. :(

This place is a classic case of over-hyped and under-delivered. The cereal flavored soft serve was honestly quite gross. I tried 3 different types of cookies, and not one of them was noteworthy. Not worth the visit!

In Cosmopolitan on 2nd floor. Small place, very pricy but had some incredible milkshakes. I had the chocolate malt with a little vodka in it and it was awesome. I think I paid $12 for it in a small cup but it's Vegas - everything is expensive. Worth a stop in if you have a sweet tooth

I have had my heart set on Milk Bar since we ran out of time to go on my last NYC visit, it was birthday weekend so my husband wanted to bring me to this location! The service was awesome, the ladies were so sweet & helpful, we ordered a cereal milk affogato, slice of crack pie and candy bar pie, malted cake balls & a cookie for my daughter. Affogato was horrible, as in, inedible horrible. Crack Pie is just like buttermilk pie, the Candy Bar slice was great but just so rich, malted cake balls were meh, couldn't detect the malt flavor. It was all sickeningly sweet and most of it just went in the trash. We were so unbelievably underwhelmed, our total was over $30 & I was really hoping to be wow'd at those prices. We won't be back.

I have been waiting a long time to get to a Momofuku Milk Bar location! I have baked some of the recipes in their cookbook and I never thought I'd get a chance to try the actual crack pie or cookies this far from New York! The store has "Milk" written all over it in pink with a crazy pink neon sign at the front so it's hard to miss (it helps that Momofuku is right next to it too!) and has the cookies all lined up by the entrance to the line. The menu board is huge so you'll be able to see what they have! There was nobody there when my family and I went and the woman at the cash register was friendly and let us sample a bunch of soft serve flavors (cereal milk, crack pie, and fruity cereal) and gave us recommendations of what to get (she recommended the chocolate malt cake truffles... haven't tried it yet!) I read that a lot of people were disappointed by the cereal milk soft serve and that it wasn't what they expected. It was true for me at first but the more I tasted it, the more was impressed by the soft serve samples! They really tasted like leftover cereal in a bowl and weren't overly sweet! It helps that the cereal milk soft serve I ordered had cornflake crunch rimmed at the edge, giving more corn-y flavor and texture. The sample crack pie soft serve was super sweet and tasted like caramel, which gave me a hint of what was to come with the crack pie slice we ordered. The fruity cereal tasted like sweet fruity pebbles! Yum! I'm happy to say that the crack pie I made at home that one time is one and the same with the crack pie from the bakery! It was super sweet and it felt like a sugar rush in your mouth. If you're not a fan of overly sweet desserts, this probably isn't for you! It had a rich caramel, buttery filling with an oatmeal crust that brought enough saltiness to balance the filling a little bit. I love sweets, but even I can't really finish a whole slice at once! I haven't tried the cake truffles or any of the cookies yet, but I can't wait! :) Overall, I loved my first experience at Milk Bar!! The people were helpful and the desserts were as delicious as I expected! I'll definitely come back when I have the chance!

Ice cream with cornflakes on it, that tastes like a bowl of corn flakes, but many times more expensive. What is the point? I did really like the crack pie, which was gooey and buttery, and husband enjoyed the birthday cake truffles. Wouldn't make a special effort to return, though.

I never write reviews but, do not waste your time on the cookies!! I should have been suspicious since they're packaged in plastic meaning they weren't baked there. Anyway, they were so stale and hard that even heating them up in the oven didn't do them any justice. Way too sweet and one dimensional, like you can barely taste the chocolate chips. Sadly, I bought 6 of them, such a waste:(

Been waiting for this place to open since I've had it in New York! I miss Milk Bar so much! I recently visited Vegas and rushed to try it! My boyfriend and I got a soft serve with sprinkles and a breakfast cereal shake total came out to be around $17! Downside is it is pricey for ice cream/desert. It also is a little mediocre for what it is but it's tasty and I always still crave it time to time!! ** Cute decor and atmosphere ** Cool and hip workers! Just like the NY location

I was excited to try this place! I got the birthday truffles and I finished them in less than 1 minute haha. As a big fan of cookie dough, this tasted sooooo good. I considered buying the big pack after that, but I was going to the pool party at Marquee so it was not good timing. The next day, I came back and tried the cereal milk soft serve with corn flakes topping and I was hesitant to buy it since it was $6 for a super small cup but I'm so glad I did cause it was REALLY good. It was the perfect combo and even my bf liked it a lot!!

We had the cereal milk boozy shake and the famous crack pie. Both were good enough and hit the late night sweet tooth craving. Certainly a fun try for one of those things you might not have anywhere else but In Vegas.

This place is always my favorite. I get really addicted to their soft serve with crunchy cereal. I had to order a pint every time and I would finish it all by myself. I can have this everyday. Their cookies is good too. It looks very simple but taste great!

My all-time favorite! It makes me so happy coming here and eating the birthday cake truffles. As someone who eats cereal daily and nightly, I was excited to try the crunchy cereal milk milkshake along with my truffles, and I was definitely impressed. Love Milk Bar, they couldn't do anything better!

I love the variety of flavors. They have a fun twist on desserts, I have come here for everything from cookies to soft serve to birthday cake. I love it all, it's nice to have something different and unique. I recommend it for anyone who can think outside the box and can appreciate different flavors. I have recommended it to family and friends who have enjoyed it as well.

First of all, sweetest counter service. Upbeat, accommodating cashier. Didn't seem like there was a bit of impatience in her. This was on a busy Sunday morning (1/14). The barista was excellent. Great latte and London Fog. And now the food...I can never get enough of MBs cookies. Last were in NYC. Had to wait two years to have them again. This time corn; cornflake-marshmallow-chocolate chip; and double chocolate. Yummy. Couldn't resist morsel-izing (that's my new word) after we ate our rye-artichoke dip bombs. And those were heavenly. First I've ever had of that type of item I could swoon over. Al of this under the chandeliers if the Cosmopolitan. A perfect breakfast.
Yes !!! I love the cereal milk ice cream with cornflakes so much. My daughter loves the cake. I think the ice cream is so unique and not to sweet.

I have never been to the Milk bar before. What a treat!! The family loved the compost cookies. I tried the corn cookie. It was nice. We bought several other kinds of cookies. They look great! The cookies are costly, but they are sure worth it.

Nah...not worth it...I heard about Milk coming from LA and was disappointed my first time trying it while staying at Cosmo. Ordered the milk bar pie for $6. Got back to my room and tasted this underwhelming oat bar that I definitely know I can make myself.

I had been dying to have the birthday cake from Milk Bar. My boyfriend and I ordered the milkshake and took a slice of the cake. The milkshake was AMAZING. However, the cake was not good at all. It was wet like it had been frozen and not thawed out yet. Simply giving a 3 star review because I came to Milk Bar for the birthday cake and it was not good but the shake was good af.
Yummy tasty treats!! Gotta go back and try cookies. I had the Cereal Soft Serve with Cornflake crunch. Yummy!

So disappointed. The chocolate, chocolate chip cookie was underwhelming. The Milk Bar pie soft serve was one note at best. Christina Tosi should be embarrassed by the lack of quality of the desserts and unfriendly service at Milk Bar Las Vegas.

The truffles were amazing, but I was a bit disappointed with the ice cream. It really reminded me of cereal milk, which to me felt like I was eating someone else's cereal milk that they froze into an ice cream. I would totally come back, but just wouldn't recommend the ice cream.. stick with the baked goods
Not quite sure what the hype is. Been here twice to give it another chance. I'm confused by the menu and what we got wasn't food.

cereal milk is so good, especially with the corn flake cereal topping! the fruity cereal milk is alright. cute place overall, with the neon signs and i love that it's in the beautiful cosmo next to other restaurants.
Meh, maybe I'm missing something...but it was just okay? Super expensive for a basic cake shake.

Not very good...we got three cookies (corn, cornflakes, and chocolate/chocolate). The corn cookie is nasty...do not get that one. Cornflake cookie was better but kind of hard. I don't even want to try the chocolate one after those two.
Great treats. Love the cereal milk latte, and also run the cereal milk soft serve with corn flakes whenever I have the munchies thanks chef tosi!!

This place was worth dusting off my keyboard for a yelp review. Precious describes the service, and Precious is the name of the woman who helped us. She was really cool and accommodating to me and more so to my kid, which is the way to my heart. My son apparently loves the place, and Precious wanted to help him out, decide what he should buy (he bought a bunch of cookies to bring back to his friends.) She was very down to Earth about it, and I appreciated it. She also seemed to enjoy her job and seemed like she actually liked the product she was selling. Shout out to the other two people there, all together, running a good thing. The 5 stars are because, with all that said above, the Milk Bar is also cool idea. Breakfast cereal and whole milk, turned into cookies and ice cream. I think it builds on that theme. And, the milk shakes we got were really good(we haven't tried the cookies yet.) My kid got the peppermint bark, and I got the cereal and milk with fruity pebbles. Beyond that, the location in the Cosmopolitan is awesome. I dug the hotel and the vibe and you gotta walk through the place to get to the Milk Bar. The only thing I'll say about prices, you're not just paying for quality, you're paying for the novelty and uniqueness of what they're selling. They basically have stuff that's really good, that you can't really get anywhere else. Overall, it's a great place, good people, amazing desserts, and it's fun to get there, ie, walk through the swanky Cosmopolitan.

Went here for a 1am milkshake and it was just alright - there aren't a great many options and the cereal milk crunchy shake that I got was pretty delicious but the quantity was pretty small and I felt that there was way too much cereal left behind in the cup that I couldn't finish and had to throw away. (Maybe use a spoon the next time? ) if I want a milkshake next time I'd prolly just go to shake shack.

We have had the birthday cake delivered to us (highly recommend) and had to come to the Vegas storefront. We got a slice of birthday cake and a cup of the cereal milk soft serve with corn flake topping. If you love sweets like we do, you can't go wrong here. Bring your dollars though!
Overrated. I can't believe this place gets so much hype. The cereal milk ice cream should not be made with corn flakes. No one loved drinking corn flake I'll! $6 is outrageous.

I think this place deserves between 3 and 4 stars. I really liked Cristina's episode on Chef's Table so we decided to go for a dessert. The place is really cute and nicely decorated. We had the cereal milk soft serve and a slice of carck pie. I really enjoyed the idea of having such an ice cream. It truly reminded me to cereal bowls from my childhood. Regarding the crack pie, I was craving this pie so much that it ended up disappointing me. I personally feel it was too sweet, buttery and overpriced for such tiny slice.

waited 25 minutes for a milkshake, eventually gave up and asked to just cancel my order for a refund, manager gave me a refund and did say "sorry" but did not seem really sincere nor care for making up for it. it's too bad I was really excited to try their shakes, there was a huge group of people waiting along with me as well and quite a few were getting very impatient and making comments so I know I wasn't the only one who was upset

If you want to spend a lot of money on a gross shake, this is the place for you. This is one of those places that invents novelty treats and then, because their treat is unique, they don't have any problem overcharging for it. Sadly, while many places can actually pull it off, Milk as a snack bar doesn't even skim close.
All hype. The cookies were crunchy and had a weird texture. The ice cream/milkshakes were nothing special. I'm would not go back there.

For years I had been so excited to try the highly acclaimed bday cake and just last week I finally had my chance. After hearing how it is the best tasting cake ever I had high expectations...however they were far from met! This is the most overrated dessert I have ever had. Dry, flavorless and overpriced- just buy funfetti at the store and you'll be better off.
Pre-packaged cookies. We were expecting so much more. Cookie was small, overpriced, and not that tasty. Crack pie was good but very small for the price.

Service was excellent! I was greeted by a young lady who explained almost everything on the menu and what her favorites were. She even offered samples for the soft serve! I chose the Fruit Milk Cereal...YUM. It definitely taste like the milk from your cereal bowl. Soft serve was creamy and just the right amount of sweet. The portion was gigantic too.

I have waited for so long for this store to come to Vegas since the first time I went here it was all the way in New York and the line was super long. My favorites here are the compost cookie, cereal milk ice cream, and birthday cake truffle.
$7.57 for a tiny cup of basic "cereal milk" soft serve and cornflake crunch. Crazy overpriced and not even good. Extremely underwhelming.
Had the corn cookie and cornflake/choc chip/marshmallow cookies. They were ok- not the same as NY. Not crunchy enough. Honestly buy the mix from target and make it at home and it'll be better.

Yay, they have gluten free and dairy free cookie options!!!!!! Thank you so much for this. Always great to have a little sweet at 1am after da club! Lol I hope soon you will have a lactose free milkshake option! You can call it the Diana menu.

When I was searching for dessert, this place showed up, and you would not believe how excited I was! About a month or two prior, I was in New York and had visited one of their locations twice to try a bit of everything. I fell in love with their cake truffles; especially the birthday cake truffles. This location is in The Cosmopolitan on the second floor with restaurants and shops. It is right in front of a set of escalators. It looks like a location you would see at a food court. It is a walk up counter where you order. There is a big pink sign that says "Milk" right outside, and they have a chalkboard menu above. When my husband and I went in the middle of the day, there wasn't a line (thank goodness), and we knew exactly what we wanted. The employee greeted us, we ordered the birthday cake truffles, paid, and we were on our way. They tasted exactly as I remembered them... delicious, yummy, soft, and sweet. It is a little pricey, but it is comparable to how much they charged in New York.

Didn't realize it was inside of the The casino we have to pay for Parking, walked a mile to get to the restaurant and of course Since was in this fancy hotel their prices were high so when I had purchased a piece of their birthday cake $14 for my birthday and it was dry as h***!!!! So disappointed

After watching Chef's Table and hearing the hype surrounding Milk Bar, we had to make it there during our visit to Vegas. Located in the Cosmopolitan, the Milk Bar is literally a walk up stand with no seating. We went with the favorites package which including a compost cookie, cereal milk soft serve, crack pie and pack of three birthday truffles. I was disappointed to see that aside from the soft serve, all the items were prepackaged. The crack pie slice was super small for the price but pretty tasty. I was unimpressed by the compost cookie and the cereal milk soft serve was only ok. I really loved the birthday truffles though. Overall it was a fun and indulgent menu but I was disappointed that the items weren't more fresh for the price.
I don't know if everybody was in line to be trendy or new place but this place sucked the ice cream taste disgusting and they were overpriced not recommended
The Location-/vegas-exclusive milkquake (strawberry&corn in our case) is pricey but one of the better options I've ever had at a Momofuku spot.
Cake was frozen and thawed, terribly dry. Was so pumped to eat here. Don't bother! $30 for two terrible slices.

After concert great convenient soft serve. Tried the cereal milk with corn flakes. It was good but should have split it and have a cookie or pie. Taking home cookies for the littles to try. Can't wait to see if they like them.

I was able to try both of the cake truffles and a few of the cookies. Everything was good but the cake truffles were amazing. I can't decide if I like the b-day cake or the chocolate flavor better. Next time I'm in Vegas I'm definitely going back to get more cake truffles.

Expensive and over rated. The crack pie is good, but not the best thing I ever ate. The bday cake milk quake was just OK. The ice cream texture wasn't my fave - too melty. I guess it didn't meet my expectations.

$15 for a slice of cake. I get it...it's Vegas...overcharge because you can. Handed to me was a freezing cold slice of birthday cake...dry, crumbly, overall just not that good. Question is- where are these cakes baked and how often? If the refridgerator is necessary, why sell cakes at all in this location. I love baking from the Milk Bar cookbook and was excited by the opportunity to try the real thing. I'm left feeling like a big fat loser.... stupid enough to think the high prices indicated fresh, quality goods. Got completely duped by all the hype.
Fast and friendly service.....and the most delicious Birthday Cake Shake. Wow! What a treat. I like this place and will happily return next time I am in Vegas.

Years, you guys. My visit to the Milk Bar has been at least 4 YEARS in the making, when I first heard about the amazing Crack Pie and Cereal Milk ice cream. I don't even remember where I heard about it but it's been in the back of my mind since then. I even made a copycat Crack Pie recipe that won a pie contest and was AMAZING. So I just HAD to try the real thing! Ugh it was disappointing. I mean the crack pie was okay but I'd rather just have like a $1 candy bar or something. The cereal milk ice cream was interesting at first bite but after that I just didn't want to eat it anymore, and that's not like me to stop eating ice cream. I couldn't finish it. My husband couldn't either. I think he was annoyed that I'd hyped this place up so much. Sorry hon. But now I know I can make a copycat crack pie that's better than the original!

I have stopped here two time already this winter while visiting Vegas. I have fallen in love with their corn cookie. I think it is just a unique flavor than your typical chocolate chip cookies and I usually pick up three with a crack pie and soft serve with cereal topping. All very unique and delicious. Last time my friend and I bought 1 container of 10 cookies each. Waiting for this summer to pick me some corn cookies on my way through Vegas!

The pink Milk sign is what caught my eye initially. I was in the mood for something sweet after dinner at the Cosmopolitan Hotel, and decided to grab dessert from Milk. There are a ton of options to chose from but I was personally in the mood for a soft serve so I went ahead with the cereal milk flavor with the corn flakes topping. It's definitely not a typical flavor but it literally does taste exactly like milk and cereal. They had two other flavors one was crack pie and the other was a chocolate something which were a little too sweet in my opinion. I'll go ahead and grab a milkshake next time.

I had high hopes for this after watching Netflix's Chef Table. I really admired Christina Tosi's creativity and hard work but everything we tried were not good at all. I've messed up a lot of cookies but they were edible.. The compost cookie was so hard and tasted like banking soda, we threw it away after a bite. The blueberry and cream was ok and soft but lacking the tasted of blueberry... crack pie was so teeny for $6 but I guess it's The Strip. Buttery but not that amazing. The birthday truffles were ok. The cereal milk with cornflakes was definitely worth it and it tastes exactly what a cereal milk taste like. But other than that.. maybe the NYC location is better.

Tried this place awhile ago not too long after it opened. I didn't have any ice cream but did try some of their cookies and crack pie. I don't get it. Their baked goods are gross. Lol. I really don't get it. But I suppose everyone who thinks their sandy textured, weird tasting stuff is tasty just have unique taste buds. Different strokes...

If you like really sweet cake, you might enjoy this. I found this cake to be dry and overly sweet. Its definitely over priced. IKEA has a slice of chocolate cake that's delicious and a much better value.

Was soo soo excited to try the anticipated Milk Bar with the opening of Momofuku! After dinner at Momofuku we decided to take some Milk Bar treats back to our house for dessert. Ordered two compost cookies, a blueberry & cream cookie, a cornflake-chocolate-chip-marshmallow cookie, a crack shake, two MilkBar totes (so cute!) & a full crack pie for my work office. Ate the conrnflake-chocolate-chip-marshmallow cookie & compost cookie right away. Both sooo delicious, unique, not too sweet & cooked perfectly. They had a great deal for buying three cookies vs. one and was informed they stay fresh room temp 3-5 days & in the fridge for a whole week. The crack shake was soo sweet but sinfully delicious, and the crack pie was a huge huge hit at my work. I forgot to order the famous cereal milk & crunchy cereal shake! The sweet potato pie soft serve looks so fun! We will be back soon to try more goodies. The cakes looked so good online but none were left (limited availability). Will order one online next event! Would definitely recommend for unique, delicious desserts.

Decided to try this out because of the hype around it. The corn flake flavored soft serve ice cream is certainly not worth the $6.00 they charge. If you want it sprinkled with some corn flakes, be prepared to fork out an additional $2.50 for a few cornflakes. The crack pie flavored soft serve was better, but maybe not worth $6.00 for a small portion.

Cereal milk soft serve! So good I think I could eat a pint by myself in one sitting. It's not overly sweet with a delicious malt taste like the whoppers malted chocolate balls from my childhood! Surprisingly refreshing for a soft serve. Definitely get it with corn flake topping! Wouldn't be the same without it. Been wanting to try it in NY but glad to finally try it here!
I got a cereal milk latte which is OK. But my friends got an affagato? The drink with Gelato and an espresso shot and I had a few bites of it and that was pretty good. So I would recommend that.

Strike 1- The dry confetti cake. Strike 2- The desecration of an already perfect classic, chess pie. Gummy and one note (served ice cold). Strike 3-The prices. I should have known better when I saw everything being mass produced in a commissary on Netflix's Chef's Table. Frosting the outside of a cake does serve a purpose- to keep it from drying out.

The birthday cake is the most overhyped thing I've ever eaten. It tasted like a grocery store cake with some flavored frosting. I'd rather gamble that 15 bucks away. Momofuku has been a giant pile of disappointment.

Got the funfetti cookie and the crack pie. The cookie was so amazing. I had it warmed up so it was extra delicious. The crack pie was just ok. Honestly, a little on the small side especially for $6.50 a slice. I tried a small taste of the corn cookie and crack pie soft serve. The corn cookie was the better of the two.

Omg!!!!! talk about cookies!!! I've never in my life enjoyed a cookie the way I did that day lol. My bf & I enjoy traveling just to eat and this is the biggest thing we regret is not getting more cookies or trying the ice cream. Previous to this trip we watched her on Netflix on how she started milk. Forget about all the cookies and ice cream spots you've had. This is def a must try!!!

Since I watched Chef's table, I was super excited to try Milk Bar. We bought the all favorite package, I think it was around $23 including cereal milk soft serve, birthday truffle, compost cookie and crack pie. They all turn out to be below average taste. They are all very very very sweet. Too sweet. I'm surprised how the show Chef's table featured the world's top restaurant Osteria Francescana in their episode 1. and Milk Bar in one of the other episode for pastry series. They are clearly not at the same level. This is my personal opinion, I am sure there are fans who just love the taste. But I truly doubt how this thing made Chef's table. Since milk bar is part of momofuku group, we also tried momofuku nextdoor and it was good!
Love the cereal milk soft serve with cereal bits. So good. Also ate way too many of their birthday cake truffles. Give them away to friends before you eat them all!

Beyond disappointing. Went here the second day after they opened at 10 am there doors were shut. Went again an hour later the doors were still shut. Went to concierge and they called them and they lied to concierge saying they've been open since 10. We came back today 1/7/17 a few days. We ordered the deal sampler thing, a coffee milk shake, and the birthday quake. We were trying to get a quick treat before having to walk over to bellagio for o and wanted to get free parking at cosmo while it lasted. We had 45 min, which we thought was plenty of time. No one was in line and 3 shakes were ordered before us (they obviously got there things before us and we saw). There had to be about 7-10 people on staff there. Only 1 person was making orders, everyone else was chatting in front of the register while this poor girl is struggling to make these orders. We were given the cookies and truffles and pie at the register so we had those but had to wait 25 minutes to get our milk shake and quake. Then had to remind them to give us our soft serve which they made ever so slowly. it was ice cream and cornflakes. We weren't sure why it took so long but we went with it. The compost cookie was terrible. I like pretzels and stuff, but it just tried too hard. The crack pie is def overrated. I would prefer the pecans. The lady described it like a pecan pie without pecans, I wasn't paying attention so i got excited for pecans to realize she said without them. that's my b,. The birthday truffle was too sweet for me. The birthday quake had an off taste that i wasn't a fan of and the coffee milkshake wasn't sweet enough oddly. We then were out 60 bucks and didn't like anything. So we went back with the milk shake hopping they would remake us something else. We asked what they recommended and we got a chocolate shake. Can't go wrong with that. We then realized we jinxed it. It was bitter and not sweet, so we tossed it in a garbage and left. I love the cosmo hotel, but there not putting good things in place of the old, and the prices are just highway robbery. I don't see this location lasting and go there with no expectations that way you might enjoy overpriced desserts, or just go to sweet raku!
Overpriced and bland. I've had better milkshake like Holsteins, strip burger or even in and out.

So I was so excited to go try some things from Milk bar after watching a show about the pastry chef behind the restaurant. The crack pie was small and nothing special. The cookies were pre-packaged and I was expecting fresh cookies based on all the hype over the milk bar... Not much of a big deal, they can still be good I thought. NO, I was wrong the cookies were hard and stale. I feel like they could've been good had they been fresh. It tasted like a cookie that had been left on the counter for a week. Literally worst cookie I've ever had hands down. Birthday cake truffles were okay, too gooey but not bad. The service was good. The people working their were super great. I didn't eat my treats until I got back to my condo or else I would've asked what the deal was. Oh well... save your money and find treats elsewhere.
Overhyped and not great. Order an milk ice cream for $7!! The ice cream ran just taste like funky.

Decided to come here since my co-workers we're saying how good it was. We were excited to go and try something new. We get there and Michele is the cashier , we are asking her questions and she just seemed over her job and gave us attitude. We asked her which size was the regular and "she's like they're over there" and we look over and there were 3 cups so we still didn't know which one was the regular and at that point we knew she didn't want to help us, so we got our order and left. The girl who then said "shake is ready" didn't say what it was and we looked at that counter and she's like yeah here. Over all the customer service was not great.

I think the place is super cute. The employees working the counter were nice & the guy made suggestions for me since it was my first visit. I was reading reviews on here & decided I had to try the slice of birthday cake and also got a baby chocolate malt shake. I was disappointed in the cake. It tasted like regular cheap grocery store cake. Had a few bites & threw it away ($14 for the cake) The chocolate malt shake was very good, I enjoyed it. Creamy & the pieces of malt were a good ratio. My friend ordered the White Russian shake that contains kahlua & vodka. He wasn't a fan. It was watery & he said it had a weird taste he couldn't describe. However there are quite a few choices & these are only a couple things, I would not return.

One of those rare times the hype matches expectations. Delightful service on top of amazing deserts. Was in Vegas for a conference at the Bellagio and walked over four nights in a row. My favorites were the Crack Pie and top item for me was the Cereal Milk Soft Serve with the Corn Flake toppings. Cheers to the Milk Bar team in Vegas, lights out.

I do not understand the negative reviews for this place! After watching the Netflix documentary I couldn't wait to try it during our stay in Vegas. We got the B-Day truffles, B-Day Latte, Cereal Milk Latte, Crack Pie, Bagel Bomb and Birthday Cake (don't judge, we were four people hungry for breakfast). The employees were so so nice and let us try all their soft serves (delicious). All our food was INCREDIBLE, I would definitely be back!!

Ok, I never write a review but I felt compelled to this time. My family and I have been on a Master Chef binge watch so when my daughter and I were in Vegas for a couple days we were very excited to go to Milk Bar. You how it feels when you're so exited to try something, spend a lot of money to do it, only to be disappointed? Sadly, that's the result of our experience. Let me start off by saying my daughter dies over birthday cake, and it's few and far between that we find one she doesn't like, so heck yeah I'll spend $15 for a slice of heaven! I ordered 2 pieces, one for us while there and one to take home to my husband and son. It looked beautiful, just like the pictures! So excited for the first bite, but we could barely get our fork through it because it was FROZEN! Ok, no problem because frozen cake can be good. Then the first taste. Hmmmm, weird. Another bite, ummm this is not good but we need to take bites of just the frosting and just the cake to figure this out. Basically what we figured out is that the frosting tasted like salty cream cheese frosting, and the cake tasted as if there was no salt added at all. I love the power of salt, and even put it in my morning coffee to enhance flavor, so to taste the cake that was flavorless because there was no salt, mixed with a slightly tangy very salty frosting was very weird. Next, we tried the birthday cake ice cream, because of course we love birthday cake and we get that flavor at every ice cream or frozen yogurt shop when available. Again, we were sadly disappointed. Have you ever tried salty ice cream? I'm so confused at this because I love salt so it's way overboard when it too salty for me! Last, we tried the milk bar pie, aka crack pie. While the flavor of this was good, the piece was small and again FROZEN. All in all, I'm glad we tried it, but wish I would've saved my $60 for something else.
So good! Cereal milk soft serve is amazing! The crack pie is also delicious! Will be there again!

Okay so you have to try this place at the Cosmopolitan hotel. Best shakes I've had in a while. The quake shakes are my favorite. I tried the chocolate sea salt dulce and it was out of this world. I also had a crack pie quake( you have to special request) and it was also a 10. I highly recommend and will come here again.

I've been waiting to try this place since I saw it on Instagram. The girl at the counter was very sweet and let me taste all the flavors before deciding on the Cereal Milk and Chocolate Pretzel twist and added chocolate chips. It was pretty good and presentation was fun and colorful. I would like to try something else on their menu next time and may skip the soft serve. I wish there were more options on ice cream (there are only 3).
The crack pie is no crazy delicious! I've been wanting to go to Milk Bar for a long time and it did not disappoint. Coffee was excellent and strong as well. Perfect for a late night sweet craving.

Give their cereal milk soft serve a try. It's pretty interesting. Texture is creamy and taste exactly like cereal. A great spot in cosmo if you are looking for some quick desserts like cookies, milk shakes and ice cream. Bare in mind they do not have any seating and it's to go only.

This place is so addicting and delicious! The cereal milk soft serve is so good. I bought a small and went back and bought a pint. It's a combination of creamy, crunchy and a little salty. The blueberry cream cookie is delicious too. I would drive out here just for this place.

Got the cereal milk soft serve with the frosted flakes. I found the frosted flakes too salty and the cereal milk was not sweet enough to balance it out. I was not a big fan of it, and thought that this was very overpriced.
Loved the hot cereal milk latte - sweet and a little salty! Cute stand in my favorite Vegas hotel

I have been a follower of Milk Bar on social media for what seems like forever so to be able to stop in a store I was very excited! Jessica was very patient and super helpful as to helping me decide what I wanted. The spiked milkeshake was delish. I also bought two containers of cookies to bring home to friends and a few cookies to take walking around LV - point of the story is you can't go wrong here, very much worth checking out!

Ok..I was so exited to try products from Christina since I watch her on Master chef and she is master baker...I was totally disappointed in her. compost cookie (had no flavor) and her milk shake with crunch, they were both totally underwhelming! I was in the Vegas Milk. The next day I went to the Hershey Store and had there Kit Kat chocolate chip cookie now that's a cookie. Needless to say I won't be going back to Milk!

this place was on my list..read about this place on fb newsfeeds..tried the cereal milk soft serve ice cream...crushed cornflakes sprinkled around vanilla soft serve in a cup..yummy! and i tried a slice of the crack pie..omg it was damn delicious! wish i bought more to take back home...i will definitely be back!!!

The fruity cereal milk ice cream with cereal on top is my favorite hands down. I love all the cookies, they are so moist and delicious. I've only had the grasshopper truffles but they definitely made me want to run back to try the others. AMAZING!

I ordered the chocolate pretzel soft serve as well as the compost cookie. The cookie was great, something different than your typical chocolate chip cookies. The soft serve has a sweet salty taste to it, but was not as smooth as expected, for $7 it's definitely overrated IMO.
It was definitely not as good as the hype was. We had the birthday milkQuake, which wasn't too bad, but the milkshake was bland. It was too pricey for what they serve. First and last time here

Tasted everything and was not impressed. It was not like the items were bad, just not worth the extra cost or wait. Reminded me of sweets/desserts you would get at a friends house after they rant and rave about them only to find they are only as good as store bought cookies and pies. Maybe New York store is better?? Birthday truffles were the best but nothing THAT great.

One of the few dessert places on the Strip that was recommended to me before I left for Christmas holiday. This is located inside the Cosmopolitan hotel. It is not obvious to find as the hotel malls themselves are a bit of a challenge to navigate through. Just as we were about to give up we found it...by luck. I got the fruity pebbles cereal soft serve. The soft serve was okay. I know that there are better ones in Vegas which I have been to (and will review later as I am catching up on all the Vegas reviews). It was super expensive, therefore, I shared a cone with my best friend which worked out for the best since we were going to a buffet later that day anyway. There is some sit down space inside but decided to just walk around the rest of the mall. Customer service was neutral.

A great place for a quick, post-dinner dessert and coffee cravings. Get the cookies ($3 each. Compost, corn, and blueberry are top notch), get the soft-serve ($6.95? Get the crack pie with the crunch topping), and pretty much anything really. Of course prices are gonna be at the high side because, duh, you're at the Cosmo. Service was friendly and quick. The only downside is the lack of seating. So I just grabbed a seat by the bar adjacent to Eggslut. Overall, if your sweet tooth beckons, give this place a shot.
Shakes are good but the location can not handle the high volume. The prices are high because it's on the strip but he service is bad, slow, and they forgot my order.
I bought some cookies, all of which were stale and extremely dry. It's such a disappointment that they sell goods past their sell by date. Perhaps this isn't the best location to visit
So glad they got a west side location! Now they need to come to LA. Love their cereal milk ice cream. I crave it often. Bought their overpriced cookies in bulk because they don't have an LA location.
I was so excited to try Milk. The cake was calling my name. The cake was moist but the texture confused me. I don't think I like my cake to be crunchy. Flavor tasted like a birthday cake.

The cookies are $8 each and unfortunately they're a little less enjoyable than the cookie my local Subway gives me for free if I choose to dine in. Sure, the idea of a corn cookie seems fun, and blueberry and cream sounds great, but in the end they're just kind of stale tasting.
It's like being a kid again eating Carnation malted ice milk. I love this place although this time it messed up my stomach a bit. Worth it? Yup

Milk Bar's neon sign and takeout window is easy to find on the second floor of the Cosmopolitan, right in front of the escalators and beside Momofuku. I'd heard so much ('too sweet", "overhyped", "nostalgia perfected", etc.), and my experience was that we enjoyed what we tried. Nothing was life-changing - but then again, I don't necessarily want my life changed by a sugary treat. The cereal milk soft serve tasted like cereal milk, and the caramelized corn flake crumbs sprinkled on it were fun. The chocolate cake batter soft serve was really intense, like frozen thick cake batter. We tried the confetti cookie, corn cookie, compost cookie, corn flake/marshmallow/chocolate cookie, and chocolate/chocolate cookie. Favorite cookie was the corn flake/marshmalow/chocolate because the sweet, salty, soft, crunchy was in perfect balance, followed by the confetti cookie because it tasted like the cookie version of a tasty vanilla birthday cake. The chocolate/chocolate and corn cookies were yummy at the time but ultimately forgettable, and the compost cookie was polarizing - some of us were turned off by the coffee grounds, others had an issue with the potato chip/pretzel bits that were unpredictably crunchy, one person loved the guilty pleasure of a cookie made from junk food compost. Yes, prices are on the high end (cookies are $4).

So glad this New York staple has made its way to Vegas. I'd never had it before, but have heard about how awesome it is. My love for this place is all in the birthday cake truffles and crack pie. You'll never get anything that tastes like it does here. The actual birthday cake is also worth the $60 if you're splurging. The soft serve is good, but definitely not what I expected. It's super cool that it's made from cereal milk, but the corn flake ice cream isn't as sweet as I expected it to be.

Kinda a bit of a sellout. Pre-package. And $6.50 for a piece on crack pie in a box like you would get it at McDonald's. No impressed at all. And $52 for the whole pie. WTF !!! Not impressed at all. Seems almost like a get rich quick scheme. Was so excited to try this place and was a total let down

It was all right. We went there with my husband for a late night snack. It was nothing special price a little high because it's the Strip the ice cream taste not as exceptional as you would expect but overall good experience

Can we talk about the milkshakes here? To die for! My sister and I both got the "fancy shakes" (boozey); I had the birthday cake and she had one of the chocolate ones (malt, I believe). The birthday cake shake is full of birthday cake pieces and sprinkles and it was seriously delicious! A little pricey for a milkshake but, hey, it is in the Cosmopolitan. Be careful, though; these things are dangerous and I left with a buzz after one shake!

Ahh Milk, locates in either the second or third floor of Cosmopolitan where the ambiance seems hip, futuristic, and glittery. I had the most eccentric opinion about this place out of every other places I reviewed. Their cereal milk ice-cream is unique where it has like a frosted flakes after taste, with an initial sweet and salty taste. When I first tried it, I thought it was nothing special and actually disliked the fact that my dessert tasted salty. So one bite turned into 2, and then to 3, and eventually it was all good. After I finished it, I was thinking to myself, I'm not even sure if I liked it or not, but I just kept eating it. But after thinking about it, I realize that this place is actually pretty good. The ice-cream is soft and creamy and has plenty of unique flavors. The more I think about it, the more I start craving it. Very weird in terms of how I realized I like Milk more than I imagined. Ask for sample sizes!! for the portions are generous. Only knock off was that the taste is somewhat inconsistent. I've had this place about 3-4 times and sometimes the ice-cream is saltier than other times. Besides that, it's definitely one of my to-go dessert spots if I'm in Cosmo!

I adore Milk and all things Christina Tosi, this location at the Cosmopolitan is crucial, the wait time is super short (especially in contrast to their Village locations), if only they had volcanos, it would be perfect. PS: serve volcanos.
Don't understand the hype. The crack pie wasn't that addicted, too sweet for my taste bud. Corn flake ice cream was okay. one cookie for $4.50, oh cmon!

The Milk Bar was a great treat after lunch. The prices are a bit high for what you get but overall the food was good. I had the crack pie which is a very small portion. I also had the crunchy cereal milkshake which was the best thing we ordered. The cinnamon was also good but the taste was very strong and got old quick. The difference between the milk shake and milk quake is the quake is more like a DQ Blizzard. I would go back for an after mean snack again and would stick to the Milkshake.

What's with the bad reviews? I came here on a Sunday night and didn't have to wait much in line. The guy working the counter was super sweet and gave me great recommendations. He had me sample a few things and I decided to order the cereal milk soft serve with cereal flakes as a topping. Goodness. It was amazing. Tasted exactly like sweet cereal milk. I noticed a lot of negative reviews complained about price. Come on people, this is Vegas, and you're ordering from a place inside the Cosmo. Obviously it's going to be a bit on the pricier side. Doesn't take away from how good the ice cream tastes. I wasn't as crazy about the milkshake as I was the soft serve, hence one star off.

I'll give this place a solid three, ordered a milkshake, birthday cake flavor that was just so-so. I ordered three individually packaged cookies that were pretty good. Worth another visit but if you're looking for a good place for desserts, go to Holsteins right around the corner.

Overpriced desserts? Check. Celebrity Chef? Check. Popular hotel? Check. But you have to try it right? I ordered a chocolate cereal milkshake. When I saw her put in the fudge and milk, I was like "I hope this $9 shake has something unique" She then put in the soft serve and blended it. Solid shake, definitely tasted like cocoa puffs.
