The waffle cone was perfectly done where it has a nice crispy outside and it still chewy inside and the ice cream and filling as delicious as well. I'm looking forward to coming back and trying their other flavors!

Tried Korean ice cream for the first time. I ordered the upside down with cookies and custard to fill the fish waffle. The ice cream was very creamy and smooth and the waffle cookie was much bigger than expected. It was a lot of nice cream for the size of the cup! Could barely finish it. Parking was easy. Big lot to the side of the shopping center. Was pretty busy when we went.

The korean icecream here is delicious! You'll find a few Asian favorites on the menu such as Ube, Thai Tea & Matcha. They have Strawberry & Oreo flavors to name a few. I loved how adorable the pancake fishes are! My only complaint is seating... there is very limited seating here & I wouldn't recommend this place for a meet up on a busy evening. Unfortunately my family had to stand as we tried to enjoy each other's company and we really couldn't. I wish there were regular tables so people can converse.

Having SomiSomi for dessert for the first time. In the same plaza as Nielsen's Custard. Just as busy too. Even more maybe. Line was full from when I entered till when I left. I tried the upside down waffle cone. Regular milk flavor with Nutella filling, topped with graham cracker and strawberry. Definitely a do over. I'll be a little more adventurous and try the Oreo next time. Staff was very friendly and working hard.
The best ice cream I ever had in my life and the taiyaky really good too . I highly recommend somi somi to everybody .

Perfect spot for your social media photos :P The staff and vibe is very inviting and friendly and the line went by quick! Here's how to order the deliciousness: 1. Order the type of taiyaki (fish shaped waffle) and filling if you want 2. Choose your ice cream flavor-- How you want the fish to eat your ice cream hahaha 3. Then when your order is ready, they ask if you want additional toppings on top of your ice cream. I can't remember 100% but I think we had options for: coconut shavings, graham crackers, cereal, and strawberry I ordered my taiyaki on the side, because I know me and the fish will fall or melt with with taro filling (SOOOOO DELECTABLE) and Ube ice cream (not my favorite but others liked it). ENJOY!!

Cute ice cream store on Eastern! Loved the swirl specials and the taiyaki! I got the mango honeydew and loved it. Daughter got the ube ice cream and she enjoyed it very much. If you want to cool down and have a little something sweet, stop by somi somi! =)

Soooo good! I love the combination of the slightly bitter matcha ice cream with the sweet red beans and the soft, sweet taiyaki pastry. You guys do this right! Getting it in the cup with the taiyaki on top is the way to go. That was you can use the fish as the scoop and every bite will have everything in it.
Sooo good! Love when the fish waffle is kind of soft and chewy instead of hard and crunchy. Ice cream and toppings are delicious! Love it here!!!

I came here last night for the first time and it was delicious! Upon entry there was a short line but it moved pretty quickly. I ordered the upside down ahboong with Nutella filling and cookies and cream soft serve, topped with Oreo crumbles and graham cracker dust. My siblings ordered the upside down ahboong with red bean filling and Ube soft serve. We were all happily satisfied and will definitely come back!
SO DELICIOUS! Ube is my favorite with custard and taro filling! It's a must try... u will LOVE it!

I'm not entirely sure how I haven't written a review on this place yet because I think we've already been about four or five times since we first decided to experience it. SomiSomi is absolutely DELISH and I'm so happy there is a location in Henderson now. This location is located off Eastern in the same shopping center as Taco y Taco and Crepe Expectations. The shop is very bright and welcoming. There's nowhere to sit inside, but there are a couple of seats outside if you want to stay and hangout. For us, we would just take it and sit in the car because taking ice cream home is damn near impossible without it melting everywhere. The menu is super simple and easy to select from. I think they rotate the flavors out because we've been a couple times and it's been different. I tend to always go for the matcha and ube swirl! And if you aren't getting your soft serve ah-boong style, you're missing out. They serve it in a cup and top it with the taiyaki, which is basically a fish waffle. And you can pick the spread you want inside. They have nutella! HELL YEAH! That's what I get with it. Seriously, this ube and matcha combo is fantastic. We are definitely addicted to this ice cream place and crave it so much now. Definitely recommend if you love soft serve.
Kind service! Helped me on my first trip Soft Serve was crazy and its just different (in a good way) worth the drive

It was my first time trying Somisomi and I am in love!! I've been meaning to try for years and Somisomi didn't disappoint. The hype is realll! I got the matcha swirl with custard filling! So goood. Can't wait to try their other flavors. Will be back here very very soon!

We bought 5 cheddar today and all of them are still raw. I ate one while driving at night so I had no idea about it. I thought it was weird cus it's sweet. It's my first time buying taiyaki at this location.
Too good! So happy with this location, nice a clean with outdoor seating. Pricing isn't too bad and staff is friendly

Somisomi does it again! New location in Henderson!! My baby loved his oreo ice cream, and I got to try their Thai tea ice cream (forgot to take picture because I inhaled it, lol) I haven't seen this flavor at any other locations so I was excited to try it and glad I did. It was bomb!! Not overly sweet but I could definitely taste the Thai tea flavor. Their ice cream is always on point no matter which flavor you get. Super creamy and not too sweet. Cute and simple interior. Currently they serve ahboong upside down to limit contact, but I like it that way way anyway. Not a problem! You get a free taiyaki this weekend if you get one ah boong, but I made sure I got a box to go. Their taiyakis are so chewy inside. So good! Just like the location in the Shanghai plaza, staff here was friendly and nice, too. Will definitely be coming back soon!!

I really like this place. The only thing that kept me from giving it five stars is that I feel the taiyaki could be cooked just a little longer. I've bought it many times and every time I buy it the inside is still just a bit underdone. Still, I will continue to come here because the flavors are great and the service is great too.
Sooooo good! Taiyaki is hot, soft, crispy, chewy, and mildly sweet all at the same time.
A Filipino family owns this place so when I am home sick I come here and order the hot Taho or Boba tea. They have great ice cream flavors, too!

Scooptopia automatically receives a high rating by default simply because of where they source their ice cream. Scootopia uses ice cream from Scooptacular, this little ice cream shop in Laveen that makes some of the most amazing ice cream that I've ever tasted. The fact that the same ice cream can be obtained here rather than driving to Laveen is enough to make me very happy. As for the other desserts, such as the halo-halo? I can't speak for those, as it will require a return visit which I fully intend on doing sooner rather than later. But if you're in the mood for some superb ice cream? Swing by here and order yourself a Cookie Monster. Check them out!

I was on a mission to find halo halo on our stop in phx. The one they make at scooptopia is beautiful, just not the proportions I'm used to. Halo halo is difficult because everyone's got their preferences for sure, so every family makes it totally different. Lots of ice, missing creamy goodness and more of that purple deliciousness that is ube ice cream. If you're a lover of the textured ice and jelly preserves this is gonna be your jam. It satisfied my craving but I also stopped at the market before getting home to pick up more ube ice cream.

Not a bad spot if you're craving ice cream! As a disclaimer, I did not visit the store in person, nor have I tried the halo-halo, so I'm unable to comment on those. I ordered some ice cream from here through Grubhub and it came cold, creamy, and tasty. I liked the cookies and cream flavor, which was fresh! Unfortunately they ran out of the strawberry flavor, and they ended up substituting it with strawberry + cheesecake (it was roughly the same, it just had cheesecake chunks in it). I appreciated them calling me first to confirm that I was ok with the change, and they wrote an apology on the delivery bag containing my food, which was quite sweet. Overall, I would come back to have more of the ice cream, as the service and food were both great!

Stopped by with my little one after dinner on a Sunday evening. The staff is so warm and kind. I didn't think I had enough small bills to pay and was rummaging through my bag to find change and the girl assisting me was about to use her tip money to pay the difference which was so nice but I didn't let her because she earned those tips The selections is quite vast here, both for ice cream and shaved ice flavors. The prices are reasonable, less than other places I've seen and, I have to say, the cotton candy flavor was actually amazing and not overdone like it can be. I'm am definitely coming back. 10/10 recommend. My daughter loved it!!!

There's only like 3 places my husband and I would drive out to Phoenix for from the East Valley and Scooptopia is one of them. :) I am so happy that there's a Filipino desserts spot in such a fun area of Phoenix. They seriously serve the best halo halo in town! I have yet to go and try their taho, and I'm sure it's just as good. They also have the best customer service ever! You don't want to miss out on this place.

Rating 3.5 TLDR: If youre looking for halo-halo, come here. However, don't be too surprised, it tastes like any other halo-halo. So, its really up to what youre craving. Please keep in mind, this rating is based solely off my order halo halo, and not a rating for their other desserts. Not TLDR: Its been a while since I've had some Filipino dessert; specifically halo-halo. Where I live now, there isnt halo halo. So, when I found out that this place had this, my wife and I had to check it out. We drove from Tempe to this little hole in the wall, and it was the perfect time for desserts since it was still pretty warm. We arrived, and got their signature dessert: halo halo. It was good, but nothing amazing. It did satisfy both our cravings though. The service was impeccable, and the other desserts looked great. However, I have to give it 3.5 stars for their most reviewed item; which left me unimpressed. Based on other reviews, I have no doubt the other desserts are good. Give this place a try based on the other reviews; however, if youre looking for a mind blowing halo-halo, come knowing that it tastes like the rest. Good but not AMAZING.
Wonderful customer service! Good selection of unique ice cream flavors. Halo halo was delicious and the perfect amount of sweetness. Would highly recommend the taro ice cream!

Iscalet was the most fabulous associate. She was friendly she was competent and she deserves a raise! The ice cream was insanely good, I sampled a few and decided on peanut butter and Rockyroad in a waffle cone, which was crisp and delicious. This was the perfect dessert after a wonderful Chinese dinner
Awesome place--super Halo Halo. Even came with a color changing spoon! So delightful. Will be coming back often. Thank you guys!!

the store is filled with a lot of nothing. i got oreo boba there and it was straight ass. It tastes like oreos in water, with hints of PEANUT BUTTER and milk. the tapioca boba texture was like a ball that was hella tore up. i wouldn't recommend getting boba there. and there wasn't boba pricing ANYWHERE. additionally my girl got a double scoop 8oz of ice cream in a plastic cup it was about 7 dollars. the portion is unrealistically small. i would just get a pint of ice cream from a store.
One of my daughters favorite ice cream places! I love the piÃ±a colada Boba! Everything is delicious

I usually come here for halo-halo but today will be 1 star because for some reason the guy who made our halo-halo was slow and didn't put enough fruits/ingredients in our halo-halo. Or maybe they are trying to be stingy with recipe.

Made it in about 30 minutes before close, and after waiting 20 minutes for the line to clear, we arrive at the counter only to hear they are not making any of the things we wanted. Disappointed, we left. Why staff your place with one person to close on a Friday night. The lone girl working had such great vibe and smile, so this rating has nothing to do with her or the yummy looking desserts.

My brother and I were craving some Ice Cream tonight and instead of going to our usual placce (Churn), we decided to Yelp another ice cream shop - and I am so glad we did!!! We now have our new go-to spot. The owners, Paul and Gina, were super duper friendly! We ordered Halo Halo (Filipino Dessert with crushed ice, evaporated milk, ice cream, flan, and all other good stuff) and a bunch of Taho (Filipino Sweet Tofu Dessert). Both were amazing, and made me reminisce so much of my childhood in the Philippines. They also have a huge selection of ice cream, as well as shaved ice and boba. We only live three minutes away (which is super dangerous for us) because we would want to be back every. single. day.

My husband and I stopped here on a Saturday afternoon. It was a perfect stop during our long bike ride. The employees were so very friendly and helpful. They really seemed to care about what I ordered and that I liked it. Everything thing I tried was very good. We'll be back for sure.

I'm always on the hunt for ways I can meet the tooth fairy sooner than later. This little hidden gem is perfect for sweets and desserts for my cravings. I can see why the Halo Halo is a hit and their best seller. The right combination of sweet and goodness. I had the large and overstuffed myself off the grass jelly and taro topping. That pirouline straw is bomb. Not to mention, it's pretty to look at as you stuff your face with it. My nieces got the taro and peach and lychee boba. They thought it was a bit sweet but good flavor. The owners are so sweet and they have regulars that bring in more guests. Aside from the sweets, they serve food too. The day we were in their daily special was noodles but I came for just dessert. I definitely will be back to try the other items if I can be persuaded to give up the Halo Halo. Life is short, make it sweet. Besides, who counts the calories when you got memories of goodness to bank on?!
Very friendly service and lots of choices. It was nice that they still offer free samples, because a lot of places have stopped them. We'll definitely be back!

This place is absolutely delicious! We got their oatmeal ice cream and their Halo Halo and we both inhaled everything! Everything is fresh, the oatmeal had crunchy and chewy pieces of cookie and the halo halo was beautiful and so delicious! We can't wait to come back and try more flavors!!! Thank you to the owners for their incredible hospitality!!!

My friends and I wanted some dessert and we stopped by after looking it up on yelp. This place used to be a wedding cake place and I remember coming here to do my cake tasting. We were greeted by the staff upon entering. They had a variety of desserts from ice creams, bobas and specialty desserts. I ordered the Halo Halo and my husband got the Thai tea. I thought the Halo Halo was good. I love all the different components of the dessert but wished they put more of the taro ice cream. We were not a fan of the Thai tea. The taste was off and the boba tasted weird. Overall the staff was friendly, place was clean and I enjoyed my dessert.

The greatest customer service I've ever experienced!! I love that their ice cream aren't too sweet. With their ice cream or any drinks they serve, you can really taste the flavors. It's unlike any other dessert where the sugars over powering and that's all you taste. I feel this place is so underrated and deserves more attention. The texture of their boba was really good too. Soft and not overly chewy but bouncy. The lady up front who helped us was really nice! She gave us samples of ice creams and made sure we were satisfied. Their black sesame and banana ice cream was to die for! Their taro ice cream in my opinion tasted better than the magnolia taro ice cream they sell at the Asian stores. Will definitely recommend this shop to my friends and family.

During these times, I found out about this place from a sibling who picked up ice cream. It was some of the best coffee ice cream I've had. I went back myself and found myself at a really nice Filipino owned drinks and dessert shop. I've seen ordered from there half a dozen times. They have my favorite milk teas, especially their Thai Tea, which are strong! Their Halo Halo is something very unique if you've never had it before with quite a memorable texture.
Ever since coming here, I get craving for their boba frequently. I bring my friends everytime they visit from out of town.

Friendly staff and great location. This is a can't miss! The oatmeal cookie dough and red velvet ice creams were sinfully delicious. I opted for the Hula Hula. Once they gave me instructions on how to properly eat it, I must say best thing I've had all day.

This place is spotless clean and they have all kind of flavors, interactive toys for lil kids, snow cones and a lot of treats ., We love that they create different flavors also the lady was very nice with us she even let us get an advantage to try a new flavor they are creating (red velvet/cookie monster) that was so nice of her . Also they give you samples so you can try before buying the whole scoop

The pacific sunset snow-cone and the cookies & cream ice cream are the best you'll find in town. My boyfriend and I love coming in for pints of ice cream to-go, along with our dessert for that night. You guys are the absolute best and the owner is so nice! Theres just one thing....the amount of times we have been craving a snow cone or some scoops of ice cream after 8pm is insane. We wish you guys would be able to find a way to stay open later, we know in Arizona a lot of people don't come out until the sun goes down. For the summer you should look into this maybe as the sun will be going down at 8pm. We can't wait to enjoy your delicious food again.
This is a super unique little ice cream shop that serves delish Halo Halo..... If you haven't had it before, you should go here and try it, I really enjoyed it! Prices are pretty standard.

An all around good place for ice cream that has a unique menu with lots of other treats. I was a little nervous when I walked into the store because of a group of maskless teenage girls walking around the store and talking very loudly (it was hard to hear the server!). We ordered small ice creams with two scoops each. I got kulfi and horchata and my husband got kulfi and german chocolate. I was impressed by the unique flavor selection (they have flavors like play doh and unicorn poop). The ice cream itself was just ok though.

Delicious! Took my kids and mom to this place to enjoy a sweet treat. I've been wanting halo-halo (Filipino deliciousness) for a long time. Found this gem when I literally looked up halo halo in the Phoenix area. Super friendly staff. Found out their yummy ice cream is sourced from Scooptacular which in near my hood in Laveen in which I also love! It's like supporting my locals times 2.

i came in with friends and we all couldn't be happier with the service provided. i've come back two times since then, and received the same exact energy. the staff are extremely friendly and went out of their way to make sure my friends ice cream looked HAPPY. every flavor is so good, the place is clean, and they even offered to serve us as they were closing. i will always tell people to come here first, it's my favorite ice cream place

I have been looking for Taho since I moved here in AZ and they have the authentic tasting Taho I can find! They also have other Filipino desserts like ube/taro cake, biko (sweet rice cake), ice cream as well. I like the Abuelita flavored ice cream! This is my new favorite place! They also have other flavored drinks and milk teas!

I stopped by Scooptopia by chance while I was in the area. The Yelp photos of the Halo Halo looked too tempting. If I'm going to be honest, it was my first time ever having one, so I'm not sure if my opinion counts, but I'd have to say it was absolutely delicious. I'm a big fan of shaved ice and have been seeing many different cultural versions of it. This Filipino version, while not served with shaved ice (I think it's crushed), was filled with a variety of ingredients. It had ube ice cream, sweet beans, coconut, sago, flan (which idk if it was homemade but it was soooo good), and much more. I wish they had a location in Chandler, but for now, if I'm in the area again, I'll make a stop!

Went in for the first time tonight. Gina (seemed like the owner) was very friendly and accommodating. She had tons of recommendations and did everything her power to make sure we were happy with our choices. Which we were. They had tons of different dessert options! I would definitely recommend. Great service and ice cream!

Yes please! This is the perfect neighborhood icecream place. The ice cream is locally made in Laveen. The workers are extremely nice and accommodating. The icecream and the Halo halo were both amazing and exactly what I want when I go out for a cold sweet treat.

Absolutely fantastic place. Loved the environment and the owners. Can tell it is a very family oriented ice cream shop. The variety of flavors are unique including Cookie Monster, unicorn poop and play doh. If you go, definitely try out their halo halo and boba!
Great service from Paul and Gina shared, catered here at FAMAZ org Xmas Party!! Ube ice cream is smooth, not super sweet and just right. Yummy!!

I heard about this place from a friend and how they have the best Halo Halo in Phoenix. I may not be the best point of reference because I only had Halo Halo once or twice in my life so I don't know if I had the best baseline. Upon walking in the shop, I was warmly greeted by the workers. I was the only one in the shop and get offered to answer any questions I had. They have a vast array of ice cream. They do not make their own ice cream but buys from a local ice cream supplier. If you want options for both traditional and slightly different flavors, I definitely recommend coming here. Additionally, they have shave ice and other specialty desserts, like Halo Halo. I ordered the Halo Halo and eating it was like a party in my mouth. So many textures and flavors in one dessert. No component was too sweet or an odd texture. It all worked together really well. Overall, it was a balanced dessert. The dessert comprises of shave ice, jellies, beans, nuts, and a cookie straw. The best part? The taro ice cream! It was flavorful and rich! I would go back just for the ice cream! I don't even really know all of the ingredients but I just remember it being really good. The dessert was around 6 dollars, which I was totally fine with because it goes to supporting local businesses. I recommend giving them a try because they are good people with a good business!

I scream... you scream.. we all scream for ice cream! I had just finished dinner and was craving something sweet. There were a few spots for ice cream & I'm so happy I went with scooptopia and tried something new! I was helped by the owner who was just the sweetest person ever. Her customer service was 100! Allowed me to try all the flavors and they do not skip out on hooking you up with ice cream. I went with the cheesecake and horchata flavors... OMG YUM!! The ice cream was just so creamy and good! I will be coming back to try more!

First time walking in with my lil family Found it on yelp like i find any other place. I was very pleased with the service & the time they took to explain what comes in Halo Halo. Oh my was this Halo amazing ! 10/10 Must stop by & try this place.
Great service, great people, great ice cream!!! The flavors they offer are so authentic, and they taste EXACTLY like the name of the ice cream.

I absolutely love their service! Not only are they very friendly, but they are Filipino owned! I will be telling more people about this place. Everything is yummy. Snow cones, ice cream, & boba! Try their halo halo as well. You won't regret it!

This was my second visit. Had the traditional taho. Brought me back to my childhood. Also, it was perfect for a rainy day. They also have excellent halo-halo. They do their own ice cream and the selection is great. They've only been open since August. Hope they'll be around for a while.

What a great place! The ice cream was outstanding and very creamy! They had some unique flavors that were really good! The owner Gina (don't know if I spelled her name right), was very nice! We spent some time talking with her and she was very friendly! We will definitely return when we come back to Phoenix. We came back again, when we came back to Phoenix! They were again amazing! We spoke with Gina again and got to meet some of her beautiful family. This is a special place!

Found Scooptopia after seeing a post about it on the AZ Asian Chamber of Commerce's instagram. We came here just for the Halo-halo and the ube ice cream-- they were both great! They also have lots of different flavors of ice cream and shaved ice. The space itself was clean and even had a kids' room where kids could play games and watch movies. Service was great and the owners were very nice. Definitely our new go-to Halo-halo place.
Amazing halo halo not a lot of places I can get halo halo in Arizona so Scooptopia is a lifesaver

We were craving an Ube milkshake and in our search, Scooptopia came up. This was a great find! The halo halo was SO good, one of the best I have ever had. Sadly, we missed out on the Ube with white chocolate chips cookies. The owner was so nice explaining her specialty desserts. Not too far, so we will definitely be back.

Ohhh so very yummy desserts! Try them all! We had the taro soy bean curd, halo halo, and some ice cream. Definitely check out this place! Workers are friendly. However, there is very limited seating inside. Thankfully there are a couple of benches sprawled throughout this shopping cove, so you may enjoy your dessert out here!
Awesome service! Even better ice cream and boba tea!! Loved every part of the experience definitely will be returning!
I really love this place! Especially since it's so close to home! Only thing is I wish they were open a little later especially on weekends.

This place had a pretty confusing and complicated menu to choose from! There were so many options on so many boards placed around their store. I got a birthday cake snow cone that was honestly less than exciting! I feel like I just paid $6 for watery ice. I wish they had more basics and staples in their menu selection. Also, when asking the girl behind the counter what all of the more elaborate creations were she had a difficult time even explaining them and had to look for someone else to explain what was in them. There are too many other good ice cream places in phoenix that i won't be returning to eat here.
Love love halo halo!!! So glad this spot opened up close to my place. Love their cookies and cream ice cream too! Def will be back !
They have amazing ice cream and boba tea.Great customer service, employees where super nice and friendly. Explained everything on the menu and let us try many flavors of ice cream.

Highly recommend! They have great flavors if you want to try something new, or if you just want the classics. Most importantly it is family owned by very sweet and nice people. They will make sure you're happy with your purchase.

Saw that they had halo halo and I had to try it out. Couple working were super nice! We tried some of their ice cream flavors while we were waiting and they were all good. The oatmeal cookie, taro, and Thai tea were all tasty. The halo halo is also awesome. Give it a try for a unique dessert!

Been here twice for the halo halo and love it! I'm so glad there's an Asian-inspired dessert spot that is so close by. The GM here is super nice. I love being able to sample ice cream and drinks. But let's get to the good stuff - the halo halo is amazing. It's made fresh by hand when you order, so it's not a premade concoction sitting in a freezer. If it was socially and fiscally acceptable to get one every day, I totally would. But I'll stick to getting it as a treat here and there. There's everything from red bean, to ube ice cream, egg pudding, beans, coconut jelly, etc. that make it taste authentic and homemade. The small is a good size equivalent to a short milk shake. The large is pretty huge, looks double the size of the small. Both sizes have all the toppings proportionately. They also have little treats like Pocky available for purchase. Go try it out! The quality is great, and the price point is fair. Makes it that much better, yum!

I found this hidden gem on yelp and decided to try something different. We did visit the location, during the takeout only services and the owner greeted us with such enthusiasm and was so nice. She explained all the items on the menu, told us a little about their specialities and ultimately we ended up with the Thai tea and Halo Halo! We have since been back and brought our family to enjoy! They loved it and this is by far one of my favorite dessert places. We can't wait to go back and I would highly recommend Scooptopia if you are looking for great service, delicious desserts and friendly conversation!

This was my first day in AZ and wanted some dessert and found this place on the maps nearby so I went to go check it out since it was highly rated and the ice cream that I have tried there in this photo was all amazing, I definitely would recommend to anyone that wants different flavored ice cream that you can't find in stores.

Finally!! A great place for ice cream and halo halo in downtown Phoenix!! Super friendly staff and the halo halo was fantastic!! Found my place for great desserts and the variety of ice cream is GREAT!!
Very friendly atmosphere and owners. They have a great selection of ice cream flavors, and their halo halo tastes amazing! Definitely will be visiting this place often.
This might be my new go-to ice cream spot. They have so many yummy and unique flavors. The owners are incredibly friendly and kind. The ice cream is all locally made too.

Came here because the Halo Halo looked so good. And we were not disappointed! It was far better than the kind we tried in Vegas, and the owner is very enthusiastic about sharing this Filipino dessert. We loved it so much we ordered more of the Ube/Taro ice cream. The owner let us taste several other ice cream flavors. They have several unique flavors and they are all very well made. We'll definitely come back here!
Owners are so friendly. Ice cream, boba and halo halo was delicious. First time eating halo halo, so good. We will be back. We even sang karaoke. So much fun..

I go here at least once a week. The owners and staff here go out of there way to treat you with kindness and respect. The want you to be satisfied. Highly recommend this place. Hidden gem in central Phoenix.
We tried the Halo-Halo for the first time and it was good. Restaurant was clean and the owners are really nice. Will definitely come here again

While the selection isn't huge, the flavors offered are unique and delicious. And the price is incredibly reasonable! My kids and I got 2 cones with very generous scoops and toppings and a milkshake for only about $14. Plus the women working were very sweet & the restaurant itself was impeccably clean.
What an amazing Thai iced tea!! The owner was so nice and sweet! I recommend the Thai tea ice cream. Everything thing was so great!

They are super nice and helpful here! I was a first time customer and they gave me helpful opinions so I could choose a flavor. I went for a boba drink, mango with strawberry popping boba. I've never used a paper boba straw so that was cool they had that. My drink was a little too sweet for me, but I think that was just my personal preference. I would definitely come back and try something different!

Found this amazing little place one night while on the hunt for a new dessert place. AMAZING!!! The Halo Halo I had was the best ever. All the ingredients were so fresh and the Ube ice cream was so flavorful and the texture was incredible. We also tried the shaved ice. This place serves the closest thing I have ever had to genuine Hawaiian shaved ice. They add ice cream and the sweet cream making it behind delicious. The customer service was outstanding and they were so friendly. I think I have found my new spot!

It was my first time going and it was amazing! The ice cream and drinks were the BEST you will not be disappointed! They gave me and my hubby some cards to stamp for the next time we go so we can eventually get a free one and we will definitely be going back again and again!
Tried the Thai tea and the matcha float. So good! Definitely coming back for the butterbeer ice cream.

Had their amazing Halo Halo. My BF is Filipino and gave it a 5/5! It's a perfect balance of sweet and refreshing without being overly sweet. The owner explained how her jelly is her secret recipe and I'd vouch that it as well as the taro ice cream was delicious. The owners were so nice and welcoming it felt like we were at a family reunion! Def recommend!

We were planning on getting ice cream from Churn, but the line was way too long. I'm glad it was, otherwise we never would have come to try Scooptopia. This place is amazing! It's family-owned and features a great selection of homemade flavors, ranging from oatmeal cookie (which was so good) and rocky road, to black sesame and avocado lime. Prices were also very affordable for an ice cream shop in Phoenix. We'll definitely be back when we're in the neighborhood.
Best shaved shaved ice in the valley that I have found thus far. Lots of flavors to choose from and they also have ice cream and other treats.

This is a really cute spot for some ice cream, boba, shaved ice, or even specialty drinks like the "Halo Halo" drink I ordered and more. It's filled with a lot of yummy ingredients. Super refreshing in this 108 degree weather haha. The owner is wonderful and they give overall great service. Give it a try!!

I scream, you scream, we all scream for ice cream! I love this place! Scooptopia offers fun flavors and their Rocky Road and Grasshoper are the best. The staff at Scooptacular are extremely friendly and accomdating. The ice cream shop is family owned and they believe in giving back the community. If you're looking for creating tasting ice cream at unbelievable prices, stop by Scooptopia you won't be disappointed.

I felt it fell short of 5 stars. The ice cream wasn't anything special. I had the chocolate overload and wasn't too impressed. My friend had a slushie and said it was good. They may have better flavors and other combinations but I felt it was "ok". The staff was friendly. Overall 3-4 stars.
Super yummy!! I recommend. We got the halo halo. The taro ice cream was amazing. Maybe next time I will just get that! They were very sweet and helpful.

We went with a large group of people an hour before close and they were extremely helpful and accommodating. Everyone sampled multiple flavors and all of them were amazing. The owners were extremely nice and deserving of all the business to come for them. Plus, we sat down and sang karoake.
Delicious. Got the pistachio and matcha ice cream. Wife got the taho. Highly recommend the taro taho!
Oh my god has to be the best place on earth. My wife and daughter took me there for the first time the other night and I won't go anywhere else again.
Amazing service and a lot of different options to choose from!! Happy to have found this gem and will definitely come again.

If you're looking for the best ice cream in town look no further. Scooptopia has, by far, the best ice cream that I've ever had, with such a diverse selection of flavors. What makes it even better is that they also offer drinks and deserts outside of their ice cream that have all been absolutely fantastic, and believe me, I've tried almost everything on the menu. My personal favorites are the oatmeal cookie ice cream, Thai tea and halo halo! It's hard to find many places in Phoenix that serve traditional Filipino deserts such as the halo halo, but Scooptopia gets it perfect every time! On top of the food and drinks earning a five star review on their own, the staff and owners are some of the most kind and friendly people that you could ever meet. Every time we come in, we are greeted right away and it makes coming to Scooptopia so pleasant. You can really tell that not only the staff, but also the owners are great people who really want to make sure that you enjoy your time at their shop! If you're considering going out for a desert in Phoenix, I would recommend Scooptopia over anywhere else ten times out of ten!

Great Dessert Place! Looking for something to satisfy your dessert craving? I recommend checking this place out! They have a variety of desserts here. They have a selection of different ice creams, my faves were the pistachio, the taro, and believe it or not, the unicorn poop, lol. The unicorn poop is purple vanilla ice cream with sprinkles. The Cookie Monster was good too, but it's very sweet. They also have boba, shaved ice drinks, floats and sobets. They have three non dairy ice cream flavors as well. What I got was the halo halo, a Filipino traditional dessert. They have a super special option that includes buko pandan. They top it with something crunchy which adds more texture to the halo halo. I enjoyed it! The way to eat a halo halo is to just go ahead and mix it all up. In Tagalog, halo halo, means mix mix, which is exactly the way to eat it. All the flavors become mixed together and it makes for a nice cold tasty treat!
We happened to come here for the first time on their 1 year anniversary. The owners were so friendly and helpful! The ice cream was also delicious. They have a large variety of items.

Great place to grab some sweets and desserts. My wife (Filipina from Phillipines) and I were surprised to find a great shop like this in AZ. We come from WA and Filipino cuisine and desserts are now everywhere. Since we were contemplating moving here, we thought it would be good to locate a new one in AZ. First, the place is owned and operated by someone who cares. She asks each of her customers after a warm greeting if they have been to her business. Just a rare amount of caring that is much needed in this crazy Covid times. It would be like walking into your aunties house. She has a wide variety of ice creams but her Taho (Taro flavored) is out of this world! The tofu us warm and silky and a lot of good sago/boba with a perfect amount of brown sugar for sweetness. I was sooooo goood... that I had to order one doe myself after my wife "jacked" me. And we polished it off with some Halo Halo... a popular Filipino version of shaved ice. We will definitely be back. Support your local small business!

My friends and I went today, a typical hot Phoenix summer day; what better time to try out a place that serves cold treats, right? The very friendly folks staffing the place let us try a variety of the ice cream and sorbet flavors - all very good ... and definitely the ube (purple taro) ice cream is a must-try! I ordered the all-time Filipino cold dessert favorite, halo halo. The Filipino word "halo" means mix, and indeed this refreshing item consists of shaved ice, milk, and a mixture of different kinds of Filipino dessert items such as kaong (sweet palm fruit), garbanzo beans cooked in syrup, ube jam, flan, and more; all of this is topped with ube ice cream. Needless to say, it's a pretty heavy dessert item but so good. This ice cream shop is really a sweet delightful place and so conveniently located too: it's on Central Avenue across the street from the St. Francis Parish Church, near the Camelback / Central Avenue stop of the light rail.
Taro and thai iced tea flavored ice cream! One of the best halo-halos I've ever had. Place is clean and tidy. Owners are very warm and friendly.

Flavor everyone's got to try - Cookie Monster. Delicious creamy ice cream. Dozens of other cold desserts to have. When you visit, make sure you bring a cooler and some ice because you're going to want to bring something home.
Love this place. Their taro ice cream is amazing! My boyfriend loves their halo halo. Definitely recommend this spot for a sweet treat.
They are so nice! And the shaved ice is fresh I love it!, the halo halo is great and they have taro ice cream is to die for
So friendly! Bomb ass tapioca boba & drinks, and always super clean! My family loves this spot!!

One of our favorite spots for halo halo and other filipino desserts and dishes! The owners really go above and beyond with customer service and they truly make their products with LOVE! Definitely our go to when we want to feel at home!

This was our first time here we were in the neighborhood and we have been to Scooptacular in Laveen. They do carry their ice cream I am not sure if this is a second location or if they just partner with them. They do have a wide selection of ice cream, boba, snoh.... Which is what I was actually wanting but they were out of small and medium snoh cups and only had large which my hubby and I had just had lunch so we weren't wanting anything that big. We opted for the raspberry pomegranate sorbet... 2 scoops which just under 7 bucks... honesty I couldn't remember if that's about what it cost at Scooptacular or not but seemed a bit steep with the amount we had. My reasoning for 4 stars opposed to 5 was that it was actually pretty warm in there, our ice cream/sorbet was actually even slightly melted not sure if it was cause of how warm it was in there or what, but we opted to sit outside since it was so hot. I don't live in this area and am rarely in that area but if I was and wanted some ice cream I would give it another shot.

I reviewed several ice cream parlors in the area and heard nothing but great things Scooptopia. The ice cream was amazing and one of the best I've eaten. The owners were very nice. Will definitely come back.
This place was great! There were a ton of unique ice cream flavors to choose from, which were all amazing! Highly recommend this place if you're looking for good ice cream and great service.
Over compensated and genuinely appreciated our business. During this corona scare they took extra precautions to make sure we had a safe experience

Our favorite place for dessert! The flavor varieties are outstanding and make choosing your flavor difficult. We love the fact the size is by weight so you can select multiple flavors even with a single.

My absolute favorite place. They have the best Taro Ice cream. I had never had it before but they convinced me and now it is my absolute favorite! The customer service is amazing. The owners are so friendly and kind.

My boyfriend and I are visiting from Chicago so we have had our fair share of delicious ice cream. This place is definitely a must! I am so happy we stopped by. From the moment you walk in you are greeted with a smile and given a little run down on all the things they have. There are a TON of options. I wish we had more days in AZ to come and try them all. Great mix of flavors, some expected and quite a few unique. I got the Taro and Oatmeal Cookie which were amazing! My boyfriend got the cookies and cream and the Cookie Monster which he loved also. Would definitely recommend to anyone visiting and especially too those who live here. What a gem!
YUM!!! This place is delicious. I sampled a ton of flavors and almost couldn't pick because they were all so good. Everyone was so kind. We will definitely be returning :)

I stumbled across this place and figured a sweet treat would be nice. The staff was very friendly. They welcomed us at the door and offered us samples and told us a little about what they serve. I tried the oatmeal and blueberry cheesecake and my boyfriend got the mango tango. They were all delicious! They have lots of unique flavors and a wide variety of treats. Prices were a little bit steep but to be expected as ice cream shops can be a little costly. I'd definitely like to go again and see what other seasonal flavors they'll have.

We just moved in to the neighborhood and stumbled upon Scooptopia and we are so happy we did! The halo halo is to die for and the owners are so welcoming and friendly. Cheers to your 1 year opening anniversary! -J&E

I've been craving for taho for so long that I randomly searched it here on Yelp. Pleasantly surprised to learn about Scooptopia and so happy to finally get my taho fix after years! It was still warm, the tapioca was freshly made and it wasn't too sweet. We also got halo-halo, sago drink and ice cream. Everything was exceptional. Also worth mentioning are the very nice people behind the counter who were so helpful and accomodating.

Generous serving of halo halo and friendly staff! There are 2 selections of halo halo with one containing more ingredients than the other. I got the one with more ingredients and honestly can't tell what all of them are. Seems like there was a variety of beans and jellies in addition to coconut shavings, ice cream, and flan. Overall it tasted good as it was not too sweet and had a lot of substance.

Come try the Halo Halo! It's delicious. The owners Gina & Paul are so nice. If you're not very adventurous they still have you covered with lots of ice cream flavors & shaved ice. Come support this new small business.
The Shaved ice is Amazing!! The Taro Taho is fantastic! Customer service is marvelous! This is a great place to come and try something a little new (:

My husband is Filipino and we've been looking for a place to get good Halo Halo. He got the extra special and I got the special. Both were excellent. The owner and her family are amazingly welcoming we will definitely be back!

Nothing tasted better after a hot day than one of their shaved ice concoctions. If you're debating getting the coconut cream added, just do it. It was so good!!!! I will be back. The girls behind the counter were also so sweet and just good energy!
The best service and great ice cream! The owner was so sweet and welcoming. We had the oatmeal cookie ice cream and it was awesome. Can't wait to come back!!
Very good ice cream. Also had a very clean and inviting atmosphere. Would love to go back and get a shake!

Came here in the afternoon on a hot hot summer day. Ordered a large halo halo. Man theres a lot of strange things in here but its soo good. The black sesame ice cream was very creamy as well. Service was a little slow but other than that, will come here again
The halo halo here is very good. Staff is rly friendly and nice. There's a lot of ice cream and milk tea flavors too
Absolutely wonderful customer service! Everything here is delicious especially the ice cream and boba. I highly recommend this place to anyone in the area looking for a treat
Best ice cream in town! If you need your ice cream fix go to Scooptopia!! This family owned shop always sweet and makes me feel welcomed!!

Super clean, decently priced and kid friendly. We love all the options and the boba is amazing. It is a great place for a daily treat. There are so many Ice cream choices that are all amazing, but also really good ice tea blends. Check out their daily tea specials.
Very friendly staff and very clean inside. I'm here my second time because the boba is so fresh and tasty. :) I also love to support local businesses that provide quality products and service!
Loved this place and the halo halo was Amazing! I will be back the ladies behind the counter were awesome! Can't wait to try more of your flavors
Love this place!!!! The staff is SUPER friendly & the oatmeal cookie ice cream was fantastic

This is a must stop while you're in Phoenix! Their halo-halo is simply delicious! Also, their ice cream selection is not only plentiful but also unique. My favorites are the oatmeal cookie, travis, and Cookie Monster! The owner is very hospitable as well. Would recommend this place in a heart beat.

Amazing!! Great ice cream, tons of flavors and options and the people working (I believe the owners) were sooo nice and sweet!! They were so passionate about the ice cream and the different unique flavors they had. Definitely will be going back!

I have found my go-to place for sweets, specifically halo halo. My goodness, the presentation and substance in my drink has done justice to my palate. It had so much of the flavorful ingredients that you have in a halo halo drink and more. The ube, buko panda, and flan what makes it so delicious. It was around $6 and well worth it. It's located in a strip mall and by the rails so it would be hard to miss. It's a great place to meet up with people for a variety of drinks and sweets. Will definitely will be back!

I went as soon as I read the article in AZ Central that they'd opened! Of course I went for the Halo-Halo, one of my favourite Filipino desserts ever. Their Special Halo-Halo had ALL the ingredients that every awesome Halo-Halo should have - coconut jelly, jack-fruit, flan, sweet beans, ube ice cream, etc. It tastes refreshing and delicious, and it's absolutely authentic. You get 3 generous scoops of ube (taro) ice cream too! Y-U-M. Aside fro the Halo-Halo, there are loads of various ice-cream flavors which I will have to try when I go next time. As an added bonus, the owners are super friendly and very welcoming. They've just opened, but if you go and there are tons of people, my only advice is just be patient. It's worth the wait!

Very busy tonight which we love to see for out favorite local Ice cream shop!! Manager did a great job making sure all customers were acknowledged and said sorry for the wait. There appeared to be some new hires who just need more training on the standards but nothing to discourage us from returning. We love your store and will be back soon!
Owner is so sweet! Had their halo-halo and hands down the best halo-halo in the west valley! Best thing about it is, they're 3 mins from my place lol. Highly recommend

My favorite little treat in Phoenix! Incredibly decadent ice creams, (but, still appropriate for the kiddies) , Shave Ice, and fun specially items. The sweetest part is the STAFF, who all treat us like family every time we stop by!
Blah. Pricey. No sugar free options. Pass. Friends liked it. Seating is weird. And not much of it.
Perfect place to get your Hawaiian ice cravings, or flavorful ice cream... or get a taste of Filipino desserts like halo-halo or taho.

The best thing about this ice cream shop are the different flavor selections. I had the choco chili which was a nice kick for chocolate ice cream. The place is tucked back off central and is small. It appears to have a great following and was busy on a Saturday night. I wasn't wowed that this was the best ice cream in Phoenix, but it was deserving of 4 stars.

Definitely one of the best ice cream shops in the area! What makes them unique is they specialize in hand crafted Filipino desserts! The owners are the most genuine people! Make sure to get a karaoke song in before you leave! A must go!
Great little place, amazing service and even better Halo Halo. I wanted to go back the next day.... THAT'S how good it is!

One of the few places in midtown you can get both a delicious snow cone and a couple amazing scoops of ice cream! Tons of different unique flavors to choose from, my FAVORITE was oatmeal cookie. Absolutely unbelievable, my only regret was not getting a double scoop of it. Also killing the snowcone game!! I could not recommend this mom and pop biz more, the owners are incredibly kind people and I plan on making many more trips here this summer!

My wife and I come here a few times each month. Their Halo halo is the main reason we come. I'm always surprised by how well they swap out their flavors for ice cream as well. I'm able to find a new favorite every time I go.

So happy to have an authentic Filipino dessert shop near us. The halo halo special was amazing! The owners are so sweet and customer service is phenomenal. It's hidden in the back so a little hard to find but will definitely be back! Maybe next time we'll try the other desserts but they do have ice cream too. The owner said they were rolling out ice cream flavored coffee too.

Best coffee ice cream I have ever had, and everything else I tried was unique and delicious. The staff is top notch, the offerings are amazing, and the prices were very reasonable. It's super clean, and you can tell the family takes pride in every detail. I love the kids room. We will definitely be back.
The best icecream I have ever had! Not only that but the customer service was immaculate. They have so many options and flavors and this is DEFINITELY a place to check out!!

Calling all ice-cream lovers in AZ! Wonder what homemade icecream tastes like? Look no further because I found the spot for you! :) Wonderful service and very friendly people! They have such fun delicious flavors like Taro and Unicorn Poop and Birthday Cake! The cool part is that you can create it your way! Like if you want it into a boba float, in a cup, cone, Hawaiian shaved ice style, all those options are available! They also have Japanese drinks and very cool combinations to give you inspiration! Honestly I want to go again! Such a cute place! Perfect for this Arizona weather I fell in love with this place!

Parents and I were craving something sweet and cold enough to get us through another brutal heatwave in the valley. We got two large halo-halo's which were nice and refreshing. Could use a bit less ice & more toppings as the ratio was a heavy on the ice. Got a four scoop cup of ice-cream as well which consisted of cookie monster, birthday cake, thai tea, and unicorn poop. Winner was definitely unicorn poop lol for the name or course but best overall flavor. Owner was as genuinely friendly as you can get.

This place is so delicious. It has great traditional ice cream flavors along with Asian Filipino treats. My kids loved the Cookie Monster ice cream. Everything was so rich and creamy. Don't miss the boba tea!

Great little shop! Delicious ice cream, we had matcha green tea, cookies n cream, and also tried the unicorn poop. Next time, halo halo! For those who don't know, it's pronounced "ha-low ha-low" not like a halo over an angels head.

I'm Filipino and this place made me feel right at home. Their Sago Gulaman and Taho is the most authentic I've had in Arizona! Decently priced and their ice cream servings are very generous with so many flavor options! Definitely recommend and coming back!!

This place is awesome! A lot of different options to choose from, and the employee was just amazing. She was extremely friendly, and allowed me to try as many ice creams as I wanted. She encouraged it, even :) ! That is a bit of fresh air, because normally if you ask to try more then two ice creams at other shops, you usually get the impression the employee is annoyed. Not here! She was fantastic. We tried almost all the flavors, and they were very good. I ended up getting lavender ice cream, a turmeric honey, and another flavor that I can't remember the name of.. any ways! It was great. I would for sure come back and bring more people in. It was a good environment, friendly staff, and delicious choices for sweets! I recommend !

Great ice cream shop. They have tasty ice cream on its own and they also specialize in Filipino desserts too. The halo halo is good. I really like the Taho. They serve it in the traditional flavor and also strawberry and taro. The lady that served me was so welcoming. The customer service was amazing. This is definitely my go to dessert spot.

Absolutely AMAZING ice cream, boba and service! We had the pleasure of being service by the owner who did a great job telling us about all the different ice creams and drinks they make! We live in California and will 110% be back for more boba and ice cream!
Delicious ! Cookie Monster +unicorn poop . Service is excellent and ice cream is amazing.
I got halo halo and it was so good! Definitely recommend, tasted exactly like how it does back home. It's also Filipino-owned and the owners are super sweet!
1st timer! I ordered the special Halo-Halo and it was amazing! Very friendly people and chill vibe! we're from Mesa, but we don't mind the drive. We'll be back...

My girlfriend and I went there a few weeks ago because it was a catchy name, it was close, and the pictures were interesting. However, I was quickly apprehensive when I ordered a very simple ( one scoop vanilla one scoop strawberry in a cup) order and the employee seemed like he didn't know where to start. He made it vastly more complicated than it had to be and it was so tiny I think a child would have been distraught. I didn't say anything because I didn't mind and told him to get my girlfriend whatever she wanted. She ordered one of the snow cones that they have featured on the sign. It had three ingredients excluding ice. He had to look back at the sign numerous times, he clearly had no idea what went into the dish, and to top it off she said she could barely taste the flavors and basically had a five dollar bowl of shaved ice. They're a little pricy for what you get and they were out of nearly all the flavors we either wanted or wanted to try. I felt bad for my friend because she agreed to go because online it says they offer frozen yogurt. Well, Inside, they don't. She can't have ice cream. I will say the inside is esthetically pleasing and could be a cool little unique place If they were accurate with their menu, knew the menu, and had the ability to make the dishes that they offer. Better luck next time I suppose.
Great family, great flavors, and great treats. My son is in love with their Cookie Monster ice cream and the mocha boba is on point.

Great place to get a treat in central Phoenix! Tons of options to help cool you off in the desert heat. They have lots of flavors to choose from and also can can create your own. I am looking forward to my next trip!
Great place! Highly recommend, very friendly people too. Gotta try the halo halo. Got really unique selection here.

Finally,was able to try their halo-halo which I was dreaming of for quite a while.. It's a distance from where I live, but since my grandson was in town visiting and wanted halo-halo--- we then drove 30 minutes just to get there. It was not a disappointment! It's a family owned store. Gina and her daughter were very accommodating! Her daughter who was taking orders was very considerate with what my grandson requested for his halo-halo. I also got us gulaman & taho & the frozen pork BBQ (which I found cheaper & fresher than the oriental stores). We took it to go and my grandson was eating his halo-halo on our way home but just kept on saying that it was really the BEST halo-halo he has tasted!!! Definitely will be going back & driving that distance just to get our craving satisfied...

I was very excited to try this place as a coworker and I had a very long stressful day at work and needed a quick pick me up. Upon arrival we were greeted and found it surprising that when we asked to see the menu the cashier left for about ten minutes. After taking our order I asked of we could add an additional item to which have rolled her eyes and headed back to the kitchen. As we were paying she provided me with the receipt and was annoyed when I asked for a pen to sign the receipt. We sipped on our drinks and surprisingly they were bland and gave us all a headache. Unfortunately we will not be returning back.
Love this place. I always get the Halo Halo. The owners are very sweet & always greets us when we visit. Definitely recommend.

Found the gem by my place! My wife and I just moved from Chicago and Found cute little ice cream shop by my Church. The staff that works at this place are super nice and have great customer service. Filipino desserts are my wife's favorite! Loves that stuff, so I go there weekly to get her something sweet. So far she has tried everything from Halo Halo, sagu, flan, Ube Cake, Bubble tea and many options on the menu. This is a must try place and you will not be disappointed.

For a place called Scooptopia, I would expect a nice sized one. I'm not sure if the ice cream was to hard for the young men to scoop but the girl (who appeared younger) was better at getting the ice cream out. She's the only reason I'm leaving a two star. The small amount of ice cream I had wasn't bad.

This is such a cute little ice cream shop! They're known for their Halo Halo's, so we had to give it a try! Upon walking in, you're greeted by Ms. Dianne, the owner, who gives you a little background about their shop and what flavors they have coming out soon. I had their special of the day which was Sagu. It was a grass jelly drink with tapioca and white jelly. My friends got their Halo Halo, which was 5$ for a giant cup! Everything tasted wonderfully-- not too sweet, not too bland. This shop was absolutely the cutest! It was bright, clean and very well maintained. Their ice creams all have cute little names such as unicorn poop, abuelita, play dough and more! My friends and I will definitely be back to try all of their other items on the menu!

Upon coming in we were greeting by Gina who was wonderful and inviting. She welcomed and answered any questions we had and was extremely polite and helpful. She walked us through the menu and gave us recommendations. I ended up getting the Hawaiian shaved ice with tigers blood and passionfruit topped with condensed milk. My boyfriend got the Halo Halo which is a specialty drink that contains 13 different ingredients! BOTH were delish and well presented. We will definitely be coming back here!

The ice cream is so good. I went in to get a drink and had to get two pints. The taro ice cream is so amazing! The service was super friendly and helpful, pointing me towards ice creams i might like. The prices were really good too considering how tasty everything was.

It's so good, I think the best in Arizona!! After one time you will be addicted! You will crave it. I need to have one at least once a week it's that good. They are so friendly and it's like a quick visit to see friends during this time of quarantine. I will be back again and again!

Shaved ice, ice cream, boba, and Filipino desserts all under one roof? Don't mind if I do! Very clean and welcoming atmosphere, sweet and accommodating staff. Their calamansi boba is unbelievable. Please keep this on the menu forever and always! They've got another loyal customer in me!

such sweet owners and staff! the tea is amazing and freshly brewed! please support local business. it's their first year and they made it through a tough year, all in the midst of the pandemic. supporting local is important right now and this place has such a great energy. their ice cream is very good too! 10/10!

One of the best ice cream spots in phx. I've been a couple times since december. the place is super clean and the employees are so kind. You can tell they are proud of their food and they should be. the texture of the ice cream is so unique. It tastes like homemade. Super fresh, always a unique assortment of flavors. Also some good authentic vietnamese desserts. definitely worth it :)

I LOVE this place!!! They always have such amazing flavors my favorites are the lavender ice cream and the honey turmeric!!! So delicious!!!!! The owners are the most friendly people you will ever meet!!! My boyfriend and I visit at least once a week and he gets a shave ice! Yum!!!! I definitely recommend!!!!!!!!!

We found this gem recently and so happy about it. We have tried halo halo and taho...so delicious! They also have very interesting ice cream flavors that are very tasty too. Can't wait to go back again and try everything. A huge bonus that everyone there are incredibly nice and helpful.

This place is amazing! Such a sweet family that runs it too! We came in for a Saturday night treat and really enjoyed ourselves! My husband got the Japanese cream soda, I enjoyed a vanilla shaved ice with taro ice cream on the bottom and my son got a kiddie size Cookie Monster ice cream (blue cotton candy ice cream with cookies)! I asked for water and was give a whole pitcher of ice water and cups for all of us! They also have a little play room in the back with a tv and toys for the kiddos! We will definitely be back!!

Yummy variety of affordable treats, great service, and even a kids room to occupy the youngsters! Come for the halo halo or myriad boba. Stay for the atmosphere and the friendly owners and staff. Check it out and remember your loyalty card to get free treats!

We got the Halo-Halo and it was delicious, the Ube ice cream was fantastic! Make sure you get it with the Boko Pandan, it was so good! My daughter tried the Unicorn ice cream, strawberry cheesecake and vanilla. All were creamy and tasty. A perfect treat on a hot summer day! The owners were super friendly and helpful, they even have a small area for kids to hang out in, play some games or watch Netflix. We will definitely be back.

We absolutely love this ice cream spot. The family that runs it is so nice and helpful and the flavors are truly unique. I'm a big of the unicorn poop flavor (just trust me on this one) as well as the Thai tea. Do yourself a favor and pop on over to this spot next time you have a craving for something sweet.

What a gem!!! My boyfriend and I visited this spot with his aunt after it came up as a yelp suggestion. We were warmly greeted by the owners who were so kind (Filipino people are always very warm and welcoming)! We knew before going in that we wanted to order their special halo halo, but were pleasantly surprised to see they also started offering Taho (Filipino dessert with soft tofu, brown sugar syrup, and tapioca balls) and Sago Gulaman (Filipino grass jelly drink)!!! We ordered all three and they were ALL SO GOOOD. My boyfriend is Filipino so I've had my share of Filipino cuisine and these desserts were one of the best I've had! For the taho we tried the taro flavor which I've never seen before and it's a must try! And the sago gulaman is the perfect refreshment on a sunny day. We also got a pint of their local made ice cream to take home (they have so many unique flavors) and some cookies!!! Trust me there were more things we wanted to try but we'll just have to wait for next time since we got so much haha. All in all the desserts here are delicious, the quality is excellent, and the service was unbeatable. Def a local business you'll want to support and see thrive!!! If you're near the midtown area in Phoenix I highly suggest you stop by! (it's right next to the light rail)

I usually don't write yelp reviews but WOW Scooptopia's ice cream was absolutely delicious! Locally made ice cream with literally so many flavors they can't all fit the front! My boyfriend got the peanut butter and German chocolate ice cream and I got a waffle bowl with bubble gum, Cookie Monster, and cookies and cream. If you are an ice cream fanatic like me I highly recommend to try some of Scooptopia's ice cream. Also the lady working there was so sweet and extremely helpful with picking what to order!
Great place to get some true great tasting Halo-Halo!! Not only is their ice cream good but they have a good selection of flavors!! Great friendly service as well!!
Large selection and great flavors of ice cream Filipino desserts like Halo Halo & Taho An amazing Ube white chocolate cookie Boba Milk Tea Loving, kind owners

This place is fabulous the Cookie Monster flavor is the best ice cream I've had in a while and they also have unicorn poop and play doh flavor- AND KARAOKE, OKAY? Oh if you're not a child like me they also have lavender flavor and it's amazeballs

We had just had dinner and were craving something sweet; we saw their sign and decided to stop in. We were greeted with smiling faces and we felt so welcomed! We tried a few flavors. I decided on the Vernonni(sp?) it was a coffee flavor - delicious! My boyfriend had the Unicorn Poop he loved it and made the comment "if someone never had ice cream before, I would have them try this flavor." All of their ice cream is made locally here in Phoenix and their flavors are so creamy and delicious. If you're in the area, definitely stop in (especially if you have a sweet tooth)! Next time I'm trying the halo halo! We'll be back!

Wow! I am so excited we found this cute little ice cream/ shaved ice/ boba tea / Philipino dessert spot! The owner and workers are so sweet and explain what they have and suggest what to get to make your experience that much better. I can't wait to keep coming back and eating more yummy treats!

Just went here for the first time and it is LITERALLY AMAZING!!! I got the unicorn poop ice cream and it is delicious! Probably one of the best vanilla ice creams i've had in my entire life!!! It has purple vanilla (so cool am I right), sprinkles, and cupcake pieces, really good, strong flavors! Such a cool atmosphere, tons of different flavors and options, and the NICEST workers ever. They are so helpful and welcoming, very professional! Great size area, amazing family atmosphere!! I will DEFINITELY be coming back!! D to the E to the L-I-O-U-S!! I will be telling ALL of my family and friends about this place, it is just that good. My friend got the grasshopper and she agrees, it is amazing! Hers was mint chocolate with thin mints and oreos, not your average mint chocolate chip ice cream!!Such a unique selection of ice creams!! and they don't just have ice cream! They have shaved ice and halo-halo. If i could give it more than five stars I definitely would!! Thank you Scooptopia, very cool!

This desert shop came up suggested and I decided to give it a shot and I am SO GLAD I did! The girl working was so friendly and put up with me wanting to try every single flavor. The prices are great. And the Thai tea ice cream is to die for!!! I will be coming back often! I'm excited to try the bubble teas especially. Happy to have a new ice cream shop.
Great place in the heart of the valley to go get dessert!!! Very friendly people, Ice cream is pretty bomb & their Hawaiian ice is good as well. Try their Super Halo Halo Special!!!
Amazing Filipino desert!!! Seriously, have not had taho freshly made and just reminds me exactly how they made it in the philippines!!

Finally, a snowcone place in Central Phoenix!!!!! My sweet tooth prayers have been answered. My snowcone was delicious, I will definitely be back. (They have lots of ice cream flavors as well if that's more of your thing. Something for everyone at Scooptopia!)

Everything we have tried here has been absolutely delicious! The owners and staff are the kindest people with the BEST customer service. They truly care about cleanliness, and all staff wear masks. And the best part is you can sample any flavor! We will support them for all time!
The place to go if you're craving for Pinoy ice cream flavors and halo-halo dessert. Yum!
Literally one of the best places on earth! The staff is incredible and so friendly. The selection is something special you won't find at any other spot! Must try.
Walked in and was greeted by the sweetest lady!! My boyfriend and I absolutely LOVE TARO so we had to try the Taro with Boba and the Taro Ice cream! Both Delicious!! We definitely will be back
Very good, friendly staff and lots of flavors! Highly recommend to try something you haven't tried before

Decided to go with my daughter to Scooptopia, which she has been raving about for the last month. It's a charming little place with a pretty wide selection of offerings. My daughter had a small shaved ice (Altho small is a relative term - it was huge), and I had chocolate covered strawberry ice cream that was to die for! Staff was very friendly and attentive, and he made us feel welcomed! I love little neighborhood places like this and I hope to come around more often!!
I had a vanilla boba tea with strawberry popping boba and it was delectable. I also had the taro ice cream and I wish I got a double instead of a single, that's how good it was.
This place was so good! The kids loved the ice cream and the adults loved the boba! The staff and owner were so sweet and kind! We were only visiting for the day but we would def. go back!

Great every single time we go! It was hot waiting outside in the line, but worth it. The winner is always Vietnamese coffee, I got an Affogato this time. Their twist on it includes vanilla & Vietnamese coffee scoops, espresso, float style w/a Mexican coke add. Wouldn't think coffee and coke would work, but it does! They have rotating seasonal specials, this time around it included peaches and honey & apple pie, amongst other flavors. We had a large group of about 11 and everyone was happy! Great little back patio. The only downside is there is no inside seating, so it's way hot in the AZ heat to enjoy your cone outside, even with the misters on.

Pro-tip: Expect a line. There's no place to eat inside. They offer samples. You can split one scoop into two mini scoops for more flavors. For the floats, they give you the rest of the soda in the bottle/can. Highlights: The pricing is really affordable for someone who wants a double or triple scoop since one scoop is $5 and it's only $1 more for 2x the ice cream or $2 more for 3x the ice cream. The ice cream is good quality and the flavors are distinct as well. Lowlights: It would be nice if they had indoor seating or even a larger space so people in line don't have to wait outside in the heat. They only have 12 flavors and a lot of them are the basic chocolate/vanilla/butter pecan type of flavors.

Updated 6/13/22: After writing my review below about the cracked ice cream cone, the team at Churn reached out to me wanting to hear more about my experience. I sent them an email and they were generous enough to send me a $15 gift card in the mail. I have now been back twice and can truly say that this is the best ice cream in the Valley (of all the places I've tried so far!). I am absolutely obsessed with the Double Chocolate and Peanut Butter combo. It is so incredibly creamy and flavorful. It reminds me a lot of the consistency of Jeni's ice cream (of which I am a big fan!). I am fortunate enough that I get my nails done at Prose nearby, so you can bet you'll see me at Churn every few weeks. And in between, I'll make any excuse to get there. For sure the best scoop shop to take out-of-towners (just wish they had more indoor/outdoor seating!).
We went there and tried the goat cheese pistachio one, OMG, best flavor ever had in my life--must try!

My favorite ice cream place in town because the ice cream is so creamy and delicious and peanut butter is a permanent flavor option. The single scoop is a generous portion and I could have been fine with a kid's scoop if I had realized sooner that was an option. Excellent topping choices too and I can't wait to try the pretzel cone when I'm in the mood. I love the seating area out back especially at night. I do avoid coming here on the weekends - I could deal with the long line but parking is just impossible.

Ice cream shop in the central Phoenix area, on Central north of Camelback. Great shop with lots of options and sweats. Coffee served as well. Great outdoor seating with cool misters. If your ever in this area, you'll love it

Stopped into Churn when we saw a carrot cake ice cream that they posted about. Just had to have it and not disappointed. Such a cute place with friendly service. This is only available for the month of April, but they bring in other seasonal flavors along with a regular menu of ice cream. Lots of retro candy too!
We love ice cream and this place lived up to our expectations and more so. It was very creamy. The milkshakes were good too.

I never get tired of this place. The seasonal flavors like hangover helper and whisky toffee almond flavors are incredible. Fairly priced considering what they could get away with charging when compared to some of their other local competitors. There's always a line, especially late on summer nights. Always worth it though.

there s'mores sundae is excellent and there hot fudge is yum along with the toasted marshmallow puff!!! At first they didn't offer at checkout a smaller say like 10-% I know some wouldn't even want to do more than 5%. ( cheapie but I understand) It's at 18% as your choice and when your checking out it can be difficult because you have to judge how much any xtra service was worth etc. and it's just you have to be able to go and pay the 18% and appreciate your ice cream treat to see the value and now I have no issue with it 18%. I wouldn't be able to see a 15% gratuity not helping in the end I mean it may bring some of your iffy customers around and end up making more in tips. Definitely recommend s'mores sundae and the guy who helped me was really nice n sexy as well. He's From Colorado he said!!
Fun ice cream shop with a delicious menu. I highly recommend the S'mores Sundae. Nice patio area in the back to enjoy. Parking can be a little busy if you go at prime time due to Windsor next door.

This ice cream shop is super cute and I love that it's open late night. It was highly recommended that I check this place out, so I did! I arrived 30mins to closing, and ordered the peanut butter and Vietnamese coffee. We ate on the picnic tables outside, and I enjoyed every minute of it.

Talk about cute!!!! First time at this place that came highly suggested as I'm addicted to ice cream. You're close to downtown so parking can be a little tricky just make sure to be alert and aware so you don't pass this gem up. With the Covid changes mask are required and we waited outside as they only allowed one group in at a time. The overall establishment is relatively small so these changes make sense to keep everyone safe. There were soooo many options so if this is your first time feel free to rely on the experts. The staff were amazing and walked me through some of their favorite dishes as well as combos they've seen other customers try. In the end I could not decide so I picked two. Ya I said it TWO. my ice cream commitment is strong. Super yummy and creamy I can't wait to try it again.
Such an adorable ice cream shop! Our sundae was so yummy and the back patio seating area was fun to hang out while we ate!

Churn has been on my list for places to check out in and around Phoenix, and I'm so glad I was able to stop in here before heading to the airport! The store itself is adorable and oozes with old time ice cream shoppe vibes. In addition to selling ice cream, they also have a selection of cookies, vintage candies, and knick knacks. I had two scoops--one of strawberry and another of peanut butter ice cream--in a waffle cone. It was delicious. The waffle cone was clearly made in-house.
