The ice cream was absolutely perfect and creamy. I will definitely be back next time I find myself in Phoenix.
The ice cream is amazing. The cookies are amazing. The sundaes are amazing. The service is amazing. That is a lot of 'amazing' from a place that deserves everyone of them.

Yummy ice cream in a great spot right near quite a few restaurants. It is lovely to walk to after a nice dinner. The line can definitely get long, but it's worth it! Great flavors and tons of toppings (must try the home made cookies!)

Got two single scoops of ice cream, the cookies and mint, and the Vietnamese coffee. Both were really creamy and delicious with a nice sweetness. The cookies n mint was very reminiscent of thin mints, with a great crunch unlike other ice cream places flavors with cookies. I'm not a big coffee fan, but the Vietnamese coffee was great, with a perfect balance of coffee flavor and sugar. Additionally the staff was super nice and welcoming! Would definitely recommend.

My husband and I just went for the first time tonight! It was delicious and looks like you can't go wrong no matter what you choose. There was a line of about 5 groups of people when we arrived which meant about 15 minutes of waiting. We just moved from Virginia and haven't seen this place when it's warmer, but I can imagine the line wraps around the block considering how delicious the product is.
Fantastic. Best ice cream in phx! Such a cool atmosphere and vibe! Always have great flavors
Everything inside this cute little ice-cream whop is amazing! If isn't too hot visit the patio area en enjoy your ice-cream there! Pretty nice vibes and the ice-cream flavors are
Great ice cream and fun little shops they have with old dime store type of toys. Very cool little shop. I recommend the strawberry & coffee ice creams.
I've been here twice, once getting the milk and cookies and the other time getting coconut sorbet (dairy free option). Both were delicious with super high quality ice cream. Definitely recommend.
OMG this ice cream is so delicious! Love all the menu options. Portions were nice and so were the employees! Definitely coming back here!
I came here for ice cream and the line was out the door. I got the double chocolate on a waffle cone. This place had one of my favorite waffle cones!

People stand outside in line IN JUNE to get this ice cream. Reminds me of the customer devotion at Mike's Pastries in Boston's North End. The ice cream is extra delicious and fresh. Lots of options and toppings to add to your order. Save room after eating at the Windsor or Postino's. It worth it.

Who doesn't like some good ice cream? Plus the interior is a candy wonderland. The staff is so helpful and assist with any questions you have. Plenty of selections with all the tasty flavors of ice cream they have to offer. Seating is limited out front, and a bit more out back.

We were referred here by friends who rave about this place. Maybe our expectations were too high because I think you can do better in the ice cream aisle of the grocery store for less than our $14 bill was here. The ice cream was fine. The chocolate wasn't rich or very flavorful. The peanut butter ice cream was nutty and not too sweet. That was good. I was told to get the hot fudge which I ordered but didn't end up on my sundae. My wife ordered a chocolate chip cookie. The cookie was baked well and had good texture but had more salt on top than I'd prefer. There's a good amount of parking and a nice outdoor seating area out back. Only one party of customers is allowed in the store at a time and all of the employees were wearing masks. Sanitizer was provided. All in you can feel okay passing on this one.
Delicious ice cream, and adorable little store front. Honestly perfect for a date night!

LOVE THIS PLACE !! The staff is always so friendly and helpful! They have unique flavors and ideas for making some pretty cool dessert creations. There are some cute walls to take photos in front of, plus a patio area in the back. Windsor and Churn connect to each other so they share a back patio. The patio isn't super large though and can fill up, especially around the time after dinner ! I always come here and can't wait to return :)

Visited churn after looking at the reviews and wasn't disappointed. Tried the double scoop with one scoop of Vietnamese coffee and the other being butter pecan- both were amazing! Got whipped cream as a topping to add to the taste... Also tried the malted milk chocolate which was yummy but butter pecan won over for me. The Vietnamese coffee was the top favorite flavor for me and my husband. The only reason I'm giving less stars here is because when I checked their online menu they had so many amazing and out of the box flavors showing up which I was really looking forward to try but they barely had 6-8 ice cream flavors to choose from at the store - whatever flavor I tried were without a doubt amazing for sure! Also, I thought my husband and I wouldn't be able to finish the double scoop portion at once (which we ended up finishing) so I asked for a lid for the cup and they had only a flat top cup not a dome shaped one which wasn't cool.

Yummy yummy yummy! We waited outside for about 15 minutes in line. There is no seating inside unless you're probably eating at the Windsor. You can even try samples which is awesome. Got the kids scoop butter pecan and it is BOMB!!!

I've been here a couple times and have enjoyed both experiences. They have 4 seasonal flavors, one of which usually includes a liquor, so you have to be 21 to taste! The most recent time I went, they had "fall" flavors like candy corn and caramel cashew; I remember the previous time I got the (alcoholic) tiramisu, which was DELICIOUS. You can choose from pre-selected sundaes, sugar/cake/waffle/pretzel cones (latter two are extra), cookie sandwiches, or just ice cream in a cup. You have the option to do a single scoop mixed with two flavors, which is very convenient. I've gotten double scoops of two different flavors but after finishing the entire cone, feel a lil ill. The cookie sandwiches are pretty large, and very splittable between two people. *****Extra points because they use reusable flatware spoons for tastings!***** The people working are so friendly and super patient. I've only been on Tuesdays around 8pm but the wait isn't long, usually only a couple of people in line. There is a shared parking lot which has ample spaces, but is packed on Tuesdays (as Joyride across the street has all day taco deals).

It's been a while since I've been to Churn but located next to Windsor and all their other delicious restaurants. It's cute and quaint with plenty of options. We got a How now, Brown cow which is a float which hubs got Coke with vanilla ice cream. It's a classic and was great. I got a 2 scoop of strawberry and milk n' cookies in a waffle cone. The ice cream is creamy and yummy and their scoops are huge. The strawberry was creamy with plenty of strawberry in it. The milk n cookies had semi baked chocolate chip cookie throughout and was amazing. The gal helping us was so friendly and helpful and definitely a reminder that we need to pop in more than every couple years. Definitely will be back soon!

Ok, I love ice cream. Yes, but not all ice cream is created equal. Having grown up with the crappy ice milk you get at certain locations that shall remain nameless, but use two letters as their name, you develop certain flawed expectations of what is good ice cream. Then the $6 tiny cup of average crap with a mix in named after the cold rock they mix your stuff on. Yes, you remember with nostalgia the hand cranked ice cream at grandma's house, as long as you were young enough to not have to take a turn, and getting to lick the paddle, but as soon as you were old enough you realized what an absolute pain in the nether regions that was and how grandpa and dad always fought against it, since its not 1885 anymore. So, when you get a little bit of nostalgia with really good ice cream that you got to buy, not recreating a turn of the century sweatshop for fun, and see candy from your childhood for sale, you jump on it right! RIGHT! So the wife and I hit churn on our stay-cation away from the kids last year, and it was amazing! Madagascar vanilla, orangecicle ice cream and the secret ingredient, a delicious apricot cranberry oatmeal cookie. HA HA HA HA, it was so good, not too sweet with tons of flavor! Wife got some combination of death by chocolate that she loved and i hardly paid attention to because mine was so good. I manage on most days to avoid driving over unless i am really stressed. I swear my therapist must be a part owner of the place. The sweets shop nature of the place with the nice shaded patio in back really is quite fun, and they also sell some jars of cool syrups and such. If you like ice cream, go and have fun, but heaven help you if you take the last apricot cranberry oatmeal cookie before I get there, some things cannot be overlooked.

This place was recommended to me and so I came to try it out. To be honest I wasn't blown away by their flavor selection. -they did offer samples :) -the place looked really nice, loved the decor -customer service was good -none of the flavors I tried jumped out and saved my life except for the coffee flavor. I was actually surprised by how good it was!!! Their most popular flavor is the mint chocolate chip; it's good but at the end of the day I probably wouldn't get it again. Pricing is fair and menu is easy to read. The place has 15 min parking. Not many spots. Would I come back? Maybe. This place didn't really leave me with a lasting impression but I wouldn't be opposed to come back.

Please keep the tiramisu ice cream on rotation!!! I'll come back every time it's served!! I went to Churn with a friend around 9pm on a Saturday. The place was packed! And by the place, I mean the line extending from the register to out the door. Lots of people were enjoying their ice cream on both the front and back patios. After about a 5-7 minute wait, we made it to the ice cream counter where we were greeted by two very sweet employees. They let us sample the Tiramisu (a seasonal flavor) and Vietnamese Coffee ice creams, and that first bite confirmed our orders. We ordered 2 kids scoops because they did not skimp on their scoop size!! I ordered a tiramisu ice cream, and they checked my ID to ensure I was over 21 since the ice cream did have trace amounts of amaretto in it (not enough to get me drunk, fortunately or unfortunately). This was truly tiramisu in a cup, complete with small pieces of ladyfinger biscuits mixed into the batter! It was a rich, sweet ice cream mixed with chocolatey, subtle coffee flavors. Now that I'm writing this review, I'm thinking about going back... This place is the perfect for a post-meal dessert or a late-night dessert run. Highly recommend! I'll be back to pick up a pint of that tiramisu!!

Miserable experience at churn trying to get ice cream. It was a Thursday night and my FiancÃ© and I decided to try church since it comes so highly recommended. I'm not exactly sure why though. We waited 40 minutes outside while one worker scooped ice cream and the other two workers "looked" busy. There was no rush or movement at all essentially. While we wait we thought well okay as long as the ice cream is amazing it'll be worth it. We were totally wrong! We got two freezies which are essentially blizzards that cost us $20 for chocolate ice cream and some toppings sprinkled on top, we didn't even eat them because they melted so quickly and were a waste of calories. We could have bought 4 gallons of ice cream for that price and would have been happier. Next time we'll go to DQ or Culver's for better ice cream for 1/4 of the cost.
They stopped allowing dogs on their patio. Now I have no reason to go because it's just overpriced ice cream.

Classic ice cream flavors and Classic Candies!!! I got the cashew caramel and chocolate sorbet. The sorbet was more like a dark chocolate ice cream. The cashew caramel was new but man it worked. It was sooo good, I highly recommend a scoop of that and top anything you get with toasted marshmallow!
I recommend this place highly fast friendly service reasonable price to takes a family or just stop in For a quick cone

My recent pictures definitely prove I've been desserting too much. Just kidding -- there's no such thing as too much dessert. Churn has an old-fashioned ice cream parlor feel to it, minus the seating. There is backyard seating, but it's limited and shared with the restaurant next door. Churn has a tiny storefront with a counter and limited choices of flavors. I've been there twice in the past few months a few weeks apart, and the flavors don't seem to have changed. Good flavors though, but limited selection. Sugar cones, waffle cones, and even pretzel cones are offered. The waffle cone is my favorite so far, although I haven't tried the pretzel cone yet. One standout thing about Churn is how huuuuge their scoops are. Their single scoop equates to at least 1.5 regular scoops at other ice cream places I've been to, and they offer a kiddie scoop that's more than enough for me. My favorite flavor so far has been vietnamese coffee, although the strawberry comes a close second. My friends have liked the cherry pie, chocolate, and buttered pecan. I wasn't a fan of the buttered pecan because of how heavy it was, but the chocolate was decently good. I would've preferred the strawberry to be a tad more strawberry and touch less cream, but the fresh strawberry taste came through. The first time I got the vietnamese coffee, it was strong and creamy and decadent. The second time, however, it was a bit more watery and not as thick. It was still good, just not as good as I'd remembered. Churn is a good option for solid, traditional flavors (with one or two adventurous twists for the daredevils out there), but its claim to fame is really the ginormous scoops. But do try the waffle cone; it's pretty darn good.

When I tell you that this was the Best Ice Cream we've Ever had, believe me! It's a darling little storefront and the young lady behind the counter was so friendly, helpful and nice. Great customer service, as she knew that I was struggling with which flavors to get for 4 people to have at home, at the best value. She packed up 4 containers (pints?) and she was incredibly generous, as each one was packed beyond full. We had the Peanut Butter (our favorite), Double Chocolate (excellent next to that PB!), Vietnamese Coffee (excellent and so smooth) and Cookies & Mint (wonderful). We had 4 nights of ice cream after dinner. And for all of that joy, my total was $20. I highly, highly recommend Churn! (Note: all staff wore masks and they have strict rules about number of customers inside to place their orders. I felt very safe).
Did someone say 3 scoops of OG vanilla in a house made pretzel cone? Yup! This is our go-to spot to satisfy our inner fat kid! So good every time.

This is soooooooooo long overdue. Do you have a friend, that takes you to other cities just to get food? Me tooo!! We have gone to AZ for Tacos, coffee and Ice Cream (different trips). On of these trips was to go to Churn. Omg talk about memorable. It was about 150 degrees outside, my shoes were melted to the pavement. Ok maybe not. They make amazing ice cream. The toppings are to die for. **put salted caramel on whatever you get :) this is where my love of salted caramel began** You won't regret it. DO NOT PUT IT IN YOUR CALORIE COUNTER!! Just enjoy it.

My oh my! Came here after dinner at Federal Pizza, and it was perfect. Quality you can taste and made with love! Employees take care of your order and make it when you place the order. Fresh, high quality you can taste! Ordered a "Lil Freezies" Rocky Road! Very natural taste, full size almonds, double chocolate ice cream flavor, marshmallow! Heaven!!! Must try!
Great flavors and awesome back patio to chill and kick back at times. Coconut is bomb and so are the rest of the flavors but coconut was absolute fire!

On my quest to find the best ice cream in the nation, Churn was a good contender! We got the Butter pecan which was yummy and had actual pecan pieces. Wish the ice cream was a bit creamier, but definitely worth a stop if you're in Phoenix!
I love ice cream. Correction...I love good ice cream. And this stuff is the good stuff. It was well worth our 20 min drive across town. I recommend this place to anyone who likes ice cream.
Such an awesome concept. We stopped in after eating dinner next door. So many choices it was hard to choose. But the milkshakes were perfect size, taste and consistency. We will def be back.

This place was on my to try list for a bit and I'm glad we stopped by. The lady who took care of us was super friendly and polite. You can do half and half scoops which I really liked. I got the double chocolate and the butter pecan and both were solid. My date got the tiramisu which I thought was pretty good too. I thought one scoop was a lot to maybe next time I'll go with the kids scoop. There is outdoor siting at the front of the shop and at the back. I think the seating at the back of the shop is cozier. I would definitely come back again and try some of their sundaes which all sounded delicious! Cookies also looked good. Bonus points for still offering samples, I thought maybe due to COVID they wouldn't but they do.

I had high hopes since many people would hype this place up but when I went I wasn't impressed. Personally what you get for the price point is not worth it in my opinion. We paid a little over $14 for the s'more sundae and strawberry shortcake sundae. First they didn't have the chocolate for the s'mores sundae so I had to substitute that. It came with one scoop of ice cream and a heaping of marshmallow fluff with one graham cracker broken in half. I did like that they toasted the fluff. Nothing wowed me from it. I've had better. Now for my husband's strawberry shortcake sundae. It was a flop. The "cake" was dry, hard, and almost old. It was as if they left it sitting out all day. You needed that ice cream to help get the cake down. The strawberries were hard and frozen and neither of us were a fan of that. We wish they would put fresh strawberries instead. They didn't put enough of the strawberry drizzle. What you see in the picture is all that was put on it. Again it was only one scoop of ice cream used. Honestly it's was an okay experience. The employees were friendly but were rushing us and the people before us. I will say if you want more for your money and better flavors, I recommend going elsewhere, like down the street to Nami!

Really good ice cream, super adorable/old school/nostalgic/fun/cute shop. Hi, I'm an ice cream snob. And as such, I'm required to know where to find the best ice cream. Churn is toward the top of my list in the Phoenix area so far, bc of their unique flavors that don't sound ridiculous/terrible AND they've got a decently creamy, buttery consistency (though I wish it were creamier and velvetier!). The shop itself literally makes me feel like a fat kid in a candy store, partly bc of all the retro vibes, and bc they also sell candy...and other goodies/novelty toys. For a tiny shop, you sure can spend a crap load of money here. My toddlers go nuts over this place. Employees (for the most part), are peppy and sweet and they genuinely seem happy to give out samples. The most memorable flavors I've had are: - butter pecan - chocolate - Vietnamese coffee - cookies and mint - carrot cake It's ALL been good and it tastes like they use high quality ingredients. On top of the classic cone options, they even have a fun pretzel cone that's pretty unique and yummy. There's a couple tables and chairs out front (and a shared dining area in the back with the neighboring restaurant). But beware: during their peak times (i.e. after dinner/Fri-Sat nights) the line can get pretty freaking long and limited seating can get ugly since the shop is small.

This place is so cute whimsical and sweet tooth lovers dream! It was like a real life Candy Land! My daughter was so excited but because I'm the worlds most ok-ist mom I said no to ice cream AND candy...one or the other...she picked ice cream! As for the ice cream there weren't many options but most of the choices were really good. But the coolest part was the homemade fluff that they torched right in front of u!!

Churns is my new secret crush...... as my hubby and I notice a little store with a line outside of it. I was so intrigued I ran across two street lanes to find my place on the line. I'm excited I'm next online....my head was like an oscillating fan. Churns is a cute hole in the wall ice cream parlor. They don't have a huge selection but what they have is amazing goodness. If you look around they also have old school candy that I remember as a kid. I ordered the butter pecan and WTF...... HAVE I GONE TO ICE CREAM HEAVEN...... The butter pecan was buttery goodness. I ordered it on my favorite childhood cone.....the waffle cone. This place brings back memories.... great memories of just closing your eyes and taking your first bite of your icecream cone and someone slaps your hand..... LoL..... that did happen but not Today! I really like this place..... trust me. You'll find yourself falling for Churns too!

Came here with kids from work to treat them to ice cream. The place is small but the ice cream was good. Not bad on pricing and all the kids were happy. Had about 8 flavors I think I got the strawberry shortcake and it was delicious. I enjoyed it

Phoenix should be food porn capital of the west, sheesh. Not only can you find pretzel cones here (yes you read that right. Salty to compliment your sweet treat.), but you can also find adult ice cream. No, that is not just chocolate in that ice cream.... mmm mmm. Churn is owned by the same people who run Federal Pizza, Joyride, and one other similar creative venture all within the same block. Whoever these folks are, they're doing it right. I've got it so bad I'm already planning my next Phoenix Foodcation. Not only is the ice cream slow churned and to die for, but the whole atmosphere is really unique. I found a wall with cassette tape wallpaper...of actual cassette tapes. Not paper. Picnic benches outside are in the shade with misters going at all times, because Arizona. Very laid back vibe, perfect for chilling with friends, or for the kids and the dog.

I came back in because their billboard said they have a "Cookies & Milk" flavor. And you know what? It was incredible! Like chocolate chip cookies dipped in milk - but in ice cream form, mmm! They have expanded their outdoor seating in the back which was much needed last time I was here, yay! They are still serving generous portions! Even their samples are bigger than everyone else's. And the prices are still reasonable. Staff is still friendly, and luckily that adjacent parking lot is still there.

We had a great time visiting this place and enjoying the fresh ice cream and cookies. There's cute little seating area outside. Perfect place to sit and enjoy when there's beautiful weather outside. My kids enjoyed looking at all the decor and goodies they had on display as well as the ice cream they chose. They switch out cookie options, so not all of the types of cookies are available every time, but the ones we tried were delicious.

Ordered a milkshake and when I found out it was $8 I was like what???? Then I took first sip and I understood... it was awesome! Could tell it was high quality and it was awesome... yummy... coming back soon!

Best ice cream place in phoenix! The staff is just as sweet too there's always a line, but that kind of thing is hard to avoid with ice cream so good. The interior is cute. You have to try the chocolate sauce and whipped cream when you go!

Had a great meal at Windsor and stopped here (next door) for dessert. Great ice cream options and they also have candy for sale. You can also sample. I had a cone with one scoop of butter pecan and one scoop of peanut butter. Both were amazing. Place gets busy but line moves fairly quickly.

Never disappoints!!!! We ordered the S'mores Sunday and the peanut butter freezie....both amazing! Every time we come here the line is out the door. Prices are good. Ice cream is homemade and AMAZING! We love coming here

The ice cream is the best, but I also go for the chocolate chip cookies and the selection of vintage candy selection. It's a blast from the past! If you have a craving for ice cream or need a bunch of cool candy or toys for a gift or party, this is a great stop in central Phoenix!
Definitely pass by here when you get a chance. Do not pass this place. The ice cream was delicious. My kids who are picky eaters really enjoyed their ice cream.

Starting off with good things: Churn was very mindful of COVID, which I was very happy about! They only allowed 1-2 parties in at a time. They also offered my pup a pup cup which consisted of whipped cream which was really nice of them!! As for the ice cream itself, it was overhyped. I got a vanilla snickerdoodle ice cream sandwich and it was just alright. The ice cream itself was not super unique or notable, it was just ice cream. The cookie was good and dense, perfect for an ice cream sandwich, but I think it could've been warmed or freshly made because mine was rock hard when I ate it. It was a nice, sweet treat, but nothing I would shout on the rooftops about.

Delicious ice cream! It's a small shop, but has a variety of ice cream flavors, sundaes, and candies. We kept it simple and got a scoop each of the double chocolate and Vietnamese coffee. The double chocolate was amazing and a chocolate lover's dream, but I'd skip the Vietnamese coffee and the flavor was a bit bland so I didn't finish mine. Churn gets points for giving huge single scoop portions! And their staff were extremely friendly while braving a massive line that seemed to never end.
It was good. Although there do have a limited selection, the flavors they do have are very good. A bit over priced, but love the atmosphere and location.

Updated review. Ice cream is still good... but for the price of a simple shake you'd expect it to come with standard whip cream. This place is overpriced. I'll stick with Novel on grand Ave.  Also if your staff is going to expect tips then they should have a better attitude.

Ice cream was good. Hot fudge was over cooked and stuck together in chunky globs instead of being soft and in liquid form. Also the mask policy on the front door references outdated CDC guidance from May. CDC updated their guidance three weeks ago on July 27. Since then 300 Arizona's have died and thousands of others have clogged up our hospitals and contracted long COVID. What will it take for you to update your sign and policy to align with the new CDC guidance?

Wowowow. Churn makes excellent ice cream. This may be in the top three ice creams I've had in the entire country. I got half a scoop of the peanut butter, half a scoop of butter pecan. Each one was to die for. The peanut butter was absolutely perfect. The butter pecan was so delicious. I tried my friend's vanilla, and it was so smooth and not your typical boring vanilla. The prices are unbelievable for the quality. Would've paid double the price. It's a small shop with seats outside. And they do samples!
The best the best!!!!! Unbelievable delicious ice cream, all natural the taste is fresh, natural! So proud of this creamery in Phoenix! Highly recommended!

Dear Readers, It was a slightly breezy night during COVID-19. Our group stood in line outside Churn (at a safe distance) for less than 10 min as they were letting in one group at a time. The staff was very friendly and knowledgeable about their products. More importantly, they were all wearing masks. The flavors were unique and intriguing but we settled on mint chip ice cream + mint chip cookie and goat cheese pistachio topped with strawberries (per the recommend of the masked associate). The flavors were fresh and authentic. We sat in the back patio with friends and enjoyed the night. Sincerely, Hillary and Andrew

This is a cool spot in Phoenix. Location is really nice and convenient since there's so many great restaurants around. The interior is small, and old timey style and have photo oriented walls. They are also known for their cassette wall which shares a hallway to the neighboring restaurant that is connected. Besides the nice interior and customer service. The ice cream is mediocre in my opinion. Nothing really special about them and they're straightforward.

This was a very quaint and cute ice cream and candy shop. They make homemade ice cream and sorbet, and they tasted amazing. I tried the vegan coconut sorbet, and I absolutely loved it. I don't usually eat vegan, but this was so good.

Everyone was complaining about parking, but I thought parking was really easy to find.. LOL. I got the s'mores. Should've replaced it with Vietnamese coffee ice cream because the double chocolate in the smores was so over the top chocolate! The graham crackers and marshmallows did complement the ice cream. My boyfriend got he rocky road freeze. I wish I got that because that was really good. You could taste the almonds and chocolate in it. My only negative about this place was that the ice cream melts pretty quick I would definitely come back!

I think my life changed for the better when I took a bite of Churn's peanut butter ice cream. It was so good that I subbed it in the S'mores Sundae. OH MAN it was a darn good sundae, especially with the addition of the torched fluff on top. My only critique? The big rectangles of graham cracker were kind of bulky and hard to eat with a spoon, and I ended up breaking them in the container. I'd say pulverizing them to crumbs would be just as tasty.

I had heard incredible things about this place - how they had the BEST ice cream. But I think the bar was set too high. We stood in line to get our ice cream (they get busy on the weekends), walked up to the counter, ordered two cones (one for my husband and one for me), and paid our bill. ~$15 for two single scoop cones. We walked outside to find a place on the curb to sit and enjoy our treat - I had ordered a Cookies & Mint cone. The ice cream was good, but nothing to write home about. It felt very overpriced for what we received. Not worth the wait/cost, for me personally. I'll go elsewhere! It is a cute place, though! Decorated in a modern ice cream parlor look.

Dropped by Churn on a Sunday night around ~8:00 pm and was met with a bit of a crowd/line. It went by quickly so yay! I opted to go for the vietnamese iced coffee flavor on a sugar cone while my friend got the same thing in a cup~ We decided to sit down in the seats in the front and chow down on our ice cream and boy was it good! My ice cream had a great coffee flavor with the perfect texture and the sugar cone was awesome too! The interior of the store itself is really cute and there's even seating in the back~ This place is located right next to Windsor and across the street from Federal Pizza so definitely swing by after eating at either of those places! There is parking in the front and on the side so you should be set if you drive over! When the night wound down and they had to shut down the outside patio, they were super nice and gave us cookies as a nice "sorry we have to ask you to leave" gesture -- which we super appreciated! Definitely going to come back from some sweet treats in the future~
Delicious milkshake that made a hot day so much better! Prices were kinda high, but she did put about 5 scoops of ice cream. Would recommend if you're in the area! :)

Super cute spot. More of like an old fashioned ice cream parlor with all the random decor and candies. 5 stars for the place. I got the strawberry shortcake and was highly disappointed. My pound cake was rock hard. Boo!!! We got the coke float, it was good, nothing stand out though.

Love this place! This was on my list for the longest time and I'm so glad I finally stopped in! They have such interesting flavors that they rotate out, but I got the oatmeal cookie dough. I wish I would've gotten a more adventurous flavor, but it was still very good and so creamy! There was a line out the door when we got there (it's pretty small inside) but finding a seat out back was no problem! They have such fun decorations and a great candy selection as well!

It's a small shop had a few parking on the back. Me and wife were craving for some desserts and we looked up this place had good reviews so we went there. The flavors we have tried was malted milk chocolate it was so good, Thai ice tea ice cream didn't like it much, butter pecan was good and my wife is all over pecan (hehe) and lastly Vietnamese coffee it's really good but didn't had that creamy texture compared to others and I found it little more sweet than others. So we ended up taking two scoops one of butter pecan and one Vietnamese coffee. Short comings: lesser flavor option compared to online menu and when my wife had asked for a lid they didn't have proper lid for the cup we had taken.

Wow! This place was freaking amazing. Not only is the vibe in the place really cool, the staff are super nice, the place is clean, the ice cream was absolutely delicious!! I got the butter pecan and I was in heaven on earth. It was seriously that good. My family and I ordered around 5 things and everybody devoured everything. I don't think my family's ever been so quiet on drive the home. Everybody finished their ice cream before we even pulled into our neighborhood. Y'all have got to go try out this place! P.s: I wish I would have grabbed a picture to show but it was so good that I forgot to stop eating to take a picture lol
Hands down the best coconut macroon I have ever had. Smash some ice cream in the middle and bam! Best dessert ever! I had it with Madagascar vanilla and 3 days later with double chocolate.

Churn was an awesome ice cream shop. I got their mint chip and cookies as a shake and it was delicious. The ice cream is a little on the pricey side but was definitely worth every cent. They have a small outdoor eating area. The Windsor is right next door and owned by the same owner. I would recommend going to the Windsor for dinner and treating yourself to dessert at Churn. Would definitely be a wonderful night!

Churn has a cute and lively shop interior. There are outdoor tables in the back to enjoy your dessert and free parking both out front and in the adjacent parking lot. The menu is expansive consisting of ice cream, cookies, floats, shakes, and freezies; you can sample ice cream flavors. However, the prices are high for desert that is comparable in taste to what one can get at a grocery store and not distinct from other parlors.
Cute local spot that's always busy. I love the logo and the marketing. Staff was friendly but the product was less than impressive. I probably wouldn't go back and didn't think it was worth the wait
10/10 would recommend! The staff was very nice and the ice cream choices are endless! So many different flavors, and signature flavors! Will be coming back again!

I wasn't feelin this place quite honestly. It's a little hole in the wall and the employees were more than nice. The ice cream just didn't really set itself apart in anyway if I'm being honest and I know the 4 other adults with me felt same way. Nonetheless, Aaron Goldsmith was in front of us with his family and that was definitely the highlight
Very good ice cream but the last time I tried to come in they were closing early which was disappointing.
So good. The coconut ice cream was loaded with coconut flakes. Small scoop was huge! Staff was very friendly.
Find ice cream place the only complaint is that they run out of supplies quite regularly and the substitutions don't seem to make up for it

Churn is a cute little ice cream parlor located near a bunch of restaurants on Central Ave north of downtown Phoenix. My friend and I got a scoop each on a sugar cone. To be honest, I wanted to like this place more because of the good reviews. However, I was quite disappointed about the small number of flavors to choose from, and they didn't sound that great either. Maybe it was just the night that we went. It was an ok first experience here, but I'd be willing to give it another chance and check out if they've switched the flavors around. Churn shares a space with the restaurant Windsor. They share a parking lot but it is quite small, so it can be challenging during busy times. I recommend checking out the parking on the right side instead of in front of Churn, if parking there is full.

This ice cream place is a cute store! Has so many toys and interesting things. I like the interior design in the store. The Vietnamese coffee tastes pretty good. But I ended up getting the strawberry ice cream. Their ice cream is really creamy and soft. Also, their scoops are so big! I couldn't finish one by myself. They had extra seating outside in the back with the water misters going on so that was nice. I was scared I was going to eat my ice cream in the heat because there is no inside seating. Only one thing I didn't like is how the ice cream was melting really quick. Its probably from the combination of the door being kept open and people were really crowded in that store. I also don't see why people like this place so much. It's okay. Nothing special to it just regular ice cream but I just went to try to say that I have gone there before.

My first couple of experiences at Churn were nothing very special. I found myself wondering what all of the hype was about. However, the last time that I came to Churn was a much different experience. My wife and I ordered a scoop of chocolate and a scoop of peanut butter ice cream and the combination of both the chocolate and the peanut butter was delicious. The first couple of times I came here I didn't care too much for the texture of their ice cream, but the texture was pretty smooth and creamy the last time. Not sure if they changed something, but I'm not complaining if they did. Cute little ice cream spot.

This is like a mini version of an old time ice cream parlor without any of the tables. The only tables that they have are a few metal tables outside. Inside is full of tiny nostalgic knickknacks (some you can even buy). Honestly this store is just fun to walk in and see all the random things they have to offer. In my opinion there aren't a ton of different flavors (maybe 15?) but it's okay, because the ones I did sample were AMAZING!! I ended up ordering a kids scoop of Vietnamese coffee and it was perfect! Also, the kids scoop was WAY bigger than I expected and what other parlors have given me before in the past! I get why people rave about this spot. I'll be making a little pit stop here when I'm on this side of town. Environment: 4/5 Food: 5/5 Price: 4.5/5 Service: 4/5

Such a cute store, I enjoyed my ice cream here on sunny October afternoon. I was looking for ice cream place and this was the closest with good reviews. It was a bit difficult to find and parking space was limited. They have a few different kind of cones including waffle and pretzels. I didn't really look too much for flavor as the first thing I saw was Vietnamese coffee and my mind was set. I always enjoy drinking strong Vietnamese coffee with condensed milk, so why not? If I look what else they might have, I may be standing there forever. Vietnamese coffee flavor ice cream was good, I enjoyed it. Well... I had better homemade ice cream somewhere else before but their ice cream was very good. They have small tables and chairs outside in the back. Very small area but most people don't stay there too long anyway. Price was where it should be. I may come back if I am in the area and craving for ice cream.

Yum X 1,000! Had to come here for dessert & coffee after a dinner. I've never had an espresso so now was the time! I had a delicious vanilla cone with salted caramel and a shot of espresso. Loved the outdoor atmosphere. Amazing music & calm people.
Go here for all of your ice cream needs . This place is awesome. All the flavors all the fixins ...I can't see this place disappointing anybody .
Churn has some of the best ice cream I've ever had! What an amazing, nostalgic and fun spot.

We were visiting Phoenix and this place came up on our search. Luckily when we came there weren't any lines, however the line was out the door when we were leaving. The ice cream shop is connected to another bar. As you walk in it's very bright and colorful. They have e about 10 flavors and will let you try any flavor you want. I went with coconut and double chocolate and was very happy with my choices. They have plenty of seating out in the back but there isn't any inside seating. So if you don't like being outside, this place might not be for you. There's plenty of free parking.

Sweet treat that's good to eat. That's how the saying goes, right? Regardless, churns out if you want sweets, it's right across the street from Postino's! (see what I did there?) I came here after Postino's and had their Vietnamese Coffee ice cream. It tastes like Haagen Dazs' coffee ice cream, but more sweet. My friend got the banana ice cream and it tastes like a fresh banana that you've just bitten into. I could have sworn I felt so healthy eating ice cream! It is on the pricey side for ice cream and a little too sweet for me, but I liked it nonetheless!

I wouldn't say I'm an ice cream connoisseur... but I also wouldn't say I'm not one. With that in mind, believe me when I say Churn is always a great choice for dessert. Their ice cream is delectable. The strawberry shortcake sundae is unbelievable. The cookies tho, that's where the money's at. The salted chocolate chip cookie is legitimately one of the best cookies I have ever consumed. Minus 1 star bc I wish the flavors were a little more fun and flirty, but you can't beat the classics so I get it.

I really love this place. Small batch ice cream of incredible flavor. They usually have an adult style ice cream as well not suitable for under 21. This ice cream is worth the calories that you put into your body.
This by far was the best ice cream I've had in a long time! I had the FAT ELVIS and can't wait to go back and have it again!

Churn was yummy but nothing special. Perhaps we didn't get the right flavors, but I'd say you can expect a pretty average ice cream shop. It's a little tough right now because of COVID so you have to wait in a line outside in the heat; just be prepared for that. There's a cute little seating area out back to settle in once you have your treat!

Churn is a classic that every college student at Grand Canyon University goes to. It is basically a rite of passage. It is fun to grab after you get dinner across the street. The ice cream is just made so well, that no matter what flavor you choose, it is almost guaranteed to taste great. You can sit outside in their back patio under the trees with your friends as you eat it all (and maybe go back inside for seconds)

What a cute little ice cream shop!! The staff was informative and helpful. The menu is easy to read. We entered through the backside from Windsor and the staff kindly let us know that the line went outside. There was 1 couple in front of us and we stayed inside in the cool air. The staff was attentive and was happy to be at work. Great attitude/atmosphere. While waiting to order, the store has several types of candy placed for viewing/purchasing in case you want to enjoy with your treat. There are so many choices but I got a classic hot fudge, strawberry, & banana sundae. Yummy!!
We stopped by this little gem before heading to the airport. Very nice gals working and the best cookie sandwich I've ever had. Highly recommend!

This place is just ok. The ice cream does not have much depth and is very flat. My husband got the strawberry cheesecake and it tasted nothing like strawberry cheesecake and I ordered fruity pebbles and for some reason the ice cream tasted like it melted and the. Was frozen again, just did not taste fresh?
Typical retro ice cream shop. I ordered the Apple Pie Float. Love the cinnamon sugar on top and was impressed with the flavor of the apple soda. Really yummy!

So many ice cream spots and tonight we visited Churn. I love the old time candy store feel and fun to see those candies (sorts, bottle caps and razzles) I remember. Even the little toys are fun to check out while waiting your turn. The staff was super friendly and outgoing. I had the butter pecan in a pretzel cone (kinda funky). If you like sweet and salty then this is for you. I loved it. My friend had the double chocolate and Madagascar vanilla with hot fudge. I totally had food envy. I'm not a super big ice cream eater but I enjoyed it and it's so very fresh it reminds me of homemade. I'm headed back to buy some candy soon and maybe some jacks. Super cute fun little joint!

RICH, CREAMY, FLAVORFUL ice cream, need i say more? they can also create sundaes, floats, sammies, and shakes from your ice cream of choice the workers are super nice & cheery, i hope they are like that all the time! --vietnamese coffee: YASSS for all the coffee lovers! NOTE: in a "single scoop" you can mix two flavors! wish i knew this when i ordered

Delicious home made icecream! There was a line when we went in November but the line moves fast. I had their strawberry icecream and normally I can't finish my own but I devoured their strawberry icecream. You can also add fluff to your icecream toppings and it'll make it taste all the better!

Well worth the wait! Saw a line out the door and knew I had to stop by. I got a scoop of the Vietnamese coffee and Almond Joy and both were delicious! Nice flavor, not overly sweet, and good creamy texture! Will be back!
The ice cream is good but there is no real seating unless you're a car . I wouldn't go again

Loved it!! We got the viet coffee and hangover (? forgot but it had whiskey in it) flavors in a cup and added a pretzel cone on top. I've been to my fair share of ice cream places but have never seen a pretzel cone!! Was surprisingly good and the ice cream was creamy and rich. They didn't skimp on the scoops either, which is always a plus. Only thing is our total came out to be close to $7, which is a high price to pay for ice cream.. even good ice cream. Good thing I don't live in the area or else my $$ would def go here.

So glad my fellow yelp Elite cousin was able to take me to some yummy places in phx!! Went here for dessert on a Monday night, around 10-ish, somewhat close to closing, this place was still busy with the back patio area pretty full... A small ice cream shop with tons of candies and toys displayed that got my kids attention... They didn't have a huge ice cream selection, but enough unique flavors to satisfy different preferences.. In contrast, there's tons of toppings to choose from!... I was planning to get an ice cream sandwich, but ended up getting a scoop of cookie and mint with toasted fluff and a cookie on the side... The ice cream was soft and creamy, sweet and minty... Very yum!... The toasted fluff was pretty good, but the combination ended up being a bit to sweet for me! And I was hoping for more of a toasted marshmallow taste... The cookie (kitchen sink), surprisingly was not too sweet, but soft and chewy... Yummy! It's a large cookie, imagine the size of an ice cream sandwich using these cookies! My kid got Madagascar vanilla, it had a real nice vanilla taste! My cousin got her scoop in a pretzel cone.. A pretzel cone? That's just nuts to me! Hehe totally unique... The back patio area with tables, chairs, and benches is pretty cozy and chill.. So glad I went here!

Had the mint & cookies and butter pecan flavors, which were both delicious and creamy! I loved that there were actual pecans in the butter pecan flavor, and did think that the cookies were a little bit lacking in the mint & cookies option. A little bit overpriced, but the ice cream is good and would definitely recommend!

The nicest thing about this place is just how it looks. My partner had the strawberry sundae and I had the kitchen sink sundae and they were completely average. We bought a brownie & oatmeal cookie as well and they weren't anything better we could have bought at a grocery store. If Churn focused on better quality of food instead of trying to be pretty maybe I'd be back..
If you are looking for the best ice cream around town look no further. This is the best homemade ice cream in Phoenix!! The staff are amazing and super kind.

A cute and small place with some delicious ice cream! The staff was very friendly, and the employee who was helping us answered our questions very politely and professionally. We enjoyed the desserts we got and there was plenty of old-time candy, which was neat!
This is seriously the best ice cream I have ever had! The Fat Elvis and the Milk and Cookies. To die for! Great atmosphere. You won't regret going.

Deliciousness - 3.5/5 Happiness - 4.5/5 This is a fun place to go. Loaded with candy, the aroma of fresh baked goods wafting out of it, and a cute sign lit up brightly, its kind of like a time travel journey. My kids and I have always enjoyed it. I wish the ice cream was a little tastier. It is perfectly fine, but it lacks a punch in all flavors that takes ice cream from fine to awesome. The Vietnamese coffee is easily the boldest and best of their flavors. I also really enjoy their milkshakes and freezes, which often come with chunks of cookies and other good stuff.
Best homemade ice cream in Phoenix! Must try their seasonal flavors and chocolate crinkle cookie you will not be disappointed

I really want to give them a 5 star review but the ice cream just wasn't that great on Friday night. Once we ordered after waiting in line for about 10 min (no biggie) we ordered 2 ice cream sandwiches and decided to eat them on their patio. Unfortunately they were out of cookies. Bummer, I wish they would've posted sold out on their board. We opted for the butter pecan and chocolate in a bowl. The butter pecan was good, but the chocolate was almost like a soft serve and turned to mush with minutes of ordering. Almost as if it wasn't kept at the same temperature as the butter pecan and was melted into mush within minutes. I'd like to mention that the staff is very friendly and greeted everyone as they came in. Not sure if that's enough for me to try again though.

I liked the aesthetic and vibes of this place, very aesthetic and sweet! I sampled a few of the flavors, and the Vietnamese Coffee packed the most punch. Real pieces of coffee beans in it. I just got 1 scoop of it. I noticed about 6 small pieces of ice in my scoop as I was eating. I wasn't a fan of that. Either way, I wasn't a huge fan of the flavor options and don't think I would personally return. But I do say give it a shot, if not only for the Vietnamese Coffee flavor because it's delicious! You may find some flavors you love

This little ice cream shop is a hidden gem stashed away down central just north of Camelback. The have some hand churned ice cream (hence the name) and the ice cream is pretty good....but its just ice cream. They also have cookies. A few different flavors and they are ALL amazing. But they are cookies. And then....You make a cookie sandwich with two different flavors of cookie and one hefty scoop of ice cream in the middle for an exquisite ice cream sandwich fit for royalty. Their sundaes are pretty incredible too and they have some fun flavors that capture your tastebuds and demand more CHURN! I love ice cream and I love cookies, so this place is a no brainer. But You can use low quality ice cream and mediocre cookies for an average result. Churn opts for some of the best ice cream in down and cookies baked to perfection. Great job - you keep making ice cream sandwiches and I will keep eating them.

This is a delightful ice cream shop connected to The Windsor restaurant. The parking can be a challenge but the goodness of the ice cream/sorbet was worth the couple times of circling to find a spot. Inside is a retro of "old school" candies and treats aligning a shelf to include Cracker Jack, Sugar Daddies, Pop Rocks, spinning tops, and many more nostalgic treats. A variety of flavorful ice cream choices and YES, tasty VEGAN options as well. While in town visiting for a month I had ice cream at least once a week... well maybe twice. And the wafers here are light and yummy as well... A must try anytime your in the Phoenix area.
This place is amazing lol truly. I've tried some other local ice cream shops but churn is my favorite. The inside is super cute and the patio is very relaxing.

TL:DR - Line is quick. They are offering samples. Carrot cake is DA BOMB! ------------------------------------------------------------------------ Holy Smokes this place is amazing! Came here on a Friday night, little bit of a line, but we got through it in about 10 min. But the ice cream is so worth it. The ice cream itself is a little denser and richer, leaning towards custard. Was a little surprised they were giving out samples, most places outside of AZ aren't doing that. Was going to get a lil freeze (which is their version of a blizzard apparently), but after trying the carrot cake, 100% getting that by itself. Great sweet cream based ice cream with just the most PERFECT chunks of carrot cake in it. It's a perfectly dense, slightly chewy, delicious carrot cake inside an ice cream. While I want to try the other flavor, it will be hard to get anything but that flavor going forward. My partner did get the vietnamese coffee flavor, I don't like coffee, and it tasted like coffee. So if you like it, get it.

We came to Churn for some dessert after enjoying tacos across the street, we really like the ice cream we got! We ordered a small cup of butter pecan and a small cup of peanut butter with chocolate chips, both were great! The nuts in the butter pecan were nice and crunchy still and the texture of the ice cream was very soft. The peanut butter was great! It was very smooth and tasted like real peanuts! The only thing that made me a little sad was they were out of 2 flavors (at least), chocolate and I believe cinnamon. I would definitely come again when visiting Phoenix!

Such a fun ice creamery! The vibes are nostalgic and fun. You can find a ton of trinkets and snacks from the past, which is pretty neat. The ice cream is tasty and there are a lot of flavors to choose from. I'm a sauce person, so the fact that they have so many is a huge plus. Try the caramel!

So I seriously need to open my eyes.... we were just at Postinos across the street the other day and never even saw this place. Probably because were distracted by the view of Circle K. Super cute old fashion ice cream polar. Trendy for sure. They had tons of the old school toys and I bought a few because they were very affordable. I got the Smores sundae and the bf got the elvis sundae. They both looked like posted pictures and were very yummy. A little pricey on the sundaes $7.50 each but I could see why.

Been here a few times and finally remembered to snap a pic of the yumminess! Cute little shop with rotating flavors. Samples are offered as well as an assortment of toppings. The line can get pretty long at times but it's worth the wait.

Churn is a cute little gourmet ice cream shop in central Phoenix. They are located on Central Avenue near Camelback. The location has very limited parking and a difficult street access. If you make it inside prepare for a long wait. The shop resembles an old fashioned ice cream parlor with a modern twist. Those that brave the parking and line will be rewarded with a good selection of fresh and delicious ice cream. Churn has the standard flavors and a selection of rotating specialties. Coffee and candy are also available. I chose the butter pecan in a pretzel cone. The pretzel cone costs extra but is a perfect salty addition to the butter pecan and similar flavors. It has a plastic sleeve to help keep things clean. Churn is really 4.5 stars losing a bit for minor hassles and a slightly grainy ice cream base, but this is still an excellent ice cream option in Phoenix and should be part of anyone's list.

You cannot go wrong here! I recently tried the cookie sandwich and WOW. Salted chocolate chunk with the Vietnamese coffee ice cream was a total treat. Summer, winter, rain or high heat, this place is to die for and has a treat everyone will absolutely love.

Fine but nothing too special. I came here with some friends and the ice cream was good but I don't really understand the crazy hype. I thought it was a little too pricy. I got a scoop of the Cookies n Mint on a waffle cone--ended up costing around $4.80. The ice cream was minty but very melty, and didn't hold very well. I liked the waffle cone but it didn't blow me away. Other flavors included strawberry, orange creamsicle, Vietnamese coffee, and your basics. Their cookies looked AMAZING but $6 for an ice cream sandwich is a little steep. Overall Churn is a cute store but I don't get why it's so popular. The flavors aren't incredibly unique and it's a little too expensive.

I don't understand how I haven't written a review about Churn yet, I've been here about 10 times and LOVE it. In fact, it's the only place I get ice cream from. Starting with the atmosphere, it's super cute and nostalgic. They have vintage toys, gum from when we were kids (25-30 years ago), sweets and a delectable selection of ice cream. I have yet to be here where the service wasn't stellar. Everyone has great recommendations plus you can try the ice cream. Great selection of sweet treats whether you are looking for ice cream, milkshakes, candy, cookies or cones. My favorites include: Vietnamese coffee ice cream and the Rocky Road Lil Freezy. My husband's favorite is a chocolate milkshake with vanilla ice cream and their chocolate syrup. Prices are more than a frozen yogurt place, but you're getting quality ice cream, sauces and mix-ins. If you haven't been here, it's a must! Also, an awesome place to go after you've eaten lunch or dinner at Joyride, Federal, or Windsor. It's a local Phoenix business and we al love supporting our community so check it out!

Very busy spot and parking was quite full because all the other restaurants around. The selection of ice cream is limited but, there were many creative combinations to choose from. One we tried was a s'mores which looked like a fun treat as they melt the marshmallows right in front of you like you would when making creme brÃ»lÃ©e. I sampled a few ice cream flavors and decided to go with butter pecan and asked to have a bit of their flavor of the day which was grapefruit it was delicious and the server didn't charge me more. With a fun Willy Wonka feel to the shop I definitely would go back.
The ice cream is amazing. They have really good sundaes and creative dessert items. Honestly the ice cream is so good I just get a scoop.

I had seen Churn on multiple lists of places to try in and around Phoenix so I made sure to squeeze in a visit. I made my group drive all the way across the city for what promised to be the best ice cream. Even though it was a cold evening the place had a line. After having some difficulty deciding what to get I went with a straight forward ice cream cone. I don't know if my expectations were set too high but I thought it was good. It nothing spectacular. I think the chocolate chip cookie I got for the next day was way better than the ice cream.

I swear I reviewed this place...what happened? ANYWAYS, we came here post Postino's for some dessert. It was a bit busy in the evening but I wanted to take advantage of a deal I got from them. I ordered 1 scoop, and the lady working the register said I could choose two flavors and do half a scoop of each. I got double chocolate and peanut butter (without trying it first). Loved the chocolate, but the PB was not my fave, should've gotten the Vietnamese coffee. It was also a hot day and with no seating inside, we sat on the patio and raced against the clock eating our melty treats. It was actually nice though, they had misters but they didn't quite reach us. They had a lot of cute, nostalgic candies and during cooler weather, the patio seating would be lovely.
Churn is definitely my go-to dessert stop in Uptown. I love their peanut butter ice cream! They have amazing sundaes and shakes too!

I can't imagine there's much that will draw a 20 minute line out the door in Phoenix on an otherwise random Thursday night, but Churn is most certainly capable of doing that - and it's because they've got it all. Star 1: How were the service and atmosphere? While the line can grow long, it's tough to beat the service and atmosphere once you're in the door at Churn. The staff couldn't be more friendly or helpful, and there's enough in here to look at from classic sodas and candy to ice cream for the line time to pass quickly. Star. Star 2: How were the portions relative to the cost? With all this dessert glitz and glam comes a relatively hefty price tag, and I did cringe just a little bit after handing over a whopping $7.50 for a S'mores sundae. The price points are right on the edge of reasonable here, but at the end of the day it's worth it. Star. Stars 3 and 4: How was the food? My S'mores sundae was both good and unique, but it's the toasted marshmallow here that you're really paying for. Besides that this was simply a cup full of vanilla ice cream, graham crackers, and chocolate fudge; which, while good, didn't really taste like s'mores on account of there only being a small single side of toasted marshmallow. Single Star. Star 5: Would you eat here every day if you could? It's really hard to say that Churn is anything but a dessert mecca. Star.
Was good wait was worth it good old school candies def come back when I'm craving a scoop again

Fun little Ice Cream Shop, off of Central. Stopped in last night for a quick ice cream fix for my sweet wife. The flavor selection was perfect size. (Too many choices just causes me to become indecisive - LOL.) We had the Madagascar Vanilla and Butter Pecan. The texture of the ice cream was great and really flavorful. Everyone working behind the counter was friendly and energetic. Besides ice cream cones/cups, they have various sundays and shakes to choose from. The line was a bit long while while we were there, but moved very quickly and was worth the wait. If you are in the area, looking for a treat and also LOVE supporting local... give Churn a shot. You will be happy you did.

This place is a hidden gem. The people working here are so nice. The flavors are amazing, and the kids had way more sugar than they needed (but that's kind of the point here)! The only downfall is the small building. If it's busy, there will be a line outside the front door, as only one group can reasonably be in there at a time, but there is no way to know that if you enter from the back. Will definitely be coming back.

It was ok. I was disappointed that they only had two non dairy options that were both sorbet. Other places also have a dairy free frozen yogurt or a tart. The prices are much higher than I would expect, parking was tough. They did have a bunch of cool candy treats which was cool. It wasn't bad. It I likely won't go back.
Just the very best homemade ice cream! Cute store with nostalgic candies and treats. Staff is always friendly.

Came here for a quick ice cream snack! This place did not disappoint! The inside decor is awesome and gives you that hip ice cream parlor feel. The lady taking orders was exceptionally nice and we felt welcomed as if we were regulars! I ordered the cookie mint with a waffle cone and it was delicious! They even have seating in the back to enjoy your treat! Forget about Dairy Queen down the street this is my new spot!

I cannot with this place. Sooooo good. I'm still thinking about it. I'm from WI aka the Dairy State. So I know ice cream and this is delicious! One of the top five I've ever had for sure. You can taste that it was homemade and made with lots of love. The seasonal flavors were amazing (we tried two) and the staff was very friendly. Do yourself a favor and take a few cookies home with you for later. You don't be disappointed

We decided to check out Churn, post an outdoor Easter event in the spicy Arizona heat. We wanted to try it last night but the line was around the building so we saved it for today. We waited in line but only for about 10 min. They are requiring a mask and only 2 parties in the building at once. Churn is the cutest little ice cream shop, it has a retro candy shop vibe and cute decor. I was pleased with the variety of flavors they offer along with tasty toppings to add to your ice cream. The also offer coffees, cookies and make your own ice cream sandwiches. Yum! My boyfriend and I each got 2 scoops. I chose the coconut and the butter pecan to share with my little one and he chose strawberry sorbet and grapefruit sherbet. All flavors were delish and I love how their ice cream doesn't taste artificially flavored and overly sugary. I also love how reasonably priced they are, cheaper than Baskin Robins and 10X tastier!! Our only disappointment was that there is VERY limited seating and the two tables they do have were full. We had to sit in our vehicle and eating ice cream with a toddler in a car is not the most ideal, but we made it work. Being that they are quite a desired ice cream shop it would be wonderful if they had a few extra tables. Otherwise, we decided we will be adding Churn to our list of Phoenix faves!!

Super cute ice cream parlor. Great customer service, the woman behind the counter was friendly and encouraged me to try flavors while I decided. The ice cream was so good. Very smooth and everything tasted great.

If you like coffee ice cream, then allow me to insist that you try their Vietnamese Coffee ice cream. It is absolutely heavenly and you won't be disappointed. In addition to their decadent ice creams, I also grab a few cookies to go. Fresh, soft, chewy and amazing.

Churn is a staple; I've been here so many times! I love checking out their new flavors and the very delicious ones that stand out to me are coconut and the hangover helper. All the candies in the store always interesting to look at while you wait in line-- and there's often a line because it's so good!

Came for a work event. We had all the flavors amongst our team. Everyone said theirs was the best. Lots of interesting varieties to choose from. Its a little pricey so its a special event kind of treat.

"When I'm no longer rapping, I want to open up an ice cream parlor and call myself Scoop Dogg." €• Snoop Dogg (Duh!) When I think of childhood birthday parties, they were always filled with pizza and ice cream. Well, not MY birthday parties because you know us Asians. We're more of the noodles for longevity and an egg type... Wow, my childhood is heartbreak. Anywho, so on my big milestone birthday, that's what I decided to do: Pizza across the street and Churn's for ice cream. YAS GIRL! Churn is stinkin' adorable with their retro decor, old school candies, and I love their back patio. It was a beautiful night and as I sat there looking at their twinkling lights with some of my bestest and closest friends, eating a single scoop of creamy decadent butter pecan in a waffle cone, I was extremely thankful and happy. Thank you, Churn, for helping me create some great memories! Glad I didn't taste that coconut one Meghan L. and Kazi H. was SO fond of. ;)

This place is WAYY too busy and the ice cream isn't worth the wait. There was a long line inside on a colder night in phoenix and the staff made everyone move outside and wait in the cold. Their store is extremely tiny and overcrowded. Do yourself a favor and go to one of the MANY other places to get ice cream in phoenix. There is NO seating inside their store which is ridiculous and seating is limited outside sharing tables with other neighboring restaurants. Just not worth the long lines and no seating battling the crowd.
The ice cream was delicious, the flavors were creative without being too wacky, and the portions were generous.

This place IS all that its cracked up to be. The line is always long but worth the wait. The ice cream cookie sandwiches look great, but they are so BIG that I have never had the gusto to try them.... yet. You cannot go wrong here and I love the ever-changing flavors.

Turn is an amazing establishment that my family and I love to visit together. It's a great family environment is amazing Desert and the kids absolutely love this place. It's an amazing experience and great ambience. I feel like you're walking back in time when we visit this establishment.
This place was so cute and small. The line was out the door Sunday evening. It was worth the wait and the staff was very friendly and quick. Great ice cream and cookies.

Let's see-- I have a big ol' sweet tooth and love everything Upward Projects does so, yeah, definitely in love with Churn. I like that they have a small selection of well made ice creams so as too not get overwhelmed by choice. Peanut butter and coffee are my go-to flavors, but their seasonal offerings are always worth a try. Churn also makes fantastic cookies. I paired their snickerdoodle with oatmeal stout ice cream, and it was heavenly! Chocolate chip is great, of course, and their coconut macaroons are delightful. When I have someone to share with, I like getting their freezies or sundaes. Get something with marshmallows so the employee can break out the blow torch! Bonus tip-- if you're on the e-posse email list, this is the best place to use your free dessert coupon.
What a cute little ice cream shop, was one of the only open after 10. The Ice cream was amazing (very creamy). The staff was kind and friendly :)

Very unique as you walk in the front and exit out the back. When you do, check out the wall in the hallway. I won't spoil it but it's cool! I always forget how much I love this ice cream. It does not have all of the gimmicks and toppings of other ice cream shops, but the quality is way better. Their ice cream here is SO creamy and tastes real. I would drive cross town for their Vietnamese Coffee. Heck I would drive across town for any of their flavors! Try it and get there before the line is across the parking lot.

This was some really good ice cream! It was nice and creamy, not so ice milky like some ice creams can be. There aren't a lot of flavor options, but there is a nice amount of toppings available. I got the cookies n mint with a little bit of hot fudge on it which was really good. Inside there isn't anywhere to sit, but if you go out the back they have a really nice area that's connected with their restaurant.
Love this place! I had a scoop of the Vietnamese coffee ice cream and my son had a butter pecan shake. Plan to visit again when I'm in town.

Love the crew that works Churn. Always happy and so patient...even when you want to try every flavor! I'm a creature of habit so it is very hard for me to stray from the Vietnamese coffee ice cream - single scoop - in a bowl. I have ventured into the Ice Cream cookie sandwich game. And let me tell you these babies are for sharing. You can either have cookies as your sandwich or they have brownies. Go big or go home....choose the brownie! Also a favorite of this spot are all the classic toys and candy options displayed on their wall. Definitely a spot to walk in enjoy even if you choose to not partake in all the goodies!
Got the strawberry shortcake sundae...AMAZING! Such a cute place and great atmosphere... will definitely be back! Also recommend the s'mores sundae!
Toasted Coconut Sorbet was absolutely light and refreshing with every bite. Only drawback about this place was the wait. it was under 30 min but haha who likes to wait?!

Decent little ice cream shop! I have to say it is very well done and honestly pretty good, it gets pretty busy so I would say if you have to wait too long it may be worth trying somewhere else but overall it's definitely worth a try!
Some of the best ice cream I've had! The Vietnamese coffee and Whiskey Toffee Almond are must gets.

Churn is a nice ice cream shop and one of the few spots that's open late in the area. It was pretty hard to choose what I wanted because they have so many delicious treats to choose from. During this visit I went with the vanilla and strawberry sorbet ice cream. It tasted great and I like that you can add as many toppings as you want. I didn't give it 5 stars because I did find the staff to be a bit rude and very pushy to order.

I'm not sure what the hype of this place is. I had to wait outside in the heat to be able to order, as they are limiting the number of people inside the store. I got a peach ice cream cone, which was alright. I was feeling nostalgic for peach ice cream from back home and this was an okay way to get my fix. The entire visit took a little more than an hour from the time I got in line to when I finished ordering. I probably won't be visiting again. I don't think the wait time, price, and quality of the product justify coming back.
This is some life changing ice cream!! I've been here twice and it's amazing! This time I had the carrot cake and it was awesome! I wish I don't live 150 miles away!

Cute shop, I loved their candy options that you can buy. Some of the flavors on their menu were unique, I've never seen a Vietnamese coffee ice cream flavor before. I ordered the lemon sorbet and it was very refreshing. There's a cute outdoor patio in the back that has plenty of shade.
My favorite place! This ice cream is homemade and so delicious best in Phoenix. Yum

I wish I could give this place 10 stars! I love how They actually treat people like humans...even the teenagers that work there have amazing attitudes and work ethic. Maybe America does have a future...#eaticecream

Ok, how adorable is this place? Parking is limited up front but there is a parking lot on the side with plenty of room. Walking in is like hopping back in time. It is a really cute little ice cream parlor. They have a bunch of fun nostalgic candy for sale too. My mom and I shared one of their seasonal freezes and it was so good. I am really glad we split it, they were nice enough to put it into two cups for us too. It was really good but also really sweet and I definitely would not have been able to finish one myself.
Amazingly flavorful ice cream. They have 2-3 rotating monthly inspired flavors. Staff is always very friendly. This is my new favorite spot!

This gem is tucked away in a little storefront across from Federal Pizza. We stopped in for a sweet tooth fix after dinner and were not disappointed. The line out the door was a sure sign that we were in for some good ice cream. Once inside the staff was helpful and friendly. The selection was a bit smaller than I thought would be typical of an ice cream shop, you can sample a couple of selections before choosing your flavor. Several combinations are offered with select toppings, you can get cups, cones (wife had the pretzel cone) and shakes. We sat outside after ordering and enjoyed a cooler than normal Phoenix evening and sunset. This place is worth the price and the wait.

Probably the best ice cream place I've gone to in Phoenix and I've been to a lot of ice cream places this year. The flavors are always delicious, the customer service is always fast and efficient and friendly and the prices are very reasonable. I return quite often. The cookies and milk ice cream is to simply die for.
The best ice cream in the Valley hands down! Great vibe and good prices. I love the Peanut butter the best. The atmosphere is fantastic. Worth the line!

Fabulous shop. My favorite flavor is the goat cheese, honey and pistachio in a pretzel cone. After reading the reviews, some people seem to really mind that they only sell about 15 flavors at a time, and that they have to sit outside to enjoy. For me, this contributes to the whole experience, and makes me feel like s kid at an authentic creamery. I wouldn't make a 20 mile drive (after all, no ice cream is THAT good), but if I'm in the neighborhood, I consider it a must go to placeX In my opinion, they have the best ice cream in Phoenix.

Absolutely loved my visit to churn. The Vietnamese coffee flavored ice cream was delicious. Be sure to add the chocolate syrup for extra tastiness! Place was exceptionally clean, staff was very friendly and they had a very cute patio out back.

Best. Chocolate. Chip. Cookies. On. Earth. The fat Elvis is to die for. Service is always spot on and it's always a fun time. It may seem cheesy, but I don't know that there is a single time I've been there that I have forgotten. Memories are made at this little magical nugget.

Love this place! It's a family favorite and I tell everyone I know about this place. Everything is made in house, with a seasonal menu too. If you're looking for flavor suggestions, Butter Pecan. It's easily the best version of the flavor I've ever had (ice cream is a food group, thank you very much). They do get busy, the parking is a bit weird, but be patient- goodness takes time y'all! There is seating in the back of the shop, so don't be shy about checking out the patio. Overall, for as long as this place is open- we'll be customers. So good!

Love this place. Its not just about the ice cream, but all of their flavors are amazing, it's walking in the door and having instant flashbacks to my childhood. It's a must try place in Phoenix and absolutely love treating myself to some Churn. Churn baby Churn
Amazing! Super friendly staff! Delicious ice cream, assortment of flavors and fun floats and sundaes! So cute and colorful inside!

We stopped here for dessert after dinner. There was a long line outside. Very popular stop! They are only allowing 2 parties inside to order at a time and masks are required. They have many ice cream flavors and baked goods. Smells delicious. They have some seating outside. We tried the coconut sorbet, dulce de leche and Vietnamese coffee. We also had the coconut macaroon cookie. All delicious! Would go back if we are in the area to try other flavors.

Such a fun little shop! The candy/decor on the walls makes it feel so fun inside. The staff was super friendly and the flavor selections were pretty good. The line was running out the door, but the staff working kept a positive attitude and got through the line very well, while still chatting with everyone. I had the milk and cookies flavor and it was to die for! It truly tasted like milk and cookies and was definitely some of the best ice cream I've ever had. Definitely worth stopping in (and waiting in line!).

Talk about Ice Cream. Used to live in central Phoenix and it's one of my favorites. Now when in the area and it's warm out always enjoy some fresh ice cream. Look forward to my next visit. P.S the S'mores is amazing.

My absolute go-to for ice cream and sundaes when I'm in the area! My personal preference is the "Fat Elvis" which I recommend ordering with one scoop of chocolate and one scoop of peanut butter ice cream. If you're not into sundaes, don't worry! Churn also rotates out some flavors seasonally, and there's always the staples (chocolate, vanilla, peanut butter, etc.) and you can always get a cone with toppings. One thing to note is that there is very little indoor seating (maybe one table), but there are tables out back, and there's usually at least a small line unless you come at an odd time. Worth it though!
