We drive 30 min for the cookies n mint!! Insane to wait so long in line sweating buckets but MARA made our night tonight and went above and beyond in customer service. So bubbly and sweet making sure everyone had a menu and staying outside with everyone in that ridiculous heat. PROPS TO HER!!! And for gods sake please let Mara wear shorts!! Having them outside in pants like that is crazy. But seriously 10/10 everyone try the cookies n mint but please save us some thx
The double chocolate ice cream is INCREDIBLE!! I was blown away!!! My son and I shared the S'mores Sundae and it was so very good! I just wish they had more locations! (Like please come to Utah!)
Yum!! Me and two others all got different things and we were all impressed! Will definitely be going back!

Ty & Natalie went out of their way to make our experience perfect. This is our favorite spot for a tasty treat. Tonight we had some friends in town and we had a bad experience somewhere else and these ladies completely turned our night around. Thank you guys for taking such good care of us
Ice cream is always delicious churn has some really good flavors. I always get the iVietnamese Coffee and the German chocolate.

I love this place. It makes any ice cream place taste like crap because Churn is so fresh. I've been here several times and every time is been great. I had a pb freeze or whatever it was called and man was it good. The ingredients were perfectly mixed throughout. The customer service is always great as well. Always super friendly and helpful. I can't wait to come here again!

Ok, I will start by saying that I'm going to be a little biased. This is, without a doubt, my favorite ice cream place in AZ and maybe the whole country! So why 4 stars and not 5? Because my favorite thing in the world is coconut, and this place has the best coconut ice cream on the planet. They switched to coconut sorbet. We drive all the way from Gilbert a few times a year, and they haven't had the coconut for at least a year. Please bring it back! I beg you!!!!! 5 star review once the coconut returns! 5th star hostage until then!

Good ice cream shop. Flavors are seasonal. I really liked the Vietnamese coffee and the strawberry sorbet flavor! They always give a generous scoop so 1 scoop is enough for me. Service is also good. Very friendly people even though the place was packed. I wish there are more places to sit other than the spaces in the back. It is shared with a bar/restaurant so it's kinda loud. Will go back here again.

When we first walked in, the place looked cheesy but fun. It reminded me of an old school ice cream parlor, like the one they have at Disneyland, and I had assumed they only had simple flavors, but I was wrong! Here is an example of a pleasant surpise. They have a lot of unique flavors that you cannot find at other ice cream spots. We got the banana and Madagascar vanilla, both great and I would get them again. I never get vanilla but when it's good vanilla, you know it's good vanilla, and this place has it. There's a nice outdoor seating area in the back too and the staff was so friendly.

I've only been to Churn twice. The first time I ordered some type of sundae and honestly the toppings were so overwhelming and the whole dessert was just a sweet bomb and I wasn't able to really appreciate the ice cream. This time I ordered a single scoop of tiramisu ice cream. The nice lady behind the counter told us that real amaretto was used. It was absolutely delightful! So creamy and decadent with true, robust tiramisu flavor! Even have lady finger bites! It was so delicious I wish I ordered 3 scoops. Will definitely return for this again and to try other flavors.

The other day I went to Churn and it was sooo good. I guess it depends how you like your ice cream, but I prefer mine not to be as rich and creamy like most. A good way to describe it is it's like homemade ice cream. Now, I usually go for anything with chocolate, but they had so many interesting flavors that I had to try them. When I tried the Vietnamese Coffee, I knew I had to get it. It wasn't too bitter (like coffee) or too sweet. It was honestly perfect for me hehe. I'd definitely come back if it wasn't so far, but for now, I can only reminisce how delicious it was!!

Really good ice cream! Vietnamese Coffee and Strawberry Shortcake are both excellent! Only recommendation is really more of a personal preference but they put all of the extra stuff like cake, graham crackers, strawberry's, etc in large pieces on the top and sides, it makes it a little difficult to eat and would love if they chopped them up and worked the extras into the ice cream! Delicious!
Great ice cream! Rich in flavor and priced similarly to other places. I wish there were more toping options, but they have decent amount of icecream flavors to choose from.

Our first time at Churn. Wow we were all very impressed. Very "home made ice cream" texture with great flavors. I had the roasted coconut and it was amazing. Great chocolate chip cookie with sea salt too.

Creamy, decadent, awesomeness. Such a cute little place and the sundaes are perfection. I had the s'mores sundae and the chocolate ice cream was so good and the toasted marshmallow was the cherry on top! It was gooey and complimented the ice cream so well. Loved it! My husband had the strawberry shortcake and said it was really good too.

This place is a incredibly fun date night for me and my fiancÃ©. He got the strawberry short cake and I got the s'mores they are so fun I've never seen ice cream in such a beautiful display. It is a little pricey however it's a treat every now and then we will be back!

Very good quality ice cream. Cookies were ok, but the ice cream was very tasty. You could really taste the difference. The prices are high. But it's the area and crowd, fits the price mold. The place was busy! But I'd go back. Good ice cream!
Learn how to scoop where the Ice cream doesn't fall on the ground. Not sure if it taste good because first taste rolled right off the cone. Thanks for nothing!

I love this place! It's very small in the front, but you turn the corner and it's just an amazing wall decor and more seating. We decided to sit outside. In PHX, AZ it wasn't too cold at all (especially being from the PNW). When you walk in they have many different old school candy like Razzles and little knick knack toys. It's like I was a kid all over again. The ice cream reminded me of cold stone, but more small town feel. The flavors were great, and I love that they make all their own ice cream. It was overall a really great experience getting dessert after eating at the really yummy Bruschetta Bar across the street. When I visit Phoenix again, I'll definitely come back!
My favorite is the ice cream sandwiches. The cookies are huge and yummy. Little over priced for ice cream, but fun flavors and great welcoming environment. Staff is incredibly friendly.

I came here from out of town and the service here sucked. The girl helping us out was kind of rude and after I paid there wasn't even a "have a good day" or anything. Maybe she was having a bad day but yeah, customer service was very VERY poor. In addition, this shop only had 12 flavors and none of them were appealing or unique. Same old same old nothing special. They dont even make their own cones. In short, going to keep exploring this was a skip for me. It's nothing special just average all around.

This is such a gem of an ice cream destination. Be prepared, the shop is very small and there is hardly any seating, plan to take this ice cream to go. The ambiance of the shop is so cure, it's very much decorated like a vintage ice cream parlor with lots of toys and candy in the background that you can also purchase. They have a wide array of flavors, with made non traditional options. I love their floats and sundaes!
Lies!!! They just told me they closed at 11 PM. I have a bad sense of smell, but I guess it smelled like sewage over here.

I love this ice cream spot it is a guilty pleasure of mine I mean they torch their marshmallows on top! How can you not love that Sebastian one of the baristas is so nice And inciting he made my churn experience that much better!

My in-laws live about ten minutes walking from here. So my main motive was getting the four year old out of the house. She needed to burn some energy before she consumed more sugar. The ice cream is everything people say it is if not more. The prices are what they are. Ice cream even at the grocery store is expensive. Rest assured this isn't grocery store cream. it is legit quality ice cream. My daughter had the chocolate which she devoured. I went with the fat Elvis, which is an amalgamation of various items that I shouldn't eat. All in all we had a ball and shall return.

Upward projects did it again!! The ice cream is creamy and rich, and they offer mostly classic flavors with a few unique options. What sets this ice cream shop apart from the others is all of the ways you can eat ice cream... so many combinations for floats, shakes, freezies and more! I had the Carmel apple pie float with a scoop of vanilla and a scoop of pumpkin ... absolutely fabulous fall treat! The staff are friendly, helpful and patien! The shop is also incredibly clean. Highly recommend you stop by after dinner or just because in the afternoon!

My favorite ice cream place in the valley!! The butter pecan is some of the best I've had. It's pretty popular and there's often a line but I think it's worth the wait. Definitely a place I keep coming back to!
This ice cream shop is pretty cute. They have a variety differ flavor others don't have such as viet coffee ice cream which was delicious. They can customize any ice cream you like as well.

First time checking this place out. Really good place for ice cream. They have seats outside in the back. It's connected to a restaurant right next to them which it's owned by the same person & there's a pizza place across from them which they also own. You can add your own toppings and choose which kind of cone you would like.
Just Ok ice cream cookie sandwich. Enjoyed the vintage shop look and sold vintage candy.

This place used to be 5 stars. They have friendly staff and great ice cream, but for the past couple months they must have tried to save some pennies by purchasing the worst spoons you have ever used. I am thinking these spoons must be repurposed from old dollar store spoons. The are flimsy, they have sharp edges, and they are something you may consider using instead of your fingers but then choose your fingers instead. But really... $5 plus for an ice deserves a spoon that makes the ice cream enjoyable Instead of painful. BRING BACK THE RED SPOONS!

We timed it well...... served fast and found a table....a miracle The downside was they mixed up our order. We decided it was not worth the wait in line to return it and swap the ice cream. Also somethings in the scheme of things little inconveniences like this are not worth moaning about We both had Fat Elvis sundaes. They look impressive. Chocolate pearls on top should be replace the taste is yuck...... but they look good. Shave REAL chocolate over the top would take it into the next dimension The ice cream was good, although I have tasted better The coconut was a little icy. The whipped cream was light.... to much air. The bananas were over ripe on the sundae. Satisfied the sweet tooth urge

Nice place set up like the soda pubs back in the Midwest. Ice cream in a cup or waffle cone, coffee, shakes, and floats. They carry a small selection of old candy and nic nacs. Strawberry shortcake and smores sundae turned very good. They even charred the marshmallow. Great place if you are in the area.

Mmmmm. A fantastic little dessert spot. We are from out of town and are so happy that we stumbled upon Churn. Delicious ice cream and non dairy choices. We'd love to come back if only we lived closer.

Cute place, creamy delicious ice cream :) we loved the vibe we got walking into the store and experience is what we live for. I like how involved the owner was, she knew it was our first time which makes me believe she enjoys getting to know customers.

Let's get this straight first: this place is super cute and the employees were very friendly. It's got an old school parlor vibe and other nostalgic candy and toys available for purchase. The vibe is pretty nice. The ice cream is decent. They had some unique flavors along with some classics, and they have toppings etc you can add on. They also have a pretzel cone for those who may be into that. There isn't any indoor seating, as this place is connected to the restaurant next door. There are some tables outside out the back though. Logistically it can be a little crazy since they have people working the restaurant in and out of the back areas. As for the ice cream, it's okay. I had half a scoop of dark chocolate and half a scoop of peanut butter. Pretty cool that they do half scoops. The peanut butter was good, the chocolate was basic. My girlfriend ordered the s'mores sundae and it was HUGE. Toasted marshmallow, lots of hot fudge, graham cracker and ice cream. The hot fudge did have the ice cream melt quickly, so it was hard to eat l more than a few bites before it turned pretty soupy. Looked great though. Overall it's cute but I'm not sure I would come running back for the ice cream.

Churn is an extraordinarily cute Ice Cream parlor located right next to The Windsor. However, for the prices I was under the inclination I was having artisanal ice cream or something. While the ice cream itself was fair and admittedly very very fresh, the prices are a bit extortionist. They do have a lot of options to go with the ice cream, from customized cones to a variety of toppings but I truly do not think the ice cream was as expensive as they made it out to be. Also, for anyone that is curious at all, their rotational menu is all their flavors on rotation, they only really serve about 8-10 flavors at the location. You might want to call and ask what they have before you make the trek there or refer to the online menu, I *believe* it's updated daily. Good ice cream, just pricey.

****3.5 STARS**** So BuzzFeed listed this place as one of the 27 must visit ice cream shops before you die. I don't think this place should have made the cut. It's good but, not amazing good. I was in town with my family helping my sister move in for school. I was really excited to try this place after seeing the list on BuzzFeed. I LOVE ICE CREAM! I could eat it everyday! What We Ordered - Ice Cream Sandwich: 2 Cookies (Kitchen Sink and Chocolate Chunk) with 2 Ice Cream Flavors (Cookies & Mint and The Stout) - Fat Elvis Sundae - S'Mores Sundae I got the ice cream sandwich. The Cookies & Mint and The Stout was a good combo together! I could have done without the cookies. The Staff recommended me getting the ice cream sandwich instead of the cone. The cookies were not that good. The Kitchen Sink Cookie was super hard!!! Not a fan of hard cookies...and no, they were not hard because of the cold ice cream. The Chocolate Chunk Cookie was really moist but too salty. I really like sea salt chocolate type cookies but this just had too much salt. :( I was really sad... I usually love cookies too. $5 for basically just the ice cream, not worth it. :( My sister's boyfriend got the Fat Elvis. He seemed to enjoy it. My sister LOVED her S'Mores Sundae but she wished there were more Graham crackers in it. I did not like the fact that there were no inside seating. Arizona is super hot. Why would there not be any indoor seating?! They had tables outside but there were a bunch of flies flying around back there. :( -1 STAR for hard/salty cookies -0.5 STAR no indoor seating and they limit the amount of samples you get

Mouth full of heaven! I ordered the S'more sundae & replaced the chocolate ice cream with cookie mint ice cream. My husband ordered a triple scoop cone with strawberry, toasted coconut, and cookie mint ice cream. The ice cream is churned to perfection. It's creamy and thick but soft. To top it off the two cashiers raced to create our masterpieces and took seconds to start eating our dessert. Lots of parking in the back, but you can park in front for a quick stop.

We came here last night around 9:20pm. Thursday night and there was a line out the door but mainly because it was one girl scooping for awhile until another one joined. Both girls were very friendly. We tried the butter pecan, Vietnamese coffee, cookies and mint, and dulce de leche. All of the flavors minus the butter pecan were really creamy and smooth. The butter pecan was pretty icy but maybe it was just a bad batch. The dulce de leche was incredibly sweet. Too sweet actually. It's a cute little shop with a small patio outside where you can sit and enjoy your ice cream. It was solid standard ice cream but I wouldn't say it's the best. We are only in town for a few days but I think we will explore other ice cream options rather than come back.

After I went to Little Miss BBQ, I decided that I needed some ice cream. I had this bookmarked and decided to have some dessert. It was bomb! I walked in and looked over the menu real quick. It was a tough choice between the "Smores Sundae" or the "Rocky Road Lil Freezie". While I was looking at the menu, the voice of Sloth in The Goonies popped into my head....... "Rocky Roooooaadddd". That was it. I ordered a Rocky Road Lil Freezie. This creation came with 2 (possibly more) scoops of ice cream, it was stuffed full of chocolate covered almonds and then topped with some marshmallow fluff. They constructed my ice cream and then at the very last minute they bust out the blow torch to toast my marshmallow. They handed over the goods and here is how it was................. Rocky Road Lil Freezie- This thing was great! They give you a huge scoop of marshmallow and then toast it for you. This is placed upon 2 scoops of chocolate ice cream and then its mixed in with chocolate covered almonds. The almonds were almost like an almond bark. They were really delicious! They blend it up like a concrete/blizzard and then hand it over. I will come back the next time I am allowed to eat ice cream ;-) and try out some of their other stuff. It's not cheap....almost $7.00 for my concoction but it was very refreshing and one hell of an ice cream treat.

Ooo buddy let me tell ya. This some good ice cream right here. Definitely worth going to try. Only negative I have of this place is it is a bit expensive in my opinion. They give you options for toppings on ice cream which I think is dope but you have to pay per topping so it can add up.
This place is amazeballs. The ice cream Here is always flavorful. It's always busy though and the ice cream is worth the time and money.

Those who know me, know I am not a fan of ice cream, never have been, some of us like cake, some like ice cream, and some like having both haha, so for me if doing a dessert I'm more of a cookie/brownie/cake kind of girl . But with that said, Churn has to be the cutest Ice Cream Shoppe in town! They are just too adorbs, its just the cutest! Was having a rough day last week and a friend and I just had dinner in the area and she wanted to try some dessert, so off to Churn we went. When we walked in I stood in wonder while I watched them make the smores sunday, holy crap they busted out with a torch and torched the marshmallow fluff! OMG I will have to come back and try that!!! Like I said I'm not one for ice cream but I saw they had Vietnamese Coffee ice cream, so I ordered a scoop and topped it with sprinkles and made my way to the patio out back, which by the way it cutely done up too! Let me tell you, this was a great scoop of ice cream! So creamy and yummy! Like eating a coffee frap! Can't wait to come back to get a Smores Sunday!

Churn is one of my favorite ice cream places for one sole reason: their cookies and mint ice cream! Out of all of the times that I've come and tried a lot of their flavors I always end up ordering the same thing because it is so good. They use huge pieces of Oreo in the ice cream which adds a little bit of crunch to the ice cream which I really love. The workers are always super nice whenever you come in too and they encourage you to try all of their flavors. The parking can be a bit tricky in front of and behind the store, so I definitely recommend carpooling if you are going with a big group of people. The inside of the store has no seating, but there is plenty in front and on the patio where they have gas heaters for chilly nights. I am definitely a big fan of churn and bring all of my friends!

I got the coffee ice cream, it was recommended to me over the vegan coconut.. it was grainy, and I didn't end up finishing it. we also got the tiramisu, which has alcohol in it, and it was good but really sweet.

One of my new favorite places for ice cream! First of all, it's connected to Windsor (my favorite restaurant and Old Fashioned!), second of all, they have a bunch of fun flavors (yes.. I tried them all. Don't judge me.) The service is great- they're super nice! One of the ice cream scoopers noticed my husband's Seahawks shirt and asked if we're from Seattle. He said he's headed back to Washington next week for school. It's so nice to meet genuine people who can relate to you. They have a Peanut Butter and Jelly flavor that tastes A LOT like an uncrustable sandwich. The Butter Pecan should have a "danger" label on it because you could easily eat an entire tub of it; it has crunchy pecans and melts in your mouth! The girl helping us said her favorite is the Blueberry Cheesecake, which was delicious! It tastes like a Blueberry O'cream pie that I make on Thanksgiving. They also have Floats; one is called "Caramel Apple Pie" with vanilla ice cream, salted caramel, apple SODA, and cinnamon sugar. I don't know what Apple Soda is but I want it! The chocolate, peanut butter and coffee were sooo good and perfect bases for toppings! There's also a bunch of cone options (Pretzel cone?!)! Everything was so good we literally couldn't decide. We went with the most popular (I know.... boring) and ordered the S'more's. It has chocolate ice cream, hot fudge, butter Grahams (better than any graham cracker I've ever had), and here's where it gets good... toasted marshmallow fluff! Honestly, I don't typically like marshmallows and I really didn't want a big mouth full of marshmallow. But this is not your typical marshmallow. This is that runny, fluffy stuff that's toasted to a crisp on top and compliments the ice cream perfectly. I actually don't think I'll ever get ice cream again without this toasted cloud on top.

the quality of the ice cream here is absolutely ASTOUNDING !! my friend and I shared the strawberry shortcake sundae to satisfy our sweet tooth cravings. the strawberry and vanilla ice cream really complimented one another. the shortcake was hardened probably due to it being kept in cold temperatures, so it was difficult to eat without making a mess. Nonetheless it was still extremely tasty :) it is kind of overpriced, $8 for a sundae. however, it is a generous portion and the the quality is A1.

Churn is an old school ice cream parlor. It gives you the feels as you stand in line among all the candies from your childhood. I got a double scoop of butter pecan and Vietnamese coffee with added fluff on top. The toasted marshmallow added a touch of sweetness to the coffee ice cream. It's a cute spot for an after dinner treat or a date!

No matter how many times I make a churn visit, I love it every time! Took my family from out of state here. We ended up getting single scoops on their free sugar cones in the flavors; Butter Pecan, Chai and Vietnamese Coffee. The ice cream was so creamy and definitely tasted spot on with what was advertised. The service and atmosphere here is so great, the workers are always so friendly and happy. Love the retro toys and candies as well as the patio out back and out front. It was a bit hot so it was a shame the misters weren't on, our scoops of ice cream were melting so fast in the Phoenix heat! They have two spacious bathrooms available as well.

This is seriously THE BEST ice cream I have had. EVER. IN MY LIFE. Like better than Sprinkles or Cold Stone or anywhere seriously oh my goodness. I'm lactose intolerant but I ate every bit of my butter pecan ice cream and #noregrets!! The place is super cute inside too!! Also the girls that were working were very nice and they gave me another ice cream cone after I accidentally dropped mine on the counter right after they gave it to me.... Lol thanks guys!! :)

What a cool place its looks like back in the 40s very retro but the milkshake was spot-on I had the coconut and chocolate mixed it was like eating a liquid Almond Joy so good the girl at the counter was very attentive and since it was my first time there she explained everything to me will definitely go back very soon they have so many other things on their menu I like to try

This place is dangerous for 2 reasons. 1. EVERYTHING IS DELICIOUS! 2. I live down the street. I have literally tried every cookie they make and they're all good. The coconut macaroons and kitchen sink cookies are my favorite. One thing to note is that they rotate cookie varieties day to day. All the ice cream is homemade and also all good. Vietnamese coffee is my go to. If you can't decide on a flavor, they let go half and half, even for a single scoop.

If you like ice cream, you'll love this place. They do a great job. The best I have had in many years. They are creative with their flavors. I had grapefruit buttermilk. Wow. Wow. You should head right down. Great friendly employees too
AWE-MAZING!!! Great homemade treats for the whole family. Even the vegan coconut ice cream was incredible. Cookies were fresh and yummy too!

The website didn't have up to date flavors but it was a nice surprise to walk into the store and see a few different flavors. I ended up with the s'mores sundae and loved it! The ice cream is great but the hot fudge sauce was out of this world!
The dairy free options here are great and the coconut sorbet is incredible great little spot to visit!

It is what every one says it is! Heaven. I mean this place lives up to the yelp stars. The marshmallow and the ice cream was bomb. Parking: lot outside is small so side parking is also an option. Service: huge line but the people who work there treat everyone the same with the same kindness and enthusiasm for each persons order. I really liked that about them. They let me try as many flavors in order to make an order I liked. There is seating in the back and they have heaters! Food: I got a double scoop of the cookies and mint and the chocolate with brownie. It was heaven. Huge huge bits of brownies in there! And the cookies and mint was yummy with big chunks of cookies. So yummy and creamy! Will go again for that chocolate and brownie!

Cute little old school candy shop and amazing ice cream! I had cherry pie and Vietnamese coffee (amazing!) skip the pretzel cone - it was hard as a rock. But ice cream and ambiance is great. It's attached to The Windsor which is also amazing for brunch, lunch or dinner

Fun flavors and helpful staff make this small AZ ice cream joint a winner in my book. I tried a few flavors, but fell for the Strawberry Rhubarb Sorbet on a sunny sunday in mid november. The place can get cramped, so be aware of that. It has an old soda fountain type feel, which I loved. I'm not often in Phoenix, but if I go back I'd probably check out Churn to see what new flavors they have. Stay Cheerful ;)

A must-see ice cream shop in Phoenix! We loved snapping Instagram pics of the decor and held up the line while trying to decide what amazing ice cream goodness to order. I ended up with a make-your-own-ice-cream-sandwich concoction with peanut butter ice cream smashed between a chocolate chip cookie and a peanut butter cookie, with a toasted marshmallow on top. The only thing that could have made it better was a warm, freshly toasted marshmallow instead of the pre-toasted one.

First time here. I got a waffle cone and it was amazinggggg. I also got the blueberry cheesecake ice cream which was also delicious. There was a line out the door when we went but it was good and worth it.

Not as many ice cream flavors as some of the more well-known chains; however, who needs a bajillion flavors when the ice cream tastes 'this.darn.good'?! I had the Vietnamese coffee, the food lady wife had butter pecan, and the girls had rocky road and something else gobbled up before I even sat down! There's a load of other specialist candies and drinks for sale - the seating area outside the back made it for us. Relaxed and peaceful. 5 stars from us.

The old fashion look is very appealing with little nick nacks and old treats every where. The shop is very small and quaint but loaded with good desserts. I tried the Cookies and Mint which very good combination of 2 favorites blended just right. I had it on a sugar cone which brought back memories of my childhood going to Baskin Robbins on my birthday in grade school. A tip is if you order a scoop ask for half scoop of one flavor and get a second flavor and it is like getting to scoops for the price of one. When we went there was no line and we walked up and were served right a way with even getting samples. The is a sitting area in the back which is nice to sit and take your time. Overall had a great first impression and will certainly come back to try other flavors and desserts. Great job Churn!
Tastiness abounds. Tried the pretzel single scoop cone. Friendly staff Attached to restaurants and stores with shared patios

Growing up in the Valley we would go to Farrell's Ice Cream Parlor or the Sugar Bowl for our ice cream experience. As time went by, many of the old cream shops disappeared. Now many variations of them have been making a comeback. Churn is a regular stop for me and has been around for a few years now. It has made a list of one of the best ice cream spots in the U.S. It has a cool retro ice cream parlor vibe to it and usually always has a line out the door. One of the fun things I like to do it reminisce some of the candies that they have on display while waiting in line. Atomic Fireballs, Old Fashioned Taffy, Big League Chew, Good & Plenty and Astropops are just some of the candies I used to buy as a kid at the store. They have an extensive list of ice cream flavors that rotates in and out quite often. My personal favorites are the Butter Pecan and Vietnamese coffee. Nostalgic cookie sandwiches have also made a comeback and Churn offers a variety of cookies to choose from to make your sandwich. Sundaes include fun creations like the S'Mores and the Fat Elvis (PB and banana). They also have Lil' Freezies on hand (blended sundaes in a cup). Prices here are very reasonable and they open late for the after dinner crowd. They have extra seating in the back if you can't grab a table up front. Churn is located next door to Windsor (their Upward Projects sister restaurant) and down the street from Uptown Plaza.

My friends and I have been coming to Churn once a week for the past 2 months and we couldn't be happier with our experience! The store looks like an old fashion ice cream parlor, the employees are friendly, and the ice cream is, well... CREAMY! The line can be long at times but you'll hardly notice the wait as the employees work quickly and are constantly talking to you as if you're one of your friends. The have unique flavors such as the cookies n' mint and Vietnamese coffee in addition to the normal flavors like chocolate, vanilla, and strawberry. The one downfall that they have is the limited parking; however, that will not stop my friends and I from coming back for more!
Churn is great! It's good desert place for quick stop. I love their flavors and their options!

One of the best ice cream cones I've ever had! My husband and I have been to numerous ice cream places in the Phoenix area and this is by far our favorite! I had a Buttermilk Tangerine that was AMAZING! My husband had Madagascar Vanilla that he said was outstanding! We can't wait to return! Yum!

The best butter pecan ice cream I have ever had. I come here once a week (okay sometimes 3 times a week). The only draw back to this place is others are hip to the deliciousness inside so there can be quite a wait at times. BUT IT IS WORTH THE WAIT.

Homemade ice cream. It doesn't get better than Churn. Smooth, creamy and super delicious. I has a children's two scoop dish. Butter pecan, a little sweet with plenty of pecans. Reminded me of pecan pie gone super creamy. Other scoop was toasted coconut. My favorite. Plenty of coconut and super yummy ice cream. The children's cup is served with a small cone and plastic toy on top. Fun!

This place is a hidden gem in the middle of the city. There is an oasis of plants all around it and the oasis known as heavenly ice cream. Parking can be a little difficult but I can see why. Many people want to come here and it shows. The interior looked like a cute old candy shop. They had some interesting flavors and I liked that they had a mix of sundaes, floats and more. Our waitress was amazing. She gave us suggestions about how to cater our treats to use and was prompt with making them. She even hand churned my ice cream to be like a shake. It was amazing. I would definitely get the Hocus Pocus again. Definitely try this place out, you will not regret it!

Food: Ice cream cookie sandwich - you choose your cookie and ice cream. -- Butter Pecan Ice Cream: delicious and creamy! 4/5 -- Salted Chocolate Chip Cookie: The cookie on the other hand was super salty! I know it's supposed to be salty but it was as if the cookies were dipped in salt! I ended up eating the ice cream and was only able to eat half a cookie. 2/5 Service: Even though the line was out the door, the employees were still quick and friendly. 3/5 Final thoughts: I'm definitely coming to try their other desserts! And I'm definitely getting the Vietnamese coffee flavored ice cream! :)

Fantastic, high quality ice cream. You can do no wrong but I'm a sucker for strawberry ice cream. I generally believe if a place can do a good job with strawberry ice cream, they can do most other favors well. It's not a big place but has a wonderful outdoor seating area behind the store.

Delicious ! Did I say delicious? I came to this place for the first time in 2015 of July. I didn't ever write a review. I haven't come back since July but this place never disappoints. Now that I live in the area, we will be frequent customers! Are you having a craving for sweets? Want delicious ice cream? This is the spot! I'm not much of a sweet tooth person ...but once in a blue moon I get this insatiable craving for sweets! This past weekend was one of them! An ohh my gosh it was so delicious! I felt like the Cookie Monster while i was eating and of course a little guilty aft wards! Believe it's worth breaking the diet every now and then for this place just do extra laps or longer gym session . So my favorite here so far are the ice cream sandwiches ! Homemade cookies with great ice cream. There are usually a great variety of cookies! Cookies I've tried with the sandwiches were: coconut macaroon, snicker doodle (my favorite ) and peanut butter (on this visit). Ice cream i have put in my sandwiches include: pumpkin, butter pecan (one of my faves ! Can't go wrong with this one), and their goat cheese honey pistachio ( also a favorite of mine and a seasonal one! I've been having a thing for goat ice cream since I've tried it in Seattle ). So the cool thing is you can mix and match anything. You don't have to have the same to cookies and choose whatever ice cream you want! Other things I've tried here, is their freezes! Very good! Similar to a blizzard but a 100 times better! Salted caramel freeze is the one my boyfriend had and I had a taste and it was yummy! The place itself is cute! Old fashioned style looking decor and lots of candy to choose from. Customer service is wonderful ! I hear there are lines here constantly but I have happened to miss the lines every time ! I definitely recommend the place! You will be happy you tried it !

We came here for a sweet bite after eating across the street at Federal Pizza. The line was out the door, but no one seemed to mind waiting. I was too busy looking at all the retro candy from my childhood, so when I got to the front of the line...I had no clue what I wanted and didn't want to hold the line up. So, one of the gals suggested the Peanut Butter ice cream (score!) and the pretzel cone I had already planned to try...because...it's a pretzel and a cone! I loved the creamy natural tasting peanut butter ice cream, but the cone was a bit of a let down. It was a tad too salty and not light and airy like a regular pretzel. It was thick and on the crunchy side. So, I think I'll skip it the next time I go in. We enjoyed sitting out back though! Make sure you make your way back there instead of sitting out front where the line is a bit in the way.

Lovely neighborhood, good parking, retro vibe. The employee working was very friendly and let me try a couple samples. They had some obscure flavors and some normal ones. I was told all the ice cream was made on property. I went with the Smores Sundae, which was 2-3 scoops of chocolate ice cream, graham crackers, hot fudge and marshmallow fluff, which they actually take a blow torch to resemble a cooked marshmallow! The sundae itself was huge, I could have (and should have) split it with someone else. It was $8.15 though, which to me is really expensive for a sundae! I would definitely come back- maybe skip the sundae and try a cone instead!

What a small space! I've wanted to visit since Churn first opened, and that was five years ago. I've noticed friends check in for all of this time, and I've seen their posted photos, and yet, I never expected this shop to be in this tiny space. I liked how the shop looked from the outside. It was 118 degrees F today, and I found a great end spot, next to a tree (?), and the shop looked really quaint in the shade. Opened the door of the shop, and bam! There were so many customers sardined in an 10 foot x 5 foot of space (guess-timate) in front of the ice cream display case. On the other side of the case were three employees, two of which were cheerfully greeting customers and offering up samples, while the other looked like she'd had enough and wanted out. She'd just washed her hands, dried them with a paper towel, and unknowingly overshot the trash can right behind her. Thankfully, she hit the target emptying a milkshake receptacle... Ah, well. I don't blame her, as who wouldn't dislike it if everyone kept opening the door to let the oppressive heat in? I noticed about 9 flavors, five of which were limited-time only (a few of which were sorbets). I asked to sample the Toasted Coconut, Vietnamese Coffee, and Peaches 'n Honey ice cream, and the Blueberry-Lemon sorbet, the latter two were LTOs. I enjoyed all four, but did find the sorbet to be a little too sweet. I normally get one, or two flavors at a time, but since I don't know when I'll be in the neighborhood again, I went for the other three. My favorite was, surprise, the coffee, followed by the coconut. I wished I could've fancied the peach more, but I found it too tart in comparison with the other two. I'd most likely order it again, possibly on a waffle cone to give it a bit more sweetness and texture (and I'm all for texture when eating ice cream!). yelp.com/biz_photos/chur€¦ The flavors and textures were very enjoyable, but I found the colors of the peach and the coconut, which looked similar, a little strange. I'm hoping it to mean that Churn does not use artificial coloring in their recipes. The coffee, however, had these gorgeous coffee bean flecks, so it was a shame that the full scoop was hidden at the bottom of the cup. I know now to order my favorite flavor last, so that it will be on top! Oh, and yes, you may order half-scoops. I originally ordered the coffee and the peach, which prompted the bubbly young man to ask "Would you like a full-scoop each, or half a scoop?" I asked what the price difference was, and he said "A dollar," so I went with two full scoops. I then decided to add the coconut, and asked for the peach and coconut as half-scoops. Next time, I'll order only one scoop of one flavor, as I ended up throwing away half of the peach and half of the coconut, anyway. (To save calories! Also, I was quite full with the coffee ice cream and halfsies of the two apps and entree from my visit to Okra previously.) What's with the cheap, nostalgic candy all over the place? Better to get rid of them, or move them to higher shelves, and use the extra space for a standing bar/table area. Since there wasn't much space in the shop to stand around in, and the misted patio** was crowded, I decided to hang out at the hall between Windsor and Churn and have a look at the wall decorated with analog tapes. Now that's nostalgia I can appreciate! **Those misters do not spray plain water! I was told elsewhere that they spray a solution blend to help prevent clogs (from lime buildup?). It's the reason I try not to park next to misters, and a reason why I don't want those misters spraying into my food and drink!

Tried out Churn for the first time today as I was in the area. I got coconut sorbet, peaches & honey and cookies & mint. The inside of the store had a lot of charm. Both peaches & honey and cookies & mint were great. Not heavy from the dairy- still remained light and felt like summer. Coconut sorbet was heavy for sorbet and had a foul/burnt after taste. May have gone bad; I was surprised how that one tasted. Not tropical or fruity at all.

This place is great! Price-wise wasn't bad at all, for 2 cones and 2 scoops of ice-cream each was less than $10.00. They have all yummy flavor, we both got the Vietnamese ice coffee and Thai ice tea flavor which was super creamy and sweet! The service here is super friendly and fast. This place also have a lot of space for parking as well!

Wow, the reviews did not lie about this place! I drove from Tempe to stop at this gem after a particularly disheartening afternoon. It was empty at 4 pm to my luck so the girl at the counter gave me a few samples and said to take my time as she described the flavors and combinations with such passion! A connoisseur just like me! I was without a doubt made to feel better by her benevolence as well as the incredible flavors of the S'mores ice cream sundae I indulged in. I paired it with chocolate and peanut butter (but probably should have gone with the vanilla that she recommended due to chocolate overload). I'm not a fan of marshmallows, but it seems they make them there (or have a magical vendor) and let me tell you...it was delicious as was the entire concoction! That definitely turned my frown upside down. I also took a pint to go like a fat kid.

I visited churn last night for dessert. I ordered two scoops of ice cream, peanut butter and chocolate. I asked for Reese's on top but the employee put Oreo instead. There was a long line so I didn't speak up about the wrong topping. They also had their brownie crinkle cookies which are AMAZING! I ordered one of those to go as well. It was delicious as always. Love the inside of churn with the many candies to pick from and the cute wall decor and paint etc. it has always been one of my favorite ice cream spots. If you are in central phoenix, this is a must try. There is always a line but it goes quick!

It was a fun night for me, my sister and brother in law and after dinner we thought we'd come here. Cozy and fun place with some good ice cream. I got a scoop of chocolate and a scoop of bailey's crunch and man I'd definitely recommend that baileys crunch. It is a rotating flavor so not always available but when it is, so your self a favor and get one.

Line like a roller coaster ride! Okay not THAT long but in the evenings the line can get pretty long...and yet it's worth it! Cute interior with old school candy and toys. It threw me off the first time but they let you try various flavors on actual mini spoons rather than disposable spoons (bc it's better for the environment and lowers costs, I'm assuming?). The dulce de leche ice cream flavor is so good!! They have several combo ice cream/cookie/topping creations that are really good too. I wish they had a menu outside so there was more time to look at it and be prepared once you get up to the register to order. Be careful this place is so good it's dangerous!

Modern but feels old fashion. I ordered the rocky road sundae. How rocky was this road? Well if I were driving Grandma around, her dentures would be rattling and once we get to the destination, she may have lost them somewhere between here and there. So if you can't picture it, the rocky road is loaded with almonds. I loved the almonds and was the best part of the sundae. The chocolate ice cream was creamy but too sweet for me. The flambÃ© marshmallow fluff was beautiful and enticing, but too sweet for me. I ordered a pretzel cone on the side to try as I read good reviews... it was kind of ehh. I would absolutely come back to try more of their imaginative menu. I was surprised at the sticker price on the menu, so be prepared. I came late at night so parking wasn't an issue, but it may be an issue during prime time. Oh those nuts... Grandma, can we go on another ride?

Chicagoan visiting with wife and kids. Hit this place twice. Friendly staff. Good portion for price.Better Run, Better Flavor, Better Value than Sweet Republic (HYPE!) I have had Coconut Ice Cream all over the world, no joke. 4 continents. Their coconut is the best i have ever had. Rocky Road was good not great. Their Strawberry was killer. Recommended.

I've been looking for a local and homemade ice cream spot for years and I absolutely love Churn! I was greeted with a warm smile and welcome by a handsome, tall, and kind server. He provided samples of a few of their ice creams to my friend and I. I tried the vanilla and chocolate mint--and both were delicious. They were so rich, creamy, and smooth; it was hard to decide which one I wanted, so the server suggested that I get a half scoop of each. I decided to do just that and add a half an oatmeal cookie to top it off. The mixture of the sweetness of the vanilla and chocolate mint and the saltiness of the cookie were just right and it was just enough to fill my sweet tooth. The cost was not bad at all--just $4. I love that this spot is local, they give samples, they have new flavors, and they are so welcoming and friendly. Definitely when I am back in Phoenix I plan to return to Churn!

Good vibes! We went for ice cream this evening and we can say with all sincerity that it was a great experience. I tried the cookie/mint and the Vietnamese coffee and it was delicious. My S/O gitot the strawberry shortcake sundae and enjoyed it. We would come here again for more ice cream. :)

This place is definitely good! When we arrived there was a bit of a wait but that was okay for us. I got the Whiskey Toffee Almond and my sister got Cookies & Milk and they were both DELICIOUS. (The Cookies & Milk was NO Cookies and Cream - It was legit like you were dipping a cookie in milk and eating it. It was amazing) My best friend got the Double Chocolate and liked it a lot, I had a lick and it was a nice sold chocolate ice cream for sure. Great place. When we had had a mix up of the wrong cones they immediately fixed the problem and got us the right flavors. Highly recommend!

Wonderful ice cream shop. I love supporting small local businesses just like this because they are usually locally owned and family run and I like supporting the community. But most of all the ice cream is fantastic. There is nothing in this shop that you can't love. The service is amazing and the people are extremely friendly so what more can you ask for?

One of the best ice cream places in the valley. My favorite is a pretzel cone with peanut butter ice cream and some salted Caramel. Their sundaes are really delicious and filling. The only downside to this place is their floats don't have enough ice cream and the soda always seems warm so it melts it too fast. The left over soda in the bottle, because it is warm, you don't really feel like drinking the rest of it.

Great small batch ice cream. They have waffle cones, sugar cones, and pretzel cones. Some of the flavors rotate each month. The pretzel cones pair well with the salted caramel and the Mexican chocolate. The Madagascar vanilla is also very good. They also have homemade caramels $.50 each and they are delicious. The service is fantastic. The staff is friendly and helpful. Did I mention the Hangover Helper? there's bourbon in the ice cream, seriously... 21 and over.

HOLY CONE-OLI! I am addicted to Churn. It is the perfect ice cream shop with perfect ice cream. A traditional ice cream cone with 2 scoops of ice cream is all I need here. I have had the pleasure of trying the ice cream sandwich with fresh cookies and a little freezie, which are both amazing. These hot nights are perfect for a quick stop to the ice cream shop, they will subside any craving immediately! Whether its the coffee flavor, mint cookie, Madagascar vanilla, coconut, chocolate, should I keep going.... I am so glad I came across Churn, it is one of the best things that has ever happened to me! I just love that ice cream :)

Wow. Churn is most definitely the best ice cream place that I've found yet in the valley (granted I've only been here 4 months, but I eat a lot of ice cream). The only better Ice Cream is way back in Illinois and since I can't really get to that, Churn is definitely a suitable replacement. The inside of the shop is small but eclectic, with all kinds of vintage toys and candy to keep someone like me interested while I wait in line (because there is certainly a line). The ice cream itself is super creamy and soft, and has just the right amount of water content to keep you from getting thirsty while eating it. THAT IS A BIG DEAL. It's just really well done ice cream. Certainly worth the trip.
My favorite ice cream! Kinda pricey but so worth it! Been many times, try the s'mores and strawberry shortcake sundaes but bring a friend because you won't be able to finish one on your own.

Came in on a rainy night and there was no line. It's worth the line though. We had the pumpkin pie and cookies and mint. They were both delicious. Natalie and Miguel helped us decide on flavors to try. They were friendly! Churn is made in house with good stuff. It's not as complicated as some of the other big ice cream places. Churn is local, simple, and so good. Try it!
My favorite is the peanut butter ice cream! If you don't mind waiting in line. It's totally worth it. Employees are nice and upbeat.

Amarena cherry!!! RUN!!!! HURRY!!! SO DELICIOUS!!! My sister and I went this past weekend. It was only raining a little but by the time we arrived it was down pouring. I ordered a pint to go but we figured we would wait out the rain. While we waited we ate all of this delicious ice cream. So creamy and so flavorful! I absolutely loved this ice cream. I was sad I didn't get a cookie to go with it but my stomach was already full. The inside is super cute and the woman working there was very friendly. She let me try several flavors so that I could pick the best ones. The mint cookie one was also delicious. If I lived in Phoenix I would likely visit this place at least once a week and then I would have to run 10 miles a week. I can't wait for my next visit to Churn!

After brunch at the Windsor, we just happen to accidentally take a wrong turn that dropped us right in the middle of a delightful ice cream and candy parlor. With an espresso machine. The menu was extensive and the candy options were nostalgic. There wasn't anyone available behind the counter right away, but a server noticed us soon enough (there was a dozen of us!). She was bombarded by espresso orders, which she made quickly and skillfully. The affogato was delicious, made with their own recipe of ice cream. The seating is entirely outdoor and limited, but it is a lovely place to visit, with or without kids.

There is something so pure about Churn. I love this place, so do many other people because almost every time I come there's a line out the door. I originally found Churn on Yelp and decided to make the drive from East Arcadia based on the reviews. I'm glad I did because this is now my go to spot for good ice cream. I do really enjoy all the little tchotchkes they have that take me back to my childhood, I usually pick up a couple of them along with my ice cream. Come to Churn!

Churn is my all time favorite ice cream place. I have been coming here for about 2 years now, and recommend it to all visiting the area! Each flavor is rich, creamy, and accompanied by a mountain of toppings (my favorite part). Not only can you expect quality ice cream, but the workers go above and beyond to ensure a positive experience. The line does have a tendency to be long, but I promise, the treat is well worth the wait. Like I said, the workers are working as hard and as fast as they can, it's just a valley hot spot! You'll see why when you go. If it's your first time going, get the "Fat Elvis" or "S'mores" sundae... Trust me! Churn AZ put a modern flair on the classic, old-fashioned ice cream parlor- and they absolutely nailed it!

Came from Los Angeles to visit . We fell in love with this ice cream parlor. Love that they add little toys on the ice cream for the kids . Life the banana flavor ice cream. I will drive here just for the ice cream .

this place. I live right down the road from it and didn't realize what I gem was had in my neighborhood. Ordered the Peaches n honey ice cream and it was delish. The ladies behind the counter were super friendly and allowed us to sample what we wanted. Luckily, my friend and I arrived early enough to beat the crowd as it quickly got crowded with a line outside of the door. Pricier than your average ice cream shop but totally worth it as they have some really cool flavors and options!
Get the peanut butter and add a scoop of chocolate. I did and it was delicious. There a nice spot out back where you can sit in the shade.

This place was just okay. I was hoping for so much more when I saw all the positive reviews online. I had higher hopes when I showed up and saw a line out the door into the parking lot. I figured it had to be amazing for people to be waiting 15-20 mins that night. I get in and the flavors were a bit unusual. Normally I do like weird and different but none of the flavors sounded good. I went with the most boring flavor I could find in the end. For the price I can't say it was mind blowing. Not worth it in my eyes. I'd never go back on my own or suggest it to friends. However, it's not so terrible that I'd refuse to return if my friends wanted to go. Customer service was friendly and fast. It just wasn't for me as far as flavors go.

Love of my life right here! I am sad that they had my favorite flavor (whiskey almond toffee)for only 4 days so I missed it yet again this year. Everything about this place is the bomb! The location, the ice cream, the plants, the patio seating with the string lights. It's all well put together with purpose! I just wish I could order my favorite flavor! But I'll have to wait yet again till next year and hope to get it!

My daughter loved her shake so much. We loved the old school look of the inside. The staff was friendly and courteous. The only thing I could complain about is the line on a hot day, but that's nitpicking. I would recommend to everyone.

One of the best ice cream I've ever had. We got there around 7:30 and the line was pretty long but we'll worth it. Also the line moves pretty quick. I got the mint and cookies with hot fudge and Oreo pieces. It was so good because they make it homemade so it's not very cold and hard. The staff there was nice too. The prices are cheap for the portions you get.

My fiancÃ© and I just looked up the closest place for ice cream. This one came up and we both got one scope- his cone and my cup. Both for under $9. I got the Vietnamese coffee ice cream and it's probably the best ice cream I've ever had. FiancÃ© did not share his cookies and mint.. environment/decor is cute. Service was great. Got to taste the flavor before I decided. Very quick even though there was people in front of us. Definitely coming back to try more flavors.
Super yummy and delicious ice cream and treats! Following all Covid procedures (limiting customers inside, spaced out line, masks, gloves, etc)!

Looks like a mom & pops shop... Fairly small & not a huge selection but very well stocked. Lots of vintage old school candy. Staff was friendly & helpful I got the FAT ELVIS SUNDAE & man was it delicious! I recommended 110%

Charming, cute, and happy. I love the adorable atmosphere, the nice employees and the adventurous flavors. I've never had a bad experience or tasted a bad flavor here. Any time I nearby and my sweet tooth is kicking in I will definitely stop by Churn. Bring back the carrot cake ice cream please!!!! (:

All I can say is "wow"! The Fat Elvis Sundae was crazy good. Peanut Butter Ice Cream was a new flavor for me. The bananas and chocolate pearls were good too. Really, the whole thing worked. Seating was hard to find but I guess that comes with being popular. The staff was friendly and helpful. Top notch experience the whole way around.

Awesome ice cream sundays, unique flavors, and endless topping choices make this one of my top spots to get ice cream in Phoenix. Plentiful outdoor seating, along with a retro nostalgic ice cream parlor shop add to the charm of this place. Although the prices may seem a bit expensive, the high quality treats make every dollar worth while.

OH MY GLOB! I went here for my first time on a Saturday night and there was a long line to get in and order! Hm, must mean this place is good. At least I hope so! I ordered a s'mores sundae (chocolate ice cream, hot fudge, butter graham's, and toasted marshmallow fluff) but I switched out the chocolate ice cream for Madagascar vanilla. It was AMAZING! And huge! They give you so much! I'm glad I traded out for vanilla ice cream because the chocolate would make it even more sweet and rich. My dad ordered a strawberry shortcake sundae but I didn't try it. I love Churn and would definitely love to return!

Amazing!!! Just went there with my wife to get prepped for Nee Year's Eve. Great staff offering help with the menu. Decided on the pretzel cone with double chocolate and a how now brown cow. Both were great. The pretzel cone is a first for us and an amazing idea mixed with the sweet cream. We've got to bring the kiddos back to this place!
Churn is outstanding. Friendly staff, free samples, many flavors, lots of different sweet options and overall great place! I recommend the peanut butter ice cream with a pretzel cone.

We had a stop in Phx and the only place I had bookmarked in Phx was this ice cream place. Very glad we checked this place out. The service was amazing and they were super helpful! I got the cookie ice cream sandwich and the cookies were nice and soft. They allowed us to test taste a few ice cream and I chose Cookie and mint. Delicious. They had some interesting ice cream flavors so make sure you try them! Very cute store and amazing service!

Definitely one of the best place to enjoy some mouth/watering boutique ice-creams! Love the music ! Hip & trendy! Nice patio (front and back) with mister-water system & chic outdoor decors. Open late on week nights...for summer in Phoenix. Great spot to hang out after the other 90% of ice-cream places close after 9 pm. Let's ice-cream after hour!

Ughhhh butter pecan ice cream is the best ice cream I have ever eaten. I don't think I've ever ordered butter pecan in my life but one sample spoon bite changed my life. I got a single scoop of it, which was surprisingly big. Halfway through eating it I started getting nauseous because I was already really full from dinner. But I kept eating and now I'm laying in bed dealing with the consequences of my gluttony. Worth. Every. Bite. Butter pecan: salty, sweet, creamy. Lots of pecans. They had a slight popcorn taste which was cool. Salted chocolate chunk cookie: chewy with crispy edges and a really nice salted taste. Also one of the best cookies I've gotten at an ice cream shop. Please go.

I have been lucky to not hit a line every time I've come here, it always start building out the door after I've ordered. Their flavors are so delicious and their staff is always so friendly! Only thing is that it is always sooooo cold inside, but perfect for when it's hot out! It's located in a very hip, very upcoming area and I love coming here. The ambiance and dÃ©cor of this place is like an old-style candy store - it's so cute! Not only do they sell ice cream and such, they also sell candies. Must try flavors are Guiness (must be 21+ to order, or even try), all of their holiday flavors are fantastic and spot on, Vietnamese Coffee (yummm). For sundaes I've tried the Strawberry Shortcake that was pretty true to taste. For Lil' Freezies I've tried the Salted Caramel which was delicious and actually had a good mixture of salty versus sweet flavors. Peanut Butter Cup is a must for peanut butter lovers! I would recommend getting one of their ice creams served on a cone; all of their cones are so good. Definitely one of my upcoming favorite ice cream spots!

Where do I begin?! My cousin took me here on my first night of vacation because we both have a strong passion and love for ice cream. She read of Churn on Buzzfeed of 27 ice cream places to try in the country before you die, and wow am I so glad she took me, and I cannot wait to go again on my next visit to Phoenix. We both went all out and got sundaes. I had the kitchen sink which was a mixture of chocolate and peanut butter ice cream, toffee sauce, butter scotch candy, and HOMEMADE whipped cream! It was one of the best ice cream sundaes I have ever had. The ice cream was clearly home made and melted sweetly in your mouth. The whipped cream may have been my favorite part. Everything was perfection. My cousin had the S'mores Sundae which was a giant cold ice cream s'more. It was delish too, but the best part of hers was they lit the fluff on fire before serving so it even had the burnt marshmallow feel you normally get on a s'more at a campfire. However, the best part was it was so huge, I got to take it home and enjoy it a second night after dinner! Next trip to Arizona, this will definitely be on my list to try again!

We have some happy kids (and adults)!!!! This is the ultimate sweet shop. The ice cream is amazing, but the cookies also rock. I love the salted chocolate chip! Great outdoor seating to make you feel comfortable. This would be a perfect end or start to a date! Actually Windsor restaurant is next door has amazing food, so this is a one stop win!

The selection of flavors that constantly change. The concrete and blizzards, shakes and Sundays. Fresh backed cookies. Tokns of topping to choose from. A super retro old school wall of old kickass candy that has Kong gone been forgotten about I am obsessed with this place and go about 4-5 times a week

Cute, unique (and busy) ice cream shop! They have a good amount of flavour selection and they make shakes, waffle cones, cookie ice cream sandwiches and floats! It was hot on Saturday and this place hit the spot. Their cookies stand up to the ice cream and still manage to be chewy and soft. My kind of cookie! They also sell interesting candies and novelty items (i.e. Whoopie cushions). The workers are all pleasant and upbeat. Definitely worth stopping by if you're ever in Phoenix!

Aside from the small space and limited parking in the front of the store, Churn is an excellent place to get delicious ice cream on a hot day in Arizona, or even not as hot day. The more typical flavors at excellent at Churn but the reason I keep going back is for their Vietnamese coffee ice cream. The texture is always creamy and Vietnamese coffee flavor is intense and strong, making it a perfect desert for a coffee lover, like me. What I recommend: -- Vietnamese coffee ice cream

Enjoyed the ice cream and sitting outdoors eating it in 65 degree weather with my family. Not too chilly for people from Hawaii. Everyone loved their selections and the one scoop servings were very generous.

The first time I came here in the summer, the line was out the door with approximately 30 people. I took this to be a good sign and vowed to return during a slower time of day. I came back last week during a heavy rainstorm and sure enough, there was little to no wait. The ice cream server was super nice and let me try as many flavors as I wanted. The candy corn flavor was seasonal but I didn't really like it, it tasted too sweet and seemed really artificial. However, I really like the cookies and mint (tasted like Girl Scouts thin mint) and the buttered pecan. I saw a few people with the s'more sundaes which looked super inviting, I shall try it next time! The rest of the shop was outfitted like a candy shop! A great place to take care of your sweet tooth cravings!

Had some time to burn so decided to stop by for an ice cream since I have been wanting to to try this place. Overall I loved it. My husband got the blueberry cheesecake in a pretzel cone and the ice cream was divine. I was told that the butter pecan is the best butter pecan ever by the people who worked there and unfortunately it fell a little short. It was over churned and the pecans were a bit over roasted and bitter. The reason I am still giving this place 5 stars is because the pretzel cone is one of the best things I have ever tasted with ice cream. I wish I would have got a different ice cream but it doesn't matter. Anything in that cone would be amazing!!! And I absolutely loved the blueberry cheesecake ice cream .

Fast service but long lines despite that. I don't know what it is but it's a very charming ice cream shop. The parking is atrocious but after that the walk is nice due to the other upscale looking restaurants around it.

I went to Churn for the first time last week! They handled everything with social distancing very well and only had one party come in at a time. The homemade icecream and cookies were amazing and the service was great! Will definitely be coming back. The location is awesome and has Windsor right next door along with the other Upward Projects restaurants.

I read some great reviews about this place so my family and I decided to check it out! First issue is the size of this place. There is no parking... so you have to find a spot somewhere and walk. With kids that's a huge turn off. And the inside is extremely small... so when it's crowded it's a nightmare. Second- the ice cream was ok. I love ice cream in any way or flavor, but I was not as wowed as others. It is good but not amazing. I gave them 3 stars because of the customer service and because it's such a cute spot.

I came here a few weeks ago on national ice cream day. I had pretty high hopes for this place after having read the review and it did not disappoint. I've been back many times since, but every time, whatever flavor I get, is always delicious. Cold, creamy, and hits the right spot.

Smooth, creamy and nicely sweet all over! Tried the Peanut Butter and Chocolate Mint Cookie flavors in a cone. The Peanut Butter boasted true PB taste without being too overpowering - probably would be a great pairing with Strawberry ice cream and, of course, Chocolate. The Mint Cookie had that perfect not-too-minty taste with slightly softened chocolate cookie chunks. This one was our fav of the two, though both didn't disappoint.The mouthfeel was quite smooth and didn't leave any of the butterfat film on my mouth or grainy texture. It was frozen to the perfect degree, not too hard or soft. Looked to be about 16 different flavors to choose from at any given time and they offer a unique pretzel cone for those looking to mash up their sweet with a little salty. The nostalgic shop atmosphere makes for a fun experience. What's more, there's a cute garden/patio type setting out back to enjoy the sweet treats.

I have no idea why this place has so many good reviews. I went there last night for first time and had two scoops with some toppings and it was damn near $10. That is EXTREMELY over priced!! The ice cream was just ok. And I really do mean just ok. The toppings didn't seem to have much flavor, except the salted caramel sauce. The salt flavor was WAY to strong!! It overwhelmed everything else. I did have a snicker doodle cookie on top which was very good. The service was excellent and very helpful, which is the reason for the two stars. I don't believe I will be coming back. Ice cream should NEVER be this expensive. Ice cream is mostly milk and sugar. Two things I don't remember being overly pricy!!

Cute little ice cream shop. I had a coffee flavored custom sundae and my son had the s'mores sundae, both were amazing! Great friendly service too worth the drive from Fountain Hills. We will be back!
Omg this ice cream is great! The people here are so nice and friendly. The vibe gives me a lux central meets ice cream! I'll be back 100%!

Amazing and utterly decadent concoctions! We loved the Vietnamese coffee, sour cream cinnamon and whisky toffee. My son devoured his peanut butter kids scoop ($3) the pretzel cone was a novelty and interesting, but I wouldn't recommend as it didn't complement the flavors and had an odd consistency in my opinion. However, still thoroughly enjoyed the ice cream and heartily recommend!

My husband and love all of the upper projects establishments. We usually eat at one and then go and get ice cream. We are members so I had a free dessert coupon so we went last night. I just wanted a single scoop with half a chocolate chip cookie but the server asked if I wanted more because I had 3.00 left on my account. Well instead of letting it go he gave me my dessert for free and gave my husband a discount! I thought that was great customer service. On another note I always try different ice cream samples and end up with the toasted coconut. It's just so good. However, I tried the tiramisu.... wow that may be my new favorite!

Went here a while ago on a road trip from Texas to Los Angeles! My friend and I wanted to pass by here because their pics looked really good! We came right when they opened and the guy working was really sweet and helpful! I ended up getting their s'mores sundae and it was super yummy! S'mores are my favorite so I have high expectations and they def did not disappoint. If I'm ever in Arizona again, I will def come and visit!
First time visiting this place it was a nice experience ! The wait is worth it . The cookies are good & so are their milkshakes

Looking at all of these amazing pictures, I wish I would have ordered something more exciting! This was a nice little ice cream shop with a huge line out the door when I went, so you know it is good. I felt bad asking to try flavors because of the line, but I went for the butter pecan with hot fudge sauce. Usually not a flavor I would order, but I was in the mood for it. Typically I strongly prefer soft serve ice cream, but this place is incredible. I had just one scoop and it was enough for me. I did not like that there was limited seating inside because it is so tiny, but sitting outside was fine. This is a place I absolutely have to give a second try...YUM!

Themed after an old fashioned ice cream parlor, Churn is a hot spot for locals to grab a scoop of hand made ice cream, which is made on site. When I visited Churn, the line went out the door and winded to the back of the shop. While I waited, I preoccupied myself by exploring; along with the display of candy and other kiddish delights, there was a cool cassette tape wall, which had about a hundred cassette tapes mounted to the walll. It was only about a 10 minute wait before it was my turn! All I need to say is S'mores Sundae!!! For $6.50, you get scoops of chocolate ice cream, hot fudge, graham cracker pieces and marshmallow fluff torched until nicely charred. Simply scrumptious! I also ordered a scoop of Peach & Honey on a pretzel cone. I didn't care too much for this flavor but the quality is definitely there. It's something good to try once but I probably wouldn't get this flavor again if I were to come back.

I came here pretty excited, you know reading the reviews and all. The parking lot is really small in front but there are more in the back. The ice cream shop is shared by a restaurant which is called the Windsor. The decoration is really beautiful and feels just like those old candy shops where they have sweets everywhere! Anyways I started sampling ice creams and they were just okay. Surprisingly I really didn't like any of them. They were creamy, sweet but the flavor just really wasn't there. There was no uniqueness about any of the flavors. I did get candy corn ice cream and even though it was good, it got boring after the first few bites. I understand everyone's fascination with this place so I am definitely in the minority but I really didn't like this ice cream shop as much as I thought I would

Toasted marshmallow topping. For that alone, I will come back over and over. Sure, the line is a pain in the ass. But the friendly staff (they'll give you as many tastes as you need to make up your mind) and, oh yeah, the kick ass ice cream make up for it. This is the low overrun, truly heavy cream and real sugar good stuff. The mint chocolate chip is heaven, as is the unabashedly floral and wonderful vanilla. The Vietnamese coffee is another star, you can actually taste the sweetened condensed milk. This place is worth the stop.

Pretty decent ice cream, it's no salt and straw from PDX but for Phoenix, it was good. The flavors are somewhat limited, about 10 flavors or so and you can sample 1 or 2 before deciding. They also have something called a pretzel cone, think waffle cone but with a hard pretzel instead. The price was $3.50 for a single scoop and a waffle cone was an additional $.75. I'd probably stick to a regular sugar cone as they don't make their waffle cones from scratch. Try the Vietnamese coffee ice cream, it was yummy. Oh and here's a tip we learned from the folks in front of us, you can do a single scoop but pick two flavors, so think of it as a half scoop of one flavor and a half scoop of another flavor for only $3.50.

Went in after seeing the toasted marshmallow they had on their smores sundaes. There was no one there when we went in, which was perfect because I wanted to try the flavors. The girl behind the counter was super nice and let us try whatever flavors we wanted. I was very undecided on the flavors I wanted for my sundae but she said she could do up to four! I was so excited. I got a combination of Tahitian Vanilla, Double Chocolate, Minty Cookie, and Peanut Butter in the smores sundae. They are all phenomenal. So smooth and bursting with flavor. By far the best ice cream I have ever had. The toasted marshmallow and graham crackers really elevated the ice cream. Will definitely be back.
Freaking delicious! Little Freezie Rocky Road is out of control good.
Ugh god. The cookies and mint ice cream is just to die for! Absolutely amazing. Would recommend to everyone!

*Dreamland fantasy retro ice cream experience* Step inside churn from the midtown Phoenix sunshine and absorb the lively friendly atmosphere taking any kid (or kid at heart) to a happy place!! Homemade ice cream, cookies, waffle cones, pretzel cones?!?!? I love thee!!!!! I'm all about the butter pecan right now but only while Vietnamese coffee and I take a break. Peanut butter and jelly was one of my favorite features!!! I don't even count churn as calories because of the inner joy I feel supporting this business and the bliss I feel while eating my ice cream.

Churn is just an awesome place. It gives you so much nostalgia. Along with their delicious ice cream are candies and toys we grew up with and you can't help but feel happy! Their ice cream is super delicious. I always get either chocolate or coffee and my boyfriend gets the mint chocolate chip. There are always lines, especially on the weekends. Take your significant other and or kids here, you won't be disappointed.

I had an excellent experience at Churn. The dessert I had was phenomenal. I tried the lil Dragon freezie and it was delicious. I'm located on the west valley but I will definitely be making the long drive for Churn again. I highly recommend it. Fun staff and awesome environment, plus unique and tasty desserts!

It's a very cute space. Like a vintage candy store and ice cream parlor equipped with nostalgic candy and toys, ice cream, and other delicious-looking confections. The whimsical designs and fonts made it welcoming. The shop is much smaller than I imagined and even more so when it's busy. The line moved quickly, but you barely have time to put your wallet away before they're ringing up the next customer. Then you have to figure out where to eat your ice cream as it's quickly melting. There aren't any tables and barely any room to stand in the shop. I believe there are tables in the back, but I wasn't looking to venture in that particularly hot afternoon. There were ten flavors available (Dulce Le Leche, Double Chocolate, Chocolate Sorbet, Strawberry, Toasted Coconut, Vietnamese Coffee, Butter Pecan, Chocolate Mint, Hangover Helper, and Sweet Cream), but unfortunately none of the flavors I wanted to try. It did make my decision very easy as I chose a scoop of Toasted Coconut on a waffle cone. Ruben went with Double Chocolate on a pretzel cone. The ice creams were creamy and flavorful. I really liked the vast amount of toasted coconut flakes in my ice cream. The cones were also delicious. I was very intrigued by the Fruit Loopy Treats and other cookies available for ice cream sandwiches. I had to take one of the large Coconut Macaroon cookies with me -- I didn't end up enjoying the cookie, which was rather disappointing. Service was pleasant. Everything made for a relatively enjoyable experience, but nothing stood out as amazing. I can't say it was the best ice cream I've ever had, although, I may have felt differently had there been more exciting flavors available like their Whiskey Toffee Almond, Lemon Buttermilk Sherbet, or Coconut Latte. I also think my experience could have been improved had they spent more than five minutes with me. I had no idea you could have toasted fluff on top of your ice cream! My bad for not monopolizing more of their time. FYI: Sugar cones and cake cones are free with your ice cream, waffle cones are an additional 50 cents, and pretzel cones are an additional $1. There's also a cold water dispenser and plastic cups available next to the register.

I love this place! Ever since we finally decided to try it... We go every chance we get. Super small place since you just order then go... It's also a candy store and bakery but i have tried their candy... Brownies good, chocolate crinkle good... Coconut macaroons yummm! And of course the ice cream! Yummm my favorite is the hangover helper! Its bourbon ice cream and frosted flakes! Sooooo yummy omg! Lol but today they didnt have it (yes their flavors rotate but they have ones that stay so far im pretty sure cookies and mint and vietnamese coffee are permanent flavors.) anyways...
