Today i tried carrot cheesecake! And oooohhhemmmgeeee best carrot flavored thing I have ever put in my mouth! I want more. It was creamy and subtly sweet (perfection!) and the little bits of carrots in the ice cream were a nice surprise! Another one to add to my faves :) Their viet coffee is also very good! Yay!!

Yum! So good! I got this recommendation from a blog on pinterest and it was worth it! Its a small little shop with a lot of different ice cream options and a bunch of candy. They make their own marshmallow creme which is mostly why I wanted to go there. Its my favorite ice cream topping. We got the smores sundae to share and it was huge and really good. She put a big scoop of marshmallow creme on it and the torched it. I usually like it more hot and melted like a syrup but this was good too. The service was great. They have a little back patio we sat on and ate our ice cream. Good spot if you are in the area!

Our new ice cream favorite! Cute little shop homemade ice cream flavors and toppings. Decent sizes too to get your ice cream fix. Fresh and clean and a small outdoor area to eat. No dine in though. Old time candy for sale along with cookies freshly baked. They also serve floats and milkshakes. Our first visit won't be our last!

Holy moley, super good REAL ice cream. I've been here lots of times and it never disappoints. Sometimes the line is long but it usually moves pretty quick and is worth it. My favorite is butter pecan with pecans as a topping.
Very cute, small store. I got the chai and banana flavored ice creams. The chai was good, but the banana ice cream was very icy. Overall, the ice cream was just OK.

Came here for date night. The line was rather long out the door but I expected that since it was Friday night. We wanted something small so we order one scoop of whiskey almond ice cream with toasted fluff on top. I like the homemade marshmallow fluff. It wasn't too sweet and they gave a generous amount so I felt that every bite of ice cream had some fluff with it. The whiskey almond ice cream had a predominantly sweet whiskey flavor with slivers of almonds in it. I liked the texture the slivers gave it. I'm glad I ordered this flavor of ice cream to try it but I'm not sure I would ever order it ever again. I probably should have just tried a sample of it and ordered something a little more to my liking such as the Vietnamese coffee or Venetian vanilla. There was no seating so we ended up going back to our truck in the parking lot and sitting on the tail gate. I actually had fun eating it there.
Best ice cream place in Phoenix! The favorites are the Vietnamese coffee and coconut, usually shared with my husband. Definitely a nice dessert place after dinner. Service has also been great so far.

An adorable little local spot who makes delicious homemade ice cream! The staff was super friendly and helpful when myself and 4 other people walked in (pretty much taking up the whole place ) and all ordered and asked for samples. They have different flavors every month to my knowledge, but I tried the Vietnamese coffee flavor and I was in love!

Adorable little ice cream spot. The service was fantastic. The choices are good, even old fashioned candy available. Tried a couple sundaes and float. It is a little pricey but a great place to splurge.

Nice ice cream parlor in a small plaza even has a bak patio setting. Awesome choices of ice cream. Not ur average ice cream, just a tad bit different. Service good and prices fair, taste great. Id come bak. My son loves it!!
Great Smores sundae with a toasted marshmallow! Nice staff. Cute shop with vintage vibe and stuff to buy Outdoor seating and Clean bathrooms.
Delicious ice cream. Cute store. Great music. What more do you want? Loads of outdoor seating in back and some in front too.

Some of the best ice cream in the valley! Churn is awesome! The line is often long, but it's worth it. Staff is always helpful. I love the random stuff that's available for purchase (little toys etc). And the ice cream rocks. The butter pecan is my favorite, and I've never liked butter pecan before. Toasted coconut is another big winner, but honestly, there are a ton of great flavors to choose from! Try the cookies as well (especially the coconut macaroon).
Awesome flavor selection and nostalgic, retro candies. The line can be long but if you can pop in for a quick scoop it's great and worth the money.

Absolutely delightful! I will for sure be back for more of this heavenly homemade goodness. This ice-cream shop has a perfect variety of options from recommended ice-cream creations to shakes to kids ice cream with a plastic toy landed in it, they've got it all. Churn uses top quality ingredients that are definitely appreciated. I would best describe this spot as a step above Coldstone.

I love Churn's ice cream. The only reason why I rarely come around is because it is right next to Windsor and it can get busy around these parts! I headed over there today and had the Vietnamese coffee flavor and the coconut flavor ice cream - two scoops. Every bite = heaven..

Love this place. It's never to early for ice cream. Wide selection of ice cream. Wide variety of regular food Love sauce. I couldn't have had A better experience anywhere. The staff was fun and friendly. Restaurant was very clean. So was the restrooms. Highly recommended. Lots of fun.

This place is a hidden gem in the middle of the city. The service and atmosphere here is so great, the workers were so friendly and happy. Love the retro toys and candies as well as the patio out back. They don't have tons of ice cream flavors but they have tons of toppings to make it personalized to your taste. They had sundaes, floats, and you could even make your own ice cream sandwich. I ordered a strawberry shortcake sundae and it was delicious.

I do not understand all the high reviews. The choice is limited and the ice cream is so-so. There were 3 of us and we each had two flavors. All of the ice cream we had was very icy. Ice cream is supposed to be velvety smooth, creamy, not a flavored snow cone. The flavors were good but was not quality ice cream.

Yum Stopped in for an after dinner treat with the fam. I had the S'mores sundae. The marshmallow fluff is AMAZING! The kiddos each had a scoop of the mint cookies and cream and they loved it. The shop is very small but there is plenty of seating out back. It was cold last night but there were plenty of heaters to keep us warm while we enjoyed our ice cream. Only 4 stars because I was not impressed by the service. The young kids behind the counter had a hard time controlling the crowd of guests.

Hands down the BEST ice cream in the valley. Trust me on that, because I have tried them all. The location is great, cutest ice cream shop around. The patio is great at night. Located across from Federal Pizza (the BEST pizza downtown or central Phoenix) and next door to Windsor (excellent burgers and amazing tots too.) Churn is a must-have for dessert any time we are eating in downtown Phoenix.

Yo! First things first, Let me make known to you that I am lactose intolerant... Therefore I am very particular as to where I choose to indulge in such deliciously sinful delights. Now that that's out the way, I have to tell you that I adore Churn. The "ice cream" the very reason you are reading this in the first place is... Just good. No need for me to over exaggerate it you'll soon discover for yourself. Churn has a great variety of standard flavors (you can try multiple samples) and they also have "red label" flavors which are on a rotating cycle! So, if you play your cards right you'll never try the same one twice. Dope right? I must also admit that I'm a creature of habit and I posses a bit of an additive nature. So I ALWAYS get two scoops for the cookie & mint (my favorite) and whatever red label flavor I can add. Which is usually a "21" and up flavor! I can forget the atmosphere, which is very reminiscent of an vintage parlor. The difference? They blast hella dope hip-hop! And other fresh jams. An additional benefit is that is connected to Windsor! SoO what I'm saying is that you get a 2 for 1. Super nice and amazing staff too. If you're in the area of even if you're not which means go out of your way & stop by. In closing... Churn down for what!?

Who doesn't want ice cream after enjoying great wine at Postino?! No one! You will feel happy waiting in line, it's worth it. I LOVE the custom made ice cream sandwiches. You can pick your cookie and ice cream flavor. It's big and yummy. My favorite is the mint chocolate chip ice cream. It's also great to be able to eat your treat in the garden behind the store. Not many tables, but people share and are friendly and everyone is happy! Recommended!

I had a single scoop with 2 flavors, vietnamese coffee and mint chocolate chip (or whatever the mint flavored ice cream was called). And both the glavors wee not that memorable to me, there was nothing that made them special. In fact, the vietnamese coffee had pieces of ice in it, like it had previously melted and re-frozen. Probably not a place I would visit again even if I were in the area.

We were referred here by friends, or at least I think they were friends. What a disappointment. Seriously, if you want good ice cream, go to the grocery store and buy some pints of Talenti. It's much better ice cream at a much more reasonable price. And chances are the grocery store clerks will treat you better than the staff at Churn. Mediocre ice cream at high prices with lousy staff and very limited seating. I see that Mikey R. had the same thoughts on 5/16/20, although Mikey was much more generous with his ratings. I had coconut gelato and lemon gelato. I've eaten gelato around the world, and this was the worst gelato I have ever eaten. Never again.

The best ice cream I've had in Arizona. I got the mint cookie one and it did not disappoint. It was light and melted so smoothly in my mouth. The cookie pieces were plentiful and not like soggy cookies. I was a little sad they didn't make their own waffle cones but sugar cone was super fresh and crunchy too.

So there I was eating at Federal Pizza seeing a long line at Churn across the way. I thought to myself, I'm gonna have to go there for icecream one of these days and so I went. Took some family that was visiting from out of town and wow, super cute decor, great friendly service, tons of flavors on a busy Friday night. From the first bite I was like wow! This is so creamy, totally worth the 3 billion calories for sure. LOL I like icecream but I'm not a crazy icecream person. Very few places make me look forward to going back again to an icecream place and Churn is definitely one of them. Absolutely delicious creamy ice cream. Wouldn't change a thing. I didn't take any photos since it was at night and we ate outside and frankly I needed to eat my cone as quickly as possible in this summer heat! Sooo good! I see why they have such good ratings and always have a long line on the weekends.

Best ice cream place in arizona. Will not go anywhere else. I refuse. Have gone to other ice cream shopS. HAVE THROWN OTHER CONES AWAY AFTER HAVING CHURN ICE CREAM CONES!!! Strawberry is the best strawberry Ive ever had. Hands down. No doubt about it.

Let me start off by telling you - I am a 9 year old girl using my moms yelp account .... yes with her permission :) I got a kids scoop of Madagascar vanilla ice cream and it came with a lollipop and a mustache tattoo which I thought was so cool .My brother had cookies and mint ice cream he said it was delicious. Me and my brother thought it was an amazing ice cream place . Can't wait to go back !
It was good but kind of high priced for what it is. You're better of getting a big sundae and splitting it. The Vietnamese coffee ice cream is also pretty delicious

Sabastian Was just as great as the ice cream. I've been here many times. Always lovin the vibe and all the fun stuff I used to play with and eat as a kid in the 80s. Butter pecan is to die for...its rich and playful. Come get some
Dutch chocolate ice cream in a pretzel cone=divine. However the said cone is too thick, dry and hard to eat once the ice cream is gone.

Great ice cream! I don't know why, but it was so hard to find good ice cream places around here.. Parking was limited in their immediate private lot, but to the right is a larger parking lot available for the neighboring restaurants. (Postino Central is right across the street!) When you enter the store, it's like going back to your childhood because all the candies you grew up with are there! They have about 20 flavors of hand made ice cream. My favorite was the cookie & mint. I loved the cookie pieces in the ice cream! I tried their seasonal Whiskey Toffee and Peach & Honey, but I didn't like either one of those.. The flavors are definitely there, but I wanted something more refreshing like mint. I'd go back for that mint ice cream again! What's cool about Churn is their pretzel cone. For 2 scoops and a pretzel cone, it was about $4.50. The scoops were average/good size. The pretzel cone was ok; I would prefer a waffle cone because it's sweeter. The pretzel was too salty; it made me more thirsty than I already was in the heat! I personally wouldn't recommend the pretzel, but I would come back for the ice cream if I were in the area!
I had the Strawberry shortcake sundae...best ice cream ever! One scoop was plenty to fill me up. The shop is super cute and the staff was really friendly.

We came here to just get some ice cream, but ended up getting the oh my! affogato and the how now, brown cow floats. Best decision ever!! My friend also got the caramel apple pie float and it was delicious! The girls working were also so sweet and the back patio was cute. We'll definitely be coming back soon. Probably my new favorite dessert place!

After some Thai food, my sister and I were craving the sweets. We decided to try Churn. When we arrived, there was a line forming outside of the shop. We were determined enough to satisfy our sugar crave that we decided to wait underneath the Phoenix sun... and were glad that we did. The moment I stepped in, I saw lots of candy that I wouldn't have thought existed. There were also some bakery items like cookies, brownies, and lemon bars. More importantly, there were lots of ice cream options. I sampled the whisky almond ice cream, and fell in love with its thick, whisky, creamy flavor. The shop itself has cute retro-style decorations. Since Churn is a relatively small shop, customers cannot eat inside, but there is a patio area dedicated for eating. The patio is adorable as well! Even if you aren't a fan of ice cream, try Churn. They have many options other than ice cream; it would also be a good place to pick gifts for people who absolutely love desserts and are up for trying something different. Yum!

Ice cream is delicious and the aesthetic of the shop is adorable! Perfect place for dessert after dinner or just a nice spot to hang out and catch up with friends. The only thing is that I wish they had more flavors!

One of the top things my boyfriend and I love: ice cream. He currently lives in California and whenever he visits, I take him to new foodie places in Arizona. After visiting Churn, he said he LOVED this place, and so do I! The flavors are simple, which is great for people like us who love everything but are indecisive. They lack crazy flavors unlike most ice cream chains, but each flavor is so fresh and delicious on its own that it doesn't need anything else! The ice cream cookie sandwiches are our favorite - the ice cream stays cold while the cookie gives it a bit of crunchy goodness. My personal favorite is chocolate chip mint on a chocolate brownie cookie. I was seeing stars (and that's a good thing)! The shop is small, yes, and parking is very limited, but that's what makes this place so special. You're there to get ice cream and enjoy it outside. Even if it's cold or blazing hot, you're in love with Churn's ice cream and after you're done, you're going to want to walk through and look at the toys and goodies they sell there. The place is too darn cute for its own good, and Arizona should be proud of having this little gem around.

Had heard great things about this place and with the temperatures around 110 degrees, decided to cool off with strawberry ice cream in a waffle cone. Really friendly staff and super quick with the order. Ice cream was very good and they have a nice outdoor seating area with lots of shade and good music.

Best ice cream in the valley. This is really made from scratch as they make their own slurry. I love to get a few scoops of vanilla and the house made carmel sauce and a fresh baked choc chip cookie...that is what I call bliss. The staff is very friendly and remembers me when I come in:)

Nothing special about the icecream. Flavor was ordinary. Not much parking available. Had to park at Boston Market and walk five minutes to get here. Place inside is really small. It's smaller than regular bathroom and I'm not kidding! Not coming back. Wife rating -2.5/5 I'm starting to doubt the genuineness of the reviews. There is no way, this place should have over 3.5. There is a Dairy Queen close to this place that we decided to go next if in the area.
Very delicious ice cream with lots of fun flavors to try. Cute atmosphere and back patio.

Perfect date place. The atmosphere and the friendly staff. The Vietnamese coffee flavor was great too. I got it in a waffle cone and then we just chilled out back in the patio while eating it. There were also toppings you can add on there too. Great ice cream place! Sometimes, it's too great and the line is long but it's worth it.

I found this place listed on Sunset Magazine's 15 Best Ice Cream Shops in the West. I was a little disappointed that they didn't have more ice cream flavors to choose from. The cool thing is there are many ways you can have your ice cream like an ice cream sandwich, milk shake, or even in a pretzel cone. I got the Vietnamese Coffee with a coconut macaroon cookie which was the only gluten free option. It was good but I wouldn't say extraordinary. There is seating in the front and plenty more outdoor seating at the back of the shop to enjoy your ice cream.
Churn is a friendly neighborhood ice cream place. The ice cream is great, flavors distinctive and unique and the ambiance is friendly

Step back in time to this old time ice cream shoppe. Sometimes the line can be a little long and wrapped outside but it's well worth the wait for the ice cream and dessert concoctions. To keep you entertained during the wait is the nostalgia of candy and dime store toys from the past that they also have for sale. Army men, potato guns, silly putty, abbazaba, oh Henry and Charleston chews line the wall. Workers are very patients with indecisive customers and have samples available and recommendations. Definitely a must after dinner or if your craving something sweet and sugary.
Beat ice cream in AZ. Must visit before any event in downtown Phoenix. The ice cream is homemade and delicious. Try the s'mores option.

Nice little ice cream joint. Plenty of seating outside. Ice cream was good. Cookies were good. Staff were friendly. Will have to make another visit to see if I should have given five stars. I will do that for my yelper family because that is the kind of guy I am. A team player for sure.
Shhhhh so good Also what is up with the slight saltiness of the chocolate chip cookie, it kills me

UPDATE: They now have Vietnamese Coffee as an ice cream flavor. Was it good? oh hell yah! If you know what I'm talking about it, you know what is up. In case you don't, you should try some coffee the next time you are at a Vietnamese restaurant. Vietnamese coffee is basically strong black coffee plus condensed milk.
Good ice cream? Good service ? Yes!! Affordable prices? Yes!! Would I go there again?? Yes!!

Boyfriend and i come here after dinner all the time for date night... orrrr you can ride your bike here with your sister and thinking you ride your calories off, but then really you enjoy scoops and scoops of ice cream and adding calories on...lolz This place is like heaven. You walk in and your jaw just drop, like a little kid in a candy shop. Haha wait. It is :D LOVE THE CHRISTMAS DECORATIONS Many flavors, My number one favorite has to be the MINT AND CHOCOLATE and the VIETNAMESE COFFEE!!! The only negative thing i have to say is... I wish there were tables INSIDE, we were standing while eating our ice cream. Boo.. Over all. 5 stars!!!! Love it.
Love the ice cream here, it is so far the best ice cream I ever had. There coconut ice cream is my favorite flavor
I got a simple vanilla ice cream + sprinkles, really cute inside, sad they didn't have banana ice cream but hope to return to try their baked good (:

Being it was 107 degrees today, ice cream sounded perfect. Unfortunately, two stars for the quality. I got butter pecan, which was extremely salty. The killer price tag of 26$ for two single scoops, a root beer float, and a pack of gum didn't exactly helped either. The decor of the shop was cute with a few different choices of candies and small toys. Overall, probably wouldn't come back.

Been here a few times and it rocks. I know everyone loves their ice cream, and I get it. However I go for the baked good. If you have not been to Churn, it's a fantastic sweets shop. They have awesome ice cream , even better cookies, and a cool selection of vintage style candy. The lines can be long and there is not a lot of room while you wait, but don't let that scare you off.

Although nothing bizarre, the conservative type flavors are still solid choices. My favorites were Italian Cherry and Cookies and Mint. Everything was good, but those two really stood out. The creaminess of the ice cream is key to the ice cream's success. The flavorings are also quite potent, which I like. Nothing breaks my heart more than mildly flavored ice cream. I wanted to try their shakes or sundaes, but I also needed to save room for elsewhere at the time. I did pick a pretzel cone for my scoop. The pretzel isn't bad, but it wasn't what I was expecting. Its not as crumbly as a traditional waffle cone. Its not necessarily as sweet either, but it does add an undeniably delicious saltiness to each bite.

Stopped in tonight to check out all the rave about this place... And was definitely not disappointed! I ordered the fat Elvis and my bf order a cookies sundae, both very good. But I have to say the Elvis one was amazing! And another plus was there was not a line at all, probably because it was so cold. The man working was very helpful and friendly. Can't wait to come back, the patio was super cute and when I bring a warmer jacket I'll definitely be enjoying it. If your thinking about coming here, give it a try you will love it.

What a great name for a company that makes ice cream... We're looking for a place that had a local vibe and this place definitely rocked the house servers were awesome ice cream marvelous top-notch great taste fantastic highly recommend the peanut butter ice cream. The facility has tons of seed in the back future is in the front we took ours to go because the place was so crowded and pack but the lines were moving so quick very very very awesome!

Stumbled on this place and I am so glad I did! Absolutely delicious. Creative sundaes, amazing homemade sauces and ridiculously good ice cream. There will probably be a line - trust me, it's so worth the wait.

I've heard sooooo many good things about this place and I love me some ice cream so I just had to check it out. I came here with my sister last weekend for dessert after a lovely dinner. I heard they have Vietnamese coffee ice cream now so OBVIOUSLY I just had to try it. lol. What a good choice! I had half of that mixed with one of my other favorites which is butter pecan. Loved it! Everyone was extremely friendly and it's such a cute little ice cream shop and everything is actually very reasonably priced. I'm so bummed that there isn't one on my side of town otherwise I'd probably go all the time. I'll definitely be coming back if I'm ever in the area. Need my Vietnamese coffee ice cream! =P

Churn where have you been all my life? Located off of Central and Oregon, my family and I stopped in for some ice cream after lunch. There weren't many flavors, maybe 10 at most but they were all super unique! I had Carrot Cheesecake, Dad had Maple Walnut, Mom had Vietnamese Iced Coffee and Mymy N. got Butter Pecan on a PRETZEL cone. Yes, I said it, a PRETZEL cone. All flavors were absolutely delicious! I believe all the ice cream is made fresh on site so I'm sure it gives them freedom to make any flavor they want really. They also offer sundaes, ice cream cookie sandwiches, milkshakes, etc I think you can get a giant toasted marshmallow on top of anything! So awesome. There's nowhere to sit inside and eat, but there is a back patio area where you can eat and relax. It's so cute and very relaxing. Limited parking in front of the store itself, but there is a lot to the side where you can park. Churn I love you and I shall be back! PS. We may have made a second trip the next day as well..... Oatmeal Cookie Dough ftw!

I love love this ice cream shop. When you walk in you are always greeted with a smile. They have a variety of candies that could fulfill your sweet tooth craving. The ice creams are all homemade and they always have a couple of interesting new flavors. The workers are always patient when it comes to trying all the ice creams before you finally decide. They always have a ice cream that is only 21 and over which makes you feel special. The seating is limited towards the back but it's cute with a couple benches and round tables. On some days they do have flavored water for free, and Ive always loved that

Great ice cream. I had the carrot cake ice cream and it was delicious. The line was long but that's because it is a small place with limited seating. A super cute outdoor seating area out back. I would recommend going! It won't disappoint.

Visited this cute ice cream shop that is attached to Windsor. I love the variety of flavors that they have! You are able to sample anything that you'd like. I got a single split scoop of the Almond Joy and the chocolate mint. You can also add toppings like toasted marshmallow fluff as well. The ice cream is delicious and extremely flavorful. I highly recommend coming here especially after having a meal at Windsor.

Super legit spot for dessert in the AZ. Think of Fosselman's in LA but in the dessert baby. Ordered their "How Now Brown Cow" A.K.A. their Rootbeer float and it was BOMB DIGGITY. Big ups on the presentation and making it so it didn't overfill. One of my favorite spots in AZ. Good job...
I love the flavors that they have and that they constantly change them! It's hard to choose a favorite! It's such a great place for couples, families, and friends!

Recently came here with my wife. The place seemed very disorganized and chaotic. The ice cream and everything just okay. My wife got a sundae and by the time she received it the ice cream was already melted.

Lines out the door this must be good right? Fun options cookie ice cream sandwiches, freezes, sundaes, etc. we opted for cones. I got a waffle cone with coconut, & my friends got mint cookie in a sugar cone & a double scoop Mexican chocolate & Vietnamese coffee. Decent portions & fair prices. They didn't have a ton of selections of flavors but everyone liked what they got. Line moved smoothly & the staff was having a great time dancing & serving up treats. Mexican chocolate was a little bitter like dark chocolate not my favorite but my coconut was pretty tasty! I would revisit this place when back in the Phoenix area.

Churn offers plenty of menu options that all sound amazing. All the ice cream samples I tried were delicious but the flavors didn't particularly stand out to me the day I went. I ordered a cookie and ice cream sandwich and it was a bit much, I should've just ordered a single scoop, which was still huge. A bit pricey but I think it's worth splurging for some delicious ice cream with huge portions, maybe worth sharing with someone else though.
Ice cream is great!!!! But the parking and finding a seat SUCKS! Maybe I need to find a better time to show up???

So my body has the same aversion to the lactose in ice cream as it has to people who use the word 'kewl'. But Churn is worth the physical punishment. This has to be the cutest ice cream shop I have ever been to. The ice cream is made all in house and the chocolate chip cookie I had mine with tasted like my grand mammy made it. It competes for the best chocolate chip cookie I've ever had. That's how serious this is people. It's a small shop but there is seating out back and they get you in and out really quick so don't let a line detour you. It's also in the same spot as a bunch of awesome hip restaurants. So let this be your last stop after Il Postino, Windsor or Federal Pizza. Look at me planning your next date for you. You're welcome.

Churn offers tasteful, albeit, normcore ice creams served by two of the friendliest, most engaging ice cream scooper deities I have ever encountered. In a nutshell, two enthusiastic dudes greeted my mom and I with, "we love giving out samples!" and it took me fourteen seconds to decide that I want these to be the only two people I have to interact with on any given day. So while I'm sampling everything and carefully trying not to mouth the words "I love you," fantastic ice cream scooper #2 tells me that Vietnamese coffee is the obvious pairing choice for mint cookie. To my dismay, I inform him that caffeine at this moderately late hour is dangerous. He tells me it's decaffeinated. I make a small animal noise. The perfectly paired mint cookie and Vietnamese coffee in a (slightly stale) waffle cone with a side of homemade, excellent, unusually light hot fudge was real good. However, by factoring in impossibly charismatic service, the experience goes from real good to dopesauce, making Churn one of my favorite ice cream spots in Phoenix.
Wow. We were tipped off to this place and have decided to be regulars. Wifey and I both had the Butter Pecan in a Pretzel Cone. Addictive. Will be back.

Churn is by far the best ice cream in town!!! Their cookies and mint is incredible! I highly recommend checking them out! Parking in the front is tough but there's parking to the right of the complex!
Favorite ice cream place in Phoenix. The area is safe and located next to a little shopping plaza that's great for a short walk while eating Churn's ice cream.

So cute! I love the decor, the vibe... Everything -- Makes me feel like I'm a little kid! I've had the ice cream float before -- definitely recommend it. I couldn't decide what to get last night and they were so helpful -- I tried the Vietnamese coffee mixed with the mint chocolate chip and it is amazing!!!! Just the perfect way to end the night. Yum!

My fiancÃ© and I heard about Churn so many times that we had to try it! We finally came here last week and it was great. They offered a sample of every flavor of ice cream that they had! Their ice cream is very creamy and you can have it many different ways! Definitely coming back!! They have a really nice patio where you can sit and enjoy your dessert outside!

Amazing staff and unique flavors! The portions were just right as well. We both enjoyed our ice cream treats on the patio and the line kept growing outside the door. The line moved shockingly fast and the staff did not seem to care about all the customers. I cannot wait to try more flavors!

I'm certain there is an urban dairy farm on the back end of this joint...this is the most well-balanced, freshest-tasting ice cream I've ever had. The flavors are just unique enough to stand out among artisan menus but classic enough to pull on your cravings. Vietnamese Coffee, for instance. Who doesn't love coffee ice cream? But, who the heck has ever had Vietnamese Coffee? Do it. You won't be sorry.

My friend introduced me to this place a month ago or so, and it is by far my favorite ice cream shop. The employees are always super friendly and efficient, but most importantly their ice cream is the best thing ever. I always order something different and have yet to try anything that didn't love. Y'ALL NEED THIS IN YOUR LIFE.
I drive from Gilbert infrequently to go here. One of my favorite ice cream places in the valley, hands down.

I like this Ice cream shop for 3 reasons the first being the convenience of the location to my home! The 2 reason it provides flavors not so typical I mean compared to like cold stones same flavors they offer. Of course this shop has flavors that everyone with a sweet tooth can enjoy. They also offer coffee, sundaes, and other sweet desserts that you are craving. I got the s'mores Sunday and my boyfriend got a strawberry ice cream cone. My dessert was delicious and quite large. I really enjoyed in even though I was in a sugar coma for a good 2 hours haha. It's what to expect, My boyfriends ice cream cone tasted home made and perfect for summer time! My 3rd reason is that both the employees rushing to get everyone taken care of were absolutely awesome!

I won't say much as, well, it's all been said. Here's what I have observed: - expect a line (but it moves pretty quickly, and if you're with friends anyways, well, it doesn't really matter) - try as many flavors as you like! (so delicious and rich AND they use metal sample spoons, which they wash and reuse *heart*) - they have a variety of cones, pretzel being one I hadn't seen before - one scoop is large and you can split it between two flavors - indulge and enjoy!
The Vietnamese coffee flavor was amazing. Tastes just lie the coffee iself!!1

I was extremely full from dinner at Windsor, but couldn't pass up on trying a sweet treat here! I couldn't decide which to get. So I got both the chai tea scoop and the honey goat cheese pistachio scoop. Chai tea was true to it's taste with that rich creaminess of a latte. The other had hints of goat cheese that was not over powering, if you're afraid of that pungent goat cheese taste. But if you're a cheese fan like me, heavenly! It's blended nicely with honey and pieces of pistachio..one of my fave nuts! I love their unique flavors! I'll be sure to come back again for more!

I have been dreaming of ice cream since I went to Churn a few nights ago! OMG, so amazing! I tasted the peanut butter and the strawberry and settled on ordering the strawberry! It's high quality and you can tell it's made with real strawberries! It hard to find strawberry ice cream that does not taste artificial or like strawberry syrup. This is the real deal! I ordered one scoop in a sugar cone. It was a ton of ice cream for one scoop. I would be scared to order two. It was a great value at $3.50. I'll be back for sure!

Wanted to participate in National Ice Cream Day. No specials, but the ice cream is bitchin'! So, why not! Settled on the Goat Cheese, Honey, and Pistachio. Holy F!!! I'm not one to seek out ice cream and if ever I do, I'm always for Ben & Jerry's "The Tonight Dough". Happy to make this a new alternative! Staff was friendly as well. I love receiving genuine customer service during moments of high volume and just before closing. Hope to see this place around for years to come!

Vietnamese coffee was amazing. Tasted exactly like it. Butter pecan was a little too rich for me, but still really delicious. Madagascar vanilla was perfect. you can get 2 flavors with one scoop. portion size was more than enough. highly recommend.

I liked the idea that everything is made in house and it's old school inside but I didn't like my ice cream. :-( I ordered a salted caramel concoction and it tasted off. Something in there made the whole thing taste like metal. also it was expensive! I paid 7 bucks for it and it went in the trash. It just wasn't for me. I like ice cream with lots of flavor and creaminess. This was weird. If you like things that have old school charm and make ice cream like the good ol days, this place is for you. Next time I'll stick to the coffee and sweets. No ice cream.

Small shop, full of unique candies and such, they offer homemade cookies and artesian ice cream. My favorites are either the oatmeal cookie dough and the butter pecan. The oatmeal is cinnamon has big chunks of oatmeal. Very yummy. Butter pecan is also good and had a good amount of pecans. I always add a topping of salted caramel, it goes perfectly with the two ice creams. I definitely recommend this place, we saw let in the back and enjoyed some shade while eating out sweet treats!

I came here because it was on yelp what else! the girl behind the counter was nice. they have a salted caramel topping - not ice cream. I ended up getting two scoops - a pecan and the coffee ice cream with the caramel and additional pecans on top. i asked another customer about other creameries in the city and she said this was the best one in town. I don't have another reference in town to comment. the selection was about 9 flavors that I can recall - and it wasn't that impressive.

I'm always fiending for some quality and unique ice cream, and thankfully, Churn exists in Phoenix to satisfy my cravings. I came here on a Thursday night with a girlfriend, and the line was out the door. When it was finally our turn, I sampled a few flavors and ultimately ended up going with the cookies and mint ice cream. It was a close call between that and the Vietnamese coffee though. The cookies and mint flavor...oh man, SO GOOD. Hands down, one of the best mint flavors I've had for ice cream. My friend ended up getting the cookies and mint flavor also. You know it's freaking good when we don't get two flavors to share and end up getting the same thing. Ice cream texture was smooth and creamy, not too overly icy or grainy. I seriously wish I lived closer to here. But then again, maybe it's a blessing I don't or else I'd be here all the time...

Yum. So many choices it is hard to figure out what I wanted. Ended up with the S'more Sundae. While it was good, it was WAY too sweet and rich for me. I only ate a third of it before I had to throw the rest away. I imagine a girl after a crap breakup would be in heaven with that beautiful monstrosity. Next time I'll try something a bit more tame. There will definitely be a next time though :)

3 bucks for a cone. No sitting inside with AC. Biting flies on the hot patio. hmmmm not my idea of a good time in during August in Phoenix. As for the Ice Cream. Got the Strawberry. Wasn't thick and rich. Kinda thin milky and icy.. Not saying that is bad if it is the style you like. But I like my ice cream thick and rich. Ben and Jerry's style. I don't really like Ice Milk. I dunno I really wonder sometimes how places get rated so high. Like they paid for reviews or something. Because this place is not 5 stars..

AWESOME icecream. I sampled three different flavors before I settled on ordering the Vietnamese Iced Coffee flavor. Everything I tried was interesting and tasty. The staff was friendly and helpfu. The atmosphere is cute and quirky. They have lots of fun things for sale there. The only con? The cookies are terrible! They are hard and dry and flavorless. So yeah, don't get the icecream cookie sandwich, just get a scoop by itself and you'll be happy. Also they have heaters on their patio which makes for a cozy time hanging out with friends!

Bit of a disappointment. I got a single scoop ice cream cup and a lollipop for my son. Came out to about 9 bucks with a tip. Call me crazy but 9 bucks for a scoop of ice cream and a freakin sucker is crazy. I will say the ice cream was very good and the feel of the place was really cool. Cool idea having a ice cream parlor with an old school feel to it. Too bad the prices aren't on par with the old school vibe. Churn is not for me.
Best customer service I could ask for in a place! We showed up super late(felt quite guilty) but they were happy to help us anyway and completely turn our night around. Will definitely be back!

The ice cream was great and the customer service was great too. Only reason it's not getting 5 stars at the moment is because I visited at a time when it was super packed with a long line reaching out the door on the other end. So I felt rushed and didn't get time to really soak it in and experience it like I would have liked. Would definitely be back. Hopefully it won't be at a peak moment.

This place is so cute! I had to go for the pretzel cone- that was love at first sight! I had hazelnut ice cream in said cone- it even had real hazelnut pieces mixed in! YUM! My sister ordered an ice cream sandwich and it was HUGE and delicious. The girl behind the counter was liiiiiitle awkward but mostly nice. I loved the mountains of candy all around too! The back patio is adorable and the perfect place to enjoy delicious ice cream. The parking is kind of a mess but that's normal for the area I suppose.

The service was excellent. Walked in and was greeted immediately with kind welcoming people. Their ice cream flavors were unique and extremely tasteful. There was no limit to samples of ice cream (as far as I was aware). The menu can be a little intimidating but I recommend getting a scoop or two of an ice cream of your choice and then creating your own sundae with the wide variety of toppings they offer which range from being .50 or a $1 more. For it being my first time I will definitely be going back.

Oh wow, go hungry. Not like me who started full and left almost sick. It's so worth it - don't stop eating! We went around 8pm on a Saturday so of course the line was way out the door. Flavors seemed pretty standard and not a massive selection. I got a sundae with chocolate and vanilla ice creams, chocolate chip cookie, hot fudge, and whipped cream. The hubs got a s'mores freezie (which is like a blizzard). The warm marshmallow fluff on the snores is AMAZING. But be prepared with your napkins... We probably could have shared but yeah no. Back patio was pretty packed but we found a place to sit easily anyway. I'd do it again. Maybe I'll try the peanut butter ice cream next time. With 1/2 a peanut butter cookie and chocolate covered pretzels. Yeah, I think so.

I got two flavors: Vietnamese coffee and Butter pecan in a waffle cone. The Vietnamese coffee flavor was spot on. It had specks of coffee grounds. It was perfect because the coffee flavor wasn't too strong, and it wasn't too sweet. The butter pecan was really good too. I would definitely go back to try different flavors. I also got a cup of coffee, which was not good. Don't get coffee here. Stick to the ice cream

This place is really good! Their ice cream is super tasty. I love how you can build your own cookie ice cream sandwich. The cookies they bake are so yummy! I would literally buy a pack of them if they sold them. Their customer service is good they are very friendly and helpful. Their menu is good they have already built sundaes or if you like to build your own you can as well. During the summer they can get very busy at night. The place has a lot of character too it looks like a 50s ice cream shop. Overall great place for ice cream with anyone.

I'm lactose intolerant and this place was SO worth the bubble guts (sorry tmi). There was a pretty long line when we pulled up Fri night. But I was pleasantly surprised that it moved really fast. So don't let the line deter you. I got the Madagascar vanilla topped with salted caramel. Oh hell yes...YES! Mouth orgasm. It was blissful. Get it. My daughter ordered strawberry which was also amazing and fresh. We were able to sit outside at the tables in the back which was lovely. My hubby ordered a cappuccino and said it was not good though :( I went back after the line died down and tried samples of all the flavors :) Vietnamese coffee, mint chocolate, blueberry, toasted coconut, praline...they were all DELICIOUS. You can tell they use really high quality ingredients. Service was really friendly too. They totally didn't mind letting me sample everything and chatting. They also made a few recommendations. The shop itself it totally cute too. Retro decor with old school candy, gum and toys to purchase as well. Can't wait to come back!
Really nice little old fashioned looking ice cream place. I got the strawberry shortcake. It was very good.

My children took me to dinner at Federal Pizza across the street so, being in the area, having ice-cream was a must! I opted for the Salted Caramel Lil Freezie (the only exception was, I swapped out the sweet cream ice-cream for butter pecan). OH EM GEE! It was absolutely scrumptious. The line for this place was literally out the door and well into the parking lot (I'm so not kidding..who knew ice-cream could be so good on a chilly November night). You could literally smell the homemade goodness of the fresh baked goods. Customer service was great! The folks behind the counter truly made the customers feel like they enjoyed what they were doing and loved it! (These did not appear to be high school students, rather young mature adults....huge plus). From the moment you walk through the door you are greeted with a smile. And, they are extremely helpful when it comes to making a selection. There is almost too much on the menu to immediately walk in and know what you want. In addition to ice-cream and fresh baked goods, there appeared to be quite the candy selection there. And not just any candy either. I'm talking almost nostalgic....kinda coincides with the theme of the establishment. Too bad they don't have a Churn on the East side of town by their other sister restaurants (hint hint). Overall, Churn is 5 stars in my book.

Friend introduced me to this place, bar on one side with good ambience and a delicious ice cream parlor on the the other... Ask Sebastian for a recommendation if you can't make up your mind-made an adult Sunday that was delicious. Short line out the door but it moves fast. Clean and friendly.

Cute place. Limited flavors, but the Vietnamese Coffee ice creme was very flavorful. Outdoor seating- in spring, it's perfect. Not sure I would the say the same during the summer. Parking patience must be high. Parking is limited and feel like a game of Frogger (yes, I'm dating myself)

We used to love churn, but the flavors have become stale. On our last visit (first time in months) two young men helped us. One gave us a single scoop the size we are used to. The other gave us two scoops that were the same size as the first scoop. Two employees looked at the scoops and acknowledged that there was a difference, but didn't do anything about it. Not sure there is a reason to go back.
Always a hit particularly the sugar cone with a single scoop of strawberry. Even better the price is affordable!

This place is one of my favorite spots in downtown. I have found that places like cold stone sell the same kind of ice cream year round and don't ever change their flavors. But this place is awesome! They have seasonal flavors as well as popular one and at a great price too! If you want to try something great and new come here!

Love this place!! When we're in the area we try to stop by the store. On one occasion my son's ice cream fell off his cone as soon as he licked it and it was one of those scenes from a comic strips where the child has an empty cone in hand and the single scoop is on the floor. Even though I offered to clean up the ice cream on the floor and pay for another scoop of ice cream, the employees were nice enough to give us a free scoop and told me they would clean it up. Great customer service and unique flavors that you can't find anywhere else!

Love the ice cream flavors and the cookies. Our favorite cookie is the chocolate chip sea salt. The blue berry lemon sorbet is excellent . The Vietnamese coffee cookie sandwhich is a meal on its own. All around great place and we come here often.

After some sampling of a few flavors of ice cream, I decided to go with the raspberry cheesecake ice cream with a waffle cone, and surprisingly I didn't enjoy the ice cream at all. It wasn't anything special, and my ice cream melted very quickly. I'm an ice cream lover, and I was not a fan of this location at all.
Yum yum yum! Stop by for the amazing options and creations. A favorite place and so happy to support a local place. They have cookies, ice cream and tons of nostalgic candy and thing.
Great little ice cream shop with old school candy and toys on the inside. Friendly staff, super clean and amazing treats!!

Great little place with a nice outdoor patio. They rotate their flavors. I had the Vietnamese Coffee with chocolate almonds. Would like to try other flavors and combinations. They also have a few different options for cones. They also have cookies and candy. The candy is very nostalgic, reminded me of my childhood. Seems like this place gets very crowded because once we got our ice cream the line started to make its way out the door.
Churn always has a line and for good reason! They have unique flavors and a lot of variety. They also have toys and candy you can buy that remind you of childhood. I suggest this place forsure!

We tried Churn on our recent visit to Phoenix. My son ordered a scoop with two flavors - strawberry and mint chip. My husband and I shared a double scoop. We were told we could pick up to six flavors but we opted for four. We had the toasted coconut, chocolate hazelnut, strawberry, and sweet cream. All of the flavors were delicious. My favorites were the chocolate hazelnut which had big chunks of nuts and the sweet cream. The portions were big. A double scoop was enough for two adults to share. My son enjoyed his ice cream so much that he asked me to find out if they had a Churn in Los Angeles. Unfortunately, not. The prices were reasonable at about $3 for a scoop (a big scoop with 2 flavors) and $4 and change for double scoop (up to 6 flavors). The staff was also friendly and helpful. We will definitely return when we're in town.
Awesome ice cream. It doesn't taste too sweet like straight up sugar like some ice creams so you can tell it has great ingredients.
I recently went on a Bumble date here and it is the cutest first date location! Nothing too long and if it goes well you can hangout on the cute patio and chat for awhile! And the ice cream is unreal

The staff was friendly, but I wasn't a fan of their malt shake. It was very watery. I had them make it with one scoop of chocolate and one scoop of peanut butter ice cream and the flavor was good, but it tasted more like I was drinking chocolate peanut butter milk.
Really cool ice cream shop...I had the Vietnamese coffee and Cookies and Mint...pretty, pretty, pretty good...

First, Upward Projects never fails to deliver the cutest, so tastefully executed concepts. I'm obsessed. Churn continues to impress. Peach & Honey ice cream in a waffle cone. First, whoever was the mastermind behind peach & honey ice cream, are you single, and do you want to marry me? Second, That waffle cone... no words. I love the old school vibes this place oozes. Also, that wall art in the hallway? SWOON. Such a fun little evening date spot. If you haven't been, I recommend. Be sure to stop for dinner at one of the Upward Project joints before you mosey on over to cure your sweet tooth!

The famous Churn ice cream. They are attached to Windsor restaurant and a fun establishment. They have old time toys and candies to browse through while you wait for your ice cream. We went right after they opened so we had to wait about 15 minutes for them to put out all the ice cream but the employee engaged us and looking through the toys killed the time. I had the pineapple sorbet in a cake cone and my boyfriend had the Vietnamese coffee. The Vietnamese coffee was very sweet and uses real coffee ground. Delicious! It was perfectly creamy and just like drinking a cup of Vietnamese coffee. The pineapple sorbet was very refreshing and crumbly. Delicious. The reason I took a star away was lack of preparation before opening and the only bad thing: stale cone. My cake cone was so stale that I took 2 bites of it and threw it away. Yuck! Being socked in the sorbet didn't help at all. I'll be back but next time, I'll just get it in the cup.

Good ice cream and a pleasing environment combine to make Churn a wonderful destination. Churn is very small, so its popularity often results in lines out the door. Not always though. Lines were short on this Saturday night visit, although it was still a bit early. It allowed us time to sample, sample, sample. An enjoyable luxury. The friendly staff patiently endured the indecisiveness of our party of five. Of all the flavors we sampled, only coconut received a thumbs down, primarily based on texture. Just one or two scoop cones for all of us. I'm afraid no Fat Elvis sundaes this night. Simple peanut butter was my flavor of choice. Loved it. The five and six year olds were fully occupied by the pin wheels planted into their cones. Any flavor will do if there's a pinwheel to play with, confirming Churn's kid friendly status. Do not, I repeat, do not, just grab your ice cream and go. Walk to the back of the store and see if there are spots open on the patio. For me, the existence of this area is what pushes Churn into five star territory. Comfortable seating. Nice music. Relaxing lighting. The patio completes the experience.

I don't eat sweets very often, but when I do, Churn hits the bill!! I love the chocolate cherry crunch with a side of their upbeat, friendly service! Our most recent visit was at 10:50 pm, just before closing time. We sat outside to enjoy our sweet treats, and then realized we needed water and some extra napkins. With it being past closing at that point, we had to knock on the door to let us back in. They rushed over to unlock the door, were super friendly about us needing a bit more service, and we left just a few moments later with everything we needed. Great service!

I am so in love with their salted caramel sauce! I could put it on anything and be a happy lady. Luckily, Churn has plenty of ice cream flavors and other treats to douse in that sweet caramel goodness! The Vietnamese Coffee ice cream is an absolute favorite of mine. It's pure sweet, creamy coffee with espresso bits. Yuuuum! I also really enjoy their vanilla - simple yet delicious. I love the inside. It's cute and brightly decorated. The shop is pretty small, but it seems much larger. The employees have always been super nice and friendly. Always quick to smile and encourage delicious decisions. Churn, Churn, Churn... this is my mantra whenever I crave ice cream. I chant their name out loud so my husband knows to prepare the automobile for delicious discoveries. I wish Churn was closer to home, but it is definitely worth the drive.
If you like PB & chocolate ice cream w/ salted caramel, nuts all in one place try the "kitchen sink" omg ! Great atmosphere on the shady back patio !
Great ice cream and lots of gluten free options! A little pricey but such a nice treat. Super cute store too!!

Very disappointed, the only lactose free ice cream was not ice cream, they only had mango sorbet. Huge disappointment. I feel that more and more people have allergies if one kind to another, to bad some places don't accommodate.

This is the ice cream spot! I mean, now, since Mrs. Mary C. closed, but this place is great! Excellent ice cream that is made by them and great flavors that are always changing. The employees are very nice and are ready to help even when it's packed and crazy. I like to pop in before dinner, because I'm an adult, or after dinner, because I try to be an adult, at one of the many restaurants around Churn. The location makes it another great place. Awesome ice cream parlor design complete with checkered tile. Lots of great toppings, except fresh bananas. You get bananas in there and you get that star. Until then, you're a four at of four, perfect, but a four at out five in this current moment in time because you chose not include fresh banana fruits on your menu. They also sell fun candy and hand buzzers. This is a five out of five star ice cream spot. Sans bananas is no problemanas.

We go to Churn so often, I had assumed I had written a review- but I realized I hadn't! Churn serves up some of the best Ice Cream in the greater Phoenix area. So good, that we stop in even during the winter. Flavors that keep us coming back: Mint Oreo Ice cream, and any number of Chocolate sorbets: dark chocolate, white raspberry chocolate, etc. with Salted Caramel on top. Also a huge fan of the s'mores bars! Kim is our favorite ice cream scooper. Everyone is super friendly. Stop in, bring the kids, your friends, or a date! Fun for everyone!

Churn reminds me what it might have been like back in the '50s when we visited the local ice cream parlor for a malted milkshake from our favorite soda jerk, and then transformed into the future to discover fancy flavors like Madagascar Vanilla, Blueberry Yogurt and Whiskey Toffee Almond. The goodies, wrapped treats, and candy toys are all there, and in easy reach of the kiddos, so be prepared, but also be prepared to go through that "my eyes where bigger than my stomach" feel, because the servings are generous and the sweetness way up there, where you might not expect. Of course, you ARE in a ice cream parlor! I got the Ice Cream Cookie Sandwich with oatmeal cookie and vanilla, and really have to stuffed it down, even though I didn't have the room, but it was sooo good, and immediately gave me a sugar high that helped get me home for this early riser. Open late to round out the evening, and in a upcoming hipster area where the "cool kids" hang, trendy and upbeat, right along Central Avenue.

We've been eyeing this spot for some time and after dinner last night we decided to give it a shot. I was impressed we actually showed up with at the perfect time with a very small line..as we always drive by and see the long lines. The ice cream was good, not great. I had the butter pecan cookie sandwich with chocolate chocolate chip cookies. The cookie was just ok. Didnt taste fresh, it wasnt soft. Disappointed. Maybe I will try it again and only get the ice cream. Side Note: It melts very fast compared to other spots we visit.

I liked the cherry ice cream, but the service and the price are not the greatest. Was given an extremely small one scoop of ice cream, and I had to joke if this was a kid's cup they were providing me. The employee returned with supposedly more, but to be honest it was still meager. For that price, I'm ok with sticking to my Sweet Republic for my gourmet ice cream needs. Better service, better location, better seating.

I'm typically a fro-yo type of girl, but every now and then I get a craving for the real deal (homemade ice cream in this case). Tonight was one of those nights, and Churn really hit my sweet spot! This little shop is adorable. They squeeze a ton of fun candy and treats into a small amount of space, but it works! Per the recommendation of the friendly scooper, I went for Churn's version of an "Almond Joy" (minus the almonds). I had a half scoop of Toasted Coconut and a half scoop of Double Chocolate in a cup. It was delicious. A few bites in, I decided to add one of Churn's homemade molasses cookies to my concoction... mmmmm! I highly recommend this combo. I sat outside on the front patio with friends and enjoyed every last bite... while we were there, we noticed big people and little people of all ages with one common interest: ice cream! Churn is a wonderful family friendly addition to the CenPho neighborhood; I'm sure it will do well and I look forward to future visits!
My favorite ice cream place for sure. I love trying all the flavors and the employees never give me a hard time. Usually I end up getting one scoop of cookies and mint ice cream and a new flavor.

This is my go to dessert whenever I'm in the central Phoenix area. I get the Vietnamese coffee and strawberry with my waffle cone! So yummmy! Service is always on point! The guy w/ the dreads is so sweet!

Really cute place and the ice cream is really good! Lots of options for toppings too. The staff was very friendly and patient (takes a while for kids to decide with all of the options!). They let you sample whatever your want. There are about 6 tables on the back patio that are shaded. Parking can be tricky here. We will definitely be back!

Most AMAZING butter pecan ice cream I have ever had. Plenty of options for my gluten allergy and the staff so nice, helpful and patient while I took entirely too long to decide because it all sounded delicious. This place will be my new go to for a midnight ice cream run!

They have the BEST butter pecan ice cream in the valley. It's always a treat to grab a cone on my way home from work. Super cute shop and always have good music playing. They also have homemade caramels which I LOVE! You are missing out if you don't try this place.

I would love to stop going here because I'm getting out of control!! I always get the double chocolate and I'm just fine with that. This is some of the best ice cream I've had. There's always a line out the door. Always! And for good reason.

Homemade, local, honest ice cream. This place is super cute, and the staff is always very friendly. There is an assortment of older style candy, brining in a nice retro-vintage-esque to your visit. The ice cream is always superb, as is their award winning salted caramel topping. (Rich, thick drizzle...need I say more?!) There is limited parking, but plenty nearby. I think we can all handle walking a block for ice cream ;).. And if not, have someone run in and grab it! There is no indoor seating, just outside in front and in back. If you appreciate local charm and are looking for some great ice cream, shakes, malts or cookies, make a pit stop at Churn. P.s. Butter Pecan & salted caramel topping is one of my favs!

Great ice cream and treats! It is a good late night stop when you really need a kick of sugar. The good - amazing store made flavors - cookies! - friendly and helpful staff - open late - decent amount of parking for a place on central - nice casual seating - always clean and bright The not so good - next to a high school, so maybe don't go during lunch hour
I think this is my favorite ice scream spot in the Phoenix, Scottsdale, Tempe region. They've always got a few new flavors when I go in as well as their basics. Great flavor! Great price!

~ The only emperor is the emperor of ice cream ~ Ice cream rules! And Churn is a welcome addition to the CenPho landscape. First impressions: cute, tough parking lot, great seating areas. Bright, upbeat, cheery interior. I went during the week with a bunch of family. Between samples from the girl serving up scoops, and family orders, I had the fortune of trying numerous flavors. Those I found to be 5 star flavors: Blackberry, butter pecan, peanut butter Those I found 4 star: coconut, vanilla, strawberry Service was friendly and efficient. The pretzel cone was unique and oh-so-good with the peanut butter ice cream. I am not going to compare this to other places in town, as each is unique in its own right. I love Sweet Republic, but Churn is of a different genre. I think they will get the kinks worked out and future reviews will add the 5th star. In fact, I think I need to run an errand down there today, maybe I'll stop in.

Ice Cream Cookie. Three words that are near and dear to my heart. What makes this delectable treat from Churn so special? They are made to order, and you can create your own combination from their assortment of ice cream and cookie flavors (made fresh daily)! Overwhelmed by the possibilities, I fell back on the fondly familiar and went with vanilla bean ice cream embraced by a chocolate chip and a double chocolate chip cookie. Oh yes! Served in a cute cup (hey, the good stuff can get messy), it was the perfect treat for a warm Saturday afternoon. Big enough for sharing, too! I was so enamored by my dessert that I probably didn't pay close enough attention to all of the other wonderful things Churn has to offer. To me, that is a perfect excuse to go back... soon!

Pretzel cone....that's about all I need to say. But I will say that the butter pecan and chocolate ice cream was perfect. Great texture. They have a neat little seating area out back that is lit up nice at night and in the shade during the day. Wish I could go back again.
Stopped by on the spur of the moment for some ice cream. Amazing! Felt like I time traveled to my youth. So good taste and ambience! Loved it! Especially the peanut butter ice cream!

Very VERY delicious ice cream. The workers were friendly. I found the place to be a little pricey but the ice cream really was that good. It's a small shop but there's seating out back that is shaded and relatively cool.
I had the cherry pie milk shake and my wife has the apple pie float. Great taste. Nice to sit outside. Good and unique flavor to ice cream. Will come back.

We got the kitchen sink sundae and shared it! Super good super delicious just be prepared to pay $8 for a Sunday. All the candy they had for sale was from my childhood! Very cute place. We sat outside on the back patio which had a very nice ambiance.

I have wanted to try this place for a long time and so after dinner at postino I walked across the street for dessert. I should have skipped. I had butter pecan. There were way to may pecans to ice cream ratio or maybe they need chopped up more so it's easier to eat. Also, I walked in there and it smelled like a nasty dirty old dish rag. It was so repulsive I nearly walked out and didn't get a thing. GROSS!

Small little ice cream parlor that has a slightly vintage look to it. They share restrooms with the restaurant next door and they have a wall filled with old cassette tapes! Their ice cream is very flavorful and creamy! I tried the chocolate and the peanut butter! If you love peanut butter i would highly recommend u try it here, it is the best i have had yet!!

Second best place in Phoenix for ice cream (behind novel). It's super small and can get super busy on weekend evenings but it is worth the wait! Fresh and delicious ice cream, awesome flavor combinations and they usually always have yummy dairy free options. My husband swears the peanut butter ice cream is the best he has ever had. The perfect weekend meal: grab pizza at federal across the street then walk over for some ice cream. Very cute store front and great outdoor seating in the back!

Came here after dinner @ Windsor. It's kinda hard to deny the kiddies after they spotting the candy store on the way to the restrooms. Guess it more of an incentive for them to behave & finish their dinner. Kids Cone (3.5*) - a big scoop of ice cream on sugar, cake cup or cup w/ a toy on top $2.50. yelp.com/biz_photos/mPfd€¦ Ice Cream Sandwich (3*) - Since you can choose your own cookies, I picked the kitchen sink & chocolate chip, along w/ butter pecan ice cream. The lady was really cool and spit it for me to share w/ my sister. At the end of the day, the cookies were too heavy & sweet and the artisan ice cream was just alright. $4 yelp.com/biz_photos/mPfd€¦ Candy store (4*) - candies galore! cute selection of novelty candy and at a very reasonable price It's only patio seating so if it's a hot day, you have to eat fast. Not sure if I'll valet my car just to eat here, but if I'm over at Windsor, I'll definitely make a pit stop.

This place has a great atmosphere and wonderful staff. The ice cream professional with a stringy curly blonde Afro made the experience for me with his positive attitude! I even left a tip- something I would never do in a similar ice cream shop setting.

stopped at churn while a family member was visiting and they were craving some ice cream...we couldn't have been more pleased with the taste of the ice cream, great local flavor! Plenty of options and they offer samples of each. A must-try in my opinion!!

We came here for the first time and it's a really cute place. The whole set up makes you feel like u entered a time machine and it's quite charming. The ice cream itself is good. Nothing too crazy to rave about. All in all I had a pleasant experience but it's a little overpriced. I'll be back but I won't be a regular here.

Churn baby churn! I'm that person that HAS to have something sweet after dinner. And Churn has a little something for everybody. Cool little spot nestled in the center of some amazing restaurants, so it's a perfect place to hit up after dinner. They have ice cream, cookies, shakes, option to make a cookie sandwich, and lots of old school candy novelties you'll probably remember from when you were a kid. I'm a huge ice cream fan and I'd say their Caramel Cashew is probably the one that stands out the most. The cookies are also great. Soft, sweet, and chewy just how I like em. And I can't forget about the Fruit Loops bar!

Tried three ice cream Sandwich and ice cream tacos . First was chocolate chip with vanilla I e cream . The ice cream was a little of the soft side . The cookie seems a little small for 6 dollars had cookie with peanut butter . The ice cream was firmer but portion a little small chocolate taco was nice and crunchy. Prices have gone up and potion smaller .lines are long

Charming little ice cream parlor. Old style decor and vintage toys in the front of store (fun to browse). Very affordable place to take the kids for a quick treat! Not as many ice cream flavors as I might like, but the options are good for a smaller selection. The back patio is a nice little retreat to enjoy your cone. Plenty of misting and umbrella shade for summer time comfort.

Delicious ice cream flavors, cute shop. Came in around 6 pm earlier today with my two cousins, tried a few samples then a big group of people came in, so we kinda felt a little pressured to hurry, since there was only one employee working at the time. I hate how small it is inside, wish it was bigger, other than that the employee was super sweet and very nice. good pricing as well
Ice cream is amazing, got Vietnamese coffee and butter pecan on a kitchen sink ice cream sandwich, it did not disappoint!!! Guys that run the place were so nice...we'll be back!

I came here with family. We're so happy we found this place. I tried the Vietnamese Coffee ice cream with caramel sauce. My sister had the peanut butter ice cream with caramel sauce. They were both really good, but if I have to recommend one it would be the peanut butter with caramel. My daughter got the Oh My Affogato float. It's the coffee ice cream, vanilla ice cream, coke and double espresso. It's really good!! There is really nice outdoor seating with misters. Great music!!

Stopped in here a couple of days ago. I'm glad I was here mid-afternoon because the parking looks tough during the busy times. I had the butter pecan and strawberry flavors. Butter pecan was delicious. Rich, smooth and creamy. Not as wild about the strawberry. Too sweet for my taste. I'll keep this place in mind when I'm in the area and looking for some good ice cream.
They hired a couple new workers and I seriously love the service there! It's better than ever! The ice cream is always super yummy!
It is loud in there but clean and unique. They have lots of options with great tasting ice cream. What a perfect location.

I'll preface this by saying this was my first real ice cream in probably a year (I've been embracing the froyo & rolled ice cream trend). The line was long on a Sunday night but well worth the wait! I got the s'mores Sunday - which was decadently delicious. My husband made his own ice cream sandwich which he thoroughly enjoyed. Cool decor & good ice cream, is there a better way to beat the heat?

Was surprised to find a line 15 deep on Friday night around 8 but the Vietnamese coffee ice cream put it all in perspective! Worth the wait and affordable! My friends also enjoyed the pecan and the shakes, we even got some old school candy that takes me back to my childhood. If you haven't tried it I recommend you give it a shot

We drove quick and made it just before they closed for the night - were greeted by the most peppy guys. They were super friendly and didn't make us feel bad for coming in just before close. Also, the ice cream is amaaaazing! Vietnamese coffee? Yas gurl.

came here after having brunch at St. Franics. Really cool place with lots of good creations. Everyone liked what they got. will definitely be back to try some other things. I got some kind of oreo/cookie icecream and it was really good

This was a very cute ice cream shop that I went to when passing through Phoenix. I loved all the flavors that I got to try without annoying them, and ended up with getting a Bailey's (there is alcohol content) and a buttermilk grapefruit ice cream. The pretzel cone is salty (goes really well with creamy ice cream), and as the name suggests, it's actually a little hardy and crunchy, which I wasn't expecting initially. The staff are super friendly! There is parking right in front of the store for 15 min for people who want to just stop and go for ice cream.

More ice than cream. I was not expecting to have a bad experience. The location is nice plenty of parking and easy to find. However the selection was not impressive and absolutely no seating inside. I don't want to sit outside in 110 heat and eat my frozen treat. I went with Butter Pecan and it was icy. It seemed like it was partly thawed then refrozen. The flavor of the fudge seemed weak, not what I know to be fudge. I don't think I will be back.

Great ice cream every time. Churn makes their ice cream with real ingredients and it shows in their product! If you are getting ice cream for more than one person, go for a multi-scoop bowl. It will save you som ca$h!

Churn is a pretty popular place that almost all my friends have been to. The girl that worked there was really nice. No one else was in line after me so she insisted that I try every flavor and I didn't complain! :) There are lots of flavors to choose from but I usually get the Vietnamese Coffee flavor because it's my favorite. I usually get one or two scoops in a waffle cone. It's pretty good :) The environment is really unique and cute. It is actually connected with a hallway that leads to a restaurant called the Windsor. The hallway consists of the famous cassette tape wall which is one of my favorite parts of the entire place. Personally, I think that Sweet Republic is better but Churn is also really good :)

It was fantasic, I'll come back here with my wife for sure. The cookie was amazing! But keep in mind it's huge. My wife and I split the cookie and they even put the sandwich in different cups. Super helpful

If you're considering Ice Cream today, your search is over. Churn is by far the greatest ice cream around. I take a trip up Central to this little Ice Cream shop at least 2-4 times a week. My brothers and I enjoy the variety of flavors, and the service is nothing like you've ever experienced before. Every employee is an abundance of joy. The second you walk through the door you're always greeted with kindness. Personal favorite employees are Megan and Raymond, they always put a smile on my face. So stop by Churn, because you've found the Ice Cream and service you've been searching for.

LOVE Churn! I always get the "How the Cookie Crumbles" and my husband loves the strawberry shortcake combo -- but subs the Gluten Free macaroon for the shortcake b/c he has celiac disease. Fun place with lots of great options.

Nothing there that I haven't liked ((except maybe the long lines on weekends)). Even their gummy bears are AMAZING ((I've never had gummy bear opinions before)). Some staff are more friendly than others //some talk about life and remember me // but all staff are great and nice! Go on a weeknight if you don't want to wait awhile. For the quality, it's not as expensive as one would think it would be. They also have fair scooping sizes! Must try-- recently less changes in ice cream flavors but hoping the lull is due to revving up for the summer?
The cookies and milk ice cream is everything!! Cute little shop with a lot of choices! Was super crowded but so worth the wait! This was my first time there but certainly not my last!!

I love ice cream no matter what but this place was amazing to me because of the people behind the counter. So fun! So cute! So nice! The guy was really excited to torch the marshmallow fluff i ordered and it was perfect. Ice cream was amazing as expected. I got a double scoop because my eyes are bigger than my stomach and it was too much. Peanut butter tastes like a cookie as opposed to from out the jar. Tiramisu has the right hint of amaretto. Oh I also grabbed one of those salted caramel things in the front. I assume it's house made but wow it's so buttery salty and 50 cents! Hehe get one on the go. So worth it if you're a caramel lover like me. Can't wait to go back. It's a really hip and crowded place.
We loved the ice cream at Churn!!! Will definitely visit again when we are back in town.
The atmosphere was nice and atheistic but the cookie sandwiches had way too much salt and very few options in ice cream.

Absolutely delicious ice cream sandwich! Mint chocolate cookies with mint cookie ice cream. The cookies were very moist with a little bit of crunch from the mint. The ice cream was perfect. It was a combination made in ice cream heaven. The staff was great - very friendly and serving a line of people at 10:30pm with speed and grace. You can sample the ice cream flavors if you aren't sure. Very clean very cute place. Nice patio outside back. Will be back next time we are in Phoenix.

The ice cream was pretty good, but we went with some of their original concoctions. The rocky road had actual toasted marshmallow but the dish was a little too salty. My son got a float that had some of their coffee ice cream, which was pretty good also. I just wish they had smaller sizes available for the chiller I had.
LOVE the EVERYTHING. The atmosphere is whimsical, staff attentive & sweet, deserts yummy & pretty darn quick to get a sugar fix for there or to go. You gotta try it if you haven't.

I love this place, we can't get here often enough! The vibe here is so cool, retro and urban, modern kitsch and small townish... it's a great meld! And the ice cream is amazing! Please do yourself a favor and come here!!

Having lunch at Federal Pizza, I spied Churn from across the street. I had heard they had really good ice cream and it was worth checking out. Well, unfortunately I was unimpressed. I opted for a ice cream sandwich. I chose the salted chocolate chip cookies with cookies'n'mint ice cream. The two cookies were extremely hard and crunchy, and honestly very subpar. One would think in an ice cream shop that the cookies would be SOFT. Nope! This created a very messy ice cream sandwich and eating it in a traditional way proved to be impossible. Every bite forced more ice cream out of the bottom of the cookies. The end result was I ate the ice cream with a spoon and ended up throwing out the cookies. The ice cream itself wasn't bad, but it wasn't great either, and isn't worthy of driving any sort of distance to eat. The ice cream sandwich was definitely not worth the ~$7.00 price.
Delicious ice cream with unique flavor combos. I got their version of a blizzard. It had a massive cookie layer in the middle. It was pretty dang great. Way better than a chain ice cream shop

Being in walking distance from Churn is a dangerous thing. Between my boyfriend and I, we go through 4-5 punchcards a month.
