My big brother has taken me here twice. We love the ambiance, and the ridiculously tasty treats! It's so nice to sit outside and listen to music, and chat with friends and/or family. There's such a fresh, urban feel! I would certainly recommend this spot to my friends!
The family loved it and we will return. Great quality and friendly service. Awesome flavors were Madagascar Vanilla, Toasted Coconut and Double Chocolate.

Congrats on recent acknowledgement of being one of the best in the US which is also indicative of Upward. Also, such a good neighbor actually 'adding' pkg. Your product is so much better than LGNo! that I drive all the way from arcadia...nice work!

The ice cream is delicious. My favorite thing to get is the ice cream sandwiched between two cookies. The available cookies can vary but my favorite is the coconut macaroon cookie mixed with some other cookie with the Vietnamese ice cream between them. So good. Also, the people that work here have always been really nice to me even when I want to try a multitude of ice cream flavors. The other random trinkets and candies in the shop don't interest me but make for a cool visual and nostalgia. Only downside is that parking can be complicated/inconvenient. Highly recommended ice cream!
Unique and creative deserts. This was really nice. Friendly staff. Wide variety to choose from. Very clean.
This place is amazing! Their strawberry shortcake was the best I've had in a very long time!!
Amazing service and great ice cream flavors, I would most likely go back for the atmosphere and the creamy delight goods.

Ok, so I have stopped in twice now, and both times were quite nice. The first time I just had a scoop of their Madagasgar vanilla ice cream with some salted caramel on top. It was good, but the caramel was SUPER salty...a bit too much. The second time, I had a scoop of vanilla (I know, so adventurous) with their fudge. Good God was is nom-worthy. I even went back to ask for more fudge, prepared to pay for my extra topping and the chick behind the counter said it was on the house. Thought that was pretty cool. Love this place and their staff...will be here again in the near future...and maybe next time I'll try something in a pretzel cone!

My husband and I were visiting from out of town we seen that this place was a feature on Food Network (Diners, Drive Ins and Dives). In my opinion this place is severely over hyped. My Ice Cream choices were Madagascar Vanilla/Cookies & Mint which were way too sweet and the lady behind the counter wasn't very helpful considering it was our first time going. She kind of speed through the menu with no clear direction so I picked the most basic option two scoops in a cup. The location(building) is very small with cute little knick knacks other than that nothing special to me.
Loved everything about this place the Vietnamese espresso was amazing and the lemon bar desert was beyond amazing!
Comparing to diddy riese cookies in los Angeles... nothing special imo. The cookies.... don't taste like anything special... the ice cream too. Its a fun dessert area though.
Amazing service! Charming location! Delicious ice cream.
After you finish a tasty meal at Windsor, you absolutely have to treat yourself to some ice cream at Churn. My fave is chocolate fudge with pecans and caramel! Score!
Amazing Strawberry ice cream!:). The best we ever had. And the Stout and Eggnog was pretty darn good too.

I've been here twice now and I have to say, Churn is delicious. I had Vietnamese Coffee and the Carrot Cheesecake ice cream and I was not disappointed. I think the Vietnamese Coffee ice cream is the best ice coffee ice cream I've ever had! They used condensed milk and espresso. They also give you an option to add toasted marshmallow fluff, which is absolutely perfect for anyone with a sweet tooth. I am sensitive to anything that is too sweet, so I stuck to a single scoop for $2.75. This place is a must try. They are open till 10pm on Sundays, which is later than other places around.
Best ice cream I've had in quite some time. Just found my favorite desert spot! I recommend the Mint Chip!

Maybe the best ice cream I have had anywhere, ever. NY, Philly, LA, SF, Italy. Anywhere. Vietnamese coffee, chocolate, and toasted coconut. I shared this huge amount of ice cream with my husband. Its probably a good thing we don't live in Phoenix.

The ice cream was so good! It's super creamy the employees were nice and the set up was the store was cool. The smoke from the nitrogen was awesome and made the ice cream seem even better. The only problem was it took 5-ever.

Best Butter Pecan Ever! The ladies that waited on us were awesome with my 2 year old. I am a chocolate girl, but the butter pecan was too die for. Will go back and back and back. They have a bike rack out back and a great patio!
Yummy!!!!! Parking was tough, but that's just the way it is in that neighborhood these days (lots of good restaurants in the ara.....). Good stuff!

Churn has the best ice cream I've had in a long time! Yes...the parking situation can be a bit hairy but there are options and it is definitely worth the effort to make it there. In fact, the butter pecan with the salted caramel is something I've been craving ever since having my first taste. The ice cream is creamy...full of flavor...and sure to leave you wanting more. The staff is very friendly and helpful and really made my children feel welcome even though they were acting a bit crazy. One girl even came out from behind the counter to have a little fun and demonstrate some of the toys for them. Churn is definitely a place I will return to again and again.
This place is amazing!!! The workers are sweet and even put little toys on our kids ice cream! What a special place with great seating in the back.
Great peanut butter cookie and I am not even a peanut butter fan! Also loved the strawberry and butter pecan ice creams.

While the ice cream is very good, I found the flavors to be uninspiring. Churn is good if your'e a classic-flavors kind of person, but I like to try new things and they didn't offer many beyond the traditional.

Churn has great ice cream and unique flavors but the experience could use improvement. The portion sizes are too small for the price they charge. The place is so small and all summer long there is a line out the door, they cannot accommodate more than a few customers at a time in the store and really creates a bad experience waiting outside when it's 110°.
Churn is definetly a popping place and the staff is always upbeat. My favorite ice cream is their 21 and over delight.

The store is very cute. It's a bit on the small side but has a spacious, shady patio out back. Customer experience was lacking. The employees could've been friendlier. They have a small selection of ice cream to choose from. The mint cookie ice cream was delicious. Not so much a fan of the others. I got a cookie sandwich that was huge! Their prices are very reasonable. I didn't absolutely love my cookie, but it was good.

Keep on keepin on!! I brought my sister in law here for some ice cream, she was a first timer and the guy that helped us was WONDERFUL! He let her taste test 3 flavors so she could make her decision, usually people get annoyed by that request, not Churn!! Our dishes were DELISH and we've been back since! Love this place!!

Love the dessert but beware of the Oh My Afagato...especially if you are a caffeine light weight like myself. We went here after my birthday dinner and I made the mistake of ordering it without realizing that it came with vietnamese coffee ice cream, not vanilla. I could not understand why I was laughing so much and felt and was motivated to just start running (i didn't!). After my realization, I traded with my fiance and ate the rest of his Everything but the kitchen sink. The combo of salty, crunchy and sweet was perfect.

Delish! We were looking for a treat after the Dbacks game... Picked the right spot! The girls are sweet and patient with my indecisive husband. I had the Vietnamese Coffee with a peanut butter cookie on the bottom (bomb choice) and he had the mint cookie which he says was "good". Reasonably priced...just wish there were more places to sit!

I found this little gem about a year ago on my quest to try as many cool ice cream places as I could find. I bring my four year old with me and she loves it. The flavors ate refreshing and unique and they taste really good. Good enough for a picky four year old to enjoy. She's eating the white chocolate raspberry sorbet right now and has gotten the blueberry frozen yogurt and the the grapefruit lime as well. The I Lu con would be that there's no indoor seating but they have outdoor seating with misters. Cute candy shop ambience.
This place is AMAZING. Best ice cream ive had in AZ. I was a newbie and of course had a pretzel cone with coconut ice cream. REAL BIG FLAKES OF COCONUT. so yummy. go check it out!

Went here with friends and loved it! Waited in line for about five minutes but it was fine because of the great atmosphere. Lots of toys and fun things to look at. I had the cookies and crÃ¨me and loved every bite. I would've gone with two scoops if I would have known. They gave a cute spoon with my cup also. Little bit overpriced, but that's all ice cream shops. Could use more seating, but definetly check this place out!

This is a really quaint ice cream shop in Phoenix that's definitely worth a stop if you're in the area. It's a pretty hopping place as the line can sometimes be out the door. I highly recommend trying two flavors if you're getting multiple scoops because their flavors are pretty intense and it can become too much after a while with only one flavor. They also offer a unique pretzel cone and I highly recommend that as the salt really enhances the flavors of the ice cream as well.

Definitely worth your money. I love how they have the classics if you so choose, but have flavors accommodating to those who dare try something different like the goat cheese pistachio honeycomb which was surprisingly delicious! It's busy which to me means it's worth sticking around for. Everyone is cheerful and helpful!

A good old fashioned ice cream store with yummy frozen treats. I normally stumble into Churn after having a dinner at Federal Pizza. I make sure I have room for dessert when I'm in the neighborhood. Churn is an adorable shop that has Great homemade ice cream with tons of toppings to choose from. They even sell nostalgic candies and toys. You remember the Fortune Fish that you would put on your hand to tell your fortune, they have it! I will be coming back for more treats soon!

My family took me here, I'm from out of town, and this ice cream makes me want to come back to phoenix! It tasted so fresh and decadent. I had the peanut butter mixed with the coffee. It was definitely the best coffee ice cream I have ever tasted. There is a small seating area in the back too.

Really cute place with an old school candy shop feel. Actually, they do sell random candy on site.. jawbreakers and the like. Staff is friendly and helpful. The Vietnamese coffee is my go to flavor..The boyfriend loves the butter pecan. Only gripe is I wish they had more flavors and they rotated them more. They have around 10 flavors. Also parking is not all that available.

OMG what? You've never been to Windsor & Churn?!??! What is your deal? This place has awesome homemade ice cream with a bunch of weird classic toys and treats that look like came straight out of the 50s. Cool little seating area outside for when it gets cold. Great date spot coupled with Windsor next door (also reviewed).

Good stuff tonight, had as the cookie crumbles. Very delicious, it is a diabetics nightmare. So good yet so sweet. The sweet cream was over the top. A friend had a chocolate with vanilla scoop of ice cream with chocolate covered nuts. He was a little disappointed, thought the covered nuts would be different. Still like the place and their wonderful selections.
Love the goat cheese, honey, pistachio. Got a free scoop on my birthday and I am obsessed!
This place is ambrosial. From the moment you walk in! The decor is perfect and their flavor combos are worth every penny!
Great local place to stop for ice cream and cookies. Their macaroons are so delicious.
Just a really nice old school ice cream joint. The staff was very nice and they also sold some old school candies I have not seen in years.
Amazing and friendly service! Great desert place and tegu finally have parking near by.

I love their late hours! My night was almost ruined until someone said churn stayed open later than other shops. We got there just before the last min rush. It was crazy how many people line up, into the parking lot, 10 minutes before closing. It's that good! The staff are always friendly too.

oh my gosh, there ice cream sandwiches are the friggin' bomb! this is the first review i wrote in all caps, because you will get your sweet tooth on! i will see you soon! Well, I tried to write in all caps, but that didn't work...

Tried this ice cream for the very first time and let me tell you something...it was delicious! Service is wonderful as the entire staff is super friendly from the minute you walk in the door. I tried the Madagascar vanilla and butter pecan and I was happily pleased! The ice cream tastes fresh and homemade...so creamy and smooth. Definitely worth the hype I had read about this place!!!

Obsessed with Churn! Such a perfect ice cream parlor, complete with homemade flavors and cones, a plethora of toppings, fresh baked cookies, expresso bar and tons old fashioned candy. This place is sure to satisfy any sweet tooth. It feels as though you are stepping back in time, to an era when grabbing an ice cream cone was a full throttle experience that encouraged socializing and indulging. Besides the perfect ambiance, the ice cream is unbelievably delish! My favorite is Butter Pecan, but you can't go wrong with any choice Churn! (Great chocolate milkshakes too!)
Great flavors (though a small selection at any one time), and friendly service. Seating is out back on a patio with heaters.

We rushed over but still only made it 10 minutes before closing on a Friday! The employees could not have been nicer. They didn't rush us at all and were chatty and friendly. They have tons of interesting flavors of ice cream and vintage and modern candy. I had cookies & mint ice cream in a pretzel cone. The ice cream was delicious. Pretzel cone was not my taste but I don't regret trying it and it was definitely something new and interesting!
Some of the best ice cream out there! Toasted coconut with hit fudge and chocolate covered almond! Divine
I absolutely love churn! Always really friendly workers, delicious homemade ice cream and baked goods and decent prices. I don't even like ice cream that much, but I love churn ice cream!

Went on Saturday afternoon around 3PM in January, I had Baileys Crunch and Vietnamese Coffee in a cup. Baileys was super creamy and smooth...divine! The coffee had very nice unique coffee flavors but was a bit grainy or icy. My wife had Toasted Coconut and Double Chocolate, both excellent in flavor and texture. Prices were very reasonable. Sat outside in the patio next to the Windsor, very pleasant, mix of families and AZ hipsters, with kind of loud indie music. Wanted to try just the ice creams, but the cookies and other toppings looked enticing for next time!

Wonderful little ice cream/candy joint right next to the Windsor Restaurant. The interior isn't very large, but it's super inviting and has a very clean/kiddish vibe to it. I think it's the perfect atmosphere for a candy/ice cream joint! They do have a wonderful back patio that is right next to the Windsor patio, but is still separate from it. The patio is very clean and inviting. There are plenty of beautiful flowers and trees to enjoy while eating your meal. The seating and shading are comfy and there are misters to keep you cool. Their menu of ice cream is not very large, but the flavors are unique and are created daily. There are plenty of topping options as well. They have a wide selection of coffees (lattes, cappuccinos, teas, Americanos, etc), as well as toppers to include Soy Milk! I ordered an Iced Americano (12oz for 2$), and my husband ordered an ice cream sandwich. You can choose to create your own sandwich using any of their delicious cookies and ice cream options. They have waffle cones, pretzel cones, and a variety of other options to pair with your ice cream experience. Unfortunately, they do not serve yogurt or sorbet ice cream at this time, a deal breaker for those of us who can't/won't eat dairy! My family has been back several times as they can't get enough of Churn's unique and tasty goodies. Churn is a must try for any ice cream lover !

Churn is adorable. They have amazing ice-cream and a great selection of other things as well. They have such a unique shoppe and cute outdoor seating that is very inviting and different. It's great after a date or a night out, and the workers are very friendly and know how to serve all the people in there in a timely manner! They are very family friendly and I believe pet friendly!

Completely obsessed. It's like the cooler cousin of a 50s-style soda shop. I'm always conflicted with whether I want coffee or ice cream when I go but then I remember that they have the world's best coffee ice cream... or the option of an affogato which includes both espresso and their Vietnamese coffee ice cream AND Mexican coke. Not just win-win. Win-win-win.
Always the best. Now on a first name basis with most of the staff and their hot chocolate is oh so very delicious. My very favourite ice cream shop!
The toasted coconut ice cream is outstanding! There is really nothing more to say.

Delicious ice cream, with unique flavours as well as standard ones. Decent prices, good service, and an adorable outdoor patio in the back. The only thing they could improve on is getting a gluten free cone!

This place is so good! We were visiting Arizona for the past 4 days and we came here twice. Thanks to the recommendation of a friend. Our kids loved it so much! Banana ice cream was the hit for our family, and the salted chocolate chunk cookie!

There's a certain amazingness that comes from fresh made ice cream. It's soft, creamy, and not filled with high fructose corn syrup and preservatives to keep it together for months in a freezer. Growing up in Arizona, we always made homemade ice cream in the summer and if you've never experienced homemade ice cream, just go to Churn. I had the banana ice cream with caramel sauce on top. I can't say anything bad about it at all. If someone doesn't like their ice cream, it's because they've been subject to all the fakeness added to ice cream in the stores and national ice cream shop chains. The shop has lots of toys and candy and knickknacks that will give you a sense of nostalgia. I'll tell you what sounds like the best day ever: riding my bike down Central on a beautiful Phoenix day... stopping in to Churn for an ice cream break (and then popping into one of the restaurants nearby for a cocktail).

While the ice cream looked delicious - there was no frozen yogurt. I was led astray! But this place sure is popular - the line was out the door. I am on a quest for a local yogurt joint - not sure why Yelp lists this as both a yogurt & ice cream shop.

Best coffee flavored ice-cream I've ever had. I had the Vietnamese coffee ice cream on the pretzel cone. The saltiness of the pretzel cone mixed with the sweet coffee ice cream was amazing! It was hard to get a bite with ice cream and cone though.

I have recently lost about seventy pounds and I take my rare chances to pig the eff out very seriously. I typically go to a frozen yogurt place and make myself sick with mini peanut butter cups, but ever since discovering Churn, I can't make a trip to the area without being tempted. Churn has a bit of an eclectic mix of different sundaes and floats that make me want to try something new every time, my favorites so far are the smores and Elvis sundaes, the Elvis being my newest finding and its mix of salty and sweet is mind blowing. This place is worth the extra notch in my belt, if it was a bit cheaper it would hit the five star home run, but I can't in good conscience give a perfect rating to a nine dollar sundae. Churn, me and all of the personal trainers out there getting business from the bad decisions made in your shop, love you.

Great place to get ice cream on an obscenely hot-as most are in Phoenix-evening. It's a real change from all the boring, self-serve fro-yo chains that make you do all the work and charge you $9 for toppings. I really liked the retro atmosphere and, despite it being a bit crowded on a Friday night, the line moved pretty fast. I ordered a Peanut Butter Freeze without knowing what to expect. The end result? A cup full of peanut butter chips, crumbled up Reese's cups and chocolate all smooshed together in a creamy concoction. Needless to say, I nearly polished it off on the ride home. One other thing I liked was the outdoor seating in the back, but you'd probably have to eat pretty fast considering the weather. Seemed like a real hang-out spot for all ages.
Ice cream is good but way too expensive I don't want to pay eight dollars for a damn sundae, Plus the line is way too long and out the door. The place is cute but really small. Wouldn't recommend.
The butter pecan and salted caramel topping is incredible. Gotta check this place out when in town.

The heavens of sugar and ice cream have opened up and blessed Churn with a bounty of amazingly-delicious treats! Everything - I repeat: everything at Churn is amazing! There is NO better ice cream in AZ. And Churn is definitely some of the best in America! Thank you sugar gods!

Churn is awesome! Old fashioned ice cream parlor done right! I love the design, super fun! It is any kid or in my case big kid's dream to have a place like Churn right next door to Windsor. You can enjoy food and drinks and then walk right over to fill your sweet tooth craving after a yummy savory meal. Loved the choice of flavors, all very unique and delicious. The wide array of candy choices was definitely a hit for my kiddo. Definitely a fun spot that is MUST to visit!
Toasted coconut with salted carmel. Do it! That's all I am going to say. Oh and the Macaroons!

Went here after Windsor, right next door. Great creamy ice cream. Loved the peanut butter flavor. They have regular, sugar, cake, and pretzel cones. Fresh cookies too. The bartender at Windsor told me that they will make an ice cream sandwich. He described his choice of a peanut butter cookie on top and chocolate chip on bottom with banana ice cream. Wow, that sounds awesome. We will be back.

Simple, honest ice-cream. Had the butter pecan with salted caramel. Not too sweet, not insecure in its culinary proximity to frozen yoghurt, and sensibly portioned. Like the outdoor patio seating; wish it was set up less as a quick stop and go and more as a place you can get a cup of ice-cream with a friend and chat for a while.

Wow! The perfect combination of creamy, sweet and flavorful ice creams with a beautiful melt. Not a lot of frilly flavors, just the basics, but done so very well. Vanilla bean and double chocolate in a cup: total yum! Best ice cream in Phoenix, no doubt.

During the summer heat there is nothing like some ice cream to cool you down, especially the homemade stuff at Churn! Inside it is a very cute 50's style candy shop, so you can't help but feel like a kid in a candy store and want everything. My friend lives right down the street and we walk there frequently, which I should note their biggest problem: PARKING! They need to have some designated Churn parking spots! There is also no indoor seating so you need to eat it outside, which can be a bit brutal in the Phoenix summer. My other issue: how to decide which YUMMY flavors to eat!! Last time I had the double chocolate, mint cookie, and peanut butter (only one scoop, 1/3 each). But their berry flavors are great too; I have had blueberry and strawberry and they were both amazing! The flavors are always changing and I don't think you can go wrong with any of them!

They offer a cookie sandwich where you pick two cookies and a scoop of ice cream and you know the rest. They let me replace a cookie with a brownie at no charge so props for that! The cookie was really sweet and its taste stuck out when trying to eat the sandwich as one, but the brownie and peanut butter ice cream were good. The line moves fast. Pleasant experience overall.

Been here a few times and it's a nice little place. I ordered the s'more ice cream cup and wow that sucker is sweet! It was a bit overwhelming for me lol so you might want to share it with someone. I felt there was a bit too much graham crackers and marshmallows in it so had to work my way through that to get to the ice cream. The chocolate tasted like dark chocolate. On another visit I took my son on a Friday night and the only complaint that it is so small that there was a line out the door so we waiting in the car until the line went down and then jumped out of the car to get in the line in the door before another crowd came lol there is very limited parking in the front. Like 5 spaces max and a restaurant next door so you might be walking. There is a valet around the corner but not sure if that's just for the restaurant. Anyhow, I ordered a brownie and it was so good! Again I love chocolate but don't realize how much chocolate I'm getting until I feel overwhelmed by it lol there was a good amount of chocolate pieces in the brownie and it was nice and soft. My son got a kids cup with chocolate and sprinkles. He gave it a thumbs up so that's good. It is a good place to get ice cream I just wish it were in a bigger place with more parking. Other than that is recommend it!

There is not one bad thing to be said about Churn, except that I wish I could get ice cream there every single day. The staff is really bubbly and friendly, the ice cream is to die for, and if you don't get one of their ice cream sandwiches made with homemade ice cream AND homemade cookies, you're completely insane.
Cookie was rough but ice cream was really good, recommend the chocolate fudge. I had the peanut butter cookie and coconut macroon cookie as my two cookies for the sandwich. A little hard to dig into.

I have to agree with the rest of my yelping friends that Churn rocks I've been here on several different occasions because like Amy D. I live close enough to walk....... out of my visits all have been fine but one........ I however have never thought that it was any better than the rest of the trendy Ice cream, soda pop, coffee shops that seem to be popping up all over and it's even harder for me to justify 16$ for a sundae for me and one for my friend I rather walk next door to Windsor and get a couple of beers and a great appetizer for the same 16$........... Til next time
Staff was great and they have the BEST peanut butter ice cream I have ever had!
Had a scoop of the Vietnamese coffee and toasted coconut. What I loved about the ice cream was how powerful the flavor was. Both were delicious. Glad I don't live close to this spot.

While gelato is my first love, I really enjoy ice cream and Churn was one of the best ice creams I've had in recent memory. I had vanilla and peanut butter with salted caramel topping. My wife had banana and butter pecan. All flavors were excellent. We talked with the owner for a few minutes and he gave us some great restaurant recommendations. Great staff, pleasant location. We were there on a Saturday afternoon in November and had no issues with parking.

What else can I say that hasn't already been said? Churn makes really great old fashioned ice cream with some unique, modern flavors. Love the cute shop with all the nostalgic candy and the little patio oasis out back. Since I live in the 'burbs the parking stresses me out but I love that they have the 15 minute parking right up front so if you are just stopping in to get a cone (rather than having dinner at Windsor) you can get in and out easily.
my vietnamese coffee was DELISH but my niece's strawberry was PERFECT. parking (on saturday night) was terrible so be prepared to walk a little from the surrounding neighborhood.

I love this place...everything here is fabulous...its ice cream treats...everyone can find something to love...i know that i have...the owners oncd again have done a fabulous job...this place is crowded for a purpose...because its amazing and fun...i love it

Excellent ice cream! Hubby and I went to this place during recent visit to AZ. In my mind I wanted to get an cookie ice cream sandwich, but was turned off when I saw a big, fat horse fly sitting on top of a chocolate chip cookie having a meal. Gross! Since none of the baked goods were covered, I dismissed any chance of trying those and hubby and I decided to split a Fat Elvis sundae. The peanut butter ice cream was great, as were all the toppings. Definitely come here for the ice cream, but skip the baked goods unless you don't mind the thought of flies walking all over your food and putting their digestive fluids on your cookie. This fly was slurping up a chocolate chip, he wasn't just flitting around, he'd settled in for a long meal on that cookie! Eew!

Really good & tasty! We had the Butter Pecan. The only thing negative we could say about it is that the pecans were over roasted & tasted just shy of burnt. We understand that this could be preference, but since butter pecan is my absolute favorite ice cream I've eaten plenty of it to know when the pecans were over roasted. But overall it was still pretty good. The guys behind the counter were very friendly & helpful. The decor of the parlor was lively & bright. It's not a cheap treat, 2 scoops in a cup $4.50, 3 scoops in a cup $5.50 but a nice indulgence especially with friends.

Heard of this place through work. Very disappointed. Flys are horrible and trapped in the dishes, no seating. Outside few tables only had one umbrella for shade so we were melting in the sun. Music is blaring. They were out of nuts, had spoiled butter pecan sitting in the freezer with the other ice cream. Horrible horrible place.

cute little space uptown. the flavors are very creamy...sometimes so creamy they mask some of the flavor. baked good are tasty but not out of the ordinary. it's a cute spot to grab a snack or dessert after eating at windsor (see other review...not sure that will ever become a destination restaurant) or postino, but wouldn't drive out of your way if you're anywhere near some of the other excellent ice cream/gelato shops around the valley.
The ice cream was excellent and we had a good time sitting out on the patio behind the shop eating on a nice evening.
LOVE this place!!! Took my mom and sister her for Mother's day. Also chose this place as my ice cream treat on my birthday!! I love the cookie sandwich... to die for!!! My absolute favorite!

Few things make my heart as happy as Churn. I wish I was kidding. Now, I try to not go more than once or twice a month for health reasons, but you better believe my trips to the best ice cream shop ever are highly-anticipated. :) I LOVE their tiramisu, Bailey's crunch, and Vietnamese coffee flavors, but in all honesty, I haven't had a flavor yet that I didn't love. It's the most wonderful, nostalgic place, and the employees are SO fun! My favorite is the guy with the fro, kind of resembles Robin Lopez (former Suns player). Anyway, go, and you won't regret it! I like two scoops in a waffle come myself, but my fiancÃ© swears by their cookie sandwiches. There is a local baker who brings them fresh brownies and cookies every day. Oh, and the flavors of both the baked goods and ice cream are always changing. Don't be afraid to call and ask about what they have that day. You might even end up catching onto the schedule. ;) Hahaha. Enjoy!

Yum Yum and Yum ! Churn makes you feel like your in a old-fashioned ice cream shop with all the sweet treats and the perfect variety of ice cream flavors. I always need to sneak by for a taste test after having dinner at Windsor . I finally had my first full cone of Strawberry Ice Cream on a pretzel cone. My concept sounded good because I love the salty sweet combo , but the cone was too salty for the strawberry. I think a chocolate or peanut butter would be better. The Strawberry Ice Cream was fresh and the perfect consistency , but too rich and had the perfect balance of sweetness.

Sweet Pea and I decided on one recent night to rail down to Churn and see what all of the fuss was about. We'd heard a lot about it and its restaurant counterpart, Windsor. Bottom line, it was good ice cream. It was not swoon-worthy. I will not be getting in my car making a mad late night ice cream run just to get Churn ice cream. But, although I am definitely an ice cream person, I couldn't really imagine myself doing that for any particular place's ice cream. We had no crystallization issues like other reviewers mentioned- the texture was good, heavy, creamy. I tried the Madagascar vanilla, which was rich and vanilla-y as you'd expect, but I ended up ordering the coconut, in a cup, with the salted caramel topping. Both the ice cream and the topping were good. The one thing I will say about the salted caramel (and I REALLY like salted caramel) was that it was overpowering in terms of flavor. Next time I'd probably just get it with the vanilla. Or maybe chocolate if I felt frisky. And I really want to try that pretzel cone thing they have there, man that looked awesome. Sweet Pea tried the bubble gum and ended up with the blackberry with salted caramel (yeah..."interesting" choice there Sweet Pea) and had the same impressions pretty much that I did. It was good. He did keep saying over and over again that the bubble gum flavor was delightful and that next time he was going to order it. I will say that the reviewer that commented in the vast disparity between scoop sizes was right on. Sweet Pea's was 1.5 to 2 times larger than mine. The atmosphere is cute. Sweet Pea did not like the layout, because the place gets quite busy, and there is no organized line nor even a really good area for everyone to stand in. It's pretty narrow and people get bunched up. On (kind of) an aside: is it me, or are these hipster places becoming interchangeable? It feels kinda beautiful, but soulless. I'm ready for the next thing.

Delicious! The butter pecan and Vietnamese coffee flavors are wonderful. Perfect treat for a hot summer day. I gave 4 stars only because I think the sundae prices are a little high, but it won't stop us from going back. What a great splurge!
This place was great. They make all their own ice cream and treats like cookies and brownies. The staff was so friendly and outgoing and happy to dish out plenty of samples.

You want creamy, fluffy, ooey-gooey, delicious ice cream? Then you're in luck!! This is the place for you. I wish I would have known that this place existed long before having tried other ice cream shops that horribly messed with my taste buds. This place is EXACTLY what the doctor ordered. I had a banana split & Sebastian helped make this yummy creation. He was super friendly & helpful & helped me enjoy ice cream once again. I love their decor inside- just candy & yumminess all around. They may have simple flavors, but it is all about what you do with those flavors is what makes this place unique. They have s'more sundaes & girl scout cookie flavored ice cream!! I will need to find a dentist real fast because I have such a sweet tooth for this place!!

Love this place! Cute retro feel, super friendly and helpful staff and amazing ice cream. My favorite is cookies and mint, but they change out their flavors pretty frequently. Last time I was in, they had buttermilk grapefruit which was awesome. Totally reminds me of one of the crazy flavor combos at Allegro (Tucson gelato place).

With all the hype on how good the butter pecan ice-cream is, we gave it a try. It tasted just like cheap store bought ice-cream. What a disappointment!!! The cookie was the only item that tasted any good.
Great ice cream, cool place to hang out, kid-friendly. You should come check it out! Oh, and they bake all kinds of cookies and treats!

This place is really cute. You feel like you're a little kid all over again. I tried the Vietnamese coffee ice cream. It was extremely flavorful! I'm definitely coming back and purchasing a pint. The staff is friendly, definitely ask them what their favorites are, they are helpful and generous when you want to try flavors. The only reason I knocked a star off is because the store is small and there isn't anywhere to sit inside. Best believe I'm not tryna melt outside in this AZ heat.

This place without exaggeration is the best! The inside is beautiful, patio adorable, staff friendly and fun, extra little trinkets to shop for are unique and nostalgic, prices cheaper than I am used to, and EVERYTHING is delicious! Aside from ice cream to satisfy your sweet tooth the brownie assortment and lemon bars are incredible.

went and tried it with my boyfriend expecting it to live up to its hype but was let down quickly. don't recommend the ice cream sandwich for the cookie is hard as a rock to where you could hardly even break it, ice cream was okay other than the fact that it was slightly melted. personally wouldn't spend $15 for two ice creams again, but the staff was extremely friendly.
They're great! The flavors are fun and tasty! I love the decor as well. Really bring my inner child out. Absolutely adore.

I looove Churn...we mosey on over there after eating at Windsor. My kids usually pick out something while I dance around to the great music that is always playing. Fun fun fun...great selection of yummy candies, silly trinkets and good selection of ice cream.

The coolest thing about this ice cream place is that you feel like you walk into a real 1950s ice cream parlor! They have all these awesome retro toys like yoyos and little toy soldiers and the decor is just beautiful. I wish, I just WISH!!! the place wouldn't have been so small and ridiculously jam-packed. The line was literally out the door and the people behind the counter were just trying to get everyone through the line as quickly as possible. It was just a mad rush of crowd and noise and it made it really hard to take everything in and really enjoy the place. The ice cream was absolutely delicious (except banana. I'm a banana FREAK and I didn't like the banana flavor). But the strawberry, chocolate, and vanilla were very, very good. AND, if you order a kid's scoop it comes with a little toy dinosaur right on the ice cream!! How fricken cool! My boys loved it. In the future, I might stop by if I see the place is completely empty (highly unlikely), but if I see it's full I'll just drive by and probably go to Melt downtown. Oh, also, they do toppings but no "mix-ins". I like mix-ins better because then it's all uniform and you don't eat all the toppings first and ice cream later. (I got bananas on top of my banana ice cream and I had bananas followed by banana ice cream).
Aw it's all cute and old timey. Flavors are good too.

Pretzel cone, OMG! Server was so friendly, she gave us several samples and chatted with us after (it was very quiet). Everything we tried was amazing, can't wait to go again. Get a single, which is plenty big in the pretzel cone, and they let you get two flavors!

Without a doubt this is my favorite ice cream place in the Phoenix area. I just recently discovered it and liked it so much I came back the following day. Apparently they rotate through different flavors each week. Get the cookies & mint if its available.

Phoenix and its large abundance of ice cream shops, Churn rates high in the cutesy scale. Small in size, it appeals to me since they have good ice cream as well delectable sweets. I love their assortment of cookies and bars. I like that you can make your own ice cream sandwich, and that it's encouraged. I've been here numerous times but I would like to highlight the professionalism of their staff when accommodating my niece who has a peanut allergy. They made sure to rinse the ice cream scooper as well take out a new tub of the double chocolate ice cream, in order to ensure that there wouldn't be any contamination whatsoever. I commend the staff for doing that extra step. bravo. Anywho, if you plan to eat at the ice cream shop, there are tables in the back patio, and since there's lack of parking, complimentary valet is offered (no need to risk your life crossing busy central ave. by parking across the street).

This ice cream is the best! So creamy! The vanilla, chocolate, and peanut butter were delicious. There was a line out the door, but it was worth the wait. They have a cute patio in the back where you can enjoy your treats!
I'm a vanilla aficionado, and theirs was deliciously creamy and not too sweet. Leaving 4 stars for now until I try some other flavors and combinations!

Service was good went monday around 2pm. I can totaly see where the parking issues are. I had no problem. I got a scoop of salted carmel and a scoop of peanutbutter both toped with chocolate. cost seven dollars. Scoops were good sized. My boyfriend inhaled his salted carmel. I ate my peanut butter a bit slower. I did have a few ice crystals in the PB. It was rich creamy and delish.. Would I go back ... YES.
Ice cream good. Service not so much. The young lady that served us this evening was much more interested in continuing her conversation with her co-worker than anything I had to say.

great location right across the street from Joyride tacos. nice seating area outside and fast, friendly service. i would recommend any ice cream flavor but my personal favorite is butter pecan . their cookies and sundaes are amazing as well. plus there's tons of cool old candies for sale.
Yum! Had the cookies and mint. Definitely delicious. I was a little surprised by the lack of flavors. They had maybe 8 or 10 and nothing crazy. The parking was also horrendous.

Great ice cream! The tahitian vanilla and double chocolate icecream are to die for!! It has a cute atmosphere, but no indoor seating, which is only a problem during the summer. There is not a huge variety of ice-cream, but the quality of the flavors are worth it.

Ice cream is delicious, cookies might be even better I don't know.... ok they tie!! Go to try it can't go wrong with homemade!!! AND on the cheaper side, shocked to pay less than $20 for 4 ice creams with cookies!! Great place!
Heavenly ice cream & unique toppings - the girl working there was super sweet & patient with my son - a little pricey but worth it !
Very small, but hip uptown ice creamery that is joining the trend of nice little eateries around that area. I love it, and I hope it gets bigger. Only problem...parking is very tough

We worked hard to find the business but it was worth it. It is in a small strip shopping center with limited signage. Parking is tight but they offer free valet parking, what a concept for an ice cream shop. The ice cream was really good, the butter pecan was the best I ever had while the peanut was excellent.
Ice cream is amazing (but the iced tea tastes like bananas). I still love this place.

i found this place on a map search, it has no sign when i last went and you don't really notice it. When i walked in i thought it was really cute, nice and CLEAN. There were some nice looking treats and was going to order some until i seen Flies sitting on their food. I told the people that work there that there were flies on their food items and nothing was done, they just kept the food there. They need to invest in those glass covers if they haven't already done so. If i didn't experience this then i would have given it a better rating.

So went to The Windsor and had to try this out afterwards. Ashley got a scoop of the butter pecan and I have to say that it was fantastic. I got the oatmeal cranberry apricot cookie and the spiced molasses cookie. The cookies were lightly crisp around the outside with a soft airy quality on the inside. They were delicious and melted in my mouth. Yummy.

Churn is adorable & the ice-cream/cookie combo is amazing! If you're a fan of peanut butter, then you have to try the PB ice cream. It's the perfect addition to the Central Avenue Corridor and I can't wait to go back.
Delicious homemade ice cream! Great place to stop in after you eat and/or drink next door at Windsor.

Cute ice cream place in Central Phoenix! I like that it has the feel of an old ice cream and candy store. The flavors are good and the service is good as well. I wish there was more seating for people that want to chill and enjoy their ice cream. Good, modern place for Central Phoenix!

We went here after enjoying dinner at Windsor next door. Everyone behind the counter was super friendly and encouraged us to sample a few flavors before deciding on one to order. I had the Caramel Cashew and it was delicious. My wife went for the Cookies and Mint. You can definitely tell the quality and homemade taste of the ice cream. A great follow up to the excellent dinner at Windsor.
This place is so cute. I've had lots of different kinds of ice cream and they are all great. I love the cookie dough/rocky road bar! The texture is perfect.

Love, Love Love this place....Great addition to the area! This is a very uniqiue idea, an Ice cream shop that keeps it simple from the flavor choices to the drinks a, throw back to when ice cream shops were family friendly and sells home made goods and little nik-naks.. and did I mention the prices very reasonable, it would of been five stars but no cookiedough ice cream, might want to consider that with the amount of kids that are visiting :)
Churn is a wonderful ice cream place a very unique traditional neighborhood establishment. Ice cream here is always fresh. Their coconut ice cream is to die for.
They should've named this place Love. It would totally work.

Had the Vanilla sprinkled w/ walnuts and drizzled w/ the home made Carmel.. It was incredible! Have eaten at Windsor many times, this would be a very nice finish to a great meal! Had two scoops as an afternoon dessert may consider getting three next time!
Get yourself some yummy icecream and plunk it down outside on the patio! Really nice space out there. Thumbs up!!

Seriously delicious!! A friend suggested we give Churn a try while on vacation in Phoenix and I'm so glad we did! The ice cream is creamy and full of flavor! The salted chocolate chip cookie is amazing! I had it with a stout ice cream and the flavors did not disappoint!
Great root beer float, but no frozen yogurt as listed in the description. Disappointed.
Best ice cream in town, the Kitchen Sink sundae was phenomenal. The staff is so energetic and have so much pride in their products. Be careful as this place is habit forming! : )

I happened by Churn on accident, and I was so pleased with my discovery. Being a chocoholic, I had to sample Churn's chocolate ice cream, and I was blown away! It tasted so fresh, creamy and heavenly, that I actually had to go back and buy a pint! So, glad there is a local ice cream shop that uses fresh ingredients and makes such wonderfully delicious desserts! I will be back many times, and I will recommend it to all of my friends.

I had the blueberry ice cream and the almond whiskey ice cream which was my favorite. The almost whiskey ice cream was very smooth and creamy. I wish I tried it in a waffle cone. The place is very small but it's cute. The ice cream was amazing and I will be back.

I love churn! The employees are always very friendly, and encourage you to try samples of new flavors. The ice cream is amazing, and the place is always clean. Whenever you're craving ice cream churn is the place to go!

I came to Churn extremely excited and with high expectations because the folks who own Postino's also own Churn. First off, the parking is poor depending on the time of day and day of the week you go, so be prepared. Inside, while tiny, is decorated absolutely amazing! It is just like an old time ice cream parlor with a bit of modern flair, cute as can be. Nostalgic toys and candy from my childhood lined the shelves by the register. Antique-appearing cake stands held other goodies behind the counter. Just lovely and so fun to look around! Then to the not so lovely part........... the ice cream itself. The texture of the ice cream was icy and tasted flavorless and dry. I even sampled several other flavors before making my purchase (which I frankly bought to be polite) all the same problem. I don't think you need to be an ice cream snob to notice that the quality, flavor, texture, etc is simply not good. As I like to say, "A for effort, D for execution".

Best donuts in Vegas. The donuts are balanced with good dough, sweet, and flavor. They are not greasy. The staff is very friendly. We are regulars here, tried everything, and find them all enjoyable. The grilled cheese donut w/ Sriracha is phenomenal! I also love the lemon pistachio and Samoa when available. The menu rotates weekly and a few constants. Get here early, they close when they sell out. Their espresso drinks are great too! Joe, the owner is a great guy. I appreciate his craftsmanship and commitment to downtown Vegas.

On every stage is a moment for you to shine, as you glow pass along that love and passion for someone else to cherish and celebrate. If your ever in old town, down town Las Vegas stop in for a donut and some coffee. What goes better than these two phrases coffee and donuts? Great I'm glad that your paying attention. Now this ordinary shop might seem dilapidated because it's "downtown," but just walk through the door and enjoy the beauty. Now make sure and get here before around noon time because when the donuts are done; so are the staff for the day. Could you contemplating waiting for the perfect donut for another day. Perhaps not, so forget not having that conversation and get here early. As you walk in the store it's usual standing room only. It's the post pandemic now, so their are no longer any mask restrictions or standing six feet apart. No longer are there rules for how many to can in the store at one time too. Make sure not to push and shove, await your turn for that perfect moment when you get to pick your favorite donuts. Tap your foot or look up at the menu, the moments tick down till it's your turn to have donuts. Can you feel the urge building inside of you? It's almost go time, all those in front of you have been taken care of. Being GO time. You clam up and don't know what you want. Let's calm down and pick one of everything please, as you drool over the glass! You will have no trouble picking out what you want. My favorite is the maple bar with "real bacon," on top. The friendly staff will waste no time making sure you are happy with your donuts decisions. It was national donut day, yes we need a day to come together and share circular moments among those in our lives. Mark the calendar for next year or be the life of the party and just bring a dozen in to everyone. Donuts please, yes. The donuts here are far beyond a donut. The creative charm and joy that makes them possible is exceptional. As you stare through the glass such choices; once you try one you will be back for the one that you did not try. Let your inhibitions go. Coffee and donuts all in the same place. Happy is here until they lock the doors. Get here early to enjoy the best selections of the day before they are gone. It's always happy even if you have to wait in line. Explore there menu options on your phone. As the line dwindles down it's getting closer to your turn be ready! Oh you were not ready! Did you just get stumped up because of the bombardment of choices. Deep breaths! Now that your on your way to making the day a little more fun and special. Sip your coffee, eat that spectacular donut and make a donut moment.

Still a great place. This time I took my daughter here. I had the apple fritter and she had a special donut of the day. I noticed they have pop tart "donuts". I didn't get one as I wasn't in the mood for that much extra sugar. Great place always busy but with friendly staff.

My only regret here was not buying more donuts to eat later throughout the day. I had seen a lot of people posting on TikTok and YouTube, and I must say that the hype was real. There was ample street parking on the road fronting the shop. I didn't notice any free stalls, just the pay by phone/kiosk, but finding open stalls was not a problem. There was no line on the Thursday morning when I went, and it looked like every flavor was still in stock at the time. There is only limited seating inside, but there are tables outside in a courtyard behind the shop if you leave through the back door. I tried the creme brulee and birthday cake donuts. The crunch of the sugar on the creme brulee was surprising. There was an audible and crisp snap with each bite. The birthday cake doughnut was also good, but could have used a little more birthday cake flavor. I'm looking forward to going back. Next time, I'll leave with significantly more donuts.

Wow! That is what both my wife and I said when we walked into the Donut Bar! We viewed some of the most interesting donuts and pastries we have ever seen! We wanted to buy one of everything! We found ourselves drooling at these beautiful creations because we had arrived early for brunch next door at Carson's Kitchen and they weren't open yet. Sometimes it pays to be early! The two ladies behind the counter were very nice and helpful with suggestions. We have discovered that the cinnamon rolls are a must at the Donut Bar! The salted caramel donut was very good as was the creme brulee. We are looking forward to coming back to try the Oreo Donut and a delicious-looking creation with fresh strawberries on it!

A little over hyped but indulgent nonetheless. The grilled cheese was sinfully delicious and the other goodies were definitely full of sugar. Everything you'd expect from a donut shop. The kid freebies were a nice Elmo-y touch which I appreciate since the tab can get up there. Enjoyed the visit and worth a stop if your driving by.

Now when I'm in old town this doughnut shoo will be one of my stops.. I had the best Chai lattes and doughnut. I haven't been able to find another Chai latte as good as theirs. I had my first creme Brule doughnut here and it was good, but wish it was a tad bit bigger to get that crunch.

Amazing donuts!!! If you're in Las Vegas you must stop and try this donut shop. The French toast donut and PB& J we're my favorite. The staff was friendly and very helpful. I even got to meet the owners. They were working right along side the staff, saying hello and goodbye to everyone, and making sure everyone was happy and enjoyed the donuts. I will definitely be coming back here.

Always a good experience when I go to Donut Bar. The food is always good. The service is always good. I'm not exactly close by, but I still continue to make the trip to get these original treats. Living in San Diego I always have to go to the downtown location. I would like to buy just one but end up buying a dozen to make the parking palatable. But once I located the one in Las Vegas, it was on! Plenty of close parking!!! My favorite will forever be the strawberry split. But I absolutely love the French toast on weekends. I'm thinking of Donut Bar for breakfast...yum!!!

I liked this place but I think it comes down to what you were raised on. I think Krispy Kreme is trash because I grew up on Shipleys. Shipleys has the best yeast donut to Me. This place the yeast is gigantic and a lil heavier but there glazes are really good hear. They are at a premium price but I will say the donuts are large. Lots of cool flavors to try, I wish the Pop tart one had actual pop tart filling but that's asking a lot. A lovely young lady in line with me suggested the French toast joint so consider it if you come. Nice way to stretch your legs in the morning if your staying on Fremont and wake your crew up with donuts.

The two women who helped me out in the front were very friendly and kind. They went back to grab more information on the vegan donuts and were a delight to talk to. They very generous and kind enough to add a couple of ones on the house. (Which they didn't have to do!!) The staff and I will enjoy these so much!! Thank you guys and much love! P.S THE DONUTS ARE AMAZING!!!
Came here to find gluten free options since it shows as having them on Yelp, but they had none. It would be helpful if they would remove that descriptor from their business.

Warning! If you are a tourist and it's June 2022, you're going to have a tough time navigating in this area. There is a lot of construction that starts at the freeway and continues down into the neighborhood where this place is. It's in the downtown area. I'm sure they have great donuts but we couldn't find a way to get there. Literally, every route our very good routing system told us to take, we ran into another "construction obstruction." If you want to go, I'd call them for directions.

I had the apple fritter and blood orange (which was a special this week). Definitely not the best donuts in the world. Apple fritter was overcooked and it just had a small amount of apple in the middle. The blood orange icong was GREAT but there was so much bland dough to the doughnut it was hard to enjoy. I wanted to try the french toast donut but they only have that on the weekend.
Big Donuts! Lots of sugary flavors not common to most donut shops. I recommend the strawberry and the chocolate glaze. The pop tart donut is loaded!

Pretty disappointed in these donuts. I'm a huge donut person. I went here thinking that it was going to be the same as the location in San Diego, but not even close. These didn't taste fresh or nearly as good. Huge let down would not recommend

Lovely staff, impressive selection, and some of the donuts and a couple others, just meh . Went to Donut Bar after our main course at Bodega Bagel at the LV Test Kitchen. First, let me say, these donuts are beautiful. Their display case was filled when we got there bright and early. We ordered a nice selection to really test them out. By far the strawberry split was a crowd favorite. Great flavor combo and just creamy and tasty with a nice sugar coating. The creme brÃ»lÃ©e was good. I loved the vanilla bean custard filling but the could've done without the hard sugar top coat. Ans finally the sleeper of the group, the pineapple donut! We threw this in last minute and although fairly sweet, it had a really good flavor and good donut base (not my usual donut selection). Would not recommend the vanilla bean. It was pretty bland. There are so many other fun options, I'd say go for the rest. My friend loved the tripe chocolate and the final verdict on the pink one...definitely made for kids (basically melted hard candies on top of an already sweet donut. Excited to come back for another round.

Good yeasted donuts with balanced toppings. We had "Homer" and a "cookies and creme" (Oreo topping with a whole Oreo inside). You do need arrive early as the specialty flavors run out early. We arrived around 11am on a Saturday and most flavors were sold out already. It's a short walk from the Deuce stop in downtown LV.

Second time we've been here and it did not disappoint. Greeted as soon as we walked in, close to our hotel. We were able to walk there for breakfast. My son and I ordered a donut and they are HUGE! As big as your head. We and my boyfriend also ordered a drink and paid only $12. Super cheap and super great! Neither my son or I was able to finish our donut. I had a powdered sugar donut with whipped cream and fresh strawberries inside and my son had a cake batter. I ordered an iced americano, my son a hot chocolate abc my boyfriend an iced vanilla latte. Everything was great and we highly recommend!

A few blocks away from the downtown strip, this donut place had an interesting selection of donuts! I tried the Big papa, the grilled cheese, the crÃ¨me brule, and the Nutella. The big papa was large and sugary, it had a full size pop tart inside! I recommend it for the photo op and experience. I thought the grilled cheese was good as a salty sweet combo! It was 2 warm sugar donuts with cheese in between, its massive and was easily shared between my 2 friends and I. the crÃ¨me brule we got because the employee told us it was a best seller. I thought it was decent but nothing super impressive. It had a hard caramel crunch on top with crÃ¨me on the inside. It is probably personal preference but I would have rather had the Boston crÃ¨me for the chocolate and crÃ¨me experience. Lastly, the Nutella donut did not have a super strong Nutella flavor. Nutella is a tricky flavor to get across without actually using Nutella. The coffee is ok, I would have rather had coffee from a coffee shop. It was nice to have to go with the donuts though. They have a patio area where you can eat in the back and a super fun fish tank inside. The ambiance is more to go than stay and chill. It was a nice quick stop in the morning.

I've written a review of Donut Bar in San Diego. Well, we were visiting Vegas and stumbled across the Donut Bar while driving around and exploring. I had my husband stop immediately and I got out of the car and checked the business hours. We were staying at the Aria and planned to wake up early to ensure I didn't miss out on the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut that I missed out on while in San Diego. The next morning, we drove to Donut Bar and there was no line. Talk about excited!!! Again, the employees were warm, welcoming, and patient. The service was cheerful and the employees were all smiles. On to the donuts. Needless to say, these donuts are great. This time we bought the strawberry split (our fave), the apple crumb (hubby barely tasted it last time cuz I ate it), the salted caramel, and of course the creme brÃ»lÃ©e. The strawberry split is our absolute favorite!!! The donut is light and the filling is light and airy without being overly sweet and the fresh strawberries brings it all together. The apple crumb is more like a light cake that has a hint of apple. The salted caramel is like a glazed donut but the glaze it caramel. This donut was good but I think a little more restraint on the salt would balance it better. It wasn't my favorite but it was good. Now on to the donut that got me up early in the morning, the creme brÃ»lÃ©e! This donut was actually really good but I'm still partial to the strawberry split. At first glance, it looks like a typical filled donut with a hard glaze. I cracked the glaze and opened the donut to expose the creme filling. Creme brÃ»lÃ©e is my favorite dessert and I was pleasantly surprised to find that the custard was spot on. Without a doubt, I will be returning to the Donut Bar!

Not a big donut fan but wow I was impressed! For a small little shop they have such a wide variety of flavors and toppings! The workers were very friendly and even gave us a free cupcake for my bro's bday. If I'm ever in town again I will definitely visit here again!!!
Three words: French Toast Donut. It's not obvious they have this, but I will order this every single time. Secret Gem near Fremont
This is the best donut shop I have ever been to. The donuts are fresh, delicious, and a combination of amazing flavors! I HIGHLY recommend! And the staff is beyond friendly and nice!

Stopped by this place on 4/18/22 and just got a basic donut with vanilla glaze. This donut was huge and anything but basic. They have huge donuts and an amazing selection. They are open until they sell out. So come early and treat yo self.

We got there right as they opened on Saturday as we were expecting freshly made donuts. The employees were friendly and helped us decide on what to get. We went with a Boston cream, blueberry poptart donut, maple bacon cinnamon roll, oreo cake donut, donut grilled cheese, creme Bru Lee, and the Nutella donut. The Boston cream was average nothing special, it was nice and airy and the had a good cream ratio. The blueberry poptart donut was cool but again nothing special. The cinnamon roll was overbaked but the very center was good. The oreo cake donut was good as long as you got a bite full of oreo. The donut grilled cheese was massive and was pretty good I think. It came with a Sriracha dipping sauce. I forgot to snag a pic of it. The creme Bru Lee was very underwhelming it just tasted like a plain donut with filling. The Nutella donut was good but I didn't really taste the Nutella. I gave this place 2 stars because I was expecting so much more due to its rating but for the most part I was disappointed. Maybe I'm just not a donut person.
Yup. THIS is where you find the World's best donuts. Extremely nice employees. Come early in the morning cause some popular donuts sell very quickly.

Let's start with the fact that this place is located in the druggy, addicted to crack section in downtown Las Vegas. Wife and kids stayed in the car while I got out to go make my purchase. I bought their, "famous" crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e donut. Paid $9 for three of them. For that price I thought I would get the best donut I've eaten in my life. What I did get is the cheat you for your money version of a donut. The donut should be called empty oily bread with sugar top BrÃ»lÃ©e . If it wasn't for the fact I had to run away from that area to not get robbed or stabbed on the way to the car I would've returned to give them back the crap I bought. Go to Dunkin' Donuts, you get the same crap for half the price...

Staff was super friendly and amazing. The split strawberry was absolutely delicious and looks beautiful. Got a cappuccino that just topped off the whole experience. If you're in the downtown area I definitely recommend stopping by.
2019 Vegas. Breakfast review. 4 - Big Poppa Tart: S'mores 3 - Creme Brulee 2 - Maple Bacon 2 - Apple Fritter Overall, "A-OK."
This was a spot we randomly found and were quite happy in doing so. My husband is vegan and has now found his most favorite donut, hands down

Donut Bar is one of the best places for breakfast. It has to be breakfast. They're only open until the donuts sell out. Most days they're out of them early. They also have coffee and vegan versions. It doesn't have official hours. It usually opens about 8 in the morning. They're only open until they sell out, which depending on how busy they are can be soon after they open. It's not a big place, and there's usually a line waiting out the door. The best thing you can do is get there soon after they open. I like the apple fritter. It's about $2 each. This is massive. It's crispy and not excessively sweet, and it goes good with coffee. This donut is also vegan. It usually has several vegan options. They also have donuts with Oreos and Twix bars in them. It doesn't have that much room inside. It only has a few seats against the wall where you can use an outlet. There is a courtyard that's shared by Juice Stars.

Let me tell you right now, you won't find a better donut in life that here at the Donut Bar. So many donuts to chose from and some very special options. My favorite crazy donut I've tried so far is the grilled cheese one. It's absolutely perfect. Get in early to avoid a line! I'll be back over and over again.

ABSOLUTELY AMAZING!!!! We started our morning with a walk to check out the area and found bliss. Neither my wife or I are big donut fans but The Donut Bar changed our minds. Beyond delicious and so light/fluffy despite the massive size of the Homer and Chocolate Euphoria. The perfect way to start your morning when exploring the city!!
If you want to find any type of donut, this is the place but you have to go early because they often sell out quickly. I have never been disappointed by the donuts and the cappuccino was great too.

I love this place! Every time I go in the workers are extremely welcoming and have great personalities. Shoutout to Anaya! I love that they always have different donuts to try out and they're all big! I can never finish one by myself. The coffees are good too, I usually get the iced chai latte with vanilla when I go. I tried the grilled cheese donut this most recent time I went and it comes with a side of siracha mayo and hot sauce, it was really good! I had a chance to meet Chef Jeff while I was there this weekend and he was really cool. I can't wait to go back.

A-MAZING!!! Best to drive and park in back, or Uber, walk from Fremont street was fine but a little ways, however, it's a must!!!! All the donuts we got were delicious. We cut them all up and shared and that was worth it to try all of them. Paired with a nitro brew.....WOW, we were in heaven. Staff is beyond nice, helpful and offered perfect suggestions. Get here early, we came at 1030ish and selection was getting small, but plenty for us. When your done head down the street to the container park!!!!!

Wanted to grab the kids some donuts before they woke up and this place was a short walk from my hotel. I was expecting a line around the corner, like the one in SD every weekend, but lucky me i was 3rd in line. All of the creations looked soo good and it was hard choosing but my ultimate favorite was the creme brulee donut!. Once you crack thru that candy shell, that yummy custard oozes out and it's heaven! I also got an americano to go. I was in and out in less than 10 minutes, which is not typical. A must try!

I feel like donut shops are the new cupcake shops. Every major city has a few competing shops trying to prove they're the best. And they're usually just alright. Nothing revolutionary or special to write home about. But they're hip and trendy and relatively easy to make and they're fucking everywhere. This place was fine. A bit over hyped if I'm being honest. The thing that put them on the map is their pop-tart stuffed donut. It looked gimmicky and I really had no interest in it. The next most popular item is their crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e donut. I did order one of these and did not like it. In theory sure adding a torched sugar top on a donut sounds good but in practicality if the sugar layer is too thick you wind up with something that is not easy to chew. I gave it chance tho! I really tried taking a bite out of it but quickly gave up on that idea and just took off the sugar top, it came off in two chunks. The creamy filling and the donut outside of the crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e aspect were really good and quite enjoyable! Red velvet was good but on the drier side. Boston cream was good, no complaints here. Strawberry cheesecake was my favorite! Idk why it didn't get more hype. Had a strawberry jam center, and topped with some kind of cream//icing and Graham crackers enough to really resemble a cheesecake. I was pleasantly surprised. It was within walking distance of my hotel and I'd go back just for the strawberry cheesecake donut if they had it again! The people working were super nice and patient as I made my way through the display case trying to pick out some donuts. Stating they're the world's best donuts is a pretty steep claim. But world's okay-est donuts doesn't have quite the same ring to it.
Part of me weekend. Love going and seeing what creation is there. Donuts are huge and tasty

It was my first time trying Donut Bar. I received A1 service from Alexia and Jasmine. There were so many options to choose from. Alexia was very sweet and patient with me as I took my time to look at all the donuts. She took her time to explain all the flavors and fillings. She recommended all the popular ones. Jasmine was very friendly and joyful to talk to as she rang me up. My favorites were the cake donuts. They were moist and not too sweet. The yeast donuts were too dense and dry. I will definitely return for the cake donuts and friendly service!

Apple fritters as big as my husbands head for only $3 and they are vegan!!!!!!!!!! Bottled water was $3 which whatever be C side these donuts are legitimately as advertised: the best donuts in the world. Cute outdoor seating area too bc no dining inside. They only stay open until they sell out so get there early. My tip is to get one of everything and tell yourself these carbs don't count. Walking distance to Circa and the rest of Fremont St experience.

I been coming here since it opened, whenever I'm downtown for anything I always stop by for the coffee and or donuts. You can have a traditional donut or go crazy and have on of their bomb ass fashionable ones. They serve Stumptown coffee which is pretty good, prices a reasonable for what you get considering the freshness and quality of donuts. I come for the chocolate bars with Bavarian creme filling...YUM! Do yourself a favor and take one to go, it's good cold from the fridge. There is a restroom which they let customers use, not a lot of donut joints have one down here. There is plenty of parking in front, I never feed the meter cause I don't wait long for my food, or check the parking lot across the street. The only negative is the hours suck in the morning, especially on weekends. It's all good tho, I just start my day early. Definitely worth the visit if your getting married or going to court. Ha!
Huge donuts but not the most flavorful. They had lots of options and we went for the apple fritter, pumpkin cream cheese and Nutella. Donuts were a bit dry. The staff was very friendly.
Really good donuts ! But don't let your eyes be bigger than your stomach their donuts are huge !! Super soft & great customer service

DONUT BAR US A MUST. Great atmosphere, awesome back patio, and the donut choices.. I mean dang you have to go back a few times because deciding between just a few is TUFF. Please take family and friends here, and make sure you get there earlier rather than later. They close when they are out of donuts for the day.

Finally made it out to the Donut Bar on my last Fremont stay. We ordered online the day before and went in for pick-up. I may have gone a bit overboard considering I was ordering for two - we left there about $60 later and with three full boxes of donuts. Oops! I had no way to compare what I ordered with what I received but it was definitely not quite right, we received two donuts I would have NEVER ordered. Not sure if they ran out of something else and gave us substitutions or gave us two extra but I wasn't going to waste any of my Vegas time trying to figure it out. Donuts weren't mind-blowing but they were good. My favorite was actually the Boston Cream, and I don't even like filled donuts! Yum. It was a little pricey for a donut but not out of line for a bakery setting; if you count it as 'breakfast', it's quite cheap by Vegas standards (if you order a donut or two per person, don't do what I did!) so it's all in your perspective. There is a good variety but it rotates so a couple of the ones I really wanted to try were unavailable the day we went which was disappointing. Overall, not sure I'd make a special trip out there if we weren't already staying downtown but a nice change of pace from the usual mediocre Fremont casino breakfasts and a good casual option for the area.

So glad they have a Donut Bar in Vegas! Some of the best donuts that I've had, no lie. Some of my faves are the lemon blueberry, apple fritter and open face strawberry. They were sold out of a lot of the popular donuts by noon but still a good selection left. The staff are all really friendly and helpful. I called in before going and they said they close when they sell out. So go early.

Like so many Nevada businesses, this place is glowing with its public image. You might try to find somebody who can explain just why some of us choose to be different. The old-fashioned answer is that you'll stand out from the others, and maybe attract customers who honestly need something that isn't for sale in all those other places. I love the courtyard area out back. I love the donut fish tank. I wish I had the time and money - - I'd stop by this place more often.

Above average, will return, will recommend. Snickers donut had delicious bites of snickers on top of the chocolate icing but the chocolate cake donut itself was lacking something... maybe I expected more chocolate. Anyhow I seem harsh but it was delicious and I would pick these donuts over those chains but I'm waiting to try an incredibly amazing donut that makes me want to return the very next day for more. Maybe it will be the poptart donut. anyhow i will be back in search of a favorite. give this place a try and tell me your favorite.

Got some donuts for the family on the way home. By the time I got home 4 hours they were kind of dry and hard. They look amazing and huge but they aren't flavorful. My brother said they like all taste the same. The small ones have a different taste a bit. I did get one of each basically to try them out. They definitely are Instagram worthy donuts lol.

I can totally see why they are award winning! At 10 AM, a LOT of flavors were almost sold out or completely sold out. Get there much, much earlier if you would like to have your choice of donut flavor. My boyfriend and I ordered 1 crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e donut to share, however the owner (?) insisted that we get 2. In hindsight, it was a good idea because I definitely would not have wanted to share. The sugar layer on top was very crunchy, and satisfying to bite into. The inside filling was surprisingly not too sweet and complemented the fresh, soft dough. We also ordered an iced coffee, not pictured, that was very smooth and not sour. If I ever come back, I will definitely be stopping in. It is well worth the visit.

Donut believe the hype. We sampled 5 donuts including the Creme Brule and a special Cinco de mayo margarita donut and the only standout was the margarita donut the rest were tired and lacking in flavor. I should never trust youtube or instagram jagoffs

Not sure what all the hype is (or why Mikey Chen recommended this place), we came here at 11am and bought 4 donuts, one of which was the highly hyped crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e. They all tasted very dry and stale. Not worth paying $3 a piece. Maybe it was an off day? Whatever it was, we won't be coming back nor recommend this to anyone.
I honestly prefer old fashioned dive type donuts, don't get me wrong this place gets points for creativity but they need to add a little more sugar for the taste to be more on point in my opinion.
French Toast donut was AMAZING! Staff is always pleasant and welcoming! Love the variety!

All street parking around the Vegas location is paid street parking. In San Diego you can get around that if you time your visit right. Both locations expect a line. I came just to see what the differences would be since I am based out of San Diego. I walked over at 7:45 am and there was already a line 20 people deep waiting for the shop to open at 8 am. The line moves pretty quick. Once you step inside they have a menu with the day's flavors. Have a look at then make your order. The sizes of donuts varies and so does the price. They have a line of coffee dispensers to pour yourself. Some march but I like how they have a Vegas tanked style fish aquarium with donuts inside. That's kinda humorous. I've had Donut bar in San Diego and in Vegas and also donuts throughout my travels. I can't agree with their self proclaimed best donuts in the world because there's a few other donut shops that were better than what I have had here in terms of texture, taste, flavor and leaving me with a wow experience. I left here with just a meh it's ok. Mel M Yelp 19:78
