If you like donuts that not only look good, but taste even better, get over to Donut Bar. Many times I come across donuts that look cool, but don't taste good. The donuts here are the exception. Made fresh daily, with a variety of flavors, Donut Bar is a local favorite (and I can taste why). Be sure to get here early since they sell out quickly. The staff here is super friendly which is always a plus. The prices? Great for the types of donuts they sell.

High marks for the Donut Bar. Cool little donut shop away from the Fremont Street nonsense. Besides the wide variety of donuts, there are plenty of coffee options, a water station, and an outdoor seating area. Shop was clean, staff was friendly, and we got an incredible deal on a box of donuts as it was near closing time. Really enjoyed the smallish creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut. Pop tart donut was gimmicky, but had to try anyway. Fun place.

Quaint little donut shop starring astonishingly flavorful donuts, paired with a small variety of hot and iced coffees. French Toast donut comes with berry jelly, butter and what I thought to be real maple syrup! If it wasn't 100% maple, it sure was great quality! I don't know if it was the customer service or the high-quality ingredients that was the most impressionable! Those who love coffee will understand this next statement....It was a bad coffee weekend until I tried the Portland Roast at The Donut Bar! Starbucks couldn't even hold their own this weekend. Thank you to The Donut Bar for the exquisite flavors, genuine helpfulness and friendly experience. My favorite bar thus far!

Donut Bar is local favorite and sells out nearly every day. RESTAURANT: The restaurant is small because it is used mostly for to-go orders. However, there are some chairs to dine-in. The restaurant is always clean and the vibe is very fresh. SERVICE: The servers are extremely friendly, efficient, and quick. I always walk out feeling better than when I walked in. FOOD: There are traditional donuts, but also eye-catching donuts, which come in unique flavors and huge sizes. If you go during happy hour, which typically around noon, you can buy a dozen donuts for $10. I think it is one of the best donuts in town. However, I feel the donuts are a little too dry and dense. I also find the frosting to be a little hard. ALL STAR DEAL: Happy hour.

Love! Love! Love it!!!!! DOOOONNNUUUTTSS. What am fun place to visit. It's not super big plane but the variety of specially donuts will leave you dizzy. So a selection of you get there early. We arrived at 930 and this place was more than 65% sold or. So don't think they pulling your leg about how fast they sell or... Wake up early!!! Going back today to try to get other donuts that we're sold out. The doctors were decorated to well, they had a fun atmosphere in the store and the customer service was so warm. In the light of everything that is going on most businesses their customer services have failed at this place makes you feel like you're welcomed and they treat you as so they really appreciate your business what a wonderful experience.

Phenomenal. Came in early on a Sunday morning and was lucky enough to snag a French toast donut with the butter, jam and syrup sides. Got a birthday cake donut stuffed with an Oreo, the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut, the strawberries and cream donut, and a s'mores pop tart donut. The strawberries and cream donut was hands down my favorite, light, fresh and absolutely incredible- 10/10. They were all awesome- my only gripe was I wish the birthday cake donut had actual birthday cake filling in it besides and Oreo, that was the whole reason I got it lol. Nonetheless, love the vibe here and all of the amazing creations! Wish I would have gotten more than 5 but could not physically fit more in my stomach lol. Will be back!!! Atmosphere: 10/10 Value: 9/10 Flavors: 10/10 Service: 10/10

Donut Bar is your typical hip donut spot located in Downtown Las Vegas. They have mainly fancy donuts, not the og stuff. Street parking. Open until they sell out. Inside has limited seating. Prices are decent for the style of donuts they have. Came in at 11:30 am on a Saturday and they had happy hour, fill a box with anything for $10. Literally 10 donuts for 10 bucks. Normally 10 donuts here would be close to $40-50. Won't review each donut, All the donuts I got tasted like how they should. The dough was good and chewy. Sweet but nothing to bad where it hurts the teeth. Big Poppa Tart - $5 - Huge jelly filled donut shaped like a pop tart. Salted Caramel - $3 - Huge! Vanilla - $3 - Huge! Birthday Cake - $2 - Sprinkles! Boston Cream - $3 Peanut Butter & Jelly - $3 - My favorite! Creme Brulee - $3 Raspberry Cheesecake - $2 Nutella Overload - $4 Cinnamon Roll - $4 Sugar high!!!

This place has the best selection of donuts for the donut aficionado. Alexia's personality is the perfect mix of sweetness and all around good karma to make this place a regular spot for that perfect donut you need in your life!
Super delicious donuts, friendly service. It's almost like a meal and I was full after just one donut.

My girlfriend and I have been eyeing this place for a while and finally went down to Fremont street to get some breakfast. These donuts look absolutely amazing! I prefer my donuts denser since it feels much more filling when I eat them so seeing these amazing donuts was a site for sore eyes! I ordered the old fashioned because I really enjoy the taste of those types of donuts. The vanilla bean icing is subtle, but I enjoyed how simply sweet it is. The poppa tart was really great though with the amazing, airy dough, sweet vanilla glaze, and deep chocolate mousse filling. Don't eat this alone because it is hefty and takes a lot of stomach and sweet tolerance to get through it all! I can't wait to go back for a small breakfast or snack to try that apple fritter!

Good donuts! My favorite was Butterfinger. I think they're more known for their yeast donuts, so definitely check those out! We got cake batter, which was tasty. Parking across the street was $3.00 for an hour. We did 15 mins for $0.75. We went at 10 AM on a Sunday (MLK weekend) and they were already sold out of French toast donut
Donut selection was awesome- something for everyone! Seating section/bar inside. Donuts not too sweet - perfect!

I came here for one thing and one thing only: the big poppa tart! They had a strawberry one (I think) and a smores one, so I went the smores route. It was a good donut! Soft dough with a chocolate and graham cracker filling. I appreciated that it wasnt too sweet despite all the things on it and how big it was! I'm not sure if it's a 5 star donut shop since, while the big poppa tart is unique, the flavors and quality is about the same as other donut shops I've been to (not a bad thing!), so I guess I'll have to come back and try more donuts and see how those are!

Wow is this place so good! They've got so many different flavors and it's just so exciting walking in seeing everything! We ordered the Cake Batter donut, the Boston Cream, a red velvet donut and a Chocolate Euphoria. This place is right off of Fremont down the way so the area is not too loud and the costumer service was pretty good. They told us all about the donuts and had patience with us while we decided. Will definitely be back!

Deliciousness! Friendly staff, great selection, a little pricey, but it's well deserved. We got the strawberry split, creme brÃ»lÃ©e and maple bacon bar. All good, but the strawberry one, with whipped cream fluffiness and light textured dough won us over. Next time I'd like to try the lemon blueberry. You can park right in front, grab and go.

Was in town for work and overly excited to visit Donut Bar. Set the alarm to be there when they opened and drove pretty far for a donut. I got the Big Poppa (mostly because I'm obsessed with Pop Tarts). Imagine my surprise when I bit into it and it was REALLY dry. It tasted like a mouthful of bread. The worst part? It didn't taste fresh. You know what a fresh donut tastes like, and this wasn't it! This place gets such amazing reviews so I have to believe this was just an off day. But I was so disappointed that I threw mine out and stopped at McDonalds for a sausage biscuit...

Doughnuts to me are one of the Single Best items for one to indulge on and enjoy, Fried Perfection that is either Glazed, filled with Cream or even a Tart Fruit Jelly or topped with Sprinkles and nuts or bits of Chocolate. You might feel guilty by indulging on the Fried Goodness but live in Moment and be taken back to this Childhood Delight, when I was planning coming to Fremont Street for the very first time coming here for Breakfast was a must. After getting off the Deuce Bus, looking through some of the Stores, playing in one of the Casinos and walking down all the side streets and looking at all the Unique Graffiti Arts. I found my way here located in a little Suite sized vicinity and as if the Sign wasn't enough of a Dead giveaway I'd say the Pink Donut on the Wall was one too. It was pretty late when it came to my Breakfast as it was nearing Quarter to 11 when I stopped in here. Seeing the menu outside they have 28 different varieties ranging from 2-5 bucks each from exciting things like Mexican Hot Chocolate, Triple Chocolate Threat, Oh My Birthday Cake Oreo and Chocolate Bacon (you can have Bacon for Breakfast in a different format). To even the simplest of flavors such as Red Velvet, Boston Cream, CrÃ¨me Brulee and Pumpkin Pie, walking through the small cafÃ© and seeing row upon row of Donuts made it even harder for me to pick. I only limited myself to 2 Donuts but which 2 was the Question, although not a big fan of Boston Cream I thought it had the best presentation (with the Frosted Ghost in the Center). My choices were the Lemon Cheesecake and Nutella Overload, both placed in a Cardboard Box for me to take, then I sat down to enjoy. I started with the Lemon Cheesecake which had a light dusting a Graham Cracker crumbs (more powder like) with Vanilla Icing coating the top, as I broke into the Donut to find a light amount of Lemony filling packed with a Profound citrus flavor enough for me to enjoy and not give a lip puckering Punch. The Nutella Overload was an extremely Decadent Experience, question is how many of us have taken a jar of the Chocolate-y Hazelnutty Spread and eat it right out of the Jar. We've all probably done it, but have you ever had it inside a Donut ?. I got past the Powdered Sugar as I yanked it open to find it almost completely filled to the brim and it oozing out all over (hence the Name). I felt like half the jar was put into this thing, I felt like Elvis Presley after he had his Peanut Butter and Banana Sandwich. Also interesting that they had a donut named after one of the most iconic Cartoon Characters of all time (Homer Simpson), its also awkward to run into him in the Bathroom with a literal speaking as there were lifelike drawings of him all over the Walls (that would be the last place I would ever run into somebody). Their signature shirt (Donut kill my vibe) really got me as I do love Puns, I wanted to get one but they didn't have any 2 or 3X's. But I thanked them and was on my way to try and work it off, their Doughnuts are equivalent to Paula's Donuts in Buffalo. Rich, Fluffy and Enjoyable, like Michael Jackson said - Donut Stop til you get Enough !!!

Get here early if you want anything from them. Came here as part of an anniversary celebration a few hours before they closed and they'd sold out of everything already. Didn't realize it was a "call-ahead" or "get it while you can" type place so just letting the rest of you know that don't expect to show up any time during business hours with a selection of donuts to choose from.

OH MY GAHHHH!!!! I've been wanting to go to Donut Bar for years, and I FINALLY got a chance to go! Creme brÃ»lÃ©e donuts are life!!! I'm so glad the franchise is expanding. There are three more coming to California in 2019 and one opened up in Pasadena (Hallelujah!!!). The creme brÃ»lÃ©e donuts are worth setting your alarm for because they sell out really fast as soon as the shop opens. I was lucky enough to try one and immediately regretted not getting at least three like people in line suggested that I do. I wanted to get a box of a dozen to sample, but honestly, I think three creme brÃ»lÃ©e donuts per person seems like a reasonable serving size portion. The big poppa (strawberry flavor) was out of this world delicious! The strawberry filling inside was perfect and the drizzle on top tasted like heaven.. I'm having major taste bud withdrawals right now writing this review.. I can't wait to go back for more! :)

A perfect place to stop in for an indulgent breakfast before we depart Las Vegas. We arrived at 9:30 on Sunday and they had plenty of selection. I am always fearful they will have sold out of the good stuff but we had lots of choice. And no line-ups when we were there. I ordered the French Toast Donut which is served warm and comes with small sides of whipped butter, jam (possibly raspberry?), and syrup. It was lovely and served me as a full breakfast meal. It had that lovely brioche taste that I enjoy in their donuts. My husband had the Brad's Fritter which is a bacon and apple fritter. Again, a full breakfast serving with no skimping on the salty, crunchy bacon chunks on top. Got a latte and Americano to go and we left to walk it off.
Great donuts and cute atmosphere. Frequently service and such a selection. Go check it out.

I visited Donut Bar on a whim because I was nearby at the court house and it was National Donut Day. I was planning on getting a dozen for my co-workers, but they had no deals on buying in bulk - at least none that were offered to me. The girl behind the counter said they are all individually priced no matter how many you buy, which is kind of ridiculous considering the most BASIC donuts are $2. I ended up getting half dozen instead and just cut each one in half. Luckily, my office isn't that big. They looked beautiful, but not anywhere close to the best donut I've ever tasted. I'd say 3/6 had the same flavour with different food colouring/decorations. $18 for mediocre donuts....I'll stick with Glaze Donut from now on.

Worth the hype worth the drive worth the wait... strawberry pop tart donut was as big as my hand definitely shareable. It's filled with strawberry and has the topping of a pop tart on top if your a fan of strawberry and donut plus pop tarts this was a great marriage. If you want a less massive donut and love apple or apple pie the apple crumb is the way to go the cake donut apple flavor again was great and my son even saved half for next day (still good) I also had a iced chai latte with almond milk and dash of cinnamon (didn't make the picture) perfect amount of chai to milk sometimes the spice from the chai can be over powering but this was great ( only regret was not getting a larger size) Customer service y'all know I love a good customer service.. they were friendly (the man plus women) sorry might even be the owner. But friendly, patient and did not rush me as I slowly looked. I was sad because the (FRENCH TOAST DONUT) served isn't during the week but if you go Saturday you can get it. Transportation I came from the strip and rode the deuce bus all the way to Fremont experience and just walked no more then 2 blocks they have a little back seating area then we walked back to Fremont st and saw the sights. When I'm back in Vegas this will be my stop!

If you ever need a reason to visit downtown Las Vegas, look no further. Previously, I tried the lemon pistachio, apple-fritter, and maple donut. I was looking forward to getting the lemon pistachio but was disappointed to learn that they change the menu weekly. Today, I decided to try the Boston creme, creme brulee, Nutella overload, strawberry split, and caramel latte. I also got an old-fashioned donut which is a cake donut with sprinkles. What I love about these donuts is that it doesn't leave an oily taste on your lips afterward. They are so soft and fluffy on the inside and full of flavor. The cream in the Boston cream and creme brulee was not overly sweet and had just the right amount inside. I don't care for cake donuts because they are usually dense and heavy; I just wanted to try this one, and it was no different. The donuts are a little on the pricey side ranging from $1.00 with the most expensive being $5.00. There is construction going on in downtown Las Vegas. If you are coming from Las Vegas Blvd to Carson street, it's closed, so you have to go around the corner and come down on the road. There are about four street parking spaces located directly in front of the store.

This is the ultimate hipster donut shop! The donuts, the vibe, the location, it's as rad as can be! Their creme brulee donut is off the hook amazing. Think Boston Creme meets crunchy toffee-like caramel glaze. It's so unique and something to be craved. Every time I go in there are seasonal special features. For instance, we happened to be in around Halloween this time and there were themed spooky donuts. They also have unicorn donuts and other festive special creations. The decor is really modern and minimal. It's as fresh as the donuts themselves. Also worth nothing is the coffee! Not sure what they are using as far as blends go but the simple drip alone was divine. This is my favorite donut shop, hands down! Can't wait to return around the holiday season and check out the season's designs!
Love this establishment. The donuts are delicious and always fresh. The product is worth the price!

Pure review: Donuts 4/4, Ambience 3/4, Social distance score 1/4, Price 2/4. So to recap everything. The place is trendy and all of the staff have a typical Socal vibe. Not to be confused with a dirty Seattle "CHOP" zone vibe. The prices are up there but the donuts are huge! I mean like unnecessarily big. Who would buy a dozen of these and bring back to a office and sabotage someone's Keto? I would but that's me. So if you like big donuts and don't mind waiting in long a line, just to see the person in front of you choose the last donut you wanted. Then you hold up the line because you didn't have a second choice, while the lady behind the counter just stares at you. So you pick one in a hurry and it has a calorie count 10x the one you wanted in the first place. And you gotta eat it in the car because if you take it back to the office, your coworkers are gonna see you in a different light. Then try it out! Enjoy!
Great selection and very nice service. Loved the cute patio out back to sip my coffee and spread a little powdered sugar around.

*pre covid review* On an early morning after a flight to Vegas for a friends wedding, we discovered this donut place and decided we wanted to give it a try. We had seen reviews about how you have to show up early because they run out of donuts the further into the day they get. We headed over and were pleasantly surprised to find that there were only a handful of people in line already. When we got up to place our order we got a couple of donuts including the Creme brulee donut, Iced coffee a hot coffee. I thought the donuts were pretty good although I was torn with the crunchy sugar coating on top of the creme brulee donut. I guess that is subjective though. The coffee was very good but if we ever came back I would ask for it to be less sweet. Overall worth giving it a shot for sure!

11 months I've been on a very good diet and I've been eating junkie as of this month if I start my diet seriously again, I better come to this place before I start LOL My friend Kristopher brought me to this place he warned me that this was not just a donut place. Once upon a Time before I was serious on a diet. I tried every donut place in town. I can compare other donut places and other cities. None can compare to this! This place is off the hook!! This is like a little Hangout you can get your awesome coffee, make it anyway you want and chill with your buddies or on the go. I was looking on the wall display of literatures that this place has a lot of recognition. It's been in couple magazines and I could see why. Just a heads up where I'm trying to explain. These are not just ordinary donuts. They're probably pricey. But rest assure it's worth buying. The Mastermind of this company has design a style and crafted with passion into these donuts. Seriously I'm not kidding I wouldn't be writing this. And my buddy Kristopher was not kidding when he was trying to tell me about this place. I had to see for myself. The ladies that was working behind the counter is pretty awesome too, They know how to move a long line fast with rhythm, they have good personality and the company's lucky to have them. And even if I did start my serious diet again. I may not be able to eat these, but I have friends that does : ) I'm pretty positive I'll be buying here for my friends and family. If you love donuts or have company with you. This is the place to take them if you want to explore or have fun or to hang out. There it is! Maybe I don't have to eat sweets. Just because this place is awesome I can buy my tea here and have my buddies eat these delicious gourmet donuts! Anyway I got to get one more donut : )
Visited here on October 17th, amazing donuts! They are huge and are perfect for sharing. I had an iced latte that was simple but strong. :)

Donut bar is one of the top donut places in Vegas. They have a wide selection of donuts and sell out quickly. On Sundays, they offer a grilled cheese donut that again sells out within hours (will definitely get this next time). I have only been here once but was very impressed. My husband and I flew in early on a Sunday to try some of the best voted donuts in Las Vegas. I got the crÃ¨me brule which is a fan favorite and the Homer donut. Although I didn't care for the crÃ¨me brulee donut, it was very light, the filling was creamy, and crunchy topping mimicked the same crunch in a real crÃ¨me brule. I LOVED the Homer donut, it was light and fluffy and the frosting was out of this world (can't tell if the frosting is strawberry or cherry but is really good! My husband got the pop tart donut and he said it was really good. This is a Vegas must visit!

I love donut bar! They're so friendly and I stop in every time I come by Vegas. My favorite is the creme brulee donut! The pop tart donut is definitely extremely sweet (what do you expect for a donut stuffed with a pop tart), but it's a nice donut to share!

Wow. So glad I had the opportunity to check this place out in between moving hotels from old Vegas to new, mid-trip. My husband and I popped in here for a "light" breakfast knowing we had plans to hit up a buffet later in the day but I severely underestimated how amazing the sweet carb-laden goodness oozing out of this establishment would be. The variety of donuts served up here was fantastic; it was hard to choose just a couple (which was great because we ended up with a few complimentary options as well). Being from the northeast, my absolute favorite was the Maple Bourbon donut. It was so large and fluffy and had the perfect amount of glaze. My husband enjoyed his Red Velvet and we enjoyed some bites of a blue-frosted donut with Halloween-inspired sprinkles as well as another gigantic concoction with chocolate filling. Not a coffee drinker myself but I'm told the coffee is delicious. Street parking out front made for an easy in-and-out. Our leftovers were a nice treat after a late-night concert (as we were assured their quality would be good for up to 24 hours). The staff were incredibly nice and helpful in our decision-making and took their time reviewing all of our options. A must-stop in Las Vegas. Safe to say one of the best donuts I've had in my life.

Yep.....these donuts are definitely mainly for Instagram. Grabbed a dozen different donuts for the fam (pre-ordered online) and despite the interesting-sounding flavors none of them really stood out. Donuts were really dry and bready (I picked up the donuts at 9 am). Some of them were surprisingly bland. The only redeeming quality is the staff; super friendly people.

Sugar bomb a Rama. I actually think they have gone to larger donuts and more frosting than their San Diego original, but hey, Vegas baby. My favorite remains the Oreo birthday cake, but most anything is good -- except the fritters. Those are the only thing on the menu that goes the other way, under glazed relative to their dough mass. Definitely worth the walk when you're near downtown.

Donut Kill My Vibe!! This is a cute, small and fun donut bar! It's been in my bookmarked list for the next time I came to Vegas, and I finally got to try them. When you walk in the aroma of fresh donuts hits you in the face. It's also super cute and colorful. I love that you could see all the donuts on display as well as the colors of the place. It's very warm and welcoming. The staff is also extremely nice and patient. I say patient because I was so eager to get inside and take pictures and create a video. Haha. However as far as taste, their donuts are pretty average. They have tons of donuts to choose from but we ended up getting the Big Poppa Tart Donut, Strawberry Filled Donut, and they gave us a free candy cane donut because we had our 14 month old daughter with us. How cool is that?! Very nice and thoughtful. I have never had a donut place offer a free kids donut. However, I will say their donuts are a little more on the expensive side, but most are bigger than your average donut so it balances out. The Big Poppa Tart was definitely big and enough to share. I got the Strawberry one. It's made to look like an oversized Pop-tart. The cool thing is, there is an entire pop tart on the inside of the Big Poppa Tart. The donut itself was very good and tender. It also tasted amazing with the strawberry jam on top. Now I will be honest and say I didn't care much for the Pop-tart on the inside. It was chewy and a little stale tasting as far as texture. It didn't taste like a regular Pop-Tart. I guess something changes as the donut is heated and fried. Overall, the Big Poppa Tart is pretty and the edges taste really good. My husband ate my entire half of my Big Poppa and he never said a thing about the Pop-Tart so I guess it didn't bother him. He just said he couldn't taste it. *Shrugs* I guess it's more of a personal preference. The Strawberry Filled tasted pretty good. I didn't get to taste it because my husband killed it but overall it was good he said. He said it honestly didn't taste like anything special or different than any other Strawberry Filled Donut he has had. I will say this is one of their smaller donuts. If you order a circular shaped donut then these are the bigger ones. I also didn't taste my daughter's donut but my husband did. He said it tasted like a regular donut. I guess she liked it because she ate it all. It was just a donut in the shape of a candy cane with white and red glaze on top. Overall, Donut Bar was cute and fun! As far as taste, I don't think they were anything special. They were pretty average. I will say their creativity of their donuts and some of the flavors is unique but other than that they taste just like any other donut shop.
A must everytime I visit Vegas. Great service and donuts. We always end up buying extra to bring back home.

These donuts are like crack! We loved the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut. It's the best by far. It wasn't to sweet. The birthday cake donut was TO SWEET. The stuffed big papa- was tasty, but big enough to feed a family of 4. The strawberry and cream tasty like a strawberry ice cream bar.
This place was fun and absolutely delicious. Quick walk from any of the downtown hotels. Staff was friendly and helpful. I have already recommended this place others!

Donut bar is a neat little find. Located in Old Vegas, near Fremont, this place is gem and on my visit I learned that they have limited stock. While I was there, we got a chocolate bar and a red velvet cream cheese velvet skull. The skull was part of a holiday treat for Dia de Los Muertos. I'm not usually a red velvet fan, but this donut was something I had to try. The design was really cute, the flavor was good and the texture was super moist. I can only imagine what the other flavors taste like. Either way,I was stuffed. Pro tip: If you want a particular donut, I suggest you get there early.

I'm not a huge donut fan, but Donut Bar's funky treats are hard to turn down- their DTLV location and available-til-sold-out hours make an actual visit fairly rare for me, but I've come across their donuts at various events and on appreciation tables at work pretty regularly. I've enjoyed the Salted Caramel, Mexican Hot Chocolate, Blood Orange and Creme Brulee donuts, while the Big Poppa Tart makes a good one to share, huge and stuffed with an actual Pop Tart and likely several days worth of sugar. I tried the Matcha on a recent visit and it was okay, small and not too sweet, but the Strawberry Split has my heart- fresh fruit, whipped cream, photogenic and shareable! Eventually I need to go back for the Caramel Latte donut and their Grilled Cheese. TIP: Go early and check their online menu to be sure they have what you want, selection varies daily.

First time there. I made a pick up order through yelp and they notified me when it was ready. I walked over and their business was very comfortable. All the guidelines were being followed to a T. Absolutely lovely little place. I ordered off the vegan menu and I will say I was not disappointed. I would definitely return. Wonderful service, safe and sanitary environment. The donuts were dope!!

Woah!.. have seen this place on YT vids and finally was able to stop by.. I'm so numbed that I didn't earlier as I had the BEST donuts ever! I won't miss this place ever again and will come by every time I'm in Vegas

6 STARS. Maybe more. We walked in to a HUGE variety of donuts. In true foodie fashion, we had to get a ton of them to try. All of them were delicious. My socks were knocked off with the French Toast Donut, the Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e Donut, and the GRILLED CHEESE DONUT. You read that right. A donut with cheese and then grilled to perfection. It was such a wonderful shock to my taste buds. The salty sweetness was perfect! It may look and sound unusual but MAN, is it an experience. All in all - you can't go wrong with anything you choose. I hope you take a chance and try them out. Keeps eating local + supporting small!
The owner is the nicest person I've met . The donuts are delicious thanks for great experience.

This place was so pretty and the staff was so nice and patient . I ordered the red velvet , the vanilla bean , and the Simpsons donut . The all were pretty good except the Simpson , the icing was nasty , but I couldn't finish cuz it was so big . I do recommend but don't get 3 like I did lol . And the prices are reasonable as well .
This is the third location we have visited and it was excellent as always. We got there a bit late in the morning and the selection was a bit kicked over, but the quality was still there.

Happy Birthday Donut Bar- 3 years old today!!!!! Such an accomplishment, and continuing to rock and sell out all the time. They have made the top 10 donut establishments across the country. When we arrived there was a line of patrons waiting and wanting to try these amazing delectable delights. There are so many to choose from. From Unicorn to Peanut butter and Jelly. Each is made fresh and they are differently priced. Upon entering off of 6th and Carson entrance, you walk up and are quickly greeted by wonderful counter people. They have so many options and are willing to take their time with you. They have espresso and coffee options as well. There is a small counter you can sit at, however seating is very limited. I obviously got several to say the least. The owner is very personable as I got the chance to meet him today. Pricing is a reflection of quality and presentation. Would def recommend. Once everything sells out, they close- come early Location is 6th/ Carson - parking is street or lots
Service was excellent! Donuts, aesthetically pretty made for a great photo opp, however NOT AT ALL WORTH $46 for 12!!! The taste not worth all the hype.

Don't keep searching on Yelp for donuts, this is the place you need to go to! Flew all the way from Texas to try these and the donuts exceeded expectations! The grilled cheese donut is loaded with cheese and cooked perfectly so it's super melty and is the perfect blend of sweet and savory. French toast donut is incredibly crunchy on the outside and so fluffy and soft on the inside. The big poppa pop tart is my second favorite. The flavor is perfectly on point for a strawberry pop tart. I love the jelly drizzle on top. Also the creme brÃ»lÃ©e is a must order. The top is crusted and pops when you open it. The filling is rich but not overwhelming. Good You really can't go wrong with anything here, but you really need to get the grilled cheese and French toast. They do have a line, but it goes to quick. Love how friendly and efficient they are here. Definitely a must try!

We heard about this place that claims to be the best donut in the world. Read the reviews and saw the stars and we knew we had to come and see their claim to fame. With that said we came around 10am and there was no line. That was nice since we could take our time and chat with the workers. They told us their claim to fame is the Big Poppa. It's a massive size donut that has a Pop Tart in the middle. So we said to throw one in the box along with creme brulee, birthday cake, chocolate bar (it's like a long John with cream inside), and a couple of others. We were excited to dig in as everything looked good. Now this is where the song lyrics came to my head "don't believe the hype!". We cut the Big Poppa and took a bite and we both thought hmmmm it's kind of dry and not too tasty. So we cut into the chocolate bar. The cream inside was nice but once again the donut itself didn't wow us. Next was the birthday cake which the frosting and sprinkles was it's saving grace. Overall the batter of the donut was not good at all. We were both disappointed. IMHO, these donuts is more like a do nut eat it. It was like grabbing a donut from a truck stop. Sorry just being honest.

Cheat meal wasted. I have this pet peeve. I absolutely hate it when a place is highly rated on my beloved Yelp or even culturally in general, only to find out that it was for novelty over actual superiority. It's like someone hooking you up with someone sexy and you get all excited because they look good in the pictures but you meet them in person and they have no personality. That's donut bar. I waited like months to try this place because I try to eat healthy most of the time. I drooled over the photos of the "strawberry poppa tart" the "creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut" etc I walked in and saw that "Brad fritter" and got one of those too on good faith even though I don't even like apple in baked goods. Because this place has a lot of stars, so its GOTTA BE GOOD. Right?? And after an extra strenuous workout to prep for the big day, I finally got to try all of the donuts I had been pining over. And none of them rocked my world. Not one. I get there and the shop is cute, clean, very nice displays and an absolutely wonderful staff. To my surprise the donuts are even waaaaaaay bigger than pictures communicate. My a*s was EXCITED! I got a strawberry poppa tart, creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut, Brad fritter, Nutella glaze, and birthday cake glaze, and not a single one of them was worthy of more than 2 stars. They are big and fluffy but they catered more to having giant donuts, than delicious ones. Something about the actual donut bodies themselves were just plain and boring and they topped them with glazes & toppings that will get you all exited but are ultimately lackluster as well. Except the candied bacon on the Brad fritter. Best part of the whole donut box was that bacon. That wound up being my breakfast. Do yourself a favor, and head on over to "Master Donuts" on the eastside or "RONALDS DONUTS" in China town! Theyre the "change yo lyfe" type of good donuts. Trust.

We arrived around 11 and had the choice of four flavors--all others sold out! I got the creme brÃ»lÃ©e because it's vegan and the donut was okay. The creme glaze on top was such a treat though--just like the dessert. I could have used more filling.

Some of the best "fancy" donuts. The pop tart donut actually has an entire pop tart inside. They have many other amazing flavors. I can't imagine getting a bad donut. The donuts seem to sell out pretty early.
Staffs are friendly! Got the strawberry split and cream brÃ»lÃ©e donuts and hot latte. Everything taste good! There's outdoor seating. Nice environment

I anticipated with excitement and expectations of a sublime doughnut experience. However, my eagerness dampened as i discovered that the quality, taste, and flavor of the doughnuts and coffee was less than impressive, more average and mediocre at best. The key feature is novelty of the variety and the size of the doughnuts that gives it it's attraction. In comparison, Blue Star doughnuts in Portland is much better in every respect. The consolation is that the doughnuts are better than your average, ok, or supermarket type doughnut retailer. Sorry, I really wanted to like this cute little shop. The stars are for the service. People are friendly and helpful and the donut variety is creative.
I was not impressed with how little filling was in these doughnuts or how stale the actual doughnut tasted. I've had amazing doughnuts before, but these were not it.

I like donuts and am always willing to try out different donut shops/bars, especially ones out of state. Las Vegas' Donut Bar is located in downtown, which is a bit out of the way if you stayed along The Strip. We ended up getting a Lyft there one morning for a quick bite to eat. If you follow them on Instagram, they post their menu daily. I was really looking forward to getting the strawberry split donut, however when we arrived - they were all out. Go early so you won't be disappointed like me. We ended up getting: Ohh My Birthday Cake Oreo ($2) Creme Brulee ($2) Caramel Latte ($3) Maple Bourbon ($3) Caramel Latte tasted a lot like coffee and we had a hard time finishing it. Same with the Maple Bourbon. Amongst the 3 of us, we demolished the smaller ones (Creme Brulee & Birthday Cake) but had to take the other two larger donuts (Caramel Latte & Maple Bourbon) back to the hotel. Their donuts are HUGE. It's kind of hard to try all the donuts unless you're with a group. I didn't really care for the Birthday Cake one. It tasted like a funfetti cake that had an oreo inside. At least it was small so we were able to finish. By the time I tried Maple Bourbon, I was already too full and on a sugar high. That was enough donuts for me. My favorites were the Creme Brulee and Caramel Latte, mainly because I love those flavors in general. Mmmmm the Creme Brulee was delicious with its crisp outer caramelized crust and custard filling on the inside. If I had known any better, I would have ordered a dozen of these and called it a day. Next time I'm in Vegas I already know what to get & hopefully they will have my strawberry split then....

Amazing, fluffy, airy donuts. First time here, and we were treated to some complementary donuts on top of the two we ordered. The employees were super nice and friendly. We got the traditional donut with chocolate dip, the crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e donut, and then had the pleasure of also trying the cinnamon sugar and Nutella iced donuts. All were amazing. The drip coffee was also great, to boot. Highly recommend!

Yum! Every time we come to old town Vegas there is a line out the door for this donut shop so I knew today would be a good day to come and try it as I had a little time to spare. Everyone here is super nice and they open fairly early however they're open until they sell out so if there's something that you're looking for and get there early and stand in line. Yes if you have butter and jelly and Oreo doughnut both were excellent.
Disappointed these donuts have no taste what's so ever They are only Big ,good looking and over priced Have tasted better.
Friendliest and most helpful staff in Vegas. Not to mention the best donuts in town. A must visit and this is always the perfect gift.

Their apple fritter was a complete fail. No flavor, no sweetness, nothing special about it. Apple fritters are my absolute favorite donut, so I'm very let down by theirs. On a positive note... the Homer donut was amazing !!!! Very soft, very sweet, a complete 10 out of 10 score. Also amazing is their Strawberry Cheesecake donut. The perfect amount of filling and also very soft donut, oooo sooo yummy. I wouldn't mind if they added more graham cracker crumbs on top. I've never had a bad Chai Latte, so I was very pleased by theirs. My junk food sidekicks ordered the following: Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e, maple bacon bar, triple chocolate threat, bacon cinnamon roll, and the caramel latte donuts. No complaints from them. Apparently the bacon cinnamon rolls was out of this world delicious.
Great donuts, not overly sweet and coffee was strong which I loved. The staff is very patient and friendly. Will def be back! ( the creme brÃ»lÃ©e & pop tart donuts are worth the trip)

Donut bar never disappoints me! The dough for their donuts is always AMAZING!! Got to take my husband here for his first time today. We got a Nutella donut and two coffees. The donut was perfect size for the two of us. Overall the donut was light and fluffy just like what you would like. We wished there was more of that Nutella flavor on top, but was still very good. The coffee was KICKING which is exactly what we wanted. Also, the staff was SOOOO nice and friendly!! Can't wait to see y'all again soon

My husband and I stopped in to redeem a Groupon I purchased today for $15.00 in donuts. I read a few weeks back that this donut shop received an award for Best of Las Vegas and was featured in the magazine that was inside the Las Vegas Review-Journal. We arrived after 11:30 am and paid for parking outside the establishment. Upon entering the store, it was reasonably busy as they close at 2:00 pm. A pleasant and helpful young lady greeted us. I informed her we were redeeming a Groupon. I explained that this was our first time visiting their store. She graciously explained the various donuts they had from regular size to very large. She let me know which ones were their bestsellers. She described some as being very light and fluffy. She was very patient as we made our selections. She let me know when I reached $15.00. She took us to the register and told me to wait a minute. She returned shortly with another box of various donuts, including some of the enormous donuts. I redeemed my Groupon and thanked her. Due to the beautiful customer service and the delightful donuts my family and I indulged in when we returned to Henderson; we will be repeat customers as these are some of the best donuts we've eaten and we have tried many donut shops over the 45+ years. This is the place to come and worth the drive. It's outstanding!
This is my happy place. The employees are nice and some of the best doughnuts I've ever had. Try the vegan strawberry cream filled. Love. This. Place.

If you want to impress someone, don't settle for ordinary donuts. Instead, surprise them with treats from Donut Bar! Since it's nice to switch things up every now and then, they change donut flavors on the regular. It's a bit pricey but you pay for the experience and incredible branding!

Very friendly staff with lots of patience as we were overwhelmed with the selection of donuts that they had out. All of the donuts range from $2-5 and are definitely worth every penny. We decided to grab 4 big ones and a smaller one and we were already full after eating just one. This place does sell out fast so make sure you get there early! We got there around 9am and were able to get in and get out within 5 minutes. There's also paid parking right outside or if you go around the corner, there are 4 free 15 minute parking spots which is where we parked.

A short walk around 12 minutes from downtown Las Vegas to the donut bar. We went around 7:45am on a Tuesday and wasn't busy at all. Walked and I was in awe of all the donuts they had and the size. These are huge and they all look delicious with interesting flavors. The staff was so helpful making recommendations and highlighting their unique and seasonal flavors. We got the classic homer donut a big pink sprinkle donut, their popular strawberry big poppa which had an entire strawberry pop tart inside, a maple Apple fritter, and the creme filled creme brÃ»lÃ©e. All were delicious and not too sweet my top favorite was the Apple fritter with the maple glaze on top. The creme brÃ»lÃ©e was also delicious and I'd recommend for its unique texture and delicious taste. We also ordered some coffee and enjoyed them in the socially distanced back patio, we actually were the only ones back there the whole time. Can't wait to comeback 10/10 I highly recommend.
The best donuts I've ever had and that includes PDX, ATX and LAX. Go early because I showed up at 9 on New Year's day and they were SOLD OUT.
The donut was amazing I had the strawberry with whip cream one it was light and airy.

Awesome place for Donut's.. Love there Strawberry n whipped cream sugar Donut. !!!!! Price some but awesome and get one every time when I'm in the area and some times just a drive there as well worth it n the coffee is awesome a long with the out door patio setting.. Love it Love it Love it.!!! Thumbs up to all n your awesome donuts.!!!!!

Nice cozy place inside. Very friendly welcoming staff. Selection was not big but we did go close to closing time so understandable. She threw in a few freebies for us which was really nice of her. The big donuts are very nice and fluffy kind of a cake texture. Not heavy or greasy. The creme brulee and Nutella are also very delicious. Parking was pretty easy but we did go on a Tuesday. They have street meter parking and its very close to the old strip if you decide to park at one of the casinos. Definitely a must try!!

Mood: Donuts for the family, and no regular donuts would do...so we all hopped in the car and made our way downtown to Donut Bar. I've been here not even a handful of times, being that its about a 20 min drive and I know you have to get here early or all the popular donuts can be gone before you make it! We made it by 10 am, which by their standards is not too early...many of the donuts were sold out, but we were still able to pick some good ones. Their donuts range in price and size, and I really like that they have a variety of flavors to satisfy many different palates. We got a few different ones to try over the next few days, one Homer, which instead of its usual pink there were several different colors (maybe for Halloween?) we got a green one, 2 Twix donuts, a blueberry cheesecake, a strawberry split, an Oh my birthday cake Oreo, and a Chai donut. For my first pick, I snacked on the blueberry cheesecake. It was one of the smaller ones of the bunch, but it packed a yummy blueberry punch! It was delightful and fluffy. Very happy with this one! My little started out with her strawberry split, this donut is cut open and filled with strawberries and whipped cream, sprinkled with powdered sugar. And just like a banana split, to me seems like it needed utensils to be eaten. But she tackled it like a pro, and got cream and powdered sugar all over her face while she did it. Hubs is more of a chocolate kinda guy, so he had the Twix. This is a chocolate cake donut, slathered with chocolate sauce, and sprinkled with big chunks of chocolate pieces and some of the other pieces of candy looked more like toffee maybe? He enjoyed and ate every last bite! We saved the other donuts to eat over the next few days. They're pretty filling, especially the larger donuts are big enough to share. Solid spot for donuts, if you're in the mood for something sweet. Get there early so you can have a large selection to pick from!

I've wanted to go here ever since I saw Donut Bar get a fish tank made on the Tanked tv show. So when I was going to Vegas on a trip this was one my big request. And I was not disappointed!! Let me just say, these donuts are NOT for the faint of heart. They're massive! So many crazy, unique options- a freaking donut with an entire pop tart stuffed inside, a giant pink donut based on Homer Simpson, a creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut with actual caramel on the outside that you break into, and so many more!! The shop is so cute and the workers are awesome. I am in love with this place and will go back any chance I get.
Vegan donuts - nuff said! Nice little are out back to sit and nosh.

This place is hands down the best donut shop I have ever been in! The vibe is amazing, the staff is super friendly and very nice. And Ofcourse the donuts are just beyond delicious!! I stumbled upon this location while looking for coffee options by our hotel and decided to walk to this place to check it out. I am glad I did coz the donut options are creative and just hands down delicious but not overly sweet where you don't taste the flavor other than sugar. To me the staff of this place took it to 5 star. We got the creme brÃ»lÃ©e and French toast donut at first and both were delicious specially the French toast was so fluffy soft. Took the maple bacon cinnamon roll for the road and it was very tasty as well with good balance of sweet with bacon! They open early 7 am on weekdays and 8 am on weekends and close till they sell out which the staff said is around 1 pm. If you're in Vegas then I highly recommend stopping by, we got here at 8:45 am and it got busy with people coming in and out with pickups. They advertise with a #BestDonutsInTheWorld and I agree!

Finally made it here after several attempts. Always too early on the weekend, so we hit other donut shops that open early mornings on weekends we are up and about with sunrise. This place opens 9 am on weekends! So the donuts look appealing, several large donuts, glazed, chocolate, Nutella. These are twice the size of regular donuts. Today, the large glazed was a little under cooked for me. It was doughy, when pulling apart, the pieces could be rolled into an almost raw like consistency. I don't care for that. The old fashion was too dried out, dry and stale. They pulled it from a large tray but I don't know how long they where sitting out, but just to dry for me. Got two of the cream brÃ»lÃ©e, good donut with hard glaze on top stuffed with cream filling. Tasted like vanilla pudding instead of real cream. Not bad for what it was. Next thing that we tried was the Boston cream bars. They where good, love the chocolate glaze, again the vanilla pudding cream taste and not truly the real cream flavor. I am not thinking it was a great choice today. Not completely opposed to trying again, but was not terribly impressed.

Best donuts in town! #ToDieFor Been to the one in San Diego, waited like 30 minutes in line, I'm glad we have one in Vegas and don't have to wait that long. It gets pretty busy though, and they close once they sell out. Aside from their sweet donuts, their grilled cheese is very good, its huge too! They have vegan donuts and you can also order online to pick up!

I wish I would have taken a picture of our delicious donuts! They were exquisite! They don't put "#bestdonutsever" on the box for nothing. Our family had a coffee, cream filled donut, old fashioned, and a maple bar donut. Everything was great!! I highly recommend this adorable donut shop.

I'll be honest, I am pretty disappointed with my last visit. I really want to support businesses but I have to be honest... Short Review: - Been here a few times, and each time wasn't great. - Spent $30+ on my last visit for 1 dozen donuts (not the grilled cheese/french toast btw) -- $35+ w/ 2 espresso - I know my donuts, been nicknamed by others "a donut expert" haha, thanks) I've been to several around the Vegas Valley and other cities. - Yes, these donuts are large, pretty & Instagrammable, (a lot of people love this place) but they taste more like bread, not donuts. Dry, thick texture & seems like they were made the night before, while other places make theirs fresh a few hours before opening and throughout the day. - the donuts are lacking in flavor. - Customer service is lacking as well, pushy sales girls don't listen well over the loud music. She tried to sell me the french toast & grilled cheese donut 3 times after I politely said no thank you each time. Gave me confusing answers when I asked her questions. Cashier wasn't friendly or nice either. (Btw... they were not busy when I went in, 8-9am) - They will still do well in business despite my review and many others like it. - I'm not sure what they use in their recipe but it made me sick for a few days :-(. - If you were disappointed with the donuts or service here, and want tasty, fresh, flavorful, soft, affordable donuts go to Ronald's Donuts in Chinatown or Friendly Donuts if you're near Boulder Hwy / Southeast Henderson / Hendertucky area. Long Detailed Review: -- worth reading if you want to know why I dropped a few stars (about their donuts and service): If you know me and my reviews I am honest about my reviews and tend to look for the positives (what's good) in a place, unless I got sick or something. I went on a Saturday after breakfast, would've came here for breakfast if we thought of it sooner. Glad we didn't. Read on to find out why... At first, I thought the girl helping us was friendly until she suggested the grilled cheese donut and french toast donut at least 3 times. After I said no thank you each time. I wonder if they get commission off of each french toast or grilled cheese donut they sell? I'll call them sales girls because after a minute or so they turned into pushy sales girls. The music was so loud in there, I asked her a few questions and she gave me confusing answers. Somehow we still ended up spending $35 THIRTY FIVE DOLLARS FOR ONE DOZEN DONUTS & 2 Espressos. That's unheard of at any other donut shop. I wouldn't mind if they tasted good but the dough in the donuts had no flavor, it tasted more like bread. Basically, most of them tasted like bread with flavorless sugary frosting on it. I'm not sure what they use in their recipe but it made me sick for a few days :-(. The donuts with filling in them, had a pea size filling, very small amount. The toppings and frosting didn't taste like their name. The specialty donuts, like the Blueberry cheesecake, pumpkin, all the donuts we got were flavorless and disappointing. I gave some to my family, hoping they'll like it and eat it all up but my brothers didn't even want to try any donut LOL. That is saying something. WHO REFUSES OR THROWS OUT DONUTS?! Not this girl or anyone that I know. We ended up throwing out a lot of the donuts. If you like large donuts, Instagrammable donuts this is your place. If you want tasty, fresh, flavorful, soft, affordable donuts go to Ronald's Donuts in Chinatown or Friendly Donuts if you're near boulder Hwy / Southeast Henderson / Hendertucky area. 2018 Yelp Challenge Review #14

We taste tested 6 donuts. The grilled cheese and French toast were warm and delicious. None of the other donuts we taste tested were edible. By far Not the best donuts in the world........ Creme brÃ»lÃ©e was greasy, topping too hard and too thick, and cream was almost nonexistent. JJust about broke a tooth. Bought two because of the hype. Waste of money. If you're charging premium $$$$$ at the very least don't go cheap on the cream........ Bacon apple fritter was hyped. Horribly bland, almost no cinnamon and no apples. Horribly hard. Nothing was fresh. Everything was hard. Chocolate deluxe was all yeast with just chocolate on top. Nothing special. Wasn't fresh. Everything tasted like yesterday's donuts. And btw, we came early hoping to get them fresh for fair taste test. Last but not least, poor selection. More donut selection and much fresher at DD. Better value too. If you can't produce consistently high quality then don't charge high prices...... And don't hard stuff my dog wouldn't eat. Toss them, don't sell em.....

I was looking for vegan treats on my drive through Vegas and was excited to try their creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut. I happened to get really lucky and got their happy hour! They were super friendly and explained that I could fill a whole box for $10, which was awesome! Vegan ones for me, and regular ones for my husband. Some of the donuts are a bit dry but had good flavor. But the cake donut was delicious and wasn't dry at all - wish they had more of them, but they were running low since it was around noon. I'll be back again next time I drive through!!

If you're visiting downtown Las Vegas a stop at Donut Bar is a must! What sets this shop apart from the rest are the creative flavors packed into each donut, friendly and helpful staff and an instagram worthy back patio. As a bonus on the weekends Donut Bar offers two specialty donuts: The grilled cheese and a fun take on French toast!

Truly massive and fluffy donuts! Either come hungry or ready to share. The Nutella donut was delicious but I wasn't a huge fame of the creme brÃ»lÃ©e, which is supposed to be their best-selling donut.

I've been wanting to try Donut Bar for years and finally planned a little venture downtown in the daylight. They open at 7am during the week and 8am on Saturdays. We got there at 7:05 on a Friday and there was no line. As soon as we walked in the staff greeted us. We asked if they had any vegan options, which they had 3-4 different donuts that were. I tried the Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e donut (because I saw it on their instagram, duh) and it honestly tasted just like Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e! Donut Bar was defiantly worth it.
Anya and Jaz! Great customer service and the first person who knew where Moreno Valley was! Such a great lil shop

They were friendly today and I got my mermaid donut so I am happy to see my last visit was just a bad experience. I only went with four stars cause I came for the Mermaid donut and most of them looked melted and not anything like their IG post. This is a tourist type attraction. Gourmet type donuts downtown so parking especially with construction isn't the easiest and the pricing is not on the low side. The french toast donut made to order is still my favorite!
Good donuts, but I can't say that they are the best in the world, as they claim. The staff is energetic and personable.

Amazing customer service! We were early for our brunch reservation next door so we popped in, we asked if they could hold our boxes till we were finished or till t hey closed. They sold out before their official closing time so they called to notify us and we were able to pick up our boxes! We will be back to try some of the ones that they had already sold out on.

If you want to try the biggest donut ever try out this place! They have a huge "homer" donut bigger than your Hand! And it is delicious. The pink frosting is creamy and taste like cake! Balance it off with a latte! There isn't much seating, more a grab and go but it looks clean and fresh! Also tried the maple bacon bar which had huge chunks of actual bacon not the small bites they usually sprinkle on top! Will be bringing more friends and family to try some new donuts and coffee!

This place is one of my favorite weekly go-to spots with my daughter. Staff is super friendly and add to the experience significantly. We try not donuts all the time and have never been disappointed by our choices. All donuts are massive in size and perfect in texture. Fluffy tasty donuts! They recently started doing sugar donuts (plain?) and it's probably my my favorite. It's massive!

My wife said, there is a Chi-fil-a in the bottom of the hotel. I shook my head and put on my shoes and after visiting another coffee shop I saw this place was opening. I showed up just in time to be first in line, the police rolled up (because.... well... sometimes the old stereotype is true) and I got to take in the great selection of donuts. The hardest part was was limiting myself. Went back again later in the week to get more donuts (hurray for getting to try more) to share with my wife's employees). Reasonably priced and just plain delicious. Coffee is good too, since what goes better with donuts?

Great donuts but they might be closed FOR GOOD. Im here for the 2nd time on my trip to Vegas & it says closed & its 7:08 am. Nothing on their website says they should be closed. Nothing on FB. THEY NEED TO UODATE THEIR STATUS so people dont waste time & gas on their vacations to come here & them not be open. .

Well I expected better. I was super excited to come here. First I tried pink donuts and I really liked them. Then I thought this place would be better. Well, it wasn't. I am the biggest donut critic. I got the cake batter, ores cake batter and apple fritters. Also got blue pop tart and bacon. Apple fritters we're over cooked. Like you can see the dark color and hardness on the donut. Barely any glaze on it too. The cake batter was way bigger in size then others, which was weird to me because usually apple fritters are bigger then most. The Oreo was so tiny compared to the rest. Cake batter was pretty much just dipped icing donut with icing blobs on top. Sooo meh. Oreo cake batter, well just basically a stuffed donut with Oreos in middle with icing on top. Pop tart donut also overcooked with tiny icing on top. All very meh donuts and overly priced. If you want a good donut, go to pinks. Lease they are usually stocked and fresh and way better tasting. Especially if you are advertising cake batter, it should take like cake batter like the one at pinks .

Donuts & coffee, the forever couple. This place gets it right in a cute downtown location. I went early afternoon on a weekday and there was still a good selection of a variety of flavors. These are really aesthetic "crowd-pleasing" donuts, I tried three. They're lighter (yeast-raised) than fancy donuts elsewhere, not so much the "i had two and I don't need to eat again today" I've run into elsewhere. The prices are also surprisingly competitive. Discounts for a dozen, and there were some basic bar-shaped donuts for just a dollar when I was there. This place won't break the bank. There's curbside parking (metered), and a shared shady courtyard out back. Check it out.
Best Donuts! Best to share. Take some with you because you won't finish everything you want to try in the store. Friendly staff.

Donuts are the perfect treat in the morning and yesterday was the perfect day for a morning trip to the Donut Bar. This donut shop is located right off of Fremont Street and is awesome from the moment you walk in. As soon as you walk in the front door you are greeted by some extremely friendly employees and a ton of the best looking donuts you'll probably ever lay you're eyes on. They have a huge selection and it was probably about 20-30 different flavours when I showed up around 7:30AM. I ended up giving 3 a try and they were the big birthday cake donut, the little birthday cake/oreo donut with an oreo in the middle of it, and the third donut was the large equivalent to basically a rocky road donut (I think, give me a break here). From the first bite of the big rocky road donut I knew that I had a new favourite donut shop and it wasn't even a contest. Next I ate the stuffed birthday cake donut and it was oh so darn good. The dough here is super soft and the oreo cookie inside made this one a truly special donut. The final donut I consumed (literally 10 minutes ago) was the large birthday cake donut. Not only was this thing large and soft, but the toppings and cream made it the best birthday cake donut I've ever had. Overall, Donut Bar is my new favourite Donut shop, period. The staff was incredibly friendly and talkative, the establishment itself was awesome featuring a fish tank with donut decorations, and the donuts themselves were top of the line tasty and they were absolutely delicious. If you like donuts, this is the place for you!

An amazing place. The employees are extremely friendly and personable. They made my and my daughters visit wonderful. My daughter has food allergies and they went beyond my expectations to verify the ingredients and help us make the right choice. The donuts were great and fun and we went during their happy hour which was a plus! We will definitely be back. Wonderful business and the hiring manager is right on when picking valuable people to represent the business.

Donut Bar has to be one of the tastiest and most unique donut spots in Vegas! I came across here about a year ago when I was visiting for the Life is Beautiful music festival. The environment felt very cozy and the donut selection blew me away. There were so many different flavors to choose from and they had many specialized donuts that you can't get elsewhere. These definitely weren't your typical donuts. They also had coffee on their menu, which was a plus! If you are ever in the Fremont St / Downtown area, I highly recommend going here. Make sure to arrive early while the donuts are fresh and still available. I guarantee everything you see will be absolutely droolworthy. IG: @ravenousfork

Thus far every time we've gone to Donut Bar, we've pre ordered the night before in order to get the donuts we want. I love the CrÃ¨me Brule donut! My husband is a fan of the Butter Beer Donut and anything Chocolate. We tried a couple new ones this time and they weren't that great...i.e. The Apple Fritter (not Apple-y enough), Pumpkin with filling. I thought the Strawberry Split was fabulous though and would certainly get it again. We do the free coffee with Yelp check in each time and we've never liked the coffee. Whether you are a fan of fluffy donuts or cake donuts I'm sure you'll find something to make you go mmmm!

Slightly off the beaten path but close enough its a can miss! Even mid-day the place is a buz with a great mix of locals and visitors alike. They flock in and sometimes line up for the very best donuts in Las Vegas perhaps nationally. Always fun and tasty custom creations like French toast or creme brule'. You would never find beauties like this in a grocery store or chain. They are big, but still light enough to enjoy your own, but I suggest being ready to share a bite if given that look. You know the look. Service is top notch, the entire crew is cool, especially Mathew

We stopped in and were wowed! Probably the best donut I've ever had! Wish I could have tried more then one. I got a strawberry cake donut and my husband got the salted caramel. Both excellent. The gals behind the front counter were both friendly and helpful. When in Vegas we will make our way back!

The Bacon-Cinnamon Roll here is epic (10/10). The Nutella donut & the Cream BrulÃ© were both above average but not life-changing like that bacon cinnamon roll. We showed up at 9:15am on a Froday and were lucky enough to get the last bacon cinnamon roll- so get here early if possible.

I actually came here when they first opened and several times since. It lives up to the hype of that video and the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donuts. Damn that crackle on that creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut and French toast donut. Also don't just come for this donut, all their other donuts are beautiful, unique, and bloody delicious. Come hungry for donuts. Not a lot of places to sit and the outside patio is nice when it's not 100 degrees. I would also make sure or know your order and get your box of donuts all in one go to forgo the long lines. Parking is also freaking terrible and make sure to pay attention to the signs

Ordered the donuts pickup through yelp and was so glad I did because when I went there were no more donuts. Out of all the donuts I got I loved the vanilla bean. Also got the Nutella overload and would have loved it to be more goey on the inside other than that they were delicious.
Yummy donuts at a decent price and it is all a feast for the eyes. Chai tea latte was pretty great too. Lots of choices and friendly service. Off the beaten path but worth the side trip.
Not gonna lie, the donuts are good. However, the parking is terrible and how are people supposed to stop in and pick up donuts for the office if they don't open till 7am?

Donut bar is always a good choice! All the donuts are delicious and the service is great! We got there a few minutes after it opened and there was no line, it was about $22 for a half dozen but majority of the donuts are HUGE! The Boston Creme is to die for, and I would definitely recommend trying their famous creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut. They had several vegan options which is always a plus! If you are in the downtown area or even if you aren't, you should definitely check out the Donut Bar!
Very good donuts. We enjoyed them all. We also had the grilled cheese donut. Super yummy. The staff was very nice and patient with us and helped us makes choices. We will be back when we are in town.

this place is crazy. If you have been, you know what I mean haha Def a cool spot, I just don't have a big enough sweet tooth for this kind of shop but a I was happy with the couple bites I had :) They have an insane happy hour too

Quite possibly the best donuts in Las Vegas. Donut Bar creates super fun & delicious donuts like their maple bacon bar, huge big papa tart or the creme brulee just to name a few. Make sure to come in early because they will sell out, FAST. We've had their donuts in our office multiple times and they're always a nice tasty treat. My favorite is the PB&J. It has real peanut butter in it which I love & the dough tastes just like a cloud. I also have tried some of their coffee before. They use local brews like Vesta which I'm a fan of. If you're a sweets lover this place is a must visit! Also a good hit for impressing your coworkers.
It was really good, coffee not so good. But would return for donuts . Had the French toast donut. Was delicious

Most of the donuts are huge! Plan to share... that way you can try all of them! Cake donuts are in there back on the cooling rack. I think the donuts are good and the price is within reason, especially for the amount. I'd go back.

My parents and I swung by today as these really pretty looking donuts caught our eye! However, after trying the strawberry donut and the mud pie donuts, we concluded that the taste of these bad boys was lackluster and as my mom said were "just okay." Looks can be deceiving when the flavors don't live up to the decor. Hopefully they can work on better less dry dough and better taste.

My friend and I did a preorder of a dozen donuts. We got everything from the vegan creme brulee to the huge butter beer donut. We were so excited to try them when we got back to her place! Some donuts were really good like the blueberry cheesecake, vegan red donut, Boston cream etc. But some were either super dry or super disappointing (like the butter beer one :( very cute looking but not enough butterscotch flavor). The chai latte was decent but super small for a "medium" I would come back for certain ones but wouldn't get any of the original cake donuts since the they seem to always be dry.

It is a quick walk from the downtown area and pretty easy to find as there is a nice large sign outside. They have a great selection of unique donuts and the staff are extremely friendly. We were super excited to try the French toast and grilled cheese donuts. They both were exceptional, but you do need to eat them while they are still hot. With that said you do need to get there early because they do sell out of things. But after trying their food today I can easily see why they constantly sell out. If you are in the downtown area it is a great place to get your donut fix!

Donut upgrade. Using better ingredients appears to work. The donuts here are generally well above average. The apple fritter was the most familiar tasting item, but it was still as good as the best I have had. I would stay away from the grilled cheese, unless you know you'll like it. It was a bit much for me, though the sauce that comes with it is delicious and well matched. I am thankful this place is an eight hour drive from home, since otherwise I might be eating these donuts often enough to get a physique to match one of them.

Small space BIG flavor. That's the summation of this gym tucked away in downtown Las Vegas. If you find yourself in the unforgiving desert of Nevada look no further than the donut bar as your oasis flowing with coffee and sugar. This sugar isn't just any sugar, it's sugar masterfully woven into scrumptious fluffy, and sometimes filled, donuts. The picture accompanying this review shows the spread for two that we purchased (and yes we ate all but two in one sitting). Here you will see the elegant body cream pie long john, the hazelnut overload (powdered sugar filled with Nutella), the caramel latte (yes a donut), and the maple bacon muffin. All the donuts surpassed expectations sending us directly into a diabetic coma (in a good way) of the likes you only see by someone ingesting something so spectacular. Simply put, if you find yourself eloping in the little white chapel or simply trying to live it up and win it big the donut bar will provide you a guaranteed win for your money in Vegas. This is no gamble but a guarantee.

I had a fun time ordering these donuts, lol! I went there to get Birthday donuts for my guy and ended up taking orders for the whole office! I first had to take pix of all that was available and then WAIT for them to get back to me. The employees were very cool and very patient with me. Now the donuts... They were good! They weren't L.A.'s Donut Man good but they were really good. I think m favorite was the Caramel Latte donut. It was sweet and creamy! The Strawberry Split was a little dry. Chocolate Euphoria was just okay. The Creme Brulee was really good but it needed more cream in the middle. I think my favorite of the group was the old fashion. I'm kicking myself for not grabbing that last Nutella donut, I think I would have loved it!! I'll go back again but I'm really missing Donut Man caliber donuts here in Vegas.

A great place! The donuts were so delicious and the dough was fresh! I got the chocolate bar and you can taste how fresh the dough is! The donut was also just $1 the prices are very reasonable! I am so glad I found this place, I def will be returning! They have a. bunch of different options
Omg these donuts are amazing ! Get there early so you have a great choice as it's first come first serve !

Very cute little donut bar downtown Las Vegas! The donuts were big & flavorful. I got the 'Cake Batter donut' & my sister got the 'Homer'! They only frost the top then it's a plain donut under which is great for balancing out the sweetness of the frosting. I feel like the price was fair for the size donut you get. All specialty donuts as well. A lot of flavors to choose from! The staff was nice & welcoming even told us where more seating was located. They made suggestions on which donuts were most popular & gave us adequate time to make a decision. The overall environment was clean, cute & artsy. This location was quiet & away from the crowd which was nice. They had outdoor seating in a little shaded courtyard which was great. If I'm ever in the area again, I'd check them out.

Creative donut and flavor combinations. Located on Carson St downtown but are only opened to 1:00 or until they sell out, so get here early if you want to try some of their favorites such as maple bacon (long donut with maple glaze and glazed bacon), cake batter (a festive frosting laden donut with sprinkles and white icing), blood orange (a sweet tangy glazed donut with tart sweet blood orange glaze and filling), birthday cake (cake donut, festive frosting and toppings), red velvet, Homer, Mexican Chocolate and so much more....they have coffee offerings, small seating area, street parking.

These really are some fantastic donuts! Do expect a line and do expect the flavors to sell out quickly. They have such a great variety, were they not so pricey I would be tempted to get one of each. Be sure to use the Yelp check in for a free coffee with the purchase of a dozen. The donuts are very rich and super sweet, one was more than enough for me, I suggest going with a group and splitting a bunch of them. Also ideal for parties and events as they are beautiful and sure to please. Great spot if you are craving something sweet!
If you don't get there early enough. You're SOL fun place good donuts. We got the blueberry poptart, pink frosting with sprinkles and a maple bar.
Neat place to drop in for a quick snack & indulging on good donuts. Pictures doesn't do justice- definitely better & bigger than it looks.

I had really high hopes due to the reviews but for me it just didn't work. I had the creme brulee donut, birthday cake donut, chocolate, and blueberry pop tart. The creme brulee donut was interesting and well presented, but the flavor was missing something, can't put my finger on it. All the other donuts unfortunately we're far too sweet for me, the dough however was airy and dense, it just wasn't enough to keep my attention. Staff was awesome, and the place really cool, for my taste it was too sweet but YMMV.
So good! My favorite was the salted caramel and blueberry filled one! So many more options to try. Their coffee was delicious. They use Vesta Coffee Roasters and they made excellent lattes with them.

Great place. We got there a little late but they still had a nice selection. Great donuts. The staff was also super nice. I even saw Joe bring out a donut and water to a homeless person passing by. I will go back if I get the chance

Last morning before class, so I stopped in. I saw the Strawberry Split and had second thoughts! That's too big for this morning. If it ain't Krispy Kreme, let me get a cake donut! I ordered the Apple Crumb & Old Fashioned w/ Vanilla Bean glaze. The Apple crumb was delicious. I expected a heavily sweet taste, but it didn't have that. The old fashioned was a tad bit crisp, but it was good. Not a bad Yelp suggestion!

This little donut shop is so cute. I love their pink decor and awesome donut themed aquarium. They have a wide variety of donuts to choose from in all sorts of unique flavors and themes. Then why am I lukewarm about it? Part of the problem is that they are all looks and less about substance. The donuts are okay, just okay. The yeast donuts are big and fluffy, but they lack flavor. For instance their birthday cake donut looks pretty but it just tastes like a donut - there's nothing to suggest it tastes like birthday cake. No icing, no batter, none of that 'eggy' flavor. All the other yeast donuts were similar. The cake donuts are a better bet, but I only had one of those, so maybe I bet on the wrong horse so to speak. It's worth a try, but it's not the best donuts you'll ever have. I would suggest sticking to cake donuts if you do come here.

Donut Bar was boppin. Got there a few mins after opening on a weekday so there were no lines yet. The employees were extremely helpful with their answers and recommendations and had really good attitudes. Donuts were very good but word of advice, make sure you're really hungry or will be sharing because some of them are huge. The Homer Donut and Classic Glazed were as big as my teens face. The Red Velvet donut was to die for and I typically don't like donuts. Overall, this is a good donut place and you should at least come once.
