Donut Bar is so much fun and delicious! I walked here on my lunch break and happen to visit during happy hour- box of a dozen for $10!! They have boxes already made or you can make your own. Each donut can be split between 2 people (they're huge). They are extremely fluffy and the flavors range from classic to festive. They have a donut fish tank and Homer makes a few appearances. The ladies working were super friendly and upbeat, they made it fun for sure! This place is a whole experience. If it's your turn to get the donuts, you will definitely impress with these. Thanks Donut Bar!!
So freaking good! Great variety to choose from. More expensive than Krispy Kreme or Dunkin, but the doughnuts are so much better tasting. Go thete!!!
I love donut bar. The donuts are huge. We walked 4 blocks each day to eat there. Our favorite is the cake batter donut

We asked the counter girl to put together a 6 pack of their top donuts. She gave us their best sellers and it was over the top goodness. Got to say we were not disappointed in the taste or the quality of the donuts. Got my sugar rush to keep me trucking in Vegas. Think the donuts maybe lucky too, cause made some dough of my own on the tables right after.
Outstanding donuts & even better service! The ladies that work there were super nice! The donuts are amazing & unique! If I could give it 6 stars I would!

So I heard soooo many great reviews about this place that I decided I had to try it myself. I came on a Saturday around 11am and they were sold out. (My fault as people have said they sell out early since their donuts are so good!) the young lady working there was very kind and told me the best time to stop by and I told her I would come back the next day. Well today is the next day. Got there around 9:10am and WOW!! The staff greet you as soon as you walk in and they are so helpful with trying to help you decide which donut you'd love the most. I decided on a grilled cheese donut and omg. I could have easily split this with someone. I didn't know it was going to be so huge! And they DONT skimp on the cheese! It was delicious! They have so many flavors that I'm sure everyone will find something they enjoy! I shall be back for the salted caramel!

This is a solid donut shop. Lots of unique flavors are available, and it is obvious they put a little extra quality into the ingredients. I sampled two raised donuts, plain glazed and pumpkin spice, and one cake, strawberry with cream cheese frosting. They were good. Not the best donuts in the world per their claim, but good. I thought the raised donuts were a little too dense and chewy, but I enjoyed them nonetheless.

Fantastic Spot for Premium Donuts When I heard San Diego's Donut Bar set up a location in Vegas, I just had to have it again. In SD, I had the Strawberry Split (an unforgettable fruity donut stuffed with whipped cream, $4) and I was pleased to see it again here in Vegas. But on this trip I had to try something new. On this Saturday morning we got there pretty late, around 10:30am, and it seemed like a lot had already been sold. Of what remained, I had two donuts: Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e ($2) & the Twix donut ($2). I gotta say, both Donuts were unlike anything I've ever had before. The brÃ»lÃ©e had a sweet sticky crunch layer of molten sugar and filled on the inside with sweet cream. I knew going into the Twix I would be smacked with an explosion of chocolate and it did not disappoint - Twix bar crumbs covered the top layer of thick chocolate dressing on chocolate dough. Amazing! For your coffee craving, there're several options to choose: espresso, mocha, chai latte, drip, etc. I had the Americano - a super smooth black coffee. Plans for my next visit, try two new donuts, try the drip coffee, and ARRIVE EARLY!!!

AMAZING!!!!!! Growing up in Vegas we used to stop at Winchell's on our way to school. I tend to compare today's word of donuts to those of my bomb ass childhood. Anyway, the cream filled chocolate bars at Donut Bar are to die for. They have an awesome and creative assortment of donuts so there is something for everyone. The best part of our stop was the iced latte's. Good Lord the coffee here is incredible! I live way up in Summerlin but I can honestly see myself take a spin to Downtown Vegas just for some of their donuts and crazy good iced latte's. While we felt prices were a bit steep, I guess you get what you pay for as we, Cesar Q. and I left happy and wanting more! The staff is outgoing and quite helpful when you don't know exactly which donut to indulge in. There is street parking right our front of the shop so it's very easy to run in and out. Damn, as I write this review I feel the need to go NOW for my afternoon pick-me-up!

Maybe I'm used to something a little different on the East Coast, but the Donut Bar was all bark and no bite. They all looked very aesthetic, but not one of them was memorable or had any real outstanding flavor Tried 3 donuts from their large selection. Cake Batter(Oreo Mini) $3 Big Poppa Tart (Strawberry) $5 Strawberry Split $4 The big poppa tart was the biggest let down, the filling of the donut was the same dry sticky filling as a actual pop tart, it did not blend very well with the soft doughy texture. It's a little bit of a hike away from the strip, I would say not worth the journey.

The Donut Bar definitely exceeded my expectations! Every time I have attempted to come to the bar the donuts have been sold out. So I finally got up early enough to make it down and I am truly glad I did. I got the funfetti and vanilla bean donut and I have truly never had donuts so good and moist in my life. Not to mention those donuts plus the orange juice I got came to a total of $8.00 even. I was more than happy with the customer service from the waitress in my pictures and it was also very pleasant seeing the owner of the shop. I love being able to see owners actually come around to their shop, it provides an extra sense of intimacy in the shop that you do not typically get otherwise. I loved the Donutwill definitely be back!

Best Donuts ever! We live in San Francisco and make sure to stop by every time I'm in town. My favorite donuts are: French toast ( sadly it's only available on the weekend) Nutella Maple bacon CrÃ©eme brÃ»lÃ©e And butter beer Well so far they're the only ones I have tried

Super friendly service, clean and inviting shop. Donut selection is outstanding. More importantly, the donuts are truly delicious. Super happy we made the quick stop into old downtown to check them out. I had the birthday cake donut (yum) and Travis got the lemon pistachio (also yum).
We had a great experience at the donut bar. Both me and my husband enjoyed a selection of donuts. They also have the best chai tea I have ever had hands-down.
Amazing donuts!!! They are HUGE for the price. We got them delivered to the Luxor and they were still so fresh when they arrived. This will be a new tradition on Vegas Trips

OOOOOO MMMMMM GGGGGGG This place is the Real Donut Deal. DDDDDDelicious. Every donut is so fresh so yummy. Must go and check this place out. I'm coming back tomorrow. The donut aquarium is so funny but cool too. Five thumbs up from me....

Donut mind if I eat all the donuts here- I've been here a handful of times and each a 5 star experience. Their creative donuts like the Big Poppa Tart- the size of yo face- it's a donut w a pop tart in it. S'mores flavor is delish! I love the large backyard- a rarity for downtown businesses where I relax w my Vesta coffee or milk. Creme brÃ»lÃ©e and strawberry split are also inventive and vegan too. On this trip I visited with Chef Jeff- whom owns the place along w his brother. His passion for great service and community involvement has made it a must visit !! Open til sold out and sells out quickly on the weekend so get there in the AM!

Don't limit yourself to Fremont St when visiting downtown Vegas - especially at breakfast time. The donut bar is a block away and serves up some pretty righteous gourmet donuts. This aint Dunkin Donuts here - they've got some funky flavors like Reeses Peanut Butter topped with chunks of the candy bar. The flavor is fantastic and they dress em up all fancy like =) And the price is right too. Coffee and a donut here costs less than just a coffee at Starbucks.

SUGAR HIGH! These donuts have to be the fluffiest I've ever had. I'm a fan of the simple, glazed, classic Krispy Kreme donuts BUT this definitely raises the DONUT standards. If you're in the mood for extravagant, flavorful, delicious donuts, try the DONUT BAR. I have to admit, their donuts are huge but worth the try!
What a cute place with such awesome service! The staff is more than helpful and upbeat! I had the coconut Latte and it was the bomb! The donuts are so fun!

I tried these donuts for the first time and they are good but pretty simple. I don't know why the overhype lol but maybe it's just me haha. Big donuts but other than the frosting at the top they are pretty simple and not too flavorful. Might give it another shot and try a different selection
Great place to get some boom donuts from when I found this place I hate eating donuts from anywhere else
Very friendly and helpful staff The selections are great. So many try amd it did not dissappint at all.

DO NOT BUY THE APPLE FRITTERS!!! I'm so disappointed that it was DRY AF...reminds me of a loaf of day old bread but it looks decent until you bite it if I had to describe it in one word it would be REFUND

This place is AMAZING! Go early for largest selection. Extremely huge AND delicious donuts. Carmelized bacon cinnamon roll & the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut were the two I tried. So good! The staff was very happy, welcoming and efficient. Also met owner Joe. Very kind to visit with us a few minutes. We are going back tomorrow to try more.

We attempted getting donuts on the way to Utah. Sold out before 1. Attempt 2 coming back home, we called before 12 and Jeff tells me there's only 12 left. I didn't know they had an online order system to reserve. I told him about my attempts and he said donut worry, well he didn't say that but he was kind enough to set 4 aside of what was left. It felt like Christmas when I picked up. I didn't know what I was getting but I knew it was going to be delicious. Sure enough they were! Chocolate explosion and cake batter for the win. Next time I will definitely order online and get the big poppa. Thank you Jeff/ the staff for your kindness and quality donuts.
The donuts were awesome! Great there early the sell out fast We got the nutella donut it was amazing

Birthday Cake Oreo (8.8) CrÃ¨me BrÃ»lÃ©e (8.6) Strawberry Cheesecake (8.0) Snickers (7.7) Taking the fight to the streets, everyone brought their A game but it's hard to compete with an Oreo stuffed donut. S'mores Pop-tart (8.9) Strawberry Pop-tart (8.6) These two donuts are comparable to Rocky and the Drago in Rocky 4! Only place to do a heavy weight match up like this is in Las Vegas. But not on the strip, throwing it back to the OG Las Vegas at Donut Bar . A healthy flavor like strawberry seems almost impossible to compete with s'mores. But it was a fair fight as we expected. S'mores taking this crown

A cute little donut shop! The creme brÃ»lÃ©e was delightful with its hard sugar shell top and yummy custard filling. The lemon pistachio donut was also surprisingly light with a great lemon flavor. They close when they run out, so get there early!

Don't worry: the calories consumed in Vegas, stay in Vegas ;) Donut Bar Las Vegas is very well-known, but I wasn't searching for this gem when I stumbled across it. In the Fremont Street Experience Area, Donut Bar is a cute, small donut shoppe that was put on the map with its signature Big Poppa Tart donut (it has a PopTart inside of it!). Let me tell you: if you have a sweet tooth, you'll LOVE this donut. It was simultaneously filling and light letting me get my fill without bloating me. In addition, the workers were SO sweet and patient, telling me about all the donuts I had a question about. This place is the MOST recommended foodie destination for anyone visiting Vegas (well, Most Recommended by me, anyways). Love, love, love! Service, donuts, and price are all five stars :)

Spontaneity wins! At 9am on a Thursday, my friend and I decided to check out Donut Bar. There was no line! The photos don't do the donut size justice. The large ones are truly huge and easily split-able, which is great for trying multiple with friends. I tasted 3 "small" donuts: toasted coconut, creme brule, and nutella explosion. They were all great - loved their consistency and Donut Bar's playfulness with the decorations. To top it office, the prices were great! Totally reasonable for a "craze" food, quality, and quantity. What a food adventure! Definitely check this spot out.

My boyfriend and I are traveling from Cali and looked this place up a few days before we got here and were stoked to try it out! We are foodies, even more when it comes to donuts I really wanted to try the Made to order French toast donut but they only do that on Sunday's it's ok, second option in mind was the Big Poppa Tart and we loved it!! We got a few of the other smaller donuts too but these ones forsure lived to what we expected, I didn't want to share it with my boyfriend at all and made him get his own lol customer service was great from the ladies working, it always makes a difference on ones experience when you are greeted properly and with a smile on their face! It can honestly make or break a companies reviews, so big kudos to these ladies starting our day off just right, thank you!!

A good way to start down the road of decadence... Donut Bar offers many varieties of donuts. I must say the creme brulee donut was delicious, while the other donuts were pretty good as well. I got a cappuccino to accompany my donuts, although a regular coffee would have fitted better. The space is pretty small, the glass window allows too much sun (joking), and there is a nice patio out back. Pretty cool place.

This place is amazing! The people are extremely friendly including the owner, all their donuts look delicious and they tasted just as good as they looked! I'm glad I found this place thanks to YouTube.
The donuts are delicious the service is great you can't go wrong with a morning treat from here

I drive through Vegas every summer to go home between LA and Idaho, and this place will be on my essentials Vegas stops list. The hype is incredibly real. Nothing says road trip quite like delicious donuts to fuel you through the long drive up Highway 93. The Big Poppa Tart is truly as delicious as it looks. The most difficult part is truly making a decision about what you want to eat! The donuts are massive and can easily be split or shared. The Homer's Donut was my second favorite. I have a preference for raised donuts, but their cake donuts were also amazing. I do wish they had some gluten-free options, but other than that I am all about these aesthetically pleasing donuts!
I can't say enough about this place! Definitely stop in if your in downtown Vegas...you will not regret it!

This place did not disappoint. As I walked in my mouth was already watery and everything looked delicious. I had to go here and see what the hype was about. You can't go wrong with their desserts here.

We were staying on Fremont street and saw this place coming back from the strip .. we walked the 7 minute walk the next day -- so worth it .. lemon cheesecake filled donut -- amazing Cream brÃ»lÃ©e filled --- ok Salted caramel donut -- super amazing Butterfinger chocolate donut --- greatness Iced vanilla latte -- super good Nitro iced coffee -- amazing Great little place .. the staff was super friendly and fast .. nice and clean inside and had a nice little patio in the back Please go and eat a donut!!

SHORTEST DONUT BAR LINE EVER (3.7 stars) It was shocking to see a 4 person line because the one in San Diego runs out the door and down the street. so many selections.... can i order them all ;P When you can't decide ALWAYS STICK TO THE ONE THAT CAUGHT YOUR EYE FIRST. And that delicious fattening fried batter goes to.... OHH MY BIRTHDAY CAKE OREO It was a very good donut but... I like my donuts with a little more fluff, a lot less sugar, and a custard texture in the middle. This was different. This was a donut with a reconstructed Oreo in the middle, with cake icing on the top with crumbles of Oreo and cake confetti. Sugar sugar and more sugar. If you strip all that and taste the donut, it's actually nothing special without that extra flavoring. The donut itself was dry. Again, good donut... I just have had a really good donut elsewhere that I hold high standards too. I'll be real honest though... donut bar seems to only be good because of the flavoring that covers the donut. Strip all that way and you have a boring stale and dry donut. Until the next review...

SO GOOD AND SO MANY OPTIONS! I had a field day when I walked in here and it took me at least 10 minutes to make a decision. I first tried the Boston cream donut and while it was delicious, it tasted a little bit too fried. I'd get it again but I'd prefer if it weren't as oily. I tried mud pie next and I couldn't stop eating it, it was so good. It has a peanut butter drizzle on it, which I don't like too much, so I'd probably try something different next time but the donut part was so good and not too fried like the Boston cream. I'm obsessed with the look of the homer donut and will have to try it someday. FYI the menu is posted every day on their instagram! Get there EARLY I've heard they have crazy lines. I went around 830 on a Monday and we were the only ones there. I'm sure the weekends are insane.

I've been visiting the Donut Bar for years. My love started at their OG location in San Diego, and trickled over into Vegas. They offer 5 rotating vegan options, but the best part is their #1 best selling donut, the Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e is fully vegan, and no one ever knows. For my kids, not vegan I bring home the classic Oreo birthday cake donut. It's a donut with an Oreo inside, cake frosting, and sprinkles. My dairy eating friends tell me it's heaven. The strawberry shortcake donut is best eaten with two hands. No knife or fork needed, pick that bad boy up and dive in. These are serious donuts meant to be eaten with gusto. The creme brÃ»lÃ©e top will crack when you bite into it, giving your mouth a journey between soft dough, creamy vanilla bean pudding type filling, and a crunchy candy shell. It's phenomenal.
Great tasting food. A must visit if you are in Las Vegas. This isn't your typical donut spot.

Who doesn't love donuts!? This place has it all. A cool sign and tons of options for breakfast... The decor is simple but elegant. I liked the fish aquarium display. I had the bacon bear claw which was huge. I also tried their iced coffee with nitro. Got here as they opened so the line wasn't long yet but it was within 15 minutes. I suggest getting here in the AM to snag parking. Be warned all spots surrounding this place are paid parking... tow trucks circle around and so do the police. You can pull up the the loading/unloading zone and be in and out in a flash. Service was just as good as the donuts. Be sure to take a minute to check out the restroom. You can thank me later. I'll frequent this place moving forward when in Vegas. Be back soon...

These are donuts! OMG. Get the pop tart donut - strawberry was my fave pick out of a dozen we sampled. Staff was super friendly - we even got to meet the owner and Chef Jeff. All donut places should be like Donut Bar.

Credit goes to Say Hi to Matthew for this one. I saw his video about it and heard about the cardboard cutout of him, and I decided I had to go. I am very happy about this decision. The place itself doesn't look like much from the outside, and it is kinda small; there was a line out the door because of the limit of people they are allowed in there. But even standing outside you could smell the donuts. One of the people I was talking to says he goes here every day and recommended the triple chocolate donut. I went with one of those, and the french toast donut, along with a nitro cold brew. Wow. I was seriously amazed by the french toast donut. It came with a side of blueberry compote, and syrup, and was covered in powdered sugar. I sat outside (in the back) and enjoyed it. I took the triple chocolate to go and enjoyed that later on in the day. I honestly wasn't too impressed with the nitro cold brew, but the donuts. Oh the donuts. I'll be back.

We finally made it to DB before they sold out and closed! I've been able to taste their delicious donuts at a Yelp Elite event, but never got to be in their store! We made it in for "happy hour", meaning we were about to get the last of the day's donuts. We ended up with creme brÃ»lÃ©e, cheesecake, apple fritter, blueberry Meyer lemon, strawberry shortcake, and chai. Creme brÃ»lÃ©e was my favorite! The crackle of sugar on the top and filling was just like a creme brÃ»lÃ©e dessert! I probably would've given DB a 5 had I had a fresh batch of donuts, and since we live so far south I'm sad we haven't been able to do that yet!

Donuts galore, people! Donuts galore! I have a major weakness for 3 things: fresh-baked chocolate chip cookies, chocolate fudge cake, and donuts. These donuts are not for the faint of heart! They are 3x the size of a normal donut packing in lots of sweetness and an explosion of flavor! They sold me on the sugar donut topped with homemade whipped cream and strawberries (which I split, rather reluctantly!) while my friend also took a vanilla donut to go. Their donuts are fresh and soft and perfect for the start of a Monday.
Just amazing food. Had lemon pistachio donut, and it's great. Flavors are just right, not exaggerated. Hazelnut coffee wasn't super though.

If you love donuts you will love this! What are you hungry for? a pop tart, pb&j, snickers, twix, French toast? It doesn't matter, chances are they have what you love and have turned it into a donut. How about a huge grilled cheese donut the size of my face (I have a big face)? Yup, they made it. The only problem with their selection is you will over spend and over eat! But that's one of those good problems!

I'm going to start this review with a bold statement. THE BEST DONUTS IN VEGAS. Seriously, the best. Ever. After moving here, I felt like I would never find another good donut again but then I stumbled upon Donut Bar and all my donut dreams have come true. Donut bar just doesn't serve regular plain donuts-- you know those shops that only have cake donuts but they all have different colored frosting. meh. No, this place is the Willy Wonka factory of donuts! Some of my creative favorites are the creme brulee, homer's donut, butterbeer and the big poppa (poptart). Big giant donuts that are completely shareable with some friends, unless you are on that donut diet like I am. If you see a crazy long line, don't leave! The line moves quickly and the customer service is on point. I strategically plan my visit during their happy hour, when they are about to close. You can fill a box for $10 and get all the donuts. Parking can be stressful since it is mostly street parking. Get ready to parallel. But no worries, a cup of their nitro cold brew will make all of your parking troubles go away.

OMD - Oh My Donut! When in Sin City, one must succumb to all of their vices. So when I discovered this sweet, sweet little gem of a donut shop in old downtown Las Vegas, I knew this was one vice I could not resist. But be warned, if you do not come to the Donut Bar before noon, chances are they will be sold out for the day. And trust me, they sell out fast. This place was so good, I had to come twice in two days to try more flavors of their donuts. On my first visit, I ordered the strawberry cream cheese donut and a blueberry donut with Meyer lemon frosting. The donuts were dense but not overwhelmingly so. The strawberry cream cheese was a little too sweet for my liking but had good strawberry flavor throughout the frosting and the donut. The blueberry donut with Meyer lemon frosting was delicious. The flavors were simple but spot on. On my second visit, I opted for the salted caramel donut and the Apple crumb donut. The salted caramel was by far my favorite (that I've tried so far). The Apple crumb was tasty with good apple flavor throughout but a little too heavy for my liking. They have so many flavors to choose from and their flavors appear to rotate almost daily. But like the saying goes, "the early bird gets the worm". Don't be the bird that misses out on these amazing donuts.

Best donuts in town! I've tried numerous donut places around town and this is the best. Pink Box, which comes up a few times as being the best, can't compete. Frankly, I don't get why people rave about Pink Box's dry, overly sugary & non fluffy donuts. Donut Bar serves up really great varieties like the Monte Cristo, creme brÃ»lÃ©e, fresh made raspberry filled, and so on. Worth the drive to downtown!

Having jury duty earlier this month allowed me to drop by Donut Bar for two days straight. First visit-11:30am...choosing from what was left, I tried a Strawberry Cheesecake and a Boston Creme. Both tasted okay, but the chocolate glaze on the boston creme wasn't only excessively sweet but looked dull, not shiny like other donut shops, and the dough part itself was a little more dense for my liking. Gave Donut Bar the benefit of the doubt and decided to catch them earlier the next day. Second visit-7:30am...arriving with a full display, I perused the list and ordered three types of cake donuts: Matcha, Blueberry Meyer Lemon, and The Samoa. I also ordered a Creme Brulee Donut and their special donut of the day, Strawberries and Cream. Best of the batch was the Creme Brulee Donut and the Strawberries and Cream not far behind. The yeast raised donut items here aren't as light and fluffy, but more dense and are alot darker than other shops around town. The cake donuts sound better than they actually tasted and I just took one bite of each and couldn't get passed how DRY each of them were. Couldn't taste matcha or meyer lemon, but sugary sweet(and I got there half an hour after they opened) Service was okay, and price point is kinda iffy with the fact that there are other shops in town that charge less for a better tasting product that won't leave you with buyers remorse. Like that song goes, "I'm a classic man"...I like classic style donuts that light and fluffy, and aren't hidden by thick glazes and don't need the addition of an oreo or pop tart. To me, less is more, and maybe third time's the charm, but for now, I'm in no hurry to rush back. ALOHA!!! Shaka Meter: \uuu/ \uuu/ \uu. 2.5

I have a love for cakes, cookies, pastries and most of all, donuts. Especially on vacation. Because when you are on vacation, everyone knows that all the rules of physics go out the door and any calories you consume are offset by all the walking you do. #truth My first order of business in Las Vegas was to find some delicious donuts other than the Krispy Kreme and Dunkin Donuts variety. Located in downtown Vegas, I found Donut Bar! At the time, I didn't know Donut Bar (original shop in San Diego) was listed as the Number 1 Donut Shop on lists from USA Today, Thrillist.com, MSN and more. But as soon as I walked in, I knew I had found a gem. The donuts they offer are huge, over the top, and look downright amazing! Their most popular is their Big Poppa Tart Donut which is made with a full pop tart and weighs one entire pound! I wanted to try everything, but I decided on three: crÃ¨me brulee, blueberry with meyer lemon, and maple bacon. The crÃ¨me brulee is a yeast donut filled with crÃ¨me topped with a hard candy shell. For those with a sweet tooth, you will love biting into it. For those that like their donuts a little less sweet, the blueberry with meyer lemon is perfect. The cake donut is topped with a perfectly lemony frosting. My favorite was the maple bacon bar. The yeast donut is so soft and topped generously with thick and chewy bacon pieces that paired with the sweet maple frosting like a dream. Mmmmmm.... It's a bit of a gamble as they close when they sell out, but if you visit Donut Bar after 10am, they serve donut ice cream cones!!! I will get one of those one day!
At a donut shop where you can have a line. It is a little bit away from downtown, but definitely go there.

Things go fast, so make sure you arrive early to ensure you get the best selection, because once they're out, they're out. On our first visit, we got here around 8am and there was a good amount of people in line to get donuts. They had everything from creative choices like their version of a Pop-Tart, a variety of sugary cartoon characters, jelly donuts and their take on the classic cake creations. The problem with going first thing in the morning is that your eyes are bigger than your stomach, and you end up ordering a ton. Totally worth it. Nothing beats remembering you have a box of these treats in your hotel room after a day of drinking, or whatever it is you do in Vegas. If you come around 11am, which has been the case on most of our visits, they box up the remaining donuts from the morning and sell them for $10 a pop. You don't get to choose, but it's still a steal if you don't care which ones you get. They also have variations of Stumptown Coffee if you need a caffeine boost. It's offered in hot and cold forms, but the cold brew is my favorite between the two, especially if you're going during the warmer months. Plenty of metered parking on the street and behind the building in a shared lot. If you want to sit and eat, they have some counter space inside, and a shared outdoor area with some tables and chairs too. Totally recommend if you haven't had a chance to check them out in San Diego. They're awesome!

The donuts looks way more appealing than the actual taste. A co-worker brought a bunch into the office. There were literally so much to choose from. Green tea, crÃ¨me brulee, strawberry shortcake, pop tarts in different flavors, blueberry cheesecake, maple bacon, pumpkin spice, cookies n cream, birthday cake oreo and a few others. Some tasted better than others. Donuts tasted fresh and the cake wasn't dried. I had half of the green tea one. No green tea taste to it at all. In fact, it tasted more like a lemon flavored donut with green colored frosting on top. The strawberry shortcake and blueberry cheesecake however, was FABULOUS!!!!!! It really taste like it sounds. I can imagine if you have a major sweet tooth, this place would be heavenly for you. I'm glad I was finally able to try their donuts though. But personally, I'm more of a cupcake kinda gal. Remember...choose your donuts wisely.
Cool staff. Cool looking donuts, but tastes so meh for the price. The small donut places around town with little to no advertisement are still way too superior. 2 stars for presentation!

Awesome place!! AWSOME DONUTS!! Awesome coffee!!!! It's a cops dream place!! We met the owner Joe that is always on "sayhitomathew" on YouTube. Very friendly! We have been to the Vegas and Riverside location and both kick ass! Make sure to get their early because they sell out FAST!! * they do have vegan options

The operating hours are not accurate, they should be updated to reflect that they close when they sell out which is no specific time. I went to take my 8 year old son who loves donuts more than anything, he opened the door to walk in and was confronted by a very much less than friendly lady who dang near closed the door on his foot while saying very unpleasantly "were closed" I tried to ask her what would be the best time to come and she answered "we are open until we sell out!" Still trying to close the door on my son, this doesn't give me a good vibe or a feeling that I want to return when they do open, if your closed that's fine, if your having a bad day fine but learn some customer service skills especially when dealing with children. I will NOT be returning to patronize this business
Such a clean and cute shop. There's a lot of variety to pick from, they close once they're sold out so get there early. The Nutella lovers was well, for Nutella lovers! Loved it

Great place. Donuts are very good and intense. I tried their best seller (i.e the creme brulee) and it was soo good. Worth a try. Also trued their most famous, the big Poppa tart and was good as well, the blue berry jelly was a little sweet if you like really sweet stuff. Stuff were very friendly. Def recommend this place

I'm going to start this off by saying this is my temporary review of Donut Bar. It's October 2nd, 2019, and after an accidental overcharge this morning, I'll be visiting again several weeks from now for some complimentary donuts per the owner and employee named Olivia. I basically only review donut shops. I literally start most days with a donut and coffee, typically a maple bacon variety. I hope my first experience here was just an outlier, and next time is more enjoyable for me. I gave a star for presentation alone, and a star for the fact my sister loved her vegan CrÃ¨me BrÃ»lÃ©e donut. However, I honestly can't give a star for my Brad Fritter. It was almost flavorless at times. I went through large bites of nothing but borderline undercooked dough; which I spit out. It was rather unpleasant considering what I was anticipating. The fritter itself lacked any real sweetness, for such a large and doughy item, it just didn't work. The only sweetness was from the maple glaze; which I was searching for, because it was delicious when present, but it was scarcely drizzled. The item suffered because of this. There was definitely a generous portion of bacon, but again the fritter truly lacked that sweetness to balance that savory. More maple drizzle or a glaze would have done wonders. I might have even powered through the doughy parts. I only ate the bacon and crispy exterior. When I return I'll prob just try the maple bacon bar, or something seasonal, assuming they honor the free donuts. Cheers to second chances in a few weeks or so!

Is the hype real? I'm still sitting on the fence about it, but I've been here a few times (if that says anything)! Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e is definitely my favorite and worth coming back for. I love that they have vegan options! I've tried The Big Poppa and Strawberry Split, which are raved about via social media and they aren't bad but elaborate donuts just aren't my thing. So maybe I'm writing this review from a sort of biased stand point. Customer service is on point! Always. Any time, any day. Chef Jeff is fantastic and I love that he is so involved! You can see him here as soon as they open and even during the last few minutes before they close. That speaks volumes to me. The one thing holding me back from giving it a 5 star review is the texture. They are more bread-like in texture and taste vs a traditional donut. When I think of a donut, I think of an almost fluffy, light, fried piece of heaven. It's not heavy (unless it's a cake donut, which in that case.. YUM) but it's not airy either. Am I making any sense? I hope so. That being said, as aforementioned, I have been a repeat customer and will continue to do so in the future. I have a few more vegan ones to try. Love that their menu changes daily and that they post it on Instagram!

It's soooo good and worth every penny. The only downfall is their hours. I haven't been there since COVID, but I have seen many Instagram posts showing the precautions they have in place. I will be going there again soon. The French Toast donuts and Boston Cream are incredible!

I've tried donut bar before, but I came here for the ice cream donut cone. They don't serve them til after 10 am, so plan accordingly if you want to try it. I also ordered the creme brÃ»lÃ©e and strawberry cheesecake. The creme brÃ»lÃ©e has a hard caramelized top that I think is way too thick. The filling inside was really good, however the donut itself was a little dry. The strawberry cheesecake had an ample amt of filling but the dough was also dry. Onto the reason I came here...the cone isn't really a donut. It's more like a pastry covered in sugar. The soft serve was good, but for $6, would I get it again? No

The giant vegan strawberries and cream donut was so so good. The powdered sugar is still all over my face (and car). The girls at the front were so sweet. I was just going to kind of blindly point at one of the delectable vegan items but instead she asked about flavors I liked and talked me through the options to make sure I picked something I would love. And I did.

I wasn't that happy about the customer service this time. The lady who works there was looking at me from the window the whole time while I was trying to figure out where I can park. So I get down and ask if I can park there. She says no you have to move forward and pay for parking. Even though I was going to be in and out. She was kind of pushy when it came to me ordering. First she says she will help me then she tells me to go to the other lady. They didn't have the French toast donut. We spent 4 dollars on 2 small donuts. They're good but I was not pleased with the service this time. I didn't feel like they were friendly like the people I met before.
One of the best donuts in town, I have tried a few different kinds. One day, I have to go in and try the grilled cheese.

Amazing little hole in the wall of of near Freemont. Staff is really quick and efficient at their job as well as just being plain nice. The donut though...they are just decadence in glaze. These things are huge and tasty as all he'll. The bigger ones are bigger than my hand and the smaller ones about the size of a donut from a franchise chain. I'll be coming back in the future when visiting Vegas.

Their coffee was good and their simple creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut @ $2 was a decent introduction to this place. I walked in on a Saturday morning to find the place alive and buzzing with several excited families seeking donuts for breakfast. Their regular donut options seemed overwhelmingly huge for $5/piece so when I asked them for their smallest donut they pointed me over to the creme brÃ»lÃ©e near the end. Americano took a few mins but was delicious and complex. The creme brÃ»lÃ©e was yummy with a sugar topping that shatters when you bite into it and that custard that's to die for. Worth the random wander off the downtown area but others may find the area too quiet for their own comfort on an early Saturday morning in Feb. Bonus: the driverless shuttle they are piloting has the Donut Bar as a stop!

Warning: you will be overwhelmed by the choices, eat more donuts than you planned, and end up with a oh-so-worth-it bellyache. I can't wait to come back here. I've already started making a list of friends and family that are coming to town so that I can bring them here too (and hopefully have a little more control and spread out the donuts that I want to try). This place is super clean, cute, and we saw both of the owners in on a Saturday morning making the french toast donuts and handing out drinks at the counter. That is one of the greatest things to me to see because it shows me that they're really here and really passionate about their business and I am so excited to go back and support them again and again. Parking is very available near here, with both street parking and a pay-to-park lot directly across the street. When you enter, you are immediately greeted by so many donut options that you will feel a little overwhelmed (so many choices) but don't worry, your donut guide will be with you shortly and will help you pick a great one. I chose the big poppa tart, a donut the size of 2 long johns, filled with a pop tart and jam, and topped with pop tart crumbles and frosting. It was awesome. The donut was super puffy and flakey and even before getting to the pop tart middle, tasted exactly like a pop tart. Next time I really want to try the strawberry split or the french toast donut (which is made to order and served warm). I honestly can't wait to go back. This is a great little local place that is fun for both locals and tourists alike. Just make sure you get up early; when they sell out for the day, they close!

This is the place for donuts!! There's plenty of different kinds to choose from and non doughnut items as well... mmmm Boston creme pie or the cinnamon roll with BACON wrapped inside! There are some massively sized donuts here, my personal favorites are the vanilla bean and carmelized pineapple!! The prices might be higher but you get what you pay for!

Thanks to Danny N. of West Covina, CA for giving me the 411 on this Hot and New business in Downtown Las Vegas! We don't have these fancy 6 inch donuts in Hawaii, so it was a fun discovery for me! We arrived at about 9am and the line was out the door, but it moved quickly since the workers are efficient, skilled, and friendly! We easily found metered street parking right in the front of the shop on Carson Avenue. I ran right in and was done before the meter maid caught me! Oh yeah for "free parking"! Donut Bar is a cozy place where the width of the shop showcases their eye-popping product. There's a row of stools along the counter on the far wall if you want to dine there. The colors, designs, and names of the donuts really intrigued me. It was so difficult to make a decision, but I finally settled on the Caramelized pineapple and the Coconut Dream. .. I'm from the Aloha State and I haven't seen a pineapple donut before. Mmm mmm... it was a delight! The Coconut Dream was even better because it reminded me of a Mounds candy with a thin layer of chocolate between the donut and the coconut layer. Yummy! Both donuts were $3 each. They did leave an oily spot on the wax paper that lined the box... and a bit of an oily feel in the mouth. The donut itself seemed a bit denser and less cakey in texture. I want to go back for the Mexican Hot Chocolate, creme brulee, chocolate bacon, and the Strawberry Split. .. (note: vegan options are available!) I heard that there is a Donut Bar in San Diego. .. oh oh...here we come!

I went to the soft opening and it surely pays not to have a salty attitude because we got great service and a free doughnut! Sweeeet! I've been waiting for this place to open for quite some time now. I've been stalking them on social media and you have to pay attention so you don't miss out - you snooze, you lose! I got a few doughnuts: Caramelized Pineapple, Caramel Latte, Red Velvet, Big Poppa Tart, Samoa, Homer, Apple Fritter, Mexican Hot Chocolate, Nutella, Maple Bacon, Banana Caramel, and Cinnamon Sugar. They're most famous for Homer, Big Poppa Tart, Strawberry Split, and doughnut ice cream cones. I would have to try the Strawberry Split, Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e, and doughnut ice cream come at a later date as they weren't available/ran out. But what I like the most from the ones I did get include Caramelized Pineapple, Mexican Hot Chocolate (sweet, cinnamony...then a spicy note. Yum!), Banana Caramel...Nutella was ok. They have Stumptown coffee, puppy treats, and milk. My pup, Ralf absolutely loved the puppy cookies I got him. Welcome to Vegas!
The world's best donuts! Iced coffee is amazing! Wow I love this place. #LasVegasDonutBar

We came here around 1:30pm on a Sunday and they were closing up and wanted to get rid of the last couple of donuts they had. We had 2 options: BOGO or one box for $10. The box deal was so much more worth it so we ended up getting 16 donuts for $10!!! WHAT A STEAL. Plus if you check in on Yelp you can get either a free Americano or drip coffee. #win Blueberry Lemon - Just okay, but I liked how it wasn't as sweet as I thought it would be. Strawberry Split - Meh. I wouldn't get this again. The donut was just cinnamon and dry (probably because it had been sitting out all day) and the whipped cream inside was dry and tasted like it came from a can. The strawberries were also very plain and it would've been better if they were glazed. CrÃ¨me Brulee - My favorite out of everything I tried. The crunchy glaze on top was cool, and I love filled donuts. After eating half though, the cream inside started tasting artificial like cheap cake frosting so I had to come back to it. Buttermilk Bar - I really liked the consistency of this! Moist and cake-like on the inside and nice and crunchy on the outside. The other donuts look bomb so I'm definitely going to come try some other flavors. I agree that I've had better donuts elsewhere, but this location just opened 3 months ago so maybe their quality will go up. Street parking was easy to find.

The donuts here are unique and tasty, but I am not crazy for them. I like to take friends who visit Vegas here because they have donuts like the Creme brÃ»lÃ©e and pop tart donuts, which you can't just find anywhere, but you won't find a regular glazed here. If you like really sweet donuts, this place is for you. If you like simpler donuts, you might want to find a different place.

Very touristy, been on insider for some of their famous donuts. If you're into some of these creative and sweet donuts than this is the place. Perfect place for a sweet tooth Only issue is that it's a pretty penny for a donut itself. And in the heart of the old Las Vegas strip. Can grab some breakfast and head down there for some sigh seeing.

I have been looking for a great donut place in LV for the past couple months. After maybe hours of YouTube suggestions, I decided on the Donut Bar. We were staying at a downtown hotel and decided to have a donut for breakfast. As soon as you walk into the store, you are immediately overwhelmed with the amount of choices you have! After carefully deciding, we went with 1 creme brulee and 1 Boston creme. The BC was just alright, nothing special just your average Boston creme donut. Now the creme brulee was awesome! The best part was hearing that crunch when pulled apart. I may have to figure out how to bring some back home.

Over sized, over priced and under whelmed. It's donuts. No matter what you do on top of a donut you'd better have a good recipe for the donut to start. Not here.. typical Vegas, inferior starting place topped with everything else and over charged. Couldn't get a simple iced mocha right either. Don't bother.
Wonderful donuts are made to be fancy and traditional. Excellent staff and great music playing!

MIND BLOWN! I am so impressed with how delicious, fluffy, and chewy their donut are. I bought the cake batter, blueberry cheesecake, Nutella, samoa, Homer's donut, and the red velvet donuts. I came in around 11 AM during their soft opening and there were quite a few good choices left. Unfortunately the strawberry split & Oreo one was sold out but that's okay because what I got was tasty! Donut Bar compared to other donut shops around town is their HUGE donuts ($4 each), and unique ones like the Oreo inside the donut, the pop tart inside the donut, and hopefully the donut cones soon (well that's what they advertised on their Instagram). The dough is exceptionally chewy, moist, the toppings are even & proportionate, and most importantly the frosting isn't overly sweet. I definitely recommend this place, just come early so you have more options!

If there's one thing I love, it's fancy donuts! So knowing that I'd be in Vegas I was already doing my Yelp research on the best place to grab the best donut. Before I even left my house I had Donut Bar bookmarked. I was staying on the Strip, but luckily our friends had a rental car and agreed to drive us to Fremont for breakfast on Sunday morning. Street parking was plentiful at 9am and Donut Bar was super easy to find. We walked in and were immediately hit with the amazing aroma of fresh donuts and I was thrilled to see the variety available. The four of us picked out 5 donuts, and the friendly employee being the counter recommend we try out the french toast donut, so we added that to our order as well. Everything I tried a bit of was absolutely delicious, but the creme brulee donut blew my mind with how good it was! And I think it's vegan too! I hit my sugar quota early on and threw in the towel, but boy was I kicked myself later in the day for not ordering more to go! Next Vegas trip, I'm definitely planning on returning to try more!

I ran my first 5K this morning! Just kidding...I'm on my third donut. Went on Sunday 5-1-16 at 11:30AM to grab some donuts. I ordered four donuts. Don't judge me. For $16 we got four donuts and two drip coffees. $4.00 "big poppa tart" is a ginormous donut which looks like a poptart on the top. You need a fork and knife for this! It's kinda greasy but fluffy and filled with a generic cheap-tasting jam. $3.00 "DB's nutella donut" is a standard donut with chocolate on top and what I think was crushed nuts. It was fluffy, huge, and nicely yeasty. It didn't taste much like Nutella to me. $4.00 "strawberry split" is a huge donut dusted in sugar, split down the middle, and filled with cream and fresh strawberries. The donut itself was kinda boring but the strawberries were ripe and juicy. The cream they use is the super-white kind that never melts....kinda like the type they use on the desserts at Golden Corral. It doesn't taste good and I'm sure it's not good for you. I'd pass on this one next time, even though it's very pretty. $3.00 "Pb & J" is a vegan jelly-filled donut with peanut butter glaze on top. My husband really liked this one. They gave my son a free donut...it was a round one with a red face on it...maybe it's a character from a cartoon or something? I'm not sure cuz' my son is two and hasn't started watching TV yet. It was a very nice gesture on their part! We both got drip coffees which were actually good but they only had regular sugar, sugar in the raw, and stevia. Gimme some splenda or nutrasweet, ya hippies!!! Let me kill myself slowly with artificial sweeteners. Usually donuts give me heartburn but I felt fine all day after gorging myself on these donuts. I'll be back to try the creme brulee donut! This place will definitely do well because they are catering to the hipster vegans and they have unique donuts. I had a lot of leftovers since the donuts are so big but they ended up in the trash...which means they weren't very good because I will gladly eat a krispy kreme donut that is 4 days old that i found on the ground somewhere.

Located in downtown Las Vegas near Fremont Street, this donut shop is cranking out the most mouth watering, unique donuts I have come across! Walking into the shop you can smell the coffee and the donuts being freshly baked. The donuts are displayed behind a glass from almost top to bottom and all look amazing. There is a little sign that tells you all of the flavors - there are a lot! The service here is great and they answer all your questions for you and are also REALLY patient - since there are so many options it is definitely hard to choose just a few. - Creme Brulee Donut - THIS IS A MUST GET! The crack of the hard sugar shell and the custard on the inside all inside a soft donut.. yes, please. ($2) This is a little bit smaller than some of the other selections, but you do not need much since it is very sweet and rich. - French Toast Donut - another favorite, light, airy, and the perfect balance between a donut & french toast. Also comes with syrup, butter, and jam ($5) - Birthday Oreo - A birthday cake donut with an oreo inside - this is the same size as the creme brulee donut - Caramel Latte Donut - This one is huge! The frosting is exactly like a caramel latte - Big Poppa Tart Donut - ALSO HUGE! Looks just like a huge pop tart and has strawberry filling on the inside. - Burning S'more (or something to that name?) - looked fancy and tasted like a fancy s'more. If you like s'mores, you'll like this. Serve Stumptown coffee here and make great Americanos. All our donuts and our coffee cost about $28 (this includes tax and tip) and we got two of each of the creme brulee and birthday donuts. The smaller donuts are less expensive and the bigger more expensive, but totally worth the splurge (might as well on donuts instead of losing it gambling, right?) Can't wait to come back!

So 200 plus reviews later not sure anything else can add.....but here we go anyway. I am just about positive am the last yelper that I know in Vegas that finally checked out Donut Bar. I noticed recently Donut Bar has started to open maybe once month or random times at night. So was like NICE finally get to try the pop tart and the creme brÃ»lÃ©e. All the videos seen of the creme brÃ»lÃ©e and one of the stables pop tart looked delicious. I do love my donuts from time to time. I heard that generally there a line when first open and the earlier get here the better. The later you come not really the best idea cause they make only so much donuts everyday and by the end slim pickings (truth nothing worst then stale donut). I got down little earlier because not sure where the place was and parking downtown flat out sucks. Honest if you park near Donut Bar they have self pay parking meters. If ur lucky depending time of day its SUPER easy and cost is cheaper then paying any hotel or parking structure. Dollar on the meter gives you hour. More then enough time (maybe if the line is long then that another story). I was surprise but the line was not that bad only four people ahead of me. Just the fact there was LINE for donut shop still blows my mind. Donut Bar does carry strong name brand. Chef Jeff is not only a passionate owner. The guy knows his donuts and all positive vibes. The minute he open the door greeting all five or six of us come on in. Friendly, all smiles, and love the atmosphere. The smell was awesome minute walked in!!! Fresh batch of donuts, the display case truly gives the donuts even more eye candy, the diversity crazy (oversize homer donut, rectangle pop tart, small circle creme brÃ»lÃ©e, traditional size ones but nothing traditional with the flavors or colors, and untraditional ones with donut cones fill with ice cream or strawberry split), and it long line of donut goodies. You might forget the selection at the top of the line. The place is small so gets filled up fast if want sit down. It located literally next to Carson Kitchen or look for the famous Donut Bar sign outside. The stumpton cold crew deserves shout out. I never had that brand before. I decided try the coconut flavor cold brew in carton. It was perfect compliment go with the donuts. They have other flavors. I believe one was chocolate and the other not sure. They also offer it on tap if you like. The donuts the pop tart is HUGE. If one person can eat one that pretty good. The way pop tart melting into the donut not sure if tasted any of the crust associate with pop tart. The filling you know if fan of pop tart is true and true. The icing and the goodies on top just pushed it sugar overload. I loved it. The creme brÃ»lÃ©e was good. I think that one better eat it on the spot cause the longer it sits the crack on top break it apart. Rock solid. I had fill out my box was got strawberry split. The strawberries was fresh, juicy, and I keep thinking strawberry shortcake.

We came here after having a late brunch at eat across the street. They were about to close and had a $10 for box of donuts deal !!! SCORE. I've been to the donut bar in SD on a weekday morning when they had more selection, but this time i still got to try some donuts I wanted to try. We ended up with about 15 donuts, including the lemon blueberry (delicious ), a massive strawberry sugar whipped cream, strawberry pop tart donut, creme Brulee, chocolate buttermilk bar, and chocolate bacon. Check in gets you a free drip coffee or espresso !! The staff here is super friendly and welcoming, and I would definitely come again because they have lots of different flavors to try and it never gets boring.

Donut Bar is located a block from Fremont Street Experience and their donuts are simply amazing. I've tried to come mid morning but every time they were sold out. I suggest you come as soon as they open to get exactly what you want because they do sell fast. I tried the sprinkled Oreo stuffed donut and my oh my was it good. They have a ton of selections and I highly recommend them. I defiantly see why they were voted the best donuts in Vegas.
I read about this place and I knew I had to try it when I went to Vegas. There were so many choices it was hard to pick just one. The coffee and donuts were amazing. Try the Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e one.

I like my donuts, just look at my Yelp reviews. I visit donuts shops or bars or store fronts often. The ambience is great, the decor is definitely interesting, even the bathroom is painted with Homer Simpson and his donut. If you're a fan of the show Tanked, then the fish tank if the lobby will interest you because it's one of theirs. Their donuts are definitely a site to behold, all creatively decorated and looking delicious. However, I have had better donuts. I got a Wonder Woman donut, it was cute and it was good, but it wasn't really anything to rave about. My friend got a donut too, but her's was dry. Like take a but and crumbs everywhere dry. I don't think that should be the case when you eat donuts. So it's a cool place to see, but I don't know if I would make the effort to go back.

Why O Why O WHY do I love this place so much??? Every donut I have ever had was delicious! It is like their basic donut recipe is so good that whatever they do after that is just an enhancement on perfection! My absolute favorite is the oreo stuffed donut-my mouth is watering remembering the last time I had one. The Poppa Tart is so unique and delicious and I am thinking it is made to be shared but....ya know...sometimes it just has to be hidden from your family and eaten bit by bit all day long :-) My first experience with the donut bar was their happy hour; they were close to closing time and did a happy hour where an entire box of donuts was $10. We had no idea the joy we were about to experience. Since that day I often drive by the donut bar hoping to catch another happy hour but it seems like they are often sold out by the time I come by. Next week I plan to make a special trip for the weekend French toast donut, you can bet I will go early for that one! Overall the donut bar is outstanding with a friendly and comfortable ambiance. I highly recommend this place.

Donut Bar... home of the biggest donuts I've ever seen. They are pretty darned tasty too. I have visited here a few times. The service is always friendly and there is always many choices. My favorite is the chocolate euphoria. Chocolate curls, delicious frosting, and light, fluffy donut. Today's visit I got a mud pie, lemon pistachio, and cake batter. The lemon pistachio was refreshing. The glaze was light and just tart enough. It had a sprinkling of pistachios. Perfect balance. The mud pie was chocolaty deliciousness. I didn't try the cake batter but it did look yummy. I recommend Donut Bar for a sweet treat. Bring your friends though because the size definitely makes them shareable!

Overall: great variety, fluffy donuts, great atmosphere This place is right by the smoothie place we went to for breakfast, so we decided to stop here for a treat after. They have a great variety of donuts and unique flavors like creme brulee. We got the blueberry lemon cake donut and the creme brulee donut. The creme brulee donut had a bruleed sugar top and a vanilla pastry cream filling. It was amazing! The donut was a perfect fluffy texture, and the filing was very creamy, and the bruleed sugar had a nice crunch. The blueberry lemon donut was great as well. I find that sometimes cake donuts can be dense, but this one was perfectly fluffy and had the perfect amount of icing on the top, so it was not overly sweet and sugary. To top it off, their bathroom has the cutest murals of Homer Simpson and his pink sprinkle donut!

Just stopped by for a snack and I was blown away. First, the theme is great. Second, there is such a huge assortment of options to choose from it's overwhelming. I opted for the spiced chai donut which was $3 and delicious. Very flavorful and the actual donut wasn't greasy, but instead light and airy. We got two coffees which were also on point. I will be back- especially with the awesome and shaded outdoor area perfect for the Vegas weather

I was indifferent towards Donut Bar until I tried the creme brulee donut. It's vegan and I had no idea until someone told me the second or third time I ordered it. I end up walking here from my office at least once a week now. It might take a few tries because there is such a large selection, but this place will have at least one donut you'll love. The coffee is what keeps me coming back though. Coffee & donuts are like peanut butter & jelly! There's hot self-serve drip coffee that is solid and the cold brews are on point.

If you eat with your eyes, this is the place for you. The shop was charming and the staff very attentive. The toppings were creative. However, I found that despite the delicious descriptions and appealing looking donuts, the taste of these donuts was So So. Perhaps I selected the wrong donuts, but I found that the donut base was cakie and did not complement the toppings. However, the coffee was excellent

I've been to Vegas quite a few times, but never have I searched out for a breakfast or donut place. For some reason I did this time and it was probably the best decision of my life!!! Quite possibly the best donuts (gourmet) that I have ever had. Located downtown, near Fremont Street (sp). By the time we got there on a Saturday morning, maybe 9am, I guess their signature strawberry shortcake or whatever was sold out :( but we were able to try some amazing other donuts. 1. CrÃ¨me brulee - they try and immolate the real dessert, and it doesn't disappoint. I normally don't like cream filling donuts, but this was light and sweet all that the same time. 2. Oreo / Bday cake - tasted just like it sounds 3. Some sort of strawberry filled donut All three were amazing, coming from a chocolate and glazed kind of guy. The even more amazing thing is that they only cost around $2-3, so hopefully they don't raise their prices, bc that is an insane deal! There are some higher end donuts near where I live and they definitely don't hold a candle to Donut Bar!! It will probably now become one of my Vegas staples!!

These donuts were delicious!!! The customer service was over the top great!! The little court yard out back gave us a nice place to eat without being in other's space! I am sad were not in Vegas long enough to go twice! I would highly recommend this place! Be mindful that they are only open until they sell out!
Awesome fun place !! Music was playing the the staff was friendly!! Donuts were sooo yummy and full of flavor and the size was huge !!

I woke a little early to make sure I didn't miss the infamous French toast donut and it did not disappoint. Dropped in this morning around 9 am and ordered a variety of donuts and of course the French toast "only sold on weekends" and it was absolutely yummy!!! Highly recommend if you in the mood and in the area!

I came across this place while looking for places to eat before I got to Vegas. Their Instagram intrigued me, so I made it a point to stop here while I was in town. The staff was incredibly friendly and super helpful the entire time I was there. Their donuts are simply the best I've ever had. The flavors are impeccable, the dough is so soft & everything you'd want from a donut. I was a little bummed they only make the French toast and grilled cheese ones on the weekends, but I'll just have to make another trip.

I wanted so much to love this place! But for the price and taste, 3 stars is as high as I can go. Pros: fantastic service - staff were friendly and knowledgeable Cute shop - set up/ decor Ginormous donuts and vegan choices Free Jiggly puff donut for my son Vegan apple fritter was yummy Cons: Aside from the apple fritter the donuts were just ok. For the elaborate toppings the actual donuts were alright, nothing special. Price varies per donut...I paid $18 for 6 donuts ( vegan: 2 creme brulee, 1 strawberry split, 1 apple fritter, 1 cake batter, 1 chocolate euphoria, and a free Jigglypuff donut) Music was a bit loud and it made it hard to hear donut descriptions and specials from the staff Had this place bookmarked for a while and decided to try it out. Apple fritter was good...probably only donut I would go back for.

Came to visit! They close super early but we came here around noon for our donuts. First time here and they offered us a $10/ box donut. We filled the entire box up with whatever donuts we wanted, and it was amazing that they still had the poppa tart donut which I wanted to try. I took a giant bite out of it, and it was so yummy! It would've been better if I heated it and the glaze was melty and warm. I recommend heating it up though. Overall, I loved the strawberry pop tart donut even though it was so big I couldn't finish it and only ate a quarter and saved the rest for later! It was delicious and I would definitely eat it again.

Just as good as the San Diego location! We get a lot of well known eateries from other cities opening in Vegas. Not all of them live up to the hype. Donut Bar definitely does. I came in around 11 am during their soft opening. There was a short line that moved quick. I was getting donuts for a few people so picked a good variety: Caramelized Pineapple, Caramel Latte, Cake Batter, Mud Pie, Red Velvet, Samoa, Chocolate Twix, Blueberry Cheesecake, Banana Caramel and Apple Fritter. Half went to work with Hubby and half came home with me. It is hard to pick a favorite but if pressed I would say the Caramel Latte and Samoa were the faves out of the ones I tried. They post the next days flavors the night before on social media. Check it out before you go so you have an idea of what you want. They are listed in store too but the line moves quick so be ready. Not all of the varieties fit on the counter so don't miss a flavor because you didn't read the list. Don't forget a drink. They have Stumptown Cold Brew, Nitro, Chocolate and Strawberry Milk on tap. See you in line.

First time here. Straight from the airport. Saw the hype on yelp and facebook. No line and plenty of parking. Close to downtown. Only got a few.. their creek brÃ»lÃ©e is a signature item. Hard crispy sugar shell. Yeast insides with custard filling. Looked good. I had the strawberry pop tart which has an actual pop tart inside. Yeast around the pop tart. It was good but not the best ever. A bit dry. This put them on the map. Had the Meyer lemon blueberry cake donut. Wow! It was delicious. I could've eaten maybe 5. Crispy edges. Moist and soft inside. Bursting with blueberry flavor in the cake. Nice lemon flavor icing. Not too sweet. I would get again if in walking distance. It's a bit overwhelming as there are so many options and I wanted to try so many. Also got a Hawaiian coffee and it was very tasty. Staff was very friendly. Recommend if you are a donut fan.

Believe the hype! Most novelty places don't give good portions or decent prices, but Donut Bar is jot one of those places. All their menus items are well worth the price and that's not including the atmosphere with the backyard and hole-in-the-wall set up. They offer vegan options and non vegan options worh some specials on certain days. The French Toast donut on the weekend is my favorite!!

I met a friend here to play catch up and try their vegan doughnuts. It's located on 6th and Carson and parking is plentiful... bring change or a credit card. All parking is metered. I walked in and was greeted by a super friendly staff. Everyone was so nice and welcoming. My friend was there waiting with a vegan green matcha tea doughnut, a creme brÃ»lÃ©e, and a apple fritter. We headed outside to the court yard and went to town. The apple fritter was the best donut I've ever eaten. It was crispy on the outside and soft and warm on the inside. There was real apples scattered throughout the donut. The green matcha tea was a delicious cake donut that wasn't overly sweet and had orange zest. It was delicious. The creme brÃ»lÃ©e was soft and oozed out a delicious and thick creme. I was thoroughly impressed... in fact... it was happy hour when we were done so I got an entire variety box for 5 dollars and gave them to my family and friends. This is definitely my new favorite donut place. I can't wait to come back and try more of their vegan options!

We have gotten donuts there a few times, and its sooooooo good! I wish their hours were better, but man is it good when I can get it. The donuts always have a good taste, well made, and worth every penny you spend on them. My mother was the one that told me about them, and while I wasn't too sure about it at first, my doubts were proven wrong.

If I could give this place more stars, I would. It's been hyped as The Best Donuts In The World and they live up to the name. We stayed in downtown Vegas for 5 days and we had breakfast 3 of the days here at DonutBar. Everything we bought and ate was delicious. Some of the donuts are oversized and I expected them to be hard but they were soft and fluffy. Great flavors in each one we tried. If you live here or visit here, you HAVE to come to DonutBar. And not just once, come a few times to try them all.

My first experience with Donut Bar was at at Yelp event where I tried their pumpkin filled yeast donut and it was pretty disappointing. The dough wasn't as perfectly light as I like. And I really prefer for the entire donut to have a thick layer of glaze - this did not. Also, the filling was barely sweetened and basically tasted like butter. However, after brunch at eat. I figured I might as well stop by and give it another chance. This time I knew not to get a yeast donut and to try the cake instead. I went with one Strawberry Cream Cheese and one Apple Crumble. The latter was nice, but the Strawberry was even better because it was super sweet and flavorful. (In case you couldn't tell, I expect as much sugar as possible.) But both were moist on the inside (the Strawberry even had little juicy specks of red) and the outside had a nice thick glaze. I went on a Saturday and there was a line to the door that moved at a pretty decent speed. There was a big family behind me and I believe I heard someone behind the counter say that kids get a free donut on Saturdays. Pretty cool! Does my three month old count? Haha!

3 stars... This place was recommended by local friends so we were sure not to miss it. There was a short line to get into the joint so we had high expectations. I got the Nutella and my wife got the salted caramel. Both were good and were large donuts. Ambiance is stripmall cafe, service was friendly, and prices are slightly above expectation. Not sure we picked the best of show, so at first glance this joint does not make the list, but we will definitely give them another shot next time we visit! We will be back!!

Holy sh!t....... This place is fantastic!! The staff was all extremely nice. They gave suggestions and offered up what their favorites are. We got a managers special box for $10!! When we were done we realized we missed some donuts and the owner GAVE us another box for free! We ordered two cold brew coffees (YA THEY HAVE COLD BREW COFFEE!) then my wife changed her mind to an iced mocha. They served us the second cold brew by accident but would not take money for it even after we tried to pay several times. The donuts are mind blowing! I will return multiple times every time I'm back in Vegas!!

Looking for a place that delivers creative and delicious donuts?! Look now further because this is your place !! I hope they bring this a little closer to the strip because that would be a game changer. I went to brunch a couple of miles away from this location and thought - I'm on vacation ... I need donuts. This place did not disappoint. Make sure you get there early if you want a lot of options because this small joint is so popular that it sells out quickly. Oh and guess what ?!?! They have vegan donuts tooooooooo and a selection of coffee to pair your sweet donut with. I actually tried a cinnamon roll and it was the bomb dot com. Okay moment of truth, I actually ordered from here two more times during my stay from Uber Eats because they were just that good. And guess what else ?! My favorite donut actually turned out to be the began creme brÃ»lÃ©e!!! Please visit this place and try as many donuts as you can- you will leave stuffed but wanting more.

This is a new-wave doughnut place which has a an interesting range of different and unusual doughnuts plus an attractive and well-thought-out decor but where the doughnuts often seem mostly to look better than they taste and don't seem to taste as interesting as the ideas would indicate. We tried a range of different ones, including maple bourbon, Homer, mud pie, and creme brulee. Of these, one of the best was the Homer, despite the fact that it was huge and seemed likely just to be plain and sweet (and seemed more of a novelty and likely to be characterless). The Homer actually had the best "doughnut" flavour with good fried-dough character and the icing was actually nice, not just plain sweet. The creme brulee and maple bourbon just seemed bland and unexpectedly just sweet with little other character. The mud pie was pretty good. I'd try this again when in downtown Las Vegas but though it seems a worthy effort so far it is not nearly on the same level as other doughnut places I've been to.

Yummy yummy. Super nice staff. Ordered the birthday cake donut. After trying my family members choices, mine was by far the best. Fluffy donut with an Oreo inside. Had the cold brew which woke me up right away. Happy we found this place on yelp. #memories :)

These donuts are good! You need to come early because they sell out only after a few hours from opening! I went on a Monday around 11:45am and they only had $10 donut boxes aka happy hour. You select a box which contains 12 donuts; a great bargain and each box has a good selection. You just can't pick which donut goes in a box; staff already has them ready. It's a steal cause some of the specialty donuts like the Big Pappa Tart is $5. If you're in Vegas it's worth a trip down to Donut Bar and you can take in the sights and sounds of Fremont St. Delicious donuts, good coffee, clean interior and friendly staff makes me want to come back every time I visit Las Vegas.

So I've been here three times now and like a fine wine, it just keeps getting better with every passing day. The Donut Bar has been killing it since day one here in Vegas, by staying true to classic fried delights of my childhood, but also upgrading a few of the sprinkled covered favorites. I've tried good portion of the offerings here, but the real standouts for me are the coconut covered donut, The Old fashioned, the peanut butter chocolate, the Pop-Tart donut, and a classic pink frosted donut simply dubbed, "The Homer". Every bite is soft; flavor packed and melts in your mouth. The icing on all of these gorgeous bakery beauties is made in house along all the donut fillings, no store bought stuff here. This process of making in everything in-house really helps to keep the quality on point; three visits later and the donuts have the same mouthwatering consistency. I will keep traveling here for these amazing donuts all the way from Henderson which wasn't the case for O' Face, R.I.P. Sorry, but a dry donut that's lavender and lemon flavored just wasn't for me, especially when they cost close $6 a piece. If you simply can't decide on what calorie bombs to order, just have the people behind the counter put together a half for you, trust me it will be amazing. Don't forget the coffee, they have Stumptown Nitro Brew on tap along with chocolate and strawberry milk being tapped daily as well. That's enough right there to visit this place. Donuts. Just do it!

I walked in with all three of my children as usual mask required sticker marker on the floor for social distancing. The people who work their are super friendly. Vegan donuts bomb AF. They have vegan options for iced coffee too. Sit down dining is outside only. They have chocolate milk for the kids. I forgot to take pictures but we liked the vegan strawberry one the most

If there was an option to put more than five stars, I would. Got a baker's dozen donuts which was more than enough. I am not a fan of the designer donuts trend... but this place blows Pinkbox and O Face out of the water. We tried all the 'fun varieties' including the delicious and decadent S'mores pop tart donut. My colleague loved the vegan creme brÃ»lÃ©e one the best even not as a vegan. I loved the maple bourbon and the caramel latte one the best. Absolutely delicious and welcome to Vegas. PS if you buy twelve they give you a free donut!

Love this place!! I've been here twice and both visits proved that quality is consistent. I went with the peanut butter donut and the maple bacon one and although more cake like than donut, both were delicious and worth the visit. I came late in the day on the second visit as I was with my brothers, so the selection was still good, but not everything was available. My brother loved the Nutella donut and the cream pie eclair was a hit with both of them. Coffee was strong and will definitely wake you up! Check out the new fish tank they installed in October 2016 and this is no ordinary tank. It's filled with donut shaped ornaments that almost look like the real thing. How clever! We'll definitely be back and maybe even try the french toast donut next time. This place is a hit as far as I'm concerned. Parking is on the street and is metered, but I can't see anyone staying more than an hour in this place. They are open until 1 pm or until they sell out of donuts, so for the best selection, get there early. Mmmm....can't wait to go back!!

This is such a cool and unique donut place. We stopped in on a Saturday morning to check it out. They gave a free character decorated donut to our son which I believe they do on saturdays. My wife and I tried the Nutella, pop tart and Oreo birthday donut. They were all very good and very filling. The donuts are a bit more expensive than a store donut, but they are worth it given the quality and size of the donuts. Give it a try if you're in the area but go early they sell out most days.

Loved donut bar. It was an honor to meet Chef Jeff. Thank you once again for having me. You must try their famous grilled cheese and creme brulee donuts. I also really liked the Nutella explosion. The caramel latte donut is another honorable mention. If you get only one thing you must get the big poppa tart. It is incredible, probably the best donut I ever had! It has a pop tart with jam inside of it! Congratulations to Donut Bar on 2 years and once again thank you for having me!

This place had an assortment of different kinds of cool donuts. The interesting thing is that their hours say an opening time, but instead of a closing time it says they close whenever they sell out of product for the day. That ensures they are fresh everyday and don't sell day old donuts. It's a small shop, and can get pretty hectic when it's breakfast or lunch time, so prepare to wait in line. Donuts were very moist and full of flavor.

The donuts played a trick on my tastebuds, the looked good but were dry and no flavor. I was really disappointed because the came so highly recommended.
