I tried the Strawberry split, apple fritter and their creme brulee, all three were dry and had very little flavor. Their Hawaiian coffee was watered down. The patio seating in the back was fantastic but the donuts and coffee sadly ended up in the trash.

3.5* doughnuts. I just ordered these on Uber eats. First impression was that the doughnuts are really big! Then I took a bite and was a bit disappointed. Not the "best doughnuts in the world" like their box claims. I've had far better, fresher and softer dough at Donut Mania or Glaze. Just ok!

I love the donuts here! They always have different flavors. The Nutella one is my favorite but it can be overwhelming. I feel that they have a flavor for everyone. You always have to go early to have a variety to choose from since they sell out so quickly, usually by noon.
This place was totally not worth the trip . Donuts were dry and tasteless . They looked good but lacked in flavor. And definitely overpriced.
Jasmine was amazing and so helpful when we stopped in on a Saturday! She educated us on all the donuts and what they had to offer. We will definitely be making our way back!
I was speechless! Everyone was so friendly and helpful. There are so many to choose from I had to take it all in for a minute. Then I went crazy It will be a staple in my Vegas trips no doubt!

I've been here twice during my travels to Vegas and I've lucked out on skipping long lines when I've visited. I follow them on Instagram, which I would suggest to anyone interested in going, as they always have updated menus and will let their customers know of any new donuts. I've tried a variety of their donuts: creme brÃ»lÃ©e, bacon cinnamon roll, strawberry cream, French toast and more. French toast donuts are only available on weekends and those are must-haves! They also have a homemade strawberry milk which reminds me of when I had strawberry Quik as a kid. :)

Most amazing shop in town for great donuts and stellar coffee - I go there weekly with my kid in Saturday's and he loves it talks about it all week. He's addicted and I'm addicted to his happiness there. Amazing confections on top of amazing fluffy donuts. Get there. Get some before they sell out daily. Sell out is by noon on weekends 2pm other days. 5 star superior choice.

I have a love/hate relationship with Donut Bar. Unquestionably, the donuts are good. Are they worth $5 a piece? Definitely not. Donut Bar has an excellent variety and without a doubt grade A marketing. I'll literally be scrolling through Instagram, see a photo of their donuts, and instantly begin prioritizing my need to drive all the way downtown to pick up a French Toast donut. In comparison to other donut shops throughout the valley, Donut Bar offers a variety of vegan donuts, made to order options, and some very "creative" choices- such as the "Big Poppa tart", a donut literally stuffed with a pop tart. As for the quality- arguable. Yes, they open super early and obviously if you get there later in the day they won't be as "fresh"- but hey, if I'm getting a "stale" donut it seems obscure to pay $4 or $5 for it. Definitely think they need a price adjustment. Flavor is a 10/10. In all the times I've been to donut bar I can honestly say I've never not loved the taste of any of their donuts. My most favorite would have to be the strawberry shortcake and the Oreo birthday cake- both absolutely delicious! The employees are also very kind and are very quick to give recommendations. I've been here super early at opening to when they were just about sold out and have always experienced exceptional service. Overall, Donut Bar is great- I'd just recommend an early arrival and preparation to pay upwards of $30 for a half dozen donuts.

The good: service was great! The Filipino girl at the front line is a great ambassador. She's really warm and super helpful. And despite getting our drink order wrong, she was apologetic and quickly made good on their error. The not so good: the donuts are okay. Great novelty flavors, names and combos. But none it them really knocked our socks off. They make for great photos but none of them made me feel like I had to go out of my way to come back here. I didn't realize it's the same franchise as the Donut Bar in San Diego.
Five stars for me based on the vegan options:) Everyone is always really nice, they have quite a variety of vegan and non vegan options. Definitely get there early.
Super delicious donuts. Make for a great sweet pick-me-up when downtown. Friendly staff and within walking distance of all the downtown hotels.

Love this place! Donut heaven!! This place never disappoints! There were so much to choose from....ya just can't have one! So it took us a few turns here and there...but then.....(Angels singing) ahhhhhhh! Let the gluttony begin.

Even though Donut Bar is brand new to the Las Vegas area, I've been twice already Haha. They are killing it! I've heard people say it is the old location of O-face donuts? Not positive about this because I never went to O-face. Anyways the original location of Donut Bar is from San Diego, really glad they brought it to downtown Las Vegas. I have to say I was pretty impressed, they had Stumptown coffee! I am a bit of a coffee snob and Stumptown coffee has got to be my favorite. They serve Stumptown at the famous Voodoo Doughnuts in Seattle/Portland area to give you a better idea of how serious this coffee is. The outdoor patio seating behind Donut bar is also on point! Very spacious and surrounded by artwork. However, the customer service was a bit lacking to me. I felt pretty rushed to order by the girl behind the counter. She almost seemed annoyed that we didn't automatically know what we wanted to order. Pros: vegan options, outdoor patio seating, Stumptown coffee, cool bathroom decor, amazing coffee selection (nitro cold brew coffee on tap), location Cons: Small space (wouldn't like dining inside), really loud music for early morning, close at 1 pm or until all sold out, have to pay for parking (only a $1 but still), customer service Vegan donuts you must try: Banana Caramel, Strawberry split, Creme Brule Tip** for every dozen donuts you buy, you get 1 free. All in all, pretty cool addition to the downtown Las Vegas area. Definitely recommend people to go check out this mouth watering new donut shop!

I was reading all the good review and finally try this place drive thru .The guy who help was not helpful since it was may Firs-time.I order 1 dozen and he fid not even ask me what Flavor I like he just decide for me and charging me $35 bucks .so he gave me the special flavors and regular and the special flavors request punch in but different from the box ..dishonest person .. The cheese cake was good .My kids does not like it..My first and last to this donut place..Nextime ,I just get winchells donuts ..
Great coffee! Yummy donuts .. my favorite was the creme brÃ»lÃ©e! Will try it again next time! So many flavors to chose from.

At the time of this review, this place surprisingly does not have a line out the door. They have many, super good items here. My favorites were the maple bacon donut with super good chewy dough in the middle, and the churro cone soft serve ice cream. These two items were incredibly orgasmic. Do yourself a favor and go to Vegas for this. Do it now. Please.

This place is awesome. Coffee is good and huge variety of donuts. They were super kind to give my daughter a free "birthday donut" when they found it was her birthday. So many yummy ones to recommend.

This place is so cute. And their dounut are OMG!!! AMAZING!!! Came from California and my son girl wanted to come and check it out. My kids all woke up early just to see what the fuss was all about. And the fuss was all so worth it!!!

If you're a donuts fan, this is a must-stop shop during your trip to Vegas! You'll be surprised how big half of their donuts are! Yes, you'll also want to order one just to see if it's possible to finish one. Plus, they have very appealing regular sized donuts, so you may as well order one of those as well! I am also curious if the fish tank has real donuts at the bottom or fake ones - that was the hot debate in our group. I still say no way those were real! Bonus tip, use the restroom before you leave for the wall art!

This was an awesome experience. I got the chocolate bar with bacon. Such great choices. Can't wait to come back once I love to Las Vegas. Support this local business. Their iced chai is awesome as well

Donuts were delicious as expected and I am so glad I stopped by for them before leaving Vegas. I ordered the peanut butter chocolate donut and it tasted like crushed Reese's blended into a cake. I wished some of the donuts had chocolate/Nutella based filling though for chocolate lovers like myself.

We stop here at least once every trip. We love this place. Get there early for the best selection. The donuts are delicious, so is the milk and they have nitro cold brew The decorations are adorable and the staff was super friendly!!

Cant be mad about them selling out on the regular. They've got good doughnuts. Is there some online sold out posting I can check rather than calling them? Anyways, the doughnuts themselves are solid. I think their creativity, quality ingredients and presentation really make it for me. The novelty of giant doughnuts is always fun. I love getting them for out of town visitors. I also appreciate that the head chef always seems to be there. It makes me feel like quality is always being ensured.

Donuts. On. Steroids. I mean massive! Walked in on Tuesday morning around 11:50 with a friend with the understanding that all the good donuts would be picked over. Wasn't wrong about that one, except that they had what both of us came in for. I was shocked to here that they did sell out 70% or something like that of the flavors... I saw plenty to choose from. The employee helping us was warm and was happy to help us with our selections. I chose the birthday cake donut with sprinkles because, duh. But also because it was of normal donut size. My second choice would have been the homer but I had errands to run and didn't want to leave the donut in my car in warm weather. My friend chose a chocolate donut. The big kind and he got through half. I ordered a glass of milk while he ordered a coffee. In regards to my donut, I wasn't blown away. It isn't the best I've had because I've had really great, moist donuts that taste extremely fresh, but there's no reason I wouldn't return to Donut Bar for more donuts. It's the first donut shop I've tried since I've been out here so my next couple visits will be in comparison to Donut Bar. I do appreciate the uniqueness they bring to something so classic, I was told they had donuts with a pop tart inside. I got cavities just thinking about it, but innovative concept to say the least. Attractive frosting and designs but traditional as far as donuts are concerned. It was a fabulous day out, a cool off after a hot couple of days. We were happy to find we could sit outside where there is a communal patio of the neighboring shops. It's clean and inviting, likely bustling in the warmer weather. I appreciated the art work on the buildings as well. I had intended to eat my donut and go back in to order a couple for others. To our surprise in 20 minutes 90% of their stock we walked into had vanished. No they had not put them away, they sold them! I was told they sell out daily! I think there's benefits to showing up fashionably late around the time they close (1p) - you get a bargain! Selection is sparse though at that point - you've been warned. Shout out to the bathroom - Homer Simpson, Family Guy art, loved it! Also loved the merch though I didn't purchase. Street parking is readily available around the block and you are in super close proximity to Fremont Experience for you tourists. I'll be heading back to try new flavors!

Came here with family they had a good variety of donuts flavors and interesting ones too. I ordered creme brulee, apple,chocolate cake donut and boston cream. The apple was a lil dry but tasted ok. The best of the four I picked was the boston cream. I hope they have other flavors the next time I come back, which if I had a taste for a donut, and I was downtown at that moment, I would come back here. P.S. Pay for parking across the street every time, the meter maid will give you a ticket.

Maybe it's because we came later in the day (around 11:30 am) that I wasn't really as impressed as I thought I would be because I had a limited selection. The staff was super nice! She immediately welcomed us as soon as we walked in. We were staring at the menu for quite some time and she remained super helpful, offering descriptions and suggestions. JUST AN FYI, just like most donut shops, they will run out of certain donuts so definitely show up early if you want a certain type that may be popular on their menu aka the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut. But I don't regret what I got! I went with the red velvet donut and the db Nutella! The red velvet was not bad! It wasn't too sweet so it's not too overwhelming to be considered a meal on its own. The only thing was with the latter was that I felt as though there was too much bread with the donut to Nutella ratio but maybe because the donut itself was HUGE. I've heard plenty of amazing things about the Donut Bar. Prior to their opening, they already had so much hype, so much talk of people lining up at their door. But personally, I thought they were OOOOKAY. Probably will give them another try when I'm in the area.

I happened to be in the neighborhood and just looking to get my son a donut. I was overwhelmed with options. Huge donuts. Reasonably priced I think. I was in a hurry so I didn't try their coffee bar. With all the rave reviews and tv appearances I expected out of this world. They're super dry. Toppings are really just ok. I think the best one was the jelly filled which was really rich so I bite or two is more than enough. My husband's apple fritter was huge but also super dry. My son didn't even his lol. Now we can at least say we've tried the famous donut bar with dry and less than average donuts. Maybe their coffee is great?
Great choices! Great atmosphere and easy ordering system. Our choices weren't overly sweet which was good because the doughnuts were huge! Vanilla latte was made perfectly with timed espresso. Yum
The French Toast donut is made to order so it comes out warm and comes with jelly and syrup on the side. The inside is a little small but they have lots of seating in the back.

I was upset with the donut bar for not making enough donuts and it was 830am. They ran out of certain flavor donuts and said they were not making anymore. I had to go to another donut shop that had lots of the flavors I was looking for. I am not sure if I will ever go back.

Amazing like always . The donuts are delicious ,light and not overly sweet which you can actually enjoy the donut. Wish they had a donut shop like this in town I would go often and bring more customers because a lot of people have never heard of the donut bar . My first time having it was in San Diego . Come into Henderson please

I finally visited Donut Bar after a few weeks of stalking their Instagram and frequently checking Yelp. Overall, it was okay. I came in around 11 AM on a Monday, and they still had quite a selection left to choose from. It's a cute shop with a nice outdoor section to enjoy your donuts, too. The music is a bit loud inside. The staff is friendly and helpful; I asked a few questions, and they were happy to help me pick out my donuts. The only donuts I really enjoyed and would probably come back for are the creme brÃ»lÃ©e, Homer's donut, and the "Oh My Birthday Cake Oreo." I didn't get to try the strawberry split I was also interested in, but maybe that will be for another visit. Not a bad experience at all, just a little bit less than what I was expecting.

The amount of donut choices is overwhelming but the prices are reasonable for the giant donut you get! I ordered the homer and an Italian roast coffee. Both were excellent and I couldn't finish all of the donut it was so big! They have out front parking so you can easily run in and pick up your items.

I stopped by in August for a drink, thanks to the extreme heat! I ordered a White Chocolate Mocha. Unfortunately, no doughnuts were on display. Basically, I was getting to know the neighborhood. I was mesmerized by the doughnut ornament inside the fishtank.

I was really excited to try these but the flavors weren't very exciting, similar to grocery store donuts. I placed an order at 8 am and they were already sold out of half the flavors. I read that they sold out every day but sounds like they should be making more if they sell out at 8 am. However, the creme brulee donut was great so that's the reason for 3 stars.

Came here because I really wanted to try their donuts. It's in downtown and parking wasn't that convenient but thanks for the meters I got in and out. It's a cute donut shop. It's small inside and you go in and get in line to order. I got 2 creme brÃ»lÃ©e donuts and I also got the Nutella donut. The Nutella donut was $4 and the creme brÃ»lÃ©e was $2. Definitely reasonable prices. I would have to say I love love love the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut. It's my favorite and I loved the Nutella one too but creme brÃ»lÃ©e definitely has my heart. I will definitely come back here for sure.

Great donuts and great service- a definite win in my book! I read an article that this spot would be opening in the same location as a former donut shop. On Sunday I was finally downtown doing one of my make my own food crawls and knew I needed to stop in. We were warmly greeted right away by the employees and the delicious looking donuts. :) Since we were doing a food crawl we narrowed to two donuts, but we were offered some free donuts and who can pass on free donuts? I'm glad that I was able to try several flavors and get a good idea of what they offer. The apple donut was my favorite. It had a nice spice cake flavor with small chunks of apple in the cake and a nice glaze on top. The chai donut was unique and also hit the spot. The birthday cake donut had Oreo in the center and was tasty as well. The vanilla was my friend's favorite and while simple, I loved this one as well. The chocolate fritter was less moist than the other donuts and had a nice flavor, but wasn't my favorite of the bunch. Overall, nice texture and awesome flavor for the donuts. We also enjoyed some of the delicious Stumptown coffee. Stumptown is always delicious and quality coffee is always good with a donut. I also tried the Nitro brew which was bold and perfect with the sweet donuts. The employees were very friendly and generous in making sure we were able to try as much as possible during our visit. I love visiting a local business where I can feel the pride in the business. It's cool to have another business join what is becoming a pretty cool downtown Las Vegas.

The donuts are huge and oh so delicious! The are not over sweet!!! The staff was friendly and helpful. We will definitely make this a must stop every time we come to Vegas. If your a Simpsons fan check out the bathroom!

I came here this past Wednesday and I pre-ordered a whole dozen. I was afraid it would sell out, so I got there at 7 am on the dot. I got a whole bunch of nutella donuts, a few creme brulee, an apple fritter, and a couple of birthday cake donuts. Let me put it this way, the ones that I liked were definitely the smaller ones to an extent. The nutella donuts(large) were borderline tasteless. Too much bread, fairly dry. The creme brulee was definitely tasteless. The cookies and creme b-day cake was fine. The best one, and the most expensive of the bunch I bought, was the nutella(small). That had some flavor and was just right. Not too much bread and just the right amount of nutella. I paid $36 in total for a dozen and I now realize that getting there early is more than enough to get what I wanted. I probably won't come here again, but it is a decent novelty donut shop.

Every time we've attempted to go to the original SD location, we were deterred by the line wrapped around the building. So after our quick brunch at Bronze Cafe, we peeked over at Donut Bar and were shocked to be able to see the front door. It also gave us the chance to continue our tradition of donuts on road trips. We walked in and perused the daily menu and made our way to the display case. The one that jumped out at me was the split donut stuffed with strawberries and whipped cream. My boyfriend stalks DB on Instagram and knew he wanted the Big Poppa Tart. I asked the sweet girl helping us out what the vegan options of the day were: apple fritter, creme brulee, chai latte cake donut, and yes, that strawberry cream beauty was in fact, a vegan soy-based whipped cream. The decision was easy for me because I'm not a big apple fan. One of each, minus the fritter. The creme brulee was of the yeast-risen variety. On top of the golden brown donut was a cap of hardened caramel that shattered at the first bite. Bite two yielded a rich ooze of vanilla bean-specked custard. The chai donut was exactly what I wanted. I'm a lover of cake donuts and this one did not disappoint. There was nothing "vegan-tasting" about it. It was just a great cake donut. The warm spices gave this a Fall feel and I was happy this was an option available in May. The strawberry cream donut was saved for last. I discarded the top because by the time I reached this, it was a little dry. The cream was dense, but still light and I couldn't believe it was dairy free. The strawberries were perfectly selected, juicy and sweet. I enjoyed the cake donut over the yeast-risen ones, but that's always been my preference. Still, I was very impressed by the vegan offerings. Street metered parking was easy to find because the location is in Old Vegas area.

I don't like donuts but stopped here on my Uber drivers recommendation ...the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut here blew my mind!!!!!! I went back for another the following day only to find SOLD OUT scrolled across the window...i was heartbroken Go early, buy lots, be happy!!!!
Awesome place! Super friendly staff. Much smaller than the one in San Diego. Got there at 9:30 am and the maple bacon donuts were already gone . They are the BEST. No line.

Love this place. Super cute. Friendly staff. The lady took the time to explain all their flavors, what they recommend, etc. Small seating area inside but there's a back courtyard that has more seating. Donuts were good. Fresh and soft. My fav was the Nutella donut and salted caramel. I was disappointed that they didn't have some of their other flavors available like the caramel latte but apparently they rotate the flavors. I'll definitely be back. This place was great.

So glad I came here for breakfast even though it was out of the way for us. All the donuts are so cheap and massive compared to what we buy in LA. I loved all the novelty choices like banana caramel, creme brÃ»lÃ©e, Nutella, etc and wanted to order more but ordered just enough for breakfast. The Stumptown iced coffee at around $4.50 was delicious as always and seems to be in every store I visit! Coming here again for some AMAZING Donuts!!

Delicious! Creme Brulee was very good. A bit hard to eat due to the crusty top but it was really good. Pumpkin Cream Cheese was sweet but SO good. blueberry with Meyer Lemon was okay but bland compared to the other two. Friendly fast service. Great place!

I'm coming from being a fan of Doughnut Plant in NYC. Not sure if we had stale ones because I ordered from Uber Eats or for their price you're paying for a batter that is not up to standard. Creme Brulee was the best. Strawberry cheesecake. Nah. Lemon Blueberry, the flavour was there but still not that great. I will be open-minded, maybe better when you get it fresh. Would want to go back to try French Toast Donut.

This place has a ton of donut flavors to choose from! We came at 10am on a Friday and there were still lots to choose from. My family got many flavors to split so we could try more. My top three (and in no particular order) was the strawberry shortcake donut, the Oreo birthday cake, and the crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e donut. All were SO delicious. The staff working was super nice as well.

Donuts after drinking in Vegas? Yes. I came here the morning after a night of drinking and what a good idea that was. My comrade and I picked up three donuts to sop up what was left of our Fat Tuesday drinks marinating in our digestive tracts. We picked up two giant donuts (one birthday cake and the other nutella) and one regular sized (strawberry shortcake). For me, the star was the strawberry shortcake. It's like one of those ice cream bars you'd eat as a kid (who am I kidding? I eat them as an adult too) but in donut form. It's the cake donut type but it's all pinkish due to the strawberries in the donut. Yes. PLEASE. The larger donuts we got were the yeast type donuts. Both tasted the same except for the toppings. One was topped with frosting and sprinkles (that tastes like the canned frosting, yum) and the other nutella. Both delicious and easy to share between three people. I'm already yearning for these when I come back.

For my boyfriends birthday, I decided to buy him one of every flavor donut from Donut Bar that they had for that day (since they rotate some flavors each day). They were so good! Each donut had a nice bite to it & the texture of the donuts ranged from light & fluffy to dense & thick. Some of our favorites were definitely the creme brulee (it has a crunchy top!), strawberry cream cheese, old fashion, & maple bacon. They have many specialty donuts that's it's hard to keep track of them! S'mores, Mexican hot chocolate, red velvet, blueberry lemon.. even some filled with pop tarts in them! It was so crazy to see! Also some of their donuts are HUGE. There was no way we could finish all 26 donuts in a decent amount of time before they got stale haha. The place was also easy to find. Located by Fremont street. There is an arrow neon sign that you can't miss. Downside is you have to pay for parking, but if you're there early enough you can park for free. Will definitely be back for the donuts we didn't get to try yet. Especially their French toast donuts that they only serve in Sunday's!

3.5 Love all the flavor choices and cool decorations. My favorite had to be the lemon pistachio, was a little disappointed with the creme brÃ»lÃ©e and that was the one I was so looking forward to try. Staff was very nice and helpful. Clean bakery with the racks of fresh donuts. Used Yelp deal for a free large coffee with purchase of a dozen.

Had a work trip to Vegas, but had to figure out my own accommodations off-strip for one night. I mostly buckled down and did work, but after getting up early the next morning, I checked out Yelp to find out this place was right down the street. My cold brew was stellar but my whipped cream strawberry donut extravaganza was the real star. Started to walk out the door. Went back for some cream brulee bites. Was not disappointed. I was in and out in a minute and had a delicious breakfast, so I had no complaints!

The Best Doughnuts EVEERRR!!!! My Son And I Went Downtown To The Donut Bar And Just Indulged, Man WhenI Tell You They Were Good, For Real, For Real They Are Bomb It Is A Must Have. Krispy Kreme's Are Good. But, The Donut Bar Is Where It Is!!!! So I Give Them Once They Open At 8:00am You Can Get Them Until They're Sold Out And It Just May Be 12 Or 1:00pm Lol
These donuts are bomb but kinda pricy, kind of expected I paid about $16 for a box of donuts not even a full dozen so the price is something you gotta watch out for other than that it's pretty good

I love doughnuts and this spot didn't disappoint! They had a wide variety to chose from and quite a few gourmet options that you just don't see very often. Of course we got more than we could possibly eat in one sitting, but it was so hard to chose. They all looked so delicious! Staff was super friendly and helpful. Easy walking distance from the Fremont St area.

These donuts are dynamite! If you come near closing (in my case ten minutes before closing) you can get a box of donuts for $10 and this box is like the size of a pizza box. As tempting as that was, I opted for their other end of day special - 2 donuts for $5. The pop tart donut was really like a pop tart...donut. it was so good! That fruity jelly on the inside. Frosting on top. I had no regrets eating this. Well, it was way too big so I only ate a quarter of it. Share. The Apple donut was good even though I ate it the next day! Mind blown. That means they fried it well because usually poorly fried donuts are soggy the next day. I love this place so much I even bought their shirt...Donut kill my vibe!

So disappointed by this place. The donuts were just sad. They look amazing but taste like disappointment. We got there in the afternoon time so they were doing $10 boxes (as many donuts you can fit in a box for $10), we were so excited to get to try a variety. Smores on fire - eh & cake donut was sad Triple chocolate - more like 1 chocolate Blueberry & Meyer lemon - decent Creme brulee - eh, cream was gross Chai - okay Chocolate covered old fashioned - gross Poptart - okay but so overly sweet Nutella - the only one where the donut dough was good Chocolate milk - don't get it, not worth it 2 stars cause we would eat 2 donuts again (blueberry & Meyer lemon & nutella) and the staff was really nice

I don't know why I always go back to donut bar. I don't know why people like donut bar so much. I don't get the hype! But I love hype! My favorite thing about donut bar is their creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut with the crunchy sugar coating and the creamy custard filling. Why are they putting less coating and less filling?! Donut bar has the most bready donuts. They are seriously just slightly sweet bread that are oversized or overly decorated. I have probably tried all of their donuts and they are just not good in my opinion. Their donut cone with soft serve is good and their creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut used to be good. I have probably been here six times because their instagram is popping but I have to say their donuts are just not good.

Short Review: Donut Bar originated in San Diego and places an emphasis on fresh, tasty, picture worthy, and creative donuts. If a caked donut full of sugar is your thing, then give Donut Bar a try. Donut Bar is considered one the best and their customer service is excellent. Just be early because these donuts sell out fast. Longer Review: I remember the excitement when Donut Bar opened in Las Vegas. I'm not going to lie. I wasn't that excited when I heard the news. I didn't bookmark this place and had the opinion that Donut Bar was just hype. I'm originally from the 619 and remember when the first Donut Bar opened their doors in Daygo. I was one of those people that waited in line. The owner of that location was pretty cool and would walk by the line with full sized donut samples to patrons waiting to get in. Originally, I wasn't a fan. I had a few failed visits because their donuts were either out or I got something that was too sweet. I always picked a donut that just didn't "wow" me. I am also not into a cake donut with a bunch of sugar on it. I'm really boring when it comes to my donuts. I prefer a chocolate glazed raised donut, maple bar, cruller, or an apple fritter. That's all I really need or want when I'm in a donut shop. But when the girlfriend loves donuts, then you support her by eating donuts. I have been here a couple of times since grand opening week. I've tried the Samoa, The French Toast, Cake Batter, Caramel Latte, the Big Poppa Tart, CrÃ¨me Brulee, Matcha Cake, PB&J, and of course, the Homer. Their originality, freshness, and consistency stands out. I haven't had anything here that was too oily and greasy. Again, these donuts really do not appeal to me and in my opinion, just too sweet. But then I had their Caramel Latte. This donut is perfectly glazed with their latte flavor. Then a little whipped cream and caramel is added. Because this donut is large, the glaze and toppings do not give it that overly sweet taste. The texture is also perfect and not dry at all. This donut with a cup of their hot coffee equals perfection. I will cheat on my chocolate raised donut any day for their Caramel Latte. This donut alone made me a fan. 2017 Yelp Review #77

An absolute gem of downtown vegas! You have to get there in the morning because once all the doughnuts are gone, they close. It's located on Carson. The doughnuts they offer are HUGE! There's such a big selection of doughnuts with so many flavors, you'll be happy with anything. They're known for their special Churro cone with ice cream.. and it's SOO good. These are popular so they go much quicker! The service is quick.. it's a small shop so you go in and out even if there's a long wait. I also saw that they cater.

Really good donuts, but not as great as we imagined. We ordered the crepe brÃ»lÃ©e and big poppa both strawberry and s'mores and were sadly less than impressed. We thought they would have a very airy soft texture to them and they were a lot more dense than we like. They had good flavor but we definitely have to knock them on that dense part. The big poppa goes with the name because it's huge! We could barely finish one together. The do have nitro cold brew here which I'm a huge fan of and will recommend it to everyone that loves coffee! Paid around $20 for two big poppas and two creme brÃ»lÃ©e so it is a bit pricey. Overall good donuts. With the reviews though we just weren't as wowed as we thought we would be

I was excited to have found this place when I went to Vegas for EDC weekend. I was actually looking for a churro place but I guess this place popped up for their cone dipped in cinnamon sugar. Even more excited that the shuttle got lost and dropped us around the corner from Donut Bar!! So why 3 stars? Let me break it down: Ambience: 5/5. No complaints. Not the strip, and not a glamorous neighborhood, but inside is cute, the donuts all look amazing. Clean, etc. The board and menu is cute as well. Service: 5/5. The girl who helped us out was patient. It was kind of hard being a short Asian to try to see the donuts displayed in the back and not in the counter. She was super friendly, cheery, and overall nice. Service was quick. Layout: Definitely up with the social media trends with the hashtags and the sign so you can instagram those ginormous and beautiful looking donuts. But the most important part is the donut itself..... Donut/Pastries: 2.5/5. The donuts LOOK amazing. So much variety. Different sizes. Awesome flavor combinations. I bought 6 donuts. A whole box for $16. BUT the donut itself was so disappointing. The batter was dry and thick. Closer to an old-fashioned when it wasnt supposed to be. We got there right when they opened at 8am so its not stale. Its just the batter itself. All the donuts had the same batter so even if the frosting was different, the dry batter was still the same. Creme brulee donut was one of the top ones according to yelp and the girl, but even though the filling (amount was also inconsistent since I bought two), it still didnt moisten the dry batter. However, the crunch of breaking it was satisfying. The maple cinnamon which I figured was the closest to a churro was burnt near the top and edges but gooey in the middle. However it was too sweet. Perhaps it was the maple. I still ate 90%. I really wanted to like this place but their actual donuts were all disappointing. Could not use the #bestdonutsintheworld. Sorry! P.s. Apparently, the cone only is available after 10am. So I never even got what I came for. The rating is purely on the 3.5 stars rounded down to 3 as I do not think its overhyped for the donut itself. Everything was good though. Come for the novelty and not for the best donut in your life.

Good donuts, damn good donuts. What else is there to know? Ah... if you insist... So I guess this place is famous. I didn't know, I just came downtown to pay a ticket and saw a neat little sign for a donut shop. Inside I go and I'm just blown away by the different types of donuts on display! Homer's donut? Matcha donut? Nutella donut? What!? Which should I try? The answer is ALL OF THEM! Haha okay not really, but I did buy a dozen. The french toast donut was my favorite. I believe they make it on request because mine came out hot, and I did have to wait additional time for it. It comes with syrup on the side as well. My only regret is not buying two! It was that good. I loved Homer's donut as well. I believe that was strawberry flavored icing on top? It was simple, but great. The strawberry split was SO good! My partner loved how it wasn't too sweet, and loved having creme and strawberries in the donut. I didn't order the creme brulee donut this time, but I hear it's their signature donut. Heck, they all look and taste like signature donuts! Instead of cooking breakfast I think I'll just order a french toast donut from here instead. It was bigger than all the donuts and very filling. They close when they're out of donuts and trust me, they will run out. I recommend arriving early as there's usually no line. Definitely a must try when you're in Las Vegas! PROTIP: Their menu changes DAILY! You can also order in advance on their website only during THE DAY BEFORE! And it has to be a dozen donuts, minimum. I believe the deadline is 6pm, but I could be mistaken. This saves a lot of time during busy weeks if there's a festival going on in the city.

Downtown Vegas. I love you and I hate you. Easy to get around for pedestrians but it's sort of like walking thru a zombie minefield of people asking for money, people talking to themselves or wondering if you're going to get mugged right around the corner. Yeah, not pretty. Perseverance is the key. My main tip for you is Donut Bar's storefront is actually on Carson Avenue & not on 6th Street. I planned on getting 2 donuts but everything looked so alluring I settled for 3 & dealt with the consequences later. This was my breakfast & snack for later. Hmm. Taste was okay. For me it was very sweet but the aim to a donut's success is the texture of the dough & unfortunately all 3 of my choices were on the dry side. Maybe it was an off day? Because look at all the 4-5 Star reviews here. I am like, huh? I dunno. Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e Donut - Their specialty. The hard, crunchy brÃ»lÃ©e'd exterior sticks to your teeth. The creme inside was good. Blueberry Cheesecake Donut-Yeast donut with comstock blueberry filling & iced cream cheese frosting was very sweet & not very cheesecake-like. Oreo Birthday Cake Donut- Yeast donut stuffed with an Oreo cookie inside. Although the Oreo was soggy if I had to choose, I liked this donut out of my 3 picks. I was also bummed to see they no longer had the cartons of Stump Town coffee and only a bottled version of cold brew which brought my bummer level down further. In my eyes I prefer Mr. Donut & Donut King so for Oahuans don't fret too much if you can't get to Donut Bar on your next trip to the 9th Island. You have very good options at home.
Just had the Oreo cookie B-day cake donut Idk how many calories I just consumed but that thing was just outrageously delicious.....good thing that I live pretty far from their shop.

We got the closing special so we tried a lot of donuts. Honestly I think they're okay. I've had specialty donuts and these were cool but I wouldn't come back. I didn't particularly care for any of them, I didn't like the donut batter itself. The crÃ¨me brulee wasn't sweet enough and I don't normally like super sweet things but something was just off. These aren't bad but aren't the best specialty donuts I've had. The search continues!

Honestly was a little disappointed after seeing all the hype. We got 3 donuts Nutella overload, Creme brÃ»lÃ©e and strawberry cheesecake. The Nutella overload haha it had a dot of Nutella, the strawberry cheesecake only had strawberry filling so not sure what made it cheesecake.
I was SO excited to try Donut Bar. I got there around 11:30 and ordered 5 donuts. Guess what? Every single one was stale. So disappointed.

Stopped by on my trip to Vegas this past weekend. I went towards the end of the day so I'm not sure if all the options were there. I purchased 3 items, 1 that they are known for and random 2 flavors. Was not that great and didn't finish any of them. Thankfully I didn't have to wait in line.
Frustrated. Don't put an end time on Yelp if it's different from your door. Walked from California casino, arrived at 12:15 to find it closed earlier instead of 1pm. Just put on Yelp- to call ahead.

I'm not a big fan of donuts but these are pretty amazing. They are pricey but this place has become my go to place whenever I'm in town. Thank goodness they're open again. Order from yelp! If you don't want to wait and know what you want. Not all flavors are listed. Coffee is not bad either. I'd recommend indulging yourself and checking this place out.

Easiest 5 stars EVER. First of all it's donuts so thats an easy 4 stars just for existing. The location is a bit tucked away which adds to the mystique of this dynamic donut experience. If you're staying in the downtown area and you have a free morning forget cheap steak and eggs. Bloody Mary's can wait... and a breakfast buffet is usually disgusting. These gourmet donuts will change the way you look at this breakfast novelty forever. Anything with bacon comes with REAL bacon. Not those stingy little crumbles at other places. This bacon was thick cut, maple cured, and had a crunch that sticks to your jaws. EVERY SINGLE FLAVOR POPPED! The glazes are delicious and leave you with an angel like after taste. I suggest looking at the pictures. Try not to drop your phone with amazement. Yes the presentation is an important part of a business like this. The passerbys or window shoppers will NEVER be disappointed walking into this business. These oversized breakfast treats are worth every penny. Here's a few suggestions - Creme Brulee ( it cracks when you bite into it) - Brad Fritter ( its an apple fritter covered in caramel drizzle and a mountain of THICK cut bacon) - The Homer ( its a giant donut just like the one from the Simpson's) - Chai Latte ( it was like sipping on a cloud) 5th star factor for me was easily the mountain of bacon I received on top of my donut. It was definitely more then the 2 strips of loneliness you get at a Denny's or any other morning diner. The service was excellent, but damnit the bacon was over the top.

I finally got to try their creme brulee donut after seeing it in a facebook video. Wow the donut does not disappoint! The crack is pretty loud and wished it delivered through the video that I posted. The donut itself tastes even better (as if the crack wasn't enough). It wasn't overly sweet like I thought it would be. The custard was smooth and delicious. I wish I ordered more. I also got the blueberry cheesecake donut, which I didn't eat until 12 hours later. It was still delightful to me, but I'm sure it would've tasted even better if I ate it fresh. For $2 per donut, this place wins my heart! Not a bad drive from the strip either :)

The moment you walk in- AMAZING! The employees are the sweetest! This is the best part of Vegas so far. It's worth the drive away from the strip! The pop tart donuts are my personal favorite and my boyfriend LOVED the pumpkin donut! Not to mention the shop is just adorable! I had high expectations for this place and they went above and BEYOND!

The early bird gets the worm! This place only stays open until they sell out. Everytime I pass this place about noonish they always have written on the window SOLD OUT! And I'm like damn it! LoL. I finally caught them with a few donuts left. I got the Mexican chocolate donut with some milk. This thing was huge! Took one bite and understood why they sell out so fast. Best donuts ever! It reminds me of donuts you get at the bakery in Hawaii. Not too sweet and the donut is perfect not too heavy but just right. The chocolate was delicious and the hind of cinnamon on one side and marshmallows on the other side was super yum and cute. I need to make it here early to see what else they had. I was eyeing out their filled nutella donut. That is definitely on the list!

Tried a donut, interesting selection. I always drive by and they have a sign that reads SOLD OUT on the glass outside. Was late at night so not many donuts left. The cake donut was kind of dry but the topping was good. Apple crumb looked much better than it actually was. The servers were very nice and friendly. I will give them another try when I know the donuts are fresh and the shelves are full.

Four stars for creativity. Donut Bar knows how to knock your socks off. Located Downtown LV, there is plenty of street parking. Get there early because a line can form quickly that will run outside along the building. Once you are ready to have your order taken, the staff is there to load your belly. Take note that the donut selection runs outside of the case. There are layers of trays behind you ready to be eaten and don't forget to look at their menu board. The Oreo Birthday Cake has been my favorite so far. There is a full Oreo inside. I mean, don't. Who doesn't love Oreos?? You also can't go wrong with the classic maple. It's a must for me. The selection here is fierce. So many donuts to try, so little time. Stop by the donut fish tank and snap a photo. Grab a cup of Cold Brew and go (do)nuts!

This was our 1st experience at Donut Bar and it will definitely not be our last! We got the creme brulee donut, blueberry cheesecake donut, big poppa tart, a cream donut, Nutella donut and a Halloween themed donut. They were all fantastic! My favorite was the blueberry cheesecake donut. The staff was wonderful, they were friendly and helpful. Highly recommend!

PROS: -convenient downtown location -fast friendly service -strawberry split donut is amazing CONS: -vegan donuts are more expensive than the non-vegan ones -loud music (like nightclub loud) which makes it hard to communicate orders or chat with friends -creme brulee donut is blah, & the strawberry split donut is pretty heavy which leaves one other vegan option. I wish they had better vegan selection (ie: simple options like glazed, eclair, sprinkle, etc) If they had better vegan options I would frequent this location weekly, for sure. I've only seen the vegan sprinkled donut on 2 occasions. So far the strawberry split & sprinkled is my fav

If you've ever thought that strawberry shortcake wasn't an appropriate breakfast food, but wanted to do it anyways, get the strawberry split. This was by far my favorite of the donuts. The cream brÃ»lÃ©e was a close second. The glazed sugar on top gives a perfectly satisfactory crack when hit and/or when bitten into and the filling was delicious. We purposefully visited on the weekend for the expanded menu and, of the specials, chose the French toast donut which did not disappoint. We'll try the grilled cheese on a later visit. I suggest you do the same. (Or take enough people that you can order all the donuts and do a sampling.) The staff was very friendly and the donuts, yummy! They are open until they sell out, so get there early.

Seeing the photo's of these donuts on Yelp, I knew I had to try these babies out. They had so many options. Almost every donut was about the size of my head. Ton's of toppings and fillings. The lady behind the counter helping us was awesome. She was super helpful, very friendly, and informed. She guided us through the different options, the favorites, and her own favorites. We ended up with the Butter Beer Donut, Apple Fritter, Maple Bacon, and CrÃ¨me Brule. I personally thought these donuts were too sweet. And really not my type of donut in general. These are mostly bready donut's with super sugary, cake icing. It wasn't bad. Just not my thing. The CrÃ¨me Brule was different. Creamy vanilla filling with sugar burleed to the top. If you are big in to sugar you may love this place. I really loved the people and the experience of it all. Very cute shop. The coffee was good as well. Just not my thing.
The donut selection was amazing! Not your typical small donut. The french toast was sooo good!! Definitely check it out!

Such a fun, family friendly donut spot. I've been there twice and been greeted with a hello upon entering. I'm sure they're smiling under those masks too. Told the girl it was my sons birthday and she gave him a birthday cake donut. They're known for their pop tart donuts. My husband had one yesterday (sorry, forgot to get a picture). My family says the donuts are really good. Unfortunately, I can't have gluten and they don't have gluten free donuts, but that's ok my family was still very happy with their choices.

I live in AZ but will be stopping here every time I'm in Vegas which I'd A LOT. Got 3 donuts and couldn't believe how cheap these huge delicious things are. Can not wait to go back and take everyone I know.

First time here. We finally found it opened. Once donuts are done they close the shop. Which is a good sign if they close early. Means they are popular. Donuts were great. Public parking in front and on the street parking too. Super friendly staff ( the girls were at least). Recommended to try at least once.

The staff is great, the doughnuts look great, and I got there at 11am...That being said I have read all the hype of this place and purchased two doughnuts...Well...I tried them and tossed them in the garbage...It is not that they are bad they are just not good...I got blueberry and meyer lemon and it had no real lemon flavor. So, one small taste and in the garbage. I tried the Butterfinger and Chocolate and one taste in the garbage. I will try it again to get more of the classic flavors. But, to date, I have tried all the doughnuts in Vegas and there are much better choices I believe.

Super cute, super friendly staff. Unique looking and large in size donuts, do you get your monies worth. However, some were lacking in flavor. For example, the Nutella was basically just like a chocolate glazed. It was good though. We also felt rushed and pushed down the line. I felt like i didn't even get to look at all the choices because of that. If you want to sit and eat there, they do have seating outside. I loved the outside sitting area. Very cute and peaceful.
The doughnuts are pretty good! The chocolate milk was so disgusting!!! I don't think it's worth the hype.
Yep !!!!!! Phenomenal!!!!!!! Maple glazed!!!! Creme brulee !!!!!!! 8$ for 2 amazing donuts !!!!!!!!!!!!!! Will definitely be back. All the way from California. Thanks guys!!!!

The music is WAY TO LOUD! You have to scream what you want! The donuts are tasteless. How can that be? My grandson would not eat them and hes 7!!!t they are the worst tasting donuts I have ever eaten, they have no flavor. And the cost is ridiculous for a tasteless donut!

Love these donut... fresh everyday they range to $2-$5 each I love the Nutella and Burlee... worth the wait if u want to get the first dibs come early coz it does get a long line. The place is really small so expect it to be crowded when they open.

This is an update from my orginal post. This is now my second time visiting Donutbar and unfortunately it will be mt last. I totally understand the excitement about this location and how it reminds people of Voodoo Donuts from Portland but it's not the same. What makes Voodoo Donuts different from Donut Bar here in Las Vegas is that they never out. They are continuously making their popular donuts for the people. For example, if Donutbar knows that their French Toast donut is only sold on the weekend, then they should make enough, due to it's popularity. In regards to their donuts they are super soft and fresh I truly enjoyed the split open strawberry donut because the strawberries are fresh and whipped cream is really smooth,Fresh & Light. The strawberry cheesecake donut simply tastes like a strawberry jelly filled donut.

Awesome vegan options! The specialty donuts that we got were delicious and huge. We also got espresso and an americano. The indoor sitting area is kind of small but we were able to find a couple seats. Cute place, definitely will go back.

Donut bar has got to be the coolest donut spot in Las Vegas. Didn't realize how spoiled I was until they stopped popping up to Las Vegas Farmers Market where I work. I mean, every week I got at least one donut when they were there at LVFM. It was incredibly difficult to resist. Their shop downtown is the cutest and they have the most delicious nitro (and regular) coffee to pair with your donut. The employees here are sweet, patient and understanding of the tricky task of selecting the right donut - picking the right donut takes careful consideration when there's a bajillion options! I'm vegan so I usually do the apple fritter (holy shit) or caramel brÃ»lÃ©e
Delicious! Need I say more? Ordered the strawberry split, cake batter, and Nutella filled donuts... Yummy! The dough was light and fluffy!

We frequent the original donut bar in San Diego so decided to stop by the one by Fremont street (downtown Las Vegas) while in town for the 4th of July. The place is pretty inconspicuous so easy to drive past, with paid parking all around, although we risked it and just parked and ran in to grab our doughnuts to go. First thing different we noticed was that there was hardly anyone there. We arrived about 35 minutes after they opened and walked right in. Normally at the one in SD you can expect a line of 20+ people waiting before they open. Maybe we caught them at just the right time since we noticed more people start to show up as we were leaving. The place is a bit smaller, and it seems like the selection may be smaller too. I also noticed that they don't give kids free doughnuts like they do at the one in SD. The staff were just as friendly and welcoming though, and we were not disappointed with the doughnuts we picked, just as delicious! If you're staying in downtown or have a car if you're on the strip, definitely worth the trip!

I was originally just going to get one donut because my pastry threshold is usually one but after stepping inside Donut Bar you quickly realize how hard it is to just buy one. That's why we have two hands right, to double fist in morning sugar rushes? I ended up getting their signature Creme Brulee and a Nutella bar with a Cold Brew. If the donuts didn't do me in, the coffee did because it rocked my Friday morning. It was all so good I bought a round back for my co-workers to share the wealth. TIP: This cute, cramped donut shop is literally always popping so make sure you strategically find parking beforehand!

The absolute freshest most delicious donuts I've ever had. I love their daily specials I've been coming here for years. The best! Try the trix, red velvet, strawberry shortcake, creme brÃ»lÃ©e or blueberry those are my favorites. They have a court yard behind to sit and relax have a coffee and enjoy the treats as well.

This place is a must see! We got to freemont looking for some caffiene and ran into this awesome place. We had the Creme Brulee and Twix donuts and they were amazing. Came here to get donuts drove from Henderson. And this place is out of donuts. They had two Donuts left. They're not like a real donut shop that make donuts all day. They do this s*** purposely for people who waste their time and their money in their gas.

I have a friend who lives in las Vegas and has been talking about how great this place is. I've never been a big fan of donuts but I wanted to try it while I was here for the weekend. OMG! Are you kidding me??! I got the chocolate bacon donut bar and the "Nutella Overload." It's too bad I didn't eat them right when I bought them, so as to have identified the MAJOR problem early on and confronted the shop about it, but I saved the donuts for a late afternoon treat-yo-self after some hours of blackjack. Go to Voodoo Donuts in Portland, OR or Psycho Donuts in San Jose, CA.

Simply the best and it is not even close!!! If you are in Vegas this is a must stop. The earlier you can get there the better. The selection varies from day-to-day. It is on the to do list anytime I am in Las Vegas. Heads up they will sell out sometimes go early for best results
not really a fan of the other donuts they have. I love the pop tart donut. But my all time favorite ? are the French toast donut and the grilled cheese donut. Very unique tasting donuts. I love it.

After reading all the great reviews, I decided to try out the Donut Bar. I drove from CA to NV for a family trip, and picked up a few boxes for the entire family. Brah! Winnahz. Creme brÃ»lÃ©e was set on kill mode. Fresh, slight crispy crust. Jus the right amount of custard filling. And the caramelized sugar on top would shatter as you bit in. Had to have another one. Forgot to take a pic

I was hoping to write a positive review after buying a half dozen this morning, but I can't. We bought the pop tart stuffed donut, red velvet, lemon blueberry, chocolate bacon, and chocolate cake. Overrated. Stumbled upon "happy hour" and got a dozen of their donuts. Was so hyped up due to the reviews. Good ones: - Cream brulee: small and creamy - Nutella overload: the nutella makes the donut - Special of the day: Rasberry pistachio - Good design on the donuts, huge portions Not so good:do - Butter beer - Mud pie MINUS one if not two star - the dough on almost every single one of their donuts are too dry and not soft/moist. What a beautiful donut shop- shop is an understatement. It's a glamorous display of gluten-laden deep-fried sugar-coated creatively crafted creations that just don't seem to be fairly priced! I love that they put your treats in an open box until they ring you up on the register. A must try if you eat donuts with gluten- truly beautiful artistic creations. You'll be so happy!

So this place is within walking distance from my hotel and man it was delicious and the donuts all look so pretty. I got myself a Boston cream and an expresso. My 5 year old got the chocolate donut. I was taking a picture of the sold out sign when he looked up at the right time I got the cutest sad face from being donutless. I recommend to go there before 12 noon. I highly recommend this place.

I wish I had taken a picture of the teenage boys when they opened the box of the #bestdonutsintheworld. The picture would have said it all! The donuts are as pretty to look at as they are delicious to eat. Coffee was perfect and the blueberry, Meyer lemon donut out of this world. Staff was super nice, friendly and helpful!

So happy I finally got to try donut bar !! I've been eyeing this place in San Diego but to my pleasant surprise they also have on near downtown Vegas ! We got the mud pie donut which is huge !!! When you walk up to Donut Bar, the window proclaims they are the best donuts in the world. Well, I have to say they just might be right. As this was my first visit, I wanted to get a variety of treats to sample. I ordered the French toast doughnut. The bacon maple longjohn and the bacon cinnamon roll were both awesome treats combining the salty of bacon and the sweet of the doughnut. This place has amazing donuts, it was kind of expensive for a donut shop but there donuts are huge! We ordered a dozen and got one free. These donuts are HUGE and delicious! The staff is friendly and welcoming. They have a cool aquarium of donuts!!! I will be coming back in the future
The nicest staff and the donuts are amazing . I love the choices and blends they had. They even have a Homer Donut !!! Wonderful can't wait to go back

Not everything I was expecting it to be. I was so hyped up from what I've seen on social media but Donut Bar just ended up being okay. The service was good. We did order online, got a confirmation email & then when we showed up they never received our order. We ordered 20 donuts online for us and friends, so I couldn't remember all the exact donuts. Our creme brÃ»lÃ©e donuts were soggy on the bottom and the dough tasted like burnt oil. The raspberry cheesecake didn't taste like raspberry cheesecake at all. The lemon blueberry was decent. Wow! Fantastic! I got the strawberry shortcake donut and Jim got the vanilla bean donut. Then we shared a creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut. By far the creme brÃ»lÃ©e was the best one! You've got to get here early otherwise they sell out, and that's all she wrote. OK so are they, as they boast, the best donuts in the world? No, but they are very good. So if you find yourself downtown early in the morning get in line before hey run out. Live It Up You Are In Las Vegas For Cryin' Out Loud!

Donut Bar is one of the best places to get donuts. It is a hidden gem located inside Downtown Las Vegas. If you visit Donut Bar past noon, they might be sold out of their baked goodies! On my first visit, I kept it simple with a chocolate donut and was not disappointed at all! My friend got the strawberry cheese cream donut and she loved it. I tried both donuts and decided that the donuts might be a little bit TOO sweet for me.. however I will be back to try more flavors!

My husband and I just got married in Vegas, and instead of a cake (my mom almost spent $800 on a cake that feeds 20-30!), we got a shit-ton of donuts from Donut Bar for $250! We worked with Chef Jeff who was super prompt in responding to our emails, and he gave us everything we wanted. Very professional and reliable. We ordered 8 different types of donuts, including a few vegan ones and a dozen donuts with Vegas-y designs. Our flavors ranged from Lemon Pistachio to Nutella, so everyone was satisfied. Overall, they were a huge hit, delicious, and a cheaper alternative!

Don't get me wrong, the donuts WERE GOOD... but they weren't exceptional or phenomenal (to me). If you enjoy cake-batter like heavy donuts, then these will be right up your alley. But if you're more into fluffy doughy donuts, then these are not for you. The second we entered, the room filled with sweet smelling goodness. All the donuts LOOKED AMAZING. We bought 2 dozen for our entire group of friends. The price was pretty high too. The doughnuts are HUGE.. But bigger is not always better. They ranged from $2-5 depending on which flavor. We ended up spending about $75 for 2 dozen. I would definitely recommend heading to the east coast if you're on the hunt for real delicious donuts!
Great donut place walking distance from Freemont experience. Huge fresh donuts. We went on Sunday at 930 and they had plenty to choose from.

Not your typical donut shop which makes this place unique and great. Went before 9 on a weekday and the wait was not long at all. Would visit this place again if ever in the area. Arguably the best donut I've ever eaten.
These donuts are delicious and creative. Fun to eat! The shop is located inside a building and has very limited space inside, maybe 10 actual spots to sit in a bar style seating.

Went here after hearing all the raves... it was disappointing. The staff were supper nice, they described all the flavors for us and was very helpful. The donuts are not the best, the Red Velvet was super dry and not very flavorful. The maple bacon was ok. I have had better donuts for way cheaper. Almost $12 for 5 donuts!

I wish I could rate this place from my experience. I got here around 11am but they were closed because they were sold out!!! If you ever make it to Vegas checkout The Donut Bar you won't be sorry!!!

Love this downtown hot spot! My kids like getting these as a treat and we've had them at parties and work gathering. Staff is always super nice and friendly. Easy location to walk to from Fremont st and container park. Close to life is beautiful and year round street art.

I personally can only speak to the vegan donuts, but they're some of the best donuts on the planet! Just picked up a dozen vegan salted caramel donuts - a special birthday request from my husband every year! My nonvegan friends and family rave about all the other donuts as well! Love this place!

I would leave 5 stars if I could, but since my friend pre-ordered two dozen and picked up for me I cannot comment on the physical location or the staff. I can say that my friend had no issues placing his the order or picking it up in the morning. Forgive me for not knowing exact amounts but there were a lot of the matcha green tea cake donuts, several blueberry lemon cake donuts, and some raspberry pistachio yeast donuts. I was most excited for the matcha donuts because I'm obsessed with matcha. This donut was an absolute success, it made the perfect cake donut. I then tried the raspberry pistachio yeast donut which was as big as my face. Seriously, the thing was HUGE! I'm generally not a fan of yeast donuts because they lack flavor, this yeast donut however had the perfect fluffy texture and was buttery. the raspberry pistachio icing was incredible as well, slightly tart but mostly sweet with subtle hints of pistachio. It melted in my mouth with each bite, I was sad but very full when it was all over. I really want to go back to try their creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut, as well as any others they're offering. I'm reading reviews about their donuts being dry but I didn't have that experience at all. I think Donut Bar's donuts are way better than the donuts O-Face used to sell. I'm hoping when I can check out the physical location I can update my review to 5 stars.

With all the good reviews I thought this place has to be good. We thought we hit the jackpot when we went there for happy hour. We purchased a whole box of donuts for $10. They put as much donuts that they could fit into the box. We got a good selection of donuts but we were not wowed. This was shocking to me because the hubs loves donuts. It was just not our cup of tea.

I would go to Donut Bar in San Diego so I was thrilled when I heard it was coming to Las Vegas. You can pre-order online to avoid the line if you're ordering at least a dozen. They do have a wide selection of specialty donuts & some are huge! However, this location isn't as up to par as their flagship location. I'm also never downtown in the morning so it's a hassle to even go there. It's good, but it's not as good, especially when there's other donut places that are easier to go to. I've been wanting to try the french toast donuts & ice cream cone, but they're only available on the weekends.

I wanted to go here our whole trip, and we finally made it on the last day. The donut selection is amazing and everything looks divine! We ordered the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut, as the girl working told us it is their best seller, as well as the maple bacon bar. Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e Donut: Very good, except for the fact that it took four bites before we got any filling. We genuinely thought it was just dough with a sugar topping and were sooo disappointed, so when we finally got to the filling we were relieved! It was tasty, but I wish it had more filling in it, as the bites without it just weren't good. Maple Bacon: Super yummy! There was a ton of salty bacon on top, which balanced the sweet maple frosting well. I would definitely come back here, and next time I would order something more exciting. A lot of the specialty donuts are HUGE, which is what kept us from ordering them this time.

Let's preface this review to say that Donut Bar claims to have the best donuts anywhere. I'll say that they're right, after visiting them for the first time, trying their donuts (multiple kinds) and a shot of their Espresso. Better than Voodoo Donuts! Why do I say that? 1. The recipes are fresh and homemade. I can taste it. No pre-made dough, no dough conditioners. Just pure, tasty donuts. Yum. 2. Great customer service. I didn't catch the name of the person who assisted me, served my donuts and pulled my espresso shot, but she was so friendly and peppy and happy and that was such a good espresso shot. 3. That was a really good espresso shot. I'll be back. Five Stars.

A cute little spot in dtlv... Very friendly folks behind the counter. Bright and airy. A great display for the donuts. We ordered the Homer. (My other half is a The Simpsons superfan.) And the Snickers donut. The Homer was delicious, soft, moist and really. Yeah. I'll say it. A happy party in my mouth. I would eat it again and again! That was a very well made and thought out donut. Brightly colored, cute sprinkles. Large in size. Easily a donut for two. The Snickers donut was a bit of a disappointment. It was dry and lacking. The dough didn't seem like it held up as well, possibly because it was chocolate? It was quite unsatisfying. In fact, it went unfinished.

I'm not a huge donut fan but they advertise they have the best donuts in the World so I had to check this place out. I came in Sunday 5/15 around 10:45am. Pictures "donut" do this place justice as many of the donuts looked like they were on steroids, they were huge! Those ones seemed to be more of the plain variety though whereas the specialty donuts were of the smaller size. They have lots of yummy flavors and I couldn't decide what to get. Luckily the employees were patient while I waited to make my selections. I finally chose: Strawberry big poppa tart Creme brulee Blueberry cheesecake Maple bacon My dining companion got the french toast donut and holy crap that was delicious. I should have gotten that. I thought they were all pretty good. The blueberry cheesecake had a yummy blueberry filling, but I didnt find the flavor to be very cheesecakey. The creme brulee was a fun one. It had a hard caramelized sugar coating on top of it that was totally reminiscent of real creme brulee. I had a couple bites and the inside was a sweet vanilla cream. I brought the other half home to my brother who said he almost broke a tooth on the hard shell, so watch out! The maple bacon was probably my favorite. It was a maple bar with real chunks of bacon on top. The salty/sweet combo never gets old and was a delight to my taste buds. The big poppa tart was really just like an oversized poptart. I thought it was fun, but was honestly my least fave. For 4 donuts it was $12, I dont think that is very unreasonable for what you are getting. I can see myself coming back here for sure. Pro Tip- If you follow them on IG @donutbar, you can check out their daily menu. They post it the night before so you know what to expect the following day.

Everyone jumped on the hype train when this place first opened and took over the old O Face Doughnuts location. My first run-in with Donut Bar was when I lived in San Diego in 2013. They were one of the first West Coast shops to try to emulate the cronut, which at the time, had just been invented by Dominique Ansel and was an overnight sensation. Donut Bar's Gaslamp location was very much like this one. There were huge lines that stretched out the door in the morning and they were often sold out by midday. In fact, I never did get to try one of their cronuts or "cro-bars," rather. Flash forward three years and once again Donut Bar is the darling of the donut world and selling out on a daily basis by 1 pm. I've visited this location twice now (but really once because one time it was sold out), and I'm still unconvinced that the majority of these doughnuts are that spectacular. For the most part, the novelty is the large size, especially the Big Poppa Tart, but I felt sick trying to finish an entire one myself. This fact holds true for most of the other large, yeast doughnuts as well, all priced $3-4. However, the one doughnut that I felt was unique enough to return here for was the crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e. The caramelized sugar topping has that deeply satisfying crack when broken in half and the filling flavor is completely on par with that of a vanilla crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e. It's advertised as vegan and also only $2. Overall, I wasn't impressed by the size or price. The yeast donuts turned dense if you didn't get them fresh. But highlights include the can't miss crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e donuts and Stumptown coffee (which just so happens to be my favorite coffee).
Great donuts. Great prices and selection. We had the Boston creme and cake batter donuts. They were amazing !

I eat approximately two donuts a year on average. Not really my thing. Someone brings in a box of donuts to work and I'm not even tempted. Bad for you and I just never find they are really very good. On our trip to Vegas in April I was doing my research on Yelp and saw the rave reviews on Donut Bar. Heather and I decided to grab a coffee and wander over on our first slightly hungover morning in Sin City. Am I ever glad we did. The donuts here are next level. So many tasty, colourful creations to choose from. We decided to share a Mexican Hot Chocolate Donut and a Maple Bacon Cinnamon Roll. Both were out of this world. The Donut was fresh and fluffy like nothing I had tried before. The chocolate and marshmallows were perfect. The Maple Bacon Cinnamon Roll stole the show however. The huge chunks of crispy bacon and the perfect blend of crunchy, chewy, sweet and gooey Cinnamon Roll made for an amazing morning treat I raved about all weekend. A place you must stop in and try just blocks from Fremont Street!

I love the size of these donuts! For donut fanatics like me, it is a glimpse of nirvana to see a giant fresh donut with delectable toppings. And the variety! So much to choose from, I get paralyzed when I want it all. I can't decide! And kudos to them for not serving all cake donuts, which is what many bakeries do so that they can stack multiple toppings and glazes on top without them losing their shape. Nope, Donut Bar serves nicely soft, huge yeast donuts, which is comparatively rare. And yummier :-) I chose the Brad Fritter with bacon and caramel, a blueberry cheesecake filled, and a lemon pistachio "glazed" yeast donut (small tire sized). Took me 2 days to finish them, such is my gluttony. They serve a nice assortment of caffeinated drinks to wash them down. Not a whole lot of sit down space, but that's the only shortcoming really. Worth the walk.

Adorable place, with fantastic donuts. The creative donuts here are the reasons why I wanted to give this place a try. It's like a new wave going on with donut chains popping up in cities. I feel a little bad for the mom and pop shops, they're going to have to step up their game. It's one thing to have cute and creative donuts but the most important part is that it has to taste good as well. I wanted to try the pretzel shape donut, but I didn't see it when I got there, so the the worker told me about a french toast donut that was made fresh. It took about several minutes to make, and it tasted just like what it was called a, "French Toast Donut". It was literally a french toast donut. I also ordered the bitrhday donut with oreo inside and a glazed buttermilk for my boyfriend. All the donuts we ordered exceeded or expectations. I can't wait to come back next time, and hopefully get my hands on the pretzel donut. *When you're there don't forget to check out their incredible aquarium created by the guys from TANKED.

I stayed down the street for one night since I came in super late! In the morning I was in search of an espresso that was going to be better than the free hotel coffee and a yelp search sent me here. I walked in and the staff was super friendly and let me look in the cases and take it all in while not pressuring me to make a decision. The strawberry short cake doughnuts looked amazing as did the one's with the pop tarts inside but, I chose a strawberry cheese cake doughnut, creme brulee doughnut and long doughnut filled with German cream. Extremely creative doughnut flavors and combinations without being over the top and not well executed. I headed back to the hotel and let me tell you the strawberry cheesecake doughnut only lasted for 4 bites. My friend ate the other two and they lasted about the same and he kept saying how amazing they were. I agreed because I had to stop myself from going back to get more for myself. The espresso was the strongest and best that I have had in quite a few years! I will definitely be back when I am here again in June!

Love, love, love donut bar. I have gone to the original one located in San Diego. From California to Nevada, awesome job chef! Donuts are still amazing, coffee is delectable, and staff is awesome! Only shocker was the line wasn't out the door like I was used to. Bonus for me, I got all my yummy delicious donuts I've longed for. Glad to see this place expanding, excited to come back soon!

After getting to experience Donut Bar in San Diego, I was stoked to find out they were coming to Vegas! We popped in today during their soft opening and not only did they have plenty of donuts and no line but we met the man behind the donuts. Friendly staff, we were greeted with smiles and offer suggestions on what to order. I chose a plain old fashioned donut, the Homer, a caramel latte and last but certainly not least....the Poptart!!!! Which I topped off with a cold brew Stumptown coffee. In the words of Ice Cube "today was a good day"!

Wow. Can I just say...MIND BLOWN! These delectable morsels are far from your everyday mom and pop donuts. Depending on the type you get, you're definitely in for a sugar rush! These donuts are definitely too pretty to eat, but I'm happy to accept that challenge. I've tried a variety of them and the only one I don't think I'll be trying and kind of disappointed about is the Mexican Hot Chocolate (i think its called). All others are very worth the hour I waited in line and 5 blocks I walked yesterday due to the walk-a-thon happening in downtown LV. You should also try their house made strawberry milk. Soo smooth and soo good!

Overall, a decent donut shop with a friendly staff. Below is a breakdown of all the donuts I tried... Strawberry Split: vegan! The fresh strawberries are a great contrast to the cream & fried donut. I wish the cream wasn't made from soy but I guess you can't be worried about GMOs at a donut shop lol Blueberry with Meyer lemon icing: reminds me of a blueberry muffin topped with lemon frosting. Not as good as the blueberry donuts from M&M Donuts in Orange County but still good. Red velvet: I would have personally liked it a little softer, but overall, I can't complain. Not bad, but not anything that I'd rave about. Salted caramel: just really HUGE, but average tasting Oreo birthday cake: For your sweet tooth, this donut tastes just like the name. More like dessert than a breakfast food, but I guess that's true of most of these donuts. Props on creativity! CrÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e: delicious & vegan! I just wish the hard caramel on top was a little thinner because it can overpower the yummy donut with creme filling a bit. Strawberry big poppa tart: A pop tart inside a donut made to look like a huge pop tart. Probably the most unique donut here. I'm not a huge fan of pop tarts but this pop tart hits the spot! If you want to be able to choose from all of their options, I suggest coming before 10am. I came at 10:30am & they had already run out of a couple things. If you come when they are almost done, like 12:30pm, you'll only have maple bars & salted caramel donuts to choose from; however, you can buy a box full of these donuts for $10 at that time.

Donut purists may not love this spot, but for those of you looking for super creative donuts, rush over to Donut Bar.
