I was one of the lucky few that got to attend the Homer's Wet Dream event where I was able to sample many of the donuts sold by Donut Bar, so when making plans to dine at nearby Carson Kitchen one Sunday I decided to stop into Donut Bar first to sample more of their offerings. I already knew that the Bigga Poppa, with a entire poptart inside, is the bomb. At $4 it's on the pricey side, but 2-3 people could share one of these, it's THAT big. The CrÃ¨me BrÃ»lÃ©e is another donut I like, it is priced at $2 and is more of a standard sized donut. For me.... it is all about the French Toast donut, cooked to order. If I had to choose one kind of donut to have for the rest of my life, it would be this one. Paired with a Stumptown Cold Brew, and you have one deliciously sweet breakfast. Even if the over-the-top, stuffed donuts don't do anything for you, Donut Bar is worth a visit just to try the delicious French Toast Donut. (Sold weekends only)

Five words - CHURRO DONUT ICE CREAM CONE!!! Seriously the best thing in Vegas especially on a hot summer day. But you have to go early bc they run out of their yummy goods so fast! So besides this delicious cone, we also got a few regular donuts. But of course these are far from "regular"! We ordered the oh-my-bday-cake-Oreo, blueberry cheesecake, blueberry with Meyer lemon, toasted coconut, birthday cake, and chocolate twix. My favorite (besides the donut cone with the vanilla soft serve AND chocolate sauce over the top) was the coconut and blueberry cheesecake. They were all good but seriously, I could not get over that darn churro cone! WITH SOFT SERVE! MY FAVORITE! I love soft serve ice cream! And to put it in a churro donut cone is freaking geeeenius! We went back a few days a later but went too late! I seriously almost cried when I saw the sold out on the window!! This is a DEFINITE stop if you're just visiting Vegas or if you live in Vegas. But go early, they run out of everything pretty darn fast, by lunch time, you're gonna be outta luck! Def worth it to wake up early and get that donuts and ice cream!!
wasn't a personal fan i thought it was a little over priced.can find better donuts elsewhere

National Donut Day! Free Birthday Cake donut. I love the price on these awesome donuts. Crime BrÃ»lÃ©e never disappoints. Make sure to stop by here before the free donuts are all gone! All employees wore masks and gloves. Was greeted warmly and received decent and timely service this morning. Thank you all at Donut Bar LV, see you again soon!

Beetus Heaven!!! This place was so legit. I was intimidated because there's just columns and rows of sinful pleasures! We stopped in around 10am and the sweet counter girl said they sold out of a lot of flavors, honestly, you wouldn't even have noticed bc it was still jam packed with Doughnuts. I decided with the Nutella Doughnut and lemme say this.. every pastry I've had for the last 30 years on this green Earth tasted like trash compared to this. It just melted in your mouth and the fricken thing was huge for only $3. Definitely a highlight on our trip.

First time at this donut shop and my kiddo and I loved it! I had the French Toast Donut and it was delicious. My daughter had the Caramel Crunch, I think, which she literally had to do a whole happy-dance about. The weather was really nice today so we headed towards the back where you can exit towards a courtyard with outdoor eating and sitting areas. We didn't notice the rooftop seating at the beginning or else we probably would've enjoyed our food there instead. Overall, this spot exceeded my expectations for a don't shop!

4.8 stars. What's not to love?! Giant, fresh donuts, lots of choices, free donut for the kids, free water, clean bathrooms, seating outdoors and at a counter... Yup, lived up to the hype. $1.50-$6, but the donuts are supersized. Quality. My favorite was the maple glazed bacon donut. Light, not was sweet as the others... Crispy, salty bacon. Old town/downtown Vegas, a few miles North of the strip.

Came here after seeing a video and several pictures of the grilled cheese donut sandwich. To my disappointment, we were told they were sold out -so that was the start of it. I got the mexican hot chocolate donut, which was $3. I thought it was worth it, not because of the flavor, it didn't taste much like mexican hot chocolate, or chocolate for that, but it did taste like a good yeast donut. It was huge, which totally made up for the price. My bf got a s'mores donut, which was a big fail. It tasted like a less sweet version of something dunkin donuts (a favorite of mine) would try to make. At $3, and a quarter of the size of my donut, I didn't think it was worth it. All in all, this is pretty much hype. Try it out and tell me what you think!

There's a wide variety of donuts - a lot of unique flavors ! I got the s'mores and birthday cake donut - the s'mores was really good and super filling ! The service was fast and everyone working there was efficient. There's ice cold water in the back that really helps with the Vegas heat. Some of the donuts are expensive though so be prepared to spend money because it adds up quick.

My family went to the Donut Bar this past weekend and on weekends they give out a free donut for children. That is a very kind gesture that is becoming more rare. Our donuts, coffee and chocolate milk were all great. I was very impressed with their HUGE selection of donuts. I had a difficult time just picking half a dozen. You have to checkout their fish tank that they had made by the guys from Tanked It looks awesome and the donuts look so real you could almost eat them. ***** They offer a military discount ***** I believe it was 10% it might have been more but whatever the amount it is great when business offer something to say thank you.

I have visited the Donut Bar twice. As a diabetic I only eat donuts occasionally. Each time I have gone in I have been greeted by a patient and professional staff member. When I say patient, I am referring to the fact it is extremely difficult to decide what to get. Since the last time I was there, they have made what seem to be "giant" donuts. Believe me I wanted the giant blood red orange donut! However, I picked the strawberry cheese cake and a creme brulee. I really liked the strawberry cheesecake donut even though I thought it should be called a strawberry filled donut more than anything. The creme brulee donut had outstanding filling! It was a delicious decadence. I wasn't into the top of the donut but I haven't had much exposure to creme brulee. Just to mention, I have also had their vegan donuts and loved them as well. I had the vegan donut when I had company in town and bought a dozen for everyone. It was a bit of sticker shock when the dozen cost me $23 but when you eat the donuts you understand you are getting "every penny's worth." Overall, I would have to say these donuts taste as if they were cooked with care and pride in craftsmanship. They are worth the drive when you have a donut craving that won't go away and demands gourmet taste.

This place is the best in Vegas Love the donuts and the service is just awesome Always bring a box of donuts home when I visit Vegas They sold out quick and during weekends they have the best French toast made out of donut yes it is the best

Meh! not impressed about average donut place I got almost every donut they had and none of them blew me away except the price of them! Nice staff Quik service but sad to say I won't be back to this place.

What a perfect way to begin a morning, with Donuts from the Donut Bar!! The staff is always friendly, donuts are amazingly delicious, fresh and I love the creativity in trying new combinations. The Blue Moon is my personal favorite so far, I find myself checking Donut Bar Las Vegas on Facebook to see what tomorrows menu will be since it is always different. Once they are gone they are gone for the day so I recommend getting here early especially on weekend's for best selection and street parking is free before 8am. Enjoy and Happy Yelping!

Who doesn't love a fun donut, well Donut bar has them! Wonder women, fidget spinner donut, homer donuts they got it! Now their Texas size donuts. Not bad. I got the green tea. The green tea donut batch was a bit over cooked & lacked some flavor. Maybe I should have gotten something else. Their not bad donuts, jus iG worthy and hipster donut vibe. Friend got the wonder women huge donut. 2-3$ donuts. Cool fast service. Coffee. Nitro. Milk. Parking on St. located right off the strip.

Huge gourmet donut selections. Plenty of coffee flavors and creams to add if you like. Very nice staff and great management. I had never heard of the plane as I never go downtown. When we got a sweet craving while there Yelp helped us find this gem. I lived it and told my friends and family. It will be fun to try another monster sized sweet treat
They never disappoint! Donuts are delicious and service is literally unmatched !!!! I always get the grilled cheese and add extra (like 4 extra) of the Spicy mayo !

such an amazing hole in the wall donut shop!!!! what's pictured is two boxes for $20 dollars they said it was happy hour time and one box is $10 dollars and you fill it up as much as you can!! My favorite donut was the strawberry cheesecake one and the crepe brÃ»lÃ©e! the other picture is churro ice cream cones I was expecting more for the churro ice cream donut cones especially cause they're $6 dollars, the ice cream wasn't up to my standards but you can get chocolate syrup or caramel syrup on it! The donut shop is about 7-10 minutes away from stratosphere.

Was here a month back in the morning, and had breakfast before heading to LA. Had a crÃ¨me brulee and it was so good that I ordered two more right after the first bite. The donuts were fresh and soft. Coffee was good. Friendly staffs. There's a backyard patio with a few tables.

I could not believe the size of some of these Donuts as soon as we walked in. It is exactly what you were expecting if not more. We were only supposed to get one donut but ended up with 4 the birthday cake donut with super super sugary very delicious but not for the faint of heart. The crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e doughnut was unbelievably good the center was so creamy and not too sweet almost looks like a vanilla bean creme custards something. Death goodness! But let me tell you something... Their regular Donuts are so good and so fluffy I've never had a fluffier donut.....and on the weekends they have free donuts for kids and they also make French toast donuts made to order... What. Im about to walk my happy arse doen there now to get the french donuts!

Yes they have Vegan donuts BUT their staff act like they don't know which ones are vegan or like I'm from mars bc I'm vegan. I rather not have anything and drive 25 min back home than to give a place with bad service my hard earned money.
Great selection of Vegan Tasty Treats (Doughnuts and Apple Fritters).. So delicious and so Healthy ;)
Over rated-over priced. $5 for a donut, not worth it. I had better ones. The only one that stood out was the old fashion that had chocolate glazed on one fourth of the piece

Definitely was excited to try Donut Bar out after all the hype and rave reviews I was hearing about it. Came here on a random Wednesday morning around 8:30 am and parked on the street for $2 (didn't see any other parking). I had heard that this place could have a line out the door with people waiting to order...I was a little worried that there might be a line to get donuts and at this point I was getting a little hangry. Fortunately for us there were only about 4-5 other patrons inside and we didn't have to wait at all! We were instantly greeted by the peppy workers with warm smiles and hellos, the place itself is pretty small with seating for only about 5-6 people inside. They did say they had seating outside, but we didn't check it out because we were able to snag seats inside. My friend and I really didn't know what to order so they gave us a couple of recommendations. I also was super excited because they serve Stumptown Coffee from Portland here! We ended up getting 4 donuts, 1 chocolate milk, and 1 Stumptown Coffee cold brew for the both of us all for about $20-$25. A little on the pricier side, but just remember people these are specialty donuts not your run-of-the-mil grocery store ones. I don't remember the specific names of the donuts so sorry in advance! -Donut with Strawberry Pop Tart In It - Delicious, but wow this is super sweet! My friend and I felt like we had to make an appt with our dentist after eating this one -CrÃ¨me Brule Donut - This was the best one in my opinion, the outside had a nice crispy glaze covering it and when I say crispy I mean crispy, it had a tasty cream inside that wasn't overly sweet either -Lemon Cream Donut - My second favorite out of the bunch, the lemon whipped cream inside was amazing and they put a ton of the whipped cream inside too! -Boston Cream Donut Bar - This was probably the most basic donut out of the bunch, it was your standard boston cream donut bar...why my friend decided to get a basic donut at a specialty donut shop I will never know, but I digress...it was still decent! -Cold Brew - not as good when I had it in Portland, it tasted a little bit on the bitter side but still delicious nonetheless I for sure see myself coming back here whenever I want a tasty specialty donut, probably on a weekday morning though because nobody wants to wait in a ridiculously long line (sorry to all you normal 9-5 workers out there, I'll think about you the next time I eat here).

Yum, yum, yum! Never have I been so excited to eat a donut! I parked at the meters on 6th street and the walk was not bad at all. You just turn the corner and all the donuts are staring at you. You walk right in and the prices of the donuts are to your immediate right. They may have different donuts depending on the season, but majority of them are the same. They're all very delicious though! I just got a variety of donuts, choosing the ones that looked good. You NEED to get the Birthday Cake donut with an surprise Oreo inside. I was so excited for it. I heard a lot of hype for the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut because of that *crack* when you break it... I tried doing that while recording it... fail. LOL. It's harder than it looks, literally. And I wasn't a big fan of the taste of it. So I went back to enjoying my birthday cake donut. YUM. Come early because I've heard that donuts sell out quick and once they're gone, Donut Bar closes. Enjoy!

Pre-ordered on their website (available from 3-9pm the prior day). Choice to pick up at 8, 9, or 10 am. Minimum order of 1 dozen. Not all flavors are available for pre-order (didn't realize this was the case until pickup). Friendly customer service. They have a coffee/espresso bar as well. The Sumpton coconut cold brew sold by the single serve carton was really good. Not too sweet with a hint of coconut. Notes for the donuts I tasted this time: db Nutella - didn't really taste like Nutella, more like milk chocolate with crushed almonds on top. Really large size, frosting was borderline too thin for the size of the donut. The donut part had good flavor and texture on it's own, which is always a good sign. Creme brÃ»lÃ©e - smallest in size, but I appreciated that. Really enjoyed the crunchy sugar crust. The cream was also the perfect sweetness. My favorite of the bunch. Butter beer - larger size. I was expecting a pronounced butterscotch flavor, but didn't even get a hint. The Harry Potter theme was cute. Lemon pistachio - larger size. Hey, this one actually tastes like lemon and pistachio! Good balance of sweetness with the lemon. S'mores on fire - standard "normal" size. The most aesthetically pleasing. The only cake donut of the dozen. Didn't care for the actual donut part which was a little dry and lacking chocolate flavor. The marshmallow on top was good; probably made in-house? Maple bacon - bar shape, normal sized. I'm a fan of the whole salty/ sweet thing, but this was just ok. Caramel latte - larger size. Had good caramel flavor, but didn't detect any coffee at all. I feel like the names of the donuts set up certain expectations, but when the flavors weren't there, it was disappointing. I am willing to give them another shot though, since I did enjoy the creme brÃ»lÃ©e.
Omg!!!! Best DONUTS ever!!!! Super friendly service. If your a fan of donuts don't miss out on this place you won't be disappointed.

Got four donuts and were even given some freebies to try since it was the first time visiting and hearing of the place. All were yummy and unique. Atmosphere was perfectly donut themed and employees were great!

So after the amazing opportunity to eat these donuts at an elite event, I wanted to come by and see the selection in person. Early on a weekday, I stopped off and picked up 6 donuts for the secretary and I to share. This donut shop is gourmet and heightened flavors. When I brought home the extra donuts for the hubby and kids, they generally ignored them. I was disappointed, but the hubby said that the flavors were outside of the kids wheelhouse. I know that the place has kid friendly options on the weekend and the chocolate milk on draft will draw my little one in. So, maybe, I need to bring them in and let them pick their own flavor options. Here's what we tried. The dipped old fashion was eh. The Pop Tart was amaze-balls. Coworker and I took turns with the plastic knife as we cut off sections. The jelly inside is tasty. The frosting is perfect and not too much. The bacon on top of the Brad fritter should just be served by itself. I wanted to eat it all. Coworker told me to, as she like the fritter, but the bacon was a bit off putting for her. She had the blueberry cheesecake; didn't share. Split the creme brulee. The cracked sugar top is interesting. The star of the show, in my opinion, is the creme filling. Looking for a weekend to go back. I hear the trick is to get there early, as they sell out of flavors.

Giant. Giant donuts. Delicious giant donuts. Amazingly puffy delicious giant donuts. Fresh and amazingly puffy delicious giant donuts. Great variety of puffy delicious giant donuts. I failed to eat just one giant donut. It was a delicious giant donut. Giant donut! Giant! Be sure to get there early because they are open until they sell out.

woke up to the screeching sound of my alarm.. sun was already out to greet me as I remembered why I had chosen to wake up at such an ungodly hour.. D O N U T B A R .. It was my first time & I heard this place was the place to be for donut lovers, which I am. Drove over to a still sleepy yet incredibly sunny downtown LV where I parked in an empty parking lot.. The heat was already starting to sear the air in my car.. I had gotten there a bit early to my surprise so it was about 11 minutes before I made my way to the entrance. I walked and turned the corner as the low murmur of the crowd awaiting reached my ears. There must have been about 7-9 people in front of me.. And by the time Donut Bar opened their door- I was no longer last, but found the line had started to wrap around the corner I had turned on earlier.. People made their way in and I trailed behind. As I stepped in, I relished in the coolness that hit me (thanks A/C). Then I saw the sight before.. Donuts, all shapes and sizes.. All different from each other and so many to choose from. But the one that caught my eye was the classic strawberry donut, you kno with the whip cream and blueberries and the stuff sits in between two halves of a donut. Oh yeah, that's the one. I got my goods and saw that the line had only grown even longer.. And I was immediately thankful for the rude yet early awakening. I sat outside in the little courtyard and ate the delicious thing. I could NOT even finish it- it was so giant and so good.. It was quite overwhelming ! But it was so worth. I left feeling stuffed but so happy. If you're ever around, pay this place a visit and set your alarms because you will want to come here to try their vast array of donuts. Service is speedy, efficient & awesome. Prices are more than reasonable. And donuts are FANTASTIC.

Holy hell this place has changed my breakfast game forever! Located on 6th & Carson (near some other tasty places), you can't miss the place with a large "Donut" sign outside. I came here with my mom and little brother to come enjoy something different for breakfast. Immediately we were greeted by a friendly gal that told us about the best donuts and recommended her favorites. I can't remember the names but we had a strawberry whipped cream, Nutella filled, and red velvet. My favorite was definitely the strawberry donut. The whipped cream is soy-based and the donut was so light. Definitely looks lighter than it is! The outside is super cute with lots of seating and artwork. I can't wait to come back and try some other delicious treats.

So, with this place receiving so much fanfare I had to stop in and see what all the fuss was about. I arrived when almost all the donuts were gone but still managed to score a dozen with the help of my good friend. We walked right in and were greeted by the friendly and fun staff. We viewed the menu for the day and could not believe the variety of donuts. There were at least 20+ flavors to choose from and this included vegan choices which I can totally get behind. These aren't just donuts, some were like mini cakes and were almost big enough to cover your whole face (No Joke)! I had never seen such large donuts before and could not believe how creative these people are with the large variety of choices. We managed to score some delicious options, such as the Strawberry Split, Mexican Hot Chocolate, Blood Orange, Boston Creme, The Oreo Donut (with an Oreo inside) and a couple of creme brÃ»lÃ©e'. My favorite donut from this batch was the Boston Creme. The creme oozes with flavor and tasted heavenly. The donut itself was moist and fresh. The creme was so rich that I found it a little overwhelming to eat in one sitting so I ate half the first day and finished it off the second day. Yeah, it was rough.... The Strawberry Split was layered with fresh strawberries and whipped creme in the middle of a large sugar donut. A different take on the strawberry short cake and perhaps a step up. I almost added a small drizzle of chocolate since I had it for dessert that night. I shared the other donuts with my staff and family and they were all very complimentary. My daughter really liked the Oreo Donut and was surprised when she found the cookie in the middle. The service was outstanding and so friendly. The shop is quaint and very clean with not a whole lot of room and it makes this place nice and cozy. They also have a new t- shirt for advertising that is available for purchase. It has a great color scheme and it gives a shout out to our city! I can hardly wait to go back early in the morning when the donuts are fresh out of the fryer. I think I can hear a Homer donut calling my name.

Amazing donuts for affordable prices. I went in around noon, and they had a special of buy 1 get 1 free OR buy a box for $10. I'm not a huge donut fan because bread + lots of sugar makes me feel sick so I only got 2! (They close until all the donuts are all sold) FOOD 5/5: -Creme Brulee ($2): This is what their famous for because INSIDER FOOD showcased this particular donut online and it became a hit! I LOVED it, I'm a fan of regular creme brulee, and they did an amazing job of filling the cream inside the donut & having a sweet/crunch on the top. -Old Fashion Glazed (Free): This was fantastic! If your not into all the sweetness and bread, I strongly recommend this donut. Simple but very good. SERVICE 5/5: -Right when you get in your greeted by smiles and whoever is working is more than happy to recommend what they're most famous for & what flavors you like!

Def a fan. Keep in mind these donuts are very fresh and do not do what I did and leave a Strawberry Shortcake one out in the box on the counter overnight. It will turn into a green fuzzy science experiment. Hubby went at 8am one morning and when I woke up I woke up to a dozen vegan donuts...ummmmm no way we were going to eat all that madness. This review is for the vegan donuts only. I found my fav was the green tea. Second fav was the creme brÃ»lÃ©e. Just get what you are going to eat that day...they will hit the bin the next day if not :)

The whipped creme donut with strawberries is VEGAN! They have a lot of vegan options and they're all amazing! The coffee is delicious too. The pricing is fair due to the quality of the donuts. My complaint: The donuts are first come first serve and they seem to run out pretty quickly. I wish they would stay open longer and make more donuts.

We got here at noon also, and also found there to be no line. We were excited to try it, and pleasantly surprised that they had several vegan donut choices. And it was buy one get one free, so we were out of there for under $4. The donuts were very very sweet. I know donuts are supposed to be sugary but this took it to a new level. My teeth hurt a little, so I picked the fruit off of the top and threw the rest away. My husband said that he had to do the same with his. That said, we did arrive late so we had slim pickings. Perhaps if we got there earlier, we would have had more choices?

Tried the donut bar yesterday! Expectations were pretty high from the reviews, so we were excited. We got the cream brÃ»lÃ©e, peanut butter and jelly, red velvet cake donut , and the sea salt caramel donut. The overall quality of the donut was disappointing it had more of a bread texture. I didn't know if we just got an old/ stale batch, that's probably why it had that texture. These donuts aren't cheap. for our donuts we had paid about $20, so I was expecting quality and unfortunately it didn't meet my expectations. The flavors of the donuts were very good though

If you're a fan of really funky sweet doughnuts piled high with toppings then look no further. There's no shortage of selection here on creative doughnuts. The vibe is fun and hip, very friendly staff and no complaints here on the coffee. I will say it's aggressively priced, which is understandable seeing as how they load up most of their doughnuts, but when you're just wanting a good old fashioned or a buttermilk bar, maybe not the best fir what you're paying. Their doughnuts run basically double what any other doughnut shop in town runs.
ETA: Try the vegan grilled cheese donut sandwich. It's a one-in-a-lifetime gotta-do-it kinda situation. I think I only need a single bypass instead of a double, cuz, yanno, vegan.

I've heard great things about this place and for a good reason. First, the owner (who I forgot his name--my apologies!!!) was amazing. He was super friendly, and patient (willingly to deal with my awe of his menagerie of donuts.) If you like--love donuts, this is the spot for you. I was surprised it wasn't busier, because this business is definitely a force to be reckoned with in the Downtown scene. I will even go so far as to say it's better than Pinkbox. So if you're craving something to satisfy that sweet tooth, look no further. Also, can we talk about the milks they have on tap? Innovative, creative, and fun! I will be back and with friends ;)

This place is very cute! I stopped by to buy a few donuts and I was not disappointed some were sold out already but I still had a good selection to pick from. Customer service was excellent and the prices are very reasonable if you're near by stop by :)

There is a reason why Donut Bar was voted best donut in Las Vegas let alone in the country by numerous sites. Donut Bar has a wide variety of donuts that can meet everyone's needs. All of their donuts are made to perfection. They are light, fluffy, gooey, and any other adjective you can think of. The french toast donut is the go to donut. Just imagine a massive circular french toast covered in powered sugar and then the drizzle of the warm maple syrup. Other donuts to consider would be the Big Pappa Donut which has a whole pop tart inside the donut! This thing weights 1lb! Next you have to get the creme brulee donut which is a soft yeast round filled with creme brulee and topped with caramelized sugar! The next must have would be the Oh My Birthday Cake Oreo which is Birthday Cake Oreo stuffed donut topped with cake batter glaze, pastel sequins, and cookie crumbs. This place is also very welcoming. The staff is super friendly and the head Chef Jeff is one of the nicest people you will ever meet! So, if you are in Vegas and you are craving Donuts and coffee (They Serve Nitro Cold Brew Too) stop by Donut Bar! Donut miss out! BrandonFitFoodie

This place has been hyped up because of it's delicious well presented donuts. I Took my boys there to try out some of their creations. My one son decided on the donut "cone" with vanilla Ice cream, I decided on the apple fritter and my younger son got the birthday cake donut. Here's where the review goes south: My son tried and ate the cone with ice cream and said that the cone tasted like pre made pilsbury pastry dough, the apple fritter I was expecting to taste full of apple and moist was VERY DRY, over cooked and had not much Apple to find in it and as for my younger sons birthday cake donut it too was very dry and made Dunkin look like the king of the cake donuts. The 3 donuts total were $11.00, yes that was for 3 donuts. So for them to claim they are #bestdonutsintheworld not in the eyes of this consumer. Pink box donuts can easily out do donut bar on quality, taste and price.

My favorite Donut place in Vegas! You gotta get em quick though because the run out so quick in the morning... because they're like crack and so fricken good! They have a variety of flavors and different seasons donuts. Get yourself some addicting DONUTS! The French toast donut is my fav!
This place is awesome! First come first serve so come early. They have plenty of vegan options and they change the flavors all the time. Donuts were fresh and delicious! Highly recommend!
Day after doughnuts from here are not good. They do not hold up. Pinkbox is forever my favorite!

Was posted in the area for work and managed to make it in right after they opened. The selection of donuts is amazing! They dream up some of the most delicious combinations you can imagine as well as keeping a few simple classics on hand. The place is filled with energy and the staff really does show pride in their creations!

I used yelp to place an order the night before, and the experience was great! I walked in, skipped the line, picked up my order, and walked out in less than 30 seconds. This place makes an exceptional apple fritter, and the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut is a little piece of heaven with crystalized sugar on top. We come here on every visit to Las Vegas.

Love this place!!! They open early so get the donuts before they sells out!!! my friend took me here for the first time. They had so many unique types of donuts but I chose my favorite basic maple/chocolate bar. Very cool spot .. it's located in downtown.

I went to the donut bar based on the yelp reviews Sorry 18.00 gets you stale creme brulee donuts Stale coconut chocolate donut, stale maple bar. The two stars go to the bourbon caramel donut. The only fresh one in the bunch. Oh and the creme brulee is NOT creme brulee, its a cheap vanilla pudding and not even tasty vanilla pudding. Not returning to spend that kind of money on garbage I decided to drive out of the Las Vegas strip after reading the reviews. God was i wrong to trust. Either people were drunk when they came here or i arrived on an off day.

The first time ever going there it was pretty awesome. It's a pretty cool They had a lot of donuts to pick from. The donut I got was called "The Homer", yes like Homer Simpson. Classic donut, pink frosting, and sprinkles. That donut was literally bigger than my face, it was very sweet, and delicious. Totally grab a coffee or milk to go with it! Donut Bar is pretty popular. So the biggest downside is that there's not that many seats inside, they do have a few seat outside in the shade. It's Las Vegas, even in the shade it's like 102° outside. I would totally recommend someone to go to the Donut Bar in Downtown Las Vegas!

I want to start off by saying I've never actually gone inside the establishment, but I follow them on Instagram and all the fitness models post epic cheat meals with these donuts. So~ when my friend went to Vegas, I made him bring home a dozen for me. Little did I know, a dozen would actually be 2 big boxes! It was totally worth making him lug it around though. Because these donuts were so bomb! We do not have anything like these in Philly. I mean a donut with a poptart in it?! Anyways, after cutting a piece of each flavor to taste them, I ended up freezing them because I couldn't possibly eat them all in one sitting, well I could, but I decided I shouldn't. Well let me tell you, have any of you guys tried frozen donuts before? It was probably even better than when I tried it fresh! How could that be possible?! Well some of the donuts were too sweet when I had it fresh (the poptart one especially) and when it was frozen it was the perfect amount of sweetness. I still dream of eating these donuts. I need to make a trip to Vegas.
Great donuts... friendly staff... just get there early or those Donuts will be gone...
It was absolutely amazing! The donuts are huge! And they are just as good as they look!!!

Based on the two mornings I went to The Donut Bar I can say they have amazing presentation but the basics are lost in the details. For example, this morning I had the fritter with bacon, the bacon was high quality and perfect, but the fritter was so done the edges were almost black. I could only eat the center of it. Yesterday I had an Old Fashion and a Strawberry Cheesecake donut. The Old Fashioned was dry , maybe cooked a bit hot, and the Strawberry Cheesecake just tasted like strawberry filing, no tangy cheese to give it that cheesecake vibe. The staff are friendly, the donuts are very beautiful, and they brew Stumptown coffee. These are all good things but I have to have more substance with my flash.

Not enough time right now for a verbose review...but just know that these donuts are AWESOME! Definitely try a creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut and a big poppa tart!! So many choices!! Everything that I bought today was really yummy. Around the corner on 6th street there's a 3 space, 15 minute, free parking area. Use those spaces unless you're ready to pay for street parking downtown.

Come here early for a wider selection because once they sell out, they sell out! However, some donuts like their grilled cheese and french toast are made to order. Note that they may not offer the grilled cheese and french toast donuts every day though. Having been to the Donut Bar in San Diego, I can say the Las Vegas location is definitely bigger and less crowded (at least on a Saturday morning, though I guess it's off season for Vegas right now). I'd say it's most worth to come here if you're excited to try their unique flavors. Blood orange, birthday cake oreo, and the blueberry cheesecake are delicious and not too sweet actually! Also, if you buy a dozen, you get one donut free. We ended up spending $29 (including tax) for three big donuts and 10 small ones, which runs a bit pricey but I'd argue it's worth it especially if you're splitting donuts. The big donuts are gigantic anyways and are (more than) worth the $3. Service is friendly and location is hard to miss (with a big donut painted on the outside of the building).

I was very excited to try these donuts. I finally made time to go to this donut shop on my day off. I purchased 4 donuts & was given an additional 4 donuts for free. The customer service was good, but the donuts were not. I was sadly disappointed in these donuts. I will most likely choose another place to buy donuts whenever I get a craving.

Donut bar takes donuts to the next level. I have had three donuts from here (homer simpson, boston cream, oreo birthday) and all were great. There is a new menu each time with some staples. The donuts are $2-4 each but delicious and some are really meant for two people. They also have caffeine drinks. The location is a block off of Freemont so pretty easy to get to. But, it is pretty popular so don't wait too long to go. Go early, go hungry, buy some extra to go for later!
Amazing place for pic and all different kinds of sweet donuts staff was nice and helpful with all the flavors and kinds. Get there early because they run  out super fast.

I've been coveting the CremÃ© BrÃ»lÃ©e donut from donut bar ever since I heard that satisfying crunch on a viral video 4 years ago. (Give or take) l. Well, I finally returned to sin city and was able to get my paws on one. The crunch was just as satisfying as I was hoping, but the donut was overall just ok. Totally worth the money, but surprisingly dry inside. The filling is a custard, which helped the inside texture and kept he middle moist, but towards the sides, there was a staleness that was probably from the time of Day we went. I'm not sure how anyone wakes up before 10am after a night in Vegas, but if you're awake, I bet they are better. The place is incredibly cute, they have a donut fish tank that was adorable and a bathroom with every donut lovers favorite Simpsons scene. Worth the stop if you're visiting or the consistent visit if you're a local!

so reading the reviews for this shop, I was expecting some deliciousness, some extraordinary, some awesomeness and all I got was another "wtf" moment, and a feeling of "should I call and complain and ask for my money back"...I mean, I dropped $25 for 8 donuts...ya let's get to the review... so I found myself in the downtown area recently, and remember hearing about a donut that crunched on top, looked it up and was happy it was there. so I drove over to the spot in downtown, and checked it out. walked into the shop, it's small, narrow, but it gets right to the point. the display of donuts was very nice. they all look delicious, and in my mind I was excited to finally try the assortment I was putting together. I went for 2 of the creme brulee donuts, one that I think had a velvet cake inside, one of the poptart donuts, a white sprinkle, and a chocolate top one and some others. total was $25 (price shock hits, it's donuts!!) but ok I paid it, drove home and dove in with wifey. this is where it just went wrong. now, I usually don't take photos, but recently I have been of the meals and stuff I'm eating or places I'm going to, and this place got the picture... every single donut we ate was dry. they were all over cooked I guess. the batter used had no flavor or sweetness. the flavors were not there, it was like trying to enjoy it but not...I only took a bite or 2 of each donut and trashed it. throughout the day just picked at them all. when I got the one that crunches, the creme brulee one, I was just SO let down. the taste was honestly gross. that mixture of the crunch on the top of your mouth, then mixing it with a soft/dry donut that has no flavor was just really gross. and I'm not picky, especially when it comes to what should have been sweet and delicious, was a major fail. again, every donut was dry, and they all had no flavor or bland flavoring. even the pop tart donut was a bust. the cake mix they use is just no good. I don't know if it was that day or what, but no go for me. now, I've tried pink box donuts which was ok. the only donut shop here in town that seems to be excellent every time is Winchells on Meadows Lane with the subway. that place is 5 star superb. I understand though, this donut bar place, it made it on tv or whatever, and people want to see it, but all these 5 star reviews is just not possible if it's consistently like my experience when quality comes in. check out my photos...you'll see what I mean.

Best donuts in the world these are not. (Depite Donut Bar's claim). Saw this place in the evening after it had closed while walking near the Fremont district and made it a point to return on Saturday morning based on the excellent reviews. Ultimately was disappointed. There were some highlights: fast service and an efficient setup to get customers in and out quickly. I always appreciate that. They also have some interesting flavors and combos. Lowlights: All our donuts were dry. Not being dry is the number one requirement for a good donut, and Donut bar basically failed on that one, precluding it from anything more than three stars. I also think the bacon on pastries thing has passed its prime. Ultimately Donut Bar has decent donuts, but they were dry and I wouldn't again venture out of my way to return.

Yum!! So many good donuts to choose from you will need to visit multiple times. The last time I went I tried to donut with the fried Oreo in the middle. Must try! Past times I have been able to try their specialty, the Pop Tart doughnut. This thing is 1lb! So tasty and big enough to share (if you're feeling generous!) The staff is very friendly as well. Good addition to the downtown area! I will be back :) Tip**Get there early or go on weekdays to have a choice of full selection-they run out early because they are so popular and tasty!

Overrated and overpriced. We went first thing in the morning and the donuts were really dry. They tasted like they were old, not fresh. We tried five different ones and I wasn't impressed. I didn't even want to eat them. They did have good chocolate milk though.

Items Sampled: Cinnamon Roll Blueberry Pop Tart Blueberry Meyer Lemon Cake Maple Bacon Bar Vanilla Cream Bar with Chocolate Glaze Red Velvet Triple Chocolate Samoa Vanilla Glazed Chocolate Glazed with Peanuts Snickers - Peanuts, Chocolate, Caramel Twix - Peanut Butter, Caramel Fresh off an Orange County shutter reportedly due to inflated real estate rates, an import from San Diego intended to replace O-Face Doughnuts which recently closed in Downtown Las Vegas for reasons just the same, it was during the soft-opening that a stop was made at Donut Bar, the friendly manager and his team all-but giving away product - a total of three purchased by myself and a friend yielding a total order of sixteen. Having myself already visited the San Diego location, parking a serious issue for good-yet-expensive goods that failed to wow in the same way as Sidecar, Blue Star or Stan's in LA, arrival at Donut Bar Las Vegas shows little to have changed from the space's previous occupant and although coffee has been replaced by Stumptown the prices are equally as aggressive while a general lack of seating remains. A bit picked over at 1:45pm on Saturday, the Fritter gone but a dozen novel options including cake, raised and Specials all accounted for, service at Donut Bar takes a page from the youthful kids at O-Face and currently using a few staff from sunny SoCal to educate cashiers as well as customers the knowledgebase and readiness speak to experience and the Turn-Key location, though quality of the fried dough will certainly need some tweaks. Taking the goods elsewhere to eat, conversation about everything from music to donuts and the local dining scene spanning across two-plus hours of small tastes, a first look at Donut Bar's raised options speaks of sharable portions that may help to soften the $3/each pricing and with a soft center somewhere between Brioche and Angelfood the texture shines in the setting of several glazes, classic candy bars no doubt playing a role in several of the variants. Clearly needing some time to adjust to the desert with items featuring cocoa powder, both the triple chocolate and red velvet far too dry to be enjoyed, additional cake options were hit-and-miss in terms of consistency, the Blueberry Meyer Lemon unfortunately tasting as though it comes from the same mix sold for 69-cents elsewhere while the Girl scout themed Samoa was far more toothsome, perhaps as a result of coconut oil that several local Vegan bakers use to retain moistness in their cakes. Not really shocking anyone with Maple Bacon Bars in 2016, the Vanilla Cream-filled Long John equally yawn inducing but more tasty overall, Cinnamon Rolls kept under warming lamps fail to hit the same highs as nearby Glutton or other artisans like Mothership or CRAFTKitchen despite a similar price per portion, the signature "Big Poppa" appropriately compared to "Fair Food" by a youngster joining in our tasting, the added jelly almost admitting that the Pop Tart alone is nothing but a gimmick and nowhere near the housemade quality of jams, creams and compotes made daily at O-Face. TWO AND A HALF STARS: Recently seeing a growth in diversity as relates to donuts, nearby Pawn Donuts and Coffee sourcing better from Donut Mania while Real Donuts on Charleston fares slightly better in texture at nearly half the price only half a mile away, one hopes that Donut Bar received a more favorable lease than that which doomed O-Face or their OC Location...or that they have some tricks besides freebies to help bolster their branding before they are too far out of the gate.
This place is worth it !!! Wake up early and head to Donut Bar! The earlier the better before they are sold out. So delicious!
This place was AMAZING! Had them delivered to our hotel. Strawberry pop tart and the original vanilla bean won our vote!

This is a must see when in Vegas. Found this place just by chance while charging the car. The overall vibe gives the local feel but with a new twist. I had the Mexican chocolate donut and was not disappointed.
First time, won't be the last time! Great location, fun decor, super yummy donuts, plus chocolate milk if you're not feeling coffee with your confectionaries! Thanks Donut Bar, I'll be back!

The donuts here were tasty and very beautiful to look at; however, I think the price is not necessarily justified. It is a nice place to visit, but not for a return trip. As you can see the photos, the case is filled with some pretty cool donuts. The second photo is the Nutella donut, and while it was good it was not filled very full.

I gave this place another shot, and I was glad to see a better selection this time. They were still out of some things however, and it was only 9:30am. These donuts are delicious, but have to be enjoyed within a few hours. They start getting crunchy after that.
894/ 894 Sinfully Delicious! Perfect customer service with CHEF Jeff. Came here to try the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut and ended up with a half dozen of deliciousness!!

The staff were so nice & helpful! And the donuts were yummy (they're just really really sweet) that's why I gave them 4 stars for all the ups. The only downfall? The prices. It's really pricey. But they only sell til they run out so get there quick.

Not sure what the hype is over this place. I live 8 hours away and could not wait to check this place out while vacationing in Vegas. The lady helping us acted like wE were a bother to her day. WTF? The doughnuts were fresh (2 stars), but very doughy. The coffee "blah". Bottom line......customer service is (should be)EVERYTHING!! If you don't like your job, then move on. Our experience could have been so much better. Glad I made the time to visit, but will not be returning!! Side note......ran into a Las Vegas police officer who was super friendly and kind!!

They had a few different vegan options- creme brulee, apple fritter, and strawberries and cream! Yum! I got the strawberries and cream to go for the road. It was HUGE and amazing. I will be back for more

Changed review because they don't open until 7am. Lethal for locals who need donuts for work. For tourist hours will work. Not since Portland have I been so excited about donuts! These are so beautiful AND delicious! One large donut could feed four people.Amazing and a must stop for Vegas.

Fun Niche donut place. We've had better donuts. But these were really fun. The pop tart was very unique. Dry and glad for the added jelly. The creme brule was a hard pass. The Boston cream was lacking filling, but a good baseline donut.

They start off with a full menu of doughnuts in the "morning", we got there at 10am and they had very few selection of doughnuts left. We caught an uber to get there just for them to be out of all the good doughnuts. You also can't eat inside and there's nowhere to eat outside either.

A friend of mine was nice enough to pick some up for me. The donuts were cute to look at, but I felt like they were a bit dry. I'll have to give this place another try once I return to Vegas to give it a better assessment when I can eat them fresh. I did like the gingerbread donut. It was pretty much a gingerbread cake.

By far the best donuts I have ever seen or eaten In my life. I loved in San Diego for 7 years and was a regular at that location and when one arrived in las vegas I had to make a trip to see if it was just as good, and it was! If you're in las vegas I highly recommend making a trip here and you just have to get there early. They tend to sell out around 11am. My favorites on the menu would have to be the caramelized pineapple, creme Brule and the big poppa tart. Though your safe with picking any flavor because they are all incredibly delicious.
The donuts here are beautiful & tasty! Cool atmosphere. Friendly & helpful staff. Bonus, while we were here, some cops came in, so you know it's a kickin' spot!

I had to see what all the hype was about. I am NOT a morning person, but I dragged my ass out of bed and headed downtown for a donut. I was there around 7:45a and there were still about 20 people in line ahead of me. Get there early because they close once they sell out. They post their menu for the following day on Instagram. I decided before I got there that I was going to get the CrÃ¨me BruleÃ© donut. I promised myself I was only getting 1. I lied. I left with 6. I did get my CrÃ¨me BruleÃ©, but I also got a Vanilla Bean Glazed, Strawberry Poppa Tart, Twix, a Maple Bar, & Cake Batter. It was around $20. I seriously ate nothing but Donuts all day. And, they were huge, fresh, & delicious. Completely worth getting up early, driving across town, and paying too much for! I already have my next must try flavors picked out. Caramelized Pineapple, S'mores Poppa Tart, Banana Caramel, Samoa, Apple Fritter, & Blood Orange. Best Donuts in Las Vegas!! A MUST TRY!!

I had been to the Donut bar in San Diego when I was in town for a conference. When I was planning my Vegas trip, I found out that there was a donut bar and it was immediately on my "must eat" list. We were driving down from Vegas to LA the day we visited so we bought lots of donuts for the ride and every one of them was amazing! I really wish we had one close by!
Ridiculous! We tried the Lemon donut, Mud Pie, chocolate bacon bar and the maple bacon cinnamon roll.... YUM. The mocha is the best I've ever had. Great coffee!!! Coming back!

Very good, quality doughnuts and friendly, patient staff while you decide on the numerous options. I really enjoyed their strawberry split. I went on an early morning Saturday about ten mins before opening and of course there is already a line forming! I've also had their blood orange at First Fridays which was yummy too!

You can get some decent donut here. Not the best donut I've eaten imo but definitely very creative, colorful and comes in different sizes, depending on how much you crave. There is not much space to sit, the service was good, I like the party music they played Vegas style!

First time coming here and the donuts were pretty good. I had the Nutella donut which were good. My nieces thought the birthday cake Oreo donut was really good. My mom thought the salted caramel was a bit too salted for her but overall good taste.

Was in town for vacation. I always like to check out the 'local' spots. This place did not disappoint. The maple bacon bar was awesome. The donuts are twice the size if not bigger than chain donuts. A must try if your in downtown Vegas!!!
The donuts were good but there is no sitting area. I little disappointed drove from San Diego to try it.

The perfect little donut shop! I love this little shop and the customer service was excellent. We went after the Color Run and don't judge this curvy girl likes sweets...lol. They had a huge selection of donuts and some were huge. I got the birthday cake, strawberry and creme, and cake batter. I also tried their grilled cheese that was awesome. Lil Olivia said it was sweet and savory. The only thing I didn't like was that their was only about 10 chairs inside for dining. We had to go to the back patio and it was a little chilly but it would be cute if a little warmer. I am really glad I tried this spot and the prices were pretty cheap. The time we went the line was out the door but went quickly.

Brought the family Sunday morning and had a very pleasant greeting upon entry. Chef Jeff came out with a handfull of balloons and put smiles on my kids faces with the choice of a free balloon and one free "insideout" themed donut. The establishment itself is very clean with limited seating inside but the have an awsome relaxing patio outside in the back. The donuts themselves taste so amazing as I tried the french toast and butter beer donut. It's not over the top sweet and the donuts are larger than how they appear in the pictures. I wanted to order more but I gotta save my cravings for another for sure visit.

They have donuts as big as your face and flavors that sound plain awesome! Luckily, they have more "normal sized" donuts on the racks behind the glass counter. That said, we went small, a Red Velvet Donut and a Chai Spice Donut. These were... awesome! Simple drip coffee in the back was perfect to wash it down. When I'm back in Las Vegas... I'll find my way here on the mornings.

First time here, and it was awesome! I came a couple minutes after they opened and it seems they were hard at work setting everything up, the display was jaw dropping. I was given a first timers huge hello from the lady in front and she was super friendly I tried the creme brÃ»lÃ©e (was smaller than expected, but good!) Nutella overload (somewhat dry, but just the right amount of Nutella to keep me going) And what I thought was the best out of what I tried Blueberry cheesecake (not expected to be my favorite) I'll come back and try the rest!

As a donut lover, I researched the best donut places in Las Vegas before flying in for my first trip. According to reviews and social media this seemed to be the place to go. My friends and I woke up early on a Sunday morning and took an Uber to the bakery. When we got there it wasn't crowded at all and we spent time looking over the menu trying to decide what we wanted. Thanks to the pictures I saw on Instagram, the French Toast donut and Strawberry Split donut seemed to be must haves. Along with those I got a vanilla bean glazed, a Nutella filled and a cheesecake filled donut. Go hard or go home right? The strawberry split was my favorite hands down and I'd go back for that alone. The French toast was made to order and served hot with syrup, jam and butter. Easily a second favorite. The other 3 were okay and kinda let me down. The nutella and cheesecake filled were both good but did NOT have enough filling...I felt like I bit through 3/4 of the doughnut before I tasted filling. The vanilla bean glaze was also okay. However, there are so many delicious looking donuts available that I'd definitely go back to try something new along with my favorites. Props to Donut Bar for having a back patio where you can sit and enjoy all your donuts. The morning we went there was plenty of seating available. If you love donuts like me, definitely make this a stop on your next trip to Vegas.

This place is a must go to if you a donut lover and in Las Vegas. Plentiful parking in the area makes it easy to pop in and pickup these treats. The building itself is a cool little place. Upon walking in you are immediately greeted and welcomed. The person helping me was able to explain each and every donut and asked me what preferences I had and suggested items to try. The selection was great on the morning that I arrived. I chose the Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e donut and a lemon cheesecake donut with a milk to go. The donuts are pricey, until you bite into them and realize the quality ingredients that they are made with. I was a few miles away before I tried my selections and immediately wished that I had purchased more. Great selection, priced right for the quality, and a friendly helpful staff. Do yourself a favor and check this place out, you'll be glad you did.

Stayed in Vegas for one night and wanted a quick coffee and doughnut fix before hitting the road again. This place was amazing. The doughnuts were crazy original and yummy. Ended up eating our doughnuts there and enjoying the small patio space they have out back. Would recommend you take the time to visit!! Super friendly and nice.

I always wanted to go here and after a year I finally got to try it! The donuts are very sweet and huge!! You get the price for the looks.. however the creme brÃ»lÃ©e wasn't what I thought it would be, but it was still sweet and delicious! The pop tart donut actually has pop tart in it! It was super sweet, so prepare for your sweet tooth.

I absolutely LOVED this place! My boyfriend and I are die hard donut addicts and we couldn't believe that this place was close to our home! The service is always so nice and attentive. It's a small little place but it's super cool!

We got there late afternoon on a Thursday and they were almost out of donuts! They stay open until they sell out and they sold us a box of these HUGE donuts for $10 and they all were quite delicious! The girls working the counter were very friendly and talkative and were happy to help. Definitely some good donuts
Um what do you say about this place?? The donuts are amazing, the people that work here are super nice and helpful and the place is super cute. I wish it was in Orlando!
Vegan donuts were yummy grilled cheese was good next time I will ask for syrup for on top for a more breakfast feel of deliciousness!!

It's a doughnut shop. If you like specialty Donuts you'll probably like this place. Personally I'm not a big doughnut fan and the one I tried was just incredibly sweet. Too sweet in my opinion but others may not think so. Service was very good and friendly. Their lattes are horrible however. On top of that I burnt my mouth on the first sip. I like giving other businesses over Starbucks my money when it comes to specialty coffees but I have to look for someplace other than Donut Bar to get one.

I don't understand the hype. They taste mediocre at best. Super bready, if you've ever been to NYC and had Dough Donuts they're reminiscent of those, but still not as good. Dough has a good balance of fluffy, bready and chewy, these are just bready. TBH they kinda taste grocery store esque with more unique flavors (not that grocery store donuts are all that bad...just "standard") I've tried a lot of donuts ever since moving to Las Vegas and so far these have been at the bottom of the list...I'd rather wait for the red sign to go on at Krispy Kreme. Again they're not bad, they're cute but not up to the hype that people have been reviewing or talking about. Is it bc they're downtown in the "cool hipster area?" I say hit up Glaze at S. Fort Apache in SW
Awesome place with great donuts & coffee. If you're in the area I definitely recommend stopping by. The workers are also very friendly & helpful!!

Loved this little spot! Went for lunch with a co-worker after seeing a photo of a donut from this place on unlokt. Apparently, it used to be O Face Donuts and looks the same inside. I never visited when it was O Face but I'm glad I did visit this time! I went with the ginormous blueberry donut and it was delish! Co-worker went with the one stuffed with the Oreo cookie. I tried both and I think the Oreo stuffed one was a little better but any donut the size of the one I got gets bonus points for 'more to love.' The guy who helped us was super friendly and told us we had to stop back in the morning to see their full display of goodies. By lunch time, they have a smaller selection remaining but I still felt like the 10-12 left were plenty to choose from. Also, at this time of day it was buy one, get one. I love a discount so that was huge for me. Next time, I'll try the one with the pop tart inside. I punked out this visit because I was trying to eat slightly less than a zillion calories of possible but next time I'm going for the gusto! Final thought: my donut was a little dry but the icing was great. As of my first visit, they didn't steal my heart for best donut in town. But I'm definitely going to give them another shot. I say go give them a try!

This place has the best donuts I've ever had in my life! I got the birthday cake and lemon donuts, which were the biggest donuts I have seen! They normally come out with donut cones at 12 p.m so I was ablw to wait for them and they came straight right out the oven which was nice.
Best Donuts in town! This place rocks! Great selection and everything is fresh and on point!

Man don't miss out on these! The shop is located in the older downtown section of Las Vegas but we made a special trip to find them on recommendation of a friend who lives locally and were not disappointed! Some of the best donuts ever. Don't miss out on the poppa tart, which is a giant pop tart shaped donut decorated like a pop tart and then has an actual entire pop tart inside it when you bite in!! Also the candied bacon apple fritter is banging!! Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e, PBJ bar and blueberry myer lemon all amazing! If you are a donut fan this is a must stop place!
I can see why this place is so popular it is definitely a place that you wanna come and bring a crowd the more donuts the better
Great assortments of gourmet donuts. I haven't tasted a donut to be on the least of my favorite. All was delicious to its creation. Definitely need to try the rest!
Absolutely amazing selection of unique and delicious donuts. Friendly & helpful staff and fair prices. My favorite was the samoa. Worth the trip to downtown!
Great customer service! The workers here were very nice. The donuts are soft and have unique flavors. This will be added to the lists of musts while in vegas.

I use to live down the street from Donut Bar. Their donuts were great! Full of flavor, fresh, fluffy, and versatile. As long as you like donuts, you can for sure find something here to your liking. Their iced chai was also very good. It was a little pricey for how watered down it seemed, but overall had a good sweet flavor.

Best donut in the world! Definitely try the lemon pistachio or s'mores with the pop tart. The staff was great at explaining the flavors. We arrived around 7:00am on a weekday and there was no line. Get there early!

Service was nice . They dang near gave us the rest of The donuts. Probably was ready to go home got there at noon and not a great selection. The donut I had was okay it wasn't what I wanted. It was chocolate which was all they had. They did give us a free apple fritter but it was burnt. Will try to come earlier when I make it back this way.

Busy and a bit pricy, but worth the wait. I've only been here once and remembered liking the one in San Diego more, but it could just be the donuts I got. Favorite donut was the Bourbon Maple in San Diego

Jessica K. pretty much took the words right out of my mouth. The only difference is that I had seen folks standing alongside the curb area but assumed they were waiting for some sort of church to open up,I mean the corner looked as though everyone was lined up for free Oprah giveaways Anyhow I digress. Overall I had a lovely first time experience the staff appears to have a bond and truly show respect for one another (REAL TEAMWORK)! Also,Upon entering I took the liberty of writing down a list of donuts from their Sunday Menu. I ordered Caramelized Pineapple,DB Nutella,Coconut dream,Blueberry Lemon and CrÃ¨me BrÃ»lÃ©e which were ALL simply delicious. Indeed the BEST donuts I've tasted thus far

Some of these reviewers are crazy, the donuts are amazing, if you think $2 for a really large tasty donut is too much, you obviously haven't been to the strip. Got to try several but the favorite was the pop tart one. Everyone loved it, keep up the good work!!

Very cute place with tons of options! I got the donut cone with the soft serve ice cream with rainbow sprinkles. The cone was completely filled with ice cream yum! I have never had a donut cone so I was expecting it to be soft like a donut but it was crunchy. It still tasted amazing because it was covered in cinnamon sugar! I definitely would like to return so that I can try the donuts which looked amazing!

So I stopped by to pick up donuts for work....it was very overwhelming! So many choices! And just let me say that every donut of any and every type was mouthwatering! Just looking at all the choices and making a decision was completely difficult....I got 12 donuts....the counter people were very helpful explaining the donuts...plus it was completely packed! The crime brÃ»lÃ©e's was allegedly their number one seller, so I got one of those! It was delicious but very sweet. I also got a maple bar with bacon very delicious...how could you go wrong with that combo anyway?! I highly recommend this place but get there before the days donuts are sold out!!

Easy breezy walk from Fremont--I know there's been talk about where you should and shouldn't walk in Vegas but I had zero issues. Or you could uber lyft it, but I enjoyed the stroll. The place had an amazing selection, super night staff. The donuts were visually dazzling and did not disappoint in the taste department. Walked a box back to the Nugget, had a great breakfast, ziplocked the left overs. Turns out they were still pretty flipping yummy the next night (two days later? Can anyone be sure of date or time in this magical city?) after a 4am hot streak on the tables when Hubby has a contagious sweet tooth. Thanks for the treats!!!

We purchased a small box of doughnuts Strawberries and Cream - HUGE but looks delicious Maple Bacon Cinnamon Roll - BEST Donut we have ever tasted, soft, luscious, not too sweet, real bacon... even my girlfriend who eats as healthily as possible, Raw fitness in the morning and spin at night took a few bites and didn't regret it for a second. Vegan Creme Brulee- coworker liked it but said the top was too burnt... that's how I prefer my creme brulee so I would'v loved it Birthday Cake - Free for their one year birthday today- Husband requested I bring it home to him so I have no review of this one Red Velvet - My husband requested I bring this home too 2X Old Fashioned Plain cake donuts- My girlfriend who again is into fitness, told me this reminded her of her childhood. That made me feel so special, a taste that triggers a memory is worth WELL OVER THE 2$

This place by far is my most favorite place to go to when I am downtown! They alway have the best selections especially for the sweet tooth cravings I alway have! There location isn't too far from downtown Fremont and the Container Park, So this is alway a good option to come to first thing in the morning. That's probably the best time to come in is early, they alway sell out fast and all the good options are gone if you decided to come in later in the day. I have been lucky so far to alway grab my favorites before they sale out. My go-to's are alway the birthday Cake, the Homer, and a Nutella one. I even love the Churro Cone with Ice Cream. My favorite time to come here is on the weekend. It should I say my little ones favorite time to come here is on Saturday or Sunday, they alway give out free donuts to kids. They make them a featured character and have it all decorated out. Last time we came here and got our free donut they were handing out Ninjago Donuts, my son was super excited and absolutely went crazy with pure happiness. He has now made it a point to request we go there everyday, but unfortunately my metabolism won't be able to keep up with that request, so we opt for the weekends only lol. If your lucky enough to come on happy hour you can grab a box full for $10, the only sad part is you don't know when they will have it or if they will. It's usually before they close and depending on how much they have left. So it's alway a win win when you come in, you can grab a speciality donut, or a free kids character donut, or a happy hour box. Either way you will definitely not be displeased with the quality of the donuts, and you can always walk off the calories at Fremont or Container Park.

Always my favorite donut shop but I am not downtown enough to enjoy it. Always make sure to stop by early to get prime picks or else you are left with the dreaded leftover offerings! Which are still going to be amazing, let's be honest.

I am big fan of Donuts and believe me I have been to palaces where they have amazing donuts. This is by far one of the best donuts place I have been too. It is like hidden gem in downtown. Place opens (on Sundays) at 8am (pst). You will find line forming from 7:30am. 8am store opens and some one comes out from store and counts how many kids they have in line with their family at that time...Chef and his assistance comes out with plate of freshly made donuts for kids and gives them each. Assistance hand over balloon to kids. Then they start serving you. You get in the shop and welcomed with smile and amazing smell of fresh donuts, cream and coffee. They take time to serve you, answer your questions and get your order ready. By the time you get to cashier, your order is ready! Place is clean, great happy environment, awesome service and amazing donuts. MUST VISIT THIS PLACE AND HAVE DONUTS....

Well I'm on a donut review writing spree right now, so I may as well write about one of my top 3 donut places in Las Vegas. I dare say Donut Bar actually makes my top 3 donut places in North America too! (The other two being Blue Star donuts in Portland and Cartems Donuterie in Vancouver Canada) Why is Donut Bar so darn good? Donut standards keep going up, and these days, you can't just have a good donut. You need something that stands out to make your donut shop - 'worth a journey'. At Donut bar, they've got TWO things that I gladly journey out for - their ice cream donut, and their creme brulee donut. That's not even mentioning their other donuts (strawberry, vanilla bean, maple bacon) that are full of flavourful donuty goodness and excellent in their own right. Unlike Pinkbox, Donut bar closes when they run out of donuts. That's usually around noon? Depending on how picky you are about your donut options, come early. They only make about 25 of their ice cream donuts every day, and they usually aim to have those ready by 10. I know eating an ice cream cone at 10am in the morning feels a little strange, but it was worth it for me. I haven't had their horchata donut, but I've seen photos -- looks pretty amazing. As soon as I lose my donut weight I'm going right back to hunt for this donut!
Great donuts, kids loved it will be back. Check out the bathroom if you're a Simpson's fan.

While I was trying to decide which of the many donuts I would order, some girl was on the phone saying "they aren't regular donuts, they are fancy ones'. That pretty much sums it up. The donuts are legit creations and not just glazed with fruit loops sprinkled on top. Some of the donuts are pretty large and pretty filling. They don't call it the Big Poppa Tart for no reason.

Love this place. They have THE most amazing donuts. Their staff is very friendly, and everything is reasonably priced. Get there early because they close when they are sold out of the daily batch of donuts already made. With each donut purchased, (at least for my kids) you get another free large sized donut in your box. So cool. My kids loved this place. We got the Double Chocolate Donut and the Birthday Cake Donut, pictured with this review, along with our two freebies. Oh, and they also hand out balloons for the kids!! They have some seating inside, but most is outside in the back of the bar. Such a great place. I highly recommend.

The donuts here are good; they're dense, unlike a lot of other donut places. You can really tell thy put effort in making them. However, the creme brulee donut was very disappointing. The hype did not match the quality. I think people were just excited about the cracking noise rather than its taste. However, the other donuts were great!

Hot damn! This place is unreallllllll! We had the French Toast donut and it does NOT disappoint! The staff is so patient and welcoming and the place itself is so cute! There's such a cute outdoor seating area so you never feel crowded. Chef Jeff came out PERSONALLY to ask us how we are doing. Best way to celebrate turning 27! Will be back!

Of course I'm sure the "regular" donuts tasted far better.. but we arrived at 10am and found there to be only 3 vegan options. The apple fritter was so burnt it was black on top. I got it anyways hoping that inside would be a delicious fritter experience... nope. Dry and tasted burnt. Tossed in the trash. The creme brÃ»lÃ©e was alright. I have had better. The last was a cake donut. Can't even remember the flavor. It was good. But not good enough to spend the amount of money I did. I would much rather got to Voodoo Donuts where they have atleast 10 different AMAZING vegan donuts at one time.

I've been here about ten times. 6 for just a cup of coffee, 4 for the donuts. I don't get it. I try and try and try and I can't bring myself to get excited over them. We came here when they first opened and I thought "They don't have their temperatures/ measurements converted to the altitude of Vegas" as they're a shop based out of San Diego if I'm remembering correctly. If you order a plain donut that's not filled or stuffed with a cookie, they're all dry :(. The worst part is that they're so expensive. A single plain donut is $2. Anywhere else a single glazed donut is .99 cents or less. They only get more expensive the more "creative" they get. The French toast donut is really good but doesn't need the syrup or extra blueberry topping since the donut is already covered in powdered sugar AND glaze. When you're feeling extra gluttonous I think it hits the spot. The only other saving grace is their hazelnut Kona coffee which I think I found the same one online so I can save myself the trip, parking meter fee, and disappointment of dry donuts.

Finally got to try this place. Yummy describes this sinful obsession of imaginative donut flavor combinations. I regret that I didn't check out the online menu to see what types they had before going there. So it was a bit over-whelming trying to view/choose what to order because the line moved too quickly. I tried the lemon cake donut drizzled with a cream cheese frosting glaze & took back a huge blueberry glazed donut (I forget what there actual names are). If that wasn't enough, I was fortunate enough to try the Homer Simpson pink donut w/ sprinkles (they always sell out, so go early). Well...they were all wonderfully delicious. But, I'm glad they are not located close to where I reside otherwise, I would be there at least once a week & that wouldn't be good for my waist line (yikes). Yet, I do think about & crave those fried desserts since I've tasted them!!

The hype is not real unfortunately. To each their own I guess, but I was only impressed with a few of their donuts. The pop tart ones are good. Strawberry being the best by far. The blueberry was ok and the smores one was WAY too sweet, like eat one bite and get diabetes sweet. Creme Brule is a good idea but that sugar coat on top makes for difficult chewing. Their apple fritter was actually pretty bad. I took a bite and threw it away, had a burnt quality to it. Personally, I enjoy donuts with a glaze AND something on top or filled. Most of these are plain donuts with something on top. I wanted to love this place. I was there at their grand opening and even met the owner. But I couldn't love it, only like certain things. That being said, their french toast donut is amazing as well as their churro donut ice cream cone. Both of those things along with their strawberry pop tart are worth it.

Greeted when entering the shop in a very friendly way and it was packed with customers! Really cute and clean! A $1.50 for an above average glazed donut is awesome! $1.50 for a SHARABLE glazed donut is even more awesome! Will be back the next time we're in town!

Other than the fact that is on the strip this donut shop is fantastic. Sugar junkie hit spot for sure. The grand kids love this place. Good coffee and Tea here also breakfast, but my for my family it is all about the donuts. Great variety and great tasting donuts! Sugary goodness! Worth a try if youve not been down.
Incredible service, coffee right on point, blueberry donuts, strawberry donuts with cream are Fantastic. Owner came out and greet.

Don't miss Donut Bar on your next visit to Las Vegas! I first heard about it on the YouTube channel SayHiToMatthew and checked it out two days ago over Labor Day weekend. The staff is very friendly and helpful and the donuts are amazing. The shop is located in the downtown area which I normally try to avoid because of parking issues and vagrants wandering the streets, but it was worth the visit. I had a donut nearly as big as my head that was topped with chocolate, cinnamon and marshmallows and tasted like Mexican hot chocolate. So good!

So this is what you call sweet and savory heaven. I am visiting a friend in town and he introduced me to the "next level" of donuts and a trip to the gym following it. I was extremely pleased by the array of options and flavors. The donuts are huge. Well worth the extra run afterwards. And this bar had the nerve to have a grilled cheese donut! I went two times. It would have been three times in 4 days, but I drove by around noon one day and they were already sold out! What a bummer. But I learned quickly, if I'm craving a donut, I need to get to Donut Bar ASAP!
Great selection of donuts, if you can think it they got it. You have get there early tho, some donuts tend to run out in the first hour or so! Yeah there are that good!!
Great donuts off the beaten path a bit but worth the walk or drive. Huge donuts and very reasonably priced. We had the Nutella and mud pie donuts both were great

Great place for a sugar rush and stomachache! Jokes aside, these donuts are something else. I would HIGHLY recommend you share a donut with a friend (or two) and not take one on yourself like I did. Go early as they do sell out throughout the day. My first time here, I was browsing the huge selection but what caught my eye was PISTACHIO. All time favorite, had to try it - even if it was pistachio lemon. Boy was I impressed. The lemon flavor punches you in the face, but the pistachio caresses you and makes it all better. The balance of flavor they manage to pack into the donut is spectacular. The size is on the outrageous side, but it definitely makes it worth the price. Their coffee is also top notch and pairs well with any donut you decide to devour. I would take visitors to town here, but I would hesitate on coming regularly. Although it's a damn good donut, my stomach would hate me.

This is the best Donuts I've ever had.. seriously. I heard about this place when it opened.. it closes kinda early so I didn't make it, kept putting it off.. eventually I made it in.
