I went three days in a row. I got two donuts each time.. I spent 4$, $5 and 9$. The prices are very reasonable .. the last time I was there.. the $9 visit. I purchased the French Toast Donut.. it involved a grill, came out hot and awesome.. with silverware; butter, syrup and jam on a plate.. my goodness!!! The first and third time I went I was that around opening and it was awesome.. the second time I went I arrived around 11:00AM. (They close at 1Pm) .. at 11 they were almost sold out. That's a positive thing. This place has fresh donuts and they are delicious. So get there earyish

Rightfully high in the ranking! These Donuts are just dreamy and so delicious! Chef Jeff is an awesome guy, we had a last minute order for the next day and he delivered a fantastic customized donut collection for our event. We had tasted at several other locations, but actually when stepping into their shop, we already knew we would end up here. The atmosphere is very relaxed, nice crew and great ambiance! This is the place to go!

Visited from out of town and a friend recommended this spot! We got the Mexican Hot Chocolate, Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e, Homer and Cake Batter doughnuts. All were good. Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e was liiiiittle dry, but still delicious. Will be back!!
Love this place. We always goto the Donut Bar when we're in San Diego. I so glad there is one in my hometown now. I will be making many many visits to this place.

Wow! Super cute and tastier than I expected! I don't usually like donuts. I'm from Alabama, where donuts are deep fried and glazed, and usually I'm not interested in a cake donut. These were spectacular! They look amazing and crazy and delicious and they are ALL of those things. I had the apple crumble. It was fluffy, moist, flavorful and not overwhelmingly sweet. It went perfectly with the coffee. Next time, gonna take a few people and tackle the Brad Fritter or one of those massive poppa dough beauties!

Donuts were pretty average, despite their promising appearance. Old fashioned glaze was the best one. I'm a cake donut kind of girl We ordered lemon blueberry, old fashioned chocolate glaze, old fashioned vanilla glaze, Nutella, Boston cream, and yeast chocolate glaze. Most of the cake donuts were dry on the inside and oily on the outside. The chocolate glaze was not sweet enough, even paired with sweetness of donut, and was akin to eating an unsweetened chocolate bar. Not my style.  I would say go here if you're from a place with no fancy donuts. They are better than Dunkin donuts, but that standard isn't very high.

I realize this is an outlier of a review, but I did reach out to Donut Bar via their website with no response. Overall, these are some good donuts. I had the maple bacon cinnamon roll before we headed off to Death Valley and Northern California. The first few bites were pretty amazing, but things turned when I got closer to the center, which by this time we were in Indian Springs. The girlfriend thought it was a molten center, but it just turned out that the center was COMPLETELY RAW! I'm not saying this was the contributing factor to some stomach problems I had for the following few days, but exactly rule it out either. The other thing is the kids donuts they have on Saturday. And while they are cool, they are really no different than those over-iced heavily food colored donuts you can get at a supermarket.

We used to go to this other donut place close to our house, but have stopped patronizing them because of their rude costumer service. Last Mother's Day, my hubby asked me where I wanted to go, and since I have been craving donuts and had the donut bar bookmarked for a while, I asked to go here. It was quite a bit of a drive considering we live in southwest, but we decided to go anyway. We got here around 12:30-1ish, and they only had a few selections left. Don't know if it was because it was Mother's Day, but the lady behind the counter informed us that because of the limited selection, we could get a box for $10 and fill it with as much donuts as we could fit. Although the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut was sold out and it was slim pickins, we were still able to get a decent amount of very yummy donuts. What would normally be a donut worth $3 a pop, we were able to get a full box for only $10! My favorite amongst our choices was the caramel latte donut. I thought it would have been too sweet, but it was actually just the right amount of sugar. Another favorite was the espresso donut, even though I'm not a big fan of the cake kind. We brought the box back to my in-laws house, and everyone was raving about the donuts. Fast forward to today-- My husband, son, and I had a hankering for donuts and braved the early Sunday morning drive to downtown. We got to the donut bar just a couple minutes shy of 8am and there was already a long line outside the door, waiting for the store to open. When 8am rolled around, the chef (?) opened the door and gleefully greeted the people waiting in line, and then proceeded to usher everyone in. We could smell the freshly made donuts before even stepping foot inside the store, which only fueled our hunger more. Upon stepping inside, it was such a different experience from when we went during Mother's Day. The cases were full of different flavored donuts, both fried and cake donuts alike. I truly felt like a kid in a candy store! The girl behind the counter offered our son a free inside-out themed donut, which I thought was really thoughtful-- they really cater to their customers at this place! Anyways, it was so hard for me to order since I wanted to try everything!!!! But we settled on the French toast donut (which was made to order ), a creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut (obviously a crowd favorite), a Samoa, and a chocolate euphoria for my son. The French toast donut was good, different, and well worth a try. The cup of stumptown coffee they serve there went great with the donut. The Samoa was pretty good but, as I'm not a big fan of cake donut (my hubby is), I think I can pass on that next time. My son enjoyed his chocolate euphoria, and started picking on the chocolate shavings as soon as the donut arrived. Last but not the least, the star among the donuts we chose, the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut. It was quite small, but for only 2 bucks, it was a steal! My hubby did say that the caramelized sugar on top was a bit thick, but we both agreed that the donut was great and surprisingly not as sweet as we thought it would be. The creme brÃ»lÃ©e filling was smooth and velvety, just how it should be, and accompanied the donut very well. I would honestly come back here just for another one of that donut, but I would be lying if I didn't say I want to try more. I might just have to make it mandatory that we go here every Sunday so we could try out a different donut each time. The strawberry shortcake donut they had looked mighty good, as well as the s'mores donut... I'm drooling just thinking about it XD Although there are plenty other donut shops close to our house, the drive to downtown just to go to donut bar is well worth it. Not only are their donuts great, but all the associates we've had the chance to encounter were all so sweet, helpful, and personable. No wonder people keep flocking this place. Customer service is obviously a priority on their list, and there is nothing better than that... Aside from the donuts, of course lol. Donut bar, you have just gained new loyal customers who will try to frequent your place every Sunday :)

The donut bar is fabulous probably my fourth visit this month I had a grilled cheese French toast doughnut and a crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e doughnut and some great coffee these people know how to do quality and serve with smiles thanks Joe and the ladies
Yummy fresh donuts! Super friendly staff! Clean establishment. Would definitely come back again.

Not bad doughnuts, but way too big in my opinion. I know bigger I better, but if you don't eat them warm, they dry out pretty quick. Good selection and different flavors. But I'll probably end up staying with some other local doughnuts for my regular everyday needs.

This is an amazing spot. East Fremont is already an incredible alternative to the over-priced sheen of the strip dining options. Add in the warm service and awesome, reasonably-priced delicacies at the Donut Bar and it's almost heaven. I tried the signature Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e donut and loved it. The donut itself was not too sweet and the creme in the middle was delicious. The hardened glaze on top cracked in a fun way as I bit in. They had dozens of other delicious looking donuts, ranging in sizes, which I liked too. If you're just there for a quick bite, grab a small donut. If you're in the mood to indulge, they have enormous donuts in all sorts of unusual flavors and with great decorations. I was especially intrigued by the grilled cheese donut but will have to check that out next time I'm in town. We got iced americanos two days we were there. So refreshing.

Place is amazing. Let me say that donuts are my weakness!!!! So many people would be surprised to pay 3-6 bucks for a donut, but I honestly say... worth it! I had the French toast donut! Amazing. Served with butter and syrup, also with a side of blue berry jelly. I destroyed it. I've also tried the pop tart donut, the birthday cake, Creame BrÃ»lÃ©e, samoa, oreo, and red velvet. All ok. I would say try the pop tart one, but it's share it. It's super rich and filling.

This place sells out everyday so get there early! I like that they always have a vegan option and I am pretty sure you can order online if you don't want to risk them selling out of your favorite. It is definitely worth trying one of their big pretty donuts... I don't have a photo because I think I was trying to hide the fact I was eating it from my boyfriend LOL.... they are closed with the city shutdown.

After seeing several posts/pics/reviews about this place we decided to try it. We were NOT disappointed. Great selection of donuts and great prices. The donuts are HUGE.....you definitely will be full after eating these.

I always make it a must do every time I come to Vegas to stop by here. There's so many different things on the menu I want to try. Creme brule donut is a must! I decided this time I would try the French toast to share with my husband. SO MUCH REGRET....agreeing to share with him... one bite and I wanted it all to myself ! LOLOLOLOL.

I wanted to give the place four stars, but the doughnut quality bordered on "day--old bread." The kids loved the decadence of it all, though. The Mexican chocolate doughnut was fantastic. The one awesome thing about the Donut Bar is the monstrous portion sizes.

It was ok. The crime brÃ»lÃ©e was the best one out of the donuts I got. The poptart was a bit much and needed to be heated up to really taste good. Overall nice selection, but was hyped up a little too much.

Got here around 9 am on Saturday and line was okay. Some of the donuts are huge! But they are airy and worth the price for 4 we paid around $14. My boyfriend has the biggest sweet tooth and loved the Pop tart one I liked the cake batter. Will be here next time I'm in Vegas.

The donuts were great! We had the apple crumb and the s'mores pop tart donut. The pop tart donut was awesome! Very cool concept. Unbelievably filling...it was huge! The staff was extremely friendly and polite. Great service.

Absolutely fantastic. Such an approachable vibe, the people are helpful & nice and the donuts are WORTH THE HYPE. I recommend their famous Big Poppa Tart - it has a poptart INSIDE it. Other notable ones: birthday cake with an Oreo inside, blueberry cheesecake, and red velvet. Price is very reasonable for a "gourmet" donut. Also, Chef Jeff is the best Truly the #bestdonutsintheworld !

#OMG €¼€¼€¼ wow blown away on how good this #frenchtoast #Donut was @donutbarlv #Crazy #Good €¼€¼ Younhave to come here if your #Local OR ON VACATION !! Yes if your coming to #Vegas on #vacation you need to make time for this place skip the cafe at your #Casino lol trust me!!!

They stayed open into late afternoon for Life Is Beautiful so I was finally able to try these gems on our way into the festival! We tried Butter Beer donut first, which was delightful, but the crown jewel was the strawberry Big Poppa Tart with a full size Pop-Tart baked right in the middle. This donut was DELICIOUS, with what tasted like strawberry jam oozing everywhere. Nicely done, Donut Bar!

I don't like donuts. But l love these donuts. Dunkin, Krispy Kreme, and Winchells never really impressed me. My issues with donuts is they always smell better than they taste. But at the donut bar, they taste just as good if not better than you imagined. I can tell that the donut bar uses fresh ingredients and takes pride in their craft. I wish it were a bit bigger but that's only because I'd like to sit and eat all the different donuts they offer. Definitely going back. Again and again.

Best freaking donuts I've ever had!!!! No joke! Got the Homer, it was huge and delicious like the ones at universal studios. The peanut butter cup was the best out of the three, it was a dense yet moist cake donut with peanut butter cups on top, it was perfection . Last but not least the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut that was super fun to crack and the combination of the hard sugar on top and a creamy filling was heavenly. The donutquarium made my entire life I live in summerlin but will drive all the way downtown to get these again for sure!!!!!
A little on the pricy side, but very very good nonetheless. Had the grilled cheese donut, over the top!!!!!

And for my obligatory donut stop in Vegas, I bring you Donut Bar. Very cool selection of donuts. You've got some unique donuts to choose from here. I grabbed half a dozen. From the crop one of the notables was the poptart donut. An entire poptart in a donut. I was skeptical but it turns out to be a winner. A few others that were tasty was the butter beer which was enormous and the creme brulee. Also the ladies who work there are very friendly. Very nice donut shop.

Wowza! We heard about Donut Bar and last week I was fortunate to have a weekday off for a change. We found Donut Bar, just off the Strip's northern end, and parked in front at the pay to park. The display is varied and colorful, while not overwhelming and the shop itself is warm and cozy. Staff are very helpful as we had lots of questions. We had already drooled over their photo of blueberry with Meyer lemon topping: amazing. So I, like a socially isolated cave hermit, right away asked "do you still ave the blueberry" while my poor husband was trying to speak. The creme brulee was the next choice, followed by Mexican Hot Chocolate and Oreo. We took some old fashioneds to go. Well, now. I post healthy foods and recipes online, but donuts are an exclusion and we do indulge! All of these donuts were superb!! We sat in the small indoor bench area next to the Donut fish tank. The coffee was wonderful- a good alternative to your run of the mill donut shop. The quality and inventiveness add up to a big 5 BFFDS for me. If you must ask, that's "best friendly fantastic donut supplier". Vegan options are here too, evidently. Check it out: DB Las Vegas is a winner!!

Came here for the first time and I must say, this place is pretty amazing. From unique donuts to classic donuts they all tasted great. I'd say its pretty pricey for some donuts but it's so worth it. They even ask for your name to put on the box so that makes me felt a little special. The staff is friendly and energized which is great for the downtown area. The drinks look amazing but I decided to get a simple strawberry milk and chocolate milk, which complemented the donuts even more. I'll definitely be coming back here. Some tips I'd recommend - Get there early preferably in the morning because they do sell till they run out of donuts. - If its a nice day I'd recommend eating outside in the back because it has a nice feel to it. - Always get a drink even if its just milk!

HOLY MOLY the vegan creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut was the best thing sweet treat that's hit my mouth this week. I had their Hawaiian hazelnut drip coffee with almond milk and it was the best combo with my donut. This place sells out incredibly fast, so come first thing in the morning!!

I had a maple bacon apple fritter and creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut. The maple bacon was good, a bit dry. I was disappointed with their signature creme brÃ»lÃ©e; it was dry and very little cream. I will try them another time if I am up in that area.
Love, love, love this spot. What an adorable shop with a lovely and surprising patio out back. We went for my sons birthday and he loves it. And I also need to mention the doughnuts are HUGE.

Finally made a trip out here!!!! The donuts looked amazing!!!! and of course very tasty and moist! Plus of it all was it wasn't too sweet like most donuts are! If you are looking for not overwhelming amounts of sugar this is place to visit! donuts ordered- maple bourbon Strawberry split strawberry cheesecake All were very tasty! Definitely coming back here and trying the others! Also if you are coffee lover, they do serve stumptown cold brew!!!

the most beautiful donuts I have ever seen...yet very dry and actually don't even taste like donuts...I can only assume the high stars are because the donuts are unusual and pretty...I had the strawberry split (I think that's what it was called), crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e, and the blueberry pop tart...the strawberry donut was the driest of them all but I think they figured the whip cream would help it out yet it didn't...the crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e was hard on the top like all the reviews said but the donut again had no flavor and what I thought was going to be airy turned out to be hard and chewy...the blueberry pop tart donut was the most disappointing with what tasted like canned blueberry filling and was completely inconsistent throughout the center...very disappointing since I had such high hopes for this place...however I did give it two stars because the donuts are beautiful

Been to this place many times, while you're in downtown LV in the morning, check this place out! Nice staff, good prices for donuts and coffee, and there's vegan options. The menu rotates everyday so you can have different options. I hope to try their other donuts on their menu, my favorite is the birthday cake oreo, blueberry meyer, and raspberry.

My mom had the lemon pistachio donut which was large. She felt like it was tasty and delicious. A nice lemon my glaze that was not too sweet. Could have been lighter but she liked it. Sister had the Samoa which is like the Girl Scout cookie. She said it was dry but it did taste exactly like the cookie. The Oreo was delicious and had Oreo in the middle. We all said we would certainly come back for more in the future. The location is convenient and it's a cute little store front with a courtyard we sat in with our little Yorkie.

Sister shop to the one in SD! Came close to closing so they had a BOGO special! Humongous donuts that are bigger than your face! We bought 4 that were a dollar each! Flavors change daily! Hope this place succeeds

You bad dirty donut bar, you had me with your ginormous big poppa filled strawberry tart and cake batter donut not to mention your filthy minds when you created the birthday filled oreo donut concoction you guys need a spanking because these donuts are banging baby! LOLZ their nutella filled donut and triple choc threat definitely has a home in my belly too bwahah. Thanks to UberEats you dropped by right before closing at noon Yas that hanger life! #thebestdonutsintheworld it must be because it's on the box lmfaoooo!

We had high expectations for this place. By 10am, they only had a very small selection left - none of the ones that the place is known for were available. My regular coffee did not taste good at all. Very nice service and a pretty back patio but nothing to write home about.
I don't usually give 5 stars but WHAT a donut place! Great BIG donuts and nice place! Good people I give them a great chance to succeed! Eat your heart out IVY!
How could I give the Donut Bar any less than 5stars? Of course the donuts were on point. This shop is located in the Art District that is totally worth checking out.

Award winning, nationally-known spot for donuts. This is a must-stop for donut lovers living in or visiting Vegas. But get there fast, because they usually sell out by 11 am. The store itself is very charming and they have a cool patio out back.
Came here to grab donuts for a friend Everyone was helpful ..:.: looked like a little to much for me but I did taste test a little bit with a friend at work was yummy

Man oh man can you drop a pretty penny here. Donuts start at $3 and go up to $6! Watch out for those pricey ones though, they're monsters.. I believe between four friends, we ordered to our hearts content (which ended up being 8 donuts and about $35, including chocolate milk for all). They supposedly have homemade strawberry milk on tap but I have my doubts since they were sold out the last two times I tried to stop in. (Maybe the trick is to go early? But how do I know the strawberry milk is worth getting up at 7am???) In any case, the donuts were magic. I highly recommend the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut since it was one of the more unique ones we had. Personally, not my favorite. The caramelization on top tasted more like honey to me than anything else but I still recommend giving it a go since I've never seen anything like it anywhere else. Also the big poppa tart donuts are INSANE. Way too much volume for my belly. It was tasty but hard to enjoy such a monstrosity. I ended up taking two-thirds of it home. We also tried the strawberry split though I wasn't all that impressed. It's a sugar donut with whipped cream and strawberries in it.. plain and simple. There are definitely better options here, in my opinion.. If I were to offer a few pieces of advice: stick to the classics (they do their simple donuts very VERY well) and GO EARLY TO GET THE STRAWBERRY MILK. I think it's one of those mystical menu items that may or may not exist in real life.. hmm...

This place is awesome!!! The people there were very friendly, nice atmosphere and overall good vibes. Probably the best donuts I've ever had, you should try the Mexican hot chocolate one and the birthday one!!!
Big. Ass. Chewy. Lemon. Pistachio. Donut. Drool. Also they close when they sell out. We were very sad yesterday. Can you come back to California with me?

We visited the Donut Bar on a Monday in late April. It wasn't busy. Great selection of donuts. The coffee was pretty awesome. We loved all the donuts, my favorite was the Strawberry Shortcake. Going into this visit I was expecting overwhelming sweetness. It was not the case. All donuts were well balanced!

Donut Bar is a solid donut place that is doing some fun and inventive things with their flavors. I've tried the Big Poppa (a donut with a pop-tart baked inside? done. i need it.), Butterbeer, vegan birthday cake, blueberry meyer lemon, creme brulee, apple fritter... They were all delicious. The Big Poppa and the Creme Brulee were my absolute favorite, I would highly recommend them. Their nitro brew coffee is also very good! The shop is small and can get kind of busy, but the employees do a good job being friendly while keeping everyone moving. I think that the prices are pretty good for the product that you get. They also do free kids donuts on Saturday mornings. We've recommended this place to so many friends and have yet to have someone tell us they didn't love it!
Ok donuts. Flavors weren't there. Ok coffee. Bitter as hell. Cute outdoor eating area. Would not come back.

If you're going to Vegas you've got to make time for a stop here!! It's not too far off of the main strip but make sure you get here when they first open because the good doughnuts sell out FAST!!! My favorite was the one that had an entire pop tart inside!!! A very neat & yummy experience! There's also a beautiful patio to eat and relax at in the back.

Presentation: 5/5 -every single donut looked mouth watering. If I was immune to diabetes I would have tried everything Taste: 3/5 -Mixed feelings on the creme brulee, strawberry shortcake and strawberry cheesecake. Don't get me wrong, it was good but I was expecting mind blowing donuts based on the overall ratings and reviews Coffee: 2/5 -Wasn't impressed with the coffee either. It just tasted like generic coffee, nothing special
The donuts I just purchased are "The Best Door Opener" to a business referral source. I'm bringing family here as well! It's the "Disneyland" of donuts!!

This place is wonderful. The donuts are as delicious as they are creative. I like how they change up what they offer daily, and keep some of the staples. French Toast Donuts? Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e Donuts? Hello! Also, the soft-serve in a donut cone is to die for. The place is pretty tiny, and the line can be confusing since they have two front doors and don't specify which you should enter from to get in line. I've seen some shade thrown over people jumping ahead in line because they came in the out door. For future reference, it's the easternmost door. They have a good concept with keeping limited hours, and closing when they sell out. Sad when you want a donut when you're waking up at 1:00 pm after closing a restaurant the night before, but smart for them.

This place isn't open for long hours so you better get there early. Friendly staff and huge selection of donuts to choose from. And these are gourmet donuts not some cheap stuff. I highly suggest going there as early as you can. Keep up the great work. Btw choc milk goes great with their donuts :) creme brÃ»lÃ©e is my fave ;)

AMAZING! AWESOME! A whole new level in donuts... Very friendly, customer oriented staff, easy street parking but I live close and walk... Get in early because the line begins at 7am. Definitely a pilgrimage for donut connoisseurs!

Best place for donuts... ever! Birthday Donut is a MUST. Oreo in the middle brings it all together to please your tastebuds. Be sure to get there bright and early for the best choices, very popular so they sell out by noon sometimes. Also, be there on weekends for the French toast donut!!! You will not be disappointed! The jam served along with it is the absolute best!

Hello, My name is Scott Bianchi, and I have a donut problem. I'm a huge fan of the Donut Bar in San Diego. They have great donuts, they have great people. It's a good place. When I heard they were opening a store in Las Vegas, I was jealous of Las Vegas. They're supposed to open a store in Santa Clarita. However, when I suddenly planned a trip out to Las Vegas, I knew a stop here was primary on my list. Saturday morning I woke up early. Having been to the San Diego location, I know there's a line a block and a half long Saturday mornings. However, when my WAZE lady told me I had arrived at the Las Vegas store, there was no huge line. There wasn't even people out the door. It seemed fairly quiet. There was also a parking issue. The lot directly across the street has signage all over it saying 'permit required' and 'we will tow your car' so when I parked in it initially, I was a bit concerned for my ride. I poked my head in the door of the Donut shop, and asked about it. The nice guy behind the counter said that the lot didn't belong to them, but there was free parking on sixth street on the weekend. So I ran back out, and relocated my car to the warm and fuzzy, safe free parking area just down the street. I then returned, knowing that I could sit for a lil while and have my ride be there when I left. I entered the shop, and the familiar donuts smiled up at me from their case. They were holiday decorated even. I walked down the case and picked out four donuts. I was going to stop at three, but then the rudolph donut just had to go along too. So, I paid for the four donuts (ended up at about twenty dollars) I then sat down to admire the donuts, and the fish tank from the fish tank tv show when I heard somebody order a french toast donut. "French toast donut?" I asked, still composing my yelp photo. "Yes, we have them on Saturdays and Sundays..." "I loooove the french toast donuts. I want one." "Excellent!" I paid for a french toast donut, and sadly put the lid back onto the box of donuts I had. I sipped on the juice I had also paid for. After a lil while, another donut box was brought out. This one had a plate and containers inside. Atop the plate was a french toast donut. In the containers were toppings. One had maple butter, one had jam, and the third had maple syrup. I've never been a syrup kinda guy, so I put that one aside. The butter I smeared on top of the donut, and the jam I also used. There was also a plastic fork and knife wrapped up in a napkin. I used them to surgically cut apart my breakfast and enjoy it as long as I could. It was good. After this french toast donut, I was actually pretty full. So I thanked the store for their tasty treats, and walked back to my car. It turns out they're a just block away from old Fremont street. So knowing my car was in a safe spot, I spent several hours wandering the area. Lots of very neat things to see right around here. Including 'old' Las Vegas, and container park with their colossal mantis. (Just in case you're looking for things to do around here) The four donuts actually went home with me. They were still tasty and fresh when I got home the following day.
Awesome donuts they were very moist, soft and fresh! I found my new donut bar! :). They also make cake donuts!

these were easily some of the greatest donuts I have ever had!!! vanilla bean, creme brÃ»lÃ©e, and raspberry cheesecake. I usually don't eat jelly filled donuts but here is an exception. I seen on Diners, Drive-Ins, and Dives and said it was an absolute must! Also everyone that worked there was very friendly.

Service girl was pushing French toast donut. Told her didn't want that. Asked what some of them had in them and she mumbled something. If the donuts didn't look so delicious I would've walked out. By the way, none of them were very nice. After choosing what I wanted to buy, she tried selling the French donut again. And again while she was boxing my donuts. Oh boy, was she going for the grand price, was she going to get a bonus??? When I got home, the donuts were very disappointing. Pumpkin spice donut? Not at all taste like pumpkin. The donuts with filling in them? What filling, had to find the cream filling in most of them. I will not be back. Would've give them a one star, except that the Boston Cream was the only one that were very good.
The biggest donuts in town friendly service music coffee drinks easy parking did I say donuts? Offering custom French Toast on Sundays. I recommend you treat yourself here often

Wasn't a big fan of the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut as the sugar on top was very thick and hard and the donut was very dense and doughy. Also tried the cinnamon sugar donut cone with the vanilla ice cream in the middle and was also disappointed. The vanilla ice cream was nice and creamy but the cinnamon sugar cone was also hard to bite into and little dry. Bookmarked this place for months and was very disappointed

This. Place. Is. Amazing. I have been to the Donut Bar in SD, and I think I like this one more! Chocolate and strawberry milk on tap... But beware, it can be loud. The staff here are all very helpful! It is a quick-service type place, with lines usually out the door (although TOTALLY worth the wait!). My recommendations are; blood orange, Creme brÃ»lÃ©e, birthday cake, caramelized pineapple, and Oreo. I haven't tried the French toast yet (but fully intend to), and I hear they now have Blue Moon as well, which is also on my donut list. Word of warning: Get there early! Because once they sell out, they close up. No matter the time!

We were looking for a donuts on our way out of Las Vegas. After looking at the pictures we deciding to go here. The donuts look wonderful, but unfortunately that is where it ends. The flavor was not matching what I was expecting. I got two donuts but they were just sub par. I had better in regular grocery store. It was a disappointment.

The Donut Bar resides in what feels like Portland in Vegas. The place smells of wonderful and fresh baked sugary goodness the moment you step in. You're immediately greeted by the sight of colorful mouth-watering donuts that line up the glass displays. Just be mindful that this place closes by 1pm so plan accordingly! I tasted the Creme Brulee donut and the Snickers donut. The Creme Brulee donut was a bit smaller compared to all the other donuts but that shouldn't shy you away from experiencing creme brulee in this doughy goodness. What makes the donut so great is the experience of cracking that shell. The sweet creme oozes out and that first bite takes you away to some far off French patisserie. It's a donut you won't find anywhere else and is a must try if you're going! The snickers donut is good for two if you're not looking to start your day on the heavy side. I enjoyed the snickers pieces on the donut but other than that it wasn't amazing. If you're looking to try something new off the strip I say stop in and grab a donut. They have a huge selection but they only make a certain batch of each donut. They have custards to french toast donuts and no matter what donut you're loyal to, The Donut Bar has something to keep you happy. Each donut is $2-4 so you won't have to feel guilty about your sugar fix.

Damn good pastries. A must try in the DT Vegas area. I had the cheese cake and creme Brulee, both fabulous. They even have the Homer pink donut. The coffee's hot a fresh, and great tunes on. There's also a cool relaxing fish tank to stare at.

While not mind-blowing in taste, the donuts are of quality. Yeast donuts are the game here, not cake, and so you will find fluffy, fresh, artsy indulgences here. It's all about the Instagram-worthy photo opportunities. If that's your thing, along with jumping on an undeserved hype bandwagon, you'll love it. If you enjoy donuts for taste and nostalgia, then graded meh+. Continuing the trend of designer donuts, DB rolled on to the scene in 2016. Since then, there's been a dedicated following. They will tell you as much on their website, which is a paragraph or two of self back-patting about celebrities and high-profile mentions. People love it! I like it. When people who haven't been ask about it, I reply, "it's fine." What has me unimpressed can be boiled down to one word: frantic. -- Parking is abysmal thanks to the location. It often can't be found or you're charged for a 15minute run-in to grab a box. -- On multiple occasions when I was first trying to check them out, they were sold out before noon. Set yourself up for disappointment before you even arrive. Donuts are a morning treat, a routine, a comfort food item. I've never experienced a donut shop that has as part of its marketing that, "hey! we're soooo popular, we run out of our own product before it's even time for lunch, so get on down and fight for a parking spot and a donut. Whee!" -- The inside is decorated trendy pop pop fun fun, part of the whole experience. But the space inside is cramped, uncomfortable. You walk in and your back is against the wall in a tight funnel herding you towards ordering, which makes everything feel urgent urgent urgent. HURRY. Claustrophobic? Go to a more spacious donut shop that doesn't run out of product, has hospitable parking, and allows you some elbow room for moving about. I will say, though: those French toast donuts I turned my nose up at? Pretty incredible. ALMOST worth the effort to gamble on there being one available.

GET THE CREME BRÃ›LÃ‰E DONUTS! I'm surprised more specialty donut shops don't do this. Super fluffy donuts filled with vanilla custard and topped with crunchy caramelized sugar. Not only are they delicious, they're also fun to eat. We also ordered a maple bourbon donut, a coconut donut, and a Boston cream donut. All were great! I wish we could've tried more. The shop is a cute little place and easy to find. I'm glad we tried it this time around.
It was close when we arrived at 11am .....but, will probably visit earlier in October and give it a 4-5 star rating!!
Donuts are the size of my 2 yo daughters head!! Staff is super nice and helpful! Nutella stuffed donut is delish!!
Tried their blood orange (big ol' donut) and strawberry cream cheese. Both are very sweet and soft. Lots of good choices. Latte was good and right temp. Stop by early as they close early.

Was in the area for a jury summons and decided to give this place a try. It's a cool little donut/coffee bar and the selection is on point. Me and my GF shared a Mexican Hot Chocolate, Strawberry Big Poppa Tart and the Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e. We both agreed that the Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e had more flavor to it and much more filling. This is one of those occasions where bigger isn't necessarily better. We both felt that the other 2 looked more appealing but were mostly bread. I would probably go back and try the Brad Fritter w/Bacon (was told it was Brad Pitt's favorite), Blueberry Cheesecake and the Nutella Filled powder donut. The donuts were all fresh, as well!
Decent donuts. Wonderful staff. Insane prices. All in all, if you know what you're in for, you'll have a great experience.

There was only few donuts to select through and it was just basic donuts. This was my first time going and will be my last time going. No high chairs in there for my baby. Stay away from this place. This is not a donut bar with only 3 choices to choose from.

The atmosphere was great. The staff is awesome. The donuts look amazing, but I was not overly impressed with what I got. I had the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut and the Elvis donut. Maybe I was expecting too much. I regret not trying the other ones I had considered. The creme brÃ»lÃ©e was weird. The burnt sugar didn't work for me with the donut. It was a little too thick and works much better when it's just over a custard. The Elvis had a peanut butter topping and a banana Bavarian cream center. Loved the peanut butter but hated the cream. It tasted like banana candy. Very artificial. I love banana and peanut butter, but real banana is better. Maybe I'll try it again in the future, but currently I don't think paying for parking is worth it.
These donuts were built for show, not taste. They are beautifully made and come with a high price tag, but the taste left me a little disappointed. I do love the cheap and tasty coffee.

Heard good things about this place so made a special trip there and it did not disappoint! Had an apple fritter and a nutella donut both were excellent and made from high quality ingredients. Worth the trip and really like the patio section in back of the building to enjoy your breakfast.
The donut was a little stale. Not hot or fresh as I would've expected it. The location was cute, restaurant was cute as well.

My mind was blown today when I tried these delicious donuts. I came in near closing time so there was only three options: coconut, blueberry,and poptart. We went with the giant coconut and split it between 3 people. It was incredible! By far one of the best donuts I have even had in my life! The customer service was pretty friendly for a hipster place and the service was fast. I also tried the Americano coffee and it was EXCELLENT!!! I HIGHLY RECOMMEND this place and I will be sending my hotel guests to this amazing place.
Lost count how many times we've been here. Never disappoint. French toast donut lifer. Too bad this one doesn't have beer like the other.

Donuts as big as your face! I see this place every year on my way to Life is Beautiful and I finally made time to stop in. It's heavenly. It's located about a block away from Freemont East on Carson and 6th Street and, without the flying pink donut on the wall outside, I might have missed it. Before walking in, you'll notice the posted hours for each day - they close when they sell out - so it's probably better arrive earlier than later. We ordered four cinnamon rolls, two strawberry cheesecake donuts, a slated carmel and a Homer. I almost went into a diabetic coma because I couldn't stop and they were gone too soon. Each one was distinctive in taste but not overly sweet or dry. My favorite were the cinnamon rolls, they were gooey in the center and melted in my mouth, I highly reccommend them!

The Donut Bar was not something we had planned to visit, especially given the time of day but we decided to get some coffee and a donut. Glad we did! We got the donut stuffed with oreo and it was DELISH! Not only was it the right size and not too much donut, it paired very well with the coffee. My husband had a donut left the next day and he said the other donut wasn't as good the second day, but i think fresh is best earlier in the day - especially when there is a lot more variety. Location is a bit small but its not like you sit and eat donuts at dunkin donuts, we take them to go. I hope to try some other donuts next time we're in Vegas.
One of the best donut shops in Vegas! We had the creme brÃ»lÃ©e, lemon cream, and strawberry cream donuts and they were all delicious and fresh but the lemon was my favorite. The coffee was good too.

THE BEST DONUTS I'VE EVER HAD!!! I'm a sucker for raised donuts and their raised donuts are THE BOMB!! There's one close to home but I can never get myself to drive there before the donuts sell out. Thus, since I'm a donut fiend I made it a mission to come here since I was staying on the strip. I absolutely loved the caramel latte donut, it was my favorite. The French toast donut was made to order and it was so fluffy and good. I also got the mud pie and Creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut and they were amazing as well. I wish I got to try all of the donuts but that would be too much for a small girl like me haha. I couldn't believe that their strawberry split was vegan and it was huge!! I came with my cousin's gf and sister and they're vegans and they couldn't believe it either. We were all in heaven and were in awe the whole time. The prices aren't bad either considering the amount of dough you're getting! I need to come back here whether in SD of LV to try the other flavors and come back for the caramel latte donut.
WOW!!! Vegan donuts are heaven and they make them so perfectly. There was a little line but it moved fast. Coffee was yummy and service was great. I'll be back here for sure.
Amazing donuts and fun staff! Come hungry and with a sweet tooth. Their donuts as so delicious!

I know donuts, by god if there's one thing I've accomplished in this world it's a palette for donuts... VooDoo, Dynamo, Bob's (SF) Blue Star & Donut Friend, I've conquered them all & I have to say this place is comfortably in the same stratosphere of its brethren. I hate the word Artisanal especially when it comes to donuts, but this place is pretty fancy as it comes to ingredients and style of donuts. Stump town coffee & yummy selections such as Nuttella donut with chopped hazelnuts on top. Maple bacon bar, the Homer for those of you that remember the Michael Jackson Simpsons episode! We paid $27 for 2 coffees, 1 bottle water & 7 fancy kine doughnuts! Yes, winchells or Krispy Kreme is like $6-8 for a dozen, but why do you hate yourself? Pay up and treat yourself!

Plus: kids got a free 'spongebob' donut, close to my house, very trendy. Great if you need a sweet fix. Downside: overpriced ($29 later for 2 bacon maple bars, 1 caramel latte, 1 mud pie, 2 plain buttermilk, 1 chocolate glazed cake, 1 vanilla bean and 1 pink sprinkle...maybe the spongebob weren't free?); very heavy and bready and super sweet. When I left, I just kept thinking 'wow, I just spent $30 on donuts...' Donuts are very large and very sweet. They don't even make a simple plain glazed. Not sure if they are going for locals or more tourists, but for locals, I think a much more simpler donut would be nice...along with a lower price.

Definitely fills Vegas' missing gourmet donut niche, an it's certainly very pretty and lively and incredibly friendly inside. But is it worth lengthy lines and the hefty price tag? Unfortunately, I don't believe so. Some donuts tasted quite old. What a sad state of affairs to reach DB on a lovely Saturday morning to have stale donuts already in the case. Bro and I were excited to try the salted caramel raised, but... it was kinda tough. How heartbreaking! Creme brulee donuts are delicious, but so small. This may be the one force in the universe that can actually make me enjoy cake donuts. Here I actually preferred them! Red velvet, Butterfinger and blueberry Meyer lemon were divine! Coffee is on point, and music selection selection is pretty sweet at that! Despite so many upticks, in a neighborhood that sure could use upticks and has been gradually, proudly, bringing them in/keeping them here, the stars of the show -- the donuts -- were just meh. An overall A-OK experience.

This place is a donut lovers paradise. The donuts here are delicious and super fluffy. There were so many great looking donuts that it took me forever to pick out the ones I wanted. The size of some of the donut choices are huge and could feed a small family. I ate my first round of donuts there at the shop and of course had to go for round two but got those to go. The service there is fantastic and the employees there are all very friendly. They treated the tourist folks with the same amount of respect as they did to the local regulars that came in. Will definetly be returning when I'm back in Vegas.

After all the Hype we had to check this place out... I'm a total donut lover, and this place unfortunately was totally underwhelming. I was disappointed in the flavors of the donuts (from their simple cake donuts, to their Nutella speciality donut) the coffee wasn't great either. 3 donuts 2 cappuccinos and $14 later, we were thinking that Dunkin Donuts would have been a better option... at least their coffee is good!
Thank you yelp for helping me find this gem! Every donut was delicious!! Best I've ever had! Please open one in San Francisco!

5:5 for the customer service!!! Everyone was smiling and helpful and dressed in Halloween costumes. They gave my 4 year old a free mummy donut which stained his entire face black, lol. But it made his day anyway. The donuts- I went with the intention to try the French toast and creme brÃ»lÃ©e, I ended up buy the French toast, blueberry lemon, apple fritter pumpkin filled. By far the best was the French toast. It was actually pumpkin French toast. I would make the 30 minute drive just for that donut, but the rest were a little too sweet for me. I still would recommend this place bc of how unique the donuts are and the awesome customer service.

Tasty donuts! So many flavors it was hard to pick. The donuts are giant! Reasonable priced at $3/donut. We ended up with one red velvet, chai, strawberry cheesecake, and creme brÃ»lÃ©e. So good! I also got a creamy chai latte made almond milk, yes they have ALMOND milk, and stumptown coffee! They also have coffee brew on tap and I'm pretty sure they serve alcohol. They also have the option of putting frozen yogurt on your donuts. Wow! Try it! Uber Eats delivers from there and they have been featured on many food websites such as Food Network, Thrillist, and Forbes Magazine. Eat up!
We tried 6 donuts and they were all amazing! My wife ate 4 of them. Make sure you try the one with the Oreo cookie in the middle!

After a long night of drinking, you are grateful for your friends who decided to call it an early night and NOT go out. One of my friends, did just that. So he woke up early and took the rental car exploring. He came back with 5 boxes of donuts for our group to sample. My favorites were the creme brulee. But every single donut was heaven!

Soo much to choose from! We happened to visit on their 1-year anniversary so they had exotic cars parked outside you can sit and take pictures with, the owner was there doing raffle for different prizes from touristy things (like bus tour) to free donuts...each person received a raffle ticket for coming in and also a free birthday cake donut. It was a nice celebration! The selection was pretty extensive as well...I loved their creme brulee donut! The glaze cracked when you broke it in half.

Delicious and cheap!! If we're ever back in Vegas, we'll be back. We got a Homer, an Apple fritter, a Strawberry Cheesecake, and a Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e. They were all delicious. After the Homer, though, I couldn't finish my Strawberry Cheesecake. So good, but big and rich!!

I get donuts for my brother here. He loves them! The variety is huge and the staff is very friendly. We especially like the "Elvis" donut we saw today! I wish they would have gluten free donuts! I haven't had one in 10 years! The coffee is quite delicious. I had an iced latte and enjoyed the flavor quite a bit!

Fantastic!!! Went in on a Weekend and it was busy but the line went really quick! We ordered the French toast donut, cremebrulee, strawberries and cream, and blueberry lemon meyer, all were delicious!!! I cant wait to go back and try them all!! They even have a little courtyard we sat in and were able to bring our dogs to sit with us while we enjoyed breakfast!!

This place is amazing! My little family and I were visiting Las Vegas and Yelp this donut shop. Based on the great reviews I told my husband that we got to try this place. When we arrived we were greeted by all their friendly staff. The ladies also asked if my children wanted to take a complimentary cookie monster donut. They gave us one for each of my kids. I thought that was very sweet of them. They even went the extra mile to give my kids each a balloon. We ordered a french toast donut, nutella filled donut, the birthday oreo donut, and maple bacon donut. Let me tell you these donuts were so delicious. I honestly could not stop smiling they were so good! I would have given them a 5 star just based on their friendliness, caring, welcoming service. This donut shop is by far my favorite just by one visit. Thank you!!

The last time I visited in the afternoon, the Donut Bar was closed because they had sold out for the day. Came a bit early yesterday and fell in love with their donut selection. I can't believe they sold out of Butterbeer donuts a few minutes after I checked out. Definitely coming back for more! Their donuts are fluffy and delicious. Not soggy the next day either.

This is a nice treat after being so good all week! The menu options are very well rounded and they take simple American favorites and turn it up a notch! One of my faves is the PB&J. It's a jelly filled donut with a peanut butter frosting on top. So good. They give free donuts to the kiddos on the weekends which helps when you're waiting in line for sure! The cold brewed coffee is also really good! The kids love picking out their own huge donuts which they never quite finish in one sitting. Disclaimer: if you go there really hungry like I did there is a chance you'll leave with more and have extras for the next day! :)

This place is my go to breakfast in Downtown Las Vegas. The donuts are made fresh everyday and of course my favorite is the Creme Brulee donut. The outside is that caramelized sugar and the inside is a fluffy donut with vanilla creme. It's something that will be on your mind until you go back. Other than the donut, my favorite part was the vanilla custard/ ice cream in a cinnamon sugar donut cone. Yup, you heard me right. And it was drizzled in caramel sauce. Let's just say it got a little messy, but was so worth it. I came back every other day for a week for it. *Key advice: They usually sell out everyday by 1 pm and close the shop when they sell out. And make sure to check in for a cup of free espresso or drip when you buy a dozen!

I love you guys! Wow all I can say is wow! I have been to your San Diego location and I come to Vegas every other week. My girlfriend and I are HUGE fans of the Big Poppa Tart & the creme brÃ»lÃ©e :-) The place looks really cool and has a great vibe to it. It's in a old historic building that has been remodeled. The backyard patio is perfect for coffee & donuts in downtown Vegas! We also saw Chef Santiago & he took the time to say hello and welcome us to his new shop! We can't wait for Ice Cream Cones from Donut Bar!!
Quick service great section of doughnuts. Was worth the short drive to find. Parking is cheap across the street from the shop. 1.00 per hour
Only place close in fun and deliciously creative donuts is Hurts Donuts in Springfield, MO. Great espresso here!
If you like donut places that run out of donuts at 915am, this is your place....make more donuts dummiez!!!!!
I have a big problem with this place... I cant stop wanting to go there.. Best donuts ever! I'm getting fat... BUT its so good!

What a great place! I have to visit a local donut joint in every city I visit; so glad I picked this one! The young lady that helped me was super cute (I love a girl who can rock blue hair) & friendly. I was bummed they were out of the salted caramel until I saw the size of their fritters! I got the one with bacon- check out the pic. And I finally got a creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut! So happy I did. Both were excellent. A bonus: the "artwork" in the bathroom!

Love it how they have so much to choose from And also it really satisfies your cravings that's for-sure I love this place overall amazing and I really can't wait to bring my family here to try them out well worth it I appreciate this place for not only having a good selection but amazing service

Super happy there is another vegan friendly donut place in Vegas!!! The donuts are unique, classic, and delicious. The coffee/tea is spot on and the perfect addition to your morning or afternoon pick me up. Make sure you get there early....the like to sell out fast! But, remember, they are now open late for those downtown bar goers! Enjoy!

Honestly love this place! I'm not a donut person and don't have a sweet tooth at all, but I'd have a donut from here everyday if life allowed it. Donuts are a bit pricier than your regular donut place but completely worth every cent.

Donuts are yummy ! My fav is the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut :) they always have a long line and run out of donuts ! I heard they usually run out of donuts around noon time . So if you are planning on trying them out make sure to come well ahead of this to ensure yourself a wide selection. One bad thing however is that they make their donuts a night ahead of time when then are all sold out.

My gf brought me home a box of donuts while she was working. They looked very appealing, looks can be deceiving. They honestly were probably some of the worst donuts I've ever had. They were very dry and super doughy. The donuts at Smiths are wayyyy better than this place. I will deft not be returning.

I, like everyone else, saw the creme brulee cracking video on Facebook, so i had to try this place. I was in town for my bachelorette party, but i visit every month so its like I still live here. I ordered a shit ton of donuts the night before because that's the only way u can try these donuts and guarantee you get what they make that day, without waiting in line. Metered parking out front, long ass line out the door. Walked right up and asked for my order. Was prompt, staff was friendly. Donuts were meh. The best part was cracking the donut in person. Everything else was grocery store quality.

Accidentally stopped in. Saturday morning after a 3 mile walk to mail 2 post cards at the USPS across the street to no avail, Ugh...... Low and behold........ a "Donut Bar" across the street. And many folks know me and donuts. Well, even though I have 4 donuts waiting for me back at the hotel (which I have to walk back to), I figured.. What the heck. What discipline. After serious consideration, talking to other patrons and using the boys room.... I settled on 1 donut. It was the cream brÃ»lÃ©e. $2 Was it worth it? Yes. Yes it was. Now to roll back south. Happy eats. BTW, the other donuts I have waiting are from a very early run to Pink Box Donuts. Pretty darn good there too and at reasonable cost. I guess this is what helped me stop at 1 donut at Donut Bar. A wise choice. Go with the BrÃ»lÃ©e.
The donuts here are incredible - and so is the service! The owners work the counter, and treat customers like friends. These Creme Brulee donuts were among my favorites.

I wish I loved you. I wish we would have worked out. Maybe I'll give you another go when I'm in the area. The workers there were friendly so I gave two stars. WHY I DIDN'T LIKE IT: -Donuts dry. I tried several too. The creme brulee which I thought I would love but the sugary top made it hard for me to eat. The birthday cake one with the oreo in it was super dry. The blueberry donut was the saving grace out of the donuts. Pretty moist and flavorful but not enough for me to want to go back there. WHY I NEED TO GO BACK: -I came late, maybe that's why the donuts were dry? I don't know. -I want that strawberry whipped cream one. It looks good, so Ill go early to try it. -Everyone needs a second chance.

I can't rate the quality of the donuts, due to the poor service I received I left without purchasing any. If you have a certain greeting for your 1st time customers, it should be practiced with ALL first timers not just those the staff choose to give the new customer greeting to. When I made it known that the same courtesy was not given to me, the response was "well do you want to buy anything", after that disrespectful treatment I made the choice to not patronize this business ever!!!!
Great donuts, they are HUGE! A little pricey but worth visiting. I tried the crepe brÃ»lÃ©e donut, it was awesome.
The Best Donuts, I have ever tasted! They are so light and fluffy, just goodness. Only bummer was the ice cream machine was down, we wasn't able to try, the donut cone. Overall, loved this place!

They were at the farmers market at DTS & was our first turns trying them. Each large donuts were $3-4. Hubby and I were not impressed. The large donuts were nothing special but ordinary which I felt like it had too much bread and not enough toppings. I'll give it another try maybe the selection we had was just off.

Service was friendly and quick, but these are absolutely not the best donuts ever. While they were beautifully presented, once we bit into them, we noticed how dry and unexceptional that they are. The hype really falls short at this establishment, which is really disappointing for how expensive these donuts are.

Found this place through Insider Eats. I was drawn to the Creme Burlee dounut. They have a Homer Simpson donut. I not big into flavored donuts, but I liked the Vanilla Bean and Cake Batter donuts. They have your typical Bacon Maple and Bacon Chocolate donut. There are fun flavors like PB&J, Red Velvet, Mud Pie. All the donuts are made fresh. Some people may feel it's overrated, but it's an overall good find.
Who doesn't love a great donut! I couldn't decide so I got the Homer and the Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e and both are delicious. I love fresh and soft and they are both.

Simply delicious. Always fresh and consistent. We love the customer service and the smile on everybody's face. We are visiting the location almost every Saturday with the kids and we never had a bad experience. Thank you Donut Bar for sweetening our family weekend. I highly recommend this place to anybody that wants to try next level donuts.

HOLY VEGAN MOLY, YOU GUYS! FOOD: It's donuts, how special are donuts, right? WRONG. These guys do it big and I mean, BIG. The flavors are unique and tasty and each donut is easily the size of two. Did I mention they have a bunch of vegan donuts too (not just the plain, boring flavors)? Couldn't even tell the difference (being vegan, doesn't make me biased, I swear!). SERVICE: Best service. Everyone was nice and was happy to chat us up. I was with my sister and it turns out two brothers were working there together. NEAT! Also, my sister didn't like the coffee drink she got so a nice woman came over to make it different so my sister could enjoy it. No extra charge and she was totally understanding. PRICE: Who cares? Worth every penny! OVERALL: Like I said to VegeNation a couple blocks over: I love you guys, come to LA?

After a big lunch at Lotus of Siam, my wife found this place, so we went... I'm not a donuts fan. Even though I've been forced to go to few donuts shops recently. This place was one of the upscales donut places. Since we went there after lunch they were about to close, we only got a maple bacon donut bar. And it was satisfying. The maple glaze actually has the taste of some bacon flavor, it banded with the bacon pieces perfectly. I'm actually looking forward to come back to this place to try other flavors.

A little off the beaten path but well with the trip! We got the crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e, blueberry Meyer lemon, vanilla bean, s'mores, Nutella overload, and Nutella glazed. They were all amazing! Hoping we have time to head back before we leave. The staff was helpful and friendly! Would defiantly recommend!

East coast gal visiting. This place was to par with the donut speciality shops near Manhattan but I was disappointed in how they were sold out within an hour of opening. They were also expensive in my opinion. The donuts were great, coffee was okay. The self serve coffee bar needed to be restocked.
Very good. Didn't knock my socks off or anything, but it was good and I'd recommend it.

On a recommendation from a LV friend, we ventured to downtown to grab custom donuts. Now, I may be biased as I am a hardcore Simpson's fan and the shop paid homage to Mr. Donut (Homer Simpson), but the donuts we had were truly delicious without being an overly heavy donut. Which was good seeing as how it was 112 degrees out. The creme brÃ»lÃ©e was fantastic, only to be trumped by the chocolate espresso donut. Loved it. Thanks Donut Bar!!!

A good place to go to at least once. Depending on the time of day and weekend, the line will be out the door. They have a variety of different fancy donuts. It is a small little place with not much seating. There is a back patio area if you don't mind sitting in the heat. Staff were very friendly! Make sure not to miss the fish tank inside.

Donuts are probable awesome, but i have never been able to try them. I have been in here a few times and they never have donuts. They are always sold out. So just be aware that there is a relatively good chance that this donut shop will not have donuts. I am sure when they have them they are good. Fool me once shame on you, fool me twice shame on me. Fool me a third time, now i am just a moron who is not coming back. But what do i know i am just guy that wants my donut shop to have donuts.

First fell in love with donut bar in San Diego! They have the best donuts around. They are always moist and the breeding isn't too dry. They have so many options to chose from including a super unique donut called "big poppa tart" it has a pop tart inside of the donut, a must try and a favorite.

I don't know why there is so much hype about this place. I was initially amped like everyone else, but was sadly put down in the blink of an eye. I guess living In LA for the past four years really spoiled me because of the myriad of donut shops I've tried there. Donut bar is different from all the donut shops in Vegas I do have to say. They offer donuts the size of your face, flavor combinations that are unique, and esthetics so pretty you don't want to eat them. Unfortunately, I can't say the same about the texture. The texture was not as moist as I had anticipated. With every bite, I had to wash it down with some water. We came at noon and maybe the donuts were sitting there for a couple hours? But that should not be a valid excuse for a shop specializing in donuts. They close at 1pm or when all the donuts are sold out. Would I come here again, probably not. Sorry donut bar but you can do better.

This place used to be my favorite Donut place to go to. Came here on Sunday only to be disappointed. The creme brÃ»lÃ©e used to be my go to donut and the flavor I'm used to is lacking. The sugar on top also used to cover the whole top of the donut. The other donuts were also mediocre.

I woke up this morning... 7 AM... because I was going to go try The Donut Bar. There was so much hype about this place from USA today to the food network to Ellen. I was energized and ready to go! I got there at 7:50 in the morning and it was easy to find parking. There was already a line of at least 40 people ahead of me who were also waiting for a shop that was about to open at 8 AM. The wait time to get in once the shop opens at 8 AM was 30 minutes in line outside. Luckily, it was a pleasant day. As I approached the inside of the store, I was surprised to see that I wasn't all that excited. I saw many very large looking donuts with hard tacky frosting that weren't at all appealing. The oversized amount made them less appealing rather than to appear yummy. The smaller donuts looked good and, by smaller, I mean normal size like Dunkin' Donuts regular donuts. The service was just OK. Whoever chose to run this place really doesn't seem to understand what the best environment for customer service is. It was glaring super loud music over the speakers where I could barely hear the person helping me and I'm not sure if they could hear me. I had to order several donuts for a party and thought this is a good place to try because it gets so much publicity so it has to be good. I decided to put my instincts aside because so many people were waiting in front of me and behind me to get into this place and it has gotten all these reviews. As I ordered, after two dozen donuts, the server just went off to help somebody else without even asking me if I was finished with my order. I couldn't believe it! I was very friendly during the whole interaction which is why this shocked me. I did not bother calling her back because I am not confrontational and simply will let something like this go, but won't let it go during a review. The donuts range from two dollars that are very small to some pastries that are upwards of four dollars. I ordered several donuts including the Twix, Samoa, blueberry with lemon, chai, Nutella, Red velvet, and the crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e. Here is what I have to say: firstly, you have to eat these donuts the day of because they are not as good the next day. With that being said, most of the donuts were not that impressive to begin with. They were just ok or disappointing. In fact, the crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e donut, which gets all of this amazing hype, was one of the worst ones of the bunch. The hard sugar/Caramel crust on top of the donut was so burnt that it carried a foul aftertaste. The donut itself had a yummy crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e center within the dough. The topping of the crunchy burnt sugar/Caramel ruined it. I also did not like that many of the donuts were grossly over sized with a great deal of tacky frosting on it which was glazed and dried off. I did order a couple of those and they were not very good. This place is OK. I did not try the coffee and I wonder if that would've changed my mind and increased their ratings. The donuts are so so. They aren't that much better than other places or don't cost a lot less so I do not know what people are talking about. Also, the wait time and price just isn't worth it. It is a very popular place and a lot of people come here. Not sure if there are people that love donuts so much that this is considered great quality??? I love food and have been very fortunate to taste some phenomenal food internationally at some of the best places. I know donuts and sadly, the donut bar does not have anywhere close to the best donuts around. The two stars are because it is expensive, the service was disappointing, the wait time to get the donuts was way too long for this,and the donuts did not impress. I am glad I tried it just take the hype away and I should have gone with my instincts.

This was one of my planned stops while in Vegas...SO GLAD I stopped in! The menu of donuts...omg...seriously, how does one decide between lemon cheesecake, Meyer lemon blueberry and triple threat chocolate? You DON'T! You get them all! Not to mention the other delicious, creative flavors, like the donut with an OREO in the middle. Be still my heart! The coffee drinks were fabulous, the staff were so friendly and the bathroom, well, I'll leave it as a secret and just tell you to check it out! Will be back before I leave this town. GO. SEE. ENJOY!

Don't even ask me.how many times I've been here. Okay. Just 3 times. The creme.brulee is a vegan donut that has a candy like carmelized consistency on top of it with a vegan made custard in that sucker. It's my fave out of all the donuts! For some reason when I bite into it-it reminds me of a Filipino dessert. Sometimes the top may taste a bit burnt minus it actually being burnt. You'll know what I mean when you try it. Weekends they give away free themed donuts to the kiddos. Nothing like seeing your 3 year old elated to bite into an angry bird, minion, or even an avenger. But nothing like imagining a parents face knowing your child is about to bite into his last chunk of sugar for the month. Lol. I'm afraid to admit I've tried a lot of the stuff they have to offer and overall, think they're all right. Nothing worth setting your alarm to, although, coming in early would be ideal because duh...the fresher the better. Everyone knows going to any kind of bakery towards closing won't get the best bite. The big poppa tart donut they're raved about or known for is all right...says the person who can tolerate only so little sugar in one sitting. The one I've had was actually dry. =/ Overall, I'd still pop in on a Saturday morning with the fam...take our our donuts then walk over to the container park where the kids can release the sugar they just swallowed. Makes for a nice morning with the fam. It's worth giving it a try. I prefer this spot over Pink Box for sure...mainly because of their vegan. I dont think theyre one of those must cross the desert for. If you happen to be by and feel like a donut, then definitely give them a try. But if youre coming without a donut craving at all, then more than likely you'll find them to be all right and overhyped. Long lines some mornings. I'd skip bringing the stroller in if possible. But if you must...then you must...especially if you're in then out. Their strawberry milk on tap was pretty deelish too! And something I've learned...these donuts have beers out there that pair really well together. Mind blown.

We bought a dozen of there donuts and then had a sampling. There was lot of hype that built this place up. First off they don't open until 8 am on the weekends, for someone like me 8 am might as well be noon on the weekends. The glaze and toppings they put on their donuts is really good, the dough though is too much. It's too "bready". To me it doesn't taste like a cake donut, it taste like 4 slices of white Weber's bread (sans the crust of course) with topping on it.To me a donuts dough should be on the light side of sweet and cakey.. maybe they bake them here, I can't say for sure. I can be a bit snobbish about my donuts, but everyone in our group agreed on that one point, I listed above.
Came here yesterday... I had no idea the donuts were so large lol. My son & I got 1 large each & 1 small. Definitely will be back

I'm definitely one that loves donuts and prefers not the traditional style with traditional toppings we came in for Labor Day weekend and saw donut bar. I was able to get a birthday cake donut on my birthday it tasted exactly like birthday cake!!! I also noticed that they have franchise options I had no idea donut bar was a franchise? Maybe one of these will pop up in California close to me soon because their donuts are fantastic!!!! They also have a large selection of drip coffee. Heather just having decaf or regular there were five options that you could choose from even in flavored coffee

Was here for their 'soft' opening. The staff were really friendly, however when I arrived at 10 they already ran out of all (but 1!) of their vegan donuts! I ended up getting the Spiced Chai (which I was highly skeptical about)... But it was AMAZING. I hate chai tea and cake donuts... But the vegan Spiced Chai cake donut was yummy! I spoke with the manager and they didn't realize the demand for vegan donuts out here, and will be adding more once they open. Overall, very good but you do have to get there early for the best selection. Looking forward to trying more donuts from here... And I think this will be a very good replacement (possibly better) than O Face. I miss O Face donuts, so I'm hoping to get a chance to try the rest of their vegan donut flavors in the future.
Delicious! The pop tart one is ah-mazing! Like a pop tart wrapped in a toaster strudel

This is by far the best creme brÃ»lÃ©e donuts I've ever had. Crunch caramel coating is sooo delicious. They didn't have much of selection since I went there around 1: p.m. I really wanted to tryout all the flavors of donuts they had to offer but my main complaint is that they close too early.
Recently moved from SD and was happy to find out Donut Bar was here in LV ! Extremely friendly staff and the donuts are to die for. Also don't forget your coffee the Mocha's pretty good.

I mean where to start ok went in for the creme brulee donut order a dozen different donuts almost 30 bucks wtf waaaaaay over priced, but anyways my creme brulee donut was good flavor but half my order was soft didnt even have the crunchy top they are suppose to have, all other donuts tasted like Albertsons donuts not impressed , Pink Box hands down are running circles around this place if you are about flavor and not ooh i have a pop tart in my donut WTF it was gross by the way, and i drove all the way from summerlin early as hell because they close at 1 so i thought for sure it was fire NOPE, yall got me with all these bull crap reviews thanks for keeping it fake this place sucks.

About a year ago we stumbled across this place and went in. Several of us and we all got multiple doughnuts to share so we could try more than one. Then the donuts were AMAZING! Great flavor. Fresh. Not just a typical donut and they seemed set apart. We've been I think 3 or 4 times as we come back and visit vegas. This trip we made the haul all the way from the other end of the strip to get some donuts for our few days stay. We got 6 - yes 6 big donuts. Unfortunately this time we were pretty disappointed. It seems they've changed something and the donuts are more cakey like, seem less fresh and the flavors just aren't there. They have the options of flavors but the best part about the donuts this time was things they didn't make: Nutella inside, Oreos on top, etc. The donuts weren't bad they just didn't seem as set apart and special or worth the hike from the other end of the strip. Not sure if we'd go back or venture to other donut places on the strip next time.

This placee is awesome! They made me some custom Chicago Cubs donuts and made me look so good at work this morning! Thank you for making those for me they looked so good and we're delicious! The look on everyones face at work was priceless! You guys aren't only making donuts but your creating memories too! Sweet! Congratulations to the Chicago Cubs! 2016 World Champs!

To me I wouldn't call these the best doughnuts, but it was good! The shop is cute and staff are super helpful in helping you, if you have any questions. I was super excited about the cream brÃ»lÃ©e donut, but that was just ok the outside was nice like a candy shell, but they center was too much like vanilla pudding instead of cream brÃ»lÃ©e taste. But, my kids loved the Oreo, vanilla glazed and the Nutella dough nut. ---extra points for the vanilla glaze doughnut, one of the more simple doughnuts they offer but hits the spot---
Donuts were great, I suggest the French Toast Donut.. Honestly it's the best of both worlds.. Won't find anything else like it.. definitely a must have if you're near Fremont Street.
Loved this place! So wonderful to have another donut shop with vegan options - maybe one day the vegan donuts will be the majority of the menu. A girl can hope. Cozy atmosphere - we love DTLV.

Loved my experience at the Donut Bar. When you walk in the door the smell of freshly baked donuts is incredible. The music is loud and the energy in the restaurant is a great day to get the day started. There was a wide selection of donuts. I chose the Homer Simpson. It was perfectly baked with a nice pink rich strawberry frosting and sprinkles. I also ordered a large coffee, however I was not impressed. It was self serve for coffee with various blends. There was no dark roast to chose from. Seating inside is limited, but there were amble seats available outside with plenty of shaded options. I'll definitely be back!

You can definitely taste the QUALITY within these donuts. They are more than just good...they bring magic and sparkle to your life. The selection they have is just amazing. Yesterday was my 1st visit to the location. I tried the following donuts: blueberry cheesecake, Homer's donut, and Boston creme. Let me tell you...this place will over exceed your expectations! I WILL BE BACK...very soon!

Passed by here after we got brunch since they had French toast donuts on Sundays and boy, did we get lucky! We got the last french toast donut and it was AHHHHMAZING! Not too sweet and very fluffy! We also got the pineapple, creams brÃ»lÃ©e, red velvet and birthday cake Oreo donuts and cafe lattes for the road. They were all superb! Really loved the donuts, cozy spot and the people working there. The donut chef was even working the register and chatted with us since we were visiting from LA. Super nice & yummy donuts!! We ate our donuts in the back where they had tables and murals, great bonding spot! Will be back again to try the rest!

I'm not the type of pig that actively seeks out for Donuts in the morning (see what I did there?) but I enjoy it once in awhile...while they have great concepts and crazy creative donuts and items the excution of the finished product could be better as it let it dry. If Yelp had half star ratings this would be a 3.5/5.... I got the: Creme Brulee Donut: I guess all big foodies have heard of this minus me...but my friends showed me the video of it. Like I said, concept is cool but execution was ehhhh... Birthday Cake w/ Oreo: So it was a birthday cake inspired donut with an oreo in the inside...but again concept is cool but execution was ehhh.... Maple Bacon: I guess this was my favorite one out of all of them just cause they actually executed this fairly comparable to a lot of other Maple Bacon donuts... I just felt that a lot of their donuts were dry compared to the place they replaced (O Face Donuts).

I finally had a chance to go here, mainly because my tattoo artist in conveniently next door ;) i didnt realize at the time but i was quite lucky to go in without having to wait in a long line that stretches around the building. Also, i was lucky enough to get donuts because, from what ive heard, they sell out frequently. I had a decent selection to choose from for it being midday. (One of the guys told me theres usually much more to choose from but they all sold out) i got the strawberry cheescake, peanut butter something, the elvis and an original. It was a "meh" for the original. The elvis was delectable, banana cream with caramel. The peanut butter was a little dry. As for the cheesecake, i cant comment because i ate it the next day.
