Will definitely be going back again, mainly to try the churro-looking donut cone they have. Also, the staff was very friendly.
So cute and the donuts were delish. Love watching downtown Vegas come alive! This place is a must stop for belly filling breakfasts or dessert
They have the best donuts in town. I love coming here. They're always so friendly. Every time I drive to this side of town it's a must to stop by.

So Glad they opened one up in Vegas (Downtown) I'm not up super early so I usually grab what's left for a dollar before they close and enjoy some of Donut Bars best creations. Nitro Coffee on Tap!! And don't miss the French Toast donut cooked to order on weekends only. These guys from San Diego know how to make their donuts that's for sure. A must stop while in Vegas!

I was really excited to try this place. Coming from Henderson, and I would say it isn't worth the drive. The donut and cappuccino was mediocre. The interior is super cute and the staff was kind. At 10:30 more than half the counter was sold out. We thought there would be a lot more options. Not sure if I'll be back.

If you're thinking of getting donuts at Krispy Kreme, don't bother, it will never be able to compete with the donuts here at donut bar. The creme brÃ»lÃ©e is a hit that's for sure, but the Oreo birthday cake, maple bacon, and red velvet donuts are also bangin. Get there before 10am and you'll have more options as they do sell out as the day rolls by.
Literally one of the best donuts I've ever had. I had a Red Velvet donut. Highly recommend this place

Great customer service, yummy diet killers; I mean donuts This place is so cute and it close to the freeway so you can run in before work and still make it on time. Not and everyday place but definitely an occasional allowance.

This place is a must!! It's on a side street but def the visit... the donuts are fresh & I am embarrassed to say I ate the damn apple fritter three days latter & it was SLAMMING absolutely delicious. Purchased a box of goodies for $10 oh yeah anything toy can fit in the box for $10.. amazingly yummy

If you're looking for special donuts that taste as good as they look then you've arrived at the right place. The store variety: smores, Oreo birthday cake, crime brÃ»lÃ©e, and etc. The donut price ranges from $2-$5 but the $4-$5 donuts are huge! You have to get to the store before 10 am, preferably 8-9:20 am or else most of the popular donuts will be sold out. You can preorder online and pick it up from 8-10 am but the minimum is 12 donuts. Easily my favorite donut store when I'm in Las Vegas or San Diego.

I was beyond excited to finally try this place, because of all the hype about it being the best! We pretty much grabbed each flavor so I had a pretty good taste of most of them. Most of them tasted the same and not really their actual flavor, but they were soft and fresh so that was good. The one I enjoyed the most had to be the Creme brÃ»lÃ©e. The donuts are decorated amazing which is probably why they are so hyped, but overall they tasted just like average donuts. The price is pretty expensive compared to other donut joints. The service was very nice and sweet, they explained to us all their flavors and their number one sellers which was great. I'm glad I finally tried it and got to see what the hype was all about.

Once upon a time I would say that waking up early and heading to the local donut shoppe prior to opening, waiting outside discussing what indulgences we will enjoy as we waft in the delicious aroma sounded like a scene from some cute 80's or 90's romantic comedy. Well in a world where life inmates art, that is exactly the concept behind the now nationally recognized Donut Bar. I work in a hotel in Downtown San Diego, and people from around the country ask for this place, by name! With a line out the door all the time, arrive early and expect to wait, but don't worry, you will not me disappointed. Its like willy wonka drank a bunch of local craft beer and conceptualized some of these out of this world breakfast desserts. My suggestion is to buy at least 3: 1 to eat immediately. 1 to sit down upstairs and enjoy with some coffee. and 1 to give to someone else.

By far the best donut shop I have been too. There was a line and I can definitely say I understand why. This morning I ordered a dozen donuts and I had to try the French toast one and thankfully I got one of the last ones!!! it is by far the most delicious scrumptious, warm, perfect amount of sweetness,! it was just delicious. I can't believe this was my first time trying this I literally work right around the corner how come I didn't know it existed so delicious hats off to the chef and the gentleman and woman working hard I would defiantly recommend this place! #bestintown

When you walk into Donut Bar you are a little overwhelmed with all the different donut choices. It's super hard to pick just 1 or 2. I tried a few different donuts and I have to admit I was a little disappointed with the taste. I think the presentation of the donut out weighs the taste. I expected more flavor. For example one of the donuts I tried was the snickers donut. Now that sounds like it should be wonderful however I didn't taste any hint of snickers flavor, it just tasted like a chocolate donut and a little dry too. The staff was super friendly and helpful explaining the different flavors. But honestly if I lived in Vegas I don't know if I'd stop here again.

All the hype not the best donuts I've ever had.. looks aesthetically beautiful, but lacks flavor and all the donuts were pretty much just all dough. We bought 8 donuts and most of it went in the trash. I live in Summerlin paid $20 for Parking and spent $35 for donuts. Wanted to see for myself what all the hype was about. The donuts are just BIG Oversized donuts that look pretty, some average as far as taste and some were really dry.

This place is a hidden gem! The donuts are amazing and so creative. It's the perfect spot for a quick breakfast, and afternoon snack! Get there early because once they Sold out they are closed for the day. Dont miss out! We will be back every year we come to Vegas.

We went during happy hour!! (About 12.30pm) you can fit as many donuts as you can in their big rectangle box for $10. Or they have buy 1 get 1. The donuts were absolutely delicious. There didn't seem to be the full selection that's written on the daily board, but that could be due to the time of day we went. I love this area and it's a refreshing little dessert place to try when you are in the area or are going for a specific treat!

Absolutely wonderful. Everything is so fresh, the nitro coffee is phenomenal, and every single worker was extremely pleasant. Loved the holiday treats they put out as well. As a local, I will be returning.

My first time here since they took over from the old O face. I have to say I am very impressed!! When first walking in the environment is hip. The smell is so amazing and could be smelled from a block away!! We decided to order a dozen to make sure we all got try everything we wanted. We ordered almost every kind or at least the kinds that we wanted to. My favorite is the French toast, so amazing and super fresh!! They make it right when you order it!! That could be breakfast alone. Price point was not bad for the size of the donuts you get! The staff was friendly and the chefs talked to us as we checked out. Check in on Yelp for your free expresso!! What a wake up call. We will be back soon enough!!

Donuts are okay. They have an interesting selection. Pricier than average, but you pay for the novelty. Had a caramel espresso donut. Seems like a regular yeast donut heavily iced. It was huge. I didn't taste coffee but it was covered in caramel. Tried the birthday cake donut. It was okay. After the hype from others, I expected more. I prefer Crunch donuts for novelty.

I read about this place on fb...i know exactly where it is becuz it was o doughnuts b4 n i would go to nomnomnom...but still i hav this place to go nomnomnom on donuts! Luckily i got there n no line..aftr i left very long line out the door! I was greeted by friendly staff...i drooled looking at display of yummy looking donuts...i finally decided to try the strawberry pop tart donut...there is actual pop tart inside of donut..donut itself was huge..me likey alot!!! Deelish! lol..i got a coffee too n sat at inside counter..there is also an outdoor patio seating in back...staff was wearing leis n said its hawaiian theme day..they had donuts malasadas n choco coconut flavors..very cute! ..awesome donuts n awesome service! I will be back! Oh n i bought a cute tshirt to wear back home..hawaii!

An amazing find! The staff was spot-on with their recommendations...which was definitely needed, given the large variety from which to choose. We had the Boston Cream, strawberry shortcake, and lemon cheesecake...all were wonderful. The lattes were very good, as well! We had the opportunity to meet the owner...suggested we get the French Toast Donut (another customer had ordered...looked incredible). We will definitely make this a regular stop for future visits to Vegas.
Not only are the donuts a work of art....but they taste amazing also. Had the Strawberry Split and 2 of us couldn't finish it, bit we sure tried.
Update: I've recently tried the creme brulee donut again. And there is definitely a LOT more filling. It's easily one of my favorite donuts now.

Doh!! This place is a no brainier for the best donuts in Las Vegas!! The Homer is a must for any Simpons fan who loves donuts. Great tasting and super creative creations won't disappoint as long as you get here early

Came from Cali to celebrate my husband birthday and all he kept talking about was going to the donut bar. Well when get there they have a board on the wall with all the donuts for the day.(they all sound amazing) but when it was time to order my husband wanted the Homer donut and big poppa tart and our friends wanted a couple of other donuts that was on this " list " and the lady behind the counter said their all sold out and aren't making any more and it was only a hour after they opened so we found that very strange and upsetting.. they only had 7 donuts out of a whole damn list!! My husband was very disappointed. It seems like the only way you can get a donut on this so called list is being there when the works clock in for their shift in the early a.m.

A friend of mines told me to visit this place for cool awesome donuts. Went by yesterday while on vacation and line was crazy. So this morning went early and I was first in line. Wooooo! Hopefully these last im taking half a dozen home to my sister! Donuts were frickin awesome. Get the maple bacon one it was warm and gooey and delicious as hell!!!

Donuts are delicious! We tried the big poppa tart, vanilla bean donut and the chocolate milk (which was amazing by the way). They also have pretty cute shirts and hats. If in the area, you should support this donut shop!

The girl at the counter greeted me and asked if I had been there before which I hadn't. I wanted to try it since their donuts looked really good from YouTube videos I've seen. She told me which ones sold the most and told me about some other popular ones. I already had in mind what I wanted so I got a Nutella ring donut which don't really taste like Nutella, a creme brulee which was really good and I also got a cinnamon roll with bacon on the top and also pieces were throughout which I loved. Next time I go I have to try the red velvet

Man, if you want some of the biggest, sweetest, craziest Donuts in Las Vegas... Donut bar is the place to be. They bake an entire pop-tart into a donut.... A creme brulee donut, apple crumble, s'mores... And those are just the ones I've tried and liked. These guys are on it. Best Donuts on Fremont St

My wife and I had been to the San Diego location so when we're heard that Las Vegas would be getting one we had to make a trip while we were in town. The location wasn't up and running yet but we were still invited in, I believe his name was Dan and Amy. They were both so friendly! Showed us around even gave us a box of delicious donuts to take with us! Mmmmmm maple bacon! If you're looking for a great place run by friendly people this is it!
Cute shop. Donuts are AMAZING. So soft if you went for the grand opening you'd get a free donut..

Went here yesterday morning because of all the raves. They supposedly had the best doughnuts in the world. We had the coconut, blueberry cheesecake, creme brulee and birthday cake oreo doughnuts. First of all they were all very dry. My daughter hated the birthday cake oreo doughnut, she said it was overly sweet, even when I took out the oreo it was still very sweet. We also ordered their strawberry milk and chocolate milk. They tasted like regular milk. Going there was a mistake. About 2 hours later my daughter started getting sick, my daughter is still suffering until now. I'll take Krispy Kreme over this place anytime.
Honestly Donut Heaven right here!! The level of Quality and Service was Awesome!! Cant wait to come back!!
Just came here again. Love this place. The owner and his staff are awesome!! Love the creme brÃ»lÃ©e. I wish I could try all the different donuts. They are all amazing!

We came here around 12:30pm before closing. I didn't expect to buy leftover donuts but they were a great deal at the moment so we decided to fill the box up with $10. Half of the box were all creme brÃ»lÃ©e, the rest were weird unwanted assorted donuts. The donuts were cold, chewy and unappetizing. Maybe it was because we came late... I wasn't very happy but for the price, it was $1 per donut approximately. None of the donuts were that good, just taste like a regular mom and pop kind of place. I also got a Nitro infused coffee because the guy recommended me as something new to try. Pricey and wasn't worth it. The coffee was SOUR! I'm not sure if it's supposed to taste that way... I mean if you really put your mind to it, you might find it drinkable. I'm a huge coffee lover and it hardly got me to finish half after an hour of walking around downtown. BUT we will be back, earlier for fresher, warm, assorted donuts instead of leftovers! This place got potential and I will update the review with my next visit.
Love the triple chocolate and Jeff and Joe are some great owners with a wonderful staff. Love the coffee and the vibe of the place

Today was the first time my family and I have been to this great place. And we loved it!!! The kids for the free donuts which were Inside Out themed, I had the Butter Beer donut, and my other half had the French Toast Donut (made to order). To drink we had 2 small drips (self service), and the kids had strawberry milk. The staff was super helpful and friendly, Chef Jeff gave the kiddos balloons and interacted with them. We will definitely be coming back!!

Yes yes and yes! If there were more stars I would be clicking on them. I work downtown at Pizza Lotto and have been craving donuts all week thanks to the growing bean in my belly ;) I walked in and COULD NOT BELIEVE MY EYES. I ended up getting a dozen because why not. Fast and friendly service and absolutely delicious donuts. Thanks guys!
It was okay, nothing special. The pop tart donut was good, but overall I think this place is overrated.
Best donuts ever! My daughter and I go every weekend and she loves their donuts! Every holiday and birthday our friends love this as a gift!

Tons of flavors to choose from! My favorites were probably the creme brÃ»lÃ©e! The outer crust of the donut was nice and hard just like the top of creme brÃ»lÃ©e! Some other good ones we had were Boston cream, very chocolate, and the apple bacon fritter. They had a steady flow of traffic coming through the doors. The staff was super friendly, patient, and helpful. They also serve coffee. I had an Americano. It was light years ahead of anything I've had from Starbucks. Overall wonderful and pleasant experience.

Get here early if you have a specific donut you want. We got here around 10:30 and they were down to one vegan kind left and only a handful of regular flavors. We got the salted caramel and cake batter. You can't go wrong!

I was surprised to see so many four and five star reviews for the Donut Bar. I give it a solid three stars which is A-Ok. I work within walking distance and deiced to give it a try this past Thursday. The donut was okay but not near one of the best I've ever had. The prices are crazy high for a single donut and I do not think you get a discount on a dozen. I guess overpriced donuts are the current trend and people have no problem paying between $2 and $4 per donut. I had a strawberry frosted donut at $3 and it was just okay and nothing special. I think the Donut Bar opens a little late at 7:00 and misses the people that want to pickup donuts before going into the office. I usually go to Real Donuts or Pink Box Donuts and both places are open very early. I probably will not go back as I'm content with run of the mill donuts from the other places I listed above. I will say the staff at the Donut Bar is very friendly and welcoming. They greet eat each customer when arriving and offer to answer any questions.

This place was on our way and dang it, I wanted a fritter! So we stopped. Luckily the line was short. Among the usual flavors (glazed and cake etc)!here was a great selection of different flavors like the Creme brÃ»lÃ©e , French toast and grilled cheese donuts. I got my fritter, a chocolate bar, cake donut and a couple other flavors. All were sweet and looked good but ended up being pretty dry. The fritter seemed over fried especially the edges.

The creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut is pretty delicious but other than that, average donuts for outrageous prices. Definitely not the "best donuts in the world". Our Seattle Top Pot and Portland Voodoo Donuts cannot be beat.
ABSOLUTELY THE BEST DONUTS IN THE WORLD!!! Get there early because once they are gone, they are closed for the day.

Had to stop by donut bar and grab to some treats for a date night with the lady. Donut bar is very creative with their menu, everything we had tasted great my only gripe was some of the donuts tasted stale, I think this has more to do with the way they are being displayed and stored which ends up drying them out faster, because the make all their stuff fresh everyday and when they run out they are out. This brings me to my second point, the earlier you go the better these donuts taste, and the more variety you get. Overall I would say try it for yourself not sure what it's called (apple fritter maybe) was amazing. Definitely going back and recommending to friends.

Uhh . . . Portland (voodoo donuts) , we have a problem. These are amazing donuts. Strawberry stack, chocolate old fashioned, and creek brÃ»lÃ©e with a hard shell! The strawberries are delicious and the whipped creams is light and fluffy! The old fashioned do it itself is not sweet at all and has a crunchy outside and the chocolate is dark and slightly sweet. The creme brÃ»lÃ©e is amazing! The filling is a rich not-too-sweet custard. Wow! I don't even like donuts, they tend to be too sweet. Huge fan!

My boyfriend & I tried the famous Donut Bar on Saturday. It was great! Donuts were very sweet but good & moist! We tried the girl scout cookie, vanilla bean, red velvet & the cone. Location isn't convenient for me so I wanted to try/take multiple ones while I was there. Staff was super friendly & helpful. Parking isn't the best but that's just how it is downtown. Restaurant itself is small but super cute! There's also an outdoor area in the back to sit& eat. I'll be back if in the area!
Yum is all I can say. Yeast donuts light and airy, cake donuts soft and moist.

I heard about this place on Facebook, and wanted to check out the hype. I went here around 12:00 PM, and surprisingly, there was no line. The service was really good! Our cashier was very nice! He was very patient with me since this had been my first time. The restroom and the restaurant layout is very nice! The restroom doesn't have a mirror just an FYI. The interior design around the restaurants suits it well. The donuts weren't as good as I expected. I got the Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e donut which wasn't very good. It tasted cold because it had been left out throughout the morning. I thought it would be warm and fluffy, but it was cold and tasteless. I really did try to like it because I heard so many great things about this place! Maybe I went during the wrong time, but I am willing to give this place another chance (donut wise)!
Good donuts and friendly staff. The patio out back was good for chilling out and reading/working. We had the old fashioned style, chocolate cake with butterfinger and blueberry cake.

Can not for the life of me figure out what the hype is all about! Disgusting abominations of sugar on top of sugar, dense bready thick, dry, stupidly huge, so called donuts. Husband went downtown early sat to get some to try since we heard about the place being so great and that they "sell out". Yeah ok. All first timers or tourists and not repeat customers I'd be sure! 2 days later and they are still sitting on my counter, most untouched, after we "tried" a tasting of a few of them..... And I have a house full of kids, one of which is a teenage boy, if that tells you anything! If they won't eat it you KNOW it's bad! Lol! The cream brÃ»lÃ©e (best seller!?! Ugh!) was disgusting. Tasteless hard coating of topping that sticks in your teeth on top of basically bread with literally a teaspoon amount of supposed Bavarian creme (also not made fresh, definitely out of a can). Ick! Every one we tried had the exact same tasteless dense dense dense bread like dough. I would compare it very much like the French bread loaves you get at Walmart for $1 topped or filled with multiple variations of whatever disgusting sugar concoction you can think of. Frosting (any of them) is nothing special and entirely pointlessly overdone, tastes like store bought in the cake isle. Apple tart topped with bacon one was dry (as were all of them due to the "bread" dough they use). I'm not sure how in the world you can make an apple filling tasteless but they did it! Dumped straight out of a can. Super disappointed since that one looked the most promising. The pop tart one... Well that is one that is still sitting untouched on the counter. Just grossly huge, pop tart wrapped in bread, filled with some sort of sickly sweet jelly, and topped with more sugar type topping. Oh! And sprinkles! Puke! My kids wouldn't even touch it. There is also a sponge bob one so decorated with the gross frosting that my 7 yr old didn't event attempt it. Basically it is clear that the object of this place is to make things "look" interesting enough to buy but absolutely no attention to actual taste, quality or ingredients. Nothing even remotely tastes like it was hand made fresh. Everything is ingredients you can buy in the cake isle (and bread isle) at the grocery store and make yourself. Blagh! Hey #donutbar...You can stop saying #bestdonutsintheworld now please! My recommendation and by far superior quality, taste, freshness, service, and overall care of product is #deesdonuts on centennial and Durango! Go check them out and see the difference!

Stumptown coffee, amazing gigantic donuts...get here early or they will run out of your favorites. Free parking around the corner in the lot by the juice store. Met the owner and founder ...everyone in there is so nice. Will have to be back soon too many good choices.
Best donut shop in Vegas. The pop tart donut is a must try! Also my son had strawberry milk that comes out of a tap! It was mad good! For real delicious! XOXOX Chris from BUNNYFiSH!

So many choices - with none of ours leaving us with regret. Grabbed some donuts to go after having some breakfast at EAT, and noshed on them later that day. They were serving french toast donuts that looked pretty good too. Would recommend if you're looking to satiate that sweet tooth!

Wow and WOW!!! I have been anticipating trying these heavenly breaths of life for months (when I frequented SD often, but could NEVER get up early enough to experience one). Well this morning, I was determined to make it happen. Since its recent opening downtown, I had no excuses to push this aside; Get out of bed and get those darn donuts before they sell out...AGAIN! Me + 2, 8am, slightly raining and a line out the door, I seriously couldn't have been more excited. The line of people were also in a good mood which made the wait pleasant. Standing in the rain, 1/2 awake, and before coffee!?? I could've cared less, especially because my experience was great. Once in the door, the menu was pleasingly overwhelming, incredibly creative options, and Vegan options as well. We got the crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e, Strawberry Split, French Toast, and the Maple Bacon Cinnamon Rolls. To the staff: You are epic!! The upbeat attitude, smiles all around, and patience during your power hours are much appreciated. It felt like we were being hosted in your home AND that we were the only customers there during our order. You unexpectedly exceeded my expectations with your service and good vibes
This place is so good, we went here two days in a row. The donuts are delicious and the service is great! The strawberry split was my favorite.

The Donut Bar is Fantastic!!!! What a wonderful way to start your day! The staff are very friendly - the old fashion donuts were great & the cinnamon roll was the best! We look forward to going back before we leave town!

Go, just go! Five bucks a donut and iced mocha in Vegas is a treat; however, donuts approved by local deputies is a sure sign you have found the best donut shop in Vegas. The friendly staff has reason to smile because they know you are in for a real treat when you order any of their donut creations!

I visited this location because of all the hype surrounding Donut Bar and because I love Donuts. This location is in Down Town Vegas so it can be a little difficult to find if you've never been to DT. There is a parking lot across from it as well as meters near so that was a plus. As soon as you walk in you are face to face with all kinds of huge and pretty donuts! I came in specifically for the Big Poppa Tart. Which is a strawberry pop tart stuffed inside of a donut. It ended up being very overwhelmingly sweet but a fun donut idea overall. We bought an assortment of yeast raised donuts and cake ones to get an overall Donut Bar experience. The staff were very genuine and helpful.
Service = The Best Location = Classic DONUTS = The Prototype Make the trip to eat here

I am a big fan of the Donut Bar in San Diego so on our Las Vegas visit this weekend, we decided to stop and pick up some donuts. The donuts are very yummy. But I feel like the location is kind of out of the way and the shop is VERY small. Basically five star donuts but three star location and shop size.

Very fulfilling! Great variety of donuts. I had the strawberries and cream and it was delicious!!! Couldn't finish it in one sitting so I saved the other half for later, surprisingly it was still soft and tasted just as good, did not get stale or hard...

If there was a great kaiju battle between Voodoo Doughnuts and The Doughnut Bar, the entire west coast would be deliciously destroyed. Thankfully these two places are far enough apart that we are safe (for now). These doughnuts ARE art. They look as delicious as they taste. The signature creme brÃ»lÃ©e is truly a marvel and the maple bacon is poetry. When one dreams of doughnuts one dreams of The Doughnut Bar. Is this too over the top a review? I can't tell when I am under the influence of maple an and bacon.
Vegan strawberry split tastes excellent even by non vegan standards. Also tried the Elvis, banana goodness . thank you thank you very much Donut Bar staff you guys are so friendly ;)

I got the strawberry split, omg so yummy! Only problem was I ordered a mocha and it taste like coffee beans no flavor at all! Sad face, but definitely will be back and will recommend to others, donut was so light, so delicious so fresh! I don't any other donut place has these many options when it comes to donuts. It was so many to choose from, I wanted them all, but definitely will be back since it's right up the street from work

Love the strawberry split and creme brulee. I will surely come back here. Love all the murals at the back definitely a good photo op site. Come here at around 8-9am because the store and not yet so busy so you can still have enough place to sit and enjoy the donuts and coffee

I came here after seeing pictures of the creme brulee donut. I love creme brulee! It did not disappoint. The top was crunchy and the filling inside was perfect. Not too sweet at all. I'm not even a huge filled donut fan. I usually get plain glazed. Boyfriend got blood orange which he said was very good as well.

Awesome. Staff is very accommodating. A wide variety of specialty donuts will have your mouth watering. The coffee is great, try the Portland blend. The kids get balloons and a cool child's donut. Gotta end this review. I'm heading to Donut Bar now!

Every time I am in Vegas I try and eat at this place however they are always sold out and closed. So I was excited when i saw they were open. I went on a Saturday around 10 am. I ordered 3 donuts. The creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut, Oreo birthday donut, and cheesecake donut with a strawberry like filling . Each were good not great. The sugar crust on the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut was executed nicely. The filling on the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut was subtly sweet it felt more of like an eclair texture than a donut. Somehow it seemed like the donuts were not fresh? Which is weird because they always sell out and they had to be made that day. I also ordered a cold brew coffee which was okay. They have other specialty donuts like the huge pop tart donut. And peanut butter jelly donuts . Overall this place is okay. Seems more like a hyped fad- like place. There are many dessert like places in Las Vegas this doesn't stand out from the rest.

Holy Moly great selection of donuts some Giant! I mean would feed 3 people but anyways peanut butter with jelly filled good, Strawberry cream cake good and Maple Bacon really good. Stumptown Coffee which was a nice treat definitely must try this place!

Uh, since doughnuts are making a come back .. at least supersize homemade ones, reinventing the wheel on new ideas is always fun to watch. This place has huge doughnuts and lots of options to choose from. Today's complimentary sponge bob idonut for the little ones is why I love this place and come back for more.

Now I'm a pink box fanatic but will splurge downtown and stop by this place. Location isn't very convenient unless you're walking around, the parking lot across the street is often full. They have a variety of vegan doughnuts which is awesome and I'm not sure if they have any gluten free options. The strawberry shortcake one is AMAZING. Definitely too large to eat yourself, most of their doughnuts are completely shareable and always fresh. I'm not surprised they sell out on a regular.

Waited for 3 trips to LV till open. Had tried donuts from SD location. Ordered several. Big Poppa my favorite. French toast was surprisingly light. Great service. Get there early. Looked like possible to order o line and pickup better than wait.

This place is great! The donuts are perfectly crafted and put together with amazing detail and deliciousness. The prices definitely reflect it, but hey, it's worth it! You can't get donuts like this just anywhere! Plus, they have strawberry milk on tap... Who does that?!?! Thank you donut bar, for doing that!

I have been hearing about this place for a while. Just waked in an hour ago and they still had some to sell. They were offering two for ones, as they wanted to close up. I bought chocolate, coconut, birthday cake and Oreo. My family loved them. I have to say they were very tasty and the friendliness of the owner/staff was outstanding. Fantabulous.

Doughnuts where very pretty other than that they where adverage at best. The creme brulee donut did not live up to the hype. Theold fashion was equal to one I'd pick up at 7/11. Other than that the shop is nice the coffee was good and the staff was great.
My favorites are the S'mores Big Poppa Tart and French Toast Donut (available weekends only). Always a great assortment, menu changes daily. Excellent customer service.

Thank you yelpers!!!!!deliciousness after deliciousness! !! Must haves, strawberry cinnamon donut, creme Brule, peanut butter and jelly ( to die for ), filling goes all the way to the end, wow just wow
I wish you guys were closer. I miss your blood orange doughnut.
A diabetic's nightmare but for the love of all donuts...a true gem of a place. Drip coffee in all sorts of flavor but the latte is the one to get for sipping. Maple glazed bacon on a donut...o.m.g!
Donuts looked really good I only tried one of them so far was not wowed I would go back because there was other ones that might be better

It was our first time visiting this place after following them them on instagram. The customer service was amazing... everyone was friendly. Best of all, it was clean and well kept. The donut ice cream was delicious and we instagram'd it right away... especially if you like cinnamon and sugar with your soft serve. Plus get the drizzle... it comes in caramel, chocolate or get them both. I am definitely going back again!
Cute little place in downtown LV with some unique donuts. My personal fave was the Lemon Pistachio giant donut. The staff is friendly & the shop is clean with a trendy decor.

A nice, small, quiet place not far from the craziness of Fremont Street. I like they way they do business: open at 7 am (8 on the weekends) and close when they sell out--which seems to happen before noon. That way the doughnuts are assuredly fresh. The service was genuinely friendly. The doughnuts were very good, but nothing too exciting.

Very disappointing!! The quality has gone down hill ever since they got popular. Almost every donut in the box this time was dry and stale. The famous creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut barely had any cream. It's especially disappointing since this place is supposed to be top rated. I think they need to focus on their product and not their trendy appearance.

Meh. We were there at 11 am on a Saturday morning after we'd gone to Donutmania and found a poor selection. Donut bar had even fewer...maybe 20 but not a great variety. We got a maple bacon apple fritter--the last one. It was the only one left that wasn't just a "regular" donut. After all, we went there to try a fun, different type of donut, not just an old fashioned or a glazed donut. So, the "bacon" is just bacon bits that you buy in a jar--not real, fresh bacon crumbles like I expected. The fritter was dry and didn't have nearly enough apple in it nor glaze on it. Had it been real bacon, and more apple, maybe it would have been worth the $4. Otherwise, I'd just stick to a national donut chain who knows what they're doing.

I am so glad that they brought what San Diego has been raving about to my town, Las Vegas. --now downtown just got better, just got sweeter! I am a fan of the frenchtoast donut with the Nitro Coffee, that's all you need! :) And, beware of their drip coffee--particularly the portland roast, --coz DAMN, it's good!

Stumbled across this place while looking for a sweet breakfast spot near my office. I had no idea what to expect since I'm a little late on the hype of this place. Walking in the doors I was greeted and I immediately diverted my attention to the array of donuts waiting for me to eat! I did not know what to choose and I couldn't just get 1 so I got 3! CrÃ¨me Brulee, Strawberry Cheesecake and the Birthday Cake Oreo! The CrÃ¨me Brulee had all the components of what you're used to, it's a bit dry but once you get to the filling, it just makes it all so much better. You bite into it and you hear that nice sugar cracking and then there's no going back. The Strawberry Cheesecake was my favorite out of the 3 because it was just so creamy and just perfect! It tasted like I was eating a cheesecake and once I had the first taste of filling, I just couldn't stop. The Oreo Birthday Cake was a great combination as well, it had a bit too much frosting for my taste but overall was a good one too!
They have a great selection of donuts. I got the chocolate/bacon and Nutella. They were fresh and very good.

I've been trying to make it here for years and today it finally happened! We arrived at 10 a.m and they still had plenty of delicious choices to choose from. We chose the famous Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e donut and a Harry Potter ButterBeer donut. Both were great, the ButterBeer donut was HUGE, I had to share it with my husband. Customer service was friendly and answered all our questions. Can't wait to come back next time we are in Las Vegas

We came here because we loved the original spot in downtown San Diego and enjoy a good donut. My wife enjoyed some donuts and I sadly didn't have any because they do not offer a gluten free donut. I think their concept of making donuts and trying to sell out everyday is silly. They could be busy all day with fresh donuts if they had different model where they baked them fresh. But the wife was happy regardless so we will be back.
Such a fun place! Great selection. The pride in their product shows through. Enjoyed a single BIG POPPA and some great fresh brewed coffee. Worth the drive from Henderson.

Great selection of donuts. Get there before 10am for best selection. You can also pre-order the day before for next-day pick-up. Donuts I've had: Creme Brulee - It's vegan, but I'm not, and it was good. Mexican Hot Chocolate - has a cayenne spice in it's chocolate; different and good. Snickers - say no more Strawberry Cheescake - great take on traditional jelly donut

So me and my mother came down because we heard about these doughnuts and unfortunately i wasn't super impressed. They were good just not for the price we had gotten the strawberry splits and the doughnut was a little hard on top and cream was a little stiff. We also had the creme brulee which was the more expensive doughnut and wasn't worth the price.

Donuts are amazing!! They have a different menu everyday, had to wake up early but was worth waiting outside for a good 30 minutes. Glad nothing was sold out when we were inside. Looks dull outside but inside is very cute.
Their donuts really are the best. I had the creme brÃ»lÃ©e and blood orange. It's a nice place to stop for a treat I would highly recommend it.

Maple bacon bar was pretty good, nutella didnt really taste nutella-y but the donut meat was delicious and puffy, hubby thought his bacon apple fritter was over cooked, but flavor good. Next time i am gonna get the Homer.

Promised my daughter I would take her here to try the nutella donut she has been dying to sink her teeth into. Came in on a Saturday morning around 11am to find a small line of about 5 people formed waiting to place their orders. Donuts are priced individually. Picked up two nutella overloads, one strawberry cheesecake and one toasted coconut; total came to $13. Nutella Overload: Nothing to call home about. In my opinion, there was no 'overload' of nutella present. This donut is basically a nutella-filled donut with powdered sugar dusted heavily on top. Strawberry Cheesecake: This is a jelly filled donut (I believe strawberry jelly - hence the strawberry in the name), with a glazed topping and a dusting pile of what I believe is graham crackers. I don't get any cheesecake from this donut, so I don't know why they find the need to call it a strawberry cheesecake donut. Toasted Coconut: An old fashion cake donut with toasted coconut on top. If you like coconut, you will enjoy the coconut topping. Overall, these donut were not terrible but they were not donuts that I 'gotta have' next time in Vegas. Side note - there is metered parking right in front of the business which only takes credit cards. Best bet, have someone drop you off and circle around and pick you up to save money on parking!
Very good food and service. Good portions. Good selection. Love this casual location.
I try to take my kids every weekend sometimes i cant. The owners are always there, always happy & greeting their customers. Dounts are really good. My fav is the French Toast Donut.
Great service, beautiful donuts! Yummy, fun donuts! This menu is long and creative! Cake batter donut, Homer Simpson donut....
The donuts were okay...not fantastic. However the girls were very nice and gave us some free donuts!

To be honest, I have had wayyyyyy better donuts. Although the donuts here are cute, they are also on the dry side. Wish I had a picture, but I'll my pics got deleted on my old phone. If you decide to get a donut here, I would say the maple bacon is my favorite.

All I can say is delicious!!! These donuts are.very indulgent, can't visit to often lol but amazing. My favorite ones were the Nutella donut and the birthday surprise with an oreo . Their portions r huge so u don't need to purchase many to share. Must come back!

Come early or you will miss out. Also if just stopping by. They have pickup parking in the back for 15 minutes. Come around 10 and most definitely you will miss out on their awesome selection. What can u ask for. Great donuts and friendly staff. Always out goto place for donuts.

Definitely NOT "the best donuts in the world" as they claim on their box. Get real. Office brought in a box of them and they were just okay, nothing special. Had the blueberry with lemon icing...gross. Won't be going there on my own. There are better donut options out there.

Family friendly! The staff was super friendly, and we didn't feel rushed to make the big decision of what amazing donut we wanted. Did you know they give free donuts and balloons to kids on Saturday mornings?! So cool. The donuts were delicious, but my 2.5 year old enjoyed the fish tank of donuts most of all! They also let someone bring their dog in which he loved too.

Flew in from the midwest, landed at 745am and made sure this was my first stop! To top it off -- greeted by awesome friendly staff who walked us through the selection of donuts displayed!! Donuts were delicious, fluffy and perfectly flavored -- definitely worth your morning stop!!

I work nearby Donut Bar & stop in to grab coffee every morning! The staff is super friendly & the donuts are AMAZING!! My favorite donut is the creme brÃ»lÃ©e cause it's unique and I love how the shell cracks just like the desert!! Last but not least the energy & vibe is very welcoming & fun to be around! They play 80's pop radio

I don't get the hype over these donuts. I was so excited to try them after following them on Instagram for some many months. I went on a weekday so the French toast donut was not available. I got a dozen to try almost every flavor. I was disappointed in their popular creme Brulee donut. There was barely any filling in them. I ordered 3. Aside from the large size, there is nothing unique or worth coming back for. Although, I did enjoy the salted caramel and apple fritter.

How do you give this place a 3 1/2 star? Anyway, this place isn't bad. To me, and this is just my own opinion and taste, this place is like any ordinary donut shop but with certain perks making this donut shop a tad bit different from other places. 1) A few of their donuts are "Vegan" 2) They have clever names that complement the donut 3) They have treats for your furry friends My first time going, I went right before they opened. I was the first in line and lines form fast right before opening. I ordered, which was the day after the news of music icon Prince passing, the Price Donut, CrÃ¨me Brule, Banana Caramel and the Boston Cream. The Prince donut was well decorated with his symbol and filled with raspberry. I liked it. It was okay for me. I did notice that the donuts I ordered, weren't as sweet as some other donut shops (not including frostings). This was a plus for me, the amount of sweetness to the donuts were good for my liking. The CrÃ¨me Brule (Vegan), I wasn't a big fan of the "caramel drizzle" over the donut. Some will like it, but it wasn't my cup of tea. Everything under that topping was okay as well. I love bananas so I tried the Banana Caramel (Vegan), and that was okay too. At first bite, banana runts came to mind. Last, Boston Cream. I love donuts filled with custard, so I couldn't leave a donut shop without getting one. This too was okay. The breading wasn't too sweet, but the sweetness of the frosting complemented this donut well. I really wanted the cinnamon roll with the bacon, but that wasn't ready when I got there. There was a 15 minute wait :( I'm still coming back to try that cinnamon roll with bacon and the french toast donut. :) With that being said, Happy Eatings!!
Wow wow wow there doughnuts are amazing delicious and there coffee is delicious also they have a cute patio are we're you can chill and have you coffee and donuts love this place.

They ran out of a lot of donuts by the time I got there so I ordered what was left. So I got the PB&J and thought it was just okay. The donuts were $1.50-$3 each but they are huge so that justifies the cost. I might come back at and earlier time to try freshly made donuts. The donuts texture is somewhere between a Krispy Kreme and Dunkin Donut texture.

This is one of the things that I put on the list before we went out to Vegas and since we had one free day with no shows and to knock off as much as we could we did this. They had some of the their seasonal donuts and a few regulars left. We did have to take a bus out for this one. I came for the highly recommended apple donut or fritter as it is actually referred to in Canada. It was nice and there was a good amount of glaze to batter. They do have a good variety of cake and batter donuts. The customer service was friendly and the prices were very decent since we were off the Strip.
I have made every attempt to come here for either donuts or there churro cone ice cream and each time they are either closed or they ran out. I'm done trying.

Just a fun place to visit. Really enjoyed the art in the bathroom. They are so friendly and have great donuts. The milk on tap is pretty cool. Would recommend the French toast donut. They are very kid friendly as well. My son loved his Captain America donut. 5/5 would recommend.

I love doughnuts and am a doughnut aficionado; but these are not good, in my opinion. They're too dense, too one note flavored, and lack good dough to icing ratio. They didn't taste very fresh on the morning (10am) I was there and I feel like doughnuts should always taste fresh before lunchtime. They're not the worst doughnuts I've ever had but aren't worth their price tag and isn't worth a special trip. I've had far better doughnuts in Las Vegas like Real Doughnuts (on Charleston) and Ron's (on Spring Mountain).
Delicious donuts. Customer service was great. Very clean. Lots of choices. Nice seating, indoor and outdoor. Who doesn't love strawberry milk on tap? Glad I came.
Yes! They have vegan options! Super happy and satisfied; it's hard find vegan sweet spots in Las Vegas but this one was totally worth the drive and (calories) for!

The location is very easy to find and the staff is very friendly. My family and I picked what looked good to us, but we're most impressed with the strawberry and whipped cream donut. It is so BOMB! I could eat it everyday. My kids got an Oreo cookie donut and I believe a strawberry cheesecake one. The lady that helped us also put in a few emoji donuts. I'm not sure if I paid for them or not but even if I did I was impressed with what I got. Will definitely be returning :)

I was checking in on Facebook at "A cut above the rest" when "donut bar" popped up. I decided to Google Map where this "Donut Bar" is and I was a block away. It was almost closing time so only a limited donuts were available. They were so excited and welcoming from the minute I walked in that I wanted to buy a shirt from them. They invited me to look them on social medias and return the next morning for a better selection. It's not too far from Fremont Experience. The whole staff is very humble and knowledgeable. Don't wait till last minute to "stop by".
Love this place can't say enough about it friendly staff clean location Donuts amazing highly recommend you should stop in and try a donut

My friends and I walked here for breakfast one morning and we were impressed. The donuts were good and the selection was awesome. A little overpriced but the donut bar is a great idea. People were friendly although I will say by 9am they are out of most of the selections. We will be back!

This is a great little donut place. They have chocolate and strawberry milk on tap. Their coffees are so smooth and addicting. I've tried a few of their donuts and have loved all of them so far. They even have a donut with a pop tart in the center! The donut ice cream cone is by far the best.
The French Toast donut was amazing!! They only make it on the weekends or something but it's good!! The other donut I had was whatever but I'll return to try more donuts.
We got there late and didn't have a lot of selection, but the donut cone was so fun and the ice cream was super yummy! Wish I had gotten there earlier!
Fun donut shop with really interesting flavors. Try the Big Poppa Tart or Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e!

From a donut standpoint, Donut Bar is simply dope. They were one of my favorites while in San Diego, so for me, the fact that they took over where O-face used to be is a straight up upgrade. Every donut they do is gourmet and you can tell they make them with care and keep them at top quality. They are also very community oriented and are always doing things hat put them out there so that people can put a face to the names. They were absolute life savers at Life Is Beautiful. They are also super cool because they post their menu for the next day on all their social media, so you know if your favorite donut is gonna be there and you don't have to guess. My only gripe is that they open relatively late for a donut place at 7am and it's super cool that they are open until sold out. This works out well for me since I work downtown so it's easy for me to get to but if you're not as lucky as me then you better make sure to get in as early as possible. Also, another super cool thing I'll say is that you should heck out their bathroom. It lets you know exactly how dope these people are. Long story short, find a way down here. Eat some donuts. Walk out like a boss

I had their pink sprinkles and creme brulee. There was nothing special about them. The filling for the creme brulee was one sided and minimal. The pink sprinkles one was not even moist on the inside. It was very dry. And even with a mustache, the lady called me ma'am lol.

1 star for their hours, 5 stars for existing because they really do have the BEST donuts in Vegas. How can you possibly go wrong with such divinely inspired, ethereal masterpieces? With a wide variety of delicious treasures, the Willy Wonka's of donuts has something for everyone, whether you're five or ninety nine. With donuts as thick as a paperback, one can easily be shared with two. Find your happy morning in Donut Bar. Once you try one, you'll swear off Dunkin forever. Just get there REALLY early. 12pm closing time may not be convenient for you. It never is for me.
Best donuts in the world. My husband and I made it a point to go twice before we went back home

Suggested to us by a security guard, a couple blocks of The Fremont Street Experience. You see the picture, delectable. A little pricey, but it is Vegas.... Well worth every penny. Don't often crave a donut, bit glad I did today. Walking distance, close to hotel, perfect. Well worth your text and Penny's, priceless!!!!

Simply the best! Just went to an event and was blown away by every little detail. Not only were those donuts just decadent, but just the way they came out and looked won huge in my eyes! I'll be at donut bar tomorrow morning for that French Toast donut in the AM and some good ol coffee
One word...yummy! Get there early for a better selection as the donuts go fast. The folks are friendly and the food is really good. Fair prices for what you get, too!

This place was walking distance from my hotel so had to stop and check it out. Definitely would recommend to anyone visiting the area! Picked up 6 different kinds of donuts but the creme brulee one was my favorite! The butterbeer one was adorable! Would love to stop by again next time I'm in Vegas!

Since they have vegan options, I got donuts to go for my family. My husband devoured the strawberry shortcake one and said it was amazing. My kids loved the apple fritter and were in heaven with this treat. Unfortunately there was nothing gluten-free so I couldn't have them. The service was GREAT (night and day from Vege-Nation next door). Definitely a place to go if you want a sweet treat.
Place was packed as usual, can't go wrong with these humongous fresh donuts. Back for my second time... First time as a vegan and happy to see the vegan options
I had the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut as well as few others! Great coffee and amazing donuts. I especially loved the caramelized sugar on top for the perfect crunch! Amazing donuts!

Donut Bar is a place you must experience. Not only are there numerous options of delicate, savory donuts-- but the staff and chef always make you feel special when you walk through the door. I would recommend the French toast donut. So soft, crunchy and delicious that it melts in your mouth. Served warm directly to you with syrup and butter. I call it the triple B: buttery, beautiful and breakfast donut! The times I've visited Chef Jeff welcomes me and recommends options-- he treats everyone the same and makes your visit special. Great place for healthy gains and not so healthy gains -- but let's face it? Donut calories do not count because they are at Donut Bar. Great place for indulging and calming your sweet tooth.

Awesome donuts! Got to try the French Toast donut! The owners, Joe & Jeff are incredibly welcoming! Eating donuts and listening to a playlist that I reminisce living back in the '80s, Great overall experience!!!! AND please come and make a home in the Bay!

Had the peanut butter cup donut and it was moist and delicious. I usually get their vegan donuts, but today I had a regular cake donut. I highly recommend this place. The service is friendly and the donuts look as good as they taste.
The donuts looked beautiful and several of them were jumbo sized. But the flavor was a bit lacking. Definitely more bready than sweet.
Good donuts love how they have so many unique options! I couldn't speak to anything else because I ordered online and had my mom pick up.

Used to go to O Face Doughnuts for maple bars so I thought id give this place a try. Was surprised to see the variety they had. Almost too overwhelming but I didn't let that stop me from trying a variety of things. There's maybe too many to list, but what definitely stood out was the French Toast Donut. It's only a weekend run but who really needs doughnuts 7 days a week ;) I did the FTD on a weekly routine for awhile with my bf. It came with hot Vermont maple syrup, whipped butter, and house made blueberry jam. It was usually big enough for me but he's a bigger guy and would also get the blueberry cheesecake donut which he said was the best sweet pastry hes ever had. In addition they also have homemade chocolate milk and cold brew on tap which alone is worth the trip. Awesome friendly staff and a quick in and out experience. I suggest you get here before the donuts run out
Wasn't impressed. Donuts were small and not as flavorful as some have made them out to be. The Boston cream I got I've had better at another donut shop out here in vegas.
Cute shop with amazing donuts! Great tasting Mochas and friendly staff. We'll be back again when we visit Las Vegas.
I don't understand why this place is so popular.. they donuts are dry AND expensive. The three stars are for the great service we received!

Pretty sure this donut changed my life - for the much better. I LOVE these - Mexican hot chocolate is my favorite, I don't know why it's better than the regular chocolate or the Nutella, but for me it is the best. Blood orange is good, really liked the blueberry lemon, and bc I am a health nut - the Cadbury egg inside the Easter donut. Actually scratch all this - the Homer is the best. And the fritter. Damn, just order a dozen and wear your sweats, these donuts are amazing. I got these for my last birthday instead of a cake. Sent my friend down to get the Easter donuts. Came for Mother's Day... you get the picture. The location is great, you can go to the vintage stores on Main Street or walk Fremont. They have a garden, a donut aquarium, cute art on the walls, nice staff, Chef Jeff is usually there, OH, and banging coffee. Ok one thing - they bake their masterpieces in the AM and close the store when they sell out. Run don't walk to Donut Bar, as their selection winds down as it gets closer to closing - around lunchtime

Came by for the Strawberry Split. Last time we came at almost closing time and they were pretty much out of everything. I walked in and was so happy to see the Strawberry Split! It was huge! My husband got the Expresso Chocolate and my chocoholic friend went for the Triple Chocolate Threat after being disappointed that they didn't have the Chocolate Euphoria today. Theirs were both cake donuts and we felt they weren't anything too special. My friend commented the Chocolate Threat was not even Chocolatey enough and I agree. I came here for the Strawberry and I was not disappointed. The donut is bit crusty like a croissant. I would prefer like a soft donut but my husband and friend enjoyed the "crust" the way it was. My husband also commented that it reminded him of a Chinese birthday cake. I felt satisfied with what I had been waiting for....months or years...

This place is a cool concept for sure. Donuts and beer. This makes sense to me. Every day their vegan selection changes and you take your chances if you don't get there early. But since they do change out their vegan selection you might be able to try a variety of flavors in just a few visits. The service has been great the two times I've been in. Sadly I haven't even paired a donut with a beer just yet. I'm slacking on my day drinking apparently. All the donuts look awesome and I'm sure are good. I've heard good things about the samoa Girl Scout style donut. I've had the creme brÃ»lÃ©e... I wish it had more filling. Had to eat the whole donut before finding any filling until the last bite. I am anticipating some flavors like the spiced chai for sure. I will definitely be back and you should swing by if you haven't yet. They close at 1pm and happy hour is just before. You could score two for one!

It's your average donut shop just w more fanfare than others. I didn't see the WOW factor honestly. I went there early morning so selection was good. I got 8 donuts for $22 felt like I overpaid for similar donuts I could of gotten at DD or other donuts shop. Won't be coming back.

Went here on vacation, donuts and staff are excellent. The Carmel, and strawberry whip cream donut were delicious. The mud pie was ok was a little different with peanut butter, think the one we got was a little dry but still good. Overall will be back to this chain as donuts and coffee are always a good breakfast!

This downtown shop has some great donuts but you really need to get there early before they sell out. Pros are the donuts were good and unique and there is seating in the back outside. Cons were the music was kind of loud and it is a bit small inside.

Lots of specialty donut places to choose but Donut Bar is our favorite! Donuts are fresh and yummy. Not an over abundance to choose from which makes it easier to have a favorite (caramel latte). Weekends they add some more specialty donuts. Coffee is really good also. Easy to get to and parking is plentiful.
Never a bad experience here! Love this place because of their mind blowing donuts!! I definitely recommend going right before they open because they do sell out pretty fast!

I am proud to have this donut bar in Las Vegas! You guys are amazing! If you are looking for a really cool place with an amazing vibe and couple that with some of the most UNIQUE and TASTY Donuts found ANYWHERE IN THE WORLD! Then this is the place for you! May you continue to serve donuts in Las Vegas for next 100+ Years! I would rate this one 10 MILLION STARS!

The Hunter S. Thompson Donut for the anniversary of Hunter's Rolling Stone Magazine publication in November 1971 of his Vegas book, Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas - The Hunter donut was made at Donut Bar, because donut bar makes the most creative donuts in Las Vegas, Nevada. Plus parents love the leaders, because children are given free donuts on Saturday and Sunday, before they play at the park.

The donuts here are to die for!! Wow! I couldn't believe how amazing and different they were. And the coffee...wow!!! Do yourself a favor and head down here! You won't regret it. the staff is super sweet, helpful and full of spirit!!! Best donut shop in Vegas!

Very good donuts! I ordered several different flavors, including the Boston creme and the Creme Brulee, both of which were delicious. The shop itself is quaint and clean, a nice place to sit and enjoy a donut and cup of coffee. They have a nice outdoor area as well. I will definitely go back the next time I'm in need of donuts!

Gourmet donuts. Stumptown nitrogen infused coffee, strawberry milk BOMB!!!! They were sold out of donuts today can't wait to try them! I mixed half coffee half strawberry milk and made my own strawberry latte it tastes amaaazzing try it !!!!!!
Meh... Nothing special. Expensive donut. Not worth driving 20 min to try them out.
Awesome, huge donuts! Great coffee. We were here for a mid day snack. Nice stop and in the summer heat of 105 it was nice and cool inside.
I don't know what people are thinking. Over priced and not very good. The donut is dry and nit very tasteful. Bigger is not always better

Really Awesome donuts, I love their fresh variety and such a great atmosphere. Our kiddos get a free donut from chef on the weekends which is so sweet, it's the little details that makes this place extra special. Love love love a must try
I love to order donuts in the morning when I don't feel like getting out of bed! Never messes up an order!

Everything about this place is fun and fattening. Yes, they actually do have a grilled cheese donut for your dining pleasure. Lots of specialty donuts. Too bad they aren't open later in the day. Get there early!

Wow....vegan donuts and the price is great. Usually the vegan donuts don't sell out, so go later and get them at half price. Creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut had vanilla inside and a toffee crunch topping. Pb&J needs no explanation....taste like the sandwich. We'll keep coming back. Oh...great drip coffee too!

Went here for the big poppa donut as I am a poptart fan. It was good but extremely sweet. Also tried the apple fritter just ok have had better and the plain was ok. The girl working there was friendly and explained all the flavors. This place is definitely not worth the hype. I have had better donuts and is not worth the trip and certainly would not wait on line. Their claim to be the best donuts in the world is a definite no while I give them credit for creativity they are not anything special.
Overall the donuts were inventive. We love donuts and try all kinds when we travel. These donuts were on the dry side. They looked delicious but lacked with taste. Gimmicky.

They had a pop up store at Illumilatte so I decided to buy a bakers dozen for my office. Can I just say I was the hit of the office that day! Each donut was fun inventive and so so good! I will definitely be going back!
Nice service, prices are crazy good, and the donuts are super good. Of course they have the famous homer and a lot more. So happy I could make it. My kids love it.
The grilled cheese donut was amazing! Friendly service. A hidden gem in downtown Las Vegas.

I have been to the Donut Bar a few times and like to bring friends/family when they visit. They have a fun collection of donuts and good coffee. The staff is friendly when ordering donuts. We also enjoy the back area for sitting and talking. My last visit ended with an unpleasant encounter and now I am not sure how I feel about visiting again. Everything was good until we were about to leave. My sister and I had our kids with us and we decided to go out in the back to eat donuts. When we went out we noticed they had gotten some corn hole boards and some other customers were enjoying them. My sister's kids played with them for a little at one point but for the most part stayed by us. As we were leaving our group was approached by an employee who asked our kids in an accusing manner what happened to the corn hole board. When we explained that others were playing with them and the kids said they didn't do it he continued to accuse them of damaging them and then proceeded to lay a guilt trip on the kids. First, if you think someone's kids did something you should approach the parents and speak with them so we can handle it. Second, if you don't have proof or a witness accusing someone is wrong. He never said he had proof or a witness...if he had we would have handled it appropriately and the kids would have been held responsible. Like I said at the start normal our visits are great and we love introducing people to the donut bar and love their treats...now I am a little put off by this last visit due to this employee.

I am obsessed with donuts, and Donut Bar only makes this worse. The first time I went there, they had a special on birthday cake donuts. I told them I wanted one of those, and one of the Homer Simpson inspired donuts. The server placed two birthday cake donuts in my box, instead of one, as a special treat as it was opening week, along with the Homer donut. When I told her it was also my birthday and that it was really cool, she put another donut in there! I've been back several times, and still haven't gotten any other free donuts; however, let me just say, I've encountered the same friendly service! Consider trying the chocolate milk or coffee on tap, and be sure to use the restroom, well, at least look in the restroom before leaving. The restaurant itself is quite small, so please be sure to explore the courtyard area for more seating that is particularly nice on Spring and Summer mornings.

If you love donuts, you should stop by the Donut Bar. They are friendly and they have an amazing selection of delicious, fresh donuts. They do sell out everyday so get up there before the donuts are gone! You'll be so happy you did.

Now I may have showed up at 11, so they had painted outside that they were sold out but when I came in to double check he did have some they didn't sell yet. Wasn't a huge variety because it was the leftovers some chocolate bars, coffee bar, and some massive sugar donuts. They were absolutely delicious! I got a good deal and more than I could eat for a great price. I got to make it on time tommorow .

OMG!! So yummy! Make sure you get there early!! The donuts are huge!! I got the grill cheese one the last time I went and it was so amazing. Along with the staff always upbeat and happy. And so many vegan options as well.
Amazing giant donuts, excellent value and many interesting flavors to choose from. Friendly service. The nitro cold brew coffee was spot on. Highly recommend this place
Great unique donuts. Highly recommend the bagel doughnut, it was REALLY good with a cup of coffee
Finally tried bacon cinnamon roll it was amazing and totally worth the wait. Delicious donut flavors, amazing and friendly staff.
The absolute best donuts in Vegas! My husband now brings them home to me when he travels for work.
Friendly staff and a clean establishment. Wide variety of different flavors of donuts.

They are not as good as they were a year ago. I didn't see the usual baking crew, and there were no vegan donuts left. When I went the first time over a year ago, the trays were loaded, with more on the way. Several people walked out without buying anything so I followed them.It just didn't have the same lively upscale vibes as before.I imagine the former bakers moved onto a different situation. Still baking, I hope.

this a great little place to get doughnuts, and they are really really good. THE HELP ARE ALWAYS FRIENDLY., and very helpful. If you are around that area make sure to stop and give them a try you will be glad you did!
Really good donuts. They have a nice selection as well. Never thought pop tarts in donuts would be so good. Only knock is the location and the price is a bit high.

This review is for the Creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut. Texture was great---crisp caramelized sugar glaze with a creamy center. However, the taste was very lacking. The caramelized sugar tasted burnt and had a slight bitterness to it. The donut itself and the creme barely had any taste. It wasn't too sweet (which is a bonus for me) but it wasn't too ANYTHING. Im kind of disappointed and I've definitely had better donuts for cheaper prices. On a positive note, very cute inside and service was great! Parking can be a bit tricky--the parallel parking available near the store is all pay-to-park

Go early! Holy selections Batman. During our short trip to Vegas, we visited this location twice. First time was already close to their closing time, despite a fewer selection we still left happy enough to return for more choices. Second time we came back, we basically overloaded our capacity as everything looked amazing. You NEED to try the creme brulee donut.

So okay donut fans! I didn't think I would ever break away from my 40 year DD habit, but I found something better than those "wicked donuts from DD". I had forgotten how tasty a donut can be until I stumbled upon this place while hanging in Downtown LV. Seriously, these guys know how make a donut explode with tastiness on your tongue. Somehow they found a way to artistically create a culinary composition of a clever captivation that just wows your senses. This is the kind of experience that one must repeat, and I would strongly urge you to make this a regular spot for you and yours!
Great selection and second best only to District donuts Sliders Brew and brew. Definitely worth the visit
Best ramen I have ever had in my life. Deep flavor, always piping hot. I get the spick chicken ramen extra hot. I promise, you cant go wrong. #noramenolife
A little pricey but so worth it. Be sure to go super early because they sell out easy.

This place is such a hidden gem!! So many choices of delicious looking donuts! And they taste as good as they look! They have indoor and outdoor sitting! Perfect place to bring the whole family. Did I mention you can get a donut cone filled with ice cream!!! Check this place out!

The Donut Bar has the best donuts in town! I frequently buy and eat their delicious donuts. I also give the donuts to clients and to my staff when I want to say thank you. The donuts look and taste amazing. They have a lot of unique and tasty flavors. The staff is also very cool. If you are looking for the top donuts in town, you need to check out the Donut Bar.

I had a more than an amazing experience working with Donut Bar. They helped me with getting donuts to someone very important to me for her birthday while out of town. The manager Joe was beyond caring and went way out of his way for me. Nothing is better than when there is still that human touch in a business. Donut Bar lv will always be way cool, glad to have them in Vegas!

My husband and I made sure to stop in at least three of the five days we were in town. Make sure you go early because once they are gone, your out of luck! My favorite hands down had to be the maple bacon but there are no wrong choices to be made here. Definitely a place not to be missed if you're down in old Vegas!

The donuts are amazing! It's no wonder why they go quick. Whatever Jeff and his staff are doing behind the scenes they definitely should not stop. I had ordered an assortment for a birthday party donut wall and Donut Bar LV did not disappoint, it was a total hit!
Got the red velvet, Nutella overload, and the triple chocolate! Definitely recommend going early because donuts sell out fast!

The donuts and coffee were ok but my wife really liked the French toast donut. More tables outside in the back but inside is limited in space. -1 Star: During our visit there was guy that appeared to know an employee or maybe the owner and he was blocking the counter like he owned the place. Maybe he was the owner but it was still annoying.

Tried this place after hearing about the hype. Had to wake up extra early so try all the flavors before they sold out. This was not worth the hype, we got a dozen doughnuts since we don't live in Vegas. The special doughnuts weren't anything special. The creme brulee didn't have enough filling nor did the other flavors. All the doughnuts tasted normal, flavors weren't special or "wow" about them compared to most normal doughnut shops. I've had better doughnuts in the east coast. This was such a disappointment.

Homer Simpson has die and gone to Heaven! Man the best donuts in Las Vegas, in the world! I had the maple and Bacon bar, I just couldn't have one I had to have three and a cup of hot coffee. The best thing to do, first thing in the morning it to stop the Donut Bar and put up a cake donut and hot cup of coffee.. You want to be a hero at your job, pick up a dozen on the way to work and bam your staff will love you...... Great Donuts.... Las Vegas Best hidden secret.....

I heard about this place and the amazing donuts they have. You need to be early to get all their amazing donuts because they sell out fast! Definitely try their daily specials and be prepared to want everything on display.
Great place, nice people, they sell out quick so come early. They have coffee self serve. Come for the donuts not the coffee really cute place.
Me & my kids love the Vegan donuts at this place!!! Best Vegan donuts in town! They have a nice lil patio area in the back that we also enjoy. Everyone is super nice & friendly.
Each individual donut is an edible work of art... ALMOST as good to look at as they are to eat (ALMOST)! Fair prices, cite place, friendly welcoming staff... It's a winner!

This place is so far away from home, but it was definitely worth the trip! When I first walked in, I was greeted by the workers and by a pleasant bakery aroma. I actually haven't heard of this place until my cousins from California mentioned it. They wanted to try the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut so we drove the distance to try it out; it's something I definitely recommend. The donuts here are very different from any other donut place, which makes it all the more special. I really just wanted to buy everything and pig out at home, but unfortunately that couldn't happen. I'll be coming back, soon!

Good donuts for the price. The salted caramel donut was big and fluffy for 3 dollars. The crepe brÃ»lÃ©e was creek filled and had a crunchy top coating. Friendly service and nice place to pick up unusual donuts.

What a waste of time and drive! Came here to buy donuts to take back to LA to our kids for Valentine's day. If your website says you close at 1pm you should make enough donuts to be open till that time....especially on Valentine's Day when you know ppl probably give them as gifts! Paid for parking too only to walk over and find that they wrote on the window that they were sold out and it's only 11:30am! It was dark inside so I'm sure they just didn't run out! Bad customer service and bad planning on owners part! I don't care if you have 4.5 stars on Yelp if your customer service sucks! Won't return! Don't care how good the donuts are!
All donuts were yummy. So many choices wish we were there long enough to try them all.

I guess you gotta have boobs to get options. Case in point, showed up this morning to have breakfast. Admittedly, we were running late and I knew I was risking what they'd have available. I love the French toast donut. By the time we walked in, I was told they'd sold out already. Fine, I get it. I ordered another donut and it was fine. But, as I turn around the corner, I see two young ladies being handed French toast donuts by the manager(?). I looked at it to make sure and he looks at me and said, "you should try one." My response: I just tried but was told you're sold out. He panicked cuz he knew he'd been caught and tried to cover his ass by saying they were out of the regular and the ladies were given the option of another version. Yeah? Where was my option? Oh, that's right, I don't have tits and wasn't offered the same options. And the cherry on top, we're local, which means I'll be telling my clients, whatever you do, don't go to the Donut Bar. Nice doing business with y'all.

Just happened to see the donut bar sign and decided to quickly stop by and grabbed a red velvet and coconut donuts! I must say they taste as good as they look. They also have variety of different donuts and they almost too pretty to eat. It's a small shop around Fremont but it can hold all those delicious donuts!

First time here. They told me the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut was vegan so how could I say no? The caramelized sugar on top was ridiculously good. I also got an almond milk latte. It was pretty good too. Very yummy and I like that they have several tasty vegan options. Def check them out.

was looking forward to trying this place, and finally made my way to downtown in the morning. i got an assortment of donuts, but every single donut I tried was dry dry dry. this was during peak business hrs. they really need to change the recipies because they are not up to par. I kept hoping the next one would be better. ended up throwing everything out. they need to work on their glazing technique too. looked like a bunch of 5 yr olds were in charge of that part of production. very messy .
Got there at 8 on a saturday, 2minute wait, friendly staff and great donuts. Strawberry Big Poppa was like a toaster strudel on steroids. Good stuff!

Really love this donut place for its uniqueness! They offer really creative creation for donuts like the pop tart one and the butterbeer. My favorite is the strawberry and whipped cream or the Boston creme. I have a really big sweet tooth but some of these donuts are too sweet even for me. The creme brulee donut was the reason I found out about this place but the donut itself is pretty decent mainly only for the aesthetic appeal. Recommend this place for donut heads cause their awesome!
Get the Creme Brulee, Maple Bacon, Blood Orange, and Donut Bar's Nutella.

Stopped in while staying in Vegas on a vacation and got the DB's Nutella with the nuts and it was delicious! I will say they're kind of bread-like and not what I'm used to but chocolate milk helped with that. Very tasty and a great way to start the day off!

Really good customer service! Everything is made fresh and is realllllly yummy. The only complaint is that these donuts won't last more than a day. After the first day the donut bread gets hard and stale, and for the price they charge i feel like they should last longer. Still really worth it if you're gonna get one or two and eat them the same day.
