OMG! This place is awesome! The staff was knowledgeable and friendly the product (donuts) were two die for! Made with love! The manager was very friendly and his brother looks just like him. Blessed family. Can't wait to visit again I think my next victim will be Lemon cheesecake and Creme Brulee. Delicious gang! Left with a full tummy and a big smile

This wonderful place was included in a Foodie Tour that my husband & I took while in Vegas last fall. Great donuts - we tried the French Toast, which was included in our tour. Enjoyed our donut on the patio out back. Glad that we found this hidden gem in downtown Vegas!!

What's not to love? They have iced coffee on tap, donuts as big as your head. When we were there, we had a buy one get one option. If I were needing a sugar shock, I might have tried the Homer (a pink frosted donut with sprinkles straight out of the Simpsons), but i wasn't feeling so bold. Instead, I opted for a chai cake donut. My boyfriend got a Boston cream. We tore through them so fast I considered getting more. This place is off of Fremont, but still worth a quick grab and go breakfast.

Cheeky names for the 'nuts and a fair selection of creative flavor combos. My wife and I actually both thought our filled options were too big - but more of a donut:filling ratio issue. The bakers and 'nut slingers were attentive and excited to walk us through the options despite the other few customers behind us (we don't take long, but not being rushed on your first trip in is a big bonus). The location was easy to find, a bit off the downtown drag, but an easy walk.
Omg wow yummy delish love love love their donuts, we go to the one in Las Vegas and everything is so good so everytime we go we get one of each

First timers for the Donut Bar tried the creme brulee for the first time it was really good I have to say is one of the best nights I've had in a long time I recommend the place highly little busy but it's really good.
Best donuts... Hands down! I love donuts and this place has whilst favorites and other inventive choices. I highly recommend the maple bacon cinnamon roll.... To die for!
Not really a sweets person. The variety was great. Service was great. Our donut was great!

Donuts taste fresh and the flavor choices were unique. Bought a dozen on my way out of Vegas to bring home to my kids. We all enjoyed sampling the various flavors. They especially enjoyed the Harry Potter butter beer donut :) i'll definitely be back the next time I'm in town.

Finding this place was a total fluke as they have a back enterace which I thought was an apartment building. There were people eating at table's in an open air type patio which reminded me of San Fran. I heard loud music, saw an incredible fish tank, and had to check it out. Shocked to find it was a donut shop since it seemed to be "hip". Didn't know such a thing existed. Wasn't hungry, but I wasn't going to leave without trying one of their many unique donuts. Crazy combinations. Poptart inside a donut? Who'd of thunk? I got the Strawberry Shortcake, or was it Strawberry Shortpuff, as it was loaded with whipped deliciousness topped with strawberries. Spent 10 minutes in bathroom taking photos. Check this place out! Must pay for parking, but no big deal. Machines take all forms of payment. Worth it.

Seen a video about this donut shop on YouTube and was intrigued to try it out. Got there a little late and yes they sell out fast. Was able to get a blue berry big daddy and a jelly filled donut. Pop tart donut was definitely a must try. Its taste was as unique as its look. The other donut was ok. Nothing cray to jump about. However I will definitely come back but allot earlier in the morning.

Bring my lady a donut and I get a get out of jail card... Yes I make mistakes and discovered a donut from this shop is better than flowers... Seriously great coffee and donuts... Wish they had a bicycle rack, almost lost a bicycle one morning getting coffee and a donut...
I'm from Portland,Or and we have Voodoo Donuts. Donut Bars donuts are creative, great tasting, and a new must when visiting Vegas!
Place was AMAZING!!! The variety of donuts they have are so tasty & the place itself attracts you to sit & enjoy! Definitely a must go to!

Incredible! The vegan whipped cream is better than any whipped cream I have ever tasted! The donuts are fresh and delicious. They are made in house daily and you wont be disappointed with any selection!

Outta sight!! Finally was able to try this place, and at First Fridays no less, but I was amazed by the kitschy donut I bought. POP-TART DONUT is exactly what you think: tastes like a Pop-tart, looks like a Pop-tart, has a Pop-tart in it!! At $4, this is a massive donut and well worth the price. I recommend sharing, even though I didn't because I have a problem with not sharing donuts, but you certainly can share this and be satisfied. It's a strawberry-flavored tart inside and includes extra homemade strawberry jelly along with the hidden Pop-tart inside!! White frosting, colorful crumb topping, and strawberry drizzle included! Can't wait to try more of their donuts!
Tasted like a regular donut place. I prefer krispy kreme than this place. The donuts here are unique, but their donut bread was dry.

I don't come to Vegas without stopping here first! After eating here I never eat donuts anywhere else. Great service, charming location (their back patio is lovely), and THE DONUTS ARE SIMPLY AMAZING! They live up to the hype! Creme brÃ»lÃ©e and peanut butter cup are probably my two favorites but any donut they have is soooo worth the calories! Also, if they still have donuts left later in the day sometimes you can get a box for $10 but those are rare occasions!

These donuts are a dream come true! I have been trying to go for a while now and I finally got to taste these delicious creations! They do sell out quickly so be sure to go early in the morning. I got the nutella donut and it was amazing. They have some very creative pastries like the Big Poppa which has an entire pop tart baked inside! The staff is very friendly as well. Great service and great donuts what more could anyone ask for?
Im the mÃ¡nager from bomb tacos at durango.. but when Ã­ visit bomb tacos at carson Ã­ need to eat donuts from here!! Omg! Amazing!

Are you kidding me??? Buy 6, take a dozen. Ok, done!!!! Every single option of doughnut was to good to be true. From the PB & J to that apple fritter. These people got it going on. Hats off to the pastry chef. The downfall is you have to get there early or you won't get very many options to choose from.
Great! Huge, delicious donuts and super strong cold brew coffee. They are only open for a few hours a day so be sure to get there early before they run out!

While I applaud their marketing strategy (Large 'Sold Out' sign in the window makes one wonder what they've missed out on and make an effort to come back and see) to say I've had better donuts is an understatement. Getting there early one is greeted by rows of elegant looking donuts with creative names and flavors and a helpful staff. Donuts aren't cheap but not as expensive as some have complained about ($5.00 for 2 - what do you expect for the "Best Donuts In the World"). I opted for a creme brulee donut for the BF and a (huge) Mud Pie one for me. My friend got a Boston Creme for herself. As soon as she took a bite of the Boston Creme I knew this was not the "Best Donut In The World" entirely too doughy not enough creme. Creme didn't go all the way through the bar. My Mud Pie tasted like a donut with chocolate sprinkles. Fancy name for a less than average donut. Again the thing was HUGE which meant a lot of dough for not nearly enough topping. I ate about half and got bored (BORED! With a donut!!!) The BF's review was the worst. He took one bite and said it was the worst donut he'd ever had and that the cooking oil needed to be changed (he works in the food industry and I don't so he is more aware of such things). He refused to eat any more (however, helpfully offered me a bite - which I declined). He puts the creme brulee as "worse than Dunkin' Donuts" which is about as low as it goes in his book. Maybe I don't have the refined donut palette of some of the other clientele, maybe I'm just looking for something different in my breakfast pastries. But I will skip this one next time.

Absolutely love this place. We come here every chance we get and they never disappoint. Today is their 2nd anniversary and they have face painting for the children, raffles and donut eating contest. They're also giving a free birthday cake donut to everyone. The staff is always very friendly and they're French toast donut is very yummy.
I buy their donuts for my clients all the time and they are absolutely amazing. Service is fast and friendly and espresso is delicious!

Wish I'd been able to get over here earlier. They closed pretty early (1pm) on a weekday and was only able to get leftover donuts. I get it though; they must want to prevent waste. I was just vacationing and wanted to try the place out. Service was quick, kind, and fair prices. Donuts that I got were good, but I'm sure would've been better fresh. Next time I'm in Vegas, I may try and make my way over here earlier in the day to get more variety.
No words for this deliciousness. At least four types of vegan donuts every day - not sure which is my fav because they're all so incredibly good. It is an honor to pay $3 each for these donuts :-)

Terrible experience! My fiancÃ© and I are getting married in exactly 2 weeks and wanted to have Donut Bar cater a section with donuts in Las Vegas. She had emailed them in the beginning of the year and didn't get a response. I had to stop there when I was in Las Vegas to personally get information about what we wanted. They took my information and then I followed up with them to get the figures. After getting that squared away I was told to get them paid for about 2-3 weeks prior to the event. I emailed them to have someone call me to take payment, no response, then called today to give them my card and the person on the phone was authorized to do so and he person that was wasn't available for about 3 hours. I left my name and number for them to call me back and never did. By far the worst customer service I've seen in a while when a person is trying to "give" you money. I wouldn't recommend using Donut Bar to cater any event in fear of them not getting back to you when time is of the essence.
THE BEST HANDS DOWN. I have tried fractured prune... it's koo. But no shop I have ever been to in my whole life is better than DONUT BAR! Donut mania is good too. But something about DONUT BAR
The best place in town, the best place to visit and the best donuts in town! I can't forget the great taste. Amazing staff!!!

I've been to the location in San Diego and thought it was just OK SO I have been looking forward to trying Vegas location out. I was pretty disappointed. The donuts didn't seem fresh. They seemed almost stale . The famous French toast was just OK. I wasn't expecting just a soggy warm donut. Prices high and just not worth it. I wouldn't recommend or go back to either location at this point.

What can I say but the Donuts are always fresh and awesome! That's not the only reason I'm giving them 5 stars .... it's the customer service , always on point. Today especially I came in with my dog and as I was going out to the patio I spilled my cold brew on the floor. Immediately the staff came over and replaced my coffee, and were super nice after the mess my dog and I made. It's these things that are the signs of a well run business. 5 stars All the Way. Thanks Donut Bar.

So first of I am hesitant about giving this 3 stars because it should be a 4 or 5 star with their amazing donuts. However, they are striking out with the brand of coffee they use. My double shot espresso tasted burnt and after tasting another friends coffee it is definitely the coffee bean. For me coffee is a big deal and if this place got a better coffee bean mixed with their amazing donuts this place would AMAZING!!
This place rocked my world. I planned another trip to Vegas just for this place. I tried the French toast donut and I'm honestly still dreaming about it.
Had a great time this morning!! The staff was really friendly and patiently waited while my wife made her selections. Can't wait to go again!! Made to order French toast is a must try.
Run. Don't walk. Everything we had was so so so good. I took a bunch back home to So Cal with me. We ate them all and enjoyed every bite. I can't wait to go back.
If you have an addictive personality stay away. The donuts are works of art and taste equally good. The staff is friendly and knowledgeable and now unfortunately no other donut will ever stack up.

This place is fantastic! Not your ordinary donut store by any means. They make gourmet donuts that will satisfy your taste buds and wow your belly. I absolutely loved their cake donuts as the freshness was apparent and not to mention the flavor of the peanut butter cup one was outstanding. Definitely a must visit when I'm back in downtown Vegas. Very friendly staff to top it all off! Nice job Donut Bar!

Before I go or I get out of court I am tempted to stop at the donut bar and choose some of their delicious donuts and a nitro iced coffee. Great spin on traditional old fashions, fritters and bismarks with creative pastry creations which are mouth watering and delicious. Lattes and other expresso drinks as well. Usually parking is available and friendly service. Not cheap but worth every penny. Good after an all nighter.

I go for the vegan options (of which there were four this morning). We picked up an apple fritter, a creme brÃ»lÃ©e and a spiced chai - delicious! I think there were at least 20 total donut varieties so a good time can be had by all (unless gluten is not your jam).
We loved it here! We had a hard time deciding on which donut we wanted.....so we had to buy a dozen variety.

Love love love this place. The Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e had a hard sugar top just like the real stuff. The Mud pie was the perfect amount of Peanut butter. Not supper sweet and well balanced. We got a box full for $10.00 around 1pm.
Go early for the best selection. Once they run out, they close. We tried the maple iced, sea salt caramel, Bavarian creme and the Big Elvis which was banana cream with peanut butter frosting!

I can't eat gluten but the coffee here is amazing. The customer service is impeccable and they remember you each time you go. I always bring in people from out of town and local groups. They are fantastic two children and go above and beyond to help you find the donut that you want. If it's available the French toast donut is a must-try. If you get there at the end of the day they will give you a deal on Donuts which is great because you never get yesterday's Donuts.

Got the vanilla bean ands my daughter got the pink birthday cake. They were huge and LOOKED impressive and yummy but. ...we're NOT. Felt like I was eating a loaf of bread with cheap cupcake frosting. not sure what the hype was ask about. Bleh.
They have a very good taste of everything. Few things that I don't like are loud music and the cashier (girl) she not smile at all , she should work at the back not front.
Best donuts Ive had in Las Vegas. Super fun and delicious. Unique flavors and helpful staff. No wait
Oh my gosh, these donuts are to die for!!! Stopped in on my walk thru downtown. Great concept, gourmet donuts with a awesome atmosphere. Try the soma donut, can't go wrong any of their donuts.
This place is amazing! The donuts are always fresh and delicious. The staff is energetic and courteous. The Big Poppa Tart is a foodie lover's dream come true!

The donuts are awesome. Great selection of specialty donuts and regular. The service staff greeted me immediately and then the manager came over and had a conversation with us before we left. I will definitely be back!
We keep trying this place since they opened but on all 3 visits the donuts were dry and stale and we've gotten really sick every single time. Gross.

So excited to finally check this place out and it didn't disappoint. Between four of us we shared several donuts and highly recommend doing that so you can try a little, or in the case of the Big Poppa Tart, a lot, of each. We also had the Creme Brulee which was excellent and the crunch of the sugar topping added a unique texture to the cream filled donut. A must try when visiting. Other donuts we had were the Apple Crumb Cake, Strawberry Shortcake, Boston Cream, and the Nutella overload. Every donut was made really well and unlike some donut shops we've been to, these weren't overly sweet or too rich. They were a perfect balance with the dough itself being fluffy and light. As far as decor there is a nice and quite fitting tribute to Homer Simpson around and if he were to try Donut Bar he'd definitely approve! I would say the one downside of this location is just the location itself and size. It's towards downtown so you need to take lyft/uber/taxi if visiting from out of town and staying on the strip. The shop itself has an incredible display for all their donuts but since it's a small building only has bar stool seating for about 8-10 people. We lucked out and had enough seating but I imagine due to the popularity of these donuts there may be times where they don't have enough space for groups to sit together. A great donut shop overall and when in Sin City worth making the trip out to downtown for.

Awesome donut place. Would definitely come back for another nutella donut. Great ambience music BTW. Super nice staff! Great donuts. I had the vanilla bean. Great deal of deliciousness. Omg the doughnuts are so big and tasty. I love it so much because I like yeasty doughnuts and that they are! The hazelnut coffee is amazing too.

This. Place. Is. AMAZING!!! Their donuts are unique yet so delicious! Delicious enough to make me wake up early enough to wait in line! Lol and it's in a cute little place downtown! Glad to see they're doing so well!

These are real gourmet donuts with a nice price their coffee is also good and the staff is so friendly you can tell they put a lot of time and effort into not only their donuts but to their coffee also I like the maple bacon donut and I got a latte which was awesome!
The lines are long but it's 100% worth waiting for this chicken I promise! Hands down the best chicken you will taste!

We came here after a lunch at Carson's Kitchen. It was almost time to close, so they had a "Happy Hour" special. We boxed up one of everything they had left. They gave us a good deal and our kids were in Donut Heaven when we brought them home. We thought they were all great. You should try them all!

I've been stalking this place on Instagram for a while so when I finally went in it was everything I expected. As soon as my daughter and I walked in we were greeted by a very friendly gal. Told her it was our first time here and she broke down all the different donuts. Overall, the donuts we had were awesome, the place was decorated super cute for Halloween, and the service matched the donuts!
Soooooo sooooo good! Really happy I can still find yummy vegan donuts in this town. Only down side: music is so loud you have to yell sometimes to place your order.

If you are craving a delicious donut, well....this is the place for you. They are huge and makes you want one everyday for breakfast. It's a bit pricey but well worth it for sure. The next time I am in Vegas, I will definitely be coming here for delicious donuts.
The doughnuts were delicious. So many different choices. Also they have great outdoor seating.
This little place is hiidden just behind the Fremont Street Experience. The donuts are fresh and amazing! My Faves were the Nutella and the Creme Brulee.

Tried Donut Bar yesterday based on the reviews and really disappointed. Paid $26.50 for a dozen donuts and only nearby parking available was pay to park. There was a few spots in front of the store and on the side that had no fee, but no available spots. A few of the donuts we purchased tasted good but most of them were greasy and tasted like they were made the day before. We did purchase a couple of the big donuts, but really not worth the price. Should have a price for a dozen with specialty add ons. Probably won't visit again, not so much the cost but the quality.

We loved this donut bar! Where else can you choose to have beer or coffee with a donut?! We also loved the donuts. They had such a variety. I tried their pop tart donut and it was soooo good. I had the strawberry and my fiancÃ© had the chocolate pop tart. They are a pound each. So we didn't eat the whole thing but it was awesome to try. It's cute and small and the staff is awesome. They give you suggestions on which donuts to try based on what you like. It's definitely a place to try if you're even close to Fremont Street.
I got the creme brÃ»lÃ©e. It tastes a little strange. The hard topping on the donut was tasty, but the inside custard like filling was strange. It kind of tastes like play-dough.

I came to Vegas before I'm the weekend and kept missing out because they were sold out before noon each day. I tried the chocolate Twix donut. Thumbs up. I tried the strawberry cheese cake- that one was amazing!. Everything looked awesome. You will not be disappointed.

Best Donuts Ever,,,, Great taste .. And always Fresh! But get there early! Once they run out. they close for the day. Their coffee and hot chocolate are not to be missed. One last thing. I enjoy sitting in the courtyard in the back of the store.

Ok so I only stopped here once for literally 2 mins or less, I was running late for a work function and i was passing by and just had to have some sweets in my jelly belly to make my day more merry. I waltzed in and was greeted by a nice lady who was behind the counter, she was giving me the spiel of the place but i was in a mad rush so abruptly looked around and saw the oreo birthday cake one so just pointed and said "that one 2 please". and rushed my dough boy butt on outta there. Upon my hasty retreat I noticed that they offer a YELP CHECK IN DISCOUNT: of a cup of fancy coffee. I didn't even have time for that :/. I was literally eating on the run and my donut was a tastebudgasm and a half of phenomenal yumness so i can only imagine what their other sweet wonders behind the counter must be like. So your's truly Benjamin glutton shall return to this purveyor of fried dough to further investigate but so far i'm a fan :D.

Pinkbox is better hands down. This place is overpriced and the donuts are mediocre at best. I set the standard too high and was expecting Pinkbox quality or better. The y taste like they are day old and super dry when you bite into them. It's not the price that bothered me as much as it is for the quality for that price. My first and last time!

I love The Donut Bar. The staff is really lax and the donuts are amazing. It just sucks that they close early but they usually sell out before then. I love their churro cones with ice cream on the top. Please open more locations!

Easily one of the best Donut shops in the world. Excellent customer service, consistently good donuts. Great deals on donuts when they need to sell out. Additionally they sometimes give balloons and free donuts to children.
Brought my daughter in today... very cool, modern place with donuts everywhere! We had the strawberry cheesecake and the Nutella galore... so good!
My favorite place to go for donuts! They have a great variety. Donut Bar would be great for office visit gift.

Best donut place ever! I went here and got a blueberry cheesecake donut on Friday, and it was heaven! The owner of the Vegas location was so nice, and he was helping his employees serve donuts to the customers which was awesome. The people who I was with got a cake batter donut and a regular cinnamon sugar one, and I tried a few bites of theres, and they were amazing! I live in LA, and I hope they will open one (or many) there ASAP, because it would be wildly successful, and I would eat there a ton. Until then, I will be coming back to this location and all the others and getting new donuts. I heard the poptart donut there is the most popular, and I think they ran out, but I hope to try that next time.
Amazing donuts, but go early as when they run out that's it ! Nice team working in there ! Can't wait to return my next visit to Vegas.
Kind of a cute place, clever Simpson painting on the wall in the bathroom but wishing we left the donuts in there too. Not tasty at all.

5 of us had 15 donuts to share between us. Every single one was delicious. The s'mores big poppa tart is an amazing creation. The lemon pistachio was shockingly our favorite donut. Lots of flavor. Staff was very friendly. The only negative was the limited seating area.
Exceptionally good donut that originated from san diego. My triple chocolate donut is so good for a bucks plus staff n store are cool.

This place was amazing! I stared at the pictures at work drooling all day on Friday lol and we went Saturday morning, the pictures don't even do this place justice! The kids LOVED the donuts and the milk on tap! I had a hazelnut ice coffee, I saw someone on here with one.. it was delicious I wish I could go here everyday! It was PACKED that's how you know its about to be good! And we loved the little patio area in the back it was so cute and everyone was very friendly! We will def be going back!

We had the pop tart donut, cremÃ© brÃ»lÃ©e and an Oreo donut. The place is super small, but the courtyard behind is cute and nice to sit in. We went around 1030 and they were already running out of donuts though, so I'd recommend you get there earlier than that!

I'm not a fan of fancy donuts. I've always just stuck with chocolate and glazed. nothing else appealed to me. but I LOVE these donuts. I could eat them every day. the pop tart one looked cool but I thought it'd be disgusting. but surprisingly it was my favorite one. nutella over load was amazing also. I didn't like strawberry cream cheese, it was really dry and just tasted like stale strawberry cake. I also didn't like the creme brule.

Three stars for the very average tasting donuts. They're of the same quality as any supermarket bakery so I don't think they warrant the "world's best donut" title, which I was disappointed about. The prices are reasonable, and the staff did an excellent job at serving the line quickly. I can see it getting chaotic as the line grows in the small place but the staff manages it well. The actual space is cute with a nice courtyard outside for extra seating. I probably wouldn't stop here again as there are places that I've had better donuts but for the time being it was a fun place to stop.

Very very good. Had the strawberry cream puff looking donut. The strawberry pop tart. They will push the grilled cheese donut on you but I just ignore upsells and get to what I want. Good coffee, service and donuts.
OH My HEAVENS!!! I'm not a big donut fan but I was impressed for sure!!! The prices, the sizes, the taste! EVERYTHING was just perfect!!! Will be back for sure!! Cute little shop. Loved it
These donuts saved me. I once was lost, but now I'm found. I once was blind, but now I see. Thanks do the Donut Bar, my chains are gone and I've been set free.
Amazing! I tried a cremÃ¨ brÃ»lÃ©e donut and the strawberry cheesecake, washed down with a nitrogen infused cold brew coffee. Boom! I was buzzing for hours... (In a good way)

Was super excited to hit up this donut shop for a long time. It was nice to know that this time around, an hour before it closed, they still had tons of choices still. This time I was smart to call first before heading there because downtown can be a pain in the butt. The first time I went was disappointing because an hour before closing, everything was already sold out. And that was the time I had a friend in town as well. But this time around, I wasn't disappointed about the options per say, but actually the taste tbh. There was a deal going on that they sometimes do on the last hour of opening and they either do buy one get one, or fill a whole box of donuts for $10. Of course we ordered the famous creme brÃ»lÃ©e, strawberry cream cheese and the pumpkin spice. I was too juiced to crack open the creme brÃ»lÃ©e. As far as taste, it wasn't that great. I could make it at home. The pumpkin spice was the tastiest. The filling was good too. Next time I need to try the ice cream donut cone when it gets warme
The store closed at one, we come in late, get three of the last donuts, but they are unbelievably delicious. They are not too sweet, soft and tasty.
100% naughty goodness!!! Yum meter is 11 out of 10!! Gourmet donuts done right. You can't go wrong here.

Donuts bring families together! This place is heaven. My family and I had just finished a 4 day vegas trip, and to say we were all sick of each other was an under statement. As we were leaving los vegas i decided to take my family here unannounced. They were not thrilled, donuts? Is what I heard from them.we had not had breakfast yet but we were in downtown and I decided to treat my self. Pleasing my family is never easy, but the Donut bar delivered. My sister is a vegan and a food snob, (guess what they make amazing vegan donuts, so amazing they don't even want to tell you so that you don't try them!) My parents are very set in their ways and we're not thrilled by donuts for breakfast......it's so good once it hits your lips!!!!!!!! My family were taken back by the creme Brule donuts, than the strawberry cream, and the lemon pistachio. But when I got the maple bacon donut (I've had dreams about this thing ) they looked at me like I was crazy. It was amazing! I had to force them to try it but they ended up loving it. Thank Donut Bar because of your donuts our family tension was gone we were able to bond and have a good drive home. Your donuts saved the day!

Pretty amazing assortment and appearance. However, it's really hard to justify spending $3 on a donut. The donuts were good, but not so much better than regular donuts to really justify it (unless you're just visiting and want some exotic donuts).

Love the donuts! I am very disappointed on the service. I finally made a trip to donut bar today, I was extremely excited to taste these donuts. The person that took my order was helpful and her recommendations were excellent. She even up sold me on other donuts and coffee. The checkout was excruciating, I had to ask for my coffee. The coffee was spilled by the cashier. The cashier forgot a whole box of donuts. Ultimately, I had to make a second trip which took an extra hour of travel time to retrieve my second box of donuts. The cashier mistake ruined my whole experience at donut bar.

Not sure what the big deal was on these! Even though we stopped by at noon, the donuts should of tasted fresh if bake today. The 4 different ones we got all tasted dry, like day or 2 days old. Paid $11 for 4 donuts! Felt was too much!

I called on Thursday 4/14/2016 business was closed for day. But, manager Joe answer phone called. I was excited was able to speak to someone.. I placed a order for a birthday party of 23rd of April. I was told I would get a call back to confirm. .Well I've been calling them myself for 4 days straight. Seeing if order was place and will be ready for pick up on 23rd.. sent business emails.. all i have to say is Don't bother with this place!! Not reliable. . Rather take business else where..
Great coffee actually!! Of course huge variety of delicious donuts -but coffee lovers rest assured, good spot.

It must be a dream...don't wake me because I never want to leave! This place is a little slice of heaven is all I can say. My girlfriend and I were in Vegas visiting her family and I thought I'd try my luck at a local donut shop. I really enjoy cake donuts and specialty donuts, so let's see what Vegas has to offer. I came across the Donut Bar. The shop is pretty small but the donuts are enormous! I walked in and thought I died and went to heaven...this place is amazing! I was created by friendly and helpful staff to assist me with my order. Sooooo many choices and they all look delicious. I got a dozen because I didn't want to miss out on anything! My girlfriend's mom had the creme brÃ»lÃ©e...she loved it. My girlfriend had the birthday cake Oreo donut and wouldn't share so I'll take that as she liked it. You can't go wrong here. I highly advise anyone to go here if you're in Vegas...these donuts are life changing! If I could give them 6 stars I would.
I was super excited about this new donut shop opening, but the donuts were just not good. They were super overdone and the icing was also dry. Maybe I came on a bad day?

We had our wedding donuts from Donut Bar and it was absolutely amazing! Jeff was so easy to work with, and helped us to pick out whatever flavors we wanted. They were such a hit at the wedding everyone was asking where they came from and wanted to go back for more! We chose them for the Vegan options and were completely in love with everything we tried. Thank you so much! Will definitely be back.

Only giving it 3 stars because I'm NOT a donut afficionado but the donut coconut dream that's pictured didn't taste freshly made. The batter tasted like yesterday. But I do love the array of amazing choice. It really is spectacular and creative and my husband who loves all things sweet, ahem, enjoyed his donut immensely.
Delicious! Get here early or else they will sell out. Definitely a must when downtown. We had the pop tart donut, the homer and the fresh strawberry one that tasted like funnel cake! So good!

I was not impressed with the Donut Bar. The French toast donut and latte I got were pretty good, but everything else I tried was flavourless. Like a lot of other reviews mentioned, the sugar topping on the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut was way too thick, the red velvet donut was very dry and didn't taste like anything, and the Nutella donut was less dry but still had almost no flavour.

This donut bar is a must see!! Off of Carson and 6th in a old motel. The workers inside are so friendly. On Saturday and Sunday they give children a free donut how cool is that!!! You must go see the store and taste them.

This place is okay, but not amazing. Surprisingly they still had a pretty large selection on a Saturday at 1pm. I've had the Creme brulee donut, the big poppa tart, Samoa, cheesecake, lemon blueberry, birthday cake, and the shortcake. None of them stood out as delicious, and the dough that they use for their donuts is too dense for me. Most of them were too sweet as well. If you come here, I just recommend getting the Creme brulee donut so you can record a video to make your friends jealous. The donut itself was overly sweet.
Good vegan selection, and so good. Friendly staff especially the owner.

My friend showed me a video on Facebook about the Donut Bar and the creme brulee looked amazing so I knew we had to stop by when we were in Vegas. My friend actually went to the Donut Bar by Fremont Street and got us donuts while we stayed back at our hotel with our babies. The creme brulee were to die for, the donuts with the poptart in the middle were huge, almost the size of my 2 month old, and they were so rich and fulfilling. See my video...
Love this place! Huge to regular size donuts fresh and delicious!

This place was good. Gotta go early it will get sold out. It's always jumping but good. It's worth the wait in my opinion and a cool atmosphere. I will be going again in the future because there's more I need to try
The donuts were pretty good. Flavors were tasty but they were a bit dry. The coffee was good. We got there at 10:30 and the selection was already very limited which was disappointing.

I've been waiting to try these donuts for the past month. Reading reviews after reviews and finally said today is the day. Packed my family up and headed over, paid for parking and walked in. Small space but loads of beautifully decorated donuts behind the case. Kids got the free monster Inc donuts, I ordered the strawberry split and creme brulee, hubby ordered an apple fritter and the espresso donut. I also wanted to try the pop tart donut and a few extras. $25 later we are walking out happy to try these award winning donuts. My first bite of the strawberry split underwhelming, I could taste old oil along with a flavorless donut. after sampling the rest of them my family came to the same conclusion, the old oil taste took over the flavor of all the donuts and we were very disappointed after waiting so long to try these.

Need to consider opening earlier than 7 am. I was very discouraged yelp did not have the hours posted & I drove across town and was told they were not open. I saw the donuts and employees, but didn't get to try them yet.
Great Donuts. Went opening weekend a while back and they were super friendly. Great for kids as well.

This is now one of my favorite donut shops. When I came in, I was excited to see a lot of fun options ranging from pistachio to strawberry cheese cake to the classic and delicious maple bacon. Most of the donuts were huge and still very well priced ($2-$4)! On top of it all, the staff was sooo friendly and that made my experience even better!

Love this place! Always a line, always worth it. The owners are very friendly and seem like they care about their customers, not just making money. Donuts are delicious. Clean place. Small, but has a great back patio area to enjoy your treats! Highly recommend to anyone that comes to visit!

Blah, stale donuts. For $17 I got 3 Donuts 2 coffees. Selection was small for 10:30 on a Monday so I had to pick what was left or they offered me an ice cream for breakfast.... apple fritter was rock hard, strawberry cheesecake donut tasted like a regular jelly filled donut, and birthday donut was a regular sprinkled donut... nothing special. Very disappointing. Used to newer donut shops were donuts are made fresh per hour (sidecar, dough donuts)

I'm not a donut fan at all but this place I absolutely love! They have the best donuts. Everything I've tried has been delicious. My favorites are blueberry cheesecake and the French toast donut! I go every chance I get.
The Donut House in downtown Las Vegas is a MUST! Their unique creations are fabulous. Their Creme brÃ»lÃ©e RULES!

This place was amazing. Drive by on my way to the golden nugget and decided to check it out. They had a great staff and great selection of donuts. I tried their strawberry shortcake and it was amazing. I was amazed by their selection. The prices were not too bad either. Definitely returning again.
We are locals and love the donut bar. Staff is always amazing. The donuts are so good you can't go wrong with whatever you choose.

It's a neat place! I a little Ali Wong's definition of hipster. But my old age I felt comfortable. The donuts were huge and cooked like remember they were 35 years ago back in the dinosaur era. My choices were an apple bacon fritter and a maple bacon log! I don't care what my wife and mother in law got, I had bacon in front of me! They said, " it was good they'd come back and tell others". I had their coffee and yes!, they'll make you what that startakeyurbucks place can make I believe I like this place better. Place is located downtown Vegas and the area is really becoming a great place geared towards us locals and giving us the non-commercial franchise associated crap local Las vegans are looking for! Great little place! Big do-NUTS! Better caffeine beverages than StraveYourBucks!

Awesome donuts, more expensive than the Krispy Kreme and Dunkins of the world for obvious reasons. Don't go expecting a dozen for 10 bucks, but go expecting some awesome donuts in flavors you never thought of.

I love donuts & I love donut bar. My favorite is with out a doubt the bacon cinnamon roll. (It's not a donut, I know. BUT BACON) I went for their grand opening, and really enjoyed it. Even got to taste their chi tea latte which was pretty good! And fret not, if you're like me, they offer dairy alternatives, like soy! they have an incredible selection of crazy awesome donuts and your basics that you love. And they also offer VEGAN & gluten free options which, while I am not vegan, think It's awesome that they offer a sweet selection for everyone!
They offer vegan donuts! Nom nom nom... stopped in during happy hour and got a ton of donuts for a low price! The donuts were great! couldn't tell the difference since they were vegan
We love this place!!' Delicious donuts! My hubby loves the chocolate euphoria donut. Going to bring my sister here for bachelorette as well

You must try place if you are staying in the down town area. There donuts are huge so it will keep you super full until lunch. You can refill your coffee for free which is always a plus. We eat our donut in their outside seating area, which was quiet and had a lot of shade.

Fast service. Clean, unique spot. But can we talk about these donuts already? Like for real!!!!! The creme brÃ»lÃ©e is everything you could imagine. For once, believe the hype!!! The filling is flavorful and luxurious. Pink box aint got nuthin on this place. Shared some others with my fam. Nutella, some giant strawberry pop tart one and a blueberry lemon. All were fabulous! Coffee was also really good. This is a cute place for a breakfast date. P.s.- theres outside seating in the back.
I'm enjoying some really great donuts right now! You gotta check this place out. You will love them!

Donut Heaven. Nuff said. But for real this place is insane!! The donuts are gigantic and taste delicious. Their coffee is also great. The service is cheerful and professional. The only thing you need to know is get there early. They are open only until the donuts run out. I recommend getting there early in the morning to ensure you get the best selection of awesome donuts.

Honestly, I don't understand the hype at all. We went with a large group and had a good selection of all donuts. They were comparable to grocery store donuts. The more simple donuts were dry and almost seemed stale, and the creative flavors were pretty gaggy. The saving grace was the cold brew iced coffee, that was very good. Unfortunately we were going for the donuts not the coffee. Not impressed!

My very first time trying this and all I can say is OMG WOW AMAZING!!! And I got there at the perfect time.... HAPPY HOUR. Staff is also amazing, very clean place. They definitely stand by their slogan. Best Donuts in the WORLD!! Wow

This place exceeds expectations, the customer service is phenomenal and the donuts were HUGE!! I tried the delicious raspberry iced with pistachio nuts, it looked fake, like a Homer Simpson donut, but the taste was as far from 'fake' as you can imagine! It was moist, sweet (not overly sweet) and melted in my mouth. I know this place is very popular and sells out quickly, so thankful I got to try one!!
Amazing! I highly recommend the maple apple beacon fritter! Wowzers!!! Their coffee is on point.

Was in Vegas and stumbled across this place when looking for a breakfast joint to go to near downtown on Yelp. There was such a variety of uncommon donut flavors (Nutella, mud pie, strawberry cheesecake, Homer Simpson) and the donuts were huge! I asked the guy at the counter for a recommendation, since there were so many choices, and he said to try the French toast donut. So I ordered and when it came out, it was a huge donut with butter, syrup, and blueberry compote on the side. I took the first bite with butter and dipped in syrup and I think the sky parted and I heard angels singing!!! The lightest French toast ever!!! What a combo! My girlfriend had the strawberry cheesecake and said it was amazing! We will be back here the next time we are in Vegas. They only served this donut Sat and Sun, from what the guy said, so if you have a cheat meal and in Vegas for a weekend, this is the meal to have. It's right down the street from the Mob Museum, which was also a great place to visit after having a foodgasm.
This place was fantastic! Took the kids and it was a real treat! Vegas people this is a must!
Such a cute spot! Donut Bar defiently lives up to the buzz that is going around. Went here with a client after they recommended it. Will be back asap!!

For the price, you would expect the donuts to be made that day but they always taste kind of stale and as if they were made two days before. Every time I go, they taste like if I could have bought the same at Krispy Kreme.
Nice people with delicious coffee and donuts. Decent selection of vegan options a plus!

This is new on our list in Vegas. It will be a stop on each visit. Order whatever you want...but the creme brÃ»lÃ©e and the blueberry cheesecake donuts were outstanding. Don't go to Vegas without stopping here.

"Best donuts in the world!" They truly exceed the expectations of this line! I had the cinnamon roll with maple bacon... And the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut and these two are my favorites! Highly recommended

Really good donuts! I had a creme brule and Nutella donut. Both donuts were beautiful, big and yummy... all you can ask for in a donut! The staff was friendly and helpful and the coffee was good. The outdoor area in the back is really cool to sit and enjoy your donut and coffee. Great spot!
Delicious! I recommend the French toast and the Big Poppa Tart. The staff was also fantastic! Whenever I come to Vegas again, this place will be a must!
Oh my god some of the best donuts in town it's a must check out. Freaking donuts are like the size of a fucking pancake it's ridiculous but it's so fucking good.
The donuts are GREAT! They even give the kiddos free donuts certain days of the week. I still have yet to try the donut Icecream cones but looks so delicious when I see the pictures.

Great donuts with lots of fun flavors to choose from! Super patient employees who are pleased to answer all your questions or give great recommendations if you can't choose from the overwhelming choices of deep fried heaven. I highly recommend the lemon pistachio donut! Great tourist spot to check out too

Oh my gosh. The donuts are the best here. I didn't go but my husband did. Said the people that work there are friendly and helpful. Huge donuts , fresh made daily. If you are downtown run don't walk go get you some donuts! They also make the pink Simpsons donut there!
A little slice of heaven in the form of a donut! The have a very large selection of gourmet flavors and unique items for anytime you want a little something sweet.
These were definitely worth the wait! Drove all the way across town to try them. Service and donuts were great!

I shouldn't have stopped by when they were closing because the donuts were buy 1 get 1 free. I ended up leaving with way too many donuts. The strawberry cheesecake and vanilla bean are my favorites. The staff are always nice, I will be back when I'm in the area again.
Unbelievably delicious and unique. I've been to VooDoo donut and this place tops it in deliciousness. Not only that, but the staff and owner were so friendly and welcoming!!
Didn't even grab one of the delicious looking donuts. Got some great coffee, but the staff and the atmosphere was incredible.

I had a creme brule donut from here and hands down THE BEST iced chai tea latte. Both were amazing!!! I also bought a few donuts to go and brought them to my mom in Boston. I wish i lived closer ( but that probably wouldn't be good for my waist line) so maybe this is for the best.

DONUT have one!!! LOL. Amazing donuts. The crime brÃ»lÃ©e donuts are so fun to crack open, but my fave was the red velvet donut. Worth the Ã¼ber ride to get there. My 2 wishes... Closer to the strip and if they deliver to California.
Loved it! So much variety and a great venue just off the beaten path. The maple bacon was amazing!
Love these donuts and I dont even eat donuts often, but if I do I come here! You gotta get there early though before all the good ones run out!

I'm gonna be honest, I think this place is way over-rated/over-hyped. My boyfriend is a fan. I like their donuts, but it's not my favorite donut place in town. I like the flavor options, but a lot of the stuff I'd otherwise want comes on an old-fashioned donut, and I find their old-fashioned to be super dry. I did have some kind of beer batter donut once that was mind-blowing, but have tried more donuts that I didn't care for from here than ones I have liked. I'm not saying they're bad by any means, but it's definitely not worth the drive to me - shout out to their marketing team for getting this place to blow up!
This place is YUMMY. The donuts are HUGE and FUN. I love the flavors, the donuts here are the best. I could not decide so I bought so many, we took them home to share with others.. You must go here..

I'm from San Diego, I miss home and to know that Donut Bar opened up here in Las Vegas I had to go! Not your traditional donuts, these are more like your own personal small cake if you would. The size of this donuts are enough to feed two or three people. The place is great easy to find especially with neon sign out side the door. Staff is awesome, ambience is great, , owners always there to great you and thank you with a friendly smile. The only problem I have with this place is that I don't know what Donut to choose, I go inn for one come out with half a dozen. It's all good I can munch on them all day. Great job guys and thank you for opening in Vegas.

The Las Vegas Donut Bar is one of the best donut places anywhere. It offers both classic and creative donut creations and the bonus is the friendly service. I will definitely come back when I am in Vegas! #deadliftsanddonuts
Omg the donut bar is so great if you haven't tried it suggest you do so. sooooooooo yummy

Really really amazing donuts! I could eat the donuts without the fancy icing even, because the dough is that good. We came Thursday around 10 am and walked right up to order. Staff is very kind and helpful! We got a dozen to try all the flavors and every single donut was delicious. Nothing beats the donut bar! Thanks for the treat, we will be back soon!

Ended up in Vegas for way too long. Thank god for this donut shop. After moving from the strip to downtown, this was a daily go-to. We actually got healthy smoothies (from the market down the street) and donuts for lunch 4 days in a row :) sweet staff, vegan options, 2 for 1 happy hour. Overall great experience!

The donuts are huge!!! I ordered the Creme brÃ»le donut and it was a satisfying experience to break it open. The donuts were fluffy and not too overwhelming. Sad that I don't have this in my city! Definitely a place to visit when you're in Vegas.
Absolutely amazing! They had so many delicious donuts, we had bought several different kinds because we couldn't decide and had to try them all.

The donuts are not worth $4! Dunkin' and Krispy Cream are much better in my opinion, and worth a whole lot more. Thats the last $12 bucks of mine you'll see!! You got me with the "Sold Out" signs, NEVER AGAIN!

One of the hyped-up places that actually lives up to the hype. Not only some of the best donuts on the planet, but very friendly staff to top it all off. The owner does a lot of community outreach and is a great guy as well. Love it!

This place is the number three on my list of favorites. I'm not a fan of doughnuts however this place has changed my mind Amazing place!! Only reason I didn't give five stars because they weren't as warm and I thought they should be but great place nevertheless.
This place is legit.....such good quality, big tasty donuts that are unique and addictive!!! Shout out to Joe/Jeff for their great service.
What I expected from a trendy donut shop. Nice selection of creative donuts, friendly service, and great taste! I would recommend to any visiting foodies.

Hands down the best donut I've ever had!! The PB&J was INSANE! The staff is so nice and friendly, such a fun environment. Tried it while I was in town from Utah and this will now be a stop every time I'm in town.

I was so excited to take my son here and experience the amazing donuts that I had seen. I was disappointed. The donuts tasted like they had been sitting for awhile and for the price that we paid I would expect more. We got a dozen donuts before even tasting them to take some home to everyone and to be honest besides the size of them, we didn't notice anything special. I hope it was just a down day, but as busy as they were I don't see how it would be. I can say that the coffee I got was great.

This place was suggested by our teenage niece, it has a social media presence. It's location is close to a seedy area with some homeless sleeping in the alley way on the way to parking, the parking is 15 minute only,so we made the order to go. We tried the red velvet,blueberry,mudpie, creme brulee, nutella overload, chocolate and strawberry shortcake. They give you 1 free donut per dozen, or a coffee of you check in Yelp,we also ordered capuccinos. Ok out of all those I would suggest the nutella overload and the mudpie, the others are just ok. Would I go here again as a matter of craving, not really. But worth it at least to try and for the experience of artisanal donuts and social media posting if you are into that

We are from OC. Went to Vegas & were recommended this place. I saw that the hours were until donuts sell out, which was weird (looks like they close on average between 1 & 3). We decided today, on our last day in Vegas to show up right at opening (Thursday btw) we showed up at 6:55 am, we were the 2nd person waiting for them to open (Yes, waiting) the lady in front of us drive from an hour away for a donut for her boyfriend who's bday was today. Before we knew it, 3 more people behind us BEFORE opening. The people behind us also raved about this place. We purchased 3 Triple Chocolate, 2 Cinnamon Sugar Donuts with Whip Topping and FRESH Strawberries, a Strawberry Cheesecake and I personally tried at least a bite of each flavor & loved them all. We also purchased a Homer donut, which I didn't try and was told it was a little dry..but it's not my cup of tea anyway..lol. My husband tried an Apple fritter which he loved so much that he texted me while at work to let me know he loved it. I have a nutella donut saved for tomorrow's breakfast and can't wait!! I was told that they do not make the same flavors daily, which is pretty cool and probably a bummer at the same time..but definitely a good reason to come early!! The lady behind the counter was friendly and knowledgeable, quick and patient with us indecisive customers which was greatly appreciated. I had been recommended the Horchata donut but was told they only make those at the San Diego location. Sounds like I'll have to make a trip, lol. But...will definitely be back to this location since Vegas is our home away from home!!

I finally came early enough to get a French toast donut! I had been teased for weeks by this donut, from Instagram and yelp! I tried the Sunday before last and missed out as I came too late, surprisingly 9:40 is too late even though they open at 8! This place is very popular. Unfortunately, you have to arrive super early to get a FT donut which they only serve on the weekends. I arrived last Saturday before the doors opened and it was well worth it! The donut was so soft and tasty, it went down smooth with the milk I ordered. I have to say it sucked sitting at the eating area as the air is blasting which made my French toast cool after a while. I only ordered the French Toast so I'm not sure about the rest of the donuts. I do plan on going back this weekend for another FT donut so maybe I'll try some others as well. The 4 stars is because I feel they should have the FT donut all week and because the hours they are open is so short, some days they close at noon. They could be making so much more business!
Donut Bar Vegas was just as good as the one in San Diego and the one that was in Costa Mesa that changed hands! Great donuts

Neat little place north of the strip. However donuts sub par. The Homer was a unique big donut. But that's about it. It's dry and topped with sugary frosting. The creme brÃ»lÃ©e was hard to bite into. If you want good donuts - try Voodoo donuts in Oregon or Denver, CO.
The donuts were delicious, we tried the creme brÃ»lÃ©e, the vanilla bean, and the poptart! We will be back before we leave Vegas!

By far the best donuts I have ever had. I traveled all the way from NYC and it was do worth it. They have a great variety and the pricing is beyond reasonable. I will definitely be visiting again if I go back to Vegas.

LITERALLY SO AMAZING! I love this place. If I am feeling like treating myself i will get a donut but usually just a coffee. Let me tell you when I say the coffee is seriously some of the best I have ever had, like EVER. I HIGHLY recommend stopping by this cute local place, the earlier you go the better because once they sell out they are done for the day! The earlier you go the better flavors they have-just saying.
Found out about the donut bar through a Google search. It's a gem of downtown Vegas! They gave us two huge donuts at a bogo price of $3! Definitely recommend and will be back
Love the fun donuts and great service! The line can get a bit log, but they move so fast it's not an issue. The outside seating makes this a fun breakfast stop!

The best vegan doughnuts I've ever had. Everyday, the menu had something new and tasty. If you go you have to try their apple fritters, they are delicious and huge. Their chocolate cake doughnuts look average, but are like nothing I've ever had...they are light and airy. They even have a whipped cream and strawberry vegan doughnut...amazing. Only tried the vegan doughnuts, but this place sells out everyday...get there early!

Wow! This is no ordinary donut shop, omg! I walked in and I could not decide what to get, I want them all. I had the vanilla bean donut which by the way are gigantic and the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut, ohhh so yummy, a must try!
Amazing!!! Love local places that treat people like people. They are amazing and their donuts are even better!!!!

I love the crueller donuts so good. Small little niche in the Carson building. Yet they create some of the most artful donuts you can imagine. Friendly and awesome staff. Offer stump town coffee. Can't get enough of the changing menu so each day you'll get something different.
Took a bunch of teenage kids and they were blown away at how great the donuts looked. Had a great time seeing all the massive donuts. Must see Las Vegas destination.

A must try. Amazing donuts, great coffee/drinks, creative restroom,an amazing sign (as of 6/9) the staff all have great, outgoing attitudes. There is so much that donutbar has to offer. Now if you can steal some of San Diego's coastline... ;) that'd be great! P.S. My diet hates you.
Beat donuts in the world. Never fails when I'm craving something sweet. Been buying donuts for years now & Donut Bar is still my favorite! I recommend to try the Oreo Donut

HUGE donuts. Picked up a big poppa tart doughnut filled with a strawberry pop tart and jelly filling. It was big enough to split in half and share with another person. Also tried the creme brulee donut which was delicious, and got a free birthday cake doughnut because it was chef Jeff's birthday which was pretty good. Tried the cold brew which tasted just as good as Starbucks. I also enjoyed a chocolate milk from the tap, it was good but nothing too special as far as chocolate milk goes. I will cone back to try some more doughnuts from their long menu.
Super cute space and amazing doughnuts!!! A must when in Vegas. The staple is the creme brÃ»lÃ©e and it is definitely a must have. Two thumbs up for this donut bar.

Had a creme brulee and a caramel latte. The donuts were great. The creme brulee is a bit overrated. It's essentially a custard donut with a hard caramel coating. Good, but I was expecting something a little more eggy and dense in terms of the filling. The donuts are huge btw. not a bad thing but makes sampling difficult and pricey. Good for sharing. It's a little tight inside but there's plenty of patio seating in the back.

I work nearby, and this is probably my favorite establishment downtown. The music is great, the staff is absolutely lovely, and the donuts and coffee are delicious. I would recommend this place to anyone. Their CrÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e is probably my favorite. It's a very unique donut that is just the right amount of sweet. I have not had a single donut that I did not like, they all tend to be very light and fluffy and are just overall great donuts. If you're a local and have not been to the Donut Bar, you definitely should stop by one morning.
Long lines... it's not even a pleasant experience... get in and get out...! For a donut...??? No thanks..!

Really love this place ! I've been to the one in SD many times! This place never disappoints and they always have awesome new idea to do with doughnuts. And there Ice cream doughnut is awesome! That's a much have!! Highly recommend this place !!

I have never been to Donut Bar until today. As soon as I walked in I was greeted by a friendly employee Jeff. I preordered donuts the previous day and they were ready when I got there right at the hour. The cleanliness of the Donut Bar is amazing. You can see all the donuts they have to offer in a great glass case. They make them fresh everyday and the employee said they rarely have any waste at the end of the day. I would highly recommend you stopping by and supporting this local business. although the donuts are around $2-$3 you get what you pay for- gourmet donuts. Thanks Donut Bar!
Absolutely perfect donuts. Owner was so kind and staff was so helpful. We went everyday we were in Vegas. Very cool establishment!!!!!!!!!!! :)

Love the selection and the donuts are huge for the most part. Had the Elvis and hubs had the birthday cake. We devoured them both and we're not usually big donut eaters. Won't go to downtown Vegas without them again

Ahh freaking mazing! Walked in greeted right away. The staff made recommendations for which donuts to try. They had so many options! They also had drip coffee or made to order coffee drinks. The prices were reasonable and well worth it. I wish I lived close to this but I'm also happy I don't. ;)
This place has the best donuts by far. My favorite is the "Brad". It's an apple fritter drizzled with maple frosting and topped with bacon.

Fabulous amazing splendid incredible!! I don't know if I love Nicole or hate her for turning me on to this place! I had a PB & J bar, out of this world. My very picky husband had a Boston cream bar and couldn't stop talking about it. The owners Jeff & Joe are sincere men who rely care about the products they are serving. I wish them a long life here in Las Vegas.
Best donuts I have ever tasted and I have tried almost every shop in town. Get there early otherwise you may miss out!

We got the bacon cinnamon roll, caramel latte donut and the creme brulee donut. To top it off, they came around and offered samples of the french toast donut. That sample made me wish we had gotten one of those for sure.

First of all, the donuts are out of this world!!! Secondly, the staff are so happy to be there. Walking in their store is like a breath of fresh air. Lovely experience overall.
Superb. Fun. New design. Urban atmosphere close to everything. Before j never walked downtown. But it's becoming a good walking city. A+

We went and ordered strawberry cream donut and maple bar. My daughters were in absolute delight. They loved the strawberry and cream. My husband loved the maple bar. The owners are extremely nice and pleasant. The place is clean and inviting. Long line but they move very quickly. This vegan will definitely be back!!!
My absolute favorite coffee donut spot in the valley. Always fresh and delicious. Fabulous variety.
Horrible. No variety. Dry. Burnt. No flavor. Not sweet enough. Expensive. And in the worst city in the world.

This morning was my first time going in here, I had heard so much about it I had to go in. Granted for the first moment I was on the phone in order to VERIFY DONUT ORDERS for other people, god forbid I purchase more from them. To which I got quite the eye roll from the lady. If the donut I rushed out an answer to get because she made me so nervous to browse the selection as I had NEVER BEEN HERE before wasn't so good I would've given one star!!! There was one person in line in front of me it wasn't busy, so why seem so bothered to the point you're rolling your eyes at a customer because they aren't sure what they want. I've never been there how can I know if I don't have the chance to look with out being made to feel bad by their employee. So disappointed at my experience here when I've heard so many good things, must've had bad luck and caught the wrong employee on the wrong day I suppose.

The Donut Bar Las Vegas is absolutely, hands down the best place to get your morning started. I eat here almost daily. The donuts are always consistent, and the service from Joe, Jeff, and their staff is always superb! Highly recommended!!!!
Not only are the donuts amazing, but the people have such a great attitude. The flavors are awesome and unique which pairs well with the cold brew they have. I had such a great time there!
Wow... great donuts and super nice employees. We tried a half dozen donuts and they were all fantastic
I love the selection Donut Bar have to offer. It's great for all occasion and especially gifting it. Well, the truth is, they're delicious and sometime just to beautiful to eat.
Pretty amazing donuts! Really amazing service! I recommend it! Try the homemade strawberry milk! Just 4 stars because it is a little pricey.

First time coming here, it was really warm and welcoming. They have some absurdly delicious doughnuts and really friendly service. Hidden gem.. ? go sneak through the back door and enjoy your confections in the lovely secret courtyard! thank me later. ;)
Love this spot. Creative, interesting donuts. Be sure to come early or they will sell out. I work near the area so it's easy for me to swing by some mornings. Good coffee too!
Incredible donuts. Beautiful and tempting to look at, delicious to eat. Very reasonably priced. A grand slam!

THE BEST DONUTS EVER! Anytime I'm craving sweets this is were i go. You can satisfy any craving with all the different options and you can tell they're made with love!! Joe & Jeff are the nicest guys as well!!

Not to long ago I tried donut bar for the first time at the farmers market at downtown summerlin. I decided to follow them for a while, and after dreaming about their donuts for months, we mad it in. This place does not disappoint! The service was helpful and friendly. Come hungry. The donuts are massive! My hubby got the CrÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e, a yeast donut and I had a cake donut called, a buttermilk it was covered with some type of chocolate ganache. My husband decided to order. This is a must visit and lives up to the Instagram photos. Totally worth the check in.
Awesome place and vegan friendly . Donuts are fresh and huge. Staff was very helpful and full of smiles. If you have the time stay... have your donuts outside scenery is great.
Amazing donuts! I'd commute for these they were so good. Lots of variety and new flavors. Friendly staff and a clean facility. A bit pricy but unlike any donut I've had before
Awesome place for donuts!!! I would recommend the pb&j donut as well as the strawberry cake donuts. Friendly people and big delicious donuts!

Insanely yummy! Was able to sample three donuts (chocolate, maple and 'vanilla' with white icing) that appeared to merely-be oversized items that any supermarket store sells. I tried it out. I particularly didn't like it. The donuts were too high priced for what you got.
I went there this morning, I ordered three donuts and an Iced coffee. I paid for my meal, and come to my surprise, I only received two donuts and still paid for three. Not very happy with this place.
its true.. their donut was so good and the dough is very soft. i like most is the crume brulee
tried the one in San Diego last month, just tried this one yesterday.......soooooooooooooooooo good!!! Not as big of a menu as the one in San Diego but still super good with our fav's!!!!!
If you like donuts this place is a must. Just get there early as they will sell out of the choice donuts.
Got a chance to try Donut bar this morning and I must say it was soooo good. My family and I enjoyed it all. Also we received 3 free birthday donuts just for ordering. I can't wait to come back!

This place was legit. We showed up a little later so some most options were already gone. For the options that were left, they definitely lived up to the hype. I would highly recommend this place to anyone in need of a donut. They will impress!
Great selection! Fabulous donuts, coffee was good. What I love about this place is the variety, cheap price Go early to ensure you get what you want..... Friendly staff
Great Place to buy delicious donuts. They're so big and pretty to look at. You don't want to eat them. Will spread the word about this great place!
Cool spot. We tried an apple crumble and a crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e. Would highly recommend. Make sure you get there early. Once they sell out, you've gotta wait until the next day.
Go there in the morning, but after a few hours after opening, just plain really bad.
Shop faces Carson not 6th. We walked from Fremont took a few extra steps, but well worth it.

I had all but given up finding a nice, big cup of coffee for a reasonable price downtown until I discovered this place!!! I just moved about a block away and love swinging in for a cup of coffee on my way into work. They offer various iced coffee options (not really my style) including a "nitro" iced coffee on tap! Great staff. We got there late when most of the day's supply was already gone. But the staff was very friendly and still had some great options available for us. Also very affordable!
Pretty awesome, every donut I had was great! "The nitro coffee was killer,"says my wife. Try it you will love it.

Have been waiting for this place to open since I first heard that they were coming to town. It was everything I hoped it would be. Donuts both in classic and unique flavors. They were absolutely delicious. The Donut Bar is awesome - great donuts and awesome service. It's great to have them in DTLV!

Best donuts in town!! Joe and Jeff are awesome!! The French toast donut is out of this world we love every donut we tried they have a homer donut it's a awesome huge pink donut with sprinkles for only $3 can't beat it! The bathroom is one of the coolest things in there! They have milk on Tap! Very cool place and yummy donuts!
Super friendly and helpful staff. Typical gigantic donuts. The Poptart filled donut is actually delicious.
Awesome donuts. They really are as billed, the best donuts in the world. Terrific flavor combinations, wonderful atmosphere, accommodating staff. I just wish they were open later in the day.

This place is near Fremont street. Had to pay for parking out front, but it was only $1. We ordered the French Toast donut and two creme brulee donuts. The French Toast donut was AMAZING! The creme brulee donuts were not very good. The sugary top was very hard and the doughnut was honestly just not good at all. The 4 star rating is more for the French Toast....the creme brulee would have gotten 1 star. I'd eat here again. Their menu was awesome and they still had options around 10:15am on a Saturday morning. Go early though, certain donuts sell out quickly!

We've been to the original location in SD while visiting the area. I just want to Thank the owner for coming outside to tell us about your training and how your donuts are made, even give the few kids that were in line a cute free donut. It's nice to see new places downtown. The donuts were awesome. I ordered a vanilla latte also - excellent! I love that you have stump town coffee (one of my fav's and to find out you have it on tap! best donuts in Las Vegas!
Ok,little too much hype! I waited for a ver long time only to have a selection of two choices! Donought was good but not what I would have selected.
Amazing amazing amazing donuts!! BOMB.com I can't say anything else.. they were theeeeee BOMB SUPER GOOD!

This place is a lot of fun. The line was a bit long when we came, but I always take the as a good sign. They have a nice selection of interesting flavors and they have vegan options as well. We ordered a variety of flavors, the creme brulee, lemon pistachio, and strawberry strawberry split are my top picks. Their coffee is also pretty good. They are a bit pricey, but most of the donuts are huge, and they are pretty fancy donuts.

It was a bit hard to find but we kept looking after hearing so much about this place. We only ordered one donut (we were going to a breakfast buffet later!) to taste and it was hard to decide which one to choose. We got the birthday cake donut for $3.00. It was huge, fluffy, and delicious!

I have to admit I was a little hesitant going to the donut bar. After all, imho it had a large shoes to fill because of the prior tenant O Face Donuts. Sure, O face is now gone and one should not compare a defunct business to the next. But I cannot help it and I feel if you take the time to read what I mean, you may just end up agreeing. There is only one single difference between the two shops yet the difference is such a critical element. Creative originality. The Donut bar attempts to dazzle you with concoctions that are really just kids play. The creme brulee is creative in thought yet executed with no afterthought. Yea, the sugar is cool however only after one bite. Attempting to get through the constant crunch soon became annoying. I found myself trying to taste the center cream however once the sugar coating finally dissolved and my taste buds came to I found it to be just commercial custard filling. Very disappointing. The maple... O face had was one step ahead of everyone on this. When you go to a donut shop,no matter what part of the U.S. you go, you know what a maple bar taste like. It doesn't change and when you have one, you have had them all. O face however took the time to develop their own maple glaze which complemented the bacon. Donut bar..the same usual maple. The oreo cookie Jeez...how much sugar can you give? People, this is a regular glazed stuffed with an oreo cookie. mmmm Lard O face made donuts that were not only creative but containing other unique flavors. Mexican chocolate with horchata creme...yea, their own homemade horchata,not a tub filled with flavored gelatin goo Apple fritter. Dark. Happen to notice this to as the tray containing the fritters all looked the same,over done. To their credit, the inside was not overdone and actually the best of the group of donuts I had. In a nutshell, this is no O Face and probably never will be. I suppose this means I need to find something more on the level of my expectations. Which leads me to a final thought. Donuts that cost 2-4$ per should be on the level of artisanal. Otherwise, what am I paying for that I couldn't already get at Von's?
Donuts mmmm. So freaking good. French toast donut and mud pie wonderful. I've brew coffee was great.

Came here again because of my colleagues. Of course I decide to order donuts. This time I decide to try something different and ask questions. Don't ask questions because you will get attitude. My colleagues love the fact the girls demeanor changed to rude towards me. You sell donuts lady and you have a customer service job. Smile and put the donuts in the box and the cashier will ring me up. The donuts are good. Yes, they are because they are donuts. The workers there need to humble down. The previous donut shop had the customer service and the downtown vibe.
First time here, and it was awesome! I came a couple minutes after they opened and it seems they were hard at work setting everything up, the display was jaw dropping.

This is an amazing hidden gem serving up some amazing donuts. The variety and uniqueness is mouthwatering. The chocolate empire, homer and cream brÃ»lÃ©e were all delightful. The staff is very friendly. Pricing is very good.
this is probably my favorite donut place ever. absolutely delicious. will definitely return. only wish is that there was one closer to home ;-))
Price is good and blueberry cheesecake donut is to die for.

Just awesome. There are two sizes of donuts. My wife and I each had a small donut, a peanut butter cup and a blueberry meyer lemon, and a large chocolate indulgence donut. She couldn't finish her half. The donuts and two small coffees cost $9 total, tax included. The donuts were all great and the price was far below Vegas standards. Will definitely visit again. Beware, they sell out so you may want to call or order online ahead of time.
Very good fluffy donuts. I will be back. Beware they close when they sell out though!
Great customer service and awesome donuts! Had 4 different ones and took Erica's recommendation. Every single bite was pure joy! I will be back. Thanks Erica for great service!

I never got to try the donuts because the manager at this establishment was very rude. We were so excited to try these donuts so we showed up at 7 am on Sunday morning because when we called the day before the employee told us that we could preorder and pick up at 7 am. However, we decided to just to go right when they open. So once we got there we were greeted rudely by the manager telling us we weren't allowed in to buy any donuts since they don't open until 8 am. We then decided to call to make an order on the phone which the employee told us that we could pick it up right away even though they haven't opened. So we decided to place the order and were so excited waiting outside for our donuts: however, we waited for 40 mins and no one came out. We decided to give them a call back and the employee stated that the manager wouldn't allow him to sell us the donuts at that point we were fed up and decided to leave because they were rude and unprofessional. They should have given us a call back instead of making us wait for 40 mins. Now I will never go back to an establishment that has bad customer service even if they are rated highly.
These aren't awful donuts, but they certainly aren't the best. I've tried their donuts on three different occasions, and each time was a lackluster experience. Dry donuts describes it best.
Went here for the first time. A little difficult to find but really good donuts and everyone was friendly.

You have to see these donuts to believe them. On top of the sheer size of some of them, the selection is awesome and they taste incredible. So worth the visit. Don't get there late. You'll miss out and you'll regret it.

Located downtown right next to Carson's Kitchen downtown makes this quite the journey for me but I still do it. Love the maple bacon cronut! The best! They typically sell out of the most popular items really quickly. Almost everything is pretty much gone by early afternoon. If you want to get the goods head there early.

Thank you Donut Bar team for the tasty experience today. I know you were closing, but you still had a box of donuts to sell me and a free coffee. My son and I loved the donuts and that you let us hang out on the back patio even though you were trying to clean up and close for the day. Thank you for your hospitality. Vegas, support this business!!
