The smell when you walk in is amazing! I brought home four different kinds of their amazing donuts for my family to taste...the chocolate bacon, cake batter, mud pie and French toast donuts. My favorite the French toast donut which was made to order, so hot and delish! The cold brew great too! I can't wait to bring my family.

Interesting donuts for the adventurous donut eater in you. The staff was attentive and they had good coffee (not Maxwell house....). The location might be a challenge for folks on the strip but it was worth an Uber ride....

This place was ok from all the reviews I thought it would have been different and omg my 13 year old son had the bourbon donut and I know they said the alcohol is burned out but oh man this donut had my son acting and feeling weird he was not his self at all but I won't ever go back it's ok nothing to brag about

Popped in to try a vegan doughnut and tried the creme brulee. I'm sure it's more traditional creme brulee so the topping was crisp and hard. Not my cup of tea BUT someone else may love it. The vegan selection was smaller than I thought because there were only 2 options at the time I went in but it's nice they have some. The filling was good and the people nice. Again the review is based on my taste and preferring a glaze versus the crust of the creme brulee. So don't hesitate to try it.

A friendly donut shop with flavorful selections. Their donuts are thicker than something most would got from Dunkin Donuts or 7/11. Donuts range from $1 upwards to $5. It's a cozy little bar with stylish furniture. I recommend those visiting here to try this place out for breakfast, just expect nothing but donuts and coffee/alcohol.

We went overboard, but it was totally worth it! We limited ourselves to 6 (Big Poppa Tart, Salted Caramel, Creme Brulee, Maple Bacon, Pumpkin Spice Cream Cheese, Butterfinger) Our favorites were the Big Poppa Tart, Salted Caramel, and Pumpkin Spice Cream Cheese. The maple bacon wasn't anything unique and the butterfinger was a cake style donut, which we preferred as an afternoon donut. The creme brulee had no flavor (or maybe it did but the others were just that overwhelming) Overall it was amazing, the staff was very patient as we made our decision, well worth the early wake up and drive. We got there just after 7am and had no line, however while we were inside 4-5 other people came in.
i'm not a huge fan of donuts but these donuts are sent from heaven and i coild eat them everyday i love this place
Fantastic donuts! Even the most basic "models" are special and delicious. Friendly staff, super clean. Our new "must stop" the next time we pass thru Vegas.

My FiancÃ© and I have been trying to get to this place for a while now, and today we got the chance to experience what we now think are the best donuts we have ever had. We are donut people and this place did not disappoint. We got there early, probably 5 minutes after they opened and they already had about 10 people ahead of us. The staff moved quick and were very friendly. The donuts were all fresh, and we were surprised at how big they all were. You certainly get your money's worth. I tried the French toast donut which is made to order, as well as the cake batter donut and they both were amazing! I think they both still would've been amazing even if I weren't 7 months pregnant lol. My fiancÃ© tried the "big poppa tart" and the lemon cheesecake. He was surely satisfied! We will definitely be back!
So fresh, ... So good! I was not a fan of the bacon bar. It was not good and not worth the $4 price tag.

I am not even all that much of a donut person, but this place is AMAZING!!!!! The donuts are light and fluffy, not greasy and the flavors are absolutely delicious!! Drip coffee is $1 which is a very welcome surprise! I would stop by even just for the coffee because it is delic. The staff is so welcoming and friendly. I cannot say enough good things about this place. I tell everyone I meet to go try it!
Pretty good. The donuts were a bit 'fancy' for my taste, but I would visit again.

Creme Brulee in a donut....need I say more!!! Not a lot of seating, but I think it's more of a "to go". Very friendly and informative staff. A little pricey for donuts, but for donuts as unique as these TOTALLY worth it!

I've been reading all the rave reviews about this place. Went there around 10am. Our donuts were awful. The glaze/frosting on the tops were so dried out. It seemed like the donuts had been out since the day before. My husband ordered the maple bacon. The bacon in top wasn't even cooked all the way! The fat wasn't even rendered out of it! The maple was so dry it was cracked and caked off! Disappointing after reading how amazing it was.

Got there before it even opened because I was scared of there being a long line, luckily it was only about 10 people in line. The staff were SO quick and ready to take orders, you got through the line fast. Loved every donut we had, but especially the Butter Beer and French Toast donut. It's not in the strip but it is definitely worth going out of your way for!

What is the hype about? I have been want to try this place for a while and I was so disappointed. Got there at 1140 on a Friday so there were only three types of donuts left; Crete brÃ»lÃ©e, strawberry cheesecake, and Nutella overload. I wasn't disappointed with the lack of selection as I would have chose two if the three anyway. They were dry, and all disappointing in flavor. The brÃ»lÃ©e topping tasted burnt and not sweet and the cream was almost tasteless. The strawberry cheese cake was a jelly filled with cheesecake icing I guess? Not enough filling , couldn't taste anything like cheesecake, and the filling tasted cheap. The Nutella overload an underload with not enough filling. It was straight Nutella which was the only saving grace of the donut experience. They did have nitro cold brew which I tried and it was good but their cold brew was bitter and not smooth. Will not try this place again.
Great service and yummay sweets ! You can also preorder online to avoid the line ! Love it

We just enjoyed a sort of different types of Donuts to take advance of time.My favorite was an awkward donut with a pop tart inside that was just outstanding! the donuts with cream brulee was very good too.The coffee was perfect. Small but very clean. Very nice and friendly staff!

Busy place both times I visited but lline moved quickly. Wanted to buy a butter beer but they were out so that is a little disappointing but nice to have so many flavor varieties. Got a bostom cream...it was perfect, not too sweet. Customer service was good, prices fair.

even though i am trying to lose weight, me and my friends decided to give this place a go because of the great reviews. the concept of a donut bar is kind of unique and cool, so definitely worth a quick visit if you have nothing to do. the donuts were fresh and tasted pretty good. only had two because i wasn't feeling well but my kids ate a bunch, so going with their thoughts rather then mine on the taste!
SINfully delicious!! Amazing flavor combinations that you would not expect in a donut, but they work!
Amazing. Incredible. Best donuts ever. Pink box, move down because you have been unseated as best donut in town. It's not even close.

on a recent trip a friend said to stop by and try the donuts and give him my thoughts... well not a fan of the two donuts i had.... first i was surprised by the size of the donuts... huge. almost too big... i am not sure you can call them donuts.... doughnut planet in nyc has big doughnuts but these were far bigger..... the variety was varied and all interesting but the two i selected were flavor-less. vanilla bean and boston creme... the cakes of both had no flavor but the filling of the boston creme was delicious. the shop is cute enough and the people friendly but please donut bar invest in paper bags for the donuts..walking out of the shop with two donuts in a box seems like such a waste and not what the earth needs......

I absolutely love the donut bar! By far my favorite place to get some donuts. They have a crazy amount of donuts that are all different assortment of colors & flavors. I am super pleased every time I come here. You always get greeted with smiles & lots of energy. Even on holidays they dress up & make you feel awesome for being there. They had a margarita donut on cinco de mayo & I wish they would bring it back! But the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut is my all time fave! Always coming back to this place.

I visited Donut Bar last weekend, recommended by a friend. I stopped in for an early morning treat before due to a craving, and let me tell you it was perfect! The staff was extremely friendly and cheerful. There isn't much light in the cafÃ©, but the service was prompt and the interior was very clean. They were willing to help out with my choices as I had never been there before. They gave us samples of the fillings to try; some of the options include strawberry split or PB and J and even DB's Nutella donut. The atmosphere was warm and pleasant. The coffee there is outstanding and there are also a lot of choices. It came with an awesome flavor and acidity. It was definitely one of the best I have ever had since I moved to Vegas. The only short of negative thing I would note is that when it gets busy you have to wait in the line to order for quite a long time. Even though it gets pretty crowded, I guarantee you the wait is worth it!

When I found this spot on Yelp, I knew we had to try it. My husband and I love bubble waffles and unique ice cream flavors and this spot delivered. My husband and I got a Bubble Waffle with Black Sesame/Ube Ice Cream and Marzipan Whipped Cream. I loved all of it. I've never seen a place that makes flavored whipped cream before. It was delicious. I'd highly recommend checking out this ice cream shop.

Did you know they served Korean corn dogs? Because I did not. This is not a corn dog review but it's worth mentioning because they are trendy and, to my knowledge, Mason's is the only one doing them in Cleveland thus far. This is a review of the ice cream. Do you want interesting flavors? If so this is your place! To be honest I'm not sure how often they change the flavors but they're always innovative. I've had the black sesame but this time I got a small two scoop - malted chocolate and tahitian(...something). Yes I know these don't go together, we're not here to judge my pairing choices. The chocolate was malted and the tahitian flavor tasted like fruit punch (the person ringing me out wa definitely right when describing the flavor). The ice cream was great and it's getting g hot, why aren't you there every week??

Amazing ice cream! My partner and I went looking for local ice cream and happened upon this gem, just a few weeks after it had been featured on Guy Fieri's Diners, Drive-Ins & Dives. I'm a sucker for coffee ice cream, and I almost went with the Dalgona Coffee flavor. But, the ube and Thai tea flavors caught my eye last minute and I got both. The combo was SO GOOD. Think of pumpkin ice cream with less overly-sweetness. The ube is especially good. Bonus points for being the smoothest and creamiest ice cream I've had in a long time. Even more bonus points for a cute seating area with lots of dogs!

Ok..... by now if you follow me I always try and find places that have gluten free/ nut free places ... and if especially it's Asian!!! So now it's desserts and Ube!!! I'm so excited when I found this place and me and my cutie went and indulged in delicious items!!! I hope to try all the yummy flavors they have to offer!!!! I'm still glad I can eat diary! But yay for the rest. Woot!

Solid 11/10. This place lives up to the hype. We saw lines around the corner over the past few days but when we went it was totally empty. Probably the time of day or the fact it's much cooler today. So def keep that in mind! We were able to find parking on the street so again just keep that in mind in case it's one of the busier days! They have such a lovely selection of flavors! I got the mango lassi and ube in a bubble cone and my husband got the Turkish coffee & cookies 'n' cream in a bubble cone. Both were $8 each. You need 2 scoops to get the bubble cone. It's worth it though - they don't overstuff the scoops like a lot of other places and the ice cream was light and not too heavy! The cone was still warm and so delicious vs a hard, or worse - stale - cone other ice cream places have! They weren't offering the ramen but that is something I saw on their website as an offering. Today they were offering Korean hot dogs and they did have a vegan dog variety available. I would totally recommend this place to anyone who will be in the Cleveland area. It would def be worth the wait!

Ramen: waste of plastic and money. I really was SAD. I want to support any business that sells vegan ice cream, but the ramen and ESPECIALLY the RAW DOUGHY vegan corn dog was NOT IT. I feel that I was ripped off by these mushrooms in the ramen alone. I don't know who said they have good ramen, but that is an incorrect assessment. I do, however, recommend their ice cream. I cannot say enough good things about how creative the flavors are and variety. I feel so mean but it needs to be said do not get the ramen please. Get the ice cream!!!! Also the people working here were so kind and there is a nice cat outside. Dress warm because the heaters inside the tent where you sit are not on a lot of the time.

I went to Mason's for the first time this week to try their Korean corn dog and ice cream, and felt that I had a good time. I think the best thing about Mason's is the customer service. All of the employees were super friendly and helpful, especially after I told them it was my first time there. I got many recommendations for both my corn dog and my ice cream, and was able to try several of the ice cream flavors - I would literally go back just because everyone there was so nice and patient. I thought the ice cream selection was weaker when I went. I don't fault Mason's for this, but I would advise that you check their Instagram before making the trip to see the flavors beforehand since they rotate frequently. I ended up getting black sesame and chocolate butterfinger. It was good, but because very few flavors were super appealing to me, I felt I didn't get a true Mason's experience with my relatively safe and not-interesting combination. This was my first time having a Korean style corn dog and I thought that it was fun. My friend got a half cheese corn dog and I got a regular all beef corn dog and we really enjoyed them. We got them with panko and tried with ketchup, mustard, gochujang marinara, and buldak yum yum. The yum yum was good but I don't feel like it added too much. To my surprise I really enjoyed the gochujang marinara. If I ever got another craving for a Korean corn dog I would get one with the marinara, along with ketchup and mustard. If you've never had Mason's before, I would say it is worth a visit. They have unique flavors and it is overall a fun experience.
Just my favorite place in the world. I always get the ube and the bubble waffle- best way to start off summer.
Great ice cream flavors and neat local ice cream place! If you are into ice cream, put this on your list
Can't say enough good things about their ice cream! Everything is delicious. They are constantly expanding their menu. All the staff is beyond friendly.

My sister in law introduced us to this spot. This place is so good. I tried there cornbread ice cream and it was killer. The staff are super friendly and nice. The ice cream is super good. Please try some out of the box flavors because you won't be disappointed. They also have color changing spoons which was a super cool retro touch! I will definitely be back
Go, just GO! The Ubu ice cream was incredible, as was the Twinkie Cream flavor. Heading back with a friend tomorrow night- cannot wait

Love love love masons ice cream! If ice cream isn't enough to get you to stop by - their fun artwork and love of dogs should be! They have such unique and fun flavors, and have amazon vegan flavors too. Don't let the lines in the summer deter you - it's worth it!

Ok so it's really cool that they have vegan soft serve ice cream... but I had the weirdest most uncomfortable experience w the staff while there with my sister. Idk if the staff were new or not but it was odd for a first time going in there having to order with 3 different people before actually being helped even though there weren't other customers. When the third person asked me what I wanted I almost didn't answer bc it was like... alright... one more time... but then they made my ice cream.

Masons does it again! They've been doing a test run on these Korean cheese corn dogs (literally all over social media) and they really hit the nail on the head! I believe they're the only restaurant in the Cleveland area serving these! The cold noodles are vegan friendly and the noodles are perfectly chewy and seasoned so well! Pro tip: get to masons right at opening time to get your hands on the corn dogs--they sell out quick!!

Majorly impressed by the black sesame-- the rich nuttiness a complement to the creamy sweet of the ice cream base. What made it outstanding was the salt in each bit that elevated the savory of the sesame. Their other flavors were fun and true to their description. However, I'd say 3 stars not 5 for the soggy egg waffle, which was premade and sitting in a cup. The batter itself wasn't bad, but it had no crispness at all. Given the churros are made to order here, I thought the egg waffle would be too.

What a cute little place with interesting and tasty flavors. They offer a variety of fresh and unique flavors with different waffle types cones and cup sizes. There's plenty of outdoor seating and snacks if you don't want ice cream. It's a bit hidden in the historical district of Cleveland but definitely worth a try. Staff is very friendly and ice cream parlor very clean. Perfect for a date and great prices. I recommend the egg waffle cone with mocha Oreo ice cream.

I've been here for both ice cream during the summer and ramen in the winter. Mason's has a variety of unique flavors, including cardamom and thai tea, that change daily. The outdoor seating is nice for the warmer months. In the winter months, I had the veggie ramen, which is mushroom based. They also have pork and chicken options. The broth and soft boiled egg were super flavorful. The mushrooms themselves were a bit too chewy for my liking. Still a great meal and perfect for a cold winter evening. I went around 6pm on a Saturday and they only had enough of the veggie ramen for two more orders for the day, so keep that in mind if you're wanting the vegetarian option.

All hail the local ice cream gods of Cleveland, Helen and Jesse! To start, Helen and Jesse, the owners, are two of the most hardworking and kind folks in Cleveland. They care so much about their product, their customers, and being a part of the neighborhood. They've become such a key part of CLE's foodie scene and Ohio City's identity. While they have a storefront, you can also catch them frequently around fairs and other pop up events. You can literally taste the difference in their ice cream... that small batch, homemade love comes through in every bite in their classic, seasonal and vegan flavors. My favorites are the Mint Watermelon and Nutella...I could literally eat the whole tub if no one was looking. Wait, did I say that out loud? Once a month, they also do a Ramen "Night" (which actually starts early afternoon), where they serve until it runs out (so get there early. Trust me, there's a line). As if the ice cream wasn't enough, they easily have the best veg and non-veg ramen in Cleveland, totally filling that niche. Its buttery, flavorful, and tastes the way ramen should. Its a miracle someone finally accomplished excellent ramen in Cleveland. Only Helen and Jesse could casually do ramen on the side for fun, but still have fantastic ice cream. If you haven't checked this place out yet, what are you waiting for? The inside is small with limited space, so the next time it's a nice day, grab some ice cream (and maybe some ramen!) and sit outside to support this fantastic local business.

If you are looking for a fantastic and unique ice cream shop, stop by Mason's Creamery! Upon arriving, I was extremely surprised to not see any of the original flavors such as chocolate or vanilla on the menu. Instead there were unique flavors such as ube and cookie butter. I ordered the two scoops of cookie butter and peanut butter butterfinger and it was delicious. My parents also ordered the root-beer float with vanilla malt ice cream which was perfect for a sunny hot day. The service was very nice and patient and the ambience was a plus. They had nice outdoor seating in the back that made the environment feel homey and fun. You can tell the team of employees are working very hard to create new flavors. I would definitely return here for more deliciousness. Fun rumor: I heard they also serve ramen in the winter time. I will need to check that out for sure!

This was a disappointing bowl of ramen, especially for the price. The soup lacked flavor, but the toppings didn't--unfortunately they weren't flavors worth tasting (shoutout to the saltiest mushrooms in the Midwest). To top it off, everything was cold. If you're going to come here, I hope it's for ice cream, not soup.

One word: delicious!!! The ice cream at Mason's creamery is so tasty you won't regret trying it out. I got the small which comes with two scoops so I ordered Ube and Vietnamese Coffee as my flavors. Both were out of this word tasty. I think when it comes to Mason's, it's best to take a chance on the more "adventurous" flavors since thats where the payoff really is. While the ordinary flavors still taste good, they aren't up to par with their unique flavors. The staff were so friendly and helpful and were giving us samples of every single flavor we even looked at twice so we were able to make a great decision. Plus, the ambiance is adorable!

This review is for their ramen that they sell during the winter. They were doing an occasional ramen pop-up, but their ramen was so popular that they started selling it every weekend during the winter! I stopped in to give it a try. It was $12 for the tonkotsu and you can either sit at the counter or they have a covered patio with tables you can sit at if you've got a little group. So I grew up on packets of ramen. Square of hard noodles and a seasoning packet that you dump water onto and heat on the stove/microwave. The legit unprocessed version at Mason's is pretty tasty upgrade and definitely a comfort on a cold day. Also, they give you a whole egg, not half like some other ramen places. Mmm I could probably eat two bowls in a sitting. Friendly service. Just make sure you get there early to score a parking spot (and before they run out of ramen!).

Earl. Grey. Ice. Cream! Now imagine that sandwiched between two piping hot churros! The sandwich holds up just enough so that you get a instagram-worthy photo- but it's a hot mess after that. The churros are heated up when it's ordered so the heat from it melts the ice cream way too soon. I would suggest asking them to give it to you on the side or have them not heated up. I also tried the macaron sandwich. Earl grey definitely meshes better with the churro than the macaron. The owner was super friendly and took her time to explain all of the flavors and the development of their store. Fellow Californian! Unfortunately- none of the other flavors caught my attention besides the earl grey.

I feel like Mason's meets the 3 star definition of "A-Ok" pretty well. I had been wanting to go here for awhile. I am from CLE and am usually up there often visiting my family. My sister was raving about Mason's and said we had to go (we normally frequent Malley's in North Olmsted or Graeter's in Westlake). We had finally planned to make it there one weekend but their ice cream machine was broke! Noooo! However, a few weeks later, I was at Platform with my brother-in-law and I told him I wanted ice cream. He reminded me that Mason's is right over there. I was excited to give it a try! Overall, this place is a tiny little shack (which usually have the best ice cream!) but the kind of stuff they serve is "fancier." So I felt like its mom & pop shack appearance doesn't really align with the higher-end ice cream that they serve. It reminded me a lot of Jeni's with the unique flavors. However, I only counted about 12 flavors total and none really sounded appealing to me. I taste tested a few and opted for the Bday cake in a cookie sandwich. It takes a little longer for those to come out since they make it with warm chocolate chip cookies. After 5ish mins, they handed me my little ice cream sandwich in a paper boat dish. I was appreciative of that since I knew it would probably melt everywhere. The cookie sandwich was good. I was glad I got one scoop instead of two. Two would have been way too much ice cream, not enough cookie. However, I felt like this was a "snack size." On that particular day, I was kind of full, so it worked for me. But for the most part, I finished this in about 6 bites. So if you're wanting a big dessert splurge, this probably isn't the place to go. Otherwise, the cookie sandwich was good. Overall, I am not the biggest fan of Mitchell's but I think I'd even pick them over Mason's next time I'm in Ohio City. They at least have bigger servings and more flavors.
Best ice cream in Cleveland. They even have dog friendly ice cream for free if you ask! A must every time I come to visit Cleveland.

So I'm rating this based on my only having their ice cream and not their ramen (yet! I definitely will though! I want to be fair) I think that the idea of constantly switching out flavors is a cool idea, but I feel like the flavors could be so much better if there was more time to develop them. It's ambitious and obviously attractive, but I feel that it could be so much better. The last time I was there I had their matcha Oreo ice cream and it was good, (very generous with the amount of Oreo!) but the matcha was bitter. The spot is cute, and I'll for sure be back to try their ramen.

Super creamy thick ice cream served here along with eggwaffles, churro sticks, and affogato. Unique flavors like ube (purple sweet potato but tastes like a fruity marshmallow), marzipan, vegan soft serve options, and more. Fast service. Outdoor eating with some picnic tables and benches around to use.

The ice cream here is fabulous. They have very unique flavors here - the lychee flavor in particular was delicious. But.. the real reason I wanted to write this review was to comment on this restaurant's ramen night. Widely publicized in Cleveland foodie circles on Facebook, this little ice cream shop decided to take on a valiant endeavor during two weekends in the winter to try to introduce authentic Japanese ramen to the Cleveland community. I attended the second ramen night, and I am pretty certain there will be a third. While I applaud these guys for the effort, I unfortunately was disappointed by their ramen. The ramen broth was great, the meat was great (though a bit on the fatty side and I wished I had more of it), and the egg nearly perfect (slightly on the raw side). However, the noodles did them in. The noodles were doughy and quite unpleasant. I am hoping that for the third ramen night, these will find a different source for their noodles. Then I'd definitely be coming back for a second helping.
Love the flavors!!! They change them constantly and so delicious. The egg waffle is amazing

My cousin introduced me to this place a few weeks ago and I can't believe I'd never been here before! The ice cream flavors are amazing, so unique and everything we sampled was great! I can't wait to try it again!

Great tasting ice cream BUT expensive. 1 cone $4.50. The vegan option was a giant glop of slush. Nothing like ice cream at all and I've had a lot of vegan ice cream. Disgusting. Only a super small amount of flavors to choose from.

The unique flavors are what made this ice cream special. There were flavors such as rosemary sea salt caramel, Thai tea, and cardamom, and we were able to try as many as we wanted before choosing. All were delicious! I think the flavors change everyday, though, so you can never really know what to expect. It's a small place with outdoor seating, and staff were very friendly. I want to go back in the winter once they've transitioned to a ramen place!

Ramen: more like 3.5/5 Service: mostly self serve It's probably a smart idea for an ice cream store to try to offer something different when it's below freezing outside. I appreciate masons creamery efforts in expanding their menu for the winter, but their ramen broth could be improved on. Their tonkotsu ramen had generous portions, but the broth was a bit lacking in flavor. Maybe it should have been cooked longer. I've never had a vegetarian based ramen before, and I thought this was almost more flavorful than the pork based broth because of its strong mushroom flavor. Overall, decent ramen for Cleveland, but maybe I would just get ice cream next time.

I had heard about this place sporadically, but what finally prompted me to seek this place out was a combination of a friend's recommendation, as well as another friend from Indiana who wanted to get good ice cream in the Cleveland area. I was very impressed with what Mason's Creamery had to offer. Egg waffles, which are very difficult to find in the states, were sold here as a an accompaniment to the ice cream selection. The ice cream selection itself was very unique, as they made their own ice cream flavors and the selection changes on an almost daily basis. The Facebook page mentioned that Mason's was serving Ovaltine ice cream, something I really wanted to try as Ovaltine is a staple breakfast drink for me. While they didn't have Ovaltine available that day, I was able to sample hot chocolate flavored ice cream instead, something I had NEVER had before. It was very very good, and had all the flavors one might expect from a hot chocolate, only frozen. The salted caramel, a more common ice cream flavor, tasted a lot better than what I'm used to from other places, so I ended up getting an egg waffle with salted caramel ice cream, hot chocolate ice cream, and Nutella whipped cream. Talk about pushing the boundaries of ingredients and experimenting with brand new flavors. I'm often skeptical about new fusion styles, but Mason's nails it with the execution. The Nutella whipped cream has all the texture of whipped cream but all the rich flavors of Nutella. The egg waffle, rather than being stored and used like other waffle cones, is made fresh on order and tastes really soft and chewy. The salted caramel and hot chocolate flavors blended very well with the whipped cream, and the egg waffle absorbed all the flavors very well. Everything fit together super nicely, rather than being a mish mash of different flavors that were fighting each other for dominance. It's rare for me to have ice cream this good, and it definitely ranks among the best I've ever had. This place is HIGHLY recommended to anyone looking for a one of a kind ice cream experience.

Mason is a great ice cream shop that has an ever changing menu. But, for people like me who like the same kind of ice cream, it is a little bit harder to get excited to go to Mason's compared to some other ice cream stores in the area. I find the ice cream a little bit to ice ish. For those who love to try different and unique flavors this is the place to be. I know recently they had a bacon flavored ice cream that a friend of mine loved. The reason that I gave Mason's a higher rating than three stars is because of additional things that Mason's offers. For anyone who has a dog Mason's offers a free scope of ice cream for the dog. While I was house sitting for a friend I took their dog to Mason's twice. The dog was so excited that once he saw Mason's he started barking and dragging me to the store. Once we entered the employees were so nice and happy to see the dog enjoying ice cream. Mason's also offers outdoor movie nights during the summer. Recently, I was able to go watch Hocus Pocus with a group of friends. It was a nice alternative from going to the bars or staying home. While Mason's may not wow me in the ice cream department I will continue to go back because Mason's is great for the community and really cares about they people they serve.

So, I heard Guy Fieri tried this place out and it literally aired a few days before our planned visit and I wanted to give it a try. Best decision I made because they had vegan options, hand-dipped and soft serve The highlight of this visit was certainly our very pleasant encounter with Marjorie. She was super sweet and made this an amazing experience for my husband and I

Hard to review this place because it like two different establishments sharing the same building, depending on the season. Summer- Amazing ice cream. Not your typical flavors, most of the time they have various vegan flavors, exotic fruit and unconventional mixups that you would not expect. They always do have a few of the usual suspects but that's not why you go to masons Winter- Their ramen is top notch. A little pricy for the amount of food you get, but you can tell they really put a lot of time and effort into each component of the ramen

Came here around 8:00 on a Saturday, didn't have to wait long whatsoever, however when we were leaving around 9 the line was quite long. Lots of parking available, small place with good amounts outdoor seating, awesome chill staff. They are more than happy to have you try every flavor. I loved each one I tried- taro, captain crunch and havla. Ultimately went with the amazing marzipan and graham cracker soft swerve. Will definitely be back!

This is my favorite ice cream place in Cleveland's west side. My most recent visit was specifically to try the ube ice cream. I also got taro so I could taste the difference between the two. I prefer ube, which was more flavorful and sweeter to me. Also, it is a pretty shade of purple! There are many other unique flavors here, and it changes weekly. Vegan flavors are available too. The best way to keep up with the ever changing menu is to follow their Instagram. I'm hoping they bring back the green tea soft serve soon. The shop is small, with outdoor seating and no indoor seating. Parking only has about five spaces, so it is easier to park on the street. The shop itself is super cute and has artwork of dogs eating ice cream on the wall and on the cups. It's just a perfect spot to hang out at during the summer.

It's great to have another excellent ice cream option here in Cleveland. The location is great, the ice cream is creamy and delicious, and the picnic table seating makes for a great outing with friends or family. I highly recommend the affogato there, and the taro flavor is delicious and is something you won't find many other places.

I love love love masons, they just have it down. The noodles come out perfectly cooked and not overdone. They package things separately so you don't get soggy noodz, I mean lets be serious its all about the chewy noodles. The egg comes out perfectly not done, which is a staple in fantastic ramen! They have been going through a toppings shortage but they let you know and are apologetic. It doesn't take away from the ramen though, it's ammmmazzzziinngggg!! I just got the 7 dollar tea for the first time and for some reason I thought it would be in a little cup, like a starbucks drink? Boy was I in for a treat, it's a cute larger reusable glass container with real fruit. The tea was delicious and I would get it again in a heartbeat. Masons Creamery makes people happy. From soft serve (vegan) to pints (varies in flavor), you can't go wrong. GO FOR THE VEGAN COOKIES AND CREAM, my favorite ^_^

Summer Masons gets 5 stars. Winter Masons gets 5 stars. SUMMER: Super funky fun small batch ice cream with some wild flavors - changes almost daily. My husband loves the egg waffle and always adds peanut butter whipped cream on top. They have regular whipped cream but don't waste your time on that unless you're a vanilla ice cream type of human. I always get marzipan whipped cream. It's to die for. Super fun toppings. Small scoops but means you can try more flavors! WINTER: the ramen. Oh the ramen! It's so good. I love the veggie ramen it has so many different types of mushrooms. If you order it to go, they put the liquid broth in a separate container to make it real easy to transport and enjoy at home.

Masons creamery is the PERFECT spot for ice cream. They don't have all the traditional flavors you'll be looking for, but so all the flavors I tried were great. I got the Frosted Flake and it tasted like I was eating a bowl of Frosted Flakes. So good. They also have plenty of places to sit and eat. Great atmosphere for ice cream!

Little creamery full of tons of flavors! This place is legit,the ice cream is out of this world with all kinds of enjoyable items to pick from on the menu . Staff is cool and willing to help you make the right choice it can be a little overwhelming with all the sweets.

The flavors are unique and tasty. They carry vegan flavors if that's your thing. Guava is the best I have had this far. Vegan Oreo was alright for being non dairy. I loved oreo matcha. It's a bit pricey for the portion in my oponion, but I go when I want something different.

It took me awhile to warm up to Mason's. I'm a creature of habit and Mason's likes to switch up their flavors often! I've found that since their inside seating is area is limited, it's best to go to Mason's in warmer months when I'm really craving ice cream. When I'm eating ice cream outside in the cold with brain freeze, it ruins the experience and the flavor. Mason's always something unique to offer if you're in the mood for trying new things. I appreciate this as it forces me to try something new. Last time, I tried taro ice cream and was surprised that it was actually creamy without sugar overload. They also had some time of apple/cinnamon combo that was DIVINE. I had a few bites of my husband's ice cream and had to restrain myself from eating all of it. I believe they list their ice cream as all double scoops, but one time, they did just let me have one scoop so don't be afraid to ask. and try something new!
The ice cream is so unique and special and they even have pup cups! I cannot wait to try the ramen!

great flavors as always, though the vegan soft serve is pretty...soy heavy go to ice cream spot in Ohio city, and can't wait for the ramen conversion coming up. hope they keep serving some ice cream at the same time! there were covered picnic tables in back also have heat lamps, so plenty of space to still have ice cream and stay warm!

BEST ICE CREAM in Cleveland! I haven't had a single bad experience with their ice cream. They rotate their selection, and I've had the good fortune of trying most of the flavors they offer. My favorite: black sesame -- very good black sesame flavor! Their dark chocolate ice cream is the best chocolate ice cream I've ever had. I also enjoyed their Thai tea ice cream and avocado ice cream! Even their durian flavor ice cream was amazing! Every once in a while, they offer ramen, which is an added bonus! Think about it - RAMEN & ICE CREAM! How awesome is that?! The owners are some of the coolest people you'll encounter here in Cleveland! They greet you and offer samples of everything! They're also very responsive to Facebook messages to their business page. I love this place and their ice cream is seriously addicting! :D

Unfortunately I feel the quality for the ramen has gone down due to the discovery of rope in our tonkotusu. Hopefully they make sure this doesn't happen again but my appetite went away after finding that in my soup

Great ice cream with a strong variety of rotating flavors. Mason's Creamery is pretty well known locally for its unique flavor concept, and I think it more or less lives up to the hype. I've tried the ube and taro flavors so far (moderate preference for taro - the ube did start to taste a little paste-y by the last few spoonfuls), but I've also seen guava and sweet corn, among others. The ube and taro flavor were strong but not to the point where they were overpowering, and the ice cream had a satisfyingly thick consistency. The restaurant itself is more of a stand. The building contains a small indoor area that contains the kitchen and space for a line, but it doesn't offer immediate seating. When you walk outside, there is indoor seating in the form of a nearby tent with tables and chairs, as well as a few outdoor benches.

I really wanted to come here after I heard that there was an option to get your ice cream served on top of egg waffles! They did not disappoint. Since my family and I came here right after dinner and birthday cake, we were already pretty stuffed, so we all shared. We got marzipan (almond) and black sesame ice cream. The black sesame was really good, but wow, the marzipan blew me away. It had a rich almond flavor and wasn't too sweet. It went perfectly with the hot, fresh, egg waffles. I also loved the whipped cream on top. This is a small local business that makes its own ice cream in small batches. I hear that the flavors rotate every day, so there is a lot of variety. It is quality stuff and I will definitely be back here as much as possible!

Finally tried it! I didn't expect it to be in a cool, 50's ice cream shop! It was busy, but there were quite a few tables outside and the line was quick. We had the ice cream cookie with banana ice cream and the vanilla ice cream cone- both were so good!

First of, I just want to begin with the fact that the staff was really friendly. it's a cute little ice cream spot and I think because we went there a little late they were basically out of all their flavors except for banana pudding and I believe it was cookie grams are graham crackers. by the way my husband decided to get their tea of the week with their ice cream and we felt that both of it was delicious. The main reason why I'm giving this place for stars is because of the fact that we could not finish the tea that they gave us because it wasn't such a large mason jar HOWEVER, when I had asked if they had a to-go container they just gave me a lid for the Mason jar so I can take the entire thing home. That liters made my entire night and I was so happy!!!!! It's such a cute concept. They do sell ramen there as well which we thought was random and weird ,but they must be doing something right if a lot of people who were coming in to the location was ordering their ramen noodles. I'm not giving 5 stars because the bathroom situation was REALLY WEIRD. they have a restroom in the kitchen area which was supper congested so if you are claustraphobic I do not recommend it. I will definitely be going back here but next time I think we will be there a little earlier during the day so we can try other flavors.I do wish that they did have chocolate on hand as extra because it's rare that you hear about a store running out of chocolate ice cream. Other than that it was a great spot.

Mason's is everything an ice cream shop should be. Ice cream is made in small batches. Flavors are creative and often unique (changing all the time and too many to list - vegan ones too). You can even suggest some! And it's all made with the care, time and precision of someone who loves the craft (this also comes through in their must-try soft Asian style egg waffle and Mexican cinnamon dusted churros). Mason's is about more than ice cream -- everyone who works there is warmly welcoming. There are a few seats inside and lots of seating outside. It's a real anchor/backbone for the neighborhood. It's like they're hosting a regular mini block party or family bbq or you'll feel like you're stopping by the living room of family friends. When the weather turns cooler, keep an eye out for the ramen nights (hopefully more and more of them). They sell hundreds of bowls in just a couple hours!

Mason's Creamery is probably one of my favorite places in Cleveland. I thought I had written a review years ago, when I first tried it, but guess not! First of all, I'm truly inspired by the owners, Jesse and Helen, who took this corner shop from what seemed like a dingy, run-down building, to a bright and colorful beauty of what it is today. And it's thriving! I hope to do something similar in the future. Serving small-batch experimental ice cream flavors when the weather is nice out and switching to a full-time ramen shop in the winter. They still have one to two options of soft serve and ice tea to sip on the side during ramen time. Every time I come here, they're adding something new - from finishing the outdoor area with the benches, to the mural on the side, to patio area that extends the indoor seating (with heaters in the winter). What I love the most, is that they take suggestions for flavors and actually make them a reality - from cereal flavors, to beer infusions, from tea flavors - you name it! My favorites have been their thai tea and vietnamese iced coffee flavors. They really are small-batch because I once went two days in a row and the thai tea one was OUT (heart breaking, right). The staff has always been so friendly and welcoming - for example: one time my friend had gotten so excited to try one of the three scoops she got in her cup...and she dug into the top scoop, which immediately fell on the floor. They replaced it, without charge and without making a big deal about it. Their blueberry sorbet was the best I've ever had before. It tasted like actual blueberries and was super refreshing - not like some of the artificial flavors you get elsewhere. If you're feeling really extra, get the churro ice cream sandwich, with your choice of ice cream. And/or, order churros on the side with the chocolate dipping sauce. Yuuuumm!! They make the churros fresh, so note that there will be a short wait for it (the wait is worth it). For their ramen shop, don't be afraid to try the veggie ramen - that broth is PACKED with flavor. I actually like it better than the pork one. But I like to compromise and order the veggie ramen and add pork belly to it, for an additional charge. They have chili oil available if you want to add some spice to your ramen. I'm already planning when I'm going to Mason's again to grab the ramen before it's gone. But that just makes me even more excited for the warmer weather, seeing all the doggos who visit, and, of course, the ice cream!

Two words ! Egg Waffle!!!!!!!! My handmade waffle was also amazing but my boyfriend got a handmade egg waffle with cookies & cream, graham cracker and whipped cream... imagine your best brunch waffle wrapped around ice cream. And when your ice cream melts and the waffle absorbs it BAAYBEEEE. This is ice cream haven...

Fabulous flavors offered! So many new and inventive combinations were offered so I tasted 3-4 varieties before I chose. I chose two, the black sesame and the brown butter. (A small is $4.50 and allows for 2 flavors) While it's not as creamy as other small-batch ice creams I've tasted, it's packed with flavor. Workers were friendly and helpful. I'd love to return and taste the other seasonal flavors.

Seriously good ice cream. If you're looking for new and interesting flavors, definitely check this place out! Compared to Mitchell's and Tremont Scoops, Mason's is more expensive and doles out smaller portions. However, this place doesn't serve the typical flavors everyone expects. It has milk chocolate, but also dark chocolate, black sesame, taro, Thai tea, pistachio, almond baklava, popcorn, rose water sorbet, cardamom and so much more! They're always changing up and trying new flavors here and I'm excited to come back and see what else they've discovered. Because apparently, all of their flavors are good. I haven't had a single one yet in which I felt disgusted by. So it's $4.50 for a small which is two scoops and they have a large size and a cone for $1 extra (which is nice and buttery). They also make root beer floats and ice cream sandwiches with different "cookie" options. It's small but still formidable. And the outdoor seating is cute too! The whole atmosphere reminds me of going to an ice cream place on the beach. It's on a street corner in a not too crowded location, no crowd at all since it's a stand alone store. I would definitely recommend coming here if you want quality ice cream and new flavors. It's nice not to get cookie dough for once, you know?

Amazing flavors. Service is great. Small, cute ice cream shop in the middle of a neighborhood with cute lights outside. Great place for a quick pit stop for a yummy treat. I love the workers here. They are very kind. I never thought I'd ever try a Hazlenut Baklava ice cream, but I did and it was DELICIOUS. There were tiny baklava pieces in the ice cream. If this is still a flavor, I highly recommend it!!
Came here with my family on a hot day, service was extremely fast, extremely nice and answered all questions... the UBE ice cream with the eggwaffle is phenomenal!!!

My wife and I came here as we were highly recommended to come here while visiting Cleveland. Just an average ice cream place. The ice cream was half melted. The shop was cute though. Disappointed. The waffle cone did not feel very crisp or fresh either.

Definitely a very good ice cream place in the Ohio City/Hingetown area! However, if you want some traditional ice cream, this might not be your place. Most of the flavors here are very unique, but very good! I know that every time I come to Mason's, I'll be able to try something I've never tried before! Also, they have a great wall that's just perfect for Instagram!
The best ice cream ever. If you get there make sure you get the egg waffle with your ice cream it is amazingly delicious. They also have ice cream for dogs

Ice cream is one of my favorite food groups. If you want to try some crazy awesome flavors of ice cream and sorbets, like taro, flan, halva, Brie & jam... Mason's is the place to go. They let you sample any flavor and with all the interesting options, I feel like take advantage of this, you know, to make sure I make the right choice. They nail the flavors! The staff is friendly and down to earth which is a big bonus. As I said, I love ice cream, you could give me a bucket of value vanilla and I'm happy camper... but Mason's ice creams are always a flavor adventure. However, the most impressive thing is Mason's events and philanthropy. They have ramen nights, show outdoor movies in the summer, and host fundraising events with corresponding flavors and unique eats (please bring back the choco-taco and PB whipped cream!!) I got my bike tuned up there for a donation to help a girl who got in a serious bike accident. All that is more impressive than anything I can shove in my mouth. I love supporting a local business, supporting great causes, and if I HAVE to eat ice cream in the process... I'll enjoy every bite!

It has been more than a year since I left my original review (preserved below) for Mason's Creamery. If anything, I like Mason's more than ever. Here's a comprehensive review of my year with Mason's Creamery. -- Short & Sweet: These are good people who care about their community and who provide a unique and high quality product at a reasonable price. As long as they keep it up, I will continue doing my part by eating their delicious ice cream (and sporadic ramen.) It's a sacrifice, but someone has to do it. (PS they'll let you sample whatever you want, so be adventurous!) --- Full Update: Last year I tried at least a couple dozen new flavors, enjoyed many good conversations with friends on the benches outside, told everyone who would listen that they HAVE to try Mason's if they're true foodventurers, converted a few people to love Mason's as much as I do, and only missed one of their ramen events. This year, I expect more of the same. What's so great? The ice cream, for one. Every single flavor I have tried - even the ones that weren't my cup of tea - were very high quality, excellent texture, and unique to Mason's. The prices are reasonable and the staff is always friendly. It gets better... in the last year, I have interacted with the Mason's crew on social media. The owner regularly praises his crew. He respects them, understands their value, and sees them as a family in some ways I think. I feel great supporting a business where employees are treated with kindness and respect. These are good people who care about their community and who provide a unique and high quality product at a reasonable price. As long as they keep it up, I will continue doing my part by eating their delicious ice cream (and sporadic ramen.) It's a sacrifice, but someone has to do it. My Original Review: This is a local gem that should be on every Clevelander's (and every visitor's) list. I've been wanting to try it for a while... everything and more I hoped it would be. They let us flavor anything we wanted. Considering the unique flavors, that's a great policy. I settled on sweet potato marshmallow ice cream in a waffle cone (I swear it tastes JUST like it!) My wife got an affogato with white russian ice cream. The staff was really friendly - no snobbery! They gave excellent customer service. It was a fun outing even though it was freezing outside.

Mason's is a real treat! Delicious, quirky, fun - my favorite ice cream place in Cleveland. Always serving a variety of different and unique flavors - all delicious. Egg waffle adds a certain flair. The fact that it becomes a Ramen shop (also super delicious - I recommend) in the winter an added bonus! Love coming here!
Flavors are interesting and tasty. And there are good vegan options. You can't go wrong!

Exterior/Location: West side Ohio City Interior: small, not particularly pretty...but they have ice cream Vibe/Ambiance: hip and artisanal Staff: younger kids that know and love their ice cream Clientele: Anybody Price: truthfully, I didn't pay... So I didn't pay attention Must get items: maybe another flavor than the Vietnamese coffee Why I love or hate it: I hate to give this place less than a stellar review. I have read so much good on Yelp, so I was confused why I might be the only person who is not gushing over Mason's. I got a small cup of Vietnamese coffee and chocolate. My ice cream seemed like it lacked cream. It tasted like ice crystals! I actually threw half of it out. Maybe it had frost bite? My entire family was sort of disappointed. It's tough to mess up ice cream. I'm not sure how they did. On a positive note, the staff was super nice and cool. They let people suggest flavors for them to create. I'm glad I tried it, but for the calories... I'd rather eat Jeni's ice cream in Chagrin Falls. Final thoughts: Not worth the calories.

So dangerously within walking distance of most parts of Ohio City, including my own! You will be hard pressed to find flavors as unique and inspired as those at Mason's Creamery. My faves so far this summer in a two-way tie: Cocoa Puffs and the chocolate lavender. I love the standout topping options too. I've had chocolate ganache, peanut butter whipped cream, various cereals and Nutella whipped cream. DELICIOUS! The outdoor area is lovely too. There's several tables and heaters throughout, if you're coming on a chillier day. The customer service is always tops too. The servers seem very knowledgeable about not just the flavors but the processes by which they were created. They're also super generous with the toppings. It's date friendly, kid friendly, riding-solo-friendly :)

The most delicious vegan soft serve I've had in quite some time. Opted for the coconut / pineapple swirl and it was a definite hit on a 90 degree Cleveland day. Eager to come back and try more flavors!

What can't this place do?! Their ice cream selection in the summer is insanely delicious, but then when the weather turns they go and make warm and delicious ramen too?! We've been waiting for them to turn back into their winter ramen, and placed an order online to-go and it was such an easy, seamless process. The food...wow! The broth was delicious and all the ingredients were simple, fresh, and so good! A must do for take out!
Big fan of their vegan soft served!! The staff is very friendly, and the outdoor seating area is a very quaint place to sit and enjoy your treats :)
Their corn dogs and ice cream are amazing! The staff is also very nice and helpful too.

This place was awesome and unique drive up the road it is on and seeing the shop what like seeing the end of the rainbow . I really liked the rube ice cream and I wanted to try their matcha ice cream but they didn't have it so that gives me reason to come back. I am definitely come back and I suggest going and enjoy their ice cream oh and a egg waffle, I had that too and that was good with my ube ice cream.

***5 stars for the ice cream, 4 stars for ramen**** I visited Mason's for the summer to try their ice cream. I was able to have flavors like rosemary sea salt, thai tea, cardamom.... such unique flavors that made it hard to pick favorites! They always have a few vegan options, including a soft serve. Their flavors change almost daily, which they usually post about on Instagram if you wanna know before you go. But Mason's decided that making bomb ice cream is too easy, so they switch to a ramen bar in December! I am a ramen lover and studied abroad in Japan so my expectations tend to be a little high. But for Cleveland, this ramen is pretty good!! I had the tonkotsu, which is pork-based, but they also serve chicken and veggie ramen. The broth was pretty thick and flavorful, noods were good, the pork was ok, but the seasoned egg was an amazing morsel of salty deliciousness. I'd go back just to eat the egg!! Make sure to add the spicy oil and powder for extra flavor. Overall, I've had better ramen, abroad and in the states, but Mason's is probably as good as it gets in CLE.

The ice cream flavors were so fun and unique! I loved the Ube and tried rosemary olive oil and it was so good! Will say the portions are a little small for our liking, but overall fun spot in Ohio city!

Easily one of my favorite ice cream spots in Cleveland with an amazing variety of different flavors...all the time. My personal favorites (I'm a bit boring) has been the Green Tea, Thai Coffee, Marzipan, and Black Sesame/Olive oil (weird I know!). They will let you try whatever you want, so if you are unsure of what you want definitely ask to test some. Favorite Menu Item: Macaron Ice Cream Sandwich. Last time I checked they were still testing around for macaron shells since Coquette Patisserie closed, but still worth it.

Wow, it has been six years since my original review for Mason's Creamery, shortly after their debut at the Cleveland Asian Festival. Since then, they've expanded beyond the mobile ice cream pop-ups and have opened a retail store. They do a great job and have earned a loyal following, not just for their delicious and creative ice cream flavors, but during the cooler months for their savory, hot, and comforting ramen noodles - so popular that they often sell out. They closed for about a week when they need to do a season change in order to transition from ice cream counter store to ramen bar. The added seating in the front is much welcome and needed to make room for their legion of fans. For ice cream, they added freshly cooked egg waffle option (a traditional yummy Hong Kong style waffle that has many round pillows of goodness) that gets folded into a cup and in the middle of which, the ice cream scoop(s) are placed. Very tasty with a delicious fresh still warm waffle in contrast to the ice cream. Additionally, they added Affogato (espresso poured over ice cream). They have dozens of constantly rotating flavors to try. I'm adding a photo of my purple Ube Ice Cream - unique and yummy - in a fresh warm egg waffle. So good. Also includes my extra caffeine kick with an Affogato over salted caramel ice cream.
I absolutely loved Mason's creamery. I had the egg waffle cone with matcha oreo and mocha Oreo all topped with ube whipped cream. So so yummy!

Only better ice cream I've had is jeni's in Columbus, and that is a maybe. All the flavors were spot on, I ordered the red velvet and cinnamon toast, and just as I was about wrapped up I spotted a brown butter pretzel that looked to legit, so I asked if I could get a taste even though I already had decided. The friendly staffer behind the counter was happy to oblige but warned me I might regret my earlier choices. He was right, so good! Rich smoky butter with salty pretzel chunks mixed in, awesome comfort food in a frozen package. So I ended up with a third scoop, poor me. Then I met the owners who are super nice and shared their back story, all around great experience and I'm glad I stopped by. My Mitchell days are gonna be a lot fewer now, or I'm just going to have a heart attack from ice cream overload.

This place makes homemade fresh ice cream with unique blends everyday, along with homemade waffle cones. Five stars isn't enough of a rating. I'd easily give it six. I chose the Taro and Rhubarb Streusel flavors. They also serve dairy free options (they had four at this particular time). I'm from Utah and I can only wish that we had a replica of this place where I lived. Super friendly staff, superior customer service by Jesse (not the Mason Jesse), and easy transactions. The ice cream is classic and beyond delicious. It is not too sweet and has the right amount of flavor to satisfy your palette. The atmosphere is a combination of nostalgic, traditional, and trendy.

I can't believe I just found out about this place!! Their ice cream is homemade and is more delicious than sweet Moses or Mitchell's. I loved their dark chocolate and pecan pies. People there are so friendly as well :)

The location, the shop's vibe, the service, and of course the ice cream were all so amazing. My boyfriend and I walked in and were greeted by some super friendly workers who offered to give us tastes of "everything"! And we took them up on that! Actually, we only tried about half the ice creams but they were all so delicious. What impressed us were the assortment of flavors! French toast, tamarind, chocolate lavender, tres leches, and dunkaroo! They got me with the nostalgia; we got a dunkaroo chocolate chip cookie sandwich. Seriously one of the best things I've ever eaten! I know they also have a ton of "sandwich" cookie options, freshly made waffle cones, churros, and espresso! Yes please! Can't wait to go back!
Matcha Cookies N' Creme was definitely one of the more unique and delicious things I've tried.
Ice cream sandwich from freshly made and warm churros. Lemon ricotta ice cream. So fresh so clean so good. Always wanted flavors at this place and great atmosphere in Ohio city

Ive been to Masons in the summer several times for ice cream and it's always been good so I decided to head out and try their winter ramen. They have a short list of options all about $12. I opted for the chicken shio and my husband got the tonkotsu. The bowls were a good portion and had veggies and meat, but the star here is their marinated soft boiled eggs, delicious! My chicken ramen was a bit bland compared to the pork, which was a more hearty flavor overall. I would like to see the option for extra veggies or noodles. Good food, good service and ice cream for dessert, what's not to enjoy?

A must go-to place if you ever visit! I always stop by here whenever I'm in Cleveland. The ice-cream is so well-made with unique flavors. Whatever flavor they try, the ice-cream captures and highlights that flavor well. It changes all the time (they'll rotate through flavors). There's been Thai tea, sesame, earl grey, so many to list. There are options for waffle cone, egg waffle, affogato....I'm a fan of the egg waffle. It's the only place in Cleveland that I know that has egg waffle ice-cream and the batter is definitely on-point. I've met the owners when they first opened and they are so great with customers! They let me test-taste new flavors they were experimenting with and took in suggestions! The other workers are always so friendly :) - so patient when I'm trying out all the flavors. I feel like the overall atmosphere is so reflective of Cleveland's heart and soul! The area is a little small with limiting seating area but it's just such a warm, lively little store that I think that is not a negative aspect.

Mason's Creamery is amazing. Awesome place. I try to go here if I am randomly in the mood for ice cream. This time I had a chance to try the French Toast flavor with a scoop of strawberry and it was absolutely delightful! I amazed by how smooth the French Toast ice cream was. Very nice. Very nice, indeed.

We went here for the ramen that I have been drooling over on Instagram. For the winter season they do ramen Wednesdays-Sundays. We have been to many places for ramen in Cleveland and also in other states as well and I have to say that Masons was pretty good! I ordered the Tonkatsu and my boyfriend ordered the chicken and both had very rich broths with nice tender pork and springy ramen noodles. My only criticism would be that I though the pork broth was a bit salty. I've also been here many times for ice cream with my niece during the summer so make sure you drop in then as well. Masons offers a great variety of unique and traditional flavors and they also make this churro ice cream dish that is to die for. Everyone is always so sweet and nice here and they have a great area to sit outside as well.

Mason's served me the blandest ice cream I've ever tasted. I wanted to like this place. It's local, seems to be in a great location, has a cool vibe and seating, and is close to our friends' place in Cleveland. Their website even shows that they have gained some local notoriety and Alton Brown likes them. That would seem to be a recipe for fantastic ice cream. The problem was product. Hunny and I got two different flavors (green tea and Vietnamese coffee). Both had an icy texture rather than a creamy texture, and both were practically flavorless. Hunny said there was only a "suggestion" of flavor. This is a fair criticism based on the two flavors we tried. Baskin Robbins is better than what we got that evening. Seriously! Clearly Mason's is doing pretty well in the media, which presumably comes from being more "hit" than "miss." I'm hoping we just got a bad batch. On the plus side, there are unique ever-changing flavors, dog treats available for your pups, and vegan options for those so inclined. The owners seem to be creative and passionate about their craft, which I respect no matter what you're serving. I'd be willing to give Mason's a second chance, but the ice cream would have to blow my mind next time to get them to four stars. I feel like I wasted my money - their product ain't cheap.
The ice cream and bubble waffles are great!! My only complaint is one of the workers poor attitude.

The ice cream was outstanding!!!! A little gem nestled in a neighborhood. There is no parking lot or indoor seating. So plan on finding street parking and sitting at benches outside. No restrooms. On a gloomy Tuesday night service was fast, but I imagine this tiny corner operation being packed on a warm summer day. Wanting to try something unique, I got the Ube flavor in a cone. A beautiful lavender color and sweet flavor! A must stop when in CLE.

Fun space in a very charming part of Ohio City. It's mature tree lined on a one way street. There is parking off street or on the south side of the building. Mind you, we went on a Saturday night. The line was massive. After waiting 40 minutes, I was super excited for my choice. And wouldn't you know it, the person in front of me got the last of it! Me and my big trap shouldn't have told my BF why I was so excited to try it ....grrr. So the lady was super nice about having me try samples but was deflated and no longer excited. The ice cream we got was very good. Portions are the kind that make you wish you would have ordered two. Not sure if I will ever wait that long again. But would like to give it another shot

Dang, this place is yummy! After two visits to Mason's Creamery, I've decided that the best thing about them is that they have really awesome and unique ice cream flavors. Ranging from black sesame, ube, mocha oreo, lavender lemon to strawberry, cookies & cream, and Thai tea, the rotating flavors give you something exciting to look forward to trying. The ice cream is creamy and smooth. They mostly do 'hard' serve (but I wouldn't call it hard, like I said, it's so smooth!) and one or two soft serve flavors. They also have churros, milkshakes, and egg waffle cones on their menu. I've heard that they also do Ramen, but because of stupid Covid, I don't believe that is currently true. The staff here is friendly and I really like the vibe of this place. It's located on Bridge Street real close to Lorain Ave. Park on the street, grab your treats and either take them to go or have a seat outside behind the building.

Kitschy, fun, yummy. Mason's Creamery has friendly staff that will be okay if you ask to sample 4 flavors (which I did! And they were so nice about it!) You'll find a rotating schedule of unique flavors from French toast to Cleveland Whiskey and seasonal options too. And soft serve! And usually the waffle cone is just the crunchy ice cream holder, but here it held its own! So so good and way better than other cones I've tried. Only downside is I wasn't super crazy about the flavor options on the day I went, but it did allow me to stray from my usual flavors I get. But still! All the more reason to come back.

Excellent ice cream unfriendly service. It had vibes like the soup episode from Seinfeld. I thoroughly enjoyed the ice cream but the service was quite stiff. Please lighten up. It's ice cream supposed to be fun.

So I went to Mason's for the first time today, so I can only comment on their ice cream. But, as far as the ice cream goes, it was fantastic! We got there right as they were opening, and thank goodness we did because it was already busy by the time we got there (it's just that popular). We only had to wait a few minutes, and then we were able to place our order at the window. They're keeping up well with COVID procedures, by the way. Marked spots on the sidewalk where people should wait, masks required. I ordered the matcha Oreo ice cream in the eggwaffle with flavored whipped cream on top (it was some sort of almond flavored whip), and it was an absolute dream. My roommate ordered the lemon ricotta flavor and loved it as well. Bonus - the spoons are color changing! Not a huge thing, but a cute touch that just shows their attention to detail and penchant for whimsy. Overall, my roommate and I both loved our ice cream and experience, and we'll definitely be coming back soon!

Must get a Churro ice cream sandwich. It's so good! Mocha cookies 'n cream and oatmeal cream pie flavors are so unique and delicious. Love this place. One of the best in Cleveland especially if you're looking for something different.

For the winter, it's a ramen shop! They've had multiple ramen pop-ups in the past couple of years but I've never been able to come, so I was very excited to try it. Came with a friend on a Thursday night, pretty limited seating, so we had to wait for a little bit. There's a bar with 8 seats or so, and a 4 or 5 small tables set up. They had a tonkotsu, chicken shio, and vegetarian option for ramen. Of course we both had the tonkotsu. I was actually super impressed with the tonkotsu ramen, considering this is Cleveland (haha sorry not sorry). The broth was perfect, rich and savory and meaty, without being too salty or greasy. The tonkotsu ramen came with a piece of Charsiu, marinated soft boiled egg, corn, seaweed, enoki mushrooms and green onion. The ramen noodles were nice and chewy. The Charsiu was so tender and melt-in-your-mouth. The egg was a perfect soft boil and so flavorful! Everything was what I was looking for (but afraid to expect) in a ramen. And I didn't even feel bloated afterwards! Wish there was a little more meat though. There was a chili oil and a chili flake/powder (w cumin, Sichuan peppercorn, salt) that you could add to the ramen. I liked that it wasn't super spicy, so you could get a lot of flavor without burning your mouth. I added both to my ramen. My friend also got the iced tea, which comes in a huge glass bottle, and you get to keep the bottle! I didn't try it because I was feeling sick, but she enjoyed it. Anyways I loved this, 10/10 would come again.

Mason's is just about as charming as they come with it's homemade ice cream, one-of-a-kind flavors, and a cute picnic tables. The waffle cone is outta this world.. they make their own and the batter has layers of flavor. A small ice cream gets you two scoops: I tired the Laro and Brownie Batter. Laro is like a more flavorful vanilla and is a popular Asian fruit... you'll see strong, surprising Asian influences on the flavors! Overall, I'd say I enjoy Mitchell's actual ice cream flavors better but Mason's is a true experience and the cone is to die for!! And really, this is fantastic ice cream. We are a bit spoiled in Cleveland by plenty of incredible ice cream options. We noticed an egg bubble waffle being served up as well, so we will be back to try it for sure! Bonus.. if you enjoy bike riding there is a UH bike docking station at Mason's!

Cute little place in Ohio City within a good walking distance of West Side Market. They have awesome flavors here. I got a churro sandwich Taro+Matcha-Oreo & my boyfriend got a churro sandwich of Thai Iced Tea+Cap'n Crunch. SO. GOOD. Even without the cereal, the ice cream STILL tasted like Cap'n Crunch!

I am not a big fan of ice creams but I felt like trying this place after reading reviews and I am glad I tried it. I had the egg waffle with a scoop of french toast and raspberry vanilla. The egg waffle was marvelous, soft and melted in mouth. Together with ice cream it was an amazing blend of flavors. I am definitely going here again. They also has a masala chai flavor which was a new fresh flavor.

So glad we stopped here! The ice cream flavors were unique while still being delicious. The Thai iced tea flavor, topped with sweetened condensed milk, was my favorite. The color-changing spoons were fun, too!

Updating my review from four to five stars because I was back for another visit last night, and I was excited to see interesting, creative, and yummy flavors. I was also impressed with the improved texture of my ice cream this go around. I got the lavender ice cream which absolutely delighted my senses and my hard-to-please elderly friend enjoyed his oatmeal cream pie ice cream "very much". I can't wait to go back and try some other flavors (blueberry mint, lucky charms, frenvh toast, etc.), or a cookie ice cream sandwich, affogato, or a waffle cone.

What a great local ice cream shop. Love the artisinal small batch flavors they make. Nice selections all the way from your normal dark chocolate to Vietnamese coffee. And a variety of vegan flavors from vanilla with sweet sriracha sauce to mint watermelon as well. A nice variety of ice cream sandwich option and the awsome egg waffle.

I am not a huge ice cream fan, but I must say I crave this place often! The ice cream flavors change constantly and they allow you to taste as many of them as you would like before you order. They make everything there fresh. The cookies and churros for ice cream sandwiches as well as the egg waffle cones, which is the most delicious way to enjoy ice cream. It's warm and flaky combined with the cold, sweet ice cream. We tried the baklava and strawberry and creme. The place is small and easy to pass if you're not looking, but look for it and check it out asap!

I think this place is more for locals rather than people passing through. I was really excited to try this place after seeing reviews, pictures, and previous flavors on the website. I was pretty disappointed when I came in to find mostly regular flavors - chocolate, strawberry, banana, butterfinger... however there was lavender vanilla and brown butter which we tried. The lavender was tasty, but ended up just tasting like just vanilla after a few bites. I got the brown butter as a churro ice cream sandwich. The ice cream definitely didn't have the nutty browned butter flavor I was expecting. They make the churros fresh, but I don't think mine was completely done. It was really doughy and didn't have enough cinnamon, but I think they may have rushed it because they put the wrong flavor in the middle the first time (they kindly and gladly remade it and gave us our money back before I even noticed the mistake). I asked for one scoop of ice cream in it instead of two. It gave me a stomach ache. The staff were very friendly and informative, so happy to hear about all the locally sourced ingredients. It's a great concept, but seeing how the flavors are always rotating, it might not be a place for passer-bys since it's a gamble. Maybe we didn't get any of the original flavors because we came during the slow season?

Hands down my favorite ice cream place! Not only do they have the best servers, but they also have interesting and fun ice cream flavors! I walked in on a quiet Sunday afternoon and I was immediately greeted by the server. My friends and I tried (almost) all of their flavors and they were always very enthusiastic about them! There was no limit, and I loved that all of their spoons were metal. One of my friends told the server to surprise him, and the guy clapped his hands in excitement! He ended up with a chocolate and coffee milkshake with chocolate ganache swirled in, nutella whipped cream and a hot churro inside! (AMAZING) The flavors at Mason's change quite often, but they are always delicious! I ended up getting Coconut pudding and dark chocolate orange. My only regret is that I did not have enough room for their Taro flavor, which was creamy and very mild in the sweetness. The decoration is very cute and rustic. The whole experience is very fun and tasty!

I came here on Halloween. I'd heard great things from a coworker who loves their ice cream and said they were exceptionally friendly. The next door neighbor was passing out candy inside the store and my friend was right, the staff were incredibly friendly. I got a large ube soft serve and they gave me extra because they were closing. It was an amazing flavor. The atmosphere makes me feel like I want to become a regular and just hang out and eat ice cream after work everyday. I can't wait to come back here--I know there's a lot of passionate Mitchell's fans in Cleveland, but I think Mason's is the better spot. Super excited to go back and try their ramen when it's a tiny bit colder.

An update of the review for Mason's Creamery in its new Winter Mode as a Ramen Shop. They have modified the stand so that the counter is set up for diners and they have enclosed the patio with some tables and chairs to provide a small dining room, overall casual, but just fine for some really good ramen. The menu is concise with 3 main options, a pork tonkotsu ramen, a chicken version and a veggie version. I of course had the vegetarian version.
