Best milkshake I have had in a LONG time and I am a big milkshake fan. Definitely go for the shabooya brownie and if you like mint the mint one was SO GOOD. I love when a place knows how to do a milkshake right.
This is one of the best places to get fun shakes and ice creams. It was my first time visiting and a wonderful experience. I would definitely go back

We rushed into Ninety's Ice Cream & Sandwich late at night when we had a sweet tooth craving. It's like the desert heavens blessed us with its sweet goodness! We did not want to interrupt their restaurant closing routine, but I did not want to deny myself the delicious treat. They were still inviting as I'm sure we would be their last customers for the evening. We learned they'd undergone renovation and rebranded their sweet spot. They took the initiative to show us the process of how they create their yummy Strawberry Shortcake Shake. The first sip/scoop of the yummy shake with shortbread crumbs was [insert bright warm lights here] delicious. Perfect for a sweet tooth who loves strawberry shortcake!

There is always a line going out of 90's whenever I'm on the boardwalk. This past weekend my boyfriend, friends, and I decided to bite the bullet and wait in line for ice cream. The wait honestly wasn't bad since the line moves pretty fast and man was it worth the wait! Looking forward to visiting again in the future.
Excellent ice cream, warm cookies and brownies. The service is very fast and they give you a lot! Definitely worth it!

This place is insane. I normally don't throw 5*'s around but this place gets a A++ from me. The insane combinations and the quality of deserts is off the charts. This warm and fuzzy desert establishment is one of a kind. They offer a variety of different desert combinations (I wanted to try them all). I had a donut fritter ice cream sandwich, and a hot chocolate. Let's just say a nap was needed afterwards! I highly recommend this place if ever in Charlotte!
I've only ever gotten their cereal flavored milkshake and it never disappoints me. It's divine.

Hot summer. Perfect day for a milkshake! I was finally able to try Ninety's which I've heard so many good reviews about. Located right near UNC Charlotte on the boardwalk where you can get a sweet treat and walk around. I I'm tried the strawberry shortcake milkshake and I cannot wait to go back to try one of the donut sandwiches or macaroons!

Yum yum yum. I'm obsessed with milkshakes so I was looking for a new spot as I just moved here a week ago. I've already been here twice!! It's so delicious! I plan to try everything but right not I'm hooked on the shakes! ICE YO CUP!!
This ice cream is great, but the ice cream sandwiches are the best- especially the macaron ice cream sandwich. Great flavors and combinations.
Delicious, fast service, the macaron was perfectly cooked and the ice cream is incredible. A must visit in Charlotte. I would definitely go back.

I was really craving a milkshake and randomly found this place in a Yelp search and it was the greatest thing I could have ever stumbled upon. I got the Bottom of the Cereal bowl milk with Cinnamon Toast Crunch with a drizzle of cookie butter and it was ABSOLUTELY delicious!!!!

One of my favorite stops when I come to the. Boardwalk. Before the renovation they use to have really good sandwiches too. I asked about it and they said they will eventually bring back the hot foods they use to serve. The renovation looks great! The sweets are sooooo good! A little too good. Lol. I tried their new cookie dough pops, they're good but a little too too sweet for my liking. Also the same with their macaron ice cream and their milkshakes. Although good, it's too sweet, so keep that in mind. The taro milkshake made me miss their old taro smoothie that didn't consists of ice cream and was just right. I can't wait for their hot foods to return. Their service is good too, it was always good in the past but I think with how business is they hired more workers to get the flow going faster.
Love it, sometimes the lines are long but the wait is worth it plus the outside scenery is definitely a vibe.

The food is pretty awesome and I love their ice cream. However, the price is pretty hefty. We got a yum e bun and a brownie sandwich for over $12. It can add up quick and it's pretty delicious! Customer service is good and the location is nice.
great dessertï¼haven't try something thisgoodï¼ for soooo longï¼i am picky on my dessert, and this is definitely sth I would recommend a friend. Great job owner!

This was pretty decent. I tried the strawberry shortcake yum-ee bun. They do something pretty cool that allows the bun to stay warm but the ice cream in the middle doesn't melt. The bun tastes like a sweet dinner roll but not as sweet as a donut. The ice cream is normal strawberry ice cream. The person I was with had a cookie dough milkshake and they thought it was decent. I did see some pretty cool looking other options.

Ninety's is hands down my favorite ice cream place in Charlotte. I have gone there so many times I can't keep track! They have the best milkshakes and macaron sandwiches, as well as brownie sandwiches. They just came out with warm gooey cookies which are to die for! Everything on the menu you can customize to your liking and they are more then happy to help with recommendations. They are constantly coming out with new flavors and ideas that just bring me back every time. They also have delicious sandwiches that are made to order. The line can be long, but very worth the wait.

Finally got around to trying this place. I really thought the ice cream sandwich would have cookies not macaroons. I settled for the brownie sandwich with the strawberry shortcake ice cream topped with pecans. There was an iPad with photos of different combinations of sandwiches but there were so many I did not have time to look at them all. They were also pretty busy. Being my first time I was really confused about what to order and wanted more explanations and patience to help me but that area was a little lacking with the service. Thy offer a student discount as well. I felt really overloaded with sugar because I'm not a heavy sweets eater but I do recommend going here because it's different and great for people with a sweet tooth.
Great service and ice cream. I HIGHLY recommend the apple pie milkshake. Absolutely delicious.

Weight watchers beware, this place is simply full of sweets and fattening ice cream sandwiches! You have to admit though that it's a good idea to Treat Yo'self every once in awhile. For those occasions where only delicious desserts will satisfy, I couldn't recommend Ninety's enough! If you're familiar with the boardwalk in the university area then you probably already know where it's at. Park on the side closest to the Light Rail and look for the Chinese restaurant, it's across the walk from there. While there's not much to talk of concerning the decor, it is very clean and there's a bit of seating for people looking to beat the heat. It seems that they're banking on most enjoying their treats on the boardwalk, the rest of the building quickly fills up with excited families and individuals alike wanting a delicious snack. So as far as the treats, what tickles your fancy? They have macaron ice cream sandwiches, ice cream filled doughnuts, ice cream cake pops, all kinds of desserts. You can also get your ice cream in a cup or cone, but why would you? The couple of macaron ice cream sandwiches I've gotten here were outstanding and well thought out. They offer different flavors of macarons paired with specific ice creams and toppings. The team even seems to have a thing for cereals, and incorporates them into a lot of their products! I have to admit, I didn't expect the macarons themselves to be such a high quality product since they're being used in ice cream sandwiches, but I'd say these were excellent macarons. They could even stand on their own with a traditional filling if they chose to do so. Maybe something to consider! I'd love give 'em the perfect score, but last time they were out of a LOT of the specials. They were very accommodating with substitutes, for example they were out of the samoa macaron and just did a regular vanilla on my sandwich. My girlfriend also wanted the coffee ice cream sandwich and they were out of its 'biscotti' macaron so she had to settle for a substitute as well. All in all it they were out of 3 macarons, and 2 ice creams. So I hope that next time I'm able to try some of their named creations as they intended. Still, a very good package either way. Not a gimmick, and still going strong. Way to rock, Ninety's!

This place has cool desserts, they are big enough to even share with someone. I ordered the Cookie Monster yum Ee Bun, it's basically an ice cream donut sandwich, something very different. I have never have had anything like this. It had a warm donut, vanill ice cream with Oreo crumbs and like cookie cereal. It was very delicious. It's not too pricy I think I paid less than $6 dollars for it. The places is well decorated and has a lot of options for you. It's in a really good location, they are a water place in the middle where you can feed the ducks or just sit around.

Came to place because we've obviously seen the pictures all over social media and it did not disappoint! There wasn't a line, the menu options were plentiful, and the staff was friendly. My husband ordered the strawberry shortcake milkshake and I got the chocolate mint macaroon sandwich. The ice cream in both items were delicious! I loved the crunch of the cocoa pebbles on the ice cream sandwich and the milkshake was super creamy. We will absolutely be going back!

Stopped here while on a road trip to Georgia. Nice ice cream gem on the way. There were so many options, it took forever for me to choose I got the Strawberry Shortcake milkshake. Definitely yummy. My husband got the Cinnamon Toast Crunch milkshake. He thought it was an "okay" milkshake. If we're ever heading back to GA, we will stop again.

We came in from a day of swimming at the YMCA. It was so hot that the kids and I thought we would enjoy some good ole ice cream. I'd seen on IG the different flavors that they make and decided it was time to give them a try. The staff greeted us right away and although it was a line they got to you within a reasonable amount of time. I don't remember the exact flavors of each thing, but I can't wait to return. They have a menu that shows all the different flavors. Its behind the counter on the wall. If you are more of a visual person they have an iPad with different pictures and the ice cream names. I usually look at the iPad and the menu to compare the ingredients and how it looks. The brownie that my daughter chose was so fresh. 2nd visit Another day after the pool we decided to visit Ninety's ice cream again. It was my friends first time visiting so I helped her look at iPad and she chose the cookie with brownie. I got the brownie with salted caramel and my daughter hot the brownie with sprinkles again. I recommend trying this place. Your gonna love it.

If you are like me, you could eat here weekly - whether you need it or not! Haha! To say that Ninety's ice cream is great, is an understatement...it's AMAZING! They have a variety of flavors available and you can get a scoop of ice cream, add toppings, or make it a sandwhich...with toppings! If you are ever in the area and can stop, please do! The staff is super friendly and helps you decide what you want. They provide details on the types of ice cream flavors, suggest the mashups that others have done and help you figure out what you like. They are an amazing family-owned business that have been around for years and it shows by their customer service and caring attitude.
Who doesn't like a great Brownie Sundae after eating dinner with the family. Love how the Brownie is warmed up compliments the ice cream really well!

I came here one day because the bakery was closed. There was a line almost out of the door, so I figured I couldn't go wrong. I ordered two of the yummy buns, which is a warm glazed donut with ice cream in between with add-ins. I tried one with vanilla ice cream with cinnamon toast crunch cereal and the salted caramel brownie. Honestly, it didn't knock my socks off. The donut was amazing, but other than that, nothing. I actually ate the ice cream without the donut and found it had zero flavor, which is why it simply wasn't worth it. I don't understand how you can serve ice cream without flavor. Seriously, if the ice cream had flavor, this place would be a staple for me right after I leave the gym. Lol

Wow! I'm so glad that my husband and I stopped by this place one weekend! We both got the brownie ice cream sandwiches and they were amazing. The brownies tasted like they were homemade and fresh off the press. They melt in your mouth. I will definitely be coming back and trying other items on the menu

Their taro milkshake is my absolute favorite!!!! They're definitely a little more pricey. Their cookies n cream milkshake is good too but you can get that anywhere else especially for a cheaper price. I love their taro milkshake though, it's definitely my favorite thing there. The way they decorate the shop is so cute! I love it. Hopefully one day, they'll open another shop somewhere else because the one they're in right now is kind of small but they know what they're doing because they're at the right area!

I've been obsessed with Macaroons lately and was super excited to see they had Macaron ice cream sandwiches!! I had the one with coffee and toffee ( I can't remember the name, don't judge me). They have a lot of cool flavors that I can't wait to go back and try. The decor is a little..blah but it's in a good location so you could take it outside or walk around the lake. The young lady at the register was super nice. This place will probably be a frequent stop for me over the summer.
Such a neat place, love the concept! very cute and different! Will definitely be back! wish they had a location closer to charlotte maybe in plaza or Noda!
Holy crap. I wish I could eat here everyday. I had the strawberry shortcake Milk Shake with an edible rim..... WOW. she had the banana split sundae... Geeeeeez. So damn good lol

I've only been here once but I'm impressed with the macaroon ice cream sandwiches. I'm also pretty sure everything else here is great hence the long line when I entered. This is the only place I know that serves one of my favorite ice cream; superman ice cream. What makes it even better is that they served it as a macaroon ice cream sandwich! We also got the strawberry shortcake macaroon ice cream sandwich which was amazing as well! Love that the store has a laid back environment. Highly recommend for anyone looking for dessert after a meal!

After reading an article in Charlotte Agenda about Ninety's Macaroon Ice Cream Sandwiches I had to have one! I live very close to Ninety's and never knew that they offered so much here. But I stayed on my mission to get a macaroon ice cream sandwich. There was so many flavors it was hard to choose from (even though Ive heard the Birthday cake is the best) but since I am all about pumpkin right now I chose the Pumpkin flavor. Not to be mistaken with the Pumpkin Bread, there is a difference smh! The Macaroon sandwich is huge! They offer to cut it in half but I decided to take mine to go. This ice cream sandwich was amazing!! and everything I hoped it to be! The macaroon is totally a macaroon and is flaky per usual. The ice cream was great as well! It taste exactly like pumpkin. It was a little bit too much for me, I definitely could not finish the whole sandwich but it would be perfect to possibly share. I cant wait to come back and try the Birthday cake!

It pains me to not give them a 5 star review! For my whole 9 month pregnancy in 2017, after doctors appointments this was our go to lunch spot. Omg I loved going there. Well after they reopened from renovations, they changed the menu. I was so sad to see long time favorites gone. As well as the sand which I love the Cajun was different and no longer have fruit cups. They are great for desserts just the sandwich menu makes me sad.

Delicious milkshake! I recommend the edible rim & whip, might as well go all out! I got the chocolate brownie, it was so smoothie and creamy, best milkshake I've had. The staff was super friendly & helpful. Make the trip here, you won't be disappointed

This is my go to spot for ice cream. Well one of them. If you are a person that hashtags on Instagram and searches for cool looking desserts that also taste good this is the spot for you. I got a macaron sand-which with vanilla ice cream and lucky charms cereal on top. What is a macaron? Glad you asked it's a small piece of heaven ! No seriously it is like a French cookie. They put just the amount of ice cream in between and Cereal so it didn't make a mess but I didn't feel cheated for paying $5 for an ice cream sand which. They also have a variety of other different sandwhiches my husband got a brownie sand-which. There are shakes as well. If you are hungry and it's not lunch time you better eat before you go. All they serve is the desserts unless it's lunch time then they have sandwhiches and wraps.

I was dying to try this place after reading yelp reviews. I was so happy one night when my husband came home from work early-ish and said he was feeling ice cream! I instantly knew we should try out Ninety's. He got an oreo milkshake. It was large and very thick. I thought it tasted OK. It wasn't the best milkshake I've ever had. I got a kids cone of banana cream pie. It was actually really good! It's the same cost to get it in a cone or a cup, so I obviously got it in a cone. I look forward to coming back and trying some of their more fun menu items. The yum-ee buns look interesting and I think I would like the macaroon icecream sandwich too! The shop itself is small and there isn't a ton of seating. There was a line when we got there, but it moved very quickly. We have plenty to come back for and look forward to trying other treats here!

THE BEST ICE CREAM & MILKSHAKES! Their creativity is amazing and I love how they've updated their shop over the years. I typically only come for the desserts, but their sandwiches are good too! Be sure to follow their Instagram to see their creations!

MACRON ICE CREAM SANDWICH! Yep, You read that right! Its bananas or better yet coconut or better yet caramel or all 3 at the same time. I got the Samoa Macron Ice cream Sandwich which was out of this world amazing. As you can see by the picture it was huge... H U G E. it was not your regular ice cream on a cookie. The macron was crisp on the outside and chew inside. I switched my ice cream to coconut to really highlight the flavors and it was out of this world amazing. The flavor of the ice cream was not soft and subtle but intense and powerful. There were drizzles of chocolate, caramel and additional coconut for enhanced flavor, texture and of course Instagram goodness (yes, I did it for the gram don't judge). It was literally one if not thee best sandwich that I've eaten. What I really enjoy to is that its close to the board walk which makes this a great first date location, catch up with girlfriend location, take the kids for treat location or I'm hiding from my s/o location. They have an assortment of other treats if your not feeling creative but I assure you once you see the Ipad menu. (got your attention huh) You'll be amazed and inspired by their creatively. Give them a try.

This is a great family spot to grab some ice cream or even a great spot for a little date and walk around the boardwalk. I ordered the strawberry shortcake milkshake . I would have loved for it to actually have cheesecake pieces in it but other than that it was great. It would also be great if they were to play music and also include a little more decor .

Pros: generous with topping; cookie (for warm cookie sundae) was large, soft, and warm. Service was quick, friendly, and efficient. I thought price I got was quite reasonable. Cons: Ice cream--really good ice cream--should be the foundation of an ice cream shop. I found the ice cream to be substandard--watery, not creamy, and with almost no flavor of its own. The taste of the cookie was unremarkable, too.

I came to check this place out when wandering the Shoppes and seeing all the pretty, colorful pics of the macaron ice cream sammies. They were not doing the unicorn macaron ice cream sammie when I came in, so I decided to indulge in a Vietnamese Coffee Yum-ee Bun (I LOVE Vietnames Coffee so I figured I would love Coffee Ice Cream w/espresso infused condensed milk in between a warm glazed halved donut). I figured incorrectly. While good in theory, I just was not feeling this Yum-ee bun. The donut was not served warm, FYI, and I think for me personally the glaze + the sweetness of the condensed milk (I didn't taste any espresso flavor) + the ice cream (the coffee flavor was good) made it just way too sweet of a treat. I may come back and try one of their macaron ice cream sandwiches, if for nothing more than it makes a prettier insta-pic than the Yum-ee bun. Staff were quick & courteous and even though there was a line, I got served and was able to pay quickly.

Was expecting a lot more from this place but in the end it was ok. And if you wanted me to sum up my experience in one word, it would be ok. I got a shake, as I love a good shake and in my recent experiences ice cream locations have had the worst shakes recently. I got the chocolate chip cookie dough shake and I was really expecting something delicious, and again, it was ok. And at $5.50 I was really disappointed, in taste and size. I will say that the store was clean and the staff was nice but that is not enough for me to go back again...

Love love this place! We found it on Yelp and so glad we did. As a 90's kid I love the throw back theme. The ice cream is delicious! As the weather starts to stay warm this will be our usual place to visit. I like that there is a little pond to walk around while you enjoy your treat or there is outdoor seating available to sit and chit chat. There is seating inside but if it gets busy it gets tight.
Had a great experience! The milkshakes were delicious and the service was nice. Really enjoyed sitting outside as well, overall the trip was a success. Highly recommend trying if you like sweets!

This is my absolute favorite ice cream shop in Charlotte. In the summertime it becomes an obsession, because warm weather warrants ice cream right? I'm pretty much here on a weekly basis when the weather is nice, don't tell my waistline. I have tried a couple of shakes and I love them, but 99% of the time I visit, it's for a macaron I've cream sandwich. They have daily macaron specials that you can choose from, or you can create your own with 1 ice cream flavor and 1 topping. It's like a 2-for-1 special : macarons AND ice cream. This is really genius. Take all of my money. If you haven't been here you are missing out. If you go in for a visit, I'm pretty sure you will find something you love too.
I love coming here with the kids after a fresh haircut to satisfy my (our) sweet tooth. Oreo milkshake gets us everytime

Love the unique ice cream flavors, sandwiches and toppings they offer here! I tried the macaron ice cream sandwich and it did not disappoint. The macaron itself was so tasty and seemed very fresh. The birthday cake ice cream had little chunks of actual birthday cake in it- it was very good but would probably try a different flavor next time. The store itself is closed right now (due to covid-19 precautions i'm guessing), so there is someone at a window taking orders and a line outside the door. Would definitely recommend this place if you're looking for a fun treat!!
Cute concept!! Great options & prices. Great location on the boardwalk for a cute date or time to yourself. Delish!!

Updating this review, as the old Ninety's is LONG GONE, and the new Ninety's is my new ice cream go-to! The owners are incredibly friendly and super helpful when picking from the variety of ice cream (and cookie dough!) treats they have available. Their milkshakes are spot-on (for extra, you can add icing and toppings on the outside for that perfect instagram photo!), and their macaron ice cream sandwiches are messy, but delicious! I would highly recommend any of their cookie dough pops. While the location itself is off the beaten path (in University), it's worth the trip to try these unique treats!

This is a really cool concept and their selections are definitely Instagram worthy. I tried this after seeing it in one of our online newsletters here in Charlotte but it wasn't quite so enticing that I've ever made an effort to try it again.
Favorite things on the menu are the strawberry shortcake milkshake and the banana split! probably spend about $7 each on both. Always pretty busy but the wait isn't long at all.
I want to scream from the rooftops "I LOVE THIS PLACE". There's always a line, but once you receive your milkshake or other dairy confection you'll realize why. Honestly everything is good.

Lots of really yummy options. Just wish it was a bigger space, it's kind of miserable how packed it is and literally lined out the front door. Tons of options and they're willing to accommodate any ideas you have wasn't crazy expensive even though it was such a special thing I bet it will be super ideal to get through the week day

This is a wonderful ice cream gem! The cookie dough pops are fantastic (I had the Twix) and the peanut butter ice cream sandwich was also super yummy! The staff was super helpful and nice and were really quick with our order. I would definitely check this place out if you like ice cream and fun deserts!

I am probably not the best person to ask about Ice cream and other sweet treats but I loved Ninetys. I got something super tame (1 scoop of cookies and cream, strawberry drizzle, with Oreos on top). They have so many options and really found a way to reinvent the ice cream sandwich. There is definitely something for everyone here and I encourage everyone to try it!
The warm apple fritter sundae was amazing!!!!!!!!! Would have loved to get another one, however I was stuffed! Will be going back!
Really nice little ice cream shop. I really like the 90's theme and dessert selection. Service was very nice and considerate as well.
Has a really chill environment and was super helpful with helping me decide what ice cream I want it will definitely be back
This place has quite the selection. This visit I chose to get a medium cone, which is two ice cream scoops. I also chose to add fruity pebbles to it and that was plus.

The first time I came here was before they remodeled the shop. I had a macaron ice cream and the macaron was dry and not as chewy as other macarons are. Their ice cream is great! So 10/10 for the ice cream! Came back after they had recently updated their menu and remodeled because I have seen people RAVING about their new products. The ice cream is still great as usual. I got the Cookie Monster Yum-ee Bun and I was not that impressed. The actual bun is like a dry croissant with glaze on it. I recommend keeping the buns warm and making it fluffier, it would compliment the ice cream more. I also didn't get much ice cream in mine. The buns though were a great disappointment for me. I saw the cookie dough pops and they were HUGE. I definitely want to try them next time I come in and also give the macarons another try.

Ninety's is located at the Boardwalk, a cute little area in the University area. Since places have opened after Rona hit, I've been utilizing online ordering and delivery more than ever. We ordered online about 5-10 minutes before we got there. There was a very long line but there is also an area to go for pick up which is nice. I stood there for a few minutes and then was acknowledged to come to the window. She asked my name, I told her and then she said they were gonna put fresh whipped cream and the toppings on them which I appreciated. My friend has the strawberry shortcake milkshake and I had the bottom of the cereal bowl one. Mine was exactly how it sounds. I chose fruit loops as my cereal and it literally tasted like the milk you drink after finishing a bowl of cereal. It was good! Next time I'm in Charlotte, I'll be back for sure.

I tried the mango and strawberry shake and it was so refreshing just what I needed. The employees were nice and working really fast. Every time I turned around the line was out of the door. There is plenty of sitting inside and outside. They also serve hot food but we didn't try any this time around.

Came here on National Ice Cream Day. I had been drooling over their Instagram pictures for weeks and was excited to finally get to try it. As expected, there was a line, but it moved fairly quickly. The wait actually gave me some time to make up my mind on what to order. The menu is extensive. It is divided into cold cuts, hot savories, salads, milkshakes, and of course ice cream. Although the bright and colorful treats looked very appetizing, I am a sucker for anything caramel and/or coffee flavor. So, I was naturally drawn to their Vietnamese Coffee Yum-ee Bun. My husband ordered a single scoop of their mint chocolate chip, I believe. Although my ice cream donut sandwich didn't look as pretty as their instagram pictures, it was definitely delicious! The donut was warm, but not too warm that it melted my ice cream quickly. The flavor was on point. Definitely tasted like a Vietnamese coffee. Creamy and sweet. The hubs enjoyed his ice cream. The shop is small, but has indoor and outdoor seating. The decor is pretty simple, definitely not as bold as their treats. Plenty of parking, but can be challenging depending on the day and time. It was very busy the day we went and took us a while to find a spot. Service was fast and friendly. Can't wait to return!

You walk up to the door and place your order. There was a great variety of flavors and different types of ice cream sandwiches. It was fall so if you like pumpkin there were about five different types of pumpkin flavors. I had a scoop of the salted caramel truffle and a scoop of the graham cracker ice creams. They put it in a cup but will top it with a cone if you want. You can then take your goody out to the boardwalk and sit outside and watch the ducks. It was great!

This place is the bomb.com. Those Yum-ee Buns will give you life! I am a huge fan of dessert. If I had it my way, I would eat dessert for breakfast, lunch, & dinner. When I stumbled upon this place, I couldn't believe they were serving ice cream in warm donuts (Yum-ee Buns). I mean what genius came up with this? But in all seriousness, this spot is probably one of the best dessert places I have been to in my life. The menu selection is huge & very unique! You can order anything from ice cream, milkshakes, Yum-ee Buns (they are huge!), macaron ice cream sandwiches, cookie dough pops, & so much more. You can even order ice cream with your favorite cereals mixed in! I ordered the Cookie Monster Yum-ee Bun with cookies & cream ice cream, oreos, & Cookie Crisp cereal. My husband ordered the Peanut Butter Galore Yum-ee Bun with chocolate ice cream, peanut butter drizzle, chocolate syrup, & Reese's cups. The Cookie Monster was absolutely delicious! I would highly recommend this if you are unsure of what to order or if it is your first time. The Yum-ee Bun is priced at $5.95 & each additional topping costs 50 cents. It's on the pricer side for dessert, but can easily be split between two people. I wish I would have known that before ordering my very own Yum-ee Bun! Expect a wait. When we arrived, the line was out the door. My husband & I waited about 25 minutes before we got our buns, but it was absolutely worth it. We will definitely be back in the future!

So we really wanted gelato but there are almost no legit gelato places in Charlotte! The best one closed down. Anyway searched for ice cream and found this. We had the ice cream bun sandwich. They have some on the menu with specific ice cream flavors but you can get any. We got the dark chocolate truffle.I have no idea how they prevent the icecream from melting in the hot bun! It was delicious!! We also got the mango drink which is SO FRIKKIN AMAZING!!! It's spicy and sweet, love the mango Chile straw and the tamarind candy!!! Oh my! I highly recommend it. I liked it more than the icecream!!

This had been on my list for a long time, ever since they were first featured by Charlotte Agenda. I finally got to try it and I can't wait to go back now. We got the St. Pat's Day Lucky Charms macaron ice cream sandwich and the strawberry shortcake yum-ee bun. The ice cream sandwich macaron was amazing. Everything about it was perfect. The cereal in the outside added good flavor to the ice cream, the macaron was delicious, and the sauce was the perfect complement. It was huge, so I had to bite the top and bottom halves separately. The yum-ee bun was good, but it felt like the portions were off. Most bites all I tasted was strawberry ice cream, which was disappointing. They said this was their most popular item which surprised me because I thought the macaron was better. They also make cereal milkshakes and cookie dough pops which I would love to come back and try. I definitely think this place is worth driving up to the University to try out! I will be day dreaming of their delicious desserts.

Some of the worst ice cream I've ever had. I got a scoop of the strawberry and it was completely flavorless. Also tried the mint milkshake, which was slightly better but still watery. Your better off buying grocery store ice cream.

Ordered the brownie ice cream sandwich with the chocolate hazelnut ice cream...the ice cream itself was delicious but the brownie was just plain boring. Came out with a couple friends, one of which ordered the donut ice cream sandwich with coffee ice cream. She also felt that the ice cream was significantly better than the donut sandwich. Verdict: I'd come back but stick to just the ice cream.
Like this spot. I've had some shakes, ice cream sandwiches, and a vegetarian sandwich. All were ok just expensive. Id go here to splurge on some guilty pleasures.

DEAR LORD. I would give it 10 stars if I could. If you are a cereal fanatic like me lol, do yourself a favor and get the Bottom of the Cereal Bowl milkshake!!! It was so amazing! I got mine with captain crunch (my fav) and I would totally drive out of my way to get that milkshake again and again. My husband got the strawberry shortcake milkshake and loved it too! He said it was just like those strawberry shortcake ice cream bars, but in milkshake form. They are doing a great job with the COVID situation as well.

This is hands down one of the best ice cream places in Charlotte. Not only do they offer traditional treats, but they also have options that you won't find at other ice cream shops. An example of this is a yum ee bun which is any filling of ice cream and toppings you want, put inside a toasted donut bun. They also have cereal milkshakes and just about any spin on a traditional ice cream snack you could want. They also have macaron car cream sandwiches which is one of my personal favorites. It is located at the boardwalk, so you can grab a treat and take a stroll.

I have been waiting to go here and I finally got the chance to go tonight! And oh my it was an amazing decision. My fiancÃ© got a macaroon ice cream sandwich. They only had a couple flavors available but she got a birthday cake macaroon. The ice cream had chunks of cake in it. I got the doughnut sandwich. I can't member the exact name but it was amazing. They have a menu you can chose from but you can also create your own. I ordered a cookie dough ice cream with strawberry syrup and strawberry short cake crumbs. They make it right in front of you and then warm up the doughnut. It was very good. Will definitely be going back to this place many to try their many creations.
Pretty good ice cream! I loved my cookies and cream shake with the Oreo rim it was delicious. Will definitely be back when it warms up again.
Get the cookies and cream "warm gooey cookie" and then me later. The fruity pebbles milkshake was fire too.
This was my first visit here and it was absolutely amazing. Portion sizes here are perfect, love the fact they also have healthy food options so you can have that balance. I will be returning soon.
Great ice cream, tons of toppings, lots of sitting room outside and overall perfect setting for ice cream after dinner.

This place was kinda cool and had lots of fancy looking treats. The menu isn't really anywhere you can see while standing in line though. We got the boo berry milkshake with the edible rim and it looked yummy but the shake was pretty bland. Not sure if all the shakes taste that bland but for how much they are they should promote other flavors for shakes beside vanilla. I do love cereal in milkshakes though. It's my favorite!

A great twist on ice cream sandwiches! Stopped by around 9 on a Saturday night. It was very busy but the service was great. The staff was friendly and helpful, and the food was awesome. The sandwiches can be served as they are listed on on the menu, or you can change things to your liking. I ordered the Cookie Monster, as is, and it was pretty awesome. The sandwich is served with several fillings and the donut it's served in is warm. Definitely a must if you enjoy ice cream!

Good ice cream. Lots of cool varieties of toppings. Chill vibe at the boardwalk. They also have non-dessert items but I have never had any of them or ever really seen anyone order them so I cannot comment on those. The decor is minimalistic but cute.

This place never disappoints me! Their coffee ice cream is my favorite. I've only ever been on Sunday afternoons post-paddle boating. It's super busy each time, but they're fully staffed with friendly folks. It's easy to get overwhelmed by their Instagram worthy treat options, so sticking with a shake or a waffle cone is easiest for me. One day I'll be adventurous with their cereal toppings.

Macaron ice cream sandwiches?! Yaassssss! What a genius concept to take two delicious desserts and then smoosh them together. My mister and I went on a busy Saturday evening and there was a line to the door, but we persisted and it moved pretty quickly. I was worried that there would be slim pickings for flavor options but I was definitely wrong because picking which macaron was a hard decision! Some of the flavor options are more traditional like mint chocolate chip and some are more wild like fruity pebbles or the strangely named play doh. I really want to go back to try that one just by the name alone. Since it was my first time I decided to stick with something more classic - cookies and cream. Whew, was that excellent! Giant cookies and cream macaron mounded with cookies and cream ice cream and then topped with another giant cookies and cream macaron. The macaron was great, but not classically baked. It had the crunch of a macaron on first bite, but the texture was more along the line of a soft baked cookie. Regardless, it was so good. The ice cream also appeared to be house made with huge chunks of cookie in it. For ~$6, it was huge portion wise. My mister and I easily could have split one and been satisfied. Definitely will be back!
Everything was presented so well and the staff was so friendly! The place is cute too! I got a milkshake and it was SO GOOD. I will definitely be going back.

Awesome little ice cream shop. We got a milkshake to share which was plenty for two people. We got the option of all edible rim which was quite nice. Milkshake it shelf comes with very large straw which you can actually use for a milkshake. This was nice because I did not finish all the milkshake at the restaurant so I took it on the road with me.
Great tasting shake. Decent amount of oreo, blended well. Straw was actually wide enough to use which was great, it wasn't a narrow soda straw.

The ice cream was great!! For it being my first time, I do wish they had the menu by the door. It was very crowded and busy. Therefore, by the time I went up to see the menu I had to give them my order. I felt extremely rushed and unprepared. It was also extremely hot, there was no air on and they were very busy. Just made it very uncomfortable.

The atmosphere of the store is awesome and my boyfriend and I love their milkshakes. The only reason for 4 stars is because I feel it's a little pricey for the size of the shake, but if you're just treating yourself every once in a while then it's definitely worth it!

This milkshake was prettier than it tasted. I really wanted to give this place 10 stars but the shake was not as sweet or savory as I'd like. The speed of service was nice, and due to COVID restrictions I was not able to sit inside which was not totally an issue. I plan to come back in hopes that maybe the milkshake will taste different. Overall cute place and I am also willing to try another dessert.

Talk about overwhelming!!! Oh boy when I seen all the pictures online and in person in the establishment I was lost for words like okay what do I get? Boring ole me ended up getting a strawberry shortcake milkshake with the special rim full of goodies added on the cup. Little did I know my milkshake was a hit! As I walked around panicking for napkins because I didn't want anything to melt, as the customers ooh and awed over my milkshake. Those macaroons they have their look really good I will be making my way back for those. May I add everything here makes for a good feature selfie!

OMG! This ice cream was ON POINT! Because I wasn't filled up from Fran's Filling station (see what I did there? corny, I know), I sought out a sweet treat elsewhere. I didn't realize this spot was bookmarked, but I'm glad it's not too far from where I reside. I ordered a brownie milkshake and it was GOOOOOODDD! It wasn't too sweet. It wasn't too milky. Everything tasted homemade. I was offered brownie pieces around the top of the cup. OMG! Wheretheydothatat?!!! Here! It was recommended I only get this if I'm not driving and I was; BUT I will be coming back for that. Someone's birthday is coming uuuuppp... guess what that means!!!! Yup! I'm coming right back to this spot. I don't care, I don't care, I don't care if there are other spots to try out there, I want this one.

So anytime I would take my son walking with me, I would reward him with a stop here for ice cream. I mean let's face it - exercise is not the ideal activity for a 7 year old boy. And he always really enjoyed coming here for a scoop of ice cream - so it was always a win, win for both of us. On my most recent visit, I finally asked to try to his ice cream. He had cookies and cream - it was so good. I mean it was smooth and creamy and not to sweet. So I said what the heck and went to order something for myself. Of course I went big! I went with the cookie monster Yummee Bun. Basically it is ice cream that is served in between a glazed donut with toppings. So the cookie monster was cookie and cream ice cream, oreos, chocolate drizzle and one other thing I cannot recall now. But after they stuff the donut, they take it to the back and put it in some kind of machine that makes it warm and "glues" it together so it becomes a warm delight. It was good. I mean it was really good. I would definitely come back for this. On all our visits, they are always friendly and serve you fast and quickly.

Not from North Carolina, but both times I've visited Charlotte Ive stopped at Ninety's. What a place. First time I had a Fruity Pebbles Macaron Sandwich. Second time I had a Cookies and Cream cookie sandwich, a warm cookie with cookies and cream filling. Both were incredible. Surprisingly not as sweet as I thought they'd be, and surprisingly not as filling as I thought (in a good way). Can't wait for my next trip to NC. Worth going significantly out of your way for. I can confidently say I've never been to an ice cream place like Ninety's.

Delicious! $6 bought me a big chunk of birthday cake ice cream with chunks of cake in it, sitting between two huge macaron halves! Loved the flavors and textures, not to mention how photogenic it is! They offer donut ice cream sandwiches and brownie versions too. They had some food options and milkshakes. The staff was quick, friendly, and helpful. The interior could use some help, maybe some photos of product shots and some plants inside would be nice. I chose to sit outside because the grounds of this shopping center are very lovely. The bathrooms aren't the best so that's an area of improvement but overall a great experience! If your GPS gives you problems just park near the center and it's on the Boardwalk Billy's side of the pond near the bridge.

I discovered this place a couple years ago. One of very places in Charlotte that serves superman ice cream. And it's delicious. Today I had the pleasure of trying the superman macaroon ice cream sandwich. They recently renovated and it looks super cool.

So I started following this page on instagram after randomly (maybe not so random) seeing one of the shakes on my explore page. Even though it is not in my neighborhood I do travel to the neighborhood it's in often. So finally I took the time to stop by on a Saturday evening. Even though it was Saturday it's not exactly warm yet so I wasn't sure what to expect in terms of wait time. I'm pleased to say even though there was a little line the wait time was less than 5 minutes. This shop is known for it's ice cream sandwiches and shakes. I opted for the "Bottom of the Bowl" Shake. This one was included whatever cereal topping you want. They do have a variety of cereals but I decided to go with crunch berries. When I tell you it was one of the best shakes I've ever had it's no exaggeration! I loved every minute of it including the edible rim on the cup! Might I add it's a pretty photogenic shake too. I finished it in a few minutes along with the edible rim which I believe to be frosting with crushed cereal pieces. My son got a regular cup of ice cream which he also enjoyed. I can't wait to come back in the warmer months and try another flavor Or another item all together!!
Their macaroon ice cream sandwiches are delicious! Definitely recommend Ninety's for a sweet treat!

Love the renovations! Definitely an Instagram worthy place and products. But the ice cream is good but really not worth the price. Everything is overpriced-especially if you order anything more than just plain ice cream.

Wow. Do you love macaroons? Do you love ice cream? Well I'm here to tell you they are amazing together!!! It's not just hype- their products are good quality and the guy who helped me made me something that wasn't on the menu that I saw on yelp. It was sooooooo good. There's so many things to choose from so do your homework a little bit before you go if it takes you a little while to make your mind up.

Heard about this ice cream shop from Pinterest and i am floored.The milkshake was the perfect consistency and wasn't overly sweet. Only thing i did not enjoy was not having a lid for my milkshake but it was only because i opted for the edible rim. I thoroughly enjoyed this cute little shop and definitely will be going back on my next trip to Charlotte!

Let me start off by saying we are SUPER PICKY people! Everything about our sundaes was on point! I ordered a gooey cookies and cream cookie with french vanilla ice cream topped with caramel. Biggs ordered honey glazed doughnut sandwich With chocolate ice cream , caramel and chocolate syrup. DELICIOUS!!!

This place is a gem, first of all. We needed something to save our disappointing lunch. My wife is a celiac, but she is willing to get sick over good desserts. She's a maniac. The menu is decadent and plenty for everyone, and when I say everyone, I mean celiacs. Taking a look at the menu we found that there were actual Gluten Free options. With cereals and cakes and cookies everywhere, they actually thought of the Celiacs. That alone is 5 star worthy. I was looking forward to have an apple fritter sandwich and was disappointed to hear it was a temporary item. Trust me, if they make that permanent item, I will be a permanent weekly customer. I settled for the warm donut with apple pie ice cream, topped with Cinnamon Toast Crunch cereal. It was awesome. My wife picked the macaroon ice cream sandwich with cotton candy ice cream, topped with gummy bears. She loved it. Only problem??? It's too far from our house!!! We will definitely be back when in the area.

Aaaaaamazing. The service here was great everyone was happy the overall mood of this place was dope. Being a 90s kid I definitely felt like I was in a little box of my childhood! I got the strawberry short cake shake and my god it had to be the best shake I've had in years. Every little detail to the rim of the shake cup was great. Can't wait to come again! It's about and hour drive for me to get here and believe me I will make the trip a lot more often!

I actually had really high expectations for this place based on their endless Instagram feed full of amazing-looking ice cream creations. I came here on a weekday with a few coworkers over lunch, so we had the place to ourselves. The atmosphere was about what you would expect from a specialty ice cream shop... pastel walls, ice cream counter, a bunch of small tables, menus on the walls, etc. There were two employees there at the time, both of whom were very nice and gave us some good suggestions on toppings and combos. I ordered the Reese's Puffs macaron sandwich, which was made with chocolate ice cream rolled into a ball and then coated with crushed Reese's Puffs cereal and then squished between two macarons with some whole Reese's Puffs placed around the edges. The sandwich was so thick, it was a bit of a challenge to eat. The employee recommended taking a spoon to the edges to start to reduce the size before eating it like a more traditional ice cream sandwich. As much as it was a very pretty creation, I can't say that the ice cream tasted any better than any other ice cream. It was just a generic chocolate that tasted like your average tub from the freezer aisle. The addition of the cereal added a little pizzazz, but nothing as impressive as I was hoping for. I was also surprised to see the macarons were a bright blue color.. which while pretty, is not super appetizing and turned my lips a little blue. I will go ahead and say that I have had another experience with Ninety's at a pop-up festival in Charlotte and I had an apple fritter sandwich... and that was amazing. So maybe it's just about what you order.

This place had tasty ice cream milkshakes and among other items. I tried the strawberry shortcake cheesecake milkshake and was impressed. The milkshake wasn't overprices, they had variety, and the ability to customize. I would recommend Ninety's Ice Cream to anyone looking for a good place with sweet treats.

My husband and I love Ninety's for a sweet treat. It is definitely indulgent if you get a yum-ee bun, but so worth it! The bun is like a donut and they warm it with your ice cream inside. I'm not sure how the bun is so warm and the ice cream is still so cold, but it's amazing! My husband gets the Oreo milkshake, and he loves it! Everything at Ninety's is just a little extra special. Also, the dark chocolate hazelnut ice cream is so good. Like, heavenly good.

I really didn't enjoy the doughnut sandwich I got. It looked amazing but the taste didn't match. The service was great, I felt welcomed and taken care of... I took one bite and throw it in the trash. It was pretty much a waste of money for me- I wish that someone nearby wanted my partially eaten food so it didn't go in the trash...

My friends and I were really disappointed with our experience at Ninety's. We had seen their instagram photos of delicious looking desserts and treats and so we made the drive from SW Charlotte to come check it out. What we got was not worth the money. The yum-ee bun was essentially a Hawaiian roll with ice cream and three pieces of cereal stuffed in it. Nothing to be excited about. The macarons were nothing special either. Please just save your money and go elsewhere.

Located in a shopping center with plenty of parking and a nice view of a body of water. The milkshake did not disappoint in taste and was aesthetically pleasing! The glazed donut stuff with icecream was perfectly made too! Nice and warm on the outside, but keeping the icecream cold and not melting everywhere. The menu has a great variety in flavors and options. The ordering process might need better structure though.
Wow wow wow! What a great area at University area. A glazed doughnut filled with ice cream then deep fried?!! Wtf???? Why does it have to be soooo good! Well done, great area and a line out the door!

I feel like overall this place is pretty solid as a dessert place especially in the summer time when a cold sweet treat will hit the spot! I got the ice cream donut and boy was that delish! It's around $6.50 and honestly it's heavy and quite a lot so maybe have a light meal before this hahahah You could also split it as it's definitely splittable with the donut and ice cream right in the middle filling it! Definitely goodness you don't want to miss out on. They also got normal ice cream and brownies and ice cream. You rlly can't go wrong at this place so make the most of it! Can get crowded so take your treat outside and get some vitamin D since there's shaded seats! Parking lot is plentiful

This ice cream place is conveniently located near I-85 and UNC Charlotte. Like other reviewers mentioned, parking is a bear when it's busy. We had to park very far away and walk in the rain, but undeterred, we carried on. Once we got there, we were overwhelmed by the amount of choices. There really are a ton. There are both preselected menu items and make your own options. This allows for endless choices. The employees were not very happy to be there and didn't offer much help. I decided on a doughnut with peanut butter and chocolate. It was good, but it was way too sweet. Probably should have been expected. I'm not sure if I'll be back, but if I do, I'll definitely get something different.

Lost of different desserts to choose from! Many different flavored ice creams. If you're like me and enjoy I've cream no matter what season it is, you'd love this place! They even have hot chocolate with their own twist! You can add toppings to them. Great for those with a sweet tooth!

The yum ee bun ice cream sandwich might have been the best thing I have ever eaten! Combining a warm donut, ice cream, and rolled in cereal is a genius idea! Can't wait to come back and try and different combination. The customer service was great as well. The team was very knowledgeable and you can create your own custom combinations. Very cute decor and atmosphere as well.

My husband and I got a "bottom of the cereal bowl" with fruity pebbles. Phenomenal. It was very busy and had a line outside but can understand why because it was delicious and well worth the wait. Highly recommend.

You can't not want to try this place. Even if you're not the desert type, you'll want to get something. There are so many different flavors and things to try, and on top of that they always switch out and recommend new flavor combinations and deserts so you'll always want to come back for more. The options are great and the location is too, as it is located right next to the boardwalk and other restaurants. My first time there I checked their Instagram page @ninetysicecream to help me decide. I have tried different combinations of the green tea (my favorite flavor) milkshake, the apple fritter ice cream sandwich, the macaroon ice cream sandwich, brownie milkshake, hot chocolate, and chocolate chip cookie that melts and oozes out when you break it apart. Everything was amazing and satisfied my sweet tooth craving even when I didn't have one!!
Great customer service and good ice cream. Loves the yummy bun (donut ice cream sandwich). I'll be back!

From all the ratings and pictures, this seemed like an amazing place to have the ice cream sandwich. I ordered a peanut butter and vanilla ice cream sandwich which took forever and then I'm handed a squished doughnut with melted ice cream in a paper bag? Very confused since I ordered directly from a picture someone posted which didn't remotely look the same but maybe the person who made my sandwich was new??

I got a small cup of Moosetracks and fell in love. The ice cream was extremely soft and gooey, and was beautiful. Service was great. They have really expensive stuff there, but that's for their really fancy milkshakes.

Who says no to desserts? Hardly no one I ever know! After walking a bit at the Boardwalk, we decided to get ice cream at Ninety's Ice Cream & Sandwiches. Since we already ate lunch, we skipped on the sandwiches and just ordered ice cream. I got the salted caramel chocolate ice cream in a waffle cone. I really love the flavors and liked the chocolate chunks, not to mention the creaminess of the texture. Next time whenever I do come back to Charlotte, I will come back and try their sandwiches.

Chocolate chip cookie definitely lived up to the pictures people constantly post. Some foods that look good end up being a let down and I'm happy to report that their chocolate chip cookie was not one of them. Lightly crispy outside with gooey inside AND they warm it up for you.

Excellent place for shakes! Can't wait to come back and try the food! We got the Sonoma Girl Scout cookie shake and the fruity pebble cereal shake! Both were on point! The shakes are not thick so if you like yours thick, I'd request that! I thought they were the perfect consistency! Great place

I got the donut ice cream sandwich. It was just on. I had high hopes. The donut tasted like a cheap Walmart glazed. That's what was the downfall and then the nuke it to warm it. Eh, kind of ruined it. But the ice cream was nice.

Okay so after my last review of Ninety's about week ago for me (which I have removed to write this) I promised to give Ninety's another chance and did so. I can honestly say I still love there sandwiches, the 90's style names are great, I had the Carlton and the Uncle Jessy. They even changed the shop a little since my last review in the way that the sandwich menu is now out in the shop on a board like the Ice Cream and I was able to get a sandwich past 8:00 p.m. I'm absolutely in love with the thin mint cookie dough pops now that I've tried one, I'm in love with the regular cookie dough bits candy and it's like the bigger flavored version of one of those, so of course I love it. I even went back twice that day, which is how I ended up trying a second sandwich for a late dinner. I wasn't expecting to go back, but I ended up picking my friend/roommate up from her late class and then she complained about Charlotte not having any good milkshake places open... I wasn't sure where she got that, but I remember that Ninety's probably had milkshakes and decided to make a quackish stop there for her. They did have milkshakes and she loved every second of the frosting rolled milkshake. She's definitely a fan now and we will be going back.

YUSSSSSSSS MACAROON ICE CREAM SANDWICHES IN CHARLOTTE! THEYRE SO GOOD! Highly recommend the fruity pebbles macaroon ice cream sandwich! So yummy! But you have to eat them fast! They'll melt soon! Love the environment and coziness of the place. The location is great too. Had a GREAT first experience! Definitely going again soon!!!
Great ice cream and not overly pricey, great place to come with the family. The Yumee Buns are delicious.
The macaron sandwiches are OUT OF THIS WORLD! The soft yet crisp macarons mixed with a soft ice cream in the middle will make you melt.

Absolutely fantastic! I used to go to this nice cream shop all the time back when I was in high school and lived in Charlotte. Over the last year or so it has been totally revamped! Today it serves all kinds of Instagram worthy treats sure to knock your socks off. The location is perfect since it is near UNCC and located in the University Lake area where lots of people spend their weekends enjoying the good food and scenery. The service here was great and I was given information about each of their popular items. I decided to go with the salted caramel brownie macroon ice cream sandwhich. This was pretty large but was good to share with my husband. They had other flavors such as red velvet, along with a number of doughnut ice cream sandwhiches as well. From looking on their instagram I can tell that they frequently change flavors to keep up with the season. This place is a definite must go if I'm the UNCC area!

I found Ninety's Ice Cream & Sandwiches through Pinterest. Pictures of their delicious looking milkshakes kept appearing and when I was passing through Charlotte on vacation I made sure we stopped there. I was not disappointed! SO GOOD. The menu is easy to understand and the employees are super helpful. I got the "Bottom of the Cereal Bowl" shake with fruity pebbles and it tasted exactly like fruity pebbles. It was incredible. My husband got the "Shabooya Brownie" shake and it was equally delicious. Some might say it's expensive for ice cream. I say it's 100% worth it.
Love their ice cream treats and they are always super nice to my kids. I am glad in the changing face of this area this place continues to survive and offer excellent service

Customer service was good and the milkshakes were very tasty. It is a little expensive for my taste. I can get a larger milkshakes, with pretty much the same ingredients for less money other places. I cannot take points away for price though. Since it is a mom and pop shop, they have to make money.

Ah this place was recommended by friends from Charlotte during our visit, and we LOVED it! Sometimes beautiful desserts are just that, but the ice cream, macaroons, and shakes here were DELICIOUS! I tried the strawberry green tea macaroon sandwich - LARGE green tea macaroons on each side with strawberry ice cream (with huge real strawberry chunks inside). It was phenomenal! They also added some matcha drizzle. My sister loved their chocolate shake! They charge appropriately - I felt like $6 was appropriate for the huge macaroons and the large scoop of ice cream. Definitely recommend! Get some ice cream to cool down and then head over to to the lake for some paddleboating!

Ninety's is always good and delicious and they are constants switching out flavors and providing new flavors to try ... This trip I got the birthday cake, cookies and cream, and Graham cracker crust which are all delicious. & they really pile on the ice cream. 3 scoops for $5 is an Excellent deal compared to some of the other ice cream places ... Customer service is always on point ... It's in a nice area and an easy date spot to get ice cream and then walk around the boardwalk to just chat. There are also other restaurants in that area as well if you wanted Ninety's as an after dinner option.

This place is so YUMMY!!! They really bring out my little self. From small memorabilia from Hey Arnold and Rugrats to even a small lunch menu names after popular 90's shows. Their ice cream is super creamy and delicious and you can put your favorite cereal on it!!! We purchased ice cream macaroon sandwiches. I ordered strawberry ice cream topped with Reese's puffs. It was amazing!! The macaroon was well made and super good. I will definitely be returning.

I can't help myself. Everytime I see this place whether it be at the store or at their food truck, I have to stop and get something. So many options, so little time. I have never been disappointed in the flavors or the service. I love having a spot that I can consistently get great shakes and great service. Best crew in Charlotte! Quick tip, always go for the edible rim if you have a shake. I promise you it's worth it.

Ninety's Ice cream is AMAZING! It is seriously the bomb-diggity, the king of all desserts in this area! This location offers shakes on shakes, and macaroon ICE CREAM SANDWICHES (with Lucky Charms, Cinnamon toast crush, Twix, Reese's Puffs cereals) as toppings. I have tried their Lucky Charms macaron sandwich, and twix macaron sandwich, along with their "o(reo) oh my gosh" shake. The staff is super friendly despite the amount of people that walk in through these doors. Each dessert themselves are a big pricey ~$6 each, but it is so worth it for those who have a sweet tooth! Will come here again and bring friends time and time again. Notes: -It has indoor and outdoor seating -bathroom only for customers -no wifi
I've probably been here 5 times since I moved to Charlotte and this place never disappoints the shakes are to die for and you can pick any ice cream on the menu and I guarantee you'll love it !
So, so good. The cookie dough pops are the best. Anything on a yummie bun is amazing. It is clean, atmosphere is totally 90's music. I recommend this place to anyone.

Instagram worthy. You could probably ask for anything on the menu and it wouldn't be bad. From donut ice cream sandwiches, to over the top milkshakes, and baka splits. They also have actual food, but I have not tried that yet. If you have a sweet tooth, give Ninety's a try!
Ice cream in a doughnut! We experienced fruity pebbles on our doughnut for the first time ever. I will never again get sprinkles when i know fruity pebbles are so much better!

More than ice cream and sammiches. They have this Cajun chicken that is AMAZEBALLS. It's not like any other Cajun chicken you have had, trust me. It's spicy and so flavorful. I personally love the salad version with their homemade vinaigrette, my hubster prefers the sammich version. You can't go wrong with either. It's a cute little family owned shop that has always been pleasant to us. Plus they have a quirky sense of humor. Peep their register display screen the next time you are there ;)
Love their ice cream! Have so many options to choose from but I've always just gotten regular ice cream scoops in a cup. Definitely have to try all their flavors! Highly recommended

This is a super cute family owned desert place! I would recommend to anyone to try, they have idea on what kind of milkshake you want or you can completely customize what you are feeling! They also have ice cream sandwiches with warm cookies on the outside! The prices are reasonable and the staff is super friendly
Absolutely Amazing Ice cream.! I went back twice while on a 4 day trip to charlotte. I've never had anything like it.If you are in the area you've gotta try it!
Hot diggity! Macaroon ice cream sandwiches. ..need I say more? You are in for a perfect treat.

A must try place if you're ever visiting Charlotte. It is located in the University area on Boardwalk. It's a nice little shop with a variety of dessert things and more. It's so versatile as it is great for a first date, date night, family night, friends hangout, grandparents date, etc. It's clean and make your order right in front of you. The line might be long during weekends (evening time) but it goes by really fast so definitely worth the wait!!!

Ninety's was first brought to my attention vÃ­a numerous Instagram tags of the most delectable-looking treats. It eventually became too much to handle and I finally gave in to my girlfriends persistence. Boy am I glad I did. Tucked in along the Boardwalk in University Area this place is producing ice cream and desserts that both look and taste amazing. I had been wanting to try this place for a while and I intend to return again soon. They have an iPad to help you select what you want, and they can make anything you may have seen on Instagram, even if it is no longer on the menu. The decision process was trying, but ultimately we decided to go with some form of a chocolate milkshake with an edible outer rim. It was both unique and delicious. The staff here were very helpful and patient as we explored the endless possibilities. I have to be back.
Just be ready to go into a sugar coma. Totally worth your money. They have many treats to choose from. Its ice cream heaven.

My friend and I visited this place on Saturday. The staff was very friendly and everything moved smoothly. We came for the ice cream, but were pleasantly surprised by how good the "goonie" sandwich was. The strawberry shortcake smoothie was absolutely amazing!! Anyone who loves the strawberry shortcake ice cream pops should definitely get one :)
The place is a classic, Charlotte staple. This is where dessert dreams are made. Grab an ice cream and take a walk around the lake. It'll cancel out.

Best creative and tasting ice cream sandwiches ever. Who can say no to their favorite ice cream between two warm donuts slices? Not me. I try to share this delicious piece of heaven because the amount is gigantic. However, even sharing it; you still get to enjoy more than enough of this beautiful piece of Delight. Go NOW!

What a fantastic Ice Cream shop. They take great care with each order. I got the chocolate chips added on the rim of my milkshake. Talking about adding texture to your dessert. I can't wait to go back. When you are talking about Ice Cream it is all about flavor. They have it!
I truly do not get the hype of this place. It's not very cleanly inside at all and I live close by and would choose other ice cream places over this one.

I enjoyed the strawberry cheesecake ice cream today from Ninety's Ice Cream & Sandwiches. A co-worker was kind enogh to bring me a surprise flavor. I had other opportunities to taste this flavor but passed them up. You see, my mind says yes but my body says no. I enjoyed the strawberry flavor with just the right amont of graham cracker crust mixed in. Also, I heard more about the lunch items offered prompting me to make a visit to this location VERY soon!

I was so thrilled to try this place based on reviews, and I left rather underwhelmed. My group of friends got everything from cereal milkshakes to chicken wraps to sundaes...and it was all "meh. this has potential!" Skip the Lucky Charms milkshake. I couldn't taste any ice cream...just the mushy cereal. Maybe that's the goal, but at an ice cream shop, whether or not it's a cereal focused dish, ice cream should also shine. Also it was expensive! The food took a long time for what it was, and the sundaes were nothing special. We did not try the macaroon ice cream sandwiches so I can't comment on that. Really 'potential' is the word for this place because with some more tweaks it could be something extraordinary.

This is a great little spot. Located on the boardwalk, one of the only walkable places in University.During my college days, I'm sure I had a sandwich here, once or twice, but I can't seem to remember. Last night, we stopped in as a celebratory first ice cream of the season. I got one scoop of the coffee cookies and cream and a scoop of the butter pecan. No complaints! if you want a sweet treat, stop by this place, grab a seat and enjoy some live music from the Wine Vault next door. Affordable, fast and casual.

This place was cool. I had The Vietnamese coffee yumee bun, which was good. My daughter had the Oreo oh my gosh milkshake thingie, which was divine! If we go back, I will try something other than a bun. For those two items, we paid $13. Not bad. Good staff.

Loved the atmosphere here! My friend and I can in for ice cream and we were in for a treat. She got a sandwich and said it was amazing and a ice cream drink. I had the Thai tea macaroon ice cream sandwich. It was delicious and a refreshing take on an ice cream sandwich. It was decently busy when we arrived, the staff was great at moving people through the line!

I don't have one bit of a sweet tooth in my body but my boyfriend and friends do and this is the place we always go to when we want a nice little pick-me-up. Since I don't get ice cream, I usually go for their mangonada, with mango ice cream and fresh mango chunks topped with Mexican salt seasoning. Mouth is just drooling thinking about it. My boyfriend loves the ginormous ice cream donut sandwiches or the milkshakes.

Worth the drive to charlotte ! Strawberry shortcake milkshake ...I also had a macaroon icecream sandwich but I ate it too quickly and didn't get a picture .. the flavor was birthday cake and the macaroon had the right amount of chewy and crunchy

I had the donut ice cream sandwich with vanilla ice cream and fruity pebbles. It was yummmyyyyyy!!! I will be back and will bring others with me! The staff was great too. I'll have to try some other yummy items on the menu next time.

Pretty standard tuna melt, except that there were peas in it, which was kinda weird. The potato salad was just ok. Basic decor: kinda boring. Nice location with a decent crowd. You could stop by for a quick bite on a Saturday afternoon, then chill at the lake, which is right around the corner. You can eat directly outside the restaurant, and they'll serve you outside. Decent price. I would consider eating here again, but I wouldn't go out of my way to do it.

Really unique selections that taste amazing. The milkshakes were incredible and the doughnut ice cream sandwiches were unique. Family said the brownies were really really good. Will definitely go back if I have a sweet tooth for something outside the norm.

Love love love Ninety's ice cream. They have so many innovative creations! They're definitely insta-worthy too. Go when it's down time though because it can definitely get packed. They're in a good location but when it's busy there is hardly any parking. You can walk around the boardwalk too where they have paddle boats and a park.
My daughter and I love this place. The options are amazing! The fact that we can order online and just walk up is even better.

I expected this place to be amazing. Got the drumstick milkshake with the edible rim. The flavor didn't really pop, presentation was nice but I felt like this place doesn't live up to the hype, especially not for an $8 milkshake. So 3 stars for being average.

So glad this was my intro to Charlotte. Been to the city before but not as a foodie, so was delighted to get this sweet first treat. After doing some research I found I had to stop at this place for a delicious and Instagram worthy snack. I wasn't disappointed. Staff was friendly attentive and caterered to my food blogger tendencies. It was busy which is always a good sign and decorated for St. Patrick's - I like it when food establishments acknowledge stuff like that. More so when it is reflected in the menu. Definitely try their macaroon ice cream sandwiches. Delicious! I would also recommend a getting one of their signature cookie dough pops. Don't really eat edible cookie dough often, but the ones they serve had me wanting another. Next time I want a milkshake, they look amazing too.

If you haven't checked out Ninety's you're missing out. This place is so cute and will bring you right back to your childhood with all their fun 90's references! The cookies are beyond! They're huge and the epitome of what every cookie should be! Their shakes are my favorite! I always get the cereal milk lucky charms shakes and they never disappoint! I would recommend Ninety's to anyone who wants a good dessert! Did you know they have a food truck that pops up around town too?! I mean...what are you waiting for?!
Generic ice cream . Shitty quality. Nothing tastes fresh. Huge disappointment after looking at the positive ratings. Was expecting much better.
The absolute best place to go get ice cream our an amazing milkshake! The Yummy buns are out of this world!!!!! So so good
They have amazing ice cream. The lines are a little long during the summer months but it's definitely worth it. Heard the food was good and worth it as well. They have great favors of ice cream.
Delicious ice cream and desserts! They have great milkshakes and plenty of flavors to choose from.

Great family place for ice cream after a long weekend. There is live music outside on Sundays from Wine Vault. Their presentations and signature sandwiches are great. The pictures are no lies to the fancy delectable treats they offer.

Never leave yelp reviews but me and my fiancÃ© stopped here for some sandwiches . I got a sandwich that had turkey , bacon, lettuce , tomato, and onion . I asked for no turkey and to add mayonnaise . When out food arrived my sandwich already came with mayonnaise on it without them telling me or having it on the menu while charging us for extra ,they placed ONE single piece of bacon on the sandwich . When I asked if I could possibly have more bacon I was told yes no problem . 1 minute later the lady at the register says that will be $2 meanwhile I already took a meat off the sandwich and they charged me for something it already came with . Won't ever be coming back and don't recommend the sandwiches . Ice cream looks very good but the food is just not good at all and no one seems to be in charge .
The butter pecan ice cream is heavenly and the waffle cones were amazing. I would definitely recommend this place for great ice cream.

Love the view, but I can get a better milkshake at Chick-fil-A for way cheaper. They will get you with the photos they have, but when it comes to taste it's average. Nothing special! Just being honest. Please go if you never been!

This place is definetly a diamind in the rough! They have the best macaron ice cream sandwiches in charlotte hands down!! My boyfriend and I came for ice cream and noticed these huge amazing macarons and we were definitely not disappointed. We got the pistachio and the strawberry cheesecake macaron ice cream sandwiches and they were delicious!! I will definitely come again and I'll be bringing in more people with me!
I always just get ice cream cones here and their flavor options are always changing which I love. Great location to grab an ice cream or shake and walk around the boardwalk when the weather is nice.
The bottom of the cereal bowl milkshakes and macaroon ice cream sandwiches are a must! The staff is very friendly as well.

Absolutely my favorite dessert place in Charlotte right now. I like 45 mins away and make sure to stop by as many times as possible. Ninety's is so creative, not to mention delicious! One of my favorites is the Macaroon Ice cream sandwich. It does not disappoint. I love how they change their flavors daily (Thai tea, strawberry shortcake etc) and always come up with unique creations!

Ninety's has been a staple in University area for quite some time now and they recently revamped and renovated the interior of the store. The menu was also revamped, with there now being a main focus on ice cream and desserts offered. The last two times I got the Yum-eee bun and both times I got the S'mores one with graham cracker crumbles, chocolate ice cream and marshmallows wedged between a heated up glazed donut. Each time I feel like I tasted more of just the donut and the ice cream than the graham cracker crumbles and marshmallows, but the concept is interesting and is a great treat if you are looking to indulge a little bit. They have other types of Yum-eee buns and you can also create your own. In addition, they have traditional ice cream offerings, macaroon ice cream sandwiches, cookie dough pops and cereal milk shakes as some of the things you will find here. It's pretty original compared to anything else in the area.
