Even the cashier was giving me attitude about handing an empty cup to me. Stay away from this place! Extremely disappointed!
Staff is very friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful. We had three flavored Sunday. Ice cream is really creamy. Great place to pop in to for an after dinner treat.

My husband and I visited this adorable ice cream shop just to browse. The customer service was exceptional!! We tasted a few flavors to narrow our search for what we wanted to purchase. And when we couldn't decide the sales lady offered the apple pie ice cream......So Good!!!! Tasted like an apple pie!! I will definitely be back for the great customer service and delicious ice cream sundae!

Small desert spot with huge portions of a diverse array of unique deserts. Have a wide variety of ice cream flavors and homemade waffle cones. I got the salted caramel ice cream and the chocolate chip ice cream in a waffle cone and it was delicious. The cone was a little stale however. Unfortunately do not have any seating. 8.5/10

I had the most delightful experience at Sloans ice cream. I was staying at the Venetian and I just had to check out this beautiful store. I couldn't help the sweet smell coming from the store so I ventured in. I was immediately greeted by the sweet girl by the counter that soon turned out to be the General manager. She offered me some of their most popular ice creams and I was just so excited to try every option. She eventually convinced me to get their luxury sampler which had about every perfect bite size sweetness can offer! Jamie if you're reading this , I just wanted to thank you for your patience and your Pristine customer service!
Very rude and unprofessional employee (Taury). Ice cream was ok. Several people walked out during our visit. Not worth the hassle.

Kid in a candy shop. That's the nostalgia Sloan's gave me upon walking in. I forgot to count how many flavors but my oh my it's a several dozen! We all found our ice creams to be delicious. Employees were attentive and available. Prices were up there but considering it's in the Venetian what else would one except? They also had a wall lined with candy! Yup you heard me! I'll be back, with my local friends and tourists. Literally can't wait!

WOW it brought me flash backs of my childhood being in a candy store. One of the best selections of candy I've seen at $16.00 a pound but they did have a 25% off sale. They also have homemade ice cream that looked really good. It definitely worth going in and buying different candies you don't see everyday. Plus it's along the canals with Gondolas going past.

I've been to Sloan's a couple more times since I posted my original review, and those visits were pretty disappointing. First, there seem to be less employees working than there were the first time I cane here. Needless to say, there were no employees offering to give samples of their ice cream on those visits. Also, it's not very clear where to line up to order or ask for a sample, since the registers are in the middle of the counter, rather than at one end of the store or another. And they don't seem to have their Chewy Pralines fudge anymore :( I tried their Kitchen Sink brownie (chocolate, peanut butter chunks, butterscotch pieces, toffee, and caramel) which I found to be moist and tasty the first time I had it. However, it was hard and didn't have enough caramel or toffee pieces in it on my next visit. Please bring back the Chewy Pralines fudge and have clear designation of where the line begins!

Loved the customer service from Laura! She was patient and encouraged us to try as much ice cream flavors before settling. She suggested flavors that what I was definitely in the mood for! Thank you, Laura! Whenever I do go back to Las Vegas will most definitely make a visit.

If you like ice cream, Sloan's ice cream is a must visit. Very different flavors the your usual ice cream parlor: toasted coconut, banana. Sundaes: Kilimanjaro and Tracy's Sink (18 scoops, 4 cookies, 4 brownies, whipped cream and cherries served in a real sink). Flavor reminds me of gelato. There are all kinds of toppings that you can add. The prices are kinda high but what the heck; Vegas is Vegas. Worth a visit or two.
Gooood. Pops chowed down on a banana split and I had a regular caramel apple. Expensive though. 35 bucks for just that.

Sorry I gave them my money... Super rude employee's. All four were occupied (or pretending to be) with their backs to the customers and when they did face the customers, they did not make eye contact. One more second of this crap and I was out of there! Once helped, we had to repeat our flavor selection several times. Although the Ice Cream was delicious the scoops were small and expensive. $7.57 for two small scoops was not worth it. Lastly, the cashier was a little shady, I think he was attempting to scam me out of my change. After giving him a $20 for the $7.57 that I owed him, he gave me my receipt and then paused. I think he was expecting me to walk away at this point. He only gave me my change when I asked for it. Beware people... beware...

Handmade and packed with flavor!! A place to definitely try. Would I try again? If the prices dropped. $6.99 for 2 scoops but it looked like only 1 scoop. But then again, it's Vegas and everything is overpriced. I can say that the ice creams we tried were all creamy and so yummy! Menu choices: coconut, wild berry, raspberry, coffee, mint chip (which wasn't green with food coloring), brownie, chocolate chip cookie. All highly recommended to try!! Customer service was nice too! Taste test the flavors as many as you'd like!

Quite a lot of good choices in ice cream flavors that made it difficult to choose. I ended up with (3) flavors in a waffle cone for about $10. A bit expensive, but that's Vegas these days. Tam, my scooper, was smiling and pleasant during the transaction. Hope to try more flavors next time in Vegas.

We stop by here not knowing what to get and Laura from Sloan's help us a lot. She is very nice and recommended some options for us. Ice cream was very good and my boys like it a lot. Thank you Laura and definitely we are coming back .

Two delicious, satisfying scoops of fatty flavorful ice cream - raspberry chocolate chunk and chocolate chocolate chunk. As others have mentioned, $7 for two scoops is pricey, but I got to savor the bites while strolling along the lovely canal at the Venetian, watching boats glide by, and doing some high end window shopping.

The sign says "ice cream," but my eyes only saw donuts ... huge frosted doughnuts that would make Homer jealous. Not since Ferris Bueller's Day Off have I been this attracted to a Sloan ... with my vision focused downward staring at her perfectly round beautiful donuts. Yes, I like big donuts and I can not lie. You other Yelpers can't deny. That when you walk by Sloan's with an itty bitty diet and see those round things in your face you get young. Sorry, I'm hooked and I can't stop staring. Oh, baby, I wanna eat cha and take your picture. Other Yelp boys tried to warn me, but that donut you got makes me so hungry. We entered Sloan's. There was a line. People were getting candies and ice cream in fresh cones, but my focus never left those big ass donuts on display in the window. Oh my God ... Olivia, look at her donut. Its sooo big. She looks like one of those Yelp guys girlfriends. Who understands those Yelp guys. They only come here because of ice cream & donuts to boot. I mean her donut ... It's just so big, I can't believe it's so round ... It's just out there ... I mean, it's the most ... Look at Sloan's donut rack ...

Some of the best ice cream I've ever tasted. I'm from WI, so I've had many a great ice creams before, but this was fantastic! I had the mint chocolate chip, which seems a bit boring. However there was little and big chunks of chocolate and the mint flavor was not too overpowering. Delicious and creamy! I also had a scoop of the chocolate reeses. The chocolate base was delicious and the peanut butter and reeses to chocolate ratio was perfect. Ahh! I wish I had more. The ice cream was very expensive tho.For two very small scoops in a cone it was almost $9. It was worth it tho! The atmosphere in the store is super cute. There are a bunch of kids toys. The wallpaper and the chandeliers are super colorful. Sadly, it's a little hard to find in the mall-area. The signs don't help. We had to walk around twice to find it but I'm so glad we found it. Best ice cream in Vegas!

I have no idea why this place is rated so highly. Pretty much just a obnoxiously colorful sweet shop that seems incredibly overpriced mediocre ice cream. I got the Dole whip pineapple and nonfat chocolate soft serve, as well as a pecan scoop. A kiddie scoop will cost you $5.99+ tax and the regular is $6.99. these are incredibly small scoops and definitely not worth so much. I guess you end up paying expensive prices in Vegas, but at least make the food good. The service was pretty nonchalant and just rang us up. There's nowhere to sit as well so you have to walk around eating your ice cream.
Came in at 10:20 and was told they were no longer making sundaes because they had already cleaned their equipment and wanted to leave for the day.

We purchased two puppy and each of them is more than 50 dollars, nobody tell us any thing before we made any payment, when we opened the puppy in their store and checked if everything was ok, and the other puppy was broken and we ask for a exchange, they told us there's no exchange, how ridiculous they are, we just get this product one minutes ago, and the employees who ever ran us up admitted that she never tell us that she explained their policy and she said that her fault, but they didn't do anything and their manager who looks doesn't know anything and just tell me it not her fault and without doing anything, useless!! Never go back to them because they have no service at all and their people just want the sale and push you out! The most important is be aware to their quality!
6 bucks for a small scoop of ice cream.... it's not even as good as basket robbins......

Cute inside and great 2 ladies working. There isn't much room at the counter and there were some idiots there either drunk or had never been to an ice cream place. They kept milling around and not trying anything but staring at the ice cream. I walked a long way and 1 flavor was melted and no good. The flavors I got- Sloan's dark chocolate and another chocolate Hodge podge flavor. Good but not better than Ben and Jerry's and not really creative. The strawberry was good but kinda melted. Way over priced. I should have known because it had almost no smell! I love the smell of fresh waffle cones and cooling fudge. They had both but no smell.

This place was okay. Prices are crazy expensive. Waffle cone was decent, but could've been fresher. The chocolate ice cream was really good. The cookie dough was bland. My husband really liked his two flavors. We also got a brownie and caramel apple to go. The brownie was pretty small and average for $5. The caramel apple was large, but the caramel was super thick and dark, which I didn't love. Also, I'm pretty sure $11 is by far the most I've ever paid for a plain caramel apple! In sum, I'd only come here if I didn't want to leave the strip and I'd skip the non-ice cream treats.
Ok, this place has SOOOO much selection! They have retail too, and candy for sale. Excellent service, and great ice cream.

Looking for vegan chocolate ice cream on the strip? You got it here! Vegan ice cream and other non-vegan ice creams are always ready here. Cash or card. Right inside the Grand Canal Shoppes. No where to sit and eat however, so be aware of that. You might have to sit on the bench outside of the store or walk about the mall with your ice cream. Would highly recommend!

Guys behind counter was friendly. Menu reads "Super thick shake". Husband ordered a vanilla shake and it was running over the sides of cup like milk. Not thick at all. The flavor was lacking. He asked for a refund. The guy said he had to get a manager. After 3 min, he came back and said that the manager told him that all sales are final but he can remake the shake. There is no sign that reads this. If it were so, the guys up front would know.

Staff was very rude! Me and my husband waited by the register forever to order and no one acknowledged us. we stood there for a couple minutes with 4 employees standing behind the counter only one was helping a guest. They have a lot of toys in the store, my husband was looking at one that was already out of the box and she accused him of opening it and wanted us to pay for it. That was all the interaction we had with the staff. We moved back over by the Register and waited for a few minutes longer but still nothing and they walked by us twice without even a "I will be right with you". At that point we left.
Great place to get a large array of homemade ice cream. Feels like an old style ice cream parlor with Vegas flare. Staff is so friendly and helpful with the many options. Laura was the best!

So when i went here we tried some donuts coz its so tempting and for some reason this day we were just having a sugar craze, we must have went to 3 dessert place trying sweets we do not need. The donuts were hard and the store offer a lot of candies you can typically buy in any store but pretty much 3 times the price. But if you are truly having a sugar fit you can buy it here no complains. The way you can get lured into here is the colorful ambience and the way the store is design. Its almost the candy house of from Hansel and Gretel in the middle of the forest but this one is inside the grand canal shops. They have other nice props that are cute that are for sale at the store too. Oh yeah, they also have the nice Chanticleer that is for sale for 300 something, pretty nice! But where am i going to put it to much my drapes ? :{ happy sweets!

Tons of flavors and the ice cream is spectacular! Keep in mind that you are paying Vegas strip prices. ($14 for 3 scoops over a brownie with hot fudge and toffee bits.) Try getting this in a Vegas restaurant - cha ching. This place will easily satisfy your sweet tooth cravings.

This is the review you hate writing. Sloan's ice cream looks great. The people behind the counter are lovely and helpful; truly wonderful service. The problem is that the ice cream just isn't good. Between the five of us we tried 7 different flavors from the usual chocolate to more elaborate concoctions. None of the ice cream had much flavor and some of the add ins, like pretzels, actually tasted stale.
Good flavors and great service but if you like ice particles in your $8 scoop of ice cream this is a place for you.

This place is over the top. Right when you walk in you're bombarded with the scent of fresh cookies and tons of interesting ice cream selections. I went here for the second time this past weekend and got their chocolate chip cookie - it was warm and gooey ugh amazing. Part of me wanted to get ice cream with it but I'm glad I didn't because it was definitely enough on its own!

Freshly made gourmet ice cream in massive portions! I stopped in for dessert and the "kiddo" size is a ginormous scoop in an oversized waffle cone. Seriously, I couldn't eat it all, though I tried. There are around 20 flavors to choose from. I was super happy to see Butter Pecan, which I never see back home in Milwaukee. The flavor was spot-on: Rich and creamy, mildly sweet with a caramel undertone, and a salty kick from the roasted pecans.

This is a store is a candy, novelty, ice cream store that feeds your eyes and your belly! It will be hard to pass it if you have kids- recently stopped there in Vegas. They have a variety of ice cream options and toppings galore! I had the butter pecan- wasn't the best ice cream I have ever had, but certainly worth a try.

Oh wow... A lot of places claim to be the best...but this is legit. Sloan's is so delicious! We got the luxury sampler which gets you 9 scoops of ice cream. FYI the scoops are small...and I wish they weren't all in the same container. It would be nice to have like an egg carton type container. However, the ice cream is delicious! I also got a brownie because brownies are my favorite. I am very picky and this was one of the best I've ever had. In my opinion it's expensive, but at least its worth it!

Walked in before 11pm, staff said they were closed. Yelp and iPhone maps says they are open til 11pm. So the staff stated they were Closed when we and two other customers walked in, before the time listed on yelp. Highly disappointed. Would not recommend. ): ): ): ):
Had the circus ice cream here with whipped cream and a cherry!!! It was amazing. I didn't think I would like cotton candy ice cream with gummy bears, but trust me you will not be disappointed
I checked this place out because of a Yelp review and it didn't disappoint. Lots of flavors, great ice cream, just a good expericance all around.

Waaay understaffed. Employees don't talk to customers. Only 3 employees and 1 in the back , while the other 2 are moving slowly. Very frustrating. Everyone in line complaining. At least if employees hustled to speedup line and make cutomers feel like their hurrying and trying their best. But its like they they don't have a care in the world, they just take their time as if there's only one person to serve and not 20. Annoyed the entire time.
This is probably the best, creamiest ice cream I've ever eaten! The candy, cookies and brownies looked delicious but 2 scoops of ice cream is all the sweet I could handle.

This place selling the most expensive ice cream ($7.50 smaller size) at the venetian and no so good, you can try a cross the Canal at Cocolini Italian Gelato place is 20% less. Is really a massing italian ice cream.

Super cute store to get your sugar rush fix. Everything is so pink with sparkles, dots, and glitter. Definitely painted by a unicorn. I usually head in for the candy sold by the pound. The ice-cream has authentic flavors, and seems to be made the old fashioned way. They also make cookies on property and I've had them on occasion while still warm. Delicious!
Delicious ice cream and great service from Ariel. Much shorter wait than Ghirardelli's. Attentive staff.

If I lived closer to the strip, I'd weigh 400lbs. So many flavors to choose from, so much to look at. I will be returning for another cookiewich at some point. Their peanut butter cup ice cream is too good to pass up.

Sloan's has a solid variety of ice cream flavors, so definitely stop by if you're looking for something out of the ordinary. We ordered the cookie dough cookie and coffee and doughnut flavors - beware you must order two scoops (we tried to order just one) but they are generous. The biggest downside is that the ice cream didn't seem very fresh or natural, as they advertised. Mine had ice flakes and the grainy taste of ice cream left too long in the freezer. May have been because we went at midnight on a Thursday, just before closing, but still disappointing. Not a bad place to catch late night ice cream if you are feeling a rumbling craving while at the Venetian/palazzo casinos!

Omg this place, it's everything glittery delicious and wonderful. You need to go, even if you're not into dessert, just for the experience. The entire place is perfectly themed, and there's an outrageous thing called "everything and the kitchen sink" (forgive me if I mis-quoted the name) that is literally served in a sink. Plus the amount of flavors and variety of dessert options go on for days!

I'screamed for ice cream and so here we are! I've been wanting to try this for a bit now and finally got to for a special occasion/reunion with long time friends. Very whimsical and colorful store interior with lots to look at and distract yourself from the large array of ice cream flavors and toppings. There is also a small confectionery corner with lots of different brownies and chocolates (kidneys couldn't handle that extra amount of sugar this time...) I got the classic sundae which comes with 3 scoops and topping of choice, liquid and one sprinkles choice costs $10.99. It's a good choice and the sampler is more than double and you get 9 scoops. The ice flavors are tempting and decadent. I chose birthday, mixed berry stracciatelli, and mom's apple pie. My favorites were the mom's apple pie and the mixed berry. I would say it is worth trying limited for very special occasions as the cost of the ice cream is almost exorbitant

A fun place for kids of all ages, as long as you've got a sweet tooth. I tried the Cookie Monster Ice Cream, the Circus Cotton Candy Ice Cream, and the Peanut Butter Fudge. Rich flavors, thick textures. A new favorite in Vegas! See it all here: youtu.be/O99LPJnnARk

If you need some Ice cream and you on the strip come to this place ASAP!! Although this place is hella expensive it is really delicious!! I Highly recommend for everyone to try the mom's apple pie flavored ice cream!!!!

When you think about ice cream this is the place you wanna beeee not only do they have amazing items on the menu like the kitchen sink that comes with real display kitchen sink field with scoops of amazing different flavors and toppings of your choosing it has a fun feel to it like your rethinking on how you eat ice cream lol this place is for sure a 5 star place employees were amazing

Super pricey but the ice cream was worth it. They have a huge selection. I had a classic hot fudge sundae. The vanilla ice cream was tasty and clearly homemade, you can see the vanilla pieces. They have bulk candy as well.

The worst customer service ever!!!! I bought 2 scoops of ice cream and asked for it in a cup. I asked for a second cup so I can split them between my 2 daughters and offered to pay for the second cup.. she starts telling me that I have to pay the full price of 2 scoops for the second cup even though it's empty!!! What kind of service is that!!! Over priced and not even that good of an ice cream! Took her literally 2 min to dig out the ice cream and scoop it out

This Sloan's Ice Cream is located inside The Venetian, in their grand canal shops. While walking around The Venetian, I decided that I wanted to grab some ice cream and so I came inside. Although there was a line, I waited a reasonable amount of time to have someone take my order. I ended getting: Two Scoop Ice Cream With Waffle Cone, $8.64 after tax- I got the Almond Joy Ice Cream & Banana Ice Cream to split with my husband (and our little girl dog). The almond joy had a nice chocolate flavor with chopped pieces of almond in it. I also really liked the banana ice cream, as it had a a great banana flavor that wasn't too sweet. Service at the counter was friendly and I was able to try samples of ice cream if I wanted. Overall, a pretty good experience.

Super cute! Super fun! Super crowded. And somewhat expensive... Located in the Venetian Hotel, this adorable old fashioned colorful ice cream / sweet shop is filled with ice cream, donuts, other baked goods, candy, stuffed animals and other fun random items like humorous dish towels and toilet paper. If you have a sweet tooth, it's heaven. My bf and I visited on a Saturday afternoon. We were drawn in by the brightly lit (mainly pink) colors and the displays located at the front of the shop. The shop was buzzing with patrons mostly wanting ice cream. There were 2 lines... one for ice cream and the other for everything else. Fortunately, I didn't have to wait in the long ice cream line. I came for the bulk candy because I'm a gummy candy addict. Although I was happy to see the bulk candy was prepackaged for Covid safety reasons, I was slightly bummed I couldn't get the amount I wanted and wasn't able to mix and match.... but I fully get it. Safety first! I ended up getting 2 bags. Considering the crowd, service was acceptable. I could tell they were a bit overwhelmed. This shop brought me back to my youth and made me feel young again. I will definitely be back.

I generally love most of the staff. The flavors are also diverse and delicious! I live close to the location and have bought Sloan's products several times. However, I dealt with an extremely rude woman that I had never met before. Very unhelpful and misinterpreted me asking a question as trying to cut in line. She didn't have a sweet attitude like the other employees that I have seen and overall had an impatient disposition. Besides this situation, I haven't had any issues.

The ice cream actually tasted very good. But the scoops are minuscule- TINY. We paid over $9 for a one scoop sundae- and it was all whipped cream. It tasted good- if we had received more than 3 spoonfuls of ice cream, it would have been 5 stars. Plus, the staff who helped us was super nice. Disappointing.

The scoops are bigger at Baskin Robbins, but the flavors are good. They have a coffee and donuts flavor, which is something you don't see everywhere. I imagine their cookies and brownies taste as good as they look

Heard a saying, don't judge the book by its cover? Very apt here, this shop looks quite pretty but ice cream is not that good. And the price they charge for such a mediocre ice cream is hard to justify. Lastly, staff here is not pleasant at all and don't have a bit of sense on how best to treat the customers. Definitely skip this place unless you are in a mood for average ice cream with high price and bad customer service.

Staff behind the counter were rude. Our party of 9 decided to take our business elsewhere. To which the worker gave us a sarcastic "bye" and laughed. I noticed others followed exiting the store. Too bad she is costing business and repeat business in this slow economy, and apparently thinks it's funny. March 15, 2021 8pm

I've been to Sloans at the Village by Topanga Mall. I Love their triple chocolate chunk cookies! I went to try their other location at the Venetian. Located on the second floor near the bridge infront of the Canaletto restaurant. This one is a bit smaller but it did not lack any goodies! The window presentation was so inviting. Their large donuts and chocolate covered apples looked so yummy!! I had to buy 2 triple chocolate chunk cookies and a few other goodies. It was as amazing as I remembered! One of my favorites cookies, a definite must, specially if you have a sweet tooth. They had such fun toys, adorable purses, amazing selection of candies and they even have dog treats! The cashier was friendly as well. I will be back!!

The BEST bakery!! I got a snickerdoodle cupcake and Oreo cookie and WOW. Speechless. So good and so fresh. The employees are so kind and warm and friendly which really made my morning. The establishment itself is absolutely adorable, the best breakfast meetup for a date, friends, family, etc. it is so beautiful inside and has a bunch of great outdoor seating. Highly recommend coming here!!

I'm absolutely obsessed with this spot! My friend brought me here on my last day visiting her in Charlotte, and I'm so glad she did! The service is AMAZING! The staff is super friendly, helpful and kind. Answered all my questions and were so patient when I couldn't decide between all their incredible desserts. My friend and I shared the millionaire cookie (chocolate chip, caramel) and their signature oatmeal cream pie. Both were decadent and insanely good. The aesthetic of this place is so quirky and charming and their Golden Girls themed bathroom is EVERYTHING. I'm sad I don't live in Charlotte because I'd make The Batchmaker a weekly stop. Oh, and it's in a complex with it's own parking, so very convenient as well!

Full disclaimer - I don't really like desserts and never order them at restaurant Another full disclaimer - I really like these cakes and I would order them at a restaurant We got the lemon blueberry cake which was probably about 10 inches high. The verticality of the cake was probably one of it's most stunning features. Had to remove a couple drawers in the fridge to make it fit but absolutely worth it. Also! We got the biscoff cheesecake. Usually my stance on this is...cake good, cheese great, cheesecake nasty crap but no sir not today! No United airline mid flight snack quality with this biscoff creation. It was light, flakey, moist and just delicious. From one cake to another, happy eating

The cookies travelled for 3 hours in a car and they were still good. I don't know if the cookies/desserts are worth the cost, but they did taste good. It's a nice treat to have once in a while since they're very sugary. I can't add anything more helpful about the cookies or the place that other yelpers have not written about yet, but that the cookies do hold up well even in a warm car. I wasn't greeted with a melted chocolate chip cookie but a sturdy cookie filled with soft chocolate chips.

Whew, I took way too long to get over here to try the great sweet offerings. I've since been twice and everything is always absolutely amazing! The parking lot is almost always full and there is some construction going on so keep that in mind. There was always plenty to choose from on my visits which were both around lunch time. I've only had cookies so far, mint chocolate chip, snickerdoodle, and double chocolate chip and they were all freshly baked, chewy and delicious.

Update for the new space: it is so cute! Warm and inviting, nice little patio seating available too. Still the best gluten free brownie of my life. There is nothing offered that I wouldn't eat. Be sure to check their Instagram for special order boxes and more!

My sister ordered a key lime cake for my birthday celebration. The person who helped us when we picked up the cake was so lovely and the location is a cute, kind of cottage core style place. The cake was denser tha I had anticipated and had a more shortbread or pound cake thickness. Lime curd was tasty. All around good cake but would prefer to try something else next time. Would give a 4.5 if I could.

We may have over did it with all the goodies! BUT let me just say this is such a cute little bakery! The decor inside is so so cute! We probably got one of everything, maybe more! Everything we tasted is so delish! It's been a couple days since we came here and I still taste the freshness of it all! My mouth is watering and I want more! Highly recommend!

What a lovely spot west of uptown! This bakery is decorated beautifully! I had the strawberry pop tart & oatmeal cream pie. Delicious! The employee working was very nice too. This is a great spot to grab a treat with a friend. Love the little play corner too. I hope they eventually do tea, this is the perfect spot for that. Love the tea decor on the wall.

Waited 3 years to try the S'more Brownie from The Batch Maker/The Batch House and it didn't disappoint. Dulce de leche brownie also deserves a shoutout. The caramel was decadent and I honestly preferred it over the s'more brownie. Oat milk cookies were almost as big as my face and apparently are a top seller along with the chocolate puddle cookies. #bergerknowsbest

Absolutely darling little bake shop with an amazing variety of top quality treats. But get there early, because they sell out quick! Must-Haves: *Definitely grab one of the rolls if they're available! Strawberry cheesecake has been my absolute favorite, but every variety has been divine! * Oatmeal crÃ¨me pies! * The cookies - s'mores, cracker, cheesecake, caramel apple, every kind is to die for! * The cheesecake or apple crumb bars! * The brownies - s'mores, Nutella, peanut butter, Oreo, oh my! * The tres leches draft latte. Even if they're sold out of baked goods, the latte alone is still worth the drive. Cris puts her heart and soul into everything she makes here and it shines through.

Bathroom Yelp: Golden Girls theme was adorable! Cute, clean and fun bathroom! Great for families! Full changing table with spares items if you don't have them. Citrus spray for freshening when you leave. The trash can is near the door so you can use your paper towel to open the door as you exit. One person bathroom. CoVid Procedures: Only 2 patrons allowed in restaurant at a time. All staff was wearing masks in the establishment. Apple Pay accepted for touch-less interactions. 6ft distance tape outside Time for the grub: The gluten "sensitive" s'mores brownie left no gluten to be desired. They do a great job of making the brownie too delicious to tell there isn't gluten. I wish I would've bought a regular one to test it against but I'll definitely be buying this again (if they have it) Coffee cake muffin was wonderfully soft and not too crumbly of a coffee cake, the softness made it seem warm the entire time I was eating it. Recommend this Just these two goodies make me want to try everything in the case. Guess I better find some more yoga pants ;)

These treats have been very popular on Instagram and made me really want to try them! I finally made it one Saturday to try the cookie I've been dying to have: the caramel apple cookie. I also picked up an oatmeal cream pie since my husband loves them. These sweets are incredible! I loved the caramel apple cookie. I really wanted more caramel and apple. Surprisingly, I think I liked the oatmeal cream pie even more. I don't know how she makes that cream but it's to die for. I definitely want to come back to try the poptarts and some of the other tasty treats she's making!

If you live in Charlotte or are ever in the area, please do yourself a favor and go to the Batchmaker aka the best bakery in the world! Every single thing I have gotten there (and it's been a lot) has been absolutely incredible! And the place is so adorable too - looks like you stepped in your grandmother's house. The Batchmaker is sure to satisfy all of your sweet treat cravings! No joke the best bakery I've ever been to! P.S. don't sleep on the draft latte. It's so good!

One of my favorite bakeries in Charlotte! The owner is extremely passionate in her baking & continues to serve in her community. When her original store got severely damaged from the flood, the community stepped in to help her recover. "People first , cake second " is a motto she stands by and it truly shows through out her work! A few of my favorite pastries are: oatmeal cream pie, cookie butter cookie & the Oreo truffle. They are out of this world Tip: arrive early because they will sell out
Absolutely wonderful!!! We tried the s'mores brownie, two kinds of pop tarts (blueberry & brown sugar) and a couple of other things whose name I can't remember but that were fantastic!!

Get there early and get there often. Crazy innovative and addictive treats and quality coffee. The options seem to rotate daily and the crowd favorite is the s'mores brownies. The bottom layer is a graham cracker crust. This may be the best brownie- even inching out the holy grail salted Carmel brownie. During COVID only two people in the store at a time. Parking is limited so bike there if you can. Prices aren't listed on the treats so ask before you get to register.

Well, the desserts are as good as they look on social media. Whatever you imagined something you viewed looked like, that's what it tastes like! After cyber-stalking this trending bakery on social media for few days , I decided to make a pilgrimage for something...anything she ( the baker) had left. Luckily, after standing in line, I was able to try a couple of items pictures with this review. It was worth the wait. If you have time to kill, the line isn't that major. Just bring a friend to catch up or whatever. There is seating indoors , and hot beverages available on the menu as well. This foodie call is worth it, trust me .

LOVE THIS PLACE! They have some of the best desserts in the area. You honestly cannot go wrong with anything on their menu. I wish they would post more special items and let the public know. They often sell out fast so go early. I also wish they would stay open later, I would love to grab some after dinner on the weekends as my dessert. Not a ton of seating inside which is a downside. Super cute place though!

The best cookies I've ever had in my life. You can taste the passion and love put into the treats. I am soo glad that there's finally a shop. I usually just put in orders for birthdays and special events. I am not a big breakfast person, so a cookie and a cup of coffee from the Batchhouse is the perfect start to the day!! Thanks for opening up your home and sharing with the community. Oh and thanks for being a friend!

Grandma, I thought of you just now, as I enjoyed a great home-made slice of delicious cake! The Batch Maker will be my go to place for the best baked goodies from now on. I wish Cristina and her great team the greatest success in this new venture, so that more and more grandmas can be remembered often!

This small bake shop is located off Freedom drive. We made our way there on a Tuesday afternoon. There is limited seating, and limited options in regards to desserts. I'm not exactly sure what I was expecting. There were a couple different cookie flavors, one brownie and the oatmeal cream pies. Aside from that there were a variety of coffee drinks to choose from. We attempted to come a few days before, but they were sold out. I could see that happening with the limited supply of baked goods. Though the oatmeal cream pie was good, I'm not sure the it was worth $4.50. The actual cookie portion was tasty, the filling was overwhelmingly sweet with a hint marshmallow flavor. I will say, we fell for the yelp hype on this one. Not sure we'll be returning.

I have been following the bakery since Charlotte Agenda posted it and I'm so glad I finally went. The bakery/ coffeehouse is adorable, the staff are all very friendly and helpful. I got the oatmeal creme pie which were heavily, and the chocolate chunk cookie. I would recommend going there early if you want to get their bake goods. They are also taking preorders now due to the Covid. You won't regret the ride over.

This is a NEW HOT SPOT to visit. The vibe is AMAZING and the owner is super sweet, just like her baked goods. My first experience here today, was very pleasant. I walked in the front door and was immediately greeted by the owner in one of the baristas. The vibe is very eclectic. Cool wallpaper on the walls and decorative plates are on display. The bathroom has a golden girls theme, how unique. I ordered a vanilla latte iced but they currently only have caramel. The caramel was amazing. Luckily, they also have oat milk. The owner let me snap a few photos around the shop for all yelpers to enjoy. The actual parking lot is small, but there is street parking nearby.Today was their soft opening. This Saturday will be their grand opening, and I can't wait to see what they have in store.

I went here for the first time yesterday and absolutely loved everything about this place! The decor, the service, and the vibe was just perfect. I went around 2pm and there were only 2 treats left; the halloween candy brownie and twix bar. If you come here for the first time, I highly recommend getting there when they open so you can choose from their wide selection of baked goods! Nonetheless, the brownie and twix bar were both so good! The cashier was so sweet and gave me an extra brownie for free since it was their last one and was very friendly and helpful! I will definitely be coming back here again, just in the morning this time! I can't wait to try what else they have!

Took a trip from NYC to Charlotte to visit friends. I've been following the batch maker, for a while now. I was super excited to go and try it out. Also, very happy that the case was stocked !! The setting is very cute and super cozy. The china that they use is to die for. Me and friends all grab some treats, to enjoy. The Banana Nutella bread, the cereal muffins, OCP, and s'mores brownies. The best out of all was the banana bread, although it was a bit too sweet. The latte that I had did help cut back the sweetness. I hope they get a microwave or a toaster. I felt like some of the thing would have been better warmer up. Like the S'more brownie, would have been amazing if it was warmed up. The texture of the cold set marshmallow was a bit off for me. The OCP, was my least favorite. The cookie itself was not the best. The filling was too sweet, and felt a bit chalky. Overall, a super cute spot and friendly staff.

It took me a few months to get here and now it's a regular Saturday stop. Most unique and delicious bakery in Charlotte? Highly recommended! I understand there were lines when they first opened but now you can get in and order quickly. Even reconnected with my friend Emily who use to work at a fish market I frequented.

I couldn't be more excited for this new addition to the local bakery scene. The goods sell out quickly most days, the line is out the door much of the time, but the goodies are worth it! I don't drink coffee so I can't review that, but the brownies are next level here! If you prefer a moist, dense brownie over the usual type that's hard enough to be used as a weapon, this is your place. I've had both the s'mores brownie that's covered with marshmallow, with a graham cracker crust, and the one with Oreos in the middle and a mint Creme on the top. Decadence! Don't miss the puddle chocolate cookies if you love chocolate as I do. The oatmeal cream pie tastes so much better than the kind out of plastic wrap. The cakes are good, but the serving size is less than I want to pay for the same price as cake slices elsewhere. If you do portion control, go for it. Mine was literally no wider than one inch. Still, it didn't affect how I feel about this place overall. This might be my favorite place that opened in Charlotte all year.

Finally got to come in person! Their hours are specific so made it happen on a Saturday which is the best shot I have. And they still had what I wanted, I had heard to come early because they sale out. So yay! First off, cutest little store!! Secondly, all you need to know is OATMEAL CREAM PIE COOKIES. Literally all you need to know, even if you think you don't like them you should get one and try it. So good! I also finally got to try the pop tart (brown sugar cinnamon). And a Carmel de leche brownie. I will say their pricing range $4-$5 each but they are big so it's worth it. Best thing I've tried tho is still that Oatmeal cream cookie!
Absolutely delicious! Everything we had (s'mores brownie, puddle cookie, Oreo truffle cookie) was fantastic. Can't wait to try more seasonal treats! This place is truly a little gem.

We've had a lot of great treats at The Batch House since they've opened. The Oatmeal Creme Pie is my favorite sweet treat in Charlotte. The Oreo truffle cookie is to die for, too. Somehow I made it this far and didn't mention the s'mores brownie. If you ever want a great drink, try their Tres Leches latte! Easily our favorite spot for sweets in Charlotte.

I just tried this place for the first time and I think this may be my favorite bakery in Charlotte. The desserts are delicious!! I had been wanting to try this place and am so happy that it lived up to the hype. My favorite item was the oatmeal cream pie. Other items I had were pumpkin loaf, apple caramel cheesecake bar, cinnamon coffee cake, & apple hand pie. All were delicious!! Everything is so flavorful and perfectly spiced. I can't wait to come back and try one of their cakes.

You ever take a bite of something so good, and for just a split second you're mad? Like you've wasted so much time on other things? Their oatmeal pie is incredible. It's without a doubt the best oatmeal cookie I've ever had and the cream filling is a perfect compliment. It's not too sweet. It's a hefty sandwich about the size of a hamburger with a price to match, but it's worth every penny. We bought some other treats that we haven't even touched but if they're even half as good as the oatmeal pie they'll be fantastic.

The chocolate puddle cookies were delicious. A little messy but definitely yummy. There is seating inside and out in love the velvet couches. How pretty! We waited in a long line right at the opening, so we weren't the only people excited to try out this new spot. The reason for the 4 stars instead of five is that prices are posted for coffee but not food. I paid $10.50 for three cookies. Go check out the yummies!

Today I ventured to a new bakery and was pleasantly surprised. It was small and quaint. Would be the perfect place for afternoon tea, treats, and girl talk. I was greeted and advised what I saw was all they had left which lead me to think you got to get here early for more variety. I decided to try Carmel chocolate chip cookie, S'mores brownie, and pastry. Let me say delicious. I am definitely going to go back again.

Our daughter moved to Charlotte from Ohio and this was her first birthday away from family. I phoned Cristina and asked if it was possible to have a cake delivered. She sent a quick response, made a beautiful cake and delivered it on a weekend in which she was swamped with Mother's Day orders!!! Our daughter was surprised, thrilled, and said it was one of the best cakes she's ever eaten! I love that this small business caters to the requests of their customers. Cristina is very sweet and great to work with. I would HIGHLY recommend this bakery to anyone wanting to make a celebration extra special. We will definitely be returning!!!

The Batch House is where The Batchmaker--Cristina Rojas--bakes her way through life, one delicious batch at a time. Recently, my loving wife surprised me with some treats from The Batchmaker--an oatmeal cream pie and a caramel apple cookie. The oatmeal cream pie was unlike any I've had before. I don't know what Cristina does to make the cream rich and moist but I hope other bakers figure it out because it is life changing.

Went and got a mixed box of yummy goodies this past weekend! I took the advice of the reviews and got there early (10 mins before opening in fact) to make sure I had my choice of things I wanted! I highly recommend everyone do the same. We ate some stuff on their outdoor bench and by the time we left (8:30/8:45), people were starting to pile in. If there's not a line, they're kinda hard to see at first sight. They're on the side of the Delectables by Holly building tucked away! Plenty of parking so get there early! The Good: the shop is just the cutest - like your grandma's home but leveled up with a modern touch. There's a small selection of rotating goodies which means the owner/baker can focus on quality vs quantity. Everything was fantastic - gingerbread cookie, puddle cookie, dulce de leche brownie, and an orange/cranberry brownie. Really wanted to try the s'mores brownie so that's for next time! Even their iced coffee is really good! The girl working the register was really nice while helping me decide on some options. The Meh: the hours might be difficult for many people who, like me, work a M-F 8-5. That just means you have to drag your sleepy ass out of bed Saturday mornings, load up on carbs, and go back to sleep after (that's what a friend told me...I wouldn't know heh) The Bad: nothing noted! Hailed as one of the best bakers in Charlotte, this shop does not disappoint!

Tried my first couple things from here -- the s'mores brownie and an Oreo cookie. I thought the Oreo cookie was incredible. I really liked the brownie but my fiancÃ© really loved it. Also ordered a cappuccino and it was perfectly made and delicious. I will definitely be back

I have been chasing their s'mores cookies, brownies and cakes for what seem to be an eternity. But finally I got some. It's not what I wanted but it's something. So I got the s'mores cake, and a tres Leche cake. My friend loves the tres Leche. And I like the s'mores. It's very moist and heavenly. I can't say their customer service was 5 stars. They were very short wirh their answers both times. So I didn't try to push it or overly chatty. First time. It was packed in there. 2nd time. It was the first Wednesday at they opened in the evening. And it seem like there were a private event going on at the same time.. So I felt a bit rushed. All in all. I would love to come back and get the s'mores cookies, and more cakes

I wish I could give them 10 stars! The Batchhouse not only continually and consistently gives us amazingly delicious treats, but the team behind this gem creates the most special and sincere environment for everyone to enjoy. From the smiles that greet you on entry to the beautiful interior, it's the perfect spot to enjoy the BEST goodies in Charlotte. Cris really does put her heart in all her recipes and it shows! Thank you Batchhouse for working so hard and giving us the best of the best! Some of my personal faves: Oreo truffle cookies, s'mores cake, dulce de leche brownies, oatmeal cream pies, and their cold brew!

I visited this place twice while in Charlotte, and man their cookies are delicious. I got the chocolate puddle cookies, the nutella cookies, and the oreo truffle cookies, and the Oreo truffle was my hands down favorite. I also got their tres leches draft latte during one of the visits and I told my friend about it within minutes because it was THAT good. I hope that they one day ship their cookies to NYC because I'm sad that I'm not close enough to get a regular fix of these cookies, but I'm so glad that I checked them out while I was down there. Next visit to Charlotte, I will definitely be back. So good - definitely give them a try! A tip - they charge extra if you get a drink without ice because it requires them to use a bit more materials. It's not a bad thing, and they tell you about it before they do - but it's something that is good to know!

We ordered the oreo truffle cookies, chocolate puddle cookie and a s'mores brownie. All of it was amazing! Looking forward to our next visit and hopefully, we get to try something with dulce de leche.

Amazing bakery, staffed and run by awesome women. The owners motto of "people first, cake second" is what drew me in, and the DELICIOUS cookies, cakes, and brownies are what keeps our family coming back!

I requested a birthday cake on short notice and The Batchmakers enthusiastically responded and the cake was both beautiful and delicious! The birthday girl chose a cereal infused vanilla cake and it was a hit with all who indulged. It was worth every calorie! We can't wait to try her other cake flavors!

Yummmmmmmmmm. Our hot chocolates were super smooth. I ordered so many baked items. My boyfriend said the brownie he had was the best in a very long time. The folks serving were very nice. Would go back!

The absolute most adorable store front in a growing location. The owner is loved by Charlotte, for the right reasons. Every single item I have ordered has been delicious. I love to get a big box twice a year to try everything out. Not to mention the oatmeal cream pie candle is the best smell ever. The Nutella banana bread, s'mores brownie, all of the cookies and literally anything else you get there is to die for!

I can't say enough good things about this place! I found the place on social media, fell in love with Cris' story behind how she started her bakery and knew I HAD to try something she made! I have tried the brownies, cookies and oatmeal cream pies with every intention of returning to try all the other goodies because everything is just DELISH! I have also tried the chocolate cake layered with cookie dough and I honestly think it's the best cake I've ever had in my life, no exaggeration! If you're thinking about visiting this quaint little bakery, do it! You most certainly won't regret it!

No change to my thoughts about this place since my first visit/they first opened - everything here is amazing and everyone that works there is so nice and helpful. Their oatmeal cream pie has changed my life - legit the only dessert I have ever craved. Pro-tip - they also freeze amazingly! Also their tres leches draft latte is amazing. How many times can I use amazing in a yelp review?? Never enough for the batch house!

Obsessed is an understatement. If you haven't had the batch maker you are missing out! The s'mores brownies are to die for! I've only been able to get a box from her but everything in it was amazing. Sells out in minutes it's so good!

I like to think of myself as a cookie/baked goods connoisseur, so when I found out about The Batch Maker I couldn't wait to go. I stood in line opening morning with my twin boys and enjoyed my treat and Tres Leches coffee. Since then, my boys and I are weekly regulars for many reasons: 1) This is hands down the best treats I have ever consumed. The Smore's Brownie, Cookie Dough brownie, Oreo Truffle cookie and the pop tarts are all worth every penny. I still have many treats to try. 2) THE STAFF and CRIS- they make you feel at home, greet you with a smile and take time with each customer to ensure he/she gets exactly what they need. 3) Kid-friendly- There are definitely some coffee places that make you feel awkward when you roll in with two toddlers, but The Batch Maker welcomes kids with open arms. They have a kid cart, which includes toys, games and everything to keep your toddler busy while you enjoy your coffee/latte HOT. They also offer storytime on Saturdays in the space next door with additional treats. 4) Tres Leches Latte-get it! The Batch Maker is the highlight of our guests' trips to Charlotte. I always recommend our Airbnb guests to stop in, and when they do they rave about it... as I do. Kudos to Cris and her absolutely incredible team and staff for making The Batch Maker such a special place for our family to visit every week. It's our favorite place in Charlotte!

I have been following this place on Instagram since before they opened and finallyyyyyyy got across town to try it out! I got the oatmeal pies and Oreo truffle cookie and let me just say it was the best cookie I've ever had in my life. No exaggeration! It taste exactly how the pictures look lol only minor minor complaint is that, it was obvious I had never been there and the cashier wasn't any help at all I asked was there a menu (I was aware that they don't always have the same desserts) and the cashier stated there wasn't one because it changes daily.. then I asked for prices and she told me between $2-$4 then kinda walked away. just would've like to had known details on what were in the treats and specific prices. I would've bought more if she was a tad bit more attentive. The treats made up for it!!!!

If I could give zero stars I would!! So I went to the bakery to buy cookies 3 weeks before I ordered the cof course I get there they were sold out. I asked the owner that I wanted to order a cake she said I HAD to do it on line I said I'm here I want to order it she said no that's not how we do it. So I sent and email because that's how you order it. Wait 2 days to get a response the pick up date was 2/19 also order cookies. During the week I tried to get them to hold cookies and I was told no they couldn't? I'm like I'm spending about $100 and you can't hold cookies? They said no. So I get there picked up the cake and the special cookies. Thankfully they had cookies so bought some. Well fast forward we cut the cake on my moms birthday and OMG!! The cake was raw!!! The third layer on the top you can see it. I'm so disgusted!! I reached out to the owner and she seemed as she was going to do blues clue and find out?? Meanwhile I'm embarrassed that everyone at the party was like what's that in the cake. I expressed this to the owner and it meant NOTHING to her. I got charged for the cake....cookies....I even paid a tip???? Since when do bakeries do this?! She was not sympathetic nor did she offer me no type of compensation towards HER mistake. Very disappointing and sad that she gets to do this and have no type of customer service!!
Chill little coffee shop with some of the best baked goods in town!! Highly recommend the banana Nutella bread or the homemade pop tart.

There are times my wife and I need to finish our night with a treat. One place we love to either get a treat to end our night or to have with our morning coffee is batchmaker. This place has great homemade baked goods and the owner and staff are such nice and friendly people. We have had the pop tarts (both apple cinnamon and strawberry), the oatmeal cream pie, their brownies, cereal killer muffins with cereal cooked inside. We have loved everything. My wife's favorite is the oatmeal cream pie and mine is the pop tart. They also serve coffee from my favorite local coffee shop, Hex/stable hand. So, two great local spots collaborating is also a big win for us all. Good people, great food and great drinks is what local shopping is all about. I would recommend this place to all sweet connoisseurs.

Even if they're all sold out of goodies, they're worth the hype alone for their Tres Leches draft coffee. I've been an OG fan of Cris and the Batchmaker since she first started selling goodies out of her house in Huntersville. Now she's on 2.0 of her Batch House bakery and I'm still obsessed. Coming from a resident Batchmaker orderer, the OCPs (Oatmeal Cream Pies) and the S'mores Brownie are MUST gets -- she's absolutely famous for them and you'll understand why when you have a bite yourself. Really any of her brownies are to-die-for because her recipe contains half part chocolate to the rest of the ingredients...so they're ooyey fudgey goodness! On the cookie end, her Puddle Cookies are jam packed with delicious chocolate. And for cake, you cannot go wrong with any slice she offers! Honestly, If I come and she doesn't have what I was looking for I order something else or order what's available because anything and everything she touches is amazing. She does custom orders of her treats and her cakes, so check out her website. I've ordered many custom goodies from her over the years for holidays or just-because. She sells out FAST everyday. So get here first thing in the morning or order ahead for bigger orders. Even if she sells out, it's such a cute place for a cup of coffee.

Love that they have the late night hours on the first Wednesday of the month! The s'mores brownie I can truly say is one of the best desserts I have eaten. The brownie portion was incredibly fudgy and had the perfect ratio of marshmallows and graham cracker crust. Excited to try more treats!

So, first things first... I like coffee-flavored coffee. So, that's what I drink. I've only had the drip coffee and pastries, but their drip is out of this world! I am certain the rest of their coffee drinks are just as good. The pastries are the rockstar of the show. I strongly recommend the pop tarts. They decadent AF and incredibly delicious! I work literally 10 steps from here, so it quickly became a daily stop. Not much else to say. If you've not been, you're totally missing out on this little gem.
Was looking for a special decadent cake for my husbands birthday. Found Batch House through internet search. Ordered chocolate salted caramel. It was FABULOUS!!! My new cake go to! Highly recommend!

My friend who I was visiting lives down the street from this place, and he took us here to start off our morning walk and let me just say I'm soooo glad he did! This little place is adorable with golden girl vibes all around! I had gotten the draft iced coffee tres leches and it was phenomenal! I also tried the apple cheesecake which I would eat all day every day if I could. Also got the caramel chocolate chunk cookie which was the size of my head and soft and gooey, yummy!

The Batch Maker has, by farrrrr, the BEST baked goods you will EVER eat. There is nothing I've tried that I haven't enjoyed. Not only is everything amazing, Cris, the owner is the sweetest woman you will ever meet! She cares so deeply for her customers and you can tell how much love goes into her baked goods. I had the pleasure of creating the mural in the bathroom and Cris was such a pleasure to work with.

RUN, don't walk, to this INCREDIBLE bakery on Charlotte's west side. It is a quaint shop in an area that is being developed into a spot you could spend all day at. Every interaction I've had with the wonderful ladies that work there has been so sweet. But the real star, are the baked goods! I love that they have a rotation of items so you always have something new to try. I have LOVED multiple variations of their coffee cakes and brownies and my husband loves the cookie sandwiches. It is impossible to walk out with just one treat since they ALL look so amazing!

I have never in my life loved a brownie so much as the ones from the batch maker! Every single baked good is made with so much love and care and it absolutely shows. The actual space is adorable and cozy and I look forward to coming back often! Amazing job!

Easily the best cookies I've ever had. I was tired of the usual with the chain cookie spots. After a little research I found this little gem. Very cute on the outside and inside. I bought a variety of things just to try out and everything was AMAZING! Chocolate Chip OCPs, Oreo truffle chocolate chip, Nutella chocolate chip, and a red velvet cookie brownie. 5/5. You won't be disappointed.

I did it! I got a Batchbox and feel like I won a golden ticket! I got a: chocolate puddle cookie, millionaire shortbread cookie, brown sugar pop tart, oatmeal cream pie, and a chocolate birthday cake slice. Would I get all of these items again? Hell yes. I wish I bought double of each. Now reviews of each item: The millionaire shortbread cookie? Perfect balance of salty, sweet. The Chocolate puddle cookie will blow any traditional chocolate chip cookie out of the water. The brown sugar cinnamon pop tart is super flaky, and filled with all the cinnamon-y goodness of your childhood - but topped with sprinkles too! The chocolate birthday cake - holy dulce de Leche filling - this cake is for serious dessert lovers only! I don't know why but the oatmeal cream pie is bigger looking in person than it is in the picture- it is dense, thicc with a "c", and absolutely ahmazing. Look at all this texture! Hate me for saying this but, Little Debbie's could never be this thicc and delicious ! The space is so chic, homey, and welcoming - as is all of the staff! I will definitely be back! There was a line when I arrived a little after 8am (on a Tuesday!) so I highly recommend going early for the best selection! @feisty.eats

I can not say enough good things about this place. First, the food. Nothing is bad, it all tastes amazing. The sweet treats are always so creative, so tasty, and for this reason they sell out fast! So get there early. I also ordered a cake for my husbands birthday, i was so impressed. The owner is sweet, kind and organized. Had fantastic communication, Emailed me a week out and one day before my cake Pick up to confirm . I will be back, and will be singing praises for this sweet business!
This place is absolutely amazing...best desserts in Charlotte! Get the oatmeal cream pie...you won't be disappointed!!
The brownies are amazing. The deserts are perfect. Short wait time and great customer service!

What delicious treats they have. This bakery is known for their s'mores brownies but their oatmeal cream pies and puddle cookies are truly to die for. I do wish the opening hours were still 7am so I could stop there before work but that will just make when I can get there that much more special. If you're lucky when you go you'll see the owner Cristina who is so sweet!

These cookies are delicious I was gifted 3 cookies in the cutest pink box. I just couldn't believe how beautiful and tasty the cookies are and even freeze well I have one more left. I had to pace myself the s'mores cookie, orange pistachio and chocolate chip are just amazing fresh buttery goodness!

The absolute best dessert place/bakery in Charlotte. My wife and I have been going to the batchmaker before she had a brick and mortar location and she never disappoints. Her second location and the quality and consistency remains. Do yourself a favor and order 2 oatmeal cream pies if there's any in stock!

Really love this place! I love the idea of a small shop and open til you sell out...I feel like the Batchmaker makes a valiant effort to be available during the week, the weekends and a couple times during the evening hours which is awesome of a small business owner and working mom! The space is small but cozy, quaint, well decorated and the employees are always so nice and helpful... getting everyone in and out but also not rushing people through. I think the prices also justify supporting a local business and quality items that you can only get there. I typically go once a week and even if my favorites are sold out it's a chance to try something new!

I had been absolutely DYING to try a bakery in West Charlotte, the Batchmaker Batch House, but the hours make it difficult for me to get here. They're only open while supplies last, between 8 AM and 3 PM, Tuesday-Saturday. When you work weekdays (like I do), the hours are not conducive to getting here! If they opened an hour earlier, I could get here more regularly. Until then, Saturdays are my only shot at making it in. It's a very limited menu, too, except on Saturdays when they showcase a wide array of goods. They WILL sell out though, so I highly recommend getting here as early as possible! This small little shop features a menu of rotating sweet treats throughout the week. There are a couple of tables outside the shop, and if it weren't for COVID, I'd love to sit in the super-cute, midcentury styled seating area inside -- complete with sofa, accent chair, a few tables, and a small bar you can work from (or simply sit and enjoy a snack). Alas, only two people are currently allowed in at a time. I love that the owner is 100% self-taught with no formal training. It makes the bakery feel more real and community-driven. I had no formal training when I worked as a chef, so I admire its owner. Heck, maybe I'll apply for a weekend job. Trade a few secrets as something to do. When I went, the service was extremely slow. It took a solid 10-15 minutes per customer, and when only two people are allowed in at a time due to COVID, the line moves at a snail's pace. I arrived at 9 AM, and it took about 40 minutes for me to get inside. The line only continued to build up behind me. I HIGHLY recommend you get there for opening, and just know that there is no "running in" for a quick treat here. Here's what I ordered: Tres Leches Draft Iced Latte. They partnered with Hex Coffee in Charlotte to offer this draft latte. It's on tap and tastes more like a dessert than a coffee. It's creamy, sweet, and delicious -- with just a hint of coffee. I TOTALLY recommend it! S'mores Cupcake. I have mixed feelings about this. Overall, it was one of my favorite things I tried. The chocolate cake was PERFECTION! It was fluffy, moist, and chocolatey... what's not to love? The marshmallow was great too. The one negative for me is that the frosting was too sweet -- like so sweet you think your teeth might fall out. If the frosting were a marshmallow frosting that was then garnished with a fancily designed graham cracker, this would be my go-to every time. I can't stop thinking about how good the chocolate cake portion was! Oatmeal Cream Pie. This is what the bakery is famous for. It's like a "Little Debbie Oatmeal CrÃ¨me Pie" but SOOOO MUCH BETTER. I find the Little Debbie one sickly sweet (like the frosting from the S'mores cupcake). The Oatmeal Cream Pie at Batchmaker is heavenly. It has insanely good vanilla and marshmallow filling that oozes out in the best way possible. This was my favorite thing I tried -- and quite frankly, if the line weren't so long, I would have gone back inside for another one. Pro tip: Sometimes, they offer a variation where they put the filling between two Oreo Truffle Cookies, which has to be INSANELY GOOD. Oreo Truffle Cookie. This is an excellent cookie. I love Oreos, and this was a whole new level of deliciousness. It's chewy with a slight Oreo/slight vanilla flavor. It's sweet but much more subdued than an Oreo is. I'd call this perfection. If you like Oreos, these are DEFINITELY worth a try. Cinnamon Coffee Cake. This was good, but a disappointment compared to everything else. Don't get me wrong; it's a knock-out for coffee cake -- it's soft, moist, and has just the right amount of cinnamon. Everything else was just so dang good; this felt a bit boring. Caramel Scone. Perhaps it was caramel apple? It tasted like a delicious apple pie, so I think there was apple in it -- but maybe my brain was playing tricks on me. I can't find it on their menu, and it didn't have a sign when I was there, so maybe I imagined it... Anyhow... it's terrific if they do have it available when you visit. Turtle Cookie. These are BRAND NEW to the menu. It's a chocolate cookie covered in caramel and topped with sea salt and a pecan. It was delicious! And definitely more chocolatey than the caramel and pecan flavor of a traditional turtle. If you're looking for something soft and chewy, this is your YUM! Strawberry Pop Tart. THANK GOD real pop tarts don't taste like this -- I'd quickly be on the way to "my 500lb life." This deliciously flakey pastry is almost a pie crust with a slight sweetness: it's a perfect pop tart. They make a few other flavors too, like blueberry, brown sugar, and PB+J (all of which I need to try). S'mores Brownie. I paid for this; however, they forgot to put it in my box. After I got home, I reached out to them when I realized it was missing, and they were super sweet and embarrassed about it. Next time I come in, they'll give me the one I paid for, plus another to make up for it!
You will never be disappointed stopping in here! It's also nearly impossible to walk out with just one thing. These cookies are absolutely amazing

Cristina was great to work with. She was very responsive when it came to a cake order we placed and the dulce de leche passed my Brasilian wife's standards with flying colors. I will absolutely be using Cristina for any future orders I have and will look forward to visiting the coffee shop more often on a regular basis.

Seriously the best cookies I've ever had! If you like cookies you have to try the Batchmaker cookies, they are life changers! The Oreo, smores, chocolate puddles and the iced tree leches coffee is pretty yummy too!

For anyone to give this place less than 5 stars, they must have a chip on their shoulder. As a sweets addict I can honestly say this is the best bakery in Charlotte, no competition. Not to mention the owner is so sweet and kind hearted. I will always support this business.

I know the City of Charlotte loves to hype up new businesses, and support is important, but you lose credibility when you exaggerate on reviews. Based on the 5 star review I had to give it a try. I mean it's a win win situation right? WRONG! It's a very small "bakery" with a small variety of desserts. Nothing really popped out at us, as it's mostly cookies, brownies and on this day a slice of "Snicker Cake" which was NOT good! At 6$ per slice it's also very expensive. The cake was not moist at all and the frosting was hard and not creamy at all. I didn't get the feeling or taste of a Snicker Bar with the exception of the occasional peanuts in the cake. The service was friendly, but I definitely won't be back! It did not fulfill my sweets craving.

Finally got to order a Jumbo box during covid and got super lucky. Her items are just legit and you can tell they were made with love. Unconditional love. It was a lot of pastries but the gf and I just nibbled on them day by day until they were gone. Everything tasted just as good days later with maybe the exception of the jelly roll (we'll eat that first next time haha). I can't wait to go try more things when she finally reopens and especially to get those oatmeal pies and cookies. Those were my highlights. Just be aware, she sells out quickly with almost everything she makes.

If you looking for the best bakery/desserts in town look no further. Our family has been supporting and going to the Batchmaker for year's. This is family owned and operated by the best team around. Don't walk but run to the batchmaker you will not regret it. Our favorite things: OCP, Poptars, and aything Oreo she makes is unreal.

I've been a customer of The Batch Maker for a while now - she's our baker for all our birthday and other celebrations. Now that she's opened a storefront, we get to enjoy her treats whenever we want! I've had the chocolate chip puddle cookies, oatmeal cream pie, smores brownies, salted caramel brownies and many of her cakes - the strawberry is to.die.for. Everything is always incredibly fresh and over the top rich, gooey and delicious - just the way you want a special treat! On our recent visit to the batch house, we also had the mocha latte and the caramel latte. Both were super delicious - I honestly think I could drink her homemade caramel sauce straight out of the jar!

Okay so The Batchmaker is a baking wizard. The only downside is that this place is so good that it sells out quickly and I don't wake up early enough to beat the crowd on the weekends so I usually end up empty handed or with the last things they have left (which have always been amazing) but it means I don't actually get to pick from all her goodies... one of these days I will get my hands on her oatmeal cookie sandwich. So my biggest suggestion for someone wanting to try this magical place is to plan ahead and wake up early!
Omg, the best brownies I've ever had! I haven't been able to try much of a variety as they're always sold out, but I can't wait to go back!

Huge fan of this new place! It's hard to get me out of bed early on a Saturday but the treats were worth it and we'll be back! I can't express in words how fantastic the oatmeal cream pies are... crunchy but chewy and just wonderful. Everything else we tried was awesome too (s'mores brownie, Oreo cake jar, Oreo truffle cookie), but those were my favorite. Also got a very solid latte here with homemade caramel. Highly recommend!

We have ordered several cakes from here. I will tell you each one is delicious. We did have some issues with our last order and the greatest thing about Chris is her customer service. She personally responds to each and every email and we emailed back-and-forth a few times and I told her how much my family loves her cakes and it is a tradition in our home to get birthday cakes from her and when I told her how we felt about the last cake she immediately fixed it. Now don't get me wrong the cake was delicious the cookie dough was phenomenal there was just a couple of issues and she fixed it... I love this place I recommend this place to everyone I think Chris and her staff are the absolute best and I wouldn't go anywhere else for my cakes.

Just when I thought I had discovered all of my favorite spots in the QC for good coffee, pastries, etc., Batch House appeared! I love everything I've experienced about this place thus far--great Wesley Heights location, comfortably nestled between Laca Projects & The Living Room. Excellent service. Phenomenal, clearly thought out assortment of sweets to choose from. I actually had a hard time because everything sounded so delicious, but the banana Nutella bread I chose was spot on for today. Fluffy yet moist banana bread up top, with a perfectly rich & inviting Nutella crust?! I'll definitely be back!

These pastries are amazing! I got half a dozen of a variety and honestly all of them where sooo good! Out of all I think my favorite one was the brownie and to second that the pop tart. We took these on a road trip and these were gonna within seconds! I also got a tres leches coffee and I have to say this was amazing. I normally drink black coffee with no sugar and I was surprised of how good this coffee was. I can't wait to go back and try different things. I keep on looking at the lemon bars on their Instagram account so hopefully next time I go those are up for grabs!

Found out about this place just a few days before heading down to Charlotte from Massachusetts. I wanted to order a special cake for my boyfriends birthday but saw on the website that a week notice was necessary. So, I messaged them to ask if they have cakes in the case that we could buy same-day when we got there. Instead, they fit in a special order for us and made an absolutely delicious cake based off my boyfriends favorite dessert- tiramisu. It was incredible!!!

I have been to the Batchmaker multiple times. It is a great place to pick up goodies for the office, grab a coffee and muffin for breakfast (or hang out and Eat it there) or to get a great birthday cake. The peanut butter cup chocolate cake is crazy good. If you need a cake, make sure to plan ahead when ordering but it will be worth the wait.

My best friend mailed me a Batchmaker cake for my birthday a few years ago and it was so good! Fast forward to last month: I was visiting my friend in CLT,so you know we had to come to the Batch House! The space is so cute and welcoming. I felt comfortable as soon as I walked in. We ordered a little bit of everything to try. I honestly can't pick a favorite, but my top faves were the puddle cookie, the oatmeal cream pie, and the edible cookie dough. I also snagged a "people first, cake second" hat that I have been wearing around Pittsburgh. As someone who likes to bake as a hobby, Cris's creations really inspire me! I can't wait to come back to Charlotte and trying some more goodies from the Batchmaker!

Everything is delicious at the Batch House! I've ordered cakes from Cris for years but I love that I finally get to stop by and grab one off treats. The caramel apple cookie was delicious! My favorite is the oatmeal cream pie but really everything there is amazing including the coffee!!! Don't miss out on this special place!
This place is amazing. Really good bakes you will pay for the quality but not outrageous. There wed-site is really helpful. Side note yelp has the wrong opening times 8am most days

This big time brownie is money - it's so rich. Easily the richest brownie I've ever tasted, with gobs of gooey fudge in the middle, graham cracker crust at rock bottom, layered with roasted marshmallow. I thoroughly enjoyed every bite of this beast brownie as it really packs a major punch. Also, a must try are their oatmeal creme pies, wow. Both items are Batchmaker's best selling and appropriately for my first visit (and easily not the last), I had to get both. Oh, and I cannot forgot to comment on their cookies, which may be up for best in town. Vast menu, and I can attest the oreo truffle chocolate chip, caramel chocolate chip, and peanut butter cookies are amazing. The Batchmaker just became my favorite bakery in town and me being a cake guy, am overly excited to try the cakes there. You have to pre-order them so those reports are soon to come. I just wish their hours were more convenient, but I understand as Cristina, The Batchmaker herself, just opened this location and bakes all the goodies by herself. Had to wait for the hype to die down as they were selling out fast daily. I'll be back (Arnold voice).

If you want to have the tastiest treats in Charlotte, then this is your place. The Batch Maker and Batch House never disappoints. From the s'mores brownies to the puddle cookies everything is consistently delicious and unique. I've seen some other local bakeries make an attempt at emulating her s'mores brownies and they don't even come close. To top it all off, the owner is a joy and clearly loves baking AND interacting with her customers.
