I am hoping to go back to try more because I really want to like this place..at this point though, I have been more disappointed than anything.

Very glad they opened a matcha place in Charlotte just wish they chose a closer location near Southend or Midwood. Have tried their Matcha Special drinks and all the soft serve flavors (matcha, black sesame, hojicha). Black Sesame needed a stronger sesame taste but no complaints here.

We stopped by here to try them out after going to try Sheng Ramen in Ballantyne. I dig the decor and it's where the old TCBY used to be at the Arboretum. I decided to get the soft serve which is a bit pricey at $5.50 but it was still good. I got the mix of Matcha and Vanilla and realized I'm still not the biggest matcha person but it was very good ice cream nonetheless. Totally instagrammable too as there were a group of girls taking selfie pics galore with their treats. I'm not sure if it's worth driving 30 mins for me but I'll def be back to try one of their drinks when I'm in the area to eat because New Zealand Cafe is my jam.

If you're coming to Charlotte, this is a must try. I've heard so much about this place and it lived up to all my expectations. The matcha soft serve and latte had such a rich matcha flavor. The ube soft serve was also very rich and paired beautifully with the matcha. The parfait had a layer of matcha cake, mochi balls, cereal, and grass jelly. Really a wonderful treat and a all-in-one dessert. I will say this again, if you come to Charlotte, this is a must visit location!
I love this place. The tea is so good! Hojicha Tea is my all time favorite. I don't mind to drive a little bit to have their tea.

I don't usually give reviews, but this place has the best and most authentic matcha! I kid you not I come here once a week! From the atmosphere to the employees, it's a great hang out spot with friends and even yourself.

If you love matcha then this is the spot for you! They have matcha EVERYTHING. Matcha drinks, pastries. And ice cream! I had the matcha ice cream with half roasted matcha and it was so good they also have a vanilla flavor for the non matcha lover friend or significant other that tags along. Prices range from $3-$9

Matcha Cafe Maiko is a must-visit! The store itself is beautifully designed and decorated; creating a warm and relaxed, trendy atmosphere. The menu is vast with matcha ice cream, iced matcha, hot matcha, matcha lattes, shaved ice matcha and more. I had the strong matcha ice cream and it was the real deal, strong matcha taste and beautiful color. The staff and owner are all so friendly and helpful. I absolutely recommend Matcha Cafe Maiko and it is one of my new favorite places!

So the first time I had Maiko was in San Francisco, they have a store front in Japan town. It was the best thing I have eaten in a long time. When I drove by the other day and noticed one in arboretum, it took everything I had to not run in there at like 10 am. So tonight we went. This one is everything I remembered it to be. This is a MUST! The decor is clean and bright. The staff is so kind and welcoming. It is midnight and we are already talking about going back tomorrow.

I absolutely love this place! It is such a tastefully decorated and cute cafe tucked towards the back of the Arboretum Shopping Center. They were the first place in Charlotte that I knew of that served Black Sesame Ice Cream! I remember making it as a suggestion at local ice cream shops but no shop ever took the idea. I'm also a huge fan of Matcha and I absolutely love their Matcha ice cream since it's not overly sweet. My latest addiction is their Ube Latte with Oak Milk. They have since added some pastry items to their menu and my favorite is the Matcha Cream Puffs. The store is really bright and clean. The staff is always friendly and so patient since I have a hard time making a decision sometimes. I love how you can order online as well. I sometimes buy their pints of ice cream to keep a stash at home since the store is a bit of a drive for me. Overall, can't wait to try more of their items!

This place is amazing! Their matcha is super high quality and their soft serve js amazing! They even have a different flavor every month which keeps the menu fresh for customers to try something new on a frequent basis, which i love! So far their ube, sesame and earl grey flavors that i tried are amazing as well! I see some people complaining about prices here but you pay for what you get and its not like u cant see the prices on the menu before paying. No ones forcing you to buy things that you cant afford *SMH. Go to McDonalds and get urself a dollar cone if ur complaining abt the prices. Ppl just dnt understand that somethings are expensive to make, especially matcha products. If u can pay $6 for a starbucks coffee that costs them probably 20 cents to make then you can pay $6 for high quality matcha that has ingredients way more expensive than coffee. =] Anyways i love this place and def recommend everyone to try.

When I was browsing Instagram stories I came across this Cafe and I knew immediately that I needed to come to Charlotte and try out this place for myself. As a lover of Matcha and everything Matcha, this place definitely hit the spot for me. The Matcha used was barely noticeably bitter, which means that it is "ceremoniously grade Matcha" or "High-Quality Matcha", which is unlike most places in North Carolina. The Cafe is decorated to match the Holiday season so it is definitely a spot to get your instagrammable foodie pictures as well as try out high-quality Matcha desserts! I'd definitely recommend this place to anyone!

This place has the best ice cream that I can find the area. The sitting area and decor were great, is nice and comfortable for some ice cream, snacks, or drinks. I love their ice cream favorites, the default Matcha, Hojicha, and Vanilla. However, the best part is their seasonal favorite, so far they had Sesame, Ube, Mango, Rose, and Thai Tea, each tasted so different and give me something to look forward to each time, I can't wait to see what they will have next, I don't mind if they have Ube all the time.

Best soft-served ice cream I ever had. At first when receiving a very dauntingly large ice cream cone I was worried about my ability to finish it. But to my surprise tthe ice cream was perfect. The temperature was perfect wasn't too cold and didn't melt to fast. The matcha flavor of the ice cream was definitely present but not over powering with the addition of the vanilla swirl to add some extra flavor. The ice cream had the perfect amount of sweetness. I don't have a sweet tooth but I still able to finish the ice cream in one sitting. The ice cream was flavor were very subtle easily melting in your mouth yet somehow so perfect in making you addicted to taste more. If you're not trying this ice cream and you're from the area you are definitely missing out.

Adorable Matcha tea and ice cream shop. Great selections and feels like you stepped right into a modern Tokyo tea shop right here in the Arboretum. The team is super patient friendly and put a great amount of effort into making the perfect drinks. I can't wait to return. I ordered the number 8, tastes liked a toasted green tea latte but not overly sweet. The shop is tucked over in the corner near Versona and Penney's Spices
Very cute location with indoor and outdoor seating! It's a very unique ice cream and the flavor is great. I'd say they are on the pricy range but worth it to try

What a cute little cafe. Got the parfait with a Matcha swirl and it was delicious!! I wish I had more appetite to get drinks. Everything we got was perfect and so unique. This is exactly the type of place Charlotte needs.
The taste of matcha, which reminds me of Japan, was good. The shop was fashionable and inspired.
A stop here is always matcha needed. Always refreshing and satisfying to my sweet cravings. Don't forget to order the golden shu. You'll feel like royalty, and maybe turn into it too ;)
This place is my go to when I am looking for a snack. It is very high quality matcha. I enjoy their soft serve and Sunday options. It makes me feel like I am back in Japan.

Obsessed with matcha anything, I'm so glad Matcha Cafe Maiko opened up here in Charlotte. The interior is decorated beautifully and the staff is extremely sweet. I will definitely be back again. We got a bit of everything but my favorite was the special matcha parfait. It's creative and everything blends well together. It is a little bit too sweet but it's not stopping me from coming back again. I enjoyed it very matcha ;)
Love their matcha, vanilla, and hojicha ice cream!! So rich and creamy and so so good!!! You have to try it if you haven't!! The owners are super nice too!

Can we talk about how aesthetically pleasing the inside of this place is so adorable and relaxing? Service has been nice and helpful. The owner makes baked good she changes up. If you like green tea this matcha place is for you. I think there is a sweetness level as well. They also offer hojicha roasted matcha which is very good and tasted almost like coffee to me in the sample. Some flavors can be mixed with soft serve. They also offer seasonal items and a variety of refreshing drinks. It is a hole in the wall location but I recommend this place. They are also offering online order curbside pickup. They also have edible gold sheets for ice cream if you're into that

May this season bring you matcha joy Super stoked that @matchacafemaikoclt opened up in Charlotte (arboretum shopping center)! @matchacafemaikoclt whips up fresh matcha everything from lattes to soft serves to their dessert special. They also have vanilla and hojicha soft serve as well!

Stopped by after dinner to grab some drinks and sweets. I had a matcha tea and it was ok. When I get hot tea I want it to be super hot and this was just mildly warm so I had to drink it faster than I cared to. My husband got the Maiko special and it was very interesting. It's a matcha ice cream with all sorts of things, like corn flakes and jelly, added into it. If you are wanting something sweet and sugary this isn't what you want but if you like Japanese flavors or just want to try something different and new you should check it out.
Matcha soft serve float was good, flavors were nice and creamy. But I paid 0.75 extra for chestnut topping and I only got one chestnut...

Went to check out this place over the weekend and I had the Maiko Speical! The ice cream (Macha & Vanilla) and the sponge cake was good but the mochi and the agar jello are very bland. The mochi was very doughy and the agar jello has no flavor. Overall this place is a cool place to hang out with friends.

We love this cafe for my Matcha soft serve craving! It taste authentic and has good amount taste of matcha. We tried hojicha as well as the seasonal, which was ube ( the purple yam). These were all great! I highly recommend this cafe and always recommend to friends and family when they were around the area.

I have ordered the soft serve in matcha flavors. They once had two matcha flavors: one creamier and one more tea flavor. Both were great depending on your preference. My hubby preferred the creamier and I preferred the more tea flavor. We both were happy. I have also tried the hojicha flavor soft serve. Very good too. Most recently, I had the matcha and sesame twist soft serve. Wonderful! The sesame flavor is just as expected, not overly sweet but sweet enough. I love matcha but wish I had ordered just the sesame to indulge my sesame crave. Their soft serves have always been consistent and creamy. Will always go back. Only one suggestion: make all flavors available all the time! They are all super good!

This little ice cream spot is amazing -- Not a lot of flavors but the flavors they do have is amazing and they have coffee , matchas , Sundaes, etc. Definitely a cool experience if you are in the area. The ube ice cream was to die for !!

At last, a matcha cafe in Charlotte! It's a superb cute cafe with delicious organic matcha! The staffs were friendly and gave lots of free samples! Not complaining! Lol! They are known for their Maiko Special which has a bit of everything from Hawaii. I got the match swirled with kokuto (brown sugar) Maiko Special & it was delicious!! Hint: You eat the soft-serve ice cream first then mix everything underneath!!

This came up on my Yelp suggestions as a hot new place that sells matcha tea drinks and food. It is located in The Arboretum near Penzey's Spices. Parking can be a bit crazy but there usually are some spots. Definitely recommend driving carefully as some people tend to drive faster than they should in this plaza. They are known for their soft-serve and parfaits with matcha. I ordered their matcha latte iced. The gals working there were pleasant and the order came out quickly. Drink tasted good - no chalky taste and a good balance of sweet and the natural flavors of matcha. Most were ordering soft-serve and it looked great - I'll try it the next time I come. The interior is cute - aesthetic lighting and natural wood tables. I'd love to sit and enjoy my purchase in the cafe next time I visit.
If I were you... Order literally anything and you'll get an amazing treat that's 100% insta-material. I have nothing more to say.
GREAT service and excellent matcha the cookies are amazing!! And the have healthy choices!!!

If you want the best matcha in town, this is your place. The strawberry matcha is delicious. The ambiance of the location is so welcoming and beautiful. The staff is so kind and willing to answer any questions you may have. I will be back and highly recommend!

How have I not already reviewed this place considering how often I try to drop by when I'm in the matthews/ballentyne area! This is a MUST TRY if you're in Charlotte. Okay so this place is amazing and you absolutely need to visit to get your matcha ice cream and other dessert options as well! It's a small cafe with much-limited capacity due to COVID but they're accomodating and doing their best which I appreciate! The ice cream is definitely the must get item for 1st timers since it's creamy and delicious as well as pretty accurate to the matcha flavors I've had in Japan. The vanilla with matcha is a good match if you're not used to the bitter taste of matcha that can be acquired, but that combination is great no matter what! I've also had hojicha (burnt matcha?), black sesame (seasonal), and ube (seasonal) and all those are great as well! Hojicha is still one of my favorites with match ice cream. The black sesame is good as well if it's an option. The ube is a lot lighter than I expected so if you're expecting that rich flavor you've had a Filipino places, you might have to curb your expectations a little bit. I've only had the other matcha ice cream with all the toppings that I forget the name of and I'd also recommend that if you're in a hungry mood or want to share! I've had that several times in Japan and this place is up to par for this dessert option! Parking is pretty easy and there's a lot of food options in the area. Or if you want boba, kung fu tea is also a short walk down because my mom wanted boba more than ice cream so there's room for everyone :D I'd say drop by if you're in the south charlotte/Matthews/Ballantyne area, but really if you're in Charlotte this is a MUST STOP AREA you have to try. It's unique and leaves a lasting great impression.

So happy we finally got to check this place out. It was delicious! Matcha is a very interesting flavor and it is distinct. We can't wait to go back! Everything here is great. Happy Charlotte finally has Cafe Maiko.

I swear this place gets better every time I come here. I learned today that they no longer sell the black sesame soft serve. I am so sad. It was amazing with the matcha soft serve. The Maiko Special with hojicha and kinako blend soft serve is to die for! I hope the hojicha and kinako soft serve stay. Anyhoo... always beautifully decorated and awesome customer service!

Super cute place. I'm still new to matcha so it takes some time to pick an item. But take a peek at the menu before you go in. And they have ice cream!!! Try the ube flavor! I'm definitely going back!

This place is awesome! The atmosphere. The music. The people. Yes, yes, yes! The Maiko Special is so good. Normally these layered desserts are super (too) sweet but this one is amazing. You can taste the flavors of each item in the cup and nothing is too sweet. The mochi is on point.

I love coming to Matcha Cafe Maiko. I really enjoy seeing the familiar faces of the workers. It gives me the small business vibes and all workers are very kind. Their coffee is excellent but their service is even better. I appreciate the work the owners put into the store, as it is always clean and well taken care of.
Yummy matcha latte and such a cute place inside. I will definitely be back, next to hangout for a bit in the cute decor

It's finally great to see Charlotte open one of these! Absolutely delicious! The parfait and soft serve was pretty good! I enjoyed the parfait especially, although it was pretty hard to mix all of the toppings and fillings. From what I remember from what the manager/owner had told us, the batter they used to make their waffle cones is the same batter from Jeni's. Correct me if I'm wrong. But it's delicious nonetheless and I would definitely go back!
Everything here is SO delicious! Glad I found this place. Definitely plan on stopping by whenever I'm in Charlotte again!
Great matcha ice cream and even better when it has Ube as the seasonal...although it could be part of the permanent collection. Great service as well and small yet nice store atmosphere
The only place I go to to get my matcha ice cream fix I freaking love this place! So good! And it's such a cute atmosphere! I love the matcha, hojicha, and the earl grey

The ube ice cream is sooooo good!!! I love the chestnut that they gave, but only ONE chestnut was a little cheap LOL if i knew, I would have added extra chestnuts. Very clean place, and plenty of parking. No dine in due to the pandemic but there outdoor sitting - 4 chairs and two small little coffee table. Cute little cafe, and you can try the ice cream first before deciding what to get.
Very rich and delicious ice cream! Actually the best in clt. Surprisingly the match is not my favorite even though I am not a big fan of match.

Best believe it -- it's a little bit of Japan food dessert culture in NC and it's worrrrth! I don't understand how these less than satisfied comments made it on this yelp page, to be fair the business might've improved after their soft opening. I can only speak to the signature Maiko special. The cafe style and personality is adorable, the staff reminds me of the service in Japan, too. The matcha tastes OG, the blend of their Maiko special is not overbearingly sweet. The cake is moist and goes well with the adzuki beans, mochi, jelly, cornflakes and chestnut. Diversify your dessert taste buds here!

Finally made it back here! My visit was just as pleasant as my first time. The staff was super patient and friendly, we asked if we could get 2 items to-go but get them when we left and they kindly said yes! This allowed us to take home treats to my parents without them melting! We tried the Matcha puffs this time, they did just that - puffed in our mouths. Very light and airy. What I love the most is the desserts aren't overly sweet. I didn't feel heavy or guilty afterwards.

I usually didn't like matcha before, but this place had change my taste for matcha. This place looks very fancy and good atmosphere inside. It is very good place to chill with friends. Thank you for brought it to Charlotte! My favorite spot for ice cream and matcha drinks.

I love the friendly staff, their so welcoming! I'm a big fan of Ube so I tried their Ube latte (hot) and it was so yummy! The latte was perfect for a cold day. I also got their Japanese milk break with berries on top, it was very delicious! I would get this again!

The matcha ice cream can be a little strong, but they have many other flavors to choose from. I like their hojicha (toasted matcha) as it adds depth and cuts the potency of the matcha. I went for the black sesame waffle cone with a kuromitsu drizzle. It was awesome! I'd never heard of a black sesame ice cream, but it's my favorite flavor now.

I'm so excited to have a matcha place in Charlotte! It's in a nice plaza in the outskirts of Charlotte. I'd recommend going to if you love Matcha and looking for the best in Charlotte! I've been to the one in Hawaii during the summer and loved the shaved ice then. It's a seasonal treat. I'll definitely be back in the summer! Parking: plenty Seating: lots of seating, not busy when I visited Experience: super nice staff and love the aesthetics

Such a beautiful, cute cafe! Beautifully decorated and the colors are so complimenting. Me and my cousin came in in the evening on their first day of soft opening and we ordered the light matcha soft serve. We were able to try out the strong matcha and roasted green tea soft serve, which are also so delicious! The owners are such wonderful people! The staff are also very nice and knowledgeable. We will definitely be back and will be inviting friends and family!
Got the Maiko Special, it was divine!! Each layer was a delicious surprise! 10/10!! Will go again!! The girls behind the counter were super nice and helpful, being it was our first time!

Truly excited to welcome the first matcha cafe in town. I ordered the matcha parfait with matcha and hojicha swirl soft serve. The matcha is rather mild. I personally would like a stronger matcha. The hojicha is perfect. The parfait is filled with red beans, corn flakes, soft mochi, and delicious chestnut. I surely love the different texture in my parfait, crunchiness from the corn flakes abs softness from the mochi. My future order the matcha float. It has so much ice cube (half a cup is literally ice cubes)!. Not only you get mostly ice cube instead of matcha drink, it's also hard to eat the soft serve with that much ice cubes. I'd avoid order this one or I'd request for less ice cubes. The cafe has a nice atmosphere to hang out. It's clean and airy.

My daughter is OBSESSED with Matcha so when I discovered there was a cafe I had to take her. It was a little tricky to find it and definitely hard to find a place to park. Once we found a spot and quickly located the cafe my daughter was super excited. When we walked in we were greeted right away and fell in love with the openness and cuteness of the cafe. It took us forever to decide on what to order. My daughter ended up ordering Strawberry Matcha float and Matcha/Ube swirl. I hade an Ube Latte and the Maiko Special dessert. I felt bad for the girl ringing us up bc we had no clue what to order. She was super patient with us. Everything was amazing!! It was a little far for an everyday kind of thing but it will definitely be back. They had sanitizer out, a plexiglass up at the check out area, everyone was wearing masks. We felt very safe there. Definitely recommend this place!!!

Calling all matcha fans!!! I can't believe they open this in Charlotte. It's just delicious. Smooth hajicha, perfect drip of sweetness. The Kokuto melts in your mouth. It's an absolute must visit. The only thing you may want to tell them is be easy on the ice. My Kokuto has probably over 75% ice.

Very tasty. Get the Special to try a bit of everything. Their matcha ice cream has strong matcha flavor. Kokuto is brown sugar taste, try it with the matcha latte. Hojicha tea is more savory, enjoy it hot and on its own. Honestly, very good and rare to find a place use enough matcha. Best matcha ice cream I've had outside of LA currently.

Ever since seeing pictures of all the Matcha Soft Serve treats, my husband and I decided we needed to try (just 2 short days later). We headed on over and did curbside pickup, which went seamlessly. We got each of our kids (toddlers) a swirled cone, Matcha and Black Sesame. They loved it! But these things are huge. The kids were eager to accept the challenge and spent maybe 40 minutes trying to eat the whole thing. I had to talk them out of it. My husband and I split the special, same swirl. I am absolutely won over. It was delicious. Black Sesame was probably my favorite part, along with the bean. Also ordered a chestnut cake for my husband. I took only one bite, trying to limit my indulgences, but it was heavenly. My husband has been dreaming about that cake ever since. All in all, everything was great. Check it out! We will be back.

If you like your matcha super sweet, steer clear from the Green matcha and try the Hojicha. The green matcha has that authentic bitter taste to it. It's sweet but not super sweet. It's very balanced. If you love super sweet matcha, get the float. The latte enhances the sweetness. Honestly, cannot go wrong with anything here. I usually get the swirl cone - matcha & hojicha. Best of both world.
Delicious, not too sweet even with the blended ice cream and whipped topping, because of the bitter (in a good way!) green tea.

I love anything Matcha. This place is heaven to me. Such a cute place to chill and enjoy the thing I love: matcha! If you love matcha , this is the place to be. So many options to have. I will definitely be back to get more!

I'm so glad they came to Charlotte! I've been to the one in the DMV area and this menu isn't as extensive yet, so hopefully they'll add more things to the menu. The matcha taste is the same as any other Matcha Cafe Maiko place so I'd definitely recommend this to any matcha lovers. They aren't as generous with the toppings because we barely got any red bean in our parfait, but it was still good. The interior was so cute and is insta-aesthetic for those of you who are into that minimalist feed! If you are hesitating to get the soft serve, they do offer samples so take advantage of that. Everyone was super sweet and inviting here :)

It is definitely worth trying. We really enjoyed the drinks we got. The Kinoka Mochi Shokupan was alright. But the lattes were creamy, rich, not overly sweet and delicious! Also the powder room was so cute and clean!

Refreshing matcha drinks! If you want a tasty treat for tea lovers try the incredible Matcha Cafe Maiko! I learned about the flavors to try and the staff was wonderful about teaching me. I had the float drink Kokuto Matcha Kuromitsu Kunako, it was delicious. The flavors of tea and honey are yummy. I liked the black honey taste was like a sweet molasses texture. There's lots of combinations and you can have hot or cold. I want to try more flavors. The awesome drink was delicious!! They're located near Michael's in the Arboretum shopping center.
Best matcha I have ever had. Probably said it 100 times. I had the matcha latte float and 10/10 recommend.

This is instantly my new favorite place. The matcha is so deep and flavorful and you can taste the charcoal roast of the Hojicha. The Maiko Special was delicious and had fantastic quality ingredients. It's rare to find mochi and red bean paste this high quality. Cant wait to see what's next for this awesome new spot!

Staff was friendly. Matcha cones were delicious. I added red bean in mine. I was disappointed that the bathroom was closed to customers. I get we are dealing with COVID-19 . But people still need a bathroom. Just gotta do a little extra cleaning.

This is the only place to find matcha soft serve in North Carolina. Trust me I have looked. There are days when the matcha soft serve is grainy but most of the time is nice, creamy and rich! The ube is also a favorite of mine. I also highly recommend the addition of mochi balls (very chewy- the perfect texture to pair with silky soft serve.) The drinks are good but the soft serve is what they're known for. I live in RTP area but every time I visit Charlotte I always make sure to stop by. 10/10 would recommend if you like matcha and/or soft serve.

My brothers and I had a great experience. The place was really inviting and the woman working there was super kind and cheerful. She gave us some matcha and green tea soft serve cream to try and it was so yummy. They were smooth and really flavorful. The quality was amazing, I didn't know how much better these things could taste until today. Together, the 3 of us shared the Maiko special and the matcha cream. 10/10 man. :))

Great quality and tasty matcha based treats. Some new and exciting tastes for your palate :) WARNING: The chocolate cookies are highly addictive! Word is that the owner bakes them fresh daily. You have been warned.

All of the desserts they sell look and taste amazing, but my ultimate favorite is just getting a soft serve ice cream cone. They make their cones fresh (you can tell as soon as you walk in) and they make really authentic flavors like matcha, hojicha, ube, and more. Love that you can swirl the flavors together too!
I personally love this place for delicious matcha treats! It's little bit of pricy though.

Every time I come to this beautiful cafe I am never disappointed! The drinks + pastries are always delicious. If you're a matcha fan, you will LOVE this cafe. The customer service is always amazing and so helpful on any questions you have or suggestions on what to get from the menu. And last but not least, everything is so aesthetically pleasing and one of a kind especially here in Charlotte. We need more cafes like this that give you the complete experience!

I loved the aesthetic, the food, the service-everything! I love sweet treats but I do not like when they are too sweet. The sweets at Matcha Cafe Maiko hit that perfect balance of sweetness and flavor. I tried the Maiko special with a mix of vanilla and matcha flavors and immediately fell in love with this place. Besides amazing flavor, the Maiko special has so many ingredients that blend effortless well with each other. The toppings are layered so when you mix it all up you can get a mix of soft and crunchy in every bite or leave it as it is. I've had good desserts but I haven't had one as unique as this in a long time. It's also pretty filling so it's great for sharing with a friend! p.s. the Madeleine matcha cookie was also very good

Popular matcha place. We came here during not so busy hours, but took them awhile to make our drinks. I got the maiko's special with Ube on top. I really like the red bean and the chestnut but I ate this after my lunch.... Didn't really finish cuz I was already so full. The ube ice cream was good, rich but not too sweet. I wanted to try the mix of matcha and ube , but I think the lady misunderstood what I said. I probably will get something smaller next time

What a neat place! The ambiance was perfect, the service was great and the sweet treats were delicious. I had never had matcha ice cream so didn't know what to expect or what to get. The girl behind the counter allowed us to try the flavors and explained the menu selections. We got the Maiko special with hojicha and vanilla swirl. There were so many delicious flavors and textures going on in that cup...it was amazing! We also had the hojicha latte float with matcha and black sesame swirl. Everything was fresh the servings were large and the prices reasonable. Would recommend it and will definitely plan a return visit!!!

It's a good thing I don't live closer to this place or I would be in serious trouble. This has to be some of the freshest matcha available. There are so many delicious flavors and various menu items to try. This is a very fun place. The ambience is also very cute.

If you're a Matcha-head, like me, then you're in for a treat. First, the location is conveniently located in the Arboretum, so walk-in if you're doing any shopping nearby. Then, when you walk in, enjoy the nicely designed decor by the owner that's insta-worthy. But finally, try the Hojicha green tea flavor (light brown colored) along with the numerous concoctions they make. The Maiko Special, using soft serve and other ingredients, will give you a refreshing blast of flavors and textures. Be bold Charlotte and try it out! I prefer cold beverages, so have not tried their hot drinks yet.

We ordered a Maiko special and it was all over the place, an amalgamation of flavors and textures that made no sense with each other. The only components that complemented each other were the red bean and the matcha ice cream. Everything else felt misplaced. Dry sponge cake with bland agar jelly? Cornflakes with chestnuts? We left pretty much everything except the ice cream untouched. The matcha ice cream itself is pretty good though. I'm not a big fan of matcha so I can't comment on the quality of the matcha. In terms of ambience and decor, Matcha CafÃ© Maiko has nailed their theme and concept. The interior is aesthetic, clean, and comfortable; it's a great place to hang out and chat. In my opinion, you're paying more for the decor and overall experience than the matcha delicacies here.

This place is THE BEST. I am addicted to matcha.. there is something about the grittiness bitter x sugar that I am obsessed with. Charlotte needs more asian fusion places if it really wants to be a diverse city so Matcha Cafe Maiko is a step in the right direction. Extra points for being in the suburbs so parking isn't hard. The matcha soft serve is premium grade- you can tell by the intensity of the color and how prominent the flavor is. Not a vanilla soft serve green tea ice cream you can get at a buffet but it ranks as high as Cha Cha Matcha in NYC. It packs a punch though so if you eat it on a weekend night expect to stay up for the next 6 hours. Also get the black sesame or hojicha ice cream, I actually feel like I'm in Japan. When I'm committed I will get the soft serve cone because they really top it high for you, but when I'm on the go I like getting the matcha float (they put matcha ice cream on top of matcha sugar water- it's good, I promise. They have a latte float version too but I can't handle so much dairy at once.) I wouldn't go there for the special though just because the way it's compiled makes it hard for you to mix the ice cream and the crunchy toppings. Anyway, was thinking of you Matcha Cafe Maiko so just thought I'd drop in and leave a review. Keep being amazing and come to the Triangle area thank you. Would give y'all 6 stars if I could

Waiting for this place come to Charlotte for a while. Finally get the chance to try. We have one of their Matcha special and a cup of Matcha latte. Their Hojicha(toasted matcha) flavor is surprisingly good! I never have if before and really love it. Their Match Latte is really rich and pure in tea flavor and you can definitely tell the matcha they use is really good.

I have always been a Matcha lover but my wife always turned her nose up to it. Well not only does she love Matcha Cafe MaiKo, but she got everyone in the family gift cards for Christmas! I had my first taste this weekend. I had a swirl of matcha with black sesame and a latte. Both were very good and the latte was crafted with care. The service is amazing and friendly. The options and a description of all the choices were given as well as her personal preferences. I was offered samples of everything as well. This is a great addition to the area and I can't wait to go back.

I was in town for a business trip and stayed in the hotel nearby. It was hot and I wanted something cool and fresh. The moment I walked into the store, I was greeted immediately by a young lady behind the counter. Everything on the menu looks really good and I finally decided to go for Shrimp Avocado Crepe with the help of the young lady. Even though it was pretty busy, but I got my crepe in just a few minutes. The avocado is just right and the shrimp is crispy, the flavor is delicious. and the setting is very comfortable. Overall I am impressed with my experience. They deserve a thumbs up!

Delicious dessert! Not quite like a French crepe but very tasty. We had the Super Crepe and the Chocolate Crepe. A bit of a wait for them to be made but worth it. Counter help fine but not super friendly, if you want a smile with your service.

Milk tea had a familiar, proper black milk tea flavor but it was too sugary. Crepes held together, matcha ice cream and red bean had good flavor. Could use more red bean paste in the crepe. Crepe batter was basic but tasty. Service was good and there were a couple tables to sit down at. I would come back for their crepes and try the milk tea at half sugar.
We got the Chocolate Lover Crepe, Paris Super Crepe, Cheesecake Delight Crepe. While the food was decent, it took quite a long time for the crepes to come out (~25 min).
I really like their takoyaki and crepes but soooo inconsistent, especially the boba! Also, the oreo milkshake I got was more like shaved ice with milk

It looks really nice with the use of lights as part of the decor and just the right amount of Parisian accoutrement (see pics). You basically get a twofer here. The crepes almost always comes with Ice Cream which you scoop out, then you have your crepes with whatever fillings you ordered. We got the Signature Parisian it came with a lot such as - mango, strawberries, almonds, custard, chocolate chips etc. That's my issue with it. It's too busy. You don't really have any distinctive flavor. It's good it's just not great.

What could be missing if you have Boba, crepes, and rolled ice cream in one location?! This is the hotspot for sweets for sure. We were stopping through and it was late afternoon and I needed my Boba fix. Luckily I was able to get a matcha milk tea, yummmm!!! This spot doesn't have many outlets and the one I used to charge my phone actually wasn't working. I'll have to come back another time and try the crepes. They smelled wonderful!

The crepe's a super freak! I'd really like to taste it.... Let's start off that I'm not usually a fan of crepes. I grew up with Polish nalesniki which are just homemade crepes with any filling you could desire. So when the crepe rage hit the US, I was underwhelmed. But I wanted something sweet and it was late in the evening, this place was close by and open. I love the sitting arrangements in this place. They have futon couches, tables and bar seating near the window. Plenty of choices for whatever sitting mood you're in (that's a thing, ya know?!) I choose the futon couches with the sparkly pillows. That's the kind of mood I was in. You place your order, have a seat, and then they call you up when your order is ready. We split the mango-berry crepe. I wasn't expecting it to come out looking like a cone. But ok cool, easy to hold. I'm a fan. The taste was good, on the positive it wasn't too sweet or over soaked, on the negative I do wish it had more cream filling throughout and not just on the bottom. All in all.... That crepe's pretty kinky.... *continues dancing to Rick James*

My friend and I got the Supreme crepe(I don't remember the name, but it is the one with all the fruits) and the mango raspberry crepe. They are generous on fillings and the crepes taste so so so good 10/10. Add ice cream because that enhances the flavor by 100x. The cafe is well-managed and clean. The employers are all really kind and nice. I would come here again! If you want drink recommendations, I really liked the mojito drinks!

We came here for dessert after eating chinese nearby. The place is very cozy with some high chair and sofa seating. As soon as you walk in, you can smell the deliciousness. There's soft techno-type music playing in the background but not too loud where you have to yell to have a conversation. We ordered the banana nutella crepe and the signature crepe to share. The banana nutella was very sweet and I'm glad I was sharing it because it was way too sweet to eat alone. The signature was very good and that one I had the opposite feeling and didn't want to share. It was just the right amount of sweetness with the vanilla ice cream and sweet fruits like mango and strawberry topped with chocolate syrup. The prices were worth the tastiness. If my daughter ends up coming here, we'll definitely be back!

The Chocolate Lover crepe is INCREDIBLE. If you're a fan of handheld dessert crepes, you're definitely in luck, as they have several unique options. Their lightbulb drinks are decent and worth a try as well. I'm definitely coming back.

Came into town for the weekend and popped in for dessert after dinner. Cute spot near U of I campus. Ambience: Paris theme, inside there are some table and couches with cubes chairs. There are some games upfront if you want hang out for a bit. Connect Four, Uno, Jenga. Food: great options for rolled ice cream, either get it in a cup or in a waffle taco. Or you can get a scoop of ice cream in a crepe that holds other flavors like Nutella or chocolate. Our friends had the rolled ice cream and crepes. I'd recommend the coffee addict, so good! Hope I can try a crepe next time. They also have some fries snacks like tater tots and lattice chips. Drinks: you need to try these cute lightbulb drinks. We had the honey lemonade and I got to try the sparkling blueberry mojito. Both were awesome! And the lightbulb is too cool to pass up on. Staff: Efficient and friendly. Fun to watch them make the crepes and rolled ice cream while you watch! Owners are great, they happened to be the staff for the night. Overall, awesome spot and we'll be back when we're in town again. Price: $4.95-$7.60, snacks run about $3.00. Good deal for what you get.
Excellent Key Lime Rolled ice cream. Easy menu, good modern atmosphere. Also have crepes that look amazing, house made.

We went there back to back for three days and had multiple crepes and drinks. I got the P.S. Milk tea which had a nice, fragrant tea flavor and the milk had a nice flavor too. My husband had a lychee mojito which he really enjoyed! We had crepes too: Eel, avocado for my husband and I got the bacon one. Both were really good. But the friendly server made all the difference; Grace is such a wonderful person. She recognized us and greeted us promptly everytime we walked in, that really made us feel special. She really connected with us and we're kind of sad that we visit Urbana only once a year for a week. We will be back as soon as we get a chance!
Lightbulb drink was colored sugar water with not much else to taste. Their ice cream was okay though

I wouldn't recommend this place for milk tea. The wait was ridiculously long and there weren't that many people there. Additionally, they said that it would be a 15-20 min wait for tapioca. I'd understand if it was later in the day, but it was around 11:30am and no one was there.

I REALLY fell in love with this place!! We stopped by Paris for dessert and loved the atmosphere. I think it adds something that they have games for you to play with while you eat your crepe and wait. When we first went, I got the banana and Nutella crepe and just thinking about it I want another one. We went back a couple of days later and I got the blueberry cheesecake. I substituted the blueberry for bananas. It was SO GOOD! Both times I had to try to not get a second crepe. The only issue I had was it was a little slow which I understand since they have door dash orders. At least they have games for you to play while you wait.

A super chill place for drinks and desserts. They opened within the past year and this place is among my favorite spots on campus to chill. Their crepes are really tasty, and I like that they serve snacks like takoyaki (octopus balls) and Taiwanese sausage.

We came here for a low key day date. Enjoyed the takoyaki (rice flour covered squid) for a little snack, and then the matcha crepe. It was amazing and beautiful. I sure want to go back and try their other flavors.

Amazing place to get dessert if you're feeling something different. Service is fact and they make sure your order is perfection. It can get a little pricey but it's so worth it especially if you go once in a while with friends. I loved the strawberry crepes and the rolled ice cream, amazing!!!

I went for some boba tea on a Sunday afternoon. They didn't have any boba prepared and I waited almost 20 minutes for my Thai tea milk tea. I also was a little disappointed they got rid of their lightbulb drinkware. Not worth going back.

Weird and amazing and very very extra. I'd say this is pretty decent (not spectacular) ice cream but the aesthetic appeal and crepes are amazing. The matcha is very intense/on the more bitter side - be warned. But the mochi on top was fun and added great texture. Oh and who doesn't want to drink taro milk tea out of a light bulb?

This place has a fun atmosphere and amazing crepes. If you like chocolate then get their chocolate crepes. I swapped out the nuts for something else. Service was a little slow, but heaven is a long way to go to get the crepes. No judgement.

This place has amazing crepes and ice cream. Came to check it out when visiting from out of town and was not disappointed. I am so glad this place wasn't around when I was in college - otherwise I'd be much fatter and poorer.
Went here with my daughter who attends the U of I and tried their berry crepe. Perfectly cooked and the custard they used inside the crepe was delicious.

Very pretty place for milk tea or boba tea. They also make Thai ice cream (ice cream rolls). All drinks are very nice looking and tasty. Small place, but ideal for good picture. Follow me on Instagram: @tryatreat
Amazing crepes! We got 2 and didn't even make it back to the room which was literally a few steps away so had to go back for more to ensure everyone was happy! Definitely try it if you're around...

Ordered a crepe with strawberry banana and Nutella and have to be honest, I was slightly disappointed in the taste and quality. I think the venue itself made for a great atmosphere, however, the food didn't feel as amped as I was expecting it to be. My rating could also be a result of eating crepes in Europe and so my level of standard could be higher than the norm.

Been here twice now. Haven't tried as many things yet, but I liked what I ate!!! Had the cheesecake crepe and the takoyaki. The crepe was SO GOOD. I felt the Takoyaki could be better, though. But I really enjoyed the crepe. The interior is SUPER cute but it seems really small to me. They also have drinks in cute lightbulb cups. Looking forward to next visit to try more of their menu!!!
It tasted like rotten dairy and the staff was very very rude!! I could not believe it because I was very excited to try. Super disappointing.
Cool to watch being made, almost like an art. Ice cream was pretty good. Great post-dinner place, ambience was nice. Good for couples or a small group.

PSC is super convenient when I'm staying over at Towneplace. I've had the Thai ice cream before and it's pretty good. But my favorite thing to get here is a Taro Bubble Tea. Those tapioca bubbles are cooked to perfection, and you can choose how much sugar and ice you want. Even with half the sugar, it's still a sweet treat after dinner.

The place is nice and the decor is cute. The crepe that I got was tasty. It was strawberry truffle and I added a scoop of ice cream . The only reaso I wouldn't go back is the price. What you see below was about 8$-9$! More than what I pay for a whole meal! It is a nice place to try out once, but not as a regular place ( unless you are rich! :D)

Just the sweet treat that you need! I had the chocolate crepe and boy was it delicious. I liked that even the high chairs had cushions and the decor was simple and fresh. The staff was very helpful and it was a nice relaxed atmosphere amidst the chaos outside. This place gives you a nice break from the world so check it out!

Almost always packed! Have tried the crepes and drinks and both are amazing! Have yet to try the rolled ice cream but it's likely just as good. They have games such as Connect 4 on a shelf which is useful for passing time while playing. Any foodie should stop by.
Love the crepes. Really surprised me. Strawberry flavor is better than mango. Also tried durian ice cream that was just ok

First time here and I thoroughly enjoyed it. My crepe didn't fall apart despite the chunk of ice cream that was in my crepe. I was selective in what I wanted and the guy at the front was nice about it and helped me decide what I didn't/did want. The seating needs to be cleaned or changed, but other than that, I would definitely come back.

I ordered the Banana and Strawberry crepe and there was some sort of custard inside the crepe that made it taste SO GOOD. I was expecting a crepe with just bananas and strawberries (since that was what I saw when served). The place doesn't look THAT established but it's a good dessert place.

I don't know why, but they got rid of their rolled ice cream :( that's what made this place unique. Their crepes are still good and of quality, but a bit overpriced, so I have no big motivation to go there anymore.

I went for a soft opening and omg their crepes were so good. I've had the mango-raspberry and mixed berry crepes as well as the avocado kani rice ball. The rice ball isn't worth the price ($2.50) but the crepes are amazing. They come out nice and crispy with a slight sweetness from the yogurt cream. There are also crunchy chocolate rice balls at the bottom of the crepe to make up for the lack of crispiness there which is so nice!! I definitely recommend this place for their crepes. I've yet to eat the other things like the lightbulb drinks and ice cream, so I'll update once I try those.
There was another Thai ice cream place that I used to go to but I really like the ambience of Paris Super Crepes a lot more.

This place is new and currently has soft opening but still the service was efficient. The staff is nice. During the soft opening time period, this restaurant is offering 20% off on all the menu items. I ordered Takoyaki and coffee addict Thai ice cream with toppings of marshmallow and macaron. Takoyaki tasted good and the ice cream had a strong kick of coffee. If You love coffee, you will definitely like this flavor. Macaron was yum too. Overall, both the items tasted good. They also have board games and cards. So you can enjoy appetizers and games with your friends. Next time I will surely try their crepes.

I always enjoyed eating their sweet crepes with ice cream. Their lightbulb drinks were creative and good, but they got rid of them. They no longer sell rolled ice cream either which is disappointing. But as a replacement, they now sell savory crepes and have many different options. They rearranged the interior, and it is still welcoming as a nice place to hang out. I had the Brown Sugar Oreo Cap this time around and it was good. Drinks here are decent, and they have punch cards for the crepes and drinks now. Not my favorite bubble tea in the area but they make some great crepes. Interior, especially the restrooms, are always very clean and hip. Nice place to stop by for dessert in the Champaign-Urbana area.

Awesome ambience and one of the best places to have Thai ice cream and crepe! Couldn't try the crepe but it looked delicious for sure. Also planning on trying the takoyaki they serve here the next time I go!

I have honestly never felt the need to review anything on here, but oh my god, my experience was absolutely terrible and I have never been so annoyed with a purchase. 1. The atmosphere is actually the worst thing I have ever come across, especially for a restaurant attempting to be trendy. Silver garland that changes color should stay at my great-aunt's Christmas party, not a restaurant. Mismatched wood wall accents EVERYWHERE make the place look like the designer stopped at a lumber liquidation sale and bought everything, whether it went together or not. The seashell tiling is atrocious and doesn't fit the vibe at all, if one can even call the aesthetic of this place a vibe. And who thinks velvet seating with RHINESTONES is okay for any restaurant that caters to anyone older than 6? And super limited seating, but I didn't want to stay in the place long enough to deal with it. 2. The wait was ridiculous for having ordered one basic crepe with absolutely no line in front of me. I had to stay in the hell hole way too long for comfort. 3. Finally, the food. It was mediocre, if I'm trying to be nice. My real issue was the pricing of it, though. You'd think that for $7.50 you'd at least get two scoops of ice cream. There's a little scoop of ice cream on the top, but it wasn't proportionate to the amount of crepe I had to eat. The crepe was shaped like an ice cream cone, so once the small amount of ice cream was eaten, you were left with a dry, plain crepe. Needless to say, I will not be returning. Please replace with a better restaurant, because I love crepes and would love to eat them regularly, but not at this place.
I have been to this place twice and like their crepes and Thai ice cream. It is different yet delicious.

I went in for their soft opening today and had a pretty good experience. I got one of their Strawberry Yogurt lightbulbs drinks and it was pretty good. The container wad cute and you were allowed to keep it. They're having a 20% promotion up until the 20th so that would be a great time to drop in. Atmosphere: 5/5 I really liked the decor. The environment was well lit, well decorated, and the decorations were really nice. They had games available and plenty of places to sit. The only complaint I have is that the music is a little loud but it's not a big deal. Food: ?/5 The pictures of the food look really nice and the prices are good. I haven't had a chance to try it yet. Drinks: 4/5 The drink I got was really tasty. However, it was a little expensive and I think a lot of it can be attributed to the lightbulbs shaped container (which I wish there was an option to opt out of for a discount.) Some drinks also don't come with a lot of liquid whole others are filled more generously. Service: 4/5 The service was a little slow and the cashier was confused at times. I attribute this mostly to the fact that they're new and still getting into the swing of things.

This place has really good ice cream! They use real fruits and make it in front of you! They give you a lot too! The atmosphere is really nice with a weird Japan/Hip vibe to it! It's super cute! They also have board/card games available to kill time and have a good time!

Yummy food and a fun experience! Summer is the best on campus...less busy. We tried the Chai Thai Lightbulb drink...interesting. I was probably over-adventurous as I had no idea what it was and still don't. It was a carrot orange color though I don't think there were any carrots in it and it lacked what I think of as "chai" spice. It did have an interesting texture element with the clear gummy rectangles floating in it.

This was a fun find just a short walk from the Union. I was delighted to try a hand rolled ice cream that had fresh berries in it. It tasted wonderful - so fresh! It was fun to learn than it came with three toppings too. Not too much, just enough to be a nice accent. The fun fabric couches could use a little cleaning from wear or use, but overall the shop is a nice experience with friendly staff.

Tried their Thai ice cream with toppings of Oreo cookies and a raspberry. Took slightly longer than I had thought it would but no biggie. I was taken aback by the odd visuals (the ice cream underneath the toppings looked like an interesting mix between tiny logs and hair braids--at least in their shape)... I'm new to the Thai ice cream experience. So this is no knock on the food item itself. Just my own "cultural" ignorance. As such, just SEEING ice cream in a new form that I was not familiar with might have been worth the price of admission. It's the best thing to traveling I have these days. To be fair, prices are a bit steep for this cheap skate reviewer (around $6) for a single ice cream selection. But the portion was surprisingly big. And it tasted great, so that's all that mattered. Went there late night, which is one of the highlights of this place. I think it closes at midnight. Inside, the floor is sort of a futuristic light show that reminded me of the light aesthetics of the Dubai fountain (Google it and you'll see) with all the ocean-like blues and whites. The rest of the interior is what you'd expect (and continue to see in most of Asia) of a fancy, "Euro-inspired" slash "Asian fusiony" design of long boards, fancy tables, couches, and other random furniture bling. There was a relatively large number of young students in the place playing, of all things, Jenga and having a blast from the looks of it. I believe the place has board games on tap. So it appeared to be a nice place to hang with your friends and they didn't seem to mind at all how long you might want to stay. Finally, there are tons of outlets, so if you want a change of pace for studying, it's not a bad deal at all. Just make sure you expect to pay a bit more than a fiver.

Really great ice cream and food. Very high quality interior and great eye feel. Ice cream has great mouth feel. It does take some time for food to come out and ice cream to be made. Interesting process but don't expect to be in and out with your ice cream.

This was a really fun dessert stop for my son and I on a Saturday night! I had the Nutella banana crepe (highly recommend!) which we both loved, and we also got the panda panda (Oreo) ice cream. We chose a marshmallow, picky sticks and pop rocks as our toppings and Carmel as the sauce! Everything tasted great, the atmosphere was fun- they even had games you could play while you were there (uno, Jenga etc) we will definitely be back.

The shape of ice cream was pretty and the Thai flavor was good. Selected blueberry as topping, and it was fresh and tastes great with the ice cream. However, I waited for 20 minutes to get this which was far longer than I expected.
Loved the Thai Rolled Ice Cream! I highly recommend the Bumble Bee. Fun and casual place to meet for a treat.

I really enjoy their signature crepe, with the fresh mangoes and strawberries it was very filling. It might be a tad overpriced, but still delicious. I wish they still had the rolled Thai ice cream. The waffle cones looked good but you can get that sort of thing anywhere.

Good food and very friendly staff. Used a hooked deal for buy 1 get 1 50% off to buy milkshakes for my friend and I. On my way out, I accidentally dropped one and it splattered everywhere. I went back into the store and the servers made me a 2nd one for free. Was a damn good milkshake too.
This place is amazing. Staff is super friendly and the deserts are beyond the delicious. Will return....forever
Was so excited to see that they had Taiwanese sausages here! We also got the rolled ice cream and light bulb drinks. Both fun and delicious!

I'm a huge matcha fan so I was delighted to see matcha dessert options at this place. The matcha crepe and matcha rolled ice cream is very good. However, it is a bit pricey. After tax, one item can range from $6-8 which is enough to buy a meal. However, I think that it's still a nice place to go to once in a while to treat yourself. Overall, I really like the items that they have here and the location and decor is really nice. :)

Thai Ice Cream is very fun and tasty, however, the downside is it does take about 5 minutes to make it. If the place is busy it may take longer. So make sure to pick the right time when there isn't a lot of people. Other than that, highly recommend to try their Thai ice cream and crepes!
Flew all the way from Las Vegas to Champaign for the Cononut Choc Almond ice cream. Just too good... I'll be back!

Wonderful, wonderful, wonderful! I ordered a brownie a la mode with the espresso chip ice cream, and it was absolutely fabulous! If I lived in Champaign, I would be back at least once a week! My son had chocolate ice cream in a sprinkle cone, and also loved it! What a nice treat to happen upon this delightful ice cream oasis in the parking lot of our hotel!

Oberweis is hands down my favorite ice cream place in town. Their ice cream is so creamy and flavorful. I have ordered the lemon blackberry twice, and I've enjoyed them both times. The sweetness of the blackberries pair well with the acid from the lemons. We also get our lemonade here. They have a program where each bottle of lemonade is only $2 when we return their empty glass bottle. This lemonade has got the right amount of tartness and is definitely refreshing during the hot summers. I absolutely love this place for their ice cream and lemonade. This place has definitely exceeded my expectations.

This stop gave me mixed vibes between a modern ice cream store and an olde fashioned soda shoppe. I'd say it lived up to both standards in its own way. I enjoyed a hot fudge sundae with Chocolate Salted Caramel ice cream in place of the standard vanilla. It was creamy, not too salty, had a perfect ribbon caramel and didn't become over powered with the hot fudge. The whip cream was swirled on top by a professional. A delectable ending to my evening and I wish we had a location at home.
Great customer service and delicious ice cream ! Love the inside ice cream parlor feel too!

Trying out a scoop of ice cream after a bit so great lunch at the burger place next door. Husband and I both got single scoops in waffle cones, total was $11 and some change. A bit pricey for some ice cream. They have several different flavors of ice cream, you can get a banana split, sundaes, shakes, malts, slice of cake, cold drinks and hot drinks. You can purchase bottles of milk and ice cream also. Got our ice cream, he got plain vanilla it's good, but vanilla is so plain and ordinary haha I got the lemon blackberry and it's delicious! So much sweet flavor. The ice cream is good and very creamy. Although the price is a little more than some other places in the area, I think we will return here every once in awhile
Good ice cream, our choice was a bit sweeter than what we usually like, but it was flavorful and creamy.

Today was our first ever visit to Oberweis and we loved it! My husband ordered cinnamon hot cocoa and we shared a peanut butter chocolate sundae. The sundae came with peanut butter chocolate ice cream in a chocolate dipped waffle bowl topped with chopped peanut butter cup and hot fudge. Yum! (They were out of the peanut butter sauce this dish usually comes with it, but we were advised it would be even better with hot fudge.) It was fantastic and I'm still thinking about it! We hope to return soon to pick up an ice cream cake or pie, a quart of ice cream, or some chocolate milk. The employees were friendly and this location was clean and inviting. Highly recommend!
Deelicious ice cream, definitely try the oberweis hot fudge brownie sundae! I recommend the flavors espresso caramel chip and butter pecan. Please follow me on Instagram @tryatreat
Hands down, the best ice cream. Shakes are so delicious. Nothing else matters...that's how good it is.

Oberweis brings in some hefty competition competition to the Chambana ice cream scene. Being a chain store, Oberweis has many locations throughout the Chicagoland area, some of which I've visited in the past. While the milk is good, the ice cream and shakes here are better. In fact, there is only one thing I consistently order at any Oberweis: the ice cream shake. The whip cream with the Oberweis milk and ice cream all combine to make a delicious and amazing dessert. Every shake gets topped off with a piroutte chocolate hazelnut wafer stick, which is fun. I have nothing against the other items on their menu but the shakes here are my go-to item. My only complaint would be the pricing could be a bit better, especially considering the ice cream shops in town. On my visit here, I got a caramel shake, which was great and tasted on par to what I've previously had at other locations. The service was a bit slow as there was only one person at the counter taking orders for a pretty big line; however, there was minimal wait in getting the shake after placing the order. It was nice to see that they've kept the tradition of having some tables where you can play chess, though it always seemed a bit of a sticky situation with the sweet milky desserts around as you played. While I think it will be hard for Oberweis to beat the other local ice cream favorites, they offer many delicious ice cream related desserts and add a nice variety of options to the other ice cream and dairy options in town.

I have been here a few times and the service is always great! The staff is usually really helpful in helping you figure out what ice cream you want and the service is always prompt. The ice cream itself is super rich and seems to have more toppings than most other Oberweis' which I really enjoy! The only thing slightly off about this particular visit was that the Manager was reprimanding one of the employees very visibly behind the counter. I totally understand holding workers accountable, but there's a time and place for that and it shouldn't be in front of the customer. Other than that, the visit was great and I will definitely be back!
The lemon blackberry ice cream was excellent. Good staff, good service, good stuff. We be back to Oberweis again. You should check it out

I always loved Oberweis! I use to go to the one located in metro Detroit, and when I found out there was one here in Champaign I had to go! My husband had the birthday cake ice cream and I had the PB sundae. Yum! We will return :)

We went here tonight and the place looks nice the service was OK after someone showed up. We got milkshakes with very little flavor. At best they were OK. My wife got a new peppermint shake and found no pepper minute to speak of. I got the strawberry shake and really had no strawberries or strawberry flavor. I get much better shakes at our local steak 'n Shake. It seems like just an overpriced Hipster type ice cream shop. I see no reason at all to go back there.

My daughter ordered the mint chocolate chip in a cup. I ordered vanilla. Mine had a sour taste to it. Like spoiled milk. I had her try and she said it was awful. We threw both of our desserts away. Not sure if the sour taste is their "thing" or it truly was spoiled. Either way, we won't be back

The drive through service here always SUCKS. It's the same girl I get every single time and she is such a freaking b*tch. People like this should not work at my favorite icecream spot. Make me want to stop coming here. Whoever this girl is who works this shift sucks. Try being nice to people for once. Taking my business to Jarlings Custard Cup from now on.

Thank you Oberweis, specifically Cassidy for making my daughters birthday so special during quarantine! I am in California, so I couldn't be with my daughter to celebrate her birthday, but knew that Oberweis was her favorite ice cream in Champaign. Cassidy made the ordering and delivery so easy, and my daughter said the ice cream cake was fantastic!

I love Oberweis products anyway and have had their home delivery service for years. It's nice to have an actual store now. Clean store. Friendly staff. Wait was a bit long, but they are a brand new place.

SUPER FAMILY FRIENDLY! The staff at this location were very friendly and helpful. The service was fast and the ice cream was really delicious! It's a bit pricey but totally worth it for the quality and quantity. They have balloons, coloring and board games. It's a great place for a family treat, to hang out or for a date.

The place is clean and the staff were friendly. But: we waited for 15 minuets to get our order, and they were not even making ice creams to order as Jarlings does. I got the chocolate almond coconut and my friend got their lemon blackberry special. Mine was half melted when I got it! My friend's seemed better, but overly sweet! It seemed like they have mixed overly sweet blackberry jam with overly sweet lemon ice cream. It wasn't lemony and refreshing at all. We barely finished our expensive melted and overly sweet ice creams and left. Never going back.

Nothing to get excited about. Overpriced ice cream with little flavor. I paid $5 Reese's Blizzard that's flavorless and tastes old. Will not return nor recommend . I see the reviews are either 5 stars or 1 star. You're first or last, huh?

I am a regular customer at the peach cobbler factory, and honestly it never misses. The peaches are always nice and fresh, and don't get me started on the praline !!! It takes it to a while new level. 10/10 would recommend.

I had a sweet tooth after eating lunch at STIR. Just a heads up do not walk there - there is not a dine in option. Please drive your car because after you place your order you have to wait for it - then pick it up. You'll be eating in your car (which is not a bad thing) . Just a huge heads up!! I ordered the peach cobbler and cinnamon peach praline. It was $5 a piece on a special they had going on. It was yummy. Just a lot of cinnamon. Very sweet. The peach praline tasted just like the peach cobbler with cinnamon glazed pecans on top. I could of went without all of the cinnamon and sweetness but that's my taste buds. There are different food options located in the building not just peach cobbler!

Ignoring all the comments about the location (okay, weird). But as my daughter just said: "I don't think I could make something this bad if I tried." We got the namesake peach cobbler. Where was the flavor? Where was the sweetness? Not in our little paper cup. And the ice cream? Is there a sugar shortage? Tasted like frozen milk. Love the idea, but concept fails here. Would also help if it wasn't just in this "take out lobby/warehouse." Oh well, we tried. Better desserts await!

I first saw this place posted on IG and couldn't wait to try it. My sweet tooth is something serious lol Location: In a blue building that says south end eats. You would definitely miss it if you aren't paying attention. This is a place you can sit down to eat . This is a take out spot only that houses multiple business. Order: you have the option to order online or order inside at the kiosk. Highly recommend ordering online to avoid a long wait. It took about 20mins for me to get my order. Parking: There is a small lot in front of the South End Eats building. My order: Peach Cobbler you don't get much for $8 but it was worth trying . It was lukewarm at best. It had a nice crust to cobbler ratio (if you know you know). The taste was good. 3.5/5 I wasn't aware of this place was takeout only before visiting so I ordered once I got there ( I should've visited yelp first lol). It took about 20mins for me to get my peach cobbler. Overall, it was just alright. I probably wouldn't visit again.

Was introduced to The Peach Cobbler Factory by my friend. As soon as she told me, I knew I had to try it. I placed my order online so that when I got there it would be ready. My friend warned me ahead of time that this isn't a place that you could order and eat there. I didn't realize that this was a facility that multiple businesses were in. It was different yet kind of cool. I'd def take the chance to try out some of the other businesses also. I ordered the strawberry and peach cobbler with ice cream. It wasn't too sweet which was perfect to me. I'm not a huge breading person, so it had more breading than I like however overall it was delicious. I've already mentioned it to my mom and sister and can't wait to try their banana pudding and cinnamon rolls.

First off there is no signage to let you know they are there. They operate out of a location that has like 20 or 30 other chefs. I sat outside for a minute till I saw someone else go inside then I followed. Placed my order at the kiosk and got my order pretty quick. I thought they were a little pricey compared to other places where u can get cobbler. I ordered 2 different types and it came to $20. The kiosk added gratuity automatically but you can change it. I had the Peach Cobbler and Honey Apple Cobbler I tried both of them and I wasn't too impressed. Not knocking them but it's just not for me, give them a try you might like it.

This was my first time here, I was not really impressed with the store itself, I past by it looking for it. It's located in a factory like setting and they need an overhead sign which they don't have. Once comparing addresses we decided to open the door and walk in finding we were correct. The business is more internet driven, one guy behind a screened desk directing everyone toward a kiosk for ordering. Different but it seems effective. The desserts were a little on the sweet side but I will definitely be back. This is a good find or choice.
Melt in your mouth peach cobbler that was just divine. I absolutely loved it. Nice portion, hot, with vanilla bean ice cream

We got an array of desserts and they were all good but I wouldn't necessarily go out of my way to come back. We had a great time sitting outside with the kids and definitely all finished our deserts but I don't think I'd go out of my way to come here again.

As others have stated, there is no clear sign to let you know your in the right place. It's located inside of something that looks like a warehouse, with terrible parking. I ordered the peach cobbler. Let's just say, if you prefer unseasoned chicken, you might love it. It was luke warm (if that) and it had no taste. If you've have good peach cobbler-you know what I mean. You taste the cinnamon etc. this tasted like nothing. Your better off getting a frozen Mrs. Smith cobbler from food lion. The ice cream is about 2 tablespoons (nothing like the pictures)

I have tried this place twice. They are very good and prices reasonable. The banana pudding is great as well as the peach cobbler (note: I do add a little lemon juice to add a bit of tartness) But this is a personal preference. It's good and it will cure any sweet tooth.

The cobbler (peach) was okay. Great fruit to crust ratio but crust wasn't crusty- overall not sweet BUT i actually liked that. The "okay" is that it lacked other spices maybe butter too to really give it a "best cobbler" stamp of approval. Mrs. Smiths frozen does it better ijs. Location: Cool concept- it's a business within like a "ghost kitchen" setup. The technology and their delivery system work for me- used kiosk to order which was easy to use and food came out within 10mins. I was there 2:00 in afternoon- parking could be a problem after this time. No complaints just not sure I'd go back for cobbler.
I got the regular peach cobbler it was really good had enough bread to match the peaches I love it !!

This place is soooo cute!!! I was actually walking to lunch when I saw this place and I had to go in and try their ice cream. Since it was a hot day, I decided to try their vanilla ice cream root beer float. The root beer hit just the spot - it was light, crisp, and refreshing. The ice cream was amazing too, as it held its form in the root beer and didn't melt too fast. The composition of the ice cream was interesting, as it had a stretch, which I thought was so cool. They have a lot of options to choose from, ranging from coffee to homemade sundaes.

I didn't actually end up trying anything because I was really low on cash and try to avoid using my credit card in places I haven't been before. But they were nice and let me take a photo of the menu and let me know they actually make ice cream on site, next time I need to literally walk down to the FBI building and back, maybe I'll stop in for a treat afterwards.

This is our first time here. If it wasn't for the hot pink and the weather being nice outside, we may have just kept walking. They have a handful of drinks from water to fruity to CBD drinks. Along with espressos, and lots of ice cream available. They have an assortment of different items like cigarette candy, loved that stuff as a kid. The staff was friendly and the ice cream was terrific. Too bad I can't have real ice cream. My daughter had the real ice cream.
Amazing coffee with customizable cold foam flavors. Every flavored syrup imaginable here. Would definitely recommend.

Churn has so many interesting flavors. Many of the flavors do change. Fun to stop by and sample a few of the new flavors before you choose the one for you that day. Stopped in the other evening and the gals behind the counter were great. Really enjoyed the ice cream treat.

Are you ficking kidding me?! This place was on fire! Yeah yeah ice cream on fire ha ha! No kidding! Every cream is that consistency more towards gelato and that is a colossal victory. Sampled 2 flavors and then cupped up 2 flavors I didn't sample (Oreo - brown sugar cinnamon chips ahoy) and I could hardly contain my gourd!!! Be back soon!! Lovely staff! Let's go!!!

Super cool ice cream shop on an easily accessible corner on Carson St in Southside. Lots of flavors to choose from, ice cream is thick and creamy, similar to Dave and Andy's, and there's a lot of seating space inside to enjoy your ice cream or pastries. Definitely love the open space inside, staff is friendly and approachable. I love that you can get multiple different flavors in a pint. A great welcomed and appreciated addition to southside!

I have been a Churn fan since their Gibsonia days- I made the drive from Pittsburgh often to stock up on my favorite ice cream flavors. I screamed from delight when I saw they were moving to Southside! I absolutely love their cookies and cream ice cream. On my recent trip, I also stocked up on their chocolate, apple pie and pumpkin - it was the fall lol. We had them for my mom's birthday and everyone loved them. Their ice cream is so creamy and DREAMY. Will be back soon!
Excellent chai and ice cream. They also sell gifts like mugs and shirts. Cute photo opportunity in the back. Love the indoor seating

Really nice local place. I took the family for treats on a Tuesday afternoon. No line. Only one employee but she was efficient. Creative flavors along with old standards. On the higher priced side but not unreasonable for the quality. We had a variety of cups, cones, shakes, and other drinks. Good seating area. No complaints!

Churn is a really nice addition to the businesses on east carson street. They have pastries, coffee, ice cream and Gelato. They probably have more products but I was looking for some good ice cream. I settled on a small cup of coffee with sprinkles. It was a nice scoop. The ice cream was rich and tasty. I also sampled a friend's girl scout thin mint ice cream. It was a winner too. The store is bright and clean. Everything seems to be clearly marked to help the new clientele. Give the place a try.

We checked out Churn on their grand opening and were pleasantly surprised by the number of delicious options available. From coffee, to lattes, to milkshakes and arctic swirls, and homemade scoops and cones, there's something here for everyone. We both enjoyed our lattes, and the menu of available flavors is quite lengthy! We also tried the S'mores ice cream, which was a perfectly soft and light consistency, almost like a gelato, and had chunks of graham cracker and chunks of chocolate. You can sample any flavor, so you can't go wrong! We'll definitely be back, and often!

FINALLY! Churn has come south of the city! I've yearned for years to have them here, and she did not disappoint!!! What a fantastic build/atmosphere! I personally go for the ice cream, which is one of the very best in the tri-county area. The taste, texture, and consistency gets an A+; the amazing flavors and presentation gets extra credit.
